Verse.Verse: Adhiyile dhevaன vAனdhdhaiyuM bhUmiyaiyuM jhiruShDhidhdhAr.
bhUmiyAனdhu òzhu~NghiனmaiyuM vèRumaiyumAy irundhadhu; Azhadhdhiனmel iruL irundhadhu; dheva AviyAனvar jaladhdhiனmel ajhaivADhighghòNDhirundhAr.
dhevaன vèLijhjhaM uNDhAghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAr, vèLijhjhaM uNDhAyiRRu.
vèLijhjhaM nalladhu èனRu dhevaன ghaNDhAr; vèLijhjhadhdhaiyuM iruLaiyuM dhevaன vèvveRAghabh bhiridhdhAr.
dhevaன vèLijhjhadhdhughghubh bhaghal èனRu bheriDhDhAr, iruLughghu iravu èனRu bheriDhDhAr; jhAya~NghAlamuM viDhiyaRghAlamumAghi mudhalAM nAL AyiRRu.
bhiனbhu dhevaன jaladhdhiன madhdhiyil AghAyavirivu uNDhAghaghghaDhavadhu èனRuM, adhu jaladhdhiனiனRu jaladhdhaibh bhirighghaghghaDhavadhu èனRuM jhòனனAr.
dhevaன AghAya virivai uNDhu bhaNNi, AghAyavirivughghugh ghIzhe irughghiRa jaladhdhiRghuM AghAyavirivughghu mele irughghiRa jaladhdhiRghuM bhirivuNDhAghghiனAr; adhu abhbhaDhiye AyiRRu.
dhevaன AghAyavirivughghu vAனM èனRu bheriDhDhAr; jhAya~NghAlamuM viDhiyaRghAlamumAghi iraNDhAM nAL AyiRRu.
bhiனbhu dhevaன vAனdhdhiன ghIzhe irughghiRa jalaM oriDhadhdhil jheravuM, vèDhDhAndharai ghANabhbhaDhavuM ghaDhavadhu èனRAr; adhu abhbhaDhiye AyiRRu.
dhevaன vèDhDhAndharaighghubh bhUmi èனRuM, jherndha jaladhdhiRghujh jhamudhdhiraM èனRuM bheriDhDhAr; dhevaன adhu nalladhu èனRu ghaNDhAr.

abhbhòzhudhu dhevaன: bhUmiyAனdhu bhullaiyuM, vidhaiyaibh bhiRabhbhighghuM bhUNDhughaLaiyuM, bhUmiyiனmel dha~NghaLil dha~NghaL vidhaiyaiyuDhaiya ghaனighaLaidh dha~NghaL dha~NghaL jAdhiyiனbhaDhiye ghòDhughghuM ghaனiviruDhjha~NghaLaiyuM muLaibhbhighghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAr; adhu abhbhaDhiye AyiRRu.

bhUmiyAனdhu bhullaiyuM, dha~NghaL jAdhiyiனbhaDhiye vidhaiyaibh bhiRabhbhighghuM bhUNDhughaLaiyuM dha~NghaL dha~NghaL jAdhiyiனbhaDhiye dha~NghaLil dha~NghaL vidhaiyaiyuDhaiya ghaனighaLaigh ghòDhughghuM viruDhjha~NghaLaiyuM muLaibhbhidhdhadhu; dhevaன adhu nalladhu èனRu ghaNDhAr.
jhAya~NghAlamuM viDhiyaRghAlamumAghi mUனRAM nAL AyiRRu.

bhiனbhu dhevaன bhaghalughghuM iravughghuM vidhdhiyAjhaM uNDhAghadhdhaghghadhAgha vAனM èனghiRa AghAya virivile jhuDharghaL uNDhAghaghghaDhavadhu, avaighaL aDhaiyALa~NghaLughghAghavuM ghAla~NghaLaiyuM nADhghaLaiyuM varuSha~NghaLaiyuM ghuRighghiRadhaRghAghavuM irughghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAr.
avaighaL bhUmiyiனmel bhiraghAjhighghuMbhaDhighghu vAனM èனghiRa AghAya virivile jhuDharghaLAyirughghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAr; adhu abhbhaDhiye AyiRRu.
dhevaன bhaghalai ALabh bhèriya jhuDharuM iravai ALajh jhiRiya jhuDharuM Aghiya iraNDhu maghadhdhAன jhuDharghaLaiyuM naDhjhadhdhira~NghaLaiyuM uNDhAghghiனAr.
avaighaL bhUmiyiனmel bhiraghAjhighghavuM,
bhaghalaiyuM iravaiyuM ALavuM, vèLijhjhadhdhughghuM iruLughghuM vidhdhiyAjhaM uNDhAghghavuM, dhevaன avaighaLai vAனM èனghiRa AghAya virivile vaidhdhAr; dhevaன adhu nalladhu èனRu ghaNDhAr.
jhAya~NghAlamuM viDhiyaRghAlamumAghi nAlAM nAL AyiRRu.
bhiனbhu dhevaன: nIndhuM jIvajandhughghaLaiyuM, bhUmiyiனmel vAனM èனghiRa AghAyavirivile bhaRaghghuM bhaRavaighaLaiyuM, jalamAனdhu dhiraLAy janibhbhighghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAr.

dhevaன, maghA majhjha~NghaLaiyuM jaladhdhil dha~NghaL dha~NghaL jAdhiyiனbhaDhiye dhiraLAy janibhbhighghabhbhaDhDha jhaghalavidha nIr vAzhuM jandhughghaLaiyuM jhiRaghuLLa jAdhi jAdhiyAன jhaghalavidhabhbhaDhjhighaLaiyuM jhiruShDhidhdhAr; dhevaன adhu nalladhu èனRu ghaNDhAr.
dhevaன avaighaLai AjhIrvadhidhdhu, nI~NghaL bhalughibh bhèrughi, jhamudhdhira jaladhdhai nirabhbhu~NghaL èனRuM, bhaRavaighaL bhUmiyil bhèrughaghghaDhavadhu èனRuM jhòனனAr.
jhAya~NghAlamuM viDhiyaRghAlamumAghi aindhAM nAL AyiRRu.

bhiனbhu dhevaன: bhUmiyAனdhu jAdhijAdhiyAன jIvajandhughghaLAghiya nADhDhu mirugha~NghaLaiyuM, UruM bhirANighaLaiyuM, ghADhDhu mirugha~NghaLaiyuM jAdhijAdhiyAghabh bhiRabhbhighghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAr; adhu abhbhaDhiye AyiRRu.
dhevaன bhUmiyiluLLa jAdhijAdhiyAன ghADhDhu mirugha~NghaLaiyuM jAdhijAdhiyAன nADhDhu mirugha~NghaLaiyuM, bhUmiyil UruM bhirANighaL èllAvaRRaiyuM uNDhAghghiனAr; dhevaன adhu nalladhu èனRu ghaNDhAr.

bhiனbhu dhevaன: namadhu jhAyalAghavuM namadhu rUbhadhdhiனbhaDhiyeyuM maனuShaனai uNDhAghghuvomAgha; avarghaL jhamudhdhiradhdhiன majhjha~NghaLaiyuM, AghAyadhdhubh bhaRavaighaLaiyuM, mirughajIvaனghaLaiyuM, bhUmiyaனaidhdhaiyuM, bhUmiyiனmel UruM jhaghalabh bhirANighaLaiyuM ALaghghaDhavarghaL èனRAr.
dhevaன dhaMmuDhaiya jhAyalAgha maனuShaனaijh jhiruShDhidhdhAr, avaனaidh dhevajhAyalAghave jhiruShDhidhdhAr, ANuM bhèNNumAgha avarghaLaijh jhiruShDhidhdhAr.

bhiனbhu dhevaன avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL bhalughibhbhèrughi, bhUmiyai nirabhbhi, adhaigh ghIzhbhbhaDhudhdhi, jhamudhdhiradhdhiன majhjha~NghaLaiyuM AghAyadhdhubh bhaRavaighaLaiyuM, bhUmiyiனmel naDhamADhughiRa jhaghala jIvajandhughghaLaiyuM ANDhughòLLu~NghaL èனRu jhòlli avarghaLai AjhIrvadhidhdhAr.

bhiனனuM dhevaன: idho, bhUmiyiனmel è~NghuM vidhaidharuM jhaghalavidhabh bhUNDhughaLaiyuM, vidhaidharuM ghaனimara~NghaLAghiya jhaghalavidha viruDhjha~NghaLaiyuM u~NghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdheன, avaighaL u~NghaLughghu AghAramAyirughghaghghaDhavadhu;

bhUmiyiluLLa jhaghala mirughajIvaனghaLughghuM, AghAyadhdhiluLLa jhaghala bhaRavaighaLughghuM, bhUmiyiனmel UruM bhirANighaL èllAvaRRiRghuM bhajhumaiyAன jhaghala bhUNDhughaLaiyuM AghAramAghagh ghòDhudhdheன èனRAr; adhu abhbhaDhiye AyiRRu.
abhbhòzhudhu dhevaன dhAM uNDhAghghiன èllAvaRRaiyuM bhArdhdhAr, adhu mighavuM naனRAyirundhadhu; jhAya~NghAlamuM viDhiyaRghAlamumAghi ARAM nAL AyiRRu.
ivvidhamAgha vAனmuM bhUmiyuM, avaighaLiன jharvajheனaiyuM uNDhAghghabhbhaDhDhudh dhIrndhaன.
dhevaன dhAM jhèydha dhaMmuDhaiya ghiriyaiyai ezhAM nALile niRaiveRRi, dhAM uNDhAghghiன dhaMmuDhaiya ghiriyaighaLai èllAM muDhidhdhabhiனbhu, ezhAM nALile oyndhirundhAr.
dhevaன dhAM jhiruShDhidhdhu uNDhubhaNNiன dhaMmuDhaiya ghiriyaighaLaiyèllAM muDhidhdhabhiனbhu adhile oyndhirundhabhaDhiyAl, dhevaன ezhAM nALai AjhIrvadhidhdhu, adhaibh bharijhudhdhamAghghiனAr.
dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar bhUmiyaiyuM vAனdhdhaiyuM uNDhAghghiன nALile, vAனmuM bhUmiyuM, jhiruShDhighghabhbhaDhDha varalARu ivaighaLe.

niladhdhiனuDhaiya jhaghalavidhajh jhèDhighaLuM bhUmiyiனmel iனனuM uNDhAghavillai, niladhdhiனuDhaiya jhaghalavidhabh bhUNDhughaLuM iனனuM muLaighghavillai; eனèனil dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar bhUmiyiனmel iனனuM mazhaiyaibh bhèyyabhbhaNNavillai; niladhdhaibh bhaNbhaDhudhdha maனuShaனuM irundhadhillai.
abhbhòzhudhu mUDhubhaனi bhUmiyilirundhu èzhuMbhi, bhUmiyaiyèllAM naனaidhdhadhu.
dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar maனuShaனaibh bhUmiyiன maNNiனAle uruvAghghi, jIvajhuvAjhadhdhai avaன nAjhiyile UdhiனAr, maனuShaன jIvAdhdhumAvAனAன.
dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar ghizhaghghe edheன èனனuM òru dhoDhDhadhdhai uNDhAghghi, dhAM uruvAghghiன maனuShaனai adhile vaidhdhAr.

dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar, bhArvaighghu azhaghuM bhujhibhbhughghu nalamumAன jhaghalavidha viruDhjha~NghaLaiyuM, dhoDhDhadhdhiன naDhuvile jIvaviruDhjhadhdhaiyuM, naனmai dhImai aRiyadhdhaghgha viruDhjhadhdhaiyuM bhUmiyirundhu muLaighghabhbhaNNiனAr.
dhoDhDhadhdhughghudh dhaNNIr bhAyuMbhaDhi edheனilirundhu òru nadhi oDhi, a~Ngheyirundhu bhirindhu nAlu bhèriya ARughaLAyiRRu.
mudhalAM ARRughghubh bhaijhoன èனRu bher, adhu AvilA dhejhaM muzhuvadhaiyuM jhuRRi oDhuM; avviDhadhdhile bhòன viLaiyuM.
andhadh dhejhadhdhiன bhòன nalladhu; avviDhadhdhile bhidholAghuM, ghomedhaghagh ghalluM uNDhu.
iraNDhAM ARRughghugh ghIghoன èனRu bher, adhu èdhdhiyobhbhiyA dhejhaM muzhuvadhaiyuM jhuRRi oDhuM.
mUனRAM ARRughghu idhèghghel èனRu bher, adhu ajhIriyAvughghugh ghizhaghghe oDhuM; nAlAM ARRughghu aibhirAdh èனRu bher.
dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar maனuShaனai edheன dhoDhDhadhdhil azhaidhdhugh ghòNDhuvandhu, adhaibh bhaNbhaDhudhdhavuM ghAghghavuM vaidhdhAr.
dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar maனuShaனai noghghi: nI dhoDhDhadhdhiluLLa jhaghala viruDhjhadhdhiன ghaனiyaiyuM bhujhighghave bhujhighghalAM.
AனAluM naனmai dhImai aRiyadhdhaghgha viruDhjhadhdhiன ghaனiyaibh bhujhighghaveNDhAM; adhai nI bhujhighghuM nALil jhAghave jhAvAy èனRu ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAr.
bhiனbhu dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar: maனuShaன dhaனimaiyAyirubhbhadhu nalladhalla, eRRa dhuNaiyai avaனughghu uNDhAghghuveன èனRAr.

dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar vèLiyiன jhaghalavidha mirugha~NghaLaiyuM AghAyadhdhiன jhaghalavidhabh bhaRavaighaLaiyuM maNNiனAle uruvAghghi, AdhAM avaighaLughghu èனன bheriDhuvAன èனRu bhArghghuMbhaDhi avaighaLai avaனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvandhAr; andhandha jIvajandhughghu AdhAM èndhèndhabh bheriDhDhAனo adhuve adhaRghubh bherAyiRRu.

abhbhaDhiye AdhAM jhaghalavidha nADhDhumirugha~NghaLughghuM, AghAyadhdhubh bhaRavaighaLughghuM, jhaghalavidhagh ghADhDhumirugha~NghaLughghuM bheriDhDhAன; AdhAmughgho eRRa dhuNai iனனuM ghANabhbhaDhavillai.

abhbhòzhudhu dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar AdhAmughghu ayarndha nidhdhiraiyai varabhbhaNNiனAr, avaன nidhdhiraiyaDhaindhAன; avar avaன vilA èluMbhughaLil òனRai èDhudhdhu, andha iDhadhdhaijh jhadhaiyiனAl aDhaidhdhAr.
dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar dhAM maனuShaனil èDhudhdha vilA èluMbhai maனuShiyAgha uruvAghghi, avaLai maனuShaனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhu vandhAr.
abhbhòzhudhu AdhAM: ivaL èன èluMbhil èluMbhuM, èன mAMjhadhdhil mAMjhamumAy irughghiRAL; ivaL maனuShaனil èDhughghabhbhaDhDhabhaDhiyiனAl maனuShi èனனbhbhaDhuvAL èனRAன.
idhiனimidhdhaM bhuruShaன dhaன dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM dhaன dhAyaiyuM viDhDhu, dhaன maனaiviyoDhe ijhaindhirubhbhAன; avarghaL òre mAMjhamAyirubhbhArghaL.
AdhAmuM avaன maனaiviyumAghiya iruvaruM nirvANighaLAyirundhuM, vèDhghabhbhaDhAdhirundhArghaL.

dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uNDhAghghiன jhaghala ghADhDhu jIvaனghaLaibh bhArghghiluM jharbhbhamAனdhu dhandhiramuLLadhAyirundhadhu. adhu sdhirIyai noghghi: nI~NghaL dhoDhDhadhdhiluLLa jhaghala viruDhjha~NghaLiன ghaனiyaiyuM bhujhighghaveNDhAM èனRu dhevaன jhòனனdhu uNDho èனRadhu.
sdhirI jharbhbhadhdhaibh bhArdhdhu: nA~NghaL dhoDhDhadhdhil uLLa viruDhjha~NghaLiன ghaனighaLaibh bhujhighghalAM;
AனAluM dhoDhDhadhdhiன naDhuvil irughghiRa viruDhjhadhdhiன ghaனiyaigh ghuRidhdhu, dhevaன: nI~NghaL jhAghAdhabhaDhighghu adhaibh bhujhighghavuM adhaidh dhòDhavuM veNDhAM èனRu jhòனனAr èனRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu jharbhbhaM sdhirIyai noghghi: nI~NghaL jhAghave jhAvadhillai;
nI~NghaL idhaibh bhujhighghuM nALile u~NghaL ghaNghaL dhiRaghghabhbhaDhuM èனRuM, nI~NghaL naனmai dhImai aRindhu dhevarghaLaibhbhol irubhbhIrghaL èனRuM dhevaன aRivAr èனRadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu sdhirIyAனvaL andha viruDhjhaM bhujhibhbhughghu nalladhuM, bhArvaighghu iனbhamuM, bhudhdhiyaidhdhèLivighghiRadhaRghu ijhjhighghabhbhaDhadhdhaghgha viruDhjhamumAy irughghiRadhu èனRu ghaNDhu, adhiன ghaனiyaibh bhaRidhdhu, bhujhidhdhu, dhaன bhuruShaனughghuM ghòDhudhdhAL; avaனuM bhujhidhdhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL iruvaruDhaiya ghaNghaLuM dhiRaghghabhbhaDhDhadhu; avarghaL dhA~NghaL nirvANighaL èனRu aRindhu, adhdhiyilaighaLaidh dhaidhdhu, dha~NghaLughghu araighghajhjhaighaLai uNDhubhaNNiனArghaL.

bhaghalil ghuLirjhjhiyAன veLaiyile dhoDhDhadhdhil ulAvughiRa dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhai avarghaL gheDhDhArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu AdhAmuM avaன maனaiviyuM dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhighghu vilaghi, dhoDhDhadhdhiன viruDhjha~NghaLughghuLLe òLidhdhughghòNDhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar AdhAmaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu: nI è~Nghe irughghiRAy èனRAr.
adhaRghu avaன: nAன dhevarIruDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhaidh dhoDhDhadhdhile gheDhDhu, nAன nirvANiyAy irubhbhadhiனAl bhayandhu, òLidhdhughghòNDheன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avar: nI nirvANi èனRu uனghghu aRividhdhavaன yAr? bhujhighghaveNDhAM èனRu nAன uனghghu vilaghghiன viruDhjhadhdhiன ghaனiyaibh bhujhidhdhAyo èனRAr.
adhaRghu AdhAM: èனனuDhaனe irughghuMbhaDhi dhevarIr dhandha sdhirIyAனvaL avviruDhjhadhdhiன ghaனiyai èனghghugh ghòDhudhdhAL, nAன bhujhidhdheன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar sdhirIyai noghghi: nI ibhbhaDhijhjhèydhadhu èனன èனRAr. sdhirIyAனvaL jharbhbhaM èனனai va~njhidhdhadhu, nAன bhujhidhdheன èனRAL.

abhbhòzhudhu dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar jharbhbhadhdhaibhbhArdhdhu: nI idhaijh jhèydhabhaDhiyAl jhaghala nADhDhu mirugha~NghaLiluM jhaghala ghADhDhumirugha~NghaLiluM jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhAy, nI uன vayiRRiனAl nagharndhu, uyiroDhirughghuM nALèllAM maNNaidhdhiனbhAy;
uனghghuM sdhirIghghuM, uன vidhdhughghuM avaL vidhdhughghuM bhaghai uNDhAghghuveன; avar uன dhalaiyai najhughghuvAr, nI avar ghudhi~NghAlai najhughghuvAy èனRAr.

avar sdhirIyai noghghi: nI gharbhbhavadhiyAyirughghuMbhodhu uன vedhaனaiyai mighavuM bhèrughabhbhaNNuveன; vedhaனaiyoDhe bhiLLai bhèRuvAy; uன Ajhai uன bhuruShaனaibh bhaRRiyirughghuM, avaன uனனai ANDhu ghòLLuvAன èனRAr.

bhiனbhu avar AdhAmai noghghi: nI uன maனaiviyiன vArdhdhaighghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhu, bhujhighghaveNDhAM èனRu nAன uனghghu vilaghghiன viruDhjhadhdhiன ghaனiyaibh bhujhidhdhabhaDhiyiனAle, bhUmi uன nimidhdhaM jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhirughghuM; nI uyiroDhirughghuM nALèllAM varudhdhadhdhoDhe adhiன bhalaனaibh bhujhibhbhAy.
adhu uனghghu muLLuM ghurughghuM muLaibhbhighghuM; vèLiyiன bhayirvaghaighaLaibh bhujhibhbhAy.
nI bhUmiyilirundhu èDhughghabhbhaDhDhabhaDhiyAl, nI bhUmighghudh dhiruMbhumaDhDhuM uன mughadhdhiன vervaiyAl AghAraM bhujhibhbhAy; nI maNNAyirughghiRAy, maNNughghudh dhiruMbhuvAy èனRAr.
AdhAM dhaன maனaivighghu evAL èனRu bheriDhDhAன; eனèனil, avaL jIvaனuLLorughghèllAM dhAyAனvaL.
dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar AdhAmughghuM avaன maனaivighghuM dhol uDhaighaLai uNDhAghghi avarghaLughghu uDhudhdhiனAr.

bhiனbhu dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar: idho, maனuShaன naனmai dhImai aRiyadhdhaghghavaனAy naMmil òruvaraibhbhol AனAன; ibhbhòzhudhuM avaன dhaன ghaiyai nIDhDhi jIvaviruDhjhadhdhiன ghaனiyaiyuM bhaRidhdhu, bhujhidhdhu, èனRaighghuM uyiroDhirAdhabhaDhighghujh jhèyyaveNDhuM èனRu,
avaன èDhughghabhbhaDhDha maNNaibh bhaNbhaDhudhdha dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar avaனai edheன dhoDhDhadhdhilirundhu aனubhbhiviDhDhAr.

avar maனuShaனaidh dhuradhdhiviDhDhu, jIvaviruDhjhadhdhughghubh bhoM vazhiyaigh ghAvaljhèyya edheன dhoDhDhadhdhughghugh ghizhaghghe gherUbhIனghaLaiyuM, vIjhighghòNDhirughghiRa jhuDharòLibh bhaDhDhayadhdhaiyuM vaidhdhAr.
AdhAM dhaன maனaiviyAghiya evALai aRindhAன; avaL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi, ghAyIனaibh bhèRRu, ghardhdharAl òru maனuShaனaibh bhèRReன èனRAL.
bhiனbhu avaனuDhaiya jhaghodharaனAghiya Abhelaibh bhèRRAL; Abhel ADhughaLai meyghghiRavaனAனAன, ghAyIன niladhdhaibh bhayiriDhughiRavaனAனAன.
jhilanAL jhèனRabhiனbhu, ghAyIன niladhdhiன ghaனighaLaigh ghardhdharughghugh ghANighghaiyAghagh ghòNDhuvandhAன.
AbheluM dhaன mandhaiyiன dhalaiyIRRughaLiluM avaighaLiன ghòzhumaiyAனvaighaLiluM jhilavaRRaigh ghòNDhuvandhAன. AbhelaiyuM avaன ghANighghaiyaiyuM ghardhdhar a~NghigharidhdhAr.
ghAyIனaiyuM avaன ghANighghaiyaiyuM avar a~Nghigharighghavillai. abhbhòzhudhu ghAyIனughghu mighavuM èrijhjhal uNDhAghi, avaன mughanADhi veRubhaDhDhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar ghAyIனai noghghi: uனghghu eன èrijhjhal uNDhAyiRRu? uன mughanADhi eன veRubhaDhDhadhu?
nI naனmai jhèydhAl meனmai illaiyo? nI naனmaijhèyyAdhirundhAl bhAvaM vAjhaRbhaDhiyil bhaDhudhdhirughghuM; avaன Ajhai uனனaibh bhaRRiyirughghuM, nI avaனai ANDhughòLLuvAy èனRAr.
ghAyIன dhaன jhaghodharaனAghiya AbheloDhe bhejhiனAன; avarghaL vayal vèLiyil irughghuM jhamayadhdhil, ghAyIன dhaன jhaghodharaனAghiya Abhelughghu virodhamAy èzhuMbhi, avaனaigh ghòlaijhèydhAன.
ghardhdhar ghAyIனai noghghi: uன jhaghodharaனAghiya Abhel è~Nghe èனRAr; adhaRghu avaன: nAன aRiyeன; èன jhaghodharaனughghu nAன ghAvalALiyo èனRAன.
adhaRghu avar: èனன jhèydhAy? uன jhaghodharaனuDhaiya iradhdhadhdhiன jhadhdhaM bhUmiyilirundhu èனனai noghghigh ghUbhbhiDhughiRadhu.
ibhbhòzhudhu uன jhaghodharaனuDhaiya iradhdhadhdhai uன ghaiyile vA~NghighghòLLadh dhaன vAyaidh dhiRandha indhabh bhUmiyil nI jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhAy.
nI niladhdhaibh bhayiriDhuMbhodhu, adhu dhaன bhalaனai iனi uனghghugh ghòDhAdhu; nI bhUmiyil nilaiyaRRu alaighiRavaனAyirubhbhAy èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu ghAyIன ghardhdharai noghghi: èனghghu iDhDha dhaNDhaனai èனனAl jhaghighghamuDhiyAdhu.

iனRu èனனai indhadh dhejhadhdhilirundhu dhuradhdhiviDhughiRIr; nAன umadhu jhamughadhdhughghu vilaghi maRaindhu, bhUmiyil nilaiyaRRu alaighiRavaனAyirubhbheன; èனனaigh ghaNDhubhiDhighghiRavaன èvaனuM èனனaigh ghòனRubhoDhuvAனe èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar avaனai noghghi: ghAyIனaigh ghòllughiRa èvaன meluM ezhu bhazhi jhumaruM èனRu jhòlli; ghAyIனaigh ghaNDhubhiDhighghiRavaன èvaனuM avaனaigh ghòனRubhoDhAdhabhaDhighghugh ghardhdhar avaனmel òru aDhaiyALadhdhaibh bhoDhDhAr.
abhbhaDhiye ghAyIன ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, edheனughghugh ghizhaghghAன nodh èனனuM dhejhadhdhil ghuDhiyirundhAன.

ghAyIன dhaன maனaiviyai aRindhAன; avaL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi, eனoghghaibh bhèRRAL; abhbhòzhudhu avaன òru bhaDhDhaNadhdhaigh ghaDhDhi, andhabh bhaDhDhaNadhdhughghudh dhaன ghumAraனAghiya èனoghghiன bherai iDhDhAன.
èனoghghughghu IrAdh bhiRandhAன; IrAdh mèghuyavelaibh bhèRRAன; mèghuyavel mèdhdhUjhavelaibh bhèRRAன; mèdhdhUjhavel lAmeghghaibh bhèRRAன.
lAmeghghu iraNDhu sdhirIghaLai vivAghaMbhaNNiனAன; òrudhdhighghu AdhAL èனRu bher, maRRòrudhdhighghujh jhillAL èனRu bher.
AdhAL yAbhAlaibh bhèRRAL; avaன ghUDhAra~NghaLil vAjhaMbhaNNughiRavarghaLughghuM mandhai meyghghiRavarghaLughghuM dhaghabhbhaனAனAன.
avaன jhaghodharaனuDhaiya bher yUbhAl; avaன ghiனனraghghArar nAghajhuraghghArar yAvarughghuM dhaghabhbhaனAனAன.
jhillALuM dhUbhAl ghAyIனaibh bhèRRAL; avaன bhidhdhaLai iruMbhu mudhaliyavaRRiன dhòzhilALar yAvarughghuM AjhAriyaனAனAன; dhUbhAl ghAyIனuDhaiya jhaghodhari nAmAL.

lAmeghghu dhaன maனaivighaLaibh bhArdhdhu: AdhALe, jhillALe, nAன jhòlvadhaigh gheLu~NghaL; lAmeghghiன maனaivighaLe, èன jhadhdhadhdhughghujh jhèvighòDhu~NghaL; èனghghugh ghAyamuNDhAgha òru maனuShaனaigh ghòனReன; èனghghudh dhazhuMbhuNDhAgha òru vAlibhaனaigh ghòlai jhèydheன;
ghAyIனughghAgha ezhubhazhi jhumarumAனAl, lAmeghghughghAgha èzhubhadhdhezhu bhazhi jhumaruM èனRAன.

bhiனனuM AdhAM dhaன maனaiviyai aRindhAன; avaL òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu: ghAyIன ghòlaijhèydha Abhelughghubh bhadhilAgha, dhevaன èனghghu veRòru bhudhdhiraனaigh ghòDhudhdhAr èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghu jhedh èனRu bheriDhDhAL.
jhedhdhughghuM òru ghumAraன bhiRandhAன; avaனughghu eனos èனRu bheriDhDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu maனuShar ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhaidh dhòzhudhughòLLa AraMbhidhdhArghaL.
AdhAmiன vaMjhavaralARu: dhevaன maனuShaனaijh jhiruShDhidhdha nALile avaனaidh dhevajhAyalAgha uNDhAghghiனAr.
avarghaLai ANuM bhèNNumAghajh jhiruShDhidhdhu, avarghaLai AjhIrvadhidhdhu, avarghaLaijh jhiruShDhidhdha nALile avarghaLughghu maனuShar èனRu bheriDhDhAr.
AdhAM nURRu mubhbhadhu vayadhAனbhodhu, dhaன jhAyalAghadh dhaன rUbhadhdhiனbhaDhiye òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu, avaனughghujh jhedh èனRu bheriDhDhAன.
AdhAM jhedhdhaibh bhèRRabhiன, èNNURu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
AdhAM uyiroDhirundha nALèllAM dhòLAyiradhdhu mubhbhadhu varuShaM; avaன maridhdhAன.
jhedh nURRaindhu vayadhAனbhodhu, eனojhaibh bhèRRAன.
jhedh eனojhaibh bhèRRabhiன, èNNURRezhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
jhedhdhuDhaiya nALèllAM dhòLAyiradhdhubh bhaனனiraNDhu varuShaM; avaன maridhdhAன.
eனos dhòNNURu vayadhAனbhodhu, gheனAனaibh bhèRRAன.
eனos gheனAனaibh bhèRRabhiன, èNNURRubh bhadhiனaindhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
eனojhuDhaiya nALèllAM dhòLAyiradhdhu aindhu varuShaM; avaன maridhdhAன.
gheனAன èzhubhadhu vayadhAனbhodhu, maghalAlèyelaibh bhèRRAன.
gheனAன maghalAlèyelaibh bhèRRabhiன, èNNURRu nARbhadhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
gheனAனuDhaiya nALèllAM dhòLAyiradhdhubh bhadhdhu varuShaM, avaன maridhdhAன.
maghalAlèyel aRubhadhdhaindhu vayadhAனbhodhu, yAredhaibh bhèRRAன.
maghalAlèyel yAredhaibh bhèRRabhiன, èNNURRu mubhbhadhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
maghalAlèyeluDhaiya nALèllAM èNNURRudh dhòNNURRu aindhu varuShaM; avaன maridhdhAன.
yAredh nURRu aRubhadhdhiraNDhu vayadhAனbhodhu, eனoghghaibh bhèRRAன.
yAredh eனoghghaibh bhèRRabhiன, èNNURu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
yAredhuDhaiya nALèllAM dhòLAyiradhdhu aRubhadhdhiraNDhu varuShaM; avaன maridhdhAன.
eனoghghu aRubhadhdhaindhu vayadhAனbhodhu, mèdhdhUjhalAvaibh bhèRRAன.
eனoghghu mèdhdhUjhalAvaibh bhèRRabhiன, munnURu varuShaM dhevaனoDhe jha~njharidhdhughghòNDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
eனoghghuDhaiya nALèllAM munnURRu aRubhadhdhaindhu varuShaM.
eனoghghu dhevaனoDhe jha~njharidhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, ghANabhbhaDhAmaRbhoனAன; dhevaன avaனai èDhudhdhughghòNDhAr.
mèdhdhUjhalA nURRèNbhadhdhezhu vayadhAனbhodhu, lAmeghghaibh bhèRRAன.
mèdhdhUjhalA lAmeghghaibh bhèRRabhiன, èzhunURRu èNbhadhdhiraNDhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
mèdhdhUjhalAvuDhaiya nALèllAM dhòLAyiradhdhu aRubhadhdhòனbhadhu varuShaM; avaன maridhdhAன.
lAmeghghu nURRèNbhadhdhiraNDhu vayadhAனbhodhu, òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu,
ghardhdhar jhabhidhdha bhUmiyile namaghghu uNDhAன velaiyiluM, naMmuDhaiya ghaighaLiன bhirayAjhadhdhiluM, ivaன naMmaidh dheRRuvAன èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghu novA èனRu bheriDhDhAன.
lAmeghghu novAvaibh bhèRRabhiன, ainnURRudh dhòNNURRu aindhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
lAmeghghuDhaiya nALèllAM èzhunURRu èzhubhadhdhezhu varuShaM; avaன maridhdhAன.
novA ainnURu vayadhAனbhodhu, jheM ghAM yAbhbhedh èனbhavarghaLaibh bhèRRAன.
maனuShar bhUmiyiனmel bhèrughadh dhuvaghghi, avarghaLughghu ghumAradhdhighaL bhiRandhabhodhu:
dhevaghumArar maனuShaghumAradhdhighaLai adhigha jhèLandhariyamuLLavarghaLèனRu ghaNDhu, avarghaLughghuLLe dha~NghaLughghubh bhèNghaLaidh dhèrindhughòNDhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar: èன Avi èனRaighghuM maனuShaனoDhe bhorADhuvadhillai; avaன mAMjhaMdhAனe, avaன irughghabh bhoghiRa nADhghaL nURRirubhadhu varuShaM èனRAr.

annADhghaLil irADhjhadhar bhUmiyile irundhArghaL; bhiனbhu dhevaghumArar maனuShaghumAradhdhighaLoDhe ghUDhughiRadhiனAl, ivarghaL avarghaLughghubh bhiLLaighaLaibh bhèRRabhodhu, ivarghaLuM bhUrvadhdhil bher bhèRRa maனuSharAghiya bhalavAனghaLAனArghaL.
maனuShaனuDhaiya aghghiramaM bhUmiyile bhèrughiனdhu èனRuM, avaன irudhayadhdhu niனaivughaLiன dhoRRamèllAM nidhdhamuM bhòllAdhadhe èனRuM, ghardhdhar ghaNDhu,
dhAM bhUmiyile maனuShaனai uNDhAghghiனdhaRghAghagh ghardhdhar maனsdhAbhabhbhaDhDhAr; adhu avar irudhayadhdhughghu vijhaனmAyirundhadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar: nAன jhiruShDhidhdha maனuShaனaibh bhUmiyiனmel vaighghAmal, maனuShaன mudhaRghòNDhu, mirugha~NghaL UruM bhirANighaL AghAyadhdhubh bhaRavaighaL bhariyandhamuM uNDhAyirughghiRavaighaLai nighghiraghaMbhaNNuveன; nAன avarghaLai uNDhAghghiனdhu èனghghu maனsdhAbhamAyirughghiRadhu èனRAr.
novAvughgho ghardhdharuDhaiya ghaNghaLil ghirubhai ghiDhaidhdhadhu.
novAviன vaMjhavaralARu: novA dhaன ghAladhdhil irundhavarghaLughghuLLe nIdhimAனuM udhdhamaனumAyirundhAன; novA dhevaனoDhe jha~njharidhdhugh ghòNDhirundhAன.
novA jheM ghAM yAbhbhedh èனனuM mUனRu ghumAraraibh bhèRRAன.
bhUmiyAனdhu dhevaனughghu muனbhAghajh jhIrghèDhDhadhAyirundhadhu; bhUmi ghòDhumaiyiனAl niRaindhirundhadhu.
dhevaன bhUmiyaibh bhArdhdhAr; idho adhu jhIrghèDhDhadhAyirundhadhu; mAMjhamAன yAvaruM bhUmiyiனmel dha~NghaL vazhiyaigh ghèDhudhdhughghòNDhirundhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu dhevaன novAvai noghghi: mAMjhamAன yAvariன muDhivuM èனghghu muனbhAgha vandhadhu; avarghaLAle bhUmi ghòDhumaiyiனAl niRaindhadhu; nAன avarghaLaibh bhUmiyoDhu~NghUDha azhidhdhubh bhoDhuveன.
nI ghòbhbher maradhdhAl uனghghu òru bhezhaiyai uNDhAghghu; andhabh bhezhaiyile aRaighaLai uNDhubhaNNi, adhai uLLuM bhuRaMbhumAgha ghIlbhUjhu.
nI adhaibh bhaNNaveNDhiya vidhaM èனனvèனRAl, bhezhaiyiன nILaM munnURu muzhamuM adhiன aghalaM aiMbhadhu muzhamuM, adhiன uyaraM mubhbhadhu muzhamumAy irughghaveNDhuM.

nI bhezhaighghu or jaனனlai uNDhubhaNNi, meldhaDhDhughghu òru muzhadhdhAzhdhdhiyile adhaijh jhèydhumuDhidhdhu, bhezhaiyiன ghadhavai adhiன bhaghghadhdhil vaidhdhu, ghIzh aRaighaLaiyuM, iraNDhAM dhaDhDhiன aRaighaLaiyuM, mUனRAM dhaDhDhiன aRaighaLaiyuM bhaNNaveNDhuM.
vAனdhdhiன ghIzhe jIvajhuvAjhamuLLa jhaghala mAMjha jandhughghaLaiyuM azhighgha nAன bhUmiyiனmel jalabhbhiraLayadhdhai varabhbhaNNuveன; bhUmiyiluLLa yAvuM mANDhubhoM.
AனAluM uனனuDhaனe èன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai eRbhaDhudhdhuveன; nIyuM uனனoDheghUDha uன ghumAraruM, uன maனaiviyuM, uன ghumArariன maனaivighaLuM, bhezhaighghuL bhiravejhiyu~NghaL.
jhaghalavidha mAMjhamAன jIvaனghaLiluM ANuM bhèNNumAgha vaghai òனRughghu òvvòru joDhu uனனuDhaன uyiroDhe ghAghghabhbhaDhuvadhaRghu, bhezhaighghuLLe jherdhdhughghòL.

jAdhijAdhiyAன bhaRavaighaLiluM, jAdhijAdhiyAன mirugha~NghaLiluM, bhUmiyiluLLa jhaghala jAdhijAdhiyAன UruM bhirANighaLiluM, vaghai òனRughghu òvvòru joDhu uyiroDhe ghAghghabhbhaDhuvadhaRghu uனனiDhadhdhile varaghghaDhavadhu.
uனghghuM avaighaLughghuM AghAramAghajh jhaghalavidha bhojaனbhadhArdhdha~NghaLaiyuM jherdhdhu, uனனiDhadhdhil vaidhdhughghòL èனRAr.
novA abhbhaDhiye jhèydhAன; dhevaன dhaனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiyèllAM avaன jhèydhu muDhidhdhAன.
ghardhdhar novAvai noghghi: nIyuM uன vIDhDhAr aனaivaruM bhezhaighghuL bhiravejhiyu~NghaL; indhajh jhandhadhiyil uனனai èனghghu muனbhAgha nIdhimAனAghagh ghaNDheன.

bhUmiyiனmIdhè~NghuM vidhdhai uyiroDhe ghAghghuM bhòruDhDhu, nI jhudhdhamAன jhaghala mirugha~NghaLiluM, ANuM bhèNNumAgha èvvezhu joDhuM, jhudhdhamallAdha mirugha~NghaLil ANuM bhèNNumAgha òvvòru joDhuM,
AghAyadhdhubh bhaRavaighaLiluM, jhevaluM bheDhumAgha èvvezhu joDhuM uனனiDhadhdhil jherdhdhughghòL.

iனனuM ezhunAL jhèனRabhiனbhu, nARbhadhunAL iravuM bhaghaluM bhUmiyiனmel mazhaiyai varuShighghabhbhaNNi, nAன uNDhAghghiன jIvajandhughghaL aனaidhdhaiyuM bhUmiyiனmel irAdhabhaDhi nighghiraghaM bhaNNuveன èனRAr.
novA dhaனghghugh ghardhdhar ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiyèllAM jhèydhAன.
jalabhbhiraLayaM bhUmiyiனmel uNDhAனbhodhu, novA aRunURu vayadhAyirundhAன.
jalabhbhiraLayadhdhughghudh dhabhbhuMbhaDhi novAvuM avaனuDhaனeghUDha avaன ghumAraruM, avaன maனaiviyuM avaன ghumArariன maனaivighaLuM bhezhaighghuL bhiravejhidhdhArghaL.
dhevaன novAvughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye, jhudhdhamAன mirugha~NghaLiluM, jhudhdhamallAdha mirugha~NghaLiluM, bhUmiyiனmel UruM bhirANighaL èllAvaRRiluM,
ANuM bhèNNuM joDhu joDhAgha novAviDhadhdhil bhezhaighghuDhbhaDhDhaன.
ezhunAL jhèனRabhiனbhu bhUmiyiனmel jalabhbhiraLayaM uNDhAyiRRu.
novAvughghu aRunURAM vayadhAghuM varuShaM iraNDhAM mAdhaM bhadhiனezhAM dhedhiyAghiya annALile, maghA Azhadhdhiன URRughghaNghaLèllAM bhiLandhaன; vAனdhdhiன madhaghughaLuM dhiRavuNDhaன.
nARbhadhunAL iravuM bhaghaluM bhUmiyiனmel bhèrumazhai bhèydhadhu.
aனRaidhdhiனme novAvuM, novAviன ghumArarAghiya jhemuM ghAmuM yAbhbhedhdhuM, avarghaLuDhaனeghUDha novAviன maனaiviyuM, avaன ghumArariன mUனRu maனaivighaLuM, bhezhaighghuL bhiravejhidhdhArghaL.

avarghaLoDhu jAdhijAdhiyAன jhaghalavidhagh ghADhDhu mirugha~NghaLuM, jAdhijAdhiyAன jhaghalavidha nADhDhu mirugha~NghaLuM, bhUmiyiனmel UrughiRa jAdhijAdhiyAன jhaghalavidha UruM bhirANighaLuM, jAdhijAdhiyAன jhaghalavidhabh bhaRavaighaLuM, bhalavidhamAன jhiRaghughaLuLLa jhaghalavidhabh bhaDhjhighaLuM bhiravejhidhdhaன.
ibhbhaDhiye jIvajhuvAjhamuLLa mAMjha jandhughghaL èllAM joDhu joDhAgha novAviDhadhdhil bhezhaighghuL bhiravejhidhdhaன.
dhevaன avaனughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye, ANuM bhèNNumAghajh jhaghalavidha mAMjha jandhughghaLuM uLLe bhiravejhidhdhaன; abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar avaனai uLLeviDhDhugh ghadhavai aDhaidhdhAr.
jalabhbhiraLayaM nARbhadhu nAL bhUmiyiனmel uNDhAனbhodhu, jalaM bhèrughi, bhezhaiyaigh ghiLaMbhabhbhaNNiRRu; adhu bhUmighghumel midhandhadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar: idho, jaன~NghaL òre ghUDhDhamAy irughghiRArghaL; avarghaL aனaivarughghuM òre bhAShaiyuM irughghiRadhu; avarghaL idhaijh jhèyyadhdhòDha~NghiனArghaL; ibhbhòzhudhuM dhA~NghaL jhèyya niனaidhdhadhu òனRuM dhaDhaibhaDhamADhDhAdhu èனRu irughghiRArghaL.
nAM iRa~Nghibhbhoy, òruvar bhejhuvadhai maRRòruvar aRiyAdhabhaDhighghu a~Nghe avarghaL bhAShaiyaidh dhARumARAghghuvoM èனRAr.
abhbhaDhiye ghardhdhar avarghaLai avviDhadhdhilirundhu bhUmiyiனmIdhè~NghuM jhidhaRibhbhoghabhbhaNNiனAr; abhbhòzhudhu nagharaM ghaDhDhughiRadhai viDhDhuviDhDhArghaL.

bhUmiyè~NghuM vazha~Nghiன bhAShaiyaigh ghardhdhar avviDhadhdhil dhARumARAghghiனbhaDhiyAl, adhiன bher bhAbhel èனனbhbhaDhDhadhu; ghardhdhar avarghaLai avviDhadhdhilirundhu bhUmiyiனmIdhè~NghuM jhidhaRibhbhoghabhbhaNNiனAr.
jhemuDhaiya vaMjhavaralARu: jalabhbhiraLayaM uNDhAghi iraNDhu varuShadhdhiRghubh bhiனbhu, jheM nURuvayadhAனbhodhu, arbhaghjhAdhdhaibh bhèRRAன.
jheM arbhaghjhAdhdhaibh bhèRRabhiன ainnURu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
arbhaghjhAdh mubhbhadhdhaindhu vayadhAனbhodhu jhAlAvaibh bhèRRAன.
jhAlAvaibh bhèRRabhiன arbhaghjhAdh nAனURRu mUனRu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
jhAlA mubhbhadhu vayadhAனbhodhu, ebheraibh bhèRRAன.
ebheraibh bhèRRabhiன jhAlA nAனURRu mUனRu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
ebher mubhbhadhdhunAlu vayadhAனbhodhu, bheleghaibh bhèRRAன.
bheleghaibh bhèRRabhiன ebher nAனURRu mubhbhadhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
bheleghu mubhbhadhu vayadhAனbhodhu, règhUvaibh bhèRRAன.
règhUvaibh bhèRRabhiன bheleghu irunURRòனbhadhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
règhU mubhbhadhdhiraNDhu vayadhAனbhodhu, jhèrUghaibh bhèRRAன.
jhèrUghaibh bhèRRabhiன règhU irunURRezhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
jhèrUghu mubhbhadhu vayadhAனbhodhu; nAghoraibh bhèRRAன.
nAghoraibh bhèRRabhiன jhèrUghu irunURu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
nAghor irubhadhdhòனbhadhu vayadhAனbhodhu, dherAghaibh bhèRRAன.
dherAghaibh bhèRRabhiன nAghor nURRubhbhadhdhòனbhadhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhu, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAன.
dherAghu èzhubhadhu vayadhAனbhodhu, AbhirAM, nAghor, ArAன èனbhavarghaLaibh bhèRRAன.
dherAghuDhaiya vaMjhavaralARu: dherAghu AbhirAM, nAghor, ArAன èனbhavarghaLaibh bhèRRAன; ArAன lodhdhaibh bhèRRAன.
ArAன dhaன janmabhUmiyAghiya Ur èனghiRa ghaldheyar dhejhadhdhubh bhaDhDhaNadhdhile dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dherAghu marighghumuனனe maridhdhAன.

AbhirAmuM nAghoruM dha~NghaLughghubh bhèNghòNDhArghaL; AbhirAmuDhaiya maனaivighghujh jhArAy èனRu bher; nAghoruDhaiya maனaivighghu milghghAL èனRu bher; ivaL ArAனuDhaiya ghumAradhdhi; andha ArAன milghghALughghuM isghALughghuM dhaghabhbhaன.
jhArAyghghubh bhiLLaiyillai, malaDhiyAyirundhAL.

dherAghu dhaன ghumAraனAghiya AbhirAmaiyuM, ArAனuDhaiya ghumAraனuM dhaன bheraனumAyirundha lodhdhaiyuM, dhaன ghumAraன AbhirAmuDhaiya maனaiviyAghiya dhaன marumaghaL jhArAyaiyuM azhaidhdhughghòNDhu, avarghaLuDhaனe Ur èனghiRa ghaldheyaruDhaiya bhaDhDhaNadhdhaiviDhDhu, ghAனAன dhejhadhdhughghubh bhoghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhAன; avarghaL ArAனmaDhDhuM vandhabhodhu, a~Nghe irundhuviDhDhArghaL.
dherAghuDhaiya AyujhunADhghaL irunURRaindhu varuShaM; dherAghu ArAனile maridhdhAன.
ghardhdhar AbhirAmai noghghi: nI uன dhejhadhdhaiyuM, uன iனdhdhaiyuM, uன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya vIDhDhaiyuM viDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, nAன uனghghugh ghANbhighghuM dhejhadhdhughghubh bho.
nAன uனனaibh bhèriya jAdhiyAghghi, uனனai AjhIrvadhidhdhu, uன bheraibh bhèrumaibhbhaDhudhdhuveன; nI AjhIrvAdhamAy irubhbhAy.
uனனai AjhIrvadhighghiRavarghaLai AjhIrvadhibhbheன, uனனaijh jhabhighghiRavaனaijh jhabhibhbheன; bhUmiyiluLLa vaMjha~NghaLèllAM uனghghuL AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuM èனRAr.
ghardhdhar AbhirAmughghujh jhòனனbhaDhiye avaன bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனAன; lodhdhuM avaனoDheghUDhabh bhoனAன. AbhirAM ArAனaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhabhodhu, èzhubhadhdhaindhu vayadhuLLavaனAyirundhAன.

AbhirAM dhaன maனaiviyAghiya jhArAyaiyuM, dhaன jhaghodharaனuDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya lodhdhaiyuM, dhA~NghaL jhaMbhAdhidhdhirundha dha~NghaL jhaMbhadhdhèllAvaRRaiyuM, ArAனile jhavadharidhdha jaன~NghaLaiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, avarghaL ghAனAன dhejhadhdhughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, ghAனAன dhejhadhdhile jherndhArghaL.
AbhirAM andhadh dhejhadhdhil jhuRRidh dhirindhu jhIgheM èனனuM iDhadhdhughghujh jhamIbhamAன more èனனuM jhamabhUmimaDhDhuM vandhAன; aghghAladhdhile ghAனAனiyar adhdhejhadhdhil irundhArghaL.

ghardhdhar AbhirAmughghudh dharijhaனmAghi: uன jhandhadhighghu indhadh dhejhadhdhaigh ghòDhubhbheன èனRAr. abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaனghghudh dharijhaனmAன ghardhdharughghu a~Nghe òru bhalibhIDhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhiனAன.

bhiனbhu avaன avviDhaM viDhDhubh bhèyarndhu, bhèdhdhelughghugh ghizhaghghe irughghuM malaighghubh bhoy, bhèdhdhel dhaனghghu meRghAghavuM AyI ghizhaghghAghavuM irughghagh ghUDhAraM bhoDhDhu, a~Nghe ghardhdharughghu òru bhalibhIDhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhi, ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhaidh dhòzhudhughòNDhAன.
adhiனbhiன AbhirAM bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, dhèRghe bhirayANaMbhaNNighghòNDhu bhoனAன.
adhdhejhadhdhile bha~njhaM uNDhAyiRRu; dhejhadhdhile bha~njhaM ghòDhidhAyirundhabhaDhiyAl, AbhirAM èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhile dha~NghuMbhaDhi avviDhadhdhughghubh bhoனAன.
avaன èghibhdhughghujh jhamIbhamAy vandhabhodhu, dhaன maனaivi jhArAyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI bhArvaighghu azhaghuLLa sdhirI èனRu aRiveன.
èghibhdhiyar uனனaigh ghANuMbhodhu, ivaL avaனuDhaiya maனaivi èனRu jhòlli, èனனaigh ghòனRubhoDhDhu, uனனai uyiroDhe vaibhbhArghaL.
AghaiyAl, uனனimidhdhaM èனghghu naனmai uNDhAghuMbhaDhighghuM, uனனAle èன uyir bhizhaighghuMbhaDhighghuM, nI uனனai èன jhaghodhari èனRu jhòl èனRAன.
AbhirAM èghibhdhile vandhabhodhu, èghibhdhiyar andha sdhirIyai mighundha azhaghuLLavaLèனRu ghaNDhArghaL.
bhArvoனuDhaiya bhirabhughghaLuM avaLaigh ghaNDhu, bhArvoனughghu muனbhAgha avaLaibh bhughazhndhArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu andha sdhirI bhArvoனuDhaiya aramaனaighghugh ghòNDhubhoghabhbhaDhDhAL.

avaL nimidhdhaM avaன AbhirAmughghudh dhayaibhArADhDhiனAன; avaனughghu ADhumADhughaLuM, ghazhudhaighaLuM, velaighghAraruM, velaighghArighaLuM, ghoLighaigh ghazhudhaighaLuM, òDhDhagha~NghaLuM ghiDhaidhdhadhu.
AbhirAmuDhaiya maனaiviyAghiya jhArAyiன nimidhdhaM ghardhdhar bhArvoனaiyuM, avaன vIDhDhAraiyuM maghA vAdhaighaLAl vAdhidhdhAr.
abhbhòzhudhu bhArvoன AbhirAmai azhaidhdhu: nI èனghghu eன ibhbhaDhijh jhèydhAy? ivaL uன maனaivi èனRu nI èனghghu aRiviyAmaR bhoனdhèனன?
ivaLai uன jhaghodhari èனRu nI jhòllaveNDhuvadhu èனன? ivaLai nAன èனghghu maனaiviyAghaghghòNDhirubhbheனe; idho uன maனaivi; ivaLai azhaidhdhughghòNDhubho èனRu jhòனனAன.
bhArvoன avaனaighghuRidhdhudh dhaன maனuSharughghugh ghaDhDhaLai ghòDhudhdhAன; avarghaL avaனaiyuM, avaன maனaiviyaiyuM avaனughghu uNDhAன èllAvaRRaiyuM aனubhbhiviDhDhArghaL.
AbhirAmuM, avaன maனaiviyuM, avaனughghu uNDhAன yAvuM, avaனuDhaனe lodhdhuM, èghibhdhai viDhDhu, dhèனdhijhaiyil vandhArghaL.
AbhirAM mirughajIvaனghaLuM vèLLiyuM bhòனனumAன AsdhighaLaiyuDhaiya jhImAனAyirundhAன.
avaன dhaன bhirayANa~NghaLile dhèRgheyirundhu bhèdhdhel maDhDhuM, bhèdhdhelughghuM AyIghghuM naDhuvAghadh dhAன muனbhu ghUDhAraMbhoDhDhadhuM,
dhAன mudhalmudhal òru bhalibhIDhadhdhai uNDhAghghiனdhumAன sdhalamaDhDhuM bhoனAன; a~Nghe AbhirAM ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhaidh dhòzhudhughòNDhAன.
AbhirAmuDhaனe vandha lodhdhughghuM ADhumADhughaLuM ghUDhAra~NghaLuM irundhaன.

avarghaL òrumidhdhugh ghuDhiyirughgha andhabh bhUmi avarghaLaidh dhA~Nghagh ghUDhAdhirundhadhu; avarghaLuDhaiya Asdhi mighudhiyAyirundhabhaDhiyAl, avarghaL òrumidhdhu vAjhaMbhaNNa edhuvillAmaRbhoyiRRu.
AbhirAmuDhaiya mandhaimeybharughghuM lodhdhuDhaiya mandhaimeybhbharughghuM vAghghuvAdhaM uNDhAyiRRu. aghghAladhdhile ghAனAனiyaruM bhèrijhiyaruM adhdhejhadhdhil ghuDhiyirundhArghaL.
AbhirAM lodhdhai noghghi: èனghghuM uனghghuM, èன meybhbharughghuM uன meybhbharughghuM vAghghuvAdhaM veNDhAM; nAM jhaghodharar.

indhadh dhejhamèllAM uனghghu muன irughghiRadhu allavA? nI èனனaiviDhDhubh bhirindhubhoghalAM; nI iDhadhubhuRaM bhoனAl, nAன valadhubhuRaM bhoghiReன; nI valadhubhuRaM bhoனAl, nAன iDhadhubhuRaM bhoghiReன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu lodhdhu dhaன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubh bhArdhdhu; yordhAன nadhighghu arughAன jhamabhUmi muzhuvadhuM nIrvaLaM bhòrundhiனdhAyirughghagh ghaNDhAன. ghardhdhar jhodhomaiyuM ghòmorAvaiyuM azhighghuMmuனனe, jhovArughghubh bhoM vazhimaDhDhuM adhu ghardhdharuDhaiya dhoDhDhadhdhaibh bholavuM èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhaibhbholavuM irundhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu lodhdhu yordhAனughghu arughAன jhamabhUmi muzhuvadhaiyuM dhèrindhughòNDhu, ghizhaghghe bhirayANabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனAன; ibhbhaDhi avarghaL òruvarai òruvar viDhDhubh bhirindhArghaL.
AbhirAM ghAனAன dhejhadhdhil ghuDhiyirundhAன; lodhdhu andha yordhAனughghu arughAன jhamabhUmiyiluLLa bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLil vAjhaMbhaNNi, jhodhomughghu nere ghUDhAraM bhoDhDhAன.
jhodhomiன jaன~NghaL bhòllAdhavarghaLuM ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha maghA bhAvighaLumAy irundhArghaL.

lodhdhu AbhirAmaiviDhDhubh bhirindhabhiனbhu, ghardhdhar AbhirAmai noghghi: uன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhu, nI irughghiRa iDhadhdhilirundhu vaDhaghgheyuM, dhèRgheyuM, ghizhaghgheyuM, meRgheyuM noghghibhbhAr.
nI bhArghghiRa indhabh bhUmi muzhuvadhaiyuM nAன uனghghuM uன jhandhadhighghuM èனRaighghuM irughghuMbhaDhi ghòDhudhdhu,
uன jhandhadhiyaibh bhUmiyiன dhULaibhbholabh bhèrughabhbhaNNuveன; òruvaன bhUmiyiன dhULai èNNaghghUDhumAனAl, uன jhandhadhiyuM èNNabhbhaDhuM.
nI èzhundhu dhejhadhdhiன nILamuM aghalamuM èMmaDhDho, aMmaDhDhuM naDhandhu dhiri; uனghghu adhaidh dharuveன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu AbhirAM ghUDhAradhdhaibh bhèyardhdhughghòNDhubhoy, èbhiroனilirughghuM maMreyiன jhamabhUmiyil jherndhu ghuDhiyirundhu, a~Nghe ghardhdharughghu òru bhalibhIDhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhiனAன.
jhineyAriன rAjAvAghiya aMrAbhbheluM, èlAjhAriன rAjAvAghiya ariyoghuM elAmiன rAjAvAghiya ghèdharlAghomeruM, jAdhighaLiன rAjAvAghiya dhidhiyAluM irundha nADhghaLil;

avarghaL jhodhomiன rAjAvAghiya bherAvoDhuM, ghòmorAviன rAjAvAghiya bhirjhAvoDhuM, adhmAviன rAjAvAghiya jhineyAvoDhuM, jhèbhoyImiன rAjAvAghiya jhèmebharoDhuM, jhovAr èனனuM bhelAviன rAjAvoDhuM yudhdhaMbhaNNiனArghaL.
ivarghaLèllAruM ubhbhughghaDhalAghiya jhidhdhIM bhaLLadhdhAghghile ghUDhiனArghaL.
ivarghaL bhaனனiraNDhu varuShaM ghèdharlAghomeraijh jhevidhdhu, bhadhiனmUனRAM varuShadhdhile ghalaghaMbhaNNiனArghaL.

bhadhiனAlAM varuShadhdhile ghèdharlAghomeruM, avaனoDhe ghUDhiyirundha rAjAghghaLuM vandhu, asdharodhgharனAyImile irundha rèbhbhAyImiyaraiyuM, ghAmile irundha jhUjhimiyaraiyuM, jhAveghIriyadhdhAyImile irundha emiyaraiyuM,
jheyIr malaighaLil irundha oriyaraiyuM, vaனAndharadhdhughghu arughAன èlbhArAனmaDhDhuM muRiyaDhidhdhu,
dhiruMbhigh ghAdhesèனனuM èனmisbhAdhdhughghu vandhu, amaleghghiyaruDhaiya nADhaனaidhdhaiyuM, adhjhAdhjhoன dhAmArile ghuDhiyirundha èmoriyaraiyuMghUDhajh jha~NgharidhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu jhodhomiன rAjAvuM ghòmorAviன rAjAvuM adhmAviன rAjAvuM jhèbhoyImiன rAjAvuM jhovAr èனனuM bhelAviன rAjAvuM bhuRabhbhaDhDhujh jhidhdhIM bhaLLadhdhAghghile,

elAmiன rAjAvAghiya ghèdharlAghomeroDhuM, jAdhighaLiன rAjAvAghiya dhidhiyAloDhuM jhineyAriன rAjAvAghiya aMrAbhbheloDhuM èlAjhAriன rAjAvAghiya ariyoghoDhuM yudhdhaMbhaNNabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, andha aindhu rAjAghghaLoDhuM indha nAlu rAjAghghaLuM yudhdhaMbhaNNiனArghaL.
andhajh jhidhdhIM bhaLLadhdhAghghu è~NghuM nilaghghIl uNDhAghuM gheNighaL irundhadhu. jhodhoM ghòmorAviன rAjAghghaL muRindhoDhi a~Nghe vizhundhArghaL; mIndhavarghaL malaighaLughghu oDhibhbhoனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL jhodhomiluM ghòmorAvilumuLLa bhòruLghaL èllAvaRRaiyuM, bhojaனbhadhArdhdha~NghaL èllAvaRRaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhu bhoyviDhDhArghaL.
AbhirAmiன jhaghodharaனuDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya lodhdhu jhodhomile ghuDhiyirundhabhaDhiyAl, avaனaiyuM avaன bhòruLghaLaiyuM ghòNDhubhoyviDhDhArghaL.

dhabhbhiyoDhiன òruvaன èbhireyaனAghiya AbhirAmiDhadhdhil vandhu adhai aRividhdhAன; AbhirAM dhaனனoDhe uDhaனbhaDhighghai jhèydhirundha maனidharAghiya èsgholughghuM AnerughghuM jhaghodharaனAghiya maMre èனனuM èmoriyaனuDhaiya jhama bhUmiyile abhbhòzhudhu ghuDhiyirundhAன.

dhaன jhaghodharaன jhiRaiyAghagh ghòNDhubhoghabhbhaDhDhadhai AbhirAM gheLvibhbhaDhDhabhodhu, avaன dhaன vIDhDhile bhiRandha ghaibhaDhindhavarghaLAghiya munnURRubh bhadhiனèDhDhu ADhghaLughghuM AyudhaM dharibhbhidhdhu, dhAN èனனuM UrmaDhDhuM avarghaLaidh dhòDharndhu,
irAghghAladhdhile avaனuM avaன velaighghAraruM bhirindhu, bhavi~njhughaLAy avarghaLmel vizhundhu, avarghaLai muRiyaDhidhdhu, dhamasghuvughghu iDhadhubhuRamAன obhAmaDhDhuM dhuradhdhi,
jhaghala bhòruLghaLaiyuM dhirubhbhighghòNDhuvandhAன; dhaன jhaghodharaனAghiya lodhdhaiyuM, avaனuDhaiya bhòruLghaLaiyuM, sdhirIghaLaiyuM, jaன~NghaLaiyuM dhirubhbhighghòNDhuvandhAன.

avaன ghèdharlAghomeraiyuM avaனoDhirundha rAjAghghaLaiyuM muRiyaDhidhdhudh dhiruMbhivarughiRabhodhu, jhodhomiன rAjA bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, rAjAviன bhaLLadhdhAghghu èனனuM jhAve bhaLLadhdhAghghumaDhDhuM avaனughghu èdhir ghòNDhubhoனAன.
aனRiyuM, uனனdhamAன dhevaனuDhaiya AjhAriyaனAyirundha jhAlemiன rAjAvAghiya mèlghijhedheghghu abhbhamuM dhirADhjharajhamuM ghòNDhuvandhu,
avaனai AjhIrvadhidhdhu, vAனdhdhaiyuM bhUmiyaiyuM uDhaiyavarAghiya uனனdhamAன dhevaனuDhaiya AjhIrvAdhaM AbhirAmughghu uNDhAvadhAgha.
uன jhadhdhurughghaLai uன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdha uனனdhamAன dhevaனughghu sdhodhdhiraM èனRu jhòனனAன. ivaனughghu AbhirAM èllAvaRRiluM dhajhamabhAghaM ghòDhudhdhAன.
jhodhomiன rAjA AbhirAmai noghghi: jaன~NghaLai èனghghudh dhAruM, bhòruLghaLai nIr èDhudhdhughghòLLuM èனRAன.

bhiனbhu andhabh bhuruShar èzhundhu avviDhaM viDhDhu, jhodhomai noghghibh bhoனArghaL; AbhiraghAmuM avarghaLoDhe ghUDhabhbhoy vazhiviDhDhaனubhbhiனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar: AbhiraghAM bhèriya bhaladhdha jAdhiyAvadhiனAluM, avaனughghuL bhUmiyiluLLa jhaghala jAdhighaLuM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuvadhiனAluM,
nAன jhèyyabhbhoghiRadhai AbhiraghAmughghu maRaibhbheனo?

ghardhdhar AbhiraghAmughghujh jhòனனdhai niRaiveRRuMbhaDhiyAy avaன dhaன bhiLLaighaLughghuM, dhaனghghubh bhiனvaruM dhaன vIDhDhArughghuM: nI~NghaL nIdhiyaiyuM niyAyadhdhaiyuM jhèydhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya vazhiyaigh ghAdhdhu naDhavu~NghaL èனRu ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuvAன èனbhadhai aRindhirughghiReன èனRAr.
bhiனbhu ghardhdhar jhodhoM ghòmorAviன ghUghghural bhèridhAyirubhbhadhiனAluM, avaighaLiன bhAvaM mighavuM ghòDhidhAyirubhbhadhiனAluM,
nAன iRa~Nghibhbhoy, èனனiDhadhdhil vandhu èDhDhiன adhiன ghUghghuraliனbhaDhiye avarghaL jhèydhirughghiRArghaLo illaiyo èனRu bhArdhdhu aRiveன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu andhabh bhuruShar avviDhaM viDhDhujh jhodhomai noghghibh bhoனArghaL; AbhiraghAmo bhiனனuM ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha niனRughòNDhirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM jhamIbhamAyjh jherndhu: dhuனmArghghaனoDhe nIdhimAனaiyuM azhibhbhIro?
bhaDhDhaNadhdhughghuLLe òruveLai aiMbhadhu nIdhimAனghaL irubhbhArghaL, adhaRghuL irughghuM andha aiMbhadhu nIdhimAனghaL nimidhdhaM iraDhjhiyAmal andha sdhaladhdhai azhibhbhIro?

dhuனmArghghaனoDhe nIdhimAனaiyuM jha~Ngharibhbhadhu umaghghudh dhUramAyirubhbhadhAgha; nIdhimAனaiyuM dhuனmArghghaனaiyuM jhamamAy naDhabhbhibhbhadhu umaghghudhdhUramAyirubhbhadhAgha; jharvalogha niyAyAdhibhadhi nIdhijhèyyAdhirubhbhAro èனRAன.
adhaRghugh ghardhdhar: nAன jhodhomil aiMbhadhu nIdhimAனghaLaigh ghaNDhAl, avarghaL nimidhdhaM andha sdhalamuzhudhaiyuM iraDhjhibhbheன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: idho, dhULuM jhAMbhalumAyirughghiRa aDhiyeன ANDhavaroDhe bhejhadhdhuNindheன.

òruveLai aiMbhadhu nIdhimAனghaLughghu aindhubher ghuRaindhirubhbhArghaL; andha aindhubher nimidhdhaM bhaDhDhaNamuzhudhaiyuM azhibhbhIro èனRAன. adhaRghu avar: nAன nARbhadhdhaindhu nIdhimAனghaLai a~Nghe ghaNDhAl, adhai azhibhbhadhillai èனRAr.
avaன bhiனனuM avaroDhe bhejhi: nARbhadhu nIdhimAனghaL a~Nghe ghANabhbhaDhDhAlo èனRAன. adhaRghu avar: nARbhadhu nIdhimAனghaLnimidhdhaM adhai azhibhbhadhillai èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nAன iனனuM bhejhughiReன, ANDhavarughghugh ghobhaM varAmalirubhbhadhAgha; mubhbhadhu nIdhimAனghaL a~Nghe ghANabhbhaDhDhAlo èனRAன. adhaRghu avar: nAன mubhbhadhu nIdhimAனghaLai a~Nghe ghaNDhAl, adhai azhibhbhadhillai èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன: idho ANDhavaroDhe bhejhadhdhuNindheன; irubhadhu nIdhimAனghaL a~Nghe ghANabhbhaDhDhAlo èனRAன. adhaRghu avar: irubhadhu nIdhimAனghaLnimidhdhaM adhai azhibhbhadhillai èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: ANDhavarughghugh ghobhaM varAdhirubhbhadhAgha; nAன iனனuM indha òruvijhaimAdhdhiraM bhejhughiReன; bhadhdhu nIdhimAனghaL a~Nghe ghANabhbhaDhDhAlo èனRAன. adhaRghu avar: bhadhdhu nIdhimAனghaL nimidhdhaM adhai azhibhbhadhillai èனRAr.
ghardhdhar AbhiraghAmoDhe bhejhimuDhindhabhiனbhu bhoyviDhDhAr; AbhiraghAmuM dhaனனuDhaiya iDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhiனAன.
andha iraNDhu dhUdharuM jhAya~NghAladhdhile jhodhomughghu vandhArghaL; lodhdhu jhodhomiன vAjhalile uDhghArndhirundhAன. avarghaLaigh ghaNDhu, lodhdhu èzhundhu èdhirghòNDhu dharaimaDhDhuM ghuனindhu:

ANDhavaனmArghaLe, aDhiyeனuDhaiya vIDhDhumughamAy nI~NghaL dhiruMbhi, u~NghaL ghAlghaLaigh ghazhuvi, irAdhdha~Nghi, ghAlaiyil èzhundhu bhirayANabhbhaDhDhubh bhoghalAM èனRAன. adhaRghu avarghaL: abhbhaDhiyalla, vIdhiyile irAdhdha~NghuvoM èனRArghaL.

avaன avarghaLai mighavuM varundhigh gheDhDhughghòNDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu avaனiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhi, avaன vIDhDhile bhiravejhidhdhArghaL. avaன bhuLibhbhillAdha abhbha~NghaLaijh jhuDhDhu, avarghaLughghu virundhubhaNNiனAன, avarghaL bhujhidhdhArghaL.
avarghaL bhaDhughghuM muனனe, jhodhoM bhaDhDhaNadhdhu maனidharAghiya vAlibharmudhal ghizhavarmaDhDhumuLLa jaன~NghaL aனaivaruM nAனAdhijhaighaLilumirundhu vandhu, vIDhDhaijh jhUzhndhughòNDhu,
lodhdhaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu: indha irAdhdhiri uனனiDhadhdhil vandha maனuShar è~Nghe? nA~NghaL avarghaLai aRiyuMbhaDhighghu avarghaLai è~NghaLiDhadhdhil vèLiye ghòNDhu vA èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu lodhdhu vAjhalughghu vèLiye vandhu, dhaனghghubh bhiனனAle ghadhavaibh bhUDhDhi, avarghaLiDhadhdhil bhoy:
jhaghodharare, indha aghghiramaM jhèyya veNDhAM.

idho, bhuruSharai aRiyAdha iraNDhu ghumAradhdhighaL èனghghu uNDhu; avarghaLai u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghu vèLiye ghòNDhuvarughiReன, avarghaLughghu u~NghaL iShDhabhbhaDhi jhèyyu~NghaL; indhabhbhuruShar èன ghUraiyiன nizhalile vandhabhaDhiyAl, ivarghaLughghu mAdhdhiraM òனRuM jhèyyaveNDhAM èனRAன.

adhaRghu avarghaL: abhbhAle bho; bharadhejhiyAy vandha ivaனA niyAyaM bhejhughiRadhu? ibhbhòzhudhu avarghaLughghujh jhèyvadhaibhbhArghghiluM uனghghu adhigha bhòllAbhbhujh jhèyvoM èனRu jhòlli, lodhdhu èனbhavaனai mighavuM nèrughghigh ghadhavai uDhaighghagh ghiDhDhiனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu andhabh bhuruSharghaL dha~NghaL ghaighaLai vèLiye nIDhDhi, lodhdhaidh dha~NghaLaNDhaighghu vIDhDhughghuL izhudhdhughghòNDhu, ghadhavaibh bhUDhDhi,
dhèruvAjhalilirundha jhiRiyoruM bhèriyorumAghiya maனidharughghugh ghuruDhDhADhDhaM bhiDhighghabhbhaNNiனArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL vAjhalaidh dheDhidhdheDhi aludhdhubhbhoனArghaL.

bhiனbhu andhabh bhuruShar lodhdhai noghghi: ivviDhadhdhil iனனuM uனghghu yAr irughghiRArghaL? marumaghaனAvadhu, uன ghumArarAvadhu, uன ghumAradhdhighaLAvadhu, bhaDhDhaNadhdhil uனghghuriya èvarghaLAvadhu irundhAl, avarghaLai indha sdhaladhdhilirundhu vèLiye azhaidhdhughghòNDhu bho.
nA~NghaL indha sdhaladhdhai azhighghabhbhoghiRoM; ivarghaL ghUghghural ghardhdharuDhaiya jhamughadhdhil bhèridhAyirughghiRadhu; idhai azhighghagh ghardhdhar è~NghaLai aனubhbhiனAr èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu lodhdhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, dhaன ghumAradhdhighaLai vivAghaMbhaNNabhbhoghiRa dhaன marumaghghaLmAroDhe bhejhi: nI~NghaL èzhundhu indha sdhaladhdhai viDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhu~NghaL; ghardhdhar indhabh bhaDhDhaNadhdhai azhighghabh bhoghiRAr èனRAன; avaனuDhaiya marumaghghaLmAriன bhArvaighghu avaன bhariyAjhaMbhaNNughiRadhAghagh ghaNDhadhu.

ghizhaghghu vèLughghuMbhodhu andhadh dhUdhar lodhdhai noghghi: bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghu varuM dhaNDhaனaiyil nI azhiyAdhabhaDhighghu èzhundhu, uன maனaiviyaiyuM, i~Nghe irughghiRa uன iraNDhu ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM azhaidhdhughghòNDhubho èனRu jhòlli, avaனaidh dhuridhabhbhaDhudhdhiனArghaL.

avaன dhAmadhidhdhughghòNDhirughghuMbhodhu ghardhdhar avaனmel vaidhdha iraghghadhdhiனAle, andhabh bhuruShar avaன ghaiyaiyuM, avaன maனaiviyiன ghaiyaiyuM, avaன iraNDhu ghumAradhdhighaLiன ghaiyaiyuM bhiDhidhdhu, avaனaibh bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghu vèLiye ghòNDhubhoy viDhDhArghaL.
avarghaLai vèLiye ghòNDhubhoy viDhDhabhiனbhu, avar: uன jIvaன dhabhbha oDhibhbho, bhiனனiDhDhubh bhArAdhe; indhajh jhamabhUmiyil è~NghuM niRghAdhe; nI azhiyAdhabhaDhighghu malaighghu oDhibhbho èனRAr.
adhaRghu lodhdhu: abhbhaDhiyalla ANDhavare,

umadhu ghaNghaLil umadhu aDhiyeனughghugh ghirubhaighiDhaidhdhadhe; èன bhirANaனaigh ghAghghadh dhevarIr èனghghujh jhèydha ghirubhaiyaibh bhèridhAgha viLa~NghabhbhaNNiனIr; malaighghu oDhibhbhogha èனனAl muDhiyAdhu, dhI~Nghu èனனaidh dhòDharuM, nAன maridhdhubhbhoveன.
adho, andha Ur irughghiRadhe, nAன adhaRghu oDhibhbhoghadhdhaghghadhAy adhu ghiDhDha irughghiRadhu; èன bhirANaன bhizhaighgha nAன a~Nghe oDhibhbhoghaDhDhuM, adhu jhiனன UrdhAனe èனRAன.
adhaRghu avar: nI gheDhDhughghòNDha Urai nAன ghavizhdhdhubhbhoDhAdhabhaDhighghu, indha viShayadhdhiluM uனghghu anughghiraghaMbhaNNiனeன.
dhIviramAy a~Nghe oDhidh dhabhbhidhdhughghòL; nI a~Nghe bhoyjh jherumaDhDhuM nAன òனRuM jhèyyagh ghUDhAdhu èனRAr; AghaiyAl andha Ur jhovAr èனனbhbhaDhDhadhu.
lodhdhu jhovArughghuL varuMbhodhu bhUmiyiனmel jhUriyaன udhidhdhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar jhodhomiனmeluM ghòmorAviனmeluM, ghardhdharAle vAனdhdhilirundhu ghandhaghadhdhaiyuM aghghiனiyaiyuM varuShighghabhbhaNNi,
andhabh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaiyuM, andhajh jhama bhUmiyaனaidhdhaiyuM, andhabh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன èllAgh ghuDhighaLaiyuM, bhUmiyiன bhayiraiyuM azhidhdhubhbhoDhDhAr.
avaன maனaiviyo bhiனனiDhDhubh bhArdhdhu, ubhbhudhdhUN AனAL.
viDhiyaRghAladhdhil AbhiraghAM èzhundhu, dhAன ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha niனRa iDhadhdhiRghubh bhoy,
jhodhoM ghòmorA bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன dhijhaiyaiyuM, jhamabhUmiyAghiya dhejhaM muzhuvadhaiyuM noghghibh bhArdhdhAன; andhabh bhUmiyiன bhughai jhULaiyiன bhughaiyaibhbhola èzhuMbhiRRu.

dhevaன andhajh jhama bhUmiyiன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLai azhighghuMbhodhu, dhevaன AbhiraghAmai niனaidhdhu, lodhdhu ghuDhiyirundha bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaidh dhAM ghavizhdhdhubh bhoDhughaiyil, lodhdhai andha azhiviன naDhuvilirundhu dhabhbhibhbhoghuMbhaDhi aனubhbhi viDhDhAr.
bhiனbhu lodhdhu jhovArile ghuDhiyirughghabh bhayandhu, jhovArai viDhDhubhbhoy, avaனuM avaனoDheghUDha avaனuDhaiya iraNDhu ghumAradhdhighaLuM malaiyile vAjhaMbhaNNiனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu mUdhdhavaL iLaiyavaLaibh bhArdhdhu: naMmuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaன mudhirvayadhAனAr, bhUmiyè~NghuM naDhaghghiRa muRaimaiyiனbhaDhiye naMmoDhe jherabh bhUmiyile òru bhuruShaனuM illai.
naMmuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaனAl jhandhadhi uNDhAghuMbhaDhighghu, avarughghu madhuvaigh ghuDhighghaghghòDhudhdhu, avaroDhe jhayaனibhbhoM vA èனRAL.

abhbhaDhiye aனRu iravile, dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனughghu madhuvaigh ghuDhighghagh ghòDhudhdhArghaL. mUdhdhavaL bhoy, dhaன dhaghabhbhaனoDhe jhayaனidhdhAL; avaL jhayaனidhdhadhaiyuM èzhundhirundhadhaiyuM avaன uNarAdhirundhAன.

maRunALile mUdhdhavaL iLaiyavaLaibh bhArdhdhu: neRRu rAdhdhiri nAன dhaghabhbhaனoDhe jhayaனidhdheன; iனRu rAdhdhiriyuM madhuvaighghuDhighghagh ghòDhubhbhoM, naMmuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaனAl jhandhadhi uNDhAghuMbhaDhi nI bhoy avaroDhe jhayaனi èனRAL.

abhbhaDhiye aனRu rAdhdhiriyiluM dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனughghu madhuvaighghuDhighghagh ghòDhudhdhArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu iLaiyavaL èzhundhu bhoy, avaனoDhe jhayaனidhdhAL; avaL jhayaனidhdhadhaiyuM èzhundhirundhadhaiyuM avaன uNarAdhirundhAன.
ivvidhamAy lodhdhiன ghumAradhdhighaL iruvaruM dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனAle gharbhbhavadhiyAனArghaL.
mUdhdhavaL òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu, avaனughghu movAbh èனRu bheriDhDhAL; avaன innALvaraighghuM irughghiRa movAbhiyarughghudh dhaghabhbhaன.
iLaiyavaLuM òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu, avaனughghubh bhèனனMmi èனRu bheriDhDhAL; avaன innALvaraighghuM irughghiRa aMmoன bhudhdhirarughghudh dhaghabhbhaன.
AbhiraghAM avviDhaM viDhDhu, dhèன dhejhadhdhiRghubh bhirayANaMbhaNNi, ghAdhejhughghuM jhUrughghuM naDhuvAghagh ghuDhiyeRi, gherArile dha~NghiனAன.
a~Nghe AbhiraghAM dhaன maனaiviyAghiya jhArALaidh dhaன jhaghodhari èனRu jhòனனdhiனAle, gherAriன rAjAvAghiya abhimèleghghu ALaனubhbhijh jhArALai azhaibhbhidhdhAன.
dhevaன iravile abhimèleghghughghujh jhòbhbhaனdhdhile dhoனRi: nI azhaibhbhidhdha sdhirIyiன nimidhdhaM nI jhèdhdhAy; avaL òruvaனuDhaiya maனaiviyAyirughghiRALe èனRAr.
abhimèleghghu avaLaijh jherAdhirundhAன. AghaiyAl avaன: ANDhavare, nIdhiyuLLa jaன~NghaLai azhibhbhIro?
ivaL dhaன jhaghodhari èனRu avaன èனனoDhe jhòllavillaiyA? avaன dhaன jhaghodharaன èனRu ivaLuM jhòனனALe; udhdhama irudhayadhdhoDhuM jhudhdhamAன ghaighaLoDhuM idhaijh jhèydheன èனRu jhòனனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu dhevaன: udhdhama irudhayadhdhoDhe nI idhaijh jhèydhAy èனRu nAன aRindhirughghiReன; nI èனghghu virodhamAghabh bhAvaM jhèyyAdhabhaDhighghu uனனaidh dhaDhudhdheன; AghaiyAl, nI avaLaidh dhòDha nAன uனghghu iDha~NghòDhughghavillai.

andha maனuShaனuDhaiya maனaiviyai avaனiDhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiviDhu; avaன òru dhIrghghadharijhi; nI bhizhaighghuMbhaDhighghu avaன uனghghAgha veNDhudhal jhèyvAன; nI avaLai aனubhbhiviDhAdhirundhAl, nIyuM uனனaijh jherndha yAvaruM jhAghave jhAvIrghaL èனRu aRivAyAgha èனRu jhòbhbhaனdhdhile avaனughghujh jhòனனAr.
abhimèleghghu adhighAlaiyil èzhundhu, dhaன UzhiyaghghAraraiyèllAM azhaibhbhidhdhu, indhajh jha~NghadhighaLaiyèllAM avarghaL gheDhghuMbhaDhi jhòனனAன; andha maனuShar mighavuM bhayandhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu abhimèleghghu AbhiraghAmai azhaibhbhidhdhu; nI è~NghaLughghu èனன ghAriya~njhèydhAy, nI èனmeluM, èன rAjyadhdhiனmeluM ghòDhiya bhAvaM jhumarabhbhaNNughiRadhaRghu uனghghu nAன èனன ghuRRaM jhèydheன? jhèyyadhdhaghAdha ghAriya~NghaLai èனனiDhadhdhil jhèydhAye èனRAன.
bhiனனuM abhimèleghghu AbhiraghAmai noghghi: èனனdhdhaigh ghaNDhu nI indhagh ghAriyadhdhaijh jhèydhAy èனRAன.
adhaRghu AbhiraghAM: ivviDhadhdhil dhèyvabhayaM illaiyèனRuM, èன maனaiviyiனimidhdhaM èனனaigh ghòனRubhoDhuvArghaL èனRuM nAன niனaidhdheன.
avaL èன jhaghodhari èனbhadhuM mèydhAன; avaL èன dhaghabhbhaனughghugh ghumAradhdhi, èன dhAyghghugh ghumAradhdhiyalla; avaL èனghghu maனaiviyAனAL.

èன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhaiviDhDhu dhevaன èனனaidh dhejhAndhariyAydh dhiriyuMbhaDhi jhèydhabhodhu, nAன avaLai noghghi: nAM bhoghuM iDhaM è~NghuM, nI èனனaijh jhaghodharaன èனRu jhòlvadhu nI èனghghujh jhèyyaveNDhiya dhayai èனRu avaLiDhadhdhil jhòlliyirundheன èனRAன
abhbhòzhudhu abhimèleghghu ADhu mADhughaLaiyuM, velaighghAraraiyuM, velaighghArighaLaiyuM AbhiraghAmughghugh ghòDhudhdhu, avaன maனaiviyAghiya jhArALaiyuM avaனiDhadhdhil dhiruMbha òbhbhuvidhdhAன.
bhiனனuM abhimèleghghu: idho, èன dhejhaM uனghghu muனbhAgha irughghiRadhu; uன bhArvaighghujh jhaMmadhiyAன iDhadhdhile ghuDhiyiru èனRu jhòனனAன.

bhiனbhu jhArALai noghghi: uன jhaghodharaனughghu AyiraM vèLLighghAjhu ghòDhudhdheன; idho, uனனoDhirughghiRa èllAr muனbhAghavuM, maRRa yAvar muனbhAghavuM, idhu uன mughadhdhu mughghADhDhughghAvadhAgha èனRAன; ibhbhaDhi avaL ghaDhindhu ghòLLabhbhaDhDhAL.
AbhiraghAmuDhaiya maனaiviyAghiya jhArALiன nimidhdhaM ghardhdhar abhimèleghghuDhaiya vIDhDhAriன gharbhbha~NghaLaiyèllAM aDhaidhdhirundhabhaDhiyAl,
AbhiraghAM dhevaனai noghghi veNDhighghòNDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu dhevaன abhimèleghghaiyuM, avaன maனaiviyaiyuM, avaன velaighghArighaLaiyuM ghuNamAghghi, bhiLLaibhèRuMbhaDhi anughghiraghaM bhaNNiனAr.
ghardhdhar dhAM jhòlliyirundhabhaDhi jhArALbheril ghaDhADhjhamAனAr; ghardhdhar dhAM uraidhdhabhaDhiye jhArALughghujh jhèydharuLiனAr.
AbhiraghAM mudhirvayadhAyirughghaiyil, jhArAL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi, dhevaன ghuRidhdhirundha ghAladhdhile avaனughghu òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM dhaனghghujh jhArAL bhèRRa ghumAraனughghu IjhAghghu èனRu bheriDhDhAன.
dhaன ghumAraனAghiya IjhAghghu bhiRandha èDhDhAM nALile, AbhiraghAM dhaனghghudh dhevaன ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirundhabhaDhi avaனughghu virudhdha jhedhaனMbhaNNiனAன.
dhaன ghumAraனAghiya IjhAghghu bhiRandhabhodhu AbhiraghAM nURu vayadhAyirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu jhArAL: dhevaன èனனai naghaighghabh bhaNNiனAr; idhaigh gheDhghiRa yAvaruM èனனoDheghUDha naghaibhbhArghaL.
jhArAL bhiLLaighaLughghubh bhAl ghòDhubhbhAL èனRu AbhiraghAmughghu èvaன jhòlluvAன? avaruDhaiya mudhirvayadhile avarughghu òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRReனe èனRAL.
bhiLLai vaLarndhu, bhAl maRandhadhu; IjhAghghu bhAl maRandhanALile AbhiraghAM bhèriya virundhubhaNNiனAன.
bhiனbhu èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhALAghiya AghAr AbhiraghAmughghubh bhèRRa ghumAraன bhariyAjhaMbhaNNughiRadhaijh jhArAL ghaNDhu,
AbhiraghAmai noghghi: indha aDhimaibh bhèNNaiyuM avaL maghaனaiyuM bhuRaMbhe dhaLLuM; indha aDhimaibh bhèNNiன maghaன èன ghumAraனAghiya IjhAghghoDhe jhudhandharavALiyAyirubhbhadhillai èனRAன.
dhaன maghaனaighghuRidhdhujh jhòllabhbhaDhDha indhagh ghAriyaM AbhiraghAmughghu mighavuM dhughghamAyirundhadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu dhevaன AbhiraghAmai noghghi: andhabh bhiLLaiyaiyuM, uன aDhimaibhbhèNNaiyuM ghuRidhdhujh jhòllabhbhaDhDhadhu uனghghudh dhughghamAyirughgha veNDhAM; IjhAghghiனiDhadhdhil uன jhandhadhi viLa~NghuM; AdhalAl jhArAL uனghghujh jhòlvadhèllAvaRRaiyuM gheL.
aDhimaibhbhèNNiன maghaனuM uன vidhdhAyirughghiRabhaDhiyAl, avaனaiyuM òru jAdhiyAghghuveன èனRAr.

AbhiraghAM adhighAlaiyil èzhundhu, abhbhadhdhaiyuM òru dhurudhdhi dhaNNIraiyuM èDhudhdhu, AghAruDhaiya dhoLiனmel vaidhdhubh bhiLLaiyaiyuM òbhbhughghòDhudhdhu, avaLai aனubhbhiviDhDhAன; avaL bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, bhèyarjhèbhAviன vaனAndharadhdhile alaindhu dhirindhAL.
dhurudhdhiyilirundha dhaNNIr jhèlavazhindhabhiனbhu, avaL bhiLLaiyai òru jhèDhiyiனghIzhe viDhDhu,
bhiLLai jhAghiRadhai nAன bhArghghamADhDheன èனRu, èdhirAgha aMbhu bhAyuM dhUradhdhile bhoy uDhghArndhu jhadhdhamiDhDhu azhudhAL.

dhevaன bhiLLaiyiன jhadhdhadhdhaigh gheDhDhAr; dhevadhUdhaன vAனdhdhilirundhu AghAraigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu AghAre, uனghghu èனன jhaMbhavidhdhadhu, bhayabhbhaDhAdhe, bhiLLaiyirughghuM iDhadhdhile dhevaன avaன jhadhdhadhdhaigh gheDhDhAr.
nI èzhundhu bhiLLaiyai èDhudhdhu avaனai uன ghaiyiனAl bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhubho, avaனaibh bhèriya jAdhiyAghghuveன èனRAr.
dhevaன avaLuDhaiya ghaNghaLaidh dhiRandhAr; abhbhòzhudhu avaL òru dhaNNIrdh dhuravaigh ghaNDhu, bhoy, dhurudhdhiyile dhaNNIr nirabhbhi, bhiLLaighghugh ghuDhighghagh ghòDhudhdhAL.
dhevaன bhiLLaiyuDhaனe irundhAr; avaன vaLarndhu vaனAndharadhdhile ghuDhiyirundhu, vilvidhdhaiyile vallavaனAனAன.
avaன bhArAன vaனAndharadhdhile ghuDhiyirughghaiyil, avaனuDhaiya dhAy èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhALAghiya òru bhèNNai avaனughghu vivAghaMbhaNNuvidhdhAL.
aghghAladhdhil abhimèleghghuM avaன jheனAdhibhadhiyAghiya bhigholuM AbhiraghAmai noghghi: nI jhèyghiRa ghAriya~NghaL èllAvaRRiluM dhevaன uனனuDhaனe irughghiRAr.

AghaiyAl, nI èனghghAvadhu, èன ghumAraனughghAvadhu, èன bheraனughghAvadhu va~njhaனai jhèyyAmal, nAன uனghghujh jhèydha dhayaviனbhaDhiye, nI èனghghuM, nI dha~NghiyirughghiRa indhadh dhejhadhdhiRghuM, dhayavu jhèyveன èனRu i~Nghe dhevaன bheril èனghghu ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhu èனRAன.
adhaRghu AbhiraghAM: nAன ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhughghiReன èனRAன.
AனAluM, abhimèleghghuDhaiya velaighghArar ghaivajhabhbhaDhudhdhighghòNDha dhuraviன nimidhdhaM AbhiraghAM abhimèleghghaigh ghaDhindhughòNDhAன.

adhaRghu abhimèleghghu: indhaghghAriyadhdhaijh jhèydhavaன iனனAன èனRu èனghghudh dhèriyAdhu, nIyuM èனghghu aRivighghavillai; iனRu nAன adhaigh gheDhDhadheyaனRi, idhaRghumuன adhai nAன gheLvibhbhaDhDhadhe illai èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM ADhumADhughaLaigh ghòNDhuvandhu abhimèleghghughghugh ghòDhudhdhAன; avarghaL iruvaruM uDhaனbhaDhighghai bhaNNighghòNDhArghaL.
AbhiraghAM ezhu bhèNNADhDhughghuDhDhighaLaidh dhaனiye niRudhdhiனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu abhimèleghghu AbhiraghAmai noghghi: nI dhaனiye dhaனiye niRudhdhiன indha ezhu bhèNNADhDhughghuDhDhighaL èனனdhdhiRghu èனRu gheDhDhAன.
adhaRghu avaன: nAன indhadh dhuravu dhoNDhiனdhaighghuRidhdhu, nIr jhADhjhiyAgha indha ezhu bhèNNADhDhughghuDhDhighaLai èன ghaiyil vA~NghighghòLLa veNDhuM èனRAன.
avarghaL iruvaruM avviDhadhdhil ANaiyiDhDhughghòNDhabhaDhiyAl, andha iDhaM bhèyarjhèbhA èனனbhbhaDhDhadhu.
avarghaL bhèyarjhèbhAvile uDhaனbhaDhighghai bhaNNighghòNDhabhiன abhimèleghghuM, avaன jheனAdhibhadhiyAghiya bhigholuM èzhundhu bhèlisdharuDhaiya dhejhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoனArghaL.
AbhiraghAM bhèyarjhèbhAvile òru dhobhbhai uNDhAghghi, jhadhAghAlamumuLLa dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhai avviDhadhdhil dhòzhudhughòNDhAன.
AbhiraghAM bhèlisdharuDhaiya dhejhadhdhil anegha nAL dha~NghiyirundhAன.
indhagh ghAriya~NghaL naDhandhabhiனbhu, dhevaன AbhiraghAmaijh jhodhidhdhAr; èbhbhaDhiyèனil, avar avaனai noghghi: AbhiraghAme èனRAr; avaன: idho aDhiyeன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avar: uன bhudhdhiraனuM uன eghajhudhaனuM uன nejhaghumAraனumAghiya IjhAghghai nI ibhbhòzhudhu azhaidhdhugh ghòNDhu, moriyA dhejhadhdhughghubh bhoy, a~Nghe nAன uனghghugh ghuRighghuM malaighaL òனRiனmel avaனaidh dhaghaனbhaliyAghabh bhaliyiDhu èனRAr.

AbhiraghAM adhighAlaiyil èzhundhu, dhaன ghazhudhaiyiனmel jheNa~NghaDhDhi, dhaன velaighghAraril iraNDhubheraiyuM dhaன ghumAraன IjhAghghaiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, dhaghaனbhalighghugh ghaDhDhaighaLaiyuM bhiLandhu ghòNDhu, dhevaன dhaனghghugh ghuRidhdha iDhadhdhiRghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAன.
mUனRAM nALil AbhiraghAM dhaன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubh bhArdhdhu, dhUradhdhile andha iDhadhdhaigh ghaNDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM dhaன velaighghArarai noghghi: nI~NghaL ghazhudhaiyai niRudhdhi i~Nghe ghAdhdhiru~NghaL, nAனuM bhiLLaiyANDhAனuM avviDhamaDhDhuM bhoy, dhòzhudhughòNDhu, u~NghaLiDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhi varuvoM èனRAன.
AbhiraghAM dhaghaனbhalighghugh ghaDhDhaighaLai èDhudhdhu, dhaன ghumAraனAghiya IjhAghghiனmel vaidhdhu, dhaன ghaiyile nèrubhbhaiyuM ghadhdhiyaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhAன; iruvaruM ghUDhibhbhoனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu IjhAghghu dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya AbhiraghAmai noghghi: èன dhaghabhbhaனe èனRAன; adhaRghu avaன: èன maghaனe, idho, irughghiReன èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu avaன: idho, nèrubhbhuM ghaDhDhaiyuM irughghiRadhu, dhaghaனbhalighghu ADhDhughghuDhDhi è~Nghe èனRAன.
adhaRghu AbhiraghAM: èன maghaனe, dhevaன dhamaghghudh dhaghaனbhalighghAன ADhDhughghuDhDhiyaibh bhArdhdhughghòLvAr èனRAன; abhbhuRaM iruvaruM ghUDhibhbhoy,

dhevaன avaனughghujh jhòlliyirundha iDhadhdhughghu vandhArghaL; a~Nghe AbhiraghAM òru bhalibhIDhadhdhai uNDhAghghi, ghaDhDhaighaLai aDhughghi, dhaன ghumAraனAghiya IjhAghghaigh ghaDhDhi, andhabh bhalibhIDhadhdhil aDhughghiya ghaDhDhaighaLiனmel avaனaigh ghiDhadhdhiனAன.
bhiனbhu AbhiraghAM dhaன ghumAraனai vèDhDhuMbhaDhighghudh dhaன ghaiyai nIDhDhigh ghadhdhiyai èDhudhdhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar vAனdhdhilirundhu, AbhiraghAme, AbhiraghAme èனRu ghUbhbhiDhDhAr; avaன: idho, aDhiyeன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avar: bhiLLaiyANDhAனmel uன ghaiyaibh bhoDhAdhe, avaனughghu òனRuM jhèyyAdhe; nI avaனai uன bhudhdhiraன èனRuM, uன eghajhudhaன èனRuM bhArAmal èனghghAgha òbhbhughghòDhudhdhabhaDhiyiனAl nI dhevaனughghubh bhayabhbhaDhughiRavaன èனRu ibhbhòzhudhu aRindhirughghiReன èனRAr.

AbhiraghAM dhaன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubh bhArghghuMbhodhu, idho, bhiனனAghabh bhudharile dhaன ghòMbhughaL jhighghighghòNDhirundha òru ADhDhughghaDhAvaigh ghaNDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM bhoy, ghaDhAvaibhbhiDhidhdhu, adhaidh dhaன ghumAraனughghubh bhadhilAghadh dhaghaனbhaliyiDhDhAன.
AbhiraghAM andha iDhadhdhughghu yeghovAyIre èனRu bheriDhDhAன; adhiனAle ghardhdharuDhaiya bharvadhadhdhile bhArdhdhughghòLLabhbhaDhuM èனRu innALvaraighghuM jhòllabhbhaDhDhu varughiRadhu.
ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar iraNDhAndharaM vAனdhdhilirundhu AbhiraghAmaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu:
nI uன bhudhdhiraன èனRuM, uன eghajhudhaனèனRuM bhArAmal avaனai òbhbhughghòDhudhdhu indhaghghAriyadhdhaijh jhèydhabhaDhiyAl;

nAன uனனai AjhIrvadhighghave AjhIrvadhidhdhu, uன jhandhadhiyai vAனdhdhiன naDhjhadhdhira~NghaLaibh bholavuM, ghaDhaRgharai maNalaibhbholavuM bhèrughave bhèrughabh bhaNNuveன èனRuM, uன jhandhadhiyAr dha~NghaL jhadhdhurughghaLiன vAjhalghaLaijh jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLuvArghaL èனRuM,
nI èன jhòllughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhindhabhaDhiyiனAl, uன jhandhadhighghuL bhUmiyiluLLa jhaghala jAdhighaLuM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuM èனRuM èனbheril ANaiyiDhDheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAr.
AbhiraghAM dhaன velaighghArariDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhi vandhAன; avarghaL èzhundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, eghamAybh bhèyarjhèbhAvughghubh bhoனArghaL; AbhiraghAM bhèyarjhèbhAvile ghuDhiyirundhAன.
indhaghghAriya~NghaL naDhandhabhiனbhu, òruvaன AbhiraghAmiDhadhdhil vandhu: milghghALuM uன jhaghodharaனAghiya nAghorughghubh bhiLLaighaLaibh bhèRRAL;
avarghaL yArèனRAl, mudhaRbheRAன Udhs, avaன dhaMbhiyAghiya bhUs, ArAmughghudh dhaghabhbhaனAghiya ghemuvel,
ghejhedh, Ajho, bhildhAs, idhlAbh, bhèdhdhuvel èனbhavarghaL; bhèdhdhuvel rèbhèghghALaibh bhèRRAன èனRu aRividhdhAன.
andha èDhDhubhbherai milghghAL AbhiraghAmuDhaiya jhaghodharaனAghiya nAghorughghubh bhèRRAL.
reyumAL èனRu bher ghòNDha avaனuDhaiya maRumaனaiyADhDhiyuM, dhebhA, ghAghAM, dhAghAs, mAghA èனbhavarghaLaibh bhèRRAL.
jhArAL nURRu irubhadhdhezhu varuShaM uyiroDhirundhAL; ivvaLave jhArALuDhaiya vayadhu.
ghAனAன dhejhadhdhiluLLa èbhiroன èனனuM ghIriyAdharbhAvile jhArAL maridhdhAL; abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM vandhu, jhArALughghAghabh bhulaMbhi azhudhAன.
bhiனbhu AbhiraghAM bhiredhaM irundha iDhadhdhilirundhu èzhundhu bhoy, edhdhiன bhudhdhiraroDhe bhejhi:

nAன u~NghaLiDhadhdhil anniyaனuM bharadhejhiyumAy irughghiReன; èனனiDhadhdhilirughghiRa indhabh bhiredhaM èன ghaNmuன irAdhabhaDhighghu nAன adhai aDhaghghaMbhaNNuvadhaRghu, u~NghaLiDhadhdhil èனghghujh jhòndhamAgha òru ghallaRaibh bhUmiyaidh dharaveNDhuM èனRAன.
adhaRghu edhdhiன bhudhdhirar AbhiraghAmughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha:

è~NghaL ANDhavaனe, nA~NghaL jhòllughiRadhaigh gheLuM è~NghaLughghuLLe nIr maghA bhirabhu, è~NghaL ghallaRaighaLil mughghiyamAனdhile bhiredhadhdhai aDhaghghaMbhaNNuM; nIr bhiredhadhdhai aDhaghghaMbhaNNa è~NghaLil òruvaனuM dhaன ghallaRaiyai umaghghudh dhaDhaijhèyvadhillai èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM èzhundhirundhu, edhdhiன bhudhdhirarAghiya adhdhejhadhdhArughghu vandhaனM jhèydhu,

avarghaLoDhe bhejhi: èனனiDhadhdhilirughghiRa bhiredhaM èன ghaNmuன irAdhabhaDhighghu, nAன adhai aDhaghghaMbhaNNa u~NghaLughghujh jhaMmadhiyAனAl, nI~NghaL èன vArdhdhaiyaigh gheDhDhu, jhoghAruDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya èbhbhèroன,

dhaன niladhdhiன ghaDhaijhiyile irughghiRa maghbhelA èனனbhbhaDhDha ghughaiyai èனghghujh jhòndhamAன ghallaRaibh bhUmiyAyirughghuMbhaDhi dharaveNDhuM èனRu, avariDhadhdhil èனghghAgha veNDhighghòLLu~NghaL; adhu bhèRumAன vilaighghu avar adhaidh dharuvArAgha èனRAன.

èbhbhèroன edhdhiன bhudhdhirar naDhuvile uDhghArndhirundhAன; abhbhòzhudhu edhdhiyaனAghiya èbhbhèroன dhaன Ur vAjhalughghuL bhiravejhighghiRa edhdhiன bhudhdhirar aனaivaruM gheDhgha AbhiraghAmughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha:

abhbhaDhiyalla, èன ANDhavaனe, èன vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLuM; andha niladhdhai umaghghudh dharughiReன, adhilirughghuM ghughaiyaiyuM umaghghudh dharughiReன, èன jaனbhbhudhdhiraruDhaiya ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha adhai umaghghudh dharughiReன, uMmiDhadhdhilirughghiRa bhiredhadhdhai aDhaghghaMbhaNNuM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM adhdhejhadhdhArughghu vandhaனM jhèydhu,

dhejhadhdhu jaன~NghaL gheDhgha, èbhbhèroனai noghghi: ghòDhughgha umaghghu maனdhAனAl èன vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLuM; niladhdhiன vilaiyaidh dharughiReன; èன ghaiyil adhai vA~NghighghòLLuM; abhbhòzhudhu èனனiDhadhdhilirughghiRa bhiredhadhdhai avviDhadhdhil aDhaghghaM bhaNNuveன èனRAன.
adhaRghu èbhbhèroன AbhiraghAmughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha:

èன ANDhavaனe, nAன jhòllughiRadhaigh gheLuM; andha nilaM nAனURu jheghghal niRai vèLLi bhèRuM; èனghghuM umaghghuM adhu èvvaLavu ghAriyaM; nIr uMmiDhadhdhilirughghiRa bhiredhadhdhai aDhaghghaM bhaNNuM èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM èbhbhèroனiன jhòllaigh gheDhDhu, edhdhiன bhudhdhirarughghu muனbhAgha èbhbhèroன jhòனனbhaDhiye, vardhdhaghariDhadhdhil jhèlluMbhaDhiyAன nAனURu jheghghal niRai vèLLiyai avaனughghu niRudhdhugh ghòDhudhdhAன.
indhabhbhiraghAraM maMreghghu èdhire maghbhelAviluLLa èbhbhèroனuDhaiya nilamAghiya andhabh bhUmiyuM, adhiluLLa ghughaiyuM, niladhdhiன èllaiyè~NghuM jhUzhndhirughghiRa mara~NghaL aDha~NghaluM,
avaனuDhaiya UrvAjhalughghuL bhiravejhighghuM edhdhiன bhudhdhirar èllAruM aRiya AbhiraghAmughghujh jhòndhamAgha uRudhibhbhaDhudhdhabhbhaDhDhadhu.
adhaRghubhbhiன AbhiraghAM dhaன maனaiviyAghiya jhArALaigh ghAனAனdhejhadhdhil èbhbhèroன Ur bhUmiyAன maMreghghu èdhire irughghiRa maghbhelA èனனuM niladhdhiன ghughaiyile aDhaghghaMbhaNNiனAன.
ibhbhaDhi edhdhiன bhudhdhirar ghaiyil ghòLLabhbhaDhDha andha nilamuM, adhiluLLa ghughaiyuM, AbhiraghAmughghujh jhòndha ghallaRaibh bhUmiyAgha uRudhibhbhaDhudhdhabhbhaDhDhadhu.
AbhiraghAM vayadhu jhèனRu mudhirndhavaனAனAன. ghardhdhar AbhiraghAmaijh jhaghala ghAriya~NghaLiluM AjhIrvadhidhdhu vandhAr.
abhbhòzhudhu AbhiraghAM dhaன vIDhDhiluLLavarghaLil vayadhil mUdhdhavaனuM, dhaனghghu uNDhAன èllAvaRRiRghuM adhighAriyumAghiya dhaன UzhiyaghghAraனai noghghi:
nAன ghuDhiyirughghiRa ghAனAனiyaruDhaiya ghumAradhdhighaLil nI èன ghumAraனughghubh bhèNghòLLAmal;

nI èன dhejhadhdhughghuM èன iனdhdhAriDhadhdhughghuM bhoy, èன ghumAraனAghiya IjhAghghughghubh bhèNghòLveன èனRu, vAனdhdhughghudh dhevaனuM bhUmighghudh dhevaனumAghiya ghardhdharbheril èனghghu ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhughghuMbhaDhighghu, nI uன ghaiyai èன dhòDhaiyiன ghIzh vai èனRAன.

adhaRghu andha UzhiyaghghAraன: avviDhadhdhubh bhèN èன bhiனனe indhadh dhejhadhdhughghu vara maனdhillAdhirundhAl, nIr viDhDhuvandha dhejhadhdhiRghudhdhAனe uMmuDhaiya ghumAraனai maRubhaDhiyuM azhaidhdhubhbhoghaveNDhumo èனRu gheDhDhAன.
adhaRghu AbhiraghAM: nI èன ghumAraனai maRubhaDhiyuM a~Nghe azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoghAdhabhaDhighghu èjhjharighghaiyAyiru.

èனனai èன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya vIDhDhiluM èன iனdhdhAr irughghiRa dhejhadhdhilumirundhu azhaidhdhu vandhavaruM, uன jhandhadhighghu indha dhejhadhdhaidh dharuveன èனRu èனghghujh jhòlli ANaiyiDhDhavarumAன vAனdhdhughghudh dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar, nI a~Ngheyirundhu èன ghumAraனughghu òru bhèNNaigh ghòNDhuvaruMbhaDhighghu, dhaMmuDhaiya dhUdhaனai uனghghu muனbhAgha aனubhbhuvAr.
bhèN uன bhiனனe vara maனdhillAdhirundhALeyAghil, abhbhòzhudhu nI indha èன ANaighghu nI~NghalAyirubhbhAy; a~NghemAdhdhiraM èன ghumAraனai maRubhaDhiyuM azhaidhdhughghòNDhu bhoghaveNDhAM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu andha UzhiyaghghAraன dhaன ghaiyaidh dhaன èjamAனAghiya AbhiraghAmiன dhòDhaiyiனghIzh vaidhdhu, indhagh ghAriyadhdhaighghuRidhdhu avaனughghu ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhudhdhAன.

bhiனbhu andha UzhiyaghghAraன dhaன èjamAனuDhaiya òDhDhagha~NghaLil bhadhdhu òDhDhagha~NghaLaidh dhaனனuDhaனe ghòNDhubhoனAன; dhaன èjamAனuDhaiya jhaghalavidha ujhjhidhamAன bhòruLghaLuM avaன ghaiyil irundhaன; avaன èzhundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, mèjhòbhbhòdhdhAmiyAvile nAghoruDhaiya Uril jherndhu,
Urughghubh bhuRaMbhe òru dhaNNIrdh dhuravaNDhaiyile, dhaNNIr mòLLa sdhirIghaL bhuRabhbhaDhughiRa jhAya~NghAla veLaiyile, òDhDhagha~NghaLai maDhaghghi, dhaனghghuLLe jhòllighghòNDhadhu èனனvèனRAl:
èன èjamAனAghiya AbhiraghAmughghu dhevaனAyirughghiRa ghardhdhAve, iனRaighghu nIr èனghghugh ghAriyaM jhidhdhighghabhbhaNNi, èன èjamAனAghiya AbhiraghAmughghudh dhayavu jhèydharuLuM.
idho, nAன indhadh dhaNNIrdh dhuravaNDhaiyile niRghiReன, indha UrAruDhaiya bhèNghaL dhaNNIr mòLLabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu varuvArghaLe.

nAன ghuDhighgha uன ghuDhadhdhaijh jhAyghghaveNDhuM èனRu nAன jhòlluMbhodhu: ghuDhi èனRuM, uன òDhDhagha~NghaLuM ghuDhighghuMbhaDhi vArbhbheன èனRuM jhòlluM bhèN èvaLo, avaLe nIr uMmuDhaiya UzhiyaghghAraனAghiya IjhAghghughghu niyamidhdhavaLAyirughghavuM, èன èjamAனughghu anughghiraghaM jhèydhIr èனRu nAன adhiனAle aRiyavuM jhèydharuLuM èனRAன.

avaன ibhbhaDhijh jhòlli muDhighghuM muனனe, idho, AbhiraghAmuDhaiya jhaghodharaனAghiya nAghoriன maனaivi milghghALuDhaiya ghumAraனAyirughghiRa bhèdhdhuvelughghubh bhiRandha rèbhèghghAL ghuDhadhdhaidh dhoLmel vaidhdhughghòNDhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu vandhAL.
andhabh bhèN maghA rUbhavadhiyuM, bhuruShaனai aRiyAdha ghaனனighaiyumAy irundhAL; avaL dhuravil iRa~Nghi, dhaன ghuDhadhdhai nirabhbhighghòNDhu eRivandhAL.
abhbhòzhudhu andha UzhiyaghghAraன, avaLughghu èdhirghòNDhoDhi: uன ghuDhadhdhilirughghiRa dhaNNIril ghò~njhaM ghuDhighghadh dharaveNDhuM èனRAன.
adhaRghu avaL: ghuDhiyuM èன ANDhavaனe èனRu jhIghghiramAygh ghuDhadhdhaidh dhaன ghaiyil iRaghghigh ghòNDhu, avaனughghugh ghuDhighghagh ghòDhudhdhAL.
ghòDhudhdhabhiன, uMmuDhaiya òDhDhagha~NghaLuM ghuDhidhdhudh dhIrumaDhDhuM avaighaLughghuM mòNDhu vArbhbheன èனRu jhòlli;
jhIghghiramAydh dhaன ghuDhadhdhudh dhaNNIraidh dhòDhDhiyile URRiviDhDhu, iனனuM mòNDhuvaradh dhuravaNDhaiyil oDhi, avaனuDhaiya òDhDhagha~NghaLughghèllAM mòNDhu vArdhdhAL.
andha maனidhaன avaLaighghuRidhdhu AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhu, ghardhdhar dhaன bhirayANadhdhai vAyghghabhbhaNNiனAro illaiyo èனRu aRiyuMbhòruDhDhu mavuனmAyirundhAன.

òDhDhagha~NghaL ghuDhidhdhudh dhIrndhabhiன, andha maனidhaன araijhjheghghal èDhaiyuLLa bhòRghAdhaNiyaiyuM, avaL ghaighaLughghubh bhadhdhujhjheghghal èDhaibhbhòனனuLLa iraNDhu ghaDhagha~NghaLaiyuM èDhudhdhugh ghòDhudhdhu,
nI yAruDhaiya maghaL, èனghghujh jhòllaveNDhuM; nA~NghaL uன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhil irAdhdha~Ngha iDhaM uNDhA èனRAன.
adhaRghu avaL: nAன nAghorughghu milghghAL bhèRRa ghumAraனAghiya bhèdhdhuveliன maghaL èனRu jhòனனdhumaனRi,
è~NghaLiDhadhdhil vaighgholuM dhIvaனmuM veNDhiyamaDhDhuM irughghiRadhu; irAdhdha~Ngha iDhamuM uNDhu èனRAL
abhbhòzhudhu andha maனidhaன dhalai ghuனindhu, ghardhdharaibh bhaNindhu ghòNDhu,

èன èjamAனAghiya AbhiraghAmiன dhevaனAyirughghiRa ghardhdharughghu sdhodhdhiraM; avar dhaMmuDhaiya ghirubhaiyaiyuM, dhaMmuDhaiya uNmaiyaiyuM èன èjamAனai viDhDhu nIghghavillai; nAன bhirayANaMbhaNNivarughaiyil, ghardhdhar èன èjamAனuDhaiya jhaghodharar vIDhDhughghu èனனai azhaidhdhughghòNDhuvandhAr èனRAன.
andhabh bhèN oDhi, indhaghghAriya~NghaLaidh dhaன dhAyiன vIDhDhiluLLavarghaLughghu aRividhdhAன.
rèbhèghghALughghu òru jhaghodharaன irundhAன; avaனughghu lAbhAன èனRu bher; andha lAbhAன vèLiye dhuravaNDhaiyil irundha andha maனidhaனiDhadhdhughghu oDhiனAன.

avaன dhaன jhaghodhari dharidhdhirundha andhagh ghAdhaNiyaiyuM, avaL ghaighaLil bhoDhDhirundha ghaDhagha~NghaLaiyuM bhArdhdhu, iனன iனனbhaDhi andha maனidhaன èனனoDhe bhejhiனAனèனRu dhaன jhaghodhari rèbhèghghAL jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhamAdhdhiradhdhil, andha maனidhaனiDhadhdhil vandhAன; avaன dhuravu arughe òDhDhagha~NghaL aNDhaiyil niனRughòNDhirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன: ghardhdharAl AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhavare, uLLe vAruM; nIr vèLiye niRbhAனeன? umaghghu vIDhuM, òDhDhagha~NghaLughghu iDhamuM AyadhdhaMbhaNNiyirughghiReன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu andha maனidhaன vIDhDhughghubh bhoனAன. lAbhAன òDhDhagha~NghaLiன ghaDhDhavizhdhdhu, òDhDhagha~NghaLughghu vaighgholuM dhIvaனmuM bhoDhDhu, avaனuM, avaனoDhe vandhavarghaLuM dha~NghaL ghAlghaLaigh ghazhuvighghòLLadh dhaNNIr ghòDhudhdhAன.
bhiனbhu, avaனughghu muனbhAgha bhojaனM vaighghabhbhaDhDhadhu. abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nAன vandha ghAriyadhdhaijh jhòllumuனனe bhujhighghamADhDheன èனRAன. adhaRghu avaன jhòlluM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nAன AbhiraghAmuDhaiya UzhiyaghghAraன.

ghardhdhar èன èjamAனai mighavuM AjhIrvadhidhdhirughghiRAr, avar jhImAனAyirughghiRAr; ghardhdhar avarughghu ADhumADhughaLaiyuM, vèLLiyaiyuM, bhòனனaiyuM, velaighghAraraiyuM, velaighghArighaLaiyuM, òDhDhagha~NghaLaiyuM, ghazhudhaighaLaiyuM ghòDhudhdhirughghiRAr.
èன èjamAனuDhaiya maனaiviyAghiya jhArAL mudhirvayadhAனbhodhu, èன èjamAனughghu òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL; avar dhamaghghu uNDhAன yAvaiyuM avaனughghugh ghòDhudhdhirughghiRAr.
èன èjamAன èனனai noghghi: nAன ghuDhiyirughghiRa ghAனAன dhejhadhdhAruDhaiya ghumAradhdhighaLil nI èன ghumAraனughghubh bhèN ghòLLAmal,
nI èன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhughghuM, èன iனdhdhAriDhadhdhughghuM bhoy, èன ghumAraனughghubh bhèNghòLLaveNDhuM èனRu ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhughghuMbhaDhi jhòனனAr.
abhbhòzhudhu nAன èன èjamAனai noghghi: òruveLai andhabh bhèN èனbhiனனe varAdhebhoனAlo èனRu gheDhDhadhaRghu,

avar: nAன vazhibhaDhuM ghardhdhar uனனoDhe dhaMmuDhaiya dhUdhaனai aனubhbhi, uன bhirayANadhdhai vAyghghabhbhaNNuvAr; èன iனdhdhAriDhadhdhiluM, èன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhiluM nI èன ghumAraனughghubh bhèNghòLvAy.
nI èன iனdhdhAriDhadhdhughghubh bhoனAl, èன ANaighghu nI~NghalAyirubhbhAy; avarghaL uனghghubh bhèNghòDhAmaRbhoனAluM, nI èன ANaighghu nI~NghalAyirubhbhAy èனRAr.
abhbhaDhiye nAன iனRu dhuravaNDhaiyile vandhu: èன èjamAனAghiya AbhiraghAmiன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhare, èன bhirayANadhdhai nIr ibhbhòzhudhu vAyghghabhbhaNNuvIrAனAl,

idho, nAன dhaNNIrdh dhuravaNDhaiyile niRghiReன, dhaNNIr mòLLa varabhbhoghiRa ghaனனighaiyai nAன noghghi: uன ghuDhadhdhilirughghiRa dhaNNIril ghò~njhaM èனghghugh ghuDhighghadh dharaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhghuMbhodhu:
nI ghuDhi èனRuM, uன òDhDhagha~NghaLughghuM mòNDhu vArbhbheன èனRuM jhòlluM bhèNNe ghardhdhar èன èjamAனuDhaiya ghumAraனughghu niyamidhdha sdhirIyAghaveNDhuM èனReன.

nAன idhai èன irudhayadhdhil jhòlli muDhighghumuனனe, idho, rèbhèghghAL dhaன ghuDhadhdhaidh dhoLmel vaidhdhughghòNDhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvandhu, dhuravil iRa~Nghibhbhoydh dhaNNIr mòNDhAL. abhbhòzhudhu nAன: èனghghugh ghuDhighghadh dharaveNDhuM èனReன.
avaL jhIghghiramAydh dhaன dhoLmelirundha ghuDhadhdhai iRaghghi, ghuDhiyuM, uMmuDhaiya òDhDhagha~NghaLughghuM vArbhbheன èனRAL. nAன ghuDhidhdheன; òDhDhagha~NghaLughghuM vArdhdhAL.

abhbhòzhudhu: nI yAruDhaiya maghaL èனRu avaLaigh gheDhDheன; adhaRghu avaL: nAன milghghAL nAghorughghubh bhèRRa ghumAraனAghiya bhèdhdhuveliன maghaL èனRAL; abhbhòzhudhu avaLughghugh ghAdhaNiyaiyuM, avaL ghaighaLile ghaDhagha~NghaLaiyuM bhoDhDhu;

dhalaighuனindhu, ghardhdharaibh bhaNindhughòNDhu, nAன èன èjamAனuDhaiya jhaghodharaன ghumAradhdhiyai avar ghumAraனughghugh ghòLLa èனனai nervazhiyAy naDhadhdhivandha èன èjamAனAghiya AbhiraghAmiன dhevaனAyirughghiRa ghardhdharai sdhodhdhiridhdheன.

ibhbhòzhudhuM nI~NghaLuM èன èjamAனughghudh dhayaiyuM uNmaiyuM uDhaiyavarghaLAy naDhaghgha maனdhuLLavarghaLAனAl, èனghghujh jhòllu~NghaL; illaiyèனRAl adhaiyuM èனghghujh jhòllu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu nAன valadhu bhuRadhdhaiyAghiluM iDhadhubhuRadhdhaiyAghiluM noghghibh bhoveன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu lAbhAனuM bhèdhdhuveluM bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: indhaghghAriyaM ghardhdharAl vandhadhu, umaghghu nA~NghaL nalaM bhòlaM òனRuM jhòllagh ghUDhAdhu.
idho, rèbhèghghAL umaghghu muனbhAgha irughghiRAL; ghardhdhar jhòனனbhaDhiye avaL umadhu èjamAனuDhaiya ghumAraனughghu maனaiviyAghuMbhaDhighghu, avaLai azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoM èனRArghaL.
AbhiraghAmiன UzhiyaghghAraன avarghaL vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhabhodhu, dharaimaDhDhuM ghuனindhu, ghardhdharaibh bhaNindhughòNDhAன.

bhiனbhu andha UzhiyaghghAraன vèLLiyuDhaimaighaLaiyuM, bhòனனuDhaimaighaLaiyuM, vasdhira~NghaLaiyuM èDhudhdhu, rèbhèghghALughghugh ghòDhudhdhadhumaனRi, avaLuDhaiya jhaghodharaனughghuM dhAyghghuM jhila ujhjhidha~NghaLaiyuM ghòDhudhdhAன.
bhiனbhu avaனuM avaனoDhirundha maனidharuM bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdhu, irAdhdha~NghiனArghaL; ghAlaiyile èzhundhirundhu, avaன: èன èjamAனiDhadhdhughghu èனனai aனubhbhiviDhu~NghaL èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaL jhaghodharaனuM avaL dhAyuM, bhadhdhu nALAghiluM bhèN è~NghaLoDhirughghaDhDhuM, bhiRbhADhu bhoghalAM èனRArghaL.
adhaRghu avaன: ghardhdhar èன bhirayANadhdhai vAyghghabhbhaNNiyirughgha, nI~NghaL èனghghudh dhaDhaijhèyyAdhiru~NghaL; nAன èன èjamAனiDhadhdhughghubh bhogha èனனai aனubhbhiviDhaveNDhuM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL: bhèNNai azhaidhdhu, avaL vAybhbhiRabhbhaigh gheDhbhoM èனRu jhòlli,
rèbhèghghALai azhaidhdhu: nI indha maனidhaனoDheghUDhabh bhoghiRAyA èனRu gheDhDhArghaL. avaL: bhoghiReன èனRAL.
abhbhaDhiye avarghaL dha~NghaL jhaghodhariyAghiya rèbhèghghALaiyuM, avaL dhAdhiyaiyuM, AbhiraghAmiன UzhiyaghghAraனaiyuM, avaன maனidharaiyuM aனubhbhuvidhdhu,

rèbhèghghALai vAzhdhdhi: è~NghaL jhaghodhariye, nI ghoDhAghoDhiyAybh bhèrughuvAyAgha; uன jhandhadhiyAr dha~NghaL bhaghai~naruDhaiya vAjhalghaLaijh jhudhandharidhdhughghòLvArghaLAgha èனRu AjhIrvadhidhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu rèbhèghghALuM avaL velaighghArighaLuM èzhundhu òDhDhagha~NghaLiனmel eRi, andha maனidhaனoDheghUDhabh bhoனArghaL. UzhiyaghghAraன rèbhèghghALai azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoனAன.
IjhAghghu dhèனdhejhadhdhil ghuDhiyirundhAன. abhbhòzhudhu avaன: laghAyroyI èனனbhbhaDhDha dhuraviன vazhiyAybh bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvandhAன.
IjhAghghu jhAya~NghAlaveLaiyile dhiyAனMbhaNNa vèLiyile bhoyirundhu, dhaன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubh bhArdhdhabhodhu, òDhDhagha~NghaL varaghghaNDhAன.
rèbhèghghALuM dhaன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhu IjhAghghaigh ghaNDhabhodhu,

UzhiyaghghAraனai noghghi: a~Nghe namaghghu èdhirAgha naDhandhu varughiRa andha maனidhaன yAr èனRu gheDhDhAL. avardhAன èன èjamAன èனRu UzhiyaghghAraன jhòனனAன. abhbhòzhudhu avaL òDhDhaghadhdhai viDhDhiRa~Nghi mughghADhiDhDhughghòNDhAL.
UzhiyaghghAraன dhAன jhèydha jhaghala ghAriya~NghaLaiyuM IjhAghghughghu vivaridhdhujh jhòனனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu IjhAghghu rèbhèghghALaidh dhaன dhAy jhArALuDhaiya ghUDhAradhdhughghu azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoy, avaLaidh dhaனghghu maனaiviyAghghighghòNDhu, avaLai nejhidhdhAன. IjhAghghu dhaன dhAyghghAghagh ghòNDhirundha dhughghaM nI~Nghi ARudhalaDhaindhAன.
AbhiraghAM ghedhdhUrAL èனனuM bher ghòNDha òru sdhirIyaiyuM vivAghaMbhaNNiyirundhAன.
avaL avaனughghujh jhiMrAனaiyuM, yakShAனaiyuM, medhAனaiyuM, mIdhiyAனaiyuM, isbhAghghaiyuM, jhUvAghaiyuM bhèRRAL.
yakShAன jhebhAvaiyuM, dhedhAனaiyuM bhèRRAன; dhedhAனuDhaiya ghumArar ajhUrIM, lèdhdhUjhIM, lèyUmIM èனbhavarghaL
mIdhiyAனuDhaiya ghumArar ebhbhA, ebhbher, Aனoghghu, abhIdhA, èldhAghA èனbhavarghaL; ivarghaL èllAruM ghedhdhUrALiன bhiLLaighaL.
AbhiraghAM dhaனghghu uNDhAன yAvaiyuM IjhAghghughghugh ghòDhudhdhAன.

AbhiraghAmughghu irundha maRumaனaiyADhDhighaLiன bhiLLaighaLughgho AbhiraghAM naனghòDhaighaLaigh ghòDhudhdhu, dhAன uyiroDhirughghuMbhodhe avarghaLaidh dhaன ghumAraனAghiya IjhAghghaiviDhDhugh ghizhaghghe bhoghagh ghIzhdhejhadhdhughghu aனubhbhiviDhDhAன.
AbhiraghAM uyiroDhirundha Ayujhu nADhghaL nURRu èzhubhadhdhaindhu varuShaM.
bhiRbhADhu AbhiraghAM nalla naraivayadhiluM, mudhirndha bhUraNa AyujhiluM bhirANaன bhoy maridhdhu, dhaன jaனdhdhAroDhe jherghghabhbhaDhDhAன.
avaன ghumArarAghiya IjhAghghuM ismaveluM maMreghghu èdhire edhdhiyaனAன jhoghAriன ghumAraனAghiya èbhbhèroனiன niladhdhiluLLa maghbhelA èனனbhbhaDhDha ghughaiyile avaனai aDhaghghaMbhaNNiனArghaL.
andha niladhdhai edhdhiன bhudhdhirar ghaiyile AbhiraghAM vA~NghiyirundhAன; a~Nghe AbhiraghAmuM avaன maனaiviyAghiya jhArALuM aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhArghaL.
AbhiraghAM maridhdhabhiன dhevaன avaன ghumAraனAghiya IjhAghghai AjhIrvadhidhdhAr. laghAyroyI èனனuM dhuravughghujh jhamIbhamAy IjhAghghu ghuDhiyirundhAன.
jhArALuDhaiya aDhimaibhbhèNNAghiya èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhALAன AghAr AbhiraghAmughghubh bhèRRa ghumAraனAghiya ismaveliன vaMjha varalARu:
