meluM lAbhAன dhaன velaighghAriyAghiya bhilghALaidh dhaன ghumAradhdhiyAghiya rAghelughghu velaighghAriyAghagh ghòDhudhdhAன.
yAghghobhu rAghelaiyuM jherndhAன; leyALaibhbhArghghiluM rAghelai avaன adhighamAy nejhidhdhu, bhiனனuM ezhu varuShaM avaனiDhadhdhil jhevidhdhAன.
leyAL aRbhamAy èNNabhbhaDhDhAL èனRu ghardhdhar ghaNDhu, avaL gharbhbhandharighghuMbhaDhi jhèydhAr; rAghelo malaDhiyAyirundhAL.
leyAL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu: ghardhdhar èன jhiRumaiyaibh bhArdhdharuLiனAr; ibhbhòzhudhu èன bhuruShaன èனனai nejhibhbhAr èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghu rUbhaன èனRu bheriDhDhAL.

maRubhaDhiyuM avaL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu: nAன aRbhamAy èNNabhbhaDhDhadhaigh ghardhdhar gheDhDharuLi ivaனaiyuM èனghghudh dhandhAr èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghujh jhimiyoன èனRu bheriDhDhAL.

bhiனனuM avaL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu: èன bhuruShaனughghu mUனRu ghumAraனaibh bhèRRabhaDhiyAl avar ibhbhòzhudhu èனனoDhe jherndhirubhbhAr èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghu levi èனRu bheriDhDhAL.

maRubhaDhiyuM avaL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu ibhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharaidh dhudhibhbheன èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghu yUdhA èனRu bheriDhDhAL; bhiRbhADhu avaLughghubh bhiLLaibhbheRu niனRubhoyiRRu.
rAghel dhAன yAghghobhughghubh bhiLLaighaLaibh bhèRAdhadhaighghaNDhu, dhaன jhaghodhariyiனmel bhòRAmaighòNDhu, yAghghobhai noghghi: èனghghubh bhiLLai ghòDhuM, illAviDhDhAl nAன jhAghiReன èனRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu yAghghobhu rAgheliனmel ghobha~NghòNDhu: dhevaனllo uன gharbhbhadhdhai aDhaidhdhirughghiRAr, nAன dhevaனo èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaL: idho, èன velaighghAriyAghiya bhilghAL irughghiRALe; avaL èன maDhighghubh bhiLLaighaLaibh bhèRavuM, avaLAlAghiluM èன vIDhu ghaDhDhabhbhaDhavuM avaLiDhadhdhil jheruM èனRu jhòlli,
avaனughghudh dhaன velaighghAriyAghiya bhilghALai maனaiviyAghagh ghòDhudhdhAL; abhbhaDhiye yAghghobhu avaLaijh jherndhAன.
bhilghAL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi, yAghghobhughghu òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu rAghel: dhevaன èன vazhaghghaidh dhIrdhdhu, èன jhadhdhadhdhaiyuM gheDhDhu, èனghghu òru ghumAraனaigh ghòDhudhdhAr èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghudh dhAN èனRu bheriDhDhAL.
maRubhaDhiyuM rAgheliன velaighghAriyAghiya bhilghAL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi, yAghghobhughghu iraNDhAM ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu rAghel: nAன maghA bhorADhDhamAy èன jhaghodhariyoDhe bhorADhi meRghòNDheன èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghu nabhdhali èனRu bheriDhDhAL.
leyAL dhAன bhiLLaibhèRughiRadhu niனRubhoனdhaigh ghaNDhu, dhaன velaighghAriyAghiya jhilbhALai azhaidhdhu, avaLai yAghghobhughghu maனaiviyAghagh ghòDhudhdhAL.
leyALiன velaighghAriyAghiya jhilbhAL yAghghobhughghu òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu leyAL: erALamAghiRadhu èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghugh ghAdh èனRu bheriDhDhAL.
bhiனbhu leyALiன velaighghAriyAghiya jhilbhAL yAghghobhughghu iraNDhAM ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu leyAL: nAன bhAghghiyavadhi, sdhirIghaL èனனaibh bhAghghiyavadhi èனbhArghaL èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghu Ajher èனRu bheriDhDhAL.

ghodhumai aRubhbhu nADhghaLile rUbhaன vayalvèLiyile bhoy, dhUdhAyIM ghaனighaLaigh ghaNDhèDhudhdhu, avaighaLaigh ghòNDhuvandhu dhaன dhAyAghiya leyALiDhadhdhil ghòDhudhdhAன. abhbhòzhudhu rAghel leyALai noghghi: uன ghumAraனuDhaiya dhUdhAyIM ghaனiyil èனghghugh ghò~njhaM dhA èனRAL.

adhaRghu avaL: nI èன bhuruShaனai èDhudhdhughghòNDhadhu aRbhaghAriyamA? èன ghumAraனuDhaiya dhUdhAyIM ghaனighaLaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòLLa veNDhumo èனRAL; adhaRghu rAghel: uன ghumAraனuDhaiya dhUdhAyIM ghaனighaLughghu IDhAgha iனRu iravu avar uனனoDhe jhayaனighghaDhDhuM èனRAL.

jhAya~NghAladhdhil yAghghobhu vèLiyilirundhu varughaiyil leyAL bhuRabhbhaDhDhu avaனughghu èdhirghòNDhubhoy: èன ghumAraனuDhaiya dhUdhAyIM ghaனighaLAl uMmaigh ghòNDheன; AghaiyAl, nIr èனனiDhadhdhil varaveNDhuM èனRAL; avaன aனRu iravu avaLoDhe jhayaனidhdhAன.
dhevaன leyALughghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhAr. avaL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi yAghghobhughghu aindhAM ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu leyAL: nAன èன velaighghAriyai èன bhuruShaனughghugh ghòDhudhdha bhalaனaidh dhevaன èனghghudh dhandhAr èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghu ijhaghghAr èனRu bheriDhDhAL.
abhbhuRaM leyAL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi yAghghobhughghu ARAM ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL.

abhbhòzhudhu leyAL: dhevaன èனghghu nalla IvaidhdhandhAr; èன bhuruShaனughghu nAன ARu ghumAraraibh bhèRRabhaDhiyAl, ibhbhòzhudhu avar èனனuDhaனe vAjhaMbhaNNuvAr èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghujh jhèbhuloன èனRu bheriDhDhAL.
bhiனbhu avaL òru ghumAradhdhiyaiyuM bhèRRu, avaLughghudh dhIனAL èனRu bheriDhDhAL.
dhevaன rAghelai niனaidhdharuLiனAr; avaLughghudh dhevaன jhèvighòDhudhdhu, avaL gharbhbhandharighghuMbhaDhi jhèydhAr.
avaL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu: dhevaன èன nindhaiyai nIghghiviDhDhAr èனRuM,
iனனuM òru ghumAraனaigh ghardhdhar èனghghudh dharuvAr èனRuM jhòlli, avaனughghu yojhebhbhu èனRu bheriDhDhAL.
rAghel yojhebhbhaibh bhèRRabhiன, yAghghobhu lAbhAனai noghghi: nAன èன sdhAனdhdhiRghuM èன dhejhadhdhughghuM bhogha èனனai aனubhbhiviDhuM.
nAன umaghghu Uzhiya~njhèydhu jhaMbhAdhidhdha èன maனaivighaLaiyuM èன bhiLLaighaLaiyuM èனghghudh dhAruM; nAன bhoveன, nAன uMmiDhadhdhil jhevidhdha jhevaghadhdhai nIr aRindhirughghiRIr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu lAbhAன: uன ghaNghaLil èனghghudh dhayavu ghiDhaidhdhadheyAனAl nI iru; uனனimidhdhaM ghardhdhar èனனai AjhIrvadhidhdhAr èனRu ghuRibhbhiனAl aRindheன.
uன jhaMbhaLaM iனனdhèனRu èனghghujh jhòl, nAன adhaidh dharuveன èனRAன.
adhaRghu avaன nAன uMmaijh jhevidhdha vidhamuM, uMmuDhaiya mandhai èனனiDhadhdhil irundha vidhamuM aRindhirughghiRIr.

nAன varumuனனe umaghghu irundhadhu ghò~njhaM; nAன vandhabhiன ghardhdhar uMmai AjhIrvadhidhdhadhiனAl adhu mighavuM bhèrughiyirughghiRadhu; iனi nAன èன ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghujh jhaMbhAdhdhiyaMbhaNNuvadhu èbhbhòzhudhu èனRAன.

adhaRghu avaன: nAன uனghghu èனன dharaveNDhuM èனRAன; yAghghobhu: nIr èனghghu òனRuM dharaveNDhiyadhillai; nAன jhòllughiRabhaDhi nIr èனghghujh jhèydhAl, uMmuDhaiya mandhaiyaidh dhiruMbha meydhdhugh ghAbhbheன.

nAன iனRaighghubh bhoy, uMmuDhaiya mandhaighaLaiyèllAM bhArvaiyiDhDhu, avaighaLil bhuLLiyuM variyuM ghaRubhbhumuLLa jhèMmaRiyADhughaLaiyuM, variyuM bhuLLiyumuLLa vèLLADhughaLaiyuM bhiridhdhuviDhughiReன; abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavai iனi èனghghujh jhaMbhaLamAyirughghaDhDhuM.

abhbhaDhiye iனimel èன jhaMbhaLamAghiya ivaRRai nIr bhArvaiyiDhuMbhodhu, èன nIdhi viLa~NghuM; bhuLLiyuM variyumillAdha vèLLADhughaLuM, ghaRubhbhAன jhèMmaRiyADhughaLuM èன vajhadhdhil irundhAl, avaiyèllAM èனனAl dhiruDhighghòLLabhbhaDhDhavaighaLAy èNNabhbhaDhaDhDhuM èனRAன.
adhaRghu lAbhAன: nI jhòனனbhaDhiye AghaDhDhuM èனRu jhòlli,

annALile ghalabhbhu niRamuM variyumuLLa vèLLADhDhugh ghaDhAghghaLaiyuM, bhuLLiyuM variyumuLLa vèLLADhughaL yAvaiyuM, jhaRRu vèNmaiyuM gharumaiyumuLLa jhèMmaRiyADhughaL yAvaiyuM bhiridhdhu, dhaன ghumArariDhadhdhil òbhbhuvidhdhu,
dhaனghghuM yAghghobhughghuM iDhaiyile mUனRu nAL bhirayANa dhUradhdhil irughghuMbhaDhi vaidhdhAன. lAbhAனuDhaiya maRRa ADhughaLai yAghghobhu meydhdhAன.
bhiனbhu yAghghobhu bhajhjhaiyAyirughghiRa bhuனனai, vAdhumai armoன èனனuM mara~NghaLiன ghòbhbhughaLai vèDhDhi, iDhaiyiDhaiye vèNmai dhoனRuMbhaDhi, bhaDhDhaiyai uridhdhu,
dhAன uridhdha ghòbhbhughaLai ADhughaL dhaNNIr ghuDhighgha varuM ghAlvAyghaLiluM dhòDhDhighaLiluM ADhughaLughghu èdhirAghabh bhoDhDhuvaibhbhAன; ADhughaL dhaNNIr ghuDhighgha varuMbhodhu bhòlivadhuNDhu.
ADhughaL andhagh ghòbhbhughaLughghu muனbhAghabh bhòlindhabhaDhiyAl, avaighaL ghalabhbhu niRamuLLadhuM bhuLLiyuLLadhuM variyuLLadhumAன ghuDhDhighaLaibh bhoDhDhadhu.

andha ADhDhughghuDhDhighaLai yAghghobhu bhiridhdhughghòNDhu, ADhughaLai lAbhAனuDhaiya mandhaiyilirughghuM ghalabhbhuniRamAனvaighaLughghuM ghaRubhbhAனvaighaLèllAvaRRiRghuM èdhirAgha niRudhdhi, dhaன ADhughaLai lAbhAனuDhaiya mandhaiyoDhe jherghghAmal, dhaனibhbhuRamAgha vaidhdhughghòLvAன.
bhaladhdha ADhughaL bhòliyuMbhodhu, andhagh ghòbhbhughaLughghu èdhire bhòliyuMbhaDhi yAghghobhu avaighaLai andha ADhughaLiன ghaNghaLiன muனbhAghagh ghAlvAyghaLile bhoDhDhuvaibhbhAன.
bhalavIனmAன ADhughaL bhòliyuMbhodhu, avaighaLaibh bhoDhAmalirubhbhAன; idhaனAl bhalavIனmAனvaighaL lAbhAனaiyuM, bhalamuLLavaighaL yAghghobhaiyuM jherndhaன.
ivvidhamAy andhabh bhuruShaன mighavuM virudhdhiyaDhaindhu, dhiraLAன ADhughaLuM, velaighghArighaLuM, velaighghAraruM, òDhDhagha~NghaLuM, ghazhudhaighaLuM uDhaiyavaனAனAன.

bhiனbhu, lAbhAனuDhaiya ghumArar: è~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனughghu uNDhAனvaighaL yAvaiyuM yAghghobhu èDhudhdhugh ghòNDhAன èனRuM, è~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya bhòruLiனAle indhajh jhèlvadhdhaiyèllAM aDhaindhAன èனRuM jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLai yAghghobhu gheDhDhAன.
lAbhAனiன mughadhdhai yAghghobhu bhArdhdhabhodhu, adhu neRRu mundhainAL irundhadhubhol irAmal veRubhaDhDhirughghagh ghaNDhAன.
ghardhdhar yAghghobhai noghghi: uன bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya dhejhadhdhiRghuM uன iனdhdhAriDhadhdhiRghuM nI dhiruMbhibhbho; nAன uனனoDheghUDha irubhbheன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu yAghghobhu, rAghelaiyuM leyALaiyuM vèLiyile dhaன mandhaiyiDhadhdhil azhaibhbhidhdhu,
avarghaLai noghghi: u~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya mughaM neRRu mundhainAL irundhadhubhola irughghavillaiyèனRu èனghghudh dhoனRughiRadhu; AனAluM èன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya dhevaன èனனoDheghUDha irughghiRAr.
èனனAl iyaனRamaDhDhuM nAன u~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனughghu Uzhiya~njhèydheன èனRu nI~NghaL aRindhirughghiRIrghaL.
u~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனo, èனனai va~njhidhdhu, èன jhaMbhaLadhdhaibh bhadhdhumuRai mARRiனAன; AனAluM avaன èனghghudh dhI~Nghujhèyya dhevaன avaனughghu iDha~NghòDhughghavillai.

bhuLLiyuLLavaighaL uன jhaMbhaLamAyirughghuM èனRu avaன jhòனனbhodhu, ADhughaLèllAM bhuLLiyuLLa ghuDhDhighaLaibh bhoDhDhadhu; ghalabhbhu niRamAனvaighaL uன jhaMbhaLamAyirughghuM èனRu avaன jhòனனbhodhu, ADhughaLèllAM ghalabhbhuniRagh ghuDhDhighaLaibh bhoDhDhadhu.
ivvidhamAy dhevaன u~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya ADhughaLai èDhudhdhu, èனghghudh dhandhAr.

ADhughaL bhòliyuM ghAladhdhile nAன ghaNDha jhòbhbhaனdhdhil èன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubh bhArghghuMbhodhu, ADhughaLoDhe bhòliyuM ghaDhAghghaL ghalabhbhu niRamuM bhuLLiyuM variyuM uLLavaighaLAghagh ghaNDheன.
aனRiyuM dhevadhUdhaன òruvar jhòbhbhaனdhdhil yAghghobhe èனRAr; idho, irughghiReன èனReன.

abhbhòzhudhu avar: uன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubhbhAr; ADhughaLoDhe bhòliyuM ghaDhAghghaLèllAM ghalabhbhuniRamuM bhuLLiyuM variyumuLLavaighaLAy irughghiRadhu; lAbhAன uனghghujh jhèyghiRa yAvaiyuM ghaNDheன.

nI dhUNughghu abhiSheghaM jhèydhu, èனghghu òru bhòrudhdhaனaiyaibh bhaNNiன bhèdhdhelile uனghghudh dharijhaனmAன dhevaன nAனe; ibhbhòzhudhu nI èzhundhu, indhadh dhejhadhdhaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, uன iனdhdhArirughghiRa dhejhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhibhbho èனRu jhòனனAr èனRAன.
adhaRghu rAgheluM leyALuM: è~NghaL dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhil iனi è~NghaLughghubh bha~NghuM jhudhandharamuM uNDho?
avarAl nA~NghaL anniyarAy èNNabhbhaDhavillaiyA? avar è~NghaLai viRRu, è~NghaL bhaNadhdhaiyuM vAyile bhoDhDhughghòNDhAr.

AghaiyAl dhevaன è~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனiDhadhdhilirundhu èDhudhdha aijhuvariyaM èllAM namaghghuM naMmuDhaiya bhiLLaighaLughghuM uriyadhu; ibhbhaDhiyirughgha, dhevaன umaghghujh jhòனனbhaDhiyèllAM jhèyyuM èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu yAghghobhu èzhundhu, dhaன bhiLLaighaLaiyuM dhaன maனaivighaLaiyuM òDhDhagha~NghaLiனmel eRRi,

dhAன bhadhAன arAmile jhaMbhAdhidhdha mirughajIvaனghaLAghiya mandhaighaL aனaidhdhaiyuM dhaன bhòruLghaL èllAvaRRaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, ghAனAன dhejhadhdhil irughghiRa dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya IjhAghghiDhadhdhughghubh bhoghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhAன.
lAbhAன, dhaன ADhughaLai mayirghadhdharighghabh bhoyirundhAன; andhajh jhamayadhdhile rAghel dhaன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya jhòrUbha~NghaLaidh dhiruDhighghòNDhAL.
yAghghobhu dhAன oDhibhbhoghiRadhaijh jhIriyaனAghiya lAbhAனughghu aRiviyAmal, dhiruDhDhaLavAybh bhoyviDhDhAன.
ibhbhaDhiye avaன dhaனghghu uNDhAனvaighaLaiyèllAM èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, ARRaigh ghaDhandhu, ghIleyAdh malaiyai noghghi oDhibhbhoனAன.
yAghghobhu oDhibhbhoனdhu mUனRAM nALile lAbhAனughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன, dhaன jhaghodhararaigh ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, ezhunAL bhirayANabhariyandhaM avaனaidh dhòDharndhubhoy, ghIleyAdh malaiyile avaனaigh ghaNDhubhiDhidhdhAன.
aனRu rAdhdhiri dhevaன jhIriyA dhejhadhdhAனAghiya lAbhAனughghujh jhòbhbhaனdhdhil dhoனRi: nI yAghghobhoDhe naனmaiye aனRidh dhImai òனRuM bhejhAdhabhaDhighghu èjhjharighghaiyAyiru èனRAr.
lAbhAன yAghghobhiனiDhadhdhil vandhAன; yAghghobhu malaiyile dhaன ghUDhAradhdhaibh bhoDhDhirundhAன; lAbhAனuM dhaன jhaghodhararoDheghUDhagh ghIleyAdh malaiyile ghUDhAraM bhoDhDhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu lAbhAன yAghghobhai noghghi: nI dhiruDhDhaLavAybh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, èன ghumAradhdhighaLai yudhdhadhdhil bhiDhidhdha jhiRaighaLaibhbholagh ghòNDhuvandhadhu èனன jhèyghai?

nI oDhibhbhovadhai maRaidhdhu, èனghghu aRiviyAmal, dhiruDhDhaLavAy èனனiDhadhdhilirundhu vandhuviDhDhadhu èனன? nAன uனனaijh jhandhoShamAy, jha~NghIdhaM meLadhALaM ghiனனramuzhaghghadhdhuDhaனe aனubhbhuveனe.
èன bhiLLaighaLaiyuM èன ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM nAன mudhdha~njhèyya viDhAmal bhoனdhèனன? indhajh jhèyghaiyai nI madhiyillAmal jhèydhAy.

u~NghaLughghubh bhòllAbhbhujh jhèyya èனghghu vallamaiyuNDhu; AghiluM u~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya dhevaன nI yAghghobhoDhe naனmaiye aனRidh dhImai òனRuM bhejhAdhabhaDhighghu èjhjharighghaiyAyiru èனRu neRRu rAdhdhiri èனனoDhe jhòனனAr.
ibhbhòzhudhuM uன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya vIDhDhiனmeluLLa vA~njhaiyiனAl bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoghiRadhAனAl bhoghalAM, èன dhèyva~NghaLai eன dhiruDhighghòNDhubhoghiRAy èனRu gheDhDhAன.
yAghghobhu lAbhAனughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: uMmuDhaiya ghumAradhdhighaLaibh bhalAdhghAramAybh bhiDhidhdhu vaidhdhughghòLvIr èனRu nAன a~njhiனdhiனAle ibhbhaDhi vandhuviDhDheன.

ejhAviன ghumAraril dhoனRiya bhirabhughghaLAvaன: ejhAvughghu mUdhdhamaghaனAghiya èlIbhbhAjhuDhaiya ghumAraril dhemAன bhirabhu, omAr bhirabhu, jhèbhbho bhirabhu, gheனAs bhirabhu,
/ghorAghu bhirabhu, ghadhdhAM bhirabhu, amaleghghu bhirabhu èனbhavarghaL; ivara͠ΕӠύ edhoM dhejhadhdhil èlIbhbhAjhiன jhandhadhiyuM AdhALiன ghumArarumAyirundha bhirabhughghaL.

ejhAviன ghumAraனAghiya règhuveliன bhudhdhiraril naghAdh bhirabhu, jhèrAghu bhirabhu, jhaMmA bhirabhu, mIjhA bhirabhu èனbhavarghaL; ivarghaL edhoM dhejhadhdhil règhuveliன jhandhadhiyuM ejhAviன maனaiviyAghiya bhasmAdhdhiன ghumArarumAyirundha bhirabhughghaL.

ejhAviன maனaiviyAghiya agholibhAmALiன ghumArar, èyUSh bhirabhu, yAlAM bhirabhu, ghorAghu bhirabhu, èனbhavarghaL; ivarghaL AனAghiன ghumAradhdhiyuM ejhAvuDhaiya maனaiviyumAghiya agholibhAmALiன jhandhadhiyAyirundha bhirabhughghaL.
ivarghaLe edhoM èனனuM ejhAviன jhandhadhi; ivarghaLe avarghaLil irundha bhirabhughghaL.
andhadh dhejhadhdhiன ghuDhighaLAghiya oriyaனAன jheyIriன ghumArar, lodhdhAன, jhobhAl, jhibhiyoன, AனAghu,
dhiShoன, edhjher, dhiShAன èனbhavarghaL; ivarghaLe edhoM dhejhadhdhil jheyIriன bhudhdhirarAghiya oriyaruDhaiya jhandhadhiyAyirundha bhirabhughghaL.
lodhdhAனuDhaiya ghumArar, ori, emAM èனbhavarghaL; lodhdhAனiன jhaghodhari dhiMனAL èனbhavaL.
jhobhAliன ghumArar, alvAன, mAனghAdh, ebhAl, jhèbhbho, oனAM èனbhavarghaL.
jhibhiyoனiன ghumArar, ayA, AனAghu èனbhavarghaL; vaனAndharadhdhile dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya jhibhèyoனiன ghazhudhaighaLai meyghghaiyil, ghoveRu ghazhudhaighaLaigh ghaNDhubhiDhidhdha AனAghu ivaனdhAன.
AனAghiன bhiLLaighaL, dhiShoன, agholibhAmAL èனbhavarghaL; indha agholibhAmAL AனAghiன ghumAradhdhi.
dhiShoனuDhaiya ghumArar, èMdhAன, èsbhAன, idhdharAன, ghèrAன èனbhavarghaL.
edhjheruDhaiya ghumArar, bhilghAன, jhaghavAன, aghghAன èனbhavarghaL.
dhiShAனuDhaiya ghumArar, Udhs, arAன èனbhavarghaL.
oriyariன jhandhadhiyil dhoனRiya bhirabhughghaL, lodhdhAன bhirabhu, jhobhAl bhirabhu, jhibhiyoன bhirabhu, AனAghu bhirabhu,
dhiShoன bhirabhu, edhjher bhirabhu, dhiShAன bhirabhu èனbhavarghaL; ivarghaLe jheyIr dhejhadhdhile dha~NghaL dha~NghaL iDha~NghaLil irundha oriyar jhandhadhiyAன bhirabhughghaL.
isravel bhudhdhirarmel rAjAghghaL arajhALughiRadhaRghu muனனe, edhoM dhejhadhdhil ANDha rAjAghghaLAvaன:
bheyoruDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya bhelA edhomile arajhANDhAன; avaனuDhaiya bhaDhDhaNadhdhughghudh dhiனghAbhA èனRu bher.
bhelA maridhdhabhiன, bhosRA bhaDhDhaNadhdhAனAghiya jherAghuDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya yobhAbh avaன bhaDhDhadhdhiRghu vandhAன
yobhAbh maridhdhabhiன, dhemAனiya dhejhadhdhAனAghiya uShAM avaன bhaDhDhadhdhiRghu vandhAன.
uShAM maridhdhabhiன, movAbhiன nADhDhile mIdhiyAனiyarai muRiya aDhidhdha bhedhAdhiன ghumAraனAghiya AdhAdh avaன bhaDhDhadhdhiRghu vandhAன; avaனuDhaiya bhaDhDhaNadhdhughghu AvIdh èனRu bher.
AdhAdh maridhdhabhiன, masreghghA UrAனAghiya jhaMlA avaனuDhaiya bhaDhDhadhdhiRghu vandhAன.
jhaMlA maridhdhabhiன a~Nghe irughghiRa nadhighghujh jhamIbhamAன règhòbhodh èனனuM UrAனAghiya jhavul avaனuDhaiya bhaDhDhadhdhiRghu vandhAன.
jhavul maridhdhabhiன, aghbhoruDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya bhAghAlghAனAன avaனuDhaiya bhaDhDhadhdhiRghu vandhAன.

aghbhoruDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya bhAghAlghAனAன maridhdhabhiன, AdhAr avaனuDhaiya bhaDhDhadhdhiRghu vandhAன; avaனuDhaiya bhaDhDhaNadhdhughghubh bhAghu èனRu bher; avaன maனaiviyiன bher mèghadhabhel; avaன madhredhdhuDhaiya ghumAradhdhiyuM mejhaghAviன ghumAradhdhiyumAy irundhAL.

dha~NghaL bhaRbhala vaMjha~NghaLiனbhaDhiyeyuM vAjhasdhala~NghaLiனbhaDhiyeyuM nAmadheya~NghaLiனbhaDhiyeyuM ejhAviன jhandhadhiyil dhoனRiya bhirabhughghaLuDhaiya nAma~NghaLAvaன: dhiMனA bhirabhu, alvA bhirabhu, edhedh bhirabhu,
agholibhAmA bhirabhu, elA bhirabhu, bhiனoன bhirabhu,
gheனAs bhirabhu, dhemAன bhirabhu, mibhjhAr bhirabhu,
maghdhiyel bhirabhu, IrAM bhirabhu; ivarghaLe dha~NghaL jhòndhamAன dhejhadhdhile bhaRbhala iDha~NghaLil ghuDhiyirundha edhoM jhandhadhibh bhirabhughghaL; indha edhomiyarughghudh dhaghabhbhaன ejhA.
yAghghobhu dhaன dhaghabhbhaன dha~Nghiyirundha ghAனAன dhejhadhdhile ghuDhiyirundhAன.

yAghghobhuDhaiya jhandhadhiyiன varalARu: yojhebhbhu bhadhiனezhu vayadhile dhaன jhaghodhararuDhaனe ADhughaLai meydhdhughghòNDhirundhAன; andha iLai~naன bhilghAL jhilbhAL èனனuM dhaன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya maRumaனaiyADhDhighaLiன ghumAraroDhe irundhu, avarghaLuDhaiya dhuனmArghghadhdhaidh dhaன dhaghabhbhaனughghujh jhòllivaruvAன.
israveliன mudhirvayadhile yojhebhbhudh dhaனghghubh bhiRandhadhiனAl, isravel dhaன ghumArar èllAriluM avaனai adhighamAy nejhidhdhu, avaனughghubh bhalavaruNamAன a~Nghiyaijh jhèyvidhdhAன.
avaனuDhaiya jhaghodharar èllAriluM avaனaidh dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaன adhighamAy nejhighghiRadhai avaன jhaghodharar ghaNDhabhodhu, avaனoDhe bhaDhjhamAybh bhejhAmal avaனaibh bhaghaidhdhArghaL.
yojhebhbhu òru jhòbhbhaனM ghaNDhu, adhaidh dhaன jhaghodhararughghu aRividhdhAன; adhiனimidhdhaM avaனai iனனuM adhighamAybh bhaghaidhdhArghaL.
avaன avarghaLai noghghi: nAன ghaNDha jhòbhbhaனdhdhaigh gheLu~NghaL:
nAM vayalil aRudhdha arighaLaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhirundhoM; abhbhòzhudhu èனனuDhaiya arighghaDhDhu nimirndhirundhadhu; u~NghaL arighghaDhDhughaL èன arighghaDhDhaijh jhuRRi vaNa~Nghi niனRadhu èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன jhaghodharar avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: nI è~NghaLmel dhuraidhdhaனM bhaNNuvAyo? nI è~NghaLai ALabhbhoghiRAyo? èனRu jhòlli, avaனai avaன jhòbhbhaன~NghaLiன nimidhdhamuM, avaன vArdhdhaighaLiன nimidhdhamuM iனனuM adhighamAybh bhaghaidhdhArghaL.
avaன veRòru jhòbhbhaனM ghaNDhu, dhaன jhaghodhararai noghghi: nAன iனனuM òru jhòbhbhaனdhdhaigh ghaNDheன; jhUriyaனuM jhandhiraனuM bhadhiனòru naDhjhadhdhira~NghaLuM èனனai vaNa~Nghiனdhu èனRAன.

idhai avaன dhaன dhaghabhbhaனughghuM dhaன jhaghodhararughghuM jhòனனbhodhu, avaன dhaghabhbhaன avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: nI ghaNDha indhajh jhòbhbhaனM èனன? nAனuM uன dhAyAruM uன jhaghodhararuM dharaimaDhDhuM ghuனindhu uனனai vaNa~Ngha varuvomo? èனRu avaனaigh ghaDhindhughòNDhAன.
avaன jhaghodharar avaனmel bhòRAmai ghòNDhArghaL; avaன dhaghabhbhaனo avaன jhòனனdhai maனdhile vaidhdhughghòNDhAன.
bhiனbhu, avaன jhaghodharar jhIghemile dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya ADhughaLai meyghghabh bhoனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu isravel yojhebhbhai noghghi: uன jhaghodharar jhIghemile ADhughaLai meyghghiRArghaL allavA? uனனai avarghaLiDhadhdhil aனubhbhabhbhoghiReன, vA èனRAன. avaன: idho, bhoghiReன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nI bhoy, uன jhaghodhararuDhaiya emaM èbhbhaDhi èனRuM, ADhughaL èbhbhaDhi irughghiRadhu èனRuM bhArdhdhu, èனghghu maRujhèydhi ghòNDhuvA èனRu avaனughghujh jhòlli, èbhiroன bhaLLadhdhAghghile irundhu avaனai aனubhbhiனAன; andhabhbhaDhiye avaன jhIghemughghubh bhoனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu òru maனidhaன avaன vèLiyile vazhidhabhbhidh dhirighiRadhaighghaNDhu, èனன dheDhughiRAy? èனRu avaனaigh gheDhDhAன.
adhaRghu avaன: èன jhaghodhararaidh dheDhughiReன, avarghaL è~Nghe ADhu meyghghiRArghaL, jhòlluM èனRAன.

andha maனidhaன: avarghaL ivviDhadhdhilirundhu bhoyviDhDhArghaL, dhodhdhAனughghubh bhovoM èனRu avarghaL jhòllaghgheDhDheன èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu yojhebhbhu dhaன jhaghodhararaidh dhòDharndhubhoy, avarghaLaidh dhodhdhAனile ghaNDhubhiDhidhdhAன.
avarghaL avaனaidh dhUradhdhil varaghghaNDhu, avaன dha~NghaLughghujh jhamIbhamAy varumuனனe, avaனaigh ghòlaijhèyyuMbhaDhi jhadhiyojhaனaibhaNNi,
òruvarai òruvar noghghi: idho, jhòbhbhaனghghAraன varughiRAன,

nAM avaனaigh ghòனRu, indhagh ghuzhighaL òனRile avaனaibh bhoDhDhu, òru dhuShDhamirughaM avaனaibh bhaDhjhidhdhadhu èனRu jhòlluvoM vAru~NghaL; avaனuDhaiya jhòbhbhaன~NghaL èbhbhaDhi muDhiyuM bhArbhbhoM èனRArghaL.
rUbhaன adhaigh gheDhDhu, avaனai avarghaL ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvidhdhu, avaனai avaன dhaghabhbhaனiDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhavuM ghòNDhubhogha maனdhuLLavaனAy,

avarghaLai noghghi: avaனaigh ghòlla veNDhAM, nI~NghaL iradhdhaM jhindhalAghAdhu; nI~NghaL avaனmel ghai vaiyAmal, avaனai vaனAndharadhdhiluLLa indhagh ghuzhiyile bhoDhDhuviDhu~NghaL èனRu jhòlli, ivvidhamAy rUbhaன avaனai avarghaL ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvidhdhAன.
yojhebhbhu dhaன jhaghodharariDhadhdhil jherndhabhodhu, yojhebhbhu uDhudhdhighghòNDhirundha bhalavaruNa a~Nghiyai avarghaL ghazhaRRi,
avaனai èDhudhdhu, andhagh ghuzhiyile bhoDhDhArghaL; adhu dhaNNIrillAdha vèRu~NghuzhiyAyirundhadhu.

bhiனbhu, avarghaL bhojaன~njhèyyuMbhaDhi uDhghArndhArghaL; avarghaL dha~NghaL ghaNghaLai eRèDhughghuMbhodhu, idho, ghIleyAdhdhilirundhu varughiRa ismavelaruDhaiya ghUDhDhadhdhaigh ghaNDhArghaL; avarghaL èghibhdhughghugh ghòNDhubhoghuMbhaDhi ghandhavarghgha~NghaLaiyuM bhijhiன dhailadhdhaiyuM vèLLaibhbhoLadhdhaiyuM òDhDhagha~NghaLmel eRRighghòNDhu vandhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu yUdhA dhaன jhaghodhararai noghghi: nAM naM jhaghodharaனaigh ghòனRu, avaன iradhdhadhdhai maRaibhbhadhiனAl lAbhaM èனன?

avaனai indha ismavelarughghu viRRubhbhoDhuvoM vAru~NghaL; namadhu ghai avaனmel bhaDhAdhirubhbhadhAgha; avaன naMmuDhaiya jhaghodharaனuM naMmuDhaiya mAMjhamumAy irughghiRAனe èனRAன. avaன jhaghodharar avaன jhòllughghu iNa~NghiனArghaL.

andha vardhdhagharAன mIdhiyAனiyar ghaDhandhubhoghiRabhodhu, avarghaL yojhebhbhai andhagh ghuzhiyilirundhu dhUghghiyèDhudhdhu, avaனai ismavelar ghaiyil irubhadhu vèLLighghAjhughghu viRRubhbhoDhDhArghaL. avarghaL yojhebhbhai èghibhdhughghugh ghòNDhubhoனArghaL.
bhiனbhu, rUbhaன andhagh ghuzhiyiனiDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoனbhodhu, yojhebhbhu ghuzhiyil illaiyèனRu ghaNDhu, dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòNDhu,
dhaன jhaghodharariDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhi vandhu: iLai~naன illaiye, aiyo! nAன è~Nghe bhoveன èனRAன.
avarghaL yojhebhbhiன a~Nghiyai èDhudhdhu, òru vèLLADhDhugh ghaDhAvai aDhidhdhu, andha a~Nghiyai iradhdhadhdhile dhoydhdhu,
bhala varuNamAன andha a~Nghiyaidh dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனiDhadhdhughghu aனubhbhi: idhai nA~NghaL ghaNDhèDhudhdhoM, idhu uMmuDhaiya ghumAraன a~Nghiyo, allavo bhAruM èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனArghaL.
yAghghobhu adhaigh ghaNDhu, idhu èன ghumAraனuDhaiya a~NghidhAன, òru dhuShDhamirughaM avaனaibh bhaDhjhidhdhubh bhoDhDhadhu, yojhebhbhu bhIRuNDhubhoனAன èனRu bhulaMbhi,
dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhu, dhaன araiyil iraDhDhugh ghaDhDhighghòNDhu, aneghanAL dhaன ghumAraனughghAghadh dhughghidhdhughghòNDhirundhAன.

avaனuDhaiya ghumArar ghumAradhdhighaL èllAruM avaனughghu ARudhal jhòllavandhu niனRArghaL; AனAluM avaன ARudhalughghu iDha~NghòDhAmal, nAன dhughghadhdhoDhe èன ghumAraனiDhadhdhil bhAdhALadhdhil iRa~Nghuveன èனRAன. ivvidhamAy avaனuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaன avaனughghAgha azhudhughòNDhirundhAன.
andha mIdhiyAனiyar yojhebhbhai èghibhdhile bhArvoனiன bhiradhAனiyuM dhalaiyArighaLughghu adhibhadhiyumAghiya bhodhdhibhAr èனbhavaனiDhadhdhil viRRArghaL.
aghghAladhdhile yUdhA dhaன jhaghodhararai viDhDhu, adhullAM UrAனAghiya IrA èனனuM òru maனidhaனiDhadhdhil bhoyjhjherndhAன.
a~Nghe yUdhA, jhUvA èனனuM bheruLLa òru ghAனAனiyaனuDhaiya ghumAradhdhiyaigh ghaNDhu, avaLai vivAghaMbhaNNi, avaLoDhe jherndhAன.
avaL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL; avaனughghu er èனRu bheriDhDhAன.
avaL maRubhaDhiyuM gharbhbhavadhiyAghi òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu, avaனughghu oனAன èனRu bheriDhDhAL.
avaL maRubhaDhiyuM gharbhbhavadhiyAghi òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu, avaனughghujh jhelA èனRu bheriDhDhAL; avaL ivaனaibh bhèRughiRabhodhu, avaன ghèjhIbhile irundhAன.
yUdhA dhaன mUdhdhamaghaனAghiya er èனbhavaனughghudh dhAmAr èனனuM bheruLLa òru bhèNNaigh ghòNDhAன.
yUdhAviன mUdhdhamaghaனAghiya er èனbhavaன ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghubh bhòllAdhavaனAyirundhadhiனAl, ghardhdhar avaனai azhidhdhubh bhoDhDhAr.
abhbhòzhudhu yUdhA oனAனai noghghi: nI uன dhamaiyaன maனaiviyaijh jherndhu, avaனai maidhdhuனjh jhudhandharamAybh bhaDhaidhdhu, uன dhamaiyaனughghujh jhandhadhiyai uNDhAghghu èனRAன.

andhajh jhandhadhi dhaன jhandhadhiyAyirAdhèனRu oனAன aRindhabhaDhiyiனAle, avaன dhaன dhamaiyaனuDhaiya maனaiviyaijh jheruMbhodhu, dhaன dhamaiyaனughghujh jhandhadhiyuNDhAghAdhabhaDhighghudh dhaன vidhdhaidh dharaiyile vizhaviDhDhugh ghèDhudhdhAன.
avaன jhèydhadhu ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghubh bhòllAdhadhAyirundhadhiனAl, avaனaiyuM avar azhidhdhubhbhoDhDhAr.

abhbhòzhudhu yUdhA, dhaன ghumAraனAghiya jhelAvuM avaன jhaghodharar jhèdhdhadhubholajh jhAvAன èனRu a~njhi, dhaன marumaghaLAன dhAmArai noghghi: èன ghumAraனAghiya jhelA bhèriyavaனAghumaDhDhuM, nI uன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhile ghaiMbhèNNAydh dha~Nghiyiru èனRu jhòனனAன; andhabhbhaDhiye dhAmAr bhoydh dhaன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhile dha~NghiyirundhAL.

aneghanAL jhèனRabhiன, jhUvAviன ghumAradhdhiyAghiya yUdhAviன maனaivi maridhdhAL. yUdhAviனuDhaiya dhughghaM ARiனbhiன, avaன adhullAM UrAனAghiya dhaன jhineghidhaன IrAvuDhaனe dhiMனAvile dhaன ADhughaLai mayirghghadhdharighghiRavarghaLiDhadhdhiRghubh bhoனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu: uன mAmaனAr dhaMmuDhaiya ADhughaLai mayirghghadhdharighghadh dhiMனAvughghubh bhoghiRAr èனRu dhAmArughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

jhelA bhèriyavaனAghiyuM dhAன avaனughghu maனaiviyAghagh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhavillai èனRu avaL ghaNDhabhaDhiyAl, dhaன ghaiMbhèNmaighghuriya vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghaLaindhubhoDhDhu, mughghADhiDhDhudh dhaனனai mUDhighghòNDhu, dhiMனAvughghubh bhoghiRa vazhiyilirughghiRa nIrURRughaLughghu muனbhAgha uDhghArndhAL.
yUdhA avaLaigh ghaNDhu, avaL dhaன mughadhdhai mUDhiyirundhabhaDhiyAl, avaL òru vejhi èனRu niனaidhdhu,
andha vazhiyAy avaLiDhadhdhil bhoy, avaL dhaன marumaghaL èனRu aRiyAmal: nAன uனனiDhadhdhil jheruMbhaDhi varuvAyA èனRAன; adhaRghu avaL: nIr èனனiDhadhdhil jheruMbhaDhi, èனghghu èனன dharuvIr èனRAL.
adhaRghu avaன: nAன mandhaiyilirundhu òru vèLLADhDhugh ghuDhDhiyai aனubhbhughiReன èனRAன. adhaRghu avaL: nIr adhai aனubhbhumaLavuM òru aDhaimAனM ghòDhubhbhIrA èனRAL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nAன uனghghu aDhaimAனmAgha èனன ghòDhughghaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu avaL: uMmuDhaiya mudhdhirai modhiramuM uMmuDhaiya AramuM uMmuDhaiya ghaighgholuM ghòDhughghaveNDhuM èனRAL. avaன avaighaLai avaLughghugh ghòDhudhdhu, avaLiDhadhdhil jherndhAன; avaL avaனAle gharbhbhavadhiyAghi,
èzhundhubhoy, dhaன mughghADhDhaigh ghaLaindhu, dhaன ghaiMbhèNmaighghuriya vasdhira~NghaLai uDhudhdhighghòNDhAL.

yUdhA andha sdhirIyiனiDhadhdhil irundha aDhaimAனdhdhai vA~NghighghòNDhu varuMbhaDhi adhullAM UrAனAghiya dhaன jhineghidhaன ghaiyile òru vèLLADhDhughghuDhDhiyaigh ghòDhudhdhaனubhbhiனAன; avaன avaLaigh ghANAmal,
avviDhadhdhu maனidharai noghghi: vazhiyaNDhai nIrURRughaL arughe irundha dhAjhi è~Nghe èனRu gheDhDhAன; adhaRghu avarghaL: i~Nghe dhAjhi illai èனRArghaL.
avaன yUdhAviனiDhadhdhil dhiruMbhi vandhu: avaLaigh ghANoM, a~Nghe dhAjhi illaiyèனRu avviDhadhdhu maனidharuM jhòllughiRArghaL èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu yUdhA: idho, indha ADhDhughghuDhDhiyai aனubhbhiனeன, nI avaLaigh ghANavillai; namaghghu avaghIrdhdhi varAdhabhaDhighghu, avaL adhaigh ghòNDhubhoனAl bhoghaDhDhuM èனRAன.

eRaghghuRaiya mUனRumAdhaM jhèனRabhiனbhu uன marumaghaLAghiya dhAmAr vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNiனAL, andha vejhidhdhaனdhdhiனAl gharbhbhavadhiyumAனAL èனRu yUdhAvughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu. abhbhòzhudhu yUdhA: avaLai vèLiye ghòNDhuvAru~NghaL, avaL jhuDhDhèrighghabhbhaDhaveNDhuM èனRAன.

avaL vèLiye ghòNDhuvarabhbhaDhDhabhodhu, avaL dhaன mAmaனiDhadhdhughghu andha aDhaimAனdhdhai aனubhbhi: indhabh bhòruDhghaLai uDhaiyavaன èvaனo avaனAle nAன gharbhbhavadhiyAனeன; indha mudhdhirai modhiramuM indha AramuM indhagh gholuM yAruDhaiyavaighaL bhAruM èனRu jhòlli aனubhbhiனAL.
yUdhA avaighaLaibh bhArdhdhaRindhu èனனiluM avaL nIdhiyuLLavaL; avaLai èன ghumAraனAghiya jhelAvughghugh ghòDhAmaRbhoனeனe èனRAன. abhbhuRaM avaன avaLaijh jheravillai.
avaLughghubh bhirajhavaghAlaM vandhabhodhu, avaL gharbhbhadhdhil iraDhDhaibh bhiLLaighaL irundhaன.
avaL bhèRughiRabhodhu, òru bhiLLai ghaiyai nIDhDhiனdhu; abhbhòzhudhu marudhdhuvajhjhi adhiன ghaiyaibh bhiDhidhdhu, adhil jhivabhbhu nUlaigh ghaDhDhi, idhu mudhalAvadhu vèLibhbhaDhDhadhu èனRAL.

adhu dhaன ghaiyaidh dhiruMbha uLLe vA~NghighghòNDhabhodhu, adhiன jhaghodharaன vèLibhbhaDhDhAன. abhbhòzhudhu avaL: nI mIRivandhadhèனன, indha mIRudhal uனmel niRghuM èனRAL; adhiனAle avaனughghubh bhAres èனRu bheriDhabhbhaDhDhadhu.
bhiRbhADhu ghaiyil jhivabhbhunUl ghaDhDhiyirundha avaனuDhaiya dhaMbhi vèLibhbhaDhDhAன; avaனughghu jherA èனRu bheriDhabhbhaDhDhadhu.

yojhebhbhu èghibhdhughghugh ghòNDhubhoghabhbhaDhDhAன. bhArvoனuDhaiya bhiradhAனiyuM dhalaiyArighaLughghu adhibhadhiyumAghiya bhodhdhibhAr èனனuM èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhAன avaனai avviDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvandha ismavelariDhadhdhil vA~NghiனAன.
ghardhdhar yojhebhbhoDhe irundhAr, avaன ghAriyajhidhdhiyuLLavaனAனAன; avaன èghibhdhiyaனAghiya dhaன èjamAனuDhaiya vIDhDhile irundhAன.
ghardhdhar avaனoDhe irughghiRAr èனRuM avaன jhèyghiRa yAvaiyuM ghardhdhar vAyghghabhbhaNNughiRAr èனRuM, avaன èjamAன ghaNDhu:
yojhebhbhiனiDhadhdhil dhayavuvaidhdhu, avaனaidh dhaனghghu UzhiyaghghAraனuM dhaன vIDhDhughghu vijhAraNaighghAraனumAghghi, dhaனghghu uNDhAன yAvaRRaiyuM avaன ghaiyil òbhbhuvidhdhAன.

avaனaidh dhaன vIDhDhughghuM dhaனghghu uNDhAன èllAvaRRiRghuM vijhAraNaighghAraனAghghiனdhumudhaRghòNDhu, ghardhdhar yojhebhbhiனimidhdhaM andha èghibhdhiyaன vIDhDhai AjhIrvadhidhdhAr; vIDhDhiluM vèLiyiluM avaனughghu uNDhAனvaighaL èllAvaRRiluM ghardhdharuDhaiya AjhIrvAdhaM irundhadhu.

AghaiyAl, avaன dhaனghghu uNDhAனdhaiyèllAM yojhebhbhiன ghaiyile òbhbhughghòDhudhdhuviDhDhu, dhAன bhujhighghiRa bhojaனMdhavira dhaனனiDhadhdhilirundha maRRòனRaighghuRidhdhuM vijhAriyAdhirundhAன. yojhebhbhu azhaghAன rUbhamuM jhèLandhariya mughamuM uLLavaனAyirundhAன.
jhilanAL jhèனRabhiன, avaனuDhaiya èjamAனனiன maனaivi yojhebhbhiனmel ghaNbhoDhDhu, èனனoDhe jhayaனi èனRAL.

avaனo dhaன èjamAனuDhaiya maனaiviyiன jhòllughghu iNa~NghAmal, avaLai noghghi: idho vIDhDhile èனனiDhadhdhil irughghiRavaighaLil yAdhòனRaighghuRidhdhuM èன ANDhavaன vijhAriyAmal, dhamaghghu uNDhAன èllAvaRRaiyuM èன ghaiyil òbhbhidhdhirughghiRAr.

indha vIDhDhile èனனiluM bhèriyavaன illai; nI avaruDhaiya maனaiviyAyirughghiRabhaDhiyAl uனனaidhdhavira veRòனRaiyuM avar èனghghu vilaghghi vaighghavillai. ibhbhaDhiyirughgha, nAன idhdhaனai bhèriya bhòllA~Nghughghu uDhaனbhaDhDhu, dhevaனughghu virodhamAybh bhAvaM jhèyvadhu èbhbhaDhi èனRAன.
avaL nidhdhaM nidhdhaM yojhebhbhoDhe ibhbhaDhibh bhejhighghòNDhu vandhuM, avaன avaLuDhaனe jhayaனighghavuM avaLuDhaனe irughghavuM jhaMmadhighghavillai.
ibhbhaDhiyirughghuMbhodhu, òrunAL avaன dhaன velaiyaijh jhèyghiRadhaRghu vIDhDhiRghuL bhoனAன; vIDhDhu maனidharil òruvaruM vIDhDhil illai.
abhbhòzhudhu avaL avaனuDhaiya vasdhiradhdhaibh bhaRRibh bhiDhidhdhu, èனனoDhe jhayaனi èனRAன. avaனo dhaன vasdhiradhdhai avaL ghaiyile viDhDhu vèLiye oDhibhbhoனAன.
avaன dhaன vasdhiradhdhai avaL ghaiyile viDhDhu vèLiye oDhibhbhoனdhai avaL ghaNDhabhodhu,

avaL dhaன vIDhDhu maனidharaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu: bhAru~NghaL, èbhirèya maனuShaன naMmiDhadhdhil jharajhaMbhaNNuMbhaDhighghu avaனai namaghghuL ghòNDhuvandhAr, avaன èனனoDhe jhayaனighghuMbhaDhighghu èனனiDhadhdhil vandhAன; nAன mighundha jhadhdhamiDhDhugh ghUbhbhiDhDheன.
nAன jhadhdhamiDhDhugh ghUbhbhiDhughiRadhai avaன gheDhDhu, dhaன vasdhiradhdhai èனனiDhadhdhil viDhDhu, vèLiye oDhibhbhoyviDhDhAன èனRu jhòனனAL.
avaனuDhaiya èjamAன vIDhDhughghu varumaLavuM avaனuDhaiya vasdhiradhdhaidh dhaனனiDhadhdhil vaidhdhirundhu,
avaனai noghghi: nIr naMmiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvandha andha èbhirèya velaighghAraன jharajhaMbhaNNuMbhaDhighghu èனனiDhadhdhil vandhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu nAன jhadhdhamiDhDhugh ghUbhbhiDhDheன, avaன dhaன vasdhiradhdhai èனனiDhadhdhil viDhDhu vèLiye oDhibhbhoனAன èனRAL.
uMmuDhaiya velaighghAraன èனghghu ibhbhaDhijh jhèydhAன èனRu dhaன maனaivi dhaனனoDhe jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLai avaன èjamAன gheDhDhabhodhu, avaனughghugh ghobhaM mUNDhadhu.
yojhebhbhiன èjamAன avaனaibh bhiDhidhdhu, rAjAviன ghaDhDhaLaiyAl ghAvalil vaighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaL irughghuM jhiRaijhjhAlaiyile avaனai òbhbhuvidhdhAன. andhajh jhiRaijhjhAlaiyil avaன irundhAன.
ghardhdharo yojhebhbhoDhe irundhu, avaனmel ghirubhai vaidhdhu, jhiRaijhjhAlaidh dhalaivaனuDhaiya dhayavu avaனughghugh ghiDhaighghuMbhaDhi jhèydhAr.
jhiRaijhjhAlaidh dhalaivaன jhiRaijhjhAlaiyil vaighghabhbhaDhDha yAvaraiyuM yojhebhbhiன ghaiyile òbhbhuvidhdhAன; a~Nghe avarghaL jhèyvadhèllAvaRRaiyuM yojhebhbhu jhèyvidhdhAன.

ghardhdhar avaனoDhe irundhabhaDhiyiனAluM, avaன èdhaijh jhèydhAனo adhaigh ghardhdhar vAyghghabhbhaNNiனbhaDhiyiனAluM, avaன vajhamAyirundha yAdhòனRaiyuM ghuRidhdhujh jhiRaijhjhAlaidh dhalaivaன vijhArighghavillai.
indha naDhabhaDhighaLughghubh bhiனbhu, èghibhdhu rAjAvughghubh bhAனbhAdhdhiraghghAraனuM jhuyaMbhAghiyuM èghibhdhu rAjAvAghiya dha~NghaL ANDhavaனughghugh ghuRRaM jhèydhArghaL.
bhArvoன dhaன bhAனbhAdhdhiraghghArariன dhalaivaனuM jhuyaMbhAghighaLiன dhalaivaனuM Aghiya ivviraNDhu bhiradhAனighaL meluM ghaDhu~Nghobha~NghòNDhu,
avarghaLai yojhebhbhu vaighghabhbhaDhDhirundha iDhamuM dhalaiyArighaLiன adhibhadhiyiன vIDhumAghiya jhiRaijhjhAlaiyile ghAvalbhaNNuvidhdhAன.
dhalaiyArighaLiன adhibhadhi avarghaLai vijhArighghuMbhaDhi yojhebhbhiன vajhadhdhil òbhbhuvidhdhAன; avaன avarghaLai vijhAridhdhuvandhAன; avarghaL aneghanAL ghAvalil irundhArghaL.
èghibhdhu rAjAvughghu bhAனbhAdhdhiraghghAraனuM jhuyaMbhAghiyumAghiya avviraNDhubheruM jhiRaijhjhAlaiyil irughghuMbhodhu, òre rAdhdhiriyile vèvveRu bhòruLghòNDha jhòbhbhaனM ghaNDhArghaL.
ghAlame yojhebhbhu avarghaLiDhadhdhil bhoy, avarghaLaibh bhArghghuMbhodhu, avarghaL ghala~NghiyirundhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன èjamAனuDhaiya vIDhDhil dhaனனoDhe ghAvalbhaNNabhbhaDhDhirundha bhArvoனuDhaiya bhiradhAனighaLai noghghi: u~NghaL mugha~NghaL iனRu dhughghamAyirughghiRadhu èனன èனRu gheDhDhAன.

adhaRghu avarghaL: jhòbhbhaனM ghaNDhoM, adhaRghu ardhdhaM jhòllughiRavaன òruvaனuM illai èனRArghaL. adhaRghu yojhebhbhu: jhòbhbhaனdhdhughghu ardhdhaM jhòlludhal dhevaனughghuriyadhallavA? avaighaLai èனனiDhadhdhil jhòllu~NghaL èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhAனbhAdhdhiraghghArariன dhalaivaன yojhebhbhai noghghi: èன jhòbhbhaனdhdhile òru dhirADhjhaijh jhèDhi èனghghu muனbhAgha irughghagh ghaNDheன.
andhadh dhirADhjhaijh jhèDhiyile mUனRu ghòDhighaL irundhadhu; adhu dhuLirghghiRadhAyirundhadhu; adhil bhUghghaL malarndhirundhadhu; adhiன ghulaighaL bhazhudhdha bhazha~NghaLAyirundhadhu.

bhArvoனuDhaiya bhAdhdhiraM èன ghaiyile irundhadhu; nAன andhabh bhazha~NghaLaibh bhaRidhdhu, avaighaLaibh bhArvoனuDhaiya bhAdhdhiradhdhil bhizhindhu, andhabh bhAdhdhiradhdhaibh bhArvoனuDhaiya ghaiyile ghòDhudhdheன èனRu, dhaன jhòbhbhaனdhdhaijh jhòனனAன.
adhaRghu yojhebhbhu: andha mUனRu ghòDhighaLuM mUனRu nALAM.

mUனRu nALaighghuLLe bhArvoன uன dhalaiyai uyardhdhi, uனனai maRubhaDhiyuM uன nilaiyile niRudhdhuvAr; muனனe avarughghubh bhAனM ghòDhudhdhuvandha vazhaghghadhdhiனbhaDhi bhArvoனiன bhAdhdhiradhdhai avar ghaiyile ghòDhubhbhAy;

idhudhAன adhiன ardhdhaM èனRu jhòனனdhuM aனRi, nI vAzhvaDhaindhirughghuMbhodhu, èனனai niனaidhdhu, èனmel dhayavuvaidhdhu, èன ghAriyadhdhaibh bhArvoனughghu aRividhdhu, indha iDhadhdhilirundhu èனனai viDhudhalaiyAghghaveNDhuM.
nAன èbhirèyaruDhaiya dhejhadhdhilirundhu ghaLavAygh ghòNDhuvarabhbhaDhDheன; èனனai indhagh ghAval ghiDha~Nghil vaighghuMbhaDhighghuM nAன ivviDhadhdhil òனRuM jhèyyavillai èனRuM jhòனனAன.
ardhdhaM naனRAyirughghiRadhu èனRu jhuyaMbhAghighaLiன dhalaivaன ghaNDhu, yojhebhbhai noghghi: nAனuM èன jhòbhbhaனdhdhil mUனRu vèLLaigh ghUDhaighaL èன dhalaiyiனmel irughghagh ghaNDheன;

meRghUDhaiyile bhArvoனughghAghajh jhamaighghabhbhaDhDha jhaghalavidha bhalaghAra~NghaLiluM ghò~njhaM ghò~njhaM irundhadhu; èன dhalaiyiனmel ghUDhaiyil irundhavaighaLaibh bhaRavaighaL vandhu bhaDhjhidhdhadhu èனRAன.
adhaRghu yojhebhbhu: andha mUனRu ghUDhaighaLuM mUனRu nALAM.
iனனuM mUனRu nALaighghuLLe bhArvoன uன dhalaiyai uyardhdhi, uனனai maradhdhile dhUghghibhbhoDhuvAr; abhbhòzhudhu bhaRavaighaL uன mAMjhadhdhaidh dhiனனuM, idhudhAன adhiன ardhdhaM èனRu jhòனனAன.

mUனRAMnAL bhArvoனuDhaiya jaனma nALAyirundhadhu; avaன dhaன UzhiyaghghArar èllArughghuM virundhubhaNNi, bhAனbhAdhdhiraghghAraruDhaiya dhalaivaன dhalaiyaiyuM jhuyaMbhAghighaLuDhaiya dhalaivaன dhalaiyaiyuM dhaன udhdhiyoghasdhariன naDhuve uyardhdhi,
bhAனbhAdhdhiraghghArariன dhalaivaனaibh bhAன~NghòDhughghiRa dhaன udhdhiyoghadhdhile maRubhaDhiyuM vaidhdhAன; andhabhbhaDhiye avaன bhArvoனuDhaiya ghaiyile bhAdhdhiradhdhaigh ghòDhudhdhAன.
jhuyaMbhAghighaLiன dhalaivaனaiyo dhUghghibhbhoDhDhAன. yojhebhbhu avarghaLughghujh jhòனன ardhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiye jhaMbhavidhdhadhu.
AனAluM bhAனbhAdhdhiraghghArariன dhalaivaன yojhebhbhai niனaiyAmal avaனai maRandhuviDhDhAன.
iraNDhu varuShaM jhèனRabhiனbhu, bhArvoன òru jhòbhbhaனM ghaNDhAன; adhu èனனvèனRAl, avaன nadhiyaNDhaiyile niனRughòNDhirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu azhaghuM bhuShDhiyumAன ezhu bhajhughghaL nadhiyilirundhu eRivandhu bhul meyndhadhu.
avaighaLiனbhiன avalaDhjhaNamuM ghevalamumAன veRe ezhu bhajhughghaL nadhiyilirundhu eRivandhu, nadhi oradhdhil maRRabh bhajhughghaLaNDhaiyile niனRadhu.
avalaDhjhaNamuM ghevalamumAன bhajhughghaL azhaghuM bhuShDhiyumAன ezhu bhajhughghaLaiyuM bhaDhjhidhdhubhbhoDhDhadhu; ibhbhaDhibh bhArvoன ghaNDhu vizhidhdhughghòNDhAன.
maRubhaDhiyuM avaன nidhdhirai jhèydhu, iraNDhAMvijhai òru jhòbhbhaனM ghaNDhAன; nalla jhèzhumaiyAன ezhu ghadhirghaL òre dhALilirundhu o~Nghi vaLarndhadhu.
bhiனbhu, jhAviyAனdhuM ghIzhghghARRiனAl dhIyndhadhumAன ezhu ghadhirghaL muLaidhdhadhu.
jhAviyAன ghadhirghaL jhèzhumaiyuM niRaimeனiyumAன andha ezhu ghadhirghaLaiyuM vizhu~NghibhbhoDhDhadhu; abhbhòzhudhu bhArvoன vizhidhdhughghòNDhu, adhu jhòbhbhaனM èனRu aRindhAன.

ghAlame bhArvoனuDhaiya maனM ghalaghgha~NghòNDhirundhadhu; abhbhòzhudhu avaன èghibhdhiluLLa jhaghala mandhiravAdhighaLaiyuM jhaghala jhAsdhirighaLaiyuM azhaibhbhidhdhu, avarghaLughghudh dhaன jhòbhbhaனdhdhaijh jhòனனAன; òruvarAluM adhiன ardhdhadhdhaibh bhArvoனughghujh jhòllagh ghUDhAmaRbhoyiRRu.
abhbhòzhudhu bhAனbhAdhdhiraghghArariன dhalaivaன bhArvoனai noghghi: nAன jhèydha ghuRRaM iனRudhAன èன niனaivil vandhadhu.
bhArvoன dhaMmuDhaiya UzhiyaghghArarmel ghaDhu~Nghobha~NghòNDhu, èனனaiyuM jhuyaMbhAghighaLiன dhalaivaனaiyuM dhalaiyArighaLiன adhibhadhi vIDhAghiya jhiRaijhjhAlaiyile vaidhdhirundha ghAladhdhil,
nAனuM avaனuM òre rAdhdhiriyile vèvveRu bhòruLghòNDha jhòbhbhaனM ghaNDhoM.

abhbhòzhudhu dhalaiyArighaLiன adhibhadhighghu velaighghAraனAghiya èbhirèya bhiLLaiyANDhAன òruvaன a~Nghe è~NghaLoDhe irundhAன; avaனiDhadhdhil avaighaLaijh jhòனனoM, avaன nA~NghaL ghaNDha jhòbhbhaன~NghaLughghuriya vèvveRu ardhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiye è~NghaL jhòbhbhaனdhdhiன bhayaனaijh jhòனனAன.
avaன è~NghaLughghujh jhòlliya ardhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiye naDhandhadhu; èனனaidh dhiruMbha èன nilaiyile niRudhdhi, avaனaidh dhUghghibhbhoDhuvidhdhAr èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhArvoன yojhebhbhai azhaibhbhidhdhAன; avaனaidh dhIviramAygh ghAvalghiDha~Nghilirundhu ghòNDhuvandhArghaL. avaன jhavaraMbhaNNighghòNDhu, veRu vasdhiraM dharidhdhu, bhArvoனiDhadhdhil vandhAன.

bhArvoன yojhebhbhai noghghi: òru jhòbhbhaனM ghaNDheன; adhiன ardhdhadhdhaijh jhòlla òruvaruM illai; nI òru jhòbhbhaனdhdhaigh gheDhDhAl, adhiன ardhdhadhdhaijh jhòlluvAy èனRu uனனaighghuRidhdhu nAன gheLvibhbhaDhDheன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu yojhebhbhu bhArvoனughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: nAன alla, dhevaனe bhArvoனughghu ma~NghaLamAன udhdharavu aruLijh jhèyvAr èனRAன.
bhArvoன yojhebhbhai noghghi: èன jhòbhbhaனdhdhile, nAன nadhiyoradhdhil niனRughòNDhirundheன.
azhaghuM bhuShDhiyumAன ezhu bhajhughghaL nadhiyilirundhu eRi vandhu bhulmeyndhadhu.
avaighaLiனbhiன iLaidhdhadhuM maghA avalaDhjhaNamuM ghevalamumAன veRe ezhu bhajhughghaL eRivandhadhu; ivaighaLaibh bhola avalaDhjhaNamAன bhajhughghaLai èghibhdhu dhejhamè~NghuM nAன ghaNDhadhillai.
ghevalamuM avalaDhjhaNamumAன bhajhughghaL ghòzhumaiyAன mundhiன ezhu bhajhughghaLaiyuM bhaDhjhidhdhubh bhoDhDhadhu.
avaighaL ivaighaLiன vayiRRughghuL bhoyuM, vayiRRughghuL bhoyiRRèனRu dhoனRAmal, muன irundhadhu bholave avalaDhjhaNamAyirundhadhu; ibhbhaDhigh ghaNDhu vizhidhdhughghòNDheன.
bhiனனuM nAன èன jhòbhbhaனdhdhile, niRaimeனiyuLLa ezhu nalla ghadhirghaL òre dhAzhilirundhu o~Nghi vaLaraghghaNDheன.

jhAviyAன ghadhirghaL andha ezhu nalla ghadhirghaLaiyuM vizhu~NghibhbhoDhDhadhu. idhai mandhiravAdhighaLiDhadhdhil jhòனனeன; idhiன bhòruLai èனghghu viDhuvighghiRavaன òruvaனuM illai èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu yojhebhbhu bhArvoனai noghghi: bhArvoனiன jhòbhbhaனM òனRudhAன; dhevaன dhAM jhèyyabhbhoghiRadhu iனனdhèனRu bhArvoனughghu aRividhdhirughghiRAr.
andha ezhu nalla bhajhughghaLuM ezhu varuShamAM; andha ezhu nalla ghadhirghaLuM ezhu varuShamAM; jhòbhbhaனM òனRe.

avaighaLiன bhiன eRivandha ghevalamuM avalaDhjhaNamumAன ezhu bhajhughghaLuM ezhu varuShamAM; ghIzhghARRiனAl dhIyndhu jhAviyAன ezhu ghadhirghaLuM ezhu varuShamAM; ivaighaL bha~njhamuLLa ezhu varuShamAM.
bhArvoனughghu nAன jhòllaveNDhiya ghAriyaM idhuve; dhevaன dhAM jhèyyabhbhoghiRadhaibh bhArvoனughghugh ghANbhidhdhirughghiRAr.
èghibhdhu dhejhamè~NghuM bharibhUraNamAன viLaivu uNDhAyirughghuM ezhu varuShaM varuM.
adhaனbhiன bha~njhamuNDhAyirughghuM ezhu varuShaM varuM; abhbhòzhudhu èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhil andhabh bharibhUraNamèllAM maRaghghabhbhaDhDhubhbhoM; andhabh bha~njhaM dhejhadhdhaibh bhAzhAghghuM.
varabhbhoghiRa maghA ghòDhumaiyAன bha~njhadhdhAl dhejhadhdhil muனனirundha bharibhUraNamèllAM òzhindhubhoM.
indhagh ghAriyaM dhevaனAl nijhjhayabhbhaDhDhirughghiRadhu èனbhadhaiyuM, dhevaன idhaijh jhIghghiradhdhil jhèyvAr èனbhadhaiyuM ghuRighghuMbhòruDhDhu, indhajh jhòbhbhaனM bhArvoனughghu iraDhDhidhdhadhu.
AghaiyAl viveghamuM ~nAனmumuLLa òru maனuShaனaidh dheDhi, avaனai èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhughghu adhighAriyAghabh bhArvoன eRbhaDhudhdhuvArAgha.

ibhbhaDhibh bhArvoன jhèydhu, dhejhadhdhiனmel vijhAraNaighghArarai vaidhdhu, bharibhUraNamuLLa ezhu varuSha~NghaLil èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhile viLaiyuM viLaijhjhalil aindhil òru bha~Nghai vA~NghuMbhaDhi jhèyvArAgha.

avarghaL varabhbhoghiRa nalla varuSha~NghaLil viLaiyuM dhAனiya~NghaLaiyèllAM jherdhdhu, bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLil AghAraM uNDhAyirughghuMbhaDhighghu, bhArvoனuDhaiya adhighAradhdhughghuLLAghadh dhAனiya~NghaLaibh bhadhdhirabhbhaDhudhdhi vaidhdhuvaibhbhArghaLAgha.

dhejhaM bha~njhadhdhiனAl azhindhu bhoghAdhabhaDhighghu, andhadh dhAனiyaM iனi èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhil uNDhAghuM bha~njhamuLLa ezhu varuSha~NghaLughghAgha dhejhadhdhiRghu òru vaibhbhAyirubhbhadhAgha èனRAன.
indha vArdhdhai bhArvoனuDhaiya bhArvaighghuM avaன èllAruDhaiya bhArvaighghuM naனRAygh ghaNDhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu bhArvoன dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai noghghi: dheva Aviyaibh bhèRRa indha maனuShaனaibhbhola veRòruvaன uNDho èனRAன.
bhiனbhu, bhArvoன yojhebhbhai noghghi: dhevaன ivaiyèllAvaRRaiyuM uனghghu vèLibhbhaDhudhdhiyirughghiRabhaDhiyAl, uனனaibhbhola viveghamuM ~nAனmumuLLavaன veRòruvaனuM illai.
nI èன aramaனaighghu adhighAriyAyirubhbhAy; uன vAghghiனbhaDhiye èன jaன~NghaL èllAruM aDha~Nghi naDhaghghagh ghaDhavarghaL; jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhil mAdhdhiraM uனனiluM nAன bhèriyavaனAy irubhbheன èனRAன.
bhiனனuM bhArvoன yojhebhbhai noghghi: bhAr, èghibhdhu dhejhaM muzhumaighghuM uனனai adhighAriyAghghiனeன èனRu jhòlli,

bhArvoன dhaன ghaiyil bhoDhDhirundha dhaன mudhdhirai modhiradhdhaigh ghazhaRRi, adhai yojhebhbhiன ghaiyile bhoDhDhu, mèlliya vasdhira~NghaLai, avaனughghu uDhudhdhi, bhòன jharabhbhaNiyai avaன ghazhudhdhile dharidhdhu,
dhaனனuDhaiya iraNDhAM iradhadhdhiனmel avaனai eRRi, dhèNDhaனiDhDhubh bhaNiyu~NghaL èனRu avaனughghu muனbhAghagh ghURuvidhdhu, èghibhdhudhejhaM muzhumaighghuM avaனai adhighAriyAghghiனAன.
bhiனனuM bhArvoன yojhebhbhai noghghi: nAன bhArvoன; AனAluM èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhiluLLavarghaLil òruvaனuM uன udhdharavillAmal dhaன ghaiyaiyAvadhu dhaன ghAlaiyAvadhu ajhaighghagh ghUDhAdhu èனRAன.

meluM, bhArvoன yojhebhbhughghu jhAbhnAdhbhaனனeyA èனghiRa bhèyaraiyiDhDhu; oனbhaDhDhaNadhdhu AjhAriyaனAghiya bhodhdhibhirAviன ghumAradhdhiyAghiya AsnAdhdhai avaனughghu maனaiviyAghagh ghòDhudhdhAன. yojhebhbhu èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhaijh jhuRRibhbhArghghuMbhaDhi bhuRabhbhaDhDhAன.

yojhebhbhu èghibhdhiன rAjAvAghiya bhArvoனughghu muனbhAgha niRghuMbhodhu mubhbhadhu vayadhAyirundhAன; yojhebhbhu bhArvoனuDhaiya jhannidhiyilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, èghibhdhudhejhaM è~NghuM bhoyjh jhuRRibhbhArdhdhAன.
bharibhUraNamuLLa ezhu varuSha~NghaLiluM bhUmi mighudhiyAன bhalaனaigh ghòDhudhdhadhu.

avvezhu varuSha~NghaLil èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhil viLaindha dhAனiya~NghaLaiyèllAM avaன jherdhdhu, andhadh dhAனiya~NghaLaibh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLil ghaDhDhivaidhdhAன; andhandhabh bhaDhDhaNadhdhil adhiனdhiன jhuRRubhbhuRadhdhudh dhAனiya~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhivaidhdhAன.
ibhbhaDhi yojhebhbhu aLaviRandhadhAygh ghaDhaRgharai maNalaibh bhola mighudhiyAghadh dhAனiyadhdhaijh jherdhdhuvaidhdhAன; adhu aLavughghu aDha~NghAdhadhAyirundhadhu.

bha~njhamuLLa varuSha~NghaL varuvadhaRghu muனனe yojhebhbhughghu iraNDhu ghumArarghaL bhiRandhArghaL; avarghaLai oன bhaDhDhaNadhdhu AjhAriyaனAghiya bhodhdhibhirAviன ghumAradhdhiyAghiya AsnAdhdhu avaனughghubh bhèRRAL.
yojhebhbhu: èன varudhdhaM yAvaiyuM èன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya ghuDhuMbhaM aனaidhdhaiyuM nAன maRaghghuMbhaDhi dhevaன bhaNNiனAr èனRu jhòlli, mUdhdhavaனughghu maனAjhe èனRu bheriDhDhAன.
nAன jhiRumaibhbhaDhDhirundha dhejhadhdhil dhevaன èனனaibh bhalughabhbhaNNiனAr èனRu jhòlli iLaiyavaனughghu èbhbhirAyIM èனRu bheriDhDhAன.
èghibhdhudhejhadhdhil vandha bharibhUraNamuLLa ezhu varuSha~NghaLuM muDhindhabhiன,
yojhebhbhu jhòlliyabhaDhi ezhu varuSha bha~njhaM dhòDha~Nghiனdhu; jhaghala dhejha~NghaLiluM bha~njhaM uNDhAyiRRu; AனAluM èghibhdhudhejhamè~NghuM AghAraM irundhadhu.

èghibhdhudhejhamè~NghuM bha~njhaM uNDhAனbhodhu, jaன~NghaL uNavughghAghabh bhArvoனai noghghi: olamiDhDhArghaL; adhaRghubh bhArvoன: nI~NghaL yojhebhbhiனiDhadhdhughghubh bhoy, avaன u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiRabhaDhi jhèyyu~NghaL èனRu èghibhdhiyar èllArughghuM jhòனனAன.
dhejhamè~NghuM bha~njhaM uNDhAனbhaDhiyAl, yojhebhbhu ghaLa~njhiya~NghaLaiyèllAM dhiRandhu, èghibhdhiyarughghu viRRAன; bha~njhaM èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhil varavaragh ghòDhidhAyiRRu.
jhaghala dhejha~NghaLiluM bha~njhaM ghòDhidhAyirundhabhaDhiyAl, jhaghala dhejhadhdhArghaLuM yojhebhbhiனiDhadhdhil dhAனiyaM ghòLLuMbhaDhi èghibhdhughghu vandhArghaL.
èghibhdhile dhAனiyaM uNDhèனRu yAghghobhu aRindhu, dhaன ghumArarai noghghi: nI~NghaL òruvar mughadhdhai òruvar bhArdhdhughghòNDhirughghiRadhu èனன?
èghibhdhile dhAனiyaM uNDhèனRu gheLvibhbhaDhughiReன; nAM jhAghAmal uyiroDhirughghuMbhaDhi nI~NghaL avviDhadhdhughghubh bhoy namaghghAghadh dhAனiyaM ghòLLu~NghaL èனRAன.
yojhebhbhiன jhaghodharar bhadhdhubhbher dhAனiya~NghòLLa èghibhdhughghubh bhoனArghaL.
yojhebhbhiன dhaMbhiyAghiya bhèனyamIனughghu edho mojhaM varuM èனRu jhòlli, yAghghobhu avaனai avaன jhaghodhararoDhu aனubhbhavillai.
ghAனAன dhejhadhdhile bha~njhaM uNDhAyirundhabhaDhiyAl, dhAனiyaM ghòLLabhbhoghiRavarghaLuDhaனeghUDha israveliன ghumAraruM bhoனArghaL.
yojhebhbhu adhdhejhadhdhughghu adhibhadhiyAyirundhu, dhejhadhdhiன jaன~NghaL yAvarughghuM viRRAன. yojhebhbhiன jhaghodharar vandhu, mugha~NghubhbhuRadh dharaiyile vizhundhu avaனai vaNa~NghiனArghaL.

yojhebhbhu avarghaLaibh bhArdhdhu, dhaன jhaghodharar èனRu aRindhughòNDhAன; aRindhuM aRiyAdhavaனbholagh ghaDhiனmAy avarghaLoDhe bhejhi: nI~NghaL è~Ngheyirundhu vandhIrghaL èனRu gheDhDhAன; adhaRghu avarghaL: ghAனAன dhejhadhdhilirundhu dhAனiyaM ghòLLa vandhoM èனRArghaL.
yojhebhbhu avarghaLaidh dhaன jhaghodharar èனRu aRindhuM, avarghaL avaனai aRiyavillai.
yojhebhbhu avarghaLaigh ghuRidhdhudh dhAன ghaNDha jhòbhbhaன~NghaLai niனaidhdhu, avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL vevughArar, dhejhaM è~Nghe dhiRandhu ghiDhaghghiRadhu èனRu bhArghgha vandhIrghaL èனRAன.
adhaRghu avarghaL: abhbhaDhiyalla, ANDhavaனe, umadhu aDhiyArAghiya nA~NghaL dhAனiyaM ghòLLa vandhoM.
nA~NghaL èllAruM òru dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya bhiLLaighaL; nA~NghaL nijasdhar; umadhu aDhiyAr vevughArar alla èனRArghaL.
adhaRghu avaன: abhbhaDhiyalla, dhejhaM è~Nghe dhiRandhu ghiDhaghghiRadhu èனRu bhArghghave vandhIrghaL èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL: umadhu aDhiyArAghiya nA~NghaL bhaனனiraNDhu jhaghodharar; ghAனAன dhejhadhdhil irughghiRa òru dhaghabhbhaன bhudhdhirar; iLaiyavaன ibhbhòzhudhu è~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனiDhadhdhil irughghiRAன; òruvaன ghANAmaRbhoனAன èனRArghaL.
yojhebhbhu avarghaLai noghghi: u~NghaLai vevughArar èனRu nAன jhòனனdhu jhari.
u~NghaL iLaiya jhaghodharaன i~Nghe vandhAlòzhiya nI~NghaL i~Ngheyirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhuvadhu illai èனRu bhArvoனiன jIvaனaighghòNDhu ANaiyiDhDhujh jhòllughiReன.

idhiனAle nI~NghaL jhodhighghabhbhaDhuvIrghaL; u~NghaL jhaghodharaனai azhaidhdhuvaruMbhaDhi u~NghaLil òruvaனai aனubhbhu~NghaL; u~NghaLiDhadhdhil uNmaiyuNDho illaiyo èனRu u~NghaL vArdhdhaighaL jhodhighghabhbhaDhumaLavuM, nI~NghaL ghAvalil irughghaveNDhuM; illAviDhDhAl, nI~NghaL vevughArardhAன èனRu bhArvoனiன jIvaனaighghòNDhu ANaiyiDhDhujh jhòllughiReன èனRu jhòlli,
avarghaL èllAraiyuM mUனRunAL ghAvalile vaidhdhAன.
mUனRAM nALile yojhebhbhu avarghaLai noghghi: nAன dhevaனughghubh bhayabhbhaDhughiRavaன; nI~NghaL uyiroDhe irughghuMbhaDhighghu òனRu jhèyyu~NghaL.

nI~NghaL nijasdharAனAl, jhaghodhararAghiya u~NghaLil òruvaன ghAvaR ghUDhadhdhil ghaDhDhuNDhirughghaDhDhuM; maRRavarghaL bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, bha~njhadhdhiனAl varundhughiRa u~NghaL ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghudh dhAனiyaM ghòNDhubhoygh ghòDhudhdhu,

u~NghaL iLaiya jhaghodharaனai èனனiDhadhdhughghu azhaidhdhughghòNDhuvAru~NghaL; abhbhòzhudhu u~NghaL vArdhdhaighaL mèyyèனRu viLa~NghuM; nI~NghaL jhAvadhillai èனRAன. avarghaL abhbhaDhijh jhèyghiRadhaRghu ijhaindhu:

naMmuDhaiya jhaghodharaனughghu nAM jhèydha dhuroghaM naMmel jhumandhadhu; avaன naMmaigh ghè~njhi veNDhighghòNDhabhodhu, avaனuDhaiya maன viyAghuladhdhai nAM ghaNDhuM, avaனughghujh jhèvighòDhAmaRbhoனome; AghaiyAl indha Abhadhdhu namaghghu neriDhDhadhu èனRu òruvarai òruvar bhArdhdhujh jhòllighghòNDhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu rUbhaன avarghaLaibh bhArdhdhu: iLai~naனughghu virodhamAghabh bhAva~njhèyyAdhiru~NghaL èனRu nAன u~NghaLughghujh jhòllavillaiyA? nI~NghaL gheLAmaRbhoனIrghaL; ibhbhòzhudhu, idho, avaன iradhdhabhbhazhi naMmiDhadhdhil vA~NghabhbhaDhughiRadhu èனRAன.
yojhebhbhu dhubhAjhiyaighghòNDhu avarghaLiDhadhdhil bhejhiனbhaDhiyAl, dhA~NghaL jhòனனdhu avaனughghudh dhèriyuM èனRu aRiyAdhirundhArghaL.
avaன avarghaLai viDhDhu abhbhuRaM bhoy azhudhu, dhiruMbha avarghaLiDhadhdhil vandhu, avarghaLoDhe bhejhi, avarghaLil jhimiyoனaibh bhiDhidhdhu, avarghaL ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAghagh ghaDhDhuvidhdhAன.

bhiனbhu, avarghaL jhAghghughaLaidh dhAனiyadhdhAl nirabhbhavuM, avarghaL bhaNadhdhaidh dhiruMbha avaனvaன jhAghghile bhoDhavuM, vazhighghu veNDhiya AghAradhdhaigh ghòDhughghavuM yojhebhbhu ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAன; abhbhaDhiye avarghaLughghujh jhèyyabhbhaDhDhadhu.
avarghaL andhadh dhAனiyadhdhaidh dha~NghaL ghazhudhaighaLmel eRRighghòNDhu, avviDhaMviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனArghaL.
dha~NghughiRa iDhadhdhile avarghaLil òruvaன dhaன ghazhudhaighghudh dhIvaனMbhoDhadh dhaன jhAghghaidh dhiRandhabhodhu, jhAghghiன vAyile dhaன bhaNaM irughghiRadhaigh ghaNDhu,

dhaன jhaghodhararaibh bhArdhdhu, èன bhaNaM dhiruMbha vandhirughghiRadhu; idho, adhu èன jhAghghile irughghiRadhu èனRAன. abhbhòzhudhu avarghaLuDhaiya irudhayaM jhorndhubhoy, avarghaL bhayandhu, òruvarai òruvar bhArdhdhu, dhevaன namaghghu ibhbhaDhijh jhèydhadhu èனன èனRArghaL.
avarghaL ghAனAன dhejhadhdhiluLLa dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனAghiya yAghghobhiனiDhadhdhil vandhu, dha~NghaLughghujh jhaMbhavidhdhavaighaLaiyèllAM avaனughghu aRividhdhu,
dhejhadhdhughghu adhibhadhiyAyirughghiRavaன è~NghaLai dhejhadhdhai vevubhArghgha vandhavarghaL èனRu èNNi è~NghaLoDhe ghaDhiனmAybh bhejhiனAன.
nA~NghaLo avaனai noghghi: nA~NghaL nijasdhar, vevughArar alla.
nA~NghaL bhaனனiraNDhu jhaghodharar, òru dhaghabhbhaன bhudhdhirar, òruvaன ghANAmaRbhoனAன, iLaiyavaன ibhbhòzhudhu ghAனAன dhejhadhdhil è~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனiDhadhdhil irughghiRAன èனRoM.

abhbhòzhudhu dhejhadhdhiன adhibhadhiyAனvaன: nI~NghaL nijasdhar èனbhadhai nAன aRiyuMbhaDhi u~NghaL jhaghodhararil òruvaனai nI~NghaL èனனiDhadhdhil viDhDhu, bha~njhadhdhiனAl varundhughiRa u~NghaL ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghudh dhAனiyaM vA~NghighghòNDhubhoygh ghòDhudhdhu,

adhaRghu yAghghobhu: nAன bharadhejhiyAyjh jha~njharidhdha nADhghaL nURRu mubhbhadhu varuShaM; èன AyujhunADhghaL ghò~njhamuM jha~njhalamuLLadhumAyirughghiRadhu; avaighaL bharadhejhighaLAyjh jha~njharidhdha èன bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya Ayujhu nADhghaLughghu vandhu èDhDhavillai èனRu bhArvoனuDhaனe jhòனனAன.
bhiனனuM yAghghobhu bhArvoனai AjhIrvadhidhdhu, avaன jhamughadhdhiனiனRu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனAன.

bhArvoன ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye, yojhebhbhu dhaன dhaghabhbhaனughghuM dhaன jhaghodhararughghuM èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhile nalla nADhAghiya rAmajhes èனனuM nADhDhile jhudhandharaM ghòDhudhdhu, avarghaLaigh ghuDhiyeRRiனAன.

yojhebhbhu dhaன dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM dhaன jhaghodhararaiyuM dhaன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya ghuDhuMbhadhdhAr aனaivaraiyuM, avaravarghaL ghuDhuMbhadhdhiRghudhdhaghghadhAy AghAraM ghòDhudhdhu Adharidhdhu vandhAன.
bha~njhaM mighavuM ghòDhidhAyirundhadhu; dhejhamè~NghuM AghAraM ghiDhaiyAmaR bhoyiRRu; èghibhdhu dhejhamuM ghAனAன dhejhamuM bha~njhadhdhiனAle mèlindhu bhoyiRRu.
yojhebhbhu èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhiluM ghAனAன dhejhadhdhilumuLLa bhaNadhdhaiyèllAM dhAனiyaM ghòNDhavarghaLiDhadhdhil vA~Nghi, adhaibh bhArvoன aramaனaiyile ghòNDhubhoyjh jherdhdhAன.

èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhiluM ghAனAன dhejhadhdhilumuLLa bhaNaM jhèlavazhindhabhodhu, èghibhdhiyar èllAruM yojhebhbhiனiDhadhdhil vandhu è~NghaLughghu AghAraM dhAruM; bhaNaM illai, adhiனAl nA~NghaL umadhu jhamughadhdhil jhAghaveNDhumo èனRArghaL
adhaRghu yojhebhbhu: u~NghaLiDhadhdhil bhaNaM illAmaRbhoனAl, u~NghaL ADhumADhughaLaigh ghòDhu~NghaL; avaighaLughghubh bhadhilAgha u~NghaLughghudh dhAனiyaM ghòDhughghiReன èனRAன.

avarghaL dha~NghaL ADhumADhu mudhalAனvaighaLai yojhebhbhiனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvandhArghaL; yojhebhbhu ghudhiraighaLaiyuM ADhughaLaiyuM mADhughaLaiyuM ghazhudhaighaLaiyuM vA~Nghigh ghòNDhu, andha varuShaM avarghaLuDhaiya ADhumADhu mudhalAன èllAvaRRiRghuM bhadhilAgha avarghaLughghu AghAraM ghòDhudhdhu, avarghaLai AdharidhdhAன.

andha varuShaM muDhindhabhiன, maRuvaruShadhdhile avarghaL avaனiDhadhdhil vandhu: bhaNamuM jhèlavazhindhu bhoyiRRu; è~NghaL ADhumADhu mudhalAனvaighaLuM è~NghaL ANDhavaனaijh jherndhadhu; è~NghaL jharIramuM nilamume òzhiya, è~NghaL ANDhavaனughghu muனbhAgha mIdhiyAனdhu òனRuM illai; idhu è~NghaL ANDhavaனughghudh dhèriyAdha ghAriyaM alla.

nA~NghaLuM è~NghaL nila~NghaLuM uMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha azhindhu bhoghalAmA? nIr è~NghaLaiyuM è~NghaL nila~NghaLaiyuM vA~NghighghòNDhu, AghAraM ghòDhughghaveNDhuM; nA~NghaLuM è~NghaL nila~NghaLuM bhArvoனughghu AdhIனmAyirubhbhoM; nA~NghaL jhAghAmal uyiroDhirughghavuM, nila~NghaL bhAzhAybh bhoghAmalirughghavuM, è~NghaLughghu vidhaidh dhAனiyadhdhaidh dhAruM èனRArghaL.

abhbhaDhiye èghibhdhiyar dha~NghaLughghubh bha~njhaM meliDhDhabhaDhiyAl avaravar dha~NghaL dha~NghaL vayal nila~NghaLai viRRArghaL; yojhebhbhu èghibhdhiன nila~NghaL yAvaiyuM bhArvoனughghAghagh ghòNDhAன; ivvidhamAy andhabh bhUmi bhArvoனuDhaiyadhAyiRRu.
meluM avaன èghibhdhiன òru èllai mudhal maRu èllaivaraighghumuLLa jaன~NghaLai andhandhabh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLil ghuDhimARibhbhoghabhbhaNNiனAன.

AjhAriyaruDhaiya niladhdhai mAdhdhiraM avaன ghòLLavillai; adhu bhArvoனAle AjhAriyarughghu mAனiyamAghagh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhirundhadhiனAluM, bhArvoன avarghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdha mAனiyadhdhiனAle avarghaL jIvaனMbhaNNivandhadhiனAluM, avarghaL dha~NghaL niladhdhai viRghavillai.

bhiனனuM yojhebhbhu jaன~NghaLai noghghi: idho, iனRu u~NghaLaiyuM u~NghaL nila~NghaLaiyuM bhArvoனughghAgha vA~NghighghòNDheன; idho, u~NghaLughghugh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhughiRa vidhaidhdhAனiyaM; idhai niladhdhil vidhaiyu~NghaL.

viLaivil aindhil òru bha~Nghaibh bhArvoனughghugh ghòDhughghaveNDhuM; maRRa nAlubha~NghuM vayalughghu vidhaiyAghavuM u~NghaLughghuM u~NghaL ghuDhuMbhadhdhArughghuM u~NghaL ghuzhandhaighaLughghuM AghAramAghavuM u~NghaLuDhaiyadhAyirughghaDhDhuM èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL: nIr è~NghaL bhirANaனaigh ghAbhbhARRiனIr; è~NghaL ANDhavaனuDhaiya ghaNghaLil è~NghaLughghudh dhayavu ghiDhaighghaveNDhuM; nA~NghaL bhArvoனughghu aDhimaighaLAyirughghiRoM èனRArghaL.

aindhil òனRu bhArvoனughghujh jheruM vAraM èனRu yojhebhbhu iDhDha ghaDhDhaLaibhbhaDhi èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhile innALvaraighghuM naDhandhu varughiRadhu; AjhAriyariன nilaM mAdhdhiraM bhArvoனaijh jherAmal nI~NghalAyirundhadhu.
isravelar èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhiluLLa ghojheன nADhDhile ghuDhiyirundhArghaL; a~Nghe nila~NghaLaigh ghaiyADhjhi jhèydhu, mighavuM bhalughibh bhèrughiனArghaL.
yAghghobhu èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhile bhadhiனezhu varuShaM irundhAன; yAghghobhuDhaiya Ayujhu nADhghaL nURRu nARbhadhdhezhu varuShaM.

isravel maraNamaDhaiyuM ghAlaM jhamIbhidhdhadhu. abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன ghumAraனAghiya yojhebhbhai varavazhaidhdhu, avaனai noghghi: èனmel uனghghudh dhayavuNDhAனAl, uன ghaiyai èன dhòDhaiyiனghIzh vaidhdhu èனmel bhaDhjhamuM uNmaiyumuLLavaனAyiru; èனனai èghibhdhile aDhaghghaMbhaNNAdhirubhbhAyAgha.

nAன èன bhidhAghghaLoDhe bhaDhudhdhughghòLLaveNDhuM; AghaiyAl, nI èனனai èghibhdhilirundhu èDhudhdhughghòNDhubhoy, avarghaLai aDhaghghaMbhaNNiyirughghiRa niladhdhile èனனaiyuM aDhaghghaMbhaNNu èனRAன. adhaRghu avaன: umadhu jhòRbhaDhi jhèyveன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன: èனghghu ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhu èனRAன; avaனughghu ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhudhdhAன. abhbhòzhudhu isravel ghaDhDhiliன dhalaimADhDhile jhAyndhu dhòzhudhughòNDhAன.

adhaRghubhbhiனbhu, uMmuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaனArughghu varudhdhamAyirughghiRadhu èனRu yojhebhbhughghujh jhòllabhbhaDhDhadhu. abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன iraNDhu ghumArarAghiya maனAjheyaiyuM èbhbhIrAyImaiyuM dhaனனoDheghUDhagh ghòNDhubhoனAன.

idho, uMmuDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya yojhebhbhu uMmiDhadhdhil vandhirughghiRAr èனRu yAghghobhughghujh aRivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu; abhbhòzhudhu isravel dhaனனaidh dhiDhabhbhaDhudhdhigh ghòNDhu, ghaDhDhiliனmel uDhghArndhAன.
yAghghobhu yojhebhbhai noghghi: jharvavallamaiyuLLa dhevaன ghAனAன dhejhadhdhiluLLa luUs èனனuM iDhadhdhil èனghghudh dharijhaனmAghi, èனனai AjhIrvadhidhdhu:

nAன uனனaibh bhalughavuM bhèrughavuM bhaNNi, uனனaibh bhala jaனghghUDhDhamAghghi, uனghghubh bhiனvaruM uன jhandhadhighghu indhadh dhejhadhdhai nidhdhiya jhudhandharamAghagh ghòDhubhbheன èனRu èனனoDhe jhòனனAr.

nAன uனனiDhadhdhil èghibhdhughghu varumuனனe uனghghu èghibhdhudhejhadhdhil bhiRandha uன iraNDhu ghumAraruM èனனuDhaiya ghumArar; rUbhaன jhimiyoன èனbhavarghaLaibhbhola, èbhbhIrAyImuM maனAjheyuM èனனuDhaiyavarghaL.
ivarghaLughghubhbhiன, nI bhèRuM bhiLLaighaL uனனuDhaiyavarghaL; avarghaL dha~NghaL dha~NghaL jhaghodhararuDhaiya bherAl azhaighghabhbhaDhDhu avarghaLughghuriya jhudhandharadhdhil bha~NghubhèRuvArghaL.

nAன bhadhAனaiviDhDhu varughaiyil, ghAனAன dhejhadhdhil èbhbhirAdhdhAvughghugh ghò~njhaM dhUraM irughghuMbhodhu, vazhiyile rAghel èனனNDhaiyile maraNamaDhaindhAL; avaLai a~Nghe bhèdhlagheM èனனuM èbhbhirAdhdhA Urughghubh bhoghiRa vazhiyile aDhaghghaMbhaNNiனeன èனRAன.
isravel yojhebhbhiன ghumAraraibh bhArdhdhu: ivarghaL yAr èனRu gheDhDhAன.
yojhebhbhu dhaன dhaghabhbhaனai noghghi: ivarghaL ivviDhadhdhil dhevaன aruLiன ghumArar èனRAன. abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nAன avarghaLai AjhIrvadhighghuMbhaDhi avarghaLai èன ghiDhDhaghghòNDhuvA èனRAன.

mudhirvayadhiனAl israveliன ghaNghaL ma~NghalAyirundhabhaDhiyAl, avaன naனRAybh bhArghghagh ghUDhAdhirundhadhu. avarghaLai avaனNDhaiyile jherabhbhaNNiனAன; abhbhòzhudhu avaன avarghaLai mudhdha~njhèydhu aNaidhdhughghòNDhAன.
isravel yojhebhbhai noghghi: uன mughadhdhaigh ghANbheன èனRu nAன niனaighghavillai; AனAluM idho, uன jhandhadhiyaiyuM ghANuMbhaDhi dhevaன èனghghu aruL jhèydhAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaனuDhaiya muzha~NghAlghaL naDhuve irundha bhiLLaighaLai yojhebhbhu bhiனனiDhabhbhaNNi, avaனuDhaiya mughadhdhughghu muனbhAghadh dharaimaDhDhuM ghuனindhu vaNa~NghiனAன.

bhiனbhu, yojhebhbhu avviruvaraiyuM ghòNDhuvandhu, èbhbhirAyImaidh dhaன valadhu ghaiyiனAle israveliன iDhadhu ghaighghu nerAghavuM, maனAjheyaidh dhaன iDhadhughaiyiனAle israveliன valadhughaighghu nerAghavuM viDhDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu isravel, maனmaRiya, dhaன valadhughaiyai nIDhDhi, iLaiyavaனAghiya èbhbhirAyImuDhaiya dhalaiyiனmeluM, maனAjhe mUdhdhavaனAyirundhuM, dhaன iDhadhughaiyai maனAjheyuDhaiya dhalaiyiனmeluM vaidhdhAன.
avaன yojhebhbhai AjhIrvadhidhdhu: èன bhidhAghghaLAghiya AbhiraghAmuM IjhAghghuM vazhibhaDhDhu vaNa~Nghiya dhevaனuM, nAன bhiRandha nALmudhal innALvaraighghuM èனனai Adharidhdhuvandha dhevaனuM,

èllAdh dhImaighghuM nI~NghalAghghi èனனai mIDhDha dhUdhaனumAனvar indhabh bhiLLaighaLai AjhIrvadhibhbhArAgha, èனbheruM èன bhidhAghghaLAghiya AbhiraghAM IjhAghghu èனbhavarghaLiன bheruM ivarghaLughghu iDhabhbhaDhaghghaDhavadhu; bhUmiyil ivarghaL mighudhiyAybh bhèrughaghghaDhavarghaL èனRAன.

dhaghabhbhaன dhaன valadhughaiyai èbhbhirAyImuDhaiya dhalaiyiனmel vaidhdhadhai yojhebhbhu ghaNDhu, adhu dhaனghghubh bhiriyamillAdhabhaDhiyAl, èbhbhIrAyImuDhaiya dhalaiyiனmel irundha dhaன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya ghaiyai maனAjheyiனuDhaiya dhalaiyiனmel vaighghuMbhaDhighghu èDhudhdhu:
èன dhaghabhbhaனe, abhbhaDhiyalla, ivaன mUdhdhavaன, ivaனuDhaiya dhalaiyiனmel uMmuDhaiya valadhughaiyai vaighghaveNDhuM èனRAன.

avaன dhaghabhbhaனo dhaDhudhdhu: adhu èனghghudh dhèriyuM, èன maghaனe, èனghghudh dhèriyuM; ivaனuM òru jaனghghUDhDhamAvAன, ivaனuM bhèrughuvAன; ivaனuDhaiya dhaMbhiyo ivaனiluM adhighamAybh bhèrughuvAன; avaனuDhaiya jhandhadhiyAr dhiraLAன jaன~NghaLAvArghaL èனRAன.

ivvidhamAgha avaன aனRaidhdhiனM avarghaLai AjhIrvadhidhdhu: dhevaன uனனai èbhbhirAyImaibhbholavuM maனAjheyaibhbholavuM AghghuvArAgha èனRu isravelar uனனai muனனiDhDhu vAzhdhdhuvArghaL èனRu jhòlli, èbhbhirAyImai maனAjheghghu muனனe vaidhdhAன.
bhiனbhu, isravel yojhebhbhai noghghi: idho, nAன maraNamaDhaiyabhbhoghiReன; dhevaன u~NghaLoDhe irubhbhAr; avar u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLiன dhejhadhdhughghu u~NghaLaidh dhiruMbhavuM bhoghabhbhaNNuvAr èனRuM,

uன jhaghodhararughghugh ghòDhudhdhadhaibhbhArghghiluM, nAன èன bhaDhDhayadhdhAluM, èன villiனAluM, èmoriyar ghaiyilirundhu jhaMbhAdhidhdha òru niladhdhai uனghghu adhighamAன bha~NghAghagh ghòDhudhdheன èனRuM jhòனனAன.
yAghghobhu dhaன ghumArarai azhaidhdhu: nI~NghaL ghUDhivAru~NghaL, ghaDhaijhi nADhghaLil u~NghaLughghu neriDhuM ghAriya~NghaLai aRivibhbheன.
yAghghobhiன ghumArare, ghUDhivandhu gheLu~NghaL; u~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனAghiya isravelughghujh jhèvighòDhu~NghaL.
rUbhaனe, nI èன jheShDhabhudhdhiraன; nI èன jhadhdhuvamuM, èன mudhaRbhèlaனumAனvaன; nI meனmaiyil bhiradhAனmuM vallamaiyil vijheShamumAனvaன.
dhaNNIraibhbholadh dhaLaMbhiனvaனe, nI meனmai aDhaiyamADhDhAy; uன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya ma~njhadhdhiனmel eRiனAy; nI adhaidh dhIDhDhubhbhaDhudhdhiனAy; èன bhaDhughghaiyiனmel eRiனAனe.
jhimiyoனuM, leviyuM egha jhaghodharar; avarghaLuDhaiya bhaDhDhaya~NghaL ghòDhumaiyiன gharuvighaL.

èன AdhdhumAve, avarghaLuDhaiya iraghajhiya Alojhaனaighghu uDhaனbhaDhAdhe; èன meனmaiye, avarghaL ghUDhDhadhdhil nI jherAdhe: avarghaL dha~NghaL ghobhadhdhiனAle òru bhuruShaனaigh ghòனRu, dha~NghaL agha~NghAradhdhiனAle araNghaLai nirmUlamAghghiனArghaLe.
ughghiramAன avarghaL ghobhamuM ghòDhumaiyAன avarghaL mUrghghamuM jhabhighghabhbhaDhaghghaDhavadhu; yAghghobhile avarghaLaibh bhiriyavuM, isravelile avarghaLaijh jhidhaRavuM bhaNNuveன.
yUdhAve, jhaghodhararAl bhughazhabhbhaDhubhavaன nIye; uன gharaM uன jhadhdhurughghaLuDhaiya bhiDhariyiனmel irughghuM; uன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya bhudhdhirar uனmuன bhaNivArghaL.
yUdhA bhAlajhi~NghaM, nI irai ghavarndhughòNDhu eRibhbhoனAy: èன maghaனe, jhi~NghaMbholuM ghizhajhjhi~NghaMbholuM maDha~Nghibh bhaDhudhdhAன: avaனai èzhubhbhughiRavaன yAr?
jhamAdhAன ghardhdhar varumaLavuM jhè~Nghol yUdhAvaiviDhDhu nI~NghuvadhuM illai, niyAyabhbhiramANighghaன avaன bhAdha~NghaLai viDhDhu òzhivadhuM illai; jaன~NghaL avariDhadhdhil jheruvArghaL.

avaன dhaன ghazhudhaigh ghuDhDhiyaidh dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyiluM dhaன ghoLighaigh ghazhudhaighaLiன ghuDhDhiyai naRghula dhirADhjhaijh jhèDhiyiluM ghaDhDhuvAன; dhirADhjharajhadhdhile dhaன vasdhiradhdhaiyuM, dhirADhjhabh bhazha~NghaLiன iradhdhadhdhile dhaன a~NghiyaiyuM dhoybhbhAன.
avaன ghaNghaL dhirADhjharajhadhdhiனAl jhivabhbhAyuM, avaன bhaRghaL bhAliனAl vèNmaiyAyuM irughghuM.
jhèbhuloன ghaDhaldhuRai arughe ghuDhiyirubhbhAன; avaன ghabhbhal dhuRaimughamAy irubhbhAன; avaன èllai jhIdhoன varaighghuM irughghuM.
ijhaghghAr iraNDhu bhòdhiyiன naDhuve bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhirughghiRa bhaladhdha ghazhudhai.
avaன, iLaibhbhARudhal nalladhu èனRuM nADhu vajhadhiyAனdhu èனRuM ghaNDhu, jhumaghghiRadhaRghudh dhaன dhoLaijh jhAydhdhu, bhaghudhighaDhDhughiRavaனAனAன.
dhAN isravel ghodhdhira~NghaLil òru ghodhdhiramAghi, dhaன jaனdhdhai niyAyaM vijhAribhbhAன.

dhAN, ghudhiraiyiனmel eRiyirughghiRavaன mallAndhu vizhuMbhaDhiyAy adhiன ghudhighAlaigh ghaDhighghiRadhaRghu vazhiyil ghiDhaghghiRa jharbhbhadhdhaibh bholavuM, bhAdhaiyil irughghiRa viriyaனaibhbholavuM irubhbhAன.
ghardhdhAve, uMmuDhaiya iraDhjhibhbhughghugh ghAdhdhirughghiReன.
ghAdh èனbhavaனmel rANuvaghghUDhDhaM bhAyndhuvizhuM; avaனo muDhivile adhiனmel bhAyndhuvizhuvAன.
AjheruDhaiya AghAraM ghòzhumaiyAyirughghuM; rAjAghghaLughghu veNDhiya rujhivarghgha~NghaLai avaன dharuvAன.
nabhdhali viDhudhalaibhèRRa bhèNmAன; iனbhamAன vajhaன~NghaLai vajhaனibhbhAன.
yojhebhbhu ghaனidharuM jhèDhi: avaன nIr URRaNDhaiyiluLLa ghaனidharuM jhèDhi: adhiன ghòDhighaL jhuvariனmel bhaDharuM.

AனAluM, avaனuDhaiya vil uRudhiyAy niனRadhu; avaன bhuya~NghaL yAghghobhuDhaiya vallavariன ghara~NghaLAl bhaladhdhaன; idhiனAl avaன meybhbhaனuM israveliன ghaனmalaiyuM AனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu meybhbharghaL vandhu, avarghaLaidh dhuradhdhiனArghaL; mojhe èzhundhirundhu, avarghaLughghudh dhuNainiனRu, avarghaLuDhaiya ADhughaLughghudh dhaNNIr ghADhDhiனAன.
avarghaL dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனAghiya règhuveliDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu, avaன: nI~NghaL iனRu idhdhaனai jhIghghiramAy vandhadhu èனன èனRu gheDhDhAன.
adhaRghu avarghaL: èghibhdhiyaன òruvaன meybhbhariன ghaighaLughghu è~NghaLaidh dhabhbhuvidhdhu, è~NghaLughghudh dhaNNIr mòNDhu ghòDhudhdhu, ADhughaLughghuM dhaNNIr ghADhDhiனAன èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன ghumAradhdhighaLaibh bhArdhdhu: avaன è~Nghe? andha maனidhaனai nI~NghaL viDhDhu vandhadhu èனன? bhojaனMbhaNNuMbhaDhighghu avaனai azhaidhdhughghòNDhu vAru~NghaL èனRAன.
mojhe andha maனidhaனiDhadhdhil dha~Nghiyirughghajh jhaMmadhidhdhAன. avaன jhibhbhorAL èனனuM dhaன ghumAradhdhiyai mojheghghugh ghòDhudhdhAன.
avaL òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL. nAன anniya dhejhadhdhil bharadhejhiyAy irughghiReன èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghu ghèrjhoM èனRu bheriDhDhAன.

jhilaghAlaM jhèனRabhiன, èghibhdhiன rAjA maridhdhAன. isravel bhudhdhirar aDhimaidhdhaனdhdhiனAl dhavidhdhu, muRaiyiDhDhughghòNDhirundhArghaL; avarghaL aDhimaidhdhaனdhdhilirundhu muRaiyiDhuM jhadhdhaM dhevajhannidhiyil èDhDhiனdhu.
dhevaன avarghaL bhèrumUjhjhaigh gheDhDhu, dhAM AbhiraghAmoDhuM IjhAghghoDhuM yAghghobhoDhuM jhèydha uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai niனaivu ghUrndhAr.
dhevaன isravel bhudhdhiraraigh ghaNNoghghiனAr; dhevaன avarghaLai niனaidhdharuLiனAr.

mojhe mIdhiyAன dhejhadhdhu AjhAriyaனAyirundha dhaன mAmaனAghiya èdhdhiroviன ADhughaLai meydhdhu vandhAன. avaன ADhughaLai vaனAndharadhdhiன bhiன bhuRadhdhile oDhDhi, dhevabharvadhamAghiya orebhmaDhDhuM vandhAன.

a~Nghe ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar òru muDhjhèDhiyiன naDhuvilirundhu uNDhAன aghghiனijuvAlaiyile niனRu avaனughghudh dharijhaனmAனAr. abhbhòzhudhu avaன uRRubhbhArdhdhAன; muDhjhèDhi aghghiனiyAl juvAlidhdhu èrindhuM, adhu vèndhubhoghAmal irundhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu mojhe: indha muDhjhèDhi vèndhu bhoghAdhirughghiRadhu èனன, nAன ghiDhDhabhbhoy indha aRbhudhaghADhjhiyaibh bhArbhbheன èனRAன.
avaன bhArghghuMbhaDhi ghiDhDha varughiRadhaigh ghardhdhar ghaNDhAr. muDhjhèDhiyiன naDhuvilirundhu dhevaன avaனai noghghi: mojhe, mojhe èனRu ghUbhbhiDhDhAr. avaன: idho, aDhiyeன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avar: i~Nghe ghiDhDhijh jherAyAgha; uன ghAlghaLil irughghiRa bhAdharaDhjhaiyaigh ghazhaRRibhbhoDhu; nI niRghiRa iDhaM bharijhudhdha bhUmi èனRAr.

bhiனனuM avar: nAன AbhiraghAmiன dhevaனuM IjhAghghiன dhevaனuM yAghghobhiன dhevaனumAghiya uன bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya dhevaனAyirughghiReன èனRAr. mojhe dhevaனai noghghibh bhArghghabh bhayandhadhiனAl, dhaன mughadhdhai mUDhighghòNDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar: èghibhdhil irughghiRa èன jaனdhdhiன ubhadhdhiravadhdhai nAன bhArghghave bhArdhdhu, ALoDhDhighaLiனimidhdhaM avarghaL iDhughiRa ghUghghuralaigh gheDhDheன, avarghaL bhaDhughiRa vedhaனaighaLaiyuM aRindhirughghiReன.

avarghaLai èghibhdhiyariன ghaighghu viDhudhalaiyAghghavuM, avarghaLai andhadh dhejhadhdhilirundhu nIghghi, ghAனAனiyaruM edhdhiyaruM èmoriyaruM bhèrijhiyaruM eviyaruM èbhUjhiyaruM irughghiRa iDhamAghiya bhAluM dheனuM oDhughiRa nalamuM vijhAlamumAன dhejhadhdhil ghòNDhubhoyjh jherghghavuM iRa~Nghiனeன.
ibhbhòzhudhuM isravel bhudhdhirariன ghUghghural èன jhannidhiyil vandhu èDhDhiனdhu; èghibhdhiyar avarghaLai òDhughghughiRa òDhughghudhalaiyuM ghaNDheன.
nI isravel bhudhdhirarAghiya èன jaனdhdhai èghibhdhilirundhu azhaidhdhu varuMbhaDhi uனனaibh bhArvoனiDhadhdhughghu aனubhbhuveன vA èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu mojhe dhevaனai noghghi: bhArvoனiDhadhdhughghubh bhoghavuM, isravel bhudhdhirarai èghibhdhilirundhu azhaidhdhuvaravuM, nAன èMmAdhdhiraM èனRAன.

adhaRghu avar: nAன uனனoDhe irubhbheன; nI jaனdhdhai èghibhdhilirundhu azhaidhdhu vandhabhiன, nI~NghaL indha malaiyil dhevaனughghu ArAdhaனai jhèyvIrghaL; nAன uனனai aனubhbhiனeன èனbhadhaRghu idhuve aDhaiyALaM èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu mojhe dhevaனai noghghi: nAன isravel bhudhdhirariDhadhdhil bhoy, u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya dhevaன u~NghaLiDhadhdhil èனனai aனubhbhiனAr èனRu avarghaLughghujh jhòlluMbhodhu, avaruDhaiya nAmaM èனன èனRu avarghaL èனனiDhadhdhil gheDhDhAl, nAன avarghaLughghu èனன jhòlluveன èனRAன.
adhaRghudh dhevaன: irughghiRavarAgha irughghiReன èனRu mojheyuDhaனe jhòlli, irughghiReன èனbhavar èனனai u~NghaLiDhadhdhughghu aனubhbhiனAr èனRu isravel bhudhdhiraroDhe jhòlvAyAgha èனRAr.

meluM, dhevaன mojheyai noghghi: AbhiraghAmiன dhevaனuM IjhAghghiன dhevaனuM yAghghobhiன dhevaனumAyirughghiRa u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èனனai u~NghaLiDhadhdhughghu aனubhbhiனAr èனRu nI isravel bhudhdhirarughghujh jhòlvAyAgha; èனRaighghuM idhuve èன nAmaM, dhalaimuRai dhalaimuRaidhoRuM idhuve èன bherbhbhirasdhAbhaM.

nI bhoy, israveliன mUbhbharaigh ghUDhDhi, avarghaLiDhadhdhil: AbhiraghAM IjhAghghu yAghghobhu èனbhavarghaLuDhaiya dhevaனAyirughghiRa u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èனghghudh dharijhaனmAghi, u~NghaLai nijhjhayamAyjh jhandhidhdhu, èghibhdhil u~NghaLughghujh jhèyyabhbhaDhDhadhaigh ghaNDheன èனRuM,

nAன u~NghaLai èghibhdhiன jhiRumaiyilirundhu nIghghi, bhAluM dheனuM oDhughiRa dhejhamAghiya ghAனAனiyar edhdhiyar èmoriyar bhèrijhiyar eviyar èbhUjhiyaruDhaiya dhejhadhdhughghugh ghòNDhubhoveன èனRuM jhòனனeன èனRAr èனRu jhòllu.

avarghaL uன vAghghughghujh jhèvi ghòDhubhbhArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu nIyuM israveliன mUbhbharuM èghibhdhiன rAjAviனiDhadhdhil bhoy: èbhirèyaruDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar è~NghaLaijh jhandhidhdhAr; ibhbhòzhudhuM nA~NghaL vaனAndharadhdhil mUனRu nAL bhirayANaMbhoy, è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghubh bhaliyiDhuMbhaDhi è~NghaLaibh bhoghaviDhaveNDhumèனRu jhòllu~NghaL.
AனAluM, èghibhdhiன rAjA ghaivallamai ghaNDhAlòzhiya, u~NghaLaibh bhoghaviDhAன èனRu nAன aRiveன.
AghaiyAl, nAன èன ghaiyai nIDhDhi, èghibhdhiன naDhuvile nAன jhèyyuM jhaghalavidha aRbhudha~NghaLAluM adhai vAdhibhbheன; adhaRghubhbhiன avaன u~NghaLaibh bhoghaviDhuvAன.
abhbhòzhudhu indha jaன~NghaLughghu èghibhdhiyariன ghaNghaLil dhayavu ghiDhaighghabhbhaNNuveன; nI~NghaL bhoghuM bhodhu vèRumaiyAybh bhovadhillai.

òvvòru sdhirIyuM, dhaன dhaன ayalaghadhdhALiDhadhdhiluM, dhaன dhaன vIDhDhil dha~NghughiRavaLiDhadhdhiluM, vèLLiyuDhamaighaLaiyuM bhòனனuDhaimaighaLaiyuM vasdhira~NghaLaiyuM gheDhDhuvA~NghuvAL; avaighaLai u~NghaL ghumArarughghuM u~NghaL ghumAradhdhighaLughghuM dharibhbhidhdhu, èghibhdhiyaraigh ghòLLaiyiDhuvIrghaL èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu mojhe: avarghaL èனனai naMbhArghaL; èன vAghghughghujh jhèvighòDhArghaL; ghardhdhar uனghghudh dharijhaனmAghavillai èனRu jhòlluvArghaL èனRAன.
ghardhdhar avaனai noghghi: uன ghaiyil irughghiRadhu èனன èனRAr. òru ghol èனRAன.
adhaidh dharaiyile bhoDhu èனRAr; avaன adhaidh dharaiyile bhoDhDhabhodhu, adhu jharbhbhamAyiRRu; mojhe adhaRghu vilaghi oDhiனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi: uன ghaiyai nIDhDhi, adhiன vAlaibh bhiDhi èனRAr; avaன dhaன ghaiyai nIDhDhi, adhaibh bhiDhidhdhabhodhu, adhu avaன ghaiyile gholAyiRRu.

AbhiraghAmiன dhevaனuM IjhAghghiன dhevaனuM yAghghobhiன dhevaனumAyirughghiRa dha~NghaL bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghu dharijhaனmAனdhai avarghaL naMbhuvadhaRghu idhuve aDhaiyALaM èனRAr.

meluM, ghardhdhar avaனai noghghi: uன ghaiyai uன maDhiyile bhoDhu èனRAr; avaன dhaன ghaiyaidh dhaன maDhiyile bhoDhDhu, adhai vèLiye èDhughghuMbhodhu, idho, avaன ghai uRaindha mazhaiyaibhbhola vèNghuShDhaM bhiDhidhdhirundhadhu.

avar: uன ghaiyaidh dhiruMbhavuM uன maDhiyile bhoDhu èனRAr. avaன dhaன ghaiyaidh dhiruMbhadh dhaன maDhiyile bhoDhDhu, dhaன maDhiyilirundhu adhai vèLiye èDhudhdhabhodhu, adhu dhiruMbha avaனuDhaiya maRRajh jhadhaiyaibh bholAyiRRu.
abhbhòzhudhu avar: mundhiன aDhaiyALadhdhai avarghaL ghaNDhu, uனனai naMbhAmaluM uனghghujh jhèvighòDhAmaluM bhoனAl, bhindhiன aDhaiyALadhdhaigh ghaNDhu naMbhuvArghaL.

ivviraNDhu aDhaiyALa~NghaLaiyuM avarghaL naMbhAmaluM, uனvAghghughghujh jhèvighòDhAmaluM irubhbhArghaLAனAl, abhbhòzhudhu nI nadhiyiன dhaNNIrai mòNDhu niladhdhil URRuvAyAgha; nadhiyil mòNDha dhaNNIr vèDhDhAndharaiyile iradhdhamAghuM èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu mojhe ghardhdharai noghghi: ANDhavare, idhaRghu muனனAvadhu, dhevarIr umadhu aDhiyAனoDhe bhejhiனdhaRghubh bhiனனAvadhu nAன vAghghuvallavaன alla; nAன dhighghuvAyuM mandha nAvuM uLLavaன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar avaனai noghghi: maனuShaனughghu vAyai uNDhAghghiனvar yAr? UmaiyaனaiyuM jhèviDhaனaiyuM bhArvaiyuLLavaனaiyuM ghuruDhaனaiyuM uNDhAghghiனvar yAr? ghardhdharAghiya nAன allavA?
AdhalAl, nI bho; nAன uன vAyoDhe irundhu, nI bhejhaveNDhiyadhai uனghghubh bhodhibhbheன èனRAr.
adhaRghu avaன: ANDhavare, nIr aனubhbhajh jhidhdhamAyirughghiRa yAraiyAghiluM aனubhbhuM èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar mojheyiன mel ghobhamUNDhavarAghi: leviyaனAghiya Aroன uன jhaghodharaன allavA? avaன naனRAybh bhejhughiRavaன èனRu aRiveன; avaன uனனaijh jhandhighghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu varughiRAன; uனனaigh ghANuMbhodhu avaன irudhayaM maghizhuM.
nI avaனoDhe bhejhi, avaன vAyil vArdhdhaighaLai bhoDhu; nAன uன vAyiluM avaன vAyiluM irundhu, nI~NghaL jhèyya veNDhiyadhai u~NghaLughghu uNardhdhuveன.
avaன uனghghubh bhadhilAgha jaன~NghaLoDhe bhejhuvAன; ivvidhamAy avaன uனghghu vAyAgha irubhbhAன; nI avaனughghudh dhevaனAgha irubhbhAy.
indhagh gholaiyuM uன ghaiyile bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhubho, idhaனAl nI aDhaiyALa~NghaLaijh jhèyvAy èனRAr.

mojhe dhaன mAmaனAghiya èdhdhiroviனiDhadhdhughghu vandhu: nAன èghibhdhilirughghiRa èன jhaghodharariDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoy, avarghaL iனனuM uyiroDhe irughghiRArghaLA èனRu bhArghghuMbhaDhibh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhogha udhdharavu dharaveNDhuM èனRAன. abhbhòzhudhu èdhdhiro mojheyai noghghi: jhughamAybh bhoyvAruM èனRAன.
bhiனனuM ghardhdhar mIdhiyAனile mojheyai noghghi: nI èghibhdhughghudh dhiruMbhibh bho, uன bhirANaனai vA~NghadhdheDhiன maனidhar èllAruM iRandhu bhoனArghaL èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu mojhe dhaன maனaiviyaiyuM dhaன bhiLLaighaLaiyuM ghazhudhaiyiன mel eRRighghòNDhu, èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhiனAன; dhevaனuDhaiya gholaiyuM mojhe dhaன ghaiyile bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhubhoனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi: nI èghibhdhile dhiruMbhibh bhoyjh jherndhabhiன, nAன uன ghaiyil aLidhdhirughghiRa aRbhudha~NghaL yAvaiyuM bhArvoனughghu muனbhAghajh jhèyyuMbhaDhi èjhjharighghaiyAyiru; AghiluM, nAன avaன irudhayadhdhaigh ghaDhiனbhbhaDhudhdhuveன; avaன jaனdhdhaibh bhoghaviDhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu nI bhArvoனoDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: isravel èனனuDhaiya ghumAraன, èன jheShDhabhudhdhiraன.

èனghghu ArAdhaனai jhèyyuMbhaDhi èன ghumAraனai aனubhbhiviDhu èனRu ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhughiReன; avaனai viDhamADhDheன èனbhAyAghil nAன uனனuDhaiya ghumAraனai, uன jheShDha bhudhdhiraனaijh jha~Ngharibhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòனனAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
vazhiyile dha~NghuM iDhadhdhil ghardhdhar avaனughghu èdhirbhbhaDhDhu, avaனaigh ghòllabhbhArdhdhAr.

abhbhòzhudhu jhibhbhorAL gharughghAன òru ghallai èDhudhdhu, dhaன bhudhdhiraனuDhaiya nuனidhdholai aRudhdhu, adhai avaன ghAlghaLughghu muனbhAgha èRindhu: nIr èனghghu iradhdha jhaMbhandhamAன bhuruShaன èனRAL.
bhiனbhu avar avaனai viDhDhu vilaghiனAr. abhbhòzhudhu avaL: virudhdha jhedhaனdhdhiனimidhdhaM nIr èனghghu iradhdha jhaMbhandhamAன bhuruShaன èனRAL.
ghardhdhar Aroனai noghghi: nI vaனAndharadhdhil mojheghghu èdhirghòNDhubho èனRAr. avaன bhoy, dhevabharvadhadhdhil avaனaijh jhandhidhdhu, avaனai mudhdha~njhèydhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu mojhe dhaனனai aனubhbhiன ghardhdharuDhaiya jhaghala vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM avar dhaனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDha jhaghala aDhaiyALa~NghaLaiyuM Aroனughghudh dhèrividhdhAன.
mojheyuM AroனuM bhoy, isravel bhudhdhirariன mUbhbhar èllAraiyuM ghUDhivarajh jhèydhArghaL.
ghardhdhar mojheghghujh jhòlliya jhaghala vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM Aroன jhòlli, jaன~NghaLiன ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha andha aDhaiyALa~NghaLaiyuM jhèydhAன.

jaன~NghaL vijhuvAjhidhdhArghaL; ghardhdhar isravel bhudhdhiraraijh jhandhidhdhAr èனRuM, avarghaL bhaDhuM ubhadhdhirava~NghaLaigh ghaNNoghghibhbhArdhdhAr èனRuM, avarghaL gheDhDhabhodhu, dhalaighuனindhudh dhòzhudhughòNDhArghaL.

bhiனbhu, mojheyuM AroனuM bhArvoனiDhadhdhil bhoy: israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar vaனAndharadhdhile èனghghubh bhaNDhighai ghòNDhADhuMbhaDhi èன jaன~NghaLaibh bhoghaviDhaveNDhuM èனRu jhòllughiRAr èனRArghaL.
adhaRghubh bhArvoன: nAன isravelaibh bhoghaviDhagh ghardhdhariன vArdhdhaiyaigh gheDhghiRadhaRghu avar yAr? nAன ghardhdharai aRiyeன; nAன isravelaibh bhogha viDhuvadhillai èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL: èbhirèyaruDhaiya dhevaன è~NghaLaijh jhandhidhdhAr; nA~NghaL vaனAndharadhdhil mUனRunAL bhirayANaM bhoy, è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghubh bhaliyiDhuMbhaDhi bhoghaviDhaveNDhuM; bhoghAdhirundhAl, avar ghòLLai noyuM bhaDhDhayamuM è~NghaL mel varabhbhaNNuvAr èனRArghaL.
èghibhdhiன rAjA avarghaLai noghghi: mojheyuM AroனumAghiya nI~NghaL jaன~NghaLaidh dha~NghaL velaighaLaiviDhDhugh ghalaiyabh bhaNNughiRadhu èனன? u~NghaL jhumaighaLaijh jhumaghghabh bho~NghaL èனRAன.
bhiனனuM bhArvoன: idho, dhejhadhdhil jaன~NghaL mighudhiyAy irughghiRArghaL; avarghaL jhumai jhumaghghiRadhai viDhDhu oyndhirughghuMbhaDhi jhèyghiRIrghaLe èனRAன.
aனRiyuM, annALile bhArvoன jaன~NghaLiன ALoDhDhighaLaiyuM avarghaL dhalaivaraiyuM noghghi:
jhè~Nghal velaighghu nI~NghaL muனbhola iனi jaன~NghaLughghu vaighghol ghòDhughgha veNDhAM; avarghaL dhA~NghaLe bhoydh dha~NghaLughghu vaighghol jherghghaDhDhuM.

bhiனbhu, ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi: nI bhArvoனiDhadhdhil bhoy: èனghghu ArAdhaனai jhèyya èன jaன~NghaLaibh bhoghaviDhu.

nI~NghaL dhiruMbhi mighdholughghuM jhamudhdhiradhdhughghuM naDhuve bhAghAljhèbhoனughghu muனbhAgha irughghiRa Irodh bhaLLadhdhAghghiன muனனDhiyile bhALayamiRa~NghaveNDhuM èனRu isravel bhudhdhirarughghujh jhòllu; adhaRghu èdhirAghajh jhamudhdhiraghgharaiyile bhALayamiRa~NghuvIrghaLAgha.

isravel bhudhdhirariன vAlibharai aனubhbhiனAன; avarghaL jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhalighaLaijh jhèludhdhi, ghardhdharughghujh jhamAdhAனbhalighaLAghagh ghALaighaLaibh bhaliyiDhDhArghaL.

uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyiன bhusdhaghadhdhai èDhudhdhu, jaன~NghaLiன ghAdhugheDhgha vAjhidhdhAன; avarghaL ghardhdhar jhòனனbhaDhiyèllAM jhèydhu, ghIzhbhbhaDhindhu naDhabhbhoM èனRArghaL.

avar isravel bhudhdhiraruDhaiya adhibhadhighaLmel dhaMmuDhaiya ghaiyai nIDhDhavillai; avarghaL dhevaனaidh dharijhidhdhu, bhiனbhu bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi: nI malaiyiனmel èனனiDhadhdhiRghu eRivandhu, a~Nghe iru; nAன uனghghugh ghaRbhalaghaighaLaiyuM, nI avarghaLughghu ubhadhejhibhbhadhaRghu, nAன èzhudhiன niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhaiyuM ghaRbhaனaighaLaiyuM ghòDhubhbheன èனRAr.

vAjhasdhaladhdhiனmel ghUDhAramAghabh bhoDhuMbhaDhi ADhDhumayirAl bhadhiனòru mUDhudhiraighaLai uNDhubhaNNuvAyAgha.
