mojhe ghardhdharai noghghi: dhevarIr indha jaன~NghaLai azhaidhdhughghòNDhu bho èனRu jhòனனIr; AghiluM, èனனoDheghUDha iனனArai aனubhbhuveன èனbhadhai èனghghu nIr aRivighghavillai; èனRAluM uனனaibh bherjhòlli azhaidhdhu aRindhirughghiReன èனRuM, èன ghaNghaLil uனghghugh ghirubhai ghiDhaidhdhadhu èனRuM, dhevarIr jhòனனdhuNDhe.

uMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLil ibhbhòzhudhu èனghghugh ghirubhai ghiDhaidhdhadhAனAl nAன uMmai aRivadhaRghuM, uMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLil èனghghugh ghirubhai ghiDhaibhbhadhaRghuM, uMmuDhaiya vazhiyai èனghghu aRiviyuM; indha jAdhi uMmuDhaiya jaனmèனRu niனaidhdharuLuM èனRAன.
adhaRghu avar: èன jhamughaM uனghghu muனbhAghajh jhèlluM, nAன uனghghu iLaibhbhARudhal dharuveன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன avarai noghghi: uMmuDhaiya jhamughaM èனனoDheghUDhajh jhèllAmaRbhoனAl, è~NghaLai ivviDhadhdhilirundhu ghòNDhubhoghAdhiruM.

èனghghuM umadhu jaன~NghaLughghuM uMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLile ghirubhai ghiDhaidhdhadhèனbhadhu èdhiனAl aRiyabhbhaDhuM; nIr è~NghaLoDhe varuvadhiனAl allavA? ibhbhaDhiye bhUmiyiனmeluLLa jaன~NghaL èllAriluM, nAனuM uMmuDhaiya jaன~NghaLuM vijheShidhdhavarghaL èனRu viLa~NghuM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi: nI jhòனன indha vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye jhèyveன; èன ghaNghaLil uனghghugh ghirubhai ghiDhaidhdhadhu; uனனaibh bherjhòlli azhaidhdhu aRindhirughghiReன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன: uMmuDhaiya maghimaiyai èனghghugh ghANbhidhdharuLuM èனRAன.

èன maghimai ghaDhandhubhoghuMbhodhu, nAன uனனai andhagh ghaனmalaiyiன vèDhibhbhile vaidhdhu, nAன ghaDhandhubhoghumaDhDhuM èன gharadhdhiனAl uனனai mUDhuveன.
bhiனbhu, èன gharadhdhai èDhubhbheன; abhbhòzhudhu èன bhiனbhaghghadhdhaigh ghANbhAy; èன mughamo ghANabhbhaDhAdhu èனRAr.

èன bharijhudhdha nAmadhdhaibh bharijhudhdhaghghulaijhjhalAghghAdhirubhbhIrghaLAgha; nAன isravel bhudhdhirar naDhuve bharijhudhdhar èனRu madhighghabhbhaDhuveன; nAன u~NghaLaibh bharijhudhdhamAghghughiRa ghardhdhar.
nAன u~NghaLughghudh dhevaனAyirubhbhadhaRghAgha, u~NghaLai èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiனeன; nAன ghardhdhar èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:
nI isravel bhudhdhiraroDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: jhabhaighUDhivandhu bharijhudhdha nADhghaLAgha AjharighghuMbhaDhi, nI~NghaL ghURaveNDhiya ghardhdharuDhaiya bhaNDhighai nADhghaLAvaன:

ARunALuM velai jhèyyaveNDhuM; ezhAMnAL bharijhudhdha jhabhaighUDhudhalAன oyvunAL, adhil òru velaiyuM jhèyyaveNDhAM; adhu u~NghaL vAjhasdhala~NghaLilèllAM ghardhdharughghèனRu oyndhirughghuM nALAyirubhbhadhAgha.
jhabhaighUDhivandhu bharijhudhdhamAy AjharighghuMbhaDhi, nI~NghaL ghuRidhdhaghAladhdhil ghURaveNDhiya ghardhdhariன bhaNDhighaighaLAvaன:
mudhalAM mAdhaM bhadhiனAlAM dhedhi andhineramAghiRa veLaiyile ghardhdhariன bhasghAbhaNDhighaiyuM,
andha mAdhaM bhadhiனaindhAM dhedhiyile, ghardhdharughghubh bhuLibhbhillA abhbhabh bhaNDhighaiyumAy irughghuM; ezhunAL bhujhibhbhillA abhbha~NghaLaibh bhujhighghaveNDhuM
mudhalAM nAL u~NghaLughghubh bharijhudhdhamAன jhabhaighUDhudhal; adhile jhAdhAraNamAன yAdhòru velaiyuM jhèyyaveNDhAM.
ezhunALuM ghardhdharughghudh dhaghaனbhaliyiDhaveNDhuM; ezhAMnAL bharijhudhdhamAன jhabhaighUDhudhal; adhil jhAdhAraNamAன yAdhòru velaiyuM jhèyyalAghAdhu èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:

nI isravel bhudhdhiraroDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: nAன u~NghaLughghugh ghòDhughghuM dhejhadhdhil nI~NghaL bhoyjh jherndhu, adhiன vèLLANmaiyai aRughghuMbhodhu, u~NghaL aRubhbhiன mudhaRbhalaனAghiya òru ghadhirghghaDhDhai AjhAriyaனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvaraghghaDhavIrghaL.
u~NghaLughghAgha adhu a~NghigharighghuMbhaDhi, AjhAriyaன andhagh ghadhirghghaDhDhai oyvunALughghu maRunALil ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil ajhaivADhDhaveNDhuM.
nI~NghaL andhagh ghadhirghghaDhDhai ajhaivADhDhuM nALil ghardhdharughghujh jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhaliyAgha, òruvayadhAன bhazhudhaRRa òru ADhDhughghuDhDhiyaiyuM,

ghardhdharughghujh jhughandha vAjhaனaiyAன dhaghaனbhaliyAgha òru maraghghAlile bhadhdhil iraNDhu bha~NghAனdhuM èNNèyile bhijhaindhadhumAன mèlliya mAvAghiya bhojaனbhaliyaiyuM, dhirADhjhabhbhazharajhadhdhile ghARbhaDhiyAghiya bhAனbhaliyaiyuM jhèludhdhaghghaDhavIrghaL.

u~NghaL dhevaனughghugh ghANighghaiyai nI~NghaL ghòNDhuvaruM annAL maDhDhuM, abhbhamuM vADhDhiya ghadhiruM bhajhjhaighghadhiruM bhujhiyIrghaLAgha; idhu u~NghaL vAjhasdhala~NghaLil èllAM u~NghaL dhalaimuRaidhoRuM jhòllaveNDhiya nidhdhiya ghaDhDhaLai.
nI~NghaL ajhaivADhDhuM ghadhirghghaDhDhaigh ghòNDhuvaruM oyvunALughghu maRunAL mudhaRghòNDhu èNNadhdhuva~Nghi, ezhuvAra~NghaL niRaiveRiனbhiனbhu,
ezhAM oyvunALughghu maRunALAghiya aiMbhadhAM nALmaDhDhuM èNNi, ghardhdharughghubh bhudhiya bhojaனbhaliyaijh jhèludhdhaghghaDhavIrghaL.

nI~NghaL òru maraghghAlile bhadhdhil iraNDhu bha~NghAghiya mèlliya mAvile bhuLibhbhAghabh bhAghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDha ajhaivADhDhuM ghANighghaiyAyirughghiRa iraNDhu abhbha~NghaLai u~NghaL vAjhasdhala~NghaLilirundhu ghardhdharughghèனRu mudhaRbhalaனAghagh ghòNDhuvandhu,

abhbhadhdhoDheghUDhagh ghardhdharughghujh jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhaliyAgha, òruvayadhAன bhazhudhaRRa ezhu ADhDhughghuDhDhighaLaiyuM, òru ghALaiyaiyuM, iraNDhu ADhDhughghaDhAghghaLaiyuM ghardhdharughghujh jhughandha vAjhaனaiyAன dhaghaனbhaliyAgha avaighaLughghu aDhudhdha bhojaனbhaliyaiyuM, bhAனbhalighaLaiyuM jhèludhdhi,
vèLLADhughaLil òru ghaDhAvaibh bhAvanivAraNabhaliyAghavuM, òruvayadhAன iraNDhu ADhDhughghuDhDhighaLaijh jhamAdhAனbhaliyAghavuM iDhaghghaDhavIrghaL.

avaighaLai AjhAriyaன mudhaRbhalaனAghiya abhbhadhdhoDhuM iraNDhu ADhDhughghuDhDhighaLoDhu~NghUDhagh ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil ajhaivADhDhuM bhaliyAgha ajhaivADhDhaghghaDhavaன; ghardhdharughghubh bharijhudhdhamAghiya avaighaL AjhAriyaனuDhaiyavaighaLAghuM.

andha nAL u~NghaLughghujh jhabhaighUDhuM bharijhudhdha nAL èனRu ghURaveNDhuM; adhile jhAdhAraNamAன yAdhòru velaiyuM jhèyyalAghAdhu; idhu u~NghaL vAjhasdhala~NghaLilèllAM u~NghaL dhalaimuRaidhoRuM jhèllaveNDhiya nidhdhiya ghaDhDhaLai.

u~NghaL dhejhadhdhiன vèLLANmaiyai nI~NghaL aRughghaiyil, vayaliன oradhdhil irughghiRadhai muRRiluM aRughghAmaluM, jhindhighghiDhaghghiRa ghadhirghaLaibh bhòRughghAmaluM, èLiyavaனughghuM bharadhejhighghuM avaighaLai viDhDhuviDhaveNDhuM; nAன u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:

nI isravel bhudhdhiraroDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl u~NghaLughghu ezhAM mAdhaM mudhalAndhedhi èghghALajh jhadhdhadhdhAl ~nAbhaghaghghuRiyAghagh ghòNDhADhughiRa bhaNDhighai èனghiRa jhabhai ghUDhuM bharijhudhdha oyvunALAyirubhbhadhAgha.
adhile jhAdhAraNamAன yAdhòru velaiyuM jhèyyAmal, ghardhdharughghudh dhaghaனbhali jhèludhdhaveNDhuM èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:

andha ezhAM mAdhaM bhadhdhAndhedhi u~NghaLughghubh bhAvanivirdhdhi jhèyyuM nALuM jhabhaighUDhuM bharijhudhdhanALumAyirubhbhadhAgha; abhbhòzhudhu nI~NghaL u~NghaL AdhdhumAghghaLaidh dhAzhmaibhbhaDhudhdhi, ghardhdharughghudh dhaghaனbhali jhèludhdhaghghaDhavIrghaL.
andha nAL u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil u~NghaLughghubh bhAvanivirdhdhi jhèyyabhbhaDhuM bhAvanivAraNa nALAyirughghiRabhaDhiyAl, adhile yAdhòru velaiyuM jhèyyaveNDhAM.
annALile dhaனனaidh dhAzhmaibhbhaDhudhdhAdha èndha AdhdhumAvuM dhaன jaனdhdhil irAdhabhaDhighghu aRubhbhuNDhu bhovAன.
annALile òru AdhdhumA yAdhòru velaiyaijh jhèydhAl, andha AdhdhumAvai avaன jaனdhdhiன naDhuvile vaighghAmal azhibhbheன.
adhil nI~NghaL èndha velaiyuM jhèyyAdhirubhbhadhu u~NghaL vAjhasdhala~NghaLil èllAM u~NghaL dhalaimuRaidhoRuM jhèllaveNDhiya nidhdhiya ghaDhDhaLai.

adhu u~NghaLughghu vijheShidhdha oyvunAL; adhil u~NghaL AdhdhumAghghaLaidh dhAzhmaibhbhaDhudhdhaveNDhuM; andha mAdhadhdhiன òனbhadhAndhedhi jhAya~NghAlandhuva~Nghi, maRunAL jhAya~NghAlaMmaDhDhuM u~NghaL oyvai AjharighghaghghaDhavIrghaL èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:
nI isravel bhudhdhiraroDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: andha ezhAM mAdhaM bhadhiனaindhAndhedhimudhal ezhunALaLavuM ghardhdharughghu AjharighghuM ghUDhArabhbhaNDhighaiyAyirubhbhadhAgha.
mudhalAM nAL jhabhaighUDhuM bharijhudhdhanAL; adhile jhAdhAraNamAன yAdhòru velaiyuM jhèyyalAghAdhu.

ezhunALuM ghardhdharughghudh dhaghaனbhali jhèludhdhaghghaDhavIrghaL; èDhDhAM nAL u~NghaLughghujh jhabhaighUDhuM bharijhudhdhanAL; adhile ghardhdharughghudh dhaghaனbhali jhèludhdhaghghaDhavIrghaL; adhu AjharighghabhbhaDhuM nAL; adhile jhAdhAraNamAன yAdhòru velaiyuM jhèyyaveNDhAM.
nI~NghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya oyvunADhghaLil jhèludhdhuvadhuM dhavira, nI~NghaL ghardhdharughghubh bhaDhaighghiRa u~NghaL èllAgh ghANighghaighaLuM bhòrudhdhaனaighaLuM uRjhAghabhalighaLuM dhavira,

nI~NghaL andhandha nALughghudhdhaghghadhAygh ghardhdharughghujh jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhali, bhojaனbhali, iradhdhabhbhali, bhAனbhali mudhalAனvaighaLaijh jhèludhdhuMbhaDhi jhabhaighUDhivandhu, bharijhudhdhamAy AjharibhbhadhaRghAgha nI~NghaL ghURaveNDhiya ghardhdharuDhaiya bhaNDhighaighaL ivaighaLe.

niladhdhiன bhalaனai nI~NghaL jherdhdhuvaighghuM ezhAM mAdhaM bhadhiனaindhAndhedhimudhal ghardhdharughghubh bhaNDhighaiyai ezhunAL AjharighghaghghaDhavIrghaL; mudhalAM nALiluM oyvu: èDhDhAM nALiluM oyvu.

mudhal nALile ala~NghAramAன viruDhjha~NghaLiன ghaனighaLaiyuM bherIjhjhiன olaighaLaiyuM dhazhaidhdhirughghiRa viruDhjha~NghaLiன ghiLaighaLaiyuM ARRalarighaLaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhu, u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil ezhunALuM maghizhjhjhiyAyiru~NghaL.

varuShandhoRuM ezhunAL ghardhdharughghu indhabh bhaNDhighaiyai AjharighghaghghaDhavIrghaL; idhu u~NghaL dhalaimuRaidhoRuM jhèllaveNDhiya nidhdhiya ghaDhDhaLai; ezhAM mAdhadhdhil adhai AjharighghaveNDhuM.
nAன isravel bhudhdhirarai èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiனbhodhu, avarghaLaigh ghUDhAra~NghaLil ghuDhiyirughghabhbhaNNiனdhai u~NghaL jhandhadhiyAr aRiyuMbhaDhighghu,

abhbhaDhiye mojhe ghardhdharuDhaiya bhaNDhighaighaLai isravel bhudhdhirarughghudh dhèrividhdhAன.
bhiனனuM ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:

ghudhdhuviLaghghu èbhbhòzhudhuM èrindhughòNDhirughghuMbhaDhi adhaRghAgha iDhidhdhubh bhizhindha dhèLivAன òliva èNNèyai isravel bhudhdhirar uனனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvaruMbhaDhi avarghaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhu.

Ajharibhbhugh ghUDhAradhdhil jhADhjhijhannidhiyiன dhiraighghu vèLibhbhuRamAgha Aroன adhai èbhbhòzhudhuM jhAya~NghAlaM dhòDha~Nghi viDhiyaRghAlaMmaDhDhuM ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil èriyuMbhaDhi eRRaghghaDhavaன; idhu u~NghaL dhalaimuRaidhoRuM jhèllaveNDhiya nidhdhiya ghaDhDhaLai.
avaன èbhbhòzhudhuM ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil bharijhudhdhamAன ghudhdhuviLaghghiனmel irughghiRa viLaghghughaLai èriya vaighghaghghaDhavaன.
aனRiyuM nI mèlliya mAvai èDhudhdhu, adhaibh bhaனனiraNDhu abhbha~NghaLAghajh jhuDhuvAyAgha; òvvòru abhbhaM maraghghAlile bhadhdhil iraNDhubha~Nghu mAviனAl jhèyyabhbhaDhaveNDhuM.
avaighaLai nI ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil bharijhudhdhamAன mejaiyiனmel iraNDhu aDhughghAgha, òvvòru aDhughghil avvARu abhbhaM irughghuMbhaDhiyAgha vaidhdhu,
òvvòru aDhughghiனiDhadhdhil jhudhdhamAன dhUbhavarghghaM bhoDhaghghaDhavAy; adhu abhbhadhdhoDhirundhu, ~nAbhaghaghghuRiyAghagh ghardhdharughgheRRa dhaghaனbhaliyAyirughghuM.
abhbhadhdhai nidhdhiya uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyAgha isravel bhudhdhirar ghaiyile vA~Nghi, oyvunALdhoRuM ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil aDhughghivaighghaghghaDhavaன.

ghardhdhariன vAghghiனAle dha~NghaLughghu udhdharavu varumaDhDhuM, avaனaigh ghAvalbhaDhudhdhiனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:

meluM nI isravel bhudhdhirarai noghghi: èvaனAghiluM dhaன dhevaனaidhdhUShidhdhAl, avaன dhaன bhAvadhdhaijh jhumabhbhAன.

ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhai nindhighghiRavaன ghòlaijhèyyabhbhaDhaveNDhuM; jhabhaiyAr èllAruM avaனaigh ghallèRiyaveNDhuM; bharadhejhiyAனAluM jhudhejhiyAனAluM ghardhdhariன nAmadhdhaidh dhUShighghiRavaன ghòlaijhèyyabhbhaDhaveNDhuM.
òru maனidhaனaigh ghòllughiRavaன èvaனo avaன ghòlaijhèyyabhbhaDhaveNDhuM.
mirughadhdhaigh ghòனRavaன mirughadhdhughghu mirughaM ghòDhughghaghghaDhavaன.
òruvaன bhiRaனai UனbhbhaDhudhdhiனAl, avaன jhèydhabhaDhiye avaனughghuM jhèyyabhbhaDhaghghaDhavadhu.
nòRughghudhalughghu nòRughghudhal, ghaNNughghugh ghaN, bhallughghubh bhal; avaன òru maனidhaனai UனbhbhaDhudhdhiனdhubhola avaனuM UனbhbhaDhudhdhabhbhaDhaveNDhuM.
mirughadhdhaigh ghòனRavaன bhadhil ghòDhughghaveNDhuM; maனidhaனaigh ghòனRavaனo ghòlaijhèyyabhbhaDhaghghaDhavaன.
u~NghaLil bharadhejhighghuM jhudhejhighghuM òre niyAyaM irughghaveNDhuM; nAன u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èனRu jhòl èனRAr.

abhbhaDhiye, dhUShidhdhavaனaibh bhALayadhdhughghubh bhuRaMbhe ghòNDhubhoy, avaனaigh ghallèRiyuMbhaDhi mojhe isravel bhudhdhiraroDhe jhòனனAன; ghardhdhar mojheghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye jhèydhArghaL.
ghardhdhar jhIனAymalaiyil mojheyai noghghi:
nI isravel bhudhdhiraroDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: nAன u~NghaLughghugh ghòDhughghuM dhejhadhdhile nI~NghaL bhoyjh jherndhirughghuMbhodhu, dhejhaM ghardhdharughghèனRu oyvu ghòNDhADhaveNDhuM.
ARu varuShaM uன vayalai vidhaidhdhu, uன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhaigh ghiLaighazhidhdhu, adhiன bhalaனaijh jherbhbhAyAgha.

dhejhadhdhiன oyvile bhayirAghiRadhu u~NghaLughghu AghAramAyirubhbhadhAgha; uன velaighghAraனughghuM, uன velaighghArighghuM, uன ghUlighghAraனughghuM, uனனiDhadhdhil dha~NghughiRa anniyaனughghuM,
uன nADhDhu mirughadhdhughghuM, uன dhejhadhdhil irughghiRa ghADhDhu mirughadhdhughghuM adhil viLaindhirubhbhadhèllAM AghAramAyirubhbhadhAgha.
aனRiyuM, ezhu oyvu varuSha~NghaLuLLa ezhu ezhu varuSha~NghaLai èNNuvAyAgha; andha ezhu oyvu varuSha~NghaLuM nARbhadhdhòனbhadhu varuShamAghuM.
abhbhòzhudhuM ezhAM mAdhaM bhadhdhAndhedhiyil èghghALajhjhadhdhaM dhòனighghuMbhaDhi jhèyyaveNDhuM; bhAvanivAraNanALil u~NghaL dhejhamè~NghuM èghghALajhjhadhdhaM dhòனighghuMbhaDhi jhèyyaveNDhuM.

aiMbhadhAM varuShadhdhaibh bharijhudhdhamAghghi, dhejhamè~NghuM adhiன ghuDhighaLughghèllAM viDhudhalai ghURaghghaDhavIrghaL; adhu u~NghaLughghu yUbhili varuShamAyirubhbhadhAgha; adhile u~NghaLil òvvòruvaனuM dhaன dhaன ghANiyADhjhighghuM dhaன dhaன ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghuM dhiruMbhibh bhoghaghghaDhavaன.

adhu yUbhili varuShaM; adhu u~NghaLughghubh bharijhudhdhamAyirughghaveNDhuM; andha varuShadhdhil vayalvèLiyil viLaindhavaighaLai nI~NghaL bhujhighghaveNDhuM.

AghaiyAl, bhiRaனughghu èdhaiyAvadhu viRRAluM, avaனiDhadhdhil èdhaiyAvadhu ghòNDhAluM òruvarughghòruvar aniyAyaM jhèyyagh ghUDhAdhu.
yUbhili varuShadhdhughghubh bhiனvaruM varuSha~NghaLiன dhòghaighgheRghabh bhiRaனiDhadhdhil ghòLLuvAyAgha; bhalaனuLLa varuSha~NghaLiன dhòghaighgheRgha avaன uனghghu viRbhAனAgha.

u~NghaLil òruvaனuM bhiRaனughghu aniyAya~njhèyyagh ghUDhAdhu; uன dhevaனughghubh bhayabhbhaDhaveNDhuM; nAன u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar.
èன ghaDhDhaLaighaLiனbhaDhi jhèydhu, èன niyAya~NghaLaigh ghaighghòNDhu avaighaLiனbhaDhi naDhaghghaghghaDhavIrghaL; abhbhòzhudhu dhejhadhdhile jhughamAyghghuDhiyirubhbhIrghaL.

ezhAM varuShadhdhil èdhaibh bhujhibhbhoM? nA~NghaL vidhaighghAmaluM, viLaindhadhaijh jherghghAmaluM irughghaveNDhume! èனRu jhòlvIrghaLAனAl,
nAன ARAM varuShadhdhil u~NghaLughghu AjhIrvAdhadhdhai anughghiraghaMbhaNNuveன; adhu u~NghaLughghu mUனRu varuShadhdhiன bhalaனaidhdharuM.
nI~NghaL èDhDhAM varuShadhdhile vidhaidhdhu, òனbhadhAM varuShaMmaDhDhuM bhazhaiya bhalaனile jhAbhbhiDhuvIrghaL; adhiன bhalaன viLaiyuMvaraighghuM bhazhaiya bhalaனaijh jhAbhbhiDhuvIrghaL.
dhejhaM èனனuDhaiyadhAyirughghiRabhaDhiyAl, nI~NghaL nila~NghaLai aRudhiyAy viRghaveNDhAM; nI~NghaL bharadhejhighaLuM èனனiDhadhdhil bhuRaghghuDhighaLumAyirughghiRIrghaL.
u~NghaL ghANiyADhjhiyAன dhejhamè~NghuM nila~NghaLai mIDhDhughghòLLa iDha~NghòDhughghaghghaDhavIrghaL.
u~NghaL jhaghodharaன dharidhdhirabhbhaDhDhu, dhaன ghANiyADhjhiyile jhiladhai viRRAl, avaன iனdhdhAன òruvaன vandhu, dhaன jhaghodharaன viRRadhai mIDhghaghghaDhavaன.
adhai mIDhgha òruvaனuM illAmal, dhAனe adhai mIDhghadhdhaghghavaனAனAl,
adhai viRRabhiன jhèனRa varuSha~NghaLiன dhòghaiyaidh dhaLLi, mIndha dhòghaiyai eRRi, ghòNDhavaனughghugh ghòDhudhdhu, avaன dhaன ghANiyADhjhighghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoghaghghaDhavaன.

abhbhaDhigh ghòDhubhbhadhaRghAன nirvAghaM avaனughghu illAviDhDhAl, avaன viRRadhu vA~Nghiனvaன ghaiyile yUbhili varuShaMmaDhDhuM irundhu, yUbhili varuShadhdhile adhu viDhudhalaiyAghuM; abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன ghANiyADhjhighghudh dhiruMbhibhbhovAன.

òruvaன madhiljhUzhndha bhaDhDhaNadhdhiluLLa dhaன vAjhasdhalamAghiya vIDhDhai viRRAl, adhai viRRa òru varuShadhdhughghuL adhai mIDhDhughghòLLalAM; òru varuShadhdhughghuLLAghave adhai mIDhDhughghòLLaveNDhuM.

òru varuShadhdhughghuLLe adhai mIDhDhughghòLLAdhirundhAl, madhiljhUzhndha bhaDhDhaNadhdhiluLLa andha vIDhu dhalaimuRaidhoRuM adhai vA~Nghiனvaனughghe uriyadhAghuM; yUbhili varuShadhdhiluM adhu viDhudhalaiyAghAdhu.
madhil jhUzhabhbhaDhAdha ghirAma~NghaLiluLLa vIDhughaLo, dhejhadhdhiன nila~NghaL bholave èNNabhbhaDhuM; avaighaL mIDhghabhbhaDhalAM; yUbhili varuShadhdhil avaighaL viDhudhalaiyAghuM.
leviyariன ghANiyADhjhiyAghiya bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiluLLa vIDhughaLaiyo leviyar èghghAladhdhiluM mIDhDhughghòLLalAM.

isravel bhudhdhirarughghuLLe leviyaruDhaiya bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiluLLa vIDhughaL avarghaLughghuriya ghANiyADhjhiyAனbhaDhiyAl, leviyariDhadhdhil avaனuDhaiya ghANiyADhjhibhbhaDhDhaNadhdhiluLLa vIDhDhai òruvaன vA~NghiனAl, viRghabhbhaDhDha andha vIDhu yUbhili varuShadhdhil viDhudhalaiyAghuM.
avarghaL bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaijh jhUzhndha vèLinilaM viRghabhbhaDhalAghAdhu; adhu avarghaLughghu nidhdhiya ghANiyADhjhiyAyirughghuM.
uன jhaghodharaன dharidhdhirabhbhaDhDhu, ghaiyiLaidhdhubhbhoனvaனAனAl, avaனai AdharighghaveNDhuM; bharadhejhiyaibhbholuM dha~NghavandhavaனaibhbholuM avaன uனனoDhe bhizhaibhbhAனAgha.
nI avaன ghaiyil vaDhDhiyAvadhu bhòlijhaiyAvadhu vA~NghAmal, uன dhevaனughghubh bhayandhu, uன jhaghodharaன uனனoDhe bhizhaighghuMbhaDhi jhèyvAyAgha.
avaனughghu uன bhaNadhdhai vaDhDhighghuM, uன dhAனiyadhdhaibh bhòlijhaighghuM ghòDhAyAgha.
u~NghaLughghugh ghAனAன dhejhadhdhaigh ghòDhudhdhu, u~NghaLughghu dhevaனAyirughghuMbhaDhi, u~NghaLai èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiன u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar nAனe.
uன jhaghodharaன dharidhdhiraனAghi, uனghghu vilaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAl, avaனai aDhimaiyaibhbhola Uzhiya~njhèyya nèrughghaveNDhAM.
avaன ghUlighghAraனaibhbholavuM dha~NghavandhavaனaibhbholavuM uனனoDhe irundhu, yUbhili varuShaMmaDhDhuM uனனiDhadhdhil jhevighghaghghaDhavaன.
bhiனbhu, dhaன bhiLLaighaLoDhu~NghUDha uனனai viDhDhu nI~NghalAghi, dhaன ghuDhuMbhadhdhAriDhadhdhughghuM dhaன bhidhAghghaLiன ghANiyADhjhighghuM dhiruMbhibhbhoghaghghaDhavaன.
avarghaL nAன èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiன èனனuDhaiya UzhiyaghghArar; AghaiyAl avarghaL aDhimaighaLAgha viRghabhbhaDhalAghAdhu.
nI avaனaigh ghòDhUramAy ALAmal uன dhevaனughghubh bhayandhiru.
uனghghu irughghuM AN aDhimaiyuM bhèN aDhimaiyuM jhuRRiluM irughghiRa bhuRajAdhighaLAyirughghaveNDhuM; avarghaLil nI AN aDhimaiyaiyuM bhèN aDhimaiyaiyuM vilaighghu vA~NghalAM.

u~NghaLiDhadhdhile bharadhejhighaLAydh dha~NghughiRa anniya bhudhdhirariluM, u~NghaL dhejhadhdhil u~NghaLiDhadhdhile bhiRandhirughghiRa avarghaLuDhaiya ghuDhuMbhadhdhAriluM nI~NghaL u~NghaLughghu aDhimaighaLaigh ghòNDhu, avarghaLai u~NghaLughghujh jhudhandharamAghghalAM.

avarghaLai u~NghaLughghubh bhiனvaruM u~NghaL jhandhadhiyAruM jhudhandharighghuMbhaDhi nI~NghaL avarghaLaijh jhudhandharamAghghighghòLLalAM; èனRaighghuM avarghaL u~NghaLughghu aDhimaighaLAyirughghalAM; u~NghaL jhaghodhararAghiya isravel bhudhdhiraro òruvaraiyòruvar ghòDhUramAgha ALagh ghUDhAdhu.

uனனiDhadhdhil irughghiRa bharadhejhiyuM anniyaனuM jhèlvaனAyirughgha, avaனiDhadhdhil irughghiRa uன jhaghodharaன dharidhdhirabhbhaDhDhu, andhabh bharadhejhighghAvadhu, anniyaனughghAvadhu, bharadhejhiyiன ghuDhuMbhadhdhAril èvaனughghAvadhu avaன vilaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAl,
avaன vilaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoனbhiன dhiruMbha mIDhghabhbhaDhalAM; avaன jhaghodhararil òruvaன avaனai mIDhghalAM.

avaனuDhaiya bhidhAviன jhaghodharaனAvadhu, andhajh jhaghodharaனuDhaiya bhudhdhiraனAvadhu, avaன ghuDhuMbhadhdhiluLLa avaனaijh jherndha iனdhdhAril èvaனAvadhu avaனai mIDhghalAM; dhaனனAl ghUDhumAனAl, dhaனனaidhdhAனe mIDhDhughghòLLalAM.

avaன dhAன vilaibhbhaDhDha varuShandhòDha~Nghi, yUbhili varuShaMvaraighghuM uNDhAன ghAladhdhaidh dhaனனai vilaighghughghòNDhavaனuDhaன ghaNaghghubhbhArghghaghghaDhavaன; avaனuDhaiya vilaighghirayaM ghUlighghAraனuDhaiya ghAlaghghaNaghghubhbhola, varuShadhdhòghaighghu òdhdhubhbhArghghaveNDhuM.
iனனuM anegha varuSha~NghaL irundhAl, avaன dhaன vilaighghirayadhdhile avaighaLughghudh dhaghghadhaidh dhaனனai mIDhghuMbhòruLAghadh dhiruMbhagh ghòDhughghaghghaDhavaன.

ivaன varuShadhdhiRghu varuShaM ghUlibhòrundhighghòNDha ghUlighghAraனaibhbhola, avaனiDhadhdhil irughghaveNDhuM; avaன ivaனai uனghghu muனbhAghagh ghòDhUramAy ALagh ghUDhAdhu.
ibhbhaDhi ivaன mIDhDhughghòLLabhbhaDhAdhirundhAl, ivaனuM ivaனoDheghUDha ivaன bhiLLaighaLuM yUbhili varuShadhdhil viDhudhalaiyAvArghaL.
isravel bhudhdhirar èன UzhiyaghghArar; avarghaL nAன èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiன èன UzhiyaghghArare; nAன u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar.

èன oyvunADhghaLai Ajharidhdhu, èன bharijhudhdha sdhaladhdhaighghuRidhdhubh bhayabhaghdhiyAyirubhbhIrghaLAgha; nAன ghardhdhar.

bhoனvaruShadhdhubh bhazhaiya dhAனiyadhdhaijh jhAbhbhiDhDhu, bhudhiya dhAனiyadhdhughghu iDhamuNDhAghuMbhaDhi, bhazhaiyadhai vilaghghuvIrghaL.

u~NghaL vallamaiyiன bhèrumaiyai muRidhdhu, u~NghaL vAனdhdhai iruMbhaibhbholavuM, u~NghaL bhUmiyai vèNghaladhdhaibhbholavuM Aghghuveன.
u~NghaL bhèlaன virudhAvile jhèlavazhiyuM; u~NghaL dhejhaM dhaன bhalaனaiyuM, dhejhadhdhiன mara~NghaL dha~NghaL ghaனighaLaiyuM ghòDhughghamADhDhAdhu.
nI~NghaL èனghghujh jhèvighòDhughgha maனdhillAmal, èனghghu èdhirdhdhu naDhabhbhIrghaLAனAl, nAன u~NghaL bhAva~NghaLughghudh dhaghghadhAgha iனனuM ezhadhdhaனai vAdhaiyai u~NghaLmel varabhbhaNNi,

èன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai mIRiனdhaRghubh bhazhivA~NghuM bhaDhDhayadhdhai u~NghaLmel varabhbhaNNi, nI~NghaL u~NghaL bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLil jherndhabhiன, ghòLLainoyai u~NghaL naDhuvile aனubhbhuveன; jhadhdhuruviன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvIrghaL.

u~NghaL abhbhaM èனனuM Adharavugholai nAன muRidhdhubhbhoDhuMbhodhu, bhadhdhu sdhirIghaL òre aDhubhbhil u~NghaL abhbhadhdhaijh jhuDhDhu, adhaidh dhiruMbha u~NghaLughghu niRudhdhughghòDhubhbhArghaL; nI~NghaL jhAbhbhiDhDhuM dhirubhdhiyaDhaiyamADhDhIrghaL
iனனuM ivaighaL èllAvaRRAluM nI~NghaL èனghghujh jhèvighòDhAmal, èனghghu èdhirdhdhu naDhandhAl,

u~NghaL ghumArariன mAMjhadhdhaiyuM u~NghaL ghumAradhdhiyiன mAMjhadhdhaiyuM bhujhibhbhIrghaL.

jAdhighaLughghuLLe u~NghaLaijh jhidhaRa aDhidhdhu, u~NghaL bhiனனAghabh bhaDhDhayadhdhai uruvuveன; u~NghaL dhejhaM bhAzhuM, u~NghaL bhaDhDhaNa~NghaL vaனAndharamumAghuM.

nI avarghaLoDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: nI~NghaL èன jhèvighaL gheDhghajh jhòனனbhiraghAraM u~NghaLughghujh jhèyveன èனbhadhai èன jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr.

nI isravel bhudhdhiraroDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: nI~NghaL ghuDhiyirughghuMbhaDhi nAன u~NghaLughghugh ghòDhughghuM dhejhadhdhil nI~NghaL bhoyjh jherndhabhiனbhu,

dhaன bhaDhaibhbhaigh ghardhdharughghujh jhèludhdhughiRavaன jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhalighghAghiluM maRRabh bhalighghAghiluM òru ADhDhughghuDhDhiyuDhaனe, òru maraghghAlile bhadhdhil òru bha~NghuM ghARbhaDhi èNNèyile bhijhaindhadhumAன mèlliya mAviன bhojaனbhaliyaijh jhèludhdhaghghaDhavaன.
bhAனbhaliyAgha ghARbhaDhi dhirADhjharajhadhdhaiyuM bhaDhaighghaveNDhuM.
ADhDhughghaDhAvAyirundhadheyAghil, bhadhdhil iraNDhu bha~NghAனdhuM, òru bhaDhiyil mUனRil òru bha~NghAghiya èNNèyile bhijhaindhadhumAன mèlliya mAviன bhojaனbhaliyaiyuM,
bhAனbhaliyAgha òru bhaDhiyil mUனRilòru bha~Nghu dhirADhjharajhadhdhaiyuM ghardhdharughghujh jhughandha vAjhaனaiyAன bhaDhaibhbhAghabh bhaDhaighghaveNDhuM.
nI jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhalighghAghiluM, vijheShidhdha bhòrudhdhaனai bhalighghAghiluM, jhamAdhAன bhalighghAghiluM, òru ghALaiyaigh ghardhdharughghujh jhèludhdha AyadhdhabhbhaDhudhdhuMbhodhu,
adhaனoDhe bhadhdhil mUனRu bha~NghAனdhuM, araibhbhaDhi èNNèyile bhijhaindhadhumAன mèlliya mAviன bhojaனbhaliyaiyuM,
bhAனbhaliyAgha araibhbhaDhi dhirADhjha rajhadhdhaiyuM, ghardhdharughghujh jhughandhavAjhaனaiyAன dhaghaனbhaliyAghabh bhaDhaighghaveNDhuM.
indhabhbhiraghAramAghave òvvòru mADhDhughghAghiluM, ADhDhughghaDhAvughghAghiluM, jhèMmaRiyADhDhugh ghuDhDhighghAghiluM, vèLLADhDhugh ghuDhDhighghAghiluM jhèydhu bhaDhaighghaveNDhuM.

nI isravel bhudhdhiraroDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: nAன u~NghaLai azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoghiRa dhejhadhdhil nI~NghaL jherndhu,

bhiனனuM ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:

nI leviyaroDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: isravel bhudhdhirar ghaiyil vA~NghighghòLLuMbhaDhi nAன u~NghaLughghujh jhudhandharamAghagh ghòDhudhdha dhajhamabhAghadhdhai nI~NghaL avarghaL ghaiyil vA~NghuMbhodhu, dhajhamabhAghadhdhil bhadhdhil òru bha~Nghaigh ghardhdharughghu eRèDhudhdhubhbhaDhaighghuM bhaDhaibhbhAghajh jhèludhdhaveNDhuM.

ibhbhaDhiye nI~NghaL isravel bhudhdhirar ghaiyil vA~NghuM dhajhamabhAghamAghiya u~NghaL bha~NghughaLilèllAM nI~NghaLuM ghardhdharughghu èனRu òru bhaDhaibhbhai eRèDhudhdhubh bhaDhaidhdhu, andhabh bhaDhaibhbhai AjhAriyaனAghiya Aroனughghugh ghòDhughghaveNDhuM.

ghardhdhar mojheyaiyuM AroனaiyuM noghghi:

ghardhdhar ghaRbhidhdha niyamabhbhiramANamAvadhu: bhazhudhaRRadhuM UனmillAdhadhuM nughadhdhaDhighghu uDhbhaDhAdhadhumAghiya jhivabhbhAன òru ghiDhAriyai uனனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvaruMbhaDhi isravel bhudhdhirarughghujh jhòllu~NghaL.
adhai èlèyAjhAr èனனuM AjhAriyaனiDhadhdhil òbhbhughghòDhu~NghaL; avaன adhaibh bhALayadhdhughghu vèLiye ghòNDhubhoghaghghaDhavaன; a~Nghe adhu avaனughghu muனbhAghagh ghòllabhbhaDhaghghaDhavadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu AjhAriyaனξghiya ΠβèyaξjhAra͠dhaன vaߠΰlaߠΩAlaύ adhaοΩ iΰdhĠΤdhil ghò~njhaM èDhudhdhu, Ajharibhbhugh ghUDhAradhdhughghu èdhirAgha ezhudharaM dhèLighghaghghaDhavaன.
bhiனbhu ghiDhAriyai avaன ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha òruvaன jhuDhDhèrighghaveNDhuM; adhiன dholuM adhiன mAMjhamuM adhiன iradhdhamuM adhiன jhANiyuM jhuDhDhèrighghabhbhaDhaveNDhuM.
abhbhòzhudhu AjhAriyaன ghedhurughghaDhDhaiyaiyuM IjhobhbhaiyuM jhivabhbhunUlaiyuM èDhudhdhu, ghiDhAri èrighghabhbhaDhughiRa nèrubhbhiன naDhuvile bhoDhaghghaDhavaன.
bhiனbhu AjhAriyaன dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaidh dhoydhdhu, jaladhdhile snAனMbhaNNi, adhiனbhiனbhu bhALayadhdhil bhiravejhighghaghghaDhavaன; AjhAriyaன jhAya~NghAlamaDhDhuM dhIDhDhubhbhaDhDhirubhbhAன.

ghiDhAriyiன jhAMbhalai vAriனvaன dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaidh dhoyghghaghghaDhavaன; avaன jhAya~NghAlamaDhDhuM dhIDhDhubhbhaDhDhirubhbhAன; idhu isravel bhudhdhirarughghuM avarghaL naDhuvile dha~NghughiRa anniyaனughghuM nidhdhiya ghaDhDhaLaiyAyirubhbhadhAgha.

AghaiyAl dhIDhDhubhbhaDhDhavaனughghAgha, bhAvadhdhaibh bharigharighghuM ghiDhAriyiன jhAMbhalile ghò~njhaM èDhudhdhu, òru bhAdhdhiradhdhil bhoDhDhu, adhiனmel URRu jalaM vArghghaveNDhuM.

jaன~NghaL dhevaனughghuM mojheghghuM virodhamAghabh bhejhi: nA~NghaL vaனAndharadhdhile jhAghuMbhaDhi nI~NghaL è~NghaLai èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhilirundhu varabhbhaNNiனdhèனன? i~Nghe abhbhamuM illai, dhaNNIruM illai; indha aRbhamAன uNavu è~NghaL maனdhughghu vèRubhbhAyirughghiRadhu èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar ghòLLivAyjhjharbhbha~NghaLai jaன~NghaLughghuLLe aனubhbhiனAr; avaighaL jaன~NghaLaigh ghaDhidhdhadhiனAl isravelarughghuLLe anegha jaன~NghaL jhèdhdhArghaL.

adhiனAl jaன~NghaL mojheyiனiDhadhdhil bhoy: nA~NghaL ghardhdharughghuM umaghghuM virodhamAybh bhejhiனdhiனAl bhAva~njhèydhoM; jharbhbha~NghaL è~NghaLaiviDhDhu nI~NghuMbhaDhi ghardhdharai noghghi viNNabhbhaM bhaNNaveNDhuM èனRArghaL; mojhe jaன~NghaLughghAgha viNNabhbhaM bhaNNiனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi: nI òru ghòLLivAyjh jharbhbhadhdhiன uruvadhdhaijh jhèydhu, adhai òru ghaMbhadhdhiனmel dhUghghivai; ghaDhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èvaனo avaன adhai noghghibhbhArdhdhAl bhizhaibhbhAன èனRAr.

abhbhaDhiye mojhe òru vèNghalajh jharbhbhadhdhai uNDhAghghi, adhai òru ghaMbhadhdhiனmel dhUghghivaidhdhAன; jharbhbhaM òruvaனaigh ghaDhidhdhabhodhu, avaன andha vèNghalajh jharbhbhadhdhai noghghibhbhArdhdhubh bhizhaibhbhAன.
isravel bhudhdhirar bhirayANabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, obhodhdhil bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL.
obhodhdhilirundhu bhirayANaM bhaNNi, jhUriyodhayadhdhiRghu nerAy movAbhughghu èdhirAன vaனAndharadhdhiluLLa abhArImiன meDhughaLil bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL.
a~Ngheyirundhu bhirayANabhbhaDhDhubh bhoy, jhAredh bhaLLadhdhAghghile bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL.

a~Ngheyirundhu bhirayANabhbhaDhDhubh bhoy, èmoriyariன èllaiyilirundhu varughiRadhuM vaனAndharadhdhil oDhughiRadhumAன arனoன ARRughghu ibhbhuRaM bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL; andha arனoன movAbhughghuM èmoriyarughghuM naDhuve irughghiRa movAbhiன èllai.
adhiனAl jhUbhbhAviluLLa vAghebhuM, arனoனiன ARRughghAlghaLuM,
Ar èனனuM sdhaladhdhughghubh bhAyuM nIroDhaiyuM movAbhiன èllaiyaijh jhArndhirughghiRadhu èனனuM vajhaனM ghardhdharuDhaiya yudhdha bhusdhaghadhdhil èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu.
a~Ngheyirundhu bheyerughghubh bhoனArghaL; jaன~NghaLaigh ghUDhivarajhjhèy, avarghaLughghudh dhaNNIr ghòDhubhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar mojheghghujh jhòனன URRu irughghiRa iDhaM adhudhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu isravelar bhADhiன bhADhDhAvadhu: URRudh dhaNNIre, bhò~NghivA; adhaighghuRidhdhubh bhADhuvoM vAru~NghaL.
niyAyabhbhiramANighghaனiன evudhalAl adhibhadhighaL ghiNaRRaidh dhoNDhiனArghaL; jaனdhdhil meனmaghghaL dha~NghaL dhaNDhAyudha~NghaLaighghòNDhu dhoNDhiனArghaL èனRu bhADhiனArghaL.
andha vaனAndharadhdhilirundhu mAdhdhaனAvughghuM, mAdhdhaனAvilirundhu naghAliyelughghuM, naghAliyelilirundhu bhAmodhdhughghuM,
bhaLLadhdhAghghiluLLa movAbhiன vèLiyil irughghiRa bhAmodhdhilirundhu èShimoனai noghghuM bhisghAviன ujhjhighghuM bhoனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu isravelar èmoriyariன rAjAvAghiya jhIghoனiDhadhdhil sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhi:

umadhu dhejhadhdhiன vazhiyAygh ghaDhandhubhoghuMbhaDhi udhdharavu ghòDhughgha veNDhuM; nA~NghaL vayalghaLiluM, dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDha~NghaLiluM bhoghAmaluM, dhuravughaLiன dhaNNIraigh ghuDhiyAmaluM, umadhu èllaiyaigh ghaDhandhubhoghumaDhDhuM rAjabhAdhaiyil naDhandhubhovoM èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனArghaL.

jhIghoன dhaன èllaivazhiyAygh ghaDhandhubhogha isravelughghu udhdharavu ghòDhAmal, dhaன jaன~NghaLèllAraiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, isravelarughghu virodhamAgha vaனAndharadhdhile bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, yAghAjhughghu vandhu, isravelaroDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNiனAன.

isravelar avaனaibh bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl vèDhDhi, arனoன dhòDha~Nghi aMmoன bhudhdhirariன dhejhadhdhaijhjhArndha yAbhbhoghghuvaraighghumuLLa avaனuDhaiya dhejhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhArghaL; aMmoன bhudhdhirariன èllai araNibhbhAனdhAyirundhadhu.
isravelar andhabh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaL yAvaiyuM bhiDhidhdhu, èsbhoனiluM adhaijh jhArndha èllAgh ghirAma~NghaLiluM èmoriyaruDhaiya èllAbhbhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiluM ghuDhiyirundhArghaL.

èsbhoனAனdhu èmoriyariன rAjAvAghiya jhIghoனiன bhaDhDhaNamAyirundhadhu; avaன movAbhiyariன mundhiன rAjAvughghu virodhamAgha yudhdhaMbhaNNi, arனoன varaighghuM irundha avaன dhejhadhdhaiyèllAM avaன ghaiyilirundhu bhaRidhdhughghòNDhAன.
adhiனAle ghavighaDhDhughiRavarghaL: èsbhoனughghu vAru~NghaL; jhIghoனiன bhaDhDhaNaM sdhiramAygh ghaDhDhabhbhaDhuvadhAgha.
èsbhoனilirundhu aghghiனiyuM jhIghoனuDhaiya bhaDhDhaNadhdhilirundhu juvAlaiyuM bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, movAbhuDhaiya Ar èனனuM UraiyuM, arனoனuDhaiya meDhughaLiluLLa ANDhavamArghaLaiyuM bhaDhjhidhdhadhu.
aiyo, movAbhe, ghemoSh dhevaனiன jaனme, nI nAjhamAனAy; dhabhbhi oDhiன dhaன ghumAraraiyuM dhaன ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM èmoriyariன rAjAvAghiya jhIghoனughghujh jhiRaighaLAgha òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAன.
avarghaLai èydhubhoDhDhoM; èsbhoன bhaDhDhaNaM dhIbhoன UrvaraighghuM nAjhamAyiRRu; medhebhAvughghujh jhamIbhamAன nobhbhA bhaDhDhaNabhariyandhaM avarghaLaibh bhAzhAghghiனoM èனRu bhADhiனArghaL.
isravelar ibhbhaDhiye èmoriyariன dhejhadhdhile ghuDhiyirundhArghaL.
bhiனbhu, mojhe yAjher bhaDhDhaNadhdhughghu vevu bhArghghiRavarghaLai aனubhbhiனAன; avarghaL adhaijhjherndha ghirAma~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhu, a~Nghe irundha èmoriyaraidh dhuradhdhiviDhDhArghaL.

bhiனbhu bhAjhAனughghubh bhoghiRa vazhiyAydh dhiruMbhiviDhDhArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu bhAjhAன rAjAvAghiya ogh èனbhavaன dhaன jhamasdha jaன~NghaLoDhuM avarghaLai èdhirdhdhu yudhdhaMbhaNNuMbhaDhighghu, èdhreyughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu vandhAன.

ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi: avaனughghubh bhayabhbhaDhaveNDhAM; avaனaiyuM avaன jaன~NghaL èllAraiyuM, avaன dhejhadhdhaiyuM uன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdheன; èsbhoனile vAjhamAyirundha èmoriyariன rAjAvAghiya jhIghoனughghu nI jhèydhabhaDhiye ivaனughghuM jhèyvAy èனRAr.
abhbhaDhiye òruvaruM uyiruDhaன mIdhiyAyirAdhabhaDhighghu avaனaiyuM, avaன ghumAraraiyuM, avaனuDhaiya jhaghala jaன~NghaLaiyuM vèDhDhibhbhoDhDhu, avaன dhejhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhArghaL.
bhiனbhu isravel bhudhdhirar bhirayANaM bhaNNi, èrighoviன ghiDhDha irughghuM yordhAனughghu ighgharaiyile movAbhiன jhamaனAன vèLighaLil bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL.
isravelar èmoriyarughghujh jhèydha yAvaiyuM jhibhbhoriன ghumAraனAghiya bhAlAgh ghaNDhAன.
jaன~NghaL erALamAyirundhabhaDhiyiனAl, movAbh mighavuM bhayandhu, isravel bhudhdhirariனimidhdhaM ghalaghghamaDhaindhu,

mIdhiyAனriன mUbhbharai noghghi: mADhu vèLiyiன bhullai meyghiRadhubhola, ibhbhòzhudhu indhagh ghUDhDhaM naMmaijh jhuRRiyirughghiRa yAvaiyuM meyndhubhoDhuM èனRAன aghghAladhdhile jhibhbhoriன ghumAraனAghiya bhAlAgh movAbhiyarughghu rAjAvAyirundhAன.

avaன bheyoriன ghumAraனAghiya bhileyAmai azhaidhdhuvaruMbhaDhi, dhaன jhandhadhiyAruDhaiya dhejhadhdhil nadhiyarugheyuLLa bhèdhdhUrughghu sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhi: èghibhdhilirundhu òru jaனghghUDhDhaM vandhirughghiRadhu; avarghaL bhUmiyiன vijhAladhdhai mUDhi, èனghghu èdhire iRa~NghiyirughghiRArghaL.

avarghaL èனனiluM bhalavAனghaL; AghiluM, nIr AjhIrvadhighghiRavaன AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன, nIr jhabhighghiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனRu aRiveன; AdhalAl, nIr vandhu, èனghghAgha andha jaனdhdhaijh jhabhighghaveNDhuM; abhbhòzhudhu òruveLai nAன avarghaLai muRiya aDhidhdhu, avarghaLai idhdhejhadhdhilirundhu dhuradhdhiviDhalAM èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAன.

abhbhaDhiye movAbhiன mUbhbharuM mIdhiyAனiன mUbhbharuM ghuRijhòlludhalughghuriya ghUliyaidh dha~NghaL ghaiyil èDhudhdhughghòNDhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, bhileyAmiDhadhdhil bhoy, bhAlAghiன vArdhdhaighaLai avaனughghujh jhòனனArghaL.

avaன avarghaLai noghghi: irAdhdhirighghu i~Nghe dha~Nghiyiru~NghaL; ghardhdhar èனghghujh jhòllughiRabhaDhiye u~NghaLughghu udhdharavu ghòDhubhbheன èனRAன; abhbhaDhiye movAbhiன bhirabhughghaL bhileyAmiDhadhdhil dha~NghiனArghaL.
dhevaன bhileyAmiDhadhdhil vandhu: uனனiDhadhdhilirughghiRa indha maனidhar yAr èனRAr.
bhileyAM dhevaனai noghghi: jhibhbhoriன ghumAraனAghiya bhAlAgh èனனuM movAbhiன rAjA avarghaLai èனனiDhadhdhughghu aனubhbhi:

bhUmiyiன vijhAladhdhai mUDhughiRa òru jaனghghUDhDhaM èghibhdhilirundhu vandhirughghiRadhu; AghaiyAl, nI vandhu èனghghAgha avarghaLaijh jhabhighghaveNDhuM; abhbhòzhudhu nAன avarghaLoDhe yudhdhaM bhaNNi, òruveLai avarghaLaidh dhuradhdhiviDhalAM èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAன èனRAன.
adhaRghudh dhevaன bhileyAmai noghghi: nI avarghaLoDhe bhoghaveNDhAM; andha jaன~NghaLaijh jhabhighghavuM veNDhAM; avarghaL AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaL èனRAr.

bhileyAM ghAlame èzhundhu, bhAlAghiன bhirabhughghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL u~NghaL dhejhadhdhiRghubh bhoyviDhu~NghaL; nAன u~NghaLoDheghUDha varughiRadhaRghugh ghardhdhar èனghghu udhdharavu ghòDhughghamADhDhoM èனghiRAr èனRu jhòனனAன.
abhbhaDhiye movAbhiyaruDhaiya bhirabhughghaL èzhundhu, bhAlAghiனiDhadhdhil bhoy: bhileyAM è~NghaLoDhe varamADhDheன èனRu jhòனனAன èனRArghaL.
bhAlAgh maRubhaDhiyuM avarghaLiluM ghaனvAனghaLAன adhigha bhirabhughghaLai aனubhbhiனAன.
avarghaL bhileyAmiDhadhdhil bhoy, avaனai noghghi: jhibhbhoriன ghumAraனAghiya bhAlAgh è~NghaLai aனubhbhi: nIr èனனiDhadhdhil varughiRadhaRghudh dhaDhaibhaDhaveNDhAM;
uMmai mighavuM ghaனMbhaNNuveன; nIr jhòlvadhaiyèllAM jhèyveன; nIr vandhu èனghghAgha andha jaன~NghaLaijh jhabhighghaveNDhuM èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAr èனRArghaL.

bhileyAM bhAlAghiன UzhiyaghghArarughghu bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: bhAlAgh èனghghudh dhaன vIDhu niRaiya vèLLiyuM bhòனனuM dhandhAluM, jhiRiya ghAriyamAனAluM bhèriyaghAriyamAனAluM jhèyyuMbhòruDhDhu, èன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன ghaDhDhaLaiyai nAன mIRagh ghUDhAdhu.
AghiluM, ghardhdhar iனimel èனghghu èனன jhòlluvAr èனbhadhai nAன aRiyuMbhaDhighghu nI~NghaLuM indha irAdhdhiri i~Nghe dha~Nghiyiru~NghaL èனRAன.

iravile dhevaன bhileyAmiDhadhdhil vandhu: andha maனidhar uனனaigh ghUbhbhiDha vandhirundhAl, nI avarghaLoDhe ghUDhabhbho; AனAluM nAன uனghghujh jhòlluM vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhimAdhdhiraM nI jhèyyaveNDhuM èனRAr.
bhileyAM ghAlame èzhundhu, dhaன ghazhudhaiyiனmel jheNa~NghaDhDhi, movAbhiன bhirabhughghaLoDheghUDhabh bhoனAன.

avaன bhoghiRadhiனAle dhevaனughghugh ghobhaM mUNDhadhu; ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar vazhiyile avaனughghu èdhirALiyAgha niனRAr. avaன dhaன ghazhudhaiyiன mel eRibhbhoனAன; avaன velaighghArar iraNDhubheruM avaனoDhe irundhArghaL.

ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar uruviன bhaDhDhayadhdhaidh dhaMmuDhaiya ghaiyile bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu vazhiyile niRghiRadhaigh ghazhudhai ghaNDhu, vazhiyai viDhDhu vayalile vilaghibhbhoyiRRu; ghazhudhaiyai vazhiyil dhirubhbha bhileyAM adhai aDhidhdhAன.
ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar irubhuRadhdhiluM jhuvar vaidhdhirundha dhirADhjhadh dhoDhDha~NghaLiன bhAdhaiyile bhoy niனRAr.
ghazhudhai ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனaighghaNDhu, jhuvar oramAy òdhu~Nghi, bhileyAmiன ghAlaijh jhuvaroDhe nèrughghiRRu; dhiruMbhavuM adhai aDhidhdhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன abhbhuRaM bhoy, valadhubhuRaM iDhadhubhuRaM vilagha vazhiyillAdha iDhughghamAன iDhadhdhile niனRAr.
ghazhudhai ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனaigh ghaNDhu, bhileyAmiன ghIzhbh bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhadhu; bhileyAM ghobhaM mUNDhavaனAghi, ghazhudhaiyaidh dhaDhiyiனAl aDhidhdhAன.
uDhaனe ghardhdhar ghazhudhaiyiன vAyaidh dhiRandhAr; adhu bhileyAmaibh bhArdhdhu: nIr èனனai ibhbhòzhudhu mUனRu dharaM aDhighghuMbhaDhi nAன umaghghu èனன jhèydheன èனRadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu bhileyAM ghazhudhaiyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI èனனaibh bhariyAjhaM bhaNNighghòNDhu varughiRAy; èன ghaiyil òru bhaDhDhayaMmAdhdhiraM irundhAl ibhbhòzhudhe uனனaigh ghòனRubhoDhuveன èனRAன.

ghazhudhai bhileyAmai noghghi: nIr èனனaigh ghaighghòNDha ghAlamudhal innALvaraighghuM nIr eRiன ghazhudhai nAன allavA? ibhbhaDhi umaghghu èbhbhodhAghiluM nAன jhèydhadhu uNDhA èனRadhu. adhaRghu avaன: illai èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar bhileyAmiன ghaNghaLaidh dhiRandhAr; vazhiyile niனRu uruviன bhaDhDhadhdhaidh dhaMmuDhaiya ghaiyile bhiDhidhdhirughghiRa dhUdhaனaigh ghaNDhu, dhalaighuனindhu mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhu bhaNindhAன.

ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar avaனai noghghi: nI uன ghazhudhaiyai idhaனoDhe mUனRudharaM aDhidhdhadhèனன? uன vazhi èனghghu mARubhADhAyirughghiRadhiனAl, nAன uனghghu èdhiriyAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu vandheன.
ghazhudhai èனனaigh ghaNDhu, indha mUனRu dharaM èனghghu vilaghiRRu; èனghghu vilaghAmal irundhadhAனAl, ibhbhòzhudhu nAன uனனai ghòனRubhoDhDhu, ghazhudhaiyai uyiroDhe vaibhbheன èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu bhileyAM ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனai noghghi: nAன bhAva~njhèydheன; vazhiyile nIr èனghghu èdhirAgha niRghiRadhai aRiyAdhirundheன; ibhbhòzhudhuM umadhu bhArvaighghu idhu dhaghAdhadhAyirughghumAனAl, nAன dhiruMbhibh bhoyviDhughiReன èனRAன.

ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar bhileyAmai noghghi: andha maனidharoDhe ghUDhabhbho; nAன uனனoDhe jhòlluM vArdhdhaiyaimAdhdhiraM nI jhòllaghghaDhavAy èனRAr; abhbhaDhiye bhileyAM bhAlAghiன bhirabhughghaLoDheghUDhabh bhoனAன.
bhileyAM varughiRadhaibh bhAlAgh gheDhDhamAdhdhiradhdhil, ghaDhaijhi èllaiyAன arனoன nadhiyiன oradhdhiluLLa movAbhiன bhaDhDhaNamaDhDhuM avaனughghu èdhirghòNDhu bhoனAன.
bhAlAgh bhileyAmai noghghi: uMmai azhaighghuMbhaDhi nAன AvaloDhe uMmiDhadhdhil AL aனubhbhavillaiyA? èனனiDhadhdhiRghu varAmal irundhadhèனன? eRRabhiraghAramAgha uMmai nAன ghaனM bhaNNamADhDheனA èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhileyAM bhAlAghai noghghi: idho, uMmiDhadhdhiRghu vandheன; AனAluM edhAghiluM jhòllughiRadhaRghu èனனAle Aghumo: dhevaன èன vAyile aLighghuM vArdhdhaiyaiye jhòlluveன èனRAன.
bhileyAM bhAlAghuDhaனeghUDhabh bhoனAன; avarghaL ghIriyAdh Ujhodhdhil jherndhArghaL.
a~Nghe bhAlAgh ADhumADhughaLai aDhidhdhu, bhileyAmughghuM avaனoDhirundha bhirabhughghaLughghuM aனubhbhiனAன.
maRunAL ghAlame bhAlAgh bhileyAmaigh ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, avaனaibh bhAghAluDhaiya meDhughaLil eRabhbhaNNiனAன; avviDhadhdhilirundhu bhileyAM jaனdhdhiன ghaDhaijhibh bhALayadhdhaibh bhArdhdhAன.
bhileyAM bhAlAghai noghghi: nIr i~Nghe èனghghu ezhu bhalibhIDha~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhi, ezhu ghALaighaLaiyuM ezhu ADhDhughghaDhAghghaLaiyuM i~Nghe èனghghu AyadhdhabhbhaDhudhdhuM èனRAன.
bhileyAM jhòனனbhaDhiye bhAlAgh jhèydhAன; bhAlAghuM bhileyAmuM òvvòru bhIDhadhdhil òvvòru ghALaiyaiyuM òvvòru ADhDhughghaDhAvaiyuM bhaliyiDhDhArghaL.

bhiனbhu bhileyAM bhAlAghai noghghi: uMmuDhaiya jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhaliyaNDhaiyil nilluM, nAன bhoyvarughiReன; ghardhdhar vandhu èனனaijh jhandhighghiRadhAyirughghuM; avar èனghghu vèLibhbhaDhudhdhuvadhai umaghghu aRivibhbheன èனRu jhòlli, òru meDhDhiனmel eRiனAன.

dhevaன bhileyAmaijh jhandhidhdhAr; abhbhòzhudhu avaன avarai noghghi: nAன ezhu bhalibhIDha~NghaLai AyadhdhaM bhaNNi, òvvòru bhalibhIDhadhdhil òvvòru ghALaiyaiyuM òvvòru ADhDhughghaDhAvaiyuM bhaliyiDhDheன èனRAன.
ghardhdhar bhileyAmiன vAyile vAghghu aruLi: nI bhAlAghiனiDhadhdhil dhiruMbhibhbhoy, ivvidhamAyjh jhòllaghghaDhavAy èனRAr.
avaனiDhadhdhughghu avaன dhiruMbhibhoனAன; bhAlAgh movAbhuDhaiya jhaghala bhirabhughghaLoDhu~NghUDhadh dhaன jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhaliyaNDhaiyile niனRughòNDhirundhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன vAghghiyadhdhai èDhudhdhuraidhdhu: movAbhiன rAjAvAghiya bhAlAgh èனனaigh ghizhaghghu malaighaLiluLLa ArAmilirundhu varavazhaidhdhu: nI vandhu èனghghAgha yAghghobhaijh jhabhighghaveNDhuM; nI vandhu isravelai vèRudhdhu viDhaveNDhuM èனRu jhòனனAன.
dhevaன jhabhighghAdhavaனai nAன jhabhibhbhadhèbhbhaDhi? ghardhdhar vèRughghAdhavaனai nAன vèRubhbhadhèbhbhaDhi?
ghaனmalaiyujhjhiyilirundhu nAன avaனaigh ghaNDhu, ghuனRughaLilirundhu avaனaibh bhArghghiReன; andha jaன~NghaL jAdhighaLoDhe ghalavAmal dhaனiye vAjhamAyirubhbhArghaL.
yAghghobhiன dhULai èNNadhdhaghghavaன yAr? israveliன ghARbha~Nghai èNNughiRavaன yAr? nIdhimAன maribhbhadhu bhol nAன maribhbheனAgha, èன muDhivu avaன muDhivubhol irubhbhadhAgha èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhAlAgh bhileyAmai noghghi: nIr èனghghu èனனjhèydhIr; èன jhadhdhurughghaLaijh jhabhighghuMbhaDhi uMmai azhaibhbhidhdheன; nIr avarghaLai AjhIrvadhighghave AjhIrvadhidhdhIr èனRAன.
adhaRghu avaன: ghardhdhar èன vAyil aruLiனdhaiye jhòlvadhu èன ghaDhamaiyallavA èனRAன.

bhiனbhu bhAlAgh avaனai noghghi: nIr avarghaLaibh bhArghghadhdhaghgha veRòru iDhadhdhiRghu èனனoDheghUDha vAruM; a~Nghe avarghaL èllAraiyuM bhArAmal, avarghaLuDhaiya ghaDhaijhibh bhALayadhdhaimAdhdhiraM bhArbhbhIr; a~Ngheyirundhu èனghghAgha avarghaLaijh jhabhighghaveNDhuM èனRu jhòlli,

avaனaibh bhisghAviன ghòDhumuDhiyil irughghiRa jhobhbhImIன vèLiyile azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoy, ezhu bhali bhIDha~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhi, òvvòru bhIDhadhdhil òvvòru ghALaiyaiyuM òvvòru ADhDhughghaDhAvaiyuM bhaliyiDhDhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhileyAM bhAlAghai noghghi: i~Nghe uMmuDhaiya jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhaliyaNDhaiyil nilluM; nAன a~Nghe bhoygh ghardhdharaijh jhandhidhdhuvarughiReன èனRAன.
ghardhdhar bhileyAmaijh jhandhidhdhu, avaன vAyile vajhaனdhdhai aruLi: nI bhAlAghiனiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhibhoy, ivvidhamAyjh jhòllaghghaDhavAy èனRAr.

avaனiDhadhdhiRghu avaன varughiRabhodhu, avaன movAbhiன bhirabhughghaLoDhu~NghUDhadh dhaனனuDhaiya jharvA~NghadhaghaனbhaliyaNDhaiyile niனRughòNDhirundhAன; bhAlAgh avaனai noghghi: ghardhdhar èனன jhòனனAr èனRu gheDhDhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன vAghghiyadhdhai èDhudhdhuraidhdhu: bhAlAghe, èzhundhirundhu gheLuM; jhibhbhoriன ghumAraனe, èனghghujh jhèvighòDhuM.
bhòy jhòlla dhevaன òru maனidhaன alla; maனMmARa avar òru maனubhudhdhiraனuM alla; avar jhòlliyuM jhèyyAdhirubhbhArA? avar vajhaனidhdhuM niRaiveRRAdhirubhbhArA?
idho, AjhIrvadhighghagh ghaDhDhaLaibhèRReன; avar AjhIrvadhighghiRAr, adhai nAன dhirubhbhagh ghUDhAdhu.

avar yAghghobhile aghghiramadhdhaigh ghANghiRadhuM illai, isravelile ghuRRaM bhArghghiRadhuM illai; avarghaLuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar avarghaLoDhe irughghiRAr; rAjAviன jayaghèMbhIraM avarghaLughghuLLe irughghiRadhu.
dhevaன avarghaLai èghibhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiனAr; ghANDhAmirughadhdhughghòdhdha bhèlaன avarghaLughghu uNDhu.

yAghghobhughghu virodhamAன mandhiravAdhaM illai, isravelughghu virodhamAன ghuRijhòlludhaluM illai; dhevaன èனனèனன jhèydhAr èனRu ghò~njhagh ghAladhdhile yAghghobhaiyuM isravelaiyuM ghuRidhdhujh jhòllabhbhaDhuM.

andha jaனM dhuShDha jhi~NghaMbhola èzhuMbhuM, bhAla jhi~NghaMbhola nimirndhu niRghuM; adhu dhAன bhiDhidhdha iraiyaibh bhaDhjhidhdhu, vèDhDhuNDhavarghaLiன iradhdhadhdhaigh ghuDhighghumaDhDhuM bhaDhudhdhughghòLvadhillai èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhAlAgh bhileyAmai noghghi: nIr avarghaLaijh jhabhighghavuM veNDhAM, avarghaLai AjhIrvadhighghavuM veNDhAM èனRAன.
adhaRghubh bhileyAM bhAlAghaibh bhArdhdhu: ghardhdhar jhòllughiRabhaDhiyèllAM jhèyveன èனRu uMmoDhe nAன jhòllavillaiyA èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhAlAgh bhileyAmai noghghi: vAruM veRòru iDhadhdhiRghu uMmai azhaidhdhughghòNDhu bhoghiReன; nIr a~NgheyirundhAvadhu èனghghAgha avarghaLaijh jhabhighghiRadhu dhevaனughghubh bhiriyamAyirughghuM èனRu jhòlli,
avaனai èShimoனughghu èdhirAyirughghiRa bheyoriன ghòDhumuDhighghu azhaidhdhughghòNDhu bhoனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhileyAM bhAlAghai noghghi: i~Nghe èனghghu ezhu bhalibhIDha~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhi, i~Nghe èனghghu ezhu ghALaighaLaiyuM ezhu ADhDhugh ghaDhAghghaLaiyuM AyadhdhaMbhaNNuM èனRAன.
bhileyAM jhòனனbhaDhi bhAlAgh jhèydhu, òvvòru bhIDhadhdhil òvvòru ghALaiyaiyuM òvvòru ADhDhughghaDhAvaiyuM bhaliyiDhDhAன.

isravelai AjhIrvadhibhbhadhe ghardhdharughghubh bhiriyaM èனRu bhileyAM ghaNDha bhodhu, avaன mundhijh jhèydhuvandhadhu bhola nimidhdhaMbhArghghabh bhoghAmal, vaனAndharadhdhiRghu nerAgha dhaன mughadhdhaidh dhirubhbhi,
dhaன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhu, isravel dhaன ghodhdhira~NghaLiனbhaDhiye bhALayamiRa~NghiyirughghiRadhaibh bhArdhdhAன; dheva Avi avaனmel vandhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன vAghghiyadhdhai èDhudhdhuraidhdhu: bheyoriன ghumAraனAghiya bhileyAM jhòllughiRadhAvadhu, ghaN dhiRaghghabhbhaDhDhavaன uraighghiRadhAvadhu,
dhevaன aruLuM vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhu, jharvavallavariன dharijhaனdhdhaigh ghaNDhu dhAzha vizhuM bhodhu, ghaNdhiRaghghabhbhaDhDhavaன viLaMbhughiRadhAvadhu,
yAghghobhe, uன ghUDhAra~NghaLuM, isravele, uன vAjhasdhala~NghaLuM èvvaLavu azhaghAனvaighaL!

avaighaL bharavibhbhoghiRa ARughaLaibh bholavuM, nadhiyoradhdhiluLLa dhoDhDha~NghaLaibhbholavuM, ghardhdhar nADhDhiன jhandhaனmara~NghaLaibhbholavuM, dhaNNIr arughe uLLa ghedhuru viruDhjha~NghaLaibhbholavuM irughghiRadhu.
avarghaLuDhaiya nIrjhjhAlghaLilirundhu dhaNNIr bhAyuM; avarghaL vidhdhu dhiraLAன dhaNNIrghaLil bharavuM; avarghaLuDhaiya rAjA AghAghaibh bhArghghiluM uyaruvAன; avarghaL rAjyaM meனmaiyaDhaiyuM.

dhevaன avarghaLai èghibhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiனAr; ghANDhAmirughadhdhughghòdhdha bhèlaன avarghaLughghu uNDhu; avarghaL dha~NghaL jhadhdhurughghaLAghiya jAdhighaLaibh bhaDhjhidhdhu, avarghaL èluMbhughaLai nòRughghi, avarghaLaidh dha~NghaL aMbhughaLAle èyvArghaL.

jhi~NghaMbholavuM dhuShDha jhi~NghaMbholavuM maDha~Nghibh bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhirughghiRArghaL; avarghaLai èzhubhbhughiRavaன yAr? u~NghaLai AjhIrvadhighghiRavaன AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன, u~NghaLaijh jhabhighghiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhAlAgh bhileyAmiன mel ghobhaM mUNDhavaனAghi, ghaiyoDhe ghaidhaDhDhi, bhileyAmai noghghi: èன jhadhdhurughghaLaijh jhabhighgha uனனai azhaidhdhaனubhbhiனeன. nIyo indha mUனRumuRaiyuM avarghaLai AjhIrvadhighghave AjhIrvadhidhdhAy.
AghaiyAl uன iDhadhdhughghu oDhibhbho; uனனai mighavuM ghaனMbhaNNuveன èனReன; nI ghaனmaDhaiyAdhabhaDhighghugh ghardhdhar dhaDhudhdhAr èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhileyAM bhAlAghai noghghi: bhAlAgh èனghghu dhaன vIDhu niRaiya vèLLiyuM bhòனனuM ghòDhudhdhAluM, nAன èன maனdhAy naனmaiyAghiluM dhImaiyAghiluM jhèyghiRadhaRghugh ghardhdhariன ghaDhDhaLaiyai mIRagh ghUDhAdhu; ghardhdhar jhòlvadhaiye jhòlveன èனRu,
nIr èனனiDhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiன sdhAனAbhadhighaLiDhadhdhil nAன jhòllavillaiyA?
idho, nAன èன jaனdhdhAriDhadhdhiRghubh bhoghiReன; bhiRghAladhdhile indha jaன~NghaL uMmuDhaiya jaன~NghaLughghujh jhèyvadhu iனனdhèனRu umaghghudh dhèrivibhbheன vAruM èனRu jhòlli,
avaன dhaன vAghghiyadhdhai èDhudhdhuraidhdhu: bheyoriன ghumAraன bhileyAM jhòllughiRadhAvadhu, ghaN dhiRaghghabhbhaDhDhavaன uraighghiRadhAvadhu,
dhevaன aruLuM vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhu, uனனdhamAனvar aLidhdha aRivai aRindhu, jharvavallavariன dharijhaனdhdhaigh ghaNDhu dhAzhavizhuMbhodhu, ghaNdhiRaghghabhbhaDhDhavaன viLaMbhughiRadhAvadhu;

avaraigh ghANbheன, ibhbhòzhudhu alla; avaraidh dharijhibhbheன, jhamIbhamAy alla; òru naDhjhadhdhiraM yAghghobhilirundhu udhighghuM, òru jhè~Nghol isravelilirundhu èzhuMbhuM; adhu movAbhiன èllaighaLai nòRughghi, jhedhbhudhdhirar èllAraiyuM nirmUlamAghghuM.
edhoM jhudhandharamAghuM, jheyIr dhaன jhadhdhurughghaLughghujh jhudhandharamAghuM; isravel bharAghghirama~njhèyyuM.
yAghghobhilirundhu dhoனRuM òruvar ALughai jhèyvAr; bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLil mIdhiyAனvarghaLai azhibhbhAr èனRAன.
meluM, avaன amaleghghaibh bhArdhdhu, dhaன vAghghiyadhdhai èDhudhdhuraidhdhu: amaleghghu mundhiyèzhuMbhiனvaன; AனAluM avaன muDhivile muRRiluM nAjhamaDhaivAன èனRAன.
aனRiyuM avaன gheனiyaனaibh bhArdhdhu, dhaன vAghghiyadhdhai èDhudhdhuraidhdhu: uன vAjhasdhalaM araNibhbhAனdhu; uன ghUDhDhaigh ghaனmalaiyil ghaDhDhiனAy.
AghiluM gheனiyaன azhindhubhovAன; ajhUr uனனaijh jhiRaibhiDhidhdhugh ghòNDhubhogha èdhdhaனainAL jhèlluM èனRAன.
bhiனனuM avaன dhaன vAghghiyadhdhai èDhudhdhuraidhdhu: aiyo, dhevaன idhaijh jhèyyuMbhodhu yAr bhizhaibhbhAன;
jhidhdhImiன gharaidhuRaiyilirundhu ghabhbhalghaL vandhu, ajhUraijh jhiRumaibh bhaDhudhdhi, ebheraiyuM varudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhuM; avaனuM muRRiluM azhindhubhovAன èனRAன.
bhiனbhu bhileyAM èzhundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, dhaன iDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhiனAன; bhAlAghuM dhaன vazhiye bhoனAன.
isravel jhidhdhImile dha~Nghiyirughghaiyil, jaன~NghaL movAbhiன ghumAradhdhighaLoDhe vejhidhdhaனM bhaNNadhdhòDha~NghiனArghaL.
avarghaL dha~NghaL dhevarghaLughghu iDhDha bhalighaLai virundhuNNuMbhaDhi jaன~NghaLai azhaidhdhArghaL; jaன~NghaL bhoy bhujhidhdhu, avarghaL dhevarghaLaibh bhaNindhughghòNDhArghaL.
ibhbhaDhi isravelar bhAghAlbheyoraibh bhaRRighghòNDhArghaL; adhaனAl isravelar mel ghardhdharuDhaiya ghobhaM mUNDhadhu.

ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi: ghardhdharuDhaiya ughghiramAன ghobhaM isravelai viDhDhu nI~NghuMbhaDhi nI jaன~NghaLiன dhalaivar èllAraiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, abhbhaDhijh jhèydhavarghaLaijh jhUriyaனughghu èdhire ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhAனdhdhil dhUghghibhbhoDhuMbhaDhi jhèy èனRAr.
abhbhaDhiye mojhe israveliன niyAyAdhibhadhighaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL avaravar bhAghAlbheyoraibh bhaRRighghòNDha u~NghaL maனidharaigh ghòனRubhoDhu~NghaL èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu mojheyuM isravel bhudhdhirarAghiya jhabhaiyAr aனaivaruM Ajharibhbhugh ghUDhAravAjhalughghu muனbhAgha azhudhughòNDhu niRghaiyil, avarghaL ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha isravel bhudhdhiraril òruvaன òru mIdhiyAனiya sdhirIyaidh dhaன jhaghodharariDhadhdhil azhaidhdhugh ghòNDhuvandhAன.
adhai AjhAriyaனAghiya Aroனiன ghumAraனAன èlèyAjhAriன maghaன bhiனèghAs ghaNDhabhodhu, avaன naDhujhjhabhaiyilirundhu èzhundhu, òru IDhDhiyaidh dhaன ghaiyile bhiDhidhdhu,

isravelaனAghiya andha maனidhaன vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNuM aRaiyile avaன bhiனனAle bhoy, isravel maனidhaனuM andha sdhirIyumAghiya iruvaruDhaiya vayiRRiluM IDhDhi uruvibhbhogha avarghaLaigh ghudhdhibhbhoDhDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu isravel bhudhdhiraril uNDhAன vAdhai niனRubhoyiRRu.
andha vAdhaiyAl jhèdhdhavarghaL irubhadhdhunAlAyiraM bher.
ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:

nAன èன èrijhjhalil isravel bhudhdhirarai nirmUlamAghghAdhabhaDhighghu, AjhAriyaனAghiya Aroனiன ghumAraனAன èlèyAjhAriன maghaன bhiனèghAs, èன nimidhdhaM avarghaL naDhuvil bhaghdhivairAghghiyaM ghANbhidhdhadhiனAl, isravel bhudhdhirar mel uNDhAன èன ughghiradhdhaidh dhirubhbhiனAன.
AghaiyAl, idho, avaனughghu èன jhamAdhAனdhdhiன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyaigh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhughiReன.

avaன dhaன dhevaனughghAgha bhaghdhivairAghghiyaM ghANbhidhdhu, isravel bhudhdhirarughghAghabh bhAvanivardhdhi jhèydhabhaDhiyiனAl, avaனughghuM avaனughghubh bhiனbhu avaன jhandhadhighghuM nidhdhiya AjhAriya bhaDhDhadhdhiRghuriya uDhaனbhaDhighghai uNDhAyirughghuM èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
mIdhiyAனiya sdhirIyoDhe ghudhdhuNDhu jhèdhdha isravel maனidhaனuDhaiya bher jhiMri; avaன jhalluUviன ghumAraனuM, jhimiyoனiyariன dhaghabhbhaன vaMjhadhdhil òru bhirabhuvumAyirundhAன.
ghudhdhuNDha mIdhiyAனiya sdhirIyiன bher ghasbhi, avaL jhUriன ghumAradhdhi, avaன mIdhiyAனiyaruDhaiya dhaghabhbhaன vaMjhadhdhArAன jaன~NghaLughghudh dhalaivaனAyirundhAன.
ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:
mIdhiyAனiyarai nèrughghi avarghaLai vèDhDhibhbhoDhu~NghaL.

bheyoriன jha~NghadhiyiluM bheyoriன nimidhdhaM vAdhaiyuNDhAன nALile ghudhdhuNDha avarghaL jhaghodhariyAghiya ghasbhi èனனuM mIdhiyAன bhirabhuviனuDhaiya ghumAradhdhiyiன jha~NghadhiyiluM, avarghaL u~NghaLughghujh jhèydha jharbhbhaனaighaLiனAl u~NghaLai mojhaMbhoghghi nèrughghiனArghaLe èனRAr.
andha vAdhai dhIrndhabhiனbhu, ghardhdhar mojheyaiyuM Aroனiன ghumAraனuM AjhAriyaனumAghiya èlèyAjhAraiyuM noghghi:

isravel bhudhdhirariன jhamasdha jhabhaiyAraiyuM avarghaL bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya vaMjhadhdhiனbhaDhi irubhadhu vayadhumudhal adhaRghu meRbhaDhDha isravelile yudhdhadhiRghubh bhuRabhbhaDhadhdhaghghavarghaL èllAraiyuM èNNu~NghaL èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu mojheyuM AjhAriyaனAghiya èlèyAjhAruM èrighoviன arughe irughghuM yordhAனughghu ibhbhAle movAbhiன jhamaனAன vèLighaLile avarghaLoDhe bhejhi:

ghardhdhar mojheghghuM èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDha isravel bhudhdhirarughghuM ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirughghiRabhaDhiye, irubhadhu vayadhumudhaRghòNDhirughghiRavarghaLai èNNu~NghaL èனRArghaL.
rUbhaன israveliன mUdhdha ghumAraன; rUbhaனuDhaiya ghumArar, AனAghghiyar ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghudh dhaghabhbhaனAன AனoghghuM, bhalluUviyar ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghudh dhaghabhbhaனAன bhalluUvuM,
èsroனiyar ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghudh dhaghabhbhaனAன èsroனuM, gharmIyar ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghudh dhaghabhbhaனAன gharmIyume.
ivaighaLe rUbhaனiyariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaL; avarghaLil èNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaL nARbhadhdhu mUvAyiradhdhu èzhunURRu mubhbhadhubher.
bhalluUviன ghumAraன èliyAbh.

èliyAbhiன ghumArar nemuvel, dhAdhdhAன, abhirAM èனbhavarghaL; indhadh dhAdhdhAன abhirAM èனbhavarghaLe jhabhaiyil bherbhèRRavarghaLAyirundhu, ghardhdharughghu virodhamAghabh bhorADhDhaM bhaNNi, ghorAghiன ghUDhDhALighaLAghi, mojheghghuM AroனughghuM virodhamAgha vivAdhaMbhaNNiனvarghaL.
bhUmi dhaன vAyaidh dhiRandhu, avarghaLaiyuM ghorAghaiyuM vizhu~NghiனdhiனAluM, aghghiனi irunURRu aiMbhadhu bheraibh bhaDhjhidhdhadhiனAluM, andhagh ghUDhDhadhdhAr jhèdhdhu, òru aDhaiyALamAனArghaL.
ghorAghiன ghumAraro jhAghavillai.

ghAdhdhuDhaiya ghumArariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaLAvaன: jhibhbhoனiன jhandhadhiyAன jhibhbhoனiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, Aghiyiன jhandhadhiyAன Aghiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, jhUனiyiன jhandhadhiyAன jhUனiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM,

ivaighaLe ijhaghghAriன ghuDhuMbha~NghaL; avarghaLil èNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaL aRubhadhdhu nAlAyiradhdhu munnURubher.

jhèbhuloனuDhaiya ghumArariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaLAvaன: jheredhdhiன jhandhadhiyAன jheredhdhiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, eloனiன jhandhadhiyAன eloனiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, yAleyeliன jhandhadhiyAன yAleyeliyariன ghuDhuMbhamume.

yojhebhbhuDhaiya ghumArarAன maனAjhe èbhbhirAyIM èனbhavarghaLiன ghuDhuMbha~NghaLAvaன:

asriyeliன jhandhadhiyAன asriyelariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, jheghemiன jhandhadhiyAன jheghemiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM,

ebhbheriன ghumAraனAன jhèlòbhbhiyAdhdhiRghugh ghumArar illAmal irundhArghaL, ghumAradhdhighaL mAdhdhiraM irundhArghaL; ivarghaL nAma~NghaL maghlAL, novAL, òghlAL, milghAL, dhirjhAL èனbhavaighaL.

èbhbhirAyImuDhaiya ghumArariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaLAvaன: jhudhdhèlAghiன jhandhadhiyAன jhudhdhèlAghiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, bhègheriன jhandhadhiyAன bhègheriyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, dhAghAனiன jhandhadhiyAன dhAghAனiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM,
jhudhdhèlAgh bhèRRa erAனiன jhandhadhiyAன erAனiyariன ghuDhuMbhamume.
ivaighaLe èbhbhirAyIM bhudhdhirariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaL; avarghaLil èNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaL mubhbhadhdhIrAyiradhdhu ainnURubher; ivarghaLe yojhebhbhu bhudhdhirariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaL.

bhèனyamIனuDhaiya ghumArariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaLAvaன: bhelAviன jhandhadhiyAன bhelAviyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, asbheliன jhandhadhiyAன asbheliyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, aghirAmiன jhandhadhiyAன aghirAmiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM,
jhubhbhAmiன jhandhadhiyAன jhubhbhAmiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, ubhbhAmiன jhandhadhiyAன ubhbhAmiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM,

ivaighaLe bhèனyamIன bhudhdhirariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaL; avarghaLil èNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaL nARbhadhdhaiyAyiradhdhu aRunURu bher.
dhANuDhaiya ghumArariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaLAvaன: jhUghAmiன jhandhadhiyAன jhUghAmiyariன ghuDhuMbhamume; ivaighaL dhANiன ghuDhuMbhaM.
jhUghAmiyariன vaMjha~NghaLil èNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaL èlloruM aRubhadhdhu nAlAyiradhdhu nAனURu bher.
AjheruDhaiya ghumArariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaLAvaன: iMனAviன jhandhadhiyAன iMனAviyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, isviyiன jhandhadhiyAன isviyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, bhèrIyAviன jhandhadhiyAன bhèrIyAviyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM,
bhèrIyA bhèRRa ebheriன jhandhadhiyAன ebheriyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, malghiyeliன jhandhadhiyAன malghiyeliyariன ghuDhuMbhamume,
AjheruDhaiya ghumAradhdhiyiன bher jhArAL.
ivaighaLe Ajher bhudhdhirariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaL; avarghaLil èNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaL aiMbhadhdhu mUvAyiradhdhu nAனURu bher.
nabhdhaliyiனuDhaiya ghumArariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaLAvaன: yAdhjhiyeliன jhandhadhiyAன yAdhjhiyeliyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, ghUனiyiன jhandhadhiyAன ghUனiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM,
èdhjhèriன jhandhadhiyAன èdhjhèriyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, jhillemiன jhandhadhiyAன jhillemiyariன ghuDhuMbhamume.
ivaighaLe nabhdhaliyiன ghuDhuMbha~NghaL; avarghaLil èNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaL nARbhadhdhaiyAyiradhdhu nAனURu bher.
isravel bhudhdhiraril èNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaL ARulaDhjhadhdhorAyiradhdhu èzhunURRu mubhbhadhubherAyirundhArghaL.
ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:
ivarghaLuDhaiya bherghaLiன ilaghghadhdhiRghudhdhaghghadhAy dhejhaM ivarghaLughghujh jhudhandharamAghabh bha~NghiDhabhbhaDhaveNDhuM.

aneghaMbherughghu adhigha jhudhandhiramuM ghò~njhaMbherughghu ghò~njha jhudhandharamuM ghòDhubhbhAyAgha; avarghaLil èNNabhbhaDhDha ilaghghadhdhiRghudh dhaghghadhAgha avaravarghaLughghujh jhudhandhiraM ghòDhughghabhbhaDhaveNDhuM.
AனAluM jhIDhDhubhbhoDhDhu, dhejhadhdhaibh bha~NghiDhaveNDhuM; dha~NghaL bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya ghodhdhira~NghaLughghuriya nAma~NghaLiனbhaDhiye jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLaghghaDhavarghaL.
aneghaMbherghaLAyiனuM ghò~njhaMbherghaLAyiனuM jhIDhDhu vizhundhabhaDhiye avaravarghaLuDhaiya jhudhandhara~NghaL bha~NghiDhabhbhaDhaveNDhuM èனRAr.

èNNabhbhaDhDha leviyariன ghuDhuMbha~NghaLAvaன: ghèrjhoனiன jhandhadhiyAன ghèrjhoனiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, ghoghAdhdhiன jhandhadhiyAன ghoghAdhdhiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, mèrAriyiன jhandhadhiyAன mèrAriyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM;

leviyiன maRRagh ghuDhuMbha~NghaLAghiya libhனIyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, èbhroனiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, maghaliyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, mUjhiyariன ghuDhuMbhamuM, ghorAghiyariன ghuDhuMbhamume. ghoghAdh aMrAmaibh bhèRRAன.
aMrAmuDhaiya maனaivighghu yoghèbhedh èனRu bher; avaL èghibhdhile levighghubh bhiRandha ghumAradhdhi; avaL aMrAmughghu AroனaiyuM mojheyaiyuM avarghaL jhaghodhariyAன miriyAmaiyuM bhèRRAL.
Aroனughghu nAdhAbhuM abhiyUvuM èlèyAjhAruM idhdhAmAruM bhiRandhArghaL.
nAdhAbhuM abhiyUvuM ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil anniya aghghiனiyaigh ghòNDhuvandhabhodhu, jhèdhdhubhbhoனArghaL.

avarghaLil òru mAdhadhdhu ANbhiLLai mudhalAgha èNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaL irubhadhdhu mUvAyiraMbher; isravel bhudhdhirariன naDhuve avarghaLughghujh jhudhandharaM ghòDhughghabhbhaDhAdhabhaDhiyiனAl, avarghaL isravel bhudhdhirariன ilaghghadhdhiRghu uDhbhaDhavillai.
mojheyuM AjhAriyaனAghiya èlèyAjharuM èrighoviன arugheyirughghuM yordhAனughghu ibhbhAle movAbhiன jhamaனAன vèLighaLil isravel bhudhdhirarai èNNughiRabhodhu irundhavarghaL ivarghaLe.
muனbhu mojheyuM AjhAriyaனAghiya AroனuM jhIனAy vaனAndharadhdhil isravel bhudhdhirarai èNNuMbhodhu irundhavarghaLil òruvaruM ivarghaLughghuL illai.

vaனAndharadhdhil jhAghave jhAvArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar avarghaLaigh ghuRidhdhujh jhòlliyirundhAr; èbhbhuனனeyiன ghumAraனAghiya ghAlebhuM nUனiன ghumAraனAghiya yojhuvAvuM dhavira, veRòruvaruM avarghaLil mIdhiyAyirughghavillai.

yojhebhbhiன ghumAraனAghiya maனAjheyiன ghuDhuMbha~NghaLil, maனAjheyiன ghumAraனAghiya mAghIriன maghaனAன ghilèyAdhdhughghubh bhiRandha ebherughghubh bhudhdhiraனAyirundha jhèlobhbhiyAdhdhiன ghumAradhdhighaLAghiya maghlAL, novAL, òghlAL, milghAL, dhirjhAL èனbhavarghaL vandhu,
Ajharibhbhugh ghUDhAravAjhalile mojheghghuM, AjhAriyaனAghiya èlèyAjhArughghuM, bhirabhughghaLughghuM, jhabhaiyaனaidhdhiRghuM muனbhAgha niனRu:

è~NghaL dhaghabhbhaன vaனAndharadhdhil maraNamaDhaindhAr; avar ghardhdharughghu virodhamAghagh ghUDhiன ghorAghiன ghUDhDhadhdhAril jherndhavar alla, dhaMmuDhaiya bhAvadhdhiனAle maridhdhAr; avarughghugh ghumArar illai.

è~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனughghugh ghumAraன illAdhadhiனAle, avaruDhaiya bher avaruDhaiya vaMjhadhdhil illAmal aRRubhbhoghalAmA? è~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya jhaghodhararughghuLLe è~NghaLughghugh ghANiyADhjhi ghòDhughghaveNDhuM èனRArghaL.
mojhe avarghaLuDhaiya niyAyadhdhaigh ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil ghòNDhubhoனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:

jhèlobhbhiyAdhdhiன ghumAradhdhighaL jhòllughiRadhu jharidhAன; avarghaLughghu avarghaL dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya jhaghodhararughghuLLe jhudhandharaM ghòDhughghabhbhaDhaveNDhuM; avarghaL dhaghabhbhaன bhiனvaidhdha jhudhandharadhdhai avarghaLughghugh ghiDhaighghuMbhaDhi jhèyvAyAgha.
meluM nI isravel bhudhdhirarai noghghi: òruvaன ghumAraன illAmal maridhdhAl, avaனughghuriya jhudhandharadhdhai avaன ghumAradhdhighghugh ghòDhughghaveNDhuM.
avaனughghu ghumAradhdhiyuM illAdhirundhAl, avaனughghuriya jhudhandharadhdhai avaன jhaghodhararughghugh ghòDhughghaveNDhuM.
avaனughghujh jhaghodhararuM illAdhirundhAl avaனughghuriya jhudhandharadhdhai avaன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya jhaghodhararughghugh ghòDhughghaveNDhuM.

avaன dhaghabhbhaனughghujh jhaghodharar illAdhirundhAl, avaனughghuriya jhudhandharadhdhai avaன vaMjhadhdhile avaனughghugh ghiDhDhiன uRaviனmuRaiyAனughghugh jhudhandharamAghagh ghòDhughghaveNDhuM; idhu, ghardhdhar mojheghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye, isravel bhudhdhirarughghu niyAyavidhibhbhiramANamAy irughghaghghaDhavadhu èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனbhu ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi: nI indha abhArIM malaiyil eRi, nAன isravel bhudhdhirarughghugh ghòDhudhdha dhejhadhdhaibh bhAr.
nI adhaibh bhArdhdhabhiனbhu, uன jhaghodharaனAghiya Aroன jherghghabhbhaDhDhadhu bhola, nIyuM uன jaனdhdhAriDhadhdhil jherghghabhbhaDhuvAy;

ghardhdharuDhaiya jhabhai meybhbhaன illAdha mandhaiyaibhbhol irAdhabhaDhighghu,

ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi: Aviyaibh bhèRRirughghiRa bhuruShaனAghiya yojhuvA èனனuM nUனiன ghumAraனai nI dhèrindhughòNDhu, avaனmel uன ghaiyai vaidhdhu,
avaனai AjhAriyaனAghiya èlèyAjhArughghuM jhabhaiyaனaidhdhiRghuM muனbhAgha niRudhdhi, avarghaL ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha avaனughghu ghaDhDhaLaighòDhudhdhu,

mojhe dhaனghghugh ghardhdhar ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye yojhuvAvai azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoy, avaனai AjhAriyaனAghiya èlèyAjhArughghuM jhabhaiyaனaidhdhiRghuM muனbhAgha niRudhdhi,

ghardhdhar mojheyai noghghi:

èனghghujh jhughandhavAjhaனaiyAgha, dhaghaனbhalighaLughghu aDhudhdha ghANighghaiyaiyuM abhbhadhdhaiyuM, ghuRidhdhaghAladhdhil èனghghujh jhèludhdhuMbhaDhighghugh ghavaனmAyirughghaghghaDhavIrghaL èனRu nI isravel bhudhdhirarughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhu.

meluM nI avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL ghardhdharughghujh jhèludhdhaveNDhiya dhaghaனbhali èனனvèனRAl: nidhdhiya jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhaliyAgha nADhoRuM òru vayadhAன bhazhudhaRRa iraNDhu ADhDhughghuDhDhighaLaibh bhaliyiDhaveNDhuM.
ghAlaiyil òru ADhDhughghuDhDhiyaiyuM, mAlaiyil òru ADhDhughghuDhDhiyaiyuM bhaliyiDhDhu,
bhojaனbhaliyAgha òru maraghghAlile bhadhdhil òru bha~NghAனdhuM iDhidhdhubh bhizhindha ghARbhaDhi èNNèyile bhijhaindhadhumAghiya mèlliya mAvaiyuM jhèludhdhagh ghaDhavIrghaL.
idhu jhIனAy malaiyile ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhabhbhaDhDha nidhdhiya jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhali; idhu ghardhdharughghujh jhughandha vAjhaனaighghAன dhaghaனbhali.
ghARbhaDhi dhirADhjharajhaM òru ADhDhughghuDhDhighghu aDhudhdha bhAனbhali; bharijhudhdha sdhaladhdhile ghardhdharughghu andha irajhaM bhAனbhaliyAgha vArghghabhbhaDhaghghaDhavadhu.
ghAlaiyiன bhojaனbhalighghuM adhiன bhAனbhalighghuM òbhbhAghave mAlaiyil maRRa ADhDhughghuDhDhiyaiyuM ghardhdharughghujh jhughandha vAjhaனaiyAன dhaghaனbhaliyAghajh jhèludhdhaghghaDhavIrghaL.

avaighaLaiyuM jha~NghAraMbhaNNiனoM; nAM èsbhoனiன rAjAvAghiya jhIghoனughghujh jhèydhadhubhola, andha èllAbh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLilumuLLa bhuruSharaiyuM sdhirIghaLaiyuM bhiLLaighaLaiyuM jha~NghAraMbhaNNiனoM.
AனAluM bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiluLLa AsdhiyaiyuM jhaghala mirughajIvaனghaLaiyuM namaghghèனRu ghòLLaiyiDhDhoM.
ibhbhaDhiye yordhAனughghu ibhbhuRadhdhiluLLa arனoன nadhidhòDha~Nghi, èrmoன malaivaraighghumuLLa dhejhadhdhai nAM aghghAladhdhil emoriyaruDhaiya iraNDhu rAjAghghaLiDhamirundhu bhiDhidhdhoM.

mIndhirundha irADhjhadharil bhAjhAனiன rAjAvAghiya ogh èனbhavaனmAdhdhiraM dhabhbhiyirundhAன; iruMbhiனAR jhèydha avaனuDhaiya ghaDhDhil maனidharuDhaiya ghai muzhadhdhiனbhaDhiye, òனbhadhu muzha nILamuM nAlumuzha aghalamumAyirundhadhu; adhu aMmoன bhudhdhiraruDhaiya rabhbhAbhaDhDhaNadhdhil irughghiRadhallavA?

maனAjheyiன ghumAraனAghiya yAvIr arghobh jhImai muzhuvadhaiyuM ghejhUriyar mAghAdhdhiyar èனbhavarghaLuDhaiya èllaimaDhDhuM ghaDhDhighghòNDhu, adhaRghudh dhaன nAmadhdhiனbhaDhiye bhAjhAன avodhyAyIr èனRu bheriDhDhAன, adhu innALvaraighghuM vazha~NghivarughiRadhu.

AனAluM ghardhdhar u~NghaLai iLaibhbhARabhbhaNNiனdhubhola, u~NghaL jhaghodhararaiyuM iLaibhbhARabhbhaNNi, yordhAனughghu abhbhuRadhdhil u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar ghòDhughghiRa dhejhadhdhaijh jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLumaDhDhuM nI~NghaL irundhu, bhiனbhu avaravar nAன u~NghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdha u~NghaL jhudhandharadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhuvIrghaLAgha èனReன.

aghghAladhdhile nAன yojhuvAvai noghghi: u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar andha iraNDhu rAjAghghaLughghuM jhèydhavaighaLaiyèllAM uன ghaNghaL ghaNDhadhu; nI bhoyjh jheruM èllA rAjya~NghaLughghuM ghardhdhar abhbhaDhiye jhèyvAr.
avarghaLughghubh bhayabhbhaDhIrghaLAgha; u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar dhAme u~NghaLughghAgha yudhdhaMbhaNNuvAr èனRu jhòனனeன.
aghghAladhdhile nAன ghardhdharai noghghi:

ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavare, nIr umadhu aDhiyeனughghu umadhu maghadhdhuvadhdhaiyuM umadhu vallamaiyuLLa gharadhdhaiyuM ghANbhighghadh dhòDha~NghiனIr; vAனdhdhiluM bhUmiyiluM uMmuDhaiya ghiriyaighaLughghuM uMmuDhaiya vallamaighaLughghuM òbhbhAghajh jhèyyadhdhaghgha dhevaனyAr?
nAன ghaDhandhubhoy yordhAனughghu abhbhuRadhdhiluLLa andha nalla dhejhadhdhaiyuM andha nalla malaiyaiyuM, lIbhaனoனaiyuM bhArghghuMbhaDhi udhdharavu ghòDhudhdharuLuM èனRu veNDhighghòNDheன.
ghardhdharo u~NghaL nimidhdhaM èனmel ghobha~NghòNDhu, èனghghujh jhèvighòDhAmal, èனனai noghghi: bhodhuM, iனi indhagh ghAriyadhdhaigh ghuRidhdhu èனனoDhe bhejhaveNDhAM.
nI bhisghAviன ghòDhumuDhiyil eRi, uன ghaNghaLai meRghiluM vaDhaghghiluM dhèRghiluM ghizhaghghiluM eRèDhudhdhu, uன ghaNghaLiனAle adhaibh bhAr; indha yordhAனai nI ghaDhandhubhovadhillai.

nI yojhuvAvughghugh ghaDhDhaLai ghòDhudhdhu, avaனaidh dhiDhabhbhaDhudhdhibh bhalabhbhaDhudhdhu; avaன indha jaன~NghaLughghu muனbhAghagh ghaDhandhubhoy, avaனe nI ghANuM dhejhadhdhai avarghaLughghubh bha~NghiDhDhughghòDhubhbhAன èனRAr.

AனAluM u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaibh bhaRRighghòNDha nI~NghaLèllAruM innALvaraighghuM uyiroDhirughghiRIrghaL.

nI~NghaL jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLuMbhaDhi bhiravejhighghuM dhejhadhdhile nI~NghaL ghaighghòLLuMbhòruDhDhu, èன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èனghghugh ghaRbhidhdhabhaDhiye, nAன u~NghaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM niyAya~NghaLaiyuM bhodhidhdheன.

AghaiyAl avaighaLaigh ghaighghòNDhu naDhavu~NghaL; jaன~NghaLiன ghaNghaLughghumuனbhAghavuM idhuve u~NghaLughghu ~nAனmuM viveghamumAy irughghuM; avarghaL indhagh ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyèllAM gheDhDhu, indhabh bhèriya jAdhiye ~nAனmuM viveghamumuLLa jaன~NghaL èனbhArghaL.
naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharai nAM dhòzhudhughòLLughiRabhodhèllAM, avar namaghghujh jhamIbhamAyirughghiRadhubhola, dhevaனai ivvaLavu jhamIbhamAybh bhèRRirughghiRa veRe bhèriya jAdhi èdhu?
innALil nAன u~NghaLughghu vidhighghiRa indha niyAyabhbhiramANaM muzhumaighghuM òdhdha ivvaLavu nIdhiyuLLa ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM niyAya~NghaLaiyuM bhèRRirughghiRa veRe bhèriya jAdhi èdhu?

orebhile uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha nI niRghuMbhodhu, ghardhdhar èனனai noghghi: jaன~NghaLai èனனiDhadhdhil ghUDhivarajhjhèydhu, èன vArdhdhaighaLai avarghaL gheDhghuMbhaDhi bhaNNuveன; avarghaL bhUmiyil uyiroDhirughghuM nALèllAM èனghghubh bhayandhirughghuMbhaDhi avaighaLaigh ghaRRughghòNDhu, dha~NghaL bhiLLaighaLughghuM bhodhighghaghghaDhavarghaL èனRu jhòlliya nALil,

uன ghaNghaL ghaNDha ghAriya~NghaLai nI maRavAdhabhaDhighghuM, uன jIvaனuLLa nALèllAM avaighaL uன irudhayadhdhai viDhDhu nI~NghAdhabhaDhighghuM nI èjhjharighghaiyAyirundhu, uன AdhdhumAvaijh jAghghiradhaiyAygh ghAdhdhughghòL; avaighaLai uன bhiLLaighaLughghuM uன bhiLLaighaLiன bhiLLaighaLughghuM aRivighghaghghaDhavAy.
nI~NghaL jherndhuvandhu, malaiyiன aDhivAradhdhil niனRIrghaL; andha malaiyil vAனdhdhai aLAviya aghghiனi èriya, iruLuM meghamuM andhaghAramuM jhUzhndhadhu.

nI~NghaL ghaighghòLLaveNDhuM èனRu avar u~NghaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDha bhadhdhughghaRbhaனaighaLAghiya dhaMmuDhaiya uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai avar u~NghaLughghu aRividhdhu, avaighaLai iraNDhu ghaRbhalaghaighaLil èzhudhiனAr.

ghardhdhar orebhile aghghiனiyiன naDhuvilirundhu u~NghaLoDhe bhejhiன nALil, nI~NghaL òru rUbhadhdhaiyuM ghANavillai.
AghaiyAl nI~NghaL u~NghaLaigh ghèDhudhdhughghòNDhu, AN uruvuM, bhèN uruvuM,

u~NghaL ghaNghaLai vAனdhdhiRghu eRèDhudhdhu, u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar vAனdhdhiன ghIzhè~NghuM irughghiRa èllA jaன~NghaLughghuM eRbhaDhudhdhiன vAனdhdhiன jharva jheனaighaLAghiya jhandhira jhUriya naDhjhadhdhira~NghaLai noghghi, avaighaLaidh dhòzhudhu jhevighgha iNa~NghAdhabhaDhighghuM, u~NghaL AdhdhumAghghaLaighghuRidhdhu mighavuM èjhjharighghaiyAyiru~NghaL.

innALil nI~NghaL irughghiRadhubhola, dhamaghghujh jhudhandharamAன jaனmAyirughghuMbhaDhi, ghardhdhar u~NghaLaijh jherdhdhughghòNDhu, u~NghaLai èghibhdhu èனனuM irubhbhughghALavAyilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiனAr.

adhiனAl indha dhejhadhdhil nAன maraNamaDhaiyaveNDhuM; nAன yordhAனaigh ghaDhandhubhovadhillai; nI~NghaLo ghaDhandhubhoy, andha nalla dhejhadhdhaijh jhudhandharidhdhughghòLvIrghaL.

nI~NghaL bhiLLaighaLuM bhiLLaighaLiன bhiLLaighaLuM bhèRRu, dhejhadhdhil vèghunAL irundhabhiனbhu, nI~NghaL u~NghaLaigh ghèDhudhdhu, yAdhòruvighghiraghadhdhaiyAvadhu yAdhòru jhAyalAன jhurUbhadhdhaiyAvadhu bhaNNi, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghugh ghobhaM uNDhAghgha avar bhArvaighghubh bhòllAbhbhAனdhaijh jhèydhAl,

ghardhdhar u~NghaLaibh bhuRajAdhighaLughghuLLe jhidhaRa aDhibhbhAr; ghardhdhar u~NghaLaigh ghòNDhubhoy viDhabhbhoghiRa jAdhighaLiDhadhdhile ghò~njha jaன~NghaLAy mIndhirubhbhIrghaL.
a~Nghe ghANAmaluM gheLAmaluM jhAbhbhiDhAmaluM mugharAmaluM irughghiRa maramuM ghallumAன, maனuShar ghaivelaiyAghiya dhevarghaLaijh jhevibhbhIrghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu a~Ngheyirundhu uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaidh dheDhuvAy; uன muzhu irudhayadhdhoDhuM uன muzhu AdhdhumAvoDhuM avaraidh dheDhuMbhodhu, avaraigh ghaNDhaDhaivAy.
nI viyAghulabhbhaDha ivaighaLèllAM uனனaidh dhòDharndhu bhiDhighghuMbhodhu, ghaDhaijhinADhghaLil uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariDhadhdhil dhiruMbhi avar jhadhdhadhdhiRghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhivAyAனAl,

dhevaன maனuShaனaibh bhUmiyile jhiruShDhidhdha nALmudhal uனghghu muன irundha bhUrvanADhghaLil, vAனdhdhiன òrumuனai dhòDha~Nghi adhiன maRumuனaimaDhDhumuLLa èvviDhadhdhilAghiluM ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha bhèriya ghAriyaM naDhandhadhuNDho, ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha ghAriyaM gheLvibhbhaDhDhadhuNDho:
aghghiனiyiன naDhuvilirundhu bhejhughiRa dhevaனuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhai nI gheDhDhadhubhola yAdhòru jaனmAvadhu gheDhDhadhuM uyiroDhirundhadhuM uNDho.

alladhu u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èghibhdhile u~NghaL ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha u~NghaLughghujh jhèydhabhaDhiyèllAM dhevaன anniya jAdhighaLiன naDhuvilirundhu òru jaனdhdhaijh jhodhaனaighaLiனAluM, aDhaiyALa~NghaLiனAluM, aRbhudha~NghaLiனAluM, yudhdhadhdhiனAluM, vallamaiyuLLa gharadhdhiனAluM, o~Nghiya bhuyadhdhiனAluM, maghA bhaya~NgharamAன jhèyalghaLiனAluM, dhamaghghèனRu dhèrindhughòLLa vaghaibhaNNiனdhuNDho èனRu nI vijhAridhdhubhbhAr.
ghardhdhare dhevaன, avaraiyallAmal veRòruvaruM illai èனbhadhai nI aRiyuMbhaDhighghu, idhu uனghghugh ghADhDhabhbhaDhDhadhu.
