avar uன bhidhAghghaLil aனbhu ghUrndhabhaDhiyAl, avarghaLuDhaiya bhiனjhandhadhiyaidh dhèrindhughòNDhu,

uனனiluM bhaladhdha bhèriya jAdhighaLai uனghghu muனனiனRu dhuradhdhavuM, uனனai azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoy, innALil irughghiRadhubhola, avarghaL dhejhadhdhai uனghghujh jhudhandharamAghagh ghòDhughghavuM, uனனaidh dhamadhu mughadhdhughghumuன dhamadhu mighundha vallamaiyiனAl èghibhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiனAr.
AghaiyAl, uyara vAனdhdhiluM dhAzha bhUmiyiluM ghardhdhare dhevaன, avaraidh dhavira òruvaruM illai èனbhadhai nI innALil aRindhu, uன maனdhile jhindhidhdhu,

nIyuM uனghghubh bhiனvaruM uன bhiLLaighaLuM naனRAyirughghuMbhaDhighghuM, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghu èனRaighghuM ghòDhughghiRa dhejhadhdhile nI nIDhidhdha nALAyirughghuMbhaDhighghuM, nAன iனRu uனghghugh ghaRbhighghiRa avaruDhaiya ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM avaruDhaiya ghaRbhaனaighaLaiyuM ghaighghòLLaghghaDhavAy èனRAன.
muRbhaghaiyiனRigh ghaibhbhijhaghAybh bhiRaனaigh ghòனRavaன aDhaighghalabhbhaDhDhaNa~NghaLil òru bhaDhDhaNadhdhil dhabhbhiyoDhibhbhoybh bhizhaidhdhirughghuMbhaDhiyAgha,
rUbhaனiyaraijh jherndha jhamabhUmiyAghiya vaனAndharadhdhiluLLa bhejheruM, ghAdhdhiyaraijh jherndha ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhuM, maனAjheyaraijh jherndha bhAjhAனiluLLa gholAனumAghiya
mUனRu bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLai mojhe yordhAனughghu ibhbhuRadhdhil jhUriyodhaya dhijhaiyile eRbhaDhudhdhiனAன.
idhuve mojhe isravel bhudhdhirarughghu vidhidhdha bhiramANaM.

isravel bhudhdhirar èghibhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhabhiனbhu, yordhAனughghu ibhbhuRadhdhil èsbhoனil ghuDhiyirundha èmoriyariன rAjAvAghiya jhIghoனuDhaiya dhejhadhdhiluLLa bhèdhbhèyorughghu èdhirAன bhaLLadhdhAghghile, avarghaLughghu mojhe jhòனன jhADhjhighaLuM ghaDhDhaLaighaLuM niyAya~NghaLuM ivaighaLe.
mojheyuM isravel bhudhdhiraruM èghibhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhabhiனbhu andha rAjAvai muRiya aDhidhdhu,
yordhAனughghu ibhbhuRadhdhil jhUriyodhaya dhijhaiyil arனoன ARRa~NgharaiyiluLLa Arover dhòDha~Nghi èrmoன èனனuM jhIyoன malaivaraighghumuLLa dhejhamuM,
yordhAனughghu ibhbhuRadhdhil jhUriyodhaya dhijhaiyil asdhodh bhisghAvughghuM dhAzhndha jhamaனAன vèLiyaijh jherndha ghaDhalmaDhDhumuLLa jhamaனAன vèLiyaனaidhdhumAghiya,
èmoriyaruDhaiya iraNDhu rAjAghghaLiன dhejha~NghaLAன jhIghoனuDhaiya dhejhadhdhaiyuM bhAjhAனiன rAjAvAghiya oghiன dhejhadhdhaiyuM ghaDhDhighghòNDhArghaL.

mojhe isravelar èllAraiyuM azhaibhbhidhdhu, avarghaLai noghghi: isravelare, nAன iனRu u~NghaL ghAdhughaL gheDhghajh jhòlluM ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM niyAya~NghaLaiyuM gheLu~NghaL; nI~NghaL avaighaLiனbhaDhiye jhèyyuMbhaDhighghu avaighaLaigh ghaRRugh ghaighghòLLaghghaDhavIrghaL.
naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar orebhile naMmoDhe uDhaனbhaDhighghaibhaNNiனAr.
andha uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyaigh ghardhdhar naMmuDhaiya bhidhAghghaLuDhaன bhaNNAmal, innALil i~Nghe uyiroDhirughghiRa naMmèllAroDhuM bhaNNiனAr.
ghardhdhar malaiyile aghghiனiyiன naDhuvilirundhu mughamughamAy u~NghaLoDhe bhejhiனAr.

ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyai u~NghaLughghu aRivighghuMbhaDhi, aghghAladhdhile nAன ghardhdharughghuM u~NghaLughghuM naDhuvAgha niனReன; nI~NghaL aghghiனighghubh bhayandhu malaiyil eRAmal irundhIrghaL; abhbhòzhudhu avar jhòனனdhu èனனvèனRAl:
uனனai aDhimaidhdhaன vIDhAghiya èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiன uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar nAனe.
èனனaiyaனRi uனghghu veRe dhevarghaL uNDhAyirughghaveNDhAM.
mele vAனdhdhiluM, ghIzhe bhUmiyiluM, bhUmiyiனghIzhdh dhaNNIriluM uNDhAyirughghiRavaighaLughghu òbhbhAன òru jhurUbhadhdhaiyAghiluM yAdhòru vighghiraghadhdhaiyAghiluM nI uனghghu uNDhAghghaveNDhAM.

nI avaighaLai namasgharighghavuM jhevighghavuM veNDhAM; uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharAyirughghiRa nAன èrijhjhaluLLa dhevaனAyirundhu, èனனaibh bhaghaighghiRavarghaLaighghuRidhdhubh bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya aghghiramadhdhaibh bhiLLaighaLiDhadhdhil mUனRAM nAனghAM dhalaimuRaimaDhDhuM vijhArighghiRavarAyirughghiReன.
èனனiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrndhu, èன ghaRbhaனaighaLaigh ghaighghòLLughiRavarghaLughgho AyiraM dhalaimuRaimaDhDhuM iraghgha~njhèyghiRavarAyirughghiReன.
uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhai vINile vazha~NghAdhirubhbhAyAgha; ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya nAmadhdhai vINile vazha~NghughiRavaனaidh dhaNDhiyAmal viDhAr.
uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye, oyvunALaibh bharijhudhdhamAy AjharibhbhAyAgha.
ARunALuM nI velaijhèydhu, uன ghiriyaighaLaiyèllAM naDhabhbhibhbhAyAgha.

ezhAM nALo uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya oyvunAL; adhile nIyAனAluM, uன ghumAraனAனAluM, uன ghumAradhdhiyAனAluM, uன velaighghAraனAனAluM, uன velaighghAriyAனAluM, uன èrudhAனAluM, uன ghazhudhaiyAனAluM, uனghghu irughghiRa maRRèndha mirughajIvaனAனAluM, uன vAjhalghaLil irughghiRa anniyaனAனAluM yAdhòru velaiyuM jhèyyaveNDhAM; nI iLaibhbhARuvadhubhola uன velaighghAraனuM uன velaighghAriyuM iLaibhbhARaveNDhuM;

nI èghibhdhudhejhadhdhil aDhimaiyAyirundhAy èனRuM, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனனai avviDhadhdhilirundhu vallamaiyuLLa gharadhdhiனAluM o~Nghiya bhuyadhdhiனAluM bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiனAr èனRuM niனaibhbhAyAgha; AghaiyAl oyvunALai Ajharighgha uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAr.

uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghugh ghòDhughghiRa dhejhadhdhile uன nADhghaL nIDhidhdhirubhbhadhaRghuM, nI naனRAyirubhbhadhaRghuM, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye, uன dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM uன dhAyaiyuM ghaனMbhaNNuvAyAgha.
ghòlai jhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha.
vibhajhAra~n jhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha
ghaLavu jhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha
bhiRaனughghu virodhamAghabh bhòyjhjhADhjhi jhòllAdhirubhbhAyAgha.

bhiRaனuDhaiya maனaiviyai ijhjhiyAdhirubhbhAyAgha; bhiRaனuDhaiya vIDhDhaiyuM, avaனuDhaiya niladhdhaiyuM, avaனuDhaiya velaighghAraனaiyuM, avaனuDhaiya velaighghAriyaiyuM, avaனuDhaiya èrudhaiyuM, avaனuDhaiya ghazhudhaiyaiyuM, bhiனனuM bhiRaனughghuLLa yAdhòனRaiyuM ijhjhiyAdhirubhbhAyAgha èனRAr.

indha vArdhdhaighaLai ghardhdhar malaiyile aghghiனiyiluM meghadhdhiluM ghAriruLiluM irundhu u~NghaL jhabhaiyAr èllAroDhuM maghA jhadhdhadhdhuDhaனe jhòனனAr; avaighaLoDhu òனRuM ghUDhDhAmal, avaighaLai iraNDhu ghaRbhalaghaighaLil èzhudhi, èனனiDhadhdhil ghòDhudhdhAr.
malai aghghiனiyAl èrighaiyil iruLiன naDhuvilirundhu uNDhAன jhadhdhadhdhai nI~NghaL gheDhDhabhodhu, ghodhdhiradh dhalaivaruM mUbhbharumAghiya nI~NghaL èllAruM èனனiDhadhdhil vandhu:

idho, naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar namaghghudh dhaMmuDhaiya maghimaiyaiyuM dhaMmuDhaiya maghadhdhuvadhdhaiyuM ghANbhidhdhAr; aghghiனiyiன naDhuvilirundhu uNDhAன avaruDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhaiyuM gheDhDhoM; dhevaன maனuShaனoDhe bhejhiyuM, avaன uyiroDhirughghiRadhai innALile ghaNDhoM.
ibhbhòzhudhu nA~NghaL jhAvAனeன? indhabh bhèriya aghghiனi è~NghaLaibh bhaDhjhighghume; nA~NghaL iனனuM naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன jhadhdhadhdhaigh gheDhbhomAghil jhAvoM.
nA~NghaL gheDhDhadhubhola, aghghiனiyiன naDhuvilirundhu bhejhughiRa jIvaனuLLa dhevaனuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhai mAMjhamAனvarghaLil yArAvadhu gheDhDhu uyiroDhirundhadhu uNDho?

nIre jhamIbhidhdhubhbhoy, naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar jhòlvadhaiyèllAM gheDhDhu, naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar jhòlvadhaiyèllAM nIre è~NghaLughghujh jhòllaveNDhuM; nA~NghaL gheDhDhu, adhiனbhaDhiye jhèyvoM èனRIrghaL.

nI~NghaL èனனoDhe bhejhughaiyil, ghardhdhar u~NghaL vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhu, ghardhdhar èனனai noghghi: indha jaன~NghaL uனனoDhe jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDheன; avarghaL jhòனனdhu èllAM naனRAyjh jhòனனArghaL.

avarghaLuM avarghaL bhiLLaighaLuM èனRèனRaighghuM naனRAyirughghuMbhaDhi, avarghaL ènnALuM èனghghubh bhayandhu, èன ghaRbhaனaighaLaiyèllAM ghaighghòLvadhaRgheRRa irudhayaM avarghaLughghu irundhAl nalamAyirughghuM.
nI bhoy: u~NghaL ghUDhAra~NghaLughghudh dhiruMbhibhbho~NghaL èனRu avarghaLughghujh jhòl.

nIyo i~Nghe èனனiDhadhdhil nil; nAன avarghaLughghujh jhudhandharamAghagh ghòDhughghuM dhejhadhdhil avarghaL jhèyyuMbhaDhi jhaghala ghaRbhaனaighaLaiyuM ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM niyAya~NghaLaiyuM uனghghujh jhòlluveன èனRAr.
u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghugh ghaRbhidhdhabhaDhiye jhèyyajh jhAvadhAனmAyiru~NghaL; valadhubhuRaM iDhadhubhuRaM jhAyAdhirubhbhIrghaLAgha.

nI~NghaL jhudhandharighghuM dhejhadhdhile bhizhaidhdhujh jhughidhdhu nIDhidhdhirughghuMbhaDhi u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghu vidhidhdha vazhighaLèllAvaRRiluM naDhaghghagh ghaDhavIrghaL.

nI uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghubh bhayandhu, uyiroDhirughghuM nALèllAM, nIyuM uன ghumAraனuM uன ghumAradhdhiyuM, nAன uனghghu vidhighghiRa avaruDhaiya èllAgh ghaRbhaனaighaLaiyuM ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM ghaighghòLLughiRadhiனAle uன vAzhnADhghaL nIDhidhdhirughghuMbhaDhi,

nI~NghaL jhudhandharighghabhbhoghiRa dhejhadhdhile ghaighghòLLavadhaRghAgha, u~NghaLughghubh bhodhighghaveNDhuM èனRu u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar ghaRbhidhdha ghaRbhaனaighaLuM ghaDhDhaLaighaLuM niyAya~NghaLuM ivaighaLe.

isravele, nI naனRAyirubhbhadhaRghuM, uன bhidhAghghaLiன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghujh jhòனனbhaDhi, bhAluM dheனuM oDhughiRa dhejhadhdhil nI mighavuM virudhdhiyaDhaivadhaRghuM, avaighaLughghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhu, avaighaLiனbhaDhi jhèyyajh jhAvadhAனmAyiru.
isravele, gheL: naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar òruvare ghardhdhar.
nI uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariDhadhdhil uன muzhu irudhayadhdhoDhuM, uன muzhu AdhdhumAvoDhuM, uன muzhubh bhaladhdhoDhuM aனbhughUruvAyAgha.
iனRu nAன uனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhughiRa indha vArdhdhaighaLai uன irudhayadhdhil irughghaghghaDhavadhu.

nI avaighaLai uன bhiLLaighaLughghugh gharudhdhAybh bhodhidhdhu, nI uன vIDhDhil uDhghArndhirughghiRabhodhuM, vazhiyil naDhaghghiRabhodhuM, bhaDhudhdhughghòLLughiRabhodhuM, èzhundhirughghiRabhodhuM avaighaLaigh ghuRidhdhubh bhejhi,
avaighaLai uன ghaiyiனmel aDhaiyALamAghagh ghaDhDhighghòLvAyAgha; avaighaL uன ghaNghaLughghu naDhuve ~nAbhaghaghghuRiyAy irughghaghghaDhavadhu.
avaighaLai uன vIDhDhu nilaighaLiluM, uன vAjhalghaLiluM èzhudhuvAyAgha.

uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghugh ghòDhubhbheன èனRu AbhiraghAM IjhAghghu yAghghobhu èனbhavarghaLAghiya uன bhidhAghghaLughghu ANaiyiDhDhugh ghòDhudhdha dhejhadhdhil uனனaibh bhiravejhighghabhbhaNNuMbhodhuM, nI ghaDhDhAdha vajhadhiyAன bhèriya bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaiyuM,

nI nirabhbhAdha jhaghala nalla vasdhughghaLAluM niraMbhiya vIDhughaLaiyuM, nI vèDhDhAmal vèDhDhabhbhaDhDhirughghiRa dhuravughaLaiyuM, nI naDhAdha dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDha~NghaLaiyuM òlivadhdhobhbhughaLaiyuM, avar uனghghugh ghòDhubhbhadhiனAl, nI jhAbhbhiDhDhudh dhirbhdhiyAghuMbhodhuM,
nI aDhimaibhbhaDhDhirundha vIDhAghiya èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu uனனaibh bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiன ghardhdharai maRavAdhabhaDhighghu èjhjharighghaiyAyiru.
uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghubh bhayandhu, avarughghe ArAdhaனaijhèydhu, avaruDhaiya nAmadhdhaighghòNDhe ANaiyiDhuvAyAgha.

uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya ghobhaM uனmel mUNDhu uனனaibh bhUmiyil vaighghAmal azhidhdhubhbhoDhAdhabhaDhighghu, u~NghaLaijh jhuRRiluM irughghiRa jaன~NghaLiன dhevarghaLAghiya anniya dhevarghaLaibh bhiனbhaRRAdhirubhbhIrghaLAgha.
uன naDhuvilirughghiRa uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èrijhjhaluLLa dhevaனAyirughghiRAre.
nI~NghaL mAjhAvile jhèydhadhubhola, u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaibh bharIDhjhai bhArAdhirubhbhIrghaLAgha.
u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghugh ghaRbhidhdha avaruDhaiya ghaRbhaனaighaLaiyuM avaruDhaiya jhADhjhighaLaiyuM avaruDhaiya ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM gharudhdhAygh ghaighghòLLuvIrghaLAgha.
nI naனRAyirughghiRadhaRghuM, ghardhdhar uன bhidhAghghaLughghu ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhudhdha nalla dhejhadhdhil nI bhiravejhidhdhu, adhaijh jhudhandharibhbhadhaRghuM,

ghardhdhar dhAM jhòனனbhaDhi, uன jhadhdhurughghaLaiyèllAM uன mughadhdhiRghu muனbhAghadh dhuradhdhiviDhuvadhaRghuM, nI ghardhdharuDhaiya bhArvaighghujh jhèMmaiyuM naனmaiyumAy irughghiRadhaijh jhèyvAyAgha.
nALaighghu uன bhudhdhiraன; naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDha indhajh jhADhjhighaLuM ghaDhDhaLaighaLuM niyAya~NghaLuM èனன èனRu uனனiDhadhdhil gheDhDhAl;
nI uன bhudhdhiraனai noghghi: nA~NghaL èghibhdhile bhArvoனughghu aDhimaighaLAyirundhoM; ghardhdhar bhaladhdha ghaiyiனAle è~NghaLai èghibhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiனAr.
ghardhdhar è~NghaL ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha, èghibhdhiனmeluM bhArvoனmeluM avaன ghuDhuMbhaM aனaidhdhiனmeluM ghòDhidhAன bhèriya aDhaiyALa~NghaLaiyuM aRbhudha~NghaLaiyuM viLa~NghabhbhaNNi,

dhAM naMmuDhaiya bhidhAghghaLughghu ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhudhdha dhejhadhdhughghu è~NghaLai azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoy, adhai namaghghugh ghòDhughghuMbhaDhi è~NghaLai avviDhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiனAr.

innALil irughghiRadhubhola, naMmai avar uyiroDhe ghAbhbhadhaRghuM, ènnALuM naனRAyirughghiRadhaRghuM, naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghubh bhayandhu indha èllAgh ghaDhDhaLaighaLiனbhaDhiyeyuM jhèyyagh ghardhdhar namaghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAr.

naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar namaghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye nAM avar jhamughadhdhil indha èllAghghaDhDhaLaighaLiனbhaDhiyuM jhèyyajh jhAvadhAனmAyirundhAl, namaghghu nIdhiyAyirughghuM èனRu jhòlvAyAgha.

nI jhudhandharighghabhbhoghiRa dhejhadhdhil uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனனaibh bhiravejhighghabhbhaNNi, uனனaibhbhArghghiluM jaனM bhèrudhdha jAdhighaLAghiya edhdhiyar, ghirghAjhiyar, èmoriyar, ghAனAனiyar bhèrijhiyar, eviyar, èbhUjhiyar èனனuM ezhu bhaladhdha jAdhighaLai uனghghu muனbhAghadh dhuradhdhi

uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar avarghaLai uனனiDhadhdhil òbhbhughghòDhughghuMbhodhu, avarghaLai muRiya aDhidhdhu, avarghaLaijh jha~NghAraM bhaNNaghghaDhavAy; avarghaLoDhe uDhaனbhaDhighghaibhaNNavuM avarghaLughghu ira~NghavuM veNDhAM.
avarghaLoDhe jhaMbhandhaM ghalavAyAgha; uன ghumAradhdhighaLai avarghaL ghumArarughghugh ghòDhAmaluM, avarghaL ghumAradhdhighaLaigh uன ghumArarughghuM ghòLLAmaluM irubhbhAyAgha.

èனனaibh bhiனbhaRRAmal, anniya dhevarghaLaijh jhevighghuMbhaDhi avarghaL uன ghumArarai vilaghabhbhaNNuvArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya ghobhaM u~NghaLmel mUNDhu, u~NghaLaijh jhIghghiradhdhil azhighghuM.

nI~NghaL avarghaLughghujh jhèyyaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: avarghaL bhalibhIDha~NghaLai iDhidhdhu, avarghaL jhilaighaLaidh dhaghardhdhu, avarghaL dhobhbhughaLai vèDhDhi, avarghaL vighghiragha~NghaLai aghghiனiyile èridhdhubhbhoDhaveNDhuM.
nI uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghubh bharijhudhdha jaனM, bhUjhjhaghgharadhdhiluLLa èllA jaன~NghaLiluM uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனனaidh dhamaghghujh dhèrindhughòNDhAr.

nAன u~NghaLai aRindha nALmudhaRghòNDhu, nI~NghaL ghardhdharughghu virodhamAghagh ghalaghaMbhaNNughiRavarghaLAyirundhIrghaL.

dhevarIr indha jaன~NghaLiன muraDhDhADhDhadhdhaiyuM, ivarghaL AghAmiyadhdhaiyuM, ivarghaL bhAvadhdhaiyuM bhArAmal, umadhu dhAjharAghiya AbhiraghAM IjhAghghu yAghghobhu èனbhavarghaLai niனaidhdharuLuM.

a~Ngheyirundhu ghudhghodhAvughghuM, ghudhghodhAvilirundhu ARughaLuLLa nADhAghiya yodhbhAdhdhughghuM bhirayANaM bhaNNiனArghaL.

AghaiyAl nI~NghaL iனi u~NghaL bhiDhariyaigh ghaDhiனbhbhaDhudhdhAmal, u~NghaL irudhayadhdhiன nuனidhdholai virudhdhajhedhaனMbhaNNu~NghaL.

u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar dhevAdhi dhevaனuM, ghardhdhAdhi ghardhdharuM, maghadhdhuvamuM vallamaiyuM bhaya~NgharamumAன dhevaனumAyirughghiRAr; avar bhaDhjhabhAdhaM bhaNNughiRavaruM alla, bharidhAனM vA~NghughiRavaruM alla.
avar dhighghaRRa bhiLLaighghuM vidhavaighghuM niyAya~njhèyghiRavaruM, anniyaனmel aனbhuvaidhdhu avaனughghu aனனvasdhiraM ghòDhughghiRavarumAy irughghiRAr.

avar èghibhdhiன naDhuvile èghibhdhiன rAjAvAghiya bhArvoனughghuM, avaன dhejhaM aனaidhdhiRghuM jhèydha avaruDhaiya aDhaiyALa~NghaLaiyuM, avaruDhaiya ghiriyaighaLaiyuM,

abhbhòzhudhu leviyar uradhdha jhadhdhamiDhDhu isravel maனidhar èllAraiyuM bhArdhdhu:

ghardhdharughghu aruvarubhbhAன ghAriyamAghiya dhòzhilALighaLuDhaiya ghaivelaiyAl jhèyyabhbhaDhDhadhuM vArbhbhighghabhbhaDhDhadhumAன yAdhòru vighghiraghadhdhai uNDhubhaNNi òLibhbhiDhadhdhile vaighghiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbhArghaLAgha; adhaRghu jaன~NghaLèllAruM bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.
dhaன dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM dhaன dhAyaiyuM dhUShighghiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbhArghaL; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.
bhiRaனuDhaiya èllaighghuRiyai òRRibhbhoDhughiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbhArghaLAgha; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.
ghuruDhaனai vazhidhabhbhajhjhèyghiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbhArghaLAgha; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.
bharadhejhi dhighghaRRavaன vidhavai Aghiya ivarghaLuDhaiya niyAyadhdhaibh bhuraDhDhughiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhavaன èனbhArghaLAgha; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.

dhaன dhaghabhbhaன maனaiviyoDhe jhayaனighghiRavaன, dhaன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya mAனdhdhaidh dhiRandhabhaDhiyiனAle, jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbhArghaLAgha; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.
yAdhòru mirughadhdhoDhe bhuNarjhjhijhèyghiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbhArghaLAgha; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.
dhaன dhaghabhbhaனughghAvadhu dhAyghghAvadhu ghumAradhdhiyAghiya dhaன jhaghodhariyoDhe jhayaனighghiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbhArghaLAgha; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.
dhaன mAmiyoDhe jhayaனighghiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbhArghaLAgha; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.
òLibhbhiDhadhdhile bhiRaனaigh ghòlaijhèyghiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbhArghaLAgha; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.
ghuRRamillAdhavaனaigh ghòlaijhèyyuMbhaDhi bharidhAனM vA~NghughiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbhArghaLAgha; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.
indha niyAyabhbhiramANa vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM ghaighghòNDhu naDhavAdhavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனbharghaLAgha; jaன~NghaLèllAruM Amèன èனRu jhòllaghghaDhavarghaL.

iனRu nAன uனghghu vidhighghiRa uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya ghaDhDhaLaighaLiனbhaDhiyèllAM jhèyya nI ghavaனmAyirughghuMbhaDhighghu, avar jhadhdhadhdhiRghu uNmaiyAyjh jhèvighòDhubhbhAyAனAl, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar bhUmiyiluLLa jhaghala jAdhighaLiluM uனனai meனmaiyAgha vaibhbhAr.
nI uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன jhadhdhadhdhughghujh jhèvighòDhughghuMbhodhu, ibhbhòzhudhu jhòllabhbhaDhuM AjhIrvAdha~NghaLèllAM uனmel vandhu uனghghubhbhalighghuM.
nI bhaDhDhaNadhdhiluM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhAy; vèLiyiluM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhAy.
uன gharbhbhadhdhiன ghaனiyuM, uன niladhdhiன ghaனiyuM, uன mADhughaLiன bhèrughghamuM, uன ADhughaLiன mandhaighaLumAghiya uன mirughajIvaனghaLiன bhalaனuM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhirughghuM.
uன ghUDhaiyuM, mAbhbhijhaighiRa uன dhòDhDhiyuM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhirughghuM.
nI varughaiyiluM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhAy, nI bhoghaiyiluM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhAy.

uனghghu virodhamAy èzhuMbhuM uன jhadhdhurughghaLaigh ghardhdhar uனghghumuனbhAgha muRiya aDhighghabhbhaDhuMbhaDhi òbhbhughghòDhubhbhAr; òru vazhiyAy uனghghu èdhirAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu varuvArghaL; ezhu vazhiyAy uனghghu muனbhAgha oDhibhbhovArghaL.
ghardhdhar uன ghaLa~njhiya~NghaLiluM, nI ghaiyiDhuM èllA velaiyiluM uனghghu AjhIrvAdhaM ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuvAr; uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghugh ghòDhughghuM dhejhadhdhile uனனai AjhIrvadhibhbhAr.

nI uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன ghaDhDhaLaighaLaigh ghaighghòNDhu, avar vazhighaLil naDhaghghuMbhodhu, ghardhdhar uனghghu ANaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye, uனனaidh dhamaghghubh bharijhudhdha jaனmAgha nilaibhbhaDhudhdhuvAr.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmaM èனghghudh dharighghabhbhaDhDhadhu èனRu bhUmiyiன jaன~NghaLèllAM ghaNDhu, uனghghubh bhayabhbhaDhuvArghaL.

uனghghugh ghòDhubhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar uன bhidhAghghaLughghu ANaiyiDhDhadhejhadhdhil, ghardhdhar uன gharbhbhadhdhiன ghaனiyiluM, uன mirughajIvaனghaLiன bhalaனiluM, uன niladhdhiன ghaனiyiluM uனghghubh bharibhUraNa naனmai uNDhAghagh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuvAr.

eRRaghAladhdhil uன dhejhadhdhile mazhai bhèyyavuM, nI ghaiyiDhDhujhjhèyyuM velaighaLaiyèllAM AjhIrvadhighghavuM, ghardhdhar uனghghudh dhamadhu nalla bhòghghiShajhAlaiyAghiya vAனdhdhaidh dhiRabhbhAr; nI aneghaM jAdhighaLughghugh ghaDhaனghòDhubhbhAy. nIyo ghaDhaன vA~NghAdhirubhbhAy.
iனRu nAன u~NghaLughghu vidhighghiRa vArdhdhaighaL yAvaiyuM viDhDhu vilaghi veRe dhevarghaLaijh jhevighghuMbhaDhi, nI valadhubhuRaM iDhadhubhuRaM jhAyAmal,

iனRu nAன uனghghu vidhighghiRa uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன ghaDhDhaLaighaLai ghaighghòLLavuM avaighaLiனbhaDhi naDhaghghavuM avaighaLughghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhuvandhAl, ghardhdhar uனனai vAlAghghAmal dhalaiyAghghuvAr, nI ghIzhAghAmal melAvAy.

iனRu nAன uனghghu vidhighghiRa uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya èllAgh ghaRbhaனaighaLiனbhaDhiyuM ghaDhDhaLaighaLiனbhaDhiyuM naDhaghghagh ghavaனmAyirughghiRadhaRghu, avar jhadhdhadhdhiRghujh jhèvighòDhAdhebhovAyAghil, ibhbhòzhudhu jhòllabhbhaDhuM jhAbha~NghaLèllAM uனmel vandhu uனghghubh bhalighghuM.
nI bhaDhDhaNadhdhiluM jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhAy, vèLiyiluM jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhAy.
uன ghUDhaiyuM, mAbhbhijhaighiRa uன dhòDhDhiyuM jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhirughghuM.
uன gharbhbhadhdhiன ghaனiyuM, uன niladhdhiன ghaனiyuM, uன mADhughaLiன bhèrughghamuM, uன ADhughaLiன mandhaighaLuM jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhirughghuM.
nI varughaiyiluM jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhAy, nI bhoghaiyiluM jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhAy.

èனனaiviDhDhu vilaghi nI jhèydhuvarughiRa uன dhurghghiriyaighaLiனimidhdhaM jhIghghiradhdhil ghèDhDhubhbhoy azhiyumaDhDhuM, nI ghaiyiDhDhujh jhèyghiRadhèllAvaRRiluM ghardhdhar uனghghujh jhAbhadhdhaiyuM jha~njhaladhdhaiyuM gheDhDhaiyuM varabhbhaNNuvAr.
nI jhudhandharighghuM dhejhadhdhil ghardhdhar uனனai nirmUlamAghghumaDhDhuM ghòLLai noy uனனaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòLLabhbhaNNuvAr.

ghardhdhar uனனai ILaiyiனAluM, ghAyjhjhaliனAluM uShNadhdhiனAluM, èribhandhadhdhiனAluM, vaRaDhjhiyiனAluM, gharughghAyiனAluM, viShabhbhaனiyiனAluM vAdhibhbhAr; nI azhiyumaDhDhuM ivaighaL uனனaibh bhiனdhòDharuM.
uன dhalaighghumeluLLa vAனM vèNghalamuM, uனghghugh ghIzhuLLa bhUmi iruMbhumAy irughghuM.
uன dhejhadhdhu mazhaiyaigh ghardhdhar bhuzhudhiyuM maNNumAgha bhèyyabhbhaNNuvAr; nI azhiyumaDhDhuM abhbhaDhiye vAனdhdhilirundhu uனmel iRa~NghivaruM.

uன jhadhdhurughghaLughghu muனbhAgha nI muRiya aDhighghabhbhaDhuMbhaDhi ghardhdhar jhèyvAr; òru vazhiyAy avarghaLughghu èdhirAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhuvAy, ezhu vazhiyAy avarghaLughghu muனbhAgha oDhibhbhovAy; nI bhUmiyiluLLa èllA rAjya~NghaLiluM jhidhaRuNDhubhovAy.
uன bhiNaM AghAyadhdhubh bhaRavaighaLughghuM bhUmiyiன mirugha~NghaLughghuM iraiyAghuM; avaighaLai viraDhDhuvArillAdhirubhbhArghaL.
nI ghuNamAghAdhabhaDhi ghardhdhar uனனai èghibhdhiன èribhandhamAன bharughghaLiனAluM, mUlaviyAdhiyiனAluM, jhòRiyiனAluM, jhira~NghiனAluM vAdhibhbhAr.
ghardhdhar uனனaibh bhudhdhimayaghghadhdhiனAluM, ghuruDhDhADhDhadhdhiனAluM, maனdhdhighaibhbhiனAluM vAdhibhbhAr.

ghuruDhaன andhaghAradhdhile dhaDhavidhdhirighiRadhubhola, nI bhaDhDhabhbhaghalile dhaDhavighghòNDhu dhirivAy; uன vazhighaLil òனRuM uனghghu vAyghghAdhebhoM; udhavijhèyvArillAmal nI ènnALuM òDhughghabhbhaDhughiRavaனuM bhaRighòDhughghiRavaனumAy irubhbhAy.
bhèNNai uனghghu niyamibhbhAy, veRòruvaன avaLuDhaன jhayaனibhbhAன; vIDhDhaigh ghaDhDhuvAy, adhile ghuDhiyirughghamADhDhAy; dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhai nADhDhuvAy, adhiன bhalaனai aனubhavighghamADhDhAy.

uன mADhughaL uன ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha aDhighghabhbhaDhuM, nI adhil òனRuM bhujhibhbhadhillai; uன ghazhudhai uனghghu muனbhAghagh ghòLLaiyiDhDhugh ghòNDhubhoghabhbhaDhDhu, uனghghudh dhiruMbha aghabhbhaDhAmaRbhoM; uன ADhughaL uன jhadhdhurughghaLughghugh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhuM; viDhuvibhbhAr òruvaruM uனghghu illAdhirubhbhArghaL.

uன ghumAraruM uன ghumAradhdhighaLuM anniya jaன~NghaLughghu òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvArghaL; avarghaLaigh ghANa uன ghaNghaL nADhoRuM bhArdhdhubhbhArdhdhubh bhUdhdhubhbhoM; uன ghaiyil bhèlaனillAdhirughghuM.
uன niladhdhiன ghaனiyaiyuM, uன bhirayAjhadhdhiன èllAbh bhalaனaiyuM nI aRiyAdha jaன~NghaL bhujhibhbhArghaL; nI jhaghalanALuM òDhughghabhbhaDhDhuM nòRughghabhbhaDhDhuM irubhbhAy.
uன ghaNghaL ghANuM ghAriya~NghaLiனAle madhimaya~NghibhbhovAy.
uன uLLa~NghAl dhòDha~Nghi ujhjhandhalaimaDhDhuM ghuNamAghAdhabhaDhighghu, ghardhdhar uனனai muzha~NghAlghaLiluM dhòDhaighaLiluM ghòDhiya èribhandhabh bharughghaLiனAle vAdhibhbhAr.

ghardhdhar uனனaiyuM, uனghghAgha nI eRbhaDhudhdhighghòNDha rAjAvaiyuM, nIyuM uன bhidhAghghaLuM aRiyAdha jAdhighaLiDhadhdhughghubh bhoghabhbhaNNuvAr; a~Nghe nI maramuM ghallumAன anniya dhevarghaLaijh jhevibhbhAy.
ghardhdhar uனனaigh ghòNDhubhoyviDhuM èllA jaன~NghaLughghuLLuM bhiramibhbhuM bhazhamòzhiyuM bhariyAjhajh jhòllumAvAy.
mighundha vidhaiyai vayalughghugh ghòNDhubhovAy, ghò~njhaM aRubhbhAy; vèDhDhughghiLi adhaibh bhaDhjhidhdhubhbhoDhuM.
dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDha~NghaLai nADhDhibhbhayiriDhuvAy, AனAluM nI dhirADhjharajhaM ghuDhibhbhadhuM illai, dhirADhjhabhbhazha~NghaLaijh jherbhbhadhuM illai; bhUjhjhi adhaidh dhiனRu bhoDhuM.
òlivamara~NghaL uன èllaighaLilè~NghuM irughghuM, AனAluM adhiன èNNèyai nI bhUjhighghòLvadhillai; uன òlivamaradhdhiன bhi~njhughaL udhirndhubhoM.
nI ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRuvAy, AனAluM avarghaL uனனoDheghUDha irArghaL; avarghaL jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhovArghaL.
uன mara~NghaLèllAvaRRaiyuM uன niladhdhiன ghaனighaLaiyuM viDhDhil bhaDhjhidhdhubhbhoDhuM.
uன naDhuvilirughghiRa anniyaன uனghghu meRbhaDhDhu meனmeluM uyarndhirubhbhAன; nI mighavuM dhAzhdhdhabhbhaDhDhubhbhovAy.
avaன uனனiDhadhdhil ghaDhaனbhaDhAன; nI avaனiDhadhdhil ghaDhaனbhaDhuvAy; avaன dhalaiyAyirubhbhAன, nI vAlAyirubhbhAy.

uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghuvidhighghadhdhaghgha avaruDhaiya ghaRbhaனaighaLaiyuM ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM ghaighghòLLuMbhaDhi, nI avar jhadhdhadhdhiRghujh jhèvighòDhAdhabhaDhiyiனAl, indhajh jhAbha~NghaL èllAM uனmel vandhu, nI azhiyumaDhDhuM uனனaidhdhòDharndhu bhiDhidhdhu,
uனனiluM uன jhandhadhiyiluM èனRaighghuM aDhaiyALamAghavuM aRbhudhamAghavuM irughghuM.
jhaghalamuM bharibhUraNamAyirughghaiyil, nI maனmaghizhjhjhiyoDhuM ghaLibhbhoDhuM uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaijh jheviyAmaRbhoனdhiனimidhdhaM,

jhaghalamuM ghuRaivubhaDhDhu, bhaDhDhiனiyoDhuM dhAghadhdhoDhuM nirvANadhdhoDhuM, ghardhdhar uனghghu virodhamAy aனubhbhuM jhadhdhurughghaLaijh jhevibhbhAy; avarghaL uனனai azhidhdhudh dhIrumaDhDhuM, irubhbhu nughadhdhaDhiyai uன ghazhudhdhiனmel bhoDhuvArghaL.
ghizhavaன èனRu mughaMbhArAmaluM, vAlibhaன èனRu ira~NghAmaluM irughghuM ghòDhiya mughamuLLadhuM,
uனghghudh dhèriyAdha bhAShaiyaibh bhejhughiRadhumAன jAdhiyai vèghudhUradhdhiluLLa bhUmiyiன ghaDhaiyAndharadhdhilirundhu ghardhdhar uனmel ghazhughu bhaRaghghuM veghamAy varabhbhaNNuvAr.

nI azhiyumaDhDhuM andha jAdhiyAன uன mirughajIvaனghaLiன bhalaனaiyuM, uன niladhdhiன ghaனiyaiyuM bhujhibhbhAன; avaன uனனai azhidhdhudh dhIrumaDhDhuM uன dhAனiyadhdhiluM, dhirADhjharajhadhdhiluM, èNNèyiluM, uன mandhaighaLiluLLa ADhumADhughaLiluM uனghghu òனRuM mIdhiyAghavaighghamADhDhAன.

uன dhejhamè~NghuM nI naMbhiyirughghuM uyaramuM araNibhbhuM madhilghaL vizhumaLavuM, avaன uன vAjhalghaLilè~NghuM uனனai muRRighghaibhbhoDhuvAன; uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghugh ghòDhudhdha uனனuDhaiya dhejhamè~NghumuLLa uனனuDhaiya vAjhalghaLdhoRuM uனனai muRRighghaibhbhoDhuvAன.
uன jhadhdhurughghaL uனனai muRRighghaibhbhoDhDhu nèrughghu~NghAladhdhil, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghugh ghòDhudhdha uன gharbhbhaghghaனiyAன uன bhudhdhirabhudhdhirighaLiன mAMjhadhdhaidh dhiனbhAy.

uன jhadhdhurughghaL uன vAjhalghaLiluM uனனai muRRighghaibhbhoDhDhu nèrughghu~NghAladhdhil, uனனiDhadhdhil jhèrughghuM jhughajhèlvamumuLLa maனidhaன jhaghaladhdhaiyuM izhandhu, dhaன illAmaiyile dhAன dhiனனuM dhaன bhiLLaighaLiன mAMjhadhdhile,
dhaன jhaghodharaனughghAghiluM, dhaன mArbhil irughghiRa maனaivighghAghiluM, dhaனghghu mIndhirughghiRa dhaன maghghaLil òruvaனughghAghiluM ghò~njhameனuM ghòDhAdhabhaDhi avarghaLmel vaனghaNNAyirubhbhAன.

uனனiDhadhdhil jhughajhèlvadhdhiனAluM jhèrughghiனAluM dhaன uLLa~NghAlaidh dharaiyiனmel vaighgha a~njhiன jhèrughghuM jhughajhèlvamumuLLa sdhirI dhaன ghAlghaLiன naDhuve bhuRabhbhaDhDha dhaன na~njhughghòDhiyiனimidhdhamuM, dhAன bhèRRa bhiLLaighaLiனimidhdhamuM, dhaன mArbhil irughghiRa bhuruShaனmeluM dhaன ghumAraனmeluM dhaன ghumAradhdhiyiனmeluM vaனghaNNAyirubhbhAL;
uன jhadhdhurughghaL uன vAjhalghaLil uனனai muRRighghaibhbhoDhDhu nèrughghu~NghAladhdhil, jhaghalamuM ghuRaivubhaDhuvadhiனAl, avaighaLai iraghajhiyamAydh dhiனனuvAன.

uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èனனuM maghimaiyuM bhaya~NgharamumAன nAmadhdhiRghubh bhayabhbhaDhuMbhaDhighghu, nI indhabh bhusdhaghadhdhil èzhudhiyirughghiRa indha niyAyabhbhiramANa vArdhdhaighaLiனbhaDhiyèllAM naDhaghghagh ghavaனmAyirAviDhDhAl,
ghardhdhar nI~NghAdha bhèriya vAdhaighaLAluM nI~NghAdha ghòDhiya rogha~NghaLAluM uனனaiyuM uன jhandhadhiyaiyuM adhijhayamAy vAdhidhdhu,
nI ghaNDhu bhayandha èghibhdhu viyAdhighaLèllAM uனmel varuvibhbhAr; avaighaL uனனaibh bhaRRighghòLLuM.
indha niyAyabhbhiramANa bhusdhaghadhdhil èzhudhiyirAdha èllAbh bhiNiyaiyuM vAdhaiyaiyuM nI azhiyumaLavuM ghardhdhar uனmel varabhbhaNNuvAr.
dhiraDhjhiyile vAனdhdhu naDhjhadhdhira~NghaLaibhbhol irundha nI~NghaL, u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன jhadhdhadhdhiRghujh jhèvighòDhAmaRbhoனdhiனAl, ghò~njhaM jaனmAybhbhovIrghaL.

ghardhdhar uனனaibh bhUmiyiன òru muனaidhuvaghghi bhUmiyiன maRumuனaimaDhDhuM irughghiRa èllA jaன~NghaLughghuLLuM jhidhaRa aDhibhbhAr; a~Nghe nIyuM uன bhidhAghghaLuM aRiyAdha maramuM ghallumAன anniya dhevarghaLaijh jhevibhbhAy.

uன jIvaன uனghghujh jhandheghadhdhil UjhalADhuM; uன jIvaனaibhbhaRRi naMbhighghaiyillAmal iravuM bhaghaluM dhighilghòNDhirubhbhAy.

nI bhayabhbhaDhuM uன irudhayadhdhiன dhighiliனAluM, uன ghaNghaL ghANuM ghADhjhiyiனAluM, viDhiyaRghAladhdhil èbhbhòzhudhu jhAya~NghAlaM varumo èனRuM, jhAya~NghAladhdhil, èbhbhòzhudhu viDhiyaRghAlaM varumo èனRuM jhòlluvAy.

AghiluM ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghu uNaradhdhaghgha irudhayadhdhaiyuM, ghANadhdhaghgha ghaNghaLaiyuM, gheDhghadhdhaghgha ghAdhughaLaiyuM innALvaraighghuM ghòDhughghavillai.

ghardhdharAghiya nAன u~NghaL dhevaன èனRu nI~NghaL aRindhughòLLuMbhaDhighghu, nAன nARbhadhu varuShaM u~NghaLai vaனAndharadhdhil naDhadhdhiனeன; u~NghaLmel irundha vasdhiraM bhazhaiyadhAybh bhoghavuM illai, u~NghaL ghAlilirundha bhAdharaDhjhaighaL bhazhaiyadhAybh bhoghavuM illai.
nI~NghaL abhbhaM jhAbhbhiDhavuM illai, dhirADhjharajhamuM madhuvuM ghuDhighghavuM illai èனRAr.
nI~NghaL ivviDhadhdhughghu vandhabhodhu, èsbhoனiன rAjAvAghiya jhIghoனuM, bhAjhAனiன rAjAvAghiya oghuM naMmoDhe yudhdha~njhèyyabh bhuRabhbhaDhDharghaL; nAM avarghaLai muRiya aDhidhdhu,
avarghaLuDhaiya dhejhadhdhaibh bhiDhidhdhu, adhai rUbhaனiyarughghuM ghAdhdhiyarughghuM maனAjheyiன bhAdhigh ghodhdhiradhdhiRghuM jhudhandharamAghagh ghòDhudhdhoM.
ibhbhòzhudhuM nI~NghaL jhèyvadhèllAM u~NghaLughghu vAyghghuMbhaDhighghu, indha uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyiன vArdhdhaighaLaigh ghaighghòNDhu, avaighaLiனbhaDhi jhèyvIrghaLAgha.

uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghujh jhòனனbhaDhiyeyuM, uன bhidhAghghaLAghiya AbhiraghAmughghuM IjhAghghughghuM yAghghobhughghuM ANaiyiDhDhugh ghòDhudhdhabhaDhiyeyuM, iனRu uனனaidh dhamaghghu jaனmAgha eRbhaDhudhdhighghòLLavuM, dhAM uனghghu dhevaனAyirughghavuM.
nI uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya uDhaனbhaDhighghaighghuM iனRu avar uனனoDhe bhaNNughiRa avaruDhaiya ANaiyuRudhighghuM uDhbhaDhuMbhaDhighghu,
u~NghaL ghodhdhira~NghaLiன dhalaivaruM u~NghaL mUbhbharuM u~NghaL adhibhadhighaLuM israveliன jhaghala bhuruSharuM,

u~NghaL bhiLLaighaLuM, u~NghaL maனaivighaLuM, u~NghaL bhALayadhdhughghuLLirughghiRa u~NghaL viRaghughghAraனuM, u~NghaL dhaNNIrghghAraனumAன anniyar èllAruM iனRu u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhamughadhdhil niRghiRIrghaLe.
nAன u~NghaLoDhemAdhdhiraM indha uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyaiyuM indha ANaiyaiyuM uRudhiyaiyuM bhaNNAmal,
iனRu i~Nghe naMmoDheghUDha naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhamughadhdhil niRghiRavarghaLoDheyuM, iனRu i~Nghe naMmoDhe irAdhavarghaLoDheyuMghUDha adhaibh bhaNNughiReன.
nAM èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhil ghuDhiyirundhadhaiyuM, nAM ghaDhandhuvandha iDha~NghaLilirundha jAdhighaLiன naDhuvil naDhandhuvandhadhaiyuM nI~NghaL aRindhirughghiRIrghaL.
avarghaLuDhaiya aruvarubhbhughaLaiyuM, avarghaLiDhadhdhilirughghiRa maramuM ghalluM vèLLiyuM bhòனனumAன avarghaLuDhaiya naraghalAன dhevarghaLaiyuM ghaNDhirughghiRIrghaL.

AghaiyAl, andha jAdhighaLiன dhevarghaLaijh jhevighghabh bhoghuMbhaDhi, iனRu naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaiviDhDhu aghalughiRa irudhayamuLLa òru bhuruShaனAghiluM sdhirIyAghiluM ghuDhuMbhamAghiluM ghodhdhiramAghiluM u~NghaLil irAdhabhaDhighghuM, na~njhaiyuM èDhDhiyaiyuM muLaibhbhighghiRa yAdhòru ver u~NghaLil irAdhabhaDhighghuM bhAru~NghaL.

abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavaன indha ANaiyuRudhiyiன vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhuM, dhAghadhdhiனimidhdhaM vèRighghagh ghuDhidhdhu, maன iShDhabhbhaDhi naDhandhAluM èனghghujh jhughamuNDhAyirughghuM èனRu dhaன uLLadhdhaidh dheRRighghòNDhAl, ghardhdhar avaனai maனனighghajh jhidhdhamAyirAr.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhariன ghobhamuM èrijhjhaluM andha maனidhaனmel bhughaiyuM; indhabh bhusdhaghadhdhil èzhudhiyirughghiRa jhAbha~NghaLèllAM avaனmel dha~NghuM; ghardhdhar avaன bherai vAனdhdhiனghIzh irAdhabhaDhighghugh ghulaidhdhubhbhoDhuvAr.

indha niyAyabhbhiramANa bhusdhaghadhdhil èzhudhiyirughghiRa uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyiனuDhaiya jhaghala jhAbha~NghaLiனbhaDhiyuM avaனughghudh dhI~NghAgha ghardhdhar isravel ghodhdhira~NghaL èllAvaRRiRghuM avaனaibh bhuRaMbhAghghibhbhoDhuvAr.

abhbhòzhudhu u~NghaLughghubh bhiன èzhuMbhuM dhalaimuRaiyAன u~NghaL bhiLLaighaLuM, dhUradhejhadhdhilirundhu varuM anniyaruM, ghardhdhar indha dhejhadhdhughghu varuvidhdha vAdhaighaLaiyuM noyghaLaiyuM ghANuMbhodhuM,

ghardhdhar dhamadhu ghobhadhdhiluM dhamadhu ughghiradhdhiluM jhodhomaiyuM ghòmorAvaiyuM adhmarAvaiyuM jhèbhoraiyuM ghavizhdhdhubhbhoDhDhadhubhola, indha dhejhadhdhiன nila~NghaLèllAM vidhaibhbhuM viLaivuM yAdhòru bhUNDhiன muLaibhbhumillAdhabhaDhighghu, ghandhaghadhdhAluM ubhbhAluM èrighghabhbhaDhDhadhaigh ghANuMbhodhuM,
andha jAdhighaLèllAM ghardhdhar indha dhejhadhdhiRghu eன ibhbhaDhijh jhèydhAr; indha maghA ghobhaM bhaRRiyèrindhadhaRghugh ghAraNaM èனன èனRu jhòlluvArghaL.

adhaRghu avarghaLuDhaiya bhidhAghghaLiன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar avarghaLai èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNuMbhodhu, avarghaLoDhe bhaNNiன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai avarghaL viDhDhubhbhoy,
dhA~NghaL aRiyAmaluM dha~NghaLughghu òru bhalaனuM aLighghAmaluM irughghiRa dhevarghaLAghiya veRe dhevarghaLaijh jhevidhdhu, avaighaLaibh bhaNindhughòNDhabhaDhiyiனAle,

maRaivAனvaighaL naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghe uriyavaighaL; vèLibhbhaDhudhdhabhbhaDhDhavaighaLo, indha niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiன vArdhdhaighaLiனbhaDhiyèllAM jhèyyuMbhaDhighghu, namaghghuM naMmuDhaiya bhiLLaighaLughghuM èனRèனRaighghuM uriyavaighaL.

nAன uனghghu muனbhAgha vaidhdha AjhIrvAdhamuM jhAbhamumAghiya indhagh ghAriya~NghaLèllAM uனmel varuMbhodhu: nI uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharAl dhuradhdhiviDhabhbhaDhDhu, èllA jAdhighaLiDhadhdhiluM bhoyirughghuMbhodhu, nI uன irudhayadhdhile jhindhaனaijhèydhu,

uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uன jhiRaiyirubhbhaidh dhirubhbhi, uனghghu ira~Nghi, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனனaijh jhidhaRa aDhidhdha èllA jaன~NghaLiDhadhdhiluM irughghiRa uனனaidh dhiruMbhajh jherdhdhughghòLLuvAr.

indhajh jhAbha~NghaLaiyèllAM uன jhadhdhurughghaLmeluM uனனaidh dhuனbhabhbhaDhudhdhiன uன bhaghai~narmeluM jhumarabhbhaNNuvAr.

uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhiRghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhu, indha niyAyabhbhiramANa bhusdhaghadhdhil èzhudhiyirughghiRa avaruDhaiya ghaRbhaனaighaLaiyuM avaruDhaiya ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM ghaighghòLLuMbhodhuM, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariDhadhdhil uன muzhu irudhayadhdhoDhuM uன muzhu AdhdhumAvoDhuM dhiruMbhuMbhodhuM, ghardhdhar uன bhidhAghghaLmel jhandhoShamAyirundhadhubhola, uனmeluM uனghghu naனmai uNDhAghadh dhiruMbhavuM jhandhoShamAyirubhbhAr.
nAன iனRu uனghghu vidhighghiRa ghaDhDhaLai uனghghu maRaibhòruLuM alla, adhu uனghghudh dhUramAனdhuM alla.

nA~NghaL adhaigh gheDhDhu, adhiனbhaDhi jhèyyuMbhòruDhDhu, è~NghaLnimidhdhaM avar vAனdhdhughghu eRi, adhai è~NghaLughghugh ghòNDhuvarughiRavaன yArèனRu nI jhòlladhdhaghghadhAgha, adhu vAனdhdhiluLLadhuM alla;

nI gheLAdhabhaDhighghu, maனM bhedhidhdhu, izhubhbhuNDhubhoy, veRe dhevarghaLaibhbhaNindhu, avarghaLaijh jhevibhbhAyAனAl,
nI~NghaL jhudhandharighghiRadhaRghu yordhAனaigh ghaDhandhubhoghiRa dhejhadhdhil nèDhunAL vAzhAmal, nijhjhayamAy azhindhubhovIrghaL èனbhadhai iனRu u~NghaLughghu aRivighghiReன.

nAன jIvaனaiyuM maraNadhdhaiyuM, AjhIrvAdhadhdhaiyuM jhAbhadhdhaiyuM uனghghumuன vaidhdheன èனRu u~NghaLmel vAனdhdhaiyuM bhUmiyaiyuM iனRu jhADhjhivaighghiReன; AghaiyAl, nIyuM uன jhandhadhiyuM bhizhaighghuMbhaDhighghu, nI jIvaனaidh dhèrindhughòNDhu,

ghardhdhar uன bhidhAghghaLAghiya AbhiraghAmughghuM IjhAghghughghuM yAghghobhughghuM ghòDhubhbheன èனRu avarghaLughghu ANaiyiDhDhugh ghòDhudhdha dhejhadhdhile ghuDhiyirughghuMbhaDhighghu, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharil aனbhughUrndhu, avar jhadhdhadhdhiRghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhu, avaraibh bhaRRighghòLvAyAgha; avare uனghghu jIvaனuM dhIrghghAyujhumAனvar èனRAன.
bhiனனuM mojhe bhoy isravelar yAvaraiyuM noghghi:

ghardhdhar azhidhdha èmoriyariன rAjAghghaLAghiya jhIghoனughghuM, oghughghuM, avarghaL dhejhadhdhiRghuM jhèydhadhubholave avarghaLughghuM jhèyvAr.
nAன u~NghaLughghu vidhidhdha ghaDhDhaLaighaLiனbhaDhi avarghaLughghujh jhèyvadhaRghu ghardhdhar avarghaLai u~NghaLughghu òbhbhughghòDhubhbhAr.

nI~NghaL bhala~NghòNDhu dhiDhamaனdhAyiru~NghaL, avarghaLughghubh bhayabhbhaDhavuM dhighaighghavuM veNDhAM; uன dhevaனAghiya, ghardhdhardhAme uனனoDheghUDha varughiRAr; avar uனனai viDhDhu vilaghuvadhuM illai; uனனaigh ghaiviDhuvadhuM illai èனRu jhòனனAன.

bhiனbhu mojhe yojhuvAvai azhaidhdhu, isravelar èllAruM bhArdhdhirughgha, avaனai noghghi bhala~NghòNDhu dhiDhamaனdhAyiru; ghardhdhar ivarghaLughghugh ghòDhubhbheன èனRu ivarghaLuDhaiya bhidhAghghaLughghu ANaiyiDhDha dhejhadhdhughghu nI indha jaனdhdhai azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoy, adhai ivarghaL jhudhandharighghuMbhaDhijhèyvAy.
ghardhdhardhAme uனghghu muனbhAghabh bhoghiRavar, avar uனனoDhe irubhbhAr; avar uனனai viDhDhu vilaghuvadhumillai, uனனaigh ghaiviDhuvadhumillai; nI bhayabhbhaDhavuM ghala~NghavuM veNDhAM èனRAன.

mojhe indha niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhai èzhudhi, adhaigh ghardhdharuDhaiya uDhaனbhaDhighghaibh bhèDhDhiyaijh jhumaghghiRa levibhudhdhirarAன AjhAriyarughghuM israveluDhaiya mUbhbhar èllArughghuM òbhbhuvidhdhu,

mèyyAghave avar jaன~NghaLaijh jhineghighghiRAr; avaruDhaiya bharijhudhdhavAனghaLèllAruM uMmuDhaiya ghaiyil irughghiRArghaL; avarghaL uMmuDhaiya bhAdhadhdhilvizhundhu, uMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaighaLiனAl bhodhaனaiyaDhaivArghaL.
mojhe namaghghu òru niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhaigh ghaRbhidhdhAன; adhu yAghghobhiன jhabhaighghujh jhudhandharamAyiRRu.
jaன~NghaLiன dhalaivaruM israveliன ghodhdhira~NghaLuM ghUDhDha~NghUDhiனbhodhu avar yèShUraனughghu rAjAvAyirundhAr.
rUbhaன jhAvAmal bhizhaibhbhAனAgha; avaன jaனM ghò~njhamAyirAdhu èனRAன.

avaன yUdhAvaigh ghuRidhdhu: ghardhdhAve, yUdhAviன jhadhdhadhdhaigh gheDhDhu, avaன dhaன jaனdhdhoDhe dhiruMbhajhjherabhbhaNNuM; avaன ghai bhalaghghaghghaDhavadhu; avaனuDhaiya jhadhdhurughghaLughghu avaனai nI~NghalAghghi viDhuvighghiRa jhaghAyarAyirubhbhIrAgha èனRAன.
leviyaighghuRidhdhu: nI mAjhAvile bharIDhjhaibhArdhdhu, meribhAviன dhaNNIriDhadhdhil vAghghuvAdhaMbhaNNiன uன bharijhudhdha bhuruShaன vajhamAy uனனuDhaiya dhuMmIM UrIM èனbhavaighaL irubhbhadhAgha.

dhaன dhaghabhbhaனughghuM dhaன dhAyghghuM: nAன u~NghaLaibh bhAreன èனRu jhòlli, dhaன jhaghodhararai a~NghighariyAmal, dhaன bhiLLaighaLaiyuM aRiyAmalirughghiRavaன vajhamAy avaighaL irubhbhadhAgha; avarghaL uMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaighaLaigh ghaighghòNDhu, uMmuDhaiya uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyaigh ghAghghiRavarghaL.

avarghaL yAghghobhughghu uMmuDhaiya niyAya~NghaLaiyuM, isravelughghu uMmuDhaiya bhiramANadhdhaiyuM bhodhidhdhu, jhannidhAனdhdhile dhUbhavarghghadhdhaiyuM, umadhu bhalibhIDhadhdhiனmel jharvA~NghadhaghaனbhalighaLaiyuM iDhuvArghaL.

ghardhdhAve, avaன jhaMbhadhdhai AjhIrvadhidhdhu, avaன ghaighghiriyaiyiனmel bhiriyamAyiruM; avaனaibh bhaghaidhdhu avaனughghu virodhamAy èzhuMbhughiRavarghaL dhiruMbha èzhundhirAdhabhaDhi avarghaLuDhaiya iDhubhbhughaLai nòRughghiviDhuM èனRAன.
bhèனyamIனaighghuRidhdhu: ghardhdharughghubh bhiriyamAனvaன, avaroDhe jhughamAydh dha~NghiyirubhbhAன; avaனai ènnALuM avar ghAbhbhARRi, avaன èllaighghuLLe vAjhamAyirubhbhAr èனRAன.
yojhebhbhaighghuRidhdhu: ghardhdharAl avaனuDhaiya dhejhaM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuvadhAgha; adhu vAனdhdhiன jhèlvadhdhiனAluM, bhaனiyiனAluM, AzhadhdhiluLLa nIrURRughaLiனAluM,
jhUriyaன bhaghghuvabhbhaDhudhdhuM arumaiyAன ghaனighaLiனAluM, jhandhiraன bhaghghuvabhbhaDhudhdhuM arumaiyAன bhalaனghaLiனAluM,
Adhibharvadha~NghaLil uNDhAghuM dhiraviya~NghaLiனAluM nidhdhiya malaighaLil bhiRaghghuM aruMbhòruLghaLiனAluM,

nADhuM adhiன niRaivuM ghòDhughghuM arumaiyAன dhAனiya~NghaLiனAluM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuvadhAgha. muDhjhèDhiyil èzhundharuLiனvariன dhayai yojhebhbhuDhaiya jhirajhiனmeluM, dhaன jhaghodhararil vijheShidhdhavaனuDhaiya ujhjhandhalaiyiனmeluM varuvadhAgha.

avaன ala~NghAraM avaன dhalaiyIRRugh ghALaiyiனuDhaiya ala~NghAradhdhaibhbholavuM, avaன ghòMbhughaL ghANDhAmirughadhdhiன ghòMbhughaLaibhbholavuM irughghuM; ŠεaighaLAle jaன~NaύghaLai eghamAy jaனdhdhiன ΕDhaiyAΨdhara~NՠγmaDhDhuM muDhDhidh dhuradhdhuvAன; avaighaL èbhbhirAyImiன bhadhiனAyira~NghaLuM maனAjheyiன Ayira~NghaLumAனvaighaL èனRAன.
jhèbhuloனaighghuRidhdhu: jhèbhuloனe, nI vèLiye bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoghaiyiluM, ijhaghghAre, nI uன ghUDhAra~NghaLil dha~NghughaiyiluM jhandhoShamAyiru.

jaன~NghaLai avarghaL malaiyiனmel varavazhaidhdhu, a~Nghe nIdhiyiன bhalighaLai iDhuvArghaL; ghaDhalghaLiluLLa jhaMbhUraNadhdhaiyuM maNalughghuLLe maRaindhirughghuM bhòruLghaLaiyuM anubhavibhbhArghaL èனRAன.

ghAdhdhaighghuRidhdhu: ghAdhdhughghu visdhAramAன iDhadhdhaigh ghòDhughghiRavar sdhodhdhirighghabhbhaDhDhavar; avaன jhi~Nghadhdhaibhbhol dha~Nghiyirundhu, bhuyadhdhaiyuM ujhjhandhalaiyaiyuM bhIRibhbhoDhuvAன.

avaன dhaனghghAgha mudhal iDhadhdhaibhbhArdhdhughghòNDhAன; a~Nghe dhaனghghu niyAyabhbhiramANighaன ghòDhudhdha bha~NghubhadhdhiramAyirughghiRadhu; AனAluM avaன jaனdhdhiன muனனNiyAy vandhu, maRRa israveluDhaனe ghardhdhariன nIdhiyaiyuM avaruDhaiya niyAya~NghaLaiyuM naDhabhbhibhbhAன èனRAன.
dhANaighghuRidhdhu: dhAN òru bhAlajhi~NghaM, avaன bhAjhAனilirundhu bhAyvAன èனRAன.

nabhdhaliyaighghuRidhdhu: nabhdhali ghardhdharuDhaiya dhayaviனAle dhirbhdhiyaDhaindhu, avaruDhaiya AjhIrvAdhadhdhiனAle niRaindhirubhbhAன. nI meRRijhaiyaiyuM dhèனdhijhaiyaiyuM jhudhandharidhdhughghòL èனRAன.
AjheraighghuRidhdhu: Ajher bhudhdhirabhAghghiyamuDhaiyavaனAy, dhaன jhaghodhararughghubh bhiriyamAyirundhu, dhaன ghAlai èNNèyile dhoybhbhAன.
iruMbhuM vèNghalamuM uன bhAdharaDhjhaiyiன ghIzhirughghuM, uன nADhghaLughghudhdhaghghadhAy uன bhèlaனuM irughghuM èனRAன.
yèShUraனuDhaiya dhevaனaibhbhol òruvaruM illai; avar uனghghujh jhaghAyamAy vAன~NghaLiனmeluM dhamadhu mADhjhimaiyoDhu AghAya maNDhala~NghaLiனmeluM eRivarughiRAr.
anAdhi dhevaனe uனghghu aDhaighghalaM; avaruDhaiya nidhdhiya bhuya~NghaL uனghghu AdhAraM; avar uனghghu muனனiனRu jhadhdhurughghaLaidh dhuradhdhi, avarghaLai azhidhdhubhbhoDhu èனRu ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuvAr.
isravel jhughamAydh dhaனidhdhu vAjhaMbhaNNuvAன; yAghghobhiன URRAனdhu dhAனiyamuM dhirADhjharajhamumuLLa dhejhadhdhile irughghuM; avaruDhaiya vAனmuM bhaனiyaibh bhèyyuM.

isravele, nI bhAghghiyavAன; ghardhdharAl iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhDha jaனme, uனghghu òbhbhAனvaன yAr? uனghghujh jhaghAya~njhèyyuM gheDhaghamuM uனghghu maghimaibhòrundhiya bhaDhDhayamuM avare; uன jhadhdhurughghaL uனghghu ijhjhaghaM bhejhi aDha~NghuvArghaL; avarghaL meDhughaLai midhibhbhAy, èனRu jhòனனAன.

bhiனbhu mojhe movAbhiன jhamaனAன vèLighaLilirundhu èrighovughghu èdhirAன nebho malaiyilirughghuM bhisghAviன ghòDhumuDhiyil eRiனAன; abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar avaனughghu, dhANmaDhDhumuLLa ghIleyAdh dhejhaM aனaidhdhaiyuM,
nabhdhali dhejhaM aனaidhdhaiyuM, èbhbhirAyIM maனAjhe èனbhavarghaLiன dhejhadhdhaiyuM, ghaDhaijhijh jhamudhdhiraMvaraighghumuLLa yUdhA dhejhaM aனaidhdhaiyuM,
dhèனbhuRadhdhaiyuM, jhovArvaraighghumuLLa bherIjhjhamara~NghaLiன bhaDhDhaNaM èனனuM UrmudhaRghòNDhu èrighoviன bhaLLadhdhAghghAghiya jhamaனAன bhUmiyaiyuM ghANbhidhdhAr.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar avaனai noghghi: nAன u~NghaL jhandhadhighghugh ghòDhubhbheன èனRu AbhiraghAmughghuM IjhAghghughghuM yAghghobhughghuM ANaiyiDhDha dhejhaM idhudhAன, idhai uன ghaN ghANuMbhaDhi jhèydheன; AனAluM avviDhadhdhiRghugh ghaDhandhubhovadhillai èனRAr.
abhbhaDhiye ghardhdhariன dhAjhaனAghiya mojhe movAbh dhejhamAன avviDhadhdhile ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye maridhdhAன.
avar avaனai movAbh dhejhadhdhiluLLa bhèdhbheyorughghu èdhirAன bhaLLadhdhAghghile aDhaghghaMbhaNNiனAr. innALvaraighghuM òruvaனuM avaன bhiredhaghghuzhiyai aRiyAன.
mojhe marighghiRabhodhu nURRirubhadhuvayadhAyirundhAன; avaன ghaN iruLaDhaiyavumillai, avaன bhèlaன ghuRaiyavumillai.
isravel bhudhdhirar movAbhiன jhamaனAன vèLighaLil mojheghghAgha mubhbhadhu nAL azhudhughòNDhirundhArghaL; mojheghghAgha azhudhu dhughgha~NghòNDhADhiன nADhghaL muDhindhadhu.

mojhe nUனiன ghumaraனAghiya yojhuvAviனmel dhaன ghaighaLai vaidhdhabhaDhiyiனAl avaன ~nAனdhdhiன AviனAl niRaiyabhbhaDhDhAன; isravel bhudhdhirar avaனughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhindhu, ghardhdhar mojheghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye jhèydhArghaL.

mojhe èghibhdhudhejhadhdhile bhArvoனughghuM, avaனuDhaiya èllA UzhiyaghghArarughghuM, avaனuDhaiya dhejhamaனaidhdhiRghuM jhèyyuMbhaDhi ghardhdhar avaனai aனubhbhijh jhèyvidhdha jhaghala aDhaiyALa~NghaLaiyuM aRbhudha~NghaLaiyuM,
avaன isravelar èllArughghuM bhiradhdhiyaDhjhamAyjh jhèydha jhaghala vallamaiyAன ghiriyaighaLaiyuM, maghA bhaya~NgharamAன jhèyghaighaLaiyuM bhArdhdhAl,
ghardhdharai mughamughamAy aRindha mojheyaibhbhola, òru dhIrghghadharijhiyuM isravelil abhbhuRaM èzhuMbhiனdhillai èனRu viLa~NghuM.
ghardhdharuDhaiya dhAjhaனAghiya mojhe maridhdhabhiனbhu, ghardhdhar mojheyiன UzhiyaghghAraனAன nUனiன ghumAraன yojhuvAvai noghghi:
èன dhAjhaனAghiya mojhe maridhdhubhbhoனAன; ibhbhòzhudhu nIyuM indha jaன~NghaL èllAruM èzhundhu, indha yordhAனaighghaDhandhu, isravel bhudhdhirarughghu nAன ghòDhughghuM dhejhadhdhughghubh bho~NghaL
nAன mojheghghujh jhòனனbhaDhi u~NghaL ghAlaDhi midhighghuM èvviDhadhdhaiyuM u~NghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdheன.

vaனAndharamuM indha lIbhaனoனuM dhòDha~Nghi aibhirAdhdhu nadhiyAன bhèriya nadhimaDhDhumuLLa edhdhiyariன dhejhaM aனaidhdhuM, jhUriyaன asdhamighghiRa dhijhaiyAன bhèriya jhamudhdhiraMvaraighghuM u~NghaL èllaiyAyirughghuM.

nI uyiroDhirughghuM nALèllAM òruvaனuM uனghghu muனbhAgha èdhirdhdhu niRbhadhillai: nAன mojheyoDhe irundhadhubhola, uனனoDhuM irubhbheன; nAன uனனaiviDhDhu vilaghuvadhumillai, uனனaigh ghaiviDhuvadhumillai.
bhala~NghòNDhu dhiDhamaனdhAyiru; indha jaனdhdhiன bhidhAghghaLughghu nAன ghòDhubhbheன èனRu ANaiyiDhDha dhejhadhdhai nI ivarghaLughghubh bha~NghiDhuvAy.

èன dhAjhaனAghiya mojhe uனghghugh ghaRbhidhdha niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiனbhaDhiyèllAM jhèyyagh ghavaனmAyirughghamAdhdhiraM mighavuM bhala~NghòNDhu dhiDhamaனdhAyiru; nI bhoghuM iDhamèllAM bhudhdhimAனAy naDhandhughòLLuMbhaDhighghu, adhai viDhDhu valadhu iDhadhubhuRaM vilaghAdhirubhbhAyAgha.

indha niyAyabhbhiramANa bhusdhaghaM uன vAyaiviDhDhubh bhiriyAdhirubhbhadhAgha; idhil èzhudhiyirughghiRavaighaLiனbhaDhiyèllAM nI jhèyyagh ghavaனmAyirughghuMbhaDhi, iravuM bhaghaluM adhaidh dhiyAனidhdhughghòNDhirubhbhAyAgha; abhbhòzhudhu nI uன vazhiyai vAyghghabhbhaNNuvAy, abhbhòzhudhu bhudhdhimAனAghavuM naDhandhughòLLuvAy.
nAன uனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhavillaiyA? bhala~NghòNDhu dhiDhamaனdhAyiru; dhighaiyAdhe, ghala~NghAdhe, nI bhoghuM iDhamèllAM uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனனoDhe irughghiRAr èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu yojhuvA jaன~NghaLiன adhibhadhighaLai noghghi:

nI~NghaL bhALayadhdhai uruva naDhandhubhoy, jaன~NghaLaibh bhArdhdhu: u~NghaLughghubh bhojaனbhadhArdhdha~NghaLai AyadhdhaMbhaNNu~NghaL; u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghujh jhudhandharighghagh ghòDhughghuM dhejhadhdhai nI~NghaL jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLuMbhaDhighghu, iனனuM mUனRu nALaighghuLLe indha yordhAனaigh ghaDhandhubhovIrghaL èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAன.
bhiனbhu yojhuvA: rUbhaனiyaraiyuM ghAdhdhiyaraiyuM maனAjheyiன bhAdhighghodhdhiradhdhAraiyuM noghghi:

ghardhdharuDhaiya dhAjhaனAghiya mojhe u~NghaLughghugh ghaRbhidhdha vArdhdhaiyai niனaidhdhughghòLLu~NghaL; u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar u~NghaLai iLaibhbhARabhbhaNNi, indha dhejhadhdhai u~NghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdhAre.

u~NghaL bhèNjhAdhighaLuM bhiLLaighaLuM mirughajIvaனghaLuM, mojhe u~NghaLughghu yordhAனughghu ibhbhuRadhdhile ghòDhudhdha dhejhadhdhil irughghaDhDhuM; u~NghaLiluLLa yudhdhavIrar yAvaruM u~NghaL jhaghodhararughghu muனbhAgha aNiyaNiyAghagh ghaDhandhubhoy,

ghardhdhar u~NghaLaibhbhola u~NghaL jhaghodhararaiyuM iLaibhbhARabhbhaNNi, avarghaLuM u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar dha~NghaLughghugh ghòDhughghuM dhejhadhdhaijh jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLumaDhDhuM, avarghaLughghu udhavijhèyyaghghaDhavIrghaL; bhiனbhu nI~NghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya dhAjhaனAghiya mojhe u~NghaLughghu yordhAனughghu ibhbhuRadhdhil jhUriyaன udhighghuM dhijhaighghu nerAghagh ghòDhudhdha u~NghaL jhudhandharamAன dhejhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhi, adhaijh jhudhandharidhdhughghòNDhirubhbhIrghaLAgha èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL yojhuvAvughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: nIr è~NghaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhughiRadhaiyèllAM jhèyvoM; nIr è~NghaLai aனubhbhuM iDhamè~NghuM bhovoM.
nA~NghaL mojheghghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhadhubhola umaghghuM jhèvighòDhubhbhoM; uMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharmAdhdhiraM mojheyoDhe irundhadhubhola, uMmoDhuM irubhbhArAgha.

nIr è~NghaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuM jhaghala ghAriyadhdhiluM uMmuDhaiya jhòllaighgheLAmal, uMmuDhaiya vAghghughghu muraDhDhADhDhaMbhaNNughiRa èvaனuM ghòlaijhèyyabhbhaDhaghghaDhavaன; bhala~NghòNDhu dhiDhamaனdhAymAdhdhiraM iruM èனRArghaL.

nUனiன ghumAraனAghiya yojhuvA jhidhdhImilirundhu vevughArarAghiya iraNDhu maனuSharai iraghajhiyamAy vevubhArghghuMbhaDhi aனubhbhi: nI~NghaL bhoy dhejhadhdhaiyuM èrighovaiyuM bhArdhdhuvAru~NghaL èனRAன. avarghaL bhoy, rAghAbh èனனuM bhèyarghòNDha vejhiyiன vIDhDhughghuL bhiravejhidhdhu, a~Nghe dha~NghiனArghaL.
dhejhadhdhai vevubhArghghuMbhaDhi, isravel bhudhdhiraril jhila maனuShar indha rAdhdhiriyile i~Nghe vandhArghaL èனRu èrighoviன rAjAvughghujh jhòllabhbhaDhDhadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu èrighoviன rAjA rAghAbhaNDhaighghu AL aனubhbhi: uனனiDhadhdhil vandhu, uன vIDhDhughghuL bhiravejhidhdha maனuSharai vèLiye ghòNDhuvA; avarghaL dhejhadhdhaiyèllAM vevubhArghghuMbhaDhi vandhArghaL èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAன.
andha sdhirI avviraNDhu maனuSharaiyuM ghòNDhubhoy avarghaLai òzhidhdhu vaidhdhu: mèydhAன, èனனiDhadhdhil maனuShar vandhirundhArghaL; AனAluM avarghaL èvviDhadhdhAro èனghghudh dhèriyAdhu.

vAjhalai aDhaighghuM neradhdhil iruDhDhuveLaiyile, andha maனuShar bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoyviDhDhArghaL; avarghaL è~Nghe bhoனArghaLo èனghghudh dhèriyAdhu; avarghaLaijh jhIghghiramAybh bhoydhdheDhu~NghaL; nI~NghaL avarghaLaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòLLalAM èனRAL.
avaL avarghaLai vIDhDhiனmel bharabhbhabhbhaDhDha jhaNal dhaDhDhaighaLughghuLLe maRaidhdhu vaidhdhirundhAL.
andha maனuShar yordhAனughghubh bhoghiRa vazhiyil dhuRaighaL maDhDhuM avarghaLaidh dheDhabhbhoனArghaL; avarghaLaidh dheDhughiRavarghaL bhuRabhbhaDhDhavuDhaனe vAjhal aDhaighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.
andha maனuShar bhaDhudhdhughghòLLumuனனe avaL vIDhDhiனmel avarghaLiDhadhdhiRghu eRibhbhoy,

ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghu dhejhadhdhai òbhbhughghòDhudhdhArèனRuM, u~NghaLaibhbhaRRi è~NghaLughghudh dhighil bhiDhidhdhirughghiRadhèனRuM, u~NghaLaighghuRidhdhu dhejhadhdhugh ghuDhighaL èllAruM jhorndhubhoனArghaL èனRuM aRiveன.

abhbhaDhiye èrujhalemiன rAjA, èbhiroனiன rAjA, yarmUdhdhiன rAjA, lAghIjhiன rAjA, èghloனiன rAjA èனghiRa èmoriyariன aindhu rAjAghghaLuM ghUDhighghòNDhu, avarghaLuM avarghaLuDhaiya èllAjhjheனaighaLuM bhoy, ghibhiyoனughghu muனbhAghabh bhALayamiRa~Nghi, adhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNiனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu ghibhiyoனiன maனuShar ghilghAlilirughghiRa bhALayadhdhughghu yojhuvAviனiDhadhdhil ALaனubhbhi: umadhu aDhiyAraigh ghaiviDhAmal, jhIghghiramAy è~NghaLiDhadhdhil vandhu, è~NghaLai iraDhjhidhdhu, è~NghaLughghudh dhuNai jhèyyuM; bharvadha~NghaLile ghuDhiyirughghiRa èmoriyariன rAjAghghaLèllAruM è~NghaLughghu virodhamAghagh ghUDhiனArghaL èனRu jhòllajh jhòனனArghaL.
uDhaனe yojhuvAvuM avaனoDheghUDhajh jhaghala yudhdhamaனuSharuM jhaghala bharAghghiramajhAlighaLuM ghilghAlilirundhu bhoனArghaL.

avarghaL bhèdhdhòroனilirundhu, iRa~NghughiRa vazhiyile isravelughghu muனbhAgha oDhibhbhoghaiyil, ajhèghghAmaDhDhuM oDhughiRa avarghaLmel ghardhdhar vAனdhdhilirundhu bhèriya ghaRghaLai vizhabhbhaNNiனAr, avarghaL jhèdhdhArghaL; isravel bhudhdhirar bhaDhDhayadhdhAl ghòனRavarghaLaibh bhArghghiluM ghalmazhaiyiனAl jhèdhdhavarghaL adhighamAyirundhArghaL.

ghardhdhar èmoriyarai isravel bhudhdhirarughghu muனbhAgha òbhbhughghòDhughghiRa annALile, yojhuvA ghardhdharai noghghibh bhejhi, bhiனbhu israveliன ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha: jhUriyaனe, nI ghibhiyoனmeluM, jhandhiraனe, nI Ayaloன bhaLLadhdhAghghiluM, dharidhdhunillu~NghaL èனRAன.

ibhbhaDhigh ghardhdhar òru maனidhaனuDhaiya jhòlgheDhDha annALaiyòdhdhanAL adhaRghu muனனumillai adhaRghubhbhiனனumillai; ghardhdhar isravelughghAgha yudhdhaMbhaNNiனAr.

aindhu rAjAghghaLuM maghghèdhAvilirughghiRa òru ghèbhiyil òLidhdhirundhu aghabhbhaDhDhArghaL èனRu yojhuvAvughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu yojhuvA: bhèriya ghaRghaLaigh ghèbhiyiன vAyile bhuraDhDhi, avviDhadhdhil avarghaLaigh ghAvalghAghgha maனuSharai vaiyu~NghaL.

nI~NghaLo nillAmal, u~NghaL jhadhdhurughghaLaidh dhuradhdhi, avarghaLuDhaiya bhiனbhaDhaighaLai vèDhDhibhbhoDhu~NghaL; avarghaLaidh dha~NghaL bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLile bhiravejhighghavòDhDhAdhiru~NghaL; u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar avarghaLai u~NghaL ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr èனRAன.
yojhuvAvuM isravel bhudhdhiraruM avarghaLai maghA bhèriya jha~NghAramAy avarghaL azhiyumaLavuM jha~NgharidhdhArghaL; avarghaLil mIdhiyAனvarghaL araNAன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLughghuL bhughundhArghaL.
jaன~NghaLèllAruM jhughamAy maghghèdhAvilirughghiRa bhALayadhdhile, yojhuvAviனiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhivandhArghaL; isravel bhudhdhirarughghu virodhamAgha òruvaனuM dhaன nAvai ajhaighghavillai.
abhbhòzhudhu yojhuvA: ghèbhiyiன vAyaidhdhiRandhu, andha aindhu rAjAghghaLaiyuM andhagh ghèbhiyilirundhu èனனiDhadhdhil vèLiye ghòNDhuvAru~NghaL èனRAன.

avarghaL abhbhaDhiye jhèydhu, èrujhalemiன rAjAvuM, èbhiroனiன rAjAvuM, yarmUdhdhiன rAjAvuM, lAghIjhiன rAjAvuM, èghloனiன rAjAvumAghiya andha aindhu rAjAghghaLaiyuM andhagh ghèbhiyilirundhu avaனiDhadhdhiRghu vèLiye ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.

avarghaLai yojhuvAviனiDhadhdhiRghugh ghòNDhuvandhabhodhu, yojhuvA isravel maனuSharaiyèllAM azhaibhbhidhdhu, dhaனனoDheghUDha vandha yudhdhamaனuShariன adhibhadhighaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL ghiDhDhavandhu, u~NghaL ghAlghaLai indha rAjAghghaLuDhaiya ghazhudhdhughaLiனmel vaiyu~NghaL èனRAன; avarghaL ghiDhDha vandhu, dha~NghaL ghAlghaLai avarghaL ghazhudhdhughaLiனmel vaidhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu yojhuvA avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL bhayabhbhaDhAmaluM ghala~NghAmaluM bhaladhdhudh dhiDhamaனdhAyiru~NghaL; nI~NghaL yudhdhaMbhaNNuM u~NghaL jhadhdhurughghaLughghèllAM ghardhdhar ibhbhaDhiye jhèyvAr èனRAன.
adhaRghubhbhiனbhu yojhuvA avarghaLai vèDhDhighghòனRu, aindhu mara~NghaLile dhUghghibhbhoDhDhAன; jhAya~NghAlamaDhDhuM mara~NghaLil dhò~NghiனArghaL.

jhUriyaன asdhamighghiRaveLaiyile, yojhuvA avarghaLai mara~NghaLilirundhu iRaghghagh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAன. avarghaL òLidhdhughghòNDhirundha ghèbhiyile avarghaLaibh bhoDhDhu; innALvaraighghuM irughghiRabhaDhi bhèriya ghaRghaLai ghèbhiyiன vAyile aDhaidhdhArghaL.

annALile yojhuvA maghghèdhAvaibhbhiDhidhdhu, adhaibhbhaDhDhayagh gharughghiனAl azhidhdhu, adhiன rAjAvaiyuM adhiluLLa maனuSharAghiya jhaghala narajIvaனghaLaiyuM, òruvaraiyuM mIdhiyAgha vaighghAmal, jha~NghAraMbhaNNi, èrighoviன rAjAvughghujh jhèydhadhubhola, maghghèdhAviன rAjAvuՠύghuM jhèydhAன.
maghghaƠΤAvilaοrunΤu yojhuεA isa͠ΰvelar aனaivaroDhu~NghUDha libhனAvughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, libhனAviனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNiனAன.

ghardhdhar adhaiyuM adhiன rAjAvaiyuM israveliன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr; adhaiyuM adhiluLLa jhaghala narajIvaனghaLaiyuM, òruvaraiyuM adhile mIdhiyAgha vaighghAmal, bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl azhidhdhu, èrighoviன rAjAvughghujh jhèydhadhubhola, adhiன rAjAvughghuM jhèydhAன.
libhனAvilirundhu yojhuvA isravel aனaidhdhoDhu~NghUDha lAghIjhughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, adhaRghu èdhire bhALayaM iRa~Nghi, adhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNiனAன.

ghardhdhar lAghIjhai israveliன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr; adhai iraNDhAM nALile bhiDhidhdhu, libhனAvughghujh jhèydhadhubhola, adhaiyuM adhiluLLa èllA narajIvaனghaLaiyuM bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl azhidhdhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghejheriன rAjAvAghiya orAM lAghIjhughghudh dhuNaijhèyyuMbhaDhi vandhAன; yojhuvA avaனaiyuM avaன jaனdhdhaiyuM òruvaனuM mIdhiyAyirAdhabhaDhi, vèDhDhibhbhoDhDhAன.
lAghIjhilirundhu yojhuvAvuM isravelar aனaivaruM èghloனughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, adhaRghu èdhire bhALayamiRa~Nghi, adhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNi,
adhai annALile bhiDhidhdhu, adhaibh bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl azhidhdhArghaL. lAghIjhughghujh jhèydhadhubhola, adhiluLLa jhaghala narajIvaனghaLaiyuM annALiledhAனe jha~NghAraMbhaNNiனAன.
bhiனbhu èghloனilirundhu yojhuvAvuM isravelar aனaivarumAy èbhiroனughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, adhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNi,

adhaibh bhiDhidhdhu, èghloனughghujh jhèydhadhubhola, adhaiyuM adhiன rAjAvaiyuM adhaRghu aDhudhdha èllAbhbhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaiyuM adhiluLLa jhaghala narajIvaனghaLaiyuM, òruvaraiyuM mIdhiyAgha vaighghAmal bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl azhidhdhArghaL; adhaiyuM adhiluLLa jhaghala narajIvaனghaLaiyuM jha~NghAraMbhaNNiனAன.
bhiனbhu yojhuvA isravelar aனaivaroDhu~NghUDhadh dhèbhIrughghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoy, adhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNi,

adhaiyuM adhiன rAjAvaiyuM adhaijh jherndha èllAbh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaiyuM bhiDhidhdhAன; avaighaLaibh bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl azhidhdhu, adhiluLLa narajIvaனghaLaiyèllAM, òruvaraiyuM mIdhiyAgha vaighghAmal, jha~NghAraMbhaNNiனArghaL; èbhiroனughghuM libhனAvughghuM avaighaLiன rAjAvughghuM jhèydhadhubholadh dhèbhIrughghuM adhiன rAjAvughghuM jhèydhAன.

ibhbhaDhiye yojhuvA malaidhdhejhaM aனaidhdhaiyuM dhèனdhejhadhdhaiyuM jhamabhUmiyaiyuM nIrbhbhAyjhjhalAன iDha~NghaLaiyuM avaighaLiன èllA rAjAghghaLaiyuM, òruvaraiyuM mIdhiyAgha vaighghAmal azhidhdhu, israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye, jhuvAjhamuLLa èllAvaRRaiyuM jha~NghAraMbhaNNi,
ghAdhesbharனeyAdhuvaghghigh ghAdhjhAmaDhDhuM irughghiRadhaiyuM ghibhiyoனmaDhDhuM irughghiRa ghojheன dhejhaM aனaidhdhaiyuM azhidhdhAன.
andha rAjAghghaL èllAraiyuM avarghaL dhejhadhdhaiyuM yojhuvA òrumighghabh bhiDhidhdhAன; israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar isravelughghAgha yudhdhaMbhaNNiனAr.
bhiனbhu yojhuvA isravelaனaidhdhoDhuMghUDhagh ghilghAlilirughghiRa bhALayadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhiனAன.
Adhjhoriன rAjAvAghiya yAbhIன adhaigh gheLvibhbhaDhDhabhodhu, avaன mAdhoனiன rAjAvAghiya yobhAbhiDhadhdhiRghuM, jhiMroனiன rAjAviDhadhdhughghuM, aghjhAbhiன rAjAviDhadhdhiRghuM,
vaDhaghgheyirughghiRa malaighaLiluM ghiனனredhdhughghudh dhèRgheyirughghiRa nADhDhubhbhuRadhdhiluM jhamabhUmiyiluM meRghu èllaiyAghiya dhoriluM irughghiRa rAjAghghaLiDhadhdhiRghuM,

avarghaL ghaDhaRgharai maNalaibhbhol erALamAன dhiraNDha jaனmAghiya dha~NghaLuDhaiya èllAjh jheனaighaLoDhuM, maghA erALamAன ghudhiraighaLoDhuM iradha~NghaLoDhuMghUDhabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhArghaL.
indha rAjAghghaLèllAruM ghUDhi, israveloDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNavandhu, mejhoM èனghiRa eriyaNDhaiyile eghamAybh bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar yojhuvAvai noghghi: avarghaLughghubh bhayabhbhaDhAyAgha, nALai inneradhdhile nAன avarghaLaiyèllAM isravelughghu muனbhAgha vèDhDhuNDhavarghaLAgha òbhbhughghòDhubhbheன; nI avarghaL ghudhiraighaLiன ghudhighAl naraMbhughaLai aRudhdhu, avarghaL iradha~NghaLai aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhèrighghaghghaDhavAy èனRAr.
yojhuvAvuM avaனoDheghUDha yudhdha jaன~NghaL aனaivaruM, dhiDhIrèனRu meroM eriyaNDhaiyilirughghiRa avarghaLiDhadhdhil vandhu, avarghaLmel vizhundhArghaL.

ghardhdhar avarghaLai israveliன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr; avarghaLai muRiya aDhidhdhu, bhèriya jhIdhoனmaDhDhuM misrabhodhmAyImaDhDhuM, ghizhaghgheyirughghiRa misbhe bhaLLadhdhAghghumaDhDhuM dhuradhdhi, avarghaLil òruvaruM mIdhiyAyirAdhabhaDhi, avarghaLai vèDhDhibhbhoDhDhArghaL.
yojhuvA ghardhdhar dhaனghghujh jhòனனbhaDhi avarghaLughghujh jhèydhu, avarghaL ghudhiraighaLiன ghudhighAl naraMbhughaLai aRudhdhu, avarghaL iradha~NghaLai aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhèridhdhAன.
aghghAladhdhile yojhuvA dhiruMbhi, AdhjhoraibhbhiDhidhdhu, adhiன rAjAvaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhiனAl vèDhDhibhbhoDhDhAன; Adhjhor muனனe andha rAjya~NghaLughghèllAM dhalaimaiyAன bhaDhDhaNamAyirundhadhu.
adhilirundha narajIvaனghaLaiyèllAM bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl vèDhDhi, jha~NghAraMbhaNNiனArghaL; jhuvAjhamuLLadhu òனRuM mIdhiyAனdhillai; Adhjhoraiyo aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhèridhdhAன.

andha rAjAghghaLuDhaiya èllAbhbhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaiyuM avaighaLuDhaiya èllA rAjAghghaLaiyuM yojhuvA bhiDhidhdhu, bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl vèDhDhi, ghardhdharuDhaiya dhAjhaனAghiya mojhe ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhi, avarghaLaijh jha~NghAraMbhaNNiனAன.
AனAluM dha~NghaL araNibhbhoDhe irundha bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaiyèllAM isravelar jhuDhDhèridhdhubhbhoDhAmal vaidhdhArghaL; AdhjhoraimAdhdhiraM yojhuvA jhuDhDhèridhdhubhbhoDhDhAன.

andhabh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiluLLa mirughajIvaனghaLaiyuM maRRaghghòLLaibh bhòruLghaLaiyuM isravel bhudhdhirar dha~NghaLughghèனRu èDhudhdhughghòNDhArghaL; AனAluM èllA maனuSharaiyuM azhidhdhudh dhIrumaDhDhuM avarghaLaibh bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl vèDhDhibhbhoDhDhArghaL; jhuvAjhamuLLa òனRaiyuM avarghaL mIdhiyAgha vaighghavillai.

ghardhdhar dhamadhu dhAjhaனAghiya mojheghghu èbhbhaDhigh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirundhAro, abhbhaDhiye mojhe yojhuvAvughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirundhAன; abhbhaDhiye yojhuvA jhèydhAன; avaன, ghardhdhar mojheghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhadhil òனRaiyuM jhèyyAmal viDhavillai.

avaighaLiன rAjAghghaLaiyèllAM bhiDhidhdhu, avarghaLai vèDhDhigh ghòனRubhoDhDhAன.

yudhdhaMbhaNNa isravelughghu èdhirAghavaruMbhaDhighghu, avarghaLuDhaiya irudhayaM ghaDhiனmAனdhuM, ibhbhaDhiye avarghaLbheril iraghghaM uNDhAghAmal, ghardhdhar mojheghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhi, avarghaLai azhidhdhujh jha~NghAraMbhaNNiனdhuM ghardhdharAl vandha ghAriyamAyirundhadhu.

abhbhaDhiye yojhuvA, ghardhdhar mojheyiனiDhadhdhil jhòனனbhaDhiyèllAM dhejhamaனaidhdhaiyuM bhiDhidhdhu, adhai isravelarughghu, avarghaL ghodhdhira~NghaLuDhaiya bha~NghughaLiனbhaDhiye, jhudhandharamAghagh ghòDhudhdhAன; yudhdhaM oyndhadhiனAl dhejhaM amaidhalAyirundhadhu.

ghidhiyoன èbhbhirAyIM malaighaLè~NghuM ADhghaLai aனubhbhi: mIdhiyAனiyarughghu virodhamAyiRa~Nghi, bhèdhdhAbharA irughghuM yordhAனmaDhDhuM vandhu, avarghaLughghu mundhidh dhuRaighaLaigh ghaDhDhighghòLLu~NghaL èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAன; abhbhaDhiye èbhbhirAyImiன maனuShar èllAruM ghUDhi, bhèdhdhAbharA irughghuM yordhAன maDhDhuM vandhu, dhuRaighaLaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhu,
