abhbhòzhudhu èbhbhirAyIM maனuShar avaனai noghghi: nI mIdhiyAனiyarmel yudhdhaM bhaNNabhbhoghiRabhodhu; è~NghaLai azhaibhbhighghavillaiye, ibhbhaDhi nI è~NghaLughghujh jhèydhadhu èனன èனRu; avaனoDhe bhaladhdha vAghghuvAdhaM bhaNNiனArghaL.
adhaRghu avaன: nI~NghaL jhèydhadhaRghu nAன jhèydhadhu èMmAdhdhiraM? abhiyesriyariன dhirADhjhabhbhazhadhdhiன muzhu aRubhbhaibhbhArghghiluM, èbhbhirAyImariன mIdhiyAன aRubhbhu adhighaM allavA?

dhevaன u~NghaL ghaiyile mIdhiyAனiyariன adhibhadhighaLAghiya orebhaiyuM jhebhaiyuM òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAre; nI~NghaL jhèydhadhiluM nAன jhèyyaghghUDhiyadhu èMmAdhdhiraM èனRAன; indha vArdhdhaiyai avaன jhòனனbhodhu, avaனmelirundha avarghaLuDhaiya ghobhaM ARiRRu.
ghidhiyoன yordhAனughghu vandhabhodhu, avaனuM avaனoDhirundha munnURubheruM adhaigh ghaDhandhubhoy, viDhAydhdhirundhuM (jhadhdhuruvai) bhiன dhòDharndhArghaL.

avaன jhughghodhdhiன maனuSharai noghghi: èனனoDhirughghiRa jaனdhdhiRghujh jhila abhbha~NghaLaigh ghòDhu~NghaL; avarghaL viDhAydhdhirughghiRArghaL, nAன mIdhiyAனiyariன rAjAghghaLAghiya jhebhAvaiyuM jhalmuனAvaiyuM bhiனdhòDharughiReன èனRAன.
adhaRghujh jhughghodhdhiன bhirabhughghaL: uன jheனaighghu nA~NghaL abhbhaM ghòDhughghiRadhaRghujh jhebhA jhalmuனA èனbhavarghaLiன ghai uன ghaivajhamAyiRRo èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu ghidhiyoன avarghaLai noghghi: ghardhdhar jhebhAvaiyuM jhalmuனAvaiyuM èன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhughghuM bhodhu, u~NghaL mAMjhadhdhai vaனAndharadhdhiன muLLughaLAluM nèri~njhilghaLAluM ghizhidhdhuviDhuveன èனRu jhòlli,
avviDhaM viDhDhu, bhèனUvelughghubhbhoy, avvUrAriDhadhdhil andhabhbhaDhiye gheDhDhAன; jhughghodhdhiன maனuShar bhiradhiyudhdharamAghajh jhòனனbhaDhiye bhèனUveliன maனuSharuM avaனughghujh jhòனனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன, bhèனUveliன maனuSharaibh bhArdhdhu: nAன jhamAdhAனdhdhoDhe dhiruMbhivaruMbhodhu, indhagh ghobhuradhdhai iDhidhdhubhbhoDhuveன èனRAன.

jhebhAvuM jhalmuனAvuM avarghaLoDheghUDha avarghaLuDhaiya jheனaighaLuM eRaghghuRaiya bhadhiனaiyAyiraM bher gharghoril irundhArghaL; bhaDhDhayaM uruvadhdhaghgha laDhjhadhdhu irubhadhiனAyiraM bher vizhundhabhaDhiyAl, ghizhaghghadhdhiyAriன jhaghala jheனaiyiluM ivarghaL mAdhdhiraM mIndhirundhArghaL.
ghidhiyoன ghUDhAra~NghaLile ghuDhiyirughghiRavarghaL vazhiyAy nobhAghughghuM, yòghibhèyAvughghuM ghizhaghghe bhoy, andhajh jheனai bhayamillai èனRirundhabhodhu, adhai muRiya aDhidhdhAன.
jhebhAvuM jhalmuனAvuM oDhibhbhoனArghaL; avaனo avarghaLaidh dhòDharndhu, jhebhA jhalmuனA èனனuM mIdhiyAனiyariன iraNDhu rAjAghghaLaiyuM bhiDhidhdhu, jheனai muzhuvadhaiyuM ghala~NghaDhidhdhAன.
yovAjhiன ghumAraனAghiya ghidhiyoன yudhdhaMbhaNNi, jhUriyaன udhighghuM muனனe dhiruMbhivandhabhodhu,

jhughghodhdhiன maனuSharil òru vAlibhaனaibh bhiDhidhdhu, avaனiDhadhdhil vijhAridhdhAன; avaன jhughghodhdhiன bhirabhughghaLuM adhiன mUbhbharumAghiya èzhubhadhdhezhu maனuShariன bherai avaனughghu èzhudhighghòDhudhdhAன.

avaன jhughghodhdhu UrAriDhadhdhil vandhu: idho, viDhAydhdhirughghiRa uன maனuSharughghu nA~NghaL abhbhaM ghòDhughghiRadhaRghujh jhebhA jhalmuனA èனbhavarghaLiன ghai uன ghaivajhamAyiRRo èனRu nI~NghaL èனனai nindhidhdhujh jhòனன jhebhAvuM jhalmuனAvuM i~Nghe irughghiRArghaL èனRu jhòlli,
bhaDhDhaNadhdhiன mUbhbharaibh bhiDhidhdhu, vaனAndharadhdhiன muLLughaLaiyuM nèri~njhilghaLaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhu, avaighaLAl jhughghodhdhiன maனuSharughghubh bhudhdhivarabhbhaNNi,
bhèனUveliன ghobhuradhdhai iDhidhdhu, avvUr maனuSharaiyuM ghòனRu bhoDhDhAன.

bhiனbhu avaன jhebhAvaiyuM jhalmuனAvaiyuM noghghi: nI~NghaL dhAbhorile ghòனRu bhoDhDha andha maனuShar èbhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavarghaL èனRu gheDhDhAன; adhaRghu avarghaL: nIr èbhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavaro avarghaLuM abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavarghaLe; òvvòruvaனuM bhArvaighghu rAjaghumAraனaibhbholirundhAன èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: avarghaL èன jhaghodhararuM èன dhAyiன bhiLLaighaLumAyirundhArghaL; avarghaLai uyiroDhe vaidhdhirundhIrghaLAனAl, u~NghaLaigh ghòllAdhirubhbheன èனRu ghardhdhariன jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRu jhòlli,
dhaன mUdhdhaghumAraனAghiya yèdhdherai noghghi: nI èzhundhu, ivarghaLai vèDhDhibhbhoDhu èனRAன; andha vAlibhaன iLai~naனAனbhaDhiyAl bhayandhu dhaன bhaDhDhayadhdhai uruvAdhirundhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu jhebhAvuM jhalmuனAvuM; nIre èzhundhu è~NghaLmel vizhuM; maனuShaன èbhbhaDhiyo abhbhaDhiye avaன bhèlaனuM irughghuM èனRArghaL; ghidhiyoன èzhundhu, jhebhAvaiyuM jhalmuனAvaiyuM ghòனRubhoDhDhu, avarghaL òDhDhagha~NghaLiன ghazhudhdhughaLil irundha jhAndhugh ghARaighaLai èDhudhdhughghòNDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu isravel maனuShar ghidhiyoனai noghghi: nIr è~NghaLai mIdhiyAனiyar ghaighghu nI~NghalAghghiviDhDhabhaDhiyiனAl nIruM uMmuDhaiya ghumAraனuM, uMmuDhaiya ghumAraனiன ghumAraனuM, è~NghaLai ALaghghaDhavIrghaL èனRArghaL.
adhaRghugh ghidhiyoன: nAன u~NghaLai ALamADhDheன; èன ghumAraனuM u~NghaLai ALamADhDhAன; ghardhdhare u~NghaLai ALuvArAgha èனRAன.

bhiனbhu ghidhiyoன avarghaLai noghghi: u~NghaLiDhadhdhil òru ghAriyadhdhaigh gheDhghiReன; nI~NghaL avaravar ghòLLaiyiDhDha ghaDhughghaனghaLai èனனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvAru~NghaL èனRAன. avarghaL ismavelarAyirundhabhaDhiyiனAl avarghaLiDhadhdhil bhòனghaDhughghaனghaL irundhadhu.
isravelar: jhandhoShamAygh ghòDhubhbhoM èனRu jhòlli, òru vasdhiradhdhai viridhdhu, avaravar ghòLLaiyiDhDha ghaDhughghaனghaLai adhile bhoDhDhArghaL.

bhiRaijh jhindhAghghughaLuM, Ara~NghaLuM, mIdhiyAனiyariன rAjAghghaL bhordhdhughghòNDhirundha iradhdhAMbhara~NghaLuM, avarghaLuDhaiya òDhDhagha~NghaLiன ghazhudhdhughaLilirundha jharabhbhaNighaLuM allAmal, avaன gheDhDhu vA~Nghiன bhòனghaDhughghaனghaLiன niRai Ayiradhdhu èzhunURu bhòன jheghghaliன niRaiyAyirundhadhu.
adhiனAl ghidhiyoன òru èbhodhdhai uNDhAghghi, adhaidh dhaன UrAன òbhrAvile vaidhdhAன; isravelarèllAruM adhaibh bhiனbhaRRijh jhoraMbhoனArghaL; adhu ghidhiyoனughghuM avaன vIDhDhArughghuM ghaNNiyAyiRRu.

indhabhbhiraghAraM mIdhiyAனiyar dhiruMbha dhalaiyèDhughghagh ghUDhAdhabhaDhighghu, isravel bhudhdhirarughghu muனbhAghadh dhAzhdhdhabhbhaDhDhArghaL; dhejhamAனdhu ghidhiyoனiன nADhghaLil nARbhadhuvaruShaM amaidhalAyirundhadhu.
yovAjhiன ghumAraனAghiya yèrubhAghAl bhoy, dhaன vIDhDhile vAjhamAyirundhAன.
ghidhiyoனughghu aneghaM sdhirIghaL irundhArghaL; avaனuDhaiya gharbhbhabhbhiRabhbhAன ghumArar èzhubhadhubher.
jhIghemilirundha avaனuDhaiya maRumaனaiyADhDhiyuM avaனughghu òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL; avaனughghu abhimèleghghu èனRu bheriDhDhAன.
bhiனbhu yovAjhiன ghumAraனAghiya ghidhiyoன nalla virudhdhAbhbhiyadhdhile maridhdhu, òbhrAvile dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya yovAs èனனuM abhiyesriyaனuDhaiya ghallaRaiyil aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன.
ghidhiyoன maridhdhabhiன isravel bhudhdhirar dhiruMbhavuM bhAghAlghaLaibh bhiனbhaRRijh jhoraMbhoy, bhAghalbherIdhdhaidh dha~NghaLughghu dhevaனAgha vaidhdhughghòNDhArghaL.
isravel bhudhdhirar dha~NghaLaijh jhuRRilumirundha dha~NghaL èllAjh jhadhdhurughghaLiன ghaiyiனiனRuM dha~NghaLai iraDhjhidhdha dha~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharai niனaiyAmaluM,
ghidhiyoன èனனuM yèrubhAghAl isravelughghujh jhèydha jhaghala naனmaighghundhaghgha dhayavai avaன vIDhDhArughghubh bhArADhDhAmaluM bhoனArghaL.
yèrubhAghAliன ghumAraன abhimèleghghu jhIghemilirughghiRa dhaன dhAyiன jhaghodharariDhadhdhiRghubh bhoy, avarghaLaiyuM dhaன dhAyiன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya vaMjhamAன aனaivaraiyuM noghghi:

yèrubhAghAliன ghumArar èzhubhadhubherAghiya èllAruM u~NghaLai ALuvadhu u~NghaLughghu nalladho, òruvaன mAdhdhiraM u~NghaLai ALuvadhu u~NghaLughghu nalladho èனRu nI~NghaL jhIghemilirughghiRa jhaghala bhèriya maனuShariன ghAdhughaLuM gheDhghabhbhejhu~NghaL; nAன u~NghaL èluMbhuM u~NghaL mAMjhamumAனvaன èனRu niனaidhdhughghòLLu~NghaL èனRAன.

abhbhaDhiye avaன dhAyiன jhaghodharar jhIghemilirughghiRa jhaghala bhèriya maனuShariன ghAdhughaLuM gheDhgha indha vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM avaனughghAghabh bhejhiனArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu: avaன naMmuDhaiya jhaghodharaன èனRu avarghaL jhòனனdhiனAl, avarghaL irudhayaM abhimèleghghaibh bhiனbhaRRajh jhAyndhadhu.

avarghaL bhAghAl bherIdhdhiன ghovililirundhu èzhubhadhu vèLLighghAjhai èDhudhdhu avaனughghugh ghòDhudhdhArghaL; avaighaLAl abhimèleghghu vINaruM bhoghghirighaLumAன maனuSharaijh jhevaghadhdhil vaidhdhAன; avarghaL avaனaibh bhiனbhaRRiனArghaL.

avaன òbhrAvilirughghiRa dhaன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhiRghubh bhoy, yèrubhAghAliன ghumArarAghiya dhaன jhaghodharar èzhubhadhu bheraiyuM òre ghalliன mel ghòlaijhèydhAன; AனAluM yèrubhAghAliன iLaiya ghumAraனAghiya yodhAM òLidhdhirundhabhaDhiyiனAl avaன dhabhbhiனAன.

bhiனbhu jhIghemilirughghiRa jhaghala bhèriya maனuSharuM, milloviன ghuDhuMbhadhdhAraனaivaruM ghUDhighghòNDhubhoy, jhIghemilirughghiRa uyarndha gharvAlimaradhdhaNDhaiyile abhimèleghghai rAjAvAghghiனArghaL.

idhu yodhAmughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhabhodhu, avaன bhoy, ghèrijhIM malaiyiன ujhjhiyil eRiniனRu, uradhdhajhadhdhamiDhDhugh ghUbhbhiDhDhu, avarghaLai noghghi: jhIghemiன bhèriya maனuShare, dhevaன u~NghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhughghuMbhaDhi nI~NghaL èனghghujh jhèvighòDhu~NghaL.
viruDhjha~NghaL dha~NghaLughghu òru rAjAvai abhiSheghaMbhaNNuMbhaDhi bhoy, òlivamaradhdhaibh bhArdhdhu: nI è~NghaLughghu rAjAvAyiru èனRadhu.
adhaRghu òlivamaraM: dhevarghaLuM maனuSharuM bhughazhughiRa èனனiluLLa èனghòzhumaiyai nAன viDhDhu, mara~NghaLai arajhALabhbhoveனo èனRadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu mara~NghaL adhdhimaradhdhaibh bhArdhdhu: nI vandhu, è~NghaLughghu rAjAvAyiru èனRadhu.
adhaRghu adhdhimaraM: nAன èன madhuradhdhaiyuM èன naRghaனiyaiyuM viDhDhu, mara~NghaLai arajhALabhbhoveனo èனRadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu mara~NghaL dhirADhjhajh jhèDhiyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI vandhu, è~NghaLughghu rAjAvAyiru èனRadhu.
adhaRghudh dhirADhjhajhjhèDhi: dhevarghaLaiyuM maனuSharaiyuM maghizhabhbhaNNuM èன rajhadhdhai nAன viDhDhu mara~NghaLai arajhALabhbhoveனo èனRadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu mara~NghaLèllAM muDhjhèDhiyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI vandhu, è~NghaLughghu rAjAvAyiru èனRadhu.

adhaRghu muDhjhèDhiyAனdhu mara~NghaLaibh bhArdhdhu: nI~NghaL èனனai u~NghaLughghu rAjAvAgha abhiSheghaMbhaNNughiRadhu mèyyAனAl, èன nizhalile vandhaDhaiyu~NghaL; illAviDhDhAl muDhjhèDhiyilirundhu aghghiனi bhuRabhbhaDhDhu lIbhaனoனiன ghedhuru mara~NghaLaibh bhaDhjhighghaghghaDhavadhu èனRadhu.
èன dhaghabhbhaன u~NghaLughghAgha yudhdhaM bhaNNi, dhaன jIvaனai èNNAmaRbhoy, u~NghaLai mIdhiyAனiyariன ghaiyiனiனRu iraDhjhidhdhAr.

nI~NghaLo iனRu èன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghu virodhamAy èzhuMbhi, avaruDhaiya ghumArarAன èzhubhadhu bheraiyuM òre ghalliனmel ghòlaijhèydhu, avaruDhaiya velaighghAriyiன maghaனAghiya abhimèleghghu u~NghaL jhaghodharaனAனbhaDhiyiனAl, avaனaijh jhIgheM bhaDhDhaNadhdhArughghu rAjAvAghghiனIrghaL.
ibhbhodhuM nI~NghaL avaனai rAjAvAghghiன jhèyghai uNmaiyuM udhdhamamumAன jhèyghaiyAyirughghumAனAl,

nI~NghaL yèrubhAghAlaiyuM avar ghuDhuMbhadhdhAraiyuM naனmaiyAgha naDhadhdhi, avar ghaighaLiன jhèyghaighghudhdhaghghadhai avarghaLughghujh jhèydhu, ibhbhaDhi innALil avaraiyuM avar ghuDhuMbhadhdhAraiyuM naDhadhdhiனdhu uNmaiyuM udhdhamumAyirughghumAனAl, abhimèleghghiனmel nI~NghaLuM jhandhoShamAyiru~NghaL; u~NghaLmel avaனuM jhandhoShamAyirughghaDhDhuM.

illAviDhDhAl abhimèleghghilirundhu aghghiனi bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, jhIgheM bhaDhDhaNadhdhAraiyuM, milloviன ghuDhuMbhadhdhAraiyuM bhaDhjhighghavuM, jhIgheM bhaDhDhaNadhdhAriluM milloviன ghuDhuMbhadhdhArilumirundhu aghghiனi bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, abhimèleghghaibh bhaDhjhighghavuM ghaDhavadhu èனRu yodhAM jhòlli,
dhaன jhaghodharAனAghiya abhimèleghghughghubh bhayandhu, dhabhbhiyoDhi, bheyerughghubh bhoy, a~Nghe ghuDhiyirundhAன.
abhimèleghghu isravelai mUனRu varuShaM arajhANDhabhiனbhu,
abhimèleghghughghuM jhIghemiன bhèriya maனuSharughghuM naDhuve bhòllAbhbhu uNDhAghghuM Aviyai dhevaன varabhbhaNNiனAr.

yèrubhAghAliன èzhubhadhu ghumArarughghujh jhèyyabhbhaDhDha ghòDhumai vandhu bhalidhdhu, avarghaLuDhaiya iradhdhabhbhazhi avarghaLaigh ghòனRa avarghaLuDhaiya jhaghodharaனAghiya abhimèleghghiனmeluM, dhaன jhaghodhararaigh ghòlla avaன ghaighaLaidh dhiDhabhbhaDhudhdhiன jhIgheM maனuShar meluM jhumaruMbhaDhiyAghajh jhIghemiன bhèriya maனuShar abhimèleghghughghu iraNDhaghaM bhaNNiனArghaL.

jhIghemiன maனuShar malaighaLiன ujhjhiyil avaனughghubh bhadhivirughghiRavarghaLai vaidhdhArghaL; avarghaL dha~NghaL arughe vazhi naDhandhu bhoghiRa yAvaraiyuM ghòLLaiyiDhDhArghaL; adhu abhimèleghghughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.
ebhedhiன ghumAraனAghiya ghAghAl dhaன jhaghodhararoDhe jhIghemughghuL bhoனAன; jhIghemiன bhèriya maனuShar avaனai naMbhi,

vèLiye bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, dha~NghaL dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDha~NghaLiன bhazha~NghaLai aRudhdhu, AlaiyADhDhi, ADhibhbhADhi, dha~NghaL dhevaனiன vIDhDhiRghuL bhoy, bhujhidhdhughghuDhidhdhu, abhimèleghghai jhabhidhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu ebhedhiன ghumAraனAghiya ghAghAl: abhimèleghghu yAr? jhIgheM yAr? nAM avaனaijh jhevighghaveNDhiyadhèனன? avaன yèrubhAghAliன maghaன allavA? jhebhUl avaனuDhaiya ghAriyaghghAraன allavA? jhIghemiன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya emoriன maனuSharaiye jheviyu~NghaL; avaனai nA~NghaL jhevibhbhAனeன?

indha jaன~NghaL mAdhdhiraM èன ghaighghuL irughghaDhDhuM; nAன abhimèleghghaidh dhuradhdhiviDhuveன èனRAன. uன jheனaiyaibh bhèrughabhbhaNNibh bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvA èனRu, avaன abhimèleghghughghujh jhòlliyaனubhbhiனAன.
bhaDhDhaNadhdhiன adhighAriyAghiya jhebhUl ebhedhiன ghumAraனAghiya ghAghAliன vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhabhodhu, ghobhamUNDhu,

iraghajhiyamAy abhimèleghghiனiDhadhdhughghu ADhghaLai aனubhbhi: idho, ebhedhiன ghumAraனAghiya ghAghAluM avaனuDhaiya jhaghodhararuM jhIghemughghu vandhirughghiRArghaL; bhaDhDhaNadhdhai umaghghu virodhamAgha èzhubhbhughiRArghaL.
AghaiyAl nIr uMmoDhirughghuM jaன~NghaLoDheghUDha iravil èzhundhu vandhu vèLiyile bhadhivirundhu,

ghAlame jhUriyaன udhighghaiyil èzhuMbhi, bhaDhDhaNadhdhiன mel vizhundhu, avaனuM avaனoDhirughghiRa jaன~NghaLuM umaghghu èdhire bhuRabhbhaDhuMbhodhu, uMmuDhaiya ghaighghu neriDhughiRabhaDhi avaனughghujh jhèyyuM èனRu jhòlliyaனubhbhiனAன.
abhbhaDhiye abhimèleghghuM, avaனoDhirundha jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM, iravil èzhundhubhoy, jhIghemughghu virodhamAgha nAlu bhaDhaiyAghabh bhadhivirundhArghaL.
ebhedhiன ghumAraன ghAghAl bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, bhaDhDhaNadhdhiன òlimughavAjhalil niனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu bhadhivirundha abhimèleghghu dhaனனoDhirughghiRa jaன~NghaLoDheghUDha èzhuMbhivandhAன.

ghAghAl andha jaன~NghaLaigh ghaNDhu: idho, malaighaLiன ujhjhighaLilirundhu jaன~NghaL iRa~NghivarughiRArghaL èனRu jhebhUloDhe jhòனனAன. adhaRghujh jhebhUl: nI malaighaLiன nizhalaigh ghaNDhu, maனuShar èனRu niனaighghiRAy èனRAன.
ghAghAlo dhiruMbhavuM: idho, jaன~NghaL dhejhadhdhiன meDhDhilirundhu iRa~Nghivandhu, òru bhaDhai mèyòனèனImiன gharvAlimaradhdhiன vazhiyAy varughiRadhu èனRAன.

adhaRghujh jhebhUl: abhimèleghghai nAM jhevighghiRadhaRghu avaன yAr èனRu nI jhòனன uன vAy ibhbhòzhudhu è~Nghe? nI nindhidhdhajaன~NghaL avarghaL allavA? ibhbhòzhudhu nI bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, avarghaLoDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNu èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghAghAl jhIghemiன maனuSharughghu muனbhAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, abhimèleghghoDhe yudhdhaM bhaNNiனAன.
abhimèleghghu avaனaidh dhuradhdha, avaன avaனughghu muனbhAgha oDhiனAன; bhaDhDhaNavAjhalmaDhDhuM aneghar vèDhDhuNDhu vizhundhArghaL.
abhimèleghghu arumAvil irundhuviDhDhAன; jhebhUl ghAghAlaiyuM avaன jhaghodhararaiyuM jhIghemile ghuDhiyirAdhabhaDhighghudh dhuradhdhiviDhDhAன.
maRunALile jaன~NghaL vèLiyile vayalughghubh bhoனArghaL; adhu abhimèleghghughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhabhodhu,

avaன jaன~NghaLaigh ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, avarghaLai mUனRu bhaDhaiyAgha vaghudhdhu, vèLiyile bhadhivirundhu, andha jaன~NghaL bhaDhDhaNadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu varughiRadhaigh ghaNDhu, avarghaLmel èzhuMbhi, avarghaLai vèDhDhiனAன.
abhimèleghghuM avaனoDhirundha bhaDhaiyuM bhAyndhuvandhu, bhaDhDhaNadhdhiன òlimughavAjhalil niனRArghaL; maRRa iraNDhu bhaDhaighaLo vèLiyilirughghiRa yAvarmeluM vizhundhu, avarghaLai vèDhDhiனArghaL.
abhimèleghghu annAL muzhuvadhuM bhaDhDhaNadhdhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNi, bhaDhDhaNadhdhaibh bhiDhidhdhu, adhilirundha jaன~NghaLaigh ghòனRu, bhaDhDhaNadhdhai iDhidhdhu viDhDhu, adhil ubhbhu vidhaidhdhAன.
adhaijh jhIgheM dhurughghadhdhu maனuShar èllAruM gheLvibhbhaDhDhabhodhu, avarghaL bherIdh dhevaனuDhaiya ghovil araNughghuL bhiravejhidhdhArghaL.
jhIgheM dhurughghadhdhu maனuShar èllAruM a~Nghe ghUDhiyirughghiRadhu abhimèleghghughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhabhodhu,

abhimèleghghu dhaனனoDhirundha èllA jaன~NghaLoDhu~NghUDhajh jhalmoன malaiyil eRi, dhaன ghaiyile ghoDhariyaibh bhiDhidhdhu, òru maradhdhiன ghòMbhai vèDhDhi, adhai èDhudhdhu, dhaன dhoLiன mel bhoDhDhughghòNDhu, dhaனனoDhirundha jaன~NghaLai noghghi: nAன èனன jhèyghiReன èனRu bhArghghiRIrghaLe, nI~NghaLuM dhIviramAy èனனaibhbholajh jhèyyu~NghaL èனRAன.

abhbhaDhiye jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM avaravar òvvòru ghòMbhai vèDhDhi, abhimèleghghughghubh bhiனjhèனRu avaighaLai andha araNughghu arughe bhoDhDhu, aghghiனi ghòLudhdhi andha araNaijh jhuDhDhubhbhoDhDhArghaL; adhiனAl bhuruSharuM sdhirIghaLuM eRaghghuRaiya AyiraMbherAghiya jhIgheM dhurughghadhdhu maனuShar èllAruM jhèdhdhArghaL.
bhiனbhu abhimèleghghu dhebhejhughghubhbhoy, adhaRghu virodhamAybh bhALayamiRa~Nghi, adhaibh bhiDhidhdhAன.

andhabh bhaDhDhaNadhdhiன naDhuve bhaladhdhadhurughghaM irundhadhu; a~Nghe jhaghala bhuruSharuM sdhirIghaLuM bhaDhDhaNadhdhu maனuShar aனaivaruM oDhibh bhughundhu, ghadhavaibh bhUDhDhighghòNDhu, dhurughghadhdhiனmel eRiனArghaL.
abhimèleghghu andhadh dhurughghaMmaDhDhuM vandhu, adhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNi, dhurughghadhdhiன ghadhavaijh jhuDhDhèridhdhubh bhoDhuMbhaDhighghu, adhiன ghiDhDhajh jherndhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu òru sdhirI òru endhiraghghalliன dhuNDhai abhimèlèghghuDhaiya dhalaiyiனmel bhoDhDhAL; adhu avaன maNDhaiyai uDhaidhdhadhu;

uDhaனe avaன dhaன AyudhadhAriyAghiya velaighghAraனaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu: òru sdhirI èனனaigh ghòனRAL èனRu èனனaigh ghuRidhdhujh jhòllAdhabhaDhighghu, nI uன bhaDhDhayadhdhai uruvi, èனனaigh ghòனRu bhoDhu èனRu avaனoDhe jhòனனAன; abhbhaDhiye avaன velaighghAraன avaனai uruvagh ghudhdhiனAன, avaன jhèdhdhubhbhoனAன.
abhimèleghghujh jhèdhdhubhbhoனdhai isravel maனuShar ghaNDhabhodhu, avarghaL dha~NghaL dha~NghaL iDha~NghaLughghubh bhoy viDhDhArghaL.
ibhbhaDhiye abhimèleghghu dhaனனuDhaiya èzhubhadhu jhaghodhararaigh ghòlaijhèydhadhiனAl, dhaன dhaghabhbhaனughghujh jhèydha bhòllAbhbhai dhevaன avaனmel dhiruMbhuMbhaDhi jhèydhAr.
jhIgheM maனuShar jhèydha èllAbh bhòllAbhbhaiyuM dhevaன avarghaL dhalaiyiனmel dhiruMbhuMbhaDhi jhèydhAr; yèrubhAghAliன ghumAraன yodhAmiன jhAbhaM avarghaLughghubh bhalidhdhadhu.

abhimèleghghughghubhbhiனbhu, dhodhoviன maghaனAghiya bhUvAviன ghumAraன dholA èனனuM ijhaghghAr ghodhdhiradhdhAன isravelai iraDhjhighgha èzhuMbhiனAன; avaன èbhbhirAyIM malaidhdhejhadhdhu UrAghiya jhAmIrile ghuDhiyirundhAன.
avaன isravelai irubhadhdhumUனRu varuShaM niyAyaM vijhAridhdhu, bhiனbhu maridhdhu, jhAmIrile aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன.
avaனughghubhbhiனbhu, ghIleyAdhdhiyaனAன yAvIr èzhuMbhi, isravelai irubhadhdhiraNDhu varuShaM niyAyaM vijhAridhdhAன.

mubhbhadhu ghazhudhaighghuDhDhighaLiனmel eRuM mubhbhadhu ghumArar avaனughghu irundhArghaL; avarghaLughghu mubhbhadhu UrghaLuM irundhadhu; ghIleyAdh dhejhadhdhilirughghiRa avaighaLughghu innALvaraighghuM yAvIriன ghirAma~NghaLèனghiRa bher irughghiRadhu.
yAvIr maridhdhu, ghAmoனile aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன.

isravel bhudhdhirar, maRubhaDhiyuM ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghubh bhòllAbhbhujh jhèydhu, ghardhdharaijh jheviyAmal avarai viDhDhubh bhoy, bhAghAlghaLaiyuM, asdharodhdhaiyuM, jhIriyAviன dhevarghaLaiyuM, jhIdhoனiன dhevarghaLaiyuM, movAbhiன dhevarghaLaiyuM, aMmoன bhudhdhirariன dhevarghaLaiyuM, bhèlisdhariன dhevarghaLaiyuM jhevidhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar israveliன mel ghobhamUNDhu, avarghaLaibh bhèlisdhar ghaiyiluM, aMmoன bhudhdhirar ghaiyiluM viRRubhbhoDhDhAr.
avarghaL andha varuShaM mudhaRghòNDhu bhadhiனèDhDhu varuShamAy yordhAனughghu abhbhAle ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa èmoriyariன dhejhadhdhil irughghiRa isravel bhudhdhiraraiyèllAM nèrughghi òDhughghiனArghaL.
aMmoன bhudhdhirar yUdhAviனmeluM, bhèனyamIனmeluM, èbhbhirAyIM ghuDhuMbhadhdhArmeluM yudhdhaM bhaNNa yordhAனaigh ghaDhandhuvandhArghaL; isravelar mighavuM nèrughghabhbhaDhDhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu isravel bhudhdhirar ghardhdharai noghghi muRaiyiDhDhu: umaghghu virodhamAghabh bhAva~njhèydhoM; nA~NghaL è~NghaL dhevaனaiviDhDhu, bhAghAlghaLaijh jhevidhdhoM èனRArghaL.
ghardhdhar isravel bhudhdhirarai noghghi: èghibhdhiyaruM, èmoriyaruM, aMmoன bhudhdhiraruM, bhèlisdhiyaruM,
jhIdhoனiyaruM, amaleghghiyaruM, mAghoனiyaruM, u~NghaLai òDhughghuM jhamaya~NghaLil, nI~NghaL èனனai noghghi muRaiyiDhDhabhodhu, nAன u~NghaLai avarghaL ghaighghu nI~NghalAghghi iraDhjhighghavillaiyA?
abhbhaDhiyirundhuM nI~NghaL èனனai viDhDhu, anniya dhevarghaLaijh jhevidhdhIrghaL; AghaiyAl iனi u~NghaLai iraDhjhiyeன.
nI~NghaL bhoy, u~NghaLughghAghadh dhèrindhughòNDha dhevarghaLai noghghi muRaiyiDhu~NghaL; avaighaL u~NghaL Abhadhdhiன ghAladhdhil u~NghaLai iraDhjhighghaDhDhuM èனRAr.
isravel bhudhdhirar ghardhdharai noghghi: bhAva~njhèydhoM, dhevarIr uMmuDhaiya bhArvaighghu nalamAனdhai è~NghaLughghujh jhèyyuM; iனRaighghumAdhdhiraM è~NghaLai iraDhjhidhdharuLuM èனRu jhòlli,
anniya dhevarghaLaidh dha~NghaL naDhuvilirundhu vilaghghiviDhDhu, ghardhdharughghu ArAdhaனai jhèydhArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu avar israveliன varudhdhadhdhaibh bhArdhdhu maனdhurughiனAr.
aMmoன bhudhdhirar ghUDhDha~NghUDhi, ghIleyAdhdhile bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL; isravel bhudhdhiraruM ghUDhighghòNDhu, misbhAvile bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu ghIleyAdhdhiன jaன~NghaLuM bhirabhughghaLuM òruvaraiyòruvar noghghi: aMmoன bhudhdhirarmel mundhi yudhdhaMbhaNNabhbhoghiRa maனuShaன yAr? avaனe ghIleyAdhdhiன ghuDhighaLughghèllAM dhalaivaனAyirubhbhAன èனRArghaL.
ghIleyAdhdhiyaனAன yèbhdhA bhaladhdha bharAghghiramajhAliyAyirundhAன; avaன bharasdhirIyiன ghumAraன; ghilèyAdh avaனaibh bhèRRAன.

ghilèyAdhdhiன maனaiviyuM avaனughghugh ghumArarghaLaibh bhèRRAL; avaன maனaivi bhèRRa ghumArar bhèriyavarghaLAன bhiனbhu, avarghaL yèbhdhAvai noghghi: uனghghu è~NghaL dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhile jhudhandharaM illai; nI anniya sdhirIyiன maghaன èனRu jhòlli avaனaidh dhuradhdhiனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu yèbhdhA: dhaன jhaghodhararai viDhDhu oDhibhbhoy, dhobhdhejhadhdhile ghuDhiyirundhAன; vINarAன maனuShar yèbhdhAvoDhe ghUDhighghòNDhu, avaனoDheghUDha yudhdhadhdhiRghubh bhovArghaL.
jhila nALaighghubhbhiனbhu, aMmòன bhudhdhirar israveliன mel yudhdhaM bhaNNiனArghaL.
avarghaL israveliனmel yudhdhaM bhaNNuMbhodhu ghIleyAdhdhiன mUbhbhar yèbhdhAvaidh dhobhdhejhadhdhilirundhu azhaidhdhuvarabhbhoy,
yèbhdhAvai noghghi: nI vandhu, nA~NghaL aMmoன bhudhdhiraroDhu yudhdhaM bhaNNa è~NghaL jheனAbhadhiyAyirughgha veNDhuM èனRArghaL.

adhaRghu yèbhdhA ghIleyAdhdhi mUbhbharaibh bhArdhdhu: nI~NghaL allavA èனனaibh bhaghaidhdhu, èன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhilirundhu èனனaidh dhuradhdhiனvarghaL? ibhbhòzhudhu u~NghaLughghu Abhadhdhu neriDhDhirughghiRa jhamayadhdhil nI~NghaL èனனiDhadhdhil eன varughiRIrghaL èனRAன.

adhaRghugh ghIleyAdhdhiன mUbhbhar yèbhdhAvai noghghi: nI è~NghaLuDhaனeghUDha vandhu, aMmoன bhudhdhiraroDhu yudhdhaMbhaNNi, ghIleyAdhdhiன ghuDhighaLAghiya è~NghaL aனaivarmeluM dhalaivaனAyirughgha veNDhuM; idhaRghAgha ibhbhòzhudhu uனனiDhadhdhil vandhoM èனRArghaL.

adhaRghu yèbhdhA: aMmoன bhudhdhiraroDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNa, nI~NghaL èனனaidh dhiruMbha azhaidhdhubhbhoனbhiனbhu, ghardhdhar avarghaLai èன muனனilaiyAy òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAl, èனனai u~NghaLughghudh dhalaivaனAy vaibhbhIrghaLA èனRu ghIleyAdhdhiன mUbhbharaigh gheDhDhAன.
ghIleyAdhdhiன mUbhbhar yèbhdhAvaibh bhArdhdhu: nA~NghaL uன vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye jhèyyAviDhDhAl, ghardhdhar namaghghu naDhuniனRu gheDhbhArAgha èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu yèbhdhA ghIleyAdhdhiன mUbhbharoDhe ghUDhabhbhoனAன; jaன~NghaL avaனaidh dha~NghaLmel dhalaivaனuM jheனAbhadhiyumAgha vaidhdhArghaL. yèbhdhA dhaன ghAriya~NghaLaiyèllAM misbhAvile ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyile jhòனனAன.

bhiனbhu yèbhdhA aMmoன bhudhdhirariன rAjAviனiDhadhdhiRghu sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhi: nI èன dhejhadhdhil èனghghu virodhamAgha yudhdhaMbhaNNa varughiRadhaRghu, èனghghuM uனghghuM èனன vazhaghghu irughghiRadhu èனRu gheDhghajhjhòனனAன.

aMmoன bhudhdhirariன rAjA yèbhdhAviன sdhAனAbhadhighaLai noghghi: isravelar èghibhdhilirundhu varughiRabhodhu, arனoன dhuvaghghi yAbhoghmaDhDhuM, yordhAனmaDhDhuM irughghiRa èன dhejhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhArghaLe; ibhbhòzhudhu adhai èனghghujh jhamAdhAனmAydh dhiruMbhaghghòDhudhdhuviDha veNDhuM èனRu jhòllu~NghaL èனRAன.
yèbhdhA maRubhaDhiyuM aMmoன bhudhdhirariன rAjAviனiDhadhdhiRghu sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhi, avaனughghujh jhòllajh jhòனனdhAvadhu:
yèbhdhA jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: isravelar movAbhiyariன dhejhadhdhaiyAghiluM, aMmoன bhudhdhirariன dhejhadhdhaiyAghiluM ghaDhDhighghòNDhadhillaiye.
isravelar èghibhdhilirundhu varughiRabhodhu, vaனAndharadhdhil jhivandha jhamudhdhira maDhDhuM naDhandhu, bhiனbhu ghAdhejhughghu vandhu,

isravelar edhomiன rAjAviனiDhadhdhiRghu sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhi: nA~NghaL uன dhejhadhdhuvazhiyAygh ghaDhandhu bhoghaDhDhuM èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனArghaL; adhaRghu edhomiன rAjA jhèvighòDhughghavillai; abhbhaDhiye movAbhiன rAjAviDhadhdhiRghuM aனubhbhiனArghaL; avaனuM jhaMmadhighghavillai. AdhalAl isravelar ghAdhejhile dharidhdhirundhu,

bhiனbhu vaனAndharavazhiyAy naDhandhu edhoM dhejhadhdhaiyuM movAbh dhejhadhdhaiyuM jhuRRibhbhoy, movAbhiன dhejhadhdhiRghugh ghizhaghghe vandhu, movAbhiன èllaighghuL bhiravejhiyAmal, movAbhiன èllaiyAன arனoன nadhighghu abhbhAle bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu isravelar èsbhoனil ALughiRa jhIghoன èனனuM èmoriyariன rAjAviனiDhadhdhiRghu sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhi: nA~NghaL uன dhejhadhdhu vazhiyAy è~NghaL sdhAனdhdhiRghugh ghaDhandhubhogha iDha~NghòDhu èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனArghaL.
jhIghoன isravelarai naMbhAdhadhiனAl, dhaன èllaiyaigh ghaDhandhubhoghiRadhaRghu iDha~NghòDhAmal dhaன jaன~NghaLaiyèllAM ghUDhDhi, yAghAjhile bhALayamiRa~Nghi, isravelaroDhe yudhdhaM bhaNNiனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar jhIghoனaiyuM avaனuDhaiya èllA jaன~NghaLaiyuM isravelariன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr; avarghaLai muRiya aDhidhdhArghaL; abhbhaDhiye isravelar andha dhejhadhdhile ghuDhiyirundha èmoriyariன jhImaiyaiyèllAM bhiDhidhdhu, arனoன dhuvaghghi,
yAbhoghmaDhDhuM vaனAndharaM dhuvaghghi yordhAனmaDhDhuM irughghiRa èmoriyariன èllaiyaiyèllAM jhudhandharamAygh ghaDhDhighghòNDhArghaL.
ibhbhaDhi israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èmoriyaraidh dhaMmuDhaiya jaனmAghiya isravelughghu muனbhAghadh dhuradhdhiyirughgha, nIr andha dhejhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhighghòLLadhdhaghumA?

uMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghAmos umaghghu muனbhAghadh dhuradhdhughiRavarghaLiன dhejhadhdhai nIr ghaDhDhighghòLLamADhDhIro? abhbhaDhiye è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar è~NghaLughghu muனbhAghadh dhuradhdhughiRavarghaLiன dhejhadhdhaiyèllAM nA~NghaLuM ghaDhDhighghòLLughiRoM.

meluM jhibhbhoriன ghumAraனAghiya bhAlAgh èனனuM movAbhiன rAjAvaibh bhArghghiluM umaghghu adhigha niyAyaM uNDho? avaன israveloDhe èbhbhodhAghiluM vazhaghghADhiனAனA? èbhbhodhAghiluM avarghaLughghu virodhamAgha yudhdhaM bhaNNiனAனA?

isravelar èsbhoனiluM adhiன ghirAma~NghaLiluM, AroveriluM adhiன ghirAma~NghaLiluM, arனoன nadhiyarughAன èllA UrghaLiluM, munnURu varuShaM ghuDhiyirughghaiyil, ivvaLavughAlamAy nI~NghaL adhaidh dhirubhbhighghòLLAdhe bhoனdhèனன?

nAன umaghghu virodhamAygh ghuRRaM jhèyyavillai; nIr èனghghu virodhamAy yudhdhaM bhaNNughiRadhiனAl nIr dhAன èனghghu aniyAyaM jhèyghiRIr; niyAyAdhibhadhiyAghiya ghardhdhar iனRu isravel bhudhdhirarughghuM aMmoன bhudhdhirarughghuM naDhuniனRu niyAyaM dhIrghghaghghaDhavar èனRu jhòlli aனubhbhiனAன.
AனAluM aMmoன bhudhdhirariன rAjA dhaனghghu yèbhdhA jhòlliyaனubhbhiன vArdhdhaighaLughghujh jhèvighòDhAdhe bhoனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya Avi yèbhdhAviன mel iRa~NghiனAr; avaன ghIleyAdhdhaiyuM maனAjhe nADhDhaiyuM ghaDhandhubhoy, ghIleyAdhdhilirughghiRa misbhAvughghu vandhu, a~Ngheyirundhu aMmoன bhudhdhirarughghu virodhamAghabh bhoனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu yèbhdhA ghardhdharughghu òru bhòrudhdhaனaiyaibh bhaNNi: dhevarIr aMmoன bhudhdhirarai èன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhughghave òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAl,

nAன aMmoன bhudhdhirariDhadhdhilirundhu jhamAdhAனdhdhoDhe dhiruMbhi varuMbhodhu, èன vIDhDhu vAjhaRbhaDhiyilirundhu èனghghu èdhirghòNDhu varuvadhu èdhuvo adhu ghardhdharughghu uriyadhAghuM. adhaijh jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhaliyAghajh jhèludhdhuveன èனRAன.
yèbhdhA aMmoன bhudhdhirariனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNa, avarghaLughghu virodhamAybh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAன; ghardhdhar avarghaLai avaன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr.

avaன avarghaLai Arover dhuvaghghi miனனidhdhiRghubh bhoghumaDhDhuM, dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhu nila~NghaL varaighghuM, maghA jha~NghAramAy muRiya aDhidhdhu, irubhadhu bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaibh bhiDhidhdhAன; ibhbhaDhi aMmoன bhudhdhirar isravel bhudhdhirarughghu muனbhAghadh dhAzhdhdhabhbhaDhDhArghaL.

yèbhdhA misbhAvilirughghiRa dhaன vIDhDhughghu varughiRabhodhu, idho, avaன ghumAradhdhi dhaMbhuru vAjhidhdhu naDhaன~njhèydhu, avaனughghu èdhirghòNDhu vandhAL; avaL avaனughghu òre bhiLLaiyAனvaL; avaLaiyallAmal avaனughghugh ghumAraனuM illai ghumAradhdhiyuM illai.

avaன avaLaigh ghaNDhavuDhaனe dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòNDhu: aiyo! èன maghaLe, èனனai mighavuM maனmaDhiyavuM ghala~NghavuM bhaNNughiRAy; nAன ghardhdharai noghghi èன vAyaidh dhiRandhu jhòlliviDhDheன; adhai nAன mARRagh ghUDhAdhu èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaL: èன dhaghabhbhaனe, nIr ghardhdharai noghghi uMmuDhaiya vAyaidh dhiRandhu bhejhiனIrallavo? aMmoன bhudhdhirarAghiya, uMmuDhaiya jhadhdhurughghaLughghu nIdhiyaijh jharighghaDhDhuM jèyadhdhaigh ghardhdhar umaghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiyiனAl, uMmuDhaiya vAyilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhabhaDhiye èனghghujh jhèyyuM èனRAL.

bhiனனuM avaன dhaன dhaghabhbhaனai noghghi: nIr èனghghu òru ghAriyaM jhèyya veNDhuM; nAன malaighaLiனmel bhoydhdhirindhu, nAனuM èன dhozhimArghaLuM èன ghaனனimaiyiனimidhdhaM dhughgha~NghòNDhADha, èனghghu iraNDhumAdhaM dhavaNaighòDhuM èனRAL.
adhaRghu avaன: bhoy vA èனRu avaLai iraNDhu mAdhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiviDhDhAன; avaL dhaன dhozhimArghaLoDhuM ghUDhabhbhoy, dhaன ghaனனimaiyiனimidhdhaM malaighaLiன mel dhughgha~NghòNDhADhi,

iraNDhumAdhaM muDhindhabhiனbhu, dhaன dhaghabhbhaனiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhivandhAL; abhbhòzhudhu avaன bhaNNiyirundha dhaன bhòrudhdhaனaiyiன bhaDhi avaLughghujh jhèydhAன; avaL bhuruShaனai aRiyAdhirundhAL.
idhiனimidhdhaM israveliன ghumAradhdhighaL varuShandhoRuM bhoy, nAlu nAL ghIleyAdhdhiyaனAன yèbhdhAviன ghumAradhdhiyaighghuRidhdhubh bhulaMbhuvadhu isravelile vazhaghghamAyiRRu.

èbhbhirAyIM maனuShar eghamAygh ghUDhi vaDhaghghe bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, yèbhdhAvai noghghi: nI è~NghaLai uனனoDheghUDha varuMbhaDhi azhaibhbhiyAmal aMmoன bhudhdhirarmel yudhdhaMbhaNNabhbhoனdhèனன? uன vIDhDhaiyuM uனனaiyuMghUDha aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhubhbhoDhuvoM èனRArghaL.

adhaRghu yèbhdhA: èனghghuM èன jaனdhdhiRghuM aMmoன bhudhdhiraroDhe bhèriya vazhaghghu irughghuMbhodhu, nAன u~NghaLaigh ghUbhbhiDhDheன; nI~NghaL èனனai avarghaL ghaighghu nI~NghalAghghi raDhjhighghavillai.

nI~NghaL èனனai raDhjhighghavillai èனRu nAன ghaNDhabhodhu, nAன èன jIvaனai èன ghaiyile bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu, aMmoன bhudhdhirarughghu virodhamAybh bhoனeன; ghardhdhar avarghaLai èன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr; ibhbhaDhiyirughgha, nI~NghaL èன mel yudhdhaMbhaNNa, iனRu èனனiDhadhdhiRghu varaveNDhiyadhu èனன èனRu jhòனனAன.

bhiனbhu yèbhdhA ghIleyAdh maனuSharaiyèllAM ghUDhDhi, èbhbhirAyImaroDhu yudhdhaM bhaNNiனAன; èbhbhirAyImughghuM maனAjheghghuM naDhuve ghuDhiyirughghiRa ghIleyAdhdhiyarAன nI~NghaL èbhbhirAyImaiviDhDhu oDhibhbhoனvarghaL èனRu èbhbhirAyImar jhòனனbhaDhiyiனAl, ghIleyAdh maனuShar avarghaLai muRiya aDhidhdhArghaL.

ghIleyAdhdhiyar èbhbhirAyImarughghu mundhi yordhAனiன dhuRaighaLaibh bhiDhidhdhArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu èbhbhirAyImarile dhabhbhiனvarghaLil yArAvadhu vandhu: nAன aghgharaighghubh bhoghaDhDhuM èனRu jhòlluMbhodhu, ghIleyAdh maனuShar: nI èbhbhirAyImaனA èனRu avaனaigh gheDhbhArghaL; avaன alla èனRAl,

nI Shibholedh èனRu jhòl èனbhArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu avaன abhbhaDhi ujhjharighghagh ghUDhAmal, jhibholedh èனbhAன; abhbhòzhudhu avaனaibh bhiDhidhdhu, yordhAன dhuRaiyile vèDhDhibhbhoDhuvArghaL; aghghAladhdhile èbhbhirAyImil nARbhadhdhIrAyiraMbher vizhundhArghaL.
yèbhdhA isravelai ARu varuShaM niyAyaM vijhAridhdhAன; bhiனbhu ghIleyAdhdhiyaனAன yèbhdhA maridhdhu, ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa òru bhaDhDhaNadhdhil aDhaghghaM bhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன.
avaனughghubhbhiனbhu bhèdhlègheM UrAனAghiya ibhjhAன isravelai niyAyaM vijhAridhdhAன.

avaனughghu mubhbhadhu ghumAraruM mubhbhadhu ghumAradhdhighaLuM irundhArghaL; mubhbhadhu ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhuRadhdhile vivAghaMbhaNNighghòDhudhdhu, dhaன ghumArarughghu mubhbhadhu bhèNghaLaibh bhuRadhdhile ghòNDhAன; avaன isravelai ezhu varuShaM niyAyaM vijhAridhdhAன.
bhiனbhu ibhjhAன maridhdhu, bhèdhlèdhemile aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன.
avaனughghubhbhiனbhu jhèbhuloனiyaனAghiya eloன isravelai niyAyaM vijhAridhdhAன; avaன bhadhdhu varuShaM isravelai niyAyaM vijhAridhdhAன.
bhiனbhu jhèbhuloனiyaனAghiya eloன maridhdhu, jhèbhuloன dhejhamAன Ayaloன Uril aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன.
avaனughghubhbhiனbhu illeliன ghumAraனAghiya bhiradhdhoனiyaனAன abhdhoன isravelai niyAyaM vijhAridhdhAன.
avaனughghu nARbhadhu ghumAraruM mubhbhadhu bherabhbhiLLaighaLuM irundhArghaL; avarghaL èzhubhadhu ghazhudhaighaLiன mel eRuvArghaL; avaன isravelai èDhDhu varuShaM niyAyaM vijhAridhdhAன.
bhiனbhu bhiradhdhoனiyaனAன illeliன ghumAraனAghiya abhdhoன maridhdhu, èbhbhirAyIM dhejhadhdhil amaleghghiyar malaiyilirughghiRa bhiradhdhoனile aDhaghghaM bhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன.
isravel bhudhdhirar maRubhaDhiyuM ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghubh bhòllAbhbhAனdhaijh jhèydhabhaDhiyAl, ghardhdhar avarghaLai nARbhadhu varuShamaLavuM bhèlisdhar ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr.
abhbhòzhudhu dhAN vaMjhadhdhAனAghiya jhorA UrAனAன òru maனuShaன irundhAன; avaன bher maனovA; avaன maனaivi bhiLLaibhèRAdha malaDhiyAyirundhAL.
ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar andha sdhirIghghudh dharijhaனmAghi, avaLai noghghi: idho, bhiLLaibhèRAdha malaDhiyAன nI gharbhbhandharidhdhu, òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRuvAy.
AdhalAl nI dhirADhjharajhamuM madhubhAனmuM ghuDhiyAdhabhaDhighghuM, dhIDhDhAனdhu òனRuM bhujhiyAdhabhaDhighghuM èjhjharighghaiyAyiru.

nI gharbhbhandharidhdhu, òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRuvAy; avaன dhalaiyiனmel jhavaraghaன ghadhdhi bhaDhalAghAdhu; andhabh bhiLLai bhiRandhadhumudhal dhevaனughghèனRu najhareyaனAyirubhbhAன; avaன isravelaibh bhèlisdhariன ghaighghu nI~NghalAghghi raDhjhighghadh dhòDha~NghuvAன èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu andha sdhirI dhaன bhuruShaனiDhadhdhil vandhu: dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன òruvar èனனiDhadhdhil vandhAr; avaruDhaiya jhAyal dhevaனuDhaiya dhUdhariன jhAyalaibhbhola maghA bhaya~NgharamAyirundhadhu; è~Ngheyirundhu vandhIr èனRu nAன avariDhadhdhil gheDhghavillai; avar dhaMmuDhaiya nAmadhdhai èனghghujh jhòllavumillai.

avar èனனai noghghi: idho, nI gharbhbhandharidhdhu, òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRuvAy; AdhalAl nI dhirADhjharajhamuM madhubhAனmuM ghuDhiyAmaluM, dhIDhDhAனdhu òனRuM bhujhiyAmaluM iru; andhabh bhiLLai bhiRandhadhu mudhal dhaன maraNanAL maDhDhuM dhevaனughghèனRu najhareyaனAyirubhbhAன èனRu jhòனனAr èனRAL.

abhbhòzhudhu maனovA ghardhdharai noghghi viNNabhbhaMbhaNNi: A, èன ANDhavare, nIr aனubhbhiன dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன maRubhaDhiyuM òruvijhai è~NghaLiDhadhdhil vandhu, bhiRaghghabhbhoghiRa bhiLLaighghAgha nA~NghaL jhèyyaveNDhiyadhai è~NghaLughghugh ghaRbhibhbhArAgha èனRu veNDhighghòNDhAன.

dhevaன maனovAviன jhadhdhadhdhughghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhAr; andha sdhirI vayal vèLiyil irughghuMbhodhu dhevaனuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar dhiruMbhavuM avaLiDhadhdhil vandhAr; abhbhòzhudhu avaL bhuruShaனAghiya maனovA avaLoDhe irughghavillai.
AghaiyAl andha sdhirI jhIghghiramAy oDhi, idho, aனRu èனனiDhadhdhil vandhavar èனghghudh dharijhaனmAனAr èனRu dhaன bhuruShaனughghu aRividhdhAL.
abhbhòzhudhu maனovA èzhundhirundhu, dhaன maனaiviyiன bhiனனAle bhoy, avariDhadhdhughghu vandhu: indha sdhirIyoDhe bhejhiனvar nIrdhAனA èனRu avariDhadhdhil gheDhDhAன; avar nAன dhAன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu maனovA: nIr jhòனனghAriyaM niRaiveRuMbhodhu, andhabh bhiLLaiyai èbhbhaDhi vaLarghghaveNDhuM, adhai èbhbhaDhi naDhadhdhaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAன.
ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar maனovAvai noghghi: nAன sdhirIyoDhe jhòனன yAvaRRiRghuM, avaL èjhjharighghaiyAyirundhu,

dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyile uNDhAghiRadhòனRuM jhAbhbhiDhAmaluM, dhirADhjharajhamuM madhubhAனmuM ghuDhiyAmaluM, dhIDhDhAனdhòனRuM bhujhiyAmaluM, nAன avaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhadhaiyèllAM ghaighghòLLaghghaDhavaL èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu maனovA ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனai noghghi: nA~NghaL òru vèLLADhDhughghuDhDhiyai umaghghAghajh jhamaidhdhughghòNDhuvarumaDhDhuM dharidhdhiruM èனRAன.

ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar maனovAvai noghghi: nI èனனai irughghajh jhòனனAluM nAன uன uNavaibh bhujhiyeன; nI jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhali iDhaveNDhumAனAl, adhai nI ghardhdharughghujh jhèludhdhuvAyAgha èனRAr. avar ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன èனRu maனovA aRiyAdhirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu maனovA ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனai noghghi: nIr jhòனனghAriyaM niRaiveRuMbhodhu, nA~NghaL uMmaigh ghaனMbhaNNuMbhaDhi uMmuDhaiya nAmaM èனன èனRu gheDhDhAன.
adhaRghugh ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar; èன nAmaM èனன èனRu nI gheDhghaveNDhiyadhu èனன? adhu adhijhayaM èனRAr.

maனovA bhoy, vèLLADhDhugh ghuDhDhiyaiyuM, bhojaனbhaliyaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhu, adhaigh ghaனmalaiyiனmel ghardhdharughghujh jhèludhdhiனAன; abhbhòzhudhu maனovAvuM avaன maனaiviyuM bhArdhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, adhijhayaM viLa~Nghiனdhu.

aghghiனijuvAlai bhalibhIDhadhdhilirundhu vAனdhdhiRghu nerAgha èzhuMbhu ghaiyil, ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar bhalibhIDhadhdhiன juvAlaiyile eRibhbhoனAr; adhai maனovAvuM avaன maனaiviyuM ghaNDhu, dharaiyile mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhArghaL.
bhiனbhu ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனAனvar maனovAvughghuM avaன maனaivighghuM ghANabhbhaDhavillai; abhbhòzhudhu avar ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன èனRu maனovA aRindhu,
dhaன maனaiviyaibh bhArdhdhu: nAM dhevaனaigh ghaNDhoM, jhAghave jhAvoM èனRAன.

adhaRghu avaன maனaivi: ghardhdhar naMmaigh ghòனRubhoDhajh jhidhdhamAyirundhAl, avar naMmuDhaiya ghaiyile jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhaliyaiyuM bhojaனbhaliyaiyuM òbhbhughghòLLamADhDhAr, ivaighaLaiyèllAM namaghghugh ghANbhighghavumADhDhAr, ivaighaLai namaghghu aRivighghavumADhDhAr èனRAL.
bhiனbhu andha sdhirI òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu, avaனughghujh jhiMjhoன èனRu bheriDhDhAL. andhabh bhiLLai vaLarndhadhu; ghardhdhar avaனai AjhIrvadhidhdhAr.
avaன jhorAvughghuM èsdhAvolughghuM naDhuviluLLa dhANiன bhALayadhdhil irughghaiyil ghardhdharuDhaiya AviyAனvar avaனai evadhdhuvaghghiனAr.
jhiMjhoன dhiMனAdhdhughghubh bhoy, dhiMனAdhdhile bhèlisdhariன ghumAradhdhighaLil òru bhèNNaigh ghaNDhu,
dhiruMbha vandhu, dhaன dhAyaiyuM dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM noghghi: dhiMனAdhdhile bhèlisdhariன ghumAradhdhighaLil òru bhèNNaigh ghaNDheன; avaLai èனghghugh ghòLLa veNDhuM èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhAyuM avaன dhaghabhbhaனuM avaனai noghghi: nI bhoy, virudhdhajhedhaனmillAdha bhèlisdhariDhadhdhil òru bhèNNaigh ghòLLaveNDhiyadhèனன? uன jhaghodharariன ghumAradhdhighaLiluM, è~NghaL jaனmaனaidhdhiluM bhèN illaiyA èனRArghaL. jhiMjhoன dhaன dhaghabhbhaனai noghghi: avaL èன ghaNNughghubh bhiriyamAனvaL, avaLaiye èனghghugh ghòLLaveNDhuM èனRAன.

avaன bhèlisdhariDhadhdhil ghuRRaM bhiDhighgha mughAndharaM uNDhAghuMbhaDhi, idhu ghardhdhariன jhèyal èனRu avaன dhAyuM dhaghabhbhaனuM aRiyAdhirundhArghaL; aghghAladhdhile bhèlisdhar isravelai ANDhArghaL.

abhbhaDhiye jhiMjhoனuM avaன dhAyuM dhaghabhbhaனuM dhiMனAdhdhughghubh bhoghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhArghaL; avarghaL dhiMனAdh Ur dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDha~NghaLmaDhDhuM vandhabhodhu, idho, ghèrjhjhighghiRa bhAlajhi~NghaM òனRu avaனughghu èdhirAgha vandhadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya Avi avaனmel bhalamAy iRa~NghiனdhiனAl, avaன dhaன ghaiyil òனRuM illAdhirundhuM, adhai òru ADhDhughghuDhDhiyaigh ghizhidhdhubhbhoDhughiRadhubhol ghizhidhdhubh bhoDhDhAன; AனAluM dhAன jhèydhadhai avaன dhaன dhAy dhaghabhbhaனughghu aRivighghavillai.
avaன bhoy andhabh bhèNNoDhe bhejhiனAன; avaL jhiMjhoனiன ghaNNughghubh bhiriyamAyirundhAL.

isravelaro bhèனyamIன bhudhdhirar mel dhiruMbhi, bhaDhDhaNadhdhil maனuShar dhòDha~Nghi mirugha~NghaLmaDhDhuM ghaNDhavaighaL èllAvaRRaiyuM bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl vèDhDhi, ghaNDha bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaiyèllAM aghghiனiyAl ghòLudhdhibh bhoDhDhArghaL.
isravelar misbhAvile irughghuM bhodhu: naMmil òruvaனuM dhaன ghumAradhdhiyaibh bhèனyamIனrughghu vivAghaMbhaNNighghòDhubhbhadhillai èனRu ANaiyiDhDhirundhArghaL.
AghaiyAl jaன~NghaL dhevaனuDhaiya vIDhDhiRghubh bhoy, a~Nghe dhevajhannidhiyil jhAya~NghAlamaDhDhuM irundhu, jhadhdhamiDhDhu, mighavuM azhudhu;

maRunALile, jaன~NghaL ghAlame èzhundhirundhu, a~Nghe òru bhalibhIDhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhi, jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhalighaLaiyuM jhamAdhAன bhalighaLaiyuM jhèludhdhiனArghaL.

isravel bhudhdhirar dha~NghaL jhaghodhararAghiya bhèனyamIனrai niனaidhdhu, maனsdhAbhabhbhaDhDhu: iனRu isravelil òru ghodhdhiraM aRubhbhuNDhubhoyiRRe.

jaன~NghaL ilaghghaMbhArghghabhbhaDhDha bhodhu, ghIleyAdhdhilirughghiRa yAbhejhiன ghuDhighaLil a~Nghe òruvaruM irundhadhillai.

uDhaனe jhabhaiyAr bhalavAனghaLil bhaனனIrAyiraMbherai a~Nghe azhaidhdhu: nI~NghaL bhoy, ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa yAbhejhiன ghuDhighaLai sdhirIghaLoDhuM bhiLLaighaLoDhuM bhaDhDhayaghgharughghiனAl vèDhDhu~NghaL.
jhaghala ANbhiLLaighaLaiyuM, bhuruSharai aRindha jhaghala bhèNbhiLLaighaLaiyuM jha~NgharighghaDhavIrghaL èனRu avarghaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhu aனubhbhiனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu riMmoன ghaனmalaiyilirughghiRa bhèனyamIன bhudhdhiraroDhe bhejhavuM, avarghaLughghujh jhamAdhAனM ghURavuM, jhabhaiyAr èllAruM maனuSharai aனubhbhiனArghaL.

abhbhaDhiye aghghAladhdhil bhèனyamIனr dhiruMbha vandhArghaL; ghIleyAdhdhilirughghiRa yAbhejhiன sdhirIghaLil uyiroDhe vaidhdha bhèNghaLai avarghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdhArghaL; abhbhaDhijh jhèydhuM avarghaL dhòghaighghugh ghANAdhirundhadhu.

bhèனyamIன ghodhdhira sdhirIghaL azhindhabhaDhiyiனAle, mIdhiyAன maRRabhbherghaLughghuM maனaivighaL ghiDhaighghuMbhaDhi èனனjhèyyalAM èனRu jhabhaiyiன mUbhbharAனvarghaL gheDhDhu,
isravelil òru ghodhdhiraM nirmUlamAghAdhabhaDhighghu, dhabhbhiனvarghaLuDhaiya jhudhandharaM bhèனyamIனughghu irughghaveNDhume,

nAmo naMmuDhaiya ghumAradhdhighaLil avarghaLughghubh bhèNghòDhughghagh ghUDhAdhu; bhèனyamIனrughghubh bhèNghòDhughghiRavaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன èனRu, isravel bhudhdhirar ANaiyiDhDhArghaLe èனRArghaL.

bhiனனuM, idho, bhèdhdhelughghu vaDhaghghe bhèdhdhelilirundhu jhIghemughghubh bhoghiRa bhAdhaighghu ghizhaghghAghavuM libhoனAvughghudh dhèRghAghavuM irughghiRa jhIlovile varuShandhoRuM ghardhdharughghubh bhaNDhighai ghòNDhADhabhbhaDhughiRadhe èனRu jhòlli,
avarghaL bhèனyamIன bhudhdhirarai noghghi: nI~NghaL bhoy, dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDha~NghaLile bhadhivirundhu,

jhIloviன ghumAradhdhighaL ghIdhavAdhdhiyadhdhoDhe naDhaனMbhaNNughiRavarghaLAybh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu varughiRadhai nI~NghaL ghANuMbhodhu, dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDha~NghaLilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, u~NghaLil avaravar jhIloviன ghumAradhdhighaLil, òvvòru bhèNNaibh bhiDhidhdhubh bhèனyamIன dhejhadhdhiRghugh ghòNDhubho~NghaL.

avarghaLuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaனmArAghiluM, jhaghodhararAghiluM è~NghaLiDhadhdhil muRaiyiDha varuMbhodhu, nA~NghaL avarghaLai noghghi: è~NghaL nimidhdhaM avarghaLughghudh dhayavujhèyyu~NghaL; nA~NghaL yudhdhaMbhaNNi, avaனvaனughghu maனaiviyai vA~NghighòDhughghavillai; u~NghaLmel ghuRRamuNDhAgha ibhbhodhu nI~NghaL avarghaLughghu maனaivighaLaigh ghòDhughghavuM illai èனbhoM èனRu jhòனனArghaL.

bhèனyamIன bhudhdhirar abhbhaDhiye jhèydhu, naDhaனMbhaNNughiRavarghaLile dha~NghaL dhòghaighghujh jhariyAன bhèNghaLai maனaivighaLAghabh bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu, dha~NghaL jhudhandharadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoy, bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaibh bhudhubhbhidhdhugh ghaDhDhi, avaighaLil ghuDhiyirundhArghaL.
isravel bhudhdhiraruM aghghAladhdhile avviDhaM viDhDhu avaravar dha~NghaL ghodhdhiradhdhughghuM dha~NghaL ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghuM bhoy, avaravar dha~NghaL jhudhandharadhdhil jherndhArghaL.
annADhghaLile isravelil rAjA illai; avaனvaன dhaனdhaன bhArvaighghujh jharibhbhoனbhaDhi jhèydhuvandhAன.

niyAyAdhibhadhighaL niyAyaM vijhAridhdhuvaruM nADhghaLil, dhejhadhdhile bha~njhaM uNDhAyiRRu; abhbhòzhudhu yUdhAviluLLa bhèdhlègheM UrAனAghiya òru maனuShaன dhaன maனaiviyoDhuM iraNDhu ghumAraroDhu~NghUDha movAbh dhejhadhdhile bhoyjh jha~njharidhdhAன.

andha maனuShaனuDhaiya bher èlimèleghghu, avaன maனaiviyiன bher naghomi, avaனuDhaiya iraNDhu ghumAraril òruvaன bher maghloன, maRRòruvaன bher ghiliyoன; yUdhAviluLLa bhèdhlègheM UrAghiya èbhbhirAdhdhiyarAghiya avarghaL movAbhdhejhadhdhiRghubh bhoy, a~Nghe irundhuviDhDhArghaL.
naghomiyiன bhuruShaனAghiya èlimèleghghu iRandhubhoனAன; avaLuM avaLuDhaiya iraNDhu ghumAraruM mAdhdhiraM irundhArghaL.
ivarghaL movAbhiyaril bhèN ghòNDhArghaL; avarghaLil òrudhdhi bher òrbhAL, maRRavaL bher rUdh; a~Nghe eRaghghuRaiyabh bhadhdhuvaruShaM vAjhaM bhaNNiனArghaL.
bhiனbhu maghloன ghiliyoன èனனuM avarghaL iruvaruM iRandhubhoனArghaL; andha sdhirI dhaன ghumArar iruvaraiyuM dhaன bhuruShaனaiyuM izhandhu dhaனidhdhavaLAனAL.

ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya jaன~NghaLaijh jhandhidhdhu, avarghaLughghu AghAraM aruLiனAr èனRu avaL movAbhdhejhadhdhile gheLvibhbhaDhDhu, dhaன marumaghaLoDheghUDha movAbh dhejhadhdhilirundhu dhiruMbhivaruMbhaDhi èzhundhu,
dhaன iraNDhu marumaghghaLoDhu~NghUDhadh dhAனirundha sdhaladhdhai viDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhAL. yUdhAdhejhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhibhbhogha, avarghaL vazhinaDhaghghaiyil,

uMmuDhaiya jaனdhdhaNDhaighghe uMmuDhaனghUDha varuvoM èனRArghaL.

èன maghghaLe, dhiruMbhibhbho~NghaL; nAன vayadhujhèனRavaL; òru bhuruShaனuDhaன vAzhadhdhaghghavaLalla; abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha naMbhighghai èனghghu uNDhAyirundhu, nAன iனRu iravil òru bhuruShaனughghu vAzhghghaibhbhaDhDhu, bhiLLaighaLaibh bhèRRAluM,

avarghaL bhèriyavarghaLAghumaDhDhuM bhuruSharughghu vAzhghghaibhbhaDhAdhabhaDhighghu nI~NghaL bhòRudhdhirubhbhIrghaLo? adhu ghUDhAdhu; èன maghghaLe, ghardhdharuDhaiya ghai èனghghu virodhamAyirughghiRadhiனAl, u~NghaLnimidhdhaM èனghghu mighundha vijhaனM irughghiRadhu èனRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL jhadhdhamiDhDhu adhighamAy azhudhArghaL; òrbhAL dhaன mAmiyai mudhdhamiDhDhubhbhoனAL; rUdhdho avaLai viDhAmal bhaRRigh ghòNDhAL.

nIr maraNamaDhaiyuM iDhadhdhil nAனuM maraNamaDhaindhu, a~Nghe aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhuveன; maraNameyallAmal veRòனRuM uMmai viDhDhu èனனaibh bhiridhdhAl, ghardhdhar adhaRghujh jhariyAghavuM adhaRghu adhighamAghavuM èனghghujh jhèyyaghghaDhavar èனRAL.
avaL dhaனனoDheghUDha vara maன uRudhiyAyirughghiRadhaigh ghaNDhu, abhbhuRaM adhaighghuRidhdhu avaLoDhe òனRuM bhejhavillai.

naghomighghu avaLuDhaiya bhuruShaனAghiya èlimèleghghiன uRaviனmuRaiyil bhovAs èனனuM bheruLLa mighundha AsdhighghAraனAghiya iனdhdhAன òruvaன irundhAன.

bhiனbhu bhovAs aRughghiRavarghaL mel ghaNghANiyAgha vaighghabhbhaDhDha dhaன velaighghAraனai noghghi: indhabh bhèNbhiLLai yAruDhaiyavaL èனRu gheDhDhAன.
aRughghiRavarghaLmel ghaNghANiyAgha vaighghabhbhaDhDha andha velaighghAraன bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: ivaL movAbh dhejhadhdhilirundhu naghomiyoDheghUDha vandha movAbhiya bhèNbhiLLai.

aRughghiRavarghaL bhiRaghe arighghaDhDhughaLilirundhu jhindhiனdhaibh bhòRughghigh ghòLLughiReன èனRu avaL èனனiDhadhdhil gheDhDhugh ghòNDhAL; ghAlame dhuvaghghi idhuvaraighghuM i~Nghe irughghiRAL; ibhbhòzhudhu avaL ghuDhijhaighghu vandhu ghò~njhanerandhAன AyiRRu èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhovAs rUdhdhaibhbhArdhdhu: maghaLe, gheL; bhòRughghighghòLLa veRe vayalil bhoghAmaluM, ivviDhadhdhaiviDhDhubh bhoghAmaluM, i~Nghe èன UzhiyaghghArabh bhèNghaLoDhu ghUDhave iru.

avarghaL aRubhbhaRughghuM vayalai nI bhArdhdhu, avarghaL bhiRaghe bho; òruvaruM uனனaidh dhòDhAdhabhaDhighghu, velaighghArarughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirughghiReன; uனghghudh dhAghaM èDhudhdhAl, dhaNNIrghghuDha~NghaLaNDhaighghubh bhoy, velaighghArar mòNDhughòNDhu varughiRadhile ghuDhighghalAM èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaL dharaiyile mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhu vaNa~Nghi: nAன anniyadhejhadhdhALAyirughgha, nIr èனனai vijhArighghuMbhaDhi èனghghu èdhiனAle uMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLil dhayai ghiDhaidhdhadhu èனRAL.

adhaRghubh bhovAs bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: uன bhuruShaன maraNamaDhaindha bhiனbhu, nI uன mAmiyArughghAghajh jhèydhadhuM, nI uன dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM uன dhAyaiyuM, uன janmadhejhadhdhaiyuM viDhDhu, muனனe nI aRiyAdha jaன~NghaLiDhadhdhil vandhadhuM èllAM èனghghu vivaramAydh dhèrivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

uன jhèyghaighghudhdhaghgha bhalaனaigh ghardhdhar uனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuvArAgha; israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhèDhDhaighaLiனghIzh aDhaighghalamAy vandha uனghghu avarAle niRaivAன bhalaன ghiDhaibhbhadhAgha èனRAன.

adhaRghu avaL: èன ANDhavaனe, uMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLil èனghghudh dhayaighiDhaighghaveNDhuM; nAன uMmuDhaiya velaighghArighaLil òrudhdhighghuM jhamAனmAyirAviDhDhAluM, nIr èனghghu ARudhal jhòlli uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALoDhe bhaDhjhamAybh bhejhiனIre èனRAL.

bhiனனuM bhovAs jhAbhbhADhDhu veLaiyil avaLaibh bhArdhdhu: nI i~Nghe vandhu, indha abhbhadhdhile bhujhidhdhu, ghADhiyile uன dhuNighghaiyaidh dhoydhdhughghòL èனRAன. abhbhaDhiye avaL aRubhbhaRughghiRavarghaL arughe uDhghArndhAL, avaLughghu vaRudhdha ghodhumaiyaigh ghòDhudhdhAன; avaL jhAbhbhiDhDhu, dhirubhdhiyaDhaindhu, mIndhadhai vaidhdhughghòNDhAL.
avaL ghadhir bhòRughghighghòLLa èzhundhabhodhu, bhovAs dhaன velaighghArarai noghghi: avaL arighghaDhDhughaL naDhuve bhòRughghighghòLLaDhDhuM; avaLai IனM bhaNNaveNDhAM.
avaL bhòRughghighghòLLuM bhaDhighghu avaLughghAgha arighaLile jhiladhaijh jhindhaviDhu~NghaL, avaLai adhaDhDhAdhiru~NghaL èனRu ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAன.
abhbhaDhiye avaL jhAya~NghAlamaDhDhuM vayalile ghadhir bhòRughghiனAL; bhòRughghiனdhai avaL dhaDhDhi aDhidhdhudh dhIrndhabhodhu, adhu eRaghghuRaiya òru maraghghAl vARghodhumai ghaNDhadhu.
avaL adhai èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, UrughghuL vandhAL; avaL bhòRughghiனdhai avaLuDhaiya mAmi bhArdhdhAL; dhAன dhirubhdhiyAyjh jhAbhbhiDhDhu mIdhiyAgha vaidhdhadhaiyuM èDhudhdhu avaLughghugh ghòDhudhdhAL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaLuDhaiya mAmi: iனRu è~Nghe ghadhirbhòRughghiனAy èvviDhadhdhil velaijhèydhAy èனRu avaLiDhadhdhil gheDhDhu; uனனai vijhAridhdhavaன AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuvAனAgha èனRAL; abhbhòzhudhu avaL: iனனAriDhadhdhile velaijhèydheன èனRu dhaன mAmighghu aRividhdhu: nAன iனRu velai jhèydha vayalghAraன bher bhovAs èனRAL.

abhbhòzhudhu naghomi dhaன marumaghaLaibh bhArdhdhu: uyiroDhirughghiRavarghaLughghuM maridhdhavarghaLughghuM dhayavujhèyghiRa ghardhdharAle avaன AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuvAனAgha èனRAL; bhiனனuM naghomi avaLaibhbhArdhdhu: andha maனuShaன namaghghu nèru~Nghiன uRaviன muRaiyAனuM naMmai AdharighghiRa jhudhandharavALighaLil òruvaனumAy irughghiRAன èனRAL.
bhiனனuM movAbhiya sdhirIyAன rUdh: avar èனனai noghghi, èன aRubhbhèllAM aRudhdhudh dhIrumaDhDhuM, nI èன velaighghArighaLoDhe ghUDhave iru èனRu jhòனனAr èனRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu naghomi dhaன marumaghaLAghiya rUdhdhaibh bhArdhdhu: èன maghaLe, veRòru vayalile maனuShar uனனai èdhirghghAdhabhaDhighghu nI avaன velaighghArighaLoDhe bhoghiRadhu nalladhu èனRAL.
abhbhaDhiye ghodhumai aRubhbhuM vARghodhumai aRubhbhuM dhIrumaDhDhuM avaL ghadhir bhòRughghuMbhaDhighghu, bhovAjhuDhaiya velaighghArighaLoDhe ghUDhiyirundhu, dhaன mAmiyiனiDhadhdhil dha~NghiனAL.
bhiனbhu avaL mAmiyAghiya naghomi avaLai noghghi: èன maghaLe, nI jhughamAy vAzhndhirughghuMbhaDhi nAன uனghghujh jhavughghiyadhdhaidh dheDhAdhirubhbheனo?
nI bhovAjhiன velaighghArighaLoDhe ghUDhiyirundhAye, avaன naMmuDhaiya uRaviன muRaiyAன allavA? idho, avaன iனRu irAdhdhiri ghaLadhdhile vARghodhumai dhURRuvAன.
nI ghuLidhdhu, èNNèy bhUjhi, uன vasdhira~NghaLai uDhudhdhighghòNDhu, andhagh ghaLadhdhiRghubh bho; andha maனuShaன bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdhudh dhIrumaDhDhuM avaன ghaNNughghu èdhirbhbhaDhAmaliru.

avaன bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhabhodhu, avaன bhaDhudhdhirughghuM iDhadhdhai nI bhArdhdhirundhu bhoy, avaன ghAlghaLiனmel mUDhiyirughghiRa bhorvaiyai òdhughghi nI bhaDhudhdhughghòL; abhbhòzhudhu nI jhèyyaveNDhiyadhu iனனdhèனRu avaன uனghghujh jhòlluvAன èனRAL.
adhaRghu avaL: nIr èனghghujh jhòனனbhaDhiyèllAM jhèyveன èனRAL.
avaL ghaLadhdhiRghubhbhoy, dhaன mAmi dhaனghghugh ghaRbhidhdhabhaDhiyèllAM jhèydhAL.

bhovAs bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdhu, maghizhjhjhiyAyirundhu, òru aMbhAradhdhu aDhiyile vandhu bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhAன. abhbhòzhudhu avaL: mèLLabhbhoy, avaன ghAlghaLiனmel mUDhiyirughghiRa bhorvaiyai òdhughghibh bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhAL.
bhAdhirAdhdhiriyile, andha maனuShaன aruNDhu, dhiruMbhi, òru sdhirI dhaன bhAdhadhdhaNDhaiyile bhaDhudhdhirughghiRadhaigh ghaNDhu,
nI yAr èனRu gheDhDhAன; avaL, nAன uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALAghiya rUdh; nIr uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALmel uMmuDhaiya bhorvaiyai viriyuM; nIr jhudhandhAvALi èனRAL.

adhaRghu avaன: maghaLe, nI ghardhdharAl AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuvAyAgha; nI dharidhdhiraruM aijhuvariyavAனghaLumAன vAlibharghaLiன bhiRaghe bhoghAdhadhiனAl, uன mundhiன naRghuNadhdhaibhbharghghiluM uன bhindhiன naRghuNaM udhdhamamAyirughghiRadhu.
ibhbhodhuM maghaLe, nI bhayabhbhaDhAdhe; uனghghu veNDhiyabhaDhiyèllAM jhèyveன; nI ghuNajhAli èனbhadhai èன jaனmAghiya UrArèllAruM aRivArghaL.
nAன jhudhandharavALi èனbhadhu mèydhAன; AனAluM èனனiluM ghiDhDhiன jhudhandharavALi òruvaன irughghiRAன.

irAdhdhirighghudh dha~Nghiyiru; nALaighghu avaன uனனaijh jhudhandharamuRaiyAy vivAghaMbhaNNajh jhaMmadhidhdhAl nalladhu, avaன vivAghaMbhaNNaDhDhuM; avaன uனனai vivAghaM bhaNNa maனdhillAdhirundhAனeyAghil, nAன uனனaijh jhudhandharamuRaiyAy vivAghaMbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhu ANaiyiDhughiReன; viDhiyaRghAlamaDhDhuM bhaDhudhdhugh ghòNDhiru èனRAன.

avaL viDhiyaRghAlamaDhDhuM avaன bhAdhadhdhaNDhaiyil bhaDhudhdhirundhu, ghaLadhdhile òru sdhirI vandhadhAgha òruvarughghuM dhèrivighghaveNDhAM èனRu avaன jhòlliyirundhabhaDhiyAl, òruvar mughaM òruvarughghudh dhèriyAdhadhaRghu muனனe èzhundhirundhAL.

avaன avaLai noghghi: nI bhordhdhughghòNDhirughghiRa bhorvaiyai viridhdhubhbhiDhi èனRAன; avaL adhaibh bhiDhidhdhabhodhu, avaன adhile ARubhaDhi vARghodhumaiyai aLandhubhoDhDhu, avaLmel dhUghghiviDhDhu, bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvandhAன.
avaL dhaன mAmiyiனiDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu, avaL: èன maghaLe, uன jhèydhi èனன èனRu gheDhDhAL; abhbhòzhudhu avaL: andha maனuShaன dhaனghghujh jhèydhadhaiyèllAM avaLughghu vivaridhdhAL.
meluM avar, nI uன mAmiyAraNDhaighghu vèRumaiyAybh bhoghaveNDhAM èனRu jhòlli, indha ARubhaDhi vARghodhumaiyai èனghghugh ghòDhudhdhAr èனRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaL: èன maghaLe, indhagh ghAriyaM èனனmAy muDhiyuM èனRu nI aRiyumaDhDhuM bhòRudhdhiru; andha maனuShaன iனRaighghu indhagh ghAriyadhdhai muDhighghumuன iLaibhbhARamADhDhAன èனRAL.

bhovAs bhaDhDhaNavAjhalil bhoy, uDhghArndhughòNDhirundhAன; abhbhòzhudhu bhovAs jhòlliyirundha andhajh jhudhandharavALi andha vazhiye vandhAன; avaனai noghghi: oy, èனRu bher jhòlligh ghUbhbhiDhDhu, i~Nghe vandhu jhaRRu uDhghAruM èனRAன; avaன vandhu uDhghArndhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன bhaDhDhaNadhdhu mUbhbharAனvarghaLil bhadhdhubhbherai azhaidhdhu, i~Nghe uDhghAru~NghaL èனRAன; avarghaLuM uDhghArndhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன andhajh jhudhandharavALiyai noghghi: èlimèlegh èனனuM naMmuDhaiya jhaghodharaனughghu irundha vayalniladhdhiன bha~Nghai movAbh dhejhadhdhilirundhu dhiruMbhi vandha naghomi viRghabhbhoghiRAL.

AghaiyAl nIr adhai UrArughghu muனbhAghavuM, èன jaனdhdhiன mUbhbharughghu muனbhAghavuM vA~NghighghòLLuMbhaDhi umaghghu aRiyabhbhaNNaveNDhuM ΎனRirundheன; nIr adhaijh jhudhandharamuRaiyAgha mIDhDhughghòLLa maனdhirundhAl, mIDhDhughghòLLuM; adhai mIDhDhughghòLLa maனdhillAdhirundhAl, nAன adhai aRiyuMbhaDhighghu èனghghujh jhòlluM; uMmaiyuM umaghghubhbhiனbhu èனனaiyuM dhavira, adhai mIDhghadhdhaghghavaன veRòruvaனuM illai èனRAன; adhaRghu avaன: nAன adhai mIDhDhughghòLLughiReன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhovAs: nIr naghomiyiன ghaiyile andha vayal niladhdhai vA~NghughiRa nALile maridhdhavaனuDhaiya jhudhandharadhdhil avaன bherai nilainiRghabhbhaNNuMbhaDhighghu, adhai maridhdhavaன maனaiviyAghiya movAbhiya sdhirIyAன rUdh ghaiyiluM vA~NghaveNDhiyadhu èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu andhajh jhudhandharavALi: nAன èன jhudhandharadhdhaigh ghèDhughghAdhabhaDhighghu, nAன adhai mIDhDhugh ghòLLamADhDheன; nAன mIDhghadhdhaghghadhai nIr mIDhDhughghòLLuM; nAன adhai mIDhDhughghòLLamADhDheன èனRAன.

mIDhghiRadhiluM mARRughiRadhiluM jhaghala ghAriyadhdhaiyuM uRudhibhbhaDhudhdhuM bhaDhighghu, isravelile bhUrvaghAla vazhaghghaM èனனvèனRAl, òruvaன dhaன bhAdharaDhjhaiyaigh ghazhaRRi, maRRavaனughghugh ghòDhubhbhAன, idhu isravelile vazha~Nghiன uRudhibhbhADhu.
abhbhaDhiye andhajh jhudhandharavALi bhovAjhai noghghi: nI adhai vA~NghighghòLLuM èனRu jhòlli, dhaன bhAdharaDhjhaiyaigh ghazhaRRibh bhoDhDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhovAs mUbhbharaiyuM jhaghala jaன~NghaLaiyuM noghghi: èlimèleghghughghu irundha èllAvaRRaiyuM ghiliyoனughghuM maghloனughghuM irundha èllAvaRRaiyuM naghomiyiன ghaiyile vA~NghighghòNDheன èனbhadhaRghu iனRaiyadhiனM nI~NghaL jhADhjhi.

idhuvumallAmal, maridhdhavaனuDhaiya jhaghodhararughghuLLuM, UrArughghuLLuM, avaனuDhaiya bher aRRubh bhoghAmal, maridhdhavaனuDhaiya jhudhandharadhdhile avaன bherai nilainiRudhdha, nAன maghloனiன maனaiviyAyirundha movAbhiya sdhirIyAன rUdhdhai èனghghu maனaiviyAghagh ghòNDheன; adhaRghuM iனRaiya dhiனM nI~NghaL jhADhjhi èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu òlimughavAjhalil irughghiRa jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM mUbhbharAனvarghaLuM avaனai noghghi: nA~NghaL jhADhjhidhAன; uன vIDhDhile varughiRa maனaiviyaigh ghardhdhar isravel vIDhDhaigh ghaDhDhuvidhdha iraNDhubherAghiya rAghelaibh bholavuM leyALaibhbholavuM vAzhndhirughghajh jhèyvArAgha: nI èbhbhirAdhdhAvile bhAghghiyavAனAyirundhu, bhèdhlèghemile bhughazhbhèRRirughghaghghaDhavAy.
indhabh bhèNNiDhadhdhile ghardhdhar uனghghu aruLijhjhèyyabhbhoghiRa jhandhAனdhdhiனAle, uன vIDhu dhAmAr yUdhAvughghubh bhèRRa bherejhiன vIDhDhaibhbhola AghaghghaDhavadhu èனRArghaL.
bhovAs rUdhdhai vivAghaM bhaNNiனAன; avaL avaனughghu maனaiviyAனAL; avaன avaLiDhadhdhil bhiravejhidhdhabhodhu, avaL gharbhbhandharidhdhu, òru ANbhiLLaiyaibh bhèRagh ghardhdhar anughghiraghaMbhaNNiனAr.

abhbhòzhudhu sdhirIghaL naghomiyaibh bhArdhdhu: jhudhandharavALi aRRubhbhoghAdhabhaDhighghu iனRu uனghghudh dhayaijhèydha ghardhdharughghu sdhodhdhiraM; avaன bher isravelile bhirabhalamAghaghghaDhavadhu.

avaன uன AdhdhumAvughghu ARudhal jhèyghiRavaனuM, uன mudhirvayadhile uனனai AdharighghiRavaனumAyirughghaghghaDhavaன; uனனaijh jhineghidhdhu, ezhu ghumAraraibhbhArghghiluM uனghghu arumaiyAyirughghiRa uன marumaghaL avaனaibh bhèRRALe èனRArghaL.
naghomi andhabh bhiLLaiyai èDhudhdhu, dhaன maDhiyile vaidhdhu, adhai vaLarghghiRa dhAyAனAL.
ayal vIDhDhughghArighaL naghomighghu òru ANbhiLLai bhiRandhadhu èனRu vAzhdhdhi, adhaRghu obhedh èனRu bheriDhDhArghaL; avaன dhAvIdhiன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya IjhAyiன dhaghabhbhaன.
bherejhuDhaiya jhandhadhiyiன varalARu: bheres èsroனaibh bhèRRAன.
èsroன rAmaibh bhèRRAன; rAM aMmiனdhAbhaibh bhèRRAன.
aMmiனdhAbh naghajhoனaibh bhèRRAன; naghajhoன jhalmoனaibh bhèRRAன.
jhalmoன bhovAjhaibh bhèRRAன; bhovAs obhedhaibh bhèRRAன.
obhedh IjhAyaibh bhèRRAன; IjhAy dhAvIdhaibh bhèRRAன.

èbhbhirAyIM malaidhdhejhadhdhilirughghiRa jherabhbhIM èனனbhbhaDhDha rAmadhAyIM UrAனAghiya òru maனuShaன irundhAன; avaனughghu èlghghAனA èனRu bher; avaன èbhbhirAyImiyaனAghiya jhUbhbhughghubh bhiRandha dhoghuviன ghumAraனAghiya èlighUviன maghaனAன èroghAmiன bhudhdhiraன.
avaனughghu iraNDhu maனaivighaL irundhArghaL; òrudhdhibher aனனAL, maRRavaLbher bhèனiனனAL; bhèனiனனALughghubh bhiLLaighaL irundhArghaL; aனனALughgho bhiLLai illai.

andha maனuShaன jhIlovile jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharaibh bhaNindhu ghòLLavuM avarughghubh bhaliyiDhavuM varuShandhoRuM dhaன Urilirundhu bhoyvaruvAன; a~Nghe ghardhdhariன AjhAriyarAன eliyiன iraNDhu ghumArarAghiya obhனiyuM bhiனèghAjhuM irundhArghaL.
a~Nghe èlghghAனA bhaliyiDhuM nALile, avaன dhaன maனaiviyAghiya bhèனiனனALughghuM, avaLuDhaiya èllAgh ghumArarughghuM ghumAradhdhighaLughghuM, bha~Nghu bhoDhDhugh ghòDhubhbhAன.
aனனALaijh jhineghidhdhabhaDhiyiனAl, avaLughghu iraDhDhibhbhAன bha~Nghu ghòDhubhbhAன; ghardhdharo avaL gharbhbhadhdhai aDhaidhdhirundhAr.
ghardhdhar avaL gharbhbhadhdhai aDhaidhdhabhaDhiyiனAl, avaLuDhaiya jhaghghaLadhdhi avaL dhughghabhbhaDhuMbhaDhiyAgha avaLai mighavuM vijhaனbhbhaDhudhdhuvAL.

avaL ghardhdharuDhaiya AlayadhdhiRghubh bhoghuM jhamayadhdhil, avaன varuShandhoRuM andhabhbhiraghAramAyjh jhèyvAன; ivaL avaLai maனmaDhivAghghuvAL; abhbhòzhudhu avaL jhAbhbhiDhAmal azhudhughòNDhirubhbhAL.

avaன bhuruShaனAghiya èlghghAனA avaLaibh bhArdhdhu: aனனALe, eன azhughiRAy? eன jhAbhbhiDhAdhirughghiRAy? eன jha~njhalabhbhaDhughiRAy? bhadhdhugh ghumAraraibhbhArghghiluM nAன uனghghu adhighamallavA èனRAன.
jhIlovile avarghaL bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdhabhiனbhu, aனனAL èzhundhirundhAL; AjhAriyaனAghiya eli ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன vAjhal nilaiyaNDhaiyile òru Ajhaனdhdhiனmel uDhghArndhirundhAன.
avaL bhoy, maன~Nghajhandhu, mighavuM azhudhu, ghardhdharai noghghi viNNabhbhaMbhaNNi:

jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhAve, dhevarIr uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALiன jhiRumaiyaigh ghaNNoghghibh bhArdhdhu, uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALai maRavAmal niனaindharuLi, umadhu aDhiyALughghu òru ANbhiLLaiyaigh ghòDhudhdhAl, avaன uyiroDhirughghuM jhaghala nALuM nAன avaனaigh ghardhdharughghu òbhbhughghòDhubhbheன; avaன dhalaiyiனmel jhavaraghaன ghadhdhi bhaDhuvadhillai èனRu òru bhòrudhdhaனai bhaNNiனAL.
avaL ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil vèghuneraM viNNabhbhaMbhaNNughiRabhodhu, eli avaL vAyaigh ghavaனidhdhughghòNDhirundhAன.
aனனAL dhaன irudhayadhdhile bhejhiனAL; avaLuDhaiya udhaDhughaL mAdhdhiraM ajhaindhadhu, avaL jhadhdhamo gheDhghabhbhaDhavillai; AghaiyAl avaL vèRidhdhirughghiRAL èனRu eli niனaidhdhu,
avaLai noghghi: nI èdhuvaraighghuM vèRidhdhirubhbhAy? uன ghuDhiyai uனனaiviDhDhu vilaghghu èனRAன.

adhaRghu aனனAL bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: abhbhaDhiyalla, èன ANDhavaனe, nAன maனghghilejhamuLLa sdhirI; nAன dhirADhjharajhamAghiluM madhuvAghiluM ghuDhighghavillai; nAன ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil èன irudhayadhdhai URRiviDhDheன.
uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALaibh bheliyALiன maghaLAgha èNNAdheyuM; mighudhiyAன vijhAradhdhiனAluM ghilejhadhdhiனAluM inneramaDhDhuM viNNabhbhaM bhaNNiனeன èனRAL.
adhaRghu eli jhamAdhAனdhdhuDhaனe bho; nI israveliன dhevaனiDhadhdhil gheDhDha uன viNNabhbhadhdhiனbhaDhi avar uனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuvArAgha èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaL: uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALughghu uMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLile dhayaighiDhaighghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAL; bhiனbhu andha sdhirI bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, bhojaன~njhèydhAL; abhbhuRaM avaL dhughghamughamAyirughghavillai.

avarghaL adhighAlaiyil èzhundhu, ghardhdharaibh bhaNindhughòNDhu, rAmAvilirughghiRa dha~NghaL vIDhDhughghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoனArghaL; èlghghAனA dhaனmaனaiviyAghiya aனனALai aRindhAன; ghardhdhar avaLai niனaindharuLiனAr.
jhilanAL jhèனRabhiனbhu aனனAL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi, òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRu, ghardhdhariDhadhdhil avaனaigh gheDhDheன èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghu jhAmuvel èனRu bheriDhDhAL.
èlghghAனA èனbhavaன ghardhdharughghu varuShAndharaM jhèludhdhuM bhaliyaiyuM dhaன bhòrudhdhaனaiyaiyuM jhèludhdhuMbhaDhiyAgha, dhaன vIDhDhAr aனaivaroDhu~NghUDhabh bhoனAன.

aனனAL ghUDhabhbhoghavillai; avaL: bhiLLai bhAlmaRandha bhiனbhu, avaன ghardhdhariன jhannidhiyile ghANabhbhaDhavuM, a~Nghe èbhbhòzhudhuM irughghavuM, nAன avaனaigh ghòNDhubhoy viDhuveன èனRu dhaன bhuruShaனiDhadhdhil jhòனனAL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaL bhuruShaனAghiya èlghghAனA avaLai noghghi: nI uன iShDhabhbhaDhi jhèydhu, avaனaibh bhAl maRaghghabhbhaNNumaDhDhuM iru; ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaimAdhdhiraM niRaiveRRuvArAgha èனRAன; abhbhaDhiye andha sdhirI dhaன bhiLLaiyaibh bhAl maRaghghabhbhaNNumaDhDhuM adhaRghu mulaighòDhudhdhAL.

avaL avaனaibh bhAlmaRaghghabhbhaNNiனbhiனbhu, mUனRu ghALaighaLaiyuM, òru maraghghAl mAvaiyuM, òru dhurudhdhi dhirADhjharajhadhdhaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, avaனaiyuM ghUDhDhigh ghòNDhu, jhIlovilirughghiRa ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhughghubh bhoனAL; bhiLLai iனனuM ghuzhandhaiyAyirundhadhu.
avarghaL òru ghALaiyaibh bhaliyiDhDhu, bhiLLaiyai eliyiனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvandhu viDhDhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaL: èன ANDhavaனe, i~Nghe uMmaNDhaiyile niனRu ghardhdharai noghghi viNNabhbhaMbhaNNiன sdhirI nAன dhAன èனRu èன ANDhavaனAghiya uMmuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன.
indhabh bhiLLaighghAgha viNNabhbhaMbhaNNiனeன; nAன ghardhdhariDhadhdhil gheDhDha èன viNNabhbhadhdhiனbhaDhi èனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAr.

AghaiyAl avaன ghardhdharughghèனRu gheDhghabhbhaDhDhabhaDhiyiனAl, avaன uyiroDhirughghuM jhaghala nALuM avaனaigh ghardhdharughghe òbhbhughghòDhughghiReன èனRAL; avaன a~Nghe ghardhdharaibh bhaNindhughòNDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu aனனAL jèbhaM bhaNNi: èΩ irudhayaM ghardhdhara`ΕghuL ghaLighUrughiRadhu; èΩ ghòΠύbhu gharaύdhdharughghuL uyarndhirughghiRadhu; èன bhaghai~nariனmel èன vAy dhiRandhirughghiRadhu; uMmuDhaiya iraDhjhibhbhiனAle jhandhoShabhbhaDhughiReன.
ghardhdharaibhbholabh bharijhudhdhamuLLavar illai; uMmaiyallAmal veRòruvaruM illai; è~NghaL dhevaனaibhbhola òru ghaனmalaiyuM illai.
iனi meDhDhimaiyAன bhejhjhaibh bhejhAdhiru~NghaL; aghandhaiyAன bhejhjhu u~NghaL vAyilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhaveNDhAM; ghardhdhar ~nAனmuLLa dhevaன; avar jhèyghaighaL yadhArdhdhamallavo?
bhalavAனghaLiன vil muRindhadhu; dhaLLADhiனvarghaLo bhaladhdhiனAl iDhaighaDhDhabhbhaDhDhArghaL.

dhirubhdhiyAyirundhavarghaL abhbhadhdhughghAgha ghUlivelai jhèyghiRArghaL; bhajhiyAyirundhavarghaLo iனibh bhajhiyAyirArghaL; malaDhiyAyirundhavaL ezhu bhèRRAL; aneghaM bhiLLaighaLaibh bhèRRavaLo bhalaDhjhayabhbhaDhDhAL.
ghardhdhar ghòllughiRavaruM uyirbhbhighghiRavarumAyirughghiRAr; avare bhAdhALadhdhil iRa~NghavuM adhilirundhu eRavuM bhaNNughiRavar.
ghardhdhar dharidhdhiraM aDhaiyajhjhèyghiRavaruM, aijhuvariyaM aDhaiyabhbhaNNughiRavarumAyirughghiRAr; avar dhAzhdhdhughiRavaruM, uyardhdhughiRavarumAனvar.

avar jhiRiyavaனaibh bhuzhudhiyilirundhu èDhudhdhu, èLiyavaனaigh ghubhbhaiyilirundhu uyardhdhughiRAr; avarghaLaibh bhirabhughghaLoDhe uDhghAravuM, maghimaiyuLLa jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhaijh jhudhandharighghavuM bhaNNughiRar; bhUmiyiன asdhibhAra~NghaL ghardhdharuDhaiyavaighaL; avare avaighaLiனmel bhUjhjhaghgharadhdhai vaidhdhAr.
avar dhamadhu bharijhudhdhavAனghaLiன bhAdha~NghaLaigh ghAbhbhAr; dhuனmArghghar iruLile mèLaனmAvArghaL; bhèladhdhiனAl òruvaனuM meRghòLvadhillai.

ghardhdharoDhe vazhaghghADhughiRavarghaL nòRughghabhbhaDhuvArghaL; vAனdhdhilirundhu avarghaLmel muzha~NghuvAr; ghardhdhar bhUmiyiன ghaDhaiyAndhara~NghaLai niyAyandhIrdhdhu, dhAM eRbhaDhudhdhiன rAjAvughghubh bhèlaன aLidhdhu, dhAM abhiSheghaM bhaNNiனvariன ghòMbhai uyarabhbhaNNuvAr èனRu dhudhidhdhAL.
bhiனbhu èlghghAனA rAmAvilirughghiRa dhaன vIDhDhughghubh bhoனAன; andhabh bhiLLaiyo, AjhAriyaனAghiya elighghu muனbhAghagh ghardhdharughghubh bhaNiviDhai jhèydhughòNDhirundhAன.
eliyiன ghumArar bheliyALiன maghghaLAyirundhArghaL; avarghaL ghardhdharai aRiyavillai.

andha AjhAriyarghaL jaன~NghaLai naDhabhbhidhdha vidhaM èனனvèனRAl, èvaனAghiluM òru bhaliyaijh jhèludhdhu~NghAladhdhil iRaijhjhi veghuMbhodhu, AjhAriyaனuDhaiya velaighghAraன mUனRu ghURuLLa òru Ayudhadhdhaidh dhaன ghaiyile bhiDhidhdhuvandhu,

adhiனAle, ghòbhbharaiyilAvadhu bhAனaiyilAvadhu jharuvadhdhilAvadhu jhaDhDhiyilAvadhu ghudhdhuvAன; andha Ayudhadhdhil varughiRadhaiyèllAM AjhAriyaன èDhudhdhughghòLLuvAன; abhbhaDhi a~Nghe jhIlovile varughiRa isravelarughghèllAM jhèydhArghaL.

ghòzhubhbhaidh dhaghaனighghiRadhaRghu muனனuM, AjhAriyaனuDhaiya velaighghAraன vandhu bhaliyiDhughiRa maனuShaனai noghghi: AjhAriyaனughghubh bhòrighghuMbhaDhi iRaijhjhighòDhu; bhajhjhai iRaijhjhiye allAmal, avidhdhadhai uனghaiyile vA~NghughiRadhillai èனbhAன.

adhaRghu andha maனuShaன: iனRu jhèyyaveNDhiyabhaDhi mudhalAvadhu ghòzhubhbhaidh dhaghaனidhdhuviDhaDhDhuM; bhiRbhADhu uன maனvirubhbhadhdhiனbhaDhi èDhudhdhughghòL èனRu jhòனனAluM; avaன: abhbhaDhiyalla, ibhbhòzhudhe ghòDhu, illAviDhDhAl bhalavandhamAy èDhudhdhughghòLLuveன èனbhAன.
AdhalAl andha vAlibhariன bhAvaM ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil mighavuM bhèridhAyirundhadhu; maனuShar ghardhdhariன ghANighghaiyai vèRubhbhAy èNNiனArghaL.
jhAmuvel èனனuM bhiLLaiyANDhAன jhaNal nUl ebhodhdhaidh dharidhdhavaனAygh ghardhdharughghu muனbhAghabh bhaNiviDhai jhèydhAன.
avaனuDhaiya dhAy varuShandhoRuM jhèludhdhuM bhaliyaijh jhèludhdhughiRadhaRghAgha, dhaன bhuruShaனoDheghUDha varughiRabhodhèllAM, avaனughghu òru jhiனனjh jhaDhDhaiyaidh dhaidhdhugh ghòNDhu varuvAL.

eli èlghghAனAvaiyuM avaன maனaiviyaiyuM AjhIrvadhidhdhu: indha sdhirI ghardhdharughghèனRu òbhbhughghòDhudhdhadhaRghubh bhadhilAghagh ghardhdhar uனghghu avaLAle jhandhAனM ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuvArAgha èனRAன; avarghaL dha~NghaL sdhAனdhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhabh bhoyviDhDhArghaL.

abhbhaDhiye ghardhdhar aனனALaigh ghaDhADhjhidhdhAr; avaL gharbhbhandharidhdhu mUனRu ghumAraraiyuM iraNDhu ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRAL; jhAmuvel èனனuM bhiLLaiyANDhAன ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil vaLarndhAன.

eli mighundha ghizhavaனAyirundhAன; avaன dhaன ghumArar isravelughghèllAM jhèyghiRa èllAvaRRaiyuM, avarghaL Ajharibhbhugh ghUDhAradhdhiன vAjhalil ghUDhDha~NghUDhughiRa sdhirIghaLoDhe jhayaனighghiRadhaiyuM gheLvibhbhaDhDhu,
avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha ghAriya~NghaLaijh jhèyghiRadhu èனன? indha jaன~NghaL èllAruM u~NghaL bhòllAdha naDhaghghaighaLaijh jhòllaghgheDhghiReன.
èன ghumArare, veNDhAM; nAன gheLvibhbhaDhughiRa indhajh jhèydhi nalladhalla; ghardhdharuDhaiya jaன~NghaL mIRi naDhaghghiRadhaRghugh ghAraNamAyirughghiRIrghaLe.

maனuShaனughghu virodhamAgha maனuShaன bhAva~njhèydhAl, niyAyAdhibhadhighaL adhaidh dhIrbhbhArghaL; òruvaன ghardhdharughghu virodhamAghabh bhAva~njhèyvAனeyAghil, avaனughghAgha viNNabhbha~njhèyyadhdhaghghavaன yAr èனRAன; avarghaLo dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaன jhòllaigh gheLAmaRbhoனArghaL; avarghaLaijh jha~Ngharighghagh ghardhdhar jhidhdhamAyirundhAr.
jhAmuvel èனனuM bhiLLaiyANDhAனo, bhèriyavaனAgha vaLarndhu, ghardhdharughghuM maனuSharughghuM bhiriyamAgha naDhandhughòNDhAன.

dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன òruvaன eliyiனiDhadhdhil vandhu: ghardhdhar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, uன bhidhAviன vIDhDhAr èghibhdhile bhArvoனiன vIDhDhil irughghaiyil, nAன èனனai avarghaLughghu vèLibhbhaDhudhdhi,

èன bhalibhIDhadhdhiனmel bhaliyiDhavuM, dhUbha~NghADhDhavuM, èன jhamughadhdhil ebhodhdhaidh dharighghavuM, isravel ghodhdhira~NghaLilèllAM avaனai èனghghu AjhAriyaனAghadh dhèrindhughòNDhu, uன bhidhAviன vIDhDhArughghu isravel bhudhdhiraruDhaiya dhaghaனbhalighaLaiyèllAM ghòDhughghavillaiyA?

èன vAjhasdhaladhdhile jhèludhdhuMbhaDhi nAன ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDha èன bhaliyaiyuM, èன ghANighghaiyaiyuM, nI~NghaL udhaibhbhAனeன? èன jaனmAghiya israveliன ghANighghaighaLilèllAM bhiradhAனmAனvaighaLaigh ghòNDhu u~NghaLaigh ghòzhughghabhbhaNNuMbhaDhighghu, nI èனனaibhbhArghghiluM uன ghumArarai madhibhbhAனeன èனghiRAr.

AghaiyAl israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhAvadhu: uன vIDhDhAruM uன bhidhAviன vIDhDhAruM èனRaighghuM èன jhannidhiyil naDhandhu ghòLvArghaL èனRu nAன nijhjhayamAyjh jhòlliyirundhuM, iனi adhu èனghghudh dhUramAyirubhbhadhAgha; èனனaigh ghaனMbhaNNughiRavarghaLai nAன ghaனM bhaNNuveன; èனனai ajhaDhDhai bhaNNughiRavarghaL ghaனIனbhbhaDhuvArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
uன vIDhDhil òru ghizhavaனuM irAdhabhaDhighghu uன bhuyadhdhaiyuM uன bhidhAviன vIDhDhAruDhaiya bhuyadhdhaiyuM nAன dhaRidhdhubhbhoDhuM nADhghaL varuM.
isravelughghujh jhèyyabhbhaDhuM jhaghala naனmaighaLughghuM mARAgha èன vAjhasdhaladhdhile ubhadhdhiravadhdhaigh ghANbhAy; òrubhodhuM uன vIDhDhil òru ghizhavaனuM irubhbhadhillai.

èன bhalibhIDhadhdhil jhevighgha, nAன uன jhandhadhiyil nirmUlamAghghAdhavarghaLo, uன ghaNghaLaibh bhUdhdhubhbhoghabh bhaNNavuM, uன AdhdhumAvai vedhaனaibhbhaDhudhdhavuM vaighghabhbhaDhuvArghaL; uன vaMjhadhdhiluLLa yAvaruM vAlavayadhile jhAvArghaL.
obhனi bhiனèghAs èனனuM uன iraNDhu ghumArariனmel varuvadhe uனghghu aDhaiyALamAyirughghuM; avarghaL iruvaruM òrenALil jhAvArghaL.

nAன èன uLLadhdhughghuM èன jhidhdhadhdhughghuM eRRabhaDhi jhèyyadhdhaghgha uNmaiyAன òru AjhAriyaனai èzhuMbhabhbhaNNi, avaனughghu nilaiyAன vIDhDhaigh ghaDhDhuveன; avaன èனனAl abhiSheghaM bhaNNabhbhaDhDhavaனughghu muனbhAghajh jhaghala nALuM naDhandhughòLLuvAன.

abhbhòzhudhu uன vIDhDhAril mIdhiyAyirubhbhavaன èvaனuM òru vèLLibhbhaNadhdhughghAghavuM òru abhbhadhdhuNighghaighghAghavuM avaனiDhadhdhil vandhu bhaNindhu: nAன ghò~njhaM abhbhaM jhAbhbhiDha yAdhòru AjhAriya Uzhiyadhdhil èனனaijh jherdhdhughghòLLuM èனRu ghè~njhuvAன èனRu jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.

jhAmuvel èனனuM bhiLLaiyANDhAன elighghu muனbhAghagh ghardhdharughghubh bhaNiviDhai jhèydhughòNDhirundhAன; annADhghaLile ghardhdharuDhaiya vajhaனM abhUrvamAyirundhadhu; bhiradhdhiyaDhjhamAன dharijhaனM irundhadhillai.
òrunAL eli dhaனனuDhaiya sdhAனdhdhile bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhirundhAன; avaன bhArghghagh ghUDhAdhabhaDhighghu avaனuDhaiya ghaNghaL iruLaDhaindhirundhadhu.
dhevaனuDhaiya bhèDhDhi irughghiRa ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhil dhevaனuDhaiya viLaghghu aNaindhubhoghumuனனe jhAmuveluM bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar, jhAmuvelaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhAr. adhaRghu avaன: idho, irughghiReன èனRu jhòlli,
eliyiனiDhadhdhil oDhi, idho, irughghiReன; èனனaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhIre èனRAன. adhaRghu avaன: nAன ghUbhbhiDhavillai, dhiruMbhibhbhoybh bhaDhudhdhughghòL èனRAன; avaன bhoybhbhaDhudhdhughghòNDhAன.

maRubhaDhiyuM ghardhdhar jhAmuvele èனRu ghUbhbhiDhDhAr; abhbhòzhudhu jhAmuvel èzhundhirundhu eliyiனiDhadhdhil bhoy: idho, irughghiReன; èனனaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhIre èனRAன. adhaRghu avaன: èன maghaனe, nAன uனனaigh ghUbhbhiDhavillai. dhiruMbhibhbhoybh bhaDhudhdhughghòL èனRAன.
jhAmuvel ghardhdharai iனனuM aRiyAdhirundhAன; ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai avaனughghu iனனuM vèLibhbhaDhavillai.

ghardhdhar maRubhaDhiyuM mUனRAMvijhai: jhAmuvele èனRu ghUbhbhiDhDhAr. avaன èzhundhirundhu eliyiனiDhadhdhil bhoy, idho, irughghiReன; èனனaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhIre èனRAன. abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar bhiLLaiyANDhAனaigh ghUbhbhiDhughiRAr èனRu eli aRindhu,

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar vandhu niனRu, muனbhola: jhAmuvele jhAmuvele èனRu ghUbhbhiDhDhAr; adhaRghujh jhAmuvel: jhòlluM; aDhiyeன gheDhghiReன èனRAன.
ghardhdhar jhAmuvelai noghghi: idho, nAன isravelil òru ghAriyadhdhaijh jhèyveன; adhaigh gheDhghiRa òvvòruvaனuDhaiya iraNDhu ghAdhughaLiluM adhu dhòனidhdhughghòNDhirughghuM.
nAன eliyiன ghuDhuMbhadhdhiRghu virodhamAghajh jhòனன yAvaiyuM, avaனmel annALile varabhbhaNNuveன; adhaidh dhòDha~NghavuM adhai muDhighghavuM bhoghiReன.

avaன ghumArar dha~NghaLmel jhAbhadhdhai varabhbhaNNughiRadhai avaன aRindhirundhuM, avarghaLai aDhaghghAmaRbhoன bhAvadhdhiனimidhdhaM, nAன avaன ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghu èனRuM nI~NghAdha niyAyadhdhIrbhbhujh jhèyveன èனRu avaனughghu aRividhdheன.

adhiனimidhdhaM eliyiன ghuDhuMbhadhdhAr jhèydha aghghiramaM òrubhodhuM bhaliyiனAlAvadhu ghANighghaiyiனAlAvadhu nivirdhdhiyAvadhillai èனRu eliyiன ghuDhuMbhadhdhaighghuRidhdhu ANaiyiDhDhirughghiReன èனRAr.

eliyo: jhAmuvele, èன maghaனe èனRu jhAmuvelaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhAன. avaன: idho, irughghiReன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: ghardhdhar uனனiDhadhdhil jhòனன ghAriyaM èனன? èனghghu adhai maRaighghaveNDhAM; avar uனனiDhadhdhil jhòனன jhaghala ghAriyadhdhiluM yAdhòனRai èனghghu maRaidhdhAyAனAl, dhevaன uனghghu adhaRghujh jhariyAghavuM adhaRghu adhighamAghavuM jhèyvArAgha èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu jhAmuvel òனRaiyuM avaனughghu maRaighghAmal, andhagh ghAriya~NghaLaiyèllAM avaனughghu aRividhdhAன. adhaRghu avaன: avar ghardhdhar; avar dhamadhu bhArvaighghu nalamAனdhaijh jhèyvArAgha èனRAன.
jhAmuvel vaLarndhAன; ghardhdhar avaனuDhaனeghUDha irundhAr; avar dhaMmuDhaiya èllA vArdhdhaighaLiluM òனRaiyAghiluM dharaiyile vizhundhu bhoghaviDhavillai.
jhAmuvel ghardhdharuDhaiya dhIrghghadharijhidhAன èனRu dhANmudhal bhèyèrjhèbhAmaDhDhumuLLa jhaghala isravelarughghuM viLa~Nghiனdhu.
ghardhdhar bhiனனuM jhIlovile dharijhaனM dhandharuLiனAr: ghardhdhar jhIlovile dhaMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyiனAle jhAmuvelughghudh dhaMmai vèLibhbhaDhudhdhiனAr.

jhAmuveliன vArdhdhai isravelughghèllAM vandhadhu. isravelar bhèlisdharughghu virodhamAy yudhdha~njhèyyabhbhuRabhbhaDhDhu, èbhèனejharughghujh jhamIbhadhdhil bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL; bhèlisdharo Abhbhèghghile bhALayamiRa~NghiyirundhArghaL.
