nI iனRaighghu èனனaiviDhDhubh bhoghiRabhodhu, bhèனyamIன èllaiyAghiya jhèljhAghil rAgheliன ghallaRaiyaNDhaiyil iraNDhu maனuSharaigh ghANbhAy; avarghaL uனனaibh bhArdhdhu: nI dheDhabhbhoன ghazhudhaighaL aghabhbhaDhDhadhu; idho, uன dhaghabhbhaன ghazhudhaighaLiனmelirundha ghavalaiyai viDhDhu, u~NghaLughghAgha vijhArabhbhaDhDhu, èன maghaனughghAgha èனனjhèyveன? èனghiRAன èனRu jhòlluvArghaL.

nI avviDhadhdhai viDhDhu abhbhuRaM ghaDhandhubhoy, dhAbhoriluLLa jhamabhUmiyil jheruMbhodhu, dhevaனaibh bhaNiyuMbhaDhi bhèdhdhelughghubh bhoghiRa mUனRu maனuShar a~Nghe uனனaigh ghaNDhu jhandhibhbhArghaL, òruvaன mUனRu ADhDhughghuDhDhighaLaiyuM, iனனòruvaன mUனRu abhbha~NghaLaiyuM, veRòruvaன dhirADhjharajhamuLLa òru dhurudhdhiyaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhu,
uனனuDhaiya jhughajhèydhiyai vijhAridhdhu, uனghghu iraNDhu abhbha~NghaLaigh ghòDhubhbhArghaL; avaighaLai nI avarghaL ghaiyile vA~NghaveNDhuM.

bhiனbhu bhèlisdhariன dhANaiyaM irughghiRa dhevaனuDhaiya malaighghubh bhovAy; a~Nghe nI bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghuL bhiravejhighghaiyil, meDhaiyilirundhu iRa~NghivarughiRa dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன ghUDhDhadhdhiRghu èdhirbhbhaDhuvAy; avarghaLughghu muனbhAghadh dhaMbhuruM meLamuM nAghajhuramuM jhuramaNDhalamuM bhoghuM; avarghaL dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòlluvArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya Avi uனmel iRa~NghuvAr; nI avarghaLoDheghUDhadh dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòlli, veRu maனuShaனAvAy.
indha aDhaiyALa~NghaL uனghghu neriDhuMbhodhu, jhamayadhdhughghu eRRabhaDhi nI jhèy; dhevaன uனனoDhe irughghiRAr.

nI èனghghu muனனe ghilghAlughghu iRa~Nghibhbho; jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhalighaLaiyuM jhamAdhAனbhalighaLaiyuM jhèludhdhuMbhaDhighghu, nAன uனனiDhadhdhil varuveன; nAன uனனiDhadhdhil vandhu, nI jhèyya veNDhiyadhai uனghghu aRivighghumaDhDhuM, ezhunAL ghAdhdhiru èனRAன.
avaன jhAmuvelai viDhDhubh bhoghuMbhaDhi dhiruMbhiனbhodhu, dhevaன avaனughghu veRe irudhayadhdhaigh ghòDhudhdhAr; andha aDhaiyALa~NghaL èllAM aனRaiya dhiனme neriDhDhadhu.

avarghaL andha malaighghu vandha bhodhu, idho, dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன ghUDhDhaM avaனughghu èdhirAgha vandhadhu; abhbhòzhudhu dhevaனuDhaiya Avi avaனmel iRa~NghiனdhiனAl, avaனuM avarghaLughghuLLe dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòனனAன.

adhaRghu muனனe avaனai aRindhavarghaL èllAruM avaன dhIrghghadharijhighaLoDhirundhu, dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòllughiRadhaigh ghaNDhabhodhu: ghIjhiன ghumAraனughghu vandhadhu èனன? jhavuluM dhIrghghadharijhighaLil òruvaனo? èனRu andha jaன~NghaL òruvaroDhòruvar jhòllighghòNDhArghaL.
adhaRghu a~Nghe irughghiRavarghaLil òruvaன: ivarghaLughghudh dhaghabhbhaன yAr èனRAன; AdhalAl jhavuluM; dhIrghghadharijhighaLil òruvaனo? èனbhadhu bhazhamòzhiyAyiRRu.
avaன dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòlli muDhindhabhiனbhu, meDhaiyiன mel vandhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu jhavuluDhaiya jhiRiya dhaghabhbhaன: nI~NghaL è~Nghe bhoனIrghaL èனRu avaனaiyuM avaன velaighghAraனaiyuM gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu avaன nA~NghaL ghazhudhaighaLaidh dheDhabhbhoy, avaighaLai è~Nghu~N ghANAdhabhaDhiyiனAl, jhAmuveliDhadhdhughghubh bhoனoM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu jhavuliன jhiRiyadhaghabhbhaன: jhAmuvel u~NghaLughghujh jhòனனdhu èனன? adhaijh jhòl èனRAன.

jhavul dhaன jhiRiyadhaghabhbhaனaibh bhArdhdhu: ghazhudhaighaL aghabhbhaDhDhadhu èனRu è~NghaLughghudh dhIrmAனmAyjh jhòனனAr èனRAன; AனAluM rAjyabhAradhdhaibhbhaRRijh jhAmuvel jhòனனdhai avaனughghu aRivighghavillai.
jhAmuvel jaன~NghaLai misbhAvile ghardhdhariDhadhdhil varavazhaidhdhu,

isravel bhudhdhirarai noghghi: israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, nAன isravelai èghibhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNi, u~NghaLai èghibhdhiyar ghaighghuM, u~NghaLai iRughabhbhiDhidhdha èllA rAjyadhdhAriன ghaighghuM nI~NghalAghghiviDhDheன.

nI~NghaLo u~NghaLuDhaiya èllAdhdhI~NghughaLughghuM nèrughgha~NghaLughghuM u~NghaLai nI~NghalAghghi raDhjhidhdha u~NghaL dhevaனai innALile bhuRaghghaNidhdhu, òru rAjAvai è~NghaLmel eRbhaDhudhdhuM èனRu avariDhadhdhil gheDhDhughghòNDhIrghaL; ibhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil u~NghaL vaMjha~NghaLiனbhaDhiyeyuM, Ayira~NghaLAன u~NghaL jhervaighaLiனbhaDhiyeyuM, vandhu nillu~NghaL; èனRAன.
jhAmuvel israveliன ghodhdhira~NghaLaiyèllAM jherabhbhaNNiனbhiனbhu bhèனyamIன ghodhdhiradhdhiனmel jhIDhDhu vizhundhadhu.

avaன bhèனyamIன ghodhdhiradhdhai adhiனuDhaiya ghuDhuMbha~NghaLiனbhaDhiye jherabhbhaNNiனbhiனbhu, mAdhdhiri ghuDhuMbhadhdhiனmeluM, adhile ghIjhiன ghumAraனAghiya jhavuliனmeluM, jhIDhDhu vizhundhadhu; avaனaidh dheDhiனbhodhu, avaன aghabhbhaDhavillai.
avaன iனi i~Nghe varuvAனA èனRu avarghaL dhiruMbhagh ghardhdhariDhadhdhil vijhAridhdhabhodhu: idho, avaன dhaLavADha~NghaLirughghiRa iDhadhdhile òLidhdhughghòNDhirughghiRAன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòனனAr.

abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL oDhi, a~Ngheyirundhu avaனai azhaidhdhughghòNDhuvandhArghaL; avaன jaன~NghaL naDhuve vandhu niனRabhodhu, èllA jaன~NghaLuM avaன dhoLughghugh ghIzhAyirughghadhdhaghgha uyaramuLLavaனAyirundhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu jhAmuvel èllA jaன~NghaLaiyuM noghghi: ghardhdhar dhèrindhughòNDhavaனaibh bhAru~NghaL, jhamasdha jaன~NghaLughghuLLuM avaனughghujh jhamAனmAனvaன illai èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu jaன~NghaL èllAruM Arbhbharidhdhu: rAjA vAzhgha èனRArghaL.

jhAmuvel rAjA~Nghadhdhiன muRaiyai jaன~NghaLughghudh dhèrividhdhu, adhai òru bhusdhaghadhdhil èzhudhi, ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil vaidhdhu, jaன~NghaLaiyèllAM avaravar vIDhDhughghu aனubhbhiviDhDhAன.
jhavuluM ghibhiyAvilirughghiRa dhaன vIDhDhughghubh bhoனAன; irANuvadhdhil dhevaன èvarghaL maனdhai eviனAro, avarghaLuM avaனoDheghUDhabh bhoனArghaL.
AனAluM bheliyALiன maghghaL: ivaனA naMmai raDhjhighghabhbhoghiRavaன èனRu jhòlli, avaனughghugh ghANighghai ghòNDhu varAmal avaனai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNiனArghaL; avaனo ghAdhugheLAdhavaன bhola irundhAன.

aghghAladhdhil nAghAs èனனuM aMmoனiyaன vandhu, ghIleyAdhdhilirughghiRa yAbhejhai muRRighghaibhoDhDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu yAbhejhiன maனuShar èllAruM nAghAjhai noghghi: è~NghaLoDhe uDhaனbhaDhighghaibhaNNuM; abhbhòzhudhu uMmaijh jhevibhbhoM èனRArghaL.

adhaRghu aMmoனiyaனAghiya nAghAs: nAன u~NghaL òvvòruvaruDhaiya valadhu ghaNNaiyuM bhiDhu~Nghi, idhiனAle isravel èllAvaRRiன meluM nindhaivarabhbhaNNuvadhe nAன u~NghaLoDhe bhaNNuM uDhaனbhaDhighghai èனRAன.

adhaRghu yAbhejhiன mUbhbharghaL: nA~NghaL isravel nADhè~NghuM sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhuMbhaDhi, ezhunAL è~NghaLughghudh dhavaNaighòDhuM, è~NghaLai raDhjhibhbhAr illAviDhDhAl, abhbhòzhudhu uMmiDhadhdhil varuvoM èனRArghaL.
andha sdhAனAbhadhighaL jhavuliன UrAghiya ghibhiyAvile vandhu, jaன~NghaLiன ghAdhugheDhgha andhajh jhèydhighaLaijh jhòனனArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu jaன~NghaLèllAruM jhadhdhamiDhDhu azhudhArghaL.
idho, jhavul mADhughaLiன bhiனனAle vayalilirundhu vandhu, jaன~NghaL azhughiRa mughAndharaM èனன èனRu gheDhDhAன; yAbhejhiன maனuShar jhòlliya jhèydhighaLai avaனughghudh dhèrividhdhArghaL.
jhavul indhajh jhèydhighaLaigh gheDhDhavuDhaனe, dhevaனuDhaiya Avi avaனmel iRa~NghiனdhiனAl avaன mighavuM ghobhaM mUNDhavaனAghi,

oriNaimADhDhaibh bhiDhidhdhu, dhuNDhidhdhu, andha sdhAனAbhadhighaL ghaiyile ghòDhudhdhu, israveliன nADhughaLughghèllAM aனubhbhi: jhavuliன bhiனனAleyuM, jhAmuveliன bhiனனAleyuM bhuRabhbhaDhAdhavaன èvaனo, avaனuDhaiya mADhughaLughghu ibhbhaDhijh jhèyyabhbhaDhuM èனRu jhòlliyaனubhbhiனAன; abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharAl uNDhAன bhaya~NgharaM jaனdhdhiனmel vandhadhiனAl, òrumaனbhbhaDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu vandhArghaL.
avarghaLaibh bhejheghghile ilaghghaM bhArdhdhAன; isravel bhudhdhiraril mUனRulaDhjhaMbheruM, yUdhA maனuSharil mubhbhadhiனAyiraMbheruM irundhArghaL.

vandha sdhAனAbhadhighaLai avarghaL noghghi: nALaighghu vèyil eRughiRadhaRghu muனனe u~NghaLughghu raDhjhibhbhugh ghiDhaighghuM èனRu ghIleyAdhdhilirughghiRa yAbhejhiன maனuSharughghujh jhòllu~NghaL èனRArghaL; sdhAனAbhadhighaL vandhu yAbhejhiன maனuShariDhadhdhil adhai aRividhdhArghaL; adhaRghu avarghaL jhandhoShabhbhaDhDhArghaL.
bhiனbhu yAbhejhiன maனuShar: nALaighghu u~NghaLiDhadhdhil varuvoM, abhbhòzhudhu u~NghaL iShDhabhbhaDhiyèllAM è~NghaLughghujh jhèyyu~NghaL èனRArghaL.

maRunALile jhavul jaன~NghaLai mUனRu bhaDhaiyAgha vaghudhdhu, ghizhaghghu vèLudhdhuvaruM jAmadhdhil bhALayadhdhiRghuL vandhu vèyil eRuMvaraighghuM aMmoனiyarai muRiya aDhidhdhAன; dhabhbhiனvarghaLil iraNDhubherAghiluM jherndhu oDhibhbhoghAdhabhaDhi èllAruM jhidhaRibh bhoனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu jaன~NghaL jhAmuvelai noghghi: jhavulA namaghghu rAjAvAyirughghabhbhoghiRavaன èனRu jhòனனvarghaL yAr? andha maனρSharai nA~NghaL ghòனRu bhoDhuMbhaDhighghu òbhbhughghòDhu~NghaL èனRArghaL.
adhaRghujh jhavul: iனRaiyadhiனM òruvaruM ghòllabhbhaDhalAghAdhu; iனRu ghardhdhar isravelughghu iraDhjhibhbhai aruLiனAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu jhAmuvel jaன~NghaLai noghghi: nAM ghilghAlughghubh bhoy, a~Nghe rAjyabhAradhdhai sdhirabhbhaDhudhdhuvoM vAru~NghaL èனRAன.

abhbhaDhiye jaன~NghaL èllAruM ghilghAlughghubh bhoy, avviDhadhdhile ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil jhavulai rAjAvAgha eRbhaDhudhdhi, a~Nghe ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil jhamAdhAனbhalighaLaijh jhèludhdhi, a~Nghe jhavuluM isravel maனuShar yAvaruM mighavuM jhandhoSha~NghòNDhADhiனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu jhAmuvel isravelar aனaivaraiyuM noghghi: idho, nI~NghaL èனghghujh jhòனனbhaDhiyèllAM u~NghaL jhòRgheDhDhu u~NghaLughghu òru rAjAvai eRbhaDhudhdhiனeன.

ibhbhodhuM idho, rAjAvAனvar u~NghaLughghu muனbhAghajh jha~njharidhdhuvarughiRAr; nAனo ghizhavaனuM naraidhdhavaனumAனeன; èன ghumArar u~NghaLoDhirubhbhArghaL; nAன èன jhiRuvayadhumudhal innALvaraighghuM u~NghaLughghu muனbhAghajh jha~njharidhdhuvandheன.

idho, irughghiReன; ghardhdhariன jhannidhiyiluM avar abhiSheghaMbhaNNi vaidhdhavarughghu muனbhAghavuM èனனaighghuRidhdhujh jhADhjhi jhòllu~NghaL; nAன yAruDhaiya èrudhai èDhudhdhughghòNDheன? yAruDhaiya ghazhudhaiyai èDhudhdhughghòNDheன? yArughghu aniyAya~njhèydheன? yArughghu iDhughghaNjhèydheன? yAr ghaiyil bharidhAனM vA~NghighghòNDhu ghaNjhADhaiyAyirundheன? jhòllu~NghaL; abhbhaDhiyuNDhAனAl adhai u~NghaLughghudh dhiruMbhagh ghòDhubhbheன èனRAன.
adhaRghu avarghaL: nIr è~NghaLughghu aniyAya~n jhèyyavuM illai; è~NghaLughghu iDhughghaN jhèyyavuM illai; òruvar ghaiyiluM òனRuM vA~NghavuM illai èனRArghaL.

adhaRghu avaன: nI~NghaL èன ghaiyil òனRuM ghaNDhubhiDhighghavillai èனbhadhaRghugh ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghu èdhirAghajh jhADhjhiyAyirughghiRAr, avar abhiSheghaM bhaNNiனvaruM iனRu adhaRghujh jhADhjhi èனRAன; adhaRghu avarghaL: avar jhADhjhi dhAன èனRArghaL.
abhbhuRaM jhAmuvel jaன~NghaLai noghghi: mojheyaiyuM AroனaiyuM eRbhaDhudhdhiனvaruM, u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLai èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiனvaruM ghardhdhare.

ibhbhodhuM ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghuM u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLughghuM jhèydhuvandha èllA nIdhiyAன ghiriyaighaLaighghuRidhdhuM, nAன ghardhdharuDhaiya jhannidhiyil u~NghaLoDhe niyAyaM bhejhuMbhaDhighghu nI~NghaL nillu~NghaL.

yAghghobhu èghibhdhile bhoyirughghuMbhodhu, u~NghaL bhidhAghghaL ghardhdharai noghghi muRaiyiDhDhArghaL, abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar mojheyaiyuM AroraiyuM aனubhbhiனAr; avarghaL u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLai èghibhdhilirundhu azhaidhdhuvandhu, avarghaLai indha sdhaladhdhile ghuDhiyirughghabhbhaNNiனArghaL.

avarghaL dha~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharai maRandhubhoghiRabhodhu, avar avarghaLai Adhjhoriன jheனAbhadhiyAghiya jhijhèrAviன ghaiyiluM, bhèlisdhariன ghaiyiluM, movAbhiya rAjAviன ghaiyiluM viRRubhbhoDhDhAr; ivarghaL avarghaLughghu virodhamAgha yudhdhaM bhaNNiனArghaL.

AghaiyAl avarghaL ghardhdharai noghghi muRaiyiDhDhu: nA~NghaL ghardhdharai viDhDhubh bhAghAlghaLaiyuM asdharodhdhaiyuM jhevidhdhadhiனAle, bhAva~njhèydhoM; ibhbhòzhudhu è~NghaL jhadhdhurughghaLiன ghaighghu è~NghaLai nI~NghalAghghi raDhjhiyuM; iனi uMmaijh jhevibhbhoM èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar èrubhAghAlaiyuM bhedhAனaiyuM yèbhdhAvaiyuM jhAmuvelaiyuM aனubhbhi, nI~NghaL bhayamillAmal ghuDhiyirughghuMbhaDhighghujh jhuRRiluM irundha u~NghaL jhadhdhurughghaLiன ghaighghuM u~NghaLai nI~NghalAghghi raDhjhidhdhAr.

aMmoன bhudhdhirariன rAjAvAghiya nAghAs u~NghaLughghu virodhamAy varughiRadhai nI~NghaL ghaNDhabhodhu, u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhare u~NghaLughghu rAjAvAyirundhuM, nI~NghaL èனனai noghghi: abhbhaDhiyalla, òru rAjA è~NghaLmel ALaveNDhuM èனRIrghaL.
ibhbhodhuM nI~NghaL veNDhuM èனRu viruMbhidh dhèrindhughòNDha rAjA, idho, irughghiRAr; idho, ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghu òru rAjAvai eRbhaDhudhdhiனAr.

nI~NghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya vAghghughghu virodhamAygh ghalaghaMbhaNNAmal ghardhdharughghubh bhayandhu, avaraijh jhevidhdhu, avaruDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhiRghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhindhAl, nI~NghaLuM u~NghaLai ALughiRa rAjAvuM u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaibh bhiனbhaRRughiRavarghaLAyirubhbhIrghaL.

nI~NghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhiRghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhiyAmal, ghardhdharuDhaiya vAghghughghu virodhamAygh ghalaghaMbhaNNiனIrghaLAனAl, ghardhdharuDhaiya ghai u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLughghu virodhamAyirundhadhu bhola u~NghaLughghuM virodhamAyirughghuM.

abhbhòzhudhu IjhAy abhiனdhAbhai azhaidhdhu, avaனaijh jhAmuvelughghu muனbhAghagh ghaDhandhubhoghabhbhaNNiனAன; avaன: ivaனaiyuM ghardhdhar dhèrindhu ghòLLavillai èனRAன.

ibhbhaDhi IjhAy dhaன ghumAraril ezhubherai jhAmuvelughghu muனbhAghagh ghaDhandhu bhoghabhbhaNNiனAன; bhiனbhu jhAmuvel IjhAyaibh bhArdhdhu: ghardhdhar ivarghaLil òruvaனaiyuM dhèrindhughòLLavillai èனRu jhòlli;

uன bhiLLaighaL ivvaLavudhAனA èனRu IjhAyaigh gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu avaன: iனனuM èllArughghuM iLaiyavaன òruvaன irughghiRAன; avaன ADhughaLai meydhdhughghòNDhirughghiRAன èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu jhAmuvel IjhAyai noghghi: AL aனubhbhi avaனai azhaibhbhi; avaன i~Nghe varumaDhDhuM nAன bhandhiyirughghamADhDheன èனRAன.
AL aனubhbhi avaனai azhaibhbhidhdhAன; avaன jhivandhameனiyuM, azhaghiyaghaNghaLuM, nalla rUbhamumuLLavaனAyirundhAன; abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar: ivaன dhAன, nI èzhundhu ivaனai abhiSheghaMbhaNNu èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu jhAmuvel: dhailaghghòMbhai èDhudhdhu, avaனai avaன jhaghodharar naDhuvile abhiSheghaMbhaNNiனAன; annALmudhaRghòNDhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya AviyAனvar dhAvIdhiனmel vandhu iRa~NghiyirundhAr; jhAmuvel èzhundhu rAmAvughghubh bhoyviDhDhAன.
ghardhdharuDhaiya Avi jhavulai viDhDhu nI~NghiனAr; ghardhdharAl varaviDhabhbhaDhDha òru bhòllAdha Avi avaனaigh ghala~NghabhbhaNNighghòNDhirundhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu jhavuliன UzhiyaghghArar avaனai noghghi: idho, dhevaனAl viDhabhbhaDhDha òru bhòllAdha Avi uMmaigh ghala~NghabhbhaNNughiRadhe.

jhuramaNDhalaM vAjhighghiRadhil dheRiன òruvaனaidh dheDhuMbhaDhighghu, è~NghaL ANDhavaனAghiya nIr umaghghu muனbhAgha niRghiRa uMmuDhaiya aDhiyArughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuM; abhbhòzhudhu dhevaனAl viDhabhbhaDhDha bhòllAdha Avi uMmel iRa~Nghughaiyil, avaன dhaன ghaiyiனAl adhai vAjhidhdhAl umaghghujh jhavughghiyamuNDhAghuM èனRArghaL.
jhavul dhaன UzhiyaghghAraraibh bhArdhdhu: naனRAy vAjhighghadhdhaghgha òruvaனaidh dheDhi, èனனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhu vAru~NghaL èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu andha velaighghAraril òruvaன bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: idho, bhèdhlèghemiyaனAghiya IjhAyiன ghumAraன òruvaனaigh ghaNDhirughghiReன; avaன vAjhibhbhadhil dheRiனvaன, avaன bharAghghiramajhAli, yudhdhavIraன, ghAriyajhamardhdhaன, jhavundhariyamuLLavaன; ghardhdhar avaனoDheghUDha irughghiRAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu jhavul: IjhAyiனiDhadhdhil ADhghaLai aனubhbhi, ADhDhumandhaiyil irughghiRa uன ghumAraனAghiya dhAvIdhai èனனiDhadhdhil aனubhbhu èனRu jhòllajh jhòனனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu IjhAy: abhbhadhdhaiyuM, òru dhurudhdhi dhirADhjharajhadhdhaiyuM, òru vèLLADhDhughghuDhDhiyaiyuM ghazhudhaiyiன mel eRRi, dhaன ghumAraனAghiya dhAvIdhiன vajhamAy jhavulughghu aனubhbhiனAன.
abhbhaDhiye dhAvIdhu jhavuliDhadhdhil vandhu, avaனughghu muனbhAgha niனRAன; avaன ivaனai mighavuM jhineghidhdhAன; avaனughghu ivaன AyudhadhAriyAனAன.
jhavul IjhAyiனiDhadhdhil AL aனubhbhi, dhAvIdhu èனghghu muனbhAgha niRghaDhDhuM; èன ghaNghaLil avaனughghudh dhayavughiDhaidhdhadhu èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAன.

abhbhaDhiye dhevaனAl viDhabhbhaDhDha Avi jhavulaibh bhiDhighghuMbhodhu, dhAvIdhu jhuramaNDhaladhdhai èDhudhdhu, dhaன ghaiyiனAl vAjhibhbhAன; adhiனAle bhòllAdha Avi avaனaiviDhDhu nI~Ngha, jhavul ARudhalaDhaindhu, jhòsdhamAvAன.

bhèlisdhar yudhdhaMbhaNNughiRadhaRghudh dha~NghaL jheனaighaLaijh jherdhdhu, yUdhAviluLLa jhoghghovile òrumidhdhugh ghUDhi, jhoghghovughghuM ajhèghghAvughghuM naDhuve irughghiRa èbhesdhaMmImile bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL.
jhavuluM isravel maனuSharuM òrumidhdhugh ghUDhi, elA bhaLLadhdhAghghile bhALayamiRa~Nghi, bhèlisdharughghu èdhirAgha yudhdhadhdhiRghu aNivaghudhdhu niனRArghaL.
bhèlisdhar andhabhbhaghghadhdhil òru malaiyiனmeluM, isravelar indhabhbhaghghadhdhil òru malaiyiனmeluM niனRArghaL; avarghaLughghu naDhuve bhaLLadhdhAghghu irundhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu ghAdh UrAனAghiya gholiyAdh èனனuM bheruLLa òru vIraன bhèlisdhariன bhALayadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvandhu naDhuve niRbhAன; avaன uyaraM ARumuzhamuM òru jANumAM.
avaன dhaன dhalaiyiனmel vèNghalajh jhIrAvaibh bhoDhDhu, òru bhorghghavajhaM dharidhdhughghòNDhirubhbhAன; andhagh ghavajhadhdhiன niRai aiyAyiraM jheghghalAன vèNghalamAyirughghuM.
avaன dhaன ghAlghaLile vèNghalaghghavajhadhdhaiyuM dhaன dhoLghaLiனmel vèNghalagh gheDhaghadhdhaiyuM dharidhdhirubhbhAன.
avaனuDhaiya IDhDhidhdhA~Nghu nèjhavughghArariன bhaDhaimaradhdhiன ghaனdhiyuM avaன IDhDhiyiன alaghu aRunURujheghghal iruMbhumAyirughghuM; bharijhaibhiDhighghiRavaன avaனughghu muனனAgha naDhabhbhAன.

avaன vandhuniனRu, isravel jheனaighaLaibh bhArdhdhujh jhadhdhamiDhDhu, nI~NghaL yudhdhadhdhiRghu aNivaghudhdhu niRghiRadhu èனன? nAன bhèlisdhaன allavA? nI~NghaL jhavuliன jhevaghar allavA? u~NghaLil òruvaனaidh dhèrindhughòLLu~NghaL, avaன èனனiDhadhdhil varaDhDhuM.

avaன èனனoDhe yudhdhaM bhaNNavuM èனனaigh ghòllavuM jhamardhdhaனAனAl nA~NghaL u~NghaLughghu velaighghArarAy irubhbhoM; nAன avaனai jèyidhdhu ghòlveனAனAl, nI~NghaL è~NghaLughghu velaighghArarAy irundhu, è~NghaLai jhevighghaveNDhuM èனRu jhòlli,
bhiனனuM andhabh bhèlisdhaன: nAன iனRaiyadhiனM israveluDhaiya jheனaighaLai nindhidhdheன; nAM òruvaroDhu òruvar yudhdhaMbhaNNa òruvaனai viDhu~NghaL èனRu jhòllighghòNDhuvaruvAன.
jhavuluM isravelar aனaivaruM andhabh bhèlisdhaனuDhaiya vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhu, ghala~Nghi mighavuM bhayabhbhaDhDhArghaL.

dhAvIdhu èனbhavaன yUdhAviluLLa bhèdhlègheM UrAனAghiya IjhAy èனனuM bheruLLa èbhbhirAdhdhiya maனuShaனuDhaiya ghumAraனAyirundhAன; IjhAyughghu èDhDhughghumArar irundhArghaL; ivaன jhavuliன nADhghaLile maRRa jaன~NghaLughghuLLe vayadhujhèனRa ghizhavaனAy madhighghabhbhaDhDhAன.

IjhAyiனuDhaiya mUனRu mUdhdha ghumArar jhavuloDheghUDha yudhdhadhdhiRghubh bhoyirundhArghaL; yudhdhadhdhiRghubh bhoyirundha avaனuDhaiya mUனRu ghumAraril mUdhdhavaனughghu èliyAbh èனRuM, iraNDhA~NghumAraனughghu abhiனdhAbh èனRuM, mUனRA~NghumAraனughghujh jhaMmA èனRuM bher.
dhAvIdhu èllArughghuM iLaiyavaன; mUdhdhavarghaLAghiya andha mUனRubheruM jhavuloDheghUDhabh bhoyirundhArghaL.
dhAvIdhu jhavulaiviDhDhudh dhiruMbhibh bhoy bhèdhlèghemilirughghiRa dhaன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya ADhughaLai meydhdhughghòNDhirundhAன.
andhabh bhèlisdhaன ghAlaiyiluM mAlaiyiluM nARbhadhunAL vandhuvandhu niRbhAன.

IjhAy dhaன ghumAraனAghiya dhAvIdhai noghghi: uன jhaghodhararughghu indha òru maraghghAl vaRudhdha bhayaRRaiyuM, indhabh bhadhdhu abhbha~NghaLaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, bhALayadhdhilirughghiRa uன jhaghodharariDhadhdhil oDhDhamAybh bhoy,

indhabh bhadhdhubh bhAlghaDhDhighaLai AyiraMbherughghu adhibhadhiyAனvaனiDhadhdhil ghòDhudhdhu, uன jhaghodharar jhughamAyirughghiRArghaLA èனRu vijhAridhdhu, avarghaLiDhadhdhil aDhaiyALaM vA~Nghigh ghòNDhuvA èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu jhavuluM, avarghaLuM, isravelar èllAruM, elA bhaLLadhdhAghghile bhèlisdharoDhu yudhdhaMbhaNNighghòNDhirundhArghaL.

dhAvIdhu adhighAlaiyil èzhundhu, ADhughaLaigh ghAvalALi vajhamAy viDhDhu, IjhAy dhaனghghugh ghaRbhidhdhabhaDhiye èDhudhdhughghòNDhubhoy, iradha~NghaL irughghiRa iDhadhdhile vandhAன; jheனaighaL aNivaghudhdhu niனRu, yudhdhadhdhiRghèனRu ArbhbharidhdhArghaL.
isravelaruM bhèlisdharuM òruvarughghu èdhirAgha òruvar aNivaghudhdhugh ghòNDhirundhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhu: dhAன ghòNDhuvandhavaighaLai iRaghghi, rasdhughghaLaigh ghAghghiRavaன vajhamAgha vaidhdhu viDhDhu, jheனaighghuL oDhi, dhaன jhaghodhararaibh bhArdhdhu: jhughamAyirughghiRIrghaLA èனRu gheDhDhAன.

avaன ivarghaLoDhe bhejhighghòNDhirughghaiyil, idho, ghAdh UrAனAghiya gholiyAdh èனனuM bheruLLa andhabh bhèlisdha vIraன bhèlisdhariன jheனaighaLilirundhu èzhuMbhivandhu niனRu, muன jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLaiye jhòனனAன; adhaidh dhAvIdhu gheDhDhAன.
isravelar èllAruM andha maனuShaனaigh ghANuMbhodhu mighavuM bhayabhbhaDhDhu, avaன mughadhdhughghu vilaghi oDhibhbhovArghaL.

anneradhdhile isravelar: vandhu niRghiRa andha maனuShaனaigh ghaNDhIrghaLA, isravelai nindhighgha vandhu niRghiRAன; ivaனaigh ghòllughiRavaன èvaனo, avaனai rAjA mighavuM aijhuvariyavAனAghghi, avaனughghudh dhaMmuDhaiya ghumAradhdhiyaidh dhandhu, avaன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhArughghu isravelile jharvamAனiyaM ghòDhubhbhAr èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhu dhaனனNDhaiyile niRghiRavarghaLaibh bhArdhdhu, indhabh bhèlisdhaனaigh ghòனRu isravelughghu neriDhDha nindhaiyai nIghghughiRavaனughghu èனன jhèyyabhbhaDhuM; jIvaனuLLa dhevaனuDhaiya jheனaighaLai nindhighghiRadhaRghu virudhdhajhedhaனM illAdha indha bhèlisdhaன èMmAdhdhiraM èனRAன.
adhaRghu jaன~NghaL: avaனaigh ghòllughiRavaனughghu iனன iனனbhaDhi jhèyyabhbhaDhuM èனRu muன jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLaiye avaனughghujh jhòனனArghaL.

andha maனuSharoDhe avaன bhejhighghòNDhirughghiRadhai avaன mUdhdha jhaghodharaனAghiya èliyAbh gheDhDhabhodhu, avaன dhAvIdhiனmel ghobha~NghòNDhu: nI i~Nghe vandhadhu èனன? vaனAndharadhdhiluLLa andhagh ghò~njha ADhughaLai nI yAr vajhadhdhil viDhDhAy? yudhdhadhdhaibh bhArghgha allavA vandhAy? uன dhuNigharadhdhaiyuM, uன irudhayadhdhiன agha~NghAradhdhaiyuM nAன aRiveன èனRAன.
adhaRghudh dhAvIdhu: nAன ibhbhòzhudhu jhèydhadhu èனன? nAன vandhadhaRghu mughAndharaM illaiyA èனRu jhòlli,
avaனai viDhDhu, veRòruvaனiDhadhdhil dhiruMbhi, andhabhbhiraghAramAghave gheDhDhAன; jaன~NghaL muனbholave udhdharavu jhòனனArghaL.
dhAvIdhu jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLai avarghaL gheDhDhu, adhaijh jhavuliன jhamughadhdhil aRividhdhArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu avaன avaனai azhaibhbhidhdhAன.
dhAvIdhu jhavulai noghghi: ivaனimidhdhaM òruvaனuDhaiya irudhayamuM ghala~Ngha veNDhiyadhillai; uMmuDhaiya aDhiyAனAghiya nAன bhoy, indhabh bhèlisdhaனoDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNuveன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu jhavul dhAvIdhai noghghi: nI indhabh bhèlisdhaனoDhe èdhirdhdhu yudhdhaM bhaNNa uனனAl AghAdhu; nI iLai~naன, avaனo dhaன jhiRu vayadhumudhal yudhdhavIraன èனRAன.

dhAvIdhu jhavulaibhbhArdhdhu: uMmuDhaiya aDhiyAன èன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya ADhughaLai meydhdhughghòNDhirughghiRa bhodhu, òruvijhai òru jhi~NghamuM òru vijhai òru gharaDhiyuM vandhu, mandhaiyilirughghiRa òru ADhDhaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhadhu.
nAன adhaidh dhòDharndhubhoy, adhai aDhidhdhu, adhai adhiன vAyghghudh dhabhbhuvidhdheன; adhu èனmel bhAyndha bhodhu, nAன adhiன dhADhiyaibh bhiDhidhdhu, adhai aDhidhdhugh ghòனRubhoDhDheன.

andhajh jhi~NghadhdhaiyuM andhagh gharaDhiyaiyuM uMmuDhaiya aDhiyAனAghiya nAன ghòனReன; virudhdhajhedhaனmillAdha indhabh bhèlisdhaனuM avaighaLil òனRaibhbhola irubhbhAன; avaன jIvaனuLLa dhevaனuDhaiya jheனaighaLai nindhidhdhAனe èனRAன.

bhiனனuM dhAvIdhu: èனனaijh jhi~Nghadhdhiன ghaighghuM gharaDhiyiன ghaighghuM dhabhbhuvidhdha ghardhdhar indhabh bhèlisdhaனuDhaiya ghaighghuM dhabhbhuvibhbhAr èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu jhavul dhAvIdhaibh bhArdhdhu: bho, ghardhdhar uனனuDhaனeghUDha irubhbhArAgha èனRAன.
jhavul dhAvIdhughghudh dhaன vasdhira~NghaLai uDhudhdhuvidhdhu, vèNghalamAன òru jhIrAvai avaன dhalaiyiனmel bhoDhDhu, òru ghavajhadhdhaiyuM avaனughghudh dharibhbhidhdhAன.

avaனuDhaiya bhaDhDhayadhdhai dhAvIdhu dhaன vasdhira~NghaLmel ghaDhDhighghòNDhu, adhile avaனughghubh bhazhaghghamillAdhadhiனAl naDhandhubhArdhdhAன; abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhu jhavulai noghghi: nAன ivaighaLaibh bhoDhDhughghòNDhu bhoghagh ghUDhAdhu; indha abhbhiyAjhaM èனghghu illai èனRu jhòlli, avaighaLaigh ghaLaindhubhoDhDhu,

dhaன dhaDhiyaigh ghaiyile bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu, ARRilirughghiRa jandhu ghUzhA~NghallughaLaidh dhèrindhèDhudhdhu, avaighaLai meybhbharughghuriya dhaனனuDhaiya aDhaibhbhabhbhaiyile bhoDhDhu, dhaன ghavaNaidh dhaன ghaiyile bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu, andhabh bhèlisdhaனNDhaiyile bhoனAன.
bhèlisdhaனuM naDhandhu, dhAvIdhaNDhaighghu ghiDhDhivandhAன; bharijhaiyai bhiDhighghiRavaன avaனughghu muனனAgha naDhandhAன.
bhèlisdhaன jhuRRibhbhArdhdhu: dhAvIdhaigh ghaNDhu, avaன iLai~naனuM jhavundhariya rUbhamAன jhivandha meனiyuLLavaனumAyirundhabhaDhiyiனAl, avaனai ajhaDhDhai bhaNNiனAன.
bhèlisdhaன dhAvIdhaibh bhArdhdhu: nI dhaDhighaLoDhe èனனiDhadhdhil vara nAன nAyA èனRu jhòlli, avaன dhaன dhevarghaLaighghòNDhu dhAvIdhaijh jhabhidhdhAன.
bhiனனuM andhabh bhèlisdhaன dhAvIdhaibh bhArdhdhu: èனனiDhadhdhil vA; nAன uன mAMjhadhdhai AghAyadhdhubh bhaRavaighaLughghuM ghADhDhu mirugha~NghaLughghuM ghòDhubhbheன èனRAன.

adhaRghudh dhAvIdhu: bhèlisdhaனai noghghi: nI bhaDhDhayadhdhoDhuM, IDhDhiyoDhuM, gheDhaghadhdhoDhuM èனனiDhadhdhil varughiRAy; nAனo nI nindhidhdha israveluDhaiya irANuva~NghaLiன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhariன nAmadhdhile uனனiDhadhdhil varughiReன.

iனRaiyadhiனM ghardhdhar uனனai èன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhubhbhAr; nAன uனனaigh ghòனRu, uன dhalaiyai uனனai viDhDhu vA~Nghi, bhèlisdharuDhaiya bhALayadhdhiன bhiNa~NghaLai iனRaiyadhiனM AghAyadhdhubh bhaRavaighaLughghuM, bhUmiyiன ghADhDhu mirugha~NghaLughghuM ghòDhubhbheன; adhaனAl isravelil dhevaன òruvar uNDhu èனRu bhUloghadhdhAr èllAruM aRindhu ghòLLuvArghaL.

ghardhdhar bhaDhDhayadhdhiனAluM IDhDhiyiனAluM raDhjhighghiRavar alla èனRu indha jaனghghUDhDhamèllAM aRindhu ghòLLuM; yudhdhaM ghardhdharuDhaiyadhu; avar u~NghaLai è~NghaL ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhubhbhAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu andhabh bhèlisdhaன èzhuMbhi, dhAvIdhughghu èdhirAghagh ghiDhDhivarughaiyil, dhAvIdhu dhIviramAy andhajh jheனaighghuM andhabh bhèlisdhaனughghuM èdhirAgha oDhi,

dhaன ghaiyai aDhaibhbhadhdhile bhoDhDhu, adhilirundhu òru ghallai èDhudhdhu, ghavaNile vaidhdhujh jhuzhaRRi, bhèlisdhaனuDhaiya nèRRiyile bhaDha èRindhAன; andhagh ghal avaன nèRRiyil bhadhindhu bhoனdhiனAl, avaன dharaiyile mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhAன.
ivvidhamAghadh dhAvIdhu òru ghavaNiனAluM òru ghalliனAluM bhèlisdhaனai meRghòNDhu, avaனai maDha~NghaDhidhdhu, avaனaigh ghòனRubhoDhDhAன; dhAvIdhiன ghaiyil bhaDhDhayaM illAdhirundhadhu.

AghaiyAl dhAvIdhu bhèlisdhaனNDhaiyil oDhi avaனmel niனRu, avaன bhaDhDhayadhdhai èDhudhdhu, adhai adhiன uRaiyilirundhu uruvi, avaனaigh ghòனRu adhiனAle avaன dhalaiyai vèDhDhibhbhoDhDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu dha~NghaL vIraன jhèdhdhubhbhoனAன èனRu bhèlisdhar ghaNDhu, oDhibhbhoனArghaL.

avaன jhavuloDhe bhejhi muDhindha bhiனbhu, yoனdhdhAனuDhaiya AdhdhumA dhAvIdhiன AdhdhumAvoDhe òனRAy ijhaindhirundhadhu; yoனdhdhAன avaனaidh dhaன uyiraibhbholajh jhineghidhdhAன.

yoனdhdhAன dhAvIdhaidh dhaன AdhdhumAvaibh bholajh jhineghidhdhadhiனAl, avaனuM ivaனuM uDhaனbhaDhighghaibhaNNigh ghòNDhArghaL.

AghaiyAl iனனuM adhighamAydh dhAvIdhughghubh bhayandhu, dhAன uyiroDhirundha nALèllAM dhAvIdhughghujh jhadhdhuruvAyirundhAன.

aghidhUbhiன ghumAraனAghiya aghimèleghghiன ghumAraril abhiyadhdhAr èனனuM bheruLLa òruvaன dhabhbhi, dhAvIdhu irughghuM bhuRamAgha oDhibhbhoy,

nI èனனiDhadhdhil iru, bhayabhbhaDhaveNDhAM; èன bhirANaனaiyuM vA~NghadhdheDhughiRavaனe uன bhirANaனaiyuM vA~NghadhdheDhughiRAன; nI èன Adharavile iru èனRAன.
idho, bhèlisdhar gheghilAviனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNi, ghaLa~njhiya~NghaLaigh ghòLLaiyiDhughiRArghaL èனRu dhAvIdhughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

èன dhaghabhbhaனe bhAruM; èன ghaiyilirughghiRa uMmuDhaiya jhAlvaiyiன dhò~Nghalaibh bhAruM; uMmaigh ghòனRu bhoDhAmal, uMmuDhaiya jhAlvaiyiன dhò~Nghalai aRudhdhughghòNDheன; èன ghaiyile bhòllAbhbhuM dhuroghamuM illai èனRuM, umaghghu nAன ghuRRaM jhèyyavillai èனRuM aRindhughòLLuM; nIro èன bhirANaனai vA~Ngha, adhai veDhDhaiyADhughiRIr.

ibhbhodhuM nI èனghghubh bhiனனirughghuM èன jhandhadhiyai veraRubhbhadhillai èனRuM, èன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhAril èன bhèyarai azhidhdhubhbhoDhuvadhillai èனRuM ghardhdharmel èனghghu ANaiyiDhDhugh ghòDhu èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhu jhavulughghu ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhudhdhAன; bhiனbhu, jhavul dhaன vIDhDhughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAன; dhAvIdhuM avaன maனuSharuM araNibhbhAன iDhadhdhiRghu eRibhbhoனArghaL.

jhAmuvel maraNamaDhaindhAன. isravelar èllAruM ghUDhivandhu, avaனughghAghadh dhughgha~NghòNDhADhi, rAmAvilirughghiRa avaனuDhaiya vaLavile avaனai aDhaghghaMbhaNNiனArghaL; dhAvIdhu èzhundhu, bhArAன vaனAndharadhdhiRghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனAன.

mAghoனile òru maனuShaன irundhAன; avaனuDhaiya dhòzhildhuRai gharmelil irundhadhu; andha maனuShaன maghA bhArigh ghuDhidhdhaனghghAraனAyirundhAன; avaனughghu mUvAyiraM ADhuM, AyiraM vèLLADhuM irundhadhu; avaன abhbhòzhudhu gharmelil dhaன ADhughaLai mayir ghadhdharidhdhughghòNDhirundhAன.

andha maனuShaனughghu nAbhAl èனRuM, avaன maனaivighghu abhighAyil èனRuM bhèyar; andha sdhirI maghA bhudhdhijhAliyuM rUbhavadhiyumAyirundhAL; andhabh bhuruShaனo muraDhaனuM dhurAghirudhaனumAyirundhAன; avaன ghAlebhuDhaiya jhandhadhiyAன.
nAbhAl dhaன ADhughaLai mayirghadhdharighghiRa jhèydhiyai vaனAndharadhdhil irughghiRa dhAvIdhu gheDhDhabhodhu,
dhAvIdhu bhadhdhu vAlibharai azhaidhdhu: nI~NghaL gharmelughghubh bhoy, nAbhAliDhadhdhil jhèனRu, èன bheraijhjhòlli, avaன jhughajhèydhiyai vijhAridhdhu,
avaனai noghghi: nIr vAzhgha, umaghghujh jhamAdhAனmuM, uMmuDhaiya vIDhDhughghujh jhamAdhAனmuM, umaghghu uNDhAன èllAvaRRiRghuM jhamAdhAனmuM uNDhAvadhAgha èனRu avaனai vAzhdhdhi,

ibhbhòzhudhu ADhughaLai mayirghadhdharighghiRavarghaL uMmiDhadhdhil irughghiRArghaL èனRu gheLvibhbhaDhDheன; uMmuDhaiya meybhbhar è~NghaLoDheghUDha irundhArghaL; avarghaL gharmelil irundha nALèllAM nA~NghaL avarghaLai varudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhavillai; avarghaLuDhaiya bhòruL òனRuM ghANAmaRbhoனdhuM illai.

uMmuDhaiya velaighghAraraigh gheLuM; avarghaL umaghghujh jhòlluvArghaL; AdhalAl indha vAlibharughghu uMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLile dhayaighiDhaighghaveNDhuM; nalla nALil vandhoM; uMmuDhaiya ghaighghu udhavuvadhai uMmuDhaiya UzhiyaghghArarughghuM, uMmuDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya dhAvIdhughghuM ghòDhughghuMbhaDhi veNDhughiReன èனRu jhòllu~NghaL èனRAன.
dhAvIdhiன vAlibhar bhoy, indha vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM dhAvIdhiன nAmadhdhiனAle nAbhAliDhadhdhil jhòlli, bhiனனòனRuM bhejhAdhirundhArghaL.
nAbhAl dhAvIdhiன UzhiyaghghArarughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: dhAvIdhu èனbhavaன yAr? IjhAyiன ghumAraன yAr? dha~NghaL èjamAனghaLai viDhDhu oDhibhbhoghiRa velaighghArar innALil aneghar uNDhu.

nAன èன abhbhadhdhaiyuM, èன dhaNNIraiyuM, èன ADhughaLai mayirghadhdharighghiRavarghaLughghAgha nAன aDhidhdhujh jhamaiyal bhaNNuvidhdhadhaiyuM èDhudhdhu, iனன iDhadhdhAr èனRu nAன aRiyAdha maனuSharughghugh ghòDhubhbheனo èனRAன.
dhAvIdhiன vAlibhar dha~NghaL vazhiye dhiruMbhi, maRubhaDhiyuM dhAvIdhiனiDhadhdhil vandhu, indha vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM avaனughghu aRividhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhu dhaன maனuSharaibh bhArdhdhu: nI~NghaL avaravar u~NghaL bhaDhDhayadhdhaigh ghaDhDhighghòLLu~NghaL èனRAன; avaravar dha~NghaL bhaDhDhayadhdhaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhArghaL; dhAvIdhuM dhaன bhaDhDhayadhdhaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhAன; eRaghghuRaiya nAனURubher dhAvIdhughghubh bhiன jhèனRu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனArghaL; irunURubher rasdhughghaL aNDhaiyil irundhuviDhDhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu velaighghAraril òruvaன nAbhAluDhaiya maனaiviyAghiya abhighAyilai noghghi: idho, naMmuDhaiya èjamAனuDhaiya jhughajhèydhi vijhArighgha dhAvIdhu vaனAndharadhdhilirundhu ADhghaLai aனubhbhiனAன; avarghaL bheril avar jhIRiனAr.

andha maனuSharo è~NghaLughghu mighavuM ubhaghArighaLAyirundhArghaL; nA~NghaL vèLighaLil irughghuMbhodhu, avarghaL è~NghaLiDhadhdhil naDhamADhiன nALèllAM avarghaL è~NghaLai varudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhiனdhumillai; namadhu bhòruLil òனRuM ghANAmaRbhoனdhumillai.
nA~NghaL ADhughaLai meydhdhu, avarghaLiDhadhdhil irundha nALèllAM avarghaL iravuMbhaghaluM è~NghaLaijh jhuRRiluM madhilAyirundhArghaL.

ibhbhodhuM nIr jhèyyaveNDhiyadhaigh ghavaனidhdhubhbhAruM; naMmuDhaiya èjamAனmeluM, avaruDhaiya vIDhDhAr yAvarmeluM, nijhjhayamAy òru bhòllAbhbhu varughiRadhAyirughghiRadhu; ivaro, òruvaruM dhaMmoDhe bhejhagh ghUDhAdhabhaDhighghu, bheliyALiன maghaனAyirughghiRAr èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu abhighAyil dhIviramAy irunURu abhbha~NghaLaiyuM, iraNDhu dhurudhdhi dhirADhjharajhadhdhaiyuM, jhamaiyal bhaNNabhbhaDhDha aindhu ADhughaLaiyuM, aindhu bhaDhi vaRudhdha bhayaRRaiyuM, vaRRalAghghabhbhaDhDha nURu dhirADhjhaghghulaighaLaiyuM, vaRRalAன irunURu adhdhibhbhazha aDhaighaLaiyuM èDhudhdhu, ghazhudhaighaLmel eRRi,
dhaன velaighghAraraibh bhArdhdhu: nI~NghaL èனghghu muனனe bho~NghaL; idho, nAன u~NghaL bhiனனe varughiReன èனRu jhòlli aனubhbhiனAL; dhaன bhuruShaனAghiya nAbhAlughghu adhai aRivighghavillai.
avaL òru ghazhudhaiyiனmel eRi, malaiyiன maRaivil iRa~Nghivarughaiyil, idho, dhAvIdhuM avaன maனuSharuM avaLughghu èdhirAgha iRa~NghivandhArghaL; avarghaLaijh jhandhidhdhAL.

dhAvIdhu dhaன jaன~NghaLai noghghi: avaனughghu vaனAndharadhdhil irughghiRadhaiyèllAM vINAghave ghAbhbhARRiனeன; avaனughghu uNDhAனdhilèllAM òனRuM ghANAmaRbhoனdhillai; èனRAluM naனmaighghubh bhadhilAgha avaன èனghghudh dhImaijhèydhAன.

avaனughghu uNDhAன èllAvaRRiluM jhuvaril nIrviDhuM òru nAyaimudhalAy bhòzhudhuviDhiyumaDhDhuM nAன uyiroDhe vaidhdhAl, dhevaன dhAvIdhiன jhadhdhurughghaLughghu adhaRghujh jhariyAghavuM adhaRghu adhighamAghavuM jhèyyaghghaDhavar èனRu jhòlliyirundhAன.
abhighAyil dhAvIdhaigh ghANghaiyil, dhIviramAygh ghazhudhaiyai viDhDhu iRa~Nghi, dhAvIdhughghu nerAghadh dharaiyil mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhu bhaNindhu,

avaன bhAdhadhdhile vizhundhu: èன ANDhavaனe, indhabh bhAdhaghaM èனmel jhumaraDhDhuM; uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALuDhaiya vArdhdhaighaLai nIr gheDhghuMbhòruDhDhAgha uMmuDhaiya aDhiyAL umadhu jhèvigheDhghabh bhejhaveNDhuM.

èன ANDhavaனAghiya nIr nAbhAl èனனuM indhabh bheliyALiன maனuShaனai òru bhòruDhDhAgha èNNaveNDhAM; avaன bhèyar èbhbhaDhiyo abhbhaDhiye avaனuM irughghiRAன; avaன bhèyar nAbhAl, avaனughghubh bhayidhdhiyamuM irughghiRadhu; uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALAghiya nAனo, èன ANDhavaன aனubhbhiன vAlibharaigh ghANavillai.

ibhbhodhuM èன ANDhavaனe, nIr iradhdhaM jhindha varavuM, uMmuDhaiya ghai nIdhiyaijh jharighghaDhDhavuM, ghardhdhar umaghghu iDha~NghòDhughghavillai èனbhadhaigh ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhuM, uMmuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhuM jhòllughiReன; ibhbhodhuM uMmuDhaiya jhadhdhurughghaLuM, èன ANDhavaனughghu virodhamAghabh bhòllAbhbhudh dheDhughiRavarghaLuM, nAbhAlaibhbhola AghaghghaDhavarghaL.
ibhbhodhuM umadhu aDhiyAL èன ANDhavaனughghugh ghòNDhuvandha ghANighghaiyai eRRughghòNDhu, èன ANDhavaனaibh bhiனbhaRRughiRa vAlibharughghugh ghòDhubhbhIrAgha.

umadhu aDhiyALiன bhAdhaghadhdhai maனனiyuM, ghardhdhar èன ANDhavaனughghu nilaiyAன vIDhDhai nijhjhayamAygh ghaDhDhuvAr; èன ANDhavaன ghardhdharuDhaiya yudhdha~NghaLai naDhadhdhughiRavarAme; nIr uyiroDhe irughghuM nALil òru bhòllAbhbhuM uMmile ghANabhbhaDhAdhirubhbhadhAgha.

uMmaidh dhuனbhabhbhaDhudhdhavuM, uMmuDhaiya bhirANaனai vA~Ngha vaghaidheDhavuM, òru maனuShaன èzhuMbhiனAluM èன ANDhavaனuDhaiya AdhdhumA uMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன Adharavil irughghiRa jIvaனuLLoruDhaiya ghaDhDhile ghaDhDhabhbhaDhDhirughghuM; uMmuDhaiya jhadhdhurughghaLiன AdhdhumAghghaLo ghavaNil vaidhdhu èRindhARbhola èRiyabhbhaDhDhubhbhoM.
ghardhdhar uMmaigh ghuRidhdhujh jhòனன naனmaiyiனbhaDhi èllAM iனi èன ANDhavaனughghujh jhèydhu, isravelughghu adhibhadhiyAgha uMmai nemighghuM bhodhu,

nIr virudhAvAy iradhdhaM jhindhAmaluM, èன ANDhavaனAghiya nIr bhazhivA~NghAmaluM irundhadhuNDhAனAl, abhbhòzhudhu èன ANDhavaனAghiya umaghghudh dhughghamuM irAdhu, maன iDhaRaluM irAdhu; ghardhdhar èன ANDhavaனughghu naனmai jhèyyuMbhodhu, uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALai niனaibhbhIrAgha èனRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhu abhighAyilai noghghi: uனனai iனRaiyadhiனM èனனaijh jhandhighgha aனubhbhiன israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu sdhodhdhiraM.

nI jhòlliya yojhaனai AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuvadhAgha; nAன iradhdhaM jhindha varAdhabhaDhighghuM, èன ghaiye bhazhivA~NghAdhabhaDhighghuM, nI iனRaiyadhiனM èனghghudh dhaDhaibhaNNiனbhaDhiyiனAl, nIyuM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuvAyAgha.

nI dhIviramAy èனனaijh jhandhighgha varAmal irundhAyAனAl, bhòzhudhu viDhiyumaDhDhuM nAbhAlughghu òru nAyuM uyiroDhe vaighghabhbhaDhuvadhillai èனRu, uனghghubh bhòllAbhbhujh jhèyya èனghghu iDha~NghòDhAdhirughghiRa israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன jIvaனaighghòNDhu mèyyAyjh jhòllughiReன èனRu jhòlli,

avaL dhaனghghugh ghòNDhuvandhadhaidh dhAvIdhu avaL ghaiyile vA~Nghi ghòNDhu, avaLaibh bhArdhdhu: nI jhamAdhAனdhdhoDhe uன vIDhDhughghubh bho; idho, nAன uன jhòllaighgheDhDhu, uன mughadhdhaibh bhArdhdhu, ibhbhaDhijh jhèydheன èனRAன.

abhighAyil nAbhAliDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu, idho, rAjavirundhughghu òbhbhAன virundhu avaன vIDhDhile naDhandhadhu; avaன irudhayaM ghaLidhdhirundhadhu; avaன mighavuM vèRidhdhumirundhAன; AghaiyAl bhòzhudhu viDhiyumaDhDhuM jhiRiyaghAriyamAனAluM bhèriya ghAriyamAனAluM, òனRaiyuM avaனughghu aRivighghavillai.
bhòzhudhu viDhindhu, nAbhAliன vèRidhèLindhabhiனbhu, avaன maனaivi indha vardhdhamAன~NghaLai avaனughghu aRividhdhAL; abhbhòzhudhu avaன irudhayaM avaனughghuLLe jhèdhdhu, avaன ghallaibhbholAனAன.
ghardhdhar nAbhAlai vAdhidhdhadhiனAl, eRaghghuRaiyabh bhadhdhunALughghubhbhiனbhu, avaன jhèdhdhAன.

nAbhAl jhèdhdhubhbhoனAன èனRu dhAvIdhu gheLvibhbhaDhDhabhodhu: èன nindhaiyiன vazhaghghai nAbhAliன ghaiyil vijhAridhdhu, dhaMmuDhaiya aDhiyAனaibh bhòllAbhbhujh jhèyyAdhabhaDhighghudh dhaDhudhdha ghardhdharughghu sdhodhdhiraM; ghardhdhar dhAme nAbhAliன bhòllAbhbhai avaன dhalaiyiனmel dhiruMbhabhbhaNNiனAr èனRu jhòlli, abhighAyilai vivAghaMbhaNNughiRadhaRghAgha avaLoDhe bhejha, dhAvIdhu ADhghaLai aனubhbhiனAன.
dhAvIdhiன UzhiyaghghArar gharmelil irughghiRa abhighAyilaNDhaighghu vandhu, dhAvIdhu uனனai vivAghaMbhaNNa maனdhAy, è~NghaLai uனனiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனAr èனRu avaLoDhe jhòllughiRabhodhu,
avaL èzhundhirundhu, dharaimaDhDhuM mugha~Nghuனindhu, idho, nAன èன ANDhavaனuDhaiya UzhiyaghghArariன ghAlghaLaigh ghazhuvadhdhaghgha bhaNiviDhaighghAriyAghiya avaruDhaiya aDhiyAL èனRAL.
bhiனbhu abhighAyil dhIviridhdhu èzhundhu, òru ghazhudhaiyiனmel eRi, aindhu dhAdhibhbhèNghaLaigh ghUDhDhigh ghòNDhu, dhAvIdhiன sdhAனAbhadhighaLughghubh bhiனjhèனRu bhoy, avaனughghu maனaiviyAனAL.
yèsrayel UrALAghiya aghiனovAmaiyuM dhAvIdhu vivAghaMbhaNNiனAன; avarghaL iruvaruM avaனughghu maனaiviyAனArghaL.
bhiனjhavul: dhAvIdhiன maனaiviyAghiya mIghAL èனனuM dhaன ghumAradhdhiyaigh ghAlIM UrAனAghiya lAyIjhiன ghumAraனAன bhaldhdhighghugh ghòDhudhdhirundhAன.
bhiனbhu jhIbh UrAr ghibhiyAvilirughghiRa jhavuliDhadhdhil vandhu: dhAvIdhu èShimoனughghu èdhirAன AghilAmeDhDhil òLidhdhughghòNDhirughghiRAன èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu jhavul: jhIbhvaனAndharadhdhile dhAvIdhaidh dheDhuMbhaDhi èzhundhu, isravelile dhèrindhughòLLabhbhaDhDha mUvAyiraM bheroDhu~N ghUDha, jhIbh vaனAndharadhdhiRghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAன.

jhavul èShimoனughghu èdhire vazhiyaNDhaiyilirughghiRa AghilAmeDhDhile bhALayamiRa~NghiனAன; dhAvIdhu vaனAndharadhdhil dha~Nghi, jhavul dhaனனaidh dhòDharndhu vaனAndharadhdhiRghu varughiRadhaigh ghaNDhu,
dhAvIdhu vevughArarai aனubhbhi, jhavul vandhadhu nijhjhayaM èனRu aRindhughòNDhAன.

bhiனbhu dhAvIdhu èzhundhu, jhavul bhALayamiRa~Nghiன iDhadhdhiRghubh bhoy, jhavuluM neriன ghumAraனAghiya abhனer èனனuM avaன bhaDhaidhdhalaivaனuM bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhirughghiRa iDhadhdhaibh bhArdhdhAன; jhavul iradha~NghaLirughghiRa iDhadhdhile bhaDhudhdhugh ghòNDhirundhAன; jaன~NghaL avaனaijh jhuRRiluM bhALayamiRa~NghiyirundhArghaL.

dhAvIdhu edhdhiyaனAghiya aghimèleghghaiyuM, jhèruyAviன ghumAraனuM yovAbhiன jhaghodharaனumAghiya abhijhAyaiyuM bhArdhdhu: èனனoDheghUDhajh jhavuliDhadhdhiRghubh bhALayadhdhil iRa~NghivarughiRavaன yAr èனRadhaRghu, abhijhAy: nAன uMmoDheghUDha varughiReன èனRAன.

abhbhaDhiye dhAvIdhuM abhijhAyuM irAdhdhiriyile andha jaன~NghaLughghuLLe vandhArghaL; idho, jhavul iradha~NghaLirughghiRa iDhadhdhile bhaDhudhdhu nidhdhiraibhaNNiனAன; avaன dhalaimADhDhil avaனuDhaiya IDhDhi niladhdhile ghudhdhiyirundhadhu; avaனaijh jhuRRiluM abhனeruM jaன~NghaLuM bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhirundhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu abhijhAy dhAvIdhaibh bhArdhdhu: iனRu dhevaன uMmuDhaiya ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr; ibhbhodhuM nAன avaனai IDhDhiyiனAl iraNDhu ghudhdhAghagh ghudhdhAmal, òre ghudhdhAgha niladhdhil uruvagh ghudhdhaDhDhumA èனRAன.
dhAvIdhu abhijhAyaibh bhArdhdhu: avaraigh ghòllAdhe; ghardhdhar abhiSheghaM bhaNNuvidhdhavarmel dhaன ghaiyaibh bhoDhDhu, ghuRRamillAmaRbhoghiRavaன yAr? èனRu jhòனனAன.
bhiனனuM dhAvIdhu: ghardhdhar avarai aDhidhdhu, alladhu avaruDhaiya ghAlaM vandhu, avar maridhdhu, alladhu avar yudhdhadhdhiRghubhbhoy mANDhAlòzhiya,

nAன èன ghaiyaigh ghardhdhar abhiSheghaMbhaNNuvidhdhavarmel bhoDhAdhabhaDhighghu, ghardhdhar èனனaigh ghAghghaghghaDhavar èனRu ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனaigh ghòNDhu jhòllughiReன; ibhbhodhuM avar dhalaimADhDhil irughghiRa IDhDhiyaiyuM, dhaNNIrjh jhèMbhaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhu bhovoM èனRAன.

dhAvIdhu jhavuliன dhalaimADhDhil irundha IDhDhiyaiyuM, dhaNNIrjh jhèMbhaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhabhiனbhu, bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhoனArghaL; adhai òruvaruM ghANavillai, aRiyavumillai, òruvaruM vizhidhdhughghòLLavumillai; ghardhdhar avarghaLughghu ayarndha nidhdhirai varuvidhdhadhiனAl, avarghaLèllAruM dhU~NghiனArghaL.
dhAvIdhu ghaDhandhu, andhabh bhaghghadhdhiRghubh bhoy, dha~NghaLughghuM avarghaLughghuM naDhuve bhondha iDhamuNDhAgha, dhUradhdhilirughghiRa malaiyiன ghòDhumuDhiyile,
jaன~NghaLughghuM neriன ghumAraனAghiya abhனerughghuM nerAgha niனRu ghUbhbhiDhDhu: abhனere, udhdharavu jhòllamADhDhIrA èனRAன; adhaRghu abhனer: rAjAvughghu nerAghagh ghUghghuraliDhughiRa nI yAr èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhu abhனerai noghghi: nIr vIraன allavA? isravelil umaghghujh jhariyAனvaன yAr? bhiனனai nIr uMmuDhaiya ANDhavaனAghiya rAjAvaigh ghAghghAmaRbhoனdhèனன? jaனdhdhil òruvaன uMmuDhaiya ANDhavaனAghiya rAjAvaigh ghòlluMbhaDhi vandhirundhAனe.

nIr jhèydha indhagh ghAriyaM nalladhalla; ghardhdhar abhiSheghaMbhaNNiன u~NghaL ANDhavaனai nI~NghaL ghAghghAmaRbhoனbhaDhiyiனAl, nI~NghaL maraNadhdhiRghubh bhAdhdhiravAனghaL; ibhbhodhuM rAjAviன dhalaimADhDhil irundha avaruDhaiya IDhDhiyuM dhaNNIrjh jhèMbhuM è~Nghe èனRu bhAruM èனRAன.

AghaiyAl dhAvIdhu dhaனனoDhirundha aRunURubheroDhu~NghUDha èzhundhirundhu, mAyoghiன ghumAraனAghiya Aghis èனனuM ghAdhdhiன rAjAviனiDhadhdhil bhoyjh jherndhAன.

dhAvIdhu AghIjhai noghghi: uMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLil èனghghudh dhayaighiDhaighghumAனAl, nAன vAjhaMbhaNNuMbhaDhi nADhDhiluLLa UrghaLile òனRil èனghghu iDhandhAruM; uMmuDhaiya aDhiyAன uMmoDheghUDha rAjadhAனi bhaDhDhaNadhdhile vAjhamAyirubhbhAனeன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu AghIs: aனRaiya dhiனM jhighlAghai avaனughghugh ghòDhudhdhAன; adhiனimidhdhaM jhighlAgh innAL varaighghuM yUdhAviன rAjAghghaLaijh jherndhirughghiRadhu.
dhAvIdhu bhèlisdhariன nADhDhile òru varuShamuM nAlu mAdhamuM ghuDhiyirundhAன.

AghIs dhAvIdhai naMbhi: avaன isravelarAghiya dhaனனuDhaiya jaன~NghaL dhaனனai vèRughghuMbhaDhi jhèyghiRAன; èனRaighghuM avaன èன UzhiyaghghAraனAyirubhbhAன èனbhAன.

annADhghaLile bhèlisdhar israveliனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNa, dha~NghaL jheனaighaLaibh bhorughghugh ghUDhDhiனArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu AghIs dhAvIdhai noghghi: nIyuM uன maனuSharuM èvvidhadhdhiluM èனனoDheghUDha yudhdhadhdhughghu varaveNDhuM èனRu aRiyaghghaDhavAy èனRAன.

dhAvIdhu AghIjhaibh bhArdhdhu: uMmuDhaiya aDhiyAன jhèyyabhbhoghiRadhai nIr nijhjhayamAy aRindhughòLvIr èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu AghIs dhAvIdhai noghghi: idhaRghAgha uனனai ènnALuM èனghghu mèyghAvalaனAgha vaibhbheன èனRAன.

jhAmuvel idhaRghu muனனme maridhdhubhbhoனAன; isravelar èllAruM avaனughghudh dhughgha~NghòNDhADhi, avaன UrAghiya rAmAvile avaனai aDhaghghaM bhaNNiனArghaL. jhavul a~njhaனM bhArghghiRavarghaLaiyuM ghuRijhòllughiRavarghaLaiyuM dhejhadhdhil irAdhabhaDhighghudh dhuradhdhi viDhDhAன.
bhèlisdhar ghUDhivandhu, jhUnemile bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL; jhavuluM isravelar èllAraiyuM ghUDhDhiனAன; avarghaL ghilbhovAvile bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL.
jhavul bhèlisdhariன bhALayadhdhaigh ghaNDhabhodhu bhayandhAன; avaன irudhayaM mighavuM dhadhdhaLidhdhughghòNDhirundhadhu.
jhavul ghardhdhariDhadhdhil vijhArighghuM bhodhu, ghardhdhar avaனughghujh jhòbhbhaன~NghaLiனAlAvadhu, UrImiனAlAvadhu, dhIrghghadharijhighaLiனAlAvadhu maRu udhdharavu aruLavillai.

abhbhòzhudhu jhavul veShaM mARi, veRu vasdhiraM dharidhdhughghòNDhu, avaனuM avaனoDheghUDha iraNDhubheruM irAdhdhiriyile andha sdhirIyiனiDhadhdhil bhoyjh jherndhArghaL; avaLai avaன noghghi: nI a~njhaனMbhArdhdhu èனghghugh ghuRijhòlli, nAன uனனiDhadhdhil jhòllughiRavaனai èzhuMbhivarajhjhèy èனRAன.

andha sdhirI jhAmuvelaigh ghaNDhamAdhdhiradhdhil maghA jhadhdhamAygh ghUbhbhiDhDhu, jhavulai noghghi: eன èனனai mojhaMbhoghghiனIr? nIrdhAன jhavulAjhjhudhe èனRAL.
rAjA avaLaibh bhArdhdhu: nI bhayabhbhaDhAdhe; nI ghANghiRadhu èனன èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu andha sdhirI: dhevarghaL bhUmighghuLLirundhu eRivarughiRadhaigh ghANghiReன èனRu jhavulughghujh jhòனனAL.

nI ghardhdharuDhaiya jhòRgheLAmaluM, amaleghghiனmel avarughghu irundha ghobhadhdhiன ughghiradhdhaidh dhIrghghAmaluM bhoனbhaDhiyiனAl, ghardhdhar iனRaiya dhiனM uனghghu indhabh bhiraghAramAghajh jhèydhAr.

abhbhòzhudhu andha sdhirI jhavuliDhadhdhil vandhu, avaன mighavuM ghala~NghiyirughghiRadhaigh ghaNDhu, avaனai noghghi: idho, uMmuDhaiya aDhiyALAghiya nAன uMmuDhaiya jhòRgheDhDhu, èன bhirANaனai èன ghaiyile bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu, nIr èனghghujh jhòனன uMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaighaLughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhindheன.

ibhbhodhuM nI nALai adhighAlaiyil uனனoDhe vandha uன ANDhavaனuDhaiya velaighghAraraigh ghUDhDhighòNDhu, viDhiyaRghAladhdhile vèLijhjhamAghiRabhodhu, bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbho èனRAன.

jaன~NghaL èllAruM adhaigh ghavaனidhdhArghaL; adhu avarghaL bhArvaighghu naனRAyirundhadhu; abhbhaDhiye rAjA jhèydhadhèllAM jhaghala jaன~NghaLughghuM nalamAydh dhoனRiனdhu.
neriன ghumAraனAghiya abhனeraigh ghòனRubhoDhDhadhu rAjAviனAl uNDhAனdhallavèனRu annALile jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM, isravelar aனaivaruM aRindhughòNDhArghaL.
rAjA dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai noghghi: iனRaiyadhiனM isravelil bhirabhuvuM, bhèriya maனuShaனumAghiya òruvaன vizhundhAன èனRu aRiyIrghaLA?

abhனer èbhroனile jhèdhdhubh bhoனdhaijh jhavuliன ghumAraன gheDhDhabhodhu, avaன ghaighaL dhiDhaனRRubhoyiRRu; isravelarèllAruM ghala~NghiனArghaL.

avaன dhaன bhaLLi aRaiyile dhaன ghaDhDhiliனmel bhaDhudhdhirughghuMbhodhu, ivarghaL uLLe bhoy avaனaidh ghudhdhigh ghòனRubhoDhDhu, avaன dhalaiyai vèDhDhibhbhoDhDhArghaL; bhiனbhu avaன dhalaiyai èDhudhdhughghòNDhu irAmuzhudhuM andharavèLi vazhiyAy naDhandhu,

èbhroனilirughghiRa dhAvIdhiனiDhadhdhil isbhojhedhdhiன dhalaiyaigh ghòNDhu vandhu, rAjAvai noghghi: idho uMmuDhaiya jhadhdhuruvAyirundha jhavuliன ghumAraனAghiya isbhojhedhdhiன dhalai; iனRaiya dhiனM ghardhdhar rAjAvAghiya è~NghaL ANDhavaனughghAghajh jhavuliன ghaiyiluM avaன ghuDhuMbhadhdhAriன ghaiyiluM bhazhivA~NghiனAr èனRArghaL.

AனAluM dhAvIdhu bherodhdhiyaனAன riMmoனiன ghumArarAghiya reghAvughghuM, avaன jhaghodharaன bhAனAvughghuM bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: èன AdhdhumAvai èllA ighghaDhDhughghuM nI~NghalAghghi mIDhDha ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhu nAன jhòllughiRadhaigh gheLu~NghaL.

aghghAladhdhile israveliன ghodhdhira~NghaLèllAM èbhroனilirughghiRa dhAvIdhiனiDhadhdhil vandhu: idho, nA~NghaL uMmuDhaiya èluMbhuM uMmuDhaiya mAMjhamumAனvarghaL.

jhavul è~NghaLmel rAjAvAyirughghuMbhodhe isravelai naDhadhdhighghòNDhubhoனvaruM naDhadhdhighòNDhu vandhavaruM nIre; ghardhdhar: èன jaனmAghiya isravelai nI meydhdhu, nI israveliனmel dhalaivaனAyirubhbhAy èனRu uMmiDhadhdhil jhòனனAre èனRArghaL.

israveliன mUbhbhar èllAruM èbhroனil rAjAviனiDhadhdhil vandhArghaL; dhAvIdhurAjA èbhroனile ghardhdharughghumuனbhAgha avarghaLoDhe uDhaனbhaDhighghaibhaNNiனbhiனbhu, avarghaL dhAvIdhai israveliனmel rAjAvAgha abhiSheghaMbhaNNiனArghaL.
dhAvIdhu rAjAvAghuMbhodhu, mubhbhadhu vayadhAyirundhAன; avaன nARbhadhu varuShaM rAjyabhAraMbhaNNiனAன.
avaன èbhroனile yUdhAviனmel ezhu varuShamuM ARu mAdhamuM, èrujhalemile jhamasdha israveliனmeluM yUdhAviனmeluM mubhbhadhdhumUனRu varuShamuM rAjyabhAraMbhaNNiனAன.

dhejhadhdhile ghuDhiyirughghiRa èbhUjhiyarmel yudhdhaMbhaNNa rAjAvAனvaன dhaன maனuSharoDheghUDha èrujhalemughghubh bhoனAன avarghaL: idhile bhiravejhighgha dhAvIdhiனAl ghUDhAdhu èனRu èNNi, dhAvIdhai noghghi: nI idhaRghuL bhiravejhibhbhadhillai; ghuruDharuM jhabhbhANighaLuM uனனaidh dhaDhubhbhArghaL èனRu jhòனனArghaL.
AனAluM dhAvIdhu jhIyoன ghoDhDhaiyaibh bhiDhidhdhAன; adhu dhAvIdhiன nagharamAyiRRu.

èvaன jhAlaghadhdhiன vazhiyAy eRi, èbhUjhiyaraiyuM dhAvIdhiன AdhdhumA bhaghaighghiRa jhabhbhANighaLaiyuM, ghuruDharaiyuM muRiya aDhighghiRAனo, avaன dhalaivaனAyirubhbhAன èனRu dhAvIdhu aனRaiyadhiனM jhòlliyirundhAன; adhaனAl ghuruDhaனuM jhabhbhANiyuM vIDhDhile varalAghAdhu èனRu jhòllughiRadhuNDhu.
andhagh ghoDhDhaiyile dhAvIdhu vAjhaMbhaNNi, adhaRghudh dhAvIdhiன nagharaM èனRu bheriDhDhu, millo èனனuM sdhalandhuvaghghi, uDhbhuRamaDhDhuM jhuRRilumirughghiRa madhilaigh ghaDhDhiனAன.

ghardhdhar dhaனனai israveliனmel rAjAvAghadh dhiDhabhbhaDhudhdhi, dhaMmuDhaiya jaனmAghiya israveliனimidhdhaM dhaனனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhai uyardhdhiனAr èனRu dhAvIdhu ghaNDhaRindhabhodhu,
avaன èbhroனilirundhu vandhabhiனbhu, èrujhalemil iனனuM adhighamAன maRumaனaiyADhDhighaLaiyuM sdhirIghaLaiyuM ghòNDhAன; iனனuM adhigha ghumAraruM ghumAradhdhighaLuM dhAvIdhughghubh bhiRandhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharughghu UjhAviனmel ghobhamUNDhadhu; avaனuDhaiya dhuNiviனimidhdhaM dhevaன a~Nghe avaனai aDhidhdhAr; avaன a~Nghe dhevaனuDhaiya bhèDhDhiyaNDhaiyil jhèdhdhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar UjhAvai aDhidhdhadhiனimidhdhaM dhAvIdhu vijhaனbhbhaDhDhu, andha sdhaladhdhiRghu innALmaDhDhuM vazha~NghivarughiRa bheresUjhA èனனuM bheriDhDhAன.

ghardhdharuDhaiya bhèDhDhiyaijh jhumandhubhoghiRavarghaL ARu dhabhbhaDhi naDhandhabhodhu, mADhughaLaiyuM ghòzhudhdha ADhDhughghaDhAghghaLaiyuM bhaliyiDhDhAன.
dhAvIdhu jhaNalnUl ebhodhdhaidh dharidhdhughghòNDhu, dhaன muzhubh bhaladhdhoDhuM ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha naDhaனMbhaNNiனAன.
abhbhaDhiye dhAvIdhuM, isravel jhandhadhiyAr aனaivaruM ghardhdharuDhaiya bhèDhDhiyai ghèMbhIra jhadhdhadhdhoDhuM èghghALa dhòனiyoDhuM ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.

ghardhdhar rAjAvaijh jhuRRilumirundha avaனuDhaiya èllAjh jhadhdhurughghaLughghuM avaனai nI~NghalAghghi, iLaibhbhARabhbhaNNiனbhodhu, avaன dhaன vIDhDhile vAjhamAyirughghaiyil,

abhbhòzhudhu nAdhdhAன rAjAvai noghghi: nIr bhoy uMmuDhaiya irudhayadhdhil uLLabhaDhiyèllAM jhèyyuM; ghardhdhar uMmoDhu irughghiRAre èனRAன.
aனRu rAdhdhiriyile ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai nAdhdhAனughghu uNDhAghi, avar:
nI bhoy èன dhAjhaனAghiya dhAvIdhai noghghi: ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, nAன vAjhamAyirughghadhdhaghgha Alayadhdhai nI èனghghugh ghaDhDhuvAyo?
nAன isravel bhudhdhirarai èghibhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiன nALmudhaRghòNDhu innALvaraighghuM, nAன òru Alayadhdhile vAjhaMbhaNNAmal, ghUDhAradhdhiluM vAjhasdhaladhdhiluM ulAviனeன.

nAன isravelAghiya èன jaனdhdhai meyghghuMbhaDhi ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDha isravel ghodhdhira~NghaLil òru ghodhdhiradhdhaiyAvadhu noghghi: nI~NghaL èனghghugh ghedhurumaradhdhAl jhèyyabhbhaDhDha Alayadhdhaigh ghaDhDhAdhirughghiRadhu èனன èனRu nAன isravel bhudhdhirarughghuL ulAvivandha èvviDhadhdhilAvadhu yAdhòru vArdhdhaiyaijh jhòனனdhuNDho?

ibhbhodhuM nI èன dhAjhaனAghiya dhAvIdhai noghghi: jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, nI isravel èனghiRa èன jaன~NghaLughghu adhibhadhiyAyirughghuMbhaDhi, ADhughaLiன bhiனனe naDhandha uனனai nAன ADhDhumandhaiyaiviDhDhu èDhudhdhu,
nI bhoன èvviDhadhdhiluM uனனoDhe irundhu, uன jhadhdhurughghaLaiyèllAM uனghghu muனbhAgha nirmUlamAghghi, bhUmiyilirughghiRa bhèriyorghaLiன nAmadhdhiRghu òdhdha bhèriya nAmadhdhai uனghghu uNDhAghghiனeன.

nAன èன jaனmAghiya isravelughghu òru iDhadhdhai eRbhaDhudhdhi, avarghaL dha~NghaL sdhAனdhdhile ghuDhiyirughghavuM, iனi avarghaL alaiyAmaluM, muனbholuM, nAன èன jaனmAghiya israveliனmel niyAyAdhibhadhighaLaigh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDha nALvaraiyil naDhandhadhubholuM, niyAyaghgheDhDhiன maghghaLAl iனijh jhiRumaibhbhaDhAmaluM irughghuMbhaDhi avarghaLai viraDhDhiனeன.
uனனuDhaiya èllAjh jhadhdhurughghaLughghuM uனனai nI~NghalAghghi, iLaibhbhARavuM bhaNNiனeன; ibhbhodhuM ghardhdhar uனghghu vIDhDhai uNDhubhaNNuvArèனbhadhaigh ghardhdhar uனghghu aRivighghiRAr.
uன nADhghaL niRaiveRi, nI uன bhidhAghghaLoDhe nidhdhiraibhaNNuMbhodhu, nAன uனghghubhbhiனbhu uன gharbhbhabhbhiRabhbhAghiya uன jhandhadhiyai èzhuMbhabhbhaNNi, avaன rAjyadhdhai nilaibhbhaDhudhdhuveன.
avaன èன nAmadhdhiRghèனRu òru Alayadhdhaigh ghaDhDhuvAன; avaன rAjyabhAradhdhiன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhai èனRaighghuM nilaighghabhbhaNNuveன.
nAன avaனughghubh bhidhAvAyirubhbheன, avaன èனghghugh ghumAraனAyirubhbhAன; avaன aghghiramaM jhèydhAl, nAன avaனai maனuSharuDhaiya milARRiனAluM maனubhudhdhiraruDhaiya aDhighaLiனAluM dhaNDhibhbheன.
uனghghu muனbhAgha nAன dhaLLiviDhDha jhavuliDhadhdhilirundhu èன ghirubhaiyai vilaghghiனdhubhola avaனaiviDhDhu vilaghghamADhDheன.
uன vIDhuM, uன rAjyamuM, èனRèனRaighghuM uனghghu muனbhAgha sdhirabhbhaDhDhirughghuM; uன rAjAjhaனM èனRèனRaighghuM nilaibhèRRirughghuM èனghiRArèனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAr.
nAdhdhAன indha èllA vArdhdhaighaLiனbhaDhiyuM, indha èllAdh dharijhaனdhdhiனbhaDhiyuM, dhAvIdhughghujh jhòனனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhurAjA uDhbhiravejhidhdhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya jhamughadhdhilirundhu: ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavare, dhevarIr èனனai idhuvaraighghuM ghòNDhuvandhadhaRghu, nAன èMmAdhdhiraM? èன vIDhuM èMmAdhdhiraM?

ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavare idhu iனனuM uMmuDhaiya bhArvaighghugh ghò~njhaghAriyamAyirughghiRadhu èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavarAyirughghiRa dhevarIr uMmuDhaiya aDhiyAனuDhaiya vIDhDhaighghuRidhdhu, vèghudhUramAyirughghuM ghAladhdhujhjhèydhiyai maனuShar muRaimaiyAyjhjhòனனIre.
iனi dhAvIdhu uMmiDhadhdhil jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனன? ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavarAyirughghiRa nIr umadhu aDhiyAனai aRivIr.
uMmuDhaiya vAghghudhdhadhdhadhdhiனimidhdhamuM, uMmuDhaiya jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiyeyuM, indhabh bhèriya ghAriya~NghaLaiyèllAM umadhu aDhiyAனughghu aRivighghuMbhaDhighghudh dhayavujhèydhIr.

AghaiyAl dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhare, nIr bhèriyavar èனRu viLa~NghughiRadhu; nA~NghaL è~NghaL ghAdhughaLAle gheDhDha jhaghala ghAriya~NghaLiனbhaDhiyuM, dhevarIrughghu nigharAனvar illai: uMmaidhdhavira veRedhevaனuM illai.

uMmuDhaiya jaனmAghiya isravelughghu nigharAன jaனmuM uNDho? bhUloghadhdhu jAdhighaLil indha òre jAdhiyai dhevaன dhamaghghu jaனmAgha mIDhghiRadhaRghuM, dhamaghghugh ghIrdhdhi viLa~NghabhbhaNNughiRadhaRghuM eRbhaDhDhAre; dhevarIr èghibhdhilirundhu mIDhDhughghòNDhuvandha uMmuDhaiya jaனdhdhiRghumuனbhAgha bhaya~NgharamAன bhèriya ghAriya~NghaLai naDhadhdhi, uMmuDhaiya dhejhadhdhiRghuM, adhilirundha jAdhighaLughghuM, avarghaL dhevarghaLughghuM, umadhu maghimaiyai viLa~Nghajhjhèydhu,
uMmuDhaiya jaனmAghiya isravelar èனRaighghuM uMmuDhaiya jaனmAyirubhbhadhaRghu, avarghaLaidh dhiDhabhbhaDhudhdhi, ghardhdharAghiya nIrdhAme avarghaLughghu dhevaனAனIr.
ibhbhodhuM dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhAve, nIr umadhu aDhiyAனaiyuM avaன vIDhDhaiyuM ghuRidhdhujh jhòனன vArdhdhaiyai èனRèனRaighghuM nilaivarabhbhaDhudhdha, dhevarIr jhòனனbhaDhiye jhèydharuLuM.

abhbhaDhiye jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar israveliனmel dhevaனAனvar èனRu jhòlli, uMmuDhaiya nAmaM èனRèனRaighghuM maghimaibhbhaDhuvadhAgha; umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya dhAvIdhiன vIDhu umaghghu muனbhAgha nilainiRbhadhAgha.

uனghghu vIDhughaDhDhuveன èனRu israveliன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharAyirughghiRa nIr umadhu aDhiyAனiன jhèvighghu vèLibhbhaDhudhdhiனIr; AghaiyAl uMmai noghghi indha viNNabhbhadhdhaijh jhèyya umadhu aDhiyAனughghu maனdhdhairiyaM ghiDhaidhdhadhu.
ibhbhodhuM ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavare, nIre dhevaன; uMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaighaL jhadhdhiyaM; dhevarIr umadhu aDhiyAனughghu indha nalvijheSha~NghaLai vAghghudhdhadhdhaMbhaNNiனIr.

ibhbhodhuM umadhu aDhiyAனiன vIDhu èனRaighghuM umaghghu muனbhAgha irughghuMbhaDhi adhai AjhIrvadhidhdharuLuM; ghardhdharAன ANDhavarAghiya dhevarIr adhaijh jhòனனIr, uMmuDhaiya AjhIrvAdhadhdhiனAle umadhu aDhiyAனiன vIDhu èனRaighghuM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhadhAgha èனRAன.
idhaRghubhbhiனbhu dhAvIdhu bhèlisdharai muRiya aDhidhdhu, avarghaLaigh ghIzhbhbhaDhudhdhi, medhdhegh aMmAvaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhAன.

avaன movAbhiyaraiyuM muRiya aDhidhdhu, avarghaLaidh dharaimaDhDhuM bhaNiyabhbhaNNi, avarghaLmel nUlbhoDhDhu, iraNDhubha~Nghu maனuSharaigh ghòனRubhoDhDhu, òru bha~Nghai uyiroDhe vaidhdhAன; ivvidhamAy movAbhiyar dhAvIdhaijh jhevidhdhu, avaனughghugh ghabhbha~NghaDhDhughiRavarghaLAனArghaL.
AjhAbhiன ghumAraனAghiya AdhAdhejhar èனனuM jhobhAviன rAjA aibhirAdhdhu nadhiyaNDhaiyil irughghiRa jhImaiyaidh dhiruMbhadh dhaன vajhamAghghighghòLLabhbhoghaiyil, dhAvIdhu avaனaiyuM muRiya aDhidhdhu,

avaனughghu irundha irANuvadhdhil Ayiradhdhu èzhunURu ghudhiraivIraraiyuM, bhadhiனAyiraM ghAlADhghaLaiyuM bhiDhidhdhu iradha~NghaLil nURu iradha~NghaLai vaidhdhughghòNDhu, maRRavaighaLaiyèllAM dhuNDhADhibhbhoDhDhAன.
jhobhAviன rAjAvAghiya AdhAdhejharughghu udhavijhèyya dhamasghubh bhaDhDhaNadhdhArAghiya jhIriyar vandhArghaL; dhAvIdhu jhIriyaril irubhadhdhIrAyiraMbherai vèDhDhibhbhoDhDhu,

dhamasghughghaDhudhdha jhIriyAvile dhANaiya~NghaLai vaidhdhAன; jhIriyar dhAvIdhaijh jhevidhdhu, avaனughghugh ghabhbha~NghaDhDhiனArghaL; dhAvIdhu bhoன iDhadhdhilèllAM, ghardhdhar avaனaigh ghAbhbhARRiனAr.
AdhAdhejhariன jhevagharuDhaiya bhòRbharijhaighaLaidh dhAvIdhu èDhudhdhu, avaighaLai èrujhalemughghugh ghòNDhuvandhAன.
AdhAdhejhariன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLAghiya bhedhdhAghiluM bheròdhdhAyilumirundhu dhAvIdhurAjA maghA dhiraLAன vèNghaladhdhaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhuvandhAன:
dhAvIdhu AdhAdhejharuDhaiya èllA irANuvadhdhaiyuM muRiya aDhidhdha jhèydhiyai AmAdhdhiன rAjAvAghiya dhoyI gheDhDhabhodhu,

AdhAdhejhar dhoyIyiனmel èbhbhodhuM yudhdhaMbhaNNighghòNDhirundhabhaDhiyAl, rAjAvAghiya dhAvIdhiன jhughajhèydhiyai vijhArighghavuM, avaன AdhAdhejharoDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNi, avaனai muRiya aDhidhdhadhaRghAgha avaனughghu vAzhdhdhudhal jhòllavuM, dhoyI dhaன ghumAraனAghiya yorAmai rAjAviனiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனAன. meluM yorAM dhaன ghaiyile vèLLiyuM bhòனனuM vèNghalamumAன dhaDhDhumuDhDhughaLaigh ghòNDhuvandhAன.
avaன ghòNDhuvandhavaighaLaidh dhAvIdhurAjA ghIzhabhbhaDhudhdhiன jhIriyar, movAbhiyar, aMmoன bhudhdhirar, bhèlisdhar, amaleghghiyar èனனuM jhaghala jAdhiyArghaLiDhadhdhiluM,

reghobhiன ghumAraனAghiya AdhAdhejhar èனனuM jhobhAviன rAjAviனiDhadhdhiluM ghòLLaiyiDhDhadhiluM èDhudhdhu, ghardhdharughghu niyamidhdha vèLLiyoDhuM bhòனனoDhu~NghUDha ghardhdharughghubh bhiradhiShDhaibhaNNiனAன.
dhAvIdhu ubhbhubhbhaLLadhdhAghghile bhadhiனèNNAyiraM jhIriyarai muRiya aDhidhdhudh dhiruMbhiனdhiனAl ghIrdhdhibhèRRAன.

edhomil dhANaiya~NghaLai vaidhdhAன; edhoM è~NghuM avaன dhANaiya~NghaLai vaidhdhadhiனAle, edhomiyar èllAruM dhAvIdhaijh jhevighghiRavarghaLAனArghaL; dhAvIdhu bhoன èllA iDhadhdhiluM ghardhdhar avaனaigh ghAbhbhARRiனAr.
ibhbhaDhiye dhAvIdhu isravel aனaidhdhiனmeluM rAjAvAyirundhAன; avaன dhaனனuDhaiya èllA jaனdhdhiRghuM niyAyamuM nIdhiyuM jhèydhuvandhAன.
jhèruyAviன ghumAraனAghiya yovAbh irANuvadhdhalaivaனAyirundhAன; aghiluUdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yojhabhAdh mandhiriyAyirundhAன.
aghidhUbhiன ghumAraன jhAdhoghghuM, abhiyadhdhAriன ghumAraன aghimèleghghuM AjhAriyarAyirundhArghaL; jhèrAyA jhaMbhiradhiyAyirundhAன.
yoydhAviன ghumAraன bhèனAyA ghiredhdhiyarughghuM bhiledhdhiyarughghuM dhalaivaனAyirundhAன; dhAvIdhiன ghumAraro bhiradhAனighaLAyirundhArghaL.
yoனdhdhAனnimidhdhaM èனனAl dhayavubhèRadhdhaghghavaன èvaனAvadhu jhavuliன vIDhDhAril iனனuM mIdhiyAyirughghiRavaன uNDhA èனRu dhAvIdhu gheDhDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu jhavuliன vIDhDhu velaighghAraனAghiya jhIbhA èனனuM bheruLLavaனaidh dhAvIdhiனiDhadhdhil azhaidhdhuvandhArghaL; rAjA avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: nIdhAனA jhIbhA èனRu gheDhDhAன; avaன aDhiyeனdhAன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: dhevaனnimidhdhaM nAன jhavuliன ghuDhuMbhadhdhArughghudh dhayaijhèyyuMbhaDhi avaன vIDhDhAril yAdhòruvaன iனனuM mIdhiyAy irughghiRAனA èனRu gheDhDhadhaRghu, jhIbhA rAjAvaibh bhArdhdhu: iனனuM yoனdhdhAனughghu iraNDhu ghAlghaLuM muDhamAன òru ghumAraன irughghiRAன èனRAன.
avaன è~Nghe èனRu rAjA gheDhDhadhaRghu, jhIbhA rAjAvaibh bhArdhdhu: idho, avaன lodhebhArile aMmiyeliன ghumAraனAghiya mAghIriன vIDhDhil irughghiRAன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhurAjA avaனai lodhebhArilirughghiRa aMmiyeliன ghumAraனAghiya mAghIriன vIDhDhilirundhu azhaibhbhidhdhAன.

jhavuliன ghumAraனAghiya yoனdhdhAனiன maghaன mevibhojhedh dhAvIdhiனiDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu, mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhuvaNa~NghiனAன; abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhu: mevibhojhedhdhe èனRAன; avaன: idho, aDhiyeன èனRAன.

dhAvIdhu avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: nI bhayabhbhaDhAdhe; uன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya yoனdhdhAனnimidhdhaM nAன nijhjhayamAy uனghghudh dhayaijhèydhu, uன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya jhavuliன nila~NghaLaiyèllAM uனghghudh dhiruMbhaghghòDhubhbheன; nI èன bhandhiyil nidhdhaM abhbhaM bhujhibhbhAy èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன vaNa~Nghi: jhèdhdha nAyaibhbholirughghiRa èனனai nIr noghghibhbhArghghiRadhaRghu, umadhu aDhiyAன èMmAdhdhiraM èனRAன.
rAjA jhavuliன velaighghAraனAghiya jhIbhAvai azhaibhbhidhdhu, avaனai noghghi: jhavulughghuM avar vIDhDhAr èllArughghuM irundha yAvaiyuM uன èjamAனuDhaiya ghumAraனughghugh ghòDhudhdheன.

AghaiyAl nI uன ghumAraraiyuM uன velaighghAraraiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, uன èjamAனuDhaiya ghumAraன bhujhighgha abhbhaM uNDhAyirughghuMbhaDhi, andha niladhdhaibh bhayiriDhDhu adhiன bhalaனaijh jherbhbhAyAgha; uன èjamAனuDhaiya ghumAraன mevibhojhedh nimidhdhaM èன bhandhiyile abhbhaM bhujhibhbhAன èனRAன; jhIbhAvughghubh bhadhiனaindhu ghumAraruM irubhadhu velaighghAraruM irundhArghaL.

jhIbhA, rAjAvai noghghi: rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaன dhamadhu aDhiyAனughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiyèllAM umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya nAன jhèyveன èனRAன. rAjaghumAraril òruvaனaibhbhola, mevibhojhedh èன bhandhiyile ajhaனMbhaNNuvAன èனRu rAjA jhòனனAன.
mevibhojhedhdhiRghu mIghA èனனuM bheruLLa jhiRuvaனAghiya òru ghumAraன irundhAன, jhIbhAviன vIDhDhile ghuDhiyirundha yAvaruM mevibhojhedhdhiRghu velaighghArarAyirundhArghaL.
mevibhojhedh rAjAviன bhandhiyil nidhdhaM ajhaனMbhaNNughiRavaனAyirundhabhaDhiyiனAl, èrujhalemile ghuDhiyirundhAன; avaனughghu iraNDhu ghAluM muDhamAyirundhadhu.
adhaனbhiனbhu aMmoன bhudhdhirariன rAjA maridhdhubhbhoனAன; avaன ghumAraனAghiya AனUன avaன bhaDhDhadhdhiRghu rAjAvAனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhu: AனUனiன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya nAghAs èனghghudh dhayavujhèydhadhubhola, avaன ghumAraனAghiya ivaனughghu nAன dhayaijhèyveன èனRu jhòlli, avaன dhaghabhbhaனughghAgha avaனughghu ARudhal jhòlla, dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai aனubhbhiனAன; dhAvIdhiன UzhiyaghghArar aMmoன bhudhdhirariன dhejhadhdhile vandhabhodhu,

aMmoன bhudhdhirariன bhirabhughghaL dha~NghaL ANDhavaனAghiya AனUனaibh bhArdhdhu dhAvIdhu ARudhal jhòllughiRavarghaLai uMmiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனdhu, uMmuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaனaigh ghaனMbhaNNughiRadhAy umaghghudh dhoனRughiRadho? indhabh bhaDhDhaNadhdhai ArAyndhu, uLavubhArdhdhu adhaigh ghavizhdhdhubhbhoDha allavo dhAvIdhu dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai uMmiDhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiனAன èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu AனUன: dhAvIdhiன UzhiyaghghAraraibh bhiDhidhdhu, avarghaLuDhaiya òrubhaghghadhdhudh dhADhiyaijh jhiraidhdhu, avarghaLuDhaiya vasdhira~NghaLai irubhbhiDhamaDhDhuM vaidhdhuviDhDhu maRRabhbhAdhiyaigh ghadhdharidhdhubhbhoDhDhu, avarghaLai aனubhbhiviDhDhAன.

adhu dhAvIdhughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhabhodhu, rAjA, andha maனuShar mighavuM vèDhghabhbhaDhDhabhaDhiyiனAl, avarghaLughghu èdhirAgha ADhghaLai aனubhbhi, u~NghaL dhADhi vaLarumaDhDhuM nI~NghaL èrighovilirundhu, bhiRbhADhu vAru~NghaL èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAன.

aMmoன bhudhdhirar dhA~NghaL dhAvIdhughghu aruvarubhbhAனdhaigh ghaNDhabhodhu, sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhi, bhèdhreghobh dhejhadhdhujh jhIriyariluM, jhobhAvilirughghiRa jhIriyariluM irubhadhiனAyiraM ghAlADhghaLaiyuM, mAghghAdhejhadhdhu rAjAviனiDhadhdhil AyiraMbheraiyuM, iShdhobhilirughghiRa bhaனனIrAyiraMbheraiyuM ghUlibhbhaDhaiyAgha azhaibhbhidhdhArghaL.

adhaRghu avaL: veNDhAM, èன jhaghodharaனe, èனனai avamAனbhbhaDhudhdhAdhe, isravelile ibhbhaDhijh jhèyyadhdhaghAdhu; ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha madhigheDhAன ghAriyadhdhaijh jhèyyaveNDhAM.
nAன èன vèDhghadhdhoDhe è~Nghe bhoveன? nIyuM isravelile madhighèDhDhavarghaLil òruvaனaibhbhola AvAy; ibhbhodhuM nI rAjAvoDhe bhejhu, avar èனனai uனghghudh dharAmal maRughghamADhDhAr èனRAL.

jhAdhoghghiன ghumAraனAghiya aghimAs: ghardhdhar rAjAvai avar jhadhdhurughghaLiன ghaighghu nI~NghalAghghi niyAya~njhèydhAr èனனuM jhèydhiyai avarughghugh ghòNDhubhogha, nAன oDhaDhDhume èனRAன.

yovAbh avaனai noghghi: iனRaiyadhiனM nI jhèydhiyaigh ghòNDhubhoghagh ghUDhAdhu; iனனòrunALile nI jhèydhiyaigh ghòNDhubhoghalAM; rAjAviன ghumAraன jhèdhdhabhaDhiyiனAl, iனRaighghu nI jhèydhiyaigh ghòNDhubhoghaveNDhAM èனRu jhòlli,
yovAbh ghUShiyai noghghi: nI bhoy ghaNDhadhai rAjAvughghu aRivi èனRAன; ghUShi yovAbhai vaNa~Nghi oDhiனAன.

jhAdhoghghiன ghumAraனAghiya aghimAs iனனuM yovAbhai noghghi: èbhbhaDhiyAனAluM ghUShiyiன bhiRaghAle nAனuM oDhaDhDhume èனRu dhiruMbhagh gheDhDhadhaRghu, yovAbh: èன maghaனe, jhòlluMbhaDhighghu uனghghu nallajhèydhi illAdhirughghaiyil, nI oDhaveNDhiyadhu èனன èனRAன.
adhaRghu avaன: èbhbhaDhiyAனAluM nAன oDhuveன èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu yovAbh: oDhu èனRAன; abhbhaDhiye aghimAs jhamaனAன bhUmivazhiyAyoDhi ghUShighghu mundhighghòNDhAன.

dhAvIdhu iraNDhu òlimughagh ghèvuனi vAjhalughghu naDhuvAgha uDhghArndhirundhAன; jAma~NghAghghiRavaன ala~NghadhdhilirughghiRa ghèvuனiyiனmel naDhandhu, dhaன ghaNghaLaidh eRèDhudhdhu, òru maனuShaன dhaனiye oDhivarughiRadhaigh ghaNDhu,
ghUbhbhiDhDhu rAjAvughghu aRividhdhAன; abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: avaன òruvaனAy vandhAl avaன vAyile nallajhèydhi irughghuM èனRAன; avaன oDhi ghiDhDhavaruMbhodhu,

jAma~NghAghghiRavaன, veRòruvaன oDhivarughiRadhaigh ghaNDhu: adho bhiனனòruvaன dhaனiye oDhivarughiRAன èனRu vAjhal ghAghghiRavaனoDhe ghUbhbhiDhDhujhjhòனனAன: abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: avaனuM nalla jhèydhi ghòNDhuvarughiRavaன èனRAன.

meluM jAma~NghAghghiRavaன mundhiனvaனuDhaiya oDhDhaM jhAdhoghghiன maghaன aghimAjhuDhaiya oDhDhaMbholighghiRadhu èனRu èனghghudh dhoனRughiRadhu èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: avaன nalla maனuShaன; avaன nalla jhèydhi jhòlla varughiRAன èனRAன.

aghimAs vandhu rAjAvai noghghi: jhamAdhAனM èனRu jhòlli, mugha~NghubhbhuRavizhundhu, rAjAvai vaNa~Nghi, rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavarughghu virodhamAydh dha~NghaL ghaighaLai èDhudhdha maனuSharai òbhbhughghòDhudhdhirughghiRa uMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu sdhodhdhiraM uNDhAvadhAgha èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: bhiLLaiyANDhAனAghiya abhjhaloM jhughamAyirughghiRAனA èனRu gheDhDhadhaRghu, aghimAs yovAbh rAjAviன velaighghArayuM uMmuDhaiya aDhiyAனaiyuM aனubhbhughiRabhodhu, òrubhèriya jhandhaDhiyirundhadhu; AனAluM adhu iனனdhèனRu dhèriyAdhu èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: nI a~Nghebhoy nil èனRAன; avaன òru bhaghghadhdhil bhoy niனRAன.
idho, ghUShi vandhu: rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனe, naRjhèydhi, iனRu ghardhdhar umaghghu virodhamAy èzhuMbhiன èllAriன ghaighghuM uMmai nI~NghalAghghi niyAya~njhèydhAr èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA ghUShiyaibh bhArdhdhu: bhiLLaiyANDhAனAghiya abhjhaloM jhughamAyirughghiRAனA èனRu gheDhDhadhaRghu, ghUShi èனbhavaன: andhabh bhiLLaiyANDhAனughghu naDhandhadhubhola rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனuDhaiya jhadhdhurughghaLughghuM, bhòllAbhbhujh jhèyya umaghghu virodhamAy èzhuMbhughiRa yAvarughghuM naDhaghghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA mighavuM ghala~Nghi, ghèvuனivAjhaliன melvIDhDhiRghuL eRibhbhoy azhudhAன; avaன eRibhbhoghaiyil: èன maghaனAghiya abhjhalome, èன maghaனe, èன maghaனAghiya abhjhalome, nAன uனghghubh bhadhilAghajh jhèdhdheனAனAl nalamAyirughghuM; abhjhalome, èன maghaனe, èன maghaனe, èனRu jhòlli azhudhAன.
idho, rAjA abhjhalomughghAgha azhudhu bhulaMbhughiRAr èனRu yovAbhughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.
rAjA dhaMmuDhaiya ghumAraனughghAgha maனMnòndhirughghiRAr èனRu aனRaiyadhiனM jaன~NghaL gheLvibhbhaDhDhArghaL; adhiனimidhdhaM aனRaiyadhiனM andhajèyaM jaனdhdhiRghèllaM dhughghamAy mARiRRu.
yudhdhadhdhil muRindhoDhughiRadhiனAl vèDhghabhbhaDhDhudh dhiruDhDhaLavAy varughivaRarghaLbhola, jaன~NghaL aனRaiyadhiனM dhiruDhDhaLavAybh bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghuL vandhArghaL.
rAjA dhaன mughadhdhai mUDhighghòNDhu, maghA jhadhdhamAy: èன maghaனAghiya abhjhalome, abhjhalomAghiya èன maghaனe, èன maghaனe èனRu alaRighghòNDhirundhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu yovAbh vIDhDhiRghuLLe rAjAviனiDhadhdhil bhoy: iனRu uMmuDhaiya jIvaனaiyuM, uMmuDhaiya ghumArar ghumAradhdhighaLiன jIvaனaiyuM, uMmuDhaiya maனaivighaLiன jIvaனaiyuM, uMmuDhaiya maRumaனaiyADhDhighaLiன jIvaனaiyuM dhabhbhuvidhdha uMmuDhaiya UzhiyaghghArar èllAriன mughadhdhaiyuM vèDhghabhbhaDhudhiனIr; iனRu nIr uMmaibh bhaghaighghiRavarghaLaijh jhineghidhdhu, uMmaijh jhineghighghiRavarghaLaibh bhaghaighghiRIr èனRu viLa~NghughiRadhu.

adhibhadhighaLuM jhevagharuM umaghghu aRbhamAனvarghaL èனRu iனRu viLa~NghabhbhaNNughiRIr; abhjhaloM uyiroDhirundhu, nA~NghaL aனaivaruM iனRu jhèdhdhubhbhoனAl, abhbhòzhudhu uMmuDhaiya bhArvaighghu nalamAyirughghuM èனRu iனRu aRindhughòNDheன.

ibhbhodhuM èzhundhirundhu vèLiye vandhu, uMmuDhaiya UzhiyaghghAraroDhe aனbhAybh bhejhuM; nIr vèLiye varAdhirundhAl, iனRu iravu òruvaruM uMήoDhe dha~Nghiyirubhbhadhillai èனRu ghardhdharmel ANaiyiDhughiReன; abhbhòzhudhu uMmuDhaiya jhiRuvayadhu mudhal idhuvaraighghuM umaghghu neriDhDha èllAdh dhImaiyaibhbhArghghiluM, adhu umaghghu adhigha dhImaiyAyirughghuM èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA èzhundhubhoy, òlimughavAjhalil uDhghArndhAன; idho, rAjA òlimughavAjhalil uDhghArndhirughghiRAr èனRu jhaghala jaன~NghaLughghuM aRivighghabhbhaDhDhabhodhu, jaன~NghaL èllAruM rAjAvughghu muனbhAgha vandhArghaL; isravelarovèனil avaravar dha~NghaL ghUDhAra~NghaLughghu oDhibhbhoனArghaL.

israveluDhaiya jhaghala ghodhdhira~NghaLilumuLLa jhaghala jaன~NghaLughghuLLuM vAghghuvAdhaM uNDhAghi, avarghaL: rAjA naMmuDhaiya jhadhdhurughghaLiன ghaighghu naMmai nI~NghalAghghiviDhDhAr, avardhAனe bhèlisdhariன ghaighghu naMmaidh dhabhbhuvidhdhAr; ibhbhodho abhjhalomughghudh dhabhbha, dhejhadhdhaiviDhDhu oDhibhbhoனAr.
namaghghu rAjAvAgha abhiSheghaMbhaNNivaidhdha abhjhaloM yudhdhadhdhile jhèdhdhAன; ibhbhodhuM rAjAvaidhdhiruMbha azhaidhdhu varAmal nI~NghaL jhuMmAyirubhbhAனeன èனRu jhòllighghòNDhArghaL

ibhbhaDhi isravelar èllAruMbhejhighòNDhirughghiRadhu, rAjA irughghiRa vIDhDhile avarughghugh gheLviyAனbhaDhiyiனAl, dhAvIdhurAjA jhAdhogh abhiyadhdhAr èனனuM AjhAriyarghaLiDhadhdhughghu AL aனubhbhi, nI~NghaL mUbhbharoDhe bhejhi: rAjAvaidh dhaMmuDhaiya vIDhDhughghudh dhiruMbha azhaidhdhuvara nI~NghaL maRRavarghaLughghubh bhindhibhbhovAனeன?
nI~NghaL avaன jhaghodharar, nI~NghaL èன èluMbhuM èன mAMjhamumAனvarghaL; rAjAvaidh dhiruMbha azhaidhdhuvara nI~NghaL bhindhiனvarghaLAyirubhbhAனeன èனRu jhòllu~NghaL.

nI~NghaL amAjhAvaiyuM noghghi: nI èன èluMbhuM èன mAMjhamuM allavo? nI yovAbhughghubh bhadhilAgha ènnALuM èனghghu muனbhAghabh bhaDhaidhdhalaivaனAyirAviDhDhAl, dhevaன adhaRghujh jhariyAghavuM adhaRghu adhighamAghavuM èனghghujh jhèyyaghghaDhavar èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAன.

ibhbhaDhiye yUdhAviன jhaghala maனuSharuDhaiya irudhayadhdhaiyuM òru maனuShaனuDhaiya irudhayadhdhaibhbhol iNa~NghabhbhaNNiனdhiனAl, avarghaL rAjAvughghu: nIr uMmuDhaiya èllA UzhiyaghghAraroDhuM dhiruMbhivAruM èனRu jhòlli aனubhbhiனArghaL.
rAjA dhiruMbha varughiRadhaRghu yordhAனmaDhDhuM vandhabhodhu, yUdhA ghodhdhiradhdhAr: rAjAvughghu èdhirghòNDhubhoy, rAjAvai yordhAனaigh ghaDhaghghabhbhaNNa ghilghAlmaDhDhuM vandhArghaL.
bhaghUriM UrAனAன bhèனyamIனனAghiya gherAviன maghaன jhImeyiyuM dhIviridhdhu, yUdhA maனuSharoDhu~NghUDhadh dhAvIdhu rAjAvughghu èdhirghòNDhubhoனAன.

avaனoDhe bhèனyamIன maனuShar AyiraMbheruM, jhavuliன vIDhDhu velaighghAraனAghiya jhIbhAvuM, ANDhavaனuDhaiya bhadhiனaindhu ghumAraruM, avaனuDhaiya irubhadhu velaighghAraruM irundhArghaL; avarghaL rAjAvughghu muனbhAgha yordhAனai veghamAygh ghaDhandhubhoனArghaL.

avarghaL rAjAviன vIDhDhArai ighgharaibhbhaDhudhdhavuM, avaன viruMbhuM ghAriyadhdhughghu udhavavuM, òru bhaDhaghu ighgharaiyile vandhadhu; abhbhòzhudhu gherAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhImeyi yordhAனaigh ghaDhaghghabhbhoghiRa rAjAvughghu muனbhAghadh dhAzhavizhundhu,

rAjAvai noghghi: èன ANDhavaன èன aghghiramadhdhai èனmel jhumadhdhAmaluM, rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaன èrujhalemilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu varughiRa nALile, umadhu aDhiyAன jhèydha dhuroghadhdhai rAjA niனaighghAmaluM, dhamadhu maனdhil vaighghAmaluM irubhbhArAgha.
umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya nAன bhAva~njhèydheன èனRu aRindhirughghiReன; ibhbhodhuM, idho, rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனughghu èdhirghòNDhuvara, yojhebhbhu vIDhDhAr aனaivarughghuM nAன iனRu mundhighghòNDheன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu jhèruyAviன ghumAraனAghiya abhijhAy bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: ghardhdhar abhiSheghaMbhaNNiனvaraijh jhImeyi dhUShidhdhabhaDhiyiனAl, avaனai adhaRghAghagh ghòllaveNDhAmA èனRAன.

adhaRghudh dhAvIdhu: jhèruyAviன ghumArare, iனRu nI~NghaL èனghghujh jhadhdhurughghaLAghiRadhaRghu, èனghghuM u~NghaLughghuM èனன? iனRu isravelil òruvaன ghòllabhbhaDhalAmA? iனRu nAன israveliனmel rAjAvAனeன èனRu èனghghudh dhèriyAdhA èனRu jhòlli,
rAjA jhImeyiyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI jhAvadhillai èனRu avaனughghu ANaiyiDhDhAன.

jhavuliன ghumaraனAghiya mevibhojhedhdhuM rAjAvughghu èdhirghòNDhuvandhAன; rAjA bhoனnALmudhal, avaன jhamAdhAனdhdhoDhe dhiruMbhivarughiRa nALmaDhDhuM, avaன dhaன ghAlghaLaijh jhudhdhaMbhaNNavumillai, dhaன dhADhiyaijh jhavaraMbhaNNavumillai; dhaன vasdhira~NghaLai vèLughghavumillai.
avaன èrujhalemilirundhu rAjAvughghu èdhirghòNDhuvarughiRabhodhu, rAjA avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: mevibhojhedhdhe, nI èனனoDhughUDha varAmalbhoனdhu èனன èனRu gheDhDhAன.

adhaRghu avaன rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனe, èன velaighghAraன èனனai mojhaMbhoghghiனAன; umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya nAன muDhavaனAனbhaDhiyiனAl, òru ghazhudhaiyiனmel jheNaMvaidhdhu adhiனmel eRi, rAjAvoDheghUDhabh bhoghiReன èனRu aDhiyeன jhòனனeன.
avaன rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனiDhadhdhil umadhu aDhiyAனmel vINbhazhi jhòனனAன; rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனo dhevaனuDhaiya dhUdhaனaibhbhola, umadhu bhArvaighghu nalamAydh dhoனRughiRabhaDhi jhèyyuM.

rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனughghumuனbhAgha èன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhAr èllAM jhavulughghu edhuvAyirundhArghaLe òzhiya, maRRabhbhaDhi alla; AனAluM umadhubhandhiyile jhAbhbhiDhughiRavarghaLoDhe umadhu aDhiyeனai vaidhdhIr; iனனuM nAன rAjAviDhadhdhil muRaiyiDha, iனi èனghghu èனன niyAyaM irughghiRadhu èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu rAjA avaனaibhbhArdhdhu: uன ghAriyadhdhaighghuRidhdhu adhighamAybh bhejhuvAனeன? nIyuM jhIbhAvuM niladhdhaibh bha~NghiDhDhughghòLLu~NghaL èனRu nAன jhòllughiReன èனRAன.
adhaRghu mevibhojhedh rAjAvai noghghi: rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaன jhamAdhAனdhdhoDhe dhaMmuDhaiya vIDhDhiRghu vandhirughghuMbhodhu, avaனe èllAvaRRaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòLLaDhDhuM èனRAன.
ghIleyAdhdhiyaனAghiya bharjhilAvuM roghilimilirundhu vandhu, yordhAனmaDhDhuM rAjAvai vazhiviDhDhaனubhbha, avaனoDheghUDha yordhAனiன dhuRaimaDhDhuM ghaDhandhuvandhAன.
bharjhilA èNbhadhu vayadhujhèனRa ghizhavaனAyirundhAன; rAjA maghனAyImile dha~NghiyirughghumaDhDhuM avaனaibh bharAmaridhdhu vandhAன; avaன maghA bhèriyamaனuShaனAyirundhAன.
rAjA bharjhilAvai noghghi: nI èனனoDheghUDhagh ghaDhandhuvA, èrujhalemile uனனai èனனiDhadhdhil vaidhdhu bharAmaribhbheன èனRAன.
bharjhilA rAjAvaibh bhArdhdhu: nAன rAjAvoDheghUDha èrujhalemughghu vara, nAன iனனuM uyiroDhirughghuM Ayujhiன nADhghaL èMmAdhdhiraM?

ibhbhòzhudhu nAன èNbhadhu vayadhuLLavaன; iனi nalamAனdhu iனனdhèனRuM dhIdhAனdhu iனனdhèனRuM èனghghudh dhèriyumo? bhujhighghiRadhuM ghuDhighghiRadhuM umadhu aDhiyeனughghu rujhigharamAyirughghumo? jha~NghIdhaghghArar jha~NghIdhaghghArighaLuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhai iனigh gheDhghaghghUDhumo? umadhu aDhiyeனAghiya nAன iனi rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனughghubh bhAramAyirughghaveNDhiyadhu èனன?
aDhiyeன ghò~njhadhUraM yordhAனmaDhDhuM rAjAvoDheghUDha varuveன; adhaRghu rAjA ivvaLavu bhèriya ubhaghAradhdhai èனghghujh jhèyyaveNDhiyadhu èனன?

nAன èன Urile maridhdhu, èன dhAy dhaghabhbhaனmAr ghallaRaiyile aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhuMbhaDhighghu, umadhu aDhiyAன dhiruMbhibhbhoghaDhDhuM; AனAluM, idho, umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya ghiMghAM rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனoDheghUDha varuvAன; uMmuDhaiya bhArvaighghu nalamAனbhaDhi avaனughghujh jhèyyuM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: ghiMghAM èனனoDheghUDha varaDhDhuM; uன bhArvaighghu nalamAனbhaDhiye nAன avaனughghu naDhabhbhidhdhu, nI èனனiDhadhdhil veNDhighghòLvadhaiyèllAM nAன uனghghujh jhèyveன èனRAன.
jaன~NghaL èllAruM yordhAனaigh ghaDhandhabhodhu, rAjA bharjhilAvai mudhdhamiDhDhu avaனai AjhIrvadhidhdhu, dhAனuM ghaDhandhubhoனAன; avaனo dhaனனiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoyviDhDhAன.
rAjA ghaDhandhu, ghilghAlmaDhDhuM bhoனAன; ghiMghAM avaனoDheghUDhagh ghaDhandhuvandhAன; yUdhA jaனM aனaidhdhuM, isravelil bhAdhijaனmuM, rAjAvai ighgharaibhbhaDhudhdhi vandhabhiனbhu,

idho, isravel maனuShar èllAruM rAjAviனiDhadhdhil vandhu, rAjAvai noghghi: è~NghaL jhaghodhararAghiya yUdhAmaனuShar dhiruDhDhaLavAy uMmai azhaidhdhuvandhu, rAjAvaiyuM, avar vIDhDhAraiyuM, avaroDheghUDha irughghiRa dhAvIdhiன maனuShar aனaivaraiyuM, yordhAனaigh ghaDhaghghabhbhaNNiனdhu èனன èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu yUdhA maனuShar èllAruM isravel maனuSharughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: rAjA è~NghaLaijh jherndhavarAனbhaDhiyiனAl idhaijh jhèydhoM; idhaRghAgha nI~NghaL ghobhibhbhAனeன? nA~NghaL rAjAviன ghaiyile èdhaiyAghiluM vA~Nghidh dhiனRomo? è~NghaLughghu vèghumAனM ghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhadho? èனRArghaL.
