dhAvIdhu ghAlame èzhundhirundhabhodhu, dhAvIdhiன ~nAனdhiruShDhighghAraனAghiya ghAdh èனனuM dhIrghghadharijhighghugh ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai uNDhAghijh jhòனனdhu:
nI dhAvIdhiனiDhadhdhil bhoy, mUனRughAriya~NghaLai uனghghu muனbhAgha vaighghiReன; avaighaLil òru ghAriyadhdhaidh dhèrindhughòL, adhai nAன uனghghujhjhèyveன èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.

abhbhaDhiye ghAdh dhAvIdhiனiDhadhdhil vandhu, avaனai noghghi: uMmuDhaiya dhejhadhdhile ezhu varuShaM bha~njhaM varaveNDhumo, alladhu mUனRumAdhaM uMmuDhaiya jhadhdhurughghaL uMmaibh bhiனdhòDhara, nIr avarghaLughghu muனbhAgha oDhibhbhoghaveNDhumo? alladhu uMmuDhaiya dhejhadhdhile mUனRunAL ghòLLainoy uNDhAghaveNDhumo? ibhbhodhuM èனனai aனubhbhiனvarughghu nAன èனன maRu udhdharavu ghòNDhubhoghaveNDhuM èனbhadhai nIr yojhidhdhubhbhAruM èனRu jhòனனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhu ghardhdharai noghghi: ghòDhiya iDhughghaNil aghabhbhaDhDhirughghiReன, ibhbhodhu nAM ghardhdharuDhaiya ghaiyile vizhuvomAgha; avaruDhaiya iraghgha~NghaL maghA bhèriyadhu; maனuShar ghaiyile vizhAdhirubhbheனAgha èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar isravelile aனRu ghAlame dhòDha~Nghi ghuRidhdhaghAlaMvaraighghuM ghòLLainoyai varabhbhaNNiனAr; adhiனAl dhANmudhal bhèyèrjhèbhAmaDhDhumuLLa jaன~NghaLil èzhubhadhiனAyiraMbher jhèdhdhubhbhoனArghaL.

dhevadhUdhaன èrujhalemai azhighghadhdhaன ghaiyai adhiனmel nIDhDhibhodhu, ghardhdhar andhadh dhI~Nghughghu maனsdhAbhabhbhaDhDhu, jaன~NghaLaijh jha~NgharighghiRa dhUdhaனai noghghi: bhodhuM, ibhbhodhu uன ghaiyai niRudhdhu èனRAr; andha veLaiyil ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன èbhUjhiyaனAghiyA arvaனAviன bhoraDhighghiRa ghaLadhdhiRghu nere irundhAன.

jaனdhdhai ubhAdhighghiRa dhUdhaனai dhAvIdhu ghaNDhabhodhu, avaன ghardhdharai noghghi: idho, nAனdhAன bhAva~njhèydheன; nAனdhAன aghghiramaMbhaNNiனeன; indha ADhughaL èனன jhèydhadhu? uMmuDhaiya ghai èனghghuM èன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhughghuM virodhamAyirubhbhadhAgha èனRu viNNabhbhaMbhaNNiனAன.
aனRaiya dhiனM ghAdh èனbhavaன dhAvIdhiனiDhadhdhil vandhu, avaனai noghghi: nIr bhoy, èbhUjhiyaனAghiya arvaனAviன ghaLadhdhile ghardhdharughghu òru bhalibhIDhadhdhai uNDhAghghuM èனRAன.
ghAdhdhuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye dhAvIdhu ghardhdhar ghaRbhidhdha bhiraghAramAghabh bhoனAன.
arvaனA eRiDhDhubhbhArdhdhu: rAjAvuM avaனuDhaiya UzhiyaghghAraruM dhaனனiDhadhdhil varughiRadhaighghaNDhu, arvaனA èdhirghòNDhubhoy dharaimaDhDhuMghuனindhu rAjAvai vaNa~Nghi,

rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaன dhamadhu aDhiyAனiDhadhdhil varughiRa ghAriyaM èனன èனRu gheDhDhadhaRghu, dhAvIdhu: vAdhai jaனdhdhaiviDhDhu niRudhdhabhbhaDhagh ghardhdharughghu òru bhalibhIDhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhuMbhaDhighghu indhagh ghaLadhdhai uன ghaiyile ghòLLavandheன èனRAன.

arvaனA dhAvIdhaibh bhArdhdhu rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaன idhai vA~NghighghòNDhu, dhaMmuDhaiya bhArvaighghu nalamAனbhaDhi bhaliyiDhuvArAgha; idho, dhaghaனbhalighghu mADhughaLuM viRaghughghubh bhoraDhighghiRa uruLaighaLuM mADhughaLiன nughadhdhaDhighaLuM i~Nghe irughghiRadhu èனRujhòlli,
arvaனA rAjayoghghiyamAy avai èllAvaRRaiyuM rAjAvughghugh ghòDhudhdhabhiனbhu, arvaனA rAjAvai noghghi: uMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uMmiDhadhdhil ghirubhaiyAyirubhbhArAgha èனRAன.

rAjA arvaனAvaibh bhArdhdhu: abhbhaDhiyalla; nAன ilavajhamAy vA~Nghi, èன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhalighaLaijh jhèludhdhAmal, adhai uன ghaiyile vilaighghirayamAy vA~Nghuveன èனRu jhòlli, dhAvIdhu andhagh ghaLadhdhaiyuM mADhughaLaiyuM aiMbhadhu jheghghal niRai vèLLighghugh ghòNDhAன.

a~Nghe dhAvIdhu ghardhdharughghu òru bhalibhIDhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhi, jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhalighaLaiyuM jhamAdhAனbhalighaLaiyuM jhèludhdhiனAன; abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar dhejhadhdhughghAghajh jhèyyabhbhaDhDha veNDhudhalaigh gheDhDharuLiனAr, israveliனmel irundha andha vAdhai niRudhdhabhbhaDhDhadhu.
dhAvIdhurAjA vayadhujhèனRa virdhdhAbhbhiyaனAனbhodhu, vasdhira~NghaLiனAl avaனai mUDhiனAluM, avaனughghu aனl uNDhAghavillai.

abhbhòzhudhu avaனuDhaiya UzhiyaghghArar avaனai noghghi: rAjajhamughadhdhil niனRu, avarughghubh bhaNiviDhai jhèyyavuM, rAjAvAghiya è~NghaL ANDhavaனughghu aனl uNDhAghuMbhaDhi uMmuDhaiya maDhiyile bhaDhudhdhughghòLLavuM ghaனனiyAghiya òru jhiRu bhèNNai rAjAvAghiya è~NghaL ANDhavaனughghudh dheDhuvoM èனRu jhòlli,
israveliன èllaiyilèllAM azhaghAன òru bhèNNaidh dheDhi, jhUனeM UrALAghiya abhiShAghaigh ghaNDhu, avaLai rAjAviனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.
andhabh bhèN vèghu azhaghAyirundhAL; avaL rAjAvughghu udhaviyAyirundhu avaனughghubh bhaNiviDhaijhèydhAL; AனAluM rAjA avaLai aRiyavillai,

AghIdhdhiRghubh bhiRandha adhoனiyA èனbhavaன; nAன rAjA Aveன èனRu jhòlli, dhaனனaidhdhAன uyardhdhi, dhaனghghu iradha~NghaLaiyuM ghudhiraivIraraiyuM, dhaனghghumuன oDhuM aiMbhadhu ghAlADhghaLaiyuM jhaMbhAdhidhdhAன.
avaனuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaன: nI ibhbhaDhijh jhèyvAனeன èனRu avaனai òrughghAluM ghaDhindhughòLLavillai; avaன mighavuM azhaghuLLavaனAyirundhAன; abhjhalomughghubhbhiன avaனuDhaiya dhAy avaனaibh bhèRRAL.
avaன jhèruyAviன ghumAraனAghiya yovAbhoDhuM, AjhAriyaனAghiya abhiyadhdhAroDhuM AlojhaனaibhaNNivandhAன; avarghaL avaனiDhadhdhilirundhu avaனughghu udhavijhèydhuvandhArghaL.

AjhAriyaனAghiya jhAdhoghghuM, yoydhAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhèனAyAvuM, dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya nAdhdhAனuM, jhImeyiyuM, reyiyuM, dhAvIdhoDhirughghiRa bharAghghiramajhAlighaLuM, adhoனiyAvughghu uDhandhaiyAyirughghavillai.

adhoனiyA iனRoghelughghujh jhamIbhamAன jhoghèlèdh èனனuM ghalliன arughe ADhumADhughaLaiyuM ghòzhudhdha jandhughghaLaiyuM aDhidhdhu, rAjAviன ghumArarAghiya dhaன jhaghodharar èllAraiyuM, rAjAviன UzhiyaghghArarAன yUdhAviன maனuShar aனaivaraiyuM azhaidhdhAன.
dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya nAdhdhAனaiyuM, bhèனAyAvaiyuM, bharAghghiramajhAlighaLaiyuM, dhaன jhaghodharaனAghiya jhAlòmoனaiyuM azhaighghavillai.

abhbhòzhudhu nAdhdhAன jhAlòmoனiன dhAyAghiya bhadhjhebhALai noghghi: naMmuDhaiya ANDhavaனAghiya dhAvIdhughghudh dhèriyAmal, AghIdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya adhoனiyA rAjAvAghiRa jhèydhiyai nI gheDhghavillaiyA?
ibhbhodhuM uன bhirANaனaiyuM, uன ghumAraனAghiya jhAlòmoனiன bhirANaனaiyuM dhabhbhuvighghuMbhaDhighghu nI vA, uனghghu nAன Alojhaனai jhòlluveன.

nI dhAvIdhu rAjAviனiDhadhdhil bhoy: rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனe, èனghghubhbhiன uன ghumAraனAghiya jhAlòmoன rAjAvAghi, avaனe èன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel vIRRirubhbhAன èனRu nIr umadhu aDhiyALughghu ANaiyiDhavillaiyA? abhbhaDhiyirughgha, adhoனiyA rAjAvAghiRadhu èனன? èனRu avariDhadhdhil gheL.
nI a~Nghe rAjAvoDhe bhejhighghòNDhirughghaiyil, nAனuM uனghghubh bhiனvandhu, uன vArdhdhaighaLai uRudhibhbhaDhudhdhuveன èனRAன.
abhbhaDhiye bhadhjhebhAL bhaLLiyaRaighghuL rAjAviDhadhdhil bhoனAL; rAjA mighavuM vayadhujhèனRavaனAyirundhAன; jhUனeM UrALAghiya abhiShAgh rAjAvughghubh bhaNiviDhai jhèydhughòNDhirundhAL.
bhadhjhebhAL ghuனindhu, rAjAvai vaNa~NghiனAL; abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: uனghghu èனனveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAன.

adhaRghu avaL: èன ANDhavaனe, èனghghubhbhiன uன ghumAraனAghiya jhAlòmoன rAjAvAghi, avaனe èன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel vIRRirubhbhAன èனRu nIr uMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaigh ghòNDhu, umadhu aDhiyALughghu ANaiyiDhDhIre.
ibhbhòzhudhu, idho, adhoனiyA, rAjAvAghiRAன; èன ANDhavaனAghiya rAjAve, nIr adhai aRiyavillai.

avaன mADhughaLaiyuM ghòzhudhdha jandhughghaLaiyuM ADhughaLaiyuM dhiraLAgha aDhidhdhu, rAjAviன ghumArar aனaivaraiyuM AjhAriyaனAghiya abhiyadhdhAraiyuM, yovAbh èனனuM bhaDhaidhdhalaivaனaiyuM azhaidhdhAன; AனAluM umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya jhAlòmoனai azhaighghavillai.

rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனe, rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனughghubhbhiRaghu avaruDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel vIRRirubhbhavaன iனனAன èனRu dha~NghaLughghu aRivighghaveNDhuM èனRu isravelar aனaivariன ghaNghaLuM uMmai noghghigh ghòNDhirughghiRadhu.
aRiviyAmaRbhoனAl rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaன dhaMmuDhaiya bhidhAghghaLoDhe bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhabhiனbhu, nAனuM èன ghumAraனAghiya jhAlòmoனuM ghuRRavALighaLAy èNNabhbhaDhuvoM èனRAL.
avaL rAjAvoDhe bhejhighghòNDhirughghaiyil, dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya nAdhdhAன vandhAன.
dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya nAdhdhAன vandhirughghiRAr èனRu rAjAvughghudh dhèrividhdhArghaL; avaன rAjAvughghu muனbhAghabh bhiravejhidhdhu mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhu rAjAvai vaNa~NghiனAன.
nAdhdhAன: rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனe, adhoனiyA èனghghubh bhiன rAjAvAghi, avaனe èன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiன mel vIRRirubhbhAன èனRu nIr jhòனனdhuNDho?

avaன iனRaiyadhiனM bhoy, mADhughaLaiyuM ghòzhudhdha jandhughghaLaiyuM ADhughaLaiyuM dhiraLAgha aDhidhdhu, rAjAviன ghumArar aனaivaraiyuM irANuvadhdhalaivaraiyuM, AjhAriyaனAghiya abhiyadhdhAraiyuM azhaidhdhAன; avarghaL avaனughghu muனbhAghabh bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdhu, rAjAvAghiya adhoனiyA vAzhgha èனRu jhòllughiRArghaL.
AனAluM umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya èனனaiyuM, AjhAriyaனAghiya jhAdhoghghaiyuM, yoydhAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhèனAyAvaiyuM, umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya jhAlòmoனaiyuM avaன azhaighghavillai.

rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனughghubhbhiன dhamadhu jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhil vIRRirubhbhavaன ivaன dhAன èனRu nIr umadhu aDhiyAனughghudh dhèrivighghAdhirughghaiyil, indhagh ghAriyaM rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaன ghaDhDhaLaiyAl naDhandhirughghumo èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu dhAvIdhurAjA bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: bhadhjhebhALai èனனiDhadhdhil varavazhaiyu~NghaL èனRAன; avaL rAjajhamughadhdhil bhiravejhidhdhu rAjAvughghu muனனe niனRAL.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: uன ghumAraனAghiya jhAlòmoன èனghghubhbhiன arajhANDhu, avaனe èன sdhAனdhdhil èன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel vIRRirubhbhAன èனRu nAன uனghghu israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharmel ANaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye, iனRaighghujh jhèydhu dhIrbhbheன èனbhadhai,
èன AdhdhumAvai èllA ighghaDhDhughghuM nI~NghalAghghi mIDhDha ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRu ANaiyiDhDhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhadhjhebhAL dharaimaDhDhuM ghuனindhu rAjAvai vaNa~Nghi, èன ANDhavaனAghiya dhAvIdhurAjA èனRaighghuM vAzhgha èனRAL.
bhiனbhu dhAvIdhurAjA, AjhAriyaனAghiya jhAdhoghghaiyuM dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya nAdhdhAனaiyuM yoydhAviன ghumAraன bhèனAyAvaiyuM èனனiDhadhdhil varavazhaiyu~NghaL èனRAன.

avarghaL rAjAvughghu muனbhAghabh bhiravejhidhdhabhodhu, rAjA avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL u~NghaL ANDhavaனuDhaiya jhevagharaigh ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, èன ghumAraனAghiya jhAlòmoனai èன ghoveRughazhudhaiyiனmel eRRi, avaனaigh ghIghoனughghu azhaidhdhughghòNDhu bho~NghaL.

a~Nghe AjhAriyAghiya jhAdhoghghuM dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya nAdhdhAனuM avaனai israveliன mel rAjAvAgha abhiSheghaM bhaNNaghghaDhavarghaL; bhiனbhu èghghALM Udhi, rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன vAzhgha èனRu vAzhdhdhu~NghaL.

adhiனbhiனbhu avaன nagharvalaM vandhu, èன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhil vIRRirughghuMbhaDhi, avaனaigh ghUDhDhighghòNDhu vAru~NghaL; avaனe èன sdhAனdhdhil rAjAvAyirubhbhAன; avaன israveliனmeluM yUdhAviனmeluM dhalaivaனAyirughghuMbhaDhi avaனai eRbhaDhudhdhiனeன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu yoydhAviன ghumAraன bhèனAyA rAjAvughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: Amèன, rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuM ibhbhaDhiye jhòlvArAgha.

ghardhdhar rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனoDhe èbhbhaDhi irundhAro, abhbhaDhiye avar jhAlòmoனoDhuM irundhu, dhAvIdhu rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனuDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhaibhbhArghghiluM avaruDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhaibh bhèridhAghghuvArAgha èனRAன.

abhbhaDhiye AjhAriyaனAghiya jhAdhoghghuM, dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya nAdhdhAனuM, yoydhAviன ghumAraன bhèனAyAvuM, ghiredhdhiyaruM bhiledhdhiyaruM bhoy, jhAlòmoனaidh dhAvIdhu rAjAviனuDhaiya ghoveRughazhudhaiyiனmel eRRi, avaனaigh ghIghoனughghu naDhadhdhighghòNDhubhoனArghaL.

AjhAriyaனAghiya jhAdhoghghu dhailaghghòMbhaigh ghUDhAradhdhilirundhu èDhudhdhugh ghòNDhubhoy, jhAlòmoனai abhiSheghaMbhaNNiனAன; abhbhòzhudhu èghghALaM Udhi, jaன~NghaLèllAruM rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன vAzhgha èனRu vAzhdhdhiனArghaL.
bhiRbhADhu jaன~NghaLèllAruM avaன bhiRaghAle bhoனArghaL; jaன~NghaL nAghajhura~NghaLai Udhi, bhUmi avarghaL jhadhdhadhdhiனAl adhiradhdhaghghadhAgha maghA bhUribhbhAyjh jhandhoShidhdhArghaL.

adhoனiyAvuM avaனoDhirundha èllA virundhALighaLuM bhojaனM bhaNNi muDhindhabhodhu adhaigh gheDhDhArghaL; yovAbh èghghALajhadhdhadhdhaigh gheDhDhabhodhu, nagharadhdhil uNDhAyirughghiRa AravAraM èனன èனRu vijhAridhdhAன.
avaன bhejhighghòNDhirughghaiyil, AjhAriyaனAghiya abhiyadhdhAriன ghumAraன yoனdhdhAன vandhAன; abhbhòzhudhu adhoனiyA, uLLe vA, nI ghèDhDhighghAraன, nI naRjhèydhi ghòNDhuvarughiRavaன èனRAன.
yoனdhdhAன adhoனiyAvughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: edhu, dhAvIdhurAjAvAghiya naMmuDhaiya ANDhavaன jhAlòmoனai rAjAvAghghiனAre.

rAjA AjhAriyaனAghiya jhAdhoghghaiyuM, dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya nAdhdhAனaiyuM, yoydhAviன ghumAraன bhèனAyAvaiyuM, ghiredhdhiyaraiyuM bhiledhdhiyaraiyuM avaனoDhe aனubhbhiனAr; avarghaL avaனai rAjAvuDhaiya ghoveRughazhudhaiyiனmel eRRiனArghaL.

AjhAriyaனAghiya jhAdhoghghuM, dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya nAdhdhAனuM, avaனaigh ghIghoனile rAjAvAgha abhiSheghaMbhaNNiனArghaL; nagharamèllAM muzha~NghadhdhaghghadhAgha a~Ngheyirundhu bhUribhbhoDhe bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனArghaL; nI~NghaL gheDhDha iraijhjhal adhudhAன.
allAmaluM jhAlòmoன rAjA~Nghadhdhughghuriya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel vIRRirughghiRAன.

rAjAviன UzhiyaghghAraruM dhAvIdhu rAjAvAghiya naMmuDhaiya ANDhavaனai vAzhdhdhudhal jhèyyavandhu: dhevaன jhAlòmoனiன nAmadhdhai uMmuDhaiya nAmadhdhaibhbhArghghiluM bhirabhalabhaDhudhdhi, avaruDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhai uMmuDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhaibh bhArghghiluM bhèridhAghghuvArAgha èனRArghaL; rAjA dhaMmuDhaiya ghaDhDhiliனmel ghuனindhu bhaNindhughòNDhAr.
bhiனனuM rAjA: èனனuDhaiya ghaNghaL ghANa iனRaiyadhiனM èன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel òruvaனai vIRRirughghajh jhèydha israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu sdhodhdhiraM èனRu jhòனனAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu adhoனiyAviன virundhALighaLèllAruM adhirndhu èzhundhirundhu, avaravar dha~NghaL vazhiye bhoyviDhDhArghaL.
adhoனiyA, jhAlòmoனughghubh bhayandhadhiனAl èzhundhubhoy, bhalibhIDhadhdhiன ghòMbhughaLaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhAன.

idho, adhoனiyA rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoனughghubh bhayabhbhaDhughiRAன èனRuM, idho, avaன bhalibhIDhadhdhiன ghòMbhughaLaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu, rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன dhamadhu aDhiyAனaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhAle ghòனRubhoDhuvadhillai èனRu iனRu èனghghu ANaiyiDhuvArAgha èனghiRAன èனRuM, jhAlòmoனughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu jhAlòmoன: avaன yoghghiyaன èனRu viLa~Ngha naDhandhu ghòNDhAl avaன dhalaimayiril òனRuM dharaiyile vizhabhbhoghiRadhillai; avaனiDhadhdhil bhòllAbhbhugh ghANabhbhaDhumeyAghil, avaன jhAghaveNDhuM èனRAன.
avaனaibh bhalibhIDhadhdhilirundhu ghòNDhuvara, rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன ADhghaLai aனubhbhiனAன; avaன vandhu, rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoனai vaNa~NghiனAன; jhAlòmoன avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: uன vIDhDhiRghubh bho èனRAன.
dhAvIdhu maraNamaDhaiyuM ghAlaM jhamIbhadhdhabhodhu, avaன dhaன ghumAraனAghiya jhAlòmoனughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhujh jhòனனdhu:
nAன bhUloghadhdhAr yAvaruM bhoghiRa vazhiye bhoghiReன; nI dhiDhaன ghòNDhu bhuruShaனAyiru.

nI èனன jhèydhAluM, nI è~Nghe bhoனAluM, èllAvaRRiluM bhudhdhimAனAyirughghiRadhaRghuM, ghardhdhar èனனaigh ghuRidhdhu: uன bhiLLaighaL dha~NghaL muzhu irudhayadhdhoDhuM dha~NghaL muzhu AdhdhumAvoDhuM èனghghu muனbhAgha uNmaiyAy naDhaghghuMbhaDhighghudh dha~NghaL vazhiyaigh ghAdhdhughghòNDhAl, israveliன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel vIRRirughghadhdhaghgha bhuruShaன uனghghu illAmaRbhovadhillai èனRu jhòனன dhaMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaidh dhiDhabhbhaDhudhdhughiRadhaRghuM,

mojheyiன niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhil èzhudhiyirughghiRabhaDhi, nI uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM, ghaRbhaனaighaLaiyuM, niyAya~NghaLaiyuM, jhADhjhighaLaiyuM ghaighghòLLa, avar vazhighaLil naDhaghghuM bhaDhighghu avaruDhaiya ghAvalaigh ghAbhbhAyAgha.

jhèruyAviன ghumAraனAghiya yovAbh, israveliன iraNDhu jheனAbhadhighaLAghiya neriன ghumAraன abhனerughghuM, edhdheriன ghumAraன amAjhAvughghuM jhèydhaghAriyadhdhiனAl èனghghujh jhèydha ghuRRadhdhai nI aRindhirughghiRAye; avaன avarghaLaigh ghòனRu, jhamAdhAனghAladhdhile yudhdhaghAladhdhu iradhdhadhdhaijh jhindhi, yudhdhaghAladhdhu iradhdhadhdhaidh dhaன araiyiluLLa dhaன ghAlghaLil irundha bhAdharaDhjhaiyiluM vaDhiyaviDhDhAனe.
AghaiyAl uன yughdhiyiனbhaDhiye nI jhèydhu, avaனuDhaiya naraimayir jhamAdhAனmAybh bhAdhALadhdhil iRa~NghavòDhDhAdhiru.

ghIleyAdhdhiyaனAன bharjhilAyiன ghumArarughghudh dhayaijhèyvAyAgha; avarghaL uன bhandhiyile jhAbhbhiDhughiRavarghaLuDhaன irubhbhArghaLAgha; uன jhaghodharaனAghiya abhjhalomughghu muனbhAgha nAன oDhibhbhoghaiyil, avarghaL èனனai AdharidhdhArghaL.

meluM bhaghUriM UrAனAன bhèனyamIனனAghiya gherAviன maghaன jhImeyi uனனiDhadhdhil irughghiRAன; nAன maghனAyImughghubh bhoghiRa nALile, avaன èனனaigh ghòDhiya dhUShaNamAydh dhUShidhdhAன; AனAluM avaன yordhAனile èனghghu èdhirghòNDhuvandhabhaDhiyiனAl: nAன uனனaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhAle ghòனRubhoDhuvadhillai èனRu ghardhdharmel avaனughghu ANaiyiDhDhughghòDhudhdheன.
AghiluM nI avaனaigh ghuRRamaRRavaன èனRu èNNAdhe; nI bhudhdhimAன; avaனuDhaiya naraimayirai iradhdhadhdhuDhaன bhAdhALadhdhil iRa~NghabhbhaNNa, nI avaனughghujh jhèyyaveNDhiyadhai aRivAy èனRAன.
bhiனbhu dhAvIdhu dhaன bhidhAghghaLoDhe nidhdhiraiyaDhaindhu, dhAvIdhiன nagharadhdhil aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன.
dhAvIdhu isravelai arajhANDha nADhghaL nARbhadhu varuShaM; avaன èbhroனil ezhu varuShamuM, èrujhalemil mubhbhadhdhumUனRu varuShamuM arajhANDhAன.
jhAlòmoன dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dhAvIdhuDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel vIRRirundhAன; avaன rAjyabhAraM mighavuM sdhirabhbhaDhDhadhu.
Aghidhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya adhoனiyA jhAlòmoனiன dhAyAghiya bhadhjhebhALiDhadhdhil vandhAன. nI jhamAdhAனmAy varughiRAyA èனRu avaL gheDhDhadhaRghu: jhamAdhAனmAydh dhAன varughiReன èனRAன.
bhiனbhu avaன: uMmoDhe nAன bhejhaveNDhiya òru ghAriyaM irughghiRadhu èனRAன. adhaRghu avaL: jhòl èனRAL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: rAjyaM èனனuDhaiyadhAyirundhadhu èனRuM, nAன arajhALughiRadhaRghu isravelarèllAruM èனmel noghghamAy irundhArghaL èனRuM nIr aRivIr; AனAluM rAjyabhAraM èனனaiviDhDhudh dhANDhi, èன jhaghodharaனughghu AyiRRu; ghardhdharAl adhu avarughghugh ghiDhaidhdhadhu.
ibhbhòzhudhu nAன uMmiDhadhdhil òru maனRADhDhaigh gheDhghiReன; adhai èனghghu maRughghaveNDhAM èனRAன. avaL: jhòl èனRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன: rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன uMmuDhaiya jhòllai maRubhbhadhillai; jhUனeM UrALAghiya abhiShAghai èனghghu avar vivAghaM bhaNNighghòDhughgha, avaroDhe bhejhuMbhaDhi veNDhughiReன èனRAன.
adhaRghubh bhadhjhebhAL: nalladhu, nAன uனghghAgha rAjAviDhadhdhil bhejhuveன èனRAL.

bhadhjhebhAL adhoனiyAvughghAgha rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoனiDhadhdhil bhejhuMbhaDhi bhoனAL; abhbhòzhudhu rAjA èzhundhirundhu, avaLughghu èdhirghòNDhu vandhu avaLai vaNa~Nghi, dhaன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel uDhghArndhu, rAjAviன dhAyAr dhaன valadhubhuRamAgha uDhghAra, avaLughghu òru Ajhaனdhdhai vaidhdhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaL: nAன uMmai òru jhiRiya maனRADhDhaigh gheDhgha viruMbhughiReன; èனghghu adhai maRughghaveNDhAM èனRAL. adhaRghu rAjA: èன dhAyAre, gheLuM; nAன umaghghu maRubhbhadhillai èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaL: jhUனeM UrALAghiya abhiShAghai uMmuDhaiya jhaghodharaனAghiya adhoனiyAvughghu vivAghaMbhaNNighghòDhughghaveNDhuM èனRAL.

rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன dhaன dhAyArughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: nIr jhUனeM UrALAghiya abhiShAghai adhoனiyAvughghugh gheDhbhAனeன? abhbhaDhiyAனAl rAjyabhAradhdhaiyuM avaனughghugh gheLuM; avaன èனghghu mUdhdha jhaghodharaன; avaனughghuM AjhAriyaனAghiya abhiyadhdhArughghuM jhèruyAviன ghumAraன yovAbhughghume adhaigh gheLuM èனRAன.

bhiனbhu jhAlòmoன rAjA: adhoனiyA indha vArdhdhaiyaidh dhaன bhirANaனughghujh jhedhamAghajh jhòllAdhirundhAl, dhevaன adhaRghujh jhariyAghavuM adhaRghu adhighamAghavuM èனghghujh jhèyyaghghaDhavar èனRu ghardhdharmel ANaiyiDhDhu,

ibhbhodhuM iனRaighghu adhoனiyA ghòlaiyuNbhAன èனRu èனனaidh dhiDhabhbhaDhudhdhiனvaruM, èனனai èன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dhAvIdhiன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhil vIRRirughghabhbhaNNi, dhAM jhòனனbhaDhi èனghghu vIDhDhaigh ghaDhDhuvidhdhavarumAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனaigh ghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRu jhòlli,
rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன yoydhAviன ghumAraன bhèனAyAvughghugh ghaDhDhaLaighòDhudhdhu avaனai aனubhbhiனAன; ivaன avaனmel vizhundhu avaனaigh ghòனRubhoDhDhAன.

rAjA: AjhAriyaனAghiya abhiyadhdhArai noghghi: nI uன nila~NghaL irughghiRa AனdhodhdhiRghubh bhoyviDhu; nI maraNadhdhiRghubh bhAdhdhiravAனAyirundhuM, nI èன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dhAvIdhughghu muனbhAghagh ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavaruDhaiya bhèDhDhiyaijh jhumandhabhaDhiyiனAluM, èன dhaghabhbhaன anubhavidhdha ubhadhdhiravadhdhaiyèllAM nIghUDha anubhavidhdhabhaDhiyiனAluM, iனRaiya dhiனM nAன uனனaigh ghòlaijhèyyamADhDheன èனRAன.

abhbhaDhiye ghardhdhar jhIlovile eliyiன vIDhDhAraighghuRidhdhujh jhòனன vArdhdhaiyai niRaiveRRuMbhaDhiyAgha, jhAlòmoன abhiyadhdhAraigh ghardhdharuDhaiya AjhAriyaனAyirAdhabhaDhighghudh dhaLLibhbhoDhDhAன.

naDhandha indhajh jhèydhi yovAbhughghu vandhabhodhu, avaன ghardhdharuDhaiya ghUDhAradhdhiRghu oDhibhbhoy, bhalibhIDhadhdhiன ghòMbhughaLaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhAன; yovAbh abhjhalomiன bhaDhjhaM jhAyAdhavaனAyirundhuM, adhoனiyAviன bhaDhjhaM jhAyndhirundhAன.

yovAbh ghardhdhariன ghUDhAradhdhiRghu oDhibhbhoனAன èனRuM, idho, bhali bhIDhadhdhaNDhaiyil niRghiRAன èனRuM, rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoனughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhabhodhu, jhAlòmoன yoydhAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhèனAyAvai aனubhbhi, nI bhoy avaனmel vizhu èனRAன.

bhèனAyA ghardhdhariன ghUDhAradhdhiRghubh bhoy, avaனaibhbhArdhdhu: vèLiye vA èனRu rAjA jhòllughiRAr èனRAன. adhaRghu avaன: nAன varamADhDheன; i~Ngheye jhAveன èனRAன; AghaiyAl bhèனAyA rAjAviனiDhadhdhil bhoy, yovAbh iனனbhaDhi jhòlli, iனனbhaDhi èனghghu maRuudhdharavu ghòDhudhdhAன èனRu maRujhèydhi jhòனனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA avaனai noghghi: avaன jhòனனbhaDhiye nI jhèydhu, avaனaigh ghòனRu, aDhaghghaMbhaNNi, ivvidhamAy yovAbh mughAndharamillAmal jhindhiன iradhdhadhdhai èனனaiviDhDhuM èன bhidhAviன vIDhDhaiviDhDhuM vilaghghibh bhoDhu.

avaன dhaனனaibhbhArghghiluM nIdhiyuM naRghuNamumuLLa iraNDhubherAghiya neriன ghumAraன abhனer èனனuM israveliன bhaDhaidhdhalaivaன meluM, edheriன ghumAraன amAjhA èனனuM yUdhAviன bhaDhaidhdhalaivaனmeluM vizhundhu, èன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dhAvIdhughghudh dhèriyAmal avarghaLaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhAl ghòனRa avaனuDhaiya iradhdhabhbhazhiyaigh ghardhdhar avaனuDhaiya dhalaiyiனmel dhiruMbhabhbhaNNuvArAgha.

ibhbhaDhiye avarghaLuDhaiya iradhdhabhbhazhi èனRuM yeޠεAbhuDhaiya dhalaiyiன maǠβuM, avaன jhandhadhiyAriன dhalaiyiன meluM dhiruMbhavuM, dhAvIdhughghuM avar jhandhadhiyArughghuM avar vIDhDhArughghuM avar jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiRghuM èனRèனRaighghuM ghardhdharAle jhamAdhAனM uNDhAyirughghavuM ghaDhavadhu èனRAன.
abhbhaDhiye yoydhAviன ghumAraன bhèனAyA bhoy, avaனmel vizhundhu avaனaigh ghòனRubhoDhDhAன; avaன vaனAndharadhdhilirughghiRa dhaனனuDhaiya vIDhDhile aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன.
avaனughghubh bhadhilAgha rAjA yoydhAviன ghumAraன bhèனAyAvai irANuvadhdhiனmeluM, AjhAriyaனAghiya jhAdhoghghai abhiyadhdhAriன sdhAனdhdhiluM vaidhdhAன.
bhiனbhu rAjA jhImeyiyai azhaibhbhidhdhu, avaனai noghghi: nI èrujhalemile uனghghu òru vIDhDhaigh ghaDhDhi, a~Ngheyirundhu è~NgheyAvadhu vèLiye bhoghAmal, a~NghedhAனe ghuDhiyiru.
nI vèLiye bhoygh ghIdharoன ARRaigh ghaDhaghghuM nALil, nI jhAghave jhAvAy; abhbhòzhudhu uன iradhdhabhbhazhi uன dhalaiyiனmel irughghuM èனbhadhai nI nijhjhayamAy aRindhughòL èனRAன.
jhImeyi rAjAvaibh bhArdhdhu: adhu nalla vArdhdhai; rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaன jhòனனbhaDhiye, umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya nAன jhèyveன èனRu jhòlli, jhImeyi aneghanAL èrujhalemile ghuDhiyirundhAன.

mUனRu varuShaM jhèனRabhodhu, jhImeyiyiன velaighghArar iraNDhubher mAghghAviன ghumAraனAghiya AghIs èனனuM ghAdhdhiன rAjAviனiDhadhdhughghu oDhibhbhoனArghaL; uன velaighghArar ghAdh Uril irughghiRArghaL èனRu jhImeyighghu aRividhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu jhImeyi èzhundhu, dhaன ghazhudhaiyiனmel jheNaMvaidhdhu, dhaன velaighghAraraidh dheDha, ghAdh UrilirughghiRa AghIjhiDhadhdhughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனAன; ibhbhaDhijh jhImeyi bhoy, dhaன velaighghAraraigh ghAdh Urilirundhu ghòNDhuvandhAன.
jhImeyi èrujhalemilirundhu ghAdh Urughghubh bhoy, dhiruMbhivandhAன èனRu jhAlòmoனughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhabhodhu,

rAjA jhImeyiyai azhaibhbhidhdhu: nI vèLiye bhuRabhbhaDhDhu è~NgheyAvadhu bhoghiRanALile jhAghave jhAvAy èனbhadhai nI nijhjhayamAy aRindhughòL èனRu nAன uனனaigh ghardhdharmel ANaiyiDhajh jhèydhu, uனghghudh dhiDhajhjhADhjhiyAghajh jhòlliyirughgha, adhaRghu nI: nAன gheDhDha vArdhdhai nalladhèனRu jhòllavillaiyA?
nI ghardhdhariன ANaiyaiyuM, nAன uனghghugh ghaRbhidhdha ghaDhDhaLaiyaiyuM ghaighghòLLAdhe bhoனdhèனன? èனRu jhòlli,

bhiனனuM rAjA jhImeyiyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI èன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dhAvIdhughghujh jhèydhadhuM uன maனdhughghudh dhèrindhirughghiRadhumAன èllAbh bhòllAbhbhaiyuM aRindhirughghiRAy; AghaiyAl ghardhdhar uன bhòllAbhbhai uன dhalaiyiன mel dhiruMbhabhbhaNNuvAr.
rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoனo AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhavaனAyirubhbhAன; dhAvIdhiன jhi~NghAjhaனM èனRaighghuM ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha uRudhiyAyirughghuM èனRu jhòlli,
rAjA yoydhAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhèனAyAvughghugh ghaDhDhaLaighòDhudhdhAன; avaன vèLiye bhoy, avaனmel vizhundhu avaனaigh ghòனRubhoDhDhAன. rAjyabhAraM jhAlòmoனiன ghaiyile sdhirabhbhaDhDhadhu.

jhAlòmoன èghibhdhiன rAjAvAghiya bhArvoனoDhe jhaMbhandha~Nghalandhu, bhArvoனiன ghumAradhdhiyai vivAghaMbhaNNi, dhaனனuDhaiya aramaனaiyaiyuM ghardhdharuDhaiya AlayadhdhaiyuM èrujhalemiன jhuRRumadhilaiyuM ghaDhDhidh dhIrumaDhDhuM avaன avaLaidh dhAvIdhiன nagharadhdhil ghòNDhuvandhu vaidhdhAன.
annADhghaLmaDhDhuM ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhiRghu òru AlayaM ghaDhDhabhbhaDhAdhirundhadhiனAl, jaன~NghaL meDhaighaLile bhaliyiDhDhuvandhArghaL.
jhAlòmoன ghardhdhariDhadhdhil aனbhughUrndhu, dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dhAvIdhiன ghaDhDhaLaighaLil naDhandhAன; AனAluM avaன meDhaighaLile bhaliyiDhDhudh dhUbha~NghADhDhi vandhAன.
abhbhaDhiye rAjA bhaliyiDha ghibhiyoனughghubh bhoனAன; adhu bhèriya meDhaiyAyirundhadhu; andhabh bhalibhIDhadhdhiனmel jhAlòmoன AyiraM jharvA~Ngha dhaghaன bhalighaLaijh jhèludhdhiனAன.
ghibhiyoனile ghardhdhar jhAlòmoனughghu irAdhdhiriyil jhòbhbhaனdhdhile dharijhaனmAghi: nI viruMbhughiRadhai èனனiDhadhdhil gheL èனRu dhevaன jhòனனAr.

adhaRghujh jhAlòmoன èன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dhAvIdhu èனனuM umadhu aDhiyAன uMmaibhbhaRRi uNmaiyuM nIdhiyuM maன nermaiyumAy umaghghu muனbhAgha naDhandhabhaDhiye dhevarIr avarughghubh bhèriya ghirubhaijhèydhu, andhabh bhèriya ghirubhaiyai avarughghugh ghAdhdhu, innALil irughghiRabhaDhiye avaruDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhil vIRRirughghiRa òru ghumAraனai avarughghudh dhandhIr.
ibhbhodhuM èன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhAve, dhevarIr umadhu aDhiyeனai èன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dhAvIdhiன sdhAனdhdhile rAjAvAghghiனIre, nAனovèனRAl bhoghghu varavu aRiyAdha jhiRubhiLLaiyAyirughghiReன.
nIr dhèrindhughòNDhadhuM erALadhdhiனAl èNNighghaighghu aDha~NghAdhadhuM ilaghghadhdhiRghu uDhbhaDhAdhadhumAன dhiraLAன jaன~NghaLAghiya umadhu jaனdhdhiன naDhuvil aDhiyeன irughghiReன.

AghaiyAl umadhu jaன~NghaLai niyAyaM vijhArighghavuM, naனmaidhImai iனனdhèனRu vaghaiyaRughghavuM, aDhiyeனughghu ~nAனmuLLa irudhayadhdhaidh dhandharuLuM; erALamAyirughghiRa indha umadhu jaன~NghaLai niyAyaM vijhArighgha yArAle AghuM èனRAன.
jhAlòmoன indhagh ghAriyadhdhaigh gheDhDhadhu ANDhavaruDhaiya bhArvaighghu ughandha viNNabhbhamAyirundhadhu.

AghaiyiனAl dhevaன avaனai noghghi: nI uனghghu nIDhidhdha nADhghaLaigh gheLAmaluM, aijhuvariyadhdhaigh gheLAmaluM, uன jhadhdhurughghaLiன bhirANaனaigh gheLAmaluM, nI indhagh ghAriyadhdhaiye gheDhDhu, niyAyaM vijhArighghiRadhaRghu eRRa ~nAனdhdhai uனghghu veNDhighghòNDhabhaDhiyiனAl,

idhuvumaனRi, nI gheLAdha aijhuvariyadhdhaiyuM maghimaiyaiyuM uனghghudh dhandheன; uன nADhghaLil irughghiRa rAjAghghaLil òruvaனuM uனghghujh jhariyAனvaன irubhbhadhillai.

nAன bhiLLaibhèRRa mUனRAM nALile, indha sdhirIyuM ANbhiLLai bhèRRAL; nA~NghaL òrumidhdhirundhoM, è~NghaL iruvaraiyuM dhavira, vIDhDhughghuLLe veRòruvaruM illai.
irAdhdhiri dhUghghadhdhile indha sdhirI dhaன bhiLLaiyiனmel bhuraNDhubhaDhudhdhadhiனAl adhu jhèdhdhubhbhoyiRRu.

èன bhiLLaighghubh bhAlghòDhughghagh ghAlame nAன èzhundhirundha bhodhu, adhu jhèdhdhughghiDhandhadhu; bhòzhudhu viDhindhabhiன nAன adhai uRRu bhArghghuM bhodhu, adhu nAன bhèRRabhiLLai allavèனRu ghaNDheன èனRAL.

adhaRghu maRRa sdhirI: abhbhaDhiyalla, uyiroDhirughghiRadhu èன bhiLLai, jhèdhdhadhu uன bhiLLai èனRAL. ivaLo: illai, jhèdhdhadhu uன bhiLLai, uyiroDhirughghiRadhu èன bhiLLai èனRAL; ibhbhaDhi rAjAvughghu muனbhAgha vAdhADhiனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: uyiroDhirughghiRadhu èன bhiLLai, jhèdhdhadhu uன bhiLLai èனRu ivaL jhòllughiRAL; abhbhaDhiyalla, jhèdhdhadhu uன bhiLLai, uyiroDhirughghiRadhu èன bhiLLai èனRu avaL jhòllughiRAL èனRu jhòlli,
òru bhaDhDhayadhdhaigh ghòNDhuvAru~NghaL èனRAன; avarghaL òru bhaDhDhayadhdhai rAjAviனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.
rAjA uyiroDhirughghiRa bhiLLaiyai iraNDhAghabh bhiLandhu, bhAdhiyai ivaLughghuM bhAdhiyai avaLughghuM ghòDhu~NghaL èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu uyiroDhirughghiRa bhiLLaiyiன dhAy, dhaன bhiLLaighghAgha avaL ghuDhal dhuDhidhdhadhiனAl, rAjAvai noghghi: aiyo, èன ANDhavaனe, uyiroDhirughghiRa bhiLLaiyaigh ghòllaveNDhAM; adhai avaLughghe ghòDhudhdhuviDhuM èனRAL; maRRavaL adhu èனghghuM veNDhAM, uனghghuM veNDhAM, bhiLandhu bhoDhu~NghaL èனRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu rAjA uyiroDhirughghiRa bhiLLaiyaigh ghòllAmal, avaLughghugh ghòDhudhdhuviDhu~NghaL; avaLe adhiன dhAy èனRAன.
rAjA dhIrdhdha indha niyAyadhdhai isravelar èllAruM gheLvibhbhaDhDhu, niyAyaM vijhArighghiRadhaRghu dhevaன aruLiன ~nAனM rAjAvughghu uNDhèனRu ghaNDhu, avaனughghubh bhayandhArghaL.
rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன jhamasdha israveliன meluM rAjAvAyirundhAன.
avaனughghu irundha bhirabhughghaL: jhAdhoghghiன ghumAraனAghiya ajhariyA bhiradhAன mandhiriyAyirundhAன.
jhIjhAviன ghumArarAghiya elighorebhbhuM aghiyAvuM jhaMbhiradhighaLAyirundhArghaL; aghiluUdhiன ghumAraன yojhabhAdh mandhiriyAyirundhAன.
yoydhAviன ghumAraன bhèனAyA bhaDhaidhdhalaivaனuM, jhAdhoghghuM abhiyadhdhAruM AjhAriyarghaLumAyirundhArghaL.
nAdhdhAனiன ghumAraன ajhariyA maNiyaghArariன dhalaivaனAyirundhAன; nAdhdhAனiன ghumAraன jhAbhUdh rAjAviன bhiradhAனiyuM iShDhaனumAyirundhAன.
aghIShAr aramaனai vijhAribhbhughghAraனuM, abhdhAviன ghumAraன adhoனirAM bhaghudhi vijhAribhbhughghAraனumAy irundhAன.

rAjAvughghuM avaன aramaனaighghuM veNDhiya uNavubhbhòruLghaLaijh jhegharighghiRa bhaனனiraNDhu maNiyaghArar jhAlòmoனughghu isravel dhejhamè~NghuM vaighghabhbhaDhDhirundhArghaL; avarghaL mAdhadhdhughghu òvvòruvarAgha varuShamuzhuvadhuM bharAmaridhdhuvandhArghaL.
avarghaL nAma~NghaLAvaன: Uriன ghumAraன, ivaன èbhbhirAyIM malaidhdhejhadhdhil irundhAன.
dheghgheriன ghumAraன, ivaன mAghghAdhjhiluM, jhAlbhImiluM, bhèdhShimejhiluM, eloனbhèdhdhAனAனiluM irundhAன.
ejhedhiன ghumAraன, ivaன aRubhodhdhil irundhAன; jhoghovuM èbhbher jhImaiyaனaidhdhuM ivaன vijhAribhbhil irundhadhu.
abhiனdhAbhiன ghumAraன, ivaன dhoriன nADhDhubhbhuRamaனaidhdhiRghuM vijhAribhbhughghAraனAyirundhAன; jhAlòmoனiன ghumAradhdhiyAghiya dhAbhAdh ivaனughghu maனaiviyAyirundhAL.

aghiluUdhiன ghumAraனAghiya bhAனA, ivaன vijhAribhbhil, dhAனAghuM, mèghidhovuM, jhardhdhaனAvughghubh bhaghghamAghavuM yèsrayelughghugh ghIzhAghavuM bhèdhjhèyAன dhòDha~Nghi Abhel mèghòllAmaDhDhuM yaghmèyAmughghu abhbhuRadhdhumaDhDhuM irughghiRa bhèdhjhèyAன aனaidhdhuM irundhadhu.

ghebheriன ghumAraன, ivaன ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhil irundhAன; ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa maனAjheyiன ghumAraனAghiya yAvIriன ghirAma~NghaLuM madhilghaLuM vèNghala dhAzhbhbhALghaLumuLLa bhAjhAன dhejhadhdhiனuDhaiya aRubhadhu bhèriya bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLuLLa arghobh jhImaiyuM ivaன vijhAribhbhil irundhadhu.
idhdhoviன ghumAraன aghiனdhAbh, ivaன maghனAyImil irundhAன.
aghimAs, ivaன nabhdhaliyil irundhAன; ivaன jhAlòmoனughghu irundha òru ghumAradhdhiyAghiya bhasmAdh èனbhavaLai vivAghaMbhaNNiனAன.
UjhAyiன ghumAraன bhAனA, ivaன AjheriluM AlodhdhiluM irundhAன.

Uriyiன ghumAraன ghebher, ivaன Ύmoriyariன rAjAvAghiya jhIghoனuΕghuM bhAΚAனiன rAjAvAghiya oՠρghghuM irundha dhejhamAghiya ghIleyAdhdhejhadhdhil irundhAன; ivaனmAdhdhiraM adhdhejhadhdhil adhibhadhiyAy irundhAன.
yUdhAvuM israveluM ghaDhaRgharai maNaladhdhaனai erALamAyirundhu, bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdhu maghizhndhughòNDhirundhArghaL.

nadhidhòDha~Nghi, bhèlisdhar dhejhavazhiyAy èghibhdhiன èllaimaDhDhuM irughghiRa jhaghala rAjya~NghaLaiyuM jhAlòmoன ANDhughòNDhirundhAன; avarghaL jhAlòmoனughghugh ghANighghaighaLaigh ghòNDhuvandhu, avaன uyiroDhirundha nALèllAM avaனaijh jhevidhdhArghaL.
nAL òனRiRghujh jhAlòmoனughghujh jhèlluM jhAbhbhADhDhujh jhèlavu, mubhbhadhu maraghghAl mèlliya mAvuM, aRubhadhu maraghghAl mAvuM,

ghalaimAனghaLaiyuM vèLimAனghaLaiyuM varaiyADhughaLaiyuM ghòzhumaiyAன bhaRavaighaLaiyuM dhavira, ghòzhughghabhbhaDhDha bhadhdhu mADhughaLuM, meyjhjhalilirundhu vandha irubhadhu mADhughaLuM nURu ADhughaLumAM.

nadhighghu ibhbhuRadhdhil irughghiRa dhibhjhAmudhaRghòNDhu AjhAmaDhDhumuLLavaiyèllAvaRRaiyuM, nadhighghu ibhbhuRadhdhiluLLa jhaghala rAjAghghaLaiyuM ANDhuvandhAன; avaனaijh jhuRRi è~NghuM jhamAdhAனmAyirundhadhu.

jhAlòmoனuDhaiya nALèllAM dhAN dhuvaghghibh bhèyèrjhèbhAmaDhDhuM, yUdhAvuM israveluM avaravar dha~NghaL dha~NghaL dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyiன nizhaliluM, dha~NghaL dha~NghaL adhdhimaradhdhiன nizhaliluM jhughamAygh ghuDhiyirundhArghaL.
jhAlòmoனughghu nAlAyiraM iradhagh ghudhirailAya~NghaLuM, bhaனனIrAyiraM ghudhiraivIraruM irundhArghaL.
meRjhòlliya maNiyaghAraril òvvòruvaruM dhaன dhaன mAdhadhdhile jhAlòmoன rAjAvughghuM, rAjAviன bhandhighghu varuM yAvarughghuM veNDhiyavaighaLai òru ghuRaivumiனRi bharAmaridhdhu,

dhevaன jhAlòmoனughghu mighudhiyAன ~nAனdhdhaiyuM bhudhdhiyaiyuM, ghaDhaRgharai maNaladhdhaனaiyAன maனovirudhdhiyaiyuM ghòDhudhdhAr.
jhaghala ghizhaghghadhdhibh bhudhdhirariன ~nAனdhdhaiyuM èghibhdhiyariன jhaghala ~nAனdhdhaiyuM bhArghghiluM jhAlòmoனiன ~nAனM jhiRandhadhAyirundhadhu.

jhAlòmoனai avaனuDhaiya bhidhAviன sdhAனdhdhil rAjAvAgha abhiSheghaM bhaNNiனArghaL èனRu dhIruviன rAjAvAghiya IrAM gheLvibhbhaDhDhu, dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai avaனiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனAன; IrAM dhAvIdhughghujh jhaghalanALuM jhineghidhaனAyirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu jhAlòmoன IrAmiனiDhadhdhil ADhghaLai aனubhbhi:

AனAluM ibhbhòzhudho èன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar è~NghuM èனghghu iLaibhbhARudhalaidh dhandhAr; virodhiyuM illai, iDhaiyURuM illai.

AdhalAl lIbhaனoனil èனghghAgha ghedhurumara~NghaLai vèDhDhagh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuM; jhIdhoனiyaraibhbhola maravèDhDhu velai aRindhavarghaL è~NghaLughghuLLe òruvarumillai èனbhadhu umaghghudh dhèriyuM; adhaRghAgha èன velaighghArar uMmuDhaiya velaighghAraroDhe irubhbhArghaL; nIr jhòlvadhiனbhaDhiyèllAM uMmuDhaiya velaighghArariன jhaMbhaLadhdhai umaghghugh ghòDhubhbheன èனRu jhòllajh jhòனனAன.

abhbhaDhiye IrAM jhAlòmoனughghu veNDhiyamaDhDhuM ghedhurumara~NghaLaiyuM dhevadhAri viruDhjha~NghaLaiyuM ghòDhudhdhugh ghòNDhuvandhAன.

jhAlòmoன IrAmiன aramaனaighghubh bhojaனdhdhiRghAgha irubhadhiனAyiraghghalaM ghodhumaiyaiyuM, iDhidhdhubhbhizhindha òlivamara~NghaLiன irubhadhughala èNNèyaiyuM ghòDhudhdhAன; ibhbhaDhijh jhAlòmoன IrAmughghu varuShAndharaM ghòDhudhdhuvandhAன.
ghardhdhar jhAlòmoனughghujh jhòlliyirundhabhaDhiye avaனughghu ~nAனdhdhaidh dhandharuLiனAr; IrAmughghuM jhAlòmoனughghuM jhamAdhAனM uNDhAyirundhu, iruvaruM uDhaனbhaDhighghai bhaNNighghòNDhArghaL.

isravel bhudhdhirar èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDha nAனURRu èNbhadhAM varuShadhdhiluM, jhAlòmoன israveliனmel rAjAvAன nAlAM varuShaM jhIbhmAdhamAghiya iraNDhAM mAdhadhdhiluM, avaன ghardhdhariன Alayadhdhaigh ghaDhDhadhdhòDha~NghiனAன.

rAjA mudhiyor dhaனghghujh jhòனன Alojhaனaiyaidh dhaLLiviDhDhu, vAlibharuDhaiya AlojhaனaiyiனbhaDhiye avarghaLoDhe bhejhi:

èன dhaghabhbhaன u~NghaL nughadhdhaibh bhAramAghghiனAr, nAன u~NghaL nughadhdhai adhigha bhAramAghghuveன; èன dhaghabhbhaன u~NghaLaijh jhavughghughaLiனAle dhaNDhidhdhAr, nAன u~NghaLaidh dheLghaLiனAle dhaNDhibhbheன èனRu jaன~NghaLughghugh ghaDhiனmAன udhdharavu ghòDhudhdhAன.

rAjA jaன~NghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhAmaRbhoனAன; ghardhdhar jhIloனiyaனAன aghiyAvaighghòNDhu nebhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yèròbhèyAmughghujh jhòனன dhaMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyai uRudhibhbhaDhudhdhuMbhaDhi ghardhdharAl ibhbhaDhi naDhandhadhu.

rAjA dha~NghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhAdhadhai isravelar èllAruM ghaNDhabhodhu, jaன~NghaL rAjAvughghu maRuudhdharavAgha: dhAvIdhoDhe è~NghaLughghubh bha~Nghedhu? IjhAyiன ghumAraனiDhadhdhil è~NghaLughghujh jhudhandharaM illai; isravele, uன ghUDhAra~NghaLughghubh bhoyviDhu; ibhbhodhu dhAvIdhe, uன jhòndha vIDhDhaibh bhArdhdhughghòL èனRu jhòlli, isravelar dha~NghaL ghUDhAra~NghaLughghubh bhoyviDhDhArghaL.
AனAluM yUdhAviன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLile ghuDhiyirundha isravel bhudhdhirar mel règhòbhèyAM rAjAvAyirundhAன.

bhiனbhu rAjAvAghiya règhòbhèyAM bhaghudhi vijhAribhbhughghAraனAghiya adhorAmai aனubhbhiனAன; isravelar èllAruM avaனaigh ghallèRindhu ghòனRArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu rAjAvAghiya règhòbhèyAM dhIviramAy iradhadhdhiனmel eRi, èrujhalemughghu oDhibhbhoனAன.
abhbhaDhiye innALvaraighghuM irughghiRabhaDhi isravelar dhAvIdhiன vaMjhadhdhai viDhDhu ghalaghaMbhaNNibh bhirindhu bhoyirughghiRArghaL.

yèròbhèyAM dhiruMbhivandhAன èனRu isravelarughghèllAM gheLviyAனbhodhu, avaனaijh jhabhaiyiனiDhadhdhil azhaidhdhaனubhbhi, avaனaijh jhamasdha israveliனmeluM rAjAvAghghiனArghaL; yUdhAghodhdhiraMmAdhdhirameyaனRi veRòruvaruM dhAvIdhiன vaMjhadhdhaibh bhiனbhaRRavillai.

règhòbhèyAM èrujhalemughghu vandhabhodhu, isravel vaMjhadhdhAroDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNavuM, rAjyadhdhaijh jhAlòmoனiன ghumAraனAghiya dhaனனiDhamAghadh dhirubhbhighghòLLavuM, yUdhA vaMjhadhdhAr bhèனyamIன ghodhdhiradhdhAr aனaivarumAghiya dhèrindhughòLLabhbhaDhDha yudhdhavIrar laDhjhadhdhu èNbhadhiனAyiraM bheraigh ghUDhDhiனAன.
dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனAghiya jhemAyAvughghu dhevaனuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyuNDhAghi, avar jhòனனdhu:
nI yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya règhòbhèyAM èனனuM jhAlòmoனiன ghumAraனaiyuM yUdhA vaMjhadhdhAr aனaivaraiyuM, bhèனyamIனraiyuM, maRRa jaன~NghaLaiyuM noghghi:

nI~NghaL bhoghAmaluM, isravel bhudhdhirarAன u~NghaL jhaghodhararoDhu yudhdhaMbhaNNAmaluM, avaravar dhaMdhaM vIDhDhiRghudh dhiruMbhu~NghaL; èனனAle indhagh ghAriyaM naDhandhadhu èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr; abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL: ghardhdharuDhaiya jhòllaigh gheDhDhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye dhiruMbhibh bhoyviDhDhArghaL.
yèròbhèyAM èbhbhirAyIM malaidhdhejhadhdhil jhIghemaigh ghaDhDhi, adhile vAjhaMbhaNNi, a~Nghirundhu bhoybh bhèனUvelaigh ghaDhDhiனAன.
yèròbhèyAM: ibhbhodhu rAjyabhAraM dhAvIdhu vaMjhavajhamAydh dhiruMbhughiRadhAyirughghuM.

indha jaன~NghaL èrujhalemiluLLa ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhile bhalighaLaijh jhèludhdhabhbhoனAl, indha jaன~NghaLiன irudhayaM yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya règhòbhèyAM èனனuM dha~NghaL ANDhavaன vajhamAydh dhiruMbhi, avarghaL èனனaigh ghòனRubhoDhDhu, yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya règhòbhèyAmiன bhArijhamAybh bhoy viDhuvArghaL èனRu dhaன maனdhile jhindhidhdhughghòNDhirundhAன.

AghaiyAl rAjAvAனvaன yojhaனaibhaNNi, bhòனனiனAl iraNDhu ghaனRughghuDhDhighaLai uNDhAghghi, jaன~NghaLaibh bhArdhdhu: nI~NghaL èrujhalemughghubh bhoghiRadhu u~NghaLughghu varudhdhaM; isravelare, idho, ivaighaL u~NghaLai èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu varabhbhaNNiன u~NghaL dhevarghaL èனRu jhòlli,
òனRaibh bhèdhdheliluM, òனRaidh dhANiluM sdhAbhidhdhAன.
indhagh ghAriyaM bhAvamAyiRRu; jaன~NghaL indha òru ghaனRughghuDhDhighghAghadh dhANmaDhDhuM bhovArghaL.
avaன meDhaiyAghiya òru ghovilaiyuM ghaDhDhi, leviyiன bhudhdhirarAyirAdha jaனdhdhil IனmAனvarghaLai AjhAriyarAghghiனAன.

yUdhAvil AjharighghabhbhaDhuM bhaNDhighaighghòbhbhAgha èDhDhAM mAdhaM bhadhiனaindhAM dhedhiyile yèròbhèyAM òru bhaNDhighaiyaiyuM ghòNDhADhi, bhalibhIDhadhdhiனmel bhaliyiDhDhAன; abhbhaDhiye bhèdhdhelile dhAன uNDhAghghiன ghaனRughghuDhDhighaLughghubh bhaliyiDhDhu, dhAன uNDhubhaNNiன meDhaighaLiன AjhAriyarghaLaibh bhèdhdhelile sdhAbhidhdhu,

dhaன maனdhile dhAனe niyamidhdhugh ghòNDha èDhDhAM mAdhaM bhadhiனaindhAM dhedhiyile bhèdhdhelil dhAன uNDhAghghiன bhalibhIDhadhdhiனmel bhaliyiDhDhu, isravel bhudhdhirarughghubh bhaNDhighaiyai eRbhaDhudhdhi, bhalibhIDhadhdhiனmel bhaliyiDhDhudh dhUbha~NghADhDhiனAன.
yèròbhèyAM dhUbha~NghADhDha bhalibhIDhadhdhaNDhaiyile niRghaiyil, idho, dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன òruvaன ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye, yUdhAvilirundhu bhèdhdhelughghu vandhu,

andha bhalibhIDhadhdhai noghghi: bhalibhIDhame bhalibhIDhame, idho, dhAvIdhiன vaMjhadhdhil yojhiyA èனனuM bheruLLa òru ghumAraன bhiRabhbhAன; avaன uனmel dhUbha~NghADhDhughiRa meDhaighaLiன AjhAriyarghaLai uனmel bhaliyiDhuvAன; maனuShariன èluMbhughaLuM uனmel jhuDhDhèrighghabhbhaDhuM èனbhadhaigh ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh ghURi;
aனRaiya dhiனM avaன òru aDhaiyALadhdhaiyuM jhòlli, idho, indhabh bhalibhIDhaM vèDhidhdhu, adhiனmeluLLa jhAMbhal ghòDhDhuNDhubhoM; ghardhdhar uraidhdhadhaRghu idhuve aDhaiyALaM èனRAன.

bhèdhdhelil irughghiRa andhabh bhalibhIDhadhdhiRghu èdhirAgha dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன ghURiன vArdhdhaiyai rAjAvAghiya yèròbhèyAM gheDhDhabhodhu, avaனaibh bhiDhiyu~NghaL èனRu dhaன ghaiyaibh bhalibhIDhadhdhilirundhu nIDhDhiனAன; avaனughghu virodhamAy nIDhDhiன ghai dhaனனiDhamAgha muDhaghghagh ghUDhAdhabhaDhighghu maradhdhubhbhoyiRRu.
dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyAl ghuRidhdhirundha aDhaiyALadhdhiனbhaDhiye bhalibhIDhaM vèDhidhdhu, jhAMbhal bhalibhIDhadhdhilirundhu ghòDhDhuNDhubhoyiRRu.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA, dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: nI uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhamughadhdhai noghghi veNDhighghòNDhu, èன ghai muன bholirughghuMbhaDhighghu èனghghAgha viNNabhbhaMbhaNNaveNDhuM èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன ghardhdharuDhaiya jhamughadhdhai noghghi varundhi viNNabhbhaM jhèydhAன, rAjAviன ghai muனனirundhabhaDhi jhIrbhbhaDhDhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu rAjA dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனai noghghi: nI èனனoDheghUDha vIDhDhughghu vandhu iLaibhbhARu; uனghghu vèghumAனM dharuveன èனRAன.

dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன rAjAvai noghghi: nIr èனghghu uMmuDhaiya vIDhDhil bhAdhi ghòDhudhdhAluM, nAன uMmoDhe varuvadhillai, indha sdhaladhdhil abhbhaM bhujhibhbhadhumillai, dhaNNIr ghuDhibhbhadhumillai.
eனèனRAl nI abhbhaM bhujhiyAmaluM, dhaNNIr ghuDhiyAmaluM, bhoனvazhiyAydh dhiruMbhAmaluM iruvèனRu ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyAl èனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirughghiRAr èனRu jhòlli,
avaன bhèdhdhelughghu vandhavazhiyAydh dhiruMbhAmal, veRuvazhiyAybh bhoyviDhDhAன.

ghizhavaனAன òru dhIrghghadharijhi bhèdhdhelile ghuDhiyirundhAன; avaன ghumArar vandhu dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன aனRaiya dhiனM bhèdhdhelile jhèydha èllAjh jhèyghaighaLaiyuM, avaன rAjAvoDhe jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனughghu aRividhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL dhaghabhbhaன: avaன èndha vazhi bhoனAன èனRu avarghaLaigh gheDhDhAன. yUdhAvilirundhu vandha dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன bhoனvazhi iனனdhèனRu avaன ghumArar bhArdhdhirundhabhaDhiyAl,
avaன dhaன ghumAraruDhaனe: ghazhudhaiyiனmel jheNaMvaidhdhugh ghòDhu~NghaL èனRAன; avarghaL ghazhudhaiyiனmel jheNaMvaidhdhugh ghòDhudhdhabhiன, avaன adhiனmel eRi,

dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனaidh dhòDharndhubhoy, òru gharvAli maradhdhiனghIzh uDhghArndhirughghiRa avaனaigh ghaNDhu: yUdhAvilirundhuvandha dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன nIrdhAனA èனRu avaனaigh gheDhDhadhaRghu; avaன, nAன dhAன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaனai noghghi: èனனoDhe vIDhDhughghu vandhu abhbhaM bhujhiyuM èனRAன.
adhaRghu avaன: nAன uMmoDhe dhiruMbhavuM uMmoDhe uLLe bhoghavumADhDheன; indha sdhaladhdhile uMmoDhe nAன abhbhaM bhujhighghavuM dhaNNIr ghuDhighghavumADhDheன.
eனèனRAl nI abhbhaM bhujhiyAmaluM, a~Nghe dhaNNIr ghuDhiyAmaluM, nI bhoனvazhiyAydh dhiruMbhivarAmaluM iru èனRu ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAyirughghiRadhu èனRAன.

adhaRghu avaன: uMmaibhbhola nAனuM dhIrghghadharijhidhAன; avaன abhbhaM bhujhidhdhudh dhaNNIr ghuDhighgha, nI avaனaidh dhirubhbhi, uன vIDhDhughghu azhaidhdhugh ghòNDhuvA èனRu òru dhUdhaன ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyAgha èனனoDhe jhòனனAன èனRu avaனiDhadhdhil bhòy jhòனனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன ivaனoDhe dhiruMbhibh bhoy, ivaன vIDhDhile abhbhaM bhujhidhdhudh dhaNNIr ghuDhidhdhAன.
avarghaL bhandhiyil uDhghArndhirughghiRabhodhu, avaனaidh dhirubhbhighghòNDhu vandha dhIrghghadharijhighghugh ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai uNDhAனdhiனAl,

avaன yUdhAvilirundhu vandha dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனaibh bhArdhdhujh jhadhdhamiDhDhu, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனghghugh ghaRbhidhdha ghaDhDhaLaiyai nI ghaighghòLLAmal ghardhdharuDhaiya vAghghai mIRi,

abhbhaM bhujhighghavuM dhaNNIr ghuDhighghavuM veNDhAM èனRu avar vilaghghiன sdhaladhdhiRghu nI dhiruMbhi, abhbhaM bhujhidhdhudh dhaNNIr ghuDhidhdhabhaDhiyiனAl, uனனuDhaiya bhiredhaM uன bhidhAghghaLiன ghallaRaiyile jheruvadhillai èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.
avaன bhojaனbhAனMbhaNNi muDhindhabhiனbhu, andhadh dhIrghghadharijhiyaidh dhirubhbhighghòNDhuvandhavaன avaனughghugh ghazhudhaiyiனmel jheNaMvaidhdhugh ghòDhudhdhAன.

avaன bhoனbhiRbhADhu vazhiyile òru jhi~NghaM avaனughghu èdhirbhbhaDhDhu avaனaigh ghòனRubhoDhDhadhu; avaன bhiredhaM vazhiyile ghiDhandhadhu; ghazhudhai adhiனNDhaiyile niனRadhu; jhi~NghamuM bhiredhadh dhaNDhaiyile niனRadhu.

andha vazhiye ghaDhandhuvarughiRa maனuShar, vazhiyile ghiDhaghghiRa bhiredhadhdhaiyuM, bhiredhadhdhaNDhaiyile niRghiRa jhi~NghadhdhaiyuM ghaNDhu, ghizhavaனAன dhIrghghadharijhi ghuDhiyirundha bhaDhDhaNadhdhile vandhu jhòனனArghaL.

avaனai vazhiyilirundhu dhiruMbhabh bhaNNiன dhIrghghadharijhi adhaigh gheDhDhabhodhu, avaன ghardhdharuDhaiya vAghghai mIRiன dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன dhAன, ghardhdhar avaனughghujh jhòனன vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye, ghardhdhar avaனai òru jhi~NghadhdhiRghu òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr; adhu avaனai muRidhdhugh ghòனRubhoDhDhadhu èனRu jhòlli,
dhaன ghumArarai noghghi: èனghghugh ghazhudhaiyiனmel jheNaMvaidhdhugh ghòDhu~NghaL èனRAன; avarghaL jheNaM vaidhdhugh ghòDhudhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன bhoy, vazhiyile ghiDhaghghiRa avaன bhiredhadhdhaiyuM, bhiredhadhdhaNDhaiyile ghazhudhaiyuM jhi~NghamuM niRghiRadhaiyuM ghaNDhAன; andhajh jhi~NghaM bhiredhadhdhaidh dhiனனvumillai, ghazhudhaiyai muRidhdhubhbhoDhavumillai.

abhbhòzhudhu ghizhavaனAன andhadh dhIrghghadharijhi dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனiன bhiredhadhdhai èDhudhdhu, adhaigh ghazhudhaiyiனmel vaidhdhu, adhaRghAghadh dhughgha~NghòNDhADhavuM adhai aDhaghghaMbhaNNavuM, adhaidh dhaன bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghugh ghòNDhuvandhu,
avaன bhiredhadhdhaidh dhaனனuDhaiya ghallaRaiyile vaidhdhAன. avaனughghAgha: aiyo, èன jhaghodharaனe èனRu bhulaMbhi, dhughgha~NghòNDhADhiனArghaL.

avaனai aDhaghghaMbhaNNiனbhiனbhu, avaன dhaன ghumArarai noghghi: nAன marighghuMbhodhu, dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDha ghallaRaiyile èனனaiyuM nI~NghaL aDhaghghaMbhaNNi, avaன èluMbhughaLaNDhaiyile èன èluMbhughaLaiyuM vaiyu~NghaL.

avaன bhèdhdhelil irughghiRa bhalibhIDhadhdhiRghuM, jhamAriyAviன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLil irughghiRa meDhaighaLAghiya jhaghala ghovilghaLughghuM virodhamAghagh ghURiன ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai nijhjhayamAy niRaiveRuM èனRAன.

indha naDhabhaDhighghubhbhiனbhu, yèròbhèyAM dhaன bhòllAdha vazhiyaiviDhDhudh dhiruMbhAmal, maRubhaDhiyuM jaனdhdhil IனmAனvarghaLai meDhaighaLiன AjhAriyarAghghiனAன; èvaன mel avaனughghu maனdhirundhadho avaனaibh bhiradhiShDhaibhbhaNNiனAன; abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavarghaL meDhaighaLiன AjhAriyarAனArghaL.
yèròbhèyAmiன vIDhDhArai bhUmiyiனmel vaighghAmal adhaMbhaNNi azhighghuMbhaDhiyAgha indhagh ghAriyaM avarghaLughghubh bhAvamAyiRRu.
aghghAladhdhile yèròbhèyAmiன ghumAraனAghiya abhiyA viyAdhiyil vizhundhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu yèròbhèyAM dhaன maனaiviyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI èzhundhu, nI yèròbhèyAmiன maனaiviyèனRu òruvaruM aRiyAdhabhaDhighghu veShaMmARi jhIlovughghubh bho; indha jaனdhdhiனmel nAன rAjAvAveன èனRu èனனoDhe jhòனன dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya aghiyA a~Nghe irughghiRAன.

nI uன ghaiyile bhadhdhu abhbha~NghaLaiyuM, bhaNiyAra~NghaLaiyuM, òru ghalajhaM dheனaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhu avaனiDhadhdhughghubh bho; bhiLLaighghujh jhaMbhavighghabhbhoghiRadhu iனனdhèனRu avaன uனghghu aRivibhbhAன èனRAன.

abhbhaDhiye yèròbhèyAmiன maனaivi jhèydhAL; avaL èzhundhu jhIlovughghubh bhoy, aghiyAviன vIDhDhiRghuL bhiravejhidhdhAL; aghiyAvo mudhir vayadhAனdhiனAl avaன ghaNghaL ma~NghalaDhaindhu bhArghghagh ghUDhAdhirundhAன.

ghardhdhar aghiyAviனiDhadhdhil: idho, yèròbhèyAmiன maனaivi viyAdhiyAyirughghiRa dhaன ghumAraனughghAgha uனனai òru vijheShaMgheDhgha varughiRAL; nI avaLughghu iனன iனன bhiraghAramAghajh jhòllaveNDhuM; avaL uDhbhiravejhighghiRabhodhu, dhaனனai anniya sdhirIyAghagh ghANbhibhbhAL èனRAr.

AghaiyAl vAjhaRbhaDhighghuL bhiravejhighghuM avaLuDhaiya naDhaiyiன jhadhdhadhdhai aghiyA gheDhDhavuDhaனe, avaன: yèròbhèyAmiன maனaiviye, uLLe vA; uனனai anniya sdhirIyAghagh ghANbhighghiRadhèனன? dhughghajhèydhiyai uனghghu aRivighgha nAன aனubhbhabhbhaDhDheன.
nI bhoy yèròbhèyAmai noghghi: israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: jaனdhdhiனiனRu uனனai nAன uyardhdhi, uனனai isravel èனனuM èன jaனdhdhiனmel adhibhadhiyAgha vaidhdheன.

nAன rAjyabhAradhdhaidh dhAvIdhu vaMjhadhdhAriன ghaiyilirundhu bhiDhu~Nghi uனghghugh ghòDhudhdheன; AனAluM èன ghaRbhaனaighaLaigh ghaighghòNDhu, èன bhArvaighghujh jhèMmaiyAனdhaiye jhèyya dhaன muzhu irudhayadhdhoDhuM èனனaibh bhiனbhaRRiன èன dhAjhaனAghiya dhAvIdhaibh bhola nI irAmal,

nebhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yèròbhèyAmiன jhaghala vazhiyiluM, israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghudh dha~NghaL vINAன vighghiragha~NghaLAle ghobhaM mUDhDhuMbhaDhiyAy isravelaibh bhAva~njhèyyabhbhaNNiன avaனuDhaiya bhAva~NghaLiluM naDhandhAன.
uMri jhèydha avaனuDhaiya maRRa vardhdhamAன~NghaLuM, avaன ghANbhidhdha vallamaiyuM, isravel rAjAghghaLiன nALAghamabh bhusdhaghadhdhil allavo èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu.
uMri dhaன bhidhAghghaLoDhe nidhdhiraiyaDhaindhu, jhamAriyAvile aDhaghghaM bhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன; avaன ghumAraனAghiya AghAbh avaன sdhAனdhdhil rAjAvAனAன.

nebhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yèròbhèyAmiன bhAva~NghaLil naDhabhbhadhu avaனughghugh ghò~njhaghghAriyamèனRu niனaidhdhARbhol avaன jhIdhoனiyariன rAjAvAghiya edhbhAghAliன ghumAradhdhi yejhabhelai vivAghaMbhaNNiனdhumallAmal, avaன bhoy bhAghAlaiyuM jhevidhdhu adhaibh bhaNindhughòNDhu,

AghAbh òru vighghiraghadhdhobhbhaiyuM vaidhdhu, israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghugh ghobhaM uNDhAghghuMbhaDhighghu dhaனghghu muனனirundha israveliன rAjAghghaLèllAM jhèydhadhaibhbhArghghiluM adhighamAyjh jhèydhuvandhAன.

avaன nADhghaLile bhèdhdhel UrAனAghiya Iyel èrighovaigh ghaDhDhiனAன; ghardhdhar nUனiன ghumAraனAghiya yojhuvAvaigh ghòNDhu jhòlliyirundha vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye, avaன adhiன asdhibhAradhdhaibh bhoDhughiRabhodhu, abhirAM èனனuM dhaன mUdhdha ghumAraனaiyuM, adhiன vAjhalghaLai vaighghiRabhodhu jhèghUbh èனனuM dhaன iLaiyaghumAraனaiyuM jhAghaghghòDhudhdhAன.

ghIleyAdhdhiன ghuDhighaLile dhisbhiyaனAghiya èliyA AghAbhai noghghi: èன vAghghiனbhaDhiye aனRi indha varuSha~NghaLile bhaனiyuM mazhaiyuM bhèyyAdhirughghuM èனRu israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha niRghiRa nAன avaruDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRAன.
bhiனbhu ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai avaனughghu uNDhAyiRRu, avar:

dhejhadhdhil mazhaibhèyyAdhabhaDhiyiனAl, jhilanALughghubhbhiனbhu andha ARu vaRRibhbhoyiRRu.

nI èzhundhu, jhIdhoனughghaDhudhdha jhARibhAdh Urughghubh bhoy, a~Nghe dha~Nghiyiru; uனனaibh bharAmarighghuMbhaDhi a~Nghe irughghiRa òru vidhavaighghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDheன èனRAr.

abhbhaDhiye avaன èzhundhu, jhARibhAdhdhughghubh bhoனAன; andhabh bhaDhDhaNadhdhiன òlimughavAjhalughghu avaன vandha bhodhu, a~Nghe òru vidhavai viRaghu bhòRughghighghòNDhirundhAL; avaன avaLaibh bhArdhdhugh ghUbhbhiDhDhu, nAன ghuDhighghiRadhaRghugh ghò~njhaM dhaNNIr òru bhAdhdhiradhdhil èனghghugh ghòNDhuvA èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu èliyA jhaghala jaனdhdhaNDhaighghuM vandhu: nI~NghaL èndhamaDhDhuM iraNDhu niனaivughaLAl ghundhighghundhi naDhabhbhIrghaL; ghardhdhar dhèyvamAனAl avaraibh bhiனbhaRRu~NghaL; bhAghAl dhèyvamAனAl avaனaibh bhiனbhaRRu~NghaL èனRAன, jaன~NghaL bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha avaனughghu òனRuM jhòllavillai.
abhbhòzhudhu èliyA jaன~NghaLai noghghi: ghardhdhariன dhIrghghadharijhighaLil mIndhirughghiRavaன nAன òruvaன; bhAghAliன dhIrghghadharijhighaLo nAனURRaiMbhadhubher.

ibhbhodhuM iraNDhu ghALaighaLai è~NghaLiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvaraDhDhuM; òru ghALaiyai avarghaL dhèrindhughòNDhu, adhaijh jhandhujhandhAghadh dhuNDhidhdhu, nèrubhbhubh bhoDhAmal viRaghughaLiனmel vaighghagh ghaDhavarghaL; nAன maRRagh ghALaiyai abhbhaDhiye jhèydhu, nèrubhbhubh bhoDhAmal viRaghughaLiனmel vaibhbheன.

dha~NghaLughghugh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhDha ghALaiyai avarghaL vA~Nghi, adhai AyadhdhaMbhaNNi: bhAghAle, è~NghaLughghu udhdharavu aruLuM èனRu ghAlaidhòDha~Nghi madhdhiyAனmaDhDhuM bhAghAliன nAmadhdhaijh jhòlligh ghUbhbhiDhDhArghaL; AனAluM òru jhadhdhamuM bhiRaghghavillai, maRu udhdharavu ghòDhubhbhAruM illai. avarghaL ghaDhDhiன bhalibhIDhadhdhiRghu èdhire ghudhidhdhu ADhiனArghaL.

avarghaL uradhdhajhadhdhamAygh ghUbhbhiDhDhu, dha~NghaL vazhaghghadhdhiனbhaDhiye iradhdhaM dha~NghaLmel vaDhiyumaDhDhuM ghadhdhighaLAluM IDhDhighaLAluM dha~NghaLaigh ghIRighghòNDhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu èliyA jhaghala jaன~NghaLaiyuM noghghi: èன ghiDhDhe vAru~NghaL èனRAன; jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM avaன ghiDhDhe vandhabhodhu, dhagharghghabhbhaDhDha ghardhdharuDhaiya bhalibhIDhadhdhai avaன jhèbhbhaனiDhDhu;

uனghghu isravel èனனuM bher irubhbhadhAgha èனRu jhòlli, ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaibhbhèRRa yAghghobhuDhaiya ghumArarAl uNDhAன ghodhdhira~NghaLuDhaiya ilaghghadhdhiனbhaDhiye, bhaனனiraNDhu ghaRghaLai èDhudhdhu,

viRaghughaLai aDhughghi, òru ghALaiyaijh jhandhujhandhAghadh dhuNDhidhdhu viRaghughaLiன mel vaidhdhAன.

bhiRbhADhu avaன: nI~NghaL nAlughuDhaM dhaNNIr ghòNDhuvandhu, jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhaliyiனmeluM, viRaghughaLiனmeluM URRu~NghaL èனRAன; bhiனbhu iraNDhAndharamuM abhbhaDhiye URRu~NghaL èனRAன; iraNDhAndharamuM URRiனArghaL; adhaRghubhbhiனbhu mUனRAndharamuM abhbhaDhiye URRu~NghaL èனRAன; mUனRAndharamuM URRiனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu dhaNNIr bhalibhIDhadhdhaijh jhuRRiluM oDhiனdhu; vAyghghAlaiyuM dhaNNIrAl nirabhbhiனAன.

andhibhbhali jhèludhdhuM neradhdhile, dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya èliyA vandhu: AbhiraghAmughghuM IjhAghghughghuM yAghghobhughghuM dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhAve, isravelile nIr dhevaன èனRuM, nAன uMmuDhaiya UzhiyaghghAraன èனRuM, nAன indhagh ghAriya~NghaLaiyèllAM uMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhi jhèydheன èனRuM iனRaighghu viLa~NghabhbhaNNuM.

ghardhdhAve, nIr dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èனRuM, dhevarIr dha~NghaL irudhayadhdhai maRubhaDhiyuM dhirubhbhiனIr èனRuM indha jaன~NghaL aRiyuMbhaDhighghu, èனனaigh gheDhDharuLuM, èனனaigh gheDhDharuLuM èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu: ghardhdhariDhadhdhil irundhu aghghiனi iRa~Nghi, andhajh jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhaliyaiyuM, viRaghughaLaiyuM, ghaRghaLaiyuM, maNNaiyuM bhaDhjhidhdhu, vAyghghAlilirundha dhaNNIraiyuM naghghibhbhoDhDhadhu.
jaன~NghaLèllAruM idhaigh ghaNDhabhodhu, mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhu: ghardhdhare dhèyvaM, ghardhdhare dhèyvaM èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu èliyA avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL bhAghAliன dhIrghghadharijhighaLil òruvaனuM dhabhbhibhbhoghAdhabhaDhighghu avarghaLaibh bhiDhiyu~NghaL èனRAன; avarghaLaibh bhiDhidhdhabhodhu, èliyA avarghaLaigh ghIzhe ghIjhoன ARRa~Ngharaiyile ghòNDhubhoy, a~Nghe avarghaLai vèDhDhibhbhoDhDhAன.
bhiனbhu èliyA AghAbhai noghghi: nIr bhoM, bhojaனbhAனMbhaNNuM; bhèrumazhaiyiன iraijhjhal gheDhghabhbhaDhughiRadhu èனRAன.
AghAbh bhojaனbhAனM bhaNNabhbhoனAன; bhiனbhu èliyA gharmel bharvadhadhdhiனuDhaiya jhigharadhdhiனmel eRi, dharaiyile bhaNindhu, dhaன mughaM dhaன muzha~NghAlil bhaDha ghuனindhu,
dhaன UzhiyaghghAraனai noghghi: nI bhoyjh jhamudhdhiramughamAybh bhAr èனRAன; avaன bhoybh bhArdhdhu, òனRuM illai èனRAன; nI iனனuM ezhudharaM bhoybh bhAr èனRAன.

ezhAndharaM ivaன: idho, jhamudhdhiradhdhilirundhu òru maனuShaனuDhaiya uLLa~Nghai adhdhaனaijh jhiRiya meghaM èzhuMbhughiRadhu èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu avaன nI bhoy, AghAbhai noghghi: mazhai uMmaidh dhaDhaijhèyyAdhabhaDhighghu iradhadhdhaibh bhUDhDhi, bhoyviDhuM èனRu jhòl èனRAL.
adhaRghuLLAgha vAனM megha~NghaLiனAluM ghARRiனAluM ghaRudhdhu bhèrumazhai uNDhAyiRRu; AghAbh iradhadhdhil eRi yèsrayelughghubh bhoனAன.
ghardhdharuDhaiya ghai èliyAviனmel irundhadhiனAl, avaன dhaன araiyaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhu, yèsrayelughghu varumaDhDhAgha AghAbhughghumuன oDhiனAன.
èliyA jhèydha èllAvaRRaiyuM, avaன dhIrghghadharijhighaLèllAraiyuM bhaDhDhayadhdhAle ghòனRubhoDhDha jhèydhi aனaidhdhaiyuM, AghAbh yejhabhelughghu aRividhdhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu yejhabhel èliyAviனiDhadhdhil AL aனubhbhi: avarghaLil òvvòruvaனuDhaiya bhirANaனughghujh jhèyyabhbhaDhDhadhubhola, nAன nALai inneradhdhil uன bhirANaனughghu jhèyyAdhebhoனAl, dhevarghaL adhaRghujh jhariyAghavuM adhaRghu adhighamAghavuM èனghghujh jhèyyaghghaDhavarghaL èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAL.
avaனughghu adhu dhèrindhabhodhu èzhundhu, dhaன bhirANaனaigh ghAghgha yUdhAvaijhjherndha bhèyèrjhèbhAvughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, dhaன velaighghAraனai a~Nghe niRudhdhiviDhDhAன.

avaன vaனAndharadhdhil òrunAL bhirabhANaM bhoy, òru jhUraijhjhèDhiyiன ghIzh uDhghArndhu, dhAன jhAghaveNDhuM èனRu ghori: bhodhuM ghardhdhAve, èன AdhdhumAvai èDhudhdhughghòLLuM; nAன èன bhidhAghghaLaibhbhArghghiluM nallavaன alla èனRu jhòlli,
òru jhUraijhjhèDhiyiனghIzhbh bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhu nidhdhiraibhaNNiனAன; abhbhòzhudhu òru dhUdhaன avaனaidh dhaDhDhiyèzhubhbhi: èzhundhirundhu bhojaனM bhaNNu èனRAன.

a~Nghe avaன òru ghèbhighghuL bhoydh dha~NghiனAன; idho, ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai avaனughghu uNDhAghi, avar: èliyAve, i~Nghe uனghghu èனன ghAriyaM èனRAr.

bhUmi adhirjhjhighghubhbhiன aghghiனi uNDhAyiRRu; aghghiனiyiluM ghardhdhar irughghavillai; aghghiனighghubhbhiன amarndha mèlliyajhadhdhaM uNDhAyiRRu.

adhai èliyA gheDhDhabhodhu, dhaன jhAlvaiyiனAl dhaன mughadhdhai mUDhighghòNDhu vèLiye vandhu, ghèbhiyiன vAjhalil niனRAன. abhbhòzhudhu, idho, èliyAve, i~Nghe uனghghu èனன ghAriyaM èனghiRa jhadhdhaM avaனughghu uNDhAyiRRu.

adhaRghu avaன: jheனaighaLiன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghAgha vèghu bhaghdhivairAghghiyamAyirundheன; isravel bhudhdhirar umadhu uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyaidh dhaLLiviDhDhArghaL; uMmuDhaiya bhalibhIDha~NghaLai iDhidhdhu, uMmuDhaiya dhIrghghadharijhighaLaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhiனAl ghòனRubhoDhDhArghaL, nAன òruvaனmAdhdhiraM mIdhiyAyirughghiReன; èன bhirANaனaiyuM vA~Nghadh dheDhughiRArghaL èனRAன.

AனAluM bhAghAlughghu muDha~NghAdhirughghiRa muzha~NghAlghaLaiyuM, avaனai mudhdha~njhèyyAdhirughghiRa vAyghaLaiyumuDhaiya ezhAyiraMbherai isravelile mIdhiyAgha vaidhdhirughghiReன èனRAr.

abhbhaDhiye avaன avviDhaM viDhDhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, bhaனனiraNDhu erbhUDhDhi uzhudha jhAbhbhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya èlijhAvaigh ghaNDhAன; avaன bhaனனiraNDhAM erai òDhDhighghòNDhirundhAன; èliyA avaன irughghuM iDhamaDhDhuM bhoy, avaனmel dhaன jhAlvaiyaibh bhoDhDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன ivaனai viDhDhubh bhoy, or ermADhughaLaibh bhiDhidhdhu aDhidhdhu, eriன maramuDhDhughaLAl avaighaLiன iRaijhjhiyaijh jhamaidhdhu jaன~NghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdhAன; avarghaL jhAbhbhiDhDhabhiRbhADhu, avaன èzhundhu, èliyAvughghubh bhiனjhèனRu avaனughghu Uzhiya~njhèydhAன.

jhIriyAviன rAjAvAghiya bhèனAdhAdh dhaன jheனaiyaiyèllAM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu bhoy, jhamAriyAvai muRRighghaibhoDhDhu adhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNiனAன; avaனoDheghUDha mubhbhadhdhiraNDhu rAjAghghaL irundhadhumallAmal, ghudhiraighaLuM iradha~NghaLuM irundhadhu.
avaன nagharadhdhiRghuL israveliன rAjAvAghiya AghAbhiDhadhdhil sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhi:
