abhbhòzhudhu israveliன rAjA, dhejhadhdhiன mUbhbharaiyèllAM azhaibhbhidhdhu: ivaன bhòllAbhbhudh dheDhughiRa vidhadhdhaigh ghavaனidhdhubhbhAru~NghaL; èன sdhirIghaLaiyuM, èன ghumArarghaLaiyuM, èன vèLLiyaiyuM, èன bhòனனaiyuM gheDhgha, ivaன èனனiDhadhdhil AL aனubhbhiனbhodhu, nAன ghòDhughghamADhDheன èனRu ivaனughghu maRughghavillaiye èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu jhaghala mUbhbharuM jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: nIr avaனughghujh jhèvighòDhughghavuM, avaனughghujh jhaMmadhighghavuM veNDhAM èனRArghaL.

adhiனAl avaன bhèனAdhAdhdhiன sdhAனAbhadhighaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனughghujh jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl, nIr mudhal vijhai umadhu aDhiyAனughghujh jhòlliyaனubhbhiன yAvuM jhèyveன; indhagh ghAriyadhdhaiyo nAன jhèyyagh ghUDhAdhu èனRu jhòllu~NghaL èனRAன; sdhAனAbhadhighaL bhoy, indha maRumòzhiyai avaனughghujh jhòனனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu bhèனAdhAdh avaனiDhadhdhil AL aனubhbhi: èனghghubh bhiன jhèllughiRa jaன~NghaL èllAruM ghaighghu òru bhiDhiyAvadhu vArighghòLLa jhamAriyAviன dhUL bhodhumAனdhAyirundhAl, dhevarghaL adhaRghujh jhariyAghavuM adhaRghu adhighamAghavuM èனghghujh jhèyyaghghaDhavarghaL èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAன.
adhaRghu israveliன rAjA bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: AyudhaM dharidhdhirughghiRavaன, AyudhaM urindhu bhoDhughiRavaனaibhbholabh bhèrumaibhArADhDhalAghAdhu èனRu avaனughghujh jhòllu~NghaL èனRAன.

bhèனAdhAdhdhuM, maRRa rAjAghghaLuM ghUDhAra~NghaLile ghuDhidhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, indha vArdhdhaiyaigh gheDhDhu, dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai noghghi: AyadhdhaM bhaNNu~NghaL èனRAன; abhbhaDhiye nagharadhdhiனmel jhaNDhaijhèyya AyadhdhaM bhaNNiனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu òru dhIrghghadharijhi israveliன rAjAvAghiya AghAbhiDhadhdhil vandhu: andha erALamAன jaனghghUDhDhadhdhaiyèllAM ghaNDhAyA? idho, nAனe ghardhdhar èனRu nI aRiyuMbhaDhi iனRaighghu adhai uன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhubhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.

yAraighghòNDhu èனRu AghAbh gheDhDhAன; adhaRghu avaன: mAghANa~NghaLuDhaiya adhibhadhighaLiன jhevagharaigh ghòNDhu èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன; bhiனbhu avaன, yudhdhadhdhai yAr dhuvaghghaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhadhaRghu; avaன, nIrdhAன èனRAன.

avaன mAghANa~NghaLuDhaiya adhibhadhighaLiன jhevagharai ilaghghaM bhArdhdhAன, avarghaL irunURRu mubhbhadhdhiraNDhubher; avarghaLughghubhbhiனbhu, isravel bhudhdhirarAghiya jhaghala jaனdhdhiன ilaghghamuM bhArdhdhu ezhAyiraMbher èனRu ghaNDhAன.

avarghaL madhdhiyAனveLaiyile vèLiye bhuRabhbhaDhDhArghaL; bhèனAdhAdhdhuM, avaனughghu udhaviyAgha vandha mubhbhadhdhiraNDhu rAjAghghaLAghiya maRRa rAjAghghaLuM, ghUDhAra~NghaLil ghuDhidhdhu vèRighòNDhirundhArghaL.

mAghANa~NghaLuDhaiya adhibhadhighaLiன jhevaghar muனdhaNDhAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhughiRabhodhu, bhèனAdhAdh aனubhbhiன maனuShar: jhamAriyAvilirundhu maனuShar bhuRabhbhaDhDhu varughiRArghaL èனRu avaனughghu aRividhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: avarghaL jhamAdhAனdhdhiRghAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvandhAluM avarghaLai uyiroDhe bhiDhiyu~NghaL; avarghaL yudhdhadhdhiRghAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvandhAluM avarghaLai uyiroDhe bhiDhiyu~NghaL èனRAன.
mAghANa~NghaLuDhaiya adhibhadhighaLiன jhevagharAன avarghaLuM, avarghaL bhiனனe varughiRa irANuvamuM, nagharadhdhilirundhu vèLiye vandhabhodhu,

avarghaL avaravar dha~NghaLughghu èdhirbhbhaDhughiRavarghaLai vèDhDhiனArghaL; jhIriyar muRindhoDhibhbhoனArghaL; isravelar avarghaLaidh dhuradhdhiனArghaL; jhIriyAviன rAjAvAghiya bhèனAdhAdh, ghudhiraiyiன mel eRijh jhila ghudhirai vIraroDhu~NghUDhadh dhabhbhiyoDhibhbhoனAன.
israveliன rAjA bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, ghudhiraighaLaiyuM iradha~NghaLaiyuM muRiya aDhidhdhu, jhIriyaril maghA jha~NghAraM uNDhAgha vèDhDhiனAன.

bhiனbhu andhadh dhIrghghadharijhi israveliன rAjAviனiDhadhdhil vandhu, avaனai noghghi: nIr bhoy uMmaibh bhalabhbhaDhudhdhighghòNDhu, nIr jhèyyadhdhaghghadhu iனனdhèனRu ghavaனidhdhubhbhAruM; maRuvaruShadhdhile jhIriyAviன rAjA umaghghu virodhamAgha varuvAன èனRAன.

jhIriyAviன rAjAvuDhaiya UzhiyaghghArar avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: avarghaLuDhaiya dhevarghaL malaidhdhevarghaL, adhiனAl avarghaL naMmai meRghòNDhArghaL; nAM avarghaLoDhe jhamabhUmiyile yudhdhaM bhaNNiனAl nalladhu; abhbhòzhudhu avarghaLai meRghòLvadhu nijhjhayaM.
adhaRghAgha nIr jhèyyaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl, indha rAjAghghaL òvvòruvaraiyuM dha~NghaL sdhaladhdhilirundhu mARRi, avarghaLughghubh bhadhilAghajh jheனAbhadhighaLai eRbhaDhudhdhi;

nIr maDhiyaghghòDhudhdha jheனaighghujh jhariyAyjh jheனaiyaiyuM, andhagh ghudhiraighaLughghujh jhariyAygh ghudhiraighaLaiyuM, iradha~NghaLughghujh jhariyAy iradha~NghaLaiyuM ilaghghaMbhArdhdhughghòLLuM; bhiRbhADhu jhamabhUmiyile nAM avarghaLoDhu yudhdhaMbhaNNi, nijhjhayamAy avarghaLai meRghòLvoM èனRArghaL; avaன avarghaL jhòRgheDhDhu abhbhaDhiye jhèydhAன.
maRuvaruShadhdhile bhèனAdhAdh jhIriyarai ilaghghaMbhArdhdhu, israveloDhu yudhdhaMbhaNNa Abhbhèghghughghu vandhAன.

isravel bhudhdhiraruM ilaghghaM bhArghghabhbhaDhDhu, dhevaiyAனdhaijh jhaMbhAdhidhdhughghòNDhu, avarghaLai èdhirghghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, avarghaLughghu èdhire iraNDhu jhiRiya vèLLADhDhugh ghiDhaighaLaibhbholabh bhALayamiRa~NghiனArghaL; dhejhaM jhIriyarAl niRaindhirundhadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன òruvaன vandhu, israveliன rAjAvaibh bhArdhdhu: ghardhdhar bhaLLadhdhAghghughaLiன dhevaனAyirAmal, malaighaLiன dhevaனAyirughghiRAr èனRu jhIriyar jhòlliyirughghiRabhaDhiyiனAl, nAன indha erALamAன jaனghghUDhDhadhdhaiyèllAM uன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdheன; adhiனAl nAனe ghardhdhar èனRu nI~NghaL aRivIrghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.
ezhunALaLavuM avarghaL mughamughamAybh bhALayamiRa~NghiyirundhArghaL; ezhAM nALil yudhdhaM ghalandhu, isravel bhudhdhirar òrenALile jhIriyaril laDhjhaM ghAlADhghaLai maDha~NghaDhidhdhArghaL.

mIdhiyAனvarghaL Abhbhègh bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghuL oDhibhbhoனArghaL; a~Nghe mIdhiyAyirundha irubhadhdhezhAyiraMbheriன mel ala~NghaM iDhindhu vizhundhadhu; bhèனAdhAdhdhuM oDhibhbhoy nagharadhdhiRghuL bhughundhu, uLLaRaiyile bhadhu~NghiனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன UzhiyaghghArar avaனai noghghi: idho, isravel vaMjhadhdhu rAjAghghaL dhayavuLLa rAjAghghaL èனRu gheDhDhirughghiRoM; nA~NghaL iraDhDhughaLai è~NghaL araighaLil ghaDhDhi, ghayiRughaLai è~NghaL dhalaighaLil jhuRRigh ghòNDhu, israveliன rAjAviனiDhadhdhil bhovoM; òruveLai uMmai uyiroDhe vaibhbhAr èனRu jhòlli,

iraDhDhaidh dha~NghaL araighaLil ghaDhDhi, ghayiRughaLaidh dha~NghaL dhalaighaLil jhuRRighghòNDhu, israveliன rAjAviனiDhadhdhil vandhu: èனனai uyiroDhevaiyuM èனRu umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya bhèனAdhAdh viNNabhbhaMbhaNNughiRAன èனRArghaL. adhaRghu avaன, iனனuM avaன uyiroDhe irughghiRAனA, avaன èன jhaghodharaன èனRAன.

andha maனuShar naனRAygh ghavaனidhdhu, avaன vAyiன jhòllai uDhaனe bhiDhidhdhu: umadhu jhaghodharaனAghiya bhèனAdhAdh irughghiRAன èனRArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nI~NghaL bhoy, avaனai azhaidhdhugh ghòNDhuvAru~NghaL èனRAன; bhèனAdhAdh avaனiDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu, avaனaidh dhaன iradhadhdhil eRRighghòNDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhèனAdhAdh ivaனaibh bhArdhdhu: èன dhaghabhbhaன uMmuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaனAr ghaiyile bhiDhidhdha bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaidh dhiruMbhagh ghòDhudhdhuviDhughiReன; èன dhaghabhbhaன jhamAriyAvile jhèydhadhubhola, nIruM dhamasghuvile vIdhighaLai uNDhAghghighghòLLalAM èனRAன. adhaRghu avaன, indha uDhaனbhaDhighghai jhèydhu nAன uMmai aனubhbhiviDhughiReன èனRu jhòlli, avaனoDhu uDhaனbhaDhighghai bhaNNi avaனai aனubhbhiviDhDhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன bhudhdhiraril òruvaன ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhi dhaன dhozhaனai noghghi: nI èனனai aDhi èனRAன; andha maனuShaன avaனaibhbhArdhdhu aDhighghamADhDheன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன ivaனaibh bhArdhdhu: nI ghardhdharuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhiRghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhiyAmaRbhoனbhaDhiyAl, idho, nI èனனaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனvuDhaனe òru jhi~NghaM uனனaigh ghòlluM èனRAன; abhbhaDhiye ivaன avaனai viDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhavuDhaனe, òru jhi~NghaM ivaனaigh ghaNDhu ghòனRubhoDhDhadhu.
adhiனbhiன avaன veRoruvaனaigh ghaNDhu: èனனai aDhi èனRAன; andha maனuShaன, avaனaigh ghAyamuNDhAgha aDhidhdhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu andhadh dhIrghghadharijhi bhoy, dhaன mughadhdhiனmel jhAMbhalaibhbhoDhDhu, veShamARiனvaனAy vazhiyile rAjAvughghAghagh ghAdhdhirundhAன.

rAjA avvazhiyAy varughiRabhodhu, ivaன rAjAvaibhbhArdhdhugh ghUbhbhiDhDhu: umadhu aDhiyAன yudhdhadhdhil niனRabhodhu, òruvaன vilaghi, èனனiDhadhdhil òruvaனaigh ghòNDhuvandhu, indha maனuShaனaibh bhadhdhiraMbhaNNu; ivaன dhabhbhibhoனAl, uன bhirANaன avaன bhirANaனughghu IDhAyirughghuM, alladhu òru dhAlandhu vèLLiyai nI ghòDhughghaveNDhuM èனRAன.
AனAluM umadhu aDhiyAன i~NghuM a~NghuM aluvalAyirughghuMbhodhu, avaன bhoyviDhDhAன èனRAன. israveliன rAjA avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: nI jhòனன dhIrbhbhiனbhaDhiye AghuM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன jhIghghiramAydh dhaன mughadhdhiனmelirughghuM jhAMbhalaidh dhuDhaidhdhuviDhDhadhiனAl, israveliன rAjA avaன dhIrghghadharijhighaLil òruvaன èனRu aRindhughòNDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ivaன avaனai noghghi: jha~NghAradhdhiRghu nAன niyamidhdha maனuShaனai uன ghaiyilirundhu dhabhbhibhbhoghuMbhaDhi nI viDhDhabhaDhiyiனAl, uன bhirANaன avaன bhirANaனughghu IDhAghavuM, uன jaனM avaன jaனdhdhiRghu IDhAghavuM irughghuM èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.
adhiனAl israveliன rAjA jhalibhbhuM vijhaனmumAydh dhaன vIDhDhiRghubh bhoghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhujh jhamAriyAvughghu vandhAன.
ivaighaLughghubh bhiனbhu, yèsrayelaனAghiya nAbhodhdhughghu yèsrayelile jhamAriyAviன rAjAvAghiya AghAbhiன aramaனai aNDhaiyil òru dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhaM irundhadhu.

AghAbh nAbhodhdhoDhe bhejhi: uன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhaM èன vIDhDhiRghu aDhudhdhirughghiRabhaDhiyAl, adhaigh ghIraighghòllaiyAghghuMbhaDhi èனghghugh ghòDhu, adhaibhbhArghghiluM nalla dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhai adhaRghubh bhadhilAgha uனghghudh dharuveன; alladhu uனghghu veNDhumAனAl, adhiன vilaighghirayamAன bhaNadhdhaidh dharuveன èனRAன.
nAbhodh AghAbhai noghghi: nAன èன bhidhAghghaLiன jhudhandharadhdhai umaghghugh ghòDhAdhabhaDhi ghardhdhar èனனaigh ghAbhbhArAgha èனRAன.

ibhbhaDhi èன bhidhAghghaLiன jhudhandharadhdhai umaghghugh ghòDheன èனRu yèsrayelaனAghiya nAbhodh dhaனனoDhe jhòனன vArdhdhaighghAgha AghAbh jhalibhbhuM jhiனmumAy, dhaன vIDhDhiRghu vandhu, bhojaனMbhaNNAmal, dhaன ghaDhDhiliன mel bhaDhudhdhu, dhaன mughadhdhaidh dhirubhbhigh ghòNDhirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன maனaiviyAghiya yejhabhel avaனiDhadhdhil vandhu: nIr bhojaனMbhaNNAdhabhaDhighghu, uMmuDhaiya maனM jhalibhbhAyirughghiRadhu èனன èனRu avaனaigh gheDhDhadhaRghu,

avaன avaLaibh bhArdhdhu: nAன yèsrayelaனAghiya nAbhodhdhoDhe bhejhi: uன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhai èனghghu vilaighghirayamAyghghòDhu; alladhu uனghghu rAjhiyAனAl adhaRghubh bhadhilAgha veRe dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhai uனghghudh dharuveன èனReன. adhaRghu avaன: èன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhai umaghghugh ghòDhughghamADhDheன èனRu jhòனனAன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன maனaiviyAghiya yejhabhel avaனai noghghi: nIr ibhbhodhu israveliனmel rAjyabhAraMbhaNNughiRavar allavA? nIr èzhundhu bhojaனM bhaNNi maனmaghizhjhjhiyAyiruM; yèsrayelaனAghiya nAbhodhdhiன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhai nAன umaghghugh ghòDhubhbheன èனRu jhòனனAL.

avaL AghAbhiன bhèyarAl nirubha~NghaLai èzhudhi, avaன mudhdhiraiyai avaighaLughghubh bhoDhDhu, andha nirubha~NghaLai nAbhodh irughghuM bhaDhDhaNadhdhil avaனoDhe ghuDhiyirughghiRa mUbhbhariDhadhdhughghuM bhèriyoriDhadhdhughghuM aனubhbhiனAL.
andha nirubha~NghaLil avaL èzhudhiனdhu èனனvèனRAl: nI~NghaL ubhavAjhaM èனRu bhirajhidhdhabhbhaDhudhdhi, nAbhodhdhai jaனdhdhiன muன niRudhdhi,

dhevaனaiyuM rAjAvaiyuM dhUShidhdhAy èனRu avaனmel jhADhjhijhòllughiRa bheliyALiன maghghaLAghiya iraNDhu bherai avaனughghu èdhirAgha niRudhdhi, avaனai vèLiye ghòNDhubhoy avaன jhAghuMbhaDhighghu avaனaigh ghallèRiyu~NghaL èனRu èzhudhiனAL.

avaன bhaDhDhaNadhdhile ghuDhiyirughghiRa mUbhbharuM bhèriyorumAghiya avaன bhaDhDhaNadhdhu maனuShar, yejhabhel dha~NghaLughghu aனubhbhiன nirubha~NghaLil èzhudhighghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirundhabhaDhiye jhèydhArghaL.
avarghaL ubhavAjhaM èனRu bhirajhidhdhabhbhaDhudhdhi nAbhodhdhai jaனdhdhiன muனனe niRudhdhiனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu bheliyALiன maghghaLAghiya iraNDhu bher vandhu, avaனughghu èdhirAgha uDhghArndhu: nAbhodh dhevaனaiyuM rAjAvaiyuM dhUShidhdhAன èனRu jaனdhdhiRghu muனbhAgha avaனmel jhADhjhi jhòனனArghaL; adhaRghubhbhiனbhu avaனaibh bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghu vèLiye ghòNDhu bhoy, avaன jhAghuMbhaDhighghu avaனaigh ghallèRindhu,
bhiRbhADhu yejhabhelughghu, nAbhodh ghallèRiyuNDhu jhèdhdhAன èனRu jhòlliyaனubhbhiனArghaL.

nAbhodh ghallèRiyuNDhu jhèdhdhadhai yejhabhel gheDhDhabhodhu, AghAbhai noghghi: nIr èzhundhirundhu, yèsrayelaனAghiya nAbhodh umaghghu vilaighghirayamAygh ghòDhughghamADhDheன èனRu jhòனன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhaijh jhòndhamAy èDhudhdhughghòLLuM; nAbhodh uyiroDhillai, avaன jhèdhdhubhbhoனAன èனRAL.
nAbhodh jhèdhdhubhbhoனdhai AghAbh gheDhDhabhodhu, avaன yèsrayelaனAghiya nAbhodhdhiன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhaijh jhòndhamAy èDhudhdhughghòLLuMbhaDhi èzhundhubhoனAன.
ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai dhisbhiyaனAghiya èliyAvughghu uNDhAyiRRu, avar:
nI èzhundhu, jhamAriyAvilirughghiRa israveliன rAjAvAghiya AghAbhaijh jhandhighghuMbhaDhi bho; idho, avaன nAbhodhdhiன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhaijh jhòndhamAy èDhudhdhughghòLLa a~Nghe bhoyirughghiRAன.

nI avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: nI ghòlai jhèydhadhuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhadhuM illaiyo èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; nAyghaL nAbhodhdhiன iradhdhadhdhai naghghiன sdhaladhdhile uனனuDhaiya iradhdhadhdhaiyuM nAyghaL naghghuM èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu AghAbh èliyAvai noghghi: èன bhaghai~naனe, èனனaigh ghaNDhubhiDhidhdhAyA èனRAன. adhaRghu avaன: ghaNDhubhiDhidhdheன; ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghubh bhòllAbhbhAனdhaijh jhèyya nI uனனai viRRubhbhoDhDhAy.

nAன uனmel bhòllAbhbhu varabhbhaNNi, uன jhandhadhiyai azhidhdhubhbhoDhDhu, AghAbhughghu jhuvaril nIrviDhuM òru nAyAghiluM irAdhabhaDhighghu isravelil aDhaibhaDhDhavaனaiyuM viDhubhaDhDhavaனaiyuM jha~Ngharidhdhu,

nI èனghghugh ghobhaM uNDhAghghi, isravelaibh bhAva~njhèyyabhbhaNNiனdhiனimidhdhaM, uனனuDhaiya ghuDhuMbhadhdhai nebhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yèròbhèyAmiன ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghuM, aghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhAShAviன ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghuM jhamAனmAghghuveன èனRAr èனRu jhòனனAன.
yejhabhelaiyuM ghuRidhdhugh ghardhdhar: nAyghaL yejhabhelai yèsrayeliன madhil arughe dhiனனuM.
AghAbhiன jhandhadhiyil bhaDhDhaNadhdhile, jhAghiRavaனai nAyghaLuM, vèLiyile jhAghiRavaனai AghAyadhdhubh bhaRavaighaLuM dhiனனuM èனRAr.
dhaன maனaiviyAghiya yejhabhel dhUNDhiviDhDhabhaDhiye, ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghubh bhòllAbhbhAனdhaijh jhèyya, dhaனனai viRRubhbhoDhDha AghAbhaibhbhola òruvaனumillai.
ghardhdhar isravel bhudhdhirarughghu muனனiனRu dhuradhdhiviDhDha èmoriyar jhèydhabhaDhiyèllAM, avaன naraghalAன vighghiragha~NghaLaibh bhiனbhaRRi, maghA aruvarubhbhAy naDhandhughòNDhAன.

AghAbh indha vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhabhodhu, dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhu, dhaன jharIradhdhiனmel iraDhDhaibhbhordhdhughghòNDhu, ubhavAjhaMbhaNNi, iraDhDhile bhaDhudhdhudh dhAzhmaiyAy naDhandhughòNDhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai dhisbhiyaனAghiya èliyAvughghu uNDhAyiRRu, avar:

AghAbh èனghghu muனbhAghadh dhaனனaidh dhAzhdhdhiனdhaigh ghaNDhAyA? avaன èனghghu muனbhAghadh dhaனனaidh dhAzhdhdhughiRabhaDhiyiனAl, nAன avaன nADhghaLil andhabh bhòllabhbhai varabhbhaNNAmal, avaன ghumAraன nADhghaLil adhai avaன vIDhDhiனmel varabhbhaNNuveன èனRAr.
jhIriyarughghuM isravelarughghuM mUனRu varuShaM yudhdhamillAmalirundhadhu.
mUனRAM varuShadhdhile yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yojhabhAdh israveliன rAjAviனiDhadhdhiRghubh bhoyirughghuM bhodhu,

israveliன rAjA dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai noghghi: ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodh naMmuDhaiyadhèனRu aRiyIrghaLA? nAM adhaijh jhIriyA rAjAviன ghaiyilirundhu bhiDhidhdhughghòLLAmal, jhuMmAyirubhbhAனeன èனRu jhòlli,

yojhabhAdhdhai noghghi: ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNa èனனoDheghUDha varughiRIrA èனRu gheDhDhAன. yojhabhAdh israveliன rAjAvai noghghi: nAனdhAன nIr, èனனuDhaiya jaன~NghaL uMmuDhaiya jaன~NghaL, èனனuDhaiya ghudhiraighaL uMmuDhaiya ghudhiraighaL èனRAன.
bhiனனuM yojhabhAdh israveliன rAjAvaibh bhArdhdhu: ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyai iனRaighghu vijhAridhdhu aRiyuM èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu israveliன rAjA eRaghghuRaiya nAனURu dhIrghghadharijhighaLaigh ghUDhivarajhjhèydhu: nAன ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNabhbhoghalAmA, bhoghalAghAdhA èனRu avarghaLaigh gheDhDhadhaRghu; avarghaL, bhoM, ANDhavar rAjAviன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhubhbhAr èனRArghaL.
bhiனbhu yojhabhAdh: nAM vijhAridhdhu aRighiRadhaRghu ivarghaLaiyallAmal ghardhdharuDhaiya dhIrghghadharijhi veRe yArAghiluM i~Nghe illaiyA èனRu gheDhDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu israveliன rAjA, yojhabhAdhdhai noghghi: ghardhdhariDhadhdhil vijhAridhdhu aRighiRadhaRghu iMlAviன ghumAraனAghiya mighAyA èனனuM iனனuM òruvaன irughghiRAன; AனAluM nAன avaனaibh bhaghaighghiReன; avaன èனனaigh ghuRidhdhu naனmaiyAgha alla, dhImaiyAghave dhIrghghadharijhaன~njhòllughiRavaன èனRAன. adhaRghu yojhabhAdh, rAjAve, abhbhaDhijh jhòllaveNDhAM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu israveliன rAjA bhiradhAனighaLil òruvaனaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu: iMlAviன ghumAraனAghiya mighAyAvaijh jhIghghiramAy azhaidhdhuvA èனRAன.

israveliன rAjAvuM, yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yojhabhAdhdhuM, jhamAriyAviன òlimughavAjhalughghu muனனirughghuM vijhAladhdhile rAjavasdhiraM dharidhdhughghòNDhavarghaLAy, avaravar dhaMdhaM jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhil uDhghArndhirundhArghaL; jhaghala dhIrghghadharijhighaLuM avarghaLughghu muனbhAghadh dhIrghghadharijhighaLuM avarghaLughghu muனbhAghadh dhIrghghadharijhaன~njhòனனArghaL.
gheனAனAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhidheghghiyA dhaனghghu irubhbhughghòMbhughaLai uNDhAghghi, ivaighaLAl nIr jhIriyarai muDhDhi nirmUlamAghghibh bhoDhuvIr èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.

jhaghala dhIrghghadharijhighaLuM adhaRghu ijhaivAghadh dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòlli, ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhughghubhbhoM, umaghghu vAyghghuM; ghardhdhar adhai rAjAviன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhubhbhAr èனRArghaL.

mighAyAvai azhaighghabhbhoன AL avaனuDhaன bhejhi: idho, dhIrghghadharijhighaLuDhaiya vArdhdhaighaL eghavAghghAy rAjAvughghu naனmaiyAyirughghiRadhu; uMmuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyuM avarghaLil òruvar vArdhdhaiyaibhbhola irughghuMbhaDhi naனmaiyAghajh jhòlluM èனRAன.
adhaRghu mighAyA: ghardhdhar èனனiDhadhdhil jhòlvadhaiye jhòlluveன èனRu ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRAன.

avaன rAjAviனiDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu, rAjA avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: mighAyAve, nA~NghaL ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNabhbhoghalAmA, bhoghalAghAdhA èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu avaன: bhoM, umaghghu vAyghghuM; ghardhdhar adhai rAjAviனghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhubhbhAr èனRAன.
rAjA avaனaibh bhArdhdhu: nI ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhile uNmaiyai allAmal veRòனRaiyuM èனனiDhadhdhil jhòllAdhabhaDhighghu, nAன èdhdhaனaidharaM uனனai ANaiyiDhuvighghaveNDhuM èனRu jhòனனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: isravelarèllAruM meybhbhaன illAdha ADhughaLaibhbhola malaighaLile jhidhaRabhbhaDhDhadhaigh ghaNDheன; abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar: ivarghaLughghu èjamAன illai; avaravar dhaM dhaM vIDhDhiRghujh jhamAdhAனdhdhoDhe dhiruMbhaghghaDhavarghaL èனRAr èனRu jhòனனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu israveliன rAjA yojhabhAdhdhai noghghi: ivaன èனனai ghuRidhdhu naனmaiyAgha alla, dhImaiyAghave dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòllughiRavaன èனRu nAன uMmoDhe jhòllavillaiyA èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன jhòனனdhu: ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLuM; ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiன mel vIRRirughghiRadhaiyuM, bharamajheனaiyèllAM avariDhaM avar valadhubhaghghadhdhiluM avar iDhadhubhaghghadhdhiluM niRghiRadhaiyuM ghaNDheன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar: AghAbh bhoy, ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhil vizhuMbhaDhighghu, avaனughghubh bhodhaனai jhèyghiRavaன yAr èனRu gheDhDhadhaRghu, òruvaன ibhbhaDhiyuM òruvaன abhbhaDhiyuM jhòனனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu òru Avi bhuRabhbhaDhDhu vandhu, ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha niனRu: nAன avaனughghubh bhodhaனai jhèyveன èனRadhu.

èdhiனAl èனRu ghardhdhar adhaigh gheDhDhAr. abhbhòzhudhu adhu: nAன bhoy, avaனuDhaiya dhIrghghadharijhighaL èllAriன vAyiluM bhòyyiன AviyAy irubhbheன èனRadhu. adhaRghu avar: nI avaனughghubh bhodhaனaijhèydhu abhbhaDhi naDhaghghabhbhaNNuvAy; bhoy abhbhaDhijh jhèy èனRAr.
AdhalAl ghardhdhar bhòyyiன Aviyai indha uMmuDhaiya dhIrghghadharijhighaLAghiya ivarghaL èllAruDhaiya vAyiluM ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAr; ghardhdhar uMmaigh ghuRidhdhudh dhImaiyAghajh jhòனனAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu gheனAனAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhidheghghiyA ghiDhDhevandhu, mighAyAvaigh ghaனனdhdhil aDhidhdhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya Avi èndhavazhiyAy èனனaiviDhDhu uனனoDhe bhejhuMbhaDhi vandhadhu èனRAன.
adhaRghu mighAyA: nI òLidhdhughghòLLa uLLaRaiyile bhadhu~NghuM annALile adhaigh ghANbhAy èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu israveliன rAjA: mighAyAvaibh bhiDhidhdhu, avaனaibh bhaDhDhaNadhdhudh dhalaivaனAghiya AmoனiDhadhdhiRghuM, rAjAviன ghumAraனAghiya yovAjhiDhadhdhiRghuM dhiruMbhagh ghòNDhu bhoy,

ivaனaijh jhiRaijhjhAlaiyile vaidhdhu, nAன jhamAdhAனdhdhoDhe varumaLavuM, ivaனughghu iDhughghadhdhiன abhbhadhdhaiyuM iDhughghadhdhiன dhaNNIraiyuM jhAbhbhiDhaghghòDhu~NghaL èனRu rAjA jhòனனAr èனRu jhòllu~NghaL èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu mighAyA: nIr jhamAdhAனdhdhoDhe dhiruMbhivarughiRadhu uNDhAனAl, ghardhdhar èனனaigh ghòNDhu bhejhiனdhillai èனRu jhòlli; jaன~NghaLe, nI~NghaL èllAruM idhaigh gheLu~NghaL èனRAன.
bhiனbhu israveliன rAjAvuM, yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yojhabhAdhdhuM ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhughghubh bhoனArghaL.
israveliன rAjA yojhabhAdhdhai noghghi: nAன veShaMmARi yudhdhadhdhil bhiravejhibhbheன; nIro rAjavasdhiraM dharidhdhiruM èனRu jhòlli, israveliன rAjA veShaMmARi, yudhdhadhdhil bhiravejhidhdhAன.

jhIriyAviன rAjA dhaனghghu irughghiRa iradha~NghaLiன mubhbhadhdhiraNDhu dhalaivaraiyuM noghghi: nI~NghaL jhiRiyavaroDhuM bhèriyavaroDhuM yudhdhaMbhaNNAmal israveliன rAjA òruvaனoDhemAdhdhiraM yudhdhaMbhaNNu~NghaL èனRu ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirundhAன.

AdhalAl iradha~NghaLiன dhalaivar yojhabhAdhdhaigh ghANghaiyil, ivaன dhAன israveliன rAjA èனRu jhòlli yudhdhaMbhaNNa avaனughghu nerAghajh jhAyndhuvandhArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu yojhabhAdh ghUghghuraliDhDhAன.
ivaன israveliன rAjA alla èனRu iradha~NghaLiன dhalaivar ghaNDhu avaனaiviDhDhu, vilaghibhbhoனArghaL.

òruvaன niனaiyAmal villai nANeRRi èydhAன; adhu israveliன rAjAviனuDhaiya ghavajhadhdhiன jhandhughaLughghuL bhaDhDhadhu; abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன jhAradhiyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI dhirubhbhi èனனai irANuvadhdhughghabhbhAl ghòNDhubho; èனghghugh ghAyaMbhaDhDhadhu èனRAன.

aனRaiyadhiனM yudhdhaM adhigharidhdhadhu; rAjAvaijh jhIriyarughghu èdhirAgha iradhadhdhil niRudhdhivaidhdhArghaL; jhAya~NghAladhdhile avaன iRandhubhoனAன; ghAyadhdhiன iradhdhaM iradhadhdhiன dhaDhDhile vaDhindhadhu.
bhòzhudhubhoghuMbhodhu avaravar dhaMdhaM bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghuM, avaravar dhaM dhaM dhejhadhdhiRghuM bhoghalAM èனRu irANuvadhdhil bhaRaijhARRabhbhaDhDhadhu.
abhbhaDhiye rAjA iRandhabhiனbhu, jhamAriyAvughghugh ghòNDhuvarabhbhaDhDhAன; rAjAvaijh jhamAriyAvil aDhaghghaM bhaNNiனArghaL.
andha iradhadhdhaiyuM avaனuDhaiya ghavajhadhdhaiyuM jhamAriyAviன ghuLadhdhile ghazhuvughiRabhodhu, ghardhdhar jhòlliyirundha vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye, nAyghaL avaன iradhdhadhdhai naghghiனdhu.

AghAbhiன maRRa vardhdhamAன~NghaLuM, avaன jhèydhavai yAvuM, avaன ghaDhDhiன dhandha aramaனaiyiன varalARuM, avaன ghaDhDhiன èllAbh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன varalARuM isravel rAjAghghaLiன nALAghamabh bhusdhaghadhdhil allavo èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu.
AghAbh dhaன bhidhAghghaLoDhe nidhdhiraiyaDhaindhabhiன, avaன ghumAraனAghiya aghajhiyA avaன sdhaladhdhil rAjAvAனAன.
AjhAviன ghumAraனAghiya yojhabhAdh israveliன rAjAvAghiya AghAbhiன nAlAM varuShadhdhil yUdhAviனmel rAjAvAனAன.
yojhabhAdh rAjAvAghiRabhodhu mubhbhadhdhaindhu vayadhAyirundhu, irubhadhdhaindhu varuShaM èrujhalemil rAjyabhAraMbhaNNiனAன; jhilghiyiன ghumAradhdhiyAghiya avaனuDhaiya dhAyiன bher ajhubhAL.

avaன dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya AjhAviன vazhighaLilèllAM naDhandhAன; avaன adhai viDhDhu vilaghAmal ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghujh jhèMmaiyAனdhaijh jhèydhAன; AghiluM meDhaighaL dhagharghghabhbhaDhavillai; jaன~NghaL iனனuM meDhaighaLiனmel bhaliyiDhDhudh dhUbha~NghADhDhivandhArghaL.
yojhabhAdh israveliன rAjAvoDhe jhamAdhAனmAyirundhAன.
yojhabhAdhdhiன maRRa vardhdhamAன~NghaLuM, avaன ghADhDhiya vallamaiyuM, avaன bhaNNiன yudhdhamuM, yUdhAvuDhaiya rAjAghghaLiன nALAghamabh bhusdhaghadhdhil allavo èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu.
dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya AjhAviன nADhghaLil mIdhiyAy viDhDhirundha ilajhjhaiyAன bhuNarjhjhighghAraraiyuM avaன dhejhadhdhilirundhu aRRubhbhoghabhbhaNNiனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu edhomil rAjA illai; bhiradhirAjA òruvaன irundhAன.
bhòனனughghAgha obhbhIrughghubh bhoghuMbhaDhi, yojhabhAdh dharShIs ghabhbhalghaLaijh jhèydhAன; AனAl avaighaL bhoghavillai; avaighaL èjhiyoனghebherile uDhaindhubhoyiன.

abhbhòzhudhu AghAbhiன ghumAraனAghiya aghajhiyA yojhabhAdhdhai noghghi: èன velaighghArar uMmuDhaiya velaighghAraroDhu~NghUDhagh ghabhbhalghaLile bhoghaDhDhuM èனRAன; adhaRghu yojhabhAdh jhaMmadhighghavillai.
yojhabhAdh dhaன bhidhAghghaLoDhe nidhdhiraiyaDhaindhu, dhAvIdhiன nagharadhdhile dhaன bhidhAghghaLoDhe aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhAன; avaன ghumAraனAghiya yorAM avaன sdhAனdhdhil rAjAvAனAன.
AghAbhiன ghumAraனAghiya aghajhiyA yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yojhabhAdhdhiன bhadhiனezhAM varuShadhdhile jhamAriyAvil rAjAvAghi, israveliனmel iraNDhu varuShaM rAjyabhAraMbhaNNi,

ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghubh bhòllAbhbhAனdhaijh jhèydhu, dhaன dhaghabhbhaன vazhiyiluM, dhaன dhAyiன vazhiyiluM, isravelaibh bhAva~njhèyyabhbhaNNiன nebhAdhdhiன ghumAraன yèròbhèyAmiன vazhiyiluM naDhandhu,
bhAghAlaijh jhevidhdhu, avaனaibh bhaNindhughòNDhu, dhaன dhaghabhbhaன jhèydhabhaDhiyèllAM israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghugh ghobhamuNDhAghghiனAன.
AghAbh maraNamaDhaindhabhiன, movAbhiyar isravelughghu virodhamAygh ghalaghaMbhaNNibh bhirindhu bhoனArghaL.

aghajhiyA jhamAriyAvilirughghiRa dhaன melvIDhDhilirundhu ghirAdhiyiன vazhiyAy vizhundhu, viyAdhibhbhaDhDhu: indha viyAdhi nI~Nghibh bhizhaibhbheனA èனRu èghroனiன dhevaனAghiya bhAghAljhebhUbhiDhadhdhil bhoy vijhAriyu~NghaL èனRu ADhghaLai aனubhbhiனAன.

ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன dhisbhiyaனAghiya èliyAvai noghghi: nI èzhundhu, jhamAriyAvuDhaiya rAjAviன ADhghaLughghu èdhirbhbhaDhabhbhoy: isravelile dhevaன illaiyèனRA nI~NghaL èghroனiன dhevaனAghiya bhAghAljhebhUbhiDhadhdhil vijhArighghabhbhoghiRIrghaL?
idhiனimidhdhaM nI eRiன ghaDhDhililirundhu iRa~NghAmal, jhAghave jhAvAy èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனbhadhai avarghaLoDhe jhòl èனRAன; abhbhaDhiye èliyA bhoyjh jhòனனAன.
andha ADhghaL avaனiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhivandhabhodhu: nI~NghaL dhiruMbhi vandhadhu èனன èனRu avaன avarghaLiDhadhdhil gheDhDhAன.

adhaRghu avarghaL: òru maனuShaன è~NghaLughghu èdhirbhbhaDhDhuvandhu: nI~NghaL u~NghaLai aனubhbhiன rAjAviனiDhadhdhil dhiruMbhibhbhoy, isravelile dhevaன illaiyèனRA nI èghroனiன dhevaனAghiya bhAghAljhebhUbhiDhadhdhil vijhArighghabhbhoghiRAy; idhiனimidhdhaM nI eRiன ghaDhDhililirundhu iRa~NghAmal jhAghave jhAvAy èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனbhadhai avaனoDhe jhòllu~NghaL èனRAன èனRu jhòனனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன avarghaLai noghghi: u~NghaLughghu èdhirbhbhaDhDhu vandhu, indha vArdhdhaighaLai u~NghaLiDhadhdhil jhòனன maனuShaன èbhbhaDhibh bhaDhDhavaன èனRu gheDhDhAன.
adhaRghu avarghaL: avaன mayir uDhaiyaidh dharidhdhu, vArghghajhjhaiyaidh dhaன araiyile ghaDhDhighghòNDhirundhAன èனRArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu avaன: dhisbhiyaனAghiya èliyAdhAன èனRu jhòlli;

avaனiDhadhdhiRghu òru dhalaivaனaiyuM, avaனuDhaiya aiMbhadhu jhevagharaiyuM aனubhbhiனAன; malaiyiன ujhjhiyil uDhghArndhirughghiRa avaனiDhadhdhil ivaன eRibhbhoy: dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனe, rAjA uனனai varajhjhòllughiRAr èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu èliyA, andha aiMbhadhubheriன dhalaivaனughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: nAன dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனAனAl, aghghiனi vAனdhdhilirundhu iRa~Nghi, uனனaiyuM uன aiMbhadhubheraiyuM bhaDhjhighghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAன; uDhaனe aghghiனi vAனdhdhilirundhu iRa~Nghi, avaனaiyuM avaன aiMbhadhu bheraiyuM bhaDhjhidhdhadhu.

èliyA avarghaLughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: nAன dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனAனAl, aghghiனi vAனdhdhilirundhu iRa~Nghi, uனனaiyuM uன aiMbhadhubheraiyuM bhaDhjhighghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAன; uDhaனe dhevaனuDhaiya aghghiனi vAனdhdhilirundhu iRa~Nghi, avaனaiyuM avaன aiMbhadhubheraiyuM bhaDhjhidhdhadhu.

èrighovilirundha dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன bhudhdhirar èlijhAviனiDhadhdhil vandhu: iனRaighghugh ghardhdhar uனghghudh dhalaimaiyAyirughghiRa uன èjamAனai uனனaiviDhDhu èDhudhdhughghòLvAr èனbhadhu uனghghudh dhèriyumA èனRu avaனaigh gheDhDhArghaL. adhaRghu avaன: èனghghudh dhèriyuM, jhuMmA iru~NghaL èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன sdhAனdhdhil rAjAvAghabhbhoghiRa dhaன jheShDhabhudhdhiraனaibh bhiDhidhdhu, ala~Nghadhdhiனmel avaனaijh jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனmAgha bhaliyiDhDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu isravelarmel ghaDhu~NghobhaM mUNDhadhiனAl, avarghaL avaனaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, dha~NghaL dhejhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhi viDhDhArghaL.

dhIrghghadharijhighaLuDhaiya bhudhdhiraril òruvaனughghu maனaiviyAyirundha òru sdhirI èlijhAvaibh bhArdhdhu: umadhu aDhiyAனAghiya èன bhuruShaன iRandhu bhoனAன; umadhu aDhiyAன ghardhdharughghubh bhayandhu naDhandhAன èனbhadhai aRivIr; ghaDhaனghòDhudhdhavaன ibhbhodhu èன iraNDhu ghumAraraiyuM dhaனghghu aDhimaighaLAghghigh ghòLLa vandhAன èனRAன.

èlijhA avaLai noghghi: nAன uனghghu èனனjhèyya veNDhuM? vIDhDhil uனனiDhadhdhil èனன irughghiRadhu jhòl èனRAன. adhaRghu avaL: òru ghuDhaM èNNèy allAmal umadhu aDhiyALuDhaiya vIDhDhil veRòனRuM illai èனRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nI bhoy, uனனuDhaiya ayalvIDhDhughArar èllAriDhadhdhiluM aneghaM vèRuMbhAdhdhira~NghaLaigh gheDhDhuvA~Nghi,
uLLe bhoy, uன bhiLLaighaLuDhaன uLLe niனRu ghadhavaibh bhUDhDhi, andhabh bhAdhdhira~NghaL èllAvaRRiluM vArdhdhu, niRaindhadhai òru bhaghghadhdhil vai èனRAன.
avaL avaனiDhadhdhilirundhu bhoy, dhaன bhiLLaighaLuDhaன ghadhavaibh bhUDhDhighghòNDhu, ivarghaL bhAdhdhira~NghaLai avaLiDhadhdhil ghòDhughgha, avaL avaighaLil vArdhdhAL.
andhabh bhAdhdhira~NghaL niRaindha bhiன, avaL dhaன maghaன òruvaனai noghghi: iனனuM òru bhAdhdhiraM ghòNDhuvA èனRAL. adhaRghu avaன: veRe bhAdhdhiraM illai èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu èNNèy niனRu; bhoyiRRu.

avaL bhoy dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனughghu adhai aRividhdhAL. abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nI bhoy andha èNNèyai viRRu, uன ghaDhaனaidh dhIrdhdhu, mIndhadhaighghòNDhu nIyuM uன bhiLLaighaLuM jIvaனMbhaNNu~NghaL èனRAன.

bhiனbhu òrunAL èlijhA jhUனemughghubh bhoyirughghuMbhodhu, a~Ngheyirundha ghaனMbhòrundhiya òru sdhirI avaனai bhojaனMbhaNNa varundhigh gheDhDhughghòNDhAL; abhbhaDhiye avaன bhayaNabhbhaDhDhu varughiRabhodhèllAM bhojaனMbhaNNuMbhaDhi a~Nghe vandhu dha~NghuvAன.
avaL dhaன bhuruShaனai noghghi: idho, naMmiDhadhdhil èbhbhodhuM vandhubhoghiRa dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனAghiya ivar bharijhudhdhavAன èனRu ghANghiReன.

nAM mèdhdhaiyiனmel òru jhiRiya aRaivIDhDhaigh ghaDhDhi, adhil avarughghu òru ghaDhDhilaiyuM, mejaiyaiyuM, nARghAliyaiyuM, ghudhdhuviLaghghaiyuM vaibhbhoM; avar naMmiDhadhdhil varuMbhodhu a~Nghe dha~NghalAM èனRAL.
òrunAL avaன a~Nghe vandhu, andha aRaivIDhDhile dha~Nghi, a~Nghe bhaDhudhdhughghòNDhirundhAன.
avaன dhaன velaighghAraனAghiya gheyAjhiyai noghghi: indhajh jhUனemiyALai azhaidhdhugh ghòNDhuvA èனRAன; avaLai azhaidhdhugh ghòNDhu vandhAன; avaL avaனughghu muனbhAgha niனRAL.

avaன gheyAjhiyaibh bhArdhdhu: idho, ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha jhaghala jhalaghgharaNaiyoDhuM è~NghaLai vijhAridhdhu varughiRAye, uனghghu nAன èனன jhèyyaveNDhuM? rAjAviனiDhadhdhilAvadhu jheனAbhadhiyiனiDhadhdhilAvadhu uனghghAgha nAன bhejhaveNDhiya ghAriyaM uNDho èனRu avaLaigh gheL èனRAன. adhaRghu avaL: èன jaனdhdhiன naDhuve nAன jhughamAygh ghuDhiyirughghiReன èனRAL.
avaLughghujh jhèyyaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRu gheyAjhiyai avaன gheDhDhadhaRghu; avaன, avaLughghubh bhiLLai illai, avaL bhuruShaனuM bhèriya vayadhuLLavaன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன: avaLaigh ghUbhbhiDhu èனRAன; avaLaigh ghUbhbhiDhDha bhodhu, avaL vandhu vAjhaRbhaDhiyile niனRAL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: òru bhirANa uRbhadhdhighAladhdhiDhDhadhdhile òru ghumAraனai aNaidhdhugh ghòNDhirubhbhAy èனRAன. adhaRghu avaL: edhu? dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனAghiya èன ANDhavaனe, umadhu aDhiyALughghu abhadhdhaM jhòllaveNDhAM èனRAL.
andha sdhirI gharbhbhandharidhdhu, èlijhA dhaனனoDhe jhòனனbhaDhi, òru uRbhadhdhighAladhdhiDhDhadhdhil òru ghumAraனai bhèRRAL.
andhabh bhiLLai vaLarndhAன, òru nAL avaன aRubhbhaRughghiRavarghaLiDhadhdhilirundha dhaன dhaghabhbhaனNDhaighghubh bhoyirughghuMbhodhu,
dhaன dhaghabhbhaனaibh bhArdhdhu: eன dhalai noghiRadhu, èன dhalai noghiRadhu èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu avaன velaighghAraனiDhadhdhil, ivaனai ivaன dhAyiனiDhadhdhil èDhudhdhughghòNDhubhoyviDhu èனRAன.
avaனai èDhudhdhu, avaன dhAyiனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhubhoனbhodhu, avaன madhdhiyAனmaDhDhuM avaL maDhiyil irundhu jhèdhdhubhbhoனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaL eRibhbhoy, avaனai dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன ghaDhDhiliனmel vaidhdhu, avaன vaighghabhbhaDhDha aRaiyiன ghadhavaibh bhUDhDhigh ghòNDhubhoy,

dhaன bhuruShaனiDhadhdhil AL aனubhbhi: nAன jhIghghiramAy dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன irughghuM iDhamaDhDhuM bhoyvaruMbhaDhighghu; velaighghAraril òruvaனaiyuM òru ghazhudhaiyaiyuM èனghghu aனubhbhaveNDhuM èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: idhu amAvAjhiyuM alla oyvunALuM allave; nI iனRaighghu avariDhadhdhughghubh bhoghaveNDhiyadhu èனன èனRu gheDhghajhjhòனனAன. adhaRaύghu avaL: èҠύlAM jhariĠξன, nAன bhogha veNDhiyirughghiRadhu èனRu jhòlliyaனubhbhi,

ghazhudhaiyiனmel jheNaMvaidhdhu eRi, dhaன velaighghAraனai noghghi: idhai oDhDhighghòNDhubho; nAன uனghghujh jhòனனAl òzhiya bhoghiRa vazhiyil è~NghuM oDhDhadhdhai niRudhdhAdhe èனRu jhòllibh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu,

gharmel bharvadhadhdhilirughghiRa dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனiDhadhdhiRghubh bhoனAL; dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன dhUradhdhile avaLai varaghghaNDhu, dhaன velaighghAraனAghiya gheyAjhiyaibh bhArdhdhu: adho jhUனemiyAL varughiRAL.
nI avaLughghu èdhirghòNDhu oDhi, nI jhughamAyirughghiRAyA? uன bhuruShaன jhughamAyirughghiRAனA? andhabh bhiLLai jhughamAyirughghiRadhA èனRu avaLiDhadhdhil gheL èனRAன. avaL: jhughandhAன èனRu jhòlli,

bharvadhadhdhilirughghiRa dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனiDhadhdhil vandhu, avaன ghAlaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhAL; abhbhòzhudhu gheyAjhi avaLai vilaghghiviDha vandhAன; dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன: avaLaidh dhaDhughghAdhe; avaL AdhdhumA dhughghamAyirughghiRadhu; ghardhdhar adhai èனghghu aRiviyAmal maRaidhdhu vaidhdhAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaL, nAன èன ANDhavaனiDhadhdhil òru ghumAraனai veNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhadhuNDhA? èனghghu abhadhdhaM jhòllaveNDhAM èனRu nAன jhòllavillaiyA èனRAL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன gheyAjhiyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI uன iDhaiyaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhu, èன dhaDhiyai uன ghaiyil bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu, vazhiyil òruvaனaijh jhandhidhdhAluM avaனai viனvAmaluM, uனனai òruvaன viனviனAluM avaனughghu maRumòzhi jhòllAmaluM bhoy; èன dhaDhiyai andhabh bhiLLaiyiன mughadhdhiனmel vai èனRAன.
bhiLLaiyiன dhAyo: nAன uMmai viDhughiRadhillai èனRu ghardhdhariன jIvaனaiyuM uMmuDhaiya jIvaனaiyuM ghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRAL; abhbhòzhudhu avaன èzhundhirundhu avaL bhiனனe bhoனAன.

gheyAjhi avarghaLughghu muனனe bhoy, andhadh dhaDhiyaibh bhiLLaiyiன mughadhdhiனmel vaidhdhAன; AனAluM jhadhdhamuM illai, uNarjhjhiyuM illai; AghaiyAl avaன dhiruMbhi avaனughghu èdhirghòNDhuvandhu: bhiLLai vizhighghavillai èனRu avaனughghu aRividhdhAன.
èlijhA vIDhDhiRghuL vandhabhodhu, idho, andhabh bhiLLai avaன ghaDhDhiliனmel jhèdhdhughghiDhandhAன.
uLLe bhoydh dha~NghaL iruvarughghuM bhiனனAgha avaன ghadhavaibh bhUDhDhi, ghardhdharai noghghi veNDhudhal jhèydhu,

ghiDhDhebhoy, dhaன vAy bhiLLaiyiன vAyiனmeluM, dhaன ghaNghaL avaன ghaNghaLiனmeluM, dhaன uLLa~NghaighaL avaன uLLa~NghaighaLiனmeluM bhaDhuMbhaDhiyAgha avaனmel ghubhbhuRabh bhaDhudhdhugh ghòNDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu bhiLLaiyiன uDhal aனl ghòNDhadhu.
avaன èzhundhu, aRaivIDhDhil i~NghuM a~NghuM ulAvi, dhiruMbhagh ghiDhDhabh bhoy avaனmel ghubhbhuRabhbhaDhudhdhAன; abhbhòzhudhu andhabh bhiLLai ezhudharaM dhuMmidh dhaன ghaNghaLaidh dhiRandhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: gheyAjhiyaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu, andhajh jhUனemiyALai azhaidhdhughghòNDhuvA èனRAன; avaLai azhaidhdhughghòNDhu vandhAன; avaL avaனiDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu ; avaன, uன ghumAraனai èDhudhdhughghòNDhu bho èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaL uLLe bhoy, avaன bhAdhadhdhile vizhundhu, dharaimaDhDhuM bhaNindhu, dhaன ghumAraனai èDhudhdhugh ghòNDhu vèLiye bhoனAL.

èlijhA ghilghAlughghudh dhiruMbhibh bhoy irughghaiyil, dhejhadhdhile bha~njhaM uNDhAyiRRu; dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன bhudhdhirar, avaனughghu muனbhAgha uDhghArndhirundhArghaL; avaன dhaன velaighghAraனai noghghi: nI bhèriya bhAனaiyai aDhubhbhile vaidhdhudh dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன bhudhdhirarughghugh ghUzhghAyjhjhu èனRAன.

òruvaன ghIraighaLaibh bhaRighgha vèLiyile bhoy, òru bheyghghòMmaDhDhigh ghòDhiyaigh ghaNDhu, adhaன ghAyghaLai maDhi niRaiya aRudhdhuvandhu, avaighaLai arindhu ghUzhbhbhAனaiyile bhoDhDhAன; adhu iனனdhèனRu avarghaLughghudh dhèriyAdhirundhadhu.

jhAbhbhiDha adhai jaன~NghaLughghu vArdhdhArghaL; avarghaL andhagh ghUzhil èDhudhdhujh jhAbhbhiDhughiRabhodhu, adhaijh jhAbhbhiDhagh ghUDhAmal; dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனe, bhAனaiyil jhAvu irughghiRadhu èனRu jhadhdhamiDhDhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன, mAvaigh ghòNDhuvarajhjhòlli, adhaibh bhAனaiyile bhoDhDhu, jaன~NghaL jhAbhbhiDhuMbhaDhi avarghaLughghu vAr èனRAன; abhbhuRaM bhAனaiyile dhoShaM illAmaR bhoyiRRu.

bhiனbhu bhAghAl jhalIShAvilirundhu òru maனuShaன dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனughghu mudhaRbhalaனAன vARghodhumaiyiன irubhadhu abhbha~NghaLaiyuM dhAL ghadhirghaLaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhAன; abhbhòzhudhu avaன: jaன~NghaLughghujh jhAbhbhiDhaghghòDhu èனRAன.

adhaRghu avaனuDhaiya bhaNiviDhaighghAraன: idhai nAன nURubherughghu muன vaibhbhadhu èbhbhaDhi èனRAன. adhaRghu avaன: adhai jaன~NghaLughghujh jhAbhbhiDhagh ghòDhu; jhAbhbhiDhDhabhiRbhADhu iனனuM mIdhiyuNDhAyirughghuM èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avarghaLughghu muனbhAgha adhai vaidhdhAன; ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye avarghaL jhAbhbhiDhDhadhumaனRi mIdhiyuM irundhadhu.

jhIriya rAjAviன bhaDhaidhdhalaivaனAghiya nAghamAன èனbhavaன dhaன ANDhavaனiDhadhdhil bhèriya maனuShaனuM èNNighghaiyuLLavaனumAyirundhAன; avaனaigh ghòNDhu ghardhdhar jhIriyAvughghu iraDhjhibhbhaigh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAr; maghA bharAghghiramajhAliyAghiya avaனo ghuShDharoghiyAyirundhAன.

jhIriyAvilirundhu dhaNDhughaL bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, isravel dhejhadhdhilirundhu òru jhiRu bhèNNaijh jhiRaibhiDhDhidhdhughghòNDhu vandhirundhArghaL; avaL nAghamAனiன maனaivighghubh bhaNiviDhai jhèydhughòNDhirundhAL.
avaL dhaன nAjhjhiyAraibh bhArdhdhu: èன ANDhavaன jhamAriyAvilirughghiRa dhIrghghadharijhiyiனiDhadhdhil bhovArAனAl nalamAyirughghuM; avar ivaruDhaiya ghuShDharoghadhdhai nIghghiviDhuvAr èனRAL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன bhoy, isravel dhejhadhdhubh bhèN iனன iனன bhiraghAramAyjh jhòllughiRAL èனRu dhaன ANDhavaனiDhadhdhil aRividhdhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu jhIriyAviன rAjA: nalladhu bhoghalAM, israveliன rAjAvughghu nirubhaM dharughiReன èனRAன; abhbhaDhiye avaன dhaன ghaiyile bhadhdhudh dhAlandhu vèLLiyaiyuM, ARAyiraM jheghghal niRaibhòனனaiyuM, bhadhdhu mARRuvasdhira~NghaLaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhubhoy,

israveliன rAjAviDhadhdhil andha nirubhadhdhaigh ghòDhudhdhAன. adhile: indha nirubhadhdhai uMmiDhadhdhil èன UzhiyaghghAraனAghiya nAghamAன ghòNDhuvaruvAன; nIr avaன ghuShDharoghadhdhai nIghghi viDha avaனai uMmiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiyirughghiReன èனRu èzhudhiyirundhadhu.

israveliன rAjA andha nirubhadhdhai vAjhidhdhabhodhu, avaன dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòNDhu: òru maனuShaனai avaன ghuShDharoghadhdhiனiனRu nIghghi viDhaveNDhuM èனRu, avaன èனனiDhadhdhil nirubhaM aனubhbhughiRadhaRghu, ghòllavuM uyirbhbhighghavuM nAன dhevaனA? ivaன èனனai virodhighgha jhamayaM dheDhughiRAன èனbhadhaijh jhindhidhdhubhbhAru~NghaL èனRAன.

israveliன rAjA dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòNDha jhèydhiyai dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனAghiya èlijhA gheDhDhabhodhu, avaன: nIr uMmuDhaiya vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòLvAனeன? avaன èனனiDhadhdhil vandhu, isravelile dhIrghghadharijhi uNDhèனbhadhai aRindhughòLLaDhDhuM èனRu rAjAvughghujh jhòlliyaனubhbhiனAன.
abhbhaDhiye nAghamAன dhaன ghudhiraighaLoDhuM dhaன iradhadhdhoDhuM vandhu èlijhAviன vAjhaRbhaDhiyile niனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu èlijhA: avaனiDhadhdhil AL aனubhbhi, nI bhoy, yordhAனil ezhudharaM snAனMbhaNNu; abhbhòzhudhu uன mAMjhaM mARi, nI jhudhdhamAvAy èனRu jhòllajhjhòனனAன.

adhaRghu nAghamAன ghaDhu~Nghobha~NghòNDhu, bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy: avaன vèLiye vandhu niனRu, dhaன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhaidh dhòzhudhu, dhaன ghaiyiனAl andha iDhadhdhaidh dhaDhavi, ivvidhamAygh ghuShDharoghadhdhai nIghghiviDhuvAன èனRu èனghghuL niனaidhdhirundheன.

nAன snAனMbhaNNijh jhudhdhamAghiRadhaRghu israveliன dhaNNIrghaL èllAvaRRaibhbhArghghiluM dhamasghuviன nadhighaLAghiya AbhனAvuM bharbhAruM nalladhallavo èனRu jhòlli, ughghiradhdhoDhe dhiruMbhibh bhoனAன.

avaன UzhiyaghghArar jhamIbhadhdhil vandhu, avaனai noghghi: dhaghabhbhaனe, andhadh dhIrghghadharijhi òru bhèriya ghAriyadhdhaijh jhèyya umaghghujh jhòlliyirundhAl adhai nIr jhèyvIr allavA? snAனM bhaNNuM, abhbhòzhudhu jhudhdhamAvIr èனRu avar uMmoDhe jhòlluM bhodhu, adhaijh jhèyyaveNDhiyadhu èdhdhaனai adhighaM èனRu jhòனனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன iRa~Nghi, dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye yordhAனil ezhudharaM muzhughiனbhodhu, avaன mAMjhaM òru jhiRubhiLLaiyiன mAMjhadhdhaibhbhola mARi, avaன jhudhdhamAனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhaன ghUDhDhadhdhoDhèllAM dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனiDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhivandhu, avaனughghu muனbhAgha niனRu: idho, isravelilirughghiRa dhevaனaidhdhavira bhUmiyè~NghuM veRe dhevaன illai èனbhadhai aRindheன; ibhbhodhuM umadhu aDhiyeன ghaiyil òru ghANighghai vA~NghighghòLLa veNDhuM èனRAன.
adhaRghu avaன: nAன vA~NghughiRadhillai èனRu ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha avaruDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRAன; vA~NghaveNDhuM èனRu avaனai varundhiனAluM dhaDhDhudhal bhaNNiviDhDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu nAghamAன: AனAluM iraNDhu ghoveRu ghazhudhaighaL jhumaghghadhdhaghgha iraNDhu bhòdhi maN umadhu aDhiyeனughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhaveNDhuM; umadhu aDhiyeன iனigh ghardhdharughghe allAmal, anniya dhevarghaLughghujh jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனdhdhaiyuM bhaliyaiyuM jhèludhdhuvadhillai.

òru ghAriyadhdhaiye ghardhdhar umadhu aDhiyeனughghu maனனibhbhArAgha; èன ANDhavaன bhaNindhughòLLa niMmoன ghovilughghuL bhiravejhighghuMbhodhu, nAன avarughghugh ghailAghu ghòDhudhdhu niMmoன ghovilile bhaNiyaveNDhiyadhAghuM; ibhbhaDhi riMmoன ghovilil nAன bhaNiya veNDhiya indhagh ghAriyadhdhaigh ghardhdhar umadhu aDhiyeனughghu maனனibhbhArAgha èனRAன.
adhaRghu avaன: jhamAdhAனdhdhoDhebho èனRAன; ivaன bhuRabhbhaDhDhugh ghò~njhadhUraM bhoனbhodhu,

dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனAghiya èlijhAviன velaighghAraன gheyAjhi èனbhavaன, andhajh jhIriyaனAghiya nAghamAன ghòNDhu vandhadhai èன ANDhavaன avaன ghaiyile vA~NghAmal avaனai viDhDhuviDhDhAr; nAன avaன bhiRaghe oDhi, avaன ghaiyile edhAghiluM vA~Nghuveன èனRu ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனmel ANaiyiDhDhu,
nAghamAனaibh bhiன dhòDharndhAன; avaன dhaன bhiRaghe oDhivarughiRadhai nAghamAன ghaNDhabhodhu, avaனughghu èdhirghòNDhu bhogha iradhdhadhdhilirundhu ghudhidhdhu: jhughajhèydhiyA èனRu gheDhDhAன.

adhaRghu avaன: jhughajhèydhidhAன; dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன bhudhdhiraril iraNDhu vAlibhar ibhbhòzhudhudhAன èbhbhirAyIM malaidhdhejhadhdhilirundhu èனனiDhadhdhil vandhArghaL; avarghaLughghu òru dhAlandhu vèLLiyaiyuM, iraNDhu mARRuvasdhira~NghaLaiyuM dharaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhgha, èன èjamAன èனனai aனubhbhiனAr èனRAன.

adhaRghu nAghamAன: dhayavujhèydhu, iraNDhu dhAlandhai vA~NghighghòL èனRu jhòlli, avaனai varundhi, iraNDhu dhAlandhu vèLLiyai iraNDhu ghaighaLil iraNDhu mARRu vasdhira~NghaLoDhe ghaDhDhi, avaனughghu muனbhAghajh jhumandhu bhogha, dhaன velaighghArarAன iraNDhu bhermel vaidhdhAன.
avaன meDhDhaNDhaighghu vandhabhodhu, avaன adhai avarghaL ghaiyilirundhu vA~Nghi, vIDhDhile vaidhdhu, andha maனuSharai aனubhbhiviDhDhAன; avarghaL bhoyviDhDhArghaL.
bhiனbhu avaன uLLe bhoydh dhaன èjamAனughghu muனbhAgha niனRAன; gheyAjhiye, è~Ngheyirundhu vandhAy èனRu èlijhA avaனaigh gheDhDhadhaRghu, avaன: umadhu aDhiyAன è~NghuM bhoghavillai èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன ivaனaibh bhArdhdhu: andha maனuShaன uனghghu èdhir ghòNDhuvara dhaன iradhadhdhilirundhu iRa~Nghidh dhiruMbhughiRabhodhu èன maனM uனனuDhaனghUDhajh jhèllavillaiyA? bhaNadhdhai vA~NghughiRadhaRghuM, vasdhira~NghaLaiyuM òlivadhdhobhbhughaLaiyuM dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDha~NghaLaiyuM ADhumADhughaLaiϠρM velaighghAraΰaiyuM velaighghArighaLaiyuM vA~NghughiRadhaRghuM idhu ghAlamA?

AghaiyAl nAghamAனiன ghuShDharoghaM uனனaiyuM uன jhandhadhiyAraiyuM èனRaighghuM bhiDhidhdhirughghuM èனRAன; uDhaனe avaன uRaindha mazhai niRamAன ghuShDharoghiyAghi, avaன jhamughadhdhai viDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனAன.
dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன bhudhdhirar èlijhAvai noghghi: idho, nA~NghaL uMmuDhaன ghuDhiyirughghiRa indha iDhaM è~NghaLughghu nèrughghamAy irughghiRadhu.
nA~NghaL yordhAனmaDhDhuM bhoy avviDhadhdhil òvvòruvar òvvòru udhdhiradhdhai vèDhDhi, ghuDhiyirughgha a~Nghe è~NghaLughghu òru iDhadhdhai uNDhAghghuvoM èனRArghaL. adhaRghu avaன: bho~NghaL èனRAன.
avarghaLil òruvaன: nIr dhayavujhèydhu umadhu aDhiyAroDheghUDha varaveNDhuM èனRAன. adhaRghu avaன: nAன varughiReன èனRu jhòlli,
avarghaLoDheghUDhabh bhoனAன; avarghaL yordhAன nadhiyarughe vandha bhodhu mara~NghaLai vèDhDhiனArghaL.
òruvaன òru udhdhiradhdhai vèDhDhi vizhudhdhughaiyil ghoDhari dhaNNIril vizhundhadhu; avaன: aiyo èன ANDhavaனe, adhu iravalAgha vA~NghabhbhaDhDhadhe èனRu ghUviனAன.
dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன adhu è~Nghe vizhundhadhu èனRu gheDhDhAன; avaன andha iDhadhdhaigh ghANbhidhdhabhodhu, òru ghòMbhai vèDhDhi, adhai a~Nghe èRindhu, andha iruMbhai midhaghghabhbhaNNi,
adhai èDhudhdhughghòL èனRAன; abhbhaDhiye avaன dhaன ghaiyai nIDhDhi adhai èDhudhdhughghòNDhAன.
aghghAladhdhil jhIriyAviன rAjA isravelughghu virodhamAy yudhdhaM bhaNNi, iனன iனன sdhaladhdhile bhALayamiRa~Nghuveன èனRu dhaன UzhiyaghghAraroDhe AlojhaனaibhaNNiனAன.
AghiluM dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன israveliன rAjAviனiDhadhdhil AL aனubhbhi: iனன iDhadhdhughghubh bhoghAdhabhaDhighghu èjhjharighghaiyAyiruM; jhIriyar a~Nghe iRa~NghuvArghaL èனRu jhòllajh jhòனனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu israveliன rAjA dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன dhaனனai èjhjharidhdhu, dhaனghghugh ghuRidhdhujhjhòனன sdhaladhdhiRghu maனuSharai aனubhbhibhbhArdhdhu èjhjharighghaiyAyirundhu, ibhbhaDhi aneghandharaM dhaனனaigh ghAdhdhughghòNDhAன.

indhagh ghAriyadhdhiனimidhdhaM jhIriya rAjAviன irudhayaM ghuzhaMbhi, avaன dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai azhaidhdhu: naMmuDhaiyavarghaLil israveliன rAjAvughghu uLavAyirughghiRavaன yAr èனRu nI~NghaL èனghghu aRivighghamADhDhIrghaLA èனRu gheDhDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன UzhiyaghghAraril òruvaன: abhbhaDhiyillai; èன ANDhavaனAghiya rAjAve, nIr uMmuDhaiya bhaLLi aRaiyile bhejhughiRa vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM isravelirughghiRa dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya èlijhA israveliன rAjAvughghu aRivibhbhAன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nAன maனuSharai aனubhbhi avaனaibh bhiDhighghuMbhaDhi, nI~NghaL bhoy avaன è~Nghe irughghiRAன èனRu bhAru~NghaL èனRAன; avaன dhodhdhAனil irughghiRAன èனRu avaனughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன a~Nghe ghudhiraighaLaiyuM iradha~NghaLaiyuM bhaladhdha irANuvadhdhaiyuM aனubhbhiனAன; avarghaL irAghghAladhdhile vandhu bhaDhDhaNadhdhai vaLaindhughòNDhArghaL.

dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனiன velaighghAraன adhighAlame èzhundhu vèLiye bhuRabhbhaDhughaiyil, idho, irANuvamuM ghudhiraighaLuM iradha~NghaLuM bhaDhDhaNadhdhaijh jhuRRigh ghòNDhirughghagh ghaNDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu velaighghAraன avaனai noghghi: aiyo, èன ANDhavaனe, èனனjhèyvoM èனRAன.
adhaRghu avaன: bhayabhbhaDhAdhe; avarghaLoDhirughghiRavarghaLaibh bhArghghiluM naMmoDhirughghiRavarghaL adhighaM èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu èlijhA viNNabhbhaM bhaNNi: ghardhdhAve, ivaன bhArghghuMbhaDhi ivaன ghaNghaLaidh dhiRandharuLuM èனRAன; uDhaனe ghardhdhar andha velaighghAraன ghaNghaLaidh dhiRandhAr; idho, èlijhAvaijh jhuRRiluM aghghiனimayamAன ghudhiraighaLAluM iradha~NghaLAluM andha malai niRaindhirughghiRadhai avaன ghaNDhAன.

avarghaL avaனiDhadhdhil varughaiyil, èlijhA ghardhdharai noghghi viNNabhbhaMbhaNNi: indha jaன~NghaLughghugh ghaN mayaghghaM uNDhAghuMbhaDhi jhèyyuM èனRAன; èlijhAvuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye avarghaLughghugh ghaNmayaghghaM uNDhAghuMbhaDhi jhèydhAr.

abhbhòzhudhu èlijhA avarghaLai noghghi: idhu vazhi alla; idhu bhaDhDhaNamuM alla; èன bhiRaghe vAru~NghaL; nI~NghaL dheDhughiRa maனuShaனiDhadhdhil nAன u~NghaLai vazhinaDhadhdhuveன èனRu jhòlli, avarghaLaijh jhamAriyAvughghu azhaidhdhugh ghòNDhubhoனAன.

avarghaL jhamAriyAvil vandhabhodhu, èlijhA: ghardhdhAve, ivarghaL bhArghghuM bhaDhighghu ivarghaL ghaNghaLaidh dhiRandharuLuM èனRAன; bhArghghuMbhaDhighghugh ghardhdhar avarghaL ghaNghaLaidh dhiRaghghuMbhodhu, idho, avarghaL jhamAriyAviன naDhuve irundhArghaL.
israveliன rAjA avarghaLaigh ghaNDhabhodhu, èlijhAvaibh bhArdhdhu: èன dhaghabhbhaனe, nAன avarghaLai vèDhDhibh bhoDhalAmA èனRu gheDhDhAன.

adhaRghu avaன: nIr vèDhDhaveNDhAM; nIr uMmuDhaiya bhaDhDhayadhdhAluM, uMmuDhaiya villiனAluM jhiRaiyAghghigh ghòNDhavarghaLai vèDhDhughiRIro? ivarghaL bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdhu, dha~NghaL ANDhavaனiDhadhdhughghubh bhoghuMbhaDhighghu, abhbhamuM dhaNNIruM avarghaLughghèdhiril vaiyuM èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avarghaLughghubh bhèriya virundhubhaNNi, avarghaL bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdhabhiனbhu, avarghaLai aனubhbhiviDhDhAன; avarghaL dha~NghaL ANDhavaனiDhadhdhughghubh bhoyviDhDhArghaL; jhIriyariன dhaNDhughaL isravel dhejhadhdhile abhbhuRaM varavillai.
idhaRghubhbhiனbhu jhIriyAviன rAjAvAghiya bhèனAdhAdh dhaன irANuvadhdhaiyèllAM ghUDhDhighghòNDhuvandhu jhamAriyAvai muRRighghaibhoDhDhAன.

adhiனAl jhamAriyAvile ghòDhiya bha~njhamuNDhAyiRRu; òru ghazhudhaidh dhalai èNbhadhu vèLLighghAjhughghuM, bhuRAghghaLughghubh bhoDhughiRa ghARbhaDhi bhayaRu aindhu vèLLighghAjhughghuM viRghabhbhaDhumaDhDhuM adhai muRRighghaibhoDhDhArghaL.
israveliன rAjA ala~Nghadhdhiன mel naDhandhubhoghaiyil, òru sdhirI avaனaibhbhArdhdhugh ghUbhbhiDhDhu, rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனe, iraDhjhiyuM èனRAL.
adhaRghu avaன: ghardhdhar uனனai iraDhjhighghAdhirundhAl nAன èdhilirundhu èDhudhdhu uனனai iraDhjhighghalAM? ghaLa~njhiyadhdhilirundhA, AlaiyilirundhA èனRu jhòlli,
rAjA bhiனனaiyuM avaLaibh bhArdhdhu: uனghghu èனனveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu avaL: indha sdhirI èனனai noghghi: uன maghaனaidh dhA, avaனai iனRu dhiனbhoM; nALaighghu èன maghaனaidh dhiனbhoM èனRAL.
abhbhaDhiye èன maghaனai Aghghidh dhiனRoM; maRunALil nAன ivaLai noghghi: nAM uன maghaனaidh dhiனன avaனaidh dhA èனReன; avaL dhaன maghaனai òLidhdhuviDhDhAL èனRAL.

andha sdhirIyiன vArdhdhaighaLai rAjA gheDhDhavuDhaனe, ala~Nghadhdhiனmel naDhandhubhoghiRa avaன dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòNDhAன; avaன uLLe dhaன jharIradhdhiனmel iraDhDhu uDhudhdhiyirughghiRadhai jaன~NghaL ghaNDhArghaL.
avaன: jhAbhbhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya èlijhAviன dhalai iனRaighghu avaனmel irundhAl, dhevaன adhaRghujh jhariyAghavuM adhaRghu adhighamAghavuM èனghghujh jhèyyaghghaDhavar èனRu jhòனனAன.

èlijhA dhaன vIDhDhil uDhghArndhirundhAன; mUbhbharuM avaனoDhu uDhghArndhirundhArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu rAjA: òru maனuShaனaidh dhaனghghu muனனe aனubhbhiனAன; indha AL èlijhAviனiDhadhdhughghu varumuனனe, avaன andha mUbhbharai noghghi: èன dhalaiyai vA~Ngha, andhagh ghòlaibhAdhaghaனuDhaiya maghaன AL aனubhbhiனAன; bhArdhdhIrghaLA? andha AL varuMbhodhu, nI~NghaL avaனai uLLe varavòDhDhAmal ghadhavaibh bhUDhDhibhbhoDhu~NghaL; avaனughghubh bhiனனAgha avaன ANDhavaனuDhaiya ghAliன jhadhdhaM gheDhghiRadhu allavA èனRAன.

avarghaLoDhe avaன bhejhighghòNDhirughghaiyil, andha AL avaனiDhadhdhil vandhu: idho, indhabh bhòllAbhbhu ghardhdharAl uNDhAனdhu; nAன iனigh ghardhdharughghAghagh ghAdhdhirughgha veNDhiyadhu èனன èனRu rAjA jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu èlijhA: ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLu~NghaL; nALai inneradhdhil jhamAriyAviன vAjhalile òru maraghghAl ghodhumai mA òru jheghghalughghuM, iraNDhu maraghghAl vARghodhumai òru jheghghalughghuM viRghabhbhaDhuM èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjAvughghugh ghailAghu ghòDhughghiRa bhiradhAனi òruvaன dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: idho, ghardhdhar vAனdhdhile madhaghughaLai uNDhAghghiனAluM ibhbhaDhi naDhaghghumA èனRAன. adhaRghu avaன: uனனuDhaiya ghaNghaLiனAle adhaigh ghANbhAy; AனAluM adhile jhAbhbhiDhamADhDhAy èனRAன.
ghuShDharoghighaLAன nAlubher òlimughavAjhalil irundhArghaL; avarghaL òruvarai òruvar noghghi: nAM i~Nghe irundhu jhAghaveNDhiyadhu èனன?

bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghuL bhovomèனRAluM bhaDhDhaNadhdhil bha~njhaM uNDhAyirughghiRadhiனAl a~Nghe jhAvoM; nAM i~Nghe irundhAluM jhAvoM; AghaiyAl ibhbhòzhudhu jhIriyaruDhaiya irANuvadhdhiRghubh bhovoM vAru~NghaL; avarghaL naMmai uyiroDhe vaidhdhAl bhizhaighghiRoM; naMmaigh ghòனRAl jhAghiRoM èனRu jhòlli,
jhIriyaruDhaiya irANuvadhdhiRghubh bhogha iruDhDhoDhe èzhundhirundhu, jhIriyaruDhaiya bhALayadhdhiன muனனNiyil vandhArghaL; a~Nghe òruvarumillai.

ANDhavar jhIriyariன irANuvadhdhiRghu iradha~NghaLiன iraijhjhalaiyuM, ghudhiraighaLiன iraijhjhalaiyuM, maghA irANuvadhdhiன iraijhjhalaiyuM gheDhghabh bhaNNiனdhiனAl, avarghaL òruvarai òruvar noghghi: idho, naMmiDhadhdhil bhorughghu vara, israveliன rAjA edhdhiyariன rAjAghghaLaiyuM èghibhdhiyariன rAjAghghaLaiyuM namaghghu virodhamAghagh ghUli bhòrudhdhiனAன èனRu jhòlli,

iruDhDhoDhe èzhundhirundhu oDhibhbhoy, dha~NghaL ghUDhAra~NghaLaiyuM dha~NghaL ghudhiraighaLaiyuM dha~NghaL ghazhudhaighaLaiyuM dha~NghaL bhALayadhdhaiyuM avaighaL irundha bhiraghAramAgha viDhDhu, dha~NghaL bhirANaனmAdhdhiraM dhabhbhuMbhaDhi oDhibhbhoனArghaL.

andhagh ghuShDharoghighaL bhALayadhdhiன muனனNimaDhDhuM vandhabhodhu, òru ghUDhAradhdhiRghuL bhiravejhidhdhu bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhidhdhu, adhilirundhu vèLLiyaiyuM bhòனனaiyuM vasdhira~NghaLaiyuM èDhudhdhugh ghòNDhu bhoy òLidhdhuvaidhdhu, dhiruMbhivandhu, veRòru ghUDhAradhdhiRghuL bhiravejhidhdhu, adhilirundhuM abhbhaDhiye èDhudhdhughghòNDhu bhoy òLidhdhu vaidhdhu,

abhbhaDhiye avarghaL vandhu, bhaDhDhaNadhdhu vAjhal ghAvalALaனai noghghigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu: nA~NghaL jhIriyariன bhALayadhdhiRghubh bhoyvandhoM; a~Nghe òruvaruM illai, òru maனuShaனuDhaiya jhadhdhamuM illai, ghaDhDhiyirughghiRa ghudhiraighaLuM ghaDhDhiyirughghiRa ghazhudhaighaLuM, ghUDhAra~NghaLuM irundhabhiraghAraM irughghiRadhu èனRu avarghaLughghujh jhòனனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன vAjhalghAghghiRa maRRavarghaLaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhAன; avarghaL uLLe bhoy rAjAviன aramaனaiyArughghu adhai aRividhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu irAjA irAdhdhiriyil èzhundhu, dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai noghghi: jhIriyar namaghghujh jhèyghiRa ghAriyadhdhai u~NghaLughghudh dhèriyabhbhaDhudhdhughiReன; nAM bhaDhDhiனiyAyirughghiRoM; èனRu avarghaL aRivArghaL; AghaiyAl nAM bhaDhDhaNadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAl naMmai uyiroDhe bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghuL bhiravejhighghalAM èனRu èNNi, avarghaL bhALayadhdhai viDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu vèLiyil òLidhdhugh ghòNDhirughghiRArghaL èனRAன.

avaன UzhiyaghghAraril òruvaன bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: i~Nghe mIdhiyAன ghudhiraighaLil aindhu ghudhiraighaLaigh ghòNDhubhogha udhdharavu ghòDhuM; idho, i~Nghe mIdhiyAன israveliன jhaghala erALadhdhiluM, mANDhubhoன israveliன jhaghala ghUDhDhadhdhiluM, avaighaL; mAdhdhiraM mIndhirughghiRadhu; avaighaLai nAM aனubhbhibhbhArbhbhoM èனRAன.
abhbhaDhiye iraNDhu iradhagh ghudhiraighaLaigh ghòNDhuvandhArghaL; rAjA bhoy vAru~NghaL èனRu jhòlli, jhIriyariன irANuvadhdhaidh dhòDharndhu bhoghuMbhaDhi aனubhbhiனAன.

avarghaL yordhAன maDhDhuM avarghaLaibh bhiன dhòDharndhubhoனArghaL; jhIriyar dhIviridhdhu oDhughaiyil, avarghaL èRindhu bhoDhDha vasdhira~NghaLAluM dhaDhDhu muDhDhughaLAluM vazhiyèllAM niRaindhirundhadhu; aனubhbhabhbhaDhDhavarghaL dhiruMbhivandhu rAjAvughghu adhai aRividhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu jaன~NghaL bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, jhIriyariன bhALayadhdhaigh ghòLLaiyiDhDhArghaL; ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye, òru maraghghAl ghodhumai mA òru jheghghalughghuM, iraNDhu maraghghAl vARghodhumai òru jheghghalughghuM viRghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

rAjA dhaனghghugh ghailAghughòDhughghiRa andhabh bhiradhAனiyai òlimughavAjhalil vijhAribhbhAyirughghagh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirundhAன; òlimughavAjhalile jaன~NghaL avaனai nèru~Nghi midhidhdhadhiனAle, rAjA dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனiDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu jhòlliyirundhabhaDhiye, avaன jhèdhdhubhbhoனAன.
iraNDhu maraghghAl vARghodhumai òru jheghghalughghuM, nALai inneradhdhile jhamAriyAviன òlimughavAjhalil viRghuM èனRu dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன rAjAvoDhe jhòனனdhiனbhaDhiye naDhandhadhu.

adhaRghu andhabh bhiradhAனi dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: idho, ghardhdhar vAனdhdhile madhaghughaLai uNDhAghghiனAluM, indha vArdhdhaiyiன bhaDhi naDhaghghumA èனRu jhòlla; ivaன, idho, uனனuDhaiya ghaNghaLiனAle adhaigh ghANbhAy, AனAluM adhile jhAbhbhiDhamADhDhAy èனRAனe.
andhabh bhiraghAramAghadhdhAனe avaனughghu naDhandhadhu; òlimughavAjhalile jaன~NghaL avaனai nèru~Nghi midhidhdhadhiனAle avaன jhèdhdhubh bhoனAன.

èlijhA dhAன uyirbhbhidhdha bhiLLaiyiன dhAyAghiya sdhirIyai noghghi: nI uன vIDhDhAroDhu~NghUDha èzhundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoy è~NgheyAghiluM jha~njhari: ghardhdhar bha~njhadhdhai varuvibhbhAr; adhu ezhuvaruShaM dhejhadhdhil irughghuM èனRu jhòlliyirundhAன.
andha sdhirI èzhundhu, dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன jhòனன vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhi jhèydhu, dhaன vIDhDhAroDhu~NghUDhabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, bhèlisdhariன dhejhadhdhil bhoy, ezhuvaruShaM jha~njharidhdhAL.
ezhuvaruShaM jhèனRabhiனbhu, avaL bhèlisdhariன dhejhadhdhai viDhDhudh dhiruMbha vandhu, dhaன vIDhDhughghAghavuM dhaன vayalughghAghavuM rAjAviனiDhadhdhil muRaiyiDhuMbhaDhi bhoனAL.
anneradhdhil rAjA, dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனiன velaighghAraனAyirundha gheyAjhiyuDhaனe bhejhi: èlijhA jhèydha adhijhaya~NghaLaiyèllAM nI èனghghu vivaramAyjh jhòl èனRAன.

jhèdhdhubh bhoனvaனai uyirbhbhidhdhAr èனbhadhai avaன rAjAvughghu aRivighghiRabhodhu, idho, avaன uyirbhbhidhdha bhiLLaiyiன dhAyAghiya andha sdhirI vandhu, dhaன vIDhDhughghAghavuM dhaன vayalughghAghavuM rAjAviனiDhadhdhil muRaiyiDhDhAL; abhbhòzhudhu gheyAjhi: rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனe, ivaLdhAன andha sdhirI; èlijhA uyirbhbhidhdha ivaLuDhaiya ghumAraன ivaன dhAன èனRAன.

rAjA andha sdhirIyaigh gheDhDhadhaRghu, avaL: adhai avaனughghu vivaridhdhujh jhòனனAL; abhbhòzhudhu rAjA avaLughghu òru bhiradhAனiyai niyamidhdhu, avaLughghu uNDhAனdhu èllAvaRRaiyuM, avaL dhejhadhdhai viDhDhubhbhoன nAL mudhal idhuvaraighghuM uNDhAன andha vayaliன varumAனM aனaidhdhaiyuM avaLughghugh ghiDhaighghuMbhaDhi jhèy èனRAன.
jhIriyAviன rAjAvAghiya bhèனAdhAdh viyAdhiyAyirundhAன; èlijhA dhamasghuvughghu vandhAன; dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன ivviDhadhdhil vandhirughghiRAன èனRu avaனughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhabhodhu,

rAjA Ajhaghelai noghghi: nI uன ghaiyile òru ghANighghaiyai èDhudhdhugh ghòNDhu, dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனughghu èdhirghòNDhubhoy, nAன indha viyAdhi nI~Nghibh bhizhaibhbheனA èனRu avaனaigh ghòNDhu ghardhdhariDhadhdhil vijhArighghajh jhòனனAன.

Ajhaghel dhamasghuviன jhaghala ujhjhidha~NghaLiluM nARbhadhu òDhDhagha~NghaLiன jhumaiyAன ghANighghaiyai èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, avaனughghu èdhirghòNDhu bhoy, avaனughghu muனbhAgha niனRu, jhIriyAviன rAjAvAghiya bhèனAdhAdh èனனuM uMmuDhaiya ghumAraன èனனai uMmiDhadhdhil aனubhbhi, indha viyAdhi nI~Nghibh bhizhaibhbheனA èனRu gheDhghajhjhòனனAr èனRAன.
èlijhA avaனai noghghi: nI bhoy, viyAdhi nI~Nghibh bhizhaibhbhIr èனRu avaனughghujh jhòlluM; AனAluM avaன jhAghave jhAvAன èனbhadhaigh ghardhdhar èனghghugh ghANbhidhdhAr èனRAன.
bhiனbhu dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaன: dhaன mughadhdhaidh dhirubhbhAmal avaன jhalidhdhubhbhoghumaDhDhuM avaனai noghghigh ghòNDhe azhudhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu Ajhaghel: èன ANDhavaன azhughiRadhu èனன èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu avaன: nI isravel bhudhdhirarughghujh jhèyyuM dhI~Nghai nAன aRindhirughghiRabhaDhiyiனAl azhughiReன; nI avarghaL ghoDhDhaighaLai aghghiனighghu iraiyAghghi, avarghaL vAlibharaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhAl ghòனRu, avarghaL ghuzhandhaighaLaidh dharaiyoDhe modhi, avarghaL gharbhbhavadhighaLaigh ghIRibhbhoDhuvAy èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu Ajhaghel: idhdhaனai bhèriya ghAriyadhdhaijh jhèyya nAyAghiya umadhu aDhiyAன èMmAdhdhiraM èனRAன. adhaRghu èlijhA: nI jhIriyAviனmel rAjAvAvAy èனbhadhaigh ghardhdhar èனghghudh dhèrividhdhAr èனRAன.

ivaன èlijhAvaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, dhaன ANDhavaனiDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu, avaன: èlijhA uனghghu èனன jhòனனAன èனRu gheDhDhadhaRghu; ivaன nIr viyAdhi nI~Nghibh bhizhaibhbhIr èனRu èனghghujh jhòனனAன èனRu jhòlli,
maRunALile òru jhamughghALadhdhai èDhudhdhu, dhaNNIrile dhoydhdhu avaன mughadhdhiனmel viridhdhAன; adhiனAl avaன jhèdhdhubhbhoனAன; Ajhaghel avaனughghubh bhadhilAy rAjAvAனAன.

israveliன rAjAvAghiya AghAyiன ghumAraன yorAmuDhaiya aindhAM varuShadhdhil, yojhabhAdh yUdhAvile iனனuM rAjAvAyirughghaiyil yojhabhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yorAM èனனuM yUdhAviன rAjA rAjyabhAraMbhaNNadh dhuvaghghiனAன.
avaன rAjAvAghiRabhodhu mubhbhadhdhiraNDhu vayadhAyirundhu, èDhDhu varuShaM èrujhalemil rAjyabhAraM bhaNNiனAன.

avaன isravel rAjAghghaLiன vazhiyile naDhandhu, AghAbhiன vIDhDhAr jhèydhadhubholajh jhèydhAன; AghAbhiன ghumAradhdhi avaனughghu maனaiviyAyirundhAL; avaன ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghubh bhòllAbhbhAனdhaijh jhèydhAன.

ghardhdhar: uன ghumArarughghuLLe ènnALuM òru viLaghghai uனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuveன èனRu dhaMmuDhaiya dhAjhaனAghiya dhAvIdhughghujh jhòனனdhiனbhaDhiye, avaனimidhdhaM avar yUdhAvai muRRiluM ghèDhughghavillai.
avaன nADhghaLil yUdhAvuDhaiya ghaiyiனghIzhirundha edhomiyar ghalaghaM bhaNNi, dha~NghaLughghu òru rAjAvai eRbhaDhudhdhighghòNDhArghaL.

adhiனAle yorAM jhaghala iradha~NghaLoDhu~NghUDhajh jhAyIrughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனAன; avaன irAdhdhiriyil èzhundhirundhu, dhaனனai vaLaindhughòNDha edhomiyaraiyuM iradha~NghaLiன dhalaivaraiyuM muRiya aDhidhdhabhodhu, jaன~NghaL dha~NghaL ghUDhAra~NghaLughghu oDhibhbhoனArghaL.
abhbhaDhiye yUdhAvuDhaiya ghaiyiன ghIzhirundha edhomiyar, innALvaraighghuM irughghiRadhubhola, ghalaghaMbhaNNiனArghaL; aghghAladhdhil dhAனe libhனA bhaDhDhaNadhdhAruM ghalaghaMbhaNNiனArghaL.
yorAmiன maRRa vardhdhamAன~NghaLuM, avaன jhèydhavai yAvuM, yUdhAvuDhaiya rAjAghghaLiன nALAghamabh bhusdhaghadhdhil allavo èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu.

israveliன rAjAvAghiya AghAbhiன ghumAraன yorAmuDhaiya bhaனனiraNDhAM varuShadhdhile, yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yorAmiன ghumAraன aghajhiyA rAjAvAனAன.
aghajhiyA rAjAvAghiRabhodhu, irubhadhdhiraNDhu vayadhAyirundhu, òre varuShaM èrujhalemil rAjyabhAraMbhaNNiனAன; israveliன rAjAvAghiya òMriyiன ghumAradhdhiyAன avaன dhAyiன bher adhdhAliyAL.
avaன AghAbhuDhaiya vIDhDhAriன vazhiye naDhandhu, AghAbhiன vIDhDhAraibhbhol ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghubh bhòllAbhbhAனdhaijh jhèydhAன; avaன AghAbh vIDhDhAroDhe jhaMbhandha~NghalandhirundhAன.
avaன AghAbhiன ghumAraனAghiya yorAmoDheghUDhagh ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhiRghujh jhIriyAviன rAjAvAghiya AjhagheloDhu yudhdhaMbhaNNabhbhoனAன; jhIriyar yorAmaigh ghAyabhbhaDhudhdhiனArghaL.

rAjAvAghiya yorAM dhAன jhIriyAviன rAjAvAghiya AjhagheloDhu yudhdhaM bhaNNughaiyil, jhIriyar rAmAvile dhaனனai vèDhDhiன ghAya~NghaLai ARRigh ghòLLa yèsrayelughghubh bhoyirundhAன; AghAbhiன ghumAraனAghiya yorAM viyAdhiyAyirundhabhaDhiyiனAl, yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yorAmiன ghumAraன aghajhiyA yèsrayelil irughghiRa avaனaibh bhArghghiRadhaRghubh bhoனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya èlijhA dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன bhudhdhiraril òruvaனai azhaidhdhu: nI iDhaighghaDhDhigh ghòNDhu, indhadh dhailaghghubhbhiyai uன ghaiyil èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhiRghubh bho.

nI a~Nghe jherndhabhodhu, niMjhiyiன maghaனAன yojhabhAdhdhiன ghumAraன yèghU è~Nghe irughghiRAன èனRu bhArdhdhu, a~Nghe uDhbhiravejhidhdhu, avaனaidh dhaன jhaghodharariன naDhuvilirundhu èzhundhirughghabhbhaNNi, avaனai uLLAன òru aRaiyile azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoy,

dhailaghghubhbhiyai èDhudhdhu, avaன dhalaiyiனmel vArdhdhu: uனனai israveliனmel rAjAvAgha abhiSheghaMbhaNNiனeன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRu jhòlli, ghadhavaidh dhiRandhu dhAmadhiyAmal oDhibhbho èனRAன.
abhbhaDhiye dhIrghghadharijhiyiன UzhiyaghghAraனAghiya andha vAlibhaன ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhiRghubh bhoனAன.

avaன uDhbhiravejhidhdhabhodhu, jheனAbhadhighaL a~Nghe uDhghArndhirundhArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu avaன: jheனAbhadhiye, umaghghujh jhòllaveNDhiya òru vArdhdhai uNDhu èனRAன. adhaRghu yèghU: è~NghaLèllArughghuLLuM yArughghu èனRu gheDhDhadhaRghu, avaன, jheனAbhadhiyAghiya umaghghudhdhAன èனRAன.

avaன èzhundhu, aRaivIDhDhiRghuL bhiravejhidhdhAன; avaன andhadh dhailadhdhai avaன dhalaiyiனmel vArdhdhu, avaனai noghghi: israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, uனனaigh ghardhdharuDhaiya jaனmAghiya israveliனmel rAjAvAgha abhiSheghaMbhaNNiனeன.

nAன èன UzhiyaghghArarAghiya dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன iradhdhabhbhazhiyaiyuM, ghardhdharuDhaiya jhaghala UzhiyaghghArariன iradhdhabh bhazhiyaiyuM, yejhabheliன ghaiyile vA~NghuMbhaDhighghu nI uன ANDhavaனAghiya AghAbhiன ghuDhuMbhadhdhai azhidhdhuviDhaghghaDhavAy.

AghAbhiன ghuDhuMbhamèllAM azhiyuM bhaDhighghu, nAன AghAbhughghujh jhuvaril nIr viDhuM òru nAy mudhalAy irAdhabhaDhighghu, isravelile avaனuDhaiyavarghaLil aDhaibhbhaDhDhavaனaiyuM viDhubhaDhDhavaனaiyuM gharuvaRudhdhu,
AghAbhiன ghuDhuMbhadhdhai nebhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yèròbhèyAmiன ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghuM, aghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhAShAviன ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghu jhariyAghghuveன.
yejhabhelai yèsrayeliன niladhdhile nAyghaL dhiனRuviDhuM; avaLai aDhaghghaMbhaNNughiRavaன illaiyèனghiRAr èனRu jhòlli, ghadhavaidh dhiRandhu oDhibh bhoனAன.

yèghU dhaன ANDhavaனuDhaiya UzhiyaghghArariDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhivandhabhodhu, avarghaL avaனai noghghi: jhughajhèydhiyA? andhabh bhayidhdhiyaghghAraன uனனiDhadhdhil vandhadhu èனன èனRu gheDhDhArghaL. adhaRghu avaன: andha maனuShaனaiyuM, avaன jhòனன ghAriyadhdhaiyuM nI~NghaL aRivIrghaL èனRAன.

adhaRghu avarghaL: adhu bhòy, adhai è~NghaLughghujh jhòlluM èனRArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu avaன: nAன uனனai israveliனmel rAjAvAgha abhiSheghaM bhaNNiனeன èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu iனன iனன bhiraghAramAgha èனனiDhadhdhil jhòனனAன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL dhIviramAy avaravar dha~NghaL vasdhiradhdhaibh bhaDhighaLiன uyaradhdhil avaன ghIzhe viridhdhu, èghghALaM Udhi: yèghU rAjAvAனAன èனRArghaL.

abhbhaDhiye niMjhiyiன maghaனAghiya yojhabhAdhdhiன ghumAraன yèghU èனbhavaன yorAmughghu virodhamAygh ghaDhDhubhbhADhu bhaNNiனAன; yorAmo isravelar èllAroDhu~NghUDha ghIleyAdhdhiluLLa rAmodhdhile jhIriyAviன rAjAvAghiya AjhagheliனimidhdhaM ghAval vaidhdhu vaidhdhAன.

AனAluM jhIriyAviன rAjAvAghiya AjhagheloDhe bhaNNiன yudhdhadhdhile, jhIriyar dhaனனai vèDhDhiன ghAya~NghaLai yèsrayelile ARRighghòLLughiRadhaRghu, rAjAvAghiya yorAM dhiruMbhibh bhoyirundhAன. yèghU èனbhavaன: idhu; u~NghaLughghujh jhaMmadhiyAyirundhAl yèsrayelil idhai aRivighghiRadhaRghu òruvaruM bhaDhDhaNadhdhilirundhu dhabhbhibh bhoghuMbhaDhi viDhAdhiru~NghaL èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu yèghU iradhadhdhiனmel eRi, yèsrayelughghu nerAghabh bhoனAன, yorAM a~Nghe viyAdhiyAygh ghiDhandhAன; yorAmaibhbhArghgha, yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya aghajhiyAvuM a~Nghe vandhirundhAன.

yèsrayelil ghobhuradhdhiனmel niRghiRa jAmaghghAraன, yèghUviன ghUDhDhaM varughiRadhaigh ghaNDhu: òru ghUDhDhadhdhaigh ghANghiReன èனRAன. abhbhòzhudhu yorAM: nI òru ghudhiraivIraனaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu, avarghaLughghu èdhirAgha aனubhbhijh jhamAdhAனmA èனRu gheDhghajhjhòl èனRAன.

andhagh ghudhiraivIraன: avaனughghu èdhirghòNDhubhoy, jhamAdhAனmA èனRu rAjA gheDhghajhjhòனனAr èனRAன. adhaRghu yèghU: jhamAdhAனdhdhaibh bhaRRi uனghghu èனன? èன bhiRaghe dhiruMbhivA èனRAன. abhbhòzhudhu jAmaghghAraன: aனubhbhabhbhaDhDhavaன avarghaL irughghuM iDhamaDhDhuM bhoனbhodhiluM dhiruMbhivaravillai èனRAன.

AghaiyAl veRòru ghudhiraivIraனai aனubhbhiனAன, avaன avarghaLiDhadhdhil bhoy: jhamAdhAனmA èனRu rAjA gheDhghajhjhòனனAr èனRAன. adhaRghu yèghU jhamAdhAனdhdhaibhbhaRRi uனghghu èனன? èன bhiRaghe dhiruMbhivA èனRAன.

AghaiyAl ghardhdhar avaனoDhirundhAr; avaன bhoghiRa iDhaM è~NghuM avaனughghu anughUlamAyiRRu; avaன ajhIriyA rAjAvaijh jhevighghAmal, avaன adhighAradhdhaidh dhaLLiviDhDhAன.
avaன bhèlisdharaigh ghAjhAmaDhDhuM adhiன èllaighaL bhariyandhamuM, ghAvalALar ghAghghiRa ghobhura~NghaL dhòDha~Nghi araNAன naghara~NghaL bhariyandhamuM muRiya aDhidhdhAன.

israveliன rAjAvAghiya elAviன ghumAraன ojhèyAviன ezhAM varuShadhdhiRghujh jhariyAன èjheghghiyA rAjAviன nAlAM varuShadhdhile ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya jhalmaனAjhAr jhamAriyAvughghu virodhamAy vandhu adhai muRRighghai bhoDhDhAன.
mUனRu varuShaM jhèனRabhiனbhu, avarghaL adhaibh bhiDhidhdhArghaL; èjheghghiyAviன ARAM varuShadhdhiluM, israveliன rAjAvAghiya ojhèyAviன òனbhadhAM varuShadhdhiluM jhamAriyA bhiDhibhaDhDhadhu.
ajhIriyA rAjA isravelai ajhIriyAvughghujh jhiRaibhiDhidhdhughghòNDhubhoy, ghojhAன nadhiyoramAன AlAghiluM AbhoriluM medhiyariன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiluM ghuDhiyeRRiனAன.

avarghaL dha~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhiRghujh jhèvighòDhAmal, avaruDhaiya uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyaiyuM ghardhdhariன dhAjhaனAghiya mojhe ghaRbhidhdha yAvaRRaiyuM mIRi, adhaRghujh jhèvighòDhAmaluM adhiனbhaDhi jhèyyAmaluM bhoனArghaL.
yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya èjheghghiyAviன bhadhiனAlAM varuShadhdhile ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya jhaனghèribh yUdhAvilirughghiRa araNAன jhaghala bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLughghuM virodhamAy vandhu avaighaLaibh bhiDhidhdhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya èjheghghiyA lAghIjhiluLLa ajhIriyA rAjAvughghu AL aனubhbhi: nAன ghuRRa~njhèydheன; èனனaiviDhDhudh dhiruMbhibhbhoM; nIr èனmel jhumadhdhuvadhaijh jhumabhbheன èனRu jhòனனAன; abhbhaDhiye ajhIriyA rAjA yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya èjheghghiyAviனmel munnURu dhAlandhu vèLLiyaiyuM mubhbhadhu dhAlandhu bhòனனaiyuM jhumadhdhiனAன.
AdhalAl èjheghghiyA ghardhdhariன AlayadhdhiluM rAjAvuDhaiya aramaனai bhòghghiSha~NghaLiluM aghabhbhaDhDha èllA vèLLiyaiyuM ghòDhudhdhAன.

aghghAladhdhile yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya èjheghghiyA ghardhdharuDhaiya AlayaghghadhavughaLiluM nilaighaLiluM dhAன azhudhdhiyirundha bhòன dhaghaDhughaLaigh ghazhaRRi avaighaLai ajhIriyA rAjAvughghugh ghòDhudhdhAன.

AghiluM ajhIriyA rAjA lAghIjhilirundhu dhardhAனaiyuM rabhjhArIjhaiyuM rabhjhAghgheyaiyuM bhèriya jheனaiyoDhe èrujhalemughghu èjheghghiyA rAjAviனiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனAன; avarghaL èrujhalemughghu vandhu, vaNNAr dhuRaiyiன vazhiyiluLLa melghuLadhdhujh jhAlaghadhdhaNDhaiyile niனRu,

rAjAvai azhaibhbhidhdhArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu ilghghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya èliyAghghIM èனனuM aramaனai vijhAribhbhughghAraனuM, jhèbhனA èனனuM jhaMbhiradhiyuM, AjhAbhbhiன ghumAraனAghiya yovAgh èனனuM ghaNaghghaனuM avarghaLiDhadhdhiRghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனArghaL.
rabhjhAghghe avarghaLai noghghi: ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya maghA rAjAvAனvar uraighghiRadhuM, nI~NghaL èjheghghiyAvughghujh jhòllaveNDhiyadhuM èனனvèனRAl: nI naMbhiyirughghiRa indha naMbhighghai èனன?
yudhdhadhdhiRghu mandhirAlojhaனaiyuM vallamaiyuM uNDhèனRu nI jhòllughiRAye, adhu vAybhbhejhjheyaனRi veRalla; nI èனனai virodhighghuM bhaDhi yArmel naMbhighghai vaidhdhirughghiRAy?

idho, nèrindha nANalgholAghiya andha èghibhdhai naMbhughiRAy; adhiனmel òruvaன jhAyndhAl, adhu avaன uLLa~Nghaiyil bhaDhDhu uruvibhbhoM; èghibhdhiன rAjAvAghiya bhArvoன dhaனனai naMbhughiRa yAvarughghuM ibhbhaDhiye irubhbhAன.

nI~NghaL èனனiDhadhdhil: è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharai naMbhughiRoM èனRu jhòlluvIrghaLAghil, avaruDhaiya meDhaighaLaiyuM avaruDhaiya bhalibhIDha~NghaLaiyuM allavo èjheghghiyA aghaRRi, yUdhAvaiyuM èrujhalemaiyuM noghghi: èrujhalemilirughghiRa indhabh bhalibhIDhadhdhiனmuன bhaNiyu~NghaL èனRAனe.
nAன uனghghu iraNDhAyiraM ghudhiraighaLaigh ghòDhubhbheன; nI avaighaL mel eRadhdhaghghavarghaLaijh jhaMbhAdhighghagh ghUDhumAனAl ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனoDhe jhabhadha~NghURu.
ghURAdhebhoனAl, nI èன ANDhavaனuDhaiya UzhiyaghghAraril òre òru jhiRiya dhalaivaனiன mughadhdhai èbhbhaDhidh dhirubhbhuvAy? iradha~NghaLoDhu ghudhiraivIraruM varuvArghaL èனRu èghibhdhaiyA naMbhughiRAy?
ibhbhodhuM ghardhdharuDhaiya ghaDhDhaLaiyillAmal indha sdhaladhdhai azhighghavandheனo? indha dhejhadhdhiRghu virodhamAybh bhoy adhai azhidhdhubhbhoDhu èனRu ghardhdhar èனனoDhe jhòனனAre èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ilghghiyAviன ghumAraன èliyAghghImuM jhèbhனAvuM yovAghuM rabhjhAghgheyaibh bhArdhdhu: umadhu aDhiyAroDhe jhIriyabhAShaiyile bhejhuM, adhu è~NghaLughghudh dhèriyuM; ala~NghadhdhilirughghiRa jaனdhdhiன jhèvighaL gheDhgha è~NghaLoDhe yUdhabhAShaiyile bhejhaveNDhAM èனRArghaL.

adhaRghu rabhjhAghghe: u~NghaLoDhu~NghUDhadh dha~NghaL maladhdhaidh dhiனனvuM dha~NghaL nIraigh ghuDhighghavuM ala~Nghadhdhile dha~NghiyirughghiRa maனuSharaNDhaighghe allAmal, uன ANDhavaனNDhaighghuM uனனNDhaighghumA èன ANDhavaன indha vArdhdhaighaLaibh bhejha èனனai aனubhbhiனAr èனRu jhòlli,
rabhjhAghghe niனRu ghòNDhu yUdhabhAShaiyile uradhdhajhadhdhamAy: ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya maghArAjAvuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLu~NghaL.
èjheghghiyA u~NghaLai va~njhiyAdhabhaDhi bhAru~NghaL; avaன u~NghaLai èன ghaiyilirundhu dhabhbhuvighghamADhDhAன.

ghardhdhar naMmai nijhjhayamAydh dhabhbhuvibhbhAr; indha nagharaM ajhIriyA rAjAviன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvadhillai èனRu jhòlli, èjheghghiyA u~NghaLaigh ghardhdharai naMbhabhbhaNNuvAன; adhaRghu iDha~NghòDhAdhiru~NghaL èனRu rAjA jhòllughiRAr.

èjheghghiyAviன jhòllaigh gheLAdhiru~NghaL; ajhIriyA rAjA jhòllughiRadhAvadhu: nI~NghaL èனனoDhe rAjhiyAghi, ghANighghaiyoDhe èனனiDhadhdhil vAru~NghaL; nAன vandhu, u~NghaLai u~NghaL dhejhadhdhughghu òbhbhAன dhAனiyamuM dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhamumuLLa dhejhamuM, abhbhamuM dhirADhjharajhamumuLLa dhejhamuM, òliva èNNèyuM dheனumuLLa dhejhamumAghiya jhImaighghu azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoghumaLavuM,

avaனvaன dhaன dhaன dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyiன ghaனiyaiyuM dhaன dhaன adhdhimaradhdhiன ghaனiyaiyuM bhujhidhdhu, avaனvaன dhaன dhaன ghiNaRRiன dhaNNIraigh ghuDhiyu~NghaL; ivvidhamAy nI~NghaL jhAghAmal bhizhaibhbhIrghaL; ghardhdhar naMmaidh dhabhbhuvibhbhAr èனRu u~NghaLaibh bhodhaனaijhèyya èjheghghiyAvughghujh jhèvighòDhAdhiru~NghaL.
jAdhighaLuDhaiya dhevarghaLil yArAvadhu dha~NghaL dhejhadhdhai ajhIriyA rAjAviன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvidhdhadhuNDho?
AmAdh, arbhAdh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன dhevarghaL è~Nghe? jhèbhbharvAyIM, eனA, IvAbh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன dhevarghaL è~Nghe? avarghaL jhamAriyAvai èன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvidhdhadhuNDho?

ghardhdhar èrujhalemai èன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvibhbhAr èனbhadhaRghu, andha dhejha~NghaLuDhaiya èllA dhevarghaLughghuLLuM dha~NghaL dhejhadhdhai èன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvidhdhavar yAr èனghiRAr èனRu jhòனனAன.
AனAluM jaன~NghaL avaனughghu òru vArdhdhaiyuM bhiradhiyudhdharamAghajh jhòllAmal mavuனmAyirundhArghaL; avaனughghu maRuudhdharavu jhòllaveNDhAM èனRu rAjA ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirundhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ilghghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya èliyAghghIM èனனuM aramaனai vijhAribhbhughghAraனuM, jhèbhனA èனனuM jhaMbhiradhiyuM, AjhAbhbhiன ghumAraன yovAgh èனனuM ghaNaghghaனuM vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòNDhu, èjheghghiyAviனiDhadhdhil vandhu, rabhjhAghgheyiன vArdhdhaighaLai avaனughghudh dhèrividhdhArghaL.
rAjAvAghiya èjheghghiyA adhaigh gheDhDhabhodhu, dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhu, iraDhDhu uDhudhdhighghòNDhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhil bhiravejhidhdhu,

aramaனai vijhAribhbhughghAraனAghiya èliyAghghImaiyuM, jhaMbhiradhiyAghiya jhèbhனAvaiyuM, AjhAriyarghaLiன mUbhbharaiyuM, Amodhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya ejhAyA èனனuM dhIrghghadharijhiyiனiDhadhdhughghu iraDhDhu uDhudhdhighghòNDhavarghaLAgha aனubhbhiனAன.
ivarghaL avaனai noghghi: indha nAL nèrughghamuM ghaNDhidhamuM dhUShaNamuM anubhavighghiRa nAL; bhiLLaibhbheRu noghghiyirughghiRadhu, bhèRavo bhèlaனillai.

jIvaனuLLa dhevaனai nindhighghuMbhaDhi ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya dhaன ANDhavaனAl aனubhbhabhbhaDhDha rabhjhAghghe jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM umadhu dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar gheDhDhirughghiRAr; umadhu dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar gheDhDhirughghiRa vArdhdhaighaLiன nimidhdhaM dhaNDhaனai jhèyvAr; AghaiyAl iனனuM mIdhiyAyirughghiRavarghaLughghAgha viNNabhbha~njhèyvIrAgha èனRu èjheghghiyA jhòllajhjhòனனAr èனRArghaL.
ivvidhamAy èjheghghiyA rAjAviன UzhiyaghghArar ejhAyAviனiDhadhdhil vandhu jhòனனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu ejhAyA avarghaLai noghghi: ajhIriyA rAjAviன UzhiyaghghArar èனனaidh dhUShidhdhadhuM nIr gheDhDhadhumAன vArdhdhaighaLiனAle bhayabhbhaDhAdheyuM.

idho, avaன òru jhèydhiyaigh gheDhDhu, dhaன dhejhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhuvadhaRghAன Aviyai nAன avaனughghuL aனubhbhi, avaனai avaன dhejhadhdhile bhaDhDhayadhdhAl vizhabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனbhadhai u~NghaL ANDhavaனiDhadhdhil jhòllu~NghaL èனRAன.
ajhIriyA rAjA lAghIjhaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhAன èனRu gheLvibhbhaDhDhu, rabhjhAghghe dhiruMbhibhbhoy, avaன libhனAviனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNughiRadhaigh ghaNDhAன.

idho, èdhdhiyobhbhiyA rAjAvAghiya dhIrAghghA uMmoDhu yudhdhaMbhaNNabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhAன èனRu jhòllagh gheLvibhbhaDhDhAன; abhbhòzhudhu avaன dhiruMbha èjheghghiyAviனiDhadhdhughghu sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhi:

nI~NghaL yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya èjheghghiyAvughghujh jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl, èrujhaleM ajhIriyA rAjAviன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvadhillaiyèனRu nI naMbhiyirughghiRa uன dhevaன uனனai èdhdha òDhDhAdhe.
idho, ajhIriyA rAjAghghaL jhaghala dhejha~NghaLaiyuM jha~Ngharidhdha jhèydhiyai nI gheDhDhirughghiRAye, nI dhabhbhuvAyo?
èன bhidhAghghaL azhidhdhuviDhDha ghojhAனaiyuM ArAனaiyuM redhjhebhbhaiyuM, dhèlAjhArilirundha edheனiன bhudhdhiraraiyuM avarghaLuDhaiya dhevarghaL dhabhbhuvidhdhadhuNDho?
AmAdhdhiன rAjAvuM, arbhAdhdhiன rAjAvuM, jhèbhbharvAyIM eனA IvA bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன rAjAvuM è~Nghe? èனRu jhòllu~NghaL èனRAன.
èjheghghiyA sdhAனAbhadhighaLiன ghaiyilirundhu nirubhadhdhai vA~Nghi vAjhidhdha bhiனbhu, avaன ghardhdhariன AlayadhdhiRghubh bhoy, adhaigh ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha viridhdhu,

ghardhdharai noghghi: gherubhIனghaLiன madhdhiyil vAjhaMbhaNNughiRa israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhAve, nIr òruvare bhUmiyiன rAjya~NghaLughghèllAM dhevaனAனvar; nIr vAனdhdhaiyuM bhUmiyaiyuM uNDhAghghiனIr.

ghardhdhAve, umadhu jhèviyaijh jhAydhdhugh gheLuM; ghardhdhAve, nIr umadhu ghaNghaLaidh dhiRandhubhAruM; jhaனghèribh jIvaனuLLa dhevaனai nindhighghuMbhaDhighghujh jhòlliyaனubhbhiன vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheLuM.
ghardhdhAve, ajhIriyA rAjAghghaL andha jAdhighaLaiyuM avarghaL dhejhadhdhaiyuM nAjhamAghghi,
avarghaLuDhaiya dhevarghaLai nèrubhbhile bhoDhDhuviDhDhadhu mèydhAன; avaighaL dhevarghaL allave, maனuShar ghaivelaiyAன maramuM ghalluMdhAனe; AghaiyAl avaighaLai nirdhdhULiyAghghiனArghaL.

ibhbhodhuM è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhAve, nIr òruvare dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar èனRu bhUmiyiன rAjya~NghaL èllAM aRiyuMbhaDhighghu, è~NghaLai avaன ghaighghu nI~NghalAghghi iraDhjhiyuM èனRu viNNabhbhaMbhaNNiனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu Amodhjhiன ghumAraனAghiya ejhAyA èjheghghiyAvughghujh jhòlliyaனubhbhiனdhu: israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya jhaனghèribhiனnimidhdhaM nI èனனai noghghibh bhaNNiன viNNabhbhadhdhaigh gheDhDheன.

avaனaigh ghuRidhdhugh ghardhdhar jhòllughiRa vajhaனmAvadhu: jhIyoன ghumAradhdhiyAghiya ghaனனiyAsdhirI uனனai ighazhndhu, uனனaibh bharighAjhaMbhaNNughiRAL; èrujhaleM ghumAradhdhi uன bhiனனAle dhalaiyaidh dhulughghughiRAL.
yArai nindhidhdhudh dhUShidhdhAy? yArughghu virodhamAy uன jhadhdhadhdhai uyardhdhiனAy? nI israveliன bharijhudhdharughghu virodhamAyallavo uன ghaNghaLai meDhDhimaiyAgha eRèDhudhdhAy?

uன sdhAனAbhadhighaLaigh ghòNDhu nI ANDhavarai nindhidhdhu: èன iradha~NghaLiன dhiraLiனAle nAன malaighaLiன ghòDhumuDhighaLughghuM lIbhaனoனiன jhighara~NghaLughghuM vandhu eRiனeன; adhiன uyaramAன ghedhurumara~NghaLaiyuM, ujhjhidhamAன dhevadhAri viruDhjha~NghaLaiyuM nAன vèDhDhi, adhiன ghaDhaiyAndharadh; dhAbharamaDhDhuM, adhiன jhèzhumaiyAன vaனmaDhDhuM varuveன èனRuM,
nAன anniyadhejha~NghaLil ghiNaRu vèDhDhi dhaNNIr ghuDhidhdheன; èன uLLa~NghAlghaLiனAl araNibhbhAன iDha~NghaLiன aghazhighaLaiyèllAM vaRaLavuM bhaNNiனeன èனRuM jhòனனAy.

nAன vèghughAladhdhiRghumuன adhai niyamidhdhu, bhUrvanADhghaL mudhal adhaidh dhiDhDhaMbhaNNiனeன èனbhadhai nI gheDhDhadhillaiyo? ibhbhòzhudhu nI araNAன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaibh bhAzhAன maNmeDhughaL AghghuMbhaDhighghu nAனe adhaijh jhaMbhavighghabhbhaNNiனeன.

adhiனAle avaighaLiன ghuDhighaL ghaiyiLaidhdhavarghaLAghi, ghala~Nghi vèDhghabhbhaDhDhu, vèLiyiன bhUNDhughghuM, bhajhjhilaighghuM, vIDhughaLiனmel muLaighghuM bhullughghuM, o~NghivaLarumuன dhIyndhubhoghuM bhayirughghuM jhamAனmAனArghaL.
uன irubhbhaiyuM, uன bhoghghaiyuM, uன varavaiyuM, nI èனghghu virodhamAygh ghòndhaLighghiRadhaiyuM aRiveன.

nI èனghghu virodhamAygh ghòndhaLidhdhu, vIriyaM bhejhiனdhu èன jhèvighaLil eRiனbhaDhiyiனAl, nAன èன dhuRaDhDhai uன mUghghiluM èன ghaDhivALadhdhai uன vAyiluM bhoDhDhu, nI vandhavazhiye uனனaidh dhirubhbhighghòNDhu bhoveன èனRu avaனaighghuRidhdhujh jhòllughiRAr.

uனghghu aDhaiyALamAyirubhbhadhu èனனvèனRAl: indha varuShadhdhile dhabhbhibh bhayirAghiRadhaiyuM, iraNDhAM varuShadhdhile dhAனAy viLaighiRadhaiyuM jhAbhbhiDhuvIrghaL; mUனRAM varuShadhdhilo vidhaidhdhu aRudhdhu, dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDha~NghaLai nADhDhi, avaighaLiன ghaனighaLaibh bhujhibhbhIrghaL.
yUdhA vaMjhadhdhAril dhabhbhi mIndhirughghiRavarghaL maRubhaDhiyuM ghIzhe verbhaRRi mele ghaனighòDhubhbhArghaL.
mIdhiyAyirughghiRavarghaL èrujhalemiluM, dhabhbhiனvarghaL jhIyoன malaiyiluM irundhu bhuRabhbhaDhuvArghaL; jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhariன vairAghghiyaM idhaijh jhèyyuM.

a~Ngheyirundhu ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன jhaghala bhòghghiSha~NghaLaiyuM, rAjAvuDhaiya aramaனaiyiன bhòghghiSha~NghaLaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, israveliன rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhil uNDhAghghiyirundha bhòன bhaNimuDhDhughaLaiyèllAM, ghardhdhar jhòlliyirundhabhaDhiye uDhaidhdhubhbhoDhDhu,

èrujhalemiyar aனaivaruM jhaghala bhirabhughghaLuM jhaghala bharAghghiramajhAlighaLumAghiya bhadhiனAyiraMbheraiyuM, jhaghala dhajhjharaiyuM ghòllaraiyuM jhiRaibhiDhidhdhigh ghòNDhubhoனAன; dhejhadhdhil ezhai jaன~NghaLe allAmal veRòruvaruM mIdhiyAyirughghavillai.

avarghaLil AjhAbh dhalaivaனuM, jhaghariyA avaனughghu iraNDhAvadhumAyirundhAன; eyèl, jhèmiramodh, yèghiyel, madhdhidhdhiyA, èliyAbh, bhèனAyA, obhedhedhoM, eyèl èனbhavarghaL dhaMbhuru jhuramaNDhalaM èனனuM ghIdhavAdhdhiya~NghaLai vAjhighghavuM, AjhAbh ghaidhdhALa~NghaLaigh ghòDhDhavuM,
bhèனAyA, yAghAjhiyel èனனuM AjhAriyar èbhbhodhuM dhevaனuDhaiya uDhaனbhaDhighghaibh bhèDhDhighghu muனbhAghabh bhUrighaighaLai UdhavuM niyamighghabhbhaDhDhArghaL.
abhbhaDhi AraMbhidhdha annALiledhAனe ghardhdharughghudh dhudhiyAghabh bhADhuMbhaDhi dhAvIdhu AjhAbhbhiDhadhdhiluM avaன jhaghodharariDhadhdhiluM ghòDhudhdha jha~NghIdhamAvadhu:
