dhAvIdhu dhevaனai noghghi: jaனdhdhai èNNajh jhòனனvaன nAன allavo? nAனdhAன bhAva~njhèydheன; bhòllAbha͠Ϊu naDhabhbhiĠύdheன; indha ADhughaL èனன jhèyĠΤu? èன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhAve, vAdhighghuMbhaDhi uMmuDhaiya gharaM uMmuDhaiya jaனdhdhiRghu virodhamAyirAmal, èனghghuM èன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhiRghuM virodhamAyirubhbhadhAgha èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu èbhUjhiyaனAghiya òrனAனiன ghaLadhdhile ghardhdharughghu òru bhalibhIDhadhdhai uNDhAghghuMbhaDhi, dhAvIdhu a~Nghe bhoghaveNDhumèனRu dhAvIdhughghujh jhòl èனRu ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன ghAdhdhughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAன.

dhAvIdhu òrனAனiDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu òrனAன ghavaனidhdhudh dhAvIdhaibh bhArdhdhu, avaன ghaLadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvandhu, dharaimaDhDhuM ghuனindhu dhAvIdhai vaNa~NghiனAன.

dhAvIdhu andha niladhdhiRghu aRunURu jheghghal niRaibhòனனai òrனAனughghughghugh ghòDhudhdhu,

a~Nghe ghardhdharughghu òru bhalibhIDhadhdhaigh ghaDhDhi, jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhalighaLaiyuM jhamAdhAன bhalighaLaiyuM jhèludhdhi, ghardhdharai noghghi viNNabhbhaMbhaNNiனAன; abhbhòzhudhu avar vAனdhdhilirundhu jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhalibhIDhadhdhiனmel iRa~Nghiன aghghiனiyil avaனughghu maRuudhdharavu ghòDhudhdhadhumallAmal,

èbhUjhiyaனAghiya òrனAனiன ghaLadhdhile ghardhdhar dhaனghghu udhdharavu aruLiனdhaidh dhAvIdhu aghghAladhdhile, ghaNDhu a~NghedhAனe bhaliyiDhDhAன.
mojhe vaனAndharadhdhil uNDhAghghiன ghardhdharuDhaiya vAjhasdhalamuM jharvA~Ngha dhaghaனbhalibhIDhamuM aghghAladhdhile ghibhiyoனiன meDhDhil irundhadhu.

dhAvIdhu vAjhalghaLiன ghadhavughaLughghu veNDhiya ANighaLughghuM ghIlghaLughghuM mighudhiyAன iruMbhaiyuM, niRudhdhu muDhiyAdha erALamAன vèNghaladhdhaiyuM,
èNNiRandha ghedhurumara~NghaLaiyuM jhaMbhAdhidhdhAன; jhIdhoனiyaruM dhIriyaruM dhAvIdhughghudh dhiraLAன ghedhurumara~NghaLaigh ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.

avaன dhaன ghumAraனAghiya jhAlòmoனai azhaidhdhu, israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu Alayadhdhaigh ghaDhDhughiRadhaRghAgha avaனughghu ghaDhDhaLaighòDhudhdhu,
jhAlòmoனai noghghi: èன ghumAraனe, nAன èன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன nAmadhdhiRghu òru Alayadhdhaigh ghaDhDha èன irudhayadhdhil niனaidhdhirundheன.

idho, uனghghubh bhiRaghghabhbhoghiRa ghumAraன amaidhiyuLLa bhuruShaனAyirubhbhAன; jhuRRilumirughghuM avaன jhadhdhurughghaLaiyèllAM vilaghghi avaனai amarndhirughghajh jhèyveன; AghaiyAl avaனbher jhAlòmoன èனனbhbhaDhuM, avaன nADhghaLil israveliனmel jhamAdhAனdhdhaiyuM amarighghaiyaiyuM aruLuvAன.

ibhbhodhuM èன ghumAraனe, nI bhAghghiyavAனAyirundhu, ghardhdhar uனனaigh ghuRidhdhujh jhòனனbhaDhiye uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன Alayadhdhaigh ghaDhDhuMbhaDhi, avar uனனuDhaனeghUDha irubhbhArAgha.

bhòனனughghuM, vèLLighghuM, vèNghaladhdhughghuM, iruMbhughghuM ghaNaghghillai; nI èzhuMbhigh ghAriyadhdhai naDhabhbhi; ghardhdhar uனனoDhe irubhbhArAgha èனRAன.
dhaன ghumAraனAghiya jhAlòmoனughghu udhavijhèyya, dhAvIdhu israveliன bhirabhughghaL aனaivarughghuM ghaRbhidhdhujh jhòனனdhu.

u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar u~NghaLoDhirundhu nAனghu dhijhaiyiluM u~NghaLughghu iLaibhbhARudhalaidh dhandhAr allavA? dhejhadhdhiன ghuDhighaLai èன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr; ghardhdharughghu muனbhAghavuM, avaruDhaiya jaனdhdhiRghu muனbhAghavuM dhejhaM ghIzhbhbhaDhDhirughghiRadhu.

jhebhAviன rAjasdhirI jhAlòmoனiன ghIrdhdhiyaigh gheLvibhbhaDhDhabhodhu, viDhughadhaighaLiனAle jhAlòmoனaijh jhodhighghiRadhaRghAgha, mighundha bharivAradhdhoDhuM, ghandhavarghgha~NghaLaiyuM, mighudhiyAன bhòனனaiyuM iradhdhiன~NghaLaiyuM jhumaghghiRa òDhDhagha~NghaLoDhuM èrujhalemughghu vandhAL; avaL jhAlòmoனiDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu, dhaன maனdhilirundha èllAvaRRaiyuM ghuRidhdhu avaனiDhadhdhil jhaMbhAShidhdhAL.
abhbhòzhudhu jhAlòmoன avaL gheDhDhavaighaLaiyèllAM viDhuvidhdhAன; avaLughghu viDhuvighghAdhabhaDhighghu òனRAghiluM jhAlòmoனughghu maRaibhòruLAyirughghavillai.
jhebhAviன rAjasdhirI jhAlòmoனuDhaiya bhAனbhAdhdhiraghghAraraiyuM, avar aramaனaiyaiyuM,

avaன bhandhiyiன bhojaனbhadhArdhdha~NghaLaiyuM, avaன UzhiyaghghArariன vIDhughaLaiyuM, avaன udhdhiyoghasdhariன varijhaiyaiyuM, avarghaL vasdhira~NghaLaiyuM, avaனuDhaiya bhAனbhAdhdhiraghghAraraiyuM, avarghaL vasdhira~NghaLaiyuM, ghardhdharuDhaiya AlayadhdhughghuL bhiravejhighghuM naDhaimaNDhabhadhdhaiyuM ghaNDhabhodhu avaL AjhjhariyadhdhAl bhiramaighòNDhu,
rAjAvai noghghi: uMmuDhaiya vardhdhamAன~NghaLaiyuM uMmuDhaiya ~nAனdhdhaiyuM ghuRidhdhu, nAன èன dhejhadhdhile gheDhDha jhèydhi mèyyAyiRRu.

nAன vandhu adhai èன ghaNghaLAl ghANumaDhDhuM avarghaL vArdhdhaighaLai naMbhavillai; uMmuDhaiya bhèriya ~nAனdhdhil bhAdhiyAghiluM avarghaL èனghghu aRivighghavillai; nAன gheLvibhbhaDhDha bhirasdhAbhadhdhaibhbhArghghiluM adhighaM uNDhAyirughghiRadhu.
uMmuDhaiya jaன~NghaL bhAghghiyavAனghaL; èbhbhodhuM umaghghu muனbhAgha niனRu, uMmuDhaiya ~nAனdhdhaigh gheDhghiRa uMmuDhaiya UzhiyaghghAraruM bhAghghiyavAனghaL.

uMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha nIr rAjAvAyirughghuMbhaDhighghu, uMmaidh dhaMmuDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel vIRRirughghabhbhaNNa, uMmel bhiriya~NghòNDha uMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar sdhodhdhirighghabhbhaDhuvArAgha; uMmuDhaiya dhevaன isravelai èனRèனRaighghuM nilainiRudhdhuMbhaDhighghujh jhineghighghiRadhiனAle, avar niyAyamuM nIdhiyuMjhèyghiRadhaRghu uMmai avarghaLmel rAjAvAgha vaidhdhAr èனRAL

avaL rAjAvughghu nURRirubhadhu dhAlandhu bhòனனaiyuM, mighudhiyAன ghandhavarghgha~NghaLaiyuM, iradhdhiன~NghaLaiyuM ghòDhudhdhAL; jhebhAviன rAjasdhirI rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoனughghughghòDhudhdha abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha ghandhavarghgha~NghaLaibhbhola òrughghAluM varavillai.
obhbhIrilirundhu bhòனனaigh ghòNDhuvarughiRa IrAmiன velaighghAraruM jhAlòmoனiன velaighghAraruM vAjhaனaimara~NghaLaiyuM iradhdhiன~NghaLaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.

andha vAjhaனaimara~NghaLAl rAjA ghardhdharuDhaiya AlayadhdhughghuM rAja aramaனaighghuM UனRughAlghaLaiyuM, jha~NghIdhaghghArarughghujh jhuramaNDhala~NghaLaiyuM dhaMbhurughaLaiyuM uNDhAghghiனAன; abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavaighaL adhaRghu muனனe yUdheyA dhejhadhdhil òrughghAluM ghANabhbhaDhavillai.

jhebhAviன rAjasdhirI rAjAvughghugh ghòNDhuvandhavaighaLaibhbhArghghiluM adhighamAy avaL AjhaibhbhaDhDhughgheDhDha èllAvaRRaiyuM rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன avaLughghugh ghòDhudhdhAன; bhiனbhu avaL dhaன bharivAradhdhoDhu~NghUDha dhaன dhejhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoனAL.
viyAbhArighaLuM vardhdhagharuM ghòNDhuvaruM bhòனனaidhdhavira, jhAlòmoனughghu òvvòru varuShadhdhiluM vandha bhòன aRunURRu aRubhadhdhARu dhAlandhu niRaiyAyirundhadhu.
arabhidhejhadhdhujh jhaghala rAjAghghaLuM mAghANa~NghaLiன adhibhadhighaLuM jhAlòmoனughghubh bhòனனaiyuM vèLLiyaiyuM ghòNDhuvaruvArghaL.
rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன irunURu bharijhaighaLai aDhidhdha bhòனdhaghaDhDhAl jhèyvidhdhAன; òvvòru bharijhaighghu aRunURu jheghghal niRai bhòனdhaghaDhDhaijh jhèlavazhidhdhAன.

aDhidhdha bhòனdhaghaDhDhAl munnURugheDhagha~NghaLaiyuM uNDhAghghiனAன; òvvòru gheDhaghadhdhiRghu munnURu jheghghalniRai bhòனனaijh jhèlavazhidhdhAன; avaighaLai rAjA lIbhaனoன vaனM èனனuM mALighaiyile vaidhdhAன.
rAjA dhandhadhdhiனAl òru bhèriya jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhaiyuM jhèyvidhdhu, adhaibh bhajhuMbhòனdhaghaDhDhAl mUDhiனAன.

andhajh jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhughghubh bhòனனiனAl jhèyyabhbhaDhDha ARu bhaDhighaLuM, òru bhAdhabhaDhiyuM, uDhghAruM iDhadhdhiRghu irubhuRadhdhiluM ghaijhjhAymAன~NghaLuM irundhadhu; iraNDhu jhi~Ngha~NghaL ghaijhjhAymAன~NghaL arughe niனRadhu.
andha ARu bhaDhighaLiனmeluM, iraNDhu bhaghghadhdhiluM bhaனனiraNDhu jhi~Ngha~NghaL niனRadhu, èndha rAjyadhdhiluM ibhbhaDhibh bhaNNabhbhaDhavillai.

rAjAvAghiya jhAlèmoனughghu irundha bhAனbhAdhdhira~NghaLèllAM bhòனனuM, lIbhaனoன vaனM èனனuM mALighaiyiன bhaNimuDhDhughaLèllAM bhajhuMbhòனனumAyirundhadhu; òனRuM vèLLiyiனAl jhèyyabhbhaDhavillai; jhAlòmoனiன nADhghaLil vèLLi òru bhòruLAy èNNabhbhaDhavillai.

rAjAviன ghabhbhalghaL IrAmiன velaighghAraruDhaன dharShIjhughghubh bhoyvaruM; dharShIjhiன ghabhbhalghaL mUனRu varuShadhdhughghu òrudharaM bhòனனaiyuM, vèLLiyaiyuM, yAனaidh dhandha~NghaLaiyuM, ghura~NghughaLaiyuM, mayilghaLaiyuM ghòNDhuvaruM.
bhUmiyiன rAjAghghaLaibhbhArghghiluM rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoன aijhuvariyadhdhiluM ~nAனdhdhiluM jhiRandhavaனAyirundhAன.
jhAlòmoனiன irudhayadhdhile dhevaன aruLiya ~nAனdhdhaigh gheDhbhadhaRghu bhUmiyiன rAjAghghaL èllAruM avaன mughadharijhaனdhdhaidh dheDhiனArghaL.

varuShAvaruShaM avaravar dha~NghaL ghANighghaiyAghiya vèLLibhbhAdhdhira~NghaLaiyuM, bhòRbhAdhdhira~NghaLaiyuM, vasdhira~NghaLaiyuM, Ayudha~NghaLaiyuM, jhughandhavarghgha~NghaLaiyuM, ghudhiraighaLaiyuM, ghoveRughazhudhaighaLaiyuM ghòNDhuvaruvArghaL.

jhAlòmoனughghu nAlAyiraMghudhirai lAya~NghaLuM iradha~NghaLuM irundhadhu, bhaனனIrAyiraM ghudhiraivIraruM irundhArghaL; avaighaLai iradha~NghaL vaighghuMbhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiluM, avarghaLai èrujhalemil dhaனனiDhadhdhiluM rAjA vaidhdhirundhAன.
nadhidhuvaghghibh bhèlisdhariன dhejhamaDhDhughghuM èghibhdhiன èllaivaraighghuM irughghiRa jhaghala rAjAghghaLaiyuM avaன ANDhAன.
èrujhalemile rAjA vèLLiyaigh ghaRghaLbholavuM, ghedhurumara~NghaLaibh bhaLLadhdhAghghughaLil irughghuM ghADhDhadhdhimara~NghaLbholavuM adhighamAghghiனAன.
èghibhdhiluM maRRa dhejha~NghaLilumirundhu jhAlòmoனughghugh ghudhiraighaL ghòNDhuvarabhbhaDhDhadhu.

jhAlòmoனuDhaiya AdhiyandhamAன naDhabhaDhighaL dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya nAdhdhAனiன bhusdhaghadhdhiluM, jhIloனiyaனAghiya aghiyA èzhudhiன dhIrghghadharijhaனdhdhiluM, nebhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yèròbhèyAmaighghuRidhdhu ~nAனdhiruShDhighghAraனAghiya idhdho èzhudhiன dharijhaன~NghaLiluM allavo èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu.
jhAlòmoன èrujhalemile isravelaiyèllAM nARbhadhu varuShaM arajhANDhAன.

bhiனbhu jhAlòmoன dhaன bhidhAghghaLoDhe nidhdhiraiyaDhaindhAன; avaனai avaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dhAvIdhiன nagharadhdhile aDhaghghaMbhaNNiனArghaL; avaன sdhAனdhdhile avaன ghumAraனAghiya règhòbhèyAM rAjAvAனAன.
règhòbhèyAmai rAjAvAghghuMbhaDhi isravelar èllAruM jhIghemughghu vandhirundhabhaDhiyAl, avaனuM jhIghemughghubhbhoனAன.
rAjAvAghiya jhAlòmoனai viDhDhuoDhibhoy, èghibhdhilirundha nebhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yèròbhèyAM adhaighgheDhDhabhodhu, avaன èghibhdhilirundhu dhiruMbhivandhAன.
AL aனubhbhi avaனai azhaibhbhidhdhArghaL; bhiனbhu yèròbhèyAmuM isravelaனaidhdhumAy vandhu, règhòbhèyAmai noghghi:

uMmuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaன bhAramAன nughadhdhai è~NghaLmel vaidhdhAr; ibhbhodhuM nIr uMmuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaன jhumadhdhiன ghaDhiனmAன velaiyaiyuM, avar è~NghaLmel vaidhdha bhAramAன nughadhdhaiyuM laghuvAghghuM; abhbhòzhudhu uMmaijhjhevibhbhoM èனRArghaL
adhaRghu avaன: nI~NghaL mUனRunALaighghubhbhiRbhADhu dhiruMbha èனனiDhadhdhil vAru~NghaL èனRAன; abhbhaDhiye jaன~NghaL bhoyirundhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjAvAghiya règhòbhayAM dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya jhAlòmoன uyiroDhirughghaiyil avaன jhamughadhdhil niனRa mudhiyoroDhe AlojhaனaibhaNNi, indha jaன~NghaLughghu maRuudhdharavu ghòDhughgha nI~NghaL èனன Alojhaனai jhòllughiRIrghaL èனRu gheDhDhAன.

adhaRghu avarghaL: nIr indha jaன~NghaLughghudh dhayavaiyuM bhaDhjhadhdhaiyuM ghANbhidhdhu, avarghaLughghu nalvArdhdhaighaLaijh jhòlvIrAனAl, èனRaighghuM avarghaL umaghghu UzhiyaghghArarAyirubhbhArghaL èனRArghaL.
mudhiyor jhòனன Alojhaனaiyai avaன dhaLLiviDhDhu, dhaனனoDhe vaLarndhavarghaLuM dhaன jhamughadhdhil niRghiRavarghaLumAghiya vAlibharoDhe AlojhaனaibhaNNi,

avarghaLai noghghi: uMmuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaன è~NghaLmel vaidhdha nughadhdhai laghuvAghghuM èனRu èனனiDhadhdhil jhòனன indha jaன~NghaLughghu maRuudhdharavu ghòDhughgha nI~NghaL èனன Alojhaனai jhòllughiRIrghaL èனRu gheDhDhAன.

avaனoDhe vaLarndha vAlibhar avaனai noghghi: uMmuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaன è~NghaL nughadhdhaibh bhAramAghghiனAr, nIr adhai è~NghaLughghu laghuvAghghuM èனRu uMmiDhadhdhil jhòனன indha jaனdhdhiRghu nIr jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: èன jhuNDhuviral èன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya iDhubhbhaibhbhArghghiluM bharumaனAyirughghuM.

ibhbhodhuM èன dhaghabhbhaன bhAramAன nughadhdhai u~NghaLmel vaidhdhAr, nAன u~NghaL nughadhdhai adhigha bhAramAghghuveன; èன dhaghabhbhaன u~NghaLaijh jhavughghughaLiனAle dhaNDhidhdhAr, nAன u~NghaLaidh dheLghaLiனAle dhaNDhibhbheன èனRu jhòlluM èனRArghaL.
mUனRAM nAL èனனiDhadhdhil vAru~NghaL èனRu rAjA jhòlliyirundhabhaDhiye, yèròbhèyAmuM jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM mUனRAM nALile règhòbhèyAmiDhadhdhil vandhArghaL.
rAjAvAghiya règhòbhèyAM mudhiyor Alojhaனaiyaidh dhaLLiviDhDhu, avarghaLughghugh ghaDhiனmAன udhdharavu ghòDhudhdhAன.

vAlibharuDhaiya AlojhaனaiyiனbhaDhiye avarghaLoDhe bhejhi, èன dhaghabhbhaன u~NghaL nughadhdhaibh bhAramAghghiனAr, nAன adhai adhigha bhAramAghghuveன; èன dhaghabhbhaன u~NghaLaijh jhavughghughaLiனAle dhaNDhidhdhAr, nAன u~NghaLaidh dheLghaLiனAle dhaNDhibhbheன èனRu jhòனனAன.

rAjA jaன~NghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhAmaRbhoனAன, ghardhdhar jhIloனiyaனAன aghiyAvaighghòNDhu nebhAdhdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yèròbhèyAmughghujh jhòனன dhamadhu vArdhdhaiyai uRudhibhbhaDhudhdhuMbhaDhi dhevaனAle ibhbhaDhi naDhandhadhu.

rAjA dha~NghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhAdhadhai isravelar èllAruM ghaNDhabhodhu, jaன~NghaL rAjAvughghu maRuudhdharamAgha dhAvIdhoDhe è~NghaLughghubh bha~Nghedhu? IjhAyiன ghumAraனiDhadhdhil è~NghaLughghujh jhudhandharaM illai; isravele, uன ghUDhAra~NghaLughghubh bhoyviDhu; ibhbhodhu dhAvIdhe, uன jhòndha vIDhDhaibh bhArdhdhughghòL èனRu jhòlli, isravelar èllAruM dha~NghaL ghUDhAra~NghaLughghubh bhoyviDhDhArghaL.
AனAluM yUdhAviன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLile ghuDhiyirundha isravel bhudhdhirarmel règhòbhèyAM rAjAvAyirundhAன.

bhiனbhu rAjAvAghiya règhòbhèyAM bhaghudhi vijhAribhbhughghAraனAghiya adhorAmai aனubhbhiனAன; isravel bhadhdhirar avaனaigh ghallèRindhu ghòனRArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu rAjAvAghiya règhòbhèyAM dhIviramAy iradhadhdhiனmel eRi èrujhalemughghu oDhibhbhoனAன.
abhbhaDhiye innALvaraighghuM irughghiRabhaDhi isravelar dhAvIdhiன vaMjhadhdhai viDhDhugh ghalaghaMbhaNNibh bhirindhubhoyirughghiRArghaL.

règhòbhèyAM èrujhalemughghu vandhabhodhu, israveloDhu yudhdhaMbhaNNavuM, rAjyadhdhaidh dhaனனiDhamAghadh dhirubhbhighghòLLavuM, yUdhA vaMjhadhdhAruM bhèனyamIன vaMjhadhdhArumAghiya dhèrindhughòLLabhbhaDhDha yudhdhavIrarAன laDhjhadhdhu èNbhadhiனAyiraMbheraigh ghUDhDhiனAன.
dhevaனuDhaiya maனuShaனAghiya jhèmAyAvughghugh ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai uNDhAghi, avar jhòனனdhu:
nI yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya règhòbhèyAM èனனuM jhAlòmoனiன ghumAraனaiyuM, yUdhAviluM bhèனyamIனiluM irughghiRa èllA isravelaraiyuM noghghi:

nI~NghaL bhoghAmaluM, u~NghaL jhaghodhararoDhu yudhdhaMbhaNNAmaluM avaravar dhaMdhaM vIDhDhughghudh dhiruMbhu~NghaL; èனனAle indhagh ghAriyaM naDhandhadhu èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr; abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaighaLughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhindhu, yèròbhèyAmughghu virodhamAy yudhdhaMbhaNNuvadhai viDhDhudh dhiruMbhibh bhoyviDhDhArghaL.
règhòbhèyAM èrujhalemil vAjhamAyirundhu, yUdhAvile araNAன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhiனAன.
avaன bhèdhlaghemuM, edhdhAmuM, dhèghghòvAvuM,
bhèdhjhUruM, jhoghovuM, adhullAmuM,
ghAdhdhuM, mareShAvuM, jhIbhbhuM, adhorAmuM, lAghIjhuM, ajheghghAvuM,
jhorAvuM, AyiloனuM, èbhroனuM Aghiya yUdhAviluM bhèனyamIனilumirughghiRa araNibhbhAன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaighghaDhDhi,
andha araNibhbhughaLaibh bhalabhbhaDhudhdhi, avaighaLile dhalaivaraiyuM, AghAramuM èNNèyuM dhirADhjharajhamumuLLa bhaNDhaghajhAlaighaLaiyuM,
yUdhAvuM bhèனyamIனuM avaன bhaDhjhadhdhilirughgha, òvvòru bhaDhDhaNadhdhiluM bharijhaighaLaiyuM IDhDhighaLaiyuM vaidhdhu, avaighaLai mighudhiyuM bhalabhbhaDhudhdhiனAன.
isravelè~NghuM irughghiRa AjhAriyaruM leviyaruM dha~NghaL èllA èllaighaLilumirundhu avaனiDhadhdhil vandhArghaL.

leviyar ghardhdharughghu AjhAriya Uzhiya~njhèyyAdhabhaDhighghu yèròbhèyAmuM avaன ghumAraruM avarghaLaidh dhaLLibhbhoDhDhabhaDhiyiனAl, dha~NghaL vèLinila~NghaLaiyuM dha~NghaL ghANiyADhjhighaLaiyuMviDhDhu, yUdhAdhejhadhdhughghuM èrujhalemughghuM vandhArghaL.
avaன meDhaighaLughghèனRuM, bheyghaLughghèனRuM, dhAன uNDhAghghiன ghaனRughghuDhDhighaLughghèனRuM AjhAriyarghaLai eRbhaDhudhdhiனAன.

andha leviyariன bhiRaghAle israveliன ghodhdhira~NghaLilèllAM israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaidh dheDhughiRadhaRghu, dha~NghaL irudhayadhdhai nerAghghiனvarghaL dha~NghaL bhidhAghghaLiன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghubh bhaliyiDhuMbhaDhighghu èrujhalemughghu vandhArghaL.

ibhbhaDhi mUனRu varuShamaDhDhuM yUdhAviன rAjyadhdhaibh bhalabhbhaDhudhdhi, jhAlòmoனiன ghumAraனAghiya règhòbhèyAmaidh dhiDhabhbhaDhudhdhiனArghaL; dhAvIdhuM jhAlòmoனuM naDhandha vazhiyile mUனRuvaruShamaDhDhuM naDhandhArghaL.
règhòbhèyAM dhAvIdhiன ghumAraனAghiya èrimodhdhiன ghumAradhdhi maghAdhdhaiyuM, IjhAyiன ghumAraனAghiya èliyAbhiன ghumAradhdhi abhiyAyelaiyuM vivAghaMbhaNNiனAன.
ivaL avaனughghu eyUs jhamariyA jhAghAM èனனuM ghumAraraibh bhèRRAL.

avaன bhudhdhiyAy naDhandhu, yUdhA bhèனyamIனuDhaiya èllA dhejha~NghaLilumuLLa araNAன jhaghala bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiluM dhaன ghumArar yAvaraiyuM bhiridhdhuvaidhdhu,

AனAluM èனனaijh jhevighghiRadhaRghuM, anniya dhejha~NghaLiன rAjya~NghaLaijh jhevighghiRadhaRghuM irughghiRa vidhdhiyAjhadhdhai avarghaL aRiyuMbhaDhighghu avaனaijh jhevighghiRavarghaLAvArghaL èனRAr.

avaன dhaனனaidh dhAzhdhdhiனbhaDhiyiனAl, ghardhdhar avaனai muzhudhuM azhighghAdhabhaDhighghu avaruDhaiya ghobhaM avaனaiviDhDhudh dhiruMbhiRRu; yUdhAvile iனனuM jhila ghAriya~NghaL jhIrAyirundhadhu.

abhbhaDhiye rAjAvAghiya règhòbhèyAM èrujhalemile dhaனனaidh dhiDhabhbhaDhudhdhighghòNDhu arajhANDhAன; règhòbhèyAM rAjAvAghiRabhodhu nARbhadhdhòru vayadhAyirundhu, ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya nAmaM viLa~NghuMbhaDhi isravel ghodhdhira~NghaLilèllAM dhèrindhughòNDha nagharamAghiya èrujhalemile bhadhiனezhu varuShaM rAjyabhAraMbhaNNiனAன; aMmoன jAdhiyAன avaனuDhaiya dhAyiன bher nAmAL.

règhAbhèyAmiன AdhiyoDhandhamAன naDhabhaDhighaL jhèmAyAviன bhusdhaghadhdhiluM, ~nAனdhiruShDhighghAraனAghiya idhdhoviன vaMjha aDhDhavaNaiyiluM allavo èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu; règhòbhèyAmughghuM yèròbhèyAmughghuM jhaghala nALuM yudhdhaM naDhandhughòNDhirundhadhu.

rAjAvAghiya yèròbhèyAmiன bhadhiனèDhDhAM varuShadhdhil abhiyA yUdhAviனmel rAjAvAghi,

abhbhòzhudhu abhiyA èbhbhirAyIM malaidhdhejhadhdhiluLLa jhèmarAyiM èனனuM malaiyiனmel eRiniனRu, yèròbhèyAme, èllA isravelare, gheLu~NghaL.
isravelai èனRaighghuM ALuM rAjyabhAradhdhai israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar dhAvIdhughghuM avaன ghumArarughghuM mARAdha uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyAygh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhadhai nI~NghaL aRiyIrghaLA?

abhiyAvuM avaனuDhaiya jaன~NghaLuM avarghaLil maghA jha~NghAraMbhaNNiனArghaL; dhèrindhughòLLabhbhaDhDha aindhulaDhjhaMbher isravelile vèDhDhuNDhuvizhundhArghaL.

aghghAla~NghaLile vèLiye bhoghiRavarghaLughghuM uLLe varughiRavarghaLughghuM jhamAdhAனM illai; dhejha~NghaLiன ghuDhighaLèllArughghuLLuM maghA amaLi uNDhAyirundhu,

uன dhevaனuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன ArAdhaனaighghAgha uனghghugh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhDha bhaNimuDhDhughaLaiyuM nI èrujhalemiன dhevaனuDhaiya jhannidhiyil òbhbhuvighghaghghaDhavAy.
bhiனனuM uன dhevaனuDhaiya Alayadhdhughghu avajhiyamAygh ghòDhughghaveNDhiyirubhbhadhai, nI rAjAviன ghajAனAvilirundhu vA~Nghigh ghòDhubhbhAyAgha.

veNDhiya ubhbhaiyuM, dhAmadhamillAmal ghòDhughghavuM,

bharaloghadhdhiன dhevaனuDhaiya ghaRbhaனaiyiனbhaDhiye, èdhu dhevaiyAyirughghumo adhuvèllAM bharaloghadhdhiன dhevaனuDhaiya AlayadhdhiRghu jAghghiradhaiyAyjh jhèludhdhabhbhaDhavuM veNDhuM; rAjAvuM avar ghumAraruM ALuM rAjyadhdhiனmel ghaDhu~NghobhaM varuvAனeன.

bhiனனuM AjhAriyaruM, leviyaruM, bhADhagharuM, vAjhal ghAvalALaruM, nidhaனImiyaruM, dhevaனuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன bhaNiviDhaighghArarumAன òruvaனmeluM bhaghudhiyAghiluM dhIrvaiyAghiluM AyamAghiluM jhumadhdhalAghAdhèனRu avarghaLaighghuRidhdhu u~NghaLughghu aRiyabhbhaDhudhdhughiRoM.

uன dhevaனuDhaiya niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiனbhaDhiyeyuM rAjAviனuDhaiya niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiனbhaDhiyeyuM jhèyyAdhavaனèvaனuM uDhaனe maraNadhdhughghAghiluM, dhejhadhdhughghubh bhuRaMbhAghghudhalughghAghiluM, abharAdhadhdhughgharaghiluM, ghAvalughghAghiluM dhIrghghabhbhaDhDhudh dhaNDhighghabhbhaDhaghghaDhavaனèனRu èzhudhiyirundhadhu.

èrujhalemiluLLa ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhai ala~Ngharighgha, ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha yojhaனaiyai rAjAviன irudhayadhdhil aruLi, rAjAvughghuM avaruDhaiya mandhirimArghaLughghuM rAjAviன ghaighghuLLAன bhaladhdha èllA maghAbhbhirabhughghaLughghuM muனbhAgha èனghghudhdhayavu ghiDhaighghabhbhaNNiன è~NghaL bhidhAghghaLiன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu sdhodhdhiraM.
abhbhaDhiye èன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya gharaM èனmel irundhadhiனAl nAன dhiDhaனghòNDhu, isravelil jhila dhalaivarai èனனoDhe ghUDhavaruMbhaDhi jherdhdhughghòNDheன.
ardhajhaShDhA rAjA arajhALuM ghAladhdhil bhAbhiloனilirundhu èனனoDheghUDha vandha dha~NghaL bhidhAghghaL vaMjha~NghaLiன dhalaivaruM avarghaL vaMjha aDhDhavaNaighaLumAvaன:
bhiனèghAjhiன bhudhdhiraril ghèrjhoM, idhdhAmAriன bhudhdhiraril dhAனiyel dhAvIdhiன bhudhdhiraril adhdhUs,
bhAroShiன bhudhdhiraril òruvaனAன jhèghghaனiyAviன bhudhdhiraril jhaghariyAvuM avaனoDheghUDha vaMjha aDhDhavaNaiyil èzhudhiyirughghiRa nURRaiMbhadhu ANmaghghaLuM,
bhAgharadhmovAbhiன bhudhdhiraril jhèraghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya èliyoனAyuM, avaனoDheghUDha irunURu ANmaghghaLuM,
jhèghghaனiyAviன bhudhdhiraril yaghajhiyeliன ghumAraனuM, avaனoDheghUDha munnURu ANmaghghaLuM,
Adhiனiன bhudhdhiraril yoனdhdhAனiன ghumAraனAghiya ebhedhuM, avaனoDheghUDha aiMbhadhu ANmaghghaLuM,

adhoனighAmiன ghaDhaijhibhbhudhdhirarAன èlibheledh, eyèl, jhèmAyA èனனuM nAma~NghaLuLLavarghaLuM, avarghaLoDheghUDha aRubhadhu ANmaghghaLuM,

ivarghaLai nAன aghAvAvughghu oDhughiRa nadhiyaNDhaiyile ghUDhDhighghòNDhubhoனeன; a~Nghe mUனRunAL dha~NghiyirundhoM; nAன jaன~NghaLaiyuM AjhAriyaraiyuM bhArvaiyiDhuMbhodhu, leviyiன bhudhdhiraril òruvaraiyuM a~Nghe ghANavillai,
AghaiyAl nAன èliyejhar, ariyel, jhèmAyA, èlnAdhdhAன, yAribh, èlnAdhdhAன, nAdhdhAன, jhaghariyA, mijhullAM èனனuM dhalaivaraiyuM, yoyAribh, èlnAdhdhAன èனனuM bhudhdhimAனghaLaiyuM azhaibhbhidhdhu,

abhbhòzhudhu rAjAviன aramaனai vAjhalilirughghiRa rAjAviன UzhiyaghghArar mòrdhèghAyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI rAjAviன ghaDhDhaLaiyai mIRughiRadhu èனன èனRu gheDhDhArghaL.

rAjAvAghiya aghAsveruviன bhaனனiraNDhAM varuShaM nijhAன mAdhamAghiya mudhalAM mAdhadhdhile AmAனughghu muனbhAghabh bhUr èனனbhbhaDhDha jhIDhDhu òvvòru nALaiyuM òvvòrumAdhadhdhaiyuM ghuRidhdhubh bhoDhabhbhaDhDhu, AdhAr mAdhamAன bhaனனiraNDhAM mAdhadhdhiனmel vizhundhadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu AmAன aghAsveru rAjAvai noghghi uMmuDhaiya rAjyadhdhiன jhaghala nADhughaLilumuLLa jaன~NghaLughghuLLe òruvidha jaன~NghaL jhidhaRuNDhu bharaMbhiyirughghiRArghaL; avarghaLuDhaiya vazhaghgha~NghaL jhaghala jaன~NghaLuDhaiya vazhaghgha~NghaLughghuM vighaRbhamAyirughghiRadhu; avarghaL rAjAviன ghaDhDhaLaighaLaigh ghaighghòLLughiRadhillai; AghaiyAl avarghaLai ibhbhaDhi viDhDhirughghiRadhu rAjAvughghu niyAyamalla.

rAjAvughghujh jhaMmadhiyAனAl, avarghaLai azhighghaveNDhumèனRu èzhudhi aனubhbhaveNDhiyadhu; abhbhòzhudhu nAன rAjAviன ghajAனAvile ghòNDhuvandhu jhèludhdha bhadhiனAyiraM dhAlandhu vèLLiyai èNNigh ghAriyaghghArar ghaiyilghòDhubhbheன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu rAjA dhaன ghaiyilirughghiRa dhaன modhiradhdhaigh ghazhaRRi, adhai AghAghiyaனAன aMmèdhAdhdhAviன ghumAraனuM yUdhariன jhadhdhuruvumAghiya AmAனiDhadhdhil ghòDhudhdhu,
AmAனai noghghi: andha vèLLiyai nI vaidhdhughghòL; andha jaனdhdhughghu uன iShDhabhbhaDhi jhèyyalAM èனRAன.

mudhalAM mAdhaM bhadhiனmUனRAndhedhiyile, rAjAviன jhaMbhiradhighaL azhaighghabhbhaDhDhArghaL; AmAன ghaRbhidhdhabhaDhiyèllAM rAjAviன dhejhAdhibhadhighaLughghuM, òvvòru nADhDhiனmel vaighghabhbhaDhDhirundha dhuraighaLughghuM, òvvòru jaனdhdhiன bhirabhughghaLughghuM, andhandha nADhDhil vazha~NghuM aDhjharadhdhiluM, andhandha jAdhiyAr bhejhuM bhAShaiyiluM èzhudhabhbhaDhDhadhu; rAjAvAghiya aghAsveruviனbherAl adhu èzhudhabhbhaDhDhu, rAjAviன modhiradhdhiனAl mudhdhirai bhoDhabhbhaDhDhadhu.

dhevaனe, èனனai iraDhjhighghun dhevaனe, iradhdhabhbhazhighaLughghu èனனai nI~NghalAghghiviDhuM; abhbhòzhudhu èன nAvu uMmuDhaiya nIdhiyaigh ghèMbhIramAybh bhADhuM.

è~NghaLaijh jhiRaibhiDhidhdhavarghaL a~Nghe è~NghaL bhADhalghaLaiyuM, è~NghaLaibh bhAzhAghghiனvarghaL ma~NghaLa jhadhdhadhdhaiyuM viruMbhi; jhIyoனiன bhADhDhughaLil jhiladhai è~NghaLughghubh bhADhu~NghaL èனRu jhòனனArghaL.

ghardhdhAve, èrujhalemiன nALile edhomiன bhudhdhirarai niனaiyuM; avarghaL: adhai iDhidhdhubhbhoDhu~NghaL, asdhibhAramaDhDhuM iDhidhdhubhbhoDhu~NghaL èனRu jhòனனArghaLe.

umadhu bharijhudhdha AlayadhdhiRghu nerAgha nAன bhaNindhu umadhu ghirubhaiyiனimidhdhamuM umadhu uNmaiyiனimidhdhamuM umadhu nAmadhdhaidh dhudhibhbheன; umadhu jhaghala bhirasdhAbhadhdhaibh bhArghghiluM umadhu vArdhdhaiyai nIr maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhiyirughghiRIr.
nAன ghUbhbhiDhDha nALile èனghghu maRuudhdharavu aruLiனIr; èன AdhdhumAvile bhalaனdhandhu èனனaidh dhairiyabhbhaDhudhdhiனIr;
ghardhdhAve, bhUmiyiன rAjAghghaLèllAruM umadhu vAyiன vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhghuMbhodhu uMmaidh dhudhibhbhArghaL.

A, nIr èன dhAyiன bhAlghuDhidhdha èன jhaghodharaனaibhbholirundhIrAனAl, nAன uMmai vèLiyile jhandhidhdhu mudhdhamiDhuveன; èனனai nindhighghavumADhDhArghaL.

nAன uMmaigh ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, èன dhAyiன vIDhDhughghu azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoveன; nIr èனனaibh bhodhibhbhIr, ghandhavarghghamiDhDha dhirADhjharajhadhdhaiyuM, èன mAdhaLaMbhazharajhadhdhaiyuM umaghghugh ghuDhighghaghghòDhubhbheன.

nIr èனனai umadhu irudhayadhdhiனmel mudhdhiraiyaibhbholavuM, umadhu bhuyadhdhiனmel mudhdhiraiyaibhbholavuM vaidhdhughghòLLuM; nejhaM maraNadhdhaibhbhol validhu; nejhavairAghghiyaM bhAdhALadhdhaibhbhol ghòDhidhAyirughghiRadhu; adhiன dhazhal aghghiனidhdhazhaluM adhiன juvAlai ghaDhuM juvAlaiyumAyirughghiRadhu.

dhiraLAன dhaNNIrghaL nejhadhdhai avighghamADhDhAdhu, vèLLa~NghaLuM adhaidh dhaNighghamADhDhAdhu; òruvaன dhaன vIDhDhiluLLa AsdhighaLaiyèllAM nejhadhdhughghAghagh ghòDhudhdhAluM, adhu muRRiluM ajhaDhDhaibhaNNabhbhaDhuM.
namaghghu òru jhiRiya jhaghodhariyuNDhu, avaLughghu sdhaன~NghaLillai; naMmuDhaiya jhaghodhariyaigh gheDhghuMnALil avaLughghAgha nAM èனன jhèyvoM?
avaL òru madhilAனAl, adhiனmel vèLLighghoDhDhaiyaigh ghaDhDhuvoM; avaL ghadhavAனAl, ghedhurubhbhalaghaighaLai adhaRghu iNaibhbhoM.
nAன madhildhAன, èன sdhaன~NghaL ghobhura~NghaL; avaruDhaiya ghaNghaLil ghaDhADhjhaMbhèRalAனeன.

bhAghAl Amoனile jhAlòmoனughghu òru dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhaM uNDhAyirundhadhu, andhadh dhoDhDhadhdhaigh ghAvalALighaL vajhadhdhile adhiன bhalaனughghAgha, òvvòruvaன AyiraM vèLLighghAjhu ghòNDhuvaruMbhaDhi viDhDhAr.

jhiRiyavaனuM ghuனighiRAன, bhèriyavaனuM bhaNighiRAன; AghaiyAl avarghaLughghu maனனiyAdhirubhbhIr.

jhIriyar èbhbhirAyImaijh jhArndhirughghiRArghaLèனRu dhAvIdhiன ghuDhuMbhadhdhughghu aRivighghabhbhaDhDhabhodhu, rAjAviன irudhayamuM avaன jaனdhdhiன irudhayamuM ghADhDhiluLLa mara~NghaL ghARRiனAl ajhaighiRadhubhol ajhaindhadhu.

nI avaனai noghghi: jhIriyar èbhbhirAyImoDhuM, rèmaliyAviன maghaனoDhuM uனghghu virodhamAghadh dhurAlojhaனai bhaNNi,
nAM yUdhAvughghu virodhamAybhbhoy, adhai nèrughghi, adhai namaghghuLLe bha~NghiDhDhughghòNDhu, adhaRghudh dhabheyAliன ghumAraனai rAjAvAgha eRbhaDhudhdhuvoM èனRu jhòனனdhiனimidhdhaM;

èbhbhirAyImiன dhalai jhamAriyA, jhamAriyAviன dhalai rèmaliyAviன maghaன; nI~NghaL vijhuvAjhiyAviDhDhAl nilaibhèRamADhDhIrghaL èனRu jhòl èனRAr.

èbhbhirAyIM yUdhAvaiviDhDhubh bhirindha nALmudhal varAdha nADhghaLaigh ghardhdhar uனmeluM, uன jaனdhdhiனmeluM, uன bhidhAvuDhaiya vaMjhadhdhiனmeluM, ajhIriyAviன rAjAviனAle varabhbhaNNuvAr.

nAன dhIrghghadharijhiyAனvaLaijh jherndhabhodhu, avaL gharbhbhavadhiyAghi òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRRAL; abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar èனனai noghghi: magher-jhAlAl-aSh-bhAs èனனuM bherai avaனughghu iDhu.
indhabh bhAlaghaன, abhbhA, aMmA èனRu ghUbhbhiDha aRiyumuனனe, dhamasghuviன AsdhiyaiyuM, jhamAriyAviன ghòLLaiyuM, ajhIriyAviன rAjAvughghu muனbhAghagh ghòNDhubhoghabhbhaDhuM èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdhar èனனai noghghi:
indha jaனM mèdhuvAy oDhughiRa jhIlovAviன dhaNNIrghaLai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNi, redhjhIனaiyuM rèmaliyAviன ghumAraனaiyuM jhArndhu jhandhoShighghiRabhaDhiyiனAl,

indha jaன~NghaL ghaDhDhubhbhADhu èனRu jhòllughiRadhaiyèllAM nI~NghaL ghaDhDhubhbhADhu èனRu jhòllAmaluM, avarghaL bhayabhbhaDhughiRa bhayadhdhiனbhaDhi nI~NghaL bhayabhbhaDhAmaluM, ghala~NghAmaluM,

mIனbhiDhighghiRavarghaL bhèrumUjhjhuviDhuvArghaL, nadhiyile dhUNDhilbhoDhughiRa yAvaruM dhughghibhbhArghaL; dhaNNIrghaLiனmel valaighaLai vIjhughiRavarghaL jhalidhdhubhbhovArghaL.
mèlliya jhaNalaibh bhaghghuvabhbhaDhudhdhughiRavarghaLuM, jhallAghghaLai nèyghiRavarghaLuM nANuvArghaL.

jhovAனbhaDhDhaNadhdhiன bhirabhughghaLAனvarghaL mUDharghaL; bhArvoனuDhaiya ~nAனmuLLa AlojhaனaighghArariன Alojhaனai madhiyIனmAyiRRu: nAன ~nAனighaLiன bhudhdhiraன, nAன bhUrva rAjAghghaLiன ghumAraன èனRu bhArvoனuDhaனe èbhbhaDhijh jhòllughiRIrghaL?
avarghaL è~Nghe? uன ~nAனighaL è~Nghe? jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar èghibhdhaighghuRidhdhubh bhaNNiன yojhaனaiyai avarghaL uனghghudh dhèrivighghaDhDhuM; alladhu dhA~NghaLe aRindhughòLLaDhDhuM.

ghardhdhar adhiன naDhuvil dhARumARughaLiன Aviyai varabhbhaNNiனAr; AனdhughòNDhu vèRiyaன vAndhibhaNNi, dhaLLADhidh dhirighiRadhubhola avarghaL èghibhdhai adhiன èllAjh jhèyghaiyiluM dhaLLADhidh dhiriyabhbhaNNughiRArghaL.
èghibhdhil dhalaiyAghiluM vAlAghiluM ghiLaiyAghiluM nANalAghiluM jhèyyuM velai òனRumirAdhu.
aghghAladhdhile èghibhdhiyar bhèNDhughaLaibhbholirundhu, jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar dha~NghaLmel ajhaighghuM ghaiyajhaivile a~njhi naDhu~NghuvArghaL.

jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar avarghaLughghu virodhamAgha nirNayidhdhughghòNDha AlojhaனaiyiனimidhdhaM yUdhAviன dhejhaM èghibhdhiyarughghubh bhaya~NgharamAyirughghuM; dhaனghghuL adhai niனaighghiRavaனèvaனuM dhiDhughghiDhuvAன.

aghghAladhdhile èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirughghuM aindhu bhaDhDhaNa~NghaL ghAனAன bhAShaiyaibh bhejhi, jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharai muனனiDhDhu ANaiyiDhuM; avaighaLil òனRu nirmUlamAன bhaDhDhaNaM èனனbhbhaDhuM.
aghghAladhdhile èghibhdhudhejhadhdhiன naDhuvile ghardhdharughghu òru bhalibhIDhamuM, adhiன èllaiyarughe ghardhdharughghu òru sdhaMbhamuM uNDhAyirughghuM.

adhu èghibhdhu dhejhadhdhile jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharughghu aDhaiyALamuM jhADhjhiyumAyirughghuM; òDhughghughiRavarghaLiனimidhdhaM avarghaL ghardhdharainoghghigh ghUbhbhiDhuvArghaL; abhbhodhu avarghaLughghu òru iraDhjhaghaனaiyuM, òru bhèlavAனaiyuM aனubhbhi avarghaLai viDhuvibhbhAr.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar èghibhdhiyarughghu aRiyabhbhaDhuvAr; èghibhdhiyar ghardhdharai aghghAladhdhile aRindhu, avarughghubh bhalighaLoDhuM ghANighghaighaLoDhuM ArAdhaனaijhèydhu ghardhdharughghubh bhòrudhdhaனaighaLaibhbhaNNi avaighaLaijh jhèludhdhuvArghaL.

ghardhdhar èghibhdhiyarai vAdhaiyiனAl aDhibhbhAr; aDhidhdhu ghuNamAghghuvAr; avarghaL ghardhdhariDhadhdhil maனndhiruMbhuvArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL viNNabhbhadhdhaigh gheDhDhu, avarghaLaigh ghuNamAghghuvAr.

aghghAladhdhile èghibhdhilirundhu ajhIriyAvughghubh bhoghiRa bhèruMbhAdhai uNDhAyirughghuM; ajhIriyar èghibhdhughghuM, èghibhdhiyar ajhIriyAvughghuM vandhu, èghibhdhiyar ajhIriyaroDhu~NghUDha ArAdhaனai jhèyvArghaL.
aghghAladhdhile isravel èghibhdhoDhuM ajhIriyAvoDhuM mUனRAvadhAgha bhUmiyiன naDhuvil AjhIrvAdhamAyirughghuM.

avarghaLaigh ghuRidhdhujh jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar: èghibhdhiyarAghiya èன jaனmuM, ajhIriyarAghiya èன gharadhdhiன ghiriyaiyuM, isravelarAghiya èன jhudhandharamuM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhadhu èனRu jhòlli, avarghaLai AjhIrvadhibhbhAr.
dhAdhdhAன ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya jharghoனAle aனubhbhabhbhaDhDhu, asdhodhdhughghu vandhu, asdhodhdhiனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNi, adhaibh bhiDhidhdha varuShadhdhile,

ghardhdhar Amodhjhiன ghumAraனAghiya ejhAyAvai noghghi: nI bhoy uன araiyilirughghiRa iraDhDhai avizhdhdhu, uன ghAlghaLilirughghiRa bhAdharaDhjhaghaLaigh ghazhaRRu èனRAr; avaன abhbhaDhiye jhèydhu, vasdhiramillAmaluM vèRu~NghAlumAy naDhandhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar: èghibhdhiனmeluM èdhdhiyobhbhiyAviனmeluM varuM mUனRuvaruShadhdhugh ghAriya~NghaLughghu aDhaiyALamuM ghuRibhbhumAgha èன UzhiyaghghAraனAghiya ejhAyA vasdhiramillAmaluM vèRu~NghAlumAy naDhaghghiRadhubhola,

ajhIriyA rAjA, dhAன jhiRaibhiDhighghabhbhoghiRa èghibhdhiyaruM, dhAன ghuDhivilaghghabhbhoghiRa èdhdhiyobhbhiyarumAghiya iLai~naraiyuM ghizhavaraiyuM, vasdhiramillAmaluM vèRu~NghAlumAy èghibhdhiyarughghu vèDhghamuNDhAghuMbhaDhi, irubhbhiDhaM mUDhabhbhaDhAdhavarghaLAygh ghòNDhubhovAன.
abhbhòzhudhu indhagh ghaDhaRgharaigh ghuDhighaL dhA~NghaL naMbhiyirundha èdhdhiyobhbhiyAvaighghuRidhdhuM, dhA~NghaL bhèrumaibhArADhDhiன èghibhdhaighghuRidhdhuM ghala~Nghi vèDhghi:

idho, ajhIriya rAjAviன mughadhdhughghudh dhabhbhuMbhaDhighghu nA~NghaL naMbhi, jhaghAyadhdhughghèனRu oDhivandhu aNDhiனvaன ibhbhaDhiyAனAனe; nA~NghaL èbhbhaDhi viDhuvighghabhbhaDhuvoM èனRu aghghAladhdhile jhòlluvArghaL èனRAr.
ghaDhal vaனAndharadhdhiன bhAraM. jhuzhalghARRu dhèனdhijhaiyilirundhu èzhuMbhigh ghaDhandhuvarughiRadhubhola, bhaya~NgharamAன dhejhamAghiya vaனAndharadhdhilirundhu adhu varughiRadhu.

ghòDhiya dharijhaனM èனghghudh dhèrivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu; dhuroghi dhuroghaMbhaNNi bhAzhAghghiRavaன bhAzhAghghighghòNDhe irughghiRAன; elAme èzhuMbhu; medhiyAvile muRRighghaibhoDhu; adhiனAle uNDhAன dhavibhbhaiyèllAM òzhiyabhbhaNNiனeன.

AghaiyAl, èன iDhubhbhu maghA vedhaனaiyAl niRaindhirughghiRadhu; bhiLLaibhèRughiRavaLiன vedhaனaighaLughghu òdhdha vedhaனaighaL èனனaibh bhiDhidhdhadhu; gheDhDhadhiனAl uLaivughòNDhu, ghaNDhadhiனAl ghala~Nghiனeன.
èன irudhayaM dhighaidhdhadhu; dhighil èனனaidh dhiDhughghiDhabhbhaNNiRRu; èனghghu iனbhandhandha iravu bhaya~NgharamAyiRRu.
bhandhiyai AyadhdhabhbhaDhudhdhu~NghaL, jAmaghghArarai vaiyu~NghaL, bhujhiyu~NghaL ghuDhiyu~NghaL; bhirabhughghaLe, èzhundhu bharijhaighaLughghu èNNèy bhUjhu~NghaL.
ANDhavar èனனai noghghi: nI bhoy, ghANbhadhaidh dhèrivighghuMbhaDhi jAmaghghAraனai vai èனRAr.

avaன òru iradhadhdhaiyuM, joDhu joDhAன ghudhiraivIraraiyuM, joDhu joDhAghagh ghazhudhaighaLiனmeluM òDhDhagha~NghaLiனmeluM eRivarughiRavarghaLaiyuM ghaNDhu, mighundha ghavaனmAygh ghavaனidhdhughghòNDhe irundhu:
ANDhavare, nAன bhaghalmuzhudhuM èன ghAvalile niனRu, irAmuzhudhuM nAன èன ghAvaliDhadhdhile dharidhdhirughghiReன èனRu jhi~Nghadhdhaibhbhol jhadhdhamiDhDhugh ghUbhbhiDhughiRAன.

idho, òru joDhu ghudhirai bhUNDha iradhadhdhiனmel eRiyirughghiRa òru maனuShaன varughiRAன; bhAbhiloன vizhundhadhu, vizhundhadhu; adhiன vighghiraghadhevarghaLaiyèllAM dharaiyoDhe modhi uDhaidhdhAr èனRu bhiradhiyudhdharaM jhòllughiRAன.
èன bhoraDhibhbhiன dhAனiyame, ghaLadhdhiன ghodhumaiye, israveliன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharAl nAன gheLvibhbhaDhDhadhai u~NghaLughghu aRividhdheன.
dhumAviன bhAraM. jheyIrilirundhu èனனai noghghi: jAmaghghAraனe, iravu èvvaLavu jhèனRadhu? èனRu ghUbhbhiDhDhugh gheDhgha;
adhaRghu jAmaghghAraன: viDhiyaRghAlaM varughiRadhu irAghghAlamuM varughiRadhu; nI~NghaL gheDhgha maனdhAனAl dhiruMbhivandhu gheLu~NghaL èனRu jhòllughiRAன.
arabhiyAviன bhAraM. dhidhAனiyarAghiya bhayaNaghghUDhDha~NghaLe, nI~NghaL arabhiyAviன ghADhughaLil irAdhdha~NghuvIrghaL.
dhemAdhejhadhdhiன ghuDhighaLe, nI~NghaL dhAghamAyirughghiRavarghaLughghudh dhaNNIr ghòNDhubhoy, dhabhbhi oDhughiRavarghaLughghu abhbha~NghòDhughgha èdhirghòNDhubho~NghaL.
avarghaL, bhaDhDhaya~NghaLughghuM, uruviன ghaDhghadhdhughghuM nANeRRiன villughghuM, yudhdhadhdhiன ghòDhumaighghuM dhabhbhi oDhughiRArghaL.
ANDhavar èனனai noghghi: òru ghUlighghAraனuDhaiya varuSha~NghaLughghòdhdha òre varuShadhdhile ghedhAruDhaiya maghimaiyèllAM aRRubhbhoM.
ghedhAr bhudhdhirarAghiya bharAghghirama vilvIrariன dhòghaiyil mIdhiyAனvarghaL ghò~njhabhbherAyirubhbhArghaL èனRAr; israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar idhai uraidhdhAr.
dharijhaனbh bhaLLadhdhAghghiன bhAraM. uனனil uLLavarghaL èllAruM vIDhughaLiனmel eRuvadhaRghu uனghghu ibhbhòzhudhu vandhadhu èனன?
jhandhaDhighaLAl niRaindhu AravAraMbhaNNi, ghaLighUrndhirundha nagharame, uனனiDhadhdhil ghòlaiyuNDhavarghaL bhaDhDhayadhdhAl ghòlaiyuNDhadhillai, yudhdhadhdhil jhèdhdhadhuM illai.
uன adhibhadhighaL èllAruM eghamAy oDhi alaindhuM, vilvIrarAl ghaDhDhabhbhaDhughiRArghaL; uனனil aghabhbhaDhDha yAvaruM dhUradhdhughghu oDhiyuM eghamAygh ghaDhDhabhbhaDhughiRArghaL.
AghaiyAl, èனனai noghghibh bhArAdheyu~NghaL; èன jaனmAghiya ghumAradhdhi bhAzhAybhbhoனdhiனimidhdhaM maன~Nghajhandhu azhuveன; èனghghu ARudhal jhòlla varAdheyu~NghaL èனghiReன.

jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavarAle idhu dharijhaனbh bhaLLadhdhAghghile amaLiyuM midhiyuNghudhaluM, ghalaghghamumuLLa nALAyirughghiRadhu, idhu ala~Nghadhdhaidh dhaghardhdhu, bharvadhadhdhughghu nere ArbhbharighghuM nALAyirughghiRadhu.
elAmiyaன aMbhaRAdhdhUNiyai èDhudhdhu, iradha~NghaLoDhuM ghAlADhghaLoDhuM ghudhiraivIraroDhuM varughiRAன; ghIr gheDhaghadhdhai vèLibhbhaDhudhdhuM.
maghA vaDhivAன uன bhaLLadhdhAghghughaL iradha~NghaLAl nirabhbhabhbhaDhuM; ghudhiraivIrar vAjhalghaL maDhDhuM vandhu aNivaghudhdhu niRbhArghaL.
avaன yUdhAviன maRaivai nIghghibhbhoDhuvAன; annALile vaனmALighaiyAghiya AyudhajhAlaiyai noghghuvAy.
nI~NghaL dhAvIdhu nagharadhdhiன iDhidhalghaL aneghamAyirubhbhadhaigh ghaNDhu ghIzhghghuLadhdhudh dhaNNIrghaLaigh ghaDhDhivaidhdhu,
èrujhalemiன vIDhughaLai èNNi, ala~Nghadhdhai araNibhbhAghghuMbhaDhi vIDhughaLai iDhidhdhu,

iraNDhu madhilghaLughghu naDhuve bhazhaiya ghuLadhdhudh dhaNNIrghaLughghu òru aghazhai uNDhubhaNNuvIrghaL; AனAluM adhaijh jhèydhavarai nI~NghaL noghghAmaluM, adhai eRbhaDhudhdhidh dhUradhdhilirundhu varabhbhaNNiனvaraigh ghavaனiyAmaluM bhoghiRIrghaL.
jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar aghghAladhdhile azhavuM, bhulaMbhavuM, mòDhDhaiyiDhavuM iraDhDhuDhudhdhavuM ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAr.
nI~NghaLo, jhandhoShidhdhughghaLidhdhu, ADhumADhughaLai aDhidhdhu, iRaijhjhiyaijh jhAbhbhiDhDhu, dhirADhjharajhadhdhaigh ghuDhidhdhu: bhujhibhbhoM ghuDhibhbhoM, nALaighghujh jhAvoM èனRu jhòlvIrghaL.

mèyyAghave nI~NghaL jhAghumaDhDhuM indha aghghiramaM u~NghaLughghu nivirdhdhiyAvadhillai èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRArèனbhadhu èன jhèvi gheDhghuMbhaDhi jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharAl dhèrivighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.
jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraidhdhadhAvadhu: nI aramaனai vijhAribhbhughghAraனuM bhòghghiShaghghAraனumAghiya jhèbhனA èனbhavaனiDhadhdhil bhoyjh jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl,

uyarndha sdhaladhdhile dhaன ghallaRaiyai vèDhDhi, ghaனmalaiyile dhaனghghu vAjhasdhaladhdhaidh dhoNDhughiRavaனaibhbhola, nI uனghghu i~Nghe ghallaRaiyai vèDhDhuMbhaDhighghu uனghghu i~Nghe èனன irughghiRadhu? uனghghu i~Nghe yAr irughghiRArghaL?
idho, bhèlavAன òruvaனaidh dhuradhdhughiRavaNNamAghagh ghardhdhar uனனaidh dhuradhdhiviDhDhu, nijhjhayamAy uனனai mUDhibhbhoDhuvAr.

avar uனனai uruNDhaiyaibhbhola aghalamuM vijhAlamumAன dhejhadhdhile jhuzhaRRi èRindhuviDhuvAr; a~Nghe nI jhAvAy, a~Nghe uன maghimaiyiன iradha~NghaL uன ANDhavaனuDhaiya vIDhDhughghu ighazhjhjhiyAgha irughghuM.
uனனai uன nilaiyaiviDhDhudh dhuradhdhiviDhuveன; uன sdhAனdhdhilirundhu nI bhiDhu~NghibhbhoDhabhbhaDhuvAy.
annALile ilaghghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya èliyAghghIM èனனuM èன UzhiyaghghAraனai nAன azhaidhdhu:

uன vasdhiradhdhai avaனughghudh dharidhdhu, uன ghajhjhaiyAl avaனai iDhaighghaDhDhi, uன adhighAradhdhai avaன ghaiyile ghòDhubhbheன; avaன èrujhalemiன ghuDhighaLughghuM yUdhAviன vaMjhadhdhughghuM dhaghabhbhaனAyirubhbhAன.
dhAvIdhuDhaiya vIDhDhiன dhiRavugholai avaன dhoLiனmel vaibhbheன; òruvaruM bhUDhDhagh ghUDhAdhabhaDhighghu avaன dhiRabhbhAன. òruvaruM dhiRaghghagh ghUDhAdhabhaDhighghu avaன bhUDhDhuvAன.
avaனai uRudhiyAன iDhadhdhile ANiyAghagh ghaDhAvuveன; avaன dhaன dhaghabhbhaன vIDhDhughghu maghimaiyAன jhi~NghAjhaனmAgha irubhbhAன.
adhiனmel avaன dhaghabhbhaன vaMjhadhdhArAghiya bhudhdhirar bhaudhdhiraruDhaiya maghimai aனaidhdhaiyuM jhiRidhuM bhèridhumAன jhaghala bhAனbhAdhdhira~NghaLaiyuM dhUghghivaibhbharghaL.

uRudhiyAன iDhadhdhil ghaDhAvabhbhaDhDhirundha ANi annALile bhiDhu~NghabhbhaDhDhu, muRindhuvizhuM; abhbhòzhudhu adhiனmel dhò~Nghiன bhAraM aRundhuvizhuM èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr; ghardhdhare idhai uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.

dhIruviன bhAraM. dharShIs ghabhbhalghaLe, alaRu~NghaL; adhu vIDhu illAdhabhaDhighghuM, adhil varuvAr illAdhabhaDhighghuM bhAzhAghghabhbhaDhDhadhu; indhajh jhèydhi ghidhdhIMdhejhadhdhilirundhu avarghaLughghudh dhèrivighghabhbhaDhughiRadhu.
dhIvughghuDhighaLe, mavuனmAyiru~NghaL; jhIdhoனiன vardhdhaghar jhamudhdhiradhdhile yAdhdhiraibhaNNi uனனai nirabhbhiனArghaL.
jhIghor nadhiyiன mighundha nIrbhbhAyjhjhalghaLAl viLaiyuM bhayirvaghaighaLuM, ARRa~Ngharaiyiன aRubhbhuM adhiன varumAனmAyirundhadhu; adhu jAdhighaLiன jhandhaiyAyirundhadhu.

jhIdhoனe, vèDhghabhbhaDhu; nAன iனigh gharbhbhavedhaனaibhbhaDhughiRadhuM illai; bhèRughiRadhuM illai; iLai~narai vaLarghghiRadhuM illai; ghaனனighaighaLai AdharighghiRadhuM illai èனRu jhamudhdhiragh ghoDhDhaiyAன ghaDhaldhuRai jhòllughiRadhu.
èghibhdhiன jhèydhi gheDhghabhbhaDhDhadhiனAl noy uNDhAனdhubhola dhIruviன jhèydhi gheDhghabhbhaDhuvadhiனAluM noy uNDhAghuM.
gharaidhuRaigh ghuDhighaLe, nI~NghaL dharShIsmaDhDhuM bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy alaRu~NghaL.
bhUrvanADhghaLmudhal nilaibhèRRughaLighUrndhirundha u~NghaL bhaDhDhaNaM idhudhAனA? bharadhejhaMbhoyjh jha~njharighghiRadhaRghu avaL ghAlghaLe avaLaidh dhUramAygh ghòNDhubhoM.
ghirIDhaM dharibhbhighghuM dhIrughghu virodhamAgha idhai yojhidhdhudh dhIrmAனidhdhavar yAr? adhiன vardhdhaghar bhirabhughghaLuM, adhiன viyAbhArighaL bhUmiyiன ghaனvAனghaLumAme.
jharva jhi~NghAradhdhiன meனmaiyaigh ghulaighghavuM bhUmiyiன ghaனvAனghaL yAvaraiyuM ghaனIனbhbhaDhudhdhavuM, jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhare idhai yojhidhdhudh dhIrmAனidhdhAr.

iravuM bhaghaluM adhu aviyAdhu; adhiன bhughai èனRèனRaighghuM èzhuMbhuM; dhalaimuRai dhalaimuRaiyAgha adhu bhAzhAyirughghuM, jhadhAghAlaM jhadhAghAlamAgha adhai òruvaruM ghaDhandhubhovadhillai.
nAraiyuM muLLaMbhaனRiyuM adhaijh jhudhandharighghuM, AndhaiyuM ghAghghaiyuM adhile ghuDhiyirughghuM; adhiனmel vèDhDhavèLiyiன nUlaiyuM, vèRumaiyiன dhUghghaiyuM bhiDhibhbhAr.
rAjyabhAraMbhaNNiன adhiன meனmaghghaLai azhaidhdhAl, a~Nghe avarghaLil òruvaruM irArghaL; adhiன bhirabhughghaL aனaivaruM illAmaRbhovArghaL.
adhiன aramaனaighaLil muDhjhèDhighaLuM, adhiன ghoDhDhaighaLil ghA~njhòRighaLuM muDhbhUNDhughaLuM muLaighghuM; adhu valujharbhbha~NghaLiன dhAbharamuM, ghoDhDhAனghaLiன mALighaiyumAyirughghuM.
a~Nghe ghADhDhumirugha~NghaLuM orighaLuM òனRaiyòனRu jhandhidhdhughADhDhADhDhaigh ghADhDhADhu ghUbhbhiDhuM; a~Nghe jhAghghuruvighaLuM dha~Nghi, iLaibhbhARuM iDhadhdhaigh ghaNDhaDhaiyuM.
a~Nghe vallURuM ghUDhughaDhDhi, muDhDhaiyiDhDhu, ghu~njhubhòridhdhu, avaighaLaidh dhaன nizhalile ghUDhDhighghòLLuM; a~Nghe ghULighaLuM joDhujoDhAghajh jheruM.
ghardhdharuDhaiya bhusdhaghadhdhiledheDhi vAjhiyu~NghaL; ivaighaLil òனRuM ghuRaiyAdhu; ivaighaLil òனRuM joDhillAdhirAdhu; avaruDhaiya vAy idhaijh jhòlliRRu; avaruDhaiya Avi ivaighaLaijh jherghghuM.

avare avaighaLughghujh jhIDhDhubhbhoDhDhAr; avaruDhaiya ghaiye adhai avaighaLughghu aLavunUlAl bhaghirndhu ghòDhudhdhadhu; avaighaL èனRaighghuM adhaijh jhudhandharidhdhudh dhalaimuRai dhalaimuRaiyAgha adhile jha~njharighghuM.
vaனAndharamuM vaRaNDha nilamuM maghizhndhu, ghaDhuvèLi ghaLidhdhu, bhuShbhadhdhaibhbhola jhèzhighghuM.

adhu mighudhiyAyjh jhèzhidhdhu bhUridhdhu AனndhaghghaLibhbhuDhaன bhADhuM; lIbhaனoனiன maghimaiyaiyuM gharmel jhAroன èனbhavaighaLiன ala~NghAramuM adhaRghu aLighghabhbhaDhuM; avarghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya maghimaiyaiyuM, namadhu dhevaனuDhaiya maghadhdhuvadhdhaiyuM ghANbhArghaL.
dhaLarndha ghaighaLaidh dhiDhabhbhaDhudhdhi, dhaLLADhughiRa muzha~NghAlghaLaibh bhalabhbhaDhudhdhu~NghaL.

maனM bhadhaRughiRavarghaLaibh bhArdhdhu: nI~NghaL bhayabhbhaDhAdhiru~NghaL, dhiDhaனghòLLu~NghaL; idho, u~NghaL dhevaன nIdhiyaijh jharighghaDhDhavuM, u~NghaL dhevaன bhadhilaLighghavuM varuvAr; avar vandhu u~NghaLai iraDhjhibhbhAr èனRu jhòllu~NghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu ghuruDhariன ghaNghaL dhiRaghghabhbhaDhDhu, jhèviDhariன jhèvighaL dhiRavuNDhubhoM.
abhbhòzhudhu muDhavaன mAனaibhbhol ghudhibhbhAன; Umaiyaன nAvuM ghèMbhIrighghuM; vaனAndharadhdhile dhaNNIrghaLuM, ghaDhuvèLiyile ARughaLuM bhAyndhoDhuM.
vèDhDhAndharai dhaNNIrdhdhaDhAghamuM, vaRaNDha nilaM nIrURRughaLumAghuM, valujharbhbha~NghaL dhAbharidhdhugh ghiDhandha iDha~NghaLile bhulluM ghòRughghaiyuM nANaluM uNDhAghuM.

a~Nghe bhèruMbhAdhaiyAன vazhiyuM irughghuM; adhu bharijhudhdha vazhi èனனbhbhaDhuM; dhIDhDhuLLavaன adhile naDhandhuvaruvadhillai; andha vazhiyil naDhaghghiRavarghaL bhedhaiyAyirundhAluM dhijhaighèDhDhubh bhovadhillai.
a~Nghe jhi~NghaM irubhbhadhillai; dhuShDhamirughaM a~Nghe bhovadhumillai, a~Nghe ghANabhbhaDhavumADhDhAdhu; mIDhghabhbhaDhDhavarghaLe adhil naDhabhbhArghaL.

ghardhdharAl mIDhghabhbhaDhDhavarghaL dhiruMbhi, AனndhaghghaLibhbhuDhaன bhADhi, jhIyoனughghu varuvArghaL; nidhdhiya maghizhjhjhi avarghaL dhalaiyiனmelirughghuM; jhandhoShamuM maghizhjhjhiyuM aDhaivArghaL; jha~njhalamuM dhavibhbhuM oDhibhbhoM.

èjheghghiyA rAjA arajhANDha bhadhiனAlAM varuShadhdhile ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya jhaனghèribh yUdhAvilirughghiRa araNAன jhaghala bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLughghuM virodhamAy vandhu, avaighaLaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ajhIriyA rAjA lAghIlirundhu rabhjhAghgheyaibh bhèriya jheனaiyoDhe èrujhalemughghu èjheghghiyA rAjAviனiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனAன; avaன vandhu vaNNAr dhuRaiyiன vazhiyiluLLa melghuLadhdhujh jhAlaghadhdhaNDhaiyile niனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ilghghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya èliyAghghIM èனனuM aramaனai vijhAribhbhughghAraனuM jhèbhனA èனனuM jhaMbhiradhiyuM, AjhAbhbhiன ghumAraனAghiya yovAgh èனனuM ghaNaghghaனuM avaனiDhadhdhiRghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனArghaL.
rAbhjhAghghe avarghaLai noghghi: ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya maghArAjAvAனvar uraighghiRadhuM, nI~NghaL èjheghghiyAvughghujh jhòllaveNDhiyadhuM èனனvèனRAl: nI naMbhiyirughghiRa indha naMbhighghai èனன?
yudhdhadhdhughghu mandhirAlojhaனaiyuM vallamaiyuM uNDhèனRu jhòllughiRAye, adhu vAybhbhejhjheyaனRi veRalla; nI èனனai virodhighghuMbhaDhi yArmel naMbhighghai vaidhdhirughghiRAy?

idho, nèrindha nANalgholAghiya andha èghibhdhai naMbhughiRAy; adhiனmel òruvaன jhAyndhAl, adhu avaன uLLa~Nghaiyil bhaDhDhuruvibhbhoM; èghibhdhiன rAjAvAghiya bhArvoன dhaனனai naMbhughiRa yAvarughghuM abhbhaDhiye irubhbhAன.

nI èனனiDhadhdhil: nA~NghaL è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharai naMbhughiRoM èனRu jhòlvAyAghil, avaruDhaiya meDhaighaLaiyuM avaruDhaiya bhalibhIDha~NghaLaiyuM allavo èjheghghiyA aghaRRi, yUdhAvaiyuM, èrujhalemaiyuM noghghi: indhabh bhalibhIDhadhdhiனmuன bhaNiyu~NghaL èனRAனe.
nAன uனghghu iraNDhAyiraM ghudhiraighaLaigh ghòDhubhbheன; nI avaighaLmel eRadhdhaghghavarghaLaijh jhaMbhAdhighghaghghUDhumAனAl ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனoDhe jhabhadha~NghURu.
ghURAdhebhoனAl, nI èன ANDhavaனuDhaiya UzhiyaghghAraril òre òru dhalaivaனuDhaiya mughadhdhai èbhbhaDhidh dhirubhbhuvAy? iradha~NghaLoDhu ghudhiraivIraruM varuvArghaL èனRu èghibhdhaiyA naMbhughiRAy?

ibhbhòzhudhuM ghardhdharuDhaiya ghaDhDhaLaiyillAmal indhadh dhejhadhdhai azhighgha vandheனo? indhadh dhejhadhdhughghu virodhamAybh bhoy adhai azhidhdhubhbhoDhu èனRu ghardhdhar èனனoDhe jhòனனAre èனRu jhòனனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu èliyAghghImuM jhèbhனAvuM yovAghuM, rabhjhAghgheyaibh bhArdhdhu: uMmuDhaiya aDhiyAroDhe jhIriyabhAShaiyile bhejhuM, adhu è~NghaLughghudh dhèriyuM; ala~NghadhdhilirughghiRa jaனdhdhiன jhèvighaL gheDhgha è~NghaLoDhe yUdhabhAShaiyile bhejhaveNDhAM èனRArghaL.

adhaRghu rabhjhAghghe u~NghaLoDhu~NghUDhadh dha~NghaL maladhdhaidh dhiனனvuM, dha~NghaL nIraigh ghuDhighghavuM, ala~Nghadhdhile dha~NghiyirughghiRa bhuruSharaNDhaghghe allAmal, uன ANDhavaனNDhaighghuM, uனனNDhaighghumA èன ANDhavaன indha vArdhdhaighaLaibhbhejha èனனai aனubhbhiனAr èனRu jhòlli,
rabhjhAghghe niனRughòNDhu yUdhabhAShaiyile uradhdhajhadhdhamAy: ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya maghA rAjAvuDhaiya vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheLu~NghaL.
èjheghghiyA u~NghaLai va~njhiyAdhabhaDhi bhAru~NghaL; avaன u~NghaLaidh dhabhbhuvighghamADhDhaன.

ghardhdhar naMmai nijhjhayamAydh dhabhbhuvibhbhAr, indha nagharaM ajhIriyA rAjAviன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvadhillai èனRu jhòlli èjheghghiyA u~NghaLaigh ghardhdharai naMbhabhbhaNNuvAன; adhaRghu iDha~NghòDhAdhiru~NghaL èனRu rAjA jhòllughiRAr.
èjheghghiyAviன jhòllaigh gheLAdhiru~NghaL ajhIriyA rAjA jhòllughiRadhAvadhu: nI~NghaL èனனoDhe rAjiyAghi, ghANighghaiyoDhe èனனiDhadhdhil vAru~NghaL.

nAன vandhu, u~NghaLaidh dhAனiyamuM dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhamumuLLa dhejhamuM, abhbhamuM dhirADhjharajhamumuLLa dhejhamumAghiya u~NghaL dhejhadhdhughghu òbhbhAன dhejhadhdhughghu azhaidhdhughghòNDhubhoghumaLavuM, avaனvaன dhaன dhaன dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyiன ghaனiyaiyuM, dhaன dhaன adhdhimaradhdhiன ghaனiyaiyuM bhujhidhdhu, avaனvaன dhaன dhaன ghiNaRRiன dhaNNIraigh ghuDhiyu~NghaL.

ghardhdhar naMmaidh dhabhbhuvibhbhArèனRu u~NghaLaibh bhodhaனaijhèyya èjheghghiyAvughghujh jhèvighòDhAdhiru~NghaL; jAdhighaLuDhaiya dhevarghaLil yArAvadhu dha~NghaL dhejhadhdhai ajhIriyA rAjAviன ghaighghu dhabhbhuvidhdhadhuNDho?
AmAdh arbhAdh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன dhevarghaL è~Nghe? jhèbhbharvAyImiன dhevarghaL è~Nghe? avarghaL jhamAriyAvai èன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvidhdhadhuNDho?

ghardhdhar èrujhalemai èன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvibhbhAr èனbhadhaRghu andhadhdhejha~NghaLuDhaiya èllAdh dhevarghaLughghuLLuM dha~NghaL dhejhadhdhai èன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvidhdhavar yAr èனRu rAjA jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.
avarghaLo avaனughghu òruvArdhdhaiyaiyuM bhiradhiyudhdharamAghajh jhòllAmal mavuனmAyirundhArghaL; avaனughghu maRuudhdharavu jhòllaveNDhAM èனRu rAjA ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhirundhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ilghghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya èliyAghghIM èனனuM aramaனai vijhAribhbhughghAraனuM, jhèbhனA èனனuM jhaMbhiradhiyuM, AjhAbhbhiன ghumAraனAghiya yovAgh èனனuM ghaNaghghaனuM vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòNDhu, èjheghghiyAviனiDhadhdhil vandhu, abhjhAghgheyiன vArdhdhaighaLai avaனughghu aRividhdhArghaL.
rAjAvAghiya èjheghghiyA adhaighgheDhDhabhodhu dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhu, iraDhDhu uDhudhdhughghòNDhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhil bhiravejhidhdhu,

aramaனai vijhAribhbhughghAraனAghiya èliyAghghImaiyuM, jhaMbhiradhiyAghiya jhèbhனAvaiyuM, AjhAriyarghaLiன mUbhbharaiyuM, Amodhjhiன ghumAraனAghiya ejhAyA èனனuM dhIrghghadharijhiyiனiDhadhdhiRghu iraDhDhu uDhudhdhavarghaLAgha aனubhbhiனAன.
ivarghaL avaனai noghghi: indhanAL nèrughghamuM, ghaNDhidhamuM, dhUShaNamuM anubhavighghiRa nAL; bhiLLaibhbheRu noghghiyirughghiRadhu; bhèRavo bhèlaன illai.

jIvaனuLLa dhevaனai nindhighghuMbhaDhi, ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya dhaன ANDhavaனAl aனubhbhabhbhaDhDha rabhjhAghghe jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLai umadhu dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar gheDhDhirughghiRAr; umadhu dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar gheDhDhirughghiRa vArdhdhaighaLiனimidhdhaM dhaNDhaனaijhèyvAr; AghaiyAl, iனனuM mIdhiyAyirughghiRavarghaLughghAgha viNNabhbha~njhèyvIrAgha èனRu èjheghghiyA jhòllajhjhòனனAr èனRArghaL.
ivvidhamAy èjheghghiyA rAjAviன UzhiyaghghArar ejhAyAviனiDhadhdhil vandhu jhòனனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu ejhAyA avarghaLainoghghi: ajhIriyA rAjAviன UzhiyaghghArar èனனaidh dhUShidhdhadhuM nIr gheDhDhadhumAன vArdhdhaighaLiனAle bhayabhbhaDhAdheyuM.

idho, avaன òru jhèydhiyaighgheDhDhu, dhaன dhejhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhuvadhaRghAன Aviyai nAன avaனughghuL aனubhbhi, avaனai avaன dhejhadhdhile bhaDhDhayadhdhAl vizhabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனbhadhai u~NghaL ANDhavaனiDhadhdhil jhòllu~NghaL èனRAன.
ajhIriyA rAjA lAghIjhaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhAன èனRu gheLvibhbhaDhDhu, rabhjhAghghe dhiruMbhibhbhoy, avaன libhனAviனmel yudhdhaMbhaNNughiRadhaigh ghaNDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu, èdhdhiyobhbhiyAviன rAjAvAghiya dhirAghghA uMmoDhu yudhdhaMbhaNNabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhAன èனRu jhòllagh gheLvibhbhaDhDhAன; adhaigh gheDhDhabhodhu avaன èjheghghiyAviனiDhadhdhughghu sdhAனAbhadhighaLai aனubhbhi:

nI~NghaL yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya èjheghghiyAvughghujh jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl, èrujhaleM ajhIriyA rAjAviன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvadhillai èனRu nI naMbhiyirughghiRa uன dhevaன uனனai èdhdhavòDhDhAdhe.
idho, ajhIriyA rAjAghghaL jhaghala dhejha~NghaLaiyuM jha~Ngharidhdha jhèydhiyai nI gheLvibhbhaDhDhirughghiRAy; nI dhabhbhuvAyo?
èன bhidhAghghaL azhidhdhuviDhDha ghojhAனaiyuM, ArAனaiyuM redhjhebhbhaiyuM, dhèlAjhArilirundha edheனiன bhudhdhiraraiyuM avarghaLuDhaiya dhevarghaL dhabhbhuvidhdhadhuNDho?
AmAdhdhiன rAjAvuM, arbhAdhdhiன rAjAvuM, jhèbhbharvAyIM eனA IvA bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன rAjAvuM è~Nghe èனRu jhòllu~NghaL èனRAr.
èjheghghiyA sdhAனAbhadhighaLiன ghaiyilirundha nirubhadhdhai vA~Nghi vAjhidhdhAன; bhiனbhu èjheghghiyA ghardhdharuDhaiya AlayadhdhiRghubh bhoy adhaigh ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha viridhdhu,
ghardhdharai noghghi:
jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhAve, gherubhIனghaLiன madhdhiyil vAjhaMbhaNNughiRa israveliன dhevaனe, nIr òruvare bhUmiyiன rAjya~NghaLughghèllAM dhevaனAனvar; nIr vAனdhdhaiyuM bhUmiyaiyuM uNDhAghghiனIr.

ghardhdhAve, umadhu jhèviyaijh jhAydhdhughgheLuM; ghardhdhAve, nIr umadhu ghaNghaLaidh dhiRandhubhAruM, jhaனghèribh jIvaனuLLa dhevaனai nindhighghuMbhaDhighghujh jhòlliyaனubhbhiன vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM gheLuM.
ghardhdhAve, ajhIriyA rAjAghghaL andha jAdhighaLaiyuM, avarghaL dhejhadhdhaiyuM nAjhamAghghi,
avarghaLuDhaiya dhevarghaLai nèrubhbhile bhoDhDhuviDhDhadhu mèydhAன; avaighaL dhevarghaL allave, maனuShar ghaiveliyAன maramuM ghallundhAனe; AghaiyAl avaighaLai nIrdhdhuLiyAghghiனArghaL.
ibhbhodhuM è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhAve, nIr òruvare ghardhdhar èனRu bhUmiyiன rAjya~NghaLèllAM aRiyuMbhaDhighghu, è~NghaLai avaன ghaighghu nI~NghalAghghi iraDhjhiyuM èனRu viNNabhbhaMbhaNNiனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu Amodhjhiன ghumAraனAghiya ejhAyA, èjheghghiyAvughghujh jhòlliyaனubhbhiனdhu: israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya jhaனghèribhiனimidhdhaM nI èனனai noghghi viNNabhbhaMbhaNNiனAye.

avaனaighghuRidhdhugh ghardhdhar jhòllughiRa vajhaனmAvadhu: jhIyoன ghumAradhdhiyAghiya ghaனனiyAsdhirI uனனai ighazhndhu, uனனaibh bharighAjhaMbhaNNughiRAL; èrujhaleM ghumAradhdhi uன bhiனனAle dhalaiyaidh dhulughghughiRAL.
yArai nindhidhdhudh dhUShidhdhAy? yArughghu virodhamAy uன jhadhdhadhdhai uyardhdhiனAy? nI israveliன bharijhudhdharughghu virodhamAy allavo uன ghaNghaLai meDhDhimaiyAy eRèDhudhdhAy.

uன UzhiyaghghAraraighghòNDhu ANDhavarai nindhidhdhu: èன iradha~NghaLiன dhiraLiனAle nAன malaighaLiன ghòDhumuDhighaLughghuM lIbhaனoனiன jhighara~NghaLughghuM vandhu eRiனeன; adhiன uyaramAன ghedhurumara~NghaLaiyuM, ujhjhidhamAன dhevadhAru viruDhjha~NghaLaiyuM nAன vèDhDhi, uyarndha adhiன ghaDhaijhi èllaimaDhDhuM, adhiன jhèzhumaiyAன vaனmaDhDhuM varuveன èனRuM,
nAன ghiNaRu vèDhDhidh dhaNNIr ghuDhidhdheன; èன uLLa~NghAliனAl araNibhbhAன iDha~NghaLiன aghazhighaLaiyèllAM vaRaLavuM bhaNNiனeன èனRuM jhòனனAy.

nAன vèghughAladhdhughghumuன adhai niyamidhdhu, bhUrvanADhghaLmudhal adhaidh dhiDhDhaMbhaNNiனeன èனbhadhai nI gheDhDhadhillaiyo? ibhbhòzhudhu nI araNAன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaibh bhAzhAன maNmeDhughaLAghghuMbhaDhi nAனe adhaijh jhaMbhavighghabhbhaNNiனeன.

adhiனAle avaighaLiன ghuDhighaL ghaiyiLaidhdhavarghaLAghi, ghala~Nghi vèDhghabhbhaDhDhu, vèLiyiன bhUNDhughghuM, bhajhjhilaighghuM, vIDhughaLiனmel muLaighghuM bhullughghuM o~Nghi vaLarumuன dhIyndhubhoM bhayirughghuM jhamAனmAனArghaL.
uன irubhbhaiyuM, uன bhoghghaiyuM, uன varavaiyuM, nI èனghghu virodhamAygh ghòndhaLighghiRadhaiyuM aRiveன.

nI èனghghu virodhamAygh ghòndhaLidhdhu, vIriyaMbhejhiனdhu èன jhèvighaLil eRiனbhaDhiyiனAle, nAன èன dhuRaDhDhai uன mUghghiluM, èன ghaDhivALadhdhai uன vAyiluM bhoDhDhu, nI vandha vazhiye uனனaidh dhiruMbhabhbhaNNuveன.

uனghghu aDhaiyALamAyirubhbhadhu èனனvèனRAl: indha varuShadhdhile dhabhbhibh bhayirAghiRadhaiyuM, iraNDhAM varuShadhdhile dhAனAy viLaighiRadhaiyuM jhAbhbhiDhuvIrghaL; mUனRAM varuShadhdhilo vidhaidhdhu aRudhdhu, dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDha~NghaLai nADhDhi, avaighaLiன ghaனighaLaibh bhujhibhbhIrghaL.
yUdhA vaMjhadhdhAril dhabhbhi mIndhirughghiRavarghaL maRubhaDhiyuM ghIzhe verbhaRRi mele ghaனighòDhubhbhArghaL.
mIdhiyAyirughghiRavarghaL èrujhalemiluM, dhabhbhiனvarghaL jhIyoன malaiyilumirundhu bhuRabhbhabhaDhuvArghaL; jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhariன vairAghghiyaM idhaijh jhèyyuM.

AghaiyAl ghardhdhar ajhIriyA rAjAvaighghuRidhdhu: avaன indha nagharadhdhughghuL bhiravejhibhbhadhillai; idhiனmel aMbhu èyvadhumillai; idhaRghumuனbhAghagh gheDhaghadhdhoDhe varuvadhumillai; idhaRghu èdhirAghagh ghòdhdhaLaMbhoDhuvadhumillai.
avaன indha nagharadhdhughghuL bhiravejhiyAmal dhAன vandhavazhiye dhiruMbhibhbhovAன.
èனனimidhdhamuM èன dhAjhaனAghiya dhAvIdhiனimidhdhamuM, nAன indha nagharadhdhai iraDhjhighghuMbhaDhighghu idhaRghu AdharavAyirubhbheன èனbhadhaigh ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòlliyaனubhbhiனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, ajhIriyariன bhALayadhdhil laDhjhadhdhèNbhadhdhaiyAyiraMbheraijh jha~NgharidhdhAன; adhighAlame èzhundhirughghuMbhodhu, idho, avarghaLèllAruM jhèdhdha bhiredha~NghaLAygh ghiDhandhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu ajhIriyA rAjAvAghiya jhaனghèribh bhirayANabhbhaDhDhudh dhiruMbhibhbhoy, niனiveyil irundhuviDhDhAன.

avaன dhaன dhevaனAghiya nisroghiன ghovilile bhaNindhughòLLughiRabhodhu, avaன ghumArarAghiya adhramaleghghuM jharedhjheruM avaனaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhiனAl vèDhDhibhbhoDhDhu, ararAdh dhejhadhdhughghudh dhabhbhi oDhibhbhoனArghaL; avaன ghumAraனAghiya èjharadhdhoன avaன bhaDhDhadhdhiRghu vandhu arajhANDhAன.

annADhghaLil èjheghghiyA viyAdhibhbhaDhDhu maraNadhdhughghu edhuvAyirundhAன; abhbhòzhudhu Amodhjhiன ghumAraனAghiya ejhAyA èனனuM dhIrghghadharijhi avaனiDhadhdhil vandhu, avaனai noghghi: nIr umadhu vIDhDhughghAriyadhdhai òzhu~NghubhbhaDhudhdhuM, nIr bhizhaighghamADhDhIr maridhdhubhbhovIr èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu èjheghghiyA dhaனmughadhdhaijh jhuvarbhbhuRamAghadh dhirubhbhighghòNDhu, ghardhdharai noghghi:
A ghardhdhAve, nAன umaghghu muனbhAgha uNmaiyuM maன udhdhamamumAy naDhandhu, umadhu bhArvaighghu nalamAனdhajh jhèydheன èனbhadhai niனaidhdharuLuM èனRu viNNabhbhaMbhaNNi, èjheghghiyA mighavuM azhudhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ejhAyAvughghu uNDhAன ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyAvadhu:

nI bhoy èjheghghiyAvai noghghi: uன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya dhAvIdhiன dhevaனAyirughghiRa ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, uன viNNabhbhadhdhaigh gheDhDheன; uன ghaNNIraigh ghaNDheன; idho, uன nADhghaLoDhe bhadhiனaindhu varuShaM ghUDhDhuveன.
nAன uனனaiyuM indha nagharadhdhaiyuM ajhIriyA rAjAviன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvidhdhu indha nagharadhdhughghu AdharavAyirubhbheன.
idho, AghAjhuDhaiya jhUriyaghaDhiyarAdhdhil bhAghaighghubh bhAghai iRa~Nghiன jhAyaiyaibh bhadhdhubhbhAghai bhiனனiDhDhudh dhirubhbhuveன èனRAr.

dhAM jhòனன indha vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhi ghardhdhar jhèyvAr èனbhadhaRghu idhu ghardhdharAl uனghghu aDhaiyALamAyirughghuM èனRu jhòl èனRAr; abhbhaDhiye ghaDhiyAradhdhil iRa~Nghiyirundha jhUriyajhAyai bhadhdhubhbhAghai dhiruMbhiRRu.
yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya èjheghghiyA viyAdhibhbhaDhDhu dhaன viyAdhi nI~Nghijh jhòsdhamAனbhodhu èzhudhivaidhdhadhAvadhu:
nAன èன bhUraNa Ayujhiன varuSha~NghaLughghujh jherAmal bhAdhALadhdhiன vAjhalghaLughghuDhbhaDhuveன èனRu èன nADhghaL aRubhbhuNghiRabhodhu jhòனனeன.
ghardhdharai, ghardhdharai, nAன iனi uyiroDhirughghiRavarghaLiன dhejhadhdhile dharijhibhbhadhillai; iனi bhUloghaghghuDhighaLoDhe irundhu maனuSharai nAன ghANbhadhillai.

èன Ayujhu meybhbhaனuDhaiya ghUDhAradhdhaibhbhola èனனaiviDhDhubh bhèyarndhubhoghiRadhu; nèyghiRavaன bhAvai aRughghiRadhubhola èன jIvaனai aRughghagh ghòDhughghiReன; èனனaibh bhAvilirundhu aRudhdhuviDhughiRAr; iனRu iravughghuLLe èனனai muDhivaDhaiyabhbhaNNuvIr.
viDhiyaRghAlamaDhDhuM nAன èNNamiDhDhughghòNDhirundheன; avar jhi~NghaMbhol èன èluMbhughaLaiyèllAM nòRughghuvAr; iனRu iravughghuLLe èனனai muDhivaDhaiyabhbhaNNuvIr èனRu jhòlli,

namuDhDhaibhbholuM, dhaghaivilAன ghuruviyaibhbholuM ghUviனeன, bhuRAvaibhbhol bhulaMbhiனeன; èன ghaNghaL uyarabh bhArghghiRadhil bhUdhdhubhbhoyiன; ghardhdhAve, òDhu~NghibhbhoghiReன; èன ghAriyadhdhai meRbhoDhDhughghòLLuM èனReன.
nAன èனன jhòlluveன? avar èனghghu vAghghu aruLiனAr; andhabhbhiraghArame jhèydhAr; èன Ayujhiன varuSha~NghaLilèllAM èன AdhdhumAviன ghajhabhbhai niனaidhdhu naDhandhughòLveன.
ANDhavare, ivaighaLiனAl maனuShar bhizhaighghiRArghaL; ivaighaLèllAM èன uyirghghu uyirAyirughghiRadhu; èனனaijh jhòsdhabhbhaDhavuM bhizhaighghavuMbhaNNiனIr.

idho, jhamAdhAனdhdhughghubh bhadhilAgha maghA ghajhabhbhu vandhirundhadhu, dhevarIro èன AdhdhumAvai nejhidhdhu azhiviன ghuzhighghu vilaghghiனIr; èன bhAva~NghaLaiyèllAM umadhu mudhughughghubh bhiனனAgha èRindhuviDhDhIr.
bhAdhALaM uMmaidh dhudhiyAdhu, maraNaM uMmaibh bhoRRAdhu; ghuzhiyiliRa~NghughiRavarghaL uMmuDhaiya jhadhdhiyadhdhai dhiyAனibhbhadhillai.
nAன iனRu jhèyghiRadhubhola, uyiroDhirughghiRavaன uyiroDhirughghiRavaனe uMmaidh dhudhibhbhAன, dhaghabhbhaன bhiLLaighaLughghu umadhu jhadhdhiyadhdhaidh dhèrivibhbhAன.
ghardhdhar èனனai iraDhjhighghavandhAr; AghaiyAl è~NghaL jIvanALèllAM ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhile èன ghIdhavAdhdhiya~NghaLai vAjhidhdhubh bhADhuvoM èனRu èzhudhivaidhdhAன.
adhdhibhbhazhadhdhu aDhaiyaigh ghòNDhuvandhu bhiLavaiyiனmel bhaRRubhbhoDhu~NghaL; abhbhòzhudhu bhizhaibhbhAr èனRu ejhAyA jhòlliyirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu èjheghghiyA: nAன ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhughghubh bhovadhaRghu aDhaiyALaM èனனvèனRu gheDhDhirundhAன.

aghghAladhdhile bhalAdhAனiன ghumAraனAghiya mèrodhAghbhalAdhAன èனனuM bhAbhiloனiன rAjA, èjheghghiyA viyAdhibhbhaDhDhirundhu AroghghiyamAனdhaigh gheLvibhbhaDhDhu avaனiDhadhdhiRghu nirubha~NghaLaiyuM vèghumAனdhdhaiyuM aனubhbhiனAன.

èjheghghiyA avarghaLaigh ghaNDhu jhandhoShabhbhaDhDhu, dhaன bhòghghiShajhAlaiyaiyuM, vèLLiyaiyuM, bhòனனaiyuM, ghandhavarghgha~NghaLaiyuM, nalla bharimaLadhailadhdhaiyuM dhaன AyudhajhAlai aனaidhdhaiyuM, dhaன bhòghghiShajhAlaighaLil uLLadhèllAvaRRaiyuM avarghaLughghugh ghANbhidhdhAன; èjheghghiyA dhaன aramaனaiyiluM, dhaன rAjyadhdhileyuM avarghaLughghugh ghANbhiyAdhabh bhòruL òனRuM illai.

abhbhòzhudhu ejhAyA dhIrghghadharijhi èjheghghiyA rAjAviனiDhadhdhil vandhu andha maனuShar èனன jhòனனArghaL, è~Ngheyirundhu uMmiDhadhdhil vandhArghaL èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu èjheghghiyA: bhAbhiloன èனனuM dhUradhejhadhdhilirundhu èனனiDhadhdhiRghu vandhArghaL èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன: uMmuDhaiya vIDhDhil èனனdhdhaibh bhArdhdhArghaL èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu èjheghghiyA èன vIDhDhiluLLadhèllAvaRRaiyuM bhArdhdhArghaL; èன bhòghghiSha~NghaLil nAன avarghaLughghugh ghANbhiyAdha bhòruL òனRuM illai èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu ejhAyA èjheghghiyAvai noghghi: jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhariன vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLuM.
idho, nADhghaL varuM; abhbhòzhudhu vIDhDhil uLLadhiluM uன bhidhAghghaL innALvaraighghuM jherdhdhadhiluM òனRuM mIdhiyAy vaighghabhbhaDhAmal èllA bhAbhiloனughghugh ghòNDhubhoghabhbhaDhuM.
nI bhèRabhbhoghiRa uன jhandhadhiyAghiya uன ghumArariluM jhilar bhAbhiloன aramaனai velaighghArarAyirubhbhArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu èjheghghiyA ejhAyAvai noghghi: nIr jhòனன ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai nalladhudhAன èனRu jhòlli, èன nADhghaLilAvadhu jhamAdhAனmuM uNmaiyuM irughghume èனRAன.
èன jaனdhdhai ARRu~NghaL, dheRRu~NghaL;

èrujhalemuDhaன bhaDhjhamAybhbhejhi, adhiன bhormuDhindhadhu èனRuM, adhiன aghghiramaM nivirdhdhiyAyiRRu èனRuM, adhu dhaன jhaghala bhAva~NghaLiனimidhdhamuM ghardhdhariன ghaiyil iraDhDhibhbhAy aDhaindhu dhIrndhadhu èனRuM, adhaRghugh ghURu~NghaL èனRu u~NghaL dhevaன jhòllughiRAr.
ghardhdharughghu vazhiyai AyadhdhabhbhaDhudhdhu~NghaL, avAndharavèLiyile naMmuDhaiya dhevaனughghubh bhAdhaiyaijh jhèvvaibhaNNu~NghaL èனRuM,
bhaLLamèllaM uyardhdhabhbhaDhDhu, jhaghala malaiyuM ghuனRuM dhAzhdhdhabhbhaDhDhu, ghoNalAனdhu jhèvvaiyAghi, gharaDhumuraDhAனvai jhamamAghghabhbhaDhuM èனRuM.
ghardhdhariன maghimai vèLiyara~NghamAghuM mAMjhamAன yAvuM adhai eghamAygh ghANuM, ghardhdhariன vAghghu adhai uraidhdhadhu èனRuM vaனAndharadhdhile ghUbhbhiDhughiRa jhadhdhaM uNDhAyiRRu.

bhiனனuM ghUbhbhiDhDhujh jhòllèனRu òru jhadhdhaM uNDhAyiRRu; èனனdhdhaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhujh jhòlveனèனReன. adhaRghu: mAMjhamèllAM bhullaibhbholavuM, adhiன meனmaiyèllAM vèLiyiன bhUvaibhbholavuM irughghiRadhu.
ghardhdhariன Avi adhiனmel UdhuMbhodhu, bhul ularndhu, bhU udhiruM; jaனme bhul.
bhul ularndhu bhU udhiruM; namadhu dhevaனuDhaiya vajhaனmo èனRèனRaighghuM niRghuM èனbhadhaiye jhòllèனRu uraidhdhadhu.

jhIyoன èனனuM jhuvijheShaghiye, nI uyarndha bharvadhadhdhil eRu; èrujhaleM èனனuM jhuvijheShaghiye, nI uradhdhajhadhdhamiDhDhugh ghUbhbhiDhu, bhayabhbhaDhAmal jhadhdhamiDhDhu, yUdhA bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLai noghghi: idho, u~NghaL dhevaனèனRu ghURu.

idho, ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar bharAghghiramajhAliyAgha varuvAr; avar dhamadhu bhuyadhdhil arajhALuvAr; idho, avar aLighghuM bhalaன avaroDheghUDha varughiRadhu; avar ghòDhughghuM bhiradhibhalaன avaruDhaiya mughadhdhughghu muனbhAghajh jhèllughiRadhu.
meybhbhaனaibhbholadh dhamadhu mandhaiyai meybhbhAr; ADhDhughghuDhDhighaLaidh dhamadhu bhuyadhdhiனAl jherdhdhu dhamadhu maDhiyile jhumandhu ghaRavalADhughaLai mèdhuvAy naDhadhdhuvAr.

dhaNNIrghaLaidh dhamadhu ghaibhbhiDhiyAl aLandhu, vAன~NghaLai jANaLavAybh bhiramANidhdhu, bhUmiyiன maNNai maraghghAlil aDhaghghi, bharvadha~NghaLaidh dhulAghgholAluM, malaighaLaidh dharAjhAluM niRudhdhavar yAr?
ghardhdharuDhaiya Aviyai aLaviDhDhu, avarughghu AlojhaனaighghAraனAyirundhu, avarughghubh bhodhidhdhavaன yAr?

dhamaghghu aRivai uNardhdhavuM, dhaMmai niyAyavazhiyile ubhadhejhighghavuM dhamaghghu ~nAனdhdhaigh ghaRRughghòDhughghavuM, dhamaghghu viveghadhdhiனvazhi aRivighghavuM, avar yAroDhe AlojhaனaibhaNNiனAr?
idho, jAdhighaL eRRajhjhAlil dhò~NghuM dhuLibholavuM, dharAjhile bhaDhiyuM dhUjhibholavuM, èNNabhbhaDhughiRArghaL; idho, dhIvughaLai òru aNuvaibhbhol dhUghghughiRAr.
lIbhaனoன èrighghuM viRaghughghubh bhodhAdhu adhiluLLa mirughajIvaனghaL dhaghaனbhalighghuM bhodhAdhu.
jhaghala jAdhighaLuM avarughghu muனbhAgha òனRumillai, avarghaL jhUனiyadhdhil jhUனiyamAghavuM, mAyaiyAghavuM èNNabhbhaDhughiRArghaL.
ibhbhaDhiyirughgha, dhevaனai yArughghu òbhbhiDhuvIrghaL? èndhajh jhAyalai avarughghu òbhbhiDhuvIrghaL?
ghaனனAன òru jhurUbhadhdhai vArghghiRAன, dhaDhDhAன bhòனdhaghaDhDhAl adhai mUDhi, adhaRghu vèLLijhjha~NghilighaLaibh bhòrundhavaighghiRAன.
adhaRghugh ghòDhughgha vaghaiyillAdhavaன uLudhdhubhbhoghAdha maradhdhaidhdhèrindhughòNDhu, ajhaiyAdha òrujhurUbhadhdhaijh jhèyyuMbhaDhi nibhuNaனAன òru dhajhjhaனaidh dheDhughiRAன.
nI~NghaL aRiyIrghaLA? nA~NghaL gheLvibhbhaDhavillaiyA? Adhimudhal u~NghaLughghudh dhèrivighghabhbhaDhavillaiyA? bhUmi asdhibhArabhbhaDhDhadhumudhal uNarAdhirughghiRIrghaLA?

avar bhUmi uNDhaiyiனmel vIRRirughghiRavar; adhiன ghuDhighaL vèDhDhughghiLighaLaibhbhola irughghiRArghaL; avar vAன~NghaLai mèlliya dhiraiyAghabh bharabhbhi, avaighaLaigh ghuDhiyirughghiRadhaRghAன ghUDhAramAgha virighghiRAr.
avar bhirabhughghaLai mAyaiyAghghi, bhUmiyiன niyAyAdhibhadhighaLai avAndharamAghghughiRAr.

avarghaL dhiruMbha nADhDhabhbhaDhuvadhumillai, vidhaighghabhbhaDhuvadhumillai; avarghaLuDhaiya aDhimaraM dhiruMbhabh bhUmiyile verviDhuvadhumillai; avarghaLmel avar Udhave bhaDhDhubhbhovArghaL; bhèru~NghARRu avarghaLai òru dhuruMbhaibhbhol aDhidhdhughghòNDhubhoM.
ibhbhaDhiyirughgha, èனனai yArughghu òbhbhiDhuvIrghaL? èனghghu yArai nigharAghghuvIrghaL? èனRu bharijhudhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

u~NghaL ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubhbhAru~NghaL; avaighaLaijh jhiruShDhidhdhavar yAr? avar avaighaLiன jheனaiyai ilaghghadhdhiDhDhamAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNi, avaighaLaiyèllAM bherbherAgha azhaighghiRavarAme; avaruDhaiya maghA bhèladhdhiனAluM, avaruDhaiya maghA vallamaiyiனAluM avaighaLil òனRuM ghuRaiyAmalirughghiRadhu.
yAghghobhe, isravele: èன vazhi ghardhdharughghu maRaivAyiRRu èனRuM, èன niyAyaM èன dhevaனiDhadhdhil èDhDhAmal bhoghiRadhu èனRuM nI jhòlvAனeன?

bhUmiyiன ghaDhaiyAndhara~NghaLaijh jhiruShDhidhdha ghardhdharAghiya anAdhidhevaன jhorndhubhovadhumillai, iLaibhbhaDhaivadhumillai; idhai nI aRiyAyo? idhai nI gheDhDhadhillaiye. avaruDhaiya bhudhdhi ArAyndhu muDhiyAdhadhu.
jhorndhubhoghiRavaனughghu avar bhèlaன ghòDhudhdhu, jhadhdhuvamillAdhavaனughghujh jhadhdhuvadhdhaibh bhèrughabhbhaNNughiRAr.
iLai~nar iLaibhbhaDhaindhu jhorndhubhovArghaL, vAlibharuM iDhaRivizhuvArghaL.

ghardhdharughghugh ghAdhdhirughghiRavarghaLo bhudhubhbhèlaனDhaidhdhu, ghazhughughaLaibhbholajh jhèDhDhaighaLai aDhidhdhu èzhuMbhuvArghaL; avarghaL oDhiனAluM iLaibhbhaDhaiyArghaL, naDhandhAluM jhorndhubhoghArghaL.

dhIvughaLe, èனghghu muனbhAgha mavuனmAyiru~NghaL; jaன~NghaL dha~NghaL bhèlaனaibh bhudhidhAghghighghòNDhu, jhamIbhidhdhu vandhu, bhiனbhu bhejhaghghaDhavarghaL; nAM òrumighgha niyAyAjhaனdhdhughghu muனbhAghajh jheruvoM.

ghizhaghghilirundhu nIdhimAனai èzhubhbhi, dhamadhu bhAdhabhaDhiyile varavazhaidhdhavar yAr? jAdhighaLai avaனughghu òbhbhughghòDhudhdhu, avaனai rAjAghghaLughghu ANDhavaனAghghi, avarghaLai avaன bhaDhDhayadhdhughghudh dhUjhiyuM, avaன villughghujh jhidhaRaDhighghabhbhaDhDha dhALaDhiyumAghghi,
avaன avarghaLaidh dhuradhdhavuM, dhaன ghAlghaL naDhavAdhirundha bhAdhaiyile jhamAdhAனdhdhoDhe naDhaghghavuM bhaNNiனvar yAr?
adhaijh jhèydhu niRaiveRRi, AdhimudhaRghòNDha dhalaimuRaighaLai varavazhaighghiRavar yAr? mundhiனvarAyirughghiRa ghardhdharAghiya nAனdhAனe; bhindhiனvarghaLoDhuM irubhbhavarAghiya nAனdhAனe.
dhIvughaL adhaigh ghaNDhu bhayabhbhaDhuM, bhUmiyiன ghaDhaiyAndhara~NghaL naDhu~NghuM; avarghaL jherndhuvandhu,
òruvarughghu òruvar òdhdhAjhai jhèydhu dhiDhaனghòL èனRu jhaghodharaனughghujh jhaghodharaன jhòllughiRAன.

jhidhdhiravelaighghAraன dhaDhDhAனaiyuM, jhudhdhiyAle mèlliya dhaghaDhu dhaDhDhughiRavaன aDhaighalliனmel aDhighghiRavaனaiyuM uRjhAghabhbhaDhudhdhi, ijhaighghiRadhaRghAன bhaghghuvamèனRu jhòlli, adhu ajhaiyAdhabhaDhighghu avaன ANighaLAl adhai iRughghughiRAன.
èன dhAjhaனAghiya isravele, nAன dhèrindhughòNDha yAghghobhe, èன jhineghidhaன AbhiraghAmiன jhandhadhiye,
nAன bhUmiyiன ghaDhaiyAndhara~NghaLilirundhu, uனனai èDhudhdhu, adhiன èllaighaLilirundhu azhaidhdhuvandhu, nI èன dhAjhaன, nAன uனனaidh dhèrindhughòNDheன, nAன uனனai vèRudhdhuviDhavillai èனRu jhòனனeன.
nI bhayabhbhaDhAdhe, nAன uனனuDhaனe irughghiReன; dhighaiyAdhe, nAன uன dhevaன; nAன uனனaibh bhalabhbhaDhudhdhi uனghghujh jhaghAyaMbhaNNuveன; èன nIdhiyiன valadhugharadhdhiனAl uனனaidh dhA~Nghuveன.
idho, uனmel èrijhjhalAyirughghiRa yAvaruM vèDhghi ilajhjhaiyaDhaivArghaL; uனனoDhe vazhaghghADhughiRavarghaL nAjhamAghi òனRumillAmaRbhovArghaL.
uனனoDhe bhorADhiனvarghaLaidhdheDhiyuM ghANAdhirubhbhAy; uனனoDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNiன maனuShar òனRumillAmal ilbhòruLAvArghaL.
uன dhevaனAyirughghiRa ghardhdharAghiya nAன uன valadhughaiyaibh bhiDhidhdhu bhayabhbhaDhAdhe, nAன uனghghudh dhuNainiRghiReன èனRu jhòllughiReன.
yAghghobhu èனனuM bhUjhjhiye, israveliன jhiRughUDhDhame, bhayabhbhaDhAdhe; nAன uனghghudh dhuNainiRghiReன èனRu ghardhdharuM israveliன bharijhudhdharumAghiya uன mIDhbhar uraighghiRAr.
idho, bhoraDhighghiRadhaRghu nAன uனனaibh bhudhidhuM ghUrmaiyumAன bhaRghaLuLLa yandharamAghghughiReன; nI malaighaLai midhidhdhu nòRughghi, ghuனRughaLaibh bhadharughghu òbhbhAghghiviDhuvAy.

avaighaLaidh dhURRuvAy, abhbhòzhudhu ghARRu avaighaLaigh ghòNDhubhoy, jhuzhalghARRu avaighaLaibh bhaRaghghaDhighghuM; nIyo ghardhdharughghuLLe ghaLighUrndhu, israveliன bharijhudhdharughghuLLe meனmaibhArADhDhighghòNDhirubhbhAy.

jhiRumaiyuM èLimaiyumAனvarghaL dhaNNIraidh dheDhi, adhu ghiDhaiyAmal, avarghaL nAvu dhAghadhdhAl vaRaLuMbhodhu, ghardhdharAghiya nAன avarghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhu, israveliன dhevaனAghiya nAன avarghaLaigh ghaiviDhAdhirubhbheன.
uyarndha meDhughaLil ARughaLaiyuM, bhaLLadhdhAghghughaLiன naDhuve URRughaLaiyuM dhiRandhu, vaனAndharadhdhaidh dhaNNIrdh dhaDhAghamuM, vaRaNDhabhUmiyai nIrghgheNighaLumAghghi

vaனAndharadhdhile ghedhurumara~NghaLaiyuM, jhIdhdhiMmara~NghaLaiyuM, mirudhujhjhèDhighaLaiyuM, òlivamara~NghaLaiyuM naDhDhu, avAndharavèLiyile dhevadhAruviruDhjha~NghaLaiyuM, bhAymaraviruDhjha~NghaLaiyuM, bhuனனaimara~NghaLaiyuM uNDhubhaNNuveன.
ghardhdharuDhaiya gharaM adhaijhjhèydhadhu èனRuM israveliன bharijhudhdhar adhaibh bhaDhaidhdhAr èனRuM, aனaivaruM ghaNDhu uNarndhu jhindhidhdhu aRivArghaL.
u~NghaL vazhaghghaigh ghòNDhuvAru~NghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; u~NghaL bhalamAன niyAya~NghaLai vèLibhbhaDhudhdhu~NghaL èனRu yAghghobhiன rAjA uraighghiRAr.

avarghaL avaighaLaigh ghòNDhuvandhu, jhaMbhavighghabhbhoghiRavaighaLai namaghghudh dhèrivighghaDhDhuM; avaighaLil mundhi jhaMbhavibhbhavaன iனனvaighaLèனRu jhòlli, nAM naMmuDhaiya maனdhai avaighaLiனmel vaighghuMbhaDhighghuM, bhindhi jhaMbhavibhbhavaighaLaiyuM nAM aRiyuMbhaDhighghuM namaghghudh dhèrivighghaDhDhuM; varu~NghAriya~NghaLai namaghghu aRivighghaDhDhuM.

bhiனvaruM ghAriya~NghaLai è~NghaLughghudh dhèriviyu~NghaL; abhbhòzhudhu nI~NghaL dhevarghaL èனRu aRivoM; alladhu naனmaiyAvadhu dhImaiίAvadhu jhèyyu~NghaL; abhbhòzhudhu nA~NghaL dhighaidhdhu eghamAygh ghUDhi adhaibhbhArbhbhoM.
idho, nI~NghaL jhUனiyadhdhiluM jhUனiyamAyirughghiRIrghaL; u~NghaL jhèyal vèRumaiyiluM vèRumaiyAனdhu; u~NghaLaidh dhèrindhughòLLughiRavaன aruvarubhbhAனvaன.

nAன vaDhaghgheyirundhu òruvaனai èzhuMbhabhbhaNNuveன, avaன varuvAன; jhUriyodhaya dhijhaiyilirundhu èன nAmadhdhaidh dhòzhudhughòLLuvAன; avaன vandhu adhibhadhighaLaijh jheRRaibhbholavuM, ghuyavaன ghaLimaNNai midhibhbhadhubholavuM midhibhbhAன.

nAM adhai aRiyuMbhaDhiyAgha Adhiyil jhòனனvaன yAr? nAM avaனai yadhArdhdhavAன èனRu jhòlluMbhaDhi bhUrvaghAladhdhil aRividhdhavaன yAr? aRivighghiRavaன òruvaனuM illaiye; uraighghiRavaனuM illaiye; u~NghaL vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhirughghiRavaனuM illaiye.
mudhal mudhal, nAனe, jhIyoனai noghghi: idho, avaighaLaibh bhArèனRu jhòlli èrujhalemughghu jhuvijheShagharaigh ghòDhughghiReன.
nAன bhArdhdheன, avarghaLil aRivighghiRavaன òruvaனumillai; nAன gheDhghu~N ghAriyadhdhughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharaM ghòDhughghadhdhaghgha òru AlojhaனaighghAraனuM avarghaLil illai.
idho, avarghaL èllAruM mAyai, avarghaL ghiriyaighaL virudhA; avarghaLuDhaiya vighghiragha~NghaL ghARRuM vèRumaiyundhAனe.

idho, nAன AdharighghiRa èன dhAjhaன, nAன dhèrindhughòNDhavaruM, èன AdhdhumAvughghubh bhiriyamAனvaruM ivare; èன Aviyai avarmel amarabhbhaNNiனeன; avar bhuRajAdhighaLughghu niyAyadhdhai vèLibhbhaDhudhdhuvAr.
avar ghUghghuraliDhavumADhDhAr, dhaMmuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhai uyardhdhavuM adhai vIdhiyile gheDhghabhbhaNNavumADhDhAr.
avar nèrindha nANalai muRiyAmaluM, ma~NghiyèrighiRa dhiriyai aNaiyAmaluM, niyAyadhdhai uNmaiyAgha vèLibhbhaDhudhdhuvAr.
avar niyAyadhdhaibh bhUmiyile nilaibhbhaDhudhdhumaDhDhuM iLaghgharibhbhadhumillai, bhadhaRuvadhumillai; avaruDhaiya vedhadhdhughghudh dhIvughaL ghAdhdhirughghuM.

vAன~NghaLaijh jhiruShDhidhdhu, avaighaLai viridhdhu, bhUmiyaiyuM, adhile uRbhadhdhiyAghiRavaighaLaiyuM bharabhbhiனvaruM, adhil irughghiRa jaனdhdhughghugh jhuvAjhadhdhaiyuM, adhil naDhamADhughiRavarghaLughghu AviyaiyuM ghòDhughghiRavarumAன ghardhdharAghiya dhevaன jhòllughiRadhAvadhu.
nIr ghuruDharuDhaiya ghaNghaLaidh dhiRaghghavuM, ghaDhDhuNDhavarghaLaigh ghAvalilirundhuM, iruLil irughghiRavarghaLaigh jhiRaijhjhAlaiyilirundhuM viDhuvighghavuM,
ghardhdharAghiya nAன nIdhiyiனbhaDhi uMmai azhaidhdhu, uMmuDhaiya ghaiyaibhbhiDhidhdhu, uMmaidh dhaRghAdhdhu, uMmai jaனdhdhiRghu uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyAghavuM, jAdhighaLughghu òLiyAghavuM vaighghiReன.
nAன ghardhdhar, idhu èன nAmaM; èன maghimaiyai veRòruvaனughghuM, èன dhudhiyai vighghiragha~NghaLughghuM ghòDheன.
bhUrvaghAladhdhil dhèrivighghabhbhaDhDhavaighaL, idho, niRaiveRalAyiன; bhudhiyavaighaLaiyuM nAனe aRivighghiReன; avaighaL dhoனRAdhadhaRghu muனனe, avaighaLai u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

jhamudhdhiradhdhil yAdhdhiraibhaNNughiRavarghaLe, adhiluLLavaighaLe, dhIvughaLe avaighaLiன ghuDhighaLe, ghardhdharughghubh bhudhubhbhADhDhaibh bhADhu~NghaL; bhUmiyiன ghaDhaiyAndharadhdhilirundhu avaruDhaiya dhudhiyaibh bhADhu~NghaL.

vaனAndharamuM, adhiன UrghaLuM, ghedhAriyA ghuDhiyirughghiRa ghirAma~NghaLuM uradhdha jhadhdhamiDhaghghaDhavadhu; ghaனmalaighaLile ghuDhiyirughghiRavarghaL ghèMbhIridhdhu, bharvadha~NghaLiன ghòDhumuDhiyilirundhu ArbhbharibhbhArghaLAgha.
ghardhdharughghu maghimaiyaijhjhèludhdhi, avar dhudhiyaidh dhIvughaLil aRivibhbhArghaLAgha.
ghardhdhar bharAghghiramajhAliyaibhbhol bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, yudhdhavIraனaibhbhol vairAghghiyamUNDhu, muzha~Nghigh ghèrjhjhidhdhu, dhaMmuDhaiya jhadhdhurughghaLai meRghòLLuvAr.
nAன vèghughAlaM mavuனmAyirundheன; jhuMmAyirundhu èனghghuLLe aDhaghghighghòNDhirundheன; ibhbhòzhudhu bhiLLai bhèRughiRavaLaibhbholajh jhadhdhamiDhDhu, avarghaLaibh bhAzhAghghi vizhu~Nghuveன.
nAன malaighaLaiyuM ghuனRughaLaiyuM bhAzhAghghi, avaighaLiluLLa bhUNDhughaLaiyèllAM vADhabhbhaNNi, ARughaLaidh dhiraDhDhughaLAghghi, erighaLai vaRRibhbhoghabhbhaNNuveன.

ghuruDharai avarghaL aRiyAdha vazhiyile naDhadhdhi, avarghaLughghudh dhèriyAdha bhAdhaighaLil avarghaLai azhaidhdhughghòNDhuvandhu, avarghaLughghu muனbhAgha iruLai vèLijhjhamuM, ghoNalaijh jhèvvaiyumAghghuveன; indhagh ghAriya~NghaLai nAன avarghaLughghujh jhèydhu, avarghaLaigh ghaiviDhAdhibhbheன.

nI anegha ghAriya~NghaLaigh ghaNDhuM ghavaனiyAdhirughghiRAy; avaனughghujh jhèvighaLaidh dhiRandhAluM gheLAdhe bhoghiRAன.
ghardhdhar dhamadhu nIdhiyiனimidhdhaM avaனmel bhiriyaM vaidhdhirundhAr; avar vedhadhdhai mughghiyabhbhaDhudhdhi adhai maghimaiyuLLadhAghghuvAr.

indha jaனmo ghòLLaiyiDhabhbhaDhDhuM, jhURaiyADhabhbhaDhDhuM irughghiRArghaL; avarghaL aனaivaruM ghèbhighaLile aghabhbhaDhDhu, ghAvalaRaighaLile aDhaighghabhbhaDhDhirughghiRArghaL, dhabhbhuvibhbhAr illAmal ghòLLaiyAghi, viDhDhuviDhu èனbhAr illAmal jhURaiyAvArghaL.
