ivarghaLmel avar dhamadhughobhadhdhiன ughghiradhdhaiyuM, yudhdhadhdhiன valimaiyaiyuM varabhbhaNNi, avarghaLaijhjhUzha aghghiனijuvAlaighaLaigh ghòLudhdhiyirundhuM uNarAdhirundhArghaL; adhu avarghaLaidh dhaghidhdhuM, adhaimaனdhile vaighghAdhebhoனArghaL.

ibhbhodhuM yAghghobhe, uனனaijh jhiruShDhidhdhavaruM isravele uனனai uruvAghghiனvarumAghiya ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhAvadhu bhayabhbhaDhAdhe; uனனai mIDhDhughghòNDheன; uனனaibh bherjhòlli azhaidhdheன; nI èனனuDhaiyavaன.

nI dhaNNIrghaLaigh ghaDhaghghuMbhodhu nAன uனனoDhu irubhbheன; nI ARughaLaigh ghaDhaghghuMbhodhu avaighaL uனmel bhuraLuvadhillai; nI aghghiனiyil naDhaghghuMbhodhu veghAdhirubhbhAy; aghghiனijuvAlai uனbheril bhaRRAdhu.
nAன israveliன bharijhudhdharuM, uன iraDhjhagharumAyirughghiRa uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar; uனனai mIDhghuMbhòruLAgha èghibhdhaiyuM, uனghghu IDhAgha èdhdhiyobhbhiyAvaiyuM jhebhAvaiyuM ghòDhudhdheன.
nI èன bhArvaighghu arumaiyAனbhaDhiyiனAl, ghaனMbhèRRAy; nAனuM uனனaijh jhineghidhdheன, AdhalAl uனghghubh bhadhilAgha maனuSharghaLaiyuM, uன jIvaனughghu IDhAgha jaன~NghaLaiyuM ghòDhubhbheன.
bhayabhbhaDhAdhe, nAன uனனoDhe irughghiReன; nAன uன jhandhadhiyaigh ghizhaghghilirundhu varabhbhaNNi, uனனai meRghiluM irundhu ghUDhDhijhjherbhbheன.
nAன vaDhaghghai noghghi ghòDhu èனRuM, dhèRghai noghghi: vaidhdhirAdhe èனRuM jhòlli, dhUradhdhilirundhu èன ghumAraraiyuM, bhUmiyiன ghaDhaiyAndharadhdhilirundhu èன ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM,
nAன èன maghimaighghèனRu jhiruShDhidhdhu uruvAghghibh bhaDhaidhdhu, èன nAmandharighghabhbhaDhDha yAvaraiyuM ghòNDhuvA èனbheன.
ghaNghaLirundhuM ghuruDharAyirughghiRa jaனdhdhaiyuM, ghAdhughaLirundhuM jhèviDharAyirughghiRavarghaLaiyuM bhuRabhbhaDhDhu varabhbhaNNu~NghaL.

jhaghala jAdhighaLuM eghamAyjh jherndhughòNDhu, jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM ghUDhivaraDhDhuM; idhai aRividhdhu, mundhi jhaMbhavibhbhavaighaLai namaghghudh dhèrivighghiRavaன yAr? gheDhDhu mèyyèனRu jhòllaghghUDhuMbhaDhighghu, avarghaL dha~NghaL jhADhjhighaLaigh ghòNDhuvandhu yadhArdhdhavAனghaLAy viLa~NghaDhDhuM.

nAனe avarèனRu nI~NghaL uNarndhu, èனனai aRindhu vijhuvAjhighghuMbhaDhighghu nI~NghaLuM nAன dhèrindhughòNDha èன dhAjhaனuM èனghghujh jhADhjhighaLAyirughghiRIrghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; èனghghu muன eRbhaDhDha dhevaன illai, èனghghubhbhiன irubhbhadhuM illai.
nAன, nAனe ghardhdhar; èனனaiyallAmal raDhjhaghar illai.

nAனe aRividhdhu, iraDhjhidhdhu, viLa~NghabhbhaNNiனeன; u~NghaLil ibhbhaDhijh jhèyyadhdhaghgha anniya dhevaன illai; nAனe, dhevaன èனbhadhaRghu nI~NghaL èனghghujh jhADhjhighaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
nAL uNDhaghAdhadhaRghu muனனuM nAனe irughghiReன; èன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvighghadhdhaghghavaன illai; nAன jhèyghiRadhaidh dhaDhubhbhavaன yAr?

nAன u~NghaLughghAgha araNghaLèllAM iDhindhuvizhavuM, ghaldheyar bhaDhavughaLilirundhu alaRavuM jhèyyadhdhaghghavarghaLaibh bhAbhiloனughghu aனubhbhiனeனèனRu, u~NghaL mIDhbharuM israveliன bharijhudhdharumAghiya ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
nAனe u~NghaL bharijhudhdharAghiya ghardhdharuM, israveliன jhiruShDhigharuM, u~NghaL rAjAvumAனvar.
jhamudhdhiradhdhile vazhiyaiyuM valiya dhaNNIrghaLile bhAdhaiyaiyuM uNDhAghghi,

iradha~NghaLaiyuM ghudhiraighaLaiyuM irANuva~NghaLaiyuM bharAghghiramajhAlighaLaiyuM bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNi, avaighaL èzhundhirAdhabhaDhighghu òrumidhdhu vizhundhughiDhaghghavuM, òru dhiri aNaindhu bhoghiRadhubhol avaighaL aNaindhubhoghavuMbhaNNughiRa ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhAvadhu:
mundhiனvaighaLai niனaighghaveNDhAM; bhUrvamAனvaighaLaijh jhindhighghaveNDhAM.
idho, nAன bhudhiya ghAriyadhdhaijh jhèyghiReன; ibhbhòzhudhe adhu dhoனRuM; nI~NghaL adhai aRiyIrghaLA? nAன vaனAndharadhdhile vazhiyaiyuM avAndharavèLiyile ARughaLaiyuM uNDhAghghuveன.

nAன dhèrindhughòNDha èன jaனdhdhiன dhAghadhdhughghu vaனAndharadhdhile dhaNNIrghaLaiyuM avAndharavèLiyile ARughaLaiyuM uNDhAghghuvadhiனAl, ghADhDhumirugha~NghaLuM, valujharbhbha~NghaLuM, ghoDhDhAன ghu~njhughaLuM èனனaigh ghaனMbhaNNuM.
indha jaனdhdhai èனghghèனRu eRbhaDhudhdhiனeன; ivarghaL èன dhudhiyai jhòllivaruvArghaL.
AனAluM yAghghobhe, nI èனனai noghghigh ghUbhbhiDhavillai; isravele, nI èனனaighghuRidhdhu maன~njhalidhdhubhbhoனAy.

uன ADhughaLai dhaghaனbhalighaLAgha nI èனghghujh jhèludhdhavillai; uன bhalighaLAle nI èனனaigh ghaனMbhaNNavumillai; ghANighghaighaLaijh jhèludhdhuMbhaDhi nAன uனனaijh jha~NghaDhabhbhaDhudhdhAmaluM, dhUbha~NghADhDhuMbhaDhi uனனai varudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhAmaluM irundheன.

nI èனghghubh bhaNa~NghaLAl jhughandhabhaDhDhayaigh ghòLLAmaluM, uன bhalighaLiன niNadhdhiனAl èனனaidh dhirubhdhiyAghghAmaluM, uன bhAva~NghaLiனAl èனனaijh jha~NghaDhabhbhaDhudhdhi, uன aghghirama~NghaLiனAl èனனai varudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhiனAy.
nAன, nAனe uன mIRudhalghaLai èன nimidhdhamAghave ghulaidhdhubhbhoDhughiReன; uன bhAva~NghaLai niனaiyAmaluM irubhbheன.
nAM òruvaroDhòruvar vazhaghghADhuMbhaDhi èனghghu niனaibhbhUDhDhu; nI nIdhimAனAgha viLa~NghuMbhaDhi uன ghAriyadhdhaijh jhòl.
uன Adhidhaghabhbhaன bhAva~njhèydhAன; uனghghu muனனiனRu bhejhughiRavarghaLuM èனghghu virodhamAydh dhuroghaMbhaNNiனArghaL.
AghaiyAl, nAன bharijhudhdhasdhaladhdhiன dhalaivarghaLaibh bharijhudhdhaghghulaijhjhalAghghi, yAghghobhaijh jhAbhadhdhughghuM, isravelai nindhaனaighghuM òbhbhughghòDhubhbheன.
ibhbhodhuM, èன dhAjhaனAghiya yAghghobhe, nAன dhèrindhughòNDha isravele, gheL.

uனனai uNDhAghghiனvaruM, dhAyiன gharbhbhadhdhil uனனai uruvAghghiனvaruM, uனghghudh dhuNaijhèyghiRavarumAghiya ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhAvadhu; èன dhAjhaனAghiya yAghghobhe, nAன dhèrindhughòNDha yèShUraனe, bhayabhbhaDhAdhe.
dhAghamuLLavaனmel dhaNNIraiyuM, vaRaNDha niladhdhiனmel ARughaLaiyuM URRuveன; uன jhandhadhiyiனmel èன AviyaiyuM, uன jhandhAனdhdhiனmel èன AjhIrvAdhadhdhaiyuM URRuveன.
adhiனAl avarghaL bhulliன naDhuve nIrghghAlghaLiன oradhdhiluLLa alarijhjhèDhighaLaibhbhola varuvArghaL.
òruvaன, nAன ghardhdharuDhaiyavaன èனbhAன; òruvaன yAghghobhiனbheraidh dharidhdhughghòLvAன; òruvaன, dhAன ghardhdharuDhaiyavaன èனRu ghaiyèzhudhdhubhbhoDhDhu, israveliன nAmadhdhaidh dharidhdhughghòLvAன.
nAன mundhiனvaruM, nAன bhindhiனvarundhAனe; èனனaidhdhavira dhevaன illaiyèனRu, israveliன rAjAvAghiya ghardhdharuM, jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharAghiya avaனuDhaiya mIDhbharuM jhòllughiRAr.

bhUrvaghAladhdhu jaன~NghaLai nAன sdhAbhidhdhadhu mudhaRghòNDhu, èனனaibhbhola èdhaiyAghiluM varavazhaidhdhu, iனனiனனdhèனRu muனனRividhdhu, èனghghu muனனe varijhaiyAgha niRudhdhadhdhaghghavaன yAr? nighazhghAriya~NghaLaiyuM varu~NghAriya~NghaLaiyuM dha~NghaLughghu avarghaL aRivighghaDhDhuM.

nI~NghaL ghala~NghAmaluM bhayabhbhaDhAmaluM iru~NghaL; aghghAlamudhaRghòNDhu nAன adhai uனghghu viLa~NghabhbhaNNiனdhuM muனனRividhdhadhumillaiyo? idhaRghu nI~NghaLe èன jhADhjhighaL, èனனaidh dhavira dhevaனuNDho? veRòru ghaனmalaiyuM illaiye; òruvaனaiyuM aRiyeன.

vighghiragha~NghaLai uruvAghghughiRa yAvaruM vINar; avarghaLAl ijhjhighghabhbhaDhDhavaighaL òனRughghuM udhavAdhu; avaighaL òனRuM ghANAmaluM, òனRuM aRiyAmaluM irughghiRadhèனRu dha~NghaLughghu vèDhghamuNDhAgha avaighaLughghudh dhA~NghaLe jhADhjhighaLAyirughghiRArghaL.
òனRughghuM udhavAdha dhèyvadhdhai uruvAghghi, vighghiraghadhdhai vArbhbhighghiRavaன èbhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavaன?
idho, avaனuDhaiya ghUDhDhALighaLèllAruM vèDhghamaDhaivArghaL; dhòzhilALighaL narajIvaனghaLdhAனe; avarghaL èllAruM ghUDhivandhu niRghaDhDhuM, avarghaL eghamAydh dhighaidhdhuvèDhghabhbhaDhuvArghaL.

ghòllaன iruMbhaigh ghuRaDhDhAl iDhughghi, ulaiyile ghAyavaidhdhu, jhudhdhighaLAl adhai uruvAghghi, dhaனbhuyabhaladhdhiனAl adhaibh bhaNbhaDhudhdhughiRAன; bhaDhDhiனiyAyirundhu bhèlaனRRubhbhoghiRAன; dhaNNIr ghuDhiyAmal ghaLaidhdhubhbhoghiRAன.

dhajhjhaன nUlbhiDhidhdhu, maDhDhabhbhalaghaiyAl maradhdhughghugh ghuRibhoDhDhu uLighaLiனAl urubhbhaDhudhdhi ghavarAjhadhdhiனAl adhai vaghudhdhu, maனuSha jhAyalAgha maனuSharUbhadhdhiனbhaDhi uruvamAghghughiRAன; adhaigh ghovilile nADhDhi vaighghiRAன.

avaன dhaனghghugh ghedhurughghaLai vèDhDhughiRAன; òru marudhamaradhdhaiyAvadhu gharvAlimaradhdhaiyAvadhu, dhèrindhughòNDhu, ghADhDhumara~NghaLile bhèladhdha maradhdhaidh dhaன ghAriyadhdhughghAgha vaLarghghiRAன; alladhu ajhoghamaradhdhai naDhughiRAன, mazhai adhai vaLarajhjhèyyuM.

maனuShaனughghu avaighaL aDhubhbhughghAghuMbhodhu, avaன avaighaLil èDhudhdhugh ghuLirghAyghiRAன; nèrubhbhaimUDhDhi abhbhamuM jhuDhughiRAன; adhiனAl òru dhèyvadhdhaiyuM uNDhubhaNNi, adhaibh bhaNindhughòLLughiRAன; òru vighghiraghadhdhaiyuM adhiனAl jhèydhu, adhai vaNa~NghughiRAன.

adhil òru dhuNDhai aDhubhbhil èrighghiRAன; òru dhuNDhiனAl iRaijhjhiyaijh jhamaidhdhubh bhujhidhdhu, bhòriyalaibhbhòridhdhu dhirubhdhiyAghi ghuLiru~NghAyndhu: AA, aனlAனeன; nèrubhbhaigh ghaNDheன èனRu jhòlli;
adhil mIdhiyAன dhuNDhaidh dhaனghghu vighghiraghadhèyvamAghajh jhèydhu, adhaRghumuன vizhundhu, adhai vaNa~Nghi; nI èன dhèyvaM, èனனai iraDhjhighgha veNDhuM èனRu adhai noghghi maனRADhughiRAன.
aRiyAmaluM uNarAmalumirughghiRArghaL; ghANAdhabhaDhighghu avarghaL ghaNghaLuM, uNarAdhabhaDhighghu avarghaL irudhayamuM aDhaighghabhbhaDhDhirughghiRadhu.

adhil bhAdhiyai aDhubhbhil èridhdheன; adhiன dhazhaliனmel abhbhadhdhaiyuM jhuDhDhu, iRaijhjhiyaiyuM bhòridhdhubh bhujhidhdheன; adhil mIdhiyAன dhuNDhai nAன aruvarubhbhAன vighghiraghamAghghalAmA? òru maraghghaDhDhaiyai vaNa~NghalAmA èனRu jhòlla, dhaன maனdhil avaனughghudh dhoனRavillai; aMmAdhdhiraM aRivuM jhòraNaiyuM illai.

avaன jhAMbhalai meyghiRAன; va~njhighghabhbhaDhDha maனM avaனai mojhabhbhaDhudhdhiனdhu; avaன dhaன AdhdhumAvaidh dhabhbhuvighghAmaluM; èன valadhughaiyile abhadhdhaM allavo irughghiRadhèனRu jhòllAmaluM irughghiRAன.
yAghghobhe, isravele, ivaighaLai niனai; nI èன dhAjhaன; nAன uனனai uruvAghghiனeன; nI èன dhAjhaன; isravele, nI èனனAl maRaghghabhbhaDhuvadhillai.
uன mIRudhalghaLai meghadhdhaibhbholavuM, uன bhAva~NghaLaigh ghArmeghadhdhaibhbholavuM aghaRRiviDhDheன; èனனiDhadhdhil dhiruMbhu; uனனai nAன mIDhDhughghòNDheன.

vAன~NghaLe, ghaLidhdhubh bhADhu~NghaL; ghardhdhar idhaijh jhèydhAr; bhUdhaladhdhiன dhAzhviDha~NghaLe, Arbhbhariyu~NghaL; bharvadha~NghaLe, ghADhughaLe, ghADhDhiluLLa jhaghala mara~NghaLe, ghèMbhIramAy muzha~Nghu~NghaL; ghardhdhar yAghghobhai mIDhDhu, isravelile maghimaibhbhaDhughiRAr.

uன mIDhbharuM, dhAyiன gharbhbhadhdhil uனனai uruvAghghiனvarumAன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhAvadhu: nAனe èllAvaRRaiyuM jhèyghiRa ghardhdhar, nAன òruvarAy vAன~NghaLai viridhdhu, nAனe bhUmiyaibh bharabhbhiனvar.
nAன ghaDhDhughghadhaighghArariன ghuRighaLai abhadhdhamAghghi, ghuRijhòllughiRavarghaLai nirmUDharAghghi, ~nAனighaLai vèDhghabhbhaDhudhdhi, avarghaL aRivaibh bhaidhdhiyamAghabh bhaNNughiRavar.

nAன èன UzhiyaghghArariன vArdhdhaiyai nilaibhbhaDhudhdhi, èன sdhAனAbhadhighaLiன Alojhaனaiyai niRaiveRRi: ghuDhiyeRuvAy èனRu èrujhalemughghuM, ghaDhDhabhbhaDhuvIrghaL èனRu yUdhAviன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLughghuM jhòlli, avaighaLiன bhAzhAன sdhala~NghaLai èDhubhbhibhbhavar.

ghorejhaigh ghuRidhdhu: avaன èன meybhbhaன; avaன èrujhalemai noghghi nI ghaDhDhabhbhaDhu èனRuM; dhevAlayadhdhai noghghi: nI asdhibhArabhbhaDhu èனRuM jhòlli, èனghghubh bhiriyamAனdhaiyèllAM niRaiveRRuvAன èனRu jhòllughiRavar nAன.

ghardhdharAghiya nAன abhiSheghaMbhaNNiன ghorejhughghu muனbhAgha jAdhighaLaigh ghIzhbhbhaDhudhdhi, rAjAghghaLiன iDhaighghaDhDhughaLai avizhghghuMbhaDhighghuM, avaனughghu muனbhAgha vAjhalghaL bhUDhDhabhbhaDhAdhirughgha, ghadhavughaLaidh dhiRandhuvaighghuMbhaDhighghuM, avaனaibhbhArdhdhu, avaன valadhughaiyaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu, avaனughghujh jhòllughiRadhAvadhu:
nAன uனghghu muனனe bhoy, ghoNalAனvaighaLaijh jhèvvaiyAghghuveன.
uனனaibh bhèyarjhòlli azhaighghiRa israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar nAனe èனRu nI aRiyuMbhaDhighghu,

nAனe ghardhdhar, veRòruvarillai; èனனaidhdhavira dhevaன illai.

èனனaidhdhavira òruvaruM illaiyèனRu jhUriyaன udhighghiRa dhijhaiyiluM, adhu asdhamighghiRa dhijhaiyiluM aRiyabhbhaDhuMbhaDhighghu nI èனனai aRiyAdhirundhuM, nAன uனghghu iDhaighghaDhDhu ghaDhDhiனeன; nAனe ghardhdhar, veRòruvar illai.
òLiyaibh bhaDhaidhdhu, iruLaiyuM uNDhAghghiனeன, jhamAdhAனdhdhaibh bhaDhaidhdhu dhI~NghaiyuM uNDhAghghughiRavar nAனe; ghardhdharAghiya nAனe ivaighaLaiyèllAM jhèyghiRavar.

vAன~NghaLe uyara irundhu jhòriyu~NghaL; AghAyamaNDhala~NghaL nIdhiyaibhbhòzhiyaghghaDhavadhu; bhUmi dhiRavuNDhu, iraDhjhibhbhiன ghaனiyaidhdhandhu, nIdhiyu~NghUDha viLaivadhAgha; ghardhdharAghiya nAன ivaighaLai uNDhAghghughiReன.

maNNoDhughaLughghòdhdha oDhAyirundhuM, dhaனனai uruvAghghiனvaroDhe vazhaghghADhughiRavaனughghu aiyo! ghaLimaN dhaனனai uruvAghghiனvaனai noghghi: èனன jhèyghiRAyèனRu jhòlladhdhaghumo? uன ghiriyaiyAனdhu: avarughghugh ghaighaLillaiyèனRu jhòllalAmo?
dhaghabhbhaனai noghghi: eன janibhbhidhdhAy èனRuM, dhAyai noghghi: eன bhèRRAy èனRuM jhòllughiRavaனughghu aiyo!

èghibhdhiன jhaMbhAdhdhiyamuM, èdhdhiyobhbhiyAviன vardhdhaghalAbhamuM, nèDhiya ADhghaLAghiya jhabheyariன vardhdhaghalAbhamuM, uனனiDhadhdhiRghudh dhANDhivandhu, uனனuDhaiyadhAghuM; avarghaL uன bhiனனe jhèனRu, vila~NghiDhabhbhaDhDhu naDhandhuvandhu: uனனuDhaனemAdhdhiraM dhevaன irughghiRAr èனRuM, avaraiyallAmal veRe dhevaன illaiyèனRuM jhòlli, uனனaibhbhaNindhughòNDhu, uனனai noghghi viNNabhbhaMbhaNNuvArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
israveliன dhevaனuM iraDhjhagharumAghiya nIr mèyyAghave uMmai maRaidhdhughghòNDhirughghiRa dhevaனAyirughghiRIr.

isravelo ghardhdharAle nidhdhiya iraDhjhibhbhiனAl iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhuvAன; nI~NghaL èனRèனRaighghumuLLa jhadhAghAla~NghaLiluM vèDhghabhbhaDhAmaluM ghala~NghAmaluM irubhbhIrghaL.

vAன~NghaLaijh jhiruShDhidhdhu bhUmiyaiyuM vèRumaiyAyirughghajh jhiruShDhiyAmal adhaigh ghuDhiyirubhbhughghAghajhjhèydhu bhaDhaidhdhu, adhai uruveRbhaDhudhdhiன dhevaனAghiya, ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhAvadhu: nAனe ghardhdhar, veRòruvar illai.

nAன andhara~NghadhdhiluM bhUmiyiன andhaghAramAன iDhadhdhiluM bhejhiனdhillai; virudhAvAgha èனனaidh dheDhu~NghaLèனRu nAன yAghghobhiன jhandhadhighghujh jhòனனdhumillai; nAன nIdhiyaibhbhejhi, yadhArdhdhamAனvaighaLai aRivighghiRa ghardhdhar.

jAdhighaLiனiனRu dhabhbhiனvarghaLe, ghUDhDha~NghUDhi vAru~NghaL; eghamAyjh jheru~NghaL; dha~NghaL vighghiramAghiya maradhdhaijh jhumandhu, iraDhjhighghamADhDhAdha dhevaனaidh dhòzhudhughòLLughiRavarghaL aRivillAdhavarghaL.

nI~NghaL dhèrivighghuMbhaDhi jherndhu, eghamAy yojhaனaibhaNNu~NghaL; idhaibh bhUrvaghAlamudhaRghòNDhu viLa~NghabhbhaNNi annALdhuvaghghi idhai aRividhdhavar yAr? ghardhdharAghiya nAன allavo? nIdhibhararuM iraDhjhagharumAghiya èனனaiyallAmal veRe dhevaன illai; èனனaidhdhavira veRòruvaruM illai.
bhUmiyiன èllaiyè~NghumuLLavarghaLe, èனனai noghghibhbhAru~NghaL; abhbhòzhudhu iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhuvIrghaL; nAனe dhevaன, veRòruvaruM illai.

muzha~NghAl yAvuM èனghghu muனbhAgha muDha~NghuM, nAvu yAvuM èனனai muனனiDhDhu ANaiyiDhuM èனRu nAன èனனaighghòNDhe ANaiyiDhDhirughghiReன; indha nIdhiyAன vArdhdhai èன vAyilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhadhu; idhu mARuvadhu illaiyèனghiRAr.
ghardhdhariDhadhdhilmAdhdhiraM nIdhiyuM vallamaiyumuNDhèனRu avaனvaன jhòlli avariDhadhdhil vandhu jheruvAன; avarughghu virodhamAy èrijhjhalghòNDhirughghiRa yAvaruM vèDhghabhbhaDhuvArghaL.
israveliன jhandhadhiyAghiya yAvaruM ghardhdharughghuL nIdhimAனghaLAghghabhbhaDhDhu meனmaibhArADhDhuvArghaL.

bhel bhaNiyuM, nebho ghuனiyuM, avaighaLiன vighghiragha~NghaL ghADhDhumirugha~NghaLughghuM nADhDhumirugha~NghaLughghuM jhumaiyAghuM; nI~NghaL jhumandha jhumaighaL iLaidhdhubhbhoன mirugha~NghaLughghubh bhAramAyirughghuM.
avaighaL eghamAygh ghuனindhubhaNiyuM; jhumaighaLai avaighaL dhabhbhuvighghamADhDhAdhu; avaighaL dhAme jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoghuM.

yAghghobhiன jhandhadhiyAre isravel jhandhadhiyil mIdhiyAghiya jhaghala jaன~NghaLe, èனghghujh jhèvighòDhu~NghaL; dhAyiன vayiRRil dhoனRiனdhumudhal u~NghaLai endhi, dhAyiன gharbhbhadhdhil uRbhadhdhiyAனdhumudhal u~NghaLaidh dhA~Nghiனeன,
u~NghaL mudhirvayadhuvaraighghuM nAன abhbhaDhijh jhèyveன; naraivayadhumaDhDhuM nAன u~NghaLaidh dhA~Nghuveன; nAன abhbhaDhijh jhèydhuvandheன; iனimeluM nAன endhuveன, nAன jhumabhbheன, dhabhbhuvibhbheன.
yArughghu èனனaijh jhAyaluM jhamamumAghghi, yArughghu nAன òbhbhAghuMbhaDhighghu èனனai òbhbhiDhuvIrghaL?

bhaiyilirughghiRa bhòனனaighghòDhDhi vèLLiyaidh dharAjhil niRudhdhu, dhaDhDhAனuDhaனe ghUlibhòrudhdhighghòLLughiRArghaL; avaன òru dhèyvadhdhai uNDhAghghughiRAன; adhai vaNa~Nghibh bhaNindhughòLLughiRArghaL.

adhaidh dhoLiனmel èDhudhdhu adhaijh jhumandhu, adhai adhiன sdhAனdhdhile vaighghiRArghaL; a~Nghe adhu niRghuM; dhaன iDhadhdhaiviDhDhu ajhaiyAdhu; òruvaன adhai noghghigh ghUbhbhiDhDhAl, adhu maRuudhdharavu ghòDhughghiRadhumillai, avaன ighghaDhDhai nIghghi avaனai iraDhjhighghiRadhumillai.
idhai niனaidhdhubh bhuruSharAyiru~NghaL; bhAdhaghare, idhai maனdhil vaiyu~NghaL.
mundhibh bhUrvaghAladhdhil naDhandhavaighaLai niனaiyu~NghaL; nAனe dhevaன, veRòruvaruM illai; nAனe dhevaன èனghghujh jhamAனmillai.

andhadhdhiluLLavaighaLai AdhimudhaRghòNDhuM, iனனuM jhèyyabhbhaDhAdhavaighaLaibh bhUrvaghAlamudhaRghòNDhuM aRivighghiReன; èன Alojhaனai nilainiRghuM, èனghghujh jhidhdhamAனvaighaLaiyèllAM jhèyveன èனRu jhòlli,

urAy~njhughiRa òru bhaDhjhiyaigh ghizhaghghilirundhuM, èன Alojhaனaiyai niRaiveRRuM maனuShaனai dhUradhejhadhdhilirundhuM varavazhaighghiRavarAyirughghiReன; adhaijh jhòனனeன, adhai niRaiveRRuveன; adhaidh dhiDhDhaMbhaNNiனeன. adhaijh jhèydhu muDhibhbheன.
muraDhDhu irudhayamuLLavarghaLe, nIdhighghudh dhUramAனvarghaLe, èனghghujhjhèvighòDhu~NghaL.

èன nIdhiyaijh jhamIbhighghabhbhaNNughiReன, adhu dhUramAyirubhbhadhillai; èன iraDhjhibhbhudh dhAmadhibhbhadhumillai; nAன jhIyoனil iraDhjhibhbhaiyuM, isravelughghu èன maghimaiyaiyuM ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuveன.

bhAbhiloன ghumAradhdhiyAghiya ghaனனighaiye, nI iRa~Nghi maNNile uDhghAru; ghaldheyariன ghumAradhdhiye, dharaiyile uDhghAru; uனghghujh jhi~NghAjhaனmillai; nI jhèrughghughghAriyuM jhughajhèlviyuM èனRu iனi azhaighghabhbhaDhuvadhillai.
endhiradhdhai èDhudhdhu mAvarai; uன mughghADhDhai nIghghiviDhu; vèRu~NghAluM aMmaNadhdhòDhaiyumAy ARughaLaigh ghaDhandhubho.
uன nirvANaM vèLibhbhaDhuM; uன ilajhjhai ghANabhbhaDhuM; nAன òruvaனaiyuM bhArAmal nIdhiyaijh jharighghaDhDhuveன.
è~NghaL mIDhbharuDhaiya nAmaM israveliன bharijhudhdharAghiya jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhar èனbhadhu.
ghaldheyariன ghumAradhdhiye, nI andhaghAradhdhughghuL bhiravejhidhdhu mavuனmAy uDhghAru; iனi nI rAjya~NghaLiன nAyaghiyèனRu azhaighghabhbhaDhuvadhillai.

nAன èன jaனdhdhiனmel ghaDhu~NghobhamaDhaindhu, èன jhudhandharadhdhaibh bharijhudhdhagh ghulaijhjhalAghghi, avarghaLai uன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdheன; nI avarghaLmel iraghghaMvaiyAmal, mudhirvayadhuLLavarghaLiனmel uன nughadhdhai maghA bhAramAghghi,
èனRèனRaighghuM nAyaghiyAyirubhbheனèனRu jhòlli, indhaghghAriya~NghaLai idhuvaraighghuM uன maனdhile vaiyAmaluM, adhiன muDhivai niனaiyAmaluM bhoனAy.

ibhbhòzhudhuM jhughajhèlviye, vijhAramillAmal vAzhghiRavaLe; nAனdhAன èனனaidhdhavira òruvarumillai; nAன vidhavaiyAvadhillai, nAன jhandhAன jhedhadhdhai aRivadhillaiyèனRu uன irudhayadhdhile jhòllughiRavaLe, nAன jhòllughiRadhaigh gheL.

jhandhAன jhedhamuM vidhavaiyirubhbhuM Aghiya ivviraNDhuM uனghghujh jhaDhidhiyAgha òrenALil varuM; uன dhiraLAன jhUனiya~NghaLiனimidhdhamuM, uன vèghuvAன sdhaMbhaன vidhdhaighaLiனimidhdhamuM avaighaL bhUraNamAy uனmel varuM.

uன dhuனmArghghadhdhile nI dhiDhanaMbhighghaiyAyirundhu: èனனaibh bhArghghiRavar òruvaruM illaiyèனRAy. uன ~nAனmuM uன aRivume uனனaigh ghèDhudhdhadhu; nAனdhAன, èனனaidhdhavira òruvarumillaiyèனRu uன irudhayadhdhil èNNiனAy.

AghaiyAl dhI~Nghu uனmel varuM, adhu è~Ngheyirundhu udhidhdhadhèனRu nI aRiyAy; vighghiனM uனmel varuM, nI adhai nivirdhdhiyAghghamADhDhAy; nI aRiyAdhabhaDhighghujh jhaDhidhiyAy uNDhAghuM bhAzhghghaDhibhbhu uனmel varuM.

nI uன jhiRuvayadhumudhal bhirayAjhabhbhaDhDhubh bhazhaghivarughiRa uன sdhaMbhaன vidhdhaighaLaiyuM, uன dhiraLAன jhUனiya~NghaLaiyuM nI anujharidhdhu nil; avaighaLAl uனghghubh bhirayojaனM uNDho, bhalaன uNDho, bhArbhbhoM.

uன dhiraLAன yojhaனaighaLiனAl nI iLaidhdhubhbhoனAy; ibhbhòzhudhuM jojhiyaruM, naDhjhadhdhiraM bhArghghiRavarghaLuM, amAvAjhi ghaNighghiRavarghaLuM èzhuMbhi, uனghghu neriDhughiRavaighaLughghu uனனai vilaghghi iraDhjhighghaDhDhuM.

idho, avarghaL dhALaDhiyaibhbhola irubhbhArghaL, nèrubhbhu avarghaLaijh jhuDhDhèrighghuM; avarghaL dha~NghaL bhirANaனai aghghiனijuvAlaiyiனiனRu viDhuvibhbhadhillai; adhu ghuLirghAyadhdhaghgha dhazhalumalla; èdhire uDhghAradhdhaghgha aDhubhbhumalla.
uன jhiRuvayadhumudhal nI bhirayAjhabhbhaDhDhu èvarghaLuDhaன viyAbhAraMbhaNNiனAyo, avarghaLuM abhbhaDhiye irubhbhArghaL, avaravar dha~NghaL bhoghghile bhoy alaivArghaL; uனனai iraDhjhibhbhAr illai.

isravelèனனuM bhèyarbhèRRu, yUdhAviன nIrURRilirundhu jhurandhavarghaLuM, ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhiனmel ANaiyiDhDhu, uNmaiyuM nIdhiyuM illAmal israveliன dhevaனai aRighghaiyiDhughiRavarghaLumAன yAghghobhiன vaMjhadhdhAre, gheLu~NghaL.
avarghaL dha~NghaLaibh bharijhudhdha nagharadhdhAr èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar èனனuM nAmamuLLa israveliன dhevaனmel bhaRRudhalAyirughghiRArghaL.
bhUrvaghAladhdhil naDhandhavaighaLai Adhimudhal aRividhdheன, avaighaL èன vAyilirundhu bhiRandhaன, avaighaLai vèLibhbhaDhudhdhiனeன; avaighaLaijh jhaDhidhiyAyjh jhèydheன, avaighaL naDhandhaன.
nI ghaDhiனmuLLavaனèனRuM, uன bhiDhari naraMbhu iruMbhèனRuM, uன nèRRi vèNghalamèனRuM aRindhirughghiReன.

AghaiyAl: èன vighghiraghaM avaighaLaijh jhèydhadhèனRuM, nAன jhèydha jhurUbhamuM, nAன vArbhbhidhdha vighghiraghamuM avaighaLaigh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhadhèனRuM nI jhòllAdhabhaDhighghu, nAன avaighaLai muனனme uனghghu aRividhdhu, avaighaL varAdhadhaRghumuனனe uனghghu vèLibhbhaDhudhdhiனeன.

avaighaLaigh gheLvibhbhaDhDhAye, avaighaLaiyèllAM bhAr, ibhbhòzhudhu nI~NghaLuM avaighaLai aRivighghalAmallavo? idhumudhal bhudhiyavaighaLAனvaighaLaiyuM, nI aRiyAdha maRaibhòruLAனvaighaLaiyuM uனghghudh dhèrivighghiReன.
avaighaL AdhimudhaRghòNDhu alla, ibhbhòzhudhe uNDhAghghabhbhaDhDhaன; idho, avaighaLai aRiveன èனRu nI jhòllAdhabhaDhighghu, innADhghaLughghu muனனe nI avaighaLaigh gheLvibhbhaDhavillai.

nI gheLvibhbhaDhavumillai, aRiyavumillai; Adhimudhal uன jhèvi dhiRandhirughghavumillai; nI dhuroghaMbhaNNuvAyèனbhadhaiyuM, dhAyiன gharbhbhandhòDha~Nghi nI mIRughiRa bhèyarbhèRRadhaiyuM aRindhirughghiReன.
èன nAmadhdhiனimidhdhaM èன ghobhadhdhai niRudhdhivaidhdheன; uனனaijh jha~NgharighghAdhabhaDhighghu nAன èன bhughazhjhjhiyiனimidhdhaM uனmel bhòRumaiyAyirubhbheன.
idho, uனனaibh bhuDhamiDhDheன; AனAluM vèLLiyaibhbholalla, ubhadhdhiravadhdhiன ghughaiyile uனனaidh dhèrindhughòNDheன.
èனனimidhdhaM, èனனimidhdhame abhbhaDhijh jhèyveன; èன nAmadhdhiன bharijhudhdhaM èbhbhaDhigh ghulaighghabhbhaDhalAM? èன maghimaiyai nAன veRòruvarughghu~NghòDheன.
yAghghobhe, nAன azhaidhdhirughghiRa isravele, èனghghujh jhèvighòDhu; nAன avare, nAன mundhiனvaruM nAன bhindhiனvarumAme.
èன gharame bhUmiyai asdhibhArabhbhaDhudhdhi, èன valadhughai vAன~NghaLai aLaviDhDhadhu; nAன avaighaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDha, avaighaL aனaidhdhuM niRghuM.

nI~NghaLèllAruM ghUDhivandhu gheLu~NghaL; ghardhdharughghubh bhiriyamAனvaன avarughghujh jhidhdhamAனdhaibh bhAbhiloனil jhèyvAன; avaன bhuyaM ghaldheyariனmel irughghuM èனbhadhai ivarghaLil aRividhdhavaன yAr?
nAன, nAனe adhaijh jhòனனeன; nAன avaனai azhaidhdheன; nAன avaனai varabhbhaNNiனeன; avaன vazhi vAyghghuM.

nI~NghaL èன jhamIbhadhdhil vandhu nAன jhòlvadhaigh gheLu~NghaL; nAன AdhimudhaRghòNDhu andhara~Nghadhdhil bhejhavillai; adhu uNDhAன ghAlandhuvaghghi a~Nghe nAன irundheன; ibhbhòzhudho ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavaruM, avaruDhaiya AviyuM èனனai aனubhbhughiRAr.

israveliன bharijhudhdharAyirughghiRa uன mIDhbharAன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhAvadhu: bhirayojaனmAyirughghiRadhai uனghghubh bhodhidhdhu, nI naDhaghghaveNDhiya vazhiyile uனனai naDhadhdhughiRa uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar nAனe.
A, èன ghaRbhaனaighaLaigh ghavaனidhdhAyAனAl nalamAyirughghuM; abhbhòzhudhu uன jhamAdhAனM nadhiyaibhbholuM, uன nIdhi jhamudhdhiradhdhiன alaighaLaibhbholuM irughghuM.

abhbhòzhudhu uன jhandhadhi maNaladhdhaனaiyAghavuM, uன gharbhbhabhbhiRabhbhu adhiன aNughghaLadhdhaனaiyAghavuM irughghuM; abhbhòzhudhu adhiன bhèyar naMmai viDhDhu aRRubhbhoghAmaluM azhighghabhbhaDhAmaluM irughghuM.

bhAbhiloனilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhu~NghaL; ghaldheyaraiviDhDhu oDhivAru~NghaL; ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya dhAjhaனAghiya yAghghobhai mIDhDhughghòNDhArèனRu jhòllu~NghaL; idhaigh ghèMbhIrajhadhdhamAygh ghURibh bhirajhidhdhabhbhaDhudhdhu~NghaL bhUmiyiன ghaDhaiyAndharamaDhDhuM vèLibhbhaDhudhdhu~NghaL èனghiRAr.

avar avarghaLai vaனAndhara~NghaLil naDhadhdhuMbhodhu, avarghaLughghudh dhAghaviDhAyirundhadhillai; ghaனmalaiyilirundhu dhaNNIrai avarghaLughghujh jhuraghghabhbhaNNiனAr, ghaனmalaiyaibh bhiLandhAr, dhaNNIr oDhivandhadhu.
dhuனmArghgharughghujh jhamAdhAனM illaiyèனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

dhIvughaLe, èனghghujh jhèvighòDhu~NghaL; dhUradhdhilirughghiRa jaன~NghaLe, ghavaனiyu~NghaL; dhAyiன gharbhbhadhdhilirundhadhumudhal ghardhdhar èனனai azhaidhdhu, nAன èன dhAyiன vayiRRil irughghaiyil èன nAmadhdhaibh bhirasdhAbhabhbhaDhudhdhiனAr.
avar èன vAyaigh ghUrmaiyAன bhaDhDhayamAghghi, dhamadhu gharadhdhiன nizhaliனAl èனனai maRaidhdhu, èனனaidh dhulaghghamAன aMbhAghghi, èனனaidh dhamadhu aMbhaRAdhdhUNiyile mUDhivaidhdhAr.
avar èனனai noghghi: nI èனdhAjhaன; isravele, nAன uனனil maghimaibhbhaDhuveன èனRAr.
adhaRghu nAன: virudhAvAy uzhaighghiReன, vINuM viyardhdhamumAy èன bhèlaனaijh jhèlavazhighghiReன; AghiluM èன niyAyaM ghardhdhariDhadhdhiluM, èன bhèlaன èன dhevaனiDhadhdhiluM irughghiRadhu èனRu jhòனனeன.

yAghghobhaidh dhaMmiDhadhdhil dhirubhbhuMbhaDhi nAன dhAyiன gharbhbhadhdhilirundhadhumudhal ghardhdhar dhamaghghudhdhAjhaனAgha èனனai uruvAghghiனAr; isravelo jherAdhebhoghiRadhu; AghiluM ghardhdharuDhaiya bhArvaiyil ghaனmaDhaiveன, èன dhevaன èன bhèlaனAyirubhbhAr.

yAghghobhiன ghodhdhira~NghaLai èzhubhbhavuM, isravelil ghAghghabhbhaDhDhavarghaLaidh dhirubhbhavuM, nIr èனghghudh dhAjhaனAyirubhbhadhu aRbhaghAriyamAyirughghiRadhu; nIr bhUmiyiன ghaDhaijhibhariyandhamuM èனனuDhaiya iraDhjhibhbhAyirughghuMbhaDhi, uMmai jAdhighaLughghu òLiyAghavuM vaibhbheன èனghiRAr.

israveliன mIDhbharuM adhiன bharijhudhdharumAghiya ghardhdhar, maனuSharAl ajhaDhDhaibhaNNabhbhaDhDhavaruM, jAdhiyArAl aruvarughghabhbhaDhDhavaruM, adhighArighaLughghu UzhiyaghghAraனumAyirughghiRavarai noghghi, uNmaiyuLLa ghardhdhar nimidhdhamuM, uMmaidh dhèrindhughòNDha israveliன bharijhudhdharnimidhdhamuM, rAjAghghaL ghaNDhu èzhundhirundhu, bhirabhughghaL bhaNindhughòLvArghaL èனRu jhòllughiRAr.

bhiனனuM ghardhdhar: anughghiragha ghAladhdhile nAன umaghghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhu, iraDhjhaNiyanALile umaghghu udhavijhèydheன; nIr bhUmiyaijh jhIrbhbhaDhudhdhi, bhAzhAyghghiDhaghghiRa iDha~NghaLaijh jhudhandharighghabhbhaNNavuM;

ghaDhDhuNDhavarghaLai noghghi: bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbho~NghaL èனRuM; iruLil irughghiRavarghaLai noghghi: vèLibhbhaDhu~NghaL èனRuM jhòllavuM, nAன uMmaigh ghAbhbhARRi, uMmai jaன~NghaLughghu uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyAgha eRbhaDhudhdhuveன; avarghaL vazhiyora~NghaLile meyvArghaL; jhaghala meDhughaLiluM avarghaLughghu meyjhjhal uNDhAyirughghuM.

avarghaL bhajhiyAyirubhbhadhumillai, dhAghamAyirubhbhadhumillai; uShNamAghiluM, vèyilAghiluM avarghaLmel bhaDhuvadhumillai; avarghaLughghu ira~NghughiRavar avarghaLai naDhadhdhi, avarghaLai nIrURRughaLiDhadhdhiRghugh ghòNDhubhoyviDhuvAr.
èன malaighaLaiyèllAM vazhighaLAghghuveன; èன bhAdhaighaL uyardhdhabhbhaDhuM.
idho, ivarghaL dhUradhdhilirundhu varuvArghaL; idho, avarghaL vaDhaghghiluM meRghilumirundhu varuvArghaL, ivarghaL jhIனIM dhejhadhdhilumirundhu varuvArghaL èனghiRAr.

vAன~NghaLe, ghèMbhIridhdhubhbhADhu~NghaL; bhUmiye, ghaLighUru; bharvadha~NghaLe, ghèMbhIramAy muzha~Nghu~NghaL; ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya jaனdhdhughghu ARudhal jhèydhAr; jhiRumaibhbhaDhDhirughghiRa dhaMmuDhaiyavarghaL mel iraghghamAyirubhbhAr.
jhIyoனo: ghardhdhar èனனaigh ghaiviDhDhAr, ANDhavar èனனai maRandhAr èனRu jhòllughiRAL.
sdhirIyAனvaL dhaன gharbhbhadhdhiன bhiLLaighghu ira~NghAmal, dhaன bhAlaghaனai maRabhbhALo? avarghaL maRandhAluM, nAன uனனai maRabhbhadhillai.
idho, èன uLLa~NghaighaLil uனனai varaindhirughghiReன; uன madhilghaL èbhbhodhuM èனmuன irughghiRadhu.
uன ghumArar dhIviridhdhu varuvArghaL; uனனai nirmUlamAghghiனvarghaLuM uனனaibh bhAzhAghghiனvarghaLuM uனனaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhovArghaL.

uன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhujh jhuRRiluM bhAr; avarghaLèllAruM eghamAyghghUDhi uனனiDhadhdhil varughiRArghaL; nI avarghaLèllAraiyuM AbharaNamAghadh dharidhdhu, maNamaghaL aNindhughòLvadhubhola, nI avarghaLai aNindhughòLvAy èனRu, èன jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu uன vaனAndhara~NghaLuM, uன bhAzhiDha~NghaLuM, nirmUlamAன uன dhejhamuM, iனigh ghuDhighaLiன dhiraLiனAle uனghghu nèrughghamAyirughghuM; uனனai vizhu~NghiனvarghaL dhUramAvArghaL.

bhiLLaighaLaRRirundha uனghghu uNDhAyirughghabhbhoghiRa bhiLLaighaL: iDhaM è~NghaLughghu nèrughghamAyirughghiRadhu; nA~NghaL ghuDhiyirughghuMbhaDhighghu vilaghiyiru èனRu, uன ghAdhughaL gheDhghajh jhòlluvArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu nI: ivarghaLai èனghghubh bhiRabhbhidhdhavar yAr? nAன bhiLLaighaLaRRuM, dhaனidhdhuM jhiRaibhbhaDhDhuM, nilaiyaRRuM irundheனe; ivarghaLai èனghghu vaLardhdhavar yAr? idho, nAன òனRiyAy viDhabhbhaDhDhirundheனe; ivarghaL è~NgheyirundhavarghaL? èனRu uன irudhayadhdhil jhòlluvAy.

idho, jAdhighaLughghu nerAgha èன gharadhdhai uyardhdhi, jaன~NghaLughghu nerAgha èன ghòDhiyai eRRuveன; abhbhòzhudhu uன ghumAraraigh ghòDhu~NghaighaLil endhighghòNDhu varuvArghaL; uன ghumAradhdhighaL dhoLiனmel èDhudhdhughghòNDhu varabhbhaDhuvArghaL èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.

rAjAghghaL uனனai vaLarghghuM dhandhaighaLuM, avarghaLuDhaiya nAyaghighaL uன ghaidhdhAyghaLumAyirubhbhArghaL; dharaiyile mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhu uனனaibh bhaNindhu, uன ghAlghaLiன dhULai naghghuvArghaL; nAன ghardhdhar, èனghghugh ghAdhdhirughghiRavarghaL vèDhghabhbhaDhuvadhillai èனbhadhai abhbhòzhudhu aRindhughòLvAy;
bharAghghiramaன ghaiyilirundhu ghòLLaibhbhòruLaibh bhaRighghaghghUDhumo? alladhu nIdhiyAyjh jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoனvarghaLai viDhuvighghaghUDhumo?

èனRAluM idho, bharAghghiramaனAl jhiRaibhbhaDhudhdhabhbhaDhDhavarghaLuM viDhuvighghabhbhaDhuvArghaL, bhèlavandhaனAl ghòLLaiyiDhabhbhaDhDhadhuM viDhudhalaiyAghghabhbhaDhuM; uனனoDhu vazhaghghADhughiRavarghaLoDhe nAன vazhaghghADhi, uன bhiLLaighaLai iraDhjhidhdhughghòLLuveன;

uனனai òDhughghiனvarghaLuDhaiya mAMjhadhdhai avarghaLughghe dhiனனghghòDhubhbheன; madhubhAனdhdhAl vèRighòLvadhubhol dha~NghaLuDhaiya iradhdhadhdhiனAl vèRighòLvArghaL; ghardhdharuM yAghghobhiன vallavarumAghiya nAன uன iraDhjhagharuM uன mIDhbharumAyirughghiRadhai mAMjhamAன yAvaruM aRindhughòLvArghaLèனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

nAன vandhabhodhu òruvaனuM illAmaRbhoனdhèனன? nAன ghUbhbhiDhDhabhodhu maRuudhdharavu ghòDhughgha òruvaனuM illAmaRbhoனdhèனன? mIDhghagh ghUDhAdhabhaDhighghu èன gharaM ghuRughiRRo? viDhuvighghiRadhaRghu èனனiDhadhdhil bhèlaனillAmaRbhoyiRRo? idho, èன ghaNDhidhadhdhiனAle ghaDhalai vaRRabhbhaNNi nadhighaLai vèDhDhAndharaiyAghghibhbhoDhughiReன; avaighaLiluLLa mIன dhaNNIrillAmal dhAghadhdhAl jhèdhdhu nARughiனRadhu.

aDhighghiRavarghaLughghu èன mudhughaiyuM, dhADhaimayiraibh bhiDhu~NghughiRavarghaLughghu èன dhADhaighaLaiyuM òbhbhughghòDhudhdheன; avamAனdhdhughghuM umizhnIrughghuM èன mughadhdhai maRaighghavillai.

èனனai nIdhimAனAghghughiRavar jhamIbhamAyirughghiRAr; èனனoDhe vazhaghghADhughiRavaன yAr? eghamAy niRbhomAgha, yAr èனghghu èdhirALi? avaன èனனiDhadhdhil varaDhDhuM.

u~NghaLil èvaன ghardhdharughghubh bhayandhu, avaruDhaiya dhAjhaனiன jhòllaigh gheDhDhu dhaனghghu vèLijhjhamillAdhadhiனAl iruDhDhile naDhaghghiRAனo, avaன ghardhdharuDhaya nAmadhdhai naMbhi, dhaன dhevaனaijh jhArndhughòLLaghghaDhavaன.

idho, nèrubhbhaigh ghòLudhdhi, aghghiனibhbhòRighaLAl jhUzhabhbhaDhDhirughghiRa nI~NghaL aனaivaruM, u~NghaL aghghiனi dhIbhadhdhiluM, nI~NghaL mUDhDhiன aghghiனi juvAlaiyiluM naDhavu~NghaL; vedhaனaiyil ghiDhabhbhIrghaL; èன gharadhdhiனAl idhu u~NghaLughghu uNDhAghuM.

nIdhiyaibh bhiனbhaRRi, ghardhdharaidh dheDhughiRa nI~NghaL èனghghujh jhèvighòDhu~NghaL; nI~NghaL vèDhDhi èDhughghabhbhaDhDha ghaனmalaiyaiyuM, nI~NghaL dhoNDhi èDhughghabhbhaDhDha dhuraviன ghuzhiyaiyuM noghghibhbhAru~NghaL.
u~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனAghiya AbhiraghAmaiyuM u~NghaLaibh bhèRRa jhArALaiyuM noghghibhbhAru~NghaL; avaன òruvaனAyirughghaiyil nAன avaனai azhaidhdhu, avaனai AjhIrvadhidhdhu avaனaibh bhèrughabhbhaNNiனeன.

ghardhdhar jhIyoனughghu ARudhaljhèyvAr; avar adhiன bhAzhAன sdhala~NghaLaiyèllAM dheRudhalaDhaiyajh jhèydhu, adhiன vaனAndharadhdhai edheனaibhbholavuM, adhiன avAndharavèLiyaigh ghardhdhariன dhoDhDhadhdhaibhbholavuM AghghuvAr; jhandhoShamuM maghizhjhjhiyuM dhudhiyuM ghIdhajhadhdhamuM adhil uNDhAyirughghuM.
èன jaன~NghaLe èனghghujh jhèvighòDhu~NghaL; èன jAdhiyAre, èன vAghghaigh ghavaனiyu~NghaL; vedhaM èனனilirundhu vèLibhbhaDhuM; èன bhiramANadhdhai jaன~NghaLiன vèLijhjhamAgha sdhAbhibhbheன.
èன nIdhi jhamIbhamAyirughghiRadhu; èன iraDhjhibhbhu vèLibhbhaDhuM; èன bhuya~NghaL jaன~NghaLai niyAyandhIrghghuM; dhIvughaL èனghghugh ghAdhdhirundhu, èன bhuyadhdhiனmel naMbhighghaiyAyirughghuM.

èzhuMbhu, èzhuMbhu, bhèlaனghòL; ghardhdhariன bhuyame mundhiன nADhghaLiluM bhUrva dhalaimuRaighaLiluM èzhuMbhiனbhaDhi èzhuMbhu; irAghAbhaidh dhuNDhidhdhadhuM valujharbhbhadhdhai vadhaidhdhadhuM nIdhAனllavo?
maghA Azhadhdhiன dhaNNIrghaLAghiya jhamudhdhiradhdhai vaRRibhbhoghabhbhaNNiனdhuM, mIDhghabhbhaDhDhavarghaL ghaDhandhubhoghagh ghaDhaliன bhaLLa~NghaLai vazhiyAghghiனdhuM nIdhAனllavo?

abhbhaDhiye ghardhdharAl mIDhghabhbhaDhDhavarghaL AனndhaghghaLibhbhuDhaனbhADhi jhIyoனughghudh dhiruMbhivaruvArghaL; nidhdhiya maghizhjhjhi avarghaL dhalaiyiனmel irughghuM; jhandhoShamuM maghizhjhjhiyuM aDhaivArghaL; jha~njhalamuM dhavibhbhuM oDhibhbhoM.

nAன, nAனe u~NghaLughghu ARudhal jhèyghiRavar; jhAghabhbhoghiRa maனuShaனughghuM, bhullughghòbhbhAghiRa maனubhudhdhiraனughghuM bhayabhbhaDhughiRadhaRghuM, vAன~NghaLai viridhdhu, bhUmiyai asdhibhArabhbhaDhudhdhi, uனனai uNDhAghghiன ghardhdharai maRaghghiRadhaRghuM nI yAr?
iDhughghaNjhèyghiRavaன azhighgha AyadhdhamAghiRabhodhu, nI avaனuDhaiya ughghiradhdhughghu nidhdhaM iDhaiviDhAmal bhayabhbhaDhughiRadhèனன? iDhughghaNjhèyghiRavaனuDhaiya ughghiraM è~Nghe?
jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoனvaன dhIviramAy viDhudhalaiyAvAன; avaன ghiDha~Nghile jhAvadhumillai, avaனuDhaiya abhbhaM ghuRaivubhaDhuvadhumillai.

èzhuMbhu, èzhuMbhu, jhIyoனe, uன vallamaiyaidh dharidhdhughghòL; bharijhudhdha nagharamAghiya èrujhaleme, uன ala~NghAra vasdhira~NghaLai uDhudhdhighghòL; virudhdhajhedhaனmillAdhavaனuM ajhudhdhaனuM iனi uனனiDhadhdhil varuvadhillai.

vilaiyiனRi viRghabhbhaDhDhArghaL, bhaNamiனRi mIDhghabhbhaDhuvIrghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

jhamAdhAனdhdhaigh ghURi, naRghAriya~NghaLaijh jhuvijheShamAy aRividhdhu, iraDhjhibhbhaibh bhirajhidhdhabhbhaDhudhdhi: uன dhevaன rAjarighaM bhaNNughiRArèனRu jhIyoனughghujh jhòllughiRa jhuvijheShaghaனuDhaiya bhAdha~NghaL malaighaLiனmel èvvaLavu azhaghAyirughghiனRaன.

èrujhalemiன bhAzhAன sdhala~NghaLe, muzha~Nghi eghamAygh ghèMbhIridhdhubh bhADhu~NghaL; ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya jaன~NghaLughghu ARudhaljhèydhu èrujhalemai mIDhDhughghòNDhAr.

idho, èன dhAjhaன ~nAனmAy naDhabhbhAr, avar uyardhdhabhbhaDha meனmaiyuM maghA uனனdhamumAyirubhbhAr.

abhbhaDhiye, avar aneghaM jAdhighaLmel dhèLibhbhAr; avarnimidhdhaM rAjAghghaL dha~NghaL vAyai mUDhuvArghaL; eனèனil, dha~NghaLughghudh dhèrivighghabhbhaDhAdhirundhadhai avarghaL ghANbhArghaL; gheLvibhbhaDhAdhirundhadhai avarghaL aRindhughòLvArghaL.
è~NghaL mUlamAygh gheLvibhbhaDhDhadhai vijhuvAjhidhdhavaன yAr? ghardhdharuDhaiya bhuyaM yArughghu vèLibhbhaDhDhadhu?

iLa~NghiLaiyaibhbholavuM, vaRaNDha niladhdhilirundhu dhuLirghghiRa veraibhbholavuM avaனughghu muனbhAgha èzhuMbhughiRAr; avarughghu azhaghumillai, jhaundhariyamuM illai; avaraibh bhArghghuMbhodhu, nAM avarai viruMbhadhdhaghgha rUbhaM avarughghu illAdhirundhadhu.

avar ajhaDhDhaibhaNNabhbhaDhDhavaruM, dhughghaM niRaindhavaruM, bhADhu anubhavidhdhavarumAyirundhAr; avaraiviDhDhu, naMmuDhaiya mugha~NghaLai maRaidhdhugh ghòNDhoM; avar ajhaDhDhaibhaNNabhbhaDhDhirundhAr; avarai èNNAmaRbhoனoM.
mèyyAghave avar naMmuDhaiya bhADhughaLai eRRughghòNDhu, naMmuDhaiya dhughgha~NghaLaijh jhumandhAr; nAmo, avar dhevaனAl aDhibhaDhDhu vAdhighghabhbhaDhDhu, jhiRumaibhbhaDhDhavarèனRu èNNiனoM.

naMmuDhaiya mIRudhalghaLiனimidhdhaM avar ghAyabhbhaDhDhu, naMmuDhaiya aghghirama~NghaLiனimidhdhaM avar nòRughghabhbhaDhDhAr; namaghghujh jhamAdhAனdhdhai uNDhubhaNNuM Aghghiனai avarmel vandhadhu; avaruDhaiya dhazhuMbhughaLAl ghuNamAghiRoM.

iDhughghaNiluM niyAyadhdhIrbhbhilumirundhu avar èDhughghabhbhaDhDhAr; avaruDhaiya vaMjhadhdhai yArAl jhòlli muDhiyuM; jIvaனuLLoruDhaiya dhejhadhdhilirundhu aRubhbhuNDhu bhoனAr; èன jaனdhdhiன mIRudhaliனimidhdhaM avar vAdhighghabhbhaDhDhAr.

nobh, dhaghabhAனes èனனuM bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன bhudhdhiraruM, uன ujhjhandhalaiyai nòRughghiனArghaL.
uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uனனai vazhiyile naDhadhdhighghòNDhubhoghu~NghAladhdhil, nI avarai viDhDhubhbhoghiRadhiனAl allavo uனghghu neriDhabhbhaNNiனAy?

uன dhImai uனனaidh dhaNDhighghuM, uன mARubhADhughaL uனனaigh ghaNDhighghuM; nI uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharai viDhughiRadhuM, èனனaibh bhaRRuM bhayaM uனனiDhadhdhil illAmalirughghiRadhuM, èdhdhaனai bhòllAbhbhuM ghajhabhbhumAன ghAriyaM èனRu uNarndhughòL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.

bhUrvaghAlandhuvaghghi nAன uன nughadhdhaDhiyai muRidhdhu, uன ghaDhDhughaLai aRudhdheன; nAன aDhimaibhbhaDhuvadhillai èனRu nIyuM jhòனனAye; AghiluM, uyaramAன jhaghala meDhDhiனmeluM, bhajhjhaiyAன jhaghalamaradhdhiனghIzhuM nI vejhiyAydh dhirighiRAy.
nAன uனனai muRRiluM naRghaனidharuM uyarghuladh dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyAgha nADhDhiனeன; nI èனghghugh ghADhDhudhdhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyiன AghAdha ghòDhighaLAy mARibhbhoனdhu èனன?
nI uனனai uvarmaNNiனAle ghazhuvi, adhigha jhavughghAradhdhaigh ghaiyADhiனAluM uன aghghiramadhdhiன ghaRaighaL èனghghu muனbhAgha irughghumèனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.

nAன dhIDhDhubhbhaDhavillai; nAன bhAghAlghaLaibh bhiனbhaRRavillai èனRu nI èbhbhaDhijh jhòllughiRAy? bhaLLadhdhAghghile nI naDhaghghiRa mArghghadhdhaibh bhAr; nI jhèydhadhai uNarndhughòL; dhARumARAyoDhughiRa veghamAன bhèNNòDhDhaghaM nI.

vaனAndharadhdhile bhazhaghiனdhuM, dhaன ijhjhaiyiன madhavèRiyile ghARRai uDhghòLLughiRadhumAன ghADhDhughghazhudhai nI; adhiன Avalai niRudhdhi, adhaidh dhirubhbhughiRavaன yAr? adhaidh dheDhughiRavarghaL òruvaruM varudhdhabhbhaDhaveNDhiyadhillai; adhiன mAjhadhdhil adhaigh ghaNDhubhiDhibhbhArghaL.

uன ghAl vèRu~NghAlAghAdhabhaDhighghuM, uன dhòNDhai vaRaDhjhiyaDhaiyAdhabhaDhighghuM aDhaghghighghòL èனRAl nI: adhu ghUDhAdhaghAriyaM; nAன abhbhaDhijh jhèyyamADhDheன; anniyarai nejhighghiReன; avarghaL bhiRaghe bhoveன èனghiRAy.

dhiruDhaன aghabhbhaDhughiRabhodhu èbhbhaDhi vèDhghabhbhaDhughiRAனo, abhbhaDhiye isravel vaMjhadhdhAr vèDhghabhbhaDhuvArghaL; ghaDhamaiyaibh bhArdhdhu, nI èன dhaghabhbhaன èனRuM; ghallaibhbhArdhdhu nI èனனaibh bhèRRAy èனRuM jhòllughiRa avarghaLuM, avarghaL rAjAghghaLuM, avarghaL bhirabhughghaLuM, avarghaL AjhAriyarghaLuM, avarghaL dhIrghghadharijhighaLuM vèDhghabhbhaDhuvArghaL.
avarghaL dha~NghaL mughadhdhaiyalla, dha~NghaL mudhughai èனghghugh ghADhDhiனArghaL; dha~NghaL AbhadhdhughghAladhdhilo èzhundhu è~NghaLai iraDhjhiyuM èனghiRArghaL.

nI uனghghu uNDhubhaNNiன dhevarghaL è~Nghe uன AbhadhdhughghAladhdhil uனனai iraDhjhighghaghghUDhumAனAl avaighaL èzhuMbhaDhDhuM; yUdhAve, uன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன ilaghghamuM, uன dhevarghaLiன ilaghghamuM jhari.
èனனoDhe nI~NghaL vazhaghghADhuvAனeன? nI~NghaL aனaivaruM èனghghu virodhamAydh dhuroghaMbhaNNiனIrghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
nAன u~NghaL bhiLLaighaLai aDhidhdhadhu virudhA; jhiDhjhaiyai eRRughghòLLAmaRbhoனArghaL; azhighghiRa jhi~Nghadhdhaibhbhola u~NghaL bhaDhDhayaM u~NghaL dhIrghghagharijhighaLaibh bhaDhjhidhdhadhu.

jhandhadhiyAre, nI~NghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyai jhindhidhdhubhbhAru~NghaL; nAன isravelughghu vaனAndharamuM, ghAriruLAன bhUmiyumAgha irundheனo? bhiனனai eன èன jaன~NghaL; nA~NghaLe èjamAனghaL, iனi uMmiDhadhdhil nA~NghaL varuvadhillaiyèனRu jhòllughiRArghaL.
òru bhèN dhaன AbharaNadhdhaiyuM, òru maNavADhDhi dhaன ADhaighaLaiyuM maRabhbhALo? èன jaன~NghaLo èNNimuDhiyAdha nADhghaLAy èனனai maRandhuviDhDhArghaL.
nejhadhdhaidh dheDhuMbhaDhighghu nI uன vazhighaLai nayabhbhaDhudhdhughiRadhèனன? ivvidhamAy nI bhòllAdha sdhirIghaLughghuM uன vazhighaLaigh ghaRRughghòDhudhdhAy.

uன vasdhira ora~NghaLiluM ghuRRamillAdha ezhai AdhdhumAghghaLiன iradhdhaM ghANabhbhaDhughiRadhu; adhaidh dhoNDhidh dheDhughiRadhiனAl alla, adhu èllAvaRRiனmeluM vèLiyAyirughghiRadhiனAl adhaigh ghaNDhubhiDhidhdheன.

nI uன vazhiyai mARRimARRi ivvaLavAy vilaghibh bhoghiRadhu èனன? nI ajhIriyAviனAl vèDhghibhbhoனdhubhola èghibhdhiனAluM vèDhghibhbhovAy.

òru bhuruShaன dhaன maனaiviyaidh dhaLLiviDha, avaL avaனiDhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy anniyabhuruShaனughghu maனaiviyAனAl, avaன avaLiDhadhdhil iனidh dhiruMbhabhbhovAனo? andha dhejhaM mighavuM dhIDhDhubhbhaDhumallavo èனRu maனuShar jhòlluvArghaL; nIyovèனRAl anegha nejharoDhe vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNiனAy; AghiluM èனனiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhivA èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

nI meDhughaLiனmel uன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhu, nI vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNAdha iDhaM òனRu uNDho èனRu bhAr; vaனAndharadhdhile arabhiyaன ghAdhdhughghòNDhirughghiRadhubhola, nI vazhi ora~NghaLil uன nejharughghugh ghAdhdhughghòNDhirundhu, uன vejhidhdhaன~NghaLAluM, uன aghghirama~NghaLAluM dhejhadhdhaidh dhIDhDhubhbhaDhudhdhiனAy.
adhiனimidhdhaM mazhai varuShiyAmaluM bhiனmAriyillAmaluM bhoyiRRu; uனghgho, jhorasdhirIyiன nèRRiyirughghiRadhu; nIyo: nANamADhDheன èனghiRAy.
nI idhumudhal èனனai noghghi: èன bhidhAve, dhevarIr èன iLavayadhiன adhibhadhiyèனRu jhòlli,

bhirajhidhdhamAன avaLuDhaiya vejhidhdhaனdhdhiனAle dhejhaM dhIDhDhubhbhaDhDhubhbhoyiRRu; ghalloDhuM maradhdhoDhuM vibhajhAraM bhaNNighghòNDhirundhAL èனRAr.

nIyo, uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu virodhamAydh dhuroghaMbhaNNi, bhajhjhaiyAன jhaghala maradhdhiனghIzhuM anniyaroDhe jhoramArghghamAy naDhandhu, uன aghghiramadhdhaiyuM, èன jhadhdhadhdhughghujh jhèvighòDhAmaRbhoனdhaiyuM òdhdhughghòL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

aghghAladhdhile èrujhalemaigh ghardhdharuDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனM èனbhArghaL; jhaghala jAdhiyAruM èrujhalemil viLa~Nghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhiனimidhdhaM adhiனiDhamAghajh jhervArghaL; avarghaL iனidh dha~NghaL bhòllAdha irudhayadhdhiன ijhjhaiyiனbhaDhi naDhavArghaL.

annADhghaLile yUdhA vaMjhadhdhAr isravel vaMjhadhdhAroDhe jherndhu, avarghaL eghamAy vaDhadhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, nAன dha~NghaL bhidhAghghaLughghujh jhudhandharamAghagh ghòDhudhdha dhejhadhdhiRghu varuvArghaL,

òru maனaivi dhaன bhuruShaனughghudh dhuroghaM jhèyvadhubhola, isravel vaMjhadhdhArAghiya nI~NghaL èனghghudh dhuroghaMjhèydhadhu mèy èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

jhIrghèDhDha bhiLLaighaLe, dhiruMbhu~NghaL; u~NghaL jhIrgheDhughaLaigh ghuNamAghghuveன èனRAr. idho, uMmiDhadhdhil varughiRoM; nIre è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar
ghuனRughaLaiyuM dhiraLAன malaighaLaiyuM naMbhughiRadhu virudhA èனbhadhu mèy; israveliன iraDhjhibhbhu è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghuL irubhbhadhu èனbhadhu mèyye.

indha ilajhjhaiyAனdhu è~NghaL jhiRuvayadhumudhal è~NghaL bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya bhirayAjhadhdhaiyuM, avarghaL ADhughaLaiyuM mADhughaLaiyuM, avarghaL ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhaDhjhidhdhubhbhoDhDhadhu.

è~NghaL ilajhjhaiyile ghiDhaghghiRoM; è~NghaL avamAனM è~NghaLai mUDhiyirughghiRadhu; nA~NghaLuM, è~NghaL bhidhAghghaLuM è~NghaL jhiRuvayadhu mudhal innALvaraighghuM è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharughghu virodhamAghabh bhAva~njhèydhoM; è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhòllaigh gheLAmaluMbhoனoM.

nI uNmaiyoDhuM, niyAyadhdhoDhuM, nIdhiyoDhuM, ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhu ANaiyiDhuvAy; bhuRajAdhighaLuM avarughghuL AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhDhu, avarughghuL meனmaibhArADhDhuvArghaL.
yUdhA maனuSharoDhuM, èrujhalemiyaroDhuM ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: nI~NghaL muLLughaLughghuLLe vidhaiyAdhiru~NghaL, u~NghaL dharijhu niladhdhaibh bhaNbhaDhudhdhu~NghaL.

dhejhadhdhil èghghALaM Udhu~NghaL èனRu jhòlli, yUdhAvil aRividhdhu, èrujhalemil gheDhghabhbhaNNu~NghaL; nAM araNAன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLughghu uDhbhaDhuMbhaDhighghujh jheru~NghaL èனRu jhòlli, uradhdha jhadhdhamAygh ghUbhbhiDhu~NghaL.
jhIyoனughghu nere ghòDhiyeRRu~NghaL; ghUDhu~NghaL, niRghAdhiru~NghaL; nAன vaDhaghgheyirundhu bhòllAbhbhaiyuM, maghA jha~NghAradhdhaiyuM varabhbhaNNughiReன.

uன dhejhadhdhaibh bhAzhAghghi viDhuMbhaDhighghujh jhi~NghaM dhaன bhudharilirundhu èzhuMbhi, jAdhighaLaijh jha~NgharighghiRavaன dhaன sdhAனdhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu varughiRAன; uன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaL ghuDhiyirAdhabhaDhi azhighghabhbhaDhuM èனghiRAr.
idhiனimidhdhaM iraDhDhaigh ghaDhDhighghòLLu~NghaL; bhulaMbhi alaRu~NghaL; ghardhdharuDhaiya ughghiraghobhaM naMmaiviDhDhudh dhiruMbhavillaiye.
annALile rAjAviன irudhayamuM, bhirabhughghaLiன irudhayamuM maDhindhubhoM; AjhAriyarghaL dhiDhughghiDhDhu, dhIrghghadharijhighaL dhighaibhbhArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu nAன: A! ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavare, u~NghaLughghujh jhamAdhAனmirughghuM èனRu jhòனனdhiனAl, mèyyAghave indha jaனdhdhughghuM èrujhalemughghuM mighudhiyAன mojhadhdhai varabhbhaNNiனIr; bhaDhDhayaM bhirANaனmaDhDhuM èDhDhughiRadhe èனReன.

idhaibhbhArghghiluM bhalamAன ghARRu èன ghAriyamAy varuM; ibhbhòzhudhu nAனuM avarghaLoDhe niyAyaM bhejhuveன.

idho, megha~NghaLaibhbhola èzhuMbhivarughiRAன; avaனuDhaiya iradha~NghaL bhèru~NghARRaibhbholirughghiRadhu; avaன ghudhiraighaL ghazhughughaLiluM veghamAனvaighaL; namaghghu aiyo! nAM bhAzhAghghabhbhaDhughiRome.
èrujhaleme, nI iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhuMbhaDhighghu uன irudhayadhdhaibh bhòllAbhbhaRagh ghazhuvu; èndhamaDhDhuM aghghirama niனaivughaL uன uLLadhdhile dha~NghuM.

ghudhiraivIraruM vilvIraruM iDhuM jhadhdhadhdhiனAle jhaghala UrAruM oDhi, aDhardhdhiyAன ghADhughaLil bhughundhu, ghaனmalaighaLiluM eRuvArghaL; òru maனuShaனuM avaighaLile ghuDhiyirAdhabhaDhi èllA UrghaLuM viDhabhbhaDhDhirughghuM.

bhAzhAybhbhoன nI ibhbhòzhudhu èனன jhèyvAy? nI iradhdhAMbharaM uDhudhdhAluM, bhòனனAbharaNa~NghaLAl uனனaijh jhi~NghAridhdhAluM, uன ghaNghaLil maiyiDhDhughghòNDhAluM, vINAy uனனai azhaghubhaDhudhdhuvAy; jhoranAyaghar uனனai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNi, uன bhirANaனai vA~Nghadh dheDhuvArghaL.

nAன bhèriyorghaLiDhadhdhile bhoy, avarghaLoDhe bhejhuveன; avarghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya vazhiyaiyuM, dha~NghaL dhevaனuDhaiya niyAyadhdhaiyuM aRivArghaLèனRuM jhòனனeன; avarghaLo eghamAy nughadhdhaDhiyai muRidhdhu, ghaDhDhughaLai aRudhdhubhbhoDhDhArghaL.

AghaiyAl ghADhDhilirundhu varuM jhi~NghaM avarghaLaigh ghòlluM, vaனAndharadhdhiluLLa onAyghaL avarghaLaibh bhIRuM, jhivi~Nghi avarghaL bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiனmel noghghamAyirughghuM; avaighaLilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhughiRavaன èvaனuM bhIRabhbhaDhuvAன; avarghaL mIRudhalghaL bhèrughi, avarghaL jhIrgheDhughaL adhigharidhdhadhu.

ivaighaLai nAன uனghghu maனனibhbhadhu èbhbhaDhi? uன bhiLLaighaL èனனai viDhDhuviDhDhu, dhèyvaM allAdhavaighaLbheril ANaiyiDhughiRArghaL; nAன dhirubhdhiyAghghiன avarghaL vibhajhAraMbhaNNi vejhivIDhDhile ghUDhDha~NghUDhughiRArghaL
avarghaL ghòzhudhdha ghudhiraighaLaibhbhol ghAlame èzhuMbhi, avaனvaன dhaனdhaன ayalAனuDhaiya bhèNjAdhiyiன bhiனனAle ghaனaighghiRAன.
ivaighaLai vijhAriyAdhirubhbheனo? ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha jAdhighghu èன AdhdhumA nIdhiyaijh jharighghaDhDhAdhirughghumo èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
adhiன madhilghaLmeleRi azhidhdhubhbhoDhu~NghaL, AனAluM jharvajha~NghAraM jhèyyAdhiru~NghaL; adhiன ghòdhdhaLa~NghaLai iDhidhdhubhbhoDhu~NghaL; avaighaL ghardhdharuDhaiyavaighaL alla.

AghaiyAl jheனaighaLiன dhevaனAghi ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: nI~NghaL indha vArdhdhaiyaijh jhòனனbhaDhiyiனAl, idho, nAன uன vAyiliDhDha èன vArdhdhaighaLai aghghiனiyuM, indha jaனdhdhai viRaghuM Aghghuveன, adhu ivarghaLaibh bhaDhjhighghuM.

isravel vaMjhadhdhAre, idho, dhUradhdhilirundhu nAன u~NghaLmel òru jAdhiyaigh ghòNDhuvaruveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; adhu bhaladhdha jAdhi, adhu bhUrvaghAladhdhu jAdhi, avarghaL nI aRiyAdha bhAShaiyaibh bhejhuM jAdhi, avarghaL bhejhughiRadhu iனனdhèனRu uனghghu viLa~NghAdhu.
dhiRandha bhiredhaghghuzhighaLaibhbhol avarghaL aMbhaRAdhdhUNighaL irughghuM; avarghaL aனaivaruM bhAghghiramajhAlighaL.

avarghaL uன ghumAraruM uன ghumAradhdhighaLuM jhAbhbhiDhaveNDhiya uன viLaijhjhalaiyuM uன abhbhadhdhaiyuM jhAbhbhiDhDhu, uன ADhughaLaiyuM uன mADhughaLaiyuM bhaDhjhidhdhu, uன dhirADhjhabhbhazha~NghaLaiyuM uன adhdhibhbhazha~NghaLaiyuM jhAbhbhiDhDhu, nI naMbhiன uனனuDhaiya araNAன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhAle vèRumaiyAghghuvArghaL.
AghiluM nAன annADhghaLiluM u~NghaLaijh jharvajha~NghAraM jhèyyAdhirubhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr

è~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar è~NghaLughghu ivaighaLaiyèllAM èdhiனimidhdhaM jhèydhAr èனRu nI~NghaL gheDhDhAl, abhbhòzhudhu nI avarghaLaibh bhArdhdhu nI~NghaL èனனaiviDhDhu, u~NghaLuDhaiya dhejhadhdhile anniya dhevarghaLaijh jhevidhdhadhubhola, u~NghaLuDhaiyadhallAdha dhejhadhdhile anniyarghaLaijh jhevibhbhIrghaLèனRu jhòlvAyAgha.

u~NghaL aghghirama~NghaL ivaighaLai vilaghghi, u~NghaL bhAva~NghaL u~NghaLughghu naனmaiyai varavòDhDhAdhirughghiRadhu.

ivaighaLai vijhAriyAdhirubhbheனo? ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha jAdhighghu èன AdhdhumA nIdhiyaijh jharighghaDhDhAdhirughghumo èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

èzhundhiru~NghaL, nAM irAghghAladhdhilAghiluM bhoyeRi, avaLuDhaiya aramaனaighaLai azhibhbhoM èனRuM jhòlluvArghaL.

èrujhaleme, èன AdhdhumA uனனaiviDhDhubh bhiriyAdhabhaDhighghuM, nAன uனனaibhbhAzhuM ghuDhiyaRRa dhejhamuM AghghAdhabhaDhighghuM bhudhdhigheL.

avarghaLuDhaiya vIDhughaLuM, avarghaLuDhaiya ghANibhUmighaLuM, avarghaLuDhaiya maனaivighaLoDhe eghamAy anniyar vajhamAghuM; èன ghaiyai indhadh dhejhadhdhiன ghuDhighaLughghu virodhamAgha nIDhDhuveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
avarghaLil, jhiRiyormudhal bhèriyormaDhDhuM, òvvòruvaruM bhòruLAjhaighghArar; idhuvumallAmal dhIrghghadharijhighaLmudhal AjhAriyarghaLmaDhDhuM òvvòruvaruM bhòyyar.
jhamAdhAனmillAdhirundhuM jhamAdhAனM jhamAdhAனM èனRu jhòlli, èன jaனdhdhiன ghAya~NghaLai meRbhUjhjhAygh ghuNamAghghughiRArghaL.

AghaiyAl idho, nAன indha jaனdhdhughghu iDhaRalghaLai vaibhbheன; avaighaLmel bhidhAghghaLuM, bhiLLaighaLuM, ghuDhiyAனvaனuM, avaனughghaDhudhdhavaனuM, eghamAy iDhaRuNDhu azhivArghaLèனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
idho, vaDhadhejhadhdhilirundhu òru jaனM vandhu, bhUmiyiன ghaDhaiyèllaighaLilirundhu òru bhèriya jAdhi èzhuMbhuM.

avarghaL villuM veluM bhiDhidhdhu varuvArghaL; avarghaL ghòDhiyar, iraghghamaRiyAdhavarghaL; avarghaL jhadhdhaM jhamudhdhira iraijhjhalughghujh jhamAனmAyirughghuM; jhIyoன ghumAradhdhiye, avarghaL èனghghu virodhamAgha yudhdhajhaனனdhdharAygh ghudhiraighaLiனmeleRi aNiyaNiyAgha varuvArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
avarghaL varughiRa jhèydhiyaigh gheDhDhoM; naMmuDhaiya ghaighaL dhaLarndhadhu; iDhughghaM, gharbhbhavadhighghu uNDhAghuM vedhaனaighghòbhbhAன vedhaனaiyuM naMmaibh bhiDhidhdhadhu.
vayalvèLiyile bhuRabhbhaDhAdhiru~NghaL; vazhiyiluM naDhavAdhiru~NghaL; jhuRRiluM jhadhdhuruviன bhaDhDhayamuM bhaya~NgharamumuNDhu.

èன jaனmAghiya ghumAradhdhiye, nI iraDhDhaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhu, jhAMbhalile bhuraNDhu, òre bhudhdhiraனughghAghadh dhughghighghiRadhubhola maன~Nghajhandhu bhulaMbhu; bhAzhAghghughiRavaன jhaDhidhiyAy naMmel varuvAன.
nI èன jaனdhdhiன vazhiyai aRindhughòLLavuM jhodhidhdhubhbhArghghavuM nAன uனனai avarghaLughghuLLe dhurughamAghavuM, araNAghavuM vaidhdheன.
avarghaLèllAruM muraDhDhADhDhamAன agha~NghArighaLuM, dhURRidhdhirighiRavarghaLumAyirughghiRArghaL; avarghaL vèNghalamuM iruMbhumAனvarghaL; avarghaLèllAruM ghèDhDhavarghaL.
dhurudhdhi vèndhadhu; IyaM nèrubhbhiனAl azhindhadhu; bhuDhamiDhughiRavaனuDhaiya bhirayAjhaM virudhAvAybhbhoyiRRu; bhòllAbhbhughaL aRRubhbhoghavillai.
avarghaL dhaLLubhaDhiyAன vèLLi èனனbhbhaDhuvArghaL; ghardhdhar avarghaLaidh dhaLLiviDhDhAr.
ghardhdharAl èremiyAvughghu uNDhAன vajhaனM:

nI ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன vAjhalile niனRu, a~Nghe ghURijh jhòllaveNDhiya vajhaனM èனனvèனRAl, ghardhdharaibh bhaNindhughòLLa indha vAjhalghaLughghuLLe bhiravejhighghiRa yUdha jaன~NghaLAghiya nI~NghaLèllAruM ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLu~NghaL.

israveliன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr: u~NghaL vazhighaLaiyuM u~NghaL ghiriyaighaLaiyuM jhIrbhbhaDhudhdhu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu u~NghaLai indha sdhaladhdhile ghuDhiyirughghabhbhaNNuveன.
ghardhdhariன AlayaM, ghardhdhariன AlayaM, ghardhdhariன AlayaM idhuve èனRu jhòlli, bhòyvArdhdhaighaLai naMbhighghòLLAdhiru~NghaL.
nI~NghaL u~NghaL vazhighaLaiyuM u~NghaL ghiriyaighaLaiyuM naனRAyjh jhIrbhbhaDhudhdhi, nI~NghaL maனuShaனughghuM maனuShaனughghumuLLa vazhaghghai niyAyamAydh dhIrdhdhu,

bharadhejhiyaiyuM dhighghaRRavaனaiyuM vidhavaiyaiyuM òDhughghAmaluM, ghuRRamillAdha iradhdhadhdhai indha sdhaladhdhile jhindhAmaluM; u~NghaLughghugh gheDhuNDhAgha anniya dhevarghaLaibh bhiனbhaRRAmalumirubhbhIrghaLeyAghil,
abhbhòzhudhu nAன u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdha dhejhamAghiya indha sdhaladhdhile u~NghaLaijh jhadhAghAlamuM ghuDhiyirughghabhbhaNNuveன.
idho, òனRughghuM udhavAdha bhòyvArdhdhaighaLai nI~NghaL naMbhughiRIrghaL.
nI~NghaL dhiruDhi, ghòlaijhèydhu, vibhajhAraMbhaNNi, bhòyyANaiyiDhDhu, bhAghAlughghudh dhUbha~NghADhDhi, nI~NghaL aRiyAdha anniya dhevarghaLaibh bhiனbhaRRi,
bhiRbhADhu vandhu, èன nAmaM dharighghabhbhaDhDha indha Alayadhdhile èனghghu muனbhAgha niனRu: indha aruvarubhbhughaLaiyèllAM jhèyvadhaRghAgha viDhudhalai bhèRRirughghiRomèனRu jhòlvIrghaLo?
èன nAmaM dharighghabhbhaDhDha indha AlayaM u~NghaL bhArvaighghugh ghaLLarghughaiyAyiRRo? idho, nAனuM idhaigh ghaNDheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
nAன mundhi èன nAmaM viLa~NghabhbhaNNiன jhIloviluLLa èன sdhaladhdhughghu nI~NghaL bhoy, isravel jaனdhdhiனuDhaiya bhòllAbhbhiனimidhdhaM nAன adhaRghujh jhèydhadhaibh bhAru~NghaL.

nI~NghaL indhagh ghiriyaighaLaiyèllAM jhèydhIrghaL, nAன u~NghaLughghu eRghaனve jhòllivandhirundhuM, nI~NghaL gheLAmaluM, nAன u~NghaLaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhuM, nI~NghaL udhdharavughòDhAmaluM bhoனbhaDhiyiனAl,

èன nAmaM dharighghabhbhaDhDhadhuM, nI~NghaL naMbhighghai ghòNDhirughghiRadhumAன indha AlayadhdhughghuM u~NghaLughghuM u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLughghuM nAன ghòDhudhdha sdhaladhdhughghuM, nAன jhIlovughghujh jhèydhadhubholajh jhèyveன.
nAன u~NghaLuDhaiya èllAjh jhaghodhararumAghiya èbhbhirAyIM jhandhadhi aனaidhdhaiyuM dhaLLibhbhoDhDhadhubhola, u~NghaLaiyuM èன mughadhdhaiviDhDhudh dhaLLibhbhoDhuveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

nI indha jaனdhdhughghAgha viNNabhbhaM jhèyyaveNDhAM; avarghaLughghAgha maனRADhavuM ghè~njhavuM veNDhAM, èனனiDhadhdhil avarghaLughghAghabh bharindhubhejhavuM veNDhAM, nAன uனghghujh jhèvighòDhubhbhadhillai.
yUdhAviன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiluM èrujhalemiன vIdhighaLiluM avarghaL jhèyghiRadhai nI ghANavillaiyA?

èனghghu maனmaDhivuNDhAgha anniyadhevarghaLughghubh bhAனbhalighaLai vArghghiRArghaL; avarghaL vAனrAghghiனighghubh bhaNiyAra~NghaLaijh jhuDhuMbhaDhi bhiLLaighaL viRaghubhòRughghughiRArghaL, bhidhAghghaL nèrubhbhumUDhDhughiRArghaL, sdhirIghaL mAbhbhijhaighiRArghaL.
avarghaL èனghghA maனmaDhivuNDhAghghughiRArghaL? dha~NghaL mugha~NghaL vèDhghadhdhughghuDhbhaDhuMbhaDhi avarghaL dha~NghaLughghe allavo maனmaDhivuNDhAghghughiRArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

AdhalAl idho, èன ghobhamuM èன ughghiramuM indha sdhaladhdhiனmeluM, maனuSharmeluM, mirugha~NghaLmeluM, vèLiyiன mara~NghaLmeluM, bhUmiyiன ghaனighaLmeluM URRabhbhaDhuM; adhu aviyAmal èriyuM èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.
israveliன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhèனனvèனRAl u~NghaL dhaghaனbhalighaLai maRRabh bhalighaLoDhu~NghUDhDhi, iRaijhjhiyaijh jhAbhbhiDhu~NghaL.

nAன u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLai èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu azhaidhdhuvandha nALile, dhaghaனbhaliyaighghuRidhdhuM, maRRabh bhalighaLaighghuRidhdhuM nAன avarghaLoDhe bhejhiனdhaiyuM ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhadhaiyuMbhArghghiluM,

èன vAghghughghujh jhèvighòDhu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu nAன u~NghaL dhevaனAyirubhbheன, nI~NghaL èன jaனmAyirubhbhIrghaL; nAன u~NghaLughghugh ghaRbhighghuM èllA vazhiyiluM, nI~NghaL u~NghaLughghu naனmai uNDhAghuMbhaDhighghu naDhavu~NghaL èனghiRa vijheShadhdhaiye avarghaLughghujh jhòlligh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDheன.
avarghaLo adhaigh gheLAmaluM, dha~NghaL jhèviyaijh jhAyAmaluMbhoy, dha~NghaL bhòllAdha irudhayadhdhiன yojhaனaighaLiனbhaDhiyuM ghaDhiனdhdhiனbhaDhiyuM naDhandhu, muனனiDhDhalla bhiனனiDhDhe bhoனArghaL.

u~NghaL bhidhAghghaL èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDha nALmudhal innALmaDhDhuM nAன dhIrghghadharijhighaLAghiya èன UzhiyaghghAraraiyèllAM dhiனndhiனM u~NghaLaNDhaighghu eRghaனve aனubhbhighghòNDhirundheன.
AனAluM avarghaL èன jhòllaigh gheLAmaluM, dha~NghaL jhèviyaijh jhAyAmaluM bhoy, dha~NghaL ghazhudhdhaigh ghaDhiனbhbhaDhudhdhi, dha~NghaL bhidhAghghaLaibhbhArghghiluM adhigha bhòllAbhbhu jhèydhArghaL.

nI indha vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM avarghaLughghujh jhòனனAluM, avarghaL uனghghujh jhèvighòDhughghamADhDhArghaL; nI avarghaLai noghghigh ghUbhbhiDhDhAluM, avarghaL uனghghu maRuudhdharavu ghòDhughghamADhDhArghaL.

AghaiyAl dha~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhaigh gheLAmaluM, bhudhdhiyai eRRughghòLLamaluM irughaύghiRa, jAdhi iΤudhAன èனRuM, ڠΤdhiyaM azhindhal adhu avarghaL vAyilirundhu aRRubhbhoனdhèனRuM avarghaLughghujh jhòl.
nI uன dhalaimayiraijh jhiraidhdhu, èRindhuviDhDhu, uyardhala~NghaLile bhulaMbhighghòNDhiru; ghardhdhar dhamadhu jhiனdhdhughghu edhuvAன jhandhadhiyai vèRudhdhu nèghizhaviDhDhAr.

dha~NghaL ghumAraraiyuM dha~NghaL ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM aghghiனiyile dhaghaனighghiRadhaRghAgha, avarghaL iனனoM ghumAraனiன bhaLLadhdhAghghiluLLa dhobhbhedhdhiன meDhaighaLaigh ghaDhDhiனArghaL; adhai nAன ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhavumillai, adhu èன maனdhil dhoனRavumillai.

AdhalAl, idho, nADhghaL varumèனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; abhbhòzhudhu adhu abhbhuRaM dhobhbhedh èனRuM, iனனoM ghumAraனiன bhaLLadhdhAghghèனRuM jhòllabhbhaDhAmal, jha~NghArabhbhaLLadhdhAghghèனRu jhòllabhbhaDhuM; dhobhbhedhdhile iDha~NghiDhaiyAmaRbhoghumaDhDhuM jhava~NghaLai aDhaghghaMbhaNNuvArghaL.

nAன yUdhAviன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiluM èrujhalemiன vIdhighaLiluM ghaLibhbhiன jhadhdhadhdhaiyuM, maghizhjhjhiyiன jhadhdhadhdhaiyuM, maNavALaனiன jhadhdhadhdhaiyuM, maNavADhDhiyiன jhadhdhadhdhaiyuM oyabhbhaNNuveன; dhejhaM bhAzhAghuM.

avarghaL nejhidhdhadhuM, jhevidhdhadhuM,bhiனbhaRRiனdhuM, nADhiனdhuM, bhaNindhughòNDhadhumAyirundha jhUriyaனughghuM, jhandhiraனughghuM, vAனdhdhiன jharvajheனaighghuM muனbhAgha avaighaLaibh bharabhbhivaibhbhArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; avaighaL vAri aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhAmal bhUmiyiனmel èruvAghuM.

nI avarghaLai noghghi: vizhundhavarghaL èzhundhirughghiRadhillaiyo? vazhidhabhbhibhbhoனvarghaL dhiruMbhughiRadhillaiyo?

AghAyadhdhiluLLa nArai mudhalAydh dhaன veLaiyai aRiyuM; ghADhDhubhbhuRAvuM, ghòghghuM, dhaghaivilAன ghuviyuM dhA~NghaL varadhdhaghgha ghAladhdhai aRiyuM; èன jaன~NghaLo ghardhdhariன niyAyadhdhai aRiyArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl.
nA~NghaL ~nAனighaLèனRuM, ghardhdharuDhaiya vedhaM è~NghaLiDhadhdhilirughghiRadhèனRuM nI~NghaL jhòllughiRadhèbhbhaDhi mèyyAghave, idho, vedhabhAraghariன ghaLLa èzhudhdhANi adhai abhadhdhamAghghiRadhu.
~nAனighaL vèDhghi, ghala~Nghibh bhiDhibhaDhuvArghaL; idho, ghardhdharuDhaiya jhòllai vèRudhdhubhbhoDhDhArghaL; avarghaLughghu ~nAனmedhu?

AghaiyAl avarghaLuDhaiya sdhirIghaLai anniyarughghuM, avarghaLuDhaiya vayalghaLai avaighaLaigh ghaDhDhighghòLbhavarghaLughghuM ghòDhubhbheன; avarghaLile jhiRiyor dhòDha~Nghibh bhèriyormaDhDhuM òvvòruvaruM bhòruLAjhaighghArarAyirughghiRArghaL; dhIrghghadharijhighaL dhòDha~Nghi AjhAriyarghaL maDhDhuM òvvòruvaruM bhòyyarAyirundhu,
jhamAdhAனmillAdhirudhuM, jhamAdhAனM jhamAdhAனM èனRu jhòlli, èன jaனmAghiya ghumAradhdhiyiன ghAya~NghaLai meRbhUjhjhAygh ghuNamAghghughiRArghaL.

dhA~NghaL aruvarubhbhAனdhaijh jhèydhadhiனimidhdhaM vèDhghabhbhaDhughiRArghaLA? bharijhjhedhaM vèDhghabhbhaDhArghaL, nANavuM aRiyArghaL; AghaiyAl vizhughiRavarghaLughghuLLe vizhuvArghaL; nAன avarghaLai vijhArighghu~NghAladhdhile iDhaRuNDhubhovArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

dhANilirundhu avarghaLuDhaiya ghudhiraighaLiன mUjhjhèRidhal gheDhghabhbhaDhughiRadhu; avarghaLuDhaiya bhaladhdha asva~NghaL ghaனaighghiRa jhadhdhadhdhiனAl dhejhamèllAM adhirughiRadhu; avarghaL vandhu dhejhadhdhaiyuM adhil uLLavaighaLaiyuM, bhaDhDhaNadhdhaiyuM adhiன ghuDhighaLaiyuM bhaDhjhibhbhArghaL.
mèyyAy, idho, dhaDhaighaDhDhabhbhaDhAdha jharbhbha~NghaLaiyuM, ghaDhDhuviriyaனghaLaiyuM u~NghaLughghuL aனubhbhughiReன, avaighaL u~NghaLaigh ghaDhighghuM èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

idho, jhIyoனil ghardhdhar illaiyo? adhil rAjA illaiyo? èனRu, èன jaனmAghiya ghumAradhdhi dhUradhejhadhdhilirundhu ghUbhbhiDhuM jhadhdhaM gheDhghabhbhaDhughiRadhu; AனAl, avarghaL dha~NghaL jhurUbha~NghaLiனAluM anniyariன mAyaighaLiனAluM èனghghugh ghobhamuNDhAghghiனdhu èனன èனghiRAr.
aRubhbhughghAlaM jhèனRadhu, ghoDhaighghAlamuM muDhindhadhu, nAmo iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhavillai.
èன jaனmAghiya ghumAradhdhiyiன ghAya~NghaLiனAl nAனuM ghAyabhbhaDhDheன; gharighaRudhdhirughghiReன; dhighaibhbhu èனனaibh bhiDhidhdhadhu.
ghIleyAdhdhile bhijhiன dhailaM illaiyo? iraNavaidhdhiyaனuM a~Nghe illaiyo? bhiனனai eன èன jaனmAghiya ghumAradhdhi jhòsdhamaDhaiyAmaRbhoனAL?
A, èன dhalai dhaNNIruM, èன ghaNghaL ghaNNIrURRumAனAl nalamAyirughghuM; abhbhòzhudhu èன jaனmAghiya ghumAradhdhi ghòlaiyuNNagh ghòDhudhdhavarghaL nimidhdhaM nAன iravuMbhaghaluM azhuveன.

A, vaனAndharadhdhil vazhibhbhoghghariன dhAbharaM èனghghu irundhAl nalamAyirughghuM; abhbhòzhudhu nAன èன jaனdhdhaiviDhDhu, avarghaLiDhadhdhil irAdhabhaDhighghubh bhoyviDhuveன; avarghaLèllAruM vibhajhAraruM dhuroghighaLiன ghUDhDhamumAyirughghiRArghaL.

avarghaL bhòyyaibh bhirayoghighghadh dha~NghaL nAvAghiya villai vaLaighghiRArghaL; avarghaL indhadh dhejhadhdhile bhaladhdhughghòLvadhu jhadhdhiyadhdhughghAgha alla; bhòllAbhbhilirundhu bhòllAbhbhughghu naDhandheRughiRArghaL; èனனaiyo aRiyAdhirughghiRArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

nI~NghaL avaனvaன dhaன dhaன jhineghidhaனughghu èjhjharighghaiyAyiru~NghaL, èndhajh jhaghodharaனaiyuM naMbhAdhiru~NghaL; èndhajh jhaghodharaனuM mojhaMbhaNNughiRAன, èndhajh jhineghidhaனuM dhURRidhdhirighiRAன.

AனAluM nIdhimAனaijh jhodhidhdhaRindhu, uLLindhiriya~NghaLaiyuM irudhayadhdhaiyuM bhArghghiRa jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhAve, nIr avarghaLughghu nIdhiyaijh jharighghaDhDhughiRadhaigh ghANbheனAgha; èன ghAriyadhdhai uMmiDhadhdhil jhADhDhiviDhDheன.

nAன bhiRandhanAL jhabhighghabhbhaDhuvadhAgha; èன dhAyAr èனனaibh bhèRRa nAL AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhAdhirubhbhadhAgha.

nIr è~NghaLughghAghagh ghardhdhariDhadhdhil vijhAriyuM; bhAbhiloன rAjAvaޠΕiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAr è~NghaLughghu virodhamAy yudhdha~njhèyghiRAன; òruveLai ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya èllA aRbhudhajh jhèyaliனbhaDhiyeyuM è~NghaLughghu anughghiragha~njhèydhu, avaனai è~NghaLaiviDhDhubh bhoghabhbhaNNuvAr èனRu jhòlliyaனubhbhiனbhodhu,
èremiyA avarghaLaibhbhArdhdhu, nI~NghaL jhidheghghiyAvughghujh jhòllaveNDhiyadhu:

nAன nIDhDhiன ghaiyiனAluM bhaladhdha bhuyadhdhiனAluM ghobhamuM ughghiramuM maghA ghaDhumaiyumAgha u~NghaLoDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNi,
indha nagharadhdhiன ghuDhighaLaiyuM, maனuSharaiyuM, mirugha~NghaLaiyuM jha~Ngharibhbheன; maghA ghòLLainoyAl jhAvArghaL.

adhaRghubhbhiனbhu nAன yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya jhidheghghiyAvaiyuM, avaன UzhiyaghghAraraiyuM, jaனdhdhaiyuM, indha nagharadhdhile ghòLLainoyghghuM bhaDhDhayadhdhughghuM bha~njhadhdhughghuM dhabhbhi mIdhiyAனvarghaLaiyuM bhAbhiloன rAjAvAghiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAruDhaiya ghaiyiluM, avarghaL jhadhdhurughghaLiன ghaiyiluM, avarghaL bhirANaனai vA~Nghadh dheDhughiRavarghaLiன ghaiyiluM òbhbhughghòDhubhbheன; avaன avarghaLaibh bhaDhDhayagh gharughghiனAl vèDhDhuvAன; avaன avarghaLaidh dhabhbhaviDhuvadhumillai, avaன maனனibhbhadhumillai, ira~NghuvadhumillaiyèனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRAன.
bhiனனaiyuM avar, indha jaன~NghaLai noghghi: idho, nAன u~NghaL muனனe jIvavazhiyaiyuM maraNavazhiyaiyuM vaighghiReன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

indha nagharadhdhile dharighghiRavaன bhaDhDhayadhdhAluM, bha~njhadhdhAluM, ghòLLainoyAluM jhAvAன; u~NghaLai muRRighghaibhoDhuM ghaldheyar vajhamAybh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoyviDhughiRavaனo bhizhaibhbhAன; avaன bhirANaன avaனughghugh ghiDhaidhdha ghòLLaibhbhòruLaibhbhol irughghuM.

èன mughadhdhai indha nagharadhdhughghu virodhamAy naனmaighghu alla, dhImaighghe vaidhdheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; adhu bhAbhiloன rAjAviன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuM; avaன aghghiனiyAl adhaijh jhuDhDhèribhbhAன èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
yUdhA rAjAviன ghuDhuMbhadhdhAraiyuM noghghi: ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLu~NghaL.

dhAvIdhiன ghuDhuMbhadhdhAre, u~NghaL jhèyghaighaLuDhaiya bhòllAbhbhiனimidhdhaM èன ughghiraM aghghiனiyaibhbhol bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, avighghiRavaன illAmal èriyAdhabhaDhighghu, nI~NghaL eRghaனve niyAya~NgheDhDhu, bhaRighòDhudhdhavaனai òDhughghughiRavaனuDhaiya ghaighghudh dhabhbhuviyu~NghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

idho bhaLLadhdhAghghil vAjhaMbhaNNughiRavaLe, jhamaனAன iDhadhdhil ghaனmalaiyAy irughghiRavaLe, è~NghaLughghu virodhamAy varughiRavaன yArèனRuM, è~NghaL vAjhasdhala~NghaLughghuL varughiRavaன yAr èனRuM jhòllughiRa uனghghu nAன èdhirALiyAyirughghiReன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

nAன u~NghaL ghiriyaighaLiன bhalaனughghudhdhaghghadhAy u~NghaLai vijhAribhbheன; nAன adhiன ghADhDhile dhIghghòLudhdhuveன; adhu adhaijh jhuRRilumuLLa yAvaiyuM bhaDhjhighghuM èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
ghardhdhar jhòனனdhu: nI yUdhA rAjAviன aramaனaighghubh bhoy, a~Nghe veNDhiya vajhaனM èனனvèனRAl:

dhAvIdhiன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhil vIRRirughghiRa yUdhAviன rAjAve, nIruM uMmuDhaiya UzhiyaghghAraruM indha vAjhalghaLughghuL bhiravejhighghiRa uMmuDhaiya jaனmuM ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLu~NghaL.

nI~NghaL niyAyamuM nIdhiyuMjhèydhu, bhaRighòDhudhdhavaனai òDhughghughiRavaனuDhaiya ghaighghudh dhabhbhuviyu~NghaL; nI~NghaL bharadhejhiyaiyuM dhighghaRRavaனaiyuM vidhavaiyaiyuM òDhughghAmaluM, ghòDhumaijhèyyAmaluM, ivviDhadhdhil ghuRRamillAdha iradhdhadhdhaijh jhindhAmaluM iru~NghaL.

indha vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye nI~NghaL mèyyAyjh jhèyvIrghaLAghil, dhAvIdhiன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhil uDhghArndhirughghiRa rAjAghghaL iradha~NghaLmeluM ghudhiraighaLmeluM eRi, avaனuM avaன UzhiyaghghAraruM avaன jaனmumAgha indha aramaனai vAjhalghaLiன vazhiyAy uDhbhiravejhibhbhArghaLèனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
nI~NghaL indha vArdhdhaighaLaighgheLAmaRbhoனIrghaLeyAghil indha aramaனai bhAzhAybhbhoM èனRu èனbheril ANaiyiDhDheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

yUdhA rAjAviன aramaனaiyaigh ghuRidhdhugh ghardhdhar: nI èனghghugh ghIleyAdhdhaibhbholavuM lIbhaனoனiன ghòDhumuDhiyaibhbholavuM irughghiRAy, AனAluM mèyyAghave nAன uனனai vaனAndharadhdhaibhbholavuM, ghuDhiyillAdha bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaibhbholavuM AghghiviDhuveன.
jha~NghAraghArarai avaravar Ayudha~NghaLoDhughUDha nAன uனghghu virodhamAgha AyadhdhabhbhaDhudhdhuveன; uன ujhjhidhamAன ghedhurughghaLai avarghaL vèDhDhi aghghiனiyile bhoDhuvArghaL
aneghaM jAdhighaL indha nagharadhdhaigh ghaDhandhuvandhu, avaனvaன dhaன dhaன ayalAனai noghghi: indhabhbhèriya nagharadhdhughghugh ghardhdhar ibhbhaDhijh jhèydhadhu èனனvèனRu gheDhbhArghaL.

maridhdhavaனughghAgha azhaveNDhAM, avaனughghAghabh bharidhabhighghavuMveNDhAM, jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoனvaனughghAghave azhu~NghaL; avaன iனidh dhiruMbhavaruvadhumillai, janana bhUmiyaigh ghANbhadhumillai.

dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya yojhiyAviன bhaDhDhadhdhughghu vandhu, arajhANDhu, ivviDhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoன yUdhAviன rAjAvAyirundha yojhiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhalluUmaighghuRidhdhu: avaன iனi i~Nghe dhiruMbha varAmal,
dhAன ghòNDhubhoghabhbhaDhDha sdhaladhdhile maribhbhAன, indhadhejhadhdhai avaன iனigh ghANbhadhillaiyèனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

lIbhaனoனiனmeleRibh bhulaMbhu, bhAjhAனil uradhdha jhadhdhamiDhu, AbharImilirundhu ghUbhbhiDhDhughghòNDhiru, uன nejhar aனaivaruM muRindhArghaL.

uன meybhbharghaL èllAraiyuM ghARRu aDhidhdhughghòNDhubhoghuM; uன nejhar jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhovArghaL; abhbhodhallavo èllAbh bhòllAbhbhiனimidhdhamuM nI vèDhghabhbhaDhDhu ilajhjhaiyaDhaivAy.

lIbhaனoனil vAjhamAyirundhu, ghedhurumara~NghaLil ghUDhughaDhDhighghòNDhirughghiRavaLe, vedhaனaighaLuM bhiLLaibhbhèRughiRavaLughghòdhdha vAdhaiyuM uனghghu varughaiyil nI èvvaLavu bharidhabhighghabhbhaDhadhdhaghghavaLAyirubhbhAy!

yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yoyAghghImiன ghumAraன ghoனiyA èன valadhughaiyiன mudhdhirai modhiramAyirundhAluM, adhilirundhu uனனaigh ghazhaRRi èRindhubhoDhuveன èனRu èன jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

uனனaiyuM, uனனaibh bhèRRa dhAyaiyuM, u~NghaL janana bhUmiyallAdha anniya dhejhadhdhile dhuradhdhiviDhuveன. a~Nghe jhAvIrghaL.

dhejhame! dhejhame! dhejhame! ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh gheL.

èன meyjhjhaliன ADhughaLaigh ghèDhudhdhujh jhidhaRaDhighghiRa meybhbharghaLughghu aiyo! èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

nAன èன ADhughaLil mIdhiyAyirubhbhavaighaLaidh dhuradhdhiyirundha èllA dhejha~NghaLilumirundhu jherdhdhu avaighaLaidh dhiruMbha avaighaLiன dhòzhuva~NghaLughghugh ghòNDhuvaruveன; abhbhòzhudhu avaighaL bhalughibhbhèrughuM.

avar nADhghaLil yUdhA iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhuM, isravel jhughamAy vAjhaMbhaNNuM; avarughghu iDhuM nAmaM namadhu nIdhiyAyirughghiRa ghardhdhar èனbhadhe.
AdhalAl, idho, nADhghaL varuM, abhbhòzhudhu isravel bhudhdhirarai èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu azhaidhdhughghòNDhuvandha ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhadhdhiyaMbhaNNAmal,

dhIrghghadharijhighaLiனimidhdhaM èன irudhayaM èன uLLadhdhile nòRu~NghiyirughghiRadhu; èன èluMbhughaLèllAM adhirughiRadhu; ghardhdhar nimidhdhamuM, avaruDhaiya bharijhudhdha vArdhdhaighaLiனimidhdhamuM nAன vèRidhdhirughghiRa maனuShaனaibhbholavuM madhubhAனM meRghòNDhavaனaibhbholavuM irughghiReன.

dhejhaM vibhajhAraghghArarAl niRaindhirughghiRadhu, dhejhaM jhAbhadhdhiனAl dhughghighghiRadhu, vaனAndharadhdhiன meyjhjhalghaL vADhibhbhoghiRadhu, avarghaL oDhDhaM bhòllAdhadhu; avarghaL bhèlaன aniyAyamAyirughghiRadhu.

avar bhadhivirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhuM jhi~NghadhdhaibhbholirubhbhAr; òDhughghughiRavaனuDhaiya ughghiradhdhiனAluM, avaனuDhaiya ughghiraghobhadhdhiனAluM avarghaL dhejhaM bhAzhAyiRRèனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
yojhiyAviன ghumAraனuM yUdhAviன rAjAvumAghiya yoyAghghImuDhaiya rAjyabhAradhdhiன dhuvaghghadhdhile ghardhdharAl uNDhAன vArdhdhai:

avarghaL jhèyghaighaLuDhaiya bhòllAbhbhiனimidhdhaM nAன avarghaLughghujh jhèyya niனaighghiRa dhI~Nghughghu nAன maனsdhAbhabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhAgha òruveLai avarghaL gheDhDhu, avaravar dhaMdhaM bhòllAdha vazhiyaiviDhDhudh dhiruMbhuvArghaL.
avarghaLai noghghi: nAன u~NghaLiDhadhdhughghu eRghaனve aனubhbhighghòNDhirundhuM, nI~NghaL gheLAmaRbhoன èன UzhiyaghghArarAghiya dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன vArdhdhaighaLai nI~NghaLgheDhghuMbhaDhighghuM,
nAன u~NghaL muனvaidhdha èன niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiனbhaDhi nI~NghaL naDhaghghuMbhaDhighghuM, nI~NghaL èன jhòllaigh gheLAmaRbhoனAl,
nAன indha Alayadhdhaijh jhIlovAbhbholAghghi, indha nagharadhdhaibh bhUmiyiluLLa èllA jAdhighaLughghu muனbhAghavuM jhAbhamAghghibhbhoDhuveன èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
èremiyA indha vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhile jhòlluMbhodhu, AjhAriyarghaLuM, dhIrghghadharijhighaLuM, jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM gheDhDhArghaL.

jhaghala jaன~NghaLughghuM jhòllagh ghardhdhar dhaனghghugh ghaRbhidhdhavaighaLaiyèllAM èremiyA jhòlli muDhidhdhabhodhu AjhAriyarghaLuM dhIrghghadharijhighaLuM jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM avaனaibh bhiDhidhdhu: nI jhAghave jhAghaveNDhuM.

indha AlayaM jhIlovaibhbholAghi, indha nagharaM ghuDhiyillAmal bhAzhAybhbhoM èனRu, nI ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhile dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòlvAனeன èனRu jhòlli, jaன~NghaL èllAruM ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhile èremiyAvughghu virodhamAygh ghUDhiனArghaL.
yUdhAviன bhirabhughghaL indha vardhdhamAன~NghaLaigh gheDhDhu, rAjAviன vIDhDhilirundhu ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhughghubh bhoy, ghardhdharuDhaiya bhudhiya vAjhalil uDhghArndhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu AjhAriyarghaLuM dhIrghghadharijhighaLuM, bhirabhughghaLaiyuM jhaghala jaன~NghaLaiyuM noghghi: indha maனuShaன maraNa Aghghiனaighghubh bhAdhdhiraன; u~NghaL jhèvighaLAle nI~NghaL gheDhDhabhaDhi, indha nagharadhdhughghu virodhamAghadh dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòனனAனe èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu èremiyA èllAbh bhirabhughghaLaiyuM, èllA jaன~NghaLaiyuM noghghi: nI~NghaL gheDhDha èllA vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM indha AlayadhdhughghuM indha nagharadhdhughghuM virodhamAghadh dhIrghghadharijhaனmAyjh jhòllagh ghardhdhar èனனai aனubhbhiனAr.

ibhbhòzhudhuM nI~NghaL u~NghaL vazhighaLaiyuM, u~NghaL ghiriyaighaLaiyuM jhIrbhbhaDhudhdhi, u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhaigh gheLu~NghaL; abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar u~NghaLughghu virodhamAyjh jhòனன dhI~Nghughghu maனsdhAbhabhbhaDhuvAr.
nAனovèனil, idho, u~NghaL ghaiyil irughghiReன; u~NghaL bhArvaighghu naனmaiyuM niyAyamumAyirughghiRadhai èனghghujh jhèyyu~NghaL.

AghiluM nI~NghaL èனனaigh ghòனRubhoDhDhAl, nI~NghaL ghuRRamillAdha iradhdhabhbhazhiyai u~NghaLmeluM indha nagharadhdhiனmeluM idhiன ghuDhighaLiனmeluM jhumadhdhighghòLvIrghaLèனRu nijhjhamAy aRiyu~NghaL; indha vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM u~NghaL jhèvighaLile jhòllagh ghardhdhar mèyyAghave èனனai u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiனAr èனRu jhòனனAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhirabhughghaLuM jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM, AjhAriyarghaLaiyuM dhIrghghadharijhighaLaiyuM noghghi: indha maனuShaன maraNa Aghghiனaighghubh bhAdhdhiraனlla; naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன nAmadhdhile naMmuDhaனe bhejhiனAன èனRArghaL.
dhejhadhdhile mUbhbhAனvarghaLil jhilar èzhuMbhi jhabhaiyAghiya jaன~NghaLai noghghi:

avaனai yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya èjheghghiyAvuM maRRa yUdharghaLuM jherndhu ghòனRubhoDhDhArghaLA? avaன ghardhdharughghubh bhayandhu, ghardhdhariன mughadhdhai noghghigh ghè~njhiனAனllavA? abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar avarghaLughghu virodhamAghajh jhòlliyirundha dhI~Nghughghu maனsdhAbhabhbhaDhDhAr; ibhbhodhuM, nAM naMmuDhaiya AdhdhumAvughghu virodhamAgha maghA bhòllAbhbhai varabhbhaNNughiRavarghaLAyirughghiRome.

AனAluM èremiyAvaigha ghòlla jaன~NghaLiன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhAdhabhaDhi, jhAbhbhAனuDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya aghIghghAM avaனughghujh jhaghAyamAyirundhAன.
yojhiyAviன ghumAraனuM yUdhAviன rAjAvumAghiya yoyAghghImuDhaiya rAjyabhAradhdhiன dhuvaghghadhdhile ghardhdharAl èremiyAvughghu, uNDhAன vArdhdhai:
ghardhdhar èனனai noghghi: nI uனghghugh ghayiRughaLaiyuM nugha~NghaLaiyuM uNDhubhaNNi, avaighaLai uன ghazhudhdhile bhUDhDhighghòNDhu,

èndha jAdhiyAvadhu, èndha rAjyamAvadhu bhAbhiloன rAjAvAghiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAr èனbhavaனaijh jheviyAmaluM, dhaன ghazhudhdhaibh bhAbhiloன rAjAviன nughadhdhughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhudhdhAmaluMbhoனAl, andha jAdhiyai nAன avaன ghaiyAle nirmUlamAghghumaLavuM, bhaDhDhayadhdhAluM bha~njhadhdhAluM ghòLLainoyAluM dhaNDhibhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

indha èllA vArdhdhaighaLiனbhaDhiye nAன yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya jhidheghghiyAvoDhu bhejhi: u~NghaL ghazhudhdhaibh bhAbhiloன rAjAviன nughadhdhughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhudhdhi, avaனaiyuM avaன jaனdhdhaiyuM jheviyu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu bhizhaibhbhIrghaL.
bhAbhiloன rAjAvaijh jheviyAmaRbhoghiRa jAdhighghu virodhamAgha ghardhdhar jhòனனdhiனbhaDhiye, nIyuM uன jaனmuM bhaDhDhayadhdhAluM bha~njhadhdhAluM ghòLLainoyAluM jhAvAனeன?

meluM nAன AjhAriyaraiyuM indha èllA jaன~NghaLaiyuM noghghi: idho, ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன bhaNimuDhDhughaL ibhbhòzhudhu jhIghghiradhdhile bhAbhiloனilirundhu dhiruMbhighghòNDhuvarabhbhaDhumèனRu, u~NghaLughghudh dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòllughiRa u~NghaLuDhaiya dhIrghghadharijhighaLiன vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheLAdhiru~NghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; avarghaL u~NghaLughghubh bhòyyAன dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòllughiRArghaL.
avarghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhAdhiru~NghaL; bhAbhiloன rAjAvaijh jheviyu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu bhizhaibhbhIrghaL indha nagharaM bhAzhAybhbhoghaveNDhiyadhèனன?

alladhu avarghaL dhIrghghadharijhighaLAyirundhu, avarghaLiDhadhdhile ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai irundhAl, ghardhdharuDhaiya AlayadhdhiluM, yUdhA rAjAviன aramaனaiyiluM, èrujhalemiluM mIdhiyAன bhaNimuDhDhughaL bhAbhiloனughghubh bhoghAdhabhaDhighghu avarghaL jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharai noghghi maனRADhaDhDhume.
