nAன avaighaLai vijhArighghuM nALvaraighghuM avaighaL a~Nghe irughghuM; bhiனbhu avaighaLaidh dhiruMbha indha sdhaladhdhiRghugh ghòNDhuvarabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனReன.

yUdhAvuDhaiya rAjAvAghiya jhidheghghiyA arajhALadh dhuvaghghiன nAlAMvaruShaM aindhAM mAdhadhdhile, ajhUriன ghumAraனAghiya aனனiyA èனனbhbhaDhDha ghibhiyoன UrAனAghiya dhIrghghadharijhi ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhile AjhAriyarghaLuM jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM bhArdhdhirughgha èனனai noghghi:
israveliன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, bhAbhiloன rAjAviன nughadhdhai muRidhdheன.

bhAbhiloன rAjAvAghiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAr ivviDhadhdhilirundhu èDhudhdhubh bhAbhiloனughghugh ghòNDhubhoன ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன bhaNimuDhDhughaLaiyèllAM nAன iraNDhu varuShaghAladhdhile ivviDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhaghghòNDhuvarabhbhaNNuveன.

yoyAghghImiன ghumAraனAghiya èghòனiyA èனghiRa yUdhAvuDhaiya rAjAvaiyuM bhAbhiloனughghujh jhiRaiyAghagh ghòNDhubhoghabhbhaDhDha yUdhar aனaivaraiyuM nAன ivviDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhivarabhbhaNNuveன; bhAbhiloன rAjAviன nughadhdhai uDhaibhbheன èனRAr èனRu jhòனனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhi AjhAriyarghaL bhArdhdhirughghavuM, ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhil niனRirundha jaன~NghaLèllAruM bhArdhdhirughghavuM aனனiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyai noghghi:

Amèன, ghardhdhar abhbhaDhiye jhèyvArAgha; ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன bhaNimuDhDhughaLaiyuM jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoன aனaivaraiyuM bhAbhiloனilirundhu dhiruMbhivarabhbhaNNuvAr èனRu nI dhIrghghadharijhaனmAghajh jhòனன uன vArdhdhaighaLaigh ghardhdhar niRaiveRRuvArAgha.
AghiluM, uன jhèvighaLuM jhaghala jaனdhdhiன jhèvighaLuM gheDhgha nAன jhòlluM vArdhdhaiyaigh gheL.

bhUrvaghAlamudhal èனghghu muனனuM uனghghu muனனuM irundha dhIrghghadharijhighaL aneghaM dhejha~NghaLughghu virodhamAghavuM, bhèriya rAjya~NghaLughghu virodhamAghavuM yudhdhadhdhaiyuM bha~njhadhdhaiyuM ghòLLainoyaiyuM ghuRidhdhudh dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòனனArghaL.

jhamAdhAனM varuM èனRu dhIrghghadharijhi dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòlliyirughgha, andhadh dhIrghghadharijhi jhòனன vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye vandhAl, abhbhòzhudhu avaன ghardhdhar mèyyAy aனubhbhiன dhIrghghadharijhiyAgha viLa~NghuvAனèனRu èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhi jhòனனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu aனனiyA èனghiRa dhIrghghadharijhi èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyiன ghazhudhdhilirundha nughadhdhai èDhudhdhu adhai uDhaidhdhubhbhoDhDhAன.

bhiனbhu aனனiyA jhaghala jaன~NghaLughghu muனbhAghavuM: indhabhbhiraghAramAgha iraNDhu varuShaghAladhdhile bhAbhiloன rAjAvAghiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAruDhaiya nughadhdhaijh jhaghala jAdhighaLiன ghazhudhdhilumirundhu vilagha uDhaidhdhubhbhoDhuveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAன. abhbhòzhudhu èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhi dhaன vazhiyebhoனAன.
aனனiyA èனghiRa dhIrghghadharijhi èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyiன ghazhudhdhilirundha nughadhdhai uDhaidhdhubhbhoDhDhabhiRbhADhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èremiyAvughghu uNDhAghi, avar:
nI bhoy, aனனiyAvai noghghi: nI mara nughadhdhai uDhaidhdhAy; adhaRghubhbhadhilAgha irubhbhu nughadhdhai uNDhubhaNNu èனRu ghardhdhar jhòனனAr.

bhAbhiloன rAjAvAghiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAraijh jhevighghuMbhaDhighghu irubhbhu nughadhdhai indha èllA jAdhighaLuDhaiya ghazhudhdhiனmeluM bhoDhDheன; avarghaL avaனaijh jhevibhbhArghaL. vèLiyiன mirughajIvaனghaLaiyuM avaனughghu òbhbhughghòDhudhdheன èனRu israveliன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனbhu èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhi aனனiyA èனghiRa dhIrghghadharijhiyai noghghi: ibhbhodhuM aனனiyAve, gheL, ghardhdhar uனனai aனubhbhiனdhillai; nIyo indha jaனdhdhaibh bhòyyai naMbhuMbhaDhijh jhèydhAy.

AghaiyAl, idho, uனனaibh bhUmiyiனmel irAdhabhaDhighghu aghaRRiviDhuveன; indha varuShadhdhile nI jhAvAy èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; ghardhdharughghu virodhamAygh ghalaghaM uNDhAghabh bhejhiனAye èனRAன.
abhbhaDhiye aனனiyA èனghiRa dhIrghghadharijhi avvaruShadhdhiledhAனe ezhAM mAdhadhdhil jhèdhdhubhbhoனAன.
èghòனiyA rAjAvuM, rAjasdhirIyuM, bhiradhAனighaLuM, yUdhAviluM èrujhalemilumuLLa bhirabhughghaLuM, dhajhjharuM, ghòllaruM èrujhalemaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoன bhiRbhADhu,

èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhi jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoன mUbhbharghaLil mIdhiyAனvarghaLughghuM, AjhAriyarghaLughghuM, dhIrghghadharijhighaLughghuM, nebhughAdhnejhjhAr jhiRaibhbhaDhudhdhi èrujhalemilirundhu bhAbhiloனughghugh ghòNDhubhoன jhaghala jaன~NghaLughghuM èzhudhi,

yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya jhidheghghiyA bhAbhiloன rAjAvAghiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAriDhadhdhil ghòDhughghuMbhaDhi jhAbhbhAனiன ghumAraனAghiya èlèyAjhAriன ghaiyiluM, ilghghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya ghèmariyAviன ghaiyiluM ghòDhudhdhu, èrujhalemilirundhu bhAbhiloனughghu aனubhbhiன nirubhadhdhiன vibharaM:
israveliன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar, dhAM èrujhalemilirundhu bhAbhiloனughghujh jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoghabhbhaNNiன aனaivarughghuM aRivighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl,
nI~NghaL vIDhughaLaigh ghaDhDhi, ghuDhiyirundhu, dhoDhDha~NghaLai nADhDhi, avaighaLiன ghaனiyaijh jhAbhbhiDhu~NghaL.

nI~NghaL bhèNghaLai vivAghaMbhaNNi, ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRRu, u~NghaL ghumArarughghubh bhèNghaLaighghòNDhu, u~NghaL ghumAradhdhighaLaibh bhuruSharughghugh ghòDhu~NghaL; ivarghaLuM ghumAraraiyuM ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM bhèRaDhDhuM; nI~NghaL a~Nghe ghuRughAmal bhèrughi,

nAன u~NghaLaijh jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoghabhbhaNNiன bhaDhDhaNadhdhiன jhamAdhAனdhdhaidh dheDhi, adhaRghAghagh ghardhdharai viNNabhbhaMbhaNNu~NghaL; adhaRghujh jhamAdhAனmirughghaiyil u~NghaLughghuM jhamAdhAனmirughghuM.

meluM, u~NghaL naDhuvilirughghiRa u~NghaL dhIrghghadharijhighaLuM u~NghaL ghuRighAraruM u~NghaLai mojhaMbhoghghavòDhDhAdhiru~NghaL; jhòbhbhaனM ghANabhbhaNNughiRa u~NghaL jhòbhbhaனghghArarughghujh jhèvighòDhAmaluM iru~NghaL èனRu israveliன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
avarghaL èன nAmadhdhaijh jhòlli u~NghaLughghubh bhòyyAன dhIrghghadharijhaனM uraighghiRArghaL; nAன avarghaLai aனubhbhiனdhillai èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

bhAbhiloனile èzhubhadhuvaruShaM niRaiveRiனbhiனbhu nAன u~NghaLaijh jhandhidhdhu, u~NghaLai ivviDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhivarabhbhaNNuMbhaDhighghu u~NghaLmel èன nalvArdhdhaiyai niRaiveRabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

nI~NghaL èdhirbhArdhdhirughghuM muDhivai u~NghaLughghu ghòDhughghuMbhaDhighghu nAன u~NghaLbheril niனaidhdhirughghiRa niனaivughaLai aRiveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; avaighaL dhImaighghalla, jhamAdhAனdhdhughghedhuvAன niனaivughaLe.
abhbhòzhudhu nI~NghaL ghUDhivandhu, èனனaidh dhòzhudhughòNDhu èனனai noghghi viNNabhbhaMbhaNNuvIrghaL; nAன u~NghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhubhbheன.
u~NghaL muzhu irudhayadhdhoDhuM èனனaidh dheDhiனIrghaLAனAl, èனனaidh dheDhughaiyil ghaNDhubhiDhibhbhIrghaL.

nAன u~NghaLughghugh ghANabhbhaDhuveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; nAன u~NghaL jhiRaiyirubhbhaidh dhirubhbhi nAன u~NghaLaidh dhuradhdhiviDhDha èllA jAdhighaLiluM èllA iDha~NghaLilumirundhu u~NghaLaijh jherdhdhu, nAன u~NghaLai vilaghghiyirundha sdhaladhdhughghe u~NghaLaidh dhiruMbhivarabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
ghardhdhar è~NghaLughghubh bhAbhiloனiluM dhIrghghadharijhighaLai èzhubhbhiனAr èனRu jhòllughiRIrghaL.

AனAl dhAvIdhiன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhil uDhghArndhirughghiRa rAjAvaighghuRidhdhuM u~NghaLoDheghUDhajh jhiRaiyirubhbhil bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoghAmal indha nagharadhdhil ghuDhiyirughghiRa u~NghaL jhaghodhararAghiya èllA jaன~NghaLaighghuRidhdhuM,

idho, nAன bhaDhDhayadhdhaiyuM, bha~njhadhdhaiyuM, ghòLLainoyaiyuM avarghaLughghuL aனubhbhuveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; bhujhighghadhdhaghAdha ghèDhDhubhbhoன adhdhibhbhazha~NghaLughghu avarghaLai òbhbhAghghuveன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

avarghaL èன vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheLAmaRbhoனbhaDhiyAl, nAன avarghaLaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhAluM, bha~njhadhdhAluM ghòLLainoyAluM bhiனdhòDharndhu, avarghaLaibh bhUmiyiluLLa èllA rAjya~NghaLiluM alaindhu dhirighiRavarghaLAghavuM, nAன avarghaLaidh dhuradhdhughiRa èllA jAdhighaLiDhadhdhiluM jhAbhamAghavuM, bhAzhAghavuM IjhaliDhudhalughghiDhamAghavuM, nindhaiyAghavuM vaibhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
nAன u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghudh dhIrghghadharijhighaLAghiya èன UzhiyaghghArarai eRghaனve aனubhbhighghòNDheyirundhuM, nI~NghaL jhèvighòDhAmaRbhoனIrghaLe èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
ibhbhodhuM jhiRaiyirughghuMbhaDhi nAன èrujhalemilirundhu bhAbhiloனughghu aனubhbhiviDhDha nI~NghaLèllAruM ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLu~NghaL.

èன nAmadhdhaijh jhòlli u~NghaLughghubh bhòyyAன dhIrghghadharijhaனM uraighghiRa ghòlAyAviன ghumAraனAghiya AghAbhaiyuM, mAjhèyAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhidheghghiyAvaiyu~NghuRidhdhu: idho, nAன avarghaLaibh bhAbhiloன rAjAvAghiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAriன ghaiyile òbhbhughghòDhughghiReன, avaன avarghaLai u~NghaL ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAghagh ghòனRubhoDhuvAன.

bhAbhiloன rAjA aghghiனiyiனAl jhuDhDhubhbhoDhDha jhidheghghiyAvughghuM AghAbhughghuM ghardhdhar uனனaijh jhamAனmAghghaghghaDhavarèனRu, avarghaLaigh ghuRidhdhu òru jhAbhavArdhdhai bhAbhiloனile jhiRaiyirughghiRa yUdhA aனaivarughghuLLuM vazha~NghuM èனRu israveliன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

avarghaL isravelile madhighèDhDha ghAriyadhdhaijh jhèydhu dha~NghaL ayalAruDhaiya bhèNjAdhighaLoDhe vibhajhAraMbhaNNi, nAன avarghaLughghugh ghaRbhiyAdha bhòyyAன vArdhdhaiyai èன nAmadhdhaijh jhòlli uraidhdhArghaL; nAன adhai aRiveன; adhaRghu nAனe jhADhjhi èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu èzhudhiனAன.
bhiனனuM ghardhdhar èனனai noghghi: nI nèghèlAmiyaனAghiya jhèmAyAvughghuM jhòlliyaனubhbhaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl:

nI èrujhalemilirughghiRa èllA jaன~NghaLughghuM mAjhèyAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhèbhbhaனiyA èனனuM AjhAriyaனughghuM, maRRa AjhAriyarghaLughghuM uன nAmadhdhile nirubhadhdhai èzhudhiyaனubhbhiனdhu èனனvèனRu israveliன dhevaனAghiya jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

ivaனughghu avaன èzhudhiyirundha nirubhamAvadhu: nI~NghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன vijhAribhbhughghArarAyirughghuMbhaDhighghuM, bhiramaighòNDhu dhaனனaidh dhIrghghadharijhiyAghghighghòLghiRavaghiனAghiya èndha maனuShaனaiyuM nIr ghAvalaRaiyiluM dhòzhuviluM bhoDhuMbhaDhighghuM, ghardhdhar uMmai AjhAriyaனAyirundha yoydhAviன sdhAனdhdhile AjhAriyaனAgha vaidhdhAre.
ibhbhodhuM u~NghaLughghudh dhIrghghadharijhaனM ghURivarughiRa Aனdhodh UrAனAghiya èremiyAvai nIr ghaDhindhughòLLAmaRbhoனdhèனன?

indhajh jhiRaiyirubhbhu nèDhu~NghAlamAgha irughghuM; nI~NghaL vIDhughaLaighghaDhDhi, avaighaLil ghuDhiyirundhu, dhoDhDha~NghaLai nADhDhi, avaighaLiன ghaனighaLaijh jhAbhbhiDhu~NghaL èனRu bhAbhiloனilirughghiRa è~NghaLughghujh jhòlliyaனubhbhiனAனèனRu èzhudhiyirundhAன.
indha nirubhadhdhaijh jhèbhbhaனiyA èனghiRa AjhAriyaன èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyiன ghAdhughaL gheDhgha vAjhidhdhAன.
AdhalAl ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èremiyAvughghu uNDhAghi avar:

jhiRaiyirughghiRa aனaivarughghuM nI jhòlliyaனubhbhaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: nèghèlAmiyaனAghiya jhèmAyAvaighghuRidhdhu ghardhdhar: jhèmAyAvai nAன aனubhbhAdhirundhuM, avaன u~NghaLughghudh dhIrghghadharijhaன~njhòlli, u~NghaLaibh bhòyyai naMbhabhbhaNNughiRabhaDhiyiனAl,

idho, nAன nèghèlAmiyaனAghiya jhèmAyAvaiyuM, avaன jhandhadhiyaiyuM dhaNDhibhbheன; indha jaனdhdhiன naDhuvile ghuDhiyirubhbhavaன òruvaனuM avaனughghu illAdhirubhbhAன; nAன èன jaனdhdhughghujh jhèyyuM naனmaiyai avaன ghANbhadhillai èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; ghardhdharughghu virodhamAygh ghalaghamuNDhAghabh bhejhiனAன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
ghardhdharAle eremiyAvughghu uNDhAன vArdhdhai:
israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, nAன uனனoDhe jhòனன èllA vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM òru bhusdhaghadhdhil èzhudhighghòL.

idho, nADhghaL varumèனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr, abhbhòzhudhu nAன israveluM yUdhAvumAghiya èனனuDhaiya jaனdhdhiன jhiRaiyirubhbhaidh dhirubhbhi, nAன avarghaL bhidhAghghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdha dhejhadhdhughghu avarghaLaidh dhiruMbha varabhbhaNNuveன; adhai avarghaL jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLuvArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
ivaighaL ghardhdhar isravelaiyuM yUdhAvaiyu~NghuRidhdhujh jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLe.
ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: dhadhdhaLibhbhiன jhadhdhadhdhaighgheDhghiRoM; dhighiluNDhu, jhamAdhAனmillai.

ANAybh bhiRandhavaன bhirajhavighghiRadhuNDho èனRu gheDhDhubhbhAru~NghaL; bhirajhavighghiRa sdhirIyaibhbhol bhuruShar yAvaruM dha~NghaL iDhubhbhughaLiனmel dha~NghaL ghaighaLai vaidhdhirughghiRadhaiyuM, mugha~NghaLèllAM mARi vèLudhdhirughghiRadhaiyuM nAன ghANghiRadhèனன?
aiyo! andha nAL bhèriyadhu; adhaibhbholòdhdha nALillai; adhu yAghghobhughghu ighghaDhDhughghAlaM; AனAluM avaன adhaRghu nI~NghalAghi iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhuvAன.
annALil nAன avaன nughadhdhai uன ghazhudhdhiனmel irAdhabhaDhighghu uDhaidhdhu, uன ghaDhDhughaLai aRubhbheன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; anniyar iனi avaனai aDhimai ghòLvadhillai.
dha~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaiyuM, nAன dha~NghaLughghu èzhubhbhabhbhoghiRa dha~NghaL rAjAvAghiya dhAvIdhaiyume jhevibhbhArghaL.

AghaiyAl èன dhAjhaனAghiya yAghghobhe, nI bhayabhbhaDhAdhe; isravele , ghala~NghAdhe èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; idho, nAன uனனaidh dhUradhdhiluM, uன jhandhadhiyaidh dha~NghaL jhiRaiyirubhbhiன dhejhadhdhiluM irAdhabhaDhighghu iraDhjhibhbheன; yAghghobhu dhiruMbhi vandhu amarndhu jhughidhdhirubhbhAன; avaனaidh dhadhdhaLighghabhbhaNNughiRavaனillai.

uனனai iraDhjhibhbhadhaRghAgha nAன uனனoDhe irughghiReன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; uனனaijh jhidhaRaDhidhdha èllA jAdhighaLaiyuM nAன nirmUlamAghghuveன; uனனaiyo nAன nirmUlamAghghAmaluM, muRRiluM dhaNDhiyAmal viDhAmaluM, maDhDhAydh dhaNDhibhbheன.
ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl; uன bhuN ARAdhadhAyuM uன ghAyaM ghòDhiyadhAyuM irughghiRadhu.

indha vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya èremiyA èrujhalemile yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya jhidheghghiyAviனiDhadhdhil jhòனனAன.

òvvòruvaனuM dhaன velaighghAraனaiyuM dhaன velaighghAriyaiyuM iனi aDhimai ghòLLAdhabhaDhighghu, jhuyAdhIனrAgha aனubhbhiviDhaveNDhumèனRu uDhaனbhaDhighghaighghu uDhbhaDhDha èllAbh bhirabhughghaLughghuM èllA jaன~NghaLuM gheDhDhabhodhu, jhèvighòDhudhdhu avarghaLai aனubhbhiviDhDhArghaL.

AdhalAl, ghardhdharAle èremiyAvughghu vArdhdhaiyuNDhAghi, avar:

israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, avaனvaன dhaனghghu viRghabhbhaDhDha èbhirèyaனAghiya dhaன jhaghodharaனai muDhivile nI~NghaL ezhAM varuShadhdhile aனubhbhiviDhaveNDhuM èனRuM, avaன uனghghu ARuvaruShaM aDhimaiyAyirundhabhiனbhu, avaனai uனனiDhadhdhil vaighghAmal jhuyAdhIனனAgha aனubhbhiviDhaveNDhuM èனRuM,

nAன u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLai aDhimai vIDhAghiya èghibhdhudhejhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNiன nALile avarghaLoDhe uDhaனbhaDhighghaibhaNNiனeன; AனAluM u~NghaL bhidhAghghaL èன jhòllaigh gheLAmaluM, dha~NghaL jhèviyaijh jhAyAmaluM bhoனArghaL.

AghaiyAl ghardhdhar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, nI~NghaL avaனvaன dhaன jhaghodharaனughghuM avaனvaன dhaன ayalAனughghuM viDhudhalaiyaigh ghURiனviShayadhdhil èன jhòllaigh gheLAmaRbhoனIrghaLe; idho nAன u~NghaLaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhughghuM, ghòLLainoyghghuM, bha~njhadhdhughghuM òbhbhughghòDhughghiRa viDhudhalaiyai u~NghaLughghugh ghURughiReன; bhUmiyiன rAjya~NghaLilèllAM alaighiRadhaRghuM u~NghaLai òbhbhughghòDhubhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

èன mughadhdhughghumuன bhaNNiன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyiன vArdhdhaighaLai niRaiveRRAmal, èன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai mIRiன maனuSharai nAன dhuNDha~NghaLiன naDhuvAghagh ghaDhandhubhoghuMbhaDhi avarghaLai iraNDhAghadh dhuNDhidhdha ghaனRughghuDhDhiyaibhbhol Aghghuveன.

ghaனRughghuDhDhiyiன dhuNDhughaLiன naDhuve ghaDhandhubhoன yUdhAviன bhirabhughghaLaiyuM, èrujhalemiன bhirabhughghaLaiyuM, bhiradhAனighaLaiyuM, AjhAriyarghaLaiyuM, dhejhadhdhiன jhaghala jaன~NghaLaiyuM abhbhaDhijh jhèydhu,

idho, nAன ghaDhDhaLaighòDhudhdhu, avarghaLai indha nagharadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhabhbhaNNuveன; avarghaL adhaRghu virodhamAgha yudhdhaMbhaNNi, adhaibh bhiDhidhdhu, adhai aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhèribhbhArghaL; yUdhAviன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLaiyuM, òruvaruM avaighaLil ghuDhiyirAdhabhaDhibh bhAzhAybhbhoghabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
yojhiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya yoyAghghIM èனனuM yUdhA rAjAviன nADhghaLil èremiyAvughghugh ghardhdharAl uNDhAன vArdhdhai:

nI reghAbhiyaruDhaiya vIDhDhughghubh bhoy, avarghaLoDhe bhejhi, avarghaLaigh ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன aRaighaLil òனRile azhaidhdhuvandhu, avarghaLughghudh dhirADhjharajhaM ghuDhighghagh ghòDhu èனRAr.

avaன rAjAviன aramaனaighghubh bhoy, jhaMbhiradhiyiன aRaiyil bhiravejhidhdhAன; idho, a~Nghe èllAbh bhirabhughghaLuM jhaMbhiradhiyAghiya èlijhAmAvuM jhèmAyAviன ghumAraன ghumAraனAghiya dhèlAyAvuM, aghbhoriன ghumAraனAghiya èsdhAdhdhaனuM, jhAbhbhaனiன ghumAraனAghiya ghèmariyAvuM, aனனiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhidheghghiyAvuM, maRRa èllAbh bhirabhughghaLuM uDhghArndhirundhArghaL.
bhArughghu jaனdhdhiன jhèvighaL gheDhghabh bhusdhaghadhdhiluLLavaighaLai vAjhighghaiyil, dhAன gheDhDha èllA vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM mighAyA avarghaLughghudh dhèrividhdhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu èllAbh bhirabhughghaLuM ghUShiyiன ghumAraனAghiya jhèlemiyAviன maghaனAன nèdhdhAனiyAviனuDhaiya ghumAraனAyirughghiRa yèghudhiyaibh bhArughghiனiDhadhdhil aனubhbhi, jaன~NghaL gheDhgha nI vAjhidhdhughghòNDhirundha jhuruLai uன ghaiyil èDhudhdhugh ghòNDhuvA èனRu jhòllajh jhòனனArghaL; AghaiyAl neriyAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhArughghu jhuruLaidh dhaன ghaiyil èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, avarghaLiDhadhdhughghu vandhAன.
avarghaL avaனai noghghi: nI uDhghArndhughòNDhu, nA~NghaL gheDhgha vAjhiyèனRArghaL; avarghaL gheDhgha vAjhidhdhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL èllA vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM gheDhghaiyil bhayamuRRavarghaLAy òruvaraiyòruvar bhArdhdhu, bhArughghai noghghi: indha èllA vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM rAjAvughghu nijhjhayamAy aRivibhbhoM èனRArghaL.
avaன vAy jhòlla, nI indha vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM èvvidhamAy èzhudhiனAy adhai è~NghaLughghujh jhòl èனRu bhArughghaigh gheDhDhArghaL.
adhaRghu bhArughghu: avar dhamadhu vAyiனAl indha èllA vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM uraidhdhu, èனனuDhaனe jhòனனAr, nAன maiyiனAl bhusdhaghadhdhil èzhudhiனeன èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhirabhughghaL bhArughghai noghghi: nIyuM èremiyAvuM bhoy òLidhdhughghòLLu~NghaL; nI~NghaL irughghuM iDhadhdhai òruvaruM aRiyabhbhaDhAdhu èனRu jhòlli,
jhuruLaijh jhaMbhiradhiyAghiya èlijhAmAviன aRaiyile vaidhdhu, rAjAviனiDhadhdhughghu aramaனaiyile bhoy, rAjAviன jhèvighaLughghu indha vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM aRividhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA andhajh jhuruLai èDhudhdhughghòNDhuvara yèghudhiyai aனubhbhiனAன; yèghudhi adhaijh jhaMbhiradhiyAghiya èlijhAmAviன aRaiyilirundhu èDhudhdhughghòNDhuvandhu, rAjA gheDhghavuM, rAjAviனiDhadhdhil niனRa èllAbh bhirabhughghaLuM gheDhghavuM vAjhidhdhAன.
òனbhadhAM mAdhadhdhile rAjA, ghuLirghAladhdhughghudh dha~NghuM vIDhDhil uDhghArndhirundhAன; avaனughghu muனbhAghagh ghaNabhbhu mUDhDhiyirundhadhu.

yèghudhi mUனRu nAlu bhadhdhighaLai vAjhidhdha bhiனbhu, rAjA òru jhUrighghadhdhiyiனAl adhai aRudhdhu, jhuruLaனaidhdhuM ghaNabhbhiluLLa aghghiனiyile vèndhu bhoghuMbhaDhi, ghaNabhbhilirundha aghghiனiyil èRindhubhoDhDhAன.
rAjAvAyiனuM andha vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM gheDhDha avaனuDhaiya jhaghala UzhiyaghghArarAyiனuM bhayabhbhaDhavumillai, dha~NghaL vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòLLavumillai.
èlnAdhdhAனuM, dhèlAyAvuM, ghèmariyAvumo: andhajh jhuruLaijh jhuDhDhèrighgha veNDhAM èனRu rAjAviனiDhadhdhil viNNabhbhaM bhaNNiனArghaL; AனAluM avarghaLughghu avaன jhèvighòDhAmal,

bhArughghu èனனuM jhaMbhiradhiyaiyuM èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyaiyuM bhiDhighghuMbhaDhighghu, rAjA aMmèleghiன ghumAraனAghiya yòmèyelughghuM, asriyeliன ghumAraனAghiya jhèrAyAvughghuM, abhdhèyeliன ghumAraனAghiya jhèlemiyAvughghuM ghaDhDhaLai ghòDhudhdhAன; AனAluM ghardhdhar avarghaLai maRaidhdhAr.
rAjA andhajh jhuruLaiyuM, adhile èremiyAviன vAy jhòllabh bhArughghu èzhudhiyirundha vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM jhuDhDhèridhdha bhiனbhu, èremiyAvughghugh ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai uNDhAghi, avar:
nI dhiruMbha veRòru jhuruLai èDhudhdhu, yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yoyAghghIM jhuDhDhèridhdha mudhalAM jhuruLilirundha mundhiன vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM adhile èzhudhu èனRAr.

meluM nI yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yoyAghghImai noghghi: bhAbhiloன rAjA nijhjhayamAy varuvAன èனbhadhaiyuM, avaன indhadh dhejhadhdhai azhidhdhu adhilirundhu maனuSharaiyuM mirugha~NghaLaiyuM òzhiyabhbhaNNuvAன èனbhadhaiyuM nI adhil èzhudhiனdhedhèனRu jhòlli, andhajh jhuruLai nI jhuDhDhèridhdhAye èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

AghaiyAl yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yoyAghghImaigh ghuRidhdhu; dhAvIdhiன jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel uDhghAruMbhaDhi avaன vaMjhadhdhil òruvaனuM irAன; avaனuDhaiya bhiredhamovèனRAl, bhaghaliன uShNadhdhughghuM iraviன ghuLirughghuM èRindhuviDhabhbhaDhDhughghiDhaghghuM.

nAன avaனiDhadhdhiluM, avaன jhandhadhiyiனiDhadhdhiluM, avaன bhirabhughghaLiனiDhadhdhiluM avarghaL aghghiramadhdhai vijhAridhdhu, avaனmeluM èrujhalemiன ghuDhighaLmeluM, yUdhA maனuSharmeluM, nAன avarghaLughghujh jhòனனdhuM, avarghaL gheLAmaRbhoனdhumAன dhI~NghaனaidhdhaiyuM varabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu èremiyA veRòru jhuruLai èDhudhdhu, adhai neriyAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhArughghu èனனuM jhaMbhiradhiyiனiDhadhdhil ghòDhudhdhAன; avaன yUdhAviன rAjAvAghiya yoyAghghIM aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhèridhdha bhusdhaghadhdhiன vArdhdhaighaLaiyèllAM, adhile èremiyAviன vAy jhòlla èzhudhiனAன; iனனuM avaighaLughghòdhdha aneghaM vArdhdhaighaLuM avaighaLoDhe jherghghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

bhAbhiloன rAjAvAghiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAr yUdhA dhejhadhdhil rAjAvAgha niyamidhdha yoyAghghImuDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya ghoனiyAviன bhaDhDhadhdhughghu yojhiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhidheghghiyA vandhu arajhANDhAன.
ghardhdhar èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyaighghòNDhu jhòனன vArdhdhaighaLughghu avaனAghiluM, avaனuDhaiya UzhiyaghghArarAghiluM, dhejhadhdhiன jaன~NghaLAghiluM jhèvighòDhughghavillai.

jhidheghghiyA rAjAvovèனil, jhèlemiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya yUghAlaiyuM, mAjhèyAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhèbhbhaனiyA èனனuM AjhAriyaனaiyuM èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyiனiDhadhdhil aனubhbhi: nI naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharai noghghi è~NghaLughghAgha viNNabhbhaMbhaNNaveNDhuM èனRu jhòllajh jhòனனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu èremiyA jaனdhdhiன naDhuve varadhdhuM bhoghghumAyirundhAன; avaனai avarghaL ghAval vIDhDhil iனனuM bhoDhavillai.
bhArvoனiன jheனaiyovèனRAl, èghibhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhadhu; èrujhalemai muRRighghaibhoDhDha ghaldheyar avarghaLuDhaiya jhèydhiyaighgheDhDhu, èrujhalemaiviDhDhu nI~NghibhbhoனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhighghugh ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai uNDhAghi, avar,

israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, èனனiDhadhdhil vijhArighghuMbhaDhi u~NghaLai èனனiDhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiன yUdhAviன rAjAvai nI~NghaL noghghi: idho, u~NghaLughghu òdhdhAjhaiyAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDha bhArvoனiன jheனai dhaன dhejhamAghiya èghibhdhughghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoghuM.
ghaldheyarovèனRAl, dhiruMbhi vandhu indha nagharadhdhughghu virodhamAgha yudhdhaMbhaNNi, adhaibh bhiDhidhdhu, aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhèribhbhArghaL.
ghaldheyar naMmaiviDhDhu nijhjhayamAybh bhoyviDhuvArghaLèனRu jhòlli, nI~NghaL mojhaMbhoghAdhiru~NghaL, avarghaL bhovadhillai.

u~NghaLoDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNughiRa ghaldheyaruDhaiya jheனaiyaiyèllAM nI~NghaL muRiya aDhidhdhAluM, mIndhavarghaL èllAruM ghAyaMbhaDhDhavarghaLAyirundhAluM, avarghaL dha~NghaL ghUDhAra~NghaLilirundhu èzhuMbhi, indha nagharadhdhai aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhèribhbhArghaLèனRu ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòllu~NghaL èனRAr.
bhArvoனiன jheனai varughiRadhèனRu, ghaldheyaruDhaiya jheனai èrujhalemaiviDhDhubh bhoனbhodhu,
èremiyA avviDhadhdhaiviDhDhu, jaனdhdhiன naDhuve jADhaiyAy vilaghi, bhèனyamIன dhejhadhdhughghubh bhogha maனdhAy èrujhalemilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAன.

avaன bhèனyamIன vAjhalil vandhabhodhu, ghAvaRjhervaiyiன adhibhadhiyAghiya yèriyA èனனuM nAmamuLLa òruvaன a~Nghe irundhAன; avaன aனனiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhèlemiyAviன maghaன; avaன: nI ghaldheyaraijh jherabhbhoghiRavaன èனRu jhòlli, èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyaibh bhiDhidhdhAன.

bhiனbhu jhidheghghiyA rAjA avaனai azhaidhdhaனubhbhi: ghardhdharAl òru vArdhdhai uNDho èனRu rAjA avaனaidh dhaன vIDhDhile iraghajhiyamAygh gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu èremiyA: uNDhu, bhAbhiloன rAjAviன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvIr èனRu jhòனனAன.

bhiனனuM èremiyA, jhidheghghiyA rAjAvai noghghi: nI~NghaL èனனaigh ghAval vIDhDhile aDhaibhbhadhaRghu, nAன umaghghuM uMmuDhaiya UzhiyaghghArarughghuM indha jaனdhdhughghuM virodhamAgha èனன ghuRRa~njhèydheன?
bhAbhiloன rAjA u~NghaLughghuM indhadh dhejhadhdhughghuM virodhamAgha varuvadhillaiyèனRu u~NghaLughghudh dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòனன u~NghaLuDhaiya dhIrghghadharijhighaL è~Nghe?

ibhbhodhuM rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனe, èனghghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhu, èன viNNabhbhadhdhughghudh dhayaijhèydhu, èனனaijh jhaMbhiradhiyAghiya yoனdhdhAனuDhaiya vIDhDhiRghudh dhiruMbha aனubhbhaveNDhAM; aனubhbhiனAl nAன a~Nghe jhèdhdhubhbhoveன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu èremiyAvaigh ghAvaRjhAlaiyiன muRRadhdhile ghAghghavuM, nagharadhdhile abhbhamirughghumaDhDhuM abhbha~njhuDhughiRavarghaLiன vIdhiyile dhiனM òru abhbhadhdhai avaனughghu vA~Nghigh ghòDhughghavuM ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAன; abhbhaDhiye èremiyA ghAvaRjhAlaiyiன muRRadhdhile irundhAன.

indha nagharadhdhile dharidhdhirughghiRavaன bhaDhDhayadhdhAluM bha~njhadhdhAluM, ghòLLai noyAluM jhAvAன; ghaldheyariDhadhdhughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoghiRavaனo uyiroDhirubhbhAன; avaனuDhaiya bhirANaன avaனughghugh ghiDhaidhdha ghòLLaiyuDhaimaiyaibhbholirughghuM; avaன bhizhaibhbhAனèனbhadhaigh ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRuM,
indha nagharaM bhAbhiloன rAjAviனuDhaiya irANuvadhdhiன ghaiyil nijhjhayamAgha òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuM; avaன adhaibh bhiDhibhbhAனèனbhadhaigh ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRuM,

èremiyA èllA jaனdhdhoDhuM jhòllighghòNDhirundha vArdhdhaighaLai mAdhdhAனiன ghumAraனAghiya jhèbhbhadhdhiyAvuM, jhèlemiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya yUghAluM, malghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhasghUruM gheDhDhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu bhirabhughghaL rAjAvai noghghi: indha maனuShaன ghòllabhbhaDha udhdharavAghaveNDhuM; adheனèனRAl, indha nagharadhdhil mIdhiyAyirughghiRa yudhdha maனuShariDhadhdhiluM, maRRumuLLa jhaghala jaன~NghaLiDhadhdhiluM, ivaன ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha vArdhdhaighaLaijh jhòllughiRadhiனAle avarghaLuDhaiya ghaighaLaidh dhaLarndhubhoghabhbhaNNughiRAன; ivaன indha jaனdhdhiன emadhdhaidh dheDhAmal, avarghaL gheDhDhaiye dheDhughiRAன èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu jhidheghghiyA rAjA: idho, avaன u~NghaL ghaiyil irughghiRAன; u~NghaLughghu virodhamAy rAjA òனRuM jhèyyagh ghUDhAdhu èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL èremiyAvaibh bhiDhidhdhu, avaனaigh ghAvaRjhAlaiyiன muRRadhdhilirundha aMmèleghiன ghumAraனAghiya malghiyAviனuDhaiya dhuravile bhoDhDhArghaL; èremiyAvaigh ghayiRughaLiனAl adhile iRaghghiviDhDhArghaL; andhadh dhuravile dhaNNIr illAmal uLaiyAyirundhadhu, andha uLaiyile èremiyA amizhndhiனAன.
avarghaL èremiyAvaidh dhuravile bhoDhDhadhai rAjAviன aramaனaiyil irundha èdhdhiyobhbhiyaனAghiya èbhedhmèlegh èனனuM òru bhiradhAனi gheLvibhbhaDhDhAன; rAjAvo bhèனyamIன vAjhalile uDhghArndhirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu èbhèdhmèlegh rAjAviன aramaனaiyilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, rAjAvai noghghi:

rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனe, indhabh bhuruShar èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyaidh dhuravile bhoDhDhujh jhèydhadhu èllAM dhaghAdha jhèyghaiyAyirughghiRadhu; avaன irughghiRa iDhadhdhile bhaDhDhiனiyiனAl jhAvAனe, iனi nagharadhdhile abhbhamillai èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu rAjA èbhèdhmèlegh èனனuM èdhdhiyobhbhiyaனai noghghi: nI ivviDhadhdhilirundhu mubhbhadhu maனuSharai uனனuDhaனe; ghUDhDhighghòNDhubhoy, èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhi jhAghAdhadhaRghumuனனe avaனaidh dhuravilirundhu dhUghghiviDhu èனRu ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu èbhèdhmèlegh andha maனuSharaidh dhaனனuDhaனe ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, rAjAviன aramaனaibh bhòghghiShajhAlaiyiன ghIzhirundha aRaighghuL bhughundhu, ghizhindhubhoன bhazhaMbhuDhaivaighaLaiyuM ghandhaidh dhuNighaLaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhubhoy, avaighaLaigh ghayiRughaLiனAl èremiyAvaNDhaighghudh dhuravile iRaghghiviDhDhu,

èbhèdhmèlegh èனனuM èdhdhiyobhbhiyaன èremiyAvuDhaனe: ghizhindhubhoன indhabh bhazhaMbhuDhavaighaLaiyuM ghandhaighaLaiyuM uMmuDhaiya aghghuLghaLil ghayiRughghuL aDha~Nghavaidhdhubh bhoDhDhughghòLLuM èனRAன: èremiyA abhbhaDhiye jhèydhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu èremiyAvaigh ghayiRughaLAl dhUghghi, avaனaidh dhuravilirundhu èDhudhdhuviDhDhArghaL; èremiyA ghAvaRjhAlaiyiன muRRadhdhil irundhAன.

bhiனbhu jhidheghghiyA rAjA, èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyaigh ghardhdharuDhaiya AlayadhdhilirughghuM mUனRAM vAjhalile dhaனனiDhadhdhiRghu varavazhaidhdhAன; a~Nghe rAjA, èremiyAvai noghghi: nAன uனனiDhadhdhil òru ghAriyaM gheDhghiReன; nI èனghghu òனRuM maRaighghaveNDhAM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu èremiyA jhidheghghiyAvai noghghi: nAன adhai umaghghu aRividhdhAl èனனai nijhjhayamAygh ghòlaijhèyvIrallavA? nAன umaghghu Alojhaனai jhòனனAluM, èன jhòllaigh gheDhghamADhDhIr èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu jhidheghghiyA rAjA: nAன uனனaigh ghòllAmaluM, uன bhirANaனai vA~NghadhdheDhughiRa indha maனuShar ghaiyil uனனai òbhbhughghòDhAmaluM irubhbheன èனbhadhai, namaghghu indha AdhdhumAvai uNDhubhaNNiன ghardhdharuDhaiya jIvaனaigh ghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRu èremiyAvughghu iraghajhiyamAy ANaiyiDhDhAன.

jhAghave jhAvAy èனRu nAன dhuனmArghghaனughghujh jhòllughaiyil, nI dhuனmArghghaனaidh dhaன dhuனmArghghamAன vazhiyil irAdhabhaDhighghu èjhjharighghuMbhaDhiyAghavuM, avaனai uyiroDhe ghAghghuMbhaDhiyAghavuM, adhai avaனughghujh jhòllAmaluM, nI avaனai èjhjharighghAmaluM irundhAl, andha dhuனmArghghaன dhaன dhuனmArghghadhdhile jhAvAன; avaன iradhdhabhbhazhiyaiyo uன ghaiyile gheDhbheன.

nI dhuனmArghghaனai èjhjharidhdhuM, avaன dhaன dhuனmArghghadhdhaiyuM dhaன AghAdha vazhiyaiyuM viDhDhudh dhiruMbhAmaR bhovAனAghil, avaன dhaன dhuனmArghghadhdhile jhAvAன nIyovèனRAl uன AdhdhumAvaidh dhabhbhuvibhbhAy.

abhbhaDhiye, nIdhimAன dhaன nIdhiyai viDhDhudh dhiruMbhi, nIdhigheDhu jhèyyuMbhodhuM, nAன avaனmuன iDhaRalai vaighghuMbhodhuM, avaன jhAvAன; nI avaனai èjhjharighghAdhabhaDhiyiனAle avaன dhaன bhAvadhdhile jhAvAன; avaன jhèydha nIdhighaL niனaighghabhbhaDhuvadhillai; avaனuDhaiya iradhdhabhbhazhiyaiyo uன ghaiyile gheDhbheன.

nIdhimAன bhAva~n jhèyyAdhabhaDhighghu nI nIdhimAனai èjhjharidhdhabhiனbhu avaன bhAva~njhèyyAviDhDhAl, avaன bhizhaighghave bhizhaibhbhAன; avaன èjhjharighghabhbhaDhDhAன; nIyuM uன AdhdhumAvaidh dhabhbhuvidhdhAy èனRAr.
avviDhadhdhile ghardhdharuDhaiya gharaM èனmel amarndhadhu; avar: nI èzhundhirundhu bhaLLadhdhAghghughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbho, a~Nghe uனனuDhaனe bhejhuveன èனRAr.
abhbhaDhiye nAன èzhundhirundhu, bhaLLadhdhAghghughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனeன; idho, ghebhAr nadhiyaNDhaiyile nAன ghaNDha maghimai viLa~Nghiனdhu; abhbhòzhudhu nAன mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundheன.
uDhaனe Avi èனghghuLLe bhughundhu, èனனaigh ghAluUனRi niRghuMbhaDhi jhèydhadhu, abhbhòzhudhu avar èனனuDhaனe bhejhi; nI bhoy, uன vIDhDhughghuLLe uனனai aDhaidhdhughghòNDhiru.
idho, maனubhudhdhiraனe, uனmel ghayiRughaLaibhbhoDhDhu, avaighaLAl uனனaigh ghaDhDhabhbhoghiRArghaL; AghaiyAl nI avarghaLughghuLLe bhoghaveNDhAM..
nAன uன nAvai uன mel vAyoDhe òDhDhighghòLLabhbhaNNuveன; nI avarghaLaigh ghaDhindhughòLLughiRa maனuShaனAyirAmal, UmaiyaனAyirubhbhAy; avarghaL ghalaghavIDhDhAr.

nAன uனனoDhe bhejhuMbhodhu, uன vAyaidh dhiRabhbheன; abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar iனனiனனdhai uraidhdhAr èனRu avarghaLoDhe jhòlvAy; gheDhghiRavaன gheDhghaDhDhuM, gheLAdhavaன gheLAdhirughghaDhDhuM; avarghaL ghalaghavIDhDhAr.
maனubhudhdhiraனe, nI òru jhè~Nghalai èDhudhdhu, adhai uனmuன vaidhdhu, adhiன mel èrujhaleM nagharadhdhai varaindhu,

adhaRghu virodhamAgha muRRighghai bhoDhDhu, adhaRghu virodhamAghagh ghòdhdhaLa~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhi, adhaRghu virodhamAgha maNmeDhubhoDhDhu, adhaRghu virodhamAgha irANuva~NghaLai niRudhdhi, jhuRRiluM adhaRghu virodhamAgha madhiliDhighghuM yandhira~NghaLai vai.

meluM nI òru irubhbhujhjhaDhDhiyai vA~Nghi, adhai uனghghuM nagharadhdhughghuM naDhuvAgha irubhbhujhjhuvarAghghi, adhu muRRighghaiyAygh ghiDhaghghuMbhaDhighghu uன mughadhdhai adhaRghu nerAydh dhirubhbhi, adhai muRRighghaibhoDhDhughghòNDhiru; idhu isravel vaMjhadhdhughghu aDhaiyALaM.

nI uன iDhadhubhaghghamAy òrughghaLidhdhubh bhaDhudhdhu, adhiனmel isravel vaMjhadhdhAriன aghghiramadhdhaijh jhumadhdhighghòL; nI andhabhbhaghghamAy òrughghaLidhdhirughghuM nADhghaLiன ilaghghadhdhiனbhaDhiye avarghaLuDhaiya aghghiramadhdhaijh jhumabhbhAy.

avarghaLuDhaiya aghghiramadhdhiன varuSha~NghaLai uனghghu nADhghaNaghghAy èNNagh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDheன; munnURRudhdhòNNURu nADhghaLvaraighghuM nI isravel vaMjhadhdhAriன aghghiramadhdhai jhumaghghaveNDhuM.

nI ivaighaLai niRaiveRRiனbhiனbhu, maRubhaDhiyuM uன valadhubhaghghamAy òrughghaLidhdhu, yUdhA vaMjhadhdhAriன aghghiramadhdhai nARbhadhunAL varaighghuM jhumaghghaveNDhuM; òvvòru varuShadhdhughghubhbhadhilAgha òvvòru nALai uனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDheன.
nI èrujhalemiன muRRighghaighghu nerAghadh dhirubhbhiya mughamuM, dhiRandha bhuyamumAgha irundhu, adhaRghu virodhamAghadh dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòllu.
idho, nI adhai muRRighghaibhbhoDhuM nADhghaLai niRaiveRRumaDhDhuM òru bhaghghadhdhilirundhu maRubhaghghadhdhil bhuraLagh ghUDhAdhabhaDhighghu uனனaigh ghayiRughaLAl ghaDhDhuveன.

nI ghodhumaiyaiyuM vARghodhumaiyaiyuM bhèruMbhayaRRaiyuM jhiRubhayaRRaiyuM dhiனaiyaiyuM ghaMbhaiyuM vA~Nghi, avaighaLai òru bhAdhdhiradhdhile bhoDhDhu, avaighaLAl uனghghu abhbha~njhuDhuvAy; nI òrughghaLidhdhubh bhaDhughghuM nADhghaLuDhaiya ilaghghadhdhiனbhaDhiye munnURRudhdhòNNURunAL adhil èDhudhdhu jhAbhbhiDhuvAyAgha.
nI jhAbhbhiDhuM bhojaனM, nAL òனRughghu irubhadhu jheghghal niRaiyAyirughghuM; abhbhaDhi nALughghunAL jhAbhbhiDhuvAyAgha.
dhaNNIraiyuM aLavAy hiன èனனuM bhaDhiyil ARilòru bha~Nghaigh ghuDhibhbhAy; abhbhaDhi nALughghunAL ghuDhibhbhAyAgha.
adhai vARghodhumai aDhaiyaibhbhol jhAbhbhiDhuvAyAgha; adhu maனuShaனilirundhu ghazhindha ghaShDhadhdhiன vaRaDhDhighaLAl avarghaL ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAghajh jhuDhabhbhaDhuvadhAgha.
adhaRghu òdhdhabhaDhiye isravel bhudhdhirar, nAன avarghaLaidh dhuradhdhughiRa bhuRajAdhighaLughghuLLe dha~NghaL abhbhadhdhaidh dhIDhDhuLLadhAghajh jhAbhbhiDhuvArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòனனAr.

abhbhòzhudhu nAன: A, ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavare, idho, èன AdhdhumA dhIDhDhubhbhaDhavillai; dhAனAyjh jhèdhdhadhaiyAvadhu, bhIRuNDhadhaiyAvadhu nAன èன jhiRuvayadhumudhal idhuvaraighghuM jhAbhbhiDhDhadhillai; aruvarubhbhAன iRaijhjhi èன vAyghghuDhbhaDhDhadhumillai èனReன.
abhbhòzhudhu avar èனனai noghghi: bhAr, maனuSha ghaShDhadhdhiன vaRaDhDhighghubh bhadhilAgha uனghghu mADhDhujhjhANi vaRaDhDhiyai ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhughiReன; adhiனAl uன abhbhadhdhai jhuDhuvAyAgha èனRAr.
bhiனனuM avar; maனubhudhdhiraனe, idho, abhbhamuM dhaNNIruM avarghaLughghugh ghuRaiyavuM, avaனvaன dhiDhughghiDhavuM, avarghaL dha~NghaL aghghiramadhdhile vADhibhbhoghavuM,
nAன èrujhalemile abhbhaM èனனuM Adharavugholai muRighghiReன; avarghaL abhbhadhdhai niRaiyiனbhaDhiye vijhAradhdhoDhe jhAbhbhiDhDhu, dhaNNIrai aLaviனbhaDhiye dhiDhughghiDhudhaloDhe ghuDhibhbhArghaL.

bhiனனuM avar: maனubhudhdhiraனe, jhavaraghaன ghadhdhiyAghiya gharughghAன ghadhdhiyai vA~Nghi, adhiனAl uன dhalaiyaiyuM uன dhADhiyaiyuM jhiraidhdhughghòNDhu, bhiனbhu niRughghuM dharAjhai èDhudhdhu, andha mayiraibh bha~NghiDhaghghaDhavAy.

mUனRil òru bha~Nghai èDhudhdhu muRRighghaibhoDhuM nADhghaL muDhighiRabhodhu nagharadhdhiன naDhuvile aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhèridhdhu, mUனRil òru bha~Nghai èDhudhdhu, adhaijh jhuRRiluM ghadhdhiyAle vèDhDhi, mUனRil òru bha~Nghai èDhudhdhugh ghARRile dhURRaghghaDhavAy; avaighaLiன bhiனனAgha nAன bhaDhDhayadhdhai uruvuveன.
adhil ghò~njhaMmAdhdhiraM èDhudhdhu, adhai uன vasdhiradhdhora~NghaLil muDhindhuvaibhbhAyAgha.
bhiனனuM adhil ghò~njhaM èDhudhdhu, adhaidh dhIyiன naDhuvil èRindhu, adhai aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhèribhbhAyAgha; adhilirundhu isravel vaMjhadhdhAr aனaivarughghuM virodhamAgha aghghiனi bhuRabhbhaDhuM.
ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, idhuve èrujhaleM, bhuRajAdhighaLiன naDhuvile nAன adhai vaidhdheன, adhaijh jhuRRiluM dhejha~NghaL irughghiRadhu.

adhu bhuRajAdhighaLaibhbhArghghiluM èன niyAya~NghaLaiyuM dhaனனaijh jhuRRiluM irughghiRa dhejha~NghaLaibhbhArghghiluM èன ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM aghghiramamAgha mARRibhbhoDhDhadhu; avarghaL èன niyAya~NghaLai vèRudhdhu, èன ghaDhDhaLaighaLil naDhavAmaR bhoனArghaL.
AghaiyAl ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, u~NghaLaijh jhuRRiluM irughghiRa bhuRajAdhighaLuDhaiya nIdhiniyAya~NghaLiனbhaDhiyAvadhu naDhavAmaluM bhoனbhaDhiyiனAle,
idho, nAன, nAனe uனghghu virodhamAgha vandhu, bhuRajAdhighaLuDhaiya ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha uன naDhuvile nIdhi jhèludhdhi,
nAன muனbhu jhèyyAdhadhuM iனijhjhèyyAdhirubhbhadhumAனvidhamAy uனghghu uன èllA aruvarubhbhughaLiனimidhdhamuM jhèyveன.

AdhalAl uன naDhuvile bhidhAghghaL bhiLLaighaLaidh dhiனbhArghaL; bhiLLaighaL bhidhAghghaLaidh dhiனbhArghaL; nAன uனனil nIdhijhèludhdhi uனனil mIdhiyAyirubhbhavarghaLaiyèllAM jhaghala dhijhaighaLiluM jhidhaRibhbhoghabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.

AdhalAl, jhIyèனRighazhabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhuM aruvarughghabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhumAன uன ghiriyaighaLAl nI èன bharijhudhdha sdhaladhdhaidh dhIDhDhubhbhaDhudhdhiனbhaDhiyAl èன ghaN uனனaidh dhabhbhaviDhAdhu, nAன uனனaigh ghuRughibhbhoghabhbhaNNuveன, nAன ira~NghamADhDheன, idhai èன jIvaனaigh ghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr.

uனனile mUனRil òru bha~Nghu ghòLLainoyAl jhAvArghaL, bha~njhadhdhAluM uன naDhuvile maDhindhubhovArghaL; mUனRil òru bha~Nghu uனனaijh jhuRRiluM irughghiRa bhaDhDhayadhdhAl vèDhDhuNDhu vizhuvArghaL; mUனRil òru bha~Nghai nAன jhaghala dhijhaighaLiluM jhidhaRibhbhoghabhbhaNNi, avarghaL bhiனனe bhaDhDhayadhdhai uruvuveன.

ibhbhaDhi èன ghobhaM niRaiveRuM; ibhbhaDhi nAன èன ughghiradhdhai avarghaLmel dha~NghabhbhaNNughiRadhiனAl èனனai ARRighghòLveன; nAன èன ughghiradhdhai avarghaLil niRaiveRRuMbhodhu, ghardhdharAghiya nAன èன vairAghghiyadhdhile idhaibh bhejhiனeன èனRu aRivArghaL.
ghaDhandhubhoghiRa yAvaruDhaiya ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAghavuM uன jhuRRubhbhuRadhdhArAghiya jAdhighaLughghuLLe nAன uனனaibh bhAzhuM nindhaiyumAghghuveன.

nAன ghobhadhdhAluM ughghiradhdhAluM ghòDhiya dhaNDhaனaighaLAluM, uனனil nIdhijhèludhdhuMbhodhu, uன jhuRRubhbhuRadhdhArAghiya jAdhighaLughghu adhu nindhaiyuM dhurghghIrdhdhiyuM èjhjharibhbhuM bhiramibhbhumAy irughghuM; ghardhdharAghiya nAன idhaijh jhòனனeன.

u~NghaLai azhibhbhadhaRghu nAன aனubhbhuM azhivughghedhuvAன bha~njhadhdhiன ghòDhiya aMbhughaLai nAன avarghaLughghuLLe èyyuMbhodhu, nAன bha~njhadhdhai u~NghaLmel adhigharighghabhbhaNNi, u~NghaL abhbhaM èனனuM Adharavugholai muRidhdhubhbhoDhuveன.

bha~njhadhdhaiyuM, uனனaibh bhiLLaiyillAmaRbhoghabhbhaNNuM dhuShDhamirugha~NghaLaiyuM u~NghaLughghu virodhamAgha aனubhbhuveன; ghòLLainoyuM iradhdha~njhindhudhaluM uனனil jhuRRidhdhiriyuM; bhaDhDhayadhdhai nAன uனmel varabhbhaNNuveன; ghardhdharAghiya nAன idhaijh jhòனனeன èனRAr.
ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:
maனubhudhdhiraனe, nI israveliன bharvadha~NghaLughghu nerAgha uன mughadhdhaidh dhirubhbhi, avaighaLughghu virodhamAghadh dhIrghghadharijhaனM uraidhdhujh jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl,

israveliன bharvadha~NghaLe, ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavariன vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLu~NghaL; ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar bharvadha~NghaLaiyuM ghuனRughaLaiyuM oDhaighaLaiyuM bhaLLadhdhAghghughaLaiyuM noghghi: idho, u~NghaLmel nAன, nAனe bhaDhDhayadhdhai varabhbhaNNi, u~NghaL meDhaighaLai azhidhdhubhbhoDhuveன.
u~NghaL bhalibhIDha~NghaL bhAzhAghghabhbhaDhDhu, u~NghaL jhilaighaL dhagharghghabhbhaDhuM; u~NghaLil ghòlaiyuNghiRavarghaLai u~NghaL naraghalAன vighghiragha~NghaLughghu muனbhAgha vizhabhbhaNNuveன.

nAன isravel bhudhdhiraruDhaiya bhiredha~NghaLai avarghaLuDhaiya naraghalAன vighghiragha~NghaLiன muனனe ghiDhaghghabhbhaNNi, u~NghaL bhalibhIDha~NghaLaijh jhuRRiluM u~NghaL èluMbhughaLaijh jhidhaRabhbhaNNuveன.

u~NghaL bhalibhIDha~NghaL nirmUlamuM bhAzhumAghuMbhaDhighghuM, u~NghaL naraghalAன vighghiragha~NghaL dhagharghghabhbhaDhDhu, oyndhu, u~NghaL jhilaighaL vèDhDhuNDhu, u~NghaL ghiriyaighaL ghulaindhubhoghuMbhaDhighghuM, u~NghaLuDhaiya jhaghala vAjhasdhala~NghaLilumuLLa bhaDhDhaNa~NghaL nirmUlamuM u~NghaL meDhaighaL bhAzhumAghuM.
ghòlaijhèyyabhbhaDhDhavarghaL u~NghaL naDhuvil vizhuvArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu nAன ghardhdhar èனRu aRindhughòLvIrghaL.
nI~NghaL dhejha~NghaLil jhidhaRaDhighghabhbhaDhuMbhodhu, bhuRajAdhighaLughghuLLe bhaDhDhayadhdhughghudh dhabhbhuvArai u~NghaLughghu mIdhiyAgha vaibhbheன.

èனனai viDhDhujh jhoraMbhoghiRa irudhayadhdhaighghuRidhdhuM, dha~NghaL naraghalAன vighghiragha~NghaLiன bhiனனe jhoraMbhoghiRa dha~NghaL ghaNghaLaighghuRidhdhuM maனmaDhivAனeன èனRu u~NghaLil dhabhbhibhbhoன avarghaL dhA~NghaL jhiRaibhbhaDhDhirughghuM bhuRajAdhighaLughghuLLe èனனai niனaidhdhu, dha~NghaLuDhaiya jhaghala aruvarubhbhughaLiனAluM dhA~NghaL jhèydha bhòllAbhbhughaLiனimidhdhaM dha~NghaLaiye vèRudhdhu,
indhadh dhI~NghughaLaiyèllAM dha~NghaLughghu neriDhabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya nAன virudhAvAyjh jhòனனdhillaiyèனRu aRindhughòLvArghaL èனRAr.

ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: nI uன ghaiyil aDhidhdhu, uன ghAlAl dhaDhDhi, isravel vaMjhadhdhAruDhaiya jhaghala bhòllAdha aruvarubhbhughaLiனimidhdhamuM aiyo! èனRu jhòl; avarghaL bhaDhDhayadhdhAluM bha~njhadhdhAluM ghòLLainoyAluM vizhuvArghaL.

dhUradhdhilirughghiRavaன ghòLLainoyAl jhAvAன; jhamIbhadhdhilirughghiRavaன bhaDhDhayadhdhAl vizhuvAன; mIdhiyAyirundhu, muRRighghaibhoDhabhbhaDhDhavaன bha~njhadhdhAl jhAvAன; ibhbhaDhi avarghaLil èன ughghiradhdhaidh dhIrdhdhughghòLLuveன.

avarghaL dha~NghaL naraghalAன jhaghala vighghiragha~NghaLughghuM madhuravAjhaனaiyAன dhUbhadhdhaigh ghADhDhiன sdhala~NghaLAghiya uyarndha jhaghala meDhughaLiluM, bharvadha~NghaLuDhaiya jhaghala jhighara~NghaLiluM, bhajhjhaiyAன jhaghala viruDhjha~NghaLiன ghIzhuM, dhazhaidhdhirughghiRa jhaghala gharvAli mara~NghaLiன ghIzhuM, avarghaLuDhaiya naraghalAன vighghiragha~NghaLiன naDhuviluM avarghaLuDhaiya bhalibhIDha~NghaLaijh jhuRRiluM, avarghaLil ghòlaiyuNDhavarghaL ghiDhaghghuMbhodhu, nAன ghardhdhar èனRu aRindhughòLvArghaL.

nAன èன ghaiyai avarghaLughghu virodhamAgha nIDhDhi, avarghaLuDhaiya èllA vAjhasdhala~NghaLumuLLa dhejhadhdhai azhidhdhu, adhaidh dhibhlAdhdhiன vaனAndharadhdhaibhbhArghghiluM adhighamAybh bhAzhAghghuveன, abhbhòzhudhu nAன ghardhdhar èனRu aRindhughòLvArghaL èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:
maனubhudhdhiraனe, isravel dhejhadhdhaighghuRidhdhugh ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: muDhivu varughiRadhu, dhejhadhdhiன nAlu muனaighaLiன meluM muDhivu varughiRadhu.

andhajh jhaghghara~NghaLaibh bhArdhdhu; jhaghgharame èனRu òruvaன ghUbhbhiDhughiRa jhadhdhadhdhaighgheDhDheன.
òvvòனRughghuM nAlu mugha~NghaL irundhaன; mudhalAM mughaM gherubhIன mughamuM, iraNDhAM mughaM maனuShamughamuM, mUனRAM mughaM jhi~NghamughamuM, nAlAM mughaM ghazhughumughamumAyirundhadhu.
gherubhIனghaL mele èzhuMbhiன; idhudhAன, nAன ghebhAr nadhiyaNDhaiyile ghaNDhirundha jIvaன.

gherubhIனghaL jhèllughaiyil jhaghghara~NghaL avaighaL arughe oDhiன; bhUmiyilirundhu èzhuMbhagh gherubhIனghaL dha~NghaL jhèDhDhaighaLai viridhdhabhodhu, jhaghghara~NghaLuM avaighaLai viDhDhu vilaghibhbhoghavillai.
avaighaL niRghaiyil ivaighaLuM niனRaன; avaighaL èzhuMbhughaiyil ivaighaLuM èzhuMbhiன; jIvaனuDhaiya Avi ivaighaLil irundhadhu.
ghardhdharuDhaiya maghimai Alayadhdhiன vAjhaRbhaDhiyaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, gherubhIனghaLiனmel niனRadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu gherubhIனghaL dha~NghaL jhèDhDhaighaLai viridhdhu, èன ghaN ghANa bhUmiyaiviDhDhu èzhuMbhiன; avaighaL bhuRabhbhaDhughaiyil jhaghghara~NghaLuM avaighaLughghujh jhariyAyjh jhèனRaன; ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன ghizhaghghu vAjhalile bhoy niRgha, israveliன dhevaனuDhaiya maghimai avaighaLiனmel uyara irundhadhu.
idhu nAன ghebhAr nadhiyaNDhaiyile israveliன dhevaனughghugh ghIzhe irughghaghghaNDha andha jIvaனdhAனe; avaighaL gherubhIனghaL èனRu aRindhughòNDheன.
avaighaLil òvvòனRughghu nAlu mughamuM, òvvòனRughghu nAlu jhèDhDhaighaLuM irundhaன; avaighaLuDhaiya jhèDhDhaighaLiன ghIzh maனuShaghaighaLiன jhAyal irundhadhu.
avaighaLuDhaiya mugha~NghaL nAன ghebhAr nadhiyaNDhaiyile ghaNDhirundha andha mugha~NghaLiன jhAyalAyirundhadhu; òvvòனRuM dhaனdhaன mughadhdhughghu èdhirAன dhijhaiyai noghghijh jhèனRadhu.

bhiனbhu AviyAனvar èனனai èDhudhdhu, èனனaigh ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhiன ghizhaghghu mughamAyirughghiRa vAjhalughghugh ghòNDhubhoனAr; idho, andha vAjhaliன naDhaiyil irubhadhdhaindhu bhuruShar irundhArghaL; avarghaLiன naDhuve jaனdhdhiன bhirabhughghaLAghiya Ajhuriன ghumAraனAghiya yajhaனiyAvaiyuM, bhèனAyAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhèladhdhiyAvaiyuM ghaNDheன.
abhbhòzhudhu avar èனனai noghghi: maனubhudhdhiraனe, ivarghaL indha nagharadhdhile aghghiramamAன niனaivughaLai niனaidhdhu, dhurAlojhaனai jhòllughiRa maனuShar..
idhu vIDhughaLaigh ghaDhDhuvadhaRghugh ghAlamalla èனRuM, indha nagharaM bhAனai, nA~NghaL adhiluLLa iRaijhjhiyèனRuM jhòllughiRArghaL.
AghaiyAl avarghaLughghu virodhamAydh dhIrghghadharijhaன~njhòllu, maனubhudhdhiraனe, dhIrghghadharijhaன~njhòllu èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya Avi èனmel iRa~NghiனAr; avar èனனai noghghi: nI jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl, isravel vaMjhadhdhAre, nI~NghaL ibhbhaDhibh bhejhughiRadhu uNDhu; u~NghaL maனdhil èzhuMbhughiRadhai nAன aRiveன.
indha nagharadhdhil nI~NghaL anegharaigh ghòlaijhèydhIrghaL; adhiன vIdhighaLaigh ghòlaiyuNDhavarghaLAl nirabhbhiனIrghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

AghaiyAl nI~NghaL ghòlaijhèydhu, adhiன naDhuvil bhoDhDhuviDhDhavarghaLe iRaijhjhiyuM, indha nagharaM bhAனaiyumAme; u~NghaLaiyo adhaRghuL irAdhabhaDhighghubh bhuRaMbhAghghuveன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.
bhaDhDhayadhdhughghubh bhayabhbhaDhDhIrghaL, bhaDhDhayadhdhaiye u~NghaLmel varabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.
nAன u~NghaLai adhaRghuL irAdhabhaDhighghu bhuRaMbhAghghi, u~NghaLai anniyariன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhu, u~NghaLil niyAyadhdhIrbhbhughaLai niRaiveRRuveன.
bhaDhDhayadhdhAl vizhuvIrghaL; isravel dhejhadhdhiன èllaiyile u~NghaLai niyAyandhIrbhbheன; abhbhòzhudhu nAன ghardhdhar èனRu aRindhughòLvIrghaL.
indha nagharaM u~NghaLughghubh bhAனaiyAyirubhbhadhumillai, nI~NghaL adhiluLLa iRaijhjhiyAyirubhbhadhumillai; isravel dhejhadhdhiன èllaiyile u~NghaLai niyAyandhIrbhbheன.

èன ghaDhDhaLaighaLiனbhaDhi naDhavAmaluM, èன niyAya~NghaLiனbhaDhi jhèyyAmaluM, u~NghaLaijh jhuRRilumirughghiRa bhuRajAdhighaLuDhaiya muRaimaighaLiனbhaDhi jhèydha nI~NghaL abhbhòzhudhu nAன ghardhdhar èனRu aRindhughòLvIrghaL èனRu jhòl èனRAr.

nAன ibhbhaDhidh dhIrghghadharijhaன~njhòllughaiyil, bhèனAyAviன ghumAraனAghiya bhèladhdhiyA jhèdhdhAன; abhbhòzhudhu nAன mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhu, maghA jhadhdhamAy: A, ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavare, dhevarIr isravelil mIdhiyAனvarghaLaijh jharvajha~NghAra~njhèyvIro èனRu muRaiyiDhDheன.
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:

maனubhudhdhiraனe, nI~NghaL ghardhdharai viDhDhudh dhUramAy bho~NghaL, è~NghaLughghu indhadh dhejhaM jhudhandharamAghagh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhadhèனRu, uன jhaghodhararughghuM, uன ghuDhuMbhadhdhArughghuM, uன bhandhu jaன~NghaLughghuM, isravel vaMjhadhdhAr aனaivarughghuM, èrujhalemiன ghuDhighaL jhòllughiRArghaL.

AghaiyAl nAன avarghaLaidh dhUramAghabh bhuRajAdhighaLughghuLLe dhuradhdhiyirundhAluM, nAன avarghaLaidh dhejha~NghaLile jhidhaRaDhidhdhAluM, nAன avarghaL bhoன dhejha~NghaLil avarghaLughghugh ghò~njha ghAladhdhughghubh bharijhudhdha sdhalamAgha irubhbheன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl.

AdhalAl nAன u~NghaLai jaன~NghaLiDhadhilirundhu jherdhdhu, nI~NghaL jhidhaRaDhighghabhbhaDhDha dhejha~NghaLilirundhu u~NghaLaigh ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, isravel dhejhadhdhai u~NghaLughghugh ghòDhubhbheன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr. èனRu jhòllu.
avarghaL a~Nghe vandhu, adhil jhIyèனRighazhabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhuM aruvarughghabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhumAyirughghiRadhaiyèllAM adhilirundhu aghaRRuvArghaL.

avarghaL èன ghaDhDhaLaighaLiனbhaDhi naDhandhu, èன niyAya~NghaLaigh ghaigh ghòNDhu, avaighaLiனbhaDhi jhèyya nAன avarghaLughghu egha irudhayadhdhai dhandhu, avarghaL uLLadhdhil bhudhiya AviyaighghòDhudhdhu, ghallAன irudhayadhdhai avarghaL mAMjhadhdhilirundhu èDhudhdhubhbhoDhDhu, jhadhaiyAன irudhayadhdhai avarghaLughghu aruLuveன.
avarghaL èன jaனmAyirubhbhArghaL, nAன avarghaL dhevaனAyirubhbheன.

AனAluM jhIyèனRighazhabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhuM aruvarughghabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhumAன dha~NghaL irudhayadhdhiன ijhjhaiyile èvarghaL naDhaghghiRArghaLo avarghaLuDhaiya vazhiyiன bhalaனai avarghaL dhalaighaLiனmel jhumarabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu gherubhIனghaL dha~NghaL jhèDhDhaighaLai viridhdhu èzhuMbhiன; jhaghghara~NghaLuM avaighaLughghu arughe jhèனRaன; israveliன dhevaனuDhaiya maghimai avaighaLiனmel uyara irundhadhu.
ghardhdharuDhaiya maghimai nagharadhdhiன naDhuvilirundhèzhuMbhi, nagharadhdhughghugh ghizhaghghe irughghiRa malaiyiனmel bhoy niனRadhu.

bhiனbhu AviyAனvar èனனai èDhudhdhu, èனனai dhevaனuDhaiya AvighghuLLAன dharijhaனdhdhile ghaldheyAvughghujh jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoனvarghaL iDhadhdhile ghòNDhubhoy viDhDhAr; abhbhòzhudhu nAன ghaNDha dharijhaனM èனனilirundhu èDhubhaDhDhubhbhoyiRRu.
ghardhdhar èனghghugh ghANbhidhdha yAvaiyuM jhiRaiyirubhbhilirundhavarghaLughghujh jhòனனeன.
ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi avar:

maனubhudhdhiraனe, nI ghalaghavIDhDhAriன naDhuvile dha~NghiyirughghiRAy; ghANuMbhaDhighghu avarghaLughghugh ghaNghaL irundhAluM ghANAmaRbhoghiRArghaL; gheDhghuMbhaDhighghu avarghaLughghugh ghAdhughaL irundhAluM gheLAmaRbhoghiRArghaL; avarghaL ghalaghavIDhDhAr.

ibhbhodhuM maனubhudhdhiraனe, nI bharadhejhaM bhoghuMbhaDhi bhirayANa jhAmAனghaLai AyadhdhabhbhaDhudhdhi, bhaghaRghAladhdhile avarghaL muனbhAghabh bhirayANabhbhaDhu; uன sdhaladhdhaiviDhDhu veRe sdhaladhdhughghu avarghaLuDhaiya ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbho; avarghaL ghalaghavIDhDhArAனbhodhiluM òruveLai jhindhidhdhu uNaruvArghaL.
avarghaLuDhaiya ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha nI jhuvarile dhuvAramiDhDhu, adhiன vazhiyAy avaighaLai vèLiye ghòNDhubhovAyAgha.

jhiRaiyirubhbhughghubh bhoghiRavaனaibhbhol uன jhAmAனghaLai nI bhaghaRghAladhdhile avarghaL ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha vèLiye vaidhdhu, nI jhAya~NghAladhdhile avarghaL ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAghajh jhiRaiyirubhbhughghubh bhoghiRavaனaibhbhola bhuRabhbhaDhuvAyAgha.

avarghaLuDhaiya ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha avaighaLai uன dhoLiனmel èDhudhdhu, mAlaimaya~NghuM veLaiyile vèLiye ghòNDhubhovAyAgha; nI dhejhadhdhaibh bhArAdhabhaDhi uன mughadhdhai mUDhighghòL; isravel vaMjhadhdhArughghu uனனai aDhaiyALamAghghiனeன èனRAr.

èனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye nAன jhèydheன; jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoghuMbhodhu jhAmAனghaLaigh ghòNDhubhovadhubhola èன jhAmAனghaLaibh bhaghaRghAladhdhil vèLiye vaidhdheன; jhAya~NghAladhdhilo ghaiyiனAl jhuvarile dhuvAramiDhDhu, mAlai maya~NghuM veLaiyile avaighaLai vèLiye ghòNDhubhoy, avarghaL ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha avaighaLaidh dhoLiனmel èDhudhdhughghòNDhubhoனeன.
viDhiyaRghAladhdhile ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:
maனubhudhdhiraனe, ghalaghavIDhDhArAghiya isravel vaMjhadhdhAr uனனai bhArdhdhu: nI jhèyghiRadhu èனனvèனRu uனனaigh gheDhDhArghaL allavA?

idhu èrujhalemil irughghiRa adhibhadhiyiனmeluM adhiன naDhuvil irughghiRa isravel vaMjhadhdhAr aனaivariனmeluM jhumaruM bhAraM èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr èனRu avarghaLiDhadhdhil jhòllu.
nI avarghaLai noghghi: nAன u~NghaLughghu aDhaiyALamAyirughghiReன; nAன jhèyvadhu èbhbhaDhiyo, abhbhaDhiye avarghaLughghuM jhèyyabhbhaDhuM; jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubh bharadhejhaM bhovArghaL.

avarghaL naDhuvil irughghiRa adhibhadhi mAlaimaya~NghuMbhodhu dhoLiனmel jhumaijhumandhu bhuRabhbhaDhuvAன; vèLiye jhumaighòNDhubhoghajh jhuvarile dhuvAramiDhuvArghaL; ghaNNiனAle avaன dhaன dhejhadhdhaigh ghANAdhabhaDhi dhaன mughadhdhai mUDhighghòLvAன.
nAன èன valaiyai avaனmel vIjhuveன, avaன èன ghaNNiyile bhiDhibhaDhuvAன; avaனaigh ghaldheyar dhejhamAghiya bhAbhiloனughghugh ghòNDhubhoveன; a~Nghe avaன jhAvAன; AghiluM adhaigh ghANamADhDhAன.
avaனughghu udhaviyAgha avaனaijh jhuRRiluM irughghiRa yAvaraiyuM avaனuDhaiya èllA irANuva~NghaLaiyuM nAன jhaghala dhijhaighaLiluM dhURRi, avarghaL bhiனனe bhaDhDhayadhdhai uruvuveன.
abhbhaDhi nAன avarghaLai jAdhighaLughghuLLe dhURRi, avarghaLai dhejha~NghaLile jhidhaRaDhighghuMbhodhu, nAன ghardhdhar èனRu aRindhughòLvArghaL.

AனAluM dhA~NghaL bhoyjhjheruM jAdhighaLughghuLLe dha~NghaL aruvarubhbhughaLaiyèllAM vivarighghuMbhaDhi, nAன avarghaLil ghò~njhaMbheraibh bha~njhadhdhughghuM bhaDhDhayadhdhughghuM ghòLLainoyghghuM dhabhbhi mIndhirughghabhbhaNNuveன; abhbhòzhudhu nAன ghardhdhar èனRu aRindhu ghòLvArghaL èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:
maனubhudhdhiraனe, nI uன abhbhadhdhai naDhughghadhdhoDhe bhujhidhdhu, uன dhaNNIraidh dhadhdhaLibhbhoDhuM vijhAradhdhoDhuM ghuDhidhdhu,

dhejhadhdhiluLLa jaன~NghaLai noghghi: isravel dhejhadhdhiluLLa èrujhalemiன ghuDhighaLaighghuRidhdhugh ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, dha~NghaL abhbhadhdhai vijhAradhdhoDhe bhujhidhdhu, dha~NghaL dhaNNIraidh dhighiloDhe ghuDhibhbhArghaL; avarghaLuDhaiya dhejhadhdhugh ghuDhighaLuDhaiya ghòDhumaighaLiனimidhdhaM adhiluLLadhèllAM azhiya, adhu bhAzhAghuM.
ghuDhiyeRiyirughghiRa bhaDhDhaNa~NghaL vaனAndhara~NghaLAghi, dhejhaM bhAzhAybhbhoghuM; abhbhòzhudhu nAன ghardhdhar èனRu aRindhughòLvIrghaL èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:
maனubhudhdhiraனe, nADhghaL nIDhighghuM, dharijhaனM èllAM avamAghuM èனRu isravel dhejhadhdhile vazha~NghuM bhazhamòzhi èனன?

AghaiyAl nI avarghaLai noghghi: ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, avarghaL iனi isravelile indhabh bhazhamòzhiyaijh jhòllivarAdhabhaDhighghu nAன adhai òzhiyabh bhaNNuveன; nADhghaLuM èllAdh dharijhaனdhdhiன bhòruLuM jhamIbhidhdhu vandhaன èனRu avarghaLoDhe jhòllu.
isravel vaMjhadhdhAriன naDhuvil iனijh jhaghala ghaLLadhdharijhaனmuM mughasdhudhiyAன ghuRijhòlludhaluM irAmaRbhoghuM.

nAன ghardhdhar, nAன jhòlluveன, nAன jhòlluM vArdhdhai niRaiveRuM; iனidh dhAmadhiyAdhu; ghalaghavIDhDhAre, u~NghaL nADhghaLile nAன vArdhdhaiyaijh jhòlluveன, adhai niRaiveRavuM bhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:
maனubhudhdhiraனe, idho, isravel vaMjhadhdhAr: ivaன ghANghiRa dharijhaனM niRaiveRa aneghanAL jhèlluM; dhUramAyirughghiRa ghAla~NghaLaighghuRidhdhu ivaன dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòllughiRAன èனghiRArghaL.

AghaiyAl èன vArdhdhaighaLil òனRAghiluM iனidh dhAmadhibhbhadhillaiyèனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr; nAன jhòனன vArdhdhai niRaiveRuM èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr èனRu avarghaLoDhe jhòl èனRAr.
ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:

maனubhudhdhiraனe, dhIrghghadharijhaனM jhòllughiRa israveliன dhIrghghadharijhighaLughghu virodhamAgha nI dhIrghghadharijhaனM uraidhdhu, dha~NghaL irudhayadhdhil irughghiRadhaiye èDhudhdhudh dhIrghghadharijhaன~njhòllughiRavarghaLoDhe nI jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl: ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh gheLu~NghaL.
ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRadhAvadhu: dhA~NghaL òனRuM dharijhiyAdhirundhuM, dha~NghaLuDhaiya Aviyiன evudhalaibh bhiனbhaRRughiRa madhighèDhDha dhIrghghadharijhighaLughghu aiyo!
isravele, uன dhIrghghadharijhighaL vaனAndhara~NghaLiluLLa narighaLughghu òbhbhAyirughghiRArghaL.
nI~NghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya nALile yudhdhadhdhil nilainiRghuMbhaDhighghu, dhiRabhbhughaLil eRiனdhumillai; isravel vaMjhadhdhArughghAghajh jhuvarai aDhaidhdhadhumillai.

ghardhdhar dha~NghaLai aனubhbhAdhirundhuM, ghardhdhar uraidhdhArèனRu jhòlli, avarghaL abhadhdhadhdhaiyuM bhòyghghuRiyaiyuM dharijhidhdhu, ghAriyadhdhai nirvAghaMbhaNNalAmèனRu naMbhighghaiyAyirughghiRArghaL.
nAன uraighghAdhirundhuM, nI~NghaL ghardhdhar uraidhdhAr èனRu jhòlluMbhodhu, abhadhdhamAன dharijhaனaiyaidh dharijhidhdhu, bhòyghghuRiyaijh jhòllughiRIrghaL allavA?

uன azhaghiனAle uன ghIrdhdhi bhuRa jAdhighaLughghuLLe bhirajhidhdhamAyiRRu; nAன uனmel vaidhdha èன maghimaiyiனAle adhu ghuRaivaRRadhAy irundhadhèனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.
nIyovèனRAl uன azhaghai naMbhi, uன ghIrdhdhiyiனAl jhoramArghghamAy naDhandhu, vazhibhbhoghgharil uனghghu nerbhaDhDha yAvaroDhuM vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNi,

uன vasdhira~NghaLil jhilavaRRai èDhudhdhu, bhalavaruNajh joDhibhbhAன meDhaighaLai uனghghu uNDhAghghi, avaighaLiனmel vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNiனAy; abhbhaDhighghòdhdha ghAriya~NghaL òrughghAluM jhaMbhavidhdhadhumillai, jhaMbhavibhbhadhumillai.
nAன uனghghugh ghòDhudhdha èன bhòனனuM èன vèLLiyumAன uன jhi~NghAra AbharaNa~NghaLai nI èDhudhdhu, uனghghu ANjhurUbha~NghaLai uNDhAghghi, avaighaLoDhe vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNi,
uன jhidhdhiradhdhaiyalADhaighaLai èDhudhdhu, avaighaLai mUDhi, èன èNNèyaiyuM èன dhUbhavarghghadhdhaiyuM avaighaLiனmuன bhaDhaidhdhu,

nAன uனghghugh ghòDhudhdha èன abhbhadhdhaiyuM, nI jhAbhbhiDhuMbhaDhi uனghghugh ghòDhudhdha mèlliya mAvaiyuM nèyyaiyuM dheனaiyuM nI avaighaLiனmuன jhughandhavAjhaனaiyAghabh bhaDhaidhdhAy; ghAriyaM ibhbhaDhi AyiRRèனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.
nI èனghghubh bhèRRa uன ghumAraraiyuM uன ghumAradhdhighaLaiyuM èDhudhdhu, avarghaLai avaighaLughghu iraiyAghabh bhaliyiDhDhAy.
nI jhèydha vejhidhdhaன~NghaL bhodhAdhèனRu, nI èன bhiLLaighaLai avaighaLughghudh dhIghghaDhaghghabhbhaNNa òbhbhughghòDhudhdhu, avarghaLaigh ghòlaijhèydhAy.

aiyo! uனghghu aiyo! èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr; nI jhèydha bhòllAbhbhughghaLèllAM dhavira,
nI uனghghu maNDhabha~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhi, uனghghujh jhaghala vIdhighaLiluM uyarndha meDhaighaLai uNDhubhaNNiனAy.

nI jhaghala vazhimughaனaiyiluM uன uyarndha meDhaighaLaigh ghaDhDhi, uன azhaghai aruvarubhbhAghghi, vazhibhbhoghghar yAvarughghuM uன ghAlghaLai viridhdhu, uன vejhidhdhaன~NghaLaidh dhiraLAybh bhèrughabhbhaNNi,

AdhalAl, idho, nAன èன ghaiyai uனghghu virodhamAgha nIDhDhi, uனghghu niyamidhdha bhojaனdhdhaigh ghuRughghi, uன muRaigheDhAன mArghghadhdhaigh ghuRidhdhu vèDhghabhbhaDhDha uன bhaghaiyALighaLAghiya bhèlisdharuDhaiya ghumAradhdhighaLiன ijhjhaighghu uனனai òbhbhughghòDhudhdheன.
nI dhirubhdhiyaDhaiyAdhadhiனAl ajhIriya bhudhdhiraroDhuM vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNiனAy; avarghaLoDhe vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNiyuM nI dhirubhdhiyaDhaiyavillai.
nI ghAனAன dhejhadhdhile jhèydha vejhidhdhaனdhdhai ghaldheyarmaDhDhuM èDhDhajh jhèydhAy; adhiனAluM nI dhirubhdhiyaDhaiyAmaRbhoனAy.
vèDhgha~NghèDhDha vejhiyiன ghiriyaighaLAghiya ivaighaLaiyèllAM nI jhèydhu,

jhaghala vazhimughaனaiyiluM uன maNDhabha~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhi, jhaghala vIdhighaLiluM uன meDhaighaLai uNDhAghghiனbhaDhiyAl, uன irudhayaM èvvaLavAygh ghaLaidhdhubhbhoyirughghiRadhu èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr; nI bhaNaiyadhdhai alaDhjhiyaMbhaNNughiRadhiனAl, nI vejhiyaibhbhola irAmal,
dhaன bhuruShaனughghubh bhadhilAgha anniyaraijh jherdhdhughghòLLughiRa vibhajhAra sdhirIyaibhbhola irughghiRAy.

èllA vejhighaLughghuM bhaNaiya~NghòDhughghiRArghaL; nIyo uன nejharghaL jhuRRubhbhuRa~NghaLilirundhu uனனiDhadhdhil vejhidhdhaன~njhèyya varuMbhaDhi avarghaLughghèllAM nIye bhaNaiya~NghòDhudhdhu, avarghaLughghu vèghumadhighaLaidh dharughiRAy.

ivvidhamAy uன vejhidhdhaன~NghaLughghuM veRe sdhirIghaLiன vejhidhdhaன~NghaLughghuM vidhdhiyAjhamuNDhu; vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNa avarghaL uனனai bhiன jhèllamADhDhArghaL; bhaNaiyaM uனghghugh ghòDhughghiRabhaDhiyAl nI jhèyvadhu vibharIdhaM.
AghaiyAl, vejhiye, ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhaiyaigh gheL.

ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: uன vejhidhdhaனdhdhiன ajhudhdhaM bhAyndhabhaDhiyiனAluM, nI uன ghAmavighArighaLoDhuM aruvarubhbhAghiya uன naraghalAன vighghiragha~NghaLoDhuM vejhidhdhaனMbhaNNi, ivaighaLughghu uன bhiLLaighaLiன iradhdhadhdhaibh bhaDhaidhdhadhiனAl uன nirvANaM dhiRaghghabhbhaDhDhabhaDhiyiனAluM,

idho, nI jhaMbhoghaMbhaNNiன uன èllAgh ghAmavighArighaLaiyuM, nI nejhidhdha yAvaraiyuM, nI bhaghaidhdhirughghiRa aனaivaroDhuM nAன ghUDhivarajhjhèydhu, jhuRRilumirundhu avarghaLai uனghghu virodhamAghajh jherdhdhu, avarghaL uன nirvAனdhdhaiyèllAM ghANuMbhaDhi uன nirvANadhdhai avarghaLughghu muனbhAghadh dhiRandhuvaidhdhu,
vibhajhArighaLaiyuM iradhdha~njhindhiனvarghaLaiyuM niyAyandhIrghghiRabhaDhiye uனனai niyAyandhIrdhdhu, ughghiraghadhdhoDhuM èrijhjhaloDhuM iradhdhabhbhazhiyai uனbheril jhumadhdhi,

uனனai avarghaL ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhubhbheன; avarghaL uன maNDhabha~NghaLai iDhidhdhu, uன meDhaighaLaidh dharaiyAghghibhbhoDhDhu, uன vasdhira~NghaLai urindhu, uன jhi~NghAra AbharaNa~NghaLai èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, uனனai aMmaNamuM nirvANamumAgha viDhDhubhbhoy,
uனghghu virodhamAgha òru ghUDhDhadhdhaigh ghòNDhuvandhu, uனனaigh ghallèRindhu, uனனaidh dha~NghaL bhaDhDhaya~NghaLAl ghudhdhibhoDhDhu,

uன vIDhughaLai aghghiனiyAl jhuDhDhèridhdhu, anegha sdhirIghaLiன ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAgha uனனil niyAyadhdhIrbhbhughaLaijh jhèyvArghaL; uன vejhidhdhaனdhdhai òzhiyabhbhaNNuveன; nI iனibh bhaNaiya~NghòDhubhbhadhillai.
ivvidhamAy èன èrijhjhal uனனai viDhDhu nI~NghuMbhaDhi nAன èன ughghiradhdhai uனனil ARabhbhaNNi, iனi ghobhamAyirAmal amaruveன.

nI uன iLavayadhiன nADhghaLai niனaiyAmal, ivaighaLèllAvaRRiனAluM èனghghugh ghobhaM uNDhAghghiனbhaDhiyiனAl, idho, nAன uன vazhiyiன bhalaனai uன dhalaiyiனmel jhumarabhbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr; adhiனAle iனi uன èllA aruvarubhbhughaLiனAluM ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha muRaigheDhAன ghAriyadhdhaijh jhèyyamADhDhAy..
idho, bhazhamòzhi jhòllughiRavarghaL èllAruM: dhAyaibhbhola maghaL èனRu uனனaighghuRidhdhu bhazhamòzhi jhòlluvArghaL.

nI, dhaன bhuruShaனaiyuM dhaன bhiLLaighaLaiyuM aruvarudhdha uன dhAyiன maghaL; nI, dha~NghaL bhuruSharaiyuM dha~NghaL bhiLLaighaLaiyuM aruvarudhdha uன jhaghodharighaLiன jhaghodhari; u~NghaL dhAy edhdhidhdhi; u~NghaL dhaghabhbhaன èmoriyaன.
uன iDhadhubhuRadhdhile, dhAனuM dhaன ghumAradhdhighaLumAygh ghuDhiyirundha jhamAriyA uன dhamaghghai; uன valadhubhuRadhdhile, dhAனuM dhaன ghumAradhdhighaLumAygh ghuDhiyirundha jhodhoM uன dha~Nghai.

AghiluM nI avarghaLuDhaiya mArghgha~NghaLile naDhavAmaluM, avarghaLuDhaiya aruvarubhbhughaLiனbhaDhi jhèyyAmaluM, adhu maghA aRbhaghAriyaM èனghiRadhubhola nI uன èllA vazhighaLileyuM avarghaLaibh bhArghghiluM gheDhAy naDhandhAy.

nIyuM uன ghumAradhdhighaLuM jhèydhadhu bhola, uன jhaghodhariyAghiya jhodhomuM avaLuDhaiya ghumAradhdhighaLuM jhèyyavillai èனRu èன jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr.

idho, ghèrvamuM, AghAradh dhiraDhjhiyuM, nirvijhAramAன jhA~NghobhA~NghamumAghiya ivaighaLe uன jhaghodhariyAன jhodhomiன aghghiramaM; ivaighaLe avaLiDhadhdhiluM avaL ghumAradhdhighaLiDhadhdhiluM irundhaன; jhiRumaiyuM èLimaiyumAனvaனuDhaiya ghaiyai avaL bhalabhbhaDhudhdhavillai.
avarghaL dha~NghaLai uyardhdhi, èன mughadhdhughghu muனbhAgha aruvarubhbhAனdhaijh jhèydhArghaL; adhai nAன ghaNDhabhodhu, avarghaLai òzhidhdhuviDhDheன.

nI jhèydha bhAva~NghaLil araivAjhiyuM jhamAriyA jhèyyavillai; nI uன jhaghodharighaLaibhbhArghghiluM uனbhAva~NghaLaibh bhèrughabhbhaNNi, nI jhèydha uன èllA aruvarubhbhughaLiluM avarghaLai nIdhiyuLLavarghaLèனRu viLa~NghabhbhaNNiனAy.

ibhbhodhuM uன jhaghodharighaLaigh ghuRRavALighaL èனRu dhIrdhdha nI avarghaLaibhbhArghghiluM aruvarubhbhAghajh jhèydha uன bhAva~NghaLiனimidhdhaM uன ilajhjhaiyaijh jhumandhughòL; uனனaibh bhArghghiluM avarghaL nIdhiyuLLavarghaL; uன jhaghodharighaLai nIdhiyuLLavarghaLèனRu viLa~NghabhbhaNNiன nI vèDhghamaDhaindhu, uன ilajhjhaiyaijh jhumandhughòL.

nAன jhodhomuM avaL ghumAradhdhighaLuM jhiRaiyirubhbhaiyuM, jhamAriyAvuM avaL ghumAradhdhighaLuM jhiRaiyirughghiRa jhiRaiyirubhbhaiyuM dhirubhbhuMbhodhu, avarghaL naDhuvil nI jhiRaiyirughghiRa uனனuDhaiya jhiRaiyirubhbhaiyuM dhirubhbhuveன.
adhiனAl nI avarghaLughghu ARudhalAgha irundhu, uன ilajhjhaiyaijh jhumandhu; nI jhèydha èllAvaRRiனAluM vèDhghamaDhaivAy.
uன jhaghodharighaLAghiya jhodhomuM avaL ghumAradhdhighaLuM dha~NghaL mundhiன jhIrughghudh dhiruMbhuvArghaL; nIyuM uன ghumAradhdhighaLuM u~NghaL mundhiன jhIrughghudh dhiruMbhuvIrghaL.
uனனai vèRughghuM jhIriyAviன ghumAradhdhighaLuM, avaLaijh jhuRRiluM irughghiRa bhèlisdhariன ghumAradhdhighaLuM avamAனM bhaNNiனbhodhu uன bhòllAbhbhu vèLiyAyiRRe.
adhaRghumuன uன ghèrvadhdhiன nALile uன jhaghodhariyAghiya jhodhomiன bhèyarai uன vAyiனAle ujhjharighghavumADhDhAy.
uன muRaigheDhDhaiyuM uன aruvarubhbhughaLaiyuM nI jhumabhbhAy èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai muRidhdhubhoDhughiRadhiனAl ANaiyai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNiன nI jhèydhadhubhola nAன uனghghujh jhèyveன.
AghiluM uன iLavayadhil uனனoDhe bhaNNiன èன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai nAன niனaidhdhu, nidhdhiya uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai uனghghu eRbhaDhudhdhuveன.

abhbhòzhudhu uன dhamaghghaighaLaiyuM uன dha~NghaighaLaiyuM nI jherdhdhughghòLLughaiyil, uன vazhighaLai niனaidhdhu nANuvAy; avarghaLai nAன uனghghu ghumAradhdhighaLAghagh ghòDhubhbheன; uனனuDhaiya uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyaibh bhArdhdhugh ghòDhubhbhadhillai.
uனனoDhe èன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyaibhbhaNNi eRbhaDhudhdhuveன; abhbhòzhudhu nAன ghardhdhar èனRu aRivAy.
nI jhèydha èllAvaRRaiyuM nAன maனனidhdharuLuMbhodhu, nI niனaidhdhu vèDhghi, uன nANadhdhiனAl uன vAyai iனidh dhiRaghghamADhDhAdhirubhbhAy èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:
maனubhudhdhiraனe, nI isravel vaMjhadhdhArughghu òru viDhughadhaiyaiyuM uvamaiyaiyuM ghURi, jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl:

ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr, bhèriya jhèDhDhaighaLaiyuM nILamAன iRaghughaLaiyuM uDhaiyadhuM, bhalavaruNamAன iRaghughaLAl niRaindhadhumAghiya òru bhèriya ghazhughu lIbhaனoனil vandhu, òru ghedhuruviன nuனighghiLaiyaibh bhiDhidhdhu,
adhiன iLa~NghiLaiyiluLLa ghòzhundhughaLaighghòydhu, adhai vardhdhagha dhejhadhdhughghugh ghòNDhubhoy, adhai vardhdhagharuDhaiya nagharadhdhil vaidhdhadhu;
dhejhadhdhiன vidhaiyil òனRai èDhudhdhu, adhaibh bhayirniladhdhile bhoDhDhu, adhai èDhudhdhu, mighundha dhaNNIr oradhdhile bhadhdhiramAy naDhDhadhu.

adhu dhuLirdhdhu, bhaDharndhu, dhAzhndha aDhimaramuLLa dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyAyiRRu; adhiனghòDhighaL andhagh ghazhughughghu nerAghavuM, adhiன verghaL adhiன ghIzhAghavuM irundhaன; ivvidhamAy adhu dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyAghi, ghiLaighaLai vIjhi, ghòbhbhughaLaiviDhDhadhu.

aனRiyuM bhèriya jhèDhDhaighaLaiyuM dhiraLAன iRaghughaLaiyuM uDhaiya veRe bhèriya ghazhughu irundhadhu; idho, adhu dhaன naDhavAghiya bhAdhdhighaLilirundhu adhaRghudh dhaNNIr bhAyjhjhuMbhaDhi indha dhirADhjhajhjhèDhi adhaRghu nerAghadh dhaன verghaLai viDhDhu, adhaRghu nerAghadh dhaன ghòDhighaLai vIjhiனdhu.
ghòbhbhughaLai viDhughiRadhaRghuM, ghaனiyaidh dharughiRadhaRghuM, maghimaiyAன dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyAghiRadhaRghuM, idhu mighundha dhaNNIrghaLiன oramAghiya nalla niladhdhil naDhabhbhaDhDhirundhadhu.

idhu jhèzhighghumA? idhu bhaDhDhubhbhoghadhdhaghghadhAy òruvaன idhiன verghaLaibh bhiDhu~NghAmaluM, idhiன ghaனiyai vèDhDhAmaluM irubhbhAனo? dhuLirdhdha èllA ilaighaLoDhuM idhu bhaDhDhubhbhoghuM; idhai veroDhe bhiDhu~NghuMbhaDhi òruvaன bhaladhdha bhuyadhdhoDhuM dhiraNDha jaனdhdhoDhuM varadhdhevaiyillai.

idho, naDhabhbhaDhDha idhu jhèzhibhbhAyirughghumo? ghòNDhalghARRu idhiனbheril bhaDhuMbhodhu idhu vADhi ularndhubhoghAdho? idhu naDhabhbhaDhDha bhAdhdhighaLile vADhibhbhomèனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனbhu ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:

ibhbhodhuM ivaighaLiன dhARbhariyaM dhèriyumA èனRu nI ghalaghavIDhDhAraighgheDhDhujh jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl, idho, bhAbhiloன rAjA èrujhalemughghu vandhu, adhiன rAjAvaiyuM adhiன bhirabhughghaLaiyuM bhiDhidhdhu, avarghaLaidh dhaனனiDhamAghabh bhAbhiloனughghugh ghòNDhubhoghuMbhodhu,
avaன rAjavaMjhadhdhile òruvaனaidh dhadhdhèDhudhdhu, avaனoDhe uDhaனbhaDhighghaibhaNNi,

rAjyaM dhaனனai uyardhdhAmal dhAzhndhirughghuMbhaDhighghuM, dhaன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai avaன ghaighghòLLughiRadhiனAl adhu nilainiRghuMbhaDhighghuM, avaனaibh ANaibhbhiramANadhdhughghu uDhbhaDhudhdhi, dhejhadhdhil bhalajhAlighaLaibh bhiDhidhdhadhughghòNDhubhoனAனe.

ivaன avaனughghu virodhamAygh virodhamAy ghalagha~njhèydhu, dhaனghghugh ghudhiraighaLaiyuM aneghaM ADhghaLaiyuM aனubhbhaveNDhumèனRu dhaன sdhAனAbhadhighaLai èghibhdhughghu aனubhbhiனAன; ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavaனughghu vAyghghumo? ibhbhaDhijh jhèyghiRavaன dhabhbhidhdhughghòLvAனo? uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai muRidhdhavaன dhabhbhidhdhughghòLvAனo?

dhaனனai rAjAvAgha eRbhaDhudhdhiya rAjAviனuDhaiya ANaiyai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNi, avaனuDhaiya uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyai muRidhdhubhbhoDhDhavaன, andha rAjAviனuDhaiya sdhAனmAghiya bhAbhiloன naDhuvile avaன aNDhaiyil irundhu maraNamaDhaivAனèனRu èன jIvaனaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr.

avaன aneghaM jaன~NghaLai nAjhaMbhaNNuMbhaDhi aNaibhoDhDhu, ghòdhdhaLa~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhuMbhodhu, bhArvoன bhèriyajheனaiyoDhuM, dhiraLAன ghUDhDhadhdhoDhuM vandhu ivaனughghAgha yudhdhadhdhil udhavamADhDhAன.

ghazhudhaimAMjhamAன mAMjhamuM, ghudhirai indhiriyamAன indhiriyamumuLLa avarghaLughghu avaL vaibhbhADhDhiyAyirughghuMbhaDhi avarghaLmel moghidhdhAL.

avaன vèLiyil irughghiRa uன ghumAradhdhighaLaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhiனAlghòனRu, uனghghu virodhamAghagh ghòdhdhaLa~NghaLaigh ghaDhDhi uனghghu virodhamAgha aNaibhoDhDhu, uனghghu virodhamAghagh gheDhaya~NghaLai èDhudhdhu,
uன madhilghaLai iDhighghiRa yandhira~NghaLai èdhire vaidhdhu, dhaன ghaDhDhaibhbhAraighaLAl uன ghòdhdhaLa~NghaLai iDhidhdhubhbhoDhuvAன.

avaன ghudhiraighaLiன erALadhdhiனAl dhUL èzhuMbhi uனனai mUDhuM; iDhidhdhudh dhiRabhbhAghghabhbhaDhDha bhaDhDhaNadhdhil bhiravejhighghuM vaNNamAgha, avaன uன vAjhalghaLughghuL bhiravejhighghaiyil, ghudhiraivIraruM vaNDhil iradha~NghaLuM iraighiRa jhadhdhadhdhile èன madhilghaL adhiruM.
dhaன ghudhiraighaLiன ghuLaMbhughaLiனAl uன vIdhighaLaiyèllAM midhibhbhAன; uன jaனdhdhaibh bhaDhDhayadhdhiனAl ghòனRubhoDhuvAன; uன bhalamAன dhUNghaL dharaiyil vizhundhubhoghuM.

avarghaL uன Asdhiyaigh ghòLLaiyiDhDhu, uன jharaghghughaLaijh jhURaiyADhi, uன madhilghaLai iDhidhdhu, uனghghu virubhbhamAன vIDhughaLai azhidhdhu, uன ghallughaLaiyuM uன mara~NghaLaiyuM uன maNNaiyuM ghaDhaliன naDhuvile bhoDhDhuviDhuvArghaL.
uன bhADhDhughaLiன jhadhdhadhdhai oyabhbhaNNuveன; uன jhuramaNDhala~NghaLiன jhadhdhaM iனigh gheDhghabhbhaDhuvadhillai.
uனனai vèRuM bhARaiyAghghiviDhuveன; nI valaighaLai virighghiRa sdhalamAyirubhbhAy; iனigh ghaDhDhabhbhaDhAy; ghardhdharAghiya nAன idhaijh jhòனனeன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr.
dhIruvughghugh ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: ghAyaMbhaDhDhavarghaL alaRuMbhodhuM, uன naDhuvil jha~NghAraM naDhaghghuMbhodhuM, nI vizhughiRa jhadhdhadhdhiனAl dhIvughaL adhirAdho?

ghaDhalarajhar èllAruM dha~NghaL jhi~NghAjhaன~NghaLaiviDhDhu iRa~Nghi; dha~NghaL jhAlvaighaLaigh ghazhaRRi, dha~NghaL jhidhdhiradhdhaiyAlaDhaighaLai urindhubhoDhuvArghaL; naDhughghame avarghaL uDhaiyAghuM; dharaiyile uDhghArndhu, nimiShandhoRuM dhadhdhaLidhdhu, uனனimidhdhaM bhiramibhbhArghaL.

avarghaL uனனimidhdhaM bhulaMbhi, uனனaigh ghuRidhdhu; ghaDhal jha~njhArighaL ghuDhiyirundha bhughazhbhbhèRRa naghariye, aiyo! uனனil dha~NghiனvarghaLughghèllAM bhayamuNDhAghghiன uன ghuDhighaLoDhu~NghUDhajh jhamudhdhiradhdhile bhaladhdhirundha nI azhindhubhoனAyo!
nI vizhuM nALil dhIvughaL dhadhdhaLighghuM; nI aghaனRubhoghuMbhodhu jhamudhdhiradhdhiluLLa dhIvughaL ghala~NghuM èனbhArghaL.

ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: nAன uனனaigh ghuDhiyillAdha, naghara~NghaLaibhbholabh bhAzhAன nagharamAghghuMbhodhuM, mighundha dhaNNIrghaL uனனai mUDhadhdhaghghadhAy nAன uனmel jhamudhdhiradhdhai varabhbhaNNuMbhodhuM,

bhUrvaghAladhdhu jaனdhdhaNDhaghghugh ghuzhiyil iRa~NghughiRavarghaLoDhe nAன uனனai iRa~NghabhbhaNNuveன; nI ghuDhiyeRAdhirughghuMbhaDhi bhUrvaghAlamudhaRghòNDhu bhAzhAyirughghiRa bhUmiyiன dhAzhviDha~NghaLile ghuzhiyil iRa~NghughiRavarghaLoDheghUDha nAன uனனaidh dha~NghiyirughghabhbhaNNuveன; jIvaனuLLoruDhaiya dhejhadhdhilo maghimai viLa~Nghajh jhèyveன.
uனனai maghA bhaya~NgharamAgha vaibhbheன; iனi nI irughghamADhDhAy; nI dheDhabhbhaDhDhAluM iனi èனRaighghuM ghANabhbhaDhamADhDhAy èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRAr èனRAr.
ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:
maனubhudhdhiraனAghiya nI ibhbhodhu dhIruviனbherile bhulaMbhi,

jhamudhdhiragh gharaidhuRaiyile ghuDhiyirundhu aneghaM dhIvughaLiன jaன~NghaLoDhe viyAbhAraMbhaNNughiRa dhIruvai noghghi: ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, dhIruve, nI uனனaibh bhUraNajhòndhariyavadhi èனghiRAy.
ghaDhalghaLiன naDhumaiyadhdhile uனdhAbharaM irughghiRadhu; uனனaigh ghaDhDhiனvarghaL uனனaibh bhUraNavaDhivAygh ghaDhDhiனArghaL.
jheனIrilirundhu vandha dhevadhAru maradhdhAl uன ghabhbhaR bhalaghaighaLaijh jhèydhArghaL; bhAymara~NghaLaijh jhèyyuMbhaDhighghu lIbhaனoனilirundhu ghedhurumara~NghaLaigh ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.

bhAjhAனiன gharvAlimara~NghaLiனAle uன dhuDhubhbhughaLaijh jhèydhArghaL; ghidhdhIM dhIvughaLilirundhu vandha AShUr maradhdhAl uன varibhalaghaighaLaijh jhèydhu, adhile yAனaidhdhandhaM azhudhdhiyirundhArghaL.
èghibhdhilirundhu vandha jhidhdhiradhdhaiyaluLLa jhaNalnUl bhuDhavai nI viridhdha bhAyAyirundhadhu; dhIvughaLiன iLanIlamuM iradhdhAMbharamuM uன vidhAனmAyirundhadhu.
jhIdhoன arvAdh èனனuM bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன ghuDhighaL uனghghudh dhaNDhuvalighghiRavarghaLAyirundhArghaL. dhIruve, uனனiDhadhdhilirundha uன jhAsdhirighaL uன mAlumighaLAyirundhArghaL.

ghebhAriன mudhiyoruM adhiன jhAsdhirighaLuM uனனil ghaMbhadhdhubhbhArghghiRavarghaLAyirundhArghaL; jhamudhdhiradhdhiன jhaghala ghabhbhalghaLuM avaighaLiluLLa ghabhbhaRghAraruM uனனoDhe dhòzhildhuRai viyAbhAraM bhaNNughiRadhaRghAgha uனனiDhadhdhil irundhArghaL.
bhèrjhiyaruM, luUdhiyaruM, bhUdhdhiyaruM uன irANuvadhdhil yudhdhavIrarAyirundhu uனghghuL gheDhaghamuM dhalaijhjhIrAvuM dhUghghivaidhdhu, uனனai ala~NgharidhdhArghaL.

arvAdh bhudhdhiraruM uன irANuva maனuSharuM uன madhilghaLmel jhuRRiluM, ghaMmAdhdhiyar uன ghòdhdhaLa~NghaLiluM irundhArghaL; ivarghaL uன madhilghaL jhuRRiluM dha~NghaL bharijhaighaLaidh dhUghghivaidhdhu, uன vaDhivadhdhaibh bhUraNabhbhaDhudhdhiனArghaL.
jhaghalavidha bhòruLghaLiன dhiraLiனAluM dharShIs UrAr uனனoDhe viyAbhAraMbhaNNiனArghaL; vèLLiyaiyuM iruMbhaiyuM dhagharadhdhaiyuM IyadhdhaiyuM uன jhandhaighaLil viRgha vandhArghaL.
yAvaன, dhUbhAl, mejhegh èனனuM jAdhiyAr uன viyAbhArighaLAyirundhu maனuSharghaLaiyuM vèNghalabhbhAdhdhira~NghaLaiyuM uன dhòzhildhuRaigh ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.
dhògharmA vaMjhadhdhAr ghudhiraighaLaiyuM ghudhiraivIraraiyuM ghoveRughazhudhaighaLaiyuM uன jhandhaighaLughghugh ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.

dhedhAன bhudhdhirar uன viyAbhArighaLAyirundhArghaL; aneghaM dhIvughaLiன vardhdhaghaM uன vajhamAghajh jherndhadhu; yAனaidhdhandha~NghaLaiyuM gharu~NghAli mara~NghaLaiyuM avaighaLughghubh bhadhilAghagh ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.

jhIriyar uன velaibhbhADhAன bhaRbhala bhòruLghaLiனimidhdhaM uனனoDhe viyAbhAraMbhaNNi, maraghadha~NghaLaiyuM, iradhdhAMbhara~NghaLaiyuM, jhidhdhiradhdhaiyAlADhaighaLaiyuM, uyarndha vasdhira~NghaLaiyuM, bhavaLa~NghaLaiyuM, bhaLi~NghaiyuM uன jhandhaighaLil viRghavandhArghaL.
yUdharuM isravel dhejhadhdhAruM uனனoDhe viyAbhAraMbhaNNi, miனனIdh bhaனனAgh èனghiRa UrghaLiன ghodhumaiyaiyuM, dheனaiyuM, èNNèyaiyuM, bhijhiனdhailadhdhaiyuM uன dhòzhildhuRaighghugh ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.

dhamasghu uன velaibhbhADhAன bhaRbhala bhòruLghaLiனimidhdhamuM, jhaghalavidhabh bhòruLghaLiன dhiraDhjhiyiனimidhdhamuM uனனoDhe vardhdhaghaMbhaNNi, ghalbhoனiன dhirADhjharajhadhdhaiyuM vèNmaiyAன ADhDhumayiraiyuM uனghghu viRRArghaL.
dhAN nADhDhAruM, bhoghghuMvaradhdhumAன yAvAனruM dhulaghghabhbhaDhDha iruMbhaiyuM ilava~NghadhdhaiyuM vaMbhaiyuM uன jhandhaighaLil ghòNDhuvandhu uன dhòzhildhuRaiyil viRRArghaL.
iradha~NghaLughghubh bhoDhughiRa meனmaiyAன iradhdhiனghghaMbhaLa~NghaLai dhedhAனiன maனuShar ghòNDhuvandhu, uனனoDhe viyAbhAraMbhaNNiனArghaL.

arabhiyaruM, ghedhAriன jhaghala bhirabhughghaLuM uனghghu vADhighghaiyAன vardhdhagharAghi ADhDhughghuDhDhighaLaiyuM ADhDhughghaDhAghghaLaiyuM vèLLADhDhughghaDhAghghaLaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhu, uனனoDhe viyAbhAraMbhaNNiனArghaL.

jhebhA, rAmA bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiன viyAbhArighaL uனனoDhe vardhdhaghaMbhaNNi, meldharamAன jhaghalavidha jhaMbhAra~NghaLaiyuM, jhaghalavidha iradhdhiனghghaRghaLaiyuM bhòனனaiyuM uன jhandhaighaLil ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.
ArAன, ghaனனe, edheன èனனuM bhaDhDhaNadhdhAruM, jhebhAviன viyAbhArighaLuM ajhIriyaruM ghilmAdh bhaDhDhaNadhdhAruM uனனoDhe viyAbhAraMbhaNNiனArghaL.

ivarghaL jhaghalavidha uyarndha jharaghghughaLaiyuM, iLanIlabh bhaDhDhughaLuM vijhidhdhiradhdhaiyalADhaighaLuM aDha~Nghiya bhuDhavaighghaDhDhughaLaiyuM, vilai uyarndha vasdhira~NghaL vaighghabhbhaDhDhu ghayiRughaLAl ghaDhDhiyirughghuM ghedhurumarabhbhèDhDhighaLaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhu, uனனoDhe viyAbhAraMbhaNNiனArghaL.
uன dhòzhildhuRaiyil dharShIjhiன ghabhbhalADhghaL uனனaibh bhoRRibh bhADhiனArghaL; nI jhamudhdhiradhdhiன naDhuvile uனனaibh bhUraNabhbhaDhudhdhi uனனai mighavuM maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhiனAy.
dhaNDhuvalighghiRavarghaL AzhamAனdhaNNIrghaLil uனனai validhdhughghòNDhu bhoனArghaL; naDhujhjhamudhdhiradhdhile ghòNDhaRghARRu uனனai uDhaidhdhubhbhoDhDhadhu.

nI nAjhamaDhaiyuM nALile uன AsdhiyoDhuM, uன jhandhaighaLoDhuM, uன dhòzhildhuRaiyoDhu~NghUDha uன ghabhbhalADhghaLuM uன mAlumighaLuM uனனiluLLa ghaMbhadhdhubhbhArghghiRavarghaLuM, uன viyAbhArighaLuM uனனiluLLa èllA yudhdhavIraruM, uன naDhuvilirughghiRa èllAghghUDhDhadhdhAruM naDhujhjhamudhdhiradhdhile vizhuvArghaL.
uன mAlumighaL olamiDhuM jhadhdhadhdhiனAl jhuRRubhbhuRa~NghaL adhiruM.
dhaNDhuvalighghiRa yAvaruM, ghabhbhalADhghaLuM, ghaDhal mAlumighaL aனaivaruM, dha~NghaL ghabhbhalghaLai viDhDhuiRa~Nghi, gharaiyile niனRu,
uனனimidhdhaM jhadhdhamiDhDhubhbhulaMbhi, maன~Nghajhandhu azhudhu, dha~NghaL dhalaighaLiனmel bhuzhudhiyaibh bhoDhDhughghòNDhu, jhAMbhalil bhuraNDhu,
uனghghAgha mòDhDhaiyiDhDhu iraDhDhuDhudhdhighghòNDhu, uனghghAgha maன~Nghajhandhu azhudhu, dhughgha~NghòNDhADhuvArghaL.
avarghaL uனghghAdh dha~NghaL dhughghadhdhile olamiDhDhu, uனனimidhdhaM bhulaMbhi, uனனaighghuRidhdhu: jhamudhdhiradhdhiன naDhuvile azhindhubhoன dhIruvughghujh jhamAன nagharaM uNDho?

uன jhandhaijhjharaghghughaL jhamudhdhira~NghaL vazhiyAygh ghòNDhuvarabhbhaDhughaiyil, anegha jaன~NghaLaidh dhirubhdhiyAghghiனAy; uன Asdhiyiன dhiraLiனAluM uன viyAbhAradhdhiனAluM bhUmiyiன rAjAghghaLai aijhuvariyavAனghaLAghghiனAy.
nI jhamudhdhiradh dhiraighaLiனAle Azha~NghaLil uDhaighghabhbhaDhDhabhodhu, uன dhòzhil dhuRaiyuM uன naDhuviluLLa ghUDhDhaM aனaidhdhuM azhindhubhoyiன èனbhArghaL.
dhIvughaLiன ghuDhighaL èllAM uனனimidhdhaM dhighaibhbhArghaL; avarghaLuDhaiya rAjAghghaL mighavuM bhiramidhdhu, ghala~Nghiன mughamAyirubhbhArghaL.
jhaghala jaன~NghaLilumuLLa vardhdhaghar uனbheril IjhalbhoDhuvArghaL; nI bhaya~NgharamAvAy; iனi òrubhodhuM irughghamADhDhAy èனghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:

maனubhudhdhiraனe nI dhIruviன adhibhadhiyai noghghi ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, uன irudhayaM meDhDhimaighòNDhu: nAன dhevaன, nAன jhamudhdhiradhdhiன naDhuve dhevAjhaனdhdhil vIRRirughghiReனèனRu nI jhòlli, uன irudhayadhdhai dhevaனiன irudhayadhdhaibhbhol AghghiனAluM, nI maனuShaனeyallAmal dhevaனlla.
idho, dhAனiyelaibhbhArghghiluM nI ~nAனvAன; iraghajhiyamAனdhòனRuM uனghghu maRaibhòruL alla.
nI uன ~nAனdhdhiனAluM uன bhudhdhiyiனAluM bhòruL jhaMbhAdhidhdhu, bhòனனaiyuM vèLLiyaiyuM uன bhòghghiShajhAlaighaLil jherdhdhughghòNDhAy.
uன viyAbhAradhdhiனAluM uன maghA ~nAனdhdhiனAluM uன bhòruLaibh bhèrughabhbhaNNiனAy; uன irudhayaM uன jhèlvadhdhiனAl meDhDhimaiyAyiRRu.
AghaiyAl ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar jhòllughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: nI uன irudhayadhdhai dhevaனiன irudhayadhdhaibhbhola AghghughiRabhaDhiyiனAl

idho, jAdhighaLil maghA bhalavAனghaLAghiya maRudhejhadhdhAr uனghghu virodhamAy varabhbhaNNuveன; avarghaL uன ~nAனdhdhiன azhaghughghu virodhamAydh dha~NghaL bhaDhDhaya~NghaLai uruvi, uன miனughghaigh ghulaidhdhubhbhoDhuvArghaL.
uனனaigh ghuzhiyile vizhadhdhaLLuvArghaL; nI jhamudhdhira~NghaLiன naDhuve ghòlaiyuNDhu jhAghiRavarghaLaibhbhol jhAvAy.
uனனaigh ghòllughiRavaனughghu muனbhAgha: nAன dhevaனèனRu nI jhòlvAyo? uனனaigh ghudhdhibhbhoDhughiRavaன ghaighghu nI maனuShaனeyallAmal dhevaனllave,
maRudhejhadhdhAriன ghaiyiனAl nI virudhdhajhedhaனmillAdhavarghaL jhAvadhubhol jhAvAy; nAன idhaijh jhòனனeன èனRu ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:

maனubhudhdhiraனe nI dhIru rAjAvaighghuRidhdhubh bhulaMbhi avaனai noghghi: ghardhdharAghiya ANDhavar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl. nI vijhidhdhiramAyjh jhèyyabhbhaDhDha mudhdhiraimodhiraM; nI ~nAனdhdhAl niRaindhavaன; bhUraNa azhaghuLLavaன.

nI dhevaனuDhaiya dhoDhDhamAghiya edheனil irundhavaன; bhadhmarAghaM bhuShbharAghaM, vairaM, bhaDhighabhbhajhjhai, ghomedhaghaM, yasbhi, indhiranIlaM, maraghadhaM, mANighghaM mudhalAன jhaghavidha iradhdhiன~NghaLuM bhòனனuM uனனai mUDhighghòNDhirughghiRadhu jhiruShDhighghabhbhaDhDha nALil uன meLavAdhdhiya~NghaLuM uன nAghajhura~NghaLuM uனனiDhadhdhil AyadhdhabhbhaDhDhirundhadhu.
nI ghAbhbhARRughiRadhaRghAgha abhiSheghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDha gherubh; dhevaனuDhaiya bharijhudhdha bharvadhadhdhil uனனai vaidhdheன; aghghiனimayamAன ghaRghaLiன naDhuve ulAviனAy.
nI jhiruShDhighghabhbhaDhDha nAL dhuvaghghi uனனil aniyAyaM ghaNDhubhiDhighghabhbhaDhDhadhumaDhDhuM, uன vazhighaLil ghuRaiyaRRirundhAy.

uன viyAbhAradhdhiன mighudhiyiனAl, uன ghòDhumai adhigharidhdhu nI bhAva~njhèydhAy; AghaiyAl nAன uனனai dhevaனuDhaiya bharvadhadhdhilirundhu AghAdhavaனèனRu dhaLLi, ghAbhbhARRughiRa gherubhAy irundha uனனai aghghiனimayamAன ghaRghaLiன naDhuve irAdhabhaDhighghu azhidhdhubhbhoDhuveன.

uன azhaghiனAl uன irudhayaM meDhDhimaiyAyiRRu; uன miனughghiனAluNDhAன ~nAனdhdhaigh ghèDhudhdhAy; uனனaidh dharaiyile dhaLLibhbhoDhuveன; rAjAghghaL uனனaibh bhArghghuMbhaDhi uனனai avarghaLughghu muனbhAgha veDhighghaiyAghghuveன.

uன aghghirama~NghaLiன erALadhdhiனAluM, uன viyAbhAradhdhiன anIdhadhdhiனAluM uன bharijhudhdha sdhala~NghaLaibh bharijhudhdhaghghulaijhjhalAghghiனAy; AghaiyAl uனனaibh bhaDhjhibhbhadhAghiya òru aghghiனiyai nAன uன naDhuvilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhabhbhaNNi, uனனaibhbhArghghiRa èllAruDhaiya ghaNghaLughghu muனbhAghavuM uனனaibh bhUmiyiனmel jhAMbhalAghghuveன.

jhAdhrAgh, meShAgh, Abhedhnegho èனனuM andha mUனRu bhuruSharuM ghaDhDhuNDhavarghaLAy èrighiRa aghghiனijhjhULaiyiன naDhuvile vizhundhArghaL.
