adhaRghu avaன: idho, nAlubher viDhudhalaiyAy aghghiனiyiன naDhuvile ulAvughiRadhaigh ghANghiReன; avarghaLughghu òru jhedhamumillai; nAlAM ALiன jhAyal dhevabhudhdhiraனughghu òbhbhAyirughghiRadhu èனRAன.

dhejhAdhibhadhighaLuM, adhighArighaLuM, dhalaivaruM, rAjAviன mandhirighaLuM ghUDhivandhu, andhabh bhuruSharuDhaiya jharIra~NghaLiனmel aghghiனi bhèla~njhèyyAmaluM, avarghaLuDhaiya dhalaimayir gharughAmaluM, avarghaLuDhaiya jhAlvaighaL jhedhabhbhaDhAmaluM, aghghiனiyiன maNaM avarghaLiDhadhdhil vIjhAmaluM irundhadhaigh ghaNDhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu nebhughAdhnejhjhAr vajhaனidhdhu: jhAdhrAgh, meShAgh, Abhedhnegho èனbhavarghaLuDhaiya dhevaனughghu sdhodhdhiraM; avarghaL dha~NghaLuDhaiya dhevaனaidh dhavira veRòru dhevaனaiyuM jhevidhdhubh bhaNiyAmal, avaraiye naMbhi, rAjAviன ghaDhDhaLaiyaidh dhaLLi, dha~NghaL jharIra~NghaLai òbhbhughghòDhudhdhadhiனAl, avar dhamadhu dhUdhaனai aனubhbhi, dhaMmuDhaiya dhAjharai viDhuvidhdhAr.

AdhalAl jhAdhrAgh, meShAgh, Abhedhnegho èனbharghaLuDhaiya dhevaனughghu virodhamAghadh dhUShaNa vArdhdhaiyaijh jhòllughiRa èndha jaனdhdhAனuM, èndha jAdhiyAனuM, èndhabh bhAShaighghAraனuM dhuNDhidhdhubhbhoDhabhbhaDhuvAன; avaன vIDhu èrughghaLamAghghabhbhaDhuM èனRu èனனAle dhIrmAனighghabhbhaDhughiRadhu; ivvidhamAy iraDhjhighghadhdhaghgha dhevaன veRòruvaruM illaiyèனRAன.
bhiனbhu rAjA jhAdhrAgh, meShAgh, Abhedhnegho èனbhavarghaLaibh bhAbhiloன dhejhadhdhile uyardhdhiனAன.

rAjAvAghiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAr bhUmiyè~NghuM ghuDhiyirughghiRa jhaghala jaனdhdhArughghuM jAdhiyArughghuM bhAShaighghArarughghuM èzhudhughiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: u~NghaLughghujh jhamAdhAனM bhèrughaghghaDhavadhu.
uனனdhamAன dhevaன èனனiDhadhdhil jhèydha aDhaiyALa~NghaLaiyuM aRbhudha~NghaLaiyuM bhirajhidhdhabhbhaDhudhdhuvadhu èனghghu naனmaiyAygh ghaNDhadhu.

avaruDhaiya aDhaiyALa~NghaL èvvaLavu maghadhdhuvamuM, avaruDhaiya aRbhudha~NghaL èvvaLavu vallamaiyumAyirughghiRadhu; avaruDhaiya rAjyaM nidhdhiya rAjyaM; avaruDhaiya ALughai dhalaimuRai dhalaimuRaiyAgha niRghuM.
nebhughAdhnejhjhArAghiya nAன èனvIDhDhile jhavughghiyamuLLavaனAyirundhu èன aramaனaiyile vAzhndhughòNDhirundheன.
nAன òru jhòbhbhaனdhdhaigh ghaNDheன; adhu èனghghudh dhighilai uNDhAghghiRRu; èன bhaDhughghaiyiனmel èனghghuL uNDhAன niனaivughaLuM, èன dhalaiyil dhoனRiன dharijhaன~NghaLuM èனனaigh ghala~NghabhbhaNNiRRu.
AghaiyAl jhòbhbhaனdhdhiன ardhdhadhdhai èனghghudh dhèrivighghiRadhaRghAghabh bhAbhiloனiன ~nAனighaLaiyèllAM èனனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvaruMbhaDhi ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDheன.

abhbhòzhudhu jhAsdhirighaLuM, jojhiyaruM, ghaldheyaruM, ghuRijhòllughiRavarghaLuM èனனiDhadhdhile vandhArghaL; jhòbhbhaனdhdhai nAன avarghaLughghujh jhòனனAluM adhiன ardhdhadhdhai èனghghudh dhèrivighghamADhDhAmaRbhoனArghaL.

ghaDhaijhiyile èன dhevaனuDhaiya nAmadhdhiனbhaDhiye bhèldhèShAdhjhAr èனனuM bhèyariDhabhbhaDhDhu bharijhudhdha dhevarghaLiன AviyaiyuDhaiya dhAனiyel èனனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvarabhbhaDhDhAன; avaனiDhadhdhil nAன jhòbhbhaனdhdhai vivaridhdhujh jhòனனdhAvadhu:

jhAsdhirighaLiன adhibhadhiyAghiya bhèldhèShAdhjhAre, bharijhudhdha dhevarghaLuDhaiya Avi uனghghuL irughghiRadhèனRuM, èndha maRaibhòruLaiyuM aRivadhu uனghghu aridhallavèனRuM nAன aRiveன; nAன ghaNDha èன jhòbhbhaனdhdhiன dharijhaன~NghaLaiyuM adhiன ardhdhadhdhaiyuM jhòllu.
nAன bhaDhudhdhirundhabhodhu èன dhalaiyil dhoனRiன dharijhaன~NghaL èனனvèனRAl idho, dhejhadhdhiன madhdhiyile mighavuM uyaramAன òru viruDhjhadhdhaigh ghaNDheன.
andha viruDhjhaM vaLarndhu bhaladhdhu, dhejhadhdhiன èllai bhariyandhamuM ghANabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhAgha adhiன uyaraM vAனbhariyandhaM èDhDhiனdhu.

adhiன ilaighaL nerdhdhiyuM, adhiன ghaனi mighudhiyumAyirundhadhu; èllA jIvaனughghuM adhil AghAraM uNDhAyirundhadhu; adhiனghIzhe vèLiyiன mirugha~NghaL nizhalughghu òdhu~Nghiனdhu; adhiன ghòbhbhughaLil AghAyadhdhubh bhaDhjhighaL dhAbharidhdhujh jhaghala bhirANighaLuM adhiனAl bhoShighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

uனனdhamAனvar maனuSharuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil ALughaijhèydhu dhamaghghujh jhidhdhamAனvaனughghu adhaigh ghòDhudhdhu, maனuSharil dhAzhndhavaனaiyuM adhiனmel adhighAriyAghghughiRAr èனRu narajIvaனghaL aRiyuMbhaDhighghugh ghAvalALariன dhIrbhbhiனAl indhagh ghAriyamuM bharijhudhdhavAனghaLiன mòzhiyiனAl indha vijhAraNaiyuM dhIrmAனighghabhbhaDhDhadhu èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhèldhèShAdhjhArèனனuM bhèyaruLLa dhAனiyel òru nAzhighaimaDhDhuM dhighaidhdhujh jhindhidhdhugh ghala~NghiனAன. rAjA avaனai noghghi: bhèldhèShAdhjhAre, jhòbhbhaனmuM adhiன ardhdhamuM uனனaigh ghala~NghabhbhaNNaveNDhiyadhillai èனRAன; abhbhòzhudhu bhèldhèShAdhjhAr bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: èன ANDhavar andhajh jhòbhbhaனM uMmuDhaiya bhaghaivariDhadhdhiluM. adhiன ardhdhaM uMmuDhaiya jhadhdhurughghaLiDhadhdhiluM bhalighghaghghaDhavadhu.
nIr ghaNDha viruDhjhaM vaLarndhu bhaladhdhu, vAனdhdhiன èllaibhariyandhaM ghANabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhAgha adhiன uyaraM vAனbhariyandhaM èDhDhiனdhu.

adhiன ilaighaL nerdhdhiyuM, adhiனghaனi mighudhiyumAyirundhadhu; èllA jIvaனughghuM adhil AghAraM uNDhAyirundhadhu; adhiனghIzhe vèLiyiன mirugha~NghaL dha~Nghiனdhu adhiன ghòbhbhughaLil AghAyadhdhubhbhaDhjhighaL dhAbharidhdhadhu.
adhu bhèriyavaruM bhaladhdhavarumAyirughghiRa rAjAvAghiya nIrdhAன; umadhu maghadhdhuvaM bhèrughi vAனbhariyandhamuM, umadhu ghardhdhadhdhuvaM bhUmiyiன èllaibhariyandhamuM èDhDhiyirughghiRadhu.

indha viruDhjhadhdhai vèDhDhi, idhai azhidhdhubhbhoDhu~NghaL; AனAluM idhiன verghaLAghiya aDhimaraM dharaiyil irughghaDhDhumèனRuM, iruMbhuM vèNghalamumAன vila~Nghu iDhabhbhaDhDhu, vèLiyiன bhajhuMbhullile dha~Nghi, AghAyadhdhubh bhaனiyile naனaivadhAgha; ezhu ghAla~NghaL avaனmel ghaDhandhubhoghumaDhDhuM mirugha~NghaLoDhe avaனuDhaiya bha~Nghu iruΕghaghghaDhavadhèனRuM vAனdhdhilirundhu Ǡα~Nghijh jhòனன bhariڠρdhdha ghAvalALaனai rAjAvAghiya nIr ghaNDhIre.

rAjAve, adhiன ardhdhamuM rAjAvAghiya èன ANDhavaனbheril vandha uனனdhamAனvaruDhaiya dhIrmAனmuM èனனvèனRAl: maனuShariனiனRu nIr dhaLLiviDhabhbhaDhuvIr; vèLiyiன mirugha~NghaLoDhe jha~njharibhbhIr; mADhughaLaibhbholabh bhullaimeyndhu, AghAyadhdhubh bhaனiyile naனaivIr.

uனனdhamAனvar maனuSharuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil ALughaijhèydhu dhamaghghujh jhidhdhamAyirughghiRavaனughghu adhaighghòDhughghiRAr èனbhadhai nIr aRindhughòLLumaDhDhuM ezhu ghAla~NghaL uMmuDhaiyabheril ghaDhandhubhoghaveNDhuM.
AனAluM viruDhjhadhdhiன verghaLAghiya aDhimaraM dharaiyil irughghaDhDhuM èனRu jhòllabhbhaDhDhadhu èனனvèனRAl: nIr bharama adhighAradhdhai aRindhabhiன rAjyaM umaghghu nilainiRghuM.

bhaனனiraNDhu mAdhaM jhèனRabhiனbhu, rAjA bhAbhiloன rAjyadhdhiன aramaனaimel ulAvighghòNDhirughghuMbhodhu:
idhu èன vallamaiyiன bharAghghiramadhdhiனAl, èன maghimaibhbhiradhAbhadhdhughghèனRu rAjyadhdhughghu aramaனaiyAgha nAன ghaDhDhiன maghA bhAbhiloன allavA èனRu jhòனனAன.
indha vArdhdhadhai rAjAviன vAyil irughghuMbhodhe vAனdhdhilirundhu òru jhadhdhaM uNDhAghi: rAjAvAghiya nebhughAdhnejhjhAre, rAjyabhAraM uனனaiviDhDhu nI~NghiRRu.

maனuShariனiனRu dhaLLabhbhaDhuvAy; vèLiyiன mirugha~NghaLoDhe jha~njharibhbhAy; mADhughaLaibhbhol bhullai meyvAy; ibhbhaDhiye uனனdhamAvar maனuSharuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil ALughaijhèydhu dhamaghghujh jhidhdhamAyirughghiRavaனughghu adhaigh ghòDhughghiRArèனbhadhai nI aRindhughòLLumaDhDhuM ezhu ghAla~NghaL uனmel ghaDhandhubhoghuM èனRu uனghghujh jhòllabhbhaDhughiRadhu èனύRu viLaMbhiனdhu.

annerame indha vArdhdhai nebhughAdhnejhjhAriDhadhdhil niRaiveRiRRu; avaன maனuShariனiனRu dhaLLabhbhaDhDhu, mADhughaLaibhbhol bhullai meyndhAன; avaனuDhaiya dhalaimayir ghazhughughaLuDhaiya iRaghughaLaibhbholavuM avaனuDhaiya nagha~NghaL bhaDhjhighaLuDhaiya nagha~NghaLaibhbholavuM vaLarumaDhDhuM avaன jharIraM AghAyadhdhubh bhaனiyile naனaindhadhu.

andha nADhghaL jhèனRabhiனbhu nebhughAdhnejhjhArAghiya nAன èன ghaNghaLai vAனdhdhughghu eRèDhudhdheன; èன bhudhdhi èனghghudh dhiruMbhi vandhadhu; abhbhòzhudhu nAன uனனdhamAனvarai sdhodhdhiridhdhu, èனRèனRaighghuM jIvidhdhirughghiRavaraibh bhughazhndhu maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhiனeன; avaruDhaiya ghardhdhadhdhuvame nidhdhiya ghardhdhadhdhuvaM, avaruDhaiya rAjyame dhalaimuRai dhalaimuRaiyAgha niRghuM.

bhUmiyiன ghuDhighaL èllAM òனRumillaiyèனRu èNNabhbhaDhughiRArghaL; avar dhamadhu jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiye vAனdhdhiன jheனaiyaiyuM bhUmiyiன ghuDhighaLaiyuM naDhadhdhughiRAr, avaruDhaiya ghaiyaidh dhaDhudhdhu avarai noghghi: èனன jhèyghiRIrèனRu jhòlladhdhaghghavaன òruvaனuM illai èனReன.

avveLaiyil èன bhudhdhi èனghghudh dhiruMbhivandhadhu; èன rAjyabhAradhdhiன meனmaighghAgha èன maghimaiyuM èன mughaghghaLaiyuM èனghghudh dhiruMbhivandhadhu, èன mandhirimAruM èன bhirabhughghaLuM èனனaidh dheDhivandhArghaL; èன rAjyadhdhile sdhirabhbhaDhudhdhabhbhaDhDheன; adhigha ghardhdhadhdhuvamuM èனghghugh ghiDhaidhdhadhu.

èன rAjyadhdhiன ALughaighghuL è~NghumuLLavarghaL yAvaruM dhAனiyeliன dhevaனughghu muனbhAgha naDhu~Nghibh bhayabhbhaDhaveNDhumèனRu èனனAle dhIrmAனMbhaNNabhbhaDhughiRadhu; avar jIvaனuLLa dhevaன. avar èனRèனRaighghuM nilaidhdhirughghiRavar; avaruDhaiya rAjyaM azhiyAdhadhu; avaruDhaiya ghardhdhadhdhuvaM muDhivubhariyandhamuM niRghuM.

dhAனiyelaijh jhi~Ngha~NghaLiன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvidhdha avare dhabhbhuvighghiRavaruM iraDhjhighghiRavaruM, vAனdhdhiluM bhUmiyiluM aDhaiyALa~NghaLaiyuM aRbhudha~NghaLaiyuM jhèyghiRavarumAyirughghiRAr èனRu èzhudhiனAன.
dhariyuviன rAjyabhAra ghAladhdhiluM, bhèrjhiyaனAghiya ghorejhuDhaiya rAjyabhAraghAladhdhiluM dhAனiyeliன ghAriyaM jèyamAyirundhadhu.

bhAbhiloன rAjAvAghiya bhèlShAdhjhAriன mudhalAM varuShadhdhile dhAனiyel òru jhòbhbhaனdhdhaiyuM dhaன bhaDhughghaiyiனmel dhaன dhalaiyil dhoனRiன dharijhaன~NghaLaiyuM ghaNDhAன. bhiனbhu avaன andhajh jhòbhbhaனdhdhai èzhudhi, ghAriya~NghaLiன dhòghaiyai vivaridhdhAன.
dhAனiyel jhòனனdhu: irAdhdhirighAladhdhil èனghghu uNDhAன dharijhaனdhdhile nAன ghaNDhadhu èனனvèனRAl: idho, vAனdhdhiன nAlu ghARRughaLuM bhèriya jhamudhdhiradhdhiனmel aDhidhdhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu vèvveRu rUbhamuLLa nAlu bhèriya mirugha~NghaL jhamudhdhiradhdhilirundhu èzhuMbhiன.

mundhiனdhu jhi~Nghadhdhaibhbhola irundhadhu; adhaRghugh ghazhughiன jhèDhDhaighaL uNDhAyirundhadhu; nAன bhArdhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, adhiன iRaghughaL bhiDhu~NghabhbhaDhDhadhu; adhu dharaiyilirundhu èDhughghabhbhaDhDhu, maனuShaனaibhbhola iraNDhu ghAliனmel nimirndhu niRghuMbhaDhi jhèyyabhbhaDhDhadhu; maனuSha irudhayaM adhaRghugh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

bhiனbhu, gharaDhighghu òbhbhAghiya veRe iraNDhAM mirughadhdhaigh ghaNDheன; adhu òru bhaghghamAyjh jhAyndhuniனRu, dhaன vAyiன bhaRghaLughghuLLe mUனRu vilAvèluMbhughaLaigh ghavvighghòNDhirundhadhu; èzhuMbhi vèghu mAMjhaM dhiனனèனRu adhaRghujh jhòllabhbhaDhDhadhu.

adhiன bhiனbhu, jhivi~NghiyaibhbholirughghiRa veRòru mirughadhdhaigh ghaNDheன; adhiன mudhughiனmel bhaDhjhiyiனjhèDhDhaighaL nAlu irundhadhu; andha mirughadhdhughghu nAlu dhalaighaLuM uNDhAyirundhadhu; adhaRghu ALughai aLighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

adhaRghubhbhiனbhu, irAdhdharijhaன~NghaLil nAlAM mirughadhdhaigh ghaNDheன; adhu ghèDhiyuM bhaya~NgharamuM maghA bhaladhdhadhumAyirundhadhu; adhaRghubh bhèriya irubhbhubhbhaRghaL irundhadhu; adhu nòRughghibh bhaDhjhidhdhu, mIdhiyAனdhaidh dhaன ghAlghaLAl midhidhdhubhbhoDhDhadhu; adhu dhaனghghu muனனirundha èllA mirugha~NghaLaibhbhArghghiluM veRRuruvamAyirundhadhu, adhaRghubh bhadhdhugh ghòMbhughaL irundhadhu.

andhagh ghòMbhughaLai nAன ghavaனidhdhirughghaiyil, idho, avaighaLughghu iDhaiyile veRòru jhiனன ghòMbhu èzhuMbhiRRu; adhaRghu muனbhAgha mundhiனghòMbhughaLil mUனRubhiDhu~NghabhbhaDhadhu; idho, andhagh ghòMbhile maனuShaghaNghaLughghu òbhbhAன ghaNghaLuM bhèrumaiyAனvaghaLaibh bhejhuM vAyuM irundhadhu.

nAன bhArdhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, jhi~NghAjhaன~NghaL vaighghabhbhaDhDhadhu; nINDha AyujhuLLavar vIRRirundhAr; avaruDhaiya vasdhiraM uRaindha malaiyaibhbholavuM, avaruDhaiya jhirajhiன mayir vèNmaiyAghavuM bha~njhaibhbhola dhubhbhuravAghavuM irundhadhu; avaruDhaiya jhi~NghAjhaனM aghghiனijuvAlaiyuM, adhiன jhaghghara~NghaL èrighiRa nèrubhbhumAyirundhadhu.

aghghiனi nadhi avar jhannidhiyilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu oDhiனdhu; AyiramAyiraMbher avaraijh jhevidhdhArghaL; ghoDhAghoDhibher avarughghu muனbhAgha niனRArghaL; niyAyajha~NghaM uDhghArndhadhu; bhusdhagha~NghaL dhiRaghghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu nAன bhArdhdheன; nAன bhArdhdhughòNDhirughghaiyil andhagh ghòMbhu bhèrumaiyAன bhejhjhughaLaibh bhejhiனdhiனimidhdhaM andha mirughaM ghòlaijhèyyabhbhaDhDhadhu; adhiன uDhal azhighghabhbhaDhDhu, èrighiRa aghghiனighghu òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

maRRa mirugha~NghaLuDhaiya ALughaiyovèனRAl, avaighaLai viDhDhu nIghghabhbhaDhDhadhu; AனAluM, avaighaLughghugh ghAlamuM jhamayamuM AghumaDhDhuM avaighaL uyiroDhe irughghuMbhaDhi ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhabhbhaDhDhadhu.

irAdhdharijhaன~NghaLile nAன bhArdhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, idho, maனuShaghumAraனuDhaiya jhAyalAன òruvar vAனdhdhu megha~NghaLuDhaனe vandhAr; avar nINDha AyujhuLLavar iDhamaDhDhuM vandhu, avar jhamIbhadhdhil ghòNDhuvarabhbhaDhDhAr.

jhaghala jaன~NghaLuM jAdhiyAruM, bhAShaighghAraruM avaraiye jhevighghuMbhaDhi avarughghugh ghardhdhadhdhuvamuM maghimaiyuM rAjarighamuM ghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhadhu; avaruDhaiya ghardhdhadhdhuvaM nI~NghAdha nidhdhiya ghardhdhadhdhuvamuM avaruDhaiya rAjyaM azhiyAdhadhumAyirughghuM.
dhAனiyelAghiya nAன èன dheghadhdhiனuL èன Aviyile jha~njhalabhbhaDhDheன; èன dhalaiyil dhoனRiன dharijhaன~NghaL èனனaigh ghala~NghabhbhaNNiனdhu.

jhamIbhadhdhil niRghiRavarghaLil òruvaனiDhadhdhil nAன bhoy, idhaன bhòruL èllAvaRRaiyuM èனghghujh jhòlluMbhaDhi avaனai veNDhighghòNDheன; avaன andhagh ghAriya~NghaLiன ardhdhadhdhai èனghghu aRividhdhujhjhòனனdhu èனனvèனRAl:
andha nAlu bhèriya mirugha~NghaLuM bhUmiyilirundhu èzhuMbhughiRa nAlu rAjAghghaL.
AனAluM uனனdhamAனvaruDhaiya bharijhudhdhavAனghaL rAjarighadhdhaibhbhèRRu, èனRèனRaighghumuLLa jhadhAghAla~NghaLiluM rAjyadhdhaijh jhudhandharidhdhughghòLvArghaL èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu maRRavaighaLaiyèllAM bhArghghiluM veRRuruvuM ghèDhiyumuLLadhumAy, irubhbhubh bhaRghaLuM, vèNghala nagha~NghaLumuDhaiyadhAy nòRughghibh bhaDhjhidhdhu, mIdhiyAனdhaidh dhaன ghAlghaLAl midhidhdhubhbhoDhDhadhumAyirundha nAlAM mirughadhdhaigh ghuRidhdhuM,

adhiன dhalaimeluLLa bhadhdhughghòMbhughaLaighghuRidhdhuM dhaனghghu muனbhAgha mUனRu ghòMbhughaL vizhundhubhogha èzhuMbhiனdhumAy, ghaNghaLaiyuM bhèrumaiyAனvaighaLaibh bhejhuM vAyaiyumuDhaiyadhumAy, maRRavaighaLaibhbhArghghiluM bharumaனAghadh dhoனRiனdhumAyirundha andha veRe ghòMbhaighghuRidhdhuM, avaRRiன bhòruLai aRiya maனdhAyirundheன.

nINDha AyujhuLLavar varumaDhDhAghavuM, niyAyavijhAribhbhu uனனdhamAனvaruDhaiya bharijhudhdhavaனghaLughghugh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhu, bharijhudhdhavAனghaL rAjyadhdhaijh jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLuM ghAlaM varumaDhDhAghavuM,
indhagh ghòMbhu bharijhudhdhavAனghaLoDhe yudhdhaMbhaNNi avarghaLai meRghòNDhadhu èனRu ghaNDheன.
avaன jhòனனdhu: nAlAM mirughaM bhUmiyile uNDhAghuM nAlAM rAjyamAM; adhu èllA rAjya~NghaLaibhbhArghghiluM veRAyirundhu, bhUmiyai èllAM bhaDhjhidhdhu, adhai midhidhdhu, adhai nòRughghibhbhoDhuM.

andhabh bhadhdhughghòMbhughaL èனனvèனRAl, andha rAjyadhdhile èzhuMbhuM bhadhdhu rAjAghghaLAM; avarghaLughghubhbhiனbhu veRòruvaன èzhuMbhuvAன; avaன mundhiனvarghaLaibhbhArghghiluM veRAyirundhu, mUனRu rAjAghghaLaidh dhAzhdhdhibhbhoDhDhu,

uனனdhamAனvarughghu virodhamAgha vArdhdhaighaLaibh bhejhi, uனனdhamAனvaruDhaiya bharijhudhdhavAனghaLai òDhughghi, ghAla~NghaLaiyuM bhiramANa~NghaLaiyuM mARRa niனaibhbhAன; avarghaL òrughAlamuM, ghAla~NghaLuM, araighghAlamuM jhèllumaDhDhuM avaன ghaiyil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvArghaL.
AனAluM niyAyajha~NghaM uDhghAruM; abhbhòzhudhu muDhivubhariyandhaM avaனaijh jha~NgharighghuMbhaDhiyAghavuM azhighghuMbhaDhiyAghavuM avaனuDhaiya ALughaiyai nIghghibhbhoDhuvArghaL.

vAனdhdhiன ghIzhè~NghumuLLa rAjya~NghaLiன rAjarighamuM ALughaiyuM maghadhdhuvamuM uனனdhamAனvaruDhaiya bharijhudhdhavAனghaLAghiya jaன~NghaLughghu ghòDhughghabhbhaDhuM; avaruDhaiya rAjyaM nidhdhiya rAjyaM; jhaghala ghardhdhadhdhuva~NghaLuM avaraijh jhevidhdhu avarughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhDhirughghuM èனRAன.
avaன jhòனன vArdhdhai idhdhoDhe muDhindhadhu. dhAனiyelAghiya nAன èன niனaivughaLAl mighavuM ghala~Nghiனeன; èன mughaM veRubhaDhDhadhu; indhagh ghAriyadhdhai èன maனdhile vaidhdhughghòNDheன.

dhAனiyelAghiya èனghghu mudhalil ghANbhighghabhbhaDhDha dharijhaனdhdhughghubhbhiனbhu, rAjAvAghiya bhèlShAdhjhAr rAjyabhAraMbhaNNiன mUனRAM varuShadhdhile veRòru dharijhaனM èனghghugh ghANbhighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.
dharijhaனdhdhile nAன ghaNDhadhu èனனvèனRAl: nAன bhArghghaiyil elAM dhejhadhdhiluLLa jhUjhAன aramaனaiyil irundheன; a~Nghe nAன UlAy èனனuM ARRa~Ngharaiyil irundhadhAghadh dharijhaனdhdhile ghaNDheன.

nAன èன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubhbhArdhdheன; idho, iraNDhu ghòMbhughaLuLLa òru ADhDhughghaDhA ARRiRghu muனbhAgha niனRadhu; adhiன iraNDhu ghòMbhughaLuM uyarndhavaighaLAyirundhadhu; AghiluM avaighaLil òனRu maRRadhaibhbhArghghiluM uyarndhirundhadhu; uyarndhaghòMbhu bhindhi muLaidhdhèzhuMbhiRRu.

andha ADhDhughghaDhA meRghuM vaDhaghghuM dhèRghuM bhAyghiRadhaigh ghaNDheன; òru mirughamuM adhiன muனனe niRghagh ghUDhAdhirundhadhu; adhiன ghaighghudh dhabhbhuvibhbhArumillai; adhu dhaன iShDhabhbhaDhiye jhèydhu vallamaighòNDhadhu.

nAன adhaigh ghavaனidhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, idho, meRgheyirundhu òru vèLLADhDhughghaDhA niladhdhile ghAl bhAvAmal dhejhadhdhiனmIdhè~NghuM jhèனRadhu; andha vèLLADhDhughghaDhAviன ghaNghaLughghu naDhuve vijheShidhdha òru ghòMbhu irundhadhu.
nAன ARRiன muனbhAgha niRghaghghaNDha iraNDhu ghòMbhughaLuLLa ADhDhughghaDhAviனiDhamaDhDhuM adhuvandhu, dhaனbhaladhdhiன ughghiradhdhoDhe adhaRghu èdhirAghabh bhAyndhadhu.

adhu ADhDhughghaDhAviன ghiDhDhajh jheraghghaNDheன; adhu ADhDhughghaDhAviனmel ghaDhu~Nghobha~NghòNDhu adhai muDhDhi, adhiன iraNDhu ghòMbhughaLaiyuM muRidhdhubhbhoDhDhadhu, adhiனmuன niRgha ADhDhughghaDhAvughghubh bhalamilmaiyAl, vèLLADhDhughghaDhA adhaidh dharaiyile dhaLLi midhidhdhubhbhoDhDhadhu, adhiன ghaighghu ADhDhughghaDhAvaidh dhabhbhuvibhbhAr illai.

abhbhòzhudhu vèLLADhDhughghaDhA mighudhiyuM vallamaighòNDhadhu; adhu bhala~NghòNDhirughghaiyil, andhabh bhèriya ghòMbhu muRindhubhoyiRRu; adhaRghubh bhadhilAgha AghAyadhdhiன nAludhijhaighaLughghuM èdhirAy vijheShidhdha nAlughòMbhughaL muLaidhdhèzhuMbhiனdhu.
avaighaLil òனRilirundhu jhiனனdhAன òru ghòMbhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu dhèRghughghuM, ghizhaghghughghuM èdhirAghavuM, jhi~NghAramAன dhejhadhdhughghu nerAghavuM mighavuM bhèriyadhAyiRRu.
adhu vAனdhdhiன jheனaibhariyandhaM vaLarndhu, adhiன jheனaiyAghiya naDhjhadhdhira~NghaLil jhilavaRRai bhUmiyile vizhabhbhaNNi, avaighaLai midhidhdhadhu.
adhu jheனaiyiனuDhaiya adhibhadhi bhariyandhamuM dhaனனai uyardhdhi, avariDhadhdhilirundhu aனRADha bhaliyai nIghghiRRu; avaruDhaiya bharijhudhdha sdhAனM dhaLLuNDhadhu.
bhAdhaghadhdhiனimidhdhaM aனRADha bhaliyoDhu~NghUDhajh jheனaiyuM adhaRghu òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhadhu; adhu jhadhdhiyadhdhaidh dharaiyile dhaLLiRRu; adhu ghiriyaijhèydhu anughUlamaDhaindhadhu.

bharijhudhdhavAனAghiya òruvaன bhejhaghgheDhDheன; abhbhòzhudhu veRòru bharijhudhdhavAன bhejhiனvarai noghghi: aனRADha bhaliyaighghuRidhdhuM, bhAzhghghaDhibhbhai uNDhAghghuM bhAdhaghadhdhaighghuRidhdhuM, bharijhudhdha sdhalamuM jheனaiyuM midhibhaDha òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvadhaighghuRidhdhuM, uNDhAன dharijhaனM èdhuvaraighghuM irughghuM èனRu gheDhDhAன.
avaன èனனai noghghi: iraNDhAyiradhdhu munnURu irAbhbhaghal jhèlluMvaraighghuM irughghuM, bhiனbhu bharijhudhdhasdhalaM jhudhdhigharighghabhbhaDhuM èனRAன.
dhAனiyelAghiya nAன indhadh dharijhaனdhdhaighghaNDhu, adhiன bhòruLai aRiya vaghaidheDhughaiyil, idho, maனuShajhAyalAன òruvaன èனghghu èdhire niனRAன.
aனRiyuM ghAbhiriyele, ivaனughghudh dharijhaனdhdhai viLa~NghabhbhaNNèனRu UlAyiன madhdhiyile ghUbhbhiDhDhujh jhòllughiRa òru maனuSha jhadhdhadhdhaiyuM gheDhDheன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன nAன niனRa iDhadhdhughghu vandhAன; avaன varughaiyil nAன dhiDhughghiDhDhu mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundheன; avaன èனனai noghghi: maனubhudhdhiraனe ghavaனi; indhadh dharijhaனM muDhivughAladhdhughghu aDhudhdhadhu èனRAன.
avaன èனனoDhe bhejhughaiyil, nAன dharaiyil mugha~NghubhbhuRaghghiDhandhu, ayarndha nidhdhiraighòNDheன; avaனo èனனaidh dhòDhDhu, nAன ghAluUனRi niRghuMbhaDhi jhèydhu:
idho, ghobhadhdhiன muDhivughAladhdhile jhaMbhavibhbhadhai uனghghudh dhèrivibhbheன; idhu ghuRighghabhbhaDhDha muDhivughAladhdhughghu aDhudhdhadhu.
nI ghaNDha iraNDhu ghòMbhuLLa ADhDhughghaDhA medhiyA bhèrjhiyA dhejha~NghaLiன rAjAghghaL;
romamuLLa andha vèLLADhDhughghaDhA ghireghghu dhejhadhdhiன rAjA; adhiன ghaNghaLughghu naDhuve irundha bhèriya ghòMbhu adhiன mudhalAM rAjA;
adhu muRindhubhoனbhiனbhu adhaRghubh bhadhilAgha nAlu ghòMbhughaL èzhuMbhiனdhu èனனvèனRAl, andha jAdhiyile nAlu rAjya~NghaL èzhuMbhuM; AனAluM avaனughghu irundha vallamai avaighaLughghu irAdhu.
avarghaLuDhaiya rAjyabhAradhdhiன ghaDhaijhighghAladhdhilovèனRAl, bhAdhagharuDhaiya bhAdhaghaM niRaiveRuMbhodhu, mUrghgha mughamuM jhUdhAன bhejhjhumuLLa jhAmardhdhiyamAɠòru rAjA èzhuMbhuvAன.

avaனuDhaiya vallamai bhèrughuM; AனAluM avaனuDhaiya jhuyabhaladhdhiனAlalla, avaன adhijhayamAனvidhamAgha azhiMbhuNDhAghghi, anughUlaM bhèRRughghiriyaijhèydhu, bhalavAனghaLaiyuM bharijhudhdha jaன~NghaLaiyuM azhibhbhAன.

avaன dhaன ubhAyadhdhiனAl va~njhaghadhdhaigh ghaighUDhivarabhbhaNNi, dhaன irudhayadhdhil bhèrumaighòNDhu, nirvijhAradhdhoDhirughghiRa anegharai azhidhdhu, adhibhadhighaLughghu adhibhadhiyAyirughghiRavarughghu virodhamAy èzhuMbhuvAன, AனAluM avaன ghaiyiனAlalla veRuvidhamAy muRidhdhubhbhoDhabhbhaDhuvAன.
jhòllabhbhaDhDha irAbhbhaghalghaLiனdharijhaனM jhadhdhiyamAyirughghiRadhu; AdhalAl indhadh dharijhaனdhdhai nI maRaidhdhuvai; adhaRghu iனனuM aneghanAL jhèlluM èனRAன.

dhAனiyelAghiya nAன jhorvaDhaindhu, jhilanAL viyAdhibhbhaDhDhirundheன; bhiனbhu nAன èzhundhirundhu, rAjAviன velaiyaijh jhèydhu, andhadh dharijhaனdhdhiனAl dhighaidhdhughghòNDhirundheன; òruvaruM adhai aRiyavillai.

uன jhabhaiyiன maனuSharAyirundhu bhaNDhighai AjharibhbhillAmaiyAl uNDhAன nindhaiyiனimidhdhaM jha~njhalabhbhaDhDhavarghaLai nAன eghamAygh ghUDhDhighghòLLuveன.

aghghAladhdhile u~NghaLaigh ghUDhDhighghòNDhuvaruveன, aghghAladhdhile u~NghaLaijh jherdhdhughghòLveன; u~NghaL ghaNghANa nAன u~NghaL jhiRaiyirubhbhaidh dhirubhbhuMbhodhu, bhUmiyiluLLa jhaghala jaன~NghaLughghuLLuM nAன u~NghaLaigh ghIrdhdhiyuM bhughazhjhjhiyumAgha vaibhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

rAjAvAghiya dhariyu arajhANDha iraNDhAM varuShaM ARAM mAdhaM mudhalAndhedhiyile, ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai AghAy èனனuM dhIrghghadharijhiyiன mUlamAy jhèyaldhdhiyeliன ghumAraனAghiya jhèrubhAbhel èனனuM yUdhAviன dhalaivaனughghuM, yodhjhadhAghghiன ghumAraனAghiya yojhuvA èனனuM bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனughghuM uNDhAghi, avar jhòனனdhu èனனvèனRAl:
indha jaன~NghaL ghardhdharuDhaiya Alayadhdhaigh ghaDhDhughiRadhaRghu eRRaghAlaM iனனuM varaviβlai èனghiRArghaL èனRu ڠχனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
AனAluM AghAy èனனuM dhIrghghadharijhiyiன mUlamAygh ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai uNDhAghi, avar jhòllughiRAr:
indha vIDhu bhAzhAygh ghiDhaghghuMbhodhu, nI~NghaL majhjhubhbhAvabhbhaDhDha u~NghaL vIDhughaLil ghuDhiyirughghuMbhaDhiyAன ghAlaM idhuvo?

nI~NghaL dhiraLAy vidhaidhdhuM ghò~njhamAy aRudhdhughghòNDhuvarughiRIrghaL; nI~NghaL bhujhidhdhuM dhirubhdhiyAghavillai; ghuDhidhdhuM bharibhUraNamaDhaiyavillai; nI~NghaL vasdhiraM uDhudhdhiyuM òruvaனughghuM ghuLirviDhavillai; ghUliyaijh jhaMbhAdhighghiRavaன bhòdhdhalAன bhaiyile bhoDhughiRavaனAy adhaijh jhaMbhAdhighghiRAன.

adhighamAy varumèனRu nI~NghaL èdhirbhArdhdhirundhuM, idho, ghò~njhaM ghiDhaidhdhadhu; nI~NghaL aRudhdhu vIDhDhughghugh ghòNDhuvandhuM, nAன adhai UdhibhbhoDhughiReன; èdhiனimidhdhamèனRAl, èன vIDhu bhAzhAyghghiDhaghghuMbhodhu nI~NghaL èllAruM avaனvaன dhaன dhaன vIDhDhiRghu oDhibhbhoghiRIrghaLe, idhiனimidhdhame èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu jhèyaldhdhiyeliன ghumAraனAghiya jhèrubhAbheluM, yodhjhadhAghghiன ghumAraனAghiya yojhuvA èனனuM bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனuM, jaனdhdhil mIdhiyAன aனaivaruM dha~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhughghuM, dha~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar aனubhbhiன AghAy èனனuM dhIrghghadharijhiyiனuDhaiya vArdhdhaighaLughghuM jhèvighòDhudhdhArghaL, jaன~NghaL ghardhdharughghu muனbhAghabh bhayandhirundhArghaL.

nI jhèyaldhdhiyeliன ghumAraனAghiya jhèrubhAbhel èனனuM yUdhAviன dhalaivaனoDhuM, yodhjhadhAghghiன ghumAraனAghiya yojhuvA èனனuM bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனoDhuM, jaனdhdhil mIdhiyAனvarghaLoDhuM jhòllaveNDhiyadhu, èனனvèனRAl:

indha Alayadhdhiன mundhiன maghimaiyaigh ghaNDhavarghaLil u~NghaLughghuLLe mIndhirughghiRavarghaL yAr? ibhbhòzhudhu idhu u~NghaLughghu èbhbhaDhigh ghANghiRadhu? adhaRghu idhu u~NghaL bhArvaiyil òனRumillAdhadhubhol ghANghiRadhallavA?

nI~NghaL èghibhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhughiRabhodhu nAன u~NghaLoDhe uDhaனbhaDhighghai bhaNNiன vArdhdhaiyiனbhaDhiye, èன AviyAனvaruM u~NghaL naDhuvil nilaighòNDhirubhbhAr; bhayabhbhaDhAdheyu~NghaL.
jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr: ghò~njhaghghAladhdhughghuLLe iனனuM òrudharaM nAன vAனdhdhaiyuM bhUmiyaiyuM jhamudhdhiradhdhaiyuM vèDhDhAndharaiyaiyuM ajhaiyabhbhaNNuveன.

mundhiன Alayadhdhiன maghimaiyaibh bhArghghiluM, indhabh bhindhiன Alayadhdhiன maghimai bhèridhAyirughghuM èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; ivviDhadhdhile jhamAdhAனdhdhaigh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuveன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.

òruvaன dhaன vasdhiradhdhiன dhò~Nghalile bharijhudhdha mAMjhadhdhaighghòNDhubhoghaiyil dhaன vasdhiradhdhiன dhò~Nghal abhbhadhdhaiyAghiluM jhAdhadhdhaiyAghiluM, dhirADhjharajhadhdhaiyAghiluM, èNNèyaiyAghiluM, maRRèndha bhojaனbhadhArdhdhadhdhaiyAghiluM dhòDhDhAl adhu bharijhudhdhamAghumo èனRu nI AjhAriyariDhadhdhil vedha niyAyadhdhaibhbhaRRigh gheL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAr.
adhaRghu AjhAriyarghaL bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: bharijhudhdhamAghAdhu èனRArghaL.
bhiNadhdhAl dhIDhDhubhbhaDhDhavaன avaighaLil èdhaiyAghiluM dhòDhDhAl, adhu dhIDhDhubhbhaDhumo èனRu AghAy bhiனனuM gheDhDhAன; adhaRghu AjhAriyarghaL bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: dhIDhDhubhbhaDhuM èனRArghaL.

ghaLa~njhiyadhdhil iனனuM vidhaidhdhAனiyaM uNDho? dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyuM adhdhimaramuM mAdhaLa~njhèDhiyuM òlivamaramuM ghaனighòDhughghavillaiye, nAன iனRumudhal u~NghaLai AjhIrvadhibhbheன èனRu jhòllughiRAr èனRAன.
irubhadhdhunAlAndhedhiyAghiya annALile ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai iraNDhAM vijhai AghAy èனbhavaனughghu uNDhAghi, avar:
nI yUdhAviன dhalaivaனAghiya jhèrubhAbheloDhe jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl, nAன vAனdhdhaiyuM bhUmiyaiyuM ajhaiyabhbhaNNi,

jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr: jhèyaldhdhiyeliன ghumAraனAghiya jhèrubhAbhel èனனuM èன UzhiyaghghAraனe, uனனai nAன annALile jherdhdhughghòNDhu, uனனai mudhdhirai modhiramAgha vaibhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; nAன uனனaidh dhèrindhughòNDheன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar uraighghiRAr èனRu jhòllughiRAr èனRAr.
dhariyu arajhANDha iraNDhAM varuShaM èDhDhAM mAdhadhdhile idhdhoviன maghaனAன bhèraghiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya jhaghariyAvughghu uNDhAன ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai:
ghardhdhar u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLiனmel ghaDhu~NghobhamAyirundhAr.

AghaiyAl nI avarghaLai noghghi: jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: èனனiDhadhdhil dhiruMbhu~NghaL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; abhbhòzhudhu nAன u~NghaLiDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhuveன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLaibh bholirAdheyu~NghaL; mundhiன dhIrghghadharijhighaL avarghaLai noghghi: u~NghaL bhòllAdha vazhighaLaiyuM u~NghaL bhòllAdha ghiriyaighaLaiyuM viDhDhudh dhiruMbhu~NghaL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRu ghUbhbhiDhDhArghaL; AனAluM èனghghujh jhèvighòDhAmaluM èனனaigh ghavaனiyAmaluM bhoனArghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
u~NghaL bhidhAghghaL è~Nghe? dhIrghghadharijhighaL èனRèனRaighghuM uyiroDhirubhbhArghaLo?

irAmaRbhoனAluma, dhIrghghadharijhighaLAghiya èன UzhiyaghghArarughghu nAன ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDha èன vArdhdhaighaLuM èன dhIrmAன~NghaLuM u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLiDhadhdhil bhalighghavillaiyo? è~NghaL vazhighaLiனbhaDhiyeyuM, è~NghaL ghiriyaighaLiனbhaDhiyeyuM jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar è~NghaLughghujh jhèyya nirNayidhdhabhaDhiye è~NghaLughghujh jhèydhArèனRu avarghaL dhiruMbhavandhu jhòனனdhillaiyo èனRu jhòl èனRAr.

dhariyu arajhANDha iraNDhAM varuShaM, jhebhAdh mAdhamAghiya bhadhiனorAM mAdhaM irubhadhdhunAlAndhedhiyile, ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai idhdhoviன maghaனAன bhèraghiyAviன ghumAraன jhaghariyA èனனuM dhIrghghadharijhighghu uNDhAyiRRu; avaன jhòனனdhu:

idho iனRu rAdhdhiri jhivabhbhugh ghudhiraiyiனmel eRiyirundha òru bhuruShaனaigh ghaNDheன; avar bhaLLadhdhAghghil irughghiRa mirudhujhjhèDhighaLughghuLLe niனRAr; avarughghubh bhiனனAle jhivabhbhuM ma~Nghiன niRamuM vèNmaiyumAன ghudhiraighaL irundhaன.
abhbhòzhudhu nAன; èன ANDhavare, ivarghaL yArèனRu gheDhDheன; èனனoDhe bhejhughiRa dhUdhaனAனvar: ivarghaL yArèனRu nAன uனghghugh ghANbhibhbheன èனRu jhòனனAr.
abhbhòzhudhu mirudhujhjhèDhighaLughghuLLe niனRa andhabh bhuruShaன bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: ivarghaL bhUmiyè~NghuM jhuRRibhbhArghghagh ghardhdhar aனubhbhiனvarghaL èனRAr.

bhiனbhu avarghaL mirudhujhjhèDhighaLughghuLLe niனRa ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனai noghghi: nA~NghaL bhUmiyè~NghuM jhuRRibhbhArdhdhoM; idho, bhUmimuzhuvadhuM amaidhaluM amarighghaiyumAyirughghiRadhu èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன dhaன maRumòzhiyaijh jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhAve, indha èzhubhadhu varuShamAy nIr ghobha~NghòNDhirughghiRa èrujhalemiனmeluM yUdhA bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLiனmeluM èndhamaDhDhuM ira~NghAdhirubhbhIr èனRu jhòlla,
abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar, èனனoDhe bhejhiன dhUdhaனughghu nalvArdhdhaighaLaiyuM ARudhalAன vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM bhiradhiyudhdharamAghajh jhòனனAr.
abhbhòzhudhu èனனoDhe bhejhiன dhUdhaன èனனai noghghi: jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: nAன èrujhalemughghAghavuM jhIyoனughghAghavuM maghA vairAghghiyaM ghòNDhirughghiReன.
nAன ghò~njha~N ghobha~NghòNDhirundhabhodhu avarghaL dha~NghaL gheDhDhai adhigharighghadh dheDhiனbhaDhiyiனAl, jhughamAy vAzhughiRa bhuRajAdhighaLbheril nAன ghaDhu~Nghobha~NghòNDheன.

AghaiyAl maனurughghadhdhoDhe èrujhalemiனiDhadhdhil dhiruMbhiனeன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; èன AlayaM adhile ghaDhDhabhbhaDhuM; èrujhalemiனmel aLavunUl bhiDhighghabhbhaDhuM èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRu ghURu èனRAr.

iனனuM èன bhaDhDhaNa~NghaL naனmaiyiனAl bharaMbhiyirughghuM; iனனuM ghardhdhar jhIyoனaidh dheRRaravu bhaNNuvAr; iனனuM èrujhalemaidh dhèrindhughòLLuvAr èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRu bhiனனuM ghURu èனRAr.
nAன èன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubhbhArdhdhabhodhu, idho, nAlu ghòMbhughaLaigh ghaNDheன.
avaighaL èனனvèனRu èனனoDhe bhejhiன dhUdhaனaigh gheDhDheன; adhaRghu avar: ivaighaL yUdhAvaiyuM isravelaiyuM èrujhalemaiyuM jhidhaRaDhidhdha ghòMbhughaL èனRAr.
bhiனbhu ghardhdhar èனghghu nAlu dhòzhilALighaLaigh ghANbhidhdhAr.

ivarghaL èனனjhèyya varughiRArghaLèனRu gheDhDheன; adhaRghu avar: òruvaனuM dhaன dhalaiyai eRèDhughghagh ghUDhAdhabhaDhi andhagh ghòMbhughaL yUdhAvaijh jhidhaRaDhidhdhadhe, avaighaLughghubh bhayamuRudhdhughiRadhaRghuM, yUdhAviன dhejhadhdhaibh bhAzhAghghadh dha~NghaL ghòMbhai èDhudhdha jAdhighaLuDhaiya ghòMbhughaLai vizhadhdhaLLughiRadhaRghuM ivarghaL vandhArghaL èனRAr.
nAன èன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubh bhArdhdhabhodhu, idho, dhaன ghaiyile aLavunUl bhiDhidhdhirundha òru bhuruShaனaigh ghaNDheன.
nIr èvviDhadhdhughghubh bhoghiRIr èனRu gheDhDheன; adhaRghu avar; èrujhalemiன aghalaM ivvaLavu èனRuM adhiன nILaM ivvaLavu èனRuM aRiyuMbhaDhi adhai aLaghghiRadhaRghubh bhoghiReன èனRAr.
idho, èனனoDhebhejhiன dhUdhaன bhuRabhbhaDhDhabhodhu, veRòru dhUdhaன avaraijh jhandhighghuMbhaDhibh bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvandhAன.

ivaனai avar noghghi: nI oDhi indha vAlibhaனiDhadhdhil jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl, èrujhaleM dhaன naDhuvile ghUDhuM maனuShariன dhiraLiனAluM mirughajIvaனghaLiன dhiraLiனAluM madhilillAdha bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLbhol vAjhasdhalamAghuM.
nAன adhaRghujh jhuRRiluM aghghiனi madhilAyirundhu, adhiன naDhuvil maghimaiyAgha irubhbheன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
ogho, nI~NghaL èzhuMbhi vaDhadhejhadhdhilirundhu oDhivAru~NghaL èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; AghAyadhdhu nAனghu dhijhaighaLiluM u~NghaLai nAன jhidhaRabhbhaNNiனeன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
bhAbhiloன ghumAradhdhiyiனiDhadhdhil ghuDhiyirughghiRa jhIyoனe, uனனai viDhuvidhdhughghòL.

bhiRbhADhu maghimaiyuNDhAghumèனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; u~NghaLaigh ghòLLaiyiDhDha jAdhighaLiDhadhdhughghu èனனai aனubhbhiனAr; u~NghaLaidh dhòDhughiRavaன avaruDhaiya ghaNmaNiyaidh dhòDhughiRAன.
idho, nAன èன ghaiyai avarghaLughghu virodhamAgha ajhaibhbheன; adhiனAl avarghaL dha~NghaL aDhimaighaLughghugh ghòLLaiyAvArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar èனனai aனubhbhiனArèனRu aRivIrghaL.
jhIyoன ghumAradhdhiye, ghèMbhIridhdhubhbhADhu; idho, nAன vandhu uன naDhuvil vAjhaMbhaNNuveன èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
annALile aneghaM jAdhighaL ghardhdharaijh jherndhu èன jaனmAvArghaL; nAன uன naDhuvil vAjhamAyirubhbheன; abhbhòzhudhu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar èனனai uனனiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனArèனRu aRivAy.
ghardhdhar bharijhudhdha dhejhadhdhile yUdhAvAghiya dhamadhu bha~Nghaijh jhudhandharidhdhu, dhiruMbhavuM èrujhalemaidh dhèrindhughòLvAr.
mAMjhamAன jhaghalamAன bherghaLe, ghardhdharughghu muனbhAgha mèLaனmAyiru~NghaL; avar dhamadhu bharijhudhdha vAjhasdhaladhdhilirundhu èzhundharuLiனAr èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
avar bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனAghiya yojhuvAvai èனghghugh ghANbhidhdhAr; avaன ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaனughghu muனbhAgha niனRAன; jhAdhdhAன avaனughghu virodha~njhèyya avaன valadhubhaghghadhdhile niனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdhar jhAdhdhAனai noghghi: ghardhdhar uனனaigh ghaDhindhughòLvArAgha; jhAdhdhAனe, èrujhalemaidh dhèrindhughòNDha ghardhdhar uனனaigh ghaDhindhughòLvArAgha; ivaன aghghiனiyiனiனRu dhabhbhuvighghabhbhaDhDha ghòLLi allavA èனRAr.
yojhuvAvovèனil azhughghu vasdhiraM dharidhdhavaனAydh dhUdhaனughghu muனbhAgha niனRirundhAன.

avar dhamaghghu muனbhAgha niRghiRavarghaLai noghghi: ivaனmel irughghiRa azhughghu vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghaLaindhubhoDhu~NghaL èனRAr; bhiனbhu avaனai noghghi: bhAr nAன uன aghghiramadhdhai uனனilirundhu nI~Nghajhjhèydhu, uனghghujh jhiRandha vasdhira~NghaLaidh dharibhbhidhdheன èனRAr.

avaன jhirajhiனmel jhudhdhamAன bhAghaiyai vaibhbhArghaLAgha èனRAr; abhbhòzhudhu jhudhdhamAன bhAghaiyai avaன jhirajhiனmel vaidhdhu, avaனughghu vasdhira~NghaLaidh dharibhbhidhdhArghaL. ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன a~Nghe niனRAr.
ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன yojhuvAvughghujh jhADhjhiyAgha:

jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl: nI èன vazhighaLil naDhandhu èன ghAvalaigh ghAdhdhAl, nI èன Alayadhdhil niyAyaM vijhAribhbhAy; èன bhirAghAra~NghaLaiyuM ghAvalghAbhbhAy; i~Nghe niRghiRavarghaLughghuLLe ulAvughiRadhaRghu iDhaM nAன uனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuveன.

ibhbhodhuM, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனAghiya yojhuvAve, nI gheL; uனghghu muனbhAgha uDhghArndhirughghiRa uன dhozharuM gheDhghaghghaDhavarghaL; ivarghaL aDhaiyALamAyirughghiRa bhuruShar; idho, ghiLai èனனbhbhaDhDhavarAghiya èன dhAjhaனai nAன varabhbhaNNuveன.

idho, nAன yojhuvAvughghu muனbhAgha vaidhdha ghal; indha òre ghalliனmel ezhu ghaNghaLuM vaighghabhbhaDhDhirughghiRadhu; idho, nAன adhiன jhidhdhiravelaiyai niRaiveRRi indhadhejhadhdhil aghghiramadhdhai òrenALile nIghghibhbhoDhuveன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
annALile nI~NghaL òruvaraiyòruvar dhirADhjhajhjhèDhiyiன ghIzhuM adhdhimaradhdhiனghIzhuM varavazhaibhbhIrghaL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAr.
èனனoDhe bhejhiன dhUdhaன dhiruMbhivandhu nidhdhirai bhaNNughiRa òruvaனai èzhubhbhuvadhubhol èனனai èzhubhbhi:

nI ghANghiRadhu èனனvèனRu gheDhDhAr; adhaRghu nAன: idho, muzhuvadhuM bhòனனiனAl jhèyyabhbhaDhDha ghudhdhuviLaghghaigh ghANghiReன; adhiன ujhjhiyil adhiன ghiNNamuM, adhiனmel adhiன ezhu aghalghaLuM adhiன ujhjhiyil irughghiRa aghalghaLughghubhbhoghiRa ezhu ghuzhAyghaLuM irughghiRadhu.
adhiன arughil ghiNNadhdhiRghu valadhubhuRamAgha òனRuM, adhaRghu iDhadhubhuRamAgha òனRuM, Agha iraNDhu òlivamara~NghaL irughghiRadhu èனReன.
nAன èனனoDhe bhejhiன dhUdhaனai noghghi: ANDhavaனe, ivaighaL èனனvèனRu gheDhDheன.
èனனoDhe bhejhiன dhUdhaன maRumòzhiyAgha: ivaighaL iனனdhèனRu uனghghudh dhèriyAdhA èனRAr; ANDhavaனe, èனghghudh dhèriyAdhu èனReன.

abhbhòzhudhu avar: jhèrubhAbhelughghujh jhòllabhbhaDhughiRa ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனனvèனRAl, bhaladhdhiனAluM alla, bharAghghiramadhdhiனAluM alla, èனனuDhaiya AviyiனAleye AghuM èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

bhèriya bharvadhame nI èMmAdhdhiraM? jhèrubhAbhelughghu muனbhAgha nI jhamabhUmiyAvAy; dhalaighghallai avaன ghòNDhuvaruvAன; adhaRghugh ghirubhaiyuNDhAvadhAgha, ghirubhaiyuNDhAvadhAgha èனRu ArbhbharibhbhArghaL èனRAr.
bhiனனuM ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:
jhèrubhAbheliன ghaighaL indha Alayadhdhughghu asdhibhAraMbhoDhDhadhu; avaன ghaighaLe idhai muDhidhdhudh dhIrghghuM; adhiனAl jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar èனனai u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiனArèனRu aRivAy.

aRbhamAன AraMbhadhdhiன nALai yAr ajhaDhDhaibhaNNalAM? bhUmiyè~NghuM jhuRRibhbhArghghiRavaighaLAghiya ghardhdharuDhaiya ezhu ghaNghaLuM jhèrubhAbheliன ghaiyil irughghiRa dhUghghunUlaijh jhandhoShamAybh bhArghghiRadhu èனRAr.
bhiனbhu nAன avarai noghghi: ghudhdhuviLaghghughghu valadhubhuRamAghavuM adhaRghu iDhadhubhuRamAghavuM irughghiRa indha iraNDhu òlivamara~NghaL èனனvèனRu gheDhDheன.

maRubhaDhiyuM nAன avarai noghghi iraNDhu bhòRghuzhAyghaLiன vazhiyAydh dhòDha~Nghi bhòனனiRamAன èNNèyaidh dha~NghaLilirundhu iRa~NghabhbhaNNughiRavaighaLAghiya òlivamara~NghaLiன iraNDhu ghiLaighaL èனனvèனRu gheDhDheன.
adhaRghu avar: ivaighaL iனனdhèனRu uனghghudh dhèriyAdhA èனRAr; ANDhavaனe, èனghghudh dhèriyAdhu èனReன.
abhbhòzhudhu avar; ivaighaL iraNDhuM jharvaloghadhdhughghuM ANDhavarAyirughghiRavariன jhamughadhdhil niRghiRa abhiSheghaM bhèRRavarghaL èனRAr.
nAன dhiruMbhavuM èன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhubh bhArghghaiyil, idho, bhaRaghghiRa òru bhusdhaghajhjhuruLaigh ghaNDheன.
dhUdhaன; nI ghANghiRadhu èனனvèனRu gheDhDhAr; bhaRaghghiRa òru bhusdhaghajhjhuruLaigh ghANghiReன, adhiன nILaM irubhadhu muzhamuM adhiன aghalaM bhadhdhumuzhamumAyirughghiRadhu èனReன.

abhbhòzhudhu avar: idhu bhUmiyiனmIdhè~NghuM bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoghiRa jhAbhaM; èndhadh dhiruDhaனuM adhiன òru bhuRadhdhilirughghiRadhiனbhaDhiye azhighghabhbhaDhDhubhbhovAன; ANaiyiDhughiRa èvaனuM, adhiன maRubhuRadhdhil irughghiRadhiனbhaDhiye azhighghabhbhaDhDhubhbhovAன.

adhu dhiruDhaன vIDhDhiluM, èன nAmadhdhaighghòNDhu bhòyyANaiyiDhughiRavaன vIDhDhiluM vandhu, avaனvaனvIDhDhiன naDhuvile dha~Nghi, adhai adhiன mara~NghaLoDhuM adhiன ghallughaLoDhu~NghUDha nirmUlamAghghuMbhaDhi adhaibh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoghabhbhaNNuveன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr èனRAr.
bhiனbhu èனனoDhe bhejhiன dhUdhaன vèLiye vandhu èனனai noghghi: nI uன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvarughiRadhai èனனvèனRu bhAr èனRAr.
adhu èனனvèனRu gheDhDheன; adhaRghu avar: adhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvarughiRadhAghiya òru maraghghAl èனRAr. bhiனனuM avar bhUmiyè~NghuM idhudhAன avarghaLuDhaiya ghaNNoghghaM èனRAr.
idho òru dhAlandhu niRaiyAன IyamUDhi dhUghghivarabhbhaDhDhadhu; maraghghAliன naDhuvile òru sdhirI uDhghArndhirundhAL.
abhbhòzhudhu avar: ivaL aghghiramaghghAri èனRu jhòlli, avaLai maraghghAlughghuLLe dhaLLi IyaghghaDhDhiyai adhiன vAyile bhoDhDhAr.

abhbhòzhudhu nAன èன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhu, idho, bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvarughiRa iraNDhu sdhirIghaLaigh ghaNDheன; avarghaLughghu nAraiyiன jhèDhDhaighaLughghòdhdha jhèDhDhaighaL irundhadhu; avarghaL jhèDhDhaighaLil ghARRirundhadhu; ivarghaL maraghghAlai bhUmighghuM vAனdhdhughghuM naDhuvAydh dhUghghighghòNDhu bhoனArghaL.
nAன èனனoDhe bhejhiன dhUdhaனai noghghi: ivarghaL maraghghAlai è~Nghe ghòNDhubhoghiRArghaL èனRu gheDhDheன.
adhaRghu avar jhinèyAr dhejhadhdhile adhaRghu òru vIDhDhaigh ghaDhDhuMbhaDhighghu adhaigh ghòNDhubhoghiRArghaL; a~Nghe adhu sdhAbhighghabhbhaDhDhu, dhaன nilaiyile vaighghabhbhaDhuM èனRAr.

nAன dhiruMbhavuM èன ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhu idho, iraNDhu bharvadha~NghaLiன naDhuvAghabh bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvarughiRa nAlu iradha~NghaLaigh ghaNDheன; andhabh bharvadha~NghaL vèNghalabh bharvadha~NghaLAyirundhaன.
mudhalAM iradhadhdhil jhivabhbhughghudhiraighaLuM, iraNDhAM iradhadhdhil ghaRubhbhugh ghudhiraighaLuM,
mUனRAM iradhadhdhil vèLLaighghudhiraighaLuM, nAனghAM iradhadhdhil bhuLLibhuLLiyAன jhivabhbhughghudhiraighaLuM bhUDhDhiyirundhaன.
nAன èனனoDhe bhejhiன dhUdhaனai noghghi ANDhavaனe, ivaighaL èனனvèனRu gheDhDheன.
andhadh dhUdhaன èனghghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: ivaighaL jharvaloghadhdhughghuM ANDhavarAyirughghiRavaruDhaiya jhamughadhdhil niனRu bhuRabhbhaDhughiRa vAனdhdhiனuDhaiya nAlu AvighaL èனRAr.

òனRil bhUDhDhabhbhaDhDhirundha ghaRubhbhughghudhiraighaL vaDhadhejhadhdhughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoyiன; vèNmaiyAன ghudhiraighaL avaighaLiன bhiனனAle bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoyiன; bhuLLi bhuLLiyAன ghudhiraighaL dhèனdhejhadhdhughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoyiன.

jhivabhbhugh ghudhiraighaLovèனRAl bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, bhUmiyile jhuRRidhdhiriyuMbhaDhi gheDhDhughghòNDhaன; adhaRghu avar: bhoy bhUmiyil jhuRRidhdhiriyu~NghaL èனRAr; abhbhaDhiye bhUmiyile jhuRRidhdhirindhaன.
bhiனbhu avar èனனaigh ghUbhbhiDhDhu; bhAr, vaDhadhejhadhdhughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனvaighaL, vaDhadhejhadhdhile èன ghobhadhdhaijh jhAndhibhaNNiRRu èனRu èனனoDhe jhòனனAr.

jhiRaiyirubhbhiன maனuSharAghiya èldhAyuM, dhòbhiyAvuM, yèdhAyAvuM bhAbhiloனilirundhu vandhirughghuM annALile nI bhoy, jhèbhbhaனiyAviன ghumAraனAghiya yojhiyAviன vIDhDhughghuL bhiravejhidhdhu,
a~Nghe avarghaL ghaiyile vèLLiyaiyuM bhòனனaiyuM vA~Nghi, ghirIDha~NghaLaijh jhèyvidhdhu yodhjhadhAghghiன ghumAraனAghiya yojhuvA èனனuM bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனuDhaiya jhirajhile vaidhdhu,

dhUradhdhiluLLavarghaL vandhu ghardhdharuDhaiya AlayadhdhaighghUDha irundhu ghaDhDhuvArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar èனனai u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiனArèனRu aRindhughòLvIrghaL; nI~NghaL u~NghaL dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariன jhadhdhadhdhaighgheDhDhu naDhandhIrghaLAனAl idhu niRaiveRuM èனRu jhòl èனRAr.

nA~NghaL idhdhaனai varuShaMvaraiyile jhèydhadhubhola aindhAM mAdhadhdhile azhudhu òDhughghadhdhilirughghaveNDhumo èனRu jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhariன AlayadhdhilirughghuM AjhAriyariDhadhdhiluM dhIrghghadharijhighaLiDhadhdhiluM gheDhghavuM, jharedhjheruM règhèMmèleghuM avaனuDhaiya maனuSharuM dhevaனuDhaiya Alayadhdhughghu aனubhbhabhbhaDhDhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhariன vArdhdhai èனghghu uNDhAghi, avar:

nI dhejhadhdhiன èllA jaனdhdhoDhuM AjhAriyarghaLoDhuM jhòllaveNDhiyadhu èனனvèனRAl, nI~NghaL indha èzhubhadhu varuShamAgha aindhAM mAdhadhdhiluM ezhAM mAdhadhdhiluM ubhAvAjhaMbhaNNi dhughgha~NghòNDhADhiனbhodhu nI~NghaL èனghghèனRudhAனA ubhavAjhaMbhaNNiனIrghaL.
nI~NghaL bhujhighghiRabhodhuM ghuDhighghiRabhodhuM u~NghaLughghèனRallavA bhujhighghiRIrghaL? u~NghaLughghèனRallavA ghuDhighghiRIrghaL?

èrujhalemuM adhaijh jhuRRilumirundha bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLuM ghuDhiniRaindhu jhughamAyirundhaghAladhdhiluM, dhèRghunADhuM jhamabhUmiyuM ghuDhiyeRiyirundha ghAladhdhiluM muனனirundha dhIrghghadharijhighaLaighghòNDhu ghardhdhar ghURiன vArdhdhaighaL ivaighaL allavo èனRu jhòl èனRAr.
bhiனbhu ghardhdharuDhaiya vArdhdhai jhaghariyAvughghu uNDhAghi, avar:
jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar uraighghiRadhu èனனvèனRAl, nI~NghaL uNmaiyAy niyAyandhIrdhdhu, avaனvaன dhaனdhaன jhaghodharaனughghudh dhayavuM iraghghamuM jhèydhu,

vidhavaiyaiyuM dhighghaRRa bhiLLaiyaiyuM bharadhejhiyaiyuM jhiRumaiyAனvaனaiyuM òDhughghAmaluM, u~NghaLil òruvaனuM dhaன jhaghodharaனughghu virodhamAydh dhaன irudhayadhdhil dhI~Nghu niனaiyAmaluM iru~NghaL èனRAr.
avarghaLo ghavaனighgha maனdhillAmal dha~NghaL dhoLai muraDhDhudhdhaனmAy vilaghghi, gheLAdhabhaDhighghudh dha~NghaLjhèvighaLai aDhaidhdhughghòNDhArghaL.

vedhadhdhaiyuM jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar dhaMmuDhaiya Aviyiன mUlamAy mundhiன dhIrghghadharijhighaLaighghòNDhu jhòlliyaனubhbhiன vArdhdhaighaLaiyuM gheLAdhabhaDhighghudh dha~NghaL irudhayadhdhai vairAghghiyamAghghiனArghaL; AghaiyAl maghA ghaDhu~NghobhaM jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhariDhadhdhilirundhu uNDhAyiRRu.
AdhalAl nAன ghUbhbhiDhDhabhodhu, avarghaL èbhbhaDhi gheLAmaRbhoனArghaLo abhbhaDhiye avarghaL ghUbhbhiDhDhabhodhu nAனuM gheLAmalirundheனèனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

avarghaL aRiyAdha bhuRajAdhighaLughghuLLe avarghaLaibh bhaRaghghaDhidhdheன; adhiனAl avarghaL bhiனvaidhdhubhbhoன dhejhaM bhoghghuvaradhdhillAmal bhAzhAybhbhoyiRRu; avarghaLiன iனbhamAன dhejhadhdhaibh bhAzhAybhbhoghabh bhaNNiனArghaL èனRAr.
jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhariன vArdhdhai uNDhAghi avar:
nAன jhIyoனughghAgha ghaDhuM vairAghghiya~NghòNDheன; adhaRghAgha maghA ughghiramAன vairAghghiya~NghòNDheன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

nAன jhIyoனiDhadhdhil dhiruMbhi, èrujhalemiன naDhuvile vAjhaMbhaNNuveன; èrujhaleM jhadhdhiya nagharaM èனRuM, jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhariன bharvadhaM bharijhudhdha bharvadhaM èனRuM azhaighghabhbhaDhuM èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
dhiruMbhavuM èrujhalemiன vIdhighaLil mudhirvayadhiனAle dha~NghaL ghaighaLil gholaibhbhiDhidhdhu naDhaghghiRa ghizhavaruM ghizhavighaLuM ghuDhiyirubhbhArghaL.
nagharadhdhiன dhèrughghaLile viLaiyADhughiRa ANbhiLLaighaLuM bhèNbhiLLaighaLuM adhiன vIdhighaLil niRaindhirughghuM èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

innADhghaLughghu muனனe maனuShaனuDhaiya velaiyAl bhalaனumillai, mirughajIvaனuDhaiya velaiyAl bhalaனumillai; bhoghiRavaனughghuM varughiRavaனughghuM nèrughghiDhaiyiனimidhdhaM jhamAdhAனmumillai; èllA maனuSharaiyuM òruvaraiyòruvar virodhighghajhjhèydheன.

uனghghu nAன jhèyvadhèனனvèனRAl, dhaNNIrillAdha ghuzhiyile aDhaibhaDhDhaߠΰughghiRa uனனuDhaiyavarghaLai nAன uன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyiன iradhdhadhĠοனAle viDhudhalaibhaNNuveன.
naMbhighghaiyuDhaiya jhiRaighaLe, araNughghudh dhiruMbhu~NghaL; iraDhDhibhbhAன naனmaiyaidh dharuveன, iனRaighghe dharuveன.

idhu èghibhdhiyaruDhaiya bhAvadhdhughghuM ghUDhArabhbhaNDhighaiyai Ajharighgha varAdha jhaghala jAdhighaLuDhaiya bhAvadhdhughghuM varuM Aghghiனai.

annALile ghudhiraighaLiன maNighaLile ghardhdharughghubh bharijhudhdhaM èனனuM vilAjhaM èzhudhiyirughghuM; ghardhdharuDhaiya AlayadhdhiluLLa bhAனaighaL bhalibhIDhadhdhughghu muனbhAgha irughghiRa bhAdhdhira~NghaLaibh bholirughghuM.

abhbhòzhudhu èrujhalemiluM yUdhAvilumuLLa èllAbh bhAனaighaLuM jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharughghubh bharijhudhdhamAyirughghuM; bhaliyiDhughiRa yAvaruM vandhu avaighaLil èDhudhdhu, avaighaLil jhamaibhbhArghaL; annALmudhal jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhariன Alayadhdhile yAdhòru ghAனAனiyaனuM irubhbhadhillai.
malghiyAvaighghòNDhu ghardhdhar isravelughghujh jhòனன vArdhdhaiyiன bhAraM.

nAன u~NghaLaijh jhineghidhdheனèனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; adhaRghu nI~NghaL: è~NghaLai èbhbhaDhijh jhineghidhdhIr èனghiRIrghaL; ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr: ejhA yAghghobhughghujh jhaghodharaனllavo? AghiluM yAghghobhai nAன jhineghidhdheன.
ejhAvaiyo nAன vèRudhdheன; avaனuDhaiya malaighaLaibh bhAzhuM avaனuDhaiya jhudhandharadhdhai vaனAndharadhdhiluLLa valujharbhbha~NghaLiன dhAvuM Aghghiனeன.

edhomiyar: nAM èLimaibhbhaDhDhoM: AனAluM bhAzhAனvaighaLaidh dhiruMbhagh ghaDhDhuvoM èனRu jhòllughiRArghaL; adhaRghugh ghardhdhar: avarghaL ghaDhDhuvArghaL, nAன iDhibhbheன. avarghaL dhuனmArghghadhdhiன èllaiyèனRuM, ghardhdhar èனRaighghuM jhiனMvaighghiRa jaனmèனRuM jhòllabhbhaDhuvArghaL èனghiRAr.
idhai u~NghaL ghaNghaL ghANuM. abhbhòzhudhu nI~NghaL: ghardhdhar israveluDhaiya èllai dhuvaghghi maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhabhbhaDhuvAr èனbhIrghaL.

ghumAraன dhaன bhidhAvaiyuM, UzhiyaghghAraன dhaன èjamAனaiyuM ghaனMbhaNNughiRArghaLe; nAன bhidhAvAனAl èன ghaனM è~Nghe? nAன èjamAனAனAl èனghghubh bhayabhbhaDhuM bhayaM è~Nghe èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar dhamadhu nAmadhdhai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNughiRa AjhAriyarghaLAghiya u~NghaLaigh gheDhghiRAr; adhaRghu nI~NghaL umadhu nAmadhdhai èdhiனAle ajhaDhDhaibhaNNiனoM èனghiRIrghaL.

èன bhIDhadhdhiனmel ajhudhdhamAன abhbhadhdhaibh bhaDhaighghiRadhiனAleye; AனAluM uMmai èdhiனAle ajhudhdhabhbhaDhudhiனoM èனghiRIrghaL; ghardhdharuDhaiya bhandhi èNNamaRRubhbhoyiRRèனRu, nI~NghaL jhòllughiRadhiனAleye.

nI~NghaL ghaN UனmAனdhaibh bhaliyiDhaghghòNDhuvandhAluM adhu bhòllAbhbhalla, nI~NghaL ghAluUனmAனdhaiyuM najhal bhiDhidhdhadhaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhAluM adhu bhòllAbhbhalla èனghiRIrghaLe; adhai nI uன adhibhadhighghujh jhèludhdhu avaன uனmel bhiriyamAyirubhbhAனo? uன mughadhdhaibh bhArbhbhAனo èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar gheDhghiRAr.

ibhbhodhuM dhevaனuDhaiya jhamughadhdhai noghghigh ghè~njhu~NghaL; abhbhòzhudhu naMmel ira~NghuvAr; idhu u~NghaLAle vandha ghAriyaM, avar u~NghaLai a~NghIgharibhbhAro èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar gheDhghiRAr.

u~NghaLil èvaன ghUliyillAmal ghadhavughaLaibh bhUDhDhuvAன; èன bhalibhIDhadhdhiனmel aghghiனiyaigh ghUliyillAmal ghòLudhdhavumADhDhIrghaL, u~NghaLbheril èனghghubh bhiriyamillaiyèனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; u~NghaL ghaighaLiluLLa ghANighghai èனghghu ughandhadhalla.

jhUriyaன udhighghiRa dhijhaidhòDha~Nghi, adhu asdhamighghiRa dhijhaivaraighghuM, èன nAmaM jAdhighaLughghuLLe maghadhdhuvamAyirughghuM; èllA iDha~NghaLiluM èன nAmadhdhughghudh dhUbhamuM jhudhdhamAன ghANighghaiyuM jhèludhdhabhbhaDhuM; èன nAmaM jAdhighaLughghuLLe maghadhdhuvamAyirughghuM èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
nI~NghaLo ghardhdharuDhaiya bhandhi ajhudhdhamAனdhu èனRuM adhiன AghAramAghiya adhiன bhalaன aRbhamAனdhu èனRuM jhòllughiRadhiனAle, èன nAmadhdhaibh bharijhudhdhaghghulaijhjhalAghghughiRIrghaL.

idho, idhu èvvaLavu varudhdhamèனRu jhòlli, adhai òru dhiraNamAybh bhejhi, bhIRuNDhadhaiyuM ghAl UனmAனdhaiyuM najhalghòNDhadhaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhu ghANighghaiyAghajh jhèludhdhughiRIrghaL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; adhai u~NghaL ghaighaLil a~NghIgharidhdhughghòLveனA èனRu ghardhdhar gheDhghiRAr.

dhaன mandhaiyil ghaDhA irughghaiyil ghèDhDhubhbhoனdhai ANDhavarughghu nerndhughòNDhu bhaliyiDhughiRa ghabhaDhasdhaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaன; èன nAmaM jAdhighaLughghuLLe bhaya~NgharamAyirughghuM; nAன maghadhdhuvamAன rAjA èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
ibhbhodhuM AjhAriyarghaLe indhagh ghaDhDhaLai u~NghaLughghuriyadhu.

nI~NghaL gheLAmaluM èன nAmadhdhughghu maghimaiyaijh jhèludhdhuMbhaDhi idhaijh jhindhiyAmalumirundhAl, nAன u~NghaLughghuLLe jhAbhadhdhai aனubhbhi, u~NghaL AjhIrvAdha~NghaLaiyuM jhAbhamAghghuveன; AM, nI~NghaL adhaijh jhindhiyAmaRbhoனdhiனAl avaighaLaijh jhabhidhdheன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
idho, nAன u~NghaLuDhaiya bhayiraigh ghèDhudhdhu, u~NghaL bhaNDhighaighaLiன jhANiyaiye u~NghaL mugha~NghaLil iRaibhbheன; adhaனoDhughUDha nI~NghaLuM dhaLLubhaDhiyAvIrghaL.

leviyoraDhebhaNNiன èன uDhaனbhaDhighghai nilaidhdhirughghuMbhaDhighghu indhagh ghaDhDhaLaiyai u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiனeன èனghiRadhai abhbhòzhudhu aRindhughòLvIrghaL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

avaனoDhe bhaNNiன èன uDhaனbhaDhighghai jIvaனuM jhamAdhAனmumAgha irundhadhu; avaன èனghghubh bhayabhbhaDhuM bhayadhdhoDhe irughghaveNDhumèனRu, ivaighaLai avaனughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDheன; abhbhaDhiye avaன èன nAmadhdhughghubh bhayandhuM irundhAன.

jhadhdhiyavedhaM avaன vAyilirundhadhu; avaனuDhaiya udhaDhughaLil aniyAyaM ghANabhbhaDhavillai; avaன èனனoDhe jhamAdhAனmuM yadhArdhdhamumAyjh jha~njharidhdhu, anegharai aghghiramadhdhiனiனRu dhirubhbhiனAன.
AjhAriyaனuDhaiya udhaDhughaL aRivaigh ghAghghaveNDhuM; vedhadhdhai avaன vAyile dheDhuvArghaLe; avaன jheனaighaLuDhaiya ghardhdhariன dhUdhaன.
nI~NghaLo vazhiyaiviDhDhu vilaghi, anegharai vedhadhdhaighghuRidhdhu iDhaRabhbhaNNiனIrghaL; leviyiன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyaigh ghèDhudhdhubhbhoDhDhIrghaL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
nI~NghaL èன vazhighaLaigh ghaighghòLLAmal vedhadhdhaighghuRidhdhubh bhaDhjhabhAdhaM bhaNNiனbhaDhiyiனAl nAனuM u~NghaLai èllA jaனdhdhughghu muனbhAghavuM aRbharuM nIjharumAghghiனeன.

naMmèllArughghuM òre bhidhA illaiyo? òre dhevaன naMmaijh jhiruShDhidhdhadhillaiyo? nAM naMmuDhaiya bhidhAghghaLiன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyaibh bharijhudhdhaghghulaijhjhalAghghi, avaனvaன dhaனdhaன jhaghodharaனughghudh dhuroghaMbhaNNuvAனeன?

yUdhA jaன~NghaL dhuroghaMbhaNNiனArghaL; israveliluM èrujhalemiluM aruvarubhbhAன ghAriyaM jhèyyabhbhaDhDhadhu; ghardhdhar jhineghighghiRa bharijhudhdhadhdhai yUdhA jaன~NghaL bharijhudhdhaghghulaijhjhalAghghi anniya dhevadhaiyiன ghumAradhdhighaLai vivAghaM bhaNNiனArghaL.

ibhbhaDhijh jhèyghiRavaன èvaனo, avaன ghAvalghAghghiRavaனAyiனuM udhdharavughòDhughiRavaனAyiனuM jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharughghugh ghANighghai jhèludhdhughiRavaனAyiனuM, avaனai yAghghobhiன ghUDhAra~NghaLil irAdhabhaDhighghugh ghardhdhar jha~NgharibhbhAr.

nI~NghaL iraNDhAndharamuM idhaijh jhèydhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya bhIDhadhdhaigh ghaNNIriனAluM azhughaiyiனAluM bhèrumUjhjhiனAluM nirabhbhughiRIrghaL; AghaiyAl, avar iனigh ghANighghaiyai madhiyAr, adhai u~NghaL ghaighaLil bhiriyamAy eRRughghòLLavumADhDhAr.
eன èனRu gheDhghiRIrghaL; ghardhdhar uனghghuM uன iLavayadhiன maனaivighghuM jhADhjhiyAyirughghiRAr; uனdhozhiyuM uன uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyiன maனaiviyumAghiya avaLughghu nI dhuroghaMbhaNNiனAye.

avar òruvaனaiyallavA bhaDhaidhdhAr? Avi avariDhadhdhil bharibhUraNamAyirundhadhe. bhiனனai eன òruvaனaibhbhaDhaidhdhAr? dhevabhaghdhiyuLLa, jhandhadhiyaibh bhèRuMbhaDhidhAனe. AghaiyAl òruvaனuM dhaன iLavayadhiன maனaivighghudh dhuroghaMbhaNNAdhabhaDhighghu, u~NghaL AviyaighghuRidhdhu èjhjharighghaiyAyiru~NghaL.

dhaLLiviDhudhalai nAன vèRughghiReன͠èனRu israveliன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavaன ghòDhumaiyiனAl dhaன vasdhiradhdhai mUDhughiRAன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; AghaiyAl nI~NghaL dhuroghaMbhaNNAmal u~NghaL AviyaighghuRidhdhu èjhjharighghaiyAyiru~NghaL.

u~NghaL vArdhdhaighaLiனAle ghardhdharai varudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhughiRIrghaL; AனAluM èdhiனAle avarai varudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhughiRoM èனghiRIrghaL; bhòllAbhbhaijh jhèyghiRavaனèvaனuM ghardhdhariன bhArvaighghu nallavaன èனRuM abhbhaDhibhbhaDhvarghaLbheril avar bhiriyamAyirughghiRArèனRuM, niyAyandhIrghghiRa dhevaன è~NgheyèனRuM, nI~NghaL jhòllughiRadhiனAleye.

idho nAன èன dhUdhaனai aனubhbhughiReன, avaன èனghghu muனbhAghabh bhoy, vazhiyai AyadhdhaMbhaNNuvAன; abhbhòzhudhu nI~NghaL dheDhughiRa ANDhavaruM nI~NghaL viruMbhughiRa uDhaனbhaDhighghaiyiன dhUdhaனumAனvar dhaMmuDhaiya Alayadhdhughghudh dhIviramAy varuvAr; idho, varughiRAr èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
AனAluM avar varuM nALai jhaghibhbhavaன yAr? avar vèLibhbhaDhughaiyil nilainiRbhavaன yAr? avar bhuDhamiDhughiRavaனuDhaiya aghghiனiyaibhbholavuM, vaNNAruDhaiya jhavughghAradhdhaibhbholavuM irubhbhAr.

avar uDhghArndhu vèLLiyaibh bhuDhamiDhDhujh jhudhdhigharidhdhughghòNDhirubhbhAr; avar leviyiன bhudhdhiraraijh jhudhdhigharidhdhu, avarghaL ghardhdharuDhaiyavarghaLAyirughghuMbhaDhighghuM, nIdhiyAy ghANighghaiyaijh jhèludhdhuMbhaDhighghuM, avarghaLaibh bhòனனaibhbholavuM vèLLiyaibhbholavuM bhuDhamiDhuvAr.
abhbhòzhudhu bhUrvanADhghaLiluM mundhiன varuSha~NghaLiluM irundhadhubhola, yUdhAviன ghANighghaiyuM èrujhalemiன ghANighghaiyuM ghardhdharughghubh bhiriyamAyirughghuM.

nAன niyAyadhdhIrbhbhu jhèyyuMbhaDhi u~NghaLiDhadhdhil vandhu, jhUனiyaghghArarughghuM vibhajhArarughghuM bhòyyANai iDhughiRavarghaLughghuM èனghghubh bhayabhbhaDhAmal vidhavaighaLuM dhighghaRRa bhiLLaighaLumAghiya ghUlighghArariன ghUliyai abhagharidhdhughghòLLughiRavarghaLughghuM, bharadhejhighghu aniyAya~njhèyghiRavarghaLughghuM virodhamAydh dhIviramAன jhADhjhiyAyirubhbheன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
nAன ghardhdhar nAன mARAdhavar; AghaiyAl yAghghobhiன bhudhdhirarAghiya nI~NghaL nirmUlamAghavillai.

nI~NghaL u~NghaL bhidhAghghaLiன nADhghaL dhòDha~Nghi èன ghaDhDhaLaighaLaigh ghaighghòLLAmal, avaighaLaiviDhDhu vilaghibhbhoனIrghaL; èனனiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhuveன èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; nA~NghaL èndha viShayadhdhil dhiruMbhaveNDhuM èனghiRIrghaL,
maனuShaன dhevaனai va~njhighghalAmA? nI~NghaLo èனனai va~njhighghiRIrghaL. èdhile uMmai va~njhidhdhoM èனghiRIrghaL. dhajhamabhAghadhdhiluM ghANighghaighaLilundhAனe.
nI~NghaL jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaL; jaனdhdhArAghiya nI~NghaL èllAruM èனனai va~njhidhdhIrghaL.

èன Alayadhdhil AghAraM uNDhAyirughghuMbhaDhidh dhajhamabhAgha~NghaLaiyèllAM bhaNDhajhAlaiyile ghòNDhuvAru~NghaL; abhbhòzhudhu nAன vAனdhdhiன bhalaghaNighaLaidh dhiRandhu, iDha~NghòLLAmaRbhoghumaDhDhuM u~NghaLmel AjhIrvAdhadhdhai varuShighghamADhDheனovèனRu adhiனAl èனனaijh jhodhidhdhubh bhAru~NghaL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

bhUmiyiன ghaனiyaibh bhaDhjhidhdhubh bhoDhughiRavaighaLai u~NghaL nimidhdhaMghaNDhibhbheன; avaighaL u~NghaL niladhdhiன bhalaனai azhibhbhadhillai. vèLiyiluLLa dhirADhjhaghghòDhi bhazhamillAmaRbhovadhumillai èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu èllA jAdhighaLuM u~NghaLaibh bhAghghiyavAனghaL èனbhArghaL; dhejhaM viruMbhabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhAyirughghuM èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
nI~NghaL èனghghu virodhamAybh bhejhiன bhejhjhughaL ghaDhiனmAyirughghiRadhu èனRu ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; AனAluM umaghghu virodhamAgha èனனdhdhaibh bhejhiனoM èனghiRIrghaL.
dhevaனaijh jhevibhbhadhu virudhA, avaruDhaiya ghaDhDhaLaighaLaigh ghaighghòLLughiRadhiனAluM jheனaighaLiன ghardhdharughghu muனbhAghadh dhughghidhdhu naDhaghghiRadhiனAluM èனன bhirayojaனM?

ibhbhodhuM agha~NghArighaLaibh bhAghghiyavAனghaL èனghiRoM; dhImaijhèyghiRavarghaL dhiDhabhbhaDhughiRArghaL; avarghaL dhevaனaibh bharIDhjhaibhArdhdhAluM viDhuvighghabhbhaDhughiRArghaLe èனRu jhòllughiRIrghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu ghardhdharughghubh bhayandhavarghaL òruvaroDhòruvar bhejhighghòLvArghaL; ghardhdhar ghavaனidhdhughgheDhbhAr; ghardhdharughghubh bhayandhavarghaLughghAghavuM avaruDhaiya nAmadhdhaidh dhiyAனighghiRavarghaLughghAghavuM ~nAbhaghabhbhusdhaghaM òனRu avarughghu muனbhAgha èzhudhabhbhaDhDhirughghiRadhu.

èன jhaMbhadhdhai nAன jherghghuM annALile avarghaL èனனuDhaiyavarghaLAyirubhbhArghaL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr; òru maனuShaன dhaனghghu Uzhiya~njhèyghiRa dhaனனuDhaiya ghumAraனaigh ghaDhADhjhighghiRadhubhola nAன avarghaLaigh ghaDhADhjhibhbheன.
abhbhòzhudhu nI~NghaL nIdhimAனughghuM dhuனmArghghaனughghuM, dhevaனughghuM Uzhiya~njhèyghiRavaனughghuM avarughghu Uzhiya~njhèyyAdhavaனughghuM irughghiRa vidhdhiyAjhadhdhaidh dhiruMbhavuM ghANbhIrghaL.

idho, jhULaiyaibhbhola èrighiRanAL varuM; abhbhòzhudhu agha~NghArighaL yAvaruM aghghirama~njhèyghiRa yAvaruM dhuruMbhAyirubhbhArghaL; varabhbhoghiRa andha nAL avarghaLaijh jhuDhDhèrighghuM; adhu avarghaLughghu veraiyuM ghòbhbhaiyuM vaighghAmaRbhoghuM èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.

AனAluM èன nAmadhdhughghubh bhayandhirughghiRa u~NghaLmel nIdhiyiன jhUriyaன udhighghuM; adhiன jhèDhDhaighaLiனghIzh AroghghiyaM irughghuM; nI~NghaL vèLiye bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, ghòzhudhdha ghaனRughaLaibhbhola vaLaruvIrghaL.
dhuனmArghgharai midhibhbhIrghaL; nAன idhaijh jhèyyuMnALile avarghaL u~NghaL uLLa~NghAlghaLiனghIzh jhAMbhalAyirubhbhArghaL èனRu jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar jhòllughiRAr.
orebhile isravelarèllArughghAghavuM èன dhAjhaனAghiya mojheghghu nAன ghaRbhidhdha niyAyabhbhiramANamAghiya ghaDhDhaLaighaLaiyuM niyAya~NghaLaiyuM niனaiyu~NghaL.
idho, ghardhdharuDhaiya bhèridhuM bhaya~NgharamumAன nAL varughiRadhaRghumuனனe nAன u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghu èliyA dhIrghghadharijhiyai aனubhbhughiReன.

nAன vandhu bhUmiyaijh jha~NghAradhdhAl aDhighghAdhabhaDhighghu, avaன bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya irudhayadhdhaibh bhiLLaighaLiDhadhdhiRghuM, bhiLLaighaLuDhaiya irudhayadhdhai avarghaL bhidhAghghaLiDhadhdhiRghuM dhirubhbhuvAன.
AbhiraghAmiன ghumAraனAghiya dhAvIdhiன ghumAraனAன iyejhughiRisdhuviனuDhaiya vaMjha varalARu:
AbhiraghAM IjhAghghaibh bhèRRAன; IjhAghghu yAghghobhaibh bhèRRAன; yAghghobhu yUdhAvaiyuM avaன jhaghodhararaiyuM bhèRRAன;
yUdhA bhArejhaiyuM jhArAvaiyuM dhAmAriனiDhadhdhil bhèRRAன; bhAres èsromaibh bhèRRAன; èsroM ArAmaibh bhèRRAன;
ArAM aMmiனdhAbhaibh bhèRRAன; aMmiனdhAbh naghajhoனaibh bhèRRAன; naghajhoன jhalmoனaibh bhèRRAன;
jhalmoன bhovAjhai rAghAbhiனiDhadhdhil bhèRRAன; bhovAs obhedhai rUdhdhiனiDhadhdhil bhèRRAன; obhedh IjhAyaibh bhèRRAன;
IjhAy dhAvIdhu rAjAvaibh bhèRRAன; dhAvIdhu uriyAviன maனaiviyAyirundhavaLiDhadhdhil jhAlòmoனaibh bhèRRAன;
jhAlòmoன règhòbhèyAmaibh bhèRRAன; règhòbhèyAM abhiyAvaibh bhèRRAன; abhiyA AjhAvaibh bhèRRAன.
AjhA yojhabhAdhdhaibh bhèRRAன; yojhabhAdh yorAmaibh bhèRRAன; yorAM ujhiyAvaibh bhèRRAன;
ujhiyA yodhAmaibh bhèRRAன; yodhAM AghAjhaibh bhèRRAன; AghAs èjheghghiyAvaibh bhèRRAன;
èjheghghiyA maனAjheyaibh bhèRRAன; maனAjhe Amoனaibh bhèRRAன; Amoன yojhiyAvaibh bhèRRAன;
bhAbhiloனughghujh jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubh bhoghu~NghAladhdhil, yojhiyA èghòனiyAvaiyuM avaனuDhaiya jhaghodhararaiyuM bhèRRAன.
bhAbhiloனughghujh jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubh bhoனbhiனbhu, èghoனiyA jhalAdhdhiyelaibh bhèRRAன; jhalAdhdhiyel jhòròbhAbhelaibh bhèRRAன;
jhòròbhAbhel abhiyUdhaibh bhèRRAன; abhiyUdh èliyAghghImaibh bhèRRAன; èliyAghghIM Ajhoraibh bhèRRAன;
Ajhor jhAdhoghghaibh bhèRRAன; jhAdhoghghu AghImaibh bhèRRAன; AghIM èliyUdhaibh bhèRRAன;
èliyUdh èlèyAjhAraibh bhèRRAன; èlèyAjhAr mAdhdhAனaibh bhèRRAன; mAdhdhAன yAghghobhaibh bhèRRAன;
yAghghobhu mariyALuDhaiya bhuruShaனAghiya yojhebhbhai bhèRRAன; avaLiDhadhdhil ghiRisdhu èனbhbhaDhughiRa iyejhu bhiRandhAr.

ivvidhamAy uNDhAன dhalaimuRaighaLèllAM AbhiraghAM mudhal dhAvIdhu varaighghuM bhadhiனAlu dhalaimuRaighaLuM; dhAvIdhumudhal bhAbhiloனughghujh jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoன ghAlaM varaighghuM bhadhiனAlu dhalaimuRaighaLuM; bhAbhiloனughghujh jhiRaibhbhaDhDhubhbhoன ghAlamudhal ghiRisdhu varaighghuM bhadhiனAlu dhalaimuRaighaLumAM.

iyejhu ghiRisdhuviனuDhaiya jènanadhdhiன vivaramAvadhu: avaruDhaiya dhAyArAghiya mariyAL yojhebhbhughghu niyamighghabhbhaDhDhirughghaiyil, avarghaL ghUDhi varumuனனe, avaL bharijhudhdha AviyAl gharbhbhavadhiyAனAL èனRu ghANabhbhaDhDhadhu.
avaL bhuruShaனAghiya yojhebhbhu nIdhimAனAyirundhu, avaLai avamAனbhbhaDhudhdha maனdhillAmal, iraghajhiyamAy avaLaidh dhaLLiviDha yojhaனaiyAyirundhAன.

avaன ibhbhaDhijh jhindhidhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன jhòbhbhaனdhdhil avaனughghugh ghANabhbhaDhDhu: dhAvIdhiன ghumAraனAghiya yojhebhbhe, uன maனaiviyAghiya mariyALai jherdhdhughghòLLa aiyabhbhaDhAdhe; avaLiDhadhdhil uRbhadhdhiyAyirughghiRadhu bharijhudhdha AviyiனAl uNDhAனdhu.
avaL òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRuvAL, avarughghu iyejhu èனRu bheriDhuvAyAgha; eனèனil avar dhamadhu jaன~NghaLiன bhAva~NghaLai nIghghi avarghaLai iraDhjhibhbhAr èனRAன.
dhIrghghadharijhiyiன mUlamAygh ghardhdharAle uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhu niRaiveRuMbhaDhi idhèllAM naDhandhadhu.
avaன: idho, òru ghaனனighai gharbhbhavadhiyAghi òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRuvAL; avarughghu iMmAனuvel èனRu bheriDhuvArghaL èனRu jhòனனAன. iMmAனuvel èனbhadhaRghu dhevaன naMmoDhu irughghiRAr èனRu ardhdhamAM.
yojhebhbhu nidhdhirai dhèLindhu èzhundhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன dhaனghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye dhaன maனaiviyaijh jherdhdhughghòNDhu;
avaL dhaன mudhaRbheRAன ghumAraனaibh bhèRumaLavuM avaLai aRiyAdhirundhu, avarughghu iyejhu èனRu bheriDhDhAன.
erodhu rAjAviன nADhghaLil yUdheyAviluLLa bhèdhlaghemile iyejhu bhiRandhabhòzhudhu, ghizhaghghilirundhu jhAsdhirighaL èrujhalemughghu vandhu,
yUdharughghu rAjAvAghabh bhiRandhirughghiRavar è~Nghe? ghizhaghghile avaruDhaiya naDhjhadhdhiradhdhaigh ghaNDhu, avaraibh bhaNindhu ghòLLa vandhoM èனRArghaL.
erodhurAjA adhaigh gheDhDhabhòzhudhu, avaனuM avaனoDhughUDha èrujhaleM nagharadhdhAr aனaivaruM ghala~NghiனArghaL.
avaன bhiradhAன AjhAriyar jaனdhdhiன vedhabhAraghar èllAraiyuM ghUDhi varajhjhèydhu: ghiRisdhuvAனvar è~Nghe bhiRabhbhAr èனRu avarghaLiDhadhdhil vijhAridhdhAன.
adhaRghu avarghaL: yUdheyAviluLLa bhèdhlaghemile bhiRabhbhAr; adheனèனRAl:

yUdheyA dhejhadhdhiluLLa bhèdhlagheme, yUdhAviன bhirabhughghaLil nI jhiRiyadhalla; èன jaனmAghiya isravelai ALuM bhirabhu uனனiDhadhdhil irundhu bhuRabhbhaDhuvAr èனRu, dhIrghghadharijhiyiனAl èzhudhabhbhaDhDhirughghiRadhu èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu erodhu, jhAsdhirighaLai raghajhiyamAy azhaidhdhu, naDhjhadhdhiraM ghANabhbhaDhDha ghAladhdhaigh ghuRidhdhu avarghaLiDhadhdhil dhiDhDhamAy vijhAridhdhu:

nI~NghaL bhoy, bhiLLaiyaighghuRidhdhudh dhiDhDhamAy vijhAriyu~NghaL; nI~NghaL adhaigh ghaNDhabhiனbhu, nAனuM vandhu adhaibh bhaNindhu ghòLLuMbhaDhi èனghghu aRiviyu~NghaL èனRu jhòlli, avarghaLaibh bhèdhlaghemughghu aனubhbhiனAன.
rAjA jhòனனdhai avarghaL gheDhDhubh bhoghaiyil, idho, avarghaL ghizhaghghile ghaNDha naDhjhadhdhiraM bhiLLai irundha sdhaladhdhiRghumel vandhu niRghuMvaraighghuM avarghaLughghumuன jhèனRadhu.
avarghaL andha naDhjhadhdhiradhdhai ghaNDha bhodhu, mighundha Aனndha jhandhoShamaDhaindhArghaL.

avarghaL andha vIDhDhughghuL bhiravejhidhdhu, bhiLLaiyaiyuM adhiன dhAyAghiya mariyALaiyuM ghaNDhu, jhAShDhA~NghamAy vizhundhu adhaibh bhaNindhughòNDhu, dha~NghaL bhòghghiSha~NghaLaidh dhiRandhu, bhòனனaiyuM dhUbhavarghghadhdhaiyuM vèLLaibhbhoLadhdhaiyuM adhaRghugh ghANighghaiyAgha vaidhdhArghaL.
bhiனbhu, avarghaL erodhiனiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhibh bhoghaveNDhAM èனRu jhòbhbhaனdhdhil dhevaனAl èjhjharighghabhbhaDhDhu, veRu vazhiyAydh dha~NghaL dhejhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoனArghaL.

avarghaL bhoனbhiனbhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன jhòbhbhaனdhdhil yojhebhbhughghugh ghANabhbhaDhDhu: erodhu bhiLLaiyaigh ghòlaijhèyyadh dheDhuvAன; AdhalAl nI èzhundhu, bhiLLaiyaiyuM adhiன dhAyaiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu èghibhdhughghu oDhibhbhoy, nAன uனghghujh jhòlluM varaighghuM a~Ngheye iru èனRAன.
avaன èzhundhu, iravile bhiLLaiyaiyuM adhiன dhAyaiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu, èghibhdhughghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoy,

erodhiன maraNabhariyandhaM a~Nghe irundhAன. èghibhdhilirundhu èனனuDhaiya ghumAraனai varavazhaidhdheன èனRu, dhIrghghadharijhiyiன mUlamAygh ghardhdharAl uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhu niRaiveRuMbhaDhi ibhbhaDhi naDhandhadhu.

abhbhòzhudhu erodhu dhAன jhAsdhirighaLAl va~njhighghabhbhaDhDhadhaigh ghaNDhu, mighundha ghobhamaDhaindhu, ADhghaLai aனubhbhi, dhAன jhAsdhirighaLiDhadhdhil dhiDhDhamAy vijhAridhdha ghAladhdhiனbhaDhiye, bhèdhlaghemiluM adhiன jhaghala èllaighaLilumirundha iraNDhu vayadhughghuDhbhaDhDha èllA ANbhiLLaighaLaiyuM ghòlaijhèydhAன.

bhulaMbhaluM azhughaiyuM mighundha dhughgha~NghòNDhADhalumAghiya ghUghghural rAmAvile gheDhghabhbhaDhDhadhu; rAghel dhaன bhiLLaighaLughghAgha azhudhu, avaighaL illAdhabhaDhiyAl ARudhalaDhaiyAdhirughghiRAL èனRu,
èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyiனAl uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhu abhbhòzhudhu niRaiveRiRRu.
erodhu iRandhabhiனbhu, ghardhdharuDhaiya dhUdhaன èghibhdhile yojhebhbhughghu jhòbhbhaனdhdhil ghANabhbhaDhDhu:
nI èzhundhu, bhiLLaiyaiyuM adhiன dhAyaiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu isravel dhejhadhdhughghubh bho; bhiLLaiyiன bhirANaனai vA~NghadhdheDhiனvarghaL iRandhu bhoனArghaL èனRAன.
avaன èzhundhu, bhiLLaiyaiyuM adhiன dhAyaiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu isravel dhejhadhdhughghu vandhAன.

AghiluM, arghèlAyu dhaன dhaghabhbhaனAghiya erodhiன bhaDhDhadhdhughghu vandhu, yUdheyAvil arajhALughiRAன èனRu gheLvibhbhaDhDhu, a~Nghe bhoghabh bhayandhAன. abhbhòzhudhu avaன jhòbhbhaனdhdhil dhevaனAl èjhjharighghabhbhaDhDhu, ghalileyA nADhDhiன bhuRa~NghaLile vilaghibhbhoy,
nAjharedhdhu èனனuM Urile vandhu vAjhaM bhaNNiனAன. najhareyaன èனனbhbhaDhuvAr èனRu, dhIrghghadharijhighaLAl uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhu niRaiveRuMbhaDhi ibhbhaDhi naDhandhadhu.
annADhghaLil yovAனsnAனன yUdheyAviன vaனAndharadhdhil vandhu:
maனndhiruMbhu~NghaL, bharalogharAjyaM jhamIbhidhdhirughghiRadhu èனRu bhirajha~NghaM bhaNNiனAன.

ghardhdharughghu vazhiyai AyadhdhabhbhaDhudhdhu~NghaL; avarughghubh bhAdhaighaLaijh jhèvvaibhaNNu~NghaL èனRu vaனAndharadhdhil ghUbhbhiDhughiRavaனuDhaiya jhadhdhaM uNDhèனRu, ejhAyA dhIrghghadharijhiyiனAl jhòllabhbhaDhDhavaன ivaனe.
indha yovAன òDhDhaghamayir uDhaiyaidh dharidhdhu, dhaன araiyil vArghajhjhaiyaigh ghaDhDhighghòNDhirundhAன; vèDhDhughghiLiyuM ghADhDhudh dheனuM avaனughghu AghAramAyirundhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu, èrujhaleM nagharadhdhAruM, yUdheyA dhejhadhdhAr aனaivaruM, yordhAனughghu aDhudhdha jhuRRubhbhuRadhdhAr yAvaruM avaனiDhadhdhiRghubh bhoy,
dha~NghaL bhAva~NghaLai aRighghaiyiDhDhu yordhAன nadhiyil avaனAl ~nAனsnAனM bhèRRArghaL.

bharijheyariluM jhadhujheyariluM aneghar dhaனனiDhadhdhil ~nAனsnAனM bhèRuMbhaDhi varughiRadhai avaன ghaNDhu: viriyaன bhAMbhughghuDhDhighaLe! varu~Nghobhadhdhughghudh dhabhbhidhdhughghòLLa u~NghaLughghu vaghaighADhDhiனvaன yAr?
maனndhiruMbhudhalughghu eRRa ghaனighaLaigh ghòDhu~NghaL.

AbhiraghAM è~NghaLughghudh dhaghabhbhaன èனRu u~NghaLughghuLLe jhòllighghòLLa niனaiyAdhiru~NghaL; dhevaன indhagh ghallughaLiனAle AbhiraghAmughghubh bhiLLaighaLai uNDhubhaNNa vallavarAyirughghiRAr èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
ibhbhòzhudhe ghoDhariyAனdhu mara~NghaLiன ver arughe vaidhdhirughghiRadhu. AghaiyAl nalla ghaனighòDhAdha maramèllAM vèDhDhuNDhu aghghiனiyile bhoDhabhbhaDhuM.

maனndhiruMbhudhalughghèனRu nAன jaladhdhiனAl u~NghaLughghu ~nAனsnAனM ghòDhughghiReன; èனghghubhbhiன varughiRavar èனனiluM vallavarAyirughghiRAr, avaruDhaiya bhAdharaDhjhaighaLaijh jhumaghghiRadhaRghu nAன bhAdhdhiraன alla; avar bharijhudhdha AviyiனAluM aghghiனiyiனAluM ~nAனsnAனM ghòDhubhbhAr.

dhURRughghUDhai avar ghaiyil irughghiRadhu; avar dhamadhu ghaLadhdhai naனRAy viLaghghi, dhamadhu ghodhumaiyaigh ghaLa~njhiyadhdhil jherbhbhAr; bhadharaiyo aviyAdha aghghiனiyiனAl jhuDhDhèribhbhAr èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu yovAனAl ~nAனsnAனM bhèRuvadhaRghu iyejhu ghalileyAvaiviDhDhu yordhAனughghu arughe avaனiDhadhdhil vandhAr.
yovAன avarughghudh dhaDhai jhèydhu: nAன uMmAle ~nAனsnAனM bhèRaveNDhiyadhAyirughgha, nIr èனனiDhadhdhil varalAmA èனRAன.
iyejhu avaனughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: ibhbhòzhudhu iDha~NghòDhu, ibhbhaDhi èllA nIdhiyaiyuM niRaiveRRuvadhu namaghghu eRRadhAyirughghiRadhu èனRAr. abhbhòzhudhu avarughghu iDha~NghòDhudhdhAன.
iyejhu ~nAனsnAனM bhèRRu, jaladhdhilirundhu gharaiyeRiனvuDhaனe, idho vAனM avarughghudh dhiRaghghabhbhaDhDhadhu; dheva Avi bhuRAvaibhbhola iRa~Nghi, dhaMmel varughiRadhaigh ghaNDhAr.
aனRiyuM, vAனdhdhilirundhu òru jhadhdhaM uNDhAghi, ivar èனனuDhaiya nejhaghumAraன, ivaril bhiriyamAyirughghiReன èனRu uraidhdhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu bhijhAjhiனAl jhodhighghabhbhaDhuvadhaRghu AviyAனvarAle vaனAndharadhdhiRghugh ghòNDhubhoghabhbhaDhDhAr.
avar iravuM bhaghaluM nARbhadhu nAL ubhavAjhamAyirundhabhiனbhu, avarughghubh bhajhiyuNDhAyiRRu.
abhbhòzhudhu jhodhaனaighghAraன avariDhadhdhil vandhu: nIr dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraனeyAனAl, indhagh ghallughaL abhbha~NghaLAghuMbhaDhi jhòlluM èனRAன.
avar bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: maனuShaன abhbhadhdhiனAlemAdhdhiramalla, dhevaனuDhaiya vAyilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhughiRa òvvòru vArdhdhaiyiனAluM bhizhaibhbhAன èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRadhe èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu bhijhAjhu avaraibh bharijhudhdha nagharadhdhiRghugh ghòNDhubhoy, dhevAlayadhdhu ubhbharighaiyiன mel avarai niRudhdhi:

nIr dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraனeyAனAl dhAzhaghghudhiyuM; eனèனil, dhaMmuDhaiya dhUdharghaLughghu uMmaighghuRidhdhugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuvAr; umadhu bhAdhaM ghallil iDhaRAdhabhaDhighghu, avarghaL uMmaigh ghaighaLil endhighghòNDhu bhovArghaL èனbhadhAy èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu èனRu jhòனனAன.
adhaRghu iyejhu: uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaibh bharIDhjhai bhArAdhirubhbhAyAgha èனRuM èzhudhiyirughghiRadhe èனRAr.
maRubhaDhiyuM bhijhAjhu avarai mighavuM uyarndha malaiyiனmel ghòNDhubhoy, ulaghadhdhiன jhaghala rAjya~NghaLaiyuM avaighaLiன maghimaiyaiyuM avarughghugh ghANbhidhdhu:
nIr jhAShDhA~NghamAy vizhundhu, èனனaibh bhaNindhughòNDhAl, ivaighaLaiyèllAM umaghghudh dharuveன èனRu jhòனனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu: abhbhAle bho jhAdhdhAனe; uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdharaibh bhaNindhughòNDhu avar òruvarughghe ArAdhaனai jhèyvAyAgha èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRadhe èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu bhijhAjhAனvaன avarai viDhDhu vilaghibhbhoனAன. uDhaனe dhevadhUdharghaL vandhu, avarughghubh bhaNiviDhai jhèydhArghaL.
yovAன ghAvalil vaighghabhbhaDhDhAன èனRu iyejhu gheLvibhbhaDhDhu ghalileyAvughghubh bhoy,
nAjharedhdhai viDhDhu, jhèbhuloன nabhdhali èனனuM nADhughaLiன èllaighaLilirughghuM ghaDhaRgharaighghu arughAன ghabhbharnaghUmile vandhu vAjhaMbhaNNiனAr.
ghaDhaRgharaiyarughiluM yordhAனughghu abhbhuRadhdhilumuLLa jhèbhuloன nADhuM nabhdhali nADhuM Aghiya bhuRajAdhiyAruDhaiya ghalileyAvile,
iruLil irughghuM jaன~NghaL bhèriya vèLijhjhadhdhaigh ghaNDhArghaL; maraNa iruLiன dhijhaiyilirughghiRavarghaLughghu vèLijhjhaM udhidhdhadhu èனRu,
ejhAyA dhIrghghadharijhiyiனAl uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhu niRaiveRuMbhaDhi ibhbhaDhi naDhandhadhu.
adhumudhal iyejhu: maனndhiruMbhu~NghaL, bharalogharAjyaM jhamIbhidhdhirughghiRadhu èனRu bhirajha~Nghighghadh dhòDha~NghiனAr.

iyejhu ghalileyA ghaDhaloramAy naDhandhu bhoghaiyil, mIனbhiDhighghiRavarghaLAyirundha iraNDhu jhaghodhararAghiya bhedhuru èனனbhbhaDhDha jhImoனuM, avaன jhaghodharaன andhireyAvuM, ghaDhalil valaibhoDhDhughghòNDhirughghiRabhodhu, avarghaLaigh ghaNDhu:
èன bhiனனe vAru~NghaL, u~NghaLai maனuSharaibh bhiDhighghiRavarghaLAghghuveன èனRAr.
uDhaனe avarghaL valaighaLai viDhDhu avarughghubh bhiன jhèனRArghaL.

avar avviDhaM viDhDhubh bhoghaiyil, veRe iraNDhu jhaghodhararAghiya jhèbhadheyuviன maghaன yAghghobhuM, avaன jhaghodharaன yovAனuM dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaன jhèbhadheyuvuDhaனe bhaDhavilirundhu, dha~NghaL valaighaLaibh bhazhudhubhArdhdhughghòNDhirughghiRabhodhu, avarghaLaigh ghaNDhu, avarghaLaiyuM azhaidhdhAr.
uDhaனe avarghaL bhaDhavaiyuM dha~NghaL dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM viDhDhu, avarughghubh bhiன jhèனRArghaL.

nI~NghaL bhUmighghu ubhbhAyirughghiRIrghaL; ubhbhAனdhu jhAramaRRubhbhoனAl, èdhiனAl jhAramAghghabhbhaDhuM? vèLiye ghòDhDhabhbhaDhuvadhaRghuM, maனuSharAl midhighghabhbhaDhuvadhaRghume òzhiya veRòனRughghuM udhavAdhu.

niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhaiyAனAluM dhIrghghadharijhaன~NghaLaiyAனAluM azhighghiRadhaRghu vandheன èனRu èNNighghòLLAdheyu~NghaL; azhighghiRadhaRghu alla, niRaiveRRughiRadhaRghe vandheன.

AghaiyAl, indhagh ghaRbhaனaighaL èllAvaRRiluM jhiRidhòனRaiyAghiluM mIRi, avvidhamAy maனuSharughghubh bhodhighghiRavaன bharalogharAjyadhdhil èllAriluM jhiRiyavaன èனனbhbhaDhuvAன; ivaighaLaigh ghaighghòNDhu bhodhighghiRavaன bharalogharAjyadhdhil èllAriluM bhèriyavaன èனனbhbhaDhuvAன.
vedhabhAraghar bharijheyar èனbhavarghaLuDhaiya nIdhiyiluM u~NghaL nIdhi adhighamAyirAviDhDhAl, bharalogharAjyadhdhil bhiravejhighghamADhDhIrghaL èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
ghòlai jhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha èனbhadhuM, ghòlaijhèyghiRavaன niyAyadhdhIrbhbhughghu edhuvAyirubhbhAன èனbhadhuM, bhUrvadhdhArughghu uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhèனRu gheLvibhbhaDhDhirughghiRIrghaL.

AghaiyAl nI bhalibhIDhadhdhiனiDhadhdhil uன ghANighghaiyaijh jhèludhdha vandhu, uன bheril uன jhaghodharaனughghugh ghuRai uNDhèனRu a~Nghe niனaivu ghUruvAyAghil,
a~NghedhAனe bhalibhIDhadhdhiன muன uன ghANighghaiyai vaidhdhuviDhDhubh bhoy, muனbhu uன jhaghodharaனoDhe òbhbhuravAghi, bhiனbhu vandhu uன ghANighghaiyaijh jhèludhdhu.

èdhirALi uனனai niyAyAdhibhadhiyiனiDhadhdhil òbhbhughghòDhAmaluM, niyAyAdhibhadhi uனனaijh jhevaghaனiDhadhdhil òbhbhughghòDhAmaluM, nI jhiRaijhjhAlaiyil vaighghabhbhaDhAmaluM irughghuMbhaDhiyAgha, nI uன èdhirALiyoDhu vazhiyil irughghuMbhodhe jhIghghiramAy avaனuDhaனe nalmaனM bhòrundhu.
bhòrundhAviDhDhAl, nI òru ghAjhuM ghuRaiviனRigh ghòDhudhdhudh dhIrghghumaDhDhuM avviDhadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhamADhDhAy èனRu, mèyyAghave uனghghujh jhòllughiReன.

dhaன maனaiviyaidh dhaLLiviDhughiRa èvaனuM dhaLLudhaRjhIDhDhai avaLughghu ghòDhughghaghghaDhavaன èனRu uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.

aனRiyuM, bhòyyANaiyiDhAmal uன ANaighaLaigh ghardhdhar muனனilaiyAyjh jhèludhdhuvAyAgha èனRu bhUrvadhdhArughghu uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhèனRu gheLvibhbhaDhDhirughghiRIrghaL.

AghaiyAl èனனdhdhai uNbhoM, èனனdhdhaigh ghuDhibhbhoM èனRu u~NghaL jIvaனughghAghavuM; èனனdhdhai uDhubhbhoM èனRu u~NghaL jharIradhdhughghAghavuM ghavalaibhbhaDhAdhiru~NghaL èனRu, u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன; AghAradhdhaibh bhArghghiluM jIvaனuM, uDhaiyaibhbhArghghiluM jharIramuM vijheShidhdhavaighaL allavA?

AghAyadhdhubh bhaDhjhighaLaigh ghavaனidhdhubhbhAru~NghaL; avaighaL vidhaighghiRadhumillai, aRughghiRadhumillai, ghaLa~njhiya~NghaLil jherdhdhuvaighghiRadhumillai; avaighaLaiyuM u~NghaL bharamabhidhA bhizhaibhbhUDhDhughiRAr; avaighaLaibhbhArghghiluM nI~NghaL vijheShidhdhavarghaL allavA?
ghavalaibhbhaDhughiRadhiனAle u~NghaLil èvaன dhaன jharIra aLavoDhu òru muzhadhdhaigh ghUDhDhuvAன?
uDhaighghAghavuM nI~NghaL ghavalaibhbhaDhughiRadhèனன? ghADhDhubhbhuShbha~NghaL èbhbhaDhi vaLarughiRadhèனbhadhaigh ghavaனidhdhubhbhAru~NghaL. avaighaL uzhaighghiRadhumillai, nURghiRadhumillai;
èனRAluM jhAlòmoன mudhalAydh dhaன jharva maghimaiyiluM avaighaLil òனRaibhbholAghiluM uDhudhdhiyirundhadhillai èனRu, u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

aRbha vijhuvAjhighaLe! iனRaighghu irundhu nALaighghu aDhubhbhile bhoDhabhbhaDhuM ghADhDhubh bhullughghudh dhevaன ivvidhamAgha uDhudhdhuvidhdhAl, u~NghaLughghu uDhudhdhuvibhbhadhu adhigha nijhjhayamallavA?
AghaiyAl, èனனdhdhai uNbhoM, èனனdhdhaigh ghuDhibhbhoM èனRu ghavalaibhbhaDhAdhiru~NghaL.
ivaighaLaiyèllAM a~n~nAனighaL nADhidhdheDhughiRArghaL; ivaighaLèllAM u~NghaLughghu veNDhiyavaighaL èனRu u~NghaL bharamabhidhA aRindhirughghiRAr.
mudhalAvadhu dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhaiyuM avaruDhaiya nIdhiyaiyuM dheDhu~NghaL; abhbhòzhudhu ivaighaLèllAM u~NghaLughghugh ghUDhagh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhuM.
AghaiyAl nALaighghAghagh ghavalaibhbhaDhAdhiru~NghaL; nALaiyadhdhiனM dhaனனuDhaiyavaighaLughghAghagh ghavalaibhbhaDhuM. andhandha nALughghu adhiனdhiன bhADhu bhodhuM.
nI~NghaL ghuRRavALighaLèனRu dhIrghghabhbhaDhAdhabhaDhighghu maRRavarghaLaigh ghuRRavALighaLèனRu dhIrghghAdhiru~NghaL.
eனèனil, nI~NghaL maRRavarghaLaidh dhIrghghiRa dhIrbhbhiனbhaDhiye nI~NghaLuM dhIrghghabhbhaDhuvIrghaL; nI~NghaL maRRavarghaLughghu aLaghghiRa aLaviனbhaDhiye u~NghaLughghuM aLaghghabhbhaDhuM.
nI uன ghaNNilirughghiRa udhdhiradhdhai uNarAmal, uன jhaghodharaன ghaNNilirughghiRa dhuruMbhaibh bhArghghiRadhèனன?
idho uன ghaNNil udhdhiraM irughghaiyil uன jhaghodharaனai noghghi nAன uன ghaNNilirughghiRa dhuruMbhai èDhudhdhubhbhoDhaDhDhuM èனRu nI jhòlvadhèbhbhaDhi?

gheLu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu u~NghaLughghugh ΕòDhughghabhbhaDhuM; dheDhu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu ghaNDhaDhaivIrghaL; dhaDhDhu~NghaL abhbhòzhudhu u~NghaLughghudh dhiRaghghabhbhaDhuM.

u~NghaLil èndha maனuShaனAனAluM dhaனனiDhadhdhil abhbhadhdhaighgheDhghiRa dhaன maghaனughghugh ghallaigh ghòDhubhbhAனA?
mIனaighgheDhDhAl avaனughghubh bhAMbhaighghòDhubhbhAனA?

AghaiyAl, bhòllAdhavarghaLAghiya nI~NghaL u~NghaL bhiLLaighaLughghu nalla IvughaLaigh ghòDhughgha aRindhirughghuMbhodhu, bharaloghadhdhilirughghiRa u~NghaL bhidhA dhaMmiDhadhdhil veNDhighghòLLughiRavarghaLughghu naனmaiyAனvaighaLaigh ghòDhubhbhadhu adhigha nijhjhayaM allavA?
AdhalAl, maனuShar u~NghaLughghu èvaighaLaijhjhèyya viruMbhughiRIrghaLo, avaighaLai nI~NghaLuM avarghaLughghujh jhèyyu~NghaL; idhuve niyAyabhbhiramANamuM dhIrghghadharijhaன~NghaLumAM.
iDhughghamAன vAjhal vazhiyAy uDhbhiravejhiyu~NghaL; gheDhDhughghubh bhoghiRa vAjhal virivuM, vazhi vijhAlamumAyirughghiRadhu; adhiன vazhiyAybh bhiravejhighghiRavarghaL aneghar.
jIvaனughghubh bhoghiRa vAjhal iDhughghamuM, vazhi nèrughghamumAyirughghiRadhu; adhaigh ghaNDhubhiDhighghiRavarghaL jhilar.
ghaLLadhdhIrghghadharijhighaLughghu èjhjharighghaiyAyiru~NghaL; avarghaL ADhDhudhdholaibh bhordhdhughghòNDhu u~NghaLiDhadhdhil varuvArghaL; uLLadhdhilo avarghaL bhaDhjhighghiRa onAyghaL.
avarghaLuDhaiya ghaனighaLiனAle avarghaLai aRivIrghaL; muDhjhèDhighaLil dhirADhjhabhbhazha~NghaLaiyuM, muDhbhUNDhughaLil adhdhibhbhazha~NghaLaiyuM bhaRighghiRArghaLA?
abhbhaDhiye nalla maramèllAM nalla ghaனighaLaigh ghòDhughghuM; ghèDhDha maramo ghèDhDha ghaனighaLaigh ghòDhughghuM.
nalla maraM ghèDhDha ghaனighaLaigh ghòDhughghamADhDhAdhu; ghèDhDha maraM nalla ghaனighaLaigh ghòDhughghamADhDhAdhu.
nalla ghaனi ghòDhAdha maramèllAM vèDhDhuNDhu aghghiனiyile bhoDhabhbhaDhuM.
AdhalAl, avarghaLuDhaiya ghaனighaLiனAle avarghaLai aRivIrghaL.

bharaloghadhdhilirughghiRa èன bhidhAviன jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhi jhèyghiRavaனe bharalogharAjyadhdhil bhiravejhibhbhAனeyallAmal, èனனai noghghigh ghardhdhAve! ghardhdhAve! èனRu jhòllughiRavaன adhil bhiravejhibhbhadhillai.
annALil aneghar èனனai noghghi: ghardhdhAve! ghardhdhAve! umadhu nAmadhdhiனAle dhIrghghadharijhaனM uraidhdhoM allavA? umadhu nAmadhdhiனAle bhijhAjhughaLaidh dhuradhdhiனoM allavA? èனbhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu, nAன òrughghAluM u~NghaLai aRiyavillai. aghghiramajh jhèyghaighghArare, èனனaiviDhDhu aghaனRu bho~NghaL èனRu avarghaLughghujh jhòlluveன.
AghaiyAl, nAன jhòlliya indha vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhu, ivaighaLiனbhaDhi jhèyghiRavaன èvaனo, avaனaigh ghaனmalaiyiனmel dhaன vIDhDhaigh ghaDhDhiன bhudhdhiyuLLa maனuShaனughghu òbhbhiDhuveன.
bhèrumazhai jhòrindhu, bhèruvèLLaM vandhu, ghARRu aDhidhdhu, andha vIDhDhiனmel modhiyuM adhu vizhavillai; eனèனRAl adhu ghaனmalaiyiனmel asdhibhAraM bhoDhabhbhaDhDhirundhadhu.
nAன jhòlliya indha vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhu, ivaighaLiனbhaDhi jhèyyAdhirughghiRavaன èvaனo, avaன dhaன vIDhDhai maNaliனmel ghaDhDhiன bhudhdhiyillAdha maனuShaனughghu òbhbhiDhabhbhaDhuvAன.
bhèrumazhai jhòrindhu, bhèruvèLLaM vandhu, ghARRu aDhidhdhu, andha vIDhDhiனmel modhiனbhodhu adhu vizhundhadhu; vizhundhu muzhuvadhuM azhindhadhu èனRAr.
iyejhu indha vArdhdhaighaLaijh jhòlli muDhidhdhabhodhu, avar vedhabhAragharaibhbhol bhodhiyAmal, adhighAramuDhaiyavarAy avarghaLughghubh bhodhidhdhabhaDhiyAl,
jaன~NghaL avaruDhaiya bhodhaghadhdhaighghuRidhdhu AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhArghaL.

iyejhu dhamadhu ghaiyai nIDhDhi avaனaidhdhòDhDhu: èனghghujh jhidhdhamuNDhu, jhudhdhamAghu èனRAr. uDhaனe ghuShDharoghaM nI~Nghi avaன jhudhdhamAனAன.

iyejhu avaனai noghghi: idhai nI òruvarughghuM jhòllAdhabhaDhi èjhjharighghaiyAyiru; AyiனuM, avarghaLughghujh jhADhjhiyAgha nI bhoy AjhAriyaனughghu uனனaigh ghANbhidhdhu, mojhe ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDha ghANighghaiyaijh jhèludhdhu èனRAr.
iyejhu ghabhbharnaghUmil bhiravejhidhdhabhodhu, nURRughghu adhibhadhi òruvaன avariDhadhdhil vandhu:
ANDhavare! èன velaighghAraன vIDhDhile dhimirvAdhamAygh ghiDhandhu ghòDhiya vedhaனaibhbhaDhughiRAன èனRu avarai veNDhighghòNDhAன.

nAன adhighAradhdhughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhDhirundhuM, èனghghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhighiRa jhevagharumuNDhu; nAன òruvaனaibh bhovèனRAl bhoghiRAன, maRRòruvaனai vAvèனRAl varughiRAன, èன velaighghAraனai idhaijh jhèy èனRAl jhèyghiRAன èனRAன.
