aneghar ghizhaghghiluM meRghilumirundhu vandhu, bharalogharAjyadhdhil AbhiraghAM IjhAghghu yAghghobhu èனbhavarghaLoDhe bhandhiyirubhbhArghaL.
rAjyadhdhiன bhudhdhiraro bhuRaMbhAன iruLile dhaLLabhbhaDhuvArghaL; a~Nghe azhughaiyuM bhaRghaDhibhbhuM uNDhAyirughghumèனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
bhiனbhu iyejhu nURRughghu adhibhadhiyai noghghi: nI bhoghalAM, nI vijhuvAjhidhdhabhaDhiye uனghghu AghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAr. andha nAzhighaiyile avaன velaighghAraன jhòsdhamAனAன.
iyejhu bhedhuruviன vIDhDhile vandhu, avaன mAmi juramAygh ghiDhaghghiRadhaigh ghaNDhAr.
avar avaL ghaiyaidh dhòDhDhavuDhaனe juraM avaLaiviDhDhu nI~NghiRRu; avaL èzhundhirundhu avarghaLughghubh bhaNiviDhai jhèydhAL.
asdhamaனmAனbhodhu, bhijhAjhu bhiDhidhdhirundha anegharai avariDhadhdhil ghòNDhu vandhArghaL; avar andha AvighaLaidh dhamadhu vArdhdhaiyiனAle dhuradhdhi, bhiNiyALighaLèllAraiyuM jhòsdhamAghghiனAr:
avar dhAme naMmuDhaiya bhèlavIன~NghaLai eRRughghòNDhu, naMmuDhaiya noyghaLaijh jhumandhAr èனRu, ejhAyA dhIrghghadharijhiyiனAl uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhu niRaiveRuMbhaDhi ibhbhaDhi naDhandhadhu.
bhiனbhu, dhiraLAன jaன~NghaL dhaMmaijh jhUzhndhirughghiRadhaigh ghaNDhu, aghgharaighghubh bhoghaghghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAr.
abhbhòzhudhu, vedhabhAraghaன òruvaன vandhu: bhodhaghare! nIr è~Nghe bhoனAluM nAன uMmaibh bhiனbhaRRi varuveன èனRAன.
adhaRghu iyejhu: narighaLughghugh ghuzhighaLuM AghAyadhdhubhbhaRavaighaLughghugh ghUDhughaLuM uNDhu; maனuShaghumAraனughgho dhalaijhAyghgha iDhamillai èனRAr.
avaruDhaiya jhISharghaLil veRòruvaன avarai noghghi: ANDhavare! muனbhu nAன bhoy, èன dhaghabhbhaனai aDhaghghaMbhaNNa èனghghu udhdharavu ghòDhughghaveNDhuM èனRAன.
adhaRghu iyejhu: maridhdhor dha~NghaL maridhdhorai aDhaghghaM bhaNNaDhDhuM, nI èனனaibh bhiனbhaRRi vA èனRAr.
avar bhaDhavil eRiனbhodhu avaruDhaiya jhISharghaL avarughghubh bhiனjhèனRu eRiனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu bhaDhavu alaighaLiனAl mUDhabhbhaDhadhdhaghghadhAygh ghaDhalil bhèru~NghARRu uNDhAyiRRu, avaro nidhdhiraiyAyirundhAr.
abhbhòzhudhu, avaruDhaiya jhISharghaL vandhu avarai èzhubhbhi: ANDhavare! è~NghaLai iraDhjhiyuM, maDhindhubhoghiRoM èனRArghaL.
adhaRghu avar: aRbhavijhuvAjhighaLe! eன bhayabhbhaDhughiRIrghaL èனRu jhòlli; èzhundhu, ghARRaiyuM ghaDhalaiyuM adhaDhDhiனAr. uDhaனe mighundha amaidhaluNDhAyiRRu.
andha maனuSharghaL AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhu: ivar èbhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavaro, ghARRuM ghaDhaluM ivarughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhighiRadhe èனRArghaL.

avar aghgharaiyile ghèrghèjheனr nADhDhil vandhabhodhu, bhijhAjhu bhiDhidhdhirundha iraNDhubher bhiredhaghghallaRaighaLilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, avarughghu èdhirAgha vandhArghaL; avarghaL mighavuM ghòDhiyarAyirundhabhaDhiyAl, andha vazhiyil yAruM naDhaghghaghghUDhAdhirundhadhu.
avarghaL avarai noghghi: iyejhuve, dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraனe, è~NghaLughghuM umaghghuM èனன? ghAlaM varumuனனe è~NghaLai vedhaனaibhbhaDhudhdha i~Nghe vandhIro èனRu ghUbhbhiDhDhArghaL.
avarghaLughghugh ghò~njhadhUradhdhile aneghaM bhaனRighaL ghUDhDhamAgha meyndhughòNDhirundhaன.
abhbhòzhudhu, bhijhAjhughaL: nIr è~NghaLaidh dhuradhdhuvIrAனAl, nA~NghaL andhabh bhaனRighghUDhDhadhdhil bhoghuMbhaDhi udhdharavu ghòDhuM èனRu avarai veNDhighghòNDhaன.

abhbhòzhudhu, avar bhaDhavil eRi, ighgharaibhbhaDhDhudh dhaMmuDhaiya bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghu vandhAr.

bhUmiyile bhAva~NghaLai maனனighgha maனuShaghumAraனughghu adhighAraM uNDhèனbhadhai nI~NghaL aRiyaveNDhuM èனRu jhòlli, dhimirvAdhaghghAraனai noghghi: nI èzhundhu uன bhaDhughghaiyai èDhudhdhughghòNDhu, uன vIDhDhughghubh bho èனRAr.
uDhaனe avaன èzhundhu, dhaன vIDhDhughghubhbhoனAன.
jaன~NghaL adhaighghaNDhu AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhu, maனuSharughghu ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha adhighAradhdhaigh ghòDhudhdhavarAghiya dhevaனai maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhiனArghaL.
iyejhu avviDhaM viDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoghaiyil, AyadhdhuRaiyil uDhghArndhirundha madhdheyu èனனuM òru maனuShaனaighghaNDhu: èனghghubh bhiனjhèனRuvA èனRAr; avaன èzhundhu avarughghubh bhiனjhèனRAன.
bhiனbhu avar vIDhDhile bhojaனbhandhiyirughghaiyil, anegha AyaghghAraruM bhAvighaLuM vandhu, iyejhuvoDhuM avar jhISharoDhu~NghUDhabh bhandhiyirundhArghaL.
bharijheyar adhaighghaNDhu, avaruDhaiya jhISharghaLai noghghi: u~NghaL bhodhaghar AyaghghAraroDhuM bhAvighaLoDhuM bhojaனM bhaNNughiRadhèனனvèனRu gheDhDhArghaL.

maனuShaghumAraன ghèDhDhubhbhoனdhai iraDhjhighgha vandhAr.

u~NghaLughghu èbhbhaDhidh dhoனRughiRadhu? òru maனuShaனughghu nURu ADhughaLirughgha, avaighaLil òனRu jhidhaRibhbhoனAl, avaன maRRadh dhòNNURRòனbhadhu ADhughaLaiyuM malaighaLil viDhDhubhbhoyjh jhidhaRibhbhoனdhaidh dheDhAmalirubhbhAனo?

avaன adhaighghaNDhubhiDhidhdhAl, jhidhaRibhbhoghAdha dhòNNURRòனbhadhu ADhughaLaighghuRidhdhujh jhandhoShabhbhaDhughiRadhaibh bhArghghiluM, adhaighghuRidhdhu adhighamAyjh jhandhoShabhbhaDhuvAன èனRu, mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
ivvidhamAgha, indhajh jhiRiyaril òruvaனAghiluM ghèDhDhubhbhovadhu bharaloghadhdhilirughghiRa u~NghaL bhidhAviன jhidhdhamalla.

uன jhaghodharaன uனghghu virodhamAghagh ghuRRa~njhèydhAl, avaனiDhadhdhil nI bhoy, nIyuM avaனuM dhaனidhdhirughghaiyil, avaன ghuRRadhdhai avaனughghu uNardhdhu avaன uனghghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhAl, uன jhaghodharaனai AdhAyabhbhaDhudhdhighghòNDhAy.
avaன jhèvighòDhAmaRbhoனAl, iraNDhu mUனRu jhADhjhighaLuDhaiya vAghghiனAle jha~NghadhighaLèllAM nilaivarabhbhaDhuMbhaDhi, iraNDhòruvarai uனனuDhaனe ghUDhDhighghòNDhu bho.

avarghaLughghuM avaன jhèvighòDhAmaRbhoனAl, adhaijh jhabhaighghudh dhèriyabhbhaDhudhdhu; jhabhaighghuM jhèvighòDhAdhirubhbhAனAனAl, avaன uனghghu a~n~nAனiyaibhbholavuM AyaghghAraனaibhbholavuM irubhbhAனAgha.

bhUloghadhdhile nI~NghaL èvaighaLaigh ghaDhDhuvIrghaLo avaighaL bharaloghadhdhiluM ghaDhDhabhbhaDhDhirughghuM; bhUloghadhdhile nI~NghaL èvaighaLaigh ghaDhDhavizhbhbhIrghaLo avaighaL bharaloghadhdhiluM ghaDhDhavizhghghabhbhaDhuM èனRu mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

allAmaluM, u~NghaLil iraNDhubher dhA~NghaL veNDhighghòLLabhbhoghiRa èndhagh ghAriyadhdhaighghuRidhdhAghiluM bhUmiyile òrumaனbhbhaDhDhirundhAl, bharaloghadhdhilirughghiRa èன bhidhAviனAl adhu avarghaLughghu uNDhAghuM èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
eனèனil, iraNDhu bherAvadhu mUனRu bherAvadhu èன nAmadhdhiனAle è~Nghe ghUDhiyirughghiRArghaLo, a~Nghe avarghaL naDhuvile irughghiReன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu, bhedhuru avariDhadhdhil vandhu, ANDhavare èன jhaghodharaன èனghghu virodhamAygh ghuRRa~njhèydhu vandhAl, nAன èdhdhaனaidharaM maனனighghaveNDhuM? ezhudharamaDhDhumo èனRu gheDhDhAன.
adhaRghu iyejhu: ezhudharamAdhdhiraM alla ezhèzhubhadhudharamaDhDhuM èனRu uனghghujh jhòllughiReன.
èbhbhaDhiyèனil, bharalogharAjyaM dhaன UzhiyaghghArariDhadhdhil ghaNaghghubhbhArghgha veNDhumèனRirundha òru rAjAvughghu òbhbhAyirughghiRadhu.
avaன ghaNaghghubhbhArghghadh dhòDha~Nghiனbhodhu, bhadhiனAyiraM dhAlandhu ghaDhaன bhaDhDhavaன òruvaனai avaனughghu muனbhAgha ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.

ghaDhaனaidhdhIrghgha avaனughghu nirvAghaM illAdhabhaDhiyAl, avaனuDhaiya ANDhavaன avaனaiyuM avaன bhèNjAdhi bhiLLaighaLaiyuM, avaனughghu uNDhAன èllAvaRRaiyuM viDhDhu, ghaDhaனaidh dhIrghghuMbhaDhigh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu andha UzhiyaghghAraன dhAzha vizhundhu, vaNa~Nghi: ANDhavaனe! èனனiDhadhdhil bhòRumaiyAyiruM, èllAvaRRaiyuM umaghghugh ghòDhudhdhudh dhIrghghiReன èனRAன.
andha UzhiyaghghAraனuDhaiya ANDhavaன maனdhira~Nghi, avaனai viDhudhalaibhbhaNNi, ghaDhaனaiyuM avaனughghu maனனidhdhuviDhDhAன.

abhbhaDhiyirughgha, andha UzhiyaghghAraன bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoghaiyil, dhaனனiDhadhdhil nURu vèLLibhbhaNaM ghaDhaனbhaDhDhirundhavaனAghiya dhaன uDhaன velaighghAraril òruvaனaighghaNDhu, avaனaibhbhiDhidhdhu, dhòNDhaiyai nèridhdhu: nI bhaDhDha ghaDhaனai èனghghu ghòDhudhdhudh dhIrghghaveNDhuM èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaனuDhaiya uDhaன velaighghAraன ghAlile vizhundhu: èனனiDhadhdhil bhòRumaiyAyiruM, èllAvaRRaiyuM umaghghugh ghòDhudhdhudh dhIrghghiReன èனRu, avaனai veNDhighghòNDhAன.
avaனo jhaMmadhiyAmal, bhoy, avaன bhaDhDha ghaDhaனaigh ghòDhudhdhudh dhIrghghumaLavuM avaனaigh ghAvalil bhoDhuvidhdhAன.
naDhandhadhai avaன uDhaனvelaighghArar ghaNDhu, mighavuM dhughghabhbhaDhDhu, ANDhavaனiDhadhdhil vandhu, naDhandhadhaiyèllAM aRividhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu, avaனuDhaiya ANDhavaன avaனai azhaibhbhidhdhu: bhòllAdha UzhiyaghghAraனe, nI èனனai veNDhighghòNDhabhaDhiyiனAl, andhagh ghaDhaன muzhuvadhaiyuM uனghghu maனனidhdhuviDhDheன.
nAன uனghghu ira~Nghiனdhubhola, nIyuM uன uDhaன velaighghAraனughghu ira~NghaveNDhAmo èனRu jhòlli,
avaனuDhaiya ANDhavaன ghobhamaDhaindhu, avaன bhaDhDha ghaDhaனaiyèllAM dhaனghghugh ghòDhudhdhudh dhIrghghumaLavuM ubhAdhighghiRavarghaLiDhadhdhil avaனai òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAன.
nI~NghaLuM avaனvaன dhaன jhaghodharaன jhèydha dhabhbhidha~NghaLai maனbhbhUrvamAy maனனiyAmaRbhoனAl, èன bharamabhidhAvuM u~NghaLughghu ibhbhaDhiye jhèyvAr èனRAr.
iyejhu indha vajhaன~NghaLaijh jhòllimuDhidhdha bhiனbhu, avar ghalileyAvai viDhDhu yordhAனughghu aghgharaiyAன yUdheyAviன èllaighaLil vandhAr.
dhiraLAன jaன~NghaL avarughghubh bhiன jhèனRArghaL; avviDhadhdhil avarghaLaijh jhòsdhamAghghiனAr.
abhbhòzhudhu, bharijheyar avaraijh jhodhighghaveNDhumèனRu avariDhadhdhil vandhu: bhuruShaனAனvaன dhaன maனaiviyai èndha mughAndharadhiனAlAghiluM dhaLLiviDhuvadhu niyAyamA èனRu gheDhDhArghaL.
avarghaLughghu avar bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: Adhiyile maனuSharai uNDhAghghiனvar avarghaLai ANuM bhèNNumAgha uNDhAghghiனAr èனbhadhaiyuM,

idhiனimidhdhaM bhuruShaனAனvaன dhaன dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM dhAyaiyuM viDhDhudh dhaன maனaiviyoDhe ijhaindhirubhbhAன; avarghaL iruvaruM òre mAMjhamAyirubhbhArghaL èனRu avar jhòனனdhaiyuM, nI~NghaL vAjhighghavillaiyA?
ibhbhaDhi irughghiRabhaDhiyAl, avarghaL iruvarAyirAmal, òre mAMjhamAyirughghiRArghaL; AghaiyAl dhevaன iNaidhdhadhai maனuShaன bhirighghAdhirughghaghghaDhavaன èனRAr.
adhaRghu avarghaL abhbhaDhiyAனAl, dhaLLudhaRjhIDhDhaighghòDhudhdhu, avaLaidh dhaLLiviDhalAmèனRu mojhe eன ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAr èனRArghaL.
adhaRghu avar: u~NghaL maனaivighaLaidh dhaLLiviDhalAmèனRu u~NghaL irudhayaghghaDhiனdhdhiனimidhdhaM mojhe u~NghaLughghu iDhaM ghòDhudhdhAr; AdhimudhalAy abhbhaDhi irughghavillai.

AdhalAl, èvaனAghiluM dhaன maனaivi vejhidhdhaன~njhèydhadhiனimidhdhameyaனRi, avaLaidh dhaLLiviDhDhu veRòrudhdhiyai vivAghaM bhaNNiனAl, avaன vibhajhAraM bhaNNughiRavaனAyirubhbhAன; dhaLLiviDhabhbhaDhDhavaLai vivAghaM bhaNNughiRavaனuM vibhajhAra~njhèyghiRavaனAyirubhbhAன èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
avaruDhaiya jhISharghaL avarai noghghi: maனaiviyaibhbhaRRibh bhuruShaனuDhaiya ghAriyaM ibhbhaDhiyirundhAl, vivAghaM bhaNNughiRadhu nalladhalla èனRArghaL.
adhaRghu avar: varaM bhèRRavarghaLe dhavira maRRavarghaL indha vajhaனdhdhai eRRughghòLLamADhDhArghaL.

dhAyiன vayiRRilirundhu aNNagharghaLAybh bhiRandhavarghaLuM uNDhu; maனuSharghaLAl aNNagharghaLAghghabhbhaDhDhavarghaLuM uNDhu; bharalogharAjyadhdhiனimidhdhaM dha~NghaLai aNNagharghaLAghghighghòNDhavarghaLuM uNDhu; idhai eRRughghòLLa vallavaன eRRughghòLLaghghaDhavaன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu, jhiRu bhiLLaighaLiனmel ghaighaLai vaidhdhu jèbhaMbhaNNubhaDhighghu avarghaLai avariDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvandhArghaL; ghòNDhuvandhavarghaLaijh jhISharghaL adhaDhDhiனArghaL.
iyejhuvo: jhiRu bhiLLaighaL èனனiDhadhdhil varughiRadhaRghu iDha~NghòDhu~NghaL; avarghaLaidh dhaDhaibhaNNAdhiru~NghaL; bharalogharAjyaM abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavarghaLuDhaiyadhu èனRu jhòlli,
avarghaL mel ghaighaLai vaidhdhu, bhiனbhu avviDhaM viDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAr.
abhbhòzhudhu òruvaன vandhu, avarai noghghi: nalla bhodhaghare nidhdhiya jIvaனai aDhaiyuMbhaDhi nAன èndha naனmaiyaijh jhèyyaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAன;
adhaRghu avar: nI èனனai nallavaன èனRu jhòlvAனeன? dhevaன òruvaraidhdhavira nallavaன òruvaனuM illaiye; nI jIvaனil bhiravejhighgha viruMbhiனAl ghaRbhaனaighaLaigh ghaighghòL èனRAr.
avaன avarai noghghi: èvaighaLai èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu iyejhu: ghòlai jhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha, vibhajhAraM jhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha, ghaLavu jhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha, bhòyjh jhADhjhi jhòllAdhirubhbhAyAgha;
uன dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM uன dhAyaiyuM ghaனMbhaNNuvAyAgha; uனனiDhadhdhil nI aனbhughUruvadhubholabh bhiRaனiDhadhdhiluM aனbhughUruvAyAgha èனbhavaighaLaiye èனRAr.
andha vAlibhaன avarai noghghi: ivaighaLaiyèllAM èன jhiRu vayadhu mudhal ghaighghòNDhirughghiReன; iனனuM èனனiDhadhdhil ghuRaivu èனன èனRAன.

adhaRghu iyejhu: nI bhUraNa jhaRghuNaனAyirughgha viruMbhiனAl, bhoy, uனghghu uNDhAனvaighaLai viRRu, dharidhdhirarughghugh ghòDhu, abhbhòzhudhu bharaloghadhdhil uனghghubh bhòghghiShaM uNDhAyirughghuM. bhiனbhu èனனaibh bhiனbhaRRivA èனRAr.
andha vAlibhaன mighundha AsdhiyuLLavaனAyirundhabhaDhiyAl, indha vArdhdhaiyaigh gheDhDhabhòzhudhu, dhughghamaDhaindhavaனAybh bhoyviDhDhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu dhaMmuDhaiya jhISharghaLai noghghi: aijhuvariyavAன dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil bhiravejhibhbhadhu aridhèனRu, mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
meluM aijhuvariyavAன dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil bhiravejhibhbhadhaibhbhArghghiluM, òDhDhaghamAனdhu Ujhiyiன ghAdhile nuzhaivadhu èLidhAyirughghuM èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
avaruDhaiya jhISharghaL adhaighgheDhDhabhòzhudhu mighavuM AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhu: abhbhaDhiyAனAl yAr raDhjhighghabhbhaDhaghghUDhuM èனRArghaL.
iyejhu, avarghaLaibh bhArdhdhu: maனuSharAl idhu ghUDhAdhadhudhAன; dhevaனAle èllAM ghUDhuM èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu bhedhuru avarai noghghi: idho, nA~NghaL èllAvaRRaiyuM viDhDhu, uMmaibhbhiனbhaRRiனome; è~NghaLughghu èனனghiDhaighghuM èனRAன.

adhaRghu iyejhu: maRujèனmaghAladhdhile maனuShaghumAraன dhaMmuDhaiya maghimaiyuLLa jhi~NghAjhaனdhdhiனmel vIRRirughghuMbhodhu, nI~NghaLuM, israveliன bhaனனiraNDhu ghodhdhira~NghaLaiyuM niyAyaM dhIrghghiRavarghaLAghabh bhaனனiraNDhu jhi~NghAjhaன~NghaLil vIRRirubhbhIrghaL èனRu, mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

èன nAmadhdhiனimidhdhaM vIDhDhaiyAvadhu, jhaghodhararaiyAvadhu, jhaghodharighaLaiyAvadhu, dhaghabhbhaனaiyAvadhu, dhAyaiyAvadhu, maனaiviyaiyAvadhu, bhiLLaighaLaiyAvadhu, nila~NghaLaiyAvadhu viDhDhavaன èvaனo, avaன nURadhdhaனaiyAy aDhaindhu, nidhdhiya jIvaனaiyuM jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLuvAன;
AghiluM mundhiனor aneghar bhindhiனorAyuM, bhindhiனor aneghar mundhiனorAyuM irubhbhArghaL èனRAr.
bharalogharAjyaM vIDhDhèjamAனAghiya òru maனuShaனughghu òbhbhAyirughghiRadhu; avaன dhaன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhughghu velaiyADhghaLai amardhdha adhighAlaiyile bhuRabhbhaDhDhAன.
velaiyADhghaLuDhaன nALòனRughghu òru bhaNaM ghUlibhejhi, avarghaLaidh dhaன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhughghu aனubhbhiனAன.
mUனRAM maNi veLaiyiluM avaன bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, ghaDhaidhdhèruvile jhuMmA niRghiRa veRu jhilaraighghaNDhu:
nI~NghaLuM dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhughghubh bho~NghaL; niyAyamAனbhaDhi u~NghaLughghu ghUli ghòDhubhbheன èனRAன; avarghaLuM bhoனArghaL.
maRubhaDhiyuM, ARAM òனbhadhAM maNiveLaiyiluM avaன bhoy abhbhaDhiye jhèydhAன.
bhadhiனorAM maNiveLaiyiluM avaனbhoy, jhuMmA niRghiRa veRu jhilaraighghaNDhu: nI~NghaL bhaghal muzhuvadhuM i~Nghe jhuMmA niRghiRadhèனன èனRu gheDhDhAன.
adhaRghu avarghaL: òruvaனuM è~NghaLughghu velaiyiDhavillai èனRArghaL. avaன avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaLuM dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhughghubh bho~NghaL. niyAyamAனbhaDhi ghUli bhèRRughghòLvIrghaL èனRAன.

jhAya~NghAladhdhil, dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhughghu èjamAன dhaன ghAriyaghghAraனai noghghi: nI velaiyADhghaLai azhaidhdhu, bhindhivandhavarghaL dhòDha~Nghi mundhivarghaLvaraighghuM avarghaLughghugh ghUli ghòDhu èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhadhiனorAM maNiveLaiyil velaiyamardhdhabhbhaDhDhavarghaL vandhu ALughghu òvvòru bhaNaM vA~NghiனArghaL.
mundhi amardhdhabhbhaDhDhavarghaL vandhu, dha~NghaLughghu adhigha ghUli ghiDhaighghuM èனRu èNNiனArghaL, avarghaLuM ALughghu òvvòru bhaNaM vA~NghiனArghaL.
vA~NghighghòNDhu vIDhDhèjamAனai noghghi:

bhindhivandhavarghaLAghiya ivarghaL òru maNi neramAdhdhiraM velai jhèydhArghaL; bhaghaliன ghaShDhadhdhaiyuM vèyiliன uShNadhdhaiyuM jhaghidhdha è~NghaLughghu ivarghaLaijh jhamamAghghiனIre èனRu muRumuRudhdhArghaL.
avarghaLil òruvaனughghu avaன bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: jhineghidhaனe, nAன uனghghu aniyAya~njhèyyavillai; nI èனனiDhadhdhil òru bhaNadhdhughghu jhaMmadhighghavillaiyA?
uனனuDhaiyadhai nI vA~NghighghòNDhu bho, uனghghugh ghòDhudhdhadhu bholabh bhindhi vandhavaனAghiya ivaனughghuM ghòDhubhbhadhu èனனuDhaiya iShDhaM.
èனனuDhaiyadhai èன iShDhabhbhaDhijh jhèyya èனghghu adhighAramillaiyA? nAன dhayALaனAyirughghiRabhaDhiyAl, nI vaனghaNNaனAyirughghalAmA èனRAன.
ivvidhamAgha mundhiனor bhindhiனorAyuM, bhindhiனor mundhiனorAyuM irubhbhArghaL; azhaighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaL aneghar, dhèrindhughòLLabhbhaDhDhavarghaLo jhilar èனRAr.
iyejhu èrujhalemughghubhbhoghuMbhodhu, vazhiyile bhaனனiraNDhu jhISharaiyuM dhaனiye azhaidhdhu:
idho, èrujhalemughghubhbhoghiRoM; maனuShaghumAraன bhiradhAன AjhAriyariDhadhdhiluM vedhabhAraghariDhadhdhiluM òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvAr; avarghaL avarai maraNa AghghiனaighghuLLAghadh dhIrdhdhu,
avaraibh bhariyAjhaMbhaNNavuM, vAriனAl aDhighghavuM, jhiluvaiyil aRaiyavuM bhuRajAdhiyAriDhadhdhil òbhbhughghòDhubhbhArghaL; AghiluM mUனRAM nALile uyiroDhe èzhundhirubhbhAr èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu jhèbhadhèyuviன ghumAraruDhaiya dhAy avariDhadhdhil vandhu avaraibhbhaNindhu ghòNDhu: uMmiDhadhdhil òru viNNabhbhaM bhaNNaveNDhuM èனRAL.

avar avaLai noghghi: uனghghu èனன veNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAr. adhaRghu avaL: uMmuDhaiya rAjyadhdhile èன ghumArarAghiya ivviraNDhubheril òruvaன umadhu valadhu bhArijhadhdhiluM, òruvaன umadhu iDhadhubhArijhadhdhiluM uDhghArndhirughghuMbhaDhi aruL jhèyyaveNDhuM èனRAL.

iyejhu bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: nI~NghaL gheDhDhughghòLLughiRadhu iனனdhu èனRu u~NghaLughghudh dhèriyavillai. nAன ghuDhighghuM bhAdhdhiradhdhil nI~NghaL ghuDhighghavuM, nAன bhèRuM snAனdhdhai nI~NghaL bhèRavuM ghUDhumA èனRAr. adhaRghu avarghaL ghUDhuM èனRArghaL.

avar avarghaLai noghghi: èன bhAdhdhiradhdhil nI~NghaL ghuDhibhbhIrghaL, nAன bhèRuM snAனdhdhaiyuM nI~NghaL bhèRuvIrghaL; AனAluM èன valadhu bhArijhadhdhiluM iDhadhu bhArijhadhdhiluM uDhghArndhirughghuMbhaDhi èன bhidhAviனAl èvarghaLughghu AyadhdhaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhirughghiRadho avarghaLughgheyallAmal, maRRòruvarughghuM adhai aruLuvadhu èன ghAriyamalla èனRAr.
maRRa bhadhdhubhbheruM adhaighgheDhDhu, andha iraNDhu jhaghodharar bheriluM èrijhjhalAனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu avarghaLai ghiDhDhavarajhjhaƠίdhu: bhuRajAdhiyAruDhaiya adhighaξrighaL avarghaLai iRumAbhbhAy ALughiRArghaL èனRuM, bhèriyavarghaL avarghaL mel ghaDhiனmAy adhighAra~njhèludhdhughiRArghaL èனRuM, nI~NghaL aRindhirughghiRIrghaL.
u~NghaLughghuLLe abhbhaDhi irughghalAghAdhu; u~NghaLil èvaனAghiluM bhèriyavaனAyirughgha viruMbhiனAl, avaன u~NghaLughghubh bhaNiviDhaighghAraனAyirughghaghghaDhavaன.
u~NghaLil èvaனAghiluM mudhaனmaiyAனvaனAyirughgha viruMbhiனAl, avaன u~NghaLughghu UzhiyaghghAraனAyirughghaghghaDhavaன.
abhbhaDhiye, maனuShaghumAraனuM Uzhiya~NghòLLuMbhaDhi varAmal, Uzhiya~njhèyyavuM, anegharai mIDhghuM bhòruLAghadh dhaMmuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòDhughghavuM vandhAr èனRAr.
avarghaL èrighovilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoghaiyil, dhiraLAன jaன~NghaL avarughghubh bhiன jhèனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu vazhiyarughe uDhghArndhirundha iraNDhu ghuruDhar, iyejhu avvazhiye varughiRAr èனRu gheLvibhbhaDhDhu: ANDhavare, dhAvIdhiன ghumAraனe, è~NghaLughghu ira~NghuM èனRu ghUbhbhiDhDhArghaL.
avarghaL bhejhAdhirughghuMbhaDhi avarghaLai jaன~NghaL adhaDhDhiனArghaL. avarghaLo: dhAvIdhiன ghumAraனe, è~NghaLughghu ira~NghuM èனRu adhighamAygh ghUbhbhiDhDhArghaL.
iyejhu niனRu, avarghaLaidh dhaMmiDhadhdhil azhaidhdhu: nAன u~NghaLughghu èனன jhèyyaveNDhuM èனRirughghiRIrghaL èனRAr.
adhaRghu avarghaL: ANDhavare, è~NghaL ghaNghaLaidh dhiRaghghaveNDhuM èனRArghaL.
iyejhu maனdhurughi, avarghaL ghaNghaLaidh dhòDhDhAr; uDhaனe avarghaL bhArvaiyaDhaindhu, avarughghubh bhiனjhèனRArghaL.
avarghaL èrujhalemughghujh jhamIbhamAyjh jherndhu, òlivamalaighghu arughAன bhèdhbhagheyughghu vandhabhodhu, iyejhuvAனvar jhISharghaLil iraNDhubherai noghghi:

u~NghaLughghu èdhire irughghiRa ghirAmadhdhughghubh bho~NghaL; bhoனvuDhaனe, a~Nghe òru ghazhudhaiyaiyuM adhaனoDhe òru ghuDhDhiyaiyuM ghaDhDhiyirughghagh ghANbhIrghaL; avaighaLai avizhdhdhu èனனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvAru~NghaL.
òruvaன u~NghaLughghu edhAghiluM jhòனனAl: ivaighaL ANDhavarughghu veNDhumèனRu jhòllu~NghaL; uDhaனe avaighaLai aனubhbhiviDhuvAன èனRu jhòlli, avarghaLai aனubhbhiனAr.
idho, uன rAjA jhAndhaghuNamuLLavarAy, ghazhudhaiyiன meluM ghazhudhaighghuDhDhiyAghiya maRiyiனmeluM eRighghòNDhu, uனனiDhadhdhil varughiRAr èனRu jhIyoனghumAradhdhighghujh jhòllu~NghaL èனRu,
dhIrghghadharijhiyiனAl uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhu niRaiveRuMbhaDhi idhèllAM naDhandhadhu.
jhISharghaL bhoy, iyejhu dha~NghaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhiye jhèydhu,
ghazhudhaiyaiyuM ghuDhDhiyaiyuM ghòNDhuvandhu, avaighaL mel dha~NghaL vasdhira~NghaLaibh bhoDhDhu, avarai eRRiனArghaL.
dhiraLAன jaன~NghaL dha~NghaL vasdhira~NghaLai vazhiyile viridhdhArghaL; veRu jhilar maraghghiLaighaLaidh dhaRidhdhu vazhiyile bharabhbhiனArghaL.

muனnaDhabhbhAruM, bhiனnaDhabhbhArumAghiya dhiraLAன jaன~NghaL: dhAvIdhiன ghumAraனughghu ojhaனனA! ghardhdhariன nAmadhdhiனAle varughiRavar sdhodhdhirighghabhbhaDhDhavar, uனனdhadhdhile ojhaனனA èனRu jhòlli ArbhbharidhdhArghaL.
avar èrujhalemughghuL bhiravejhighghaiyil, nagharadhdhAr yAvaruM AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhu, ivar yAr? èனRu vijhAridhdhArghaL.
adhaRghu jaன~NghaL: ghalileyAviluLLa nAjharedhdhilirundhu vandha dhIrghghadharijhiyAghiya iyejhu èனRArghaL.

iyejhu dhevAlayadhdhil bhiravejhidhdhu, Alayadhdhile viRghiRavarghaLuM ghòLLughiRavarghaLumAghiya yAvaraiyuM vèLiyile dhuradhdhi, ghAjhughghAraruDhaiya bhalaghaighaLaiyuM bhuRA viRghiRavarghaLiன Ajhaன~NghaLaiyuM ghavizhdhdhu:
èனனuDhaiya vIDhu jèbhavIDhu èனனbhbhaDhuM èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu; nI~NghaLo adhaigh ghaLLar ghughaiyAghghiனIrghaL èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu, ghuruDharuM jhabhbhANighaLuM dhevAlayadhdhile avariDhadhdhiRghu vandhArghaL, avarghaLaijh jhòsdhamAghghiனAr.
avar jhèydha adhijhaya~NghaLaiyuM, dhAvIdhiன ghumAraனughghu ojhaனனA! èனRu dhevAlayadhdhile ArbhbharighghiRa bhiLLaighaLaiyuM, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM vedhabhAragharuM ghaNDhu, ghobhamaDhaindhu,

avarai noghghi: ivarghaL jhòllughiRadhaigh gheDhghiRIro èனRArghaL. adhaRghu iyejhu: AM, gheDhghiReன. ghuzhandhaighaLuDhaiya vAyiனAluM bhAlagharuDhaiya vAyiனAluM dhudhi uNDhAghuMbhaDhi jhèydhIr èனbhadhai nI~NghaL òrughghAluM vAjhighghavillaiyA èனRAr.
avarghaLaiviDhDhu nagharadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, bhèdhdhAனiyAvughghubh bhoy, a~Nghe irAdhdha~NghiனAr.
ghAlaiyile avar nagharadhdhughghu dhiruMbhi varughaiyil, avarughghubh bhajhi uNDhAyiRRu.

abhbhòzhudhu vazhiyarughe òru adhdhimaradhdhaigh ghaNDhu, adhaனiDhadhdhiR bhoy, adhile ilaighaLaiyaனRi veRòனRaiyuM ghANAmal: iனi òrughghAluM uனனiDhadhdhil ghaனi uNDhAghAdhirughghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAr; uDhaனe adhdhimaraM bhaDhDhubhbhoyiRRu.
jhISharghaL adhaighghaNDhu: indha adhdhimaraM èdhdhaனai jhIghghiramAybh bhaDhDhubh bhoyiRRu! èனRu jhòlli AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhArghaL.

iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL jhandheghabhbhaDhAmal vijhuvAjhamuLLavarghaLAyirundhAl, indha adhdhimaradhdhiRghu jhèydhadhai nI~NghaL jhèyvadhumallAmal, indha malaiyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI bhèyarndhu jhamudhdhiradhdhile dhaLLuNDhubho èனRu jhòனனAluM abhbhaDhiyAghuM èனRu, mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
meluM, nI~NghaL vijhuvAjhamuLLavarghaLAy jèbhadhdhile èvaighaLaigh gheDhbhIrghaLo avaighaLaiyèllAM bhèRuvIrghaL èனRAr.

avar dhevAlayadhdhil vandhu, ubhadhejhaMbhaNNughaiyil, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM jaனdhdhiன mUbhbharuM avariDhadhdhil vandhu: nIr èndha adhighAradhdhiனAl ivaighaLaijh jhèyghiRIr? indha adhighAradhdhai umaghghugh ghòDhudhdhavar yAr? èனRu gheDhDhArghaL.

iyejhu avarghaLughghu bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: nAனuM u~NghaLiDhadhdhil òru ghAriyadhdhaigh gheDhghiReன, adhai èனghghujh jhòlluvIrghaLAனAl, nAனuM iனன adhighAradhdhiனAle ivaighaLaijh jhèyghiReன èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòlluveன.

yovAன ghòDhudhdha snAனM dhevaனAl uNDhAyiRRo? maனuSharAl uNDhAyiRRo? yArAl uNDhAyiRRu? èனRu gheDhDhAr. adhaRghu avarghaL: dhevaனAl uNDhAyiRRu èனRu jhòlvomAனAl, bhiனனai eன avaனai vijhuvAjhighghavillai èனRu naMmaigh gheDhbhAr;
maனuSharAl uNDhAyiRRèனRu jhòlvomAனAl, jaன~NghaLughghubh bhayabhbhaDhughiRoM, èllAruM yovAனaidh dhIrghghadhdharijhi èனRu èNNughiRArghaLe èனRu, dha~NghaLughghuLLe AlojhaனaibhaNNi,
iyejhuvughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: è~NghaLughghudh dhèriyAdhu èனRArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu, avar: nAனuM iனன adhighAradhdhiனAle ivaighaLaijh jhèyghiReனèனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòlleன èனRAr.

AyiனuM u~NghaLughghu èbhbhaDhidhdhoனRughiRadhu? òrumaனuShaனughghu iraNDhu ghumArar irundhArghaL; mUdhdhavaனiDhadhdhil avaன vandhu: maghaனe, nI bhoy iனRaighghu èன dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhil velaijhèy èனRAன.
adhaRghu avaன: mADhDheன èனRAன; AghiluM, bhiனbhu avaன maனsdhAbhabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனAன.
iLaiyavaனiDhadhdhiluM avaன vandhu abhbhaDhiye jhòனனAன; adhaRghu avaன: bhoghiReன aiyA, èனRu jhòlliyuM, bhoghavillai.

ivviruvaril èvaன dhaன dhaghabhbhaனuDhaiya jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhi jhèydhavaன èனRu gheDhDhAr; adhaRghu avarghaL: mUdhdhavaன dhAன èனRArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu, iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: AyaghghAraruM vejhighaLuM u~NghaLughghu muனனe dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil bhiravejhighghiRArghaL èனRu mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

eனèனRAl, yovAன nIdhimArghghamAy u~NghaLiDhadhdhil vandhirundhuM, nI~NghaL avaனai vijhuvAjhighghavillai; AyaghghAraruM vejhighaLumo avaனai vijhuvAjhidhdhArghaL; adhai nI~NghaL ghaNDhuM, avaனai vijhuvAjhighghuMbhaDhiyAghabh bhiனbhAghiluM maனsdhAbhabhbhaDhavillai èனRAr.

veRòru uvamaiyaigh gheLu~NghaL: vIDhDhèjamAனAghiya òru maனuShaன irundhAன, avaன òru dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhai uNDhAghghi, adhaijh jhuRRiluM veliyaDhaidhdhu, adhil òru Alaiyai nADhDhi, ghobhuradhdhaiyuM ghaDhDhi, dhoDhDhaghghArarughghu adhaigh ghudhdhaghaiyAgha viDhDhu, bhuRadhejhadhdhughghubh bhoyirundhAன.
ghaனighAlaM jhamIbhidhdhabhodhu, adhiன ghaனighaLai vA~NghighghòNDhuvaruMbhaDhi dhaன UzhiyaghghAraraidh dhoDhDhaghghArariDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனAன.
dhoDhDhaghghArar andha UzhiyaghghAraraibh bhiDhidhdhu, òruvaனai aDhidhdhu, òruvaனaigh ghòlaijhèydhu, òruvaனaigh ghallèRindhu ghòனRArghaL.
bhiனனuM avaன mundhiனvarghaLiluM adhighamAன veRe UzhiyaghghArarai aனubhbhiனAன; avarghaLaiyuM abhbhaDhiye jhèydhArghaL.
ghaDhaijhiyile avaன: èன ghumAraனughghu a~njhuvArghaL èனRu jhòlli, dhaன ghumAraனai avarghaLiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனAன.
dhoDhDhaghghArar ghumAraனaigh ghaNDhabhodhu: ivaன jhudhandharavALi, ivaனaigh ghòனRu, ivaன jhudhandharadhdhaigh ghaDhDhighghòLLuvoM vAru~NghaL èனRu òruvaroDhòruvar jhòllighghòNDhu;
avaனaibh bhiDhidhdhudh dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhiRghubh bhuRaMbhe dhaLLighghòlai jhèydhArghaL.
abhbhaDhiyirughgha, dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhiன èjamAன varuMbhodhu, andha dhoDhDhaghghArarai èனன jhèyvAன èனRu gheDhDhAr.

adhaRghu avarghaL: andhagh ghòDhiyavaraigh ghòDhumaiyAy azhidhdhu, eRRaghAla~NghaLil dhaனghghugh ghaனighaLaigh ghòDhughghadhdhaghgha veRe dhoDhDhaghghArariDhadhdhil dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhaigh ghudhdhaghaiyAghagh ghòDhubhbhAன èனRArghaL.

iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: vIDhu ghaDhDhughiRavarghaL AghAdhèனRu dhaLLiன ghalle mUlaighghudh dhalaighghallAyiRRu, adhu ghardhdharAle AyiRRu, adhu naMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLughghu AjhjhariyamAyirughghiRadhu èனRu nI~NghaL vedhadhdhil òrughghAluM vAjhighghavillaiyA?
AghaiyAl dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyaM u~NghaLiDhadhdhilirundhu nIghghabhbhaDhDhu, adhaRgheRRa ghaனighaLaidh dharughiRa jaன~NghaLughghugh ghòDhughghabhbhaDhuM.
indhagh ghalliனmel vizhughiRavaன nòRu~NghibhbhovAன; idhu èvaன mel vizhumo avaனai najhughghibhbhoDhuM èனRu nAன u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM, bharijheyaruM avaruDhaiya uvamaighaLaighgheDhDhu, dha~NghaLaighghuRidhdhujh jhòllughiRAr èனRu aRindhu,
avaraibh bhiDhighgha vaghaidheDhiனArghaL; AghiluM jaன~NghaL avaraidh dhIrghghadharijhi èனRu èNNiனbhaDhiyAl avarghaLughghubh bhayandhirundhArghaL.
iyejhu maRubhaDhiyuM avarghaLoDhe uvamaighaLAybh bhejhijh jhòனனdhu èனனvèனRAl:
bharalogharAjyaM dhaன ghumAraனughghugh ghaliyANa~njhèydha òru rAjAvughghu òbhbhAyirughghiRadhu.
azhaighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaLaigh ghaliyANadhdhiRghu varajhjhòlluMbhaDhi avaன dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai aனubhbhiனAன; avarghaLo vara maனdhillAdhirundhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu avaன veRu UzhiyaghghArarai azhaidhdhu: nI~NghaL bhoy, idho, èன virundhai AyadhdhaMbhaNNiனeன, èன èrudhughaLuM ghòzhudhdha jèndhughghaLuM aDhighghabhbhaDhDhadhu, èllAM AyadhdhamAyirughghiRadhu; ghaliyANadhdhiRghu vAru~NghaL èனRu azhaighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaLughghujh jhòllu~NghaLèனRu aனubhbhiனAன.
azhaighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaLo adhai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNi, òruvaன dhaன vayalughghuM, òruvaன dhaன viyAbhAradhdhughghuM bhoyviDhDhArghaL.
maRRavarghaL avaன UzhiyaghghAraraibh bhiDhidhdhu, avamAனbhbhaDhudhdhi, ghòlaijhèydhArghaL.
rAjA adhaigh gheLvibhbhaDhDhu, ghobhamaDhaindhu, dhaன jheனaighaLai aனubhbhi, andhagh ghòlaibhAdhagharai azhidhdhu, avarghaL bhaDhDhaNadhdhaiyuM jhuDhDhèridhdhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu, avaன dhaன UzhiyaghghArarai noghghi: ghaliyANa virundhu AyadhdhamAyirughghiRadhu, azhaighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaLo adhaRghu abhAdhdhirarAybhbhoனArghaL.
AghaiyAl, nI~NghaL vazhijhjhandhighaLile bhoy, ghANabhbhaDhughiRa yAvaraiyuM ghaliyANadhdhiRghu azhaidhdhughghòNDhu vAru~NghaL èனRAன.
andha UzhiyaghghArar bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, vazhighaLile bhoy, dhA~NghaL ghaNDha nallAr bhòllAr yAvaraiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhu vandhArghaL; ghaliyANajhAlai virundhALighaLAl niRaindhadhu.
virundhALighaLaibh bhArghghuMbhaDhi rAjA uLLe bhiravejhidhdhabhodhu, ghaliyANa vasdhiraM dharidhdhirAdha òrumaனuShaனai a~Nghe ghaNDhu:
jhineghidhaனe, nI ghaliyANa vasdhiramillAdhavaனAy i~Nghe èbhbhaDhi vandhAy èனRu gheDhDhAr. adhaRghu avaன bhejhAmalirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu, rAjA bhaNiviDhaighghArarai noghghi: ivaனaigh ghaiyu~NghAluM ghaDhDhighghòNDhubhoy, azhughaiyuM bhaRghaDhibhbhuM uNDhAyirughghiRa bhuRaMbhAன iruLile bhoDhu~NghaL èனRAன.
andhabhbhaDhiye, azhaighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaL aneghar, dhèrindhughghòLLabhbhaDhDhavarghaLo jhilar èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu, bharijheyar bhoy, bhejhjhile avarai aghabhbhaDhudhdhuMbhaDhi yojhaனaibhaNNi,

dha~NghaL jhISharaiyuM erodhiyaraiyuM avariDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனArghaL. avarghaL vandhu: bhodhaghare, nIr jhadhdhiyamuLLavarèனRuM, dhevaனuDhaiya mArghghadhdhaijh jhadhdhiyamAybh bhodhighghiRavarèனRuM, nIr mughadhADhjhiNiyaM illAdhavarAghaiyAl èvaனaighghuRidhdhuM umaghghugh ghavaiyillaiyèனRuM aRindhirughghiRoM.
AdhalAl, umaghghu èbhbhaDhidh dhoனRughiRadhu? irAyaனughghu varighòDhughghiRadhu niyAyamo, allavo? adhai è~NghaLughghujh jhòlluM èனRu gheDhDhArghaL.
iyejhu avarghaL dhurghghuNadhdhai aRindhu: mAyaghghArare, nI~NghaL èனனai eன jhodhighghiRIrghaL?
varighghAjhai èனghghugh ghANbhiyu~NghaL èனRAr; avarghaL òru bhaNadhdhai avariDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvandhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avar: indhajh jhurUbhamuM melèzhudhdhuM yAruDhaiyadhu èனRu gheDhDhAr.
irAyaனuDhaiyadhu èனRArghaL. adhaRghu avar: abhbhaDhiyAனAl, irAyaனuDhaiyadhai irAyaனughghuM, dhevaனuDhaiyadhai dhevaனughghuM jhèludhdhu~NghaL èனRAr.
avarghaL adhaighgheDhDhu AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhu avarai viDhDhubh bhoyviDhDhArghaL.
uyirdhdhèzhudhal illai èனRu jhAdhighghiRa jhadhujheyar aனRaiyadhdhiனM avariDhadhdhil vandhu:
bhodhaghare, òruvaன jhandhAனM illAmal iRandhubhoனAl, avaனuDhaiya jhaghodharaன avaன maனaiviyai vivAghaM bhaNNi, dhaன jhaghodharaனughghujh jhandhAனM uNDhAghghaveNDhuM èனRu mojhe jhòனனAre.
è~NghaLughghuLLe jhaghodharar ezhu bher irundhArghaL; mUdhdhavaன vivAghaMbhaNNi, maridhdhu, jhandhAனmillAdhadhiனAl dhaன maனaiviyaidh dhaன jhaghodharaனughghu viDhDhuviDhDhubhbhoனAன.
abhbhaDhiye iraNDhAM mUனRAM jhaghodharaன mudhal ezhAM jhaghodharaன varaighghuM jhèydhArghaL.

idhu mudhal indhadh dhirADhjhabhbhazharajhadhdhai navamAனdhAy u~NghaLoDheghUDha èன bhidhAviன rAjyadhdhile nAன bhAனM bhaNNuM nAL varaighghuM idhaibh bhAனM bhaNNuvadhillaiyèனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
avarghaL sdhodhdhirabhbhADhDhaibh bhADhiன bhiனbhu, òlivamalaighghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: meybhbhaனai vèDhDhuveன, mandhaiyiன ADhughaL jhidhaRaDhighghabhbhaDhuM èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRabhaDhi, indha irAdhdhiriyile nI~NghaL èllAruM èனனimidhdhaM iDhaRalaDhaivIrghaL.
AghiluM, nAன uyirdhdhèzhundha bhiனbhu, u~NghaLughghu muனனe ghalileyAvughghubh bhoveன èனRAr.
bhedhuru avarughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: umadhunimidhdhaM èllAruM iDhaRalaDhaindhAluM, nAன òrughghAluM iDhaRalaDhaiyeன èனRAன.
iyejhu avaனai noghghi: indha irAdhdhiriyile jheval ghUvughiRadhaRghu muனனe, nI èனனai mUனRu dharaM maRudhalibhbhAy èனRu mèyyAghave uனghghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
adhaRghubh bhedhuru: nAன uMmoDhe marighghaveNDhiyadhAyirundhAluM, uMmai maRudhalighghamADhDheன èனRAன; jhISharghaL èllAruM abhbhaDhiye jhòனனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu, iyejhu avarghaLoDhe ghèdhjhèmaனe èனனbhbhaDhDha iDhadhdhiRghu vandhu, jhISharghaLai noghghi: nAன a~Nghe bhoy jèbhaMbhaNNumaLavuM nI~NghaL i~Nghe uDhghArndhiru~NghaL èனRu jhòlli;
bhedhuruvaiyuM, jhèbhadheyuviன ghumArar iruvaraiyuM ghUDhDhighghòNDhubhoy, dhughghamaDhaiyavuM, viyAghulabhbhaDhavuM dhòDha~NghiனAr.
abhbhòzhudhu, avar: èன AdhdhumA maraNadhdhughghedhuvAன dhughgha~NghòNDhirughghiRadhu; nI~NghaL i~Nghe dha~Nghi, èனனoDhe ghUDha vizhidhdhiru~NghaL èனRu jhòlli;

jhaRRu abhbhuRaMbhoy, mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhu: èன bhidhAve, indhabhbhAdhdhiraM èனனaiviDhDhu nI~NghaghghUDhumAனAl nI~NghuMbhaDhijhèyyuM; AghiluM èன jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiyalla, uMmuDhaiya jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiye AghaghghaDhavadhu èனRu jèbhaMbhaNNiனAr.
bhiனbhu, avar jhISharghaLiDhadhdhil vandhu, avarghaL nidhdhiraibhaNNughiRadhaighghaNDhu, bhedhuruvai noghghi: nI~NghaL òru maNi neramAvadhu èனனoDheghUDha vizhidhdhirughghaghghUDhAdhA?
nI~NghaL jhodhaனaighghuDhbhaDhAdhabhaDhighghu vizhidhdhirundhu jèbhaMbhaNNu~NghaL; Avi uRjhAghamuLLadhudhAன, mAMjhamo bhalavIனmuLLadhu èனRAr.

avar maRubhaDhiyuM iraNDhAndharaM bhoy: èன bhidhAve, indhabh bhAdhdhiradhdhil nAன bhAனMbhaNNiனAlòzhiya idhu èனனai viDhDhu nI~NghaghghUDhAdhAghil, uMmuDhaiya jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhi AghaghghaDhavadhu èனRu jèbhaMbhaNNiனAr.
avar dhiruMbha vandhabhodhu, avarghaL maRubhaDhiyuM, nidhdhiraibhaNNughiRadhaigh ghaNDhAr; avarghaLuDhaiya ghaNghaL mighundha nidhdhiraimayaghghaM aDhaindhirundhadhu.
avar maRubhaDhiyuM avarghaLaiviDhDhubh bhoy, mUனRAndharamuM andha vArdhdhaighaLaiye jhòlli jèbhaMbhaNNiனAr.
bhiனbhu avar dhaMmuDhaiya jhISharghaLiDhadhdhil vandhu: iனi nidhdhiraibhaNNi iLaibhbhARu~NghaL; idho, maனuShaghumAraன bhAvighaLuDhaiya ghaighaLil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhughiRa veLaivandhadhu.
èனனaigh ghADhDhighghòDhughghiRavaன, idho, vandhuviDhDhAன, èzhundhiru~NghaL bhovoM èனRAr.

avar ibhbhaDhibh bhejhughaiyil, bhaனனiruvaril òruvaனAghiya yUdhAs vandhAன; avaனoDhe ghUDhabh bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM jaனdhdhiன mUbhbharuM aனubhbhiன dhiraLAன jaன~NghaL bhaDhDhaya~NghaLaiyuM, dhaDhighaLaiyuM bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu vandhArghaL.
avaraigh ghADhDhighghòDhughghiRavaன: nAன èvaனai mudhdha~njhèyveனo avaனdhAன, avaனaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòLLu~NghaL èனRu avarghaLughghu aDhaiyALaM jhòlliyirundhAன.
uDhaனe, avaன iyejhuviனiDhadhdhil vandhu: rabhI, vAzhgha èனRu jhòlli, avarai mudhdha~njhèydhAன.
iyejhu avaனai noghghi: jhineghidhaனe èனனdhdhiRghAgha vandhirughghiRAy èனRAr. abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL ghiDhDha vandhu, iyejhuviன mel ghaibhoDhDhu, avaraibh bhiDhidhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhuvoDhirundhavarghaLil òruvaன ghainIDhDhidh dhaன bhaDhDhayadhdhai uruvi, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனuDhaiya velaighghAraனaigh ghAdhaRa vèDhDhiனAன.
abhbhòzhudhu, iyejhu avaனai noghghi: uன bhaDhDhayadhdhai dhiruMbha adhiன uRaiyile bhoDhu; bhaDhDhayadhdhai èDhughghiRa yAvaruM bhaDhDhayadhdhAl maDhindhu bhovArghaL.
nAன ibhbhòzhudhu èன bhidhAvai veNDhighghòNDhAl, avar bhaனனiraNDhu leghiyoனughghu adhighamAன dhUdharai èனனiDhadhdhil aனubhbhamADhDhArèனRu niனaighghiRAyA?
abhbhaDhijh jhèyveனAனAl, ivvidhamAyjh jhaMbhavighghaveNDhuM èனghiRa vedhavAghghiya~NghaL èbhbhaDhi niRaiveRuM èனRAr.

andha veLaiyile iyejhu jaன~NghaLai noghghi: ghaLLaனaibh bhiDhighghabh bhuRabhbhaDhughiRadhu bhola, nI~NghaL bhaDhDhaya~NghaLaiyuM dhaDhighaLaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhu èனனaibh bhiDhighghavandhIrghaL; nAன dhiனndhoRuM u~NghaL naDhuvile uDhghArndhu dhevAlayadhdhil ubhadhejhaMbhaNNighghòNDhirundheன; abhbhòzhudhu, nI~NghaL èனனaibh bhiDhighghavillaiye.
AghiluM dhIrghghadharijhighaL èzhudhiyirughghiRa vajhaன~NghaL niRaiveRuMbhaDhi ivaighaLèllAM jhaMbhavighghiRadhu èனRAr. abhbhòzhudhu, jhISharghaLèllAruM avaraiviDhDhu oDhibhbhoனArghaL.
iyejhuvaibhbhiDhidhdhavarghaL avaraibh bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனAghiya ghAybhAviனiDhadhdhiRghugh ghòNDhubhoனArghaL; a~Nghe vedhabhAragharuM mUbhbharuM ghUDhivandhirundhArghaL.
bhedhuru, dhUradhdhile avarughghubh bhiனjhèனRu, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனuDhaiya aramaனaivaraighghuM vandhu, uLLe bhiravejhidhdhu, muDhivaibhbhArghghuMbhaDhi jhevagharoDhe uDhghArndhAன.
bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM mUbhbharuM jha~NghadhdhAr yAvaruM iyejhuvaigh ghòlaijhèyyuMbhaDhi avarughghu virodhamAybh bhòyjhjhADhjhi dheDhiனArghaL.
òruvaruM aghabhbhaDhavillai; aneghar vandhu bhòy jhADhjhi jhòlliyuM avarghaL jhADhjhi òvvavillai; ghaDhaijhiyile iraNDhu bhòyjhADhjhighaL vandhu:
dhevaனuDhaiya Alayadhdhai iDhidhdhubhbhoDhavuM, mUனRu nALaighghuLLe adhaigh ghaDhDhavuM èனனAle AghuM èனRAன èனRu ivaன jhòனனAன èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaன èzhundhirundhu, avarai noghghi: ivarghaL uனghghu virodhamAy jhADhjhi jhòllughiRadhaighghuRidhdhu nI òனRuM jhòllughiRadhillaiyA èனRAன.

iyejhuvo bhejhAmalirundhAr. abhbhòzhudhu, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaன avarai noghghi: nI dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya ghiRisdhudhAனA? adhai è~NghaLughghujh jhòlluMbhaDhi jIvaனuLLa dhevaனbheril uனனai ANaiyiDhDhugh gheDhghiReன èனRAன.

adhaRghu iyejhu: nIr jhòனனbhaDhidhAன; aனRiyuM maனuShaghumAraன jharva vallavaruDhaiya valadhu bhArijhadhdhil vIRRirubhbhadhaiyuM vAனdhdhiன megha~NghaLmel varuvadhaiyuM idhumudhal ghANbhIrghaLèனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu bhiradhAன AjhAriyaன dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòNDhu: ivaன dhevadhUShaNaM jhòனனAன; iனijh jhADhjhighaL namaghghu veNDhiyadhèனன? idho ivaன dhUShaNadhdhai ibhbhòzhudhu gheDhDhIrghaLe.
u~NghaLughghu èனனmAydh dhoனRughiRadhèனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu avarghaL: maraNadhdhughghubh bhAdhdhiraனAyirughghiRAன èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu, avaruDhaiya mughadhdhil dhubhbhi, avaraigh ghuDhDhiனArghaL; jhilar avaraigh ghaனனdhdhil aRaindhu:
ghiRisdhuve, uMmai aDhidhdhavaன yAr? adhai ~nAனdhiruShDhiyiனAl è~NghaLughghujh jhòlluM èனRArghaL.
adhdharuNadhdhil bhedhuru vèLiye vandhu aramaனai muRRadhdhil uDhghArndhirundhAன. abhbhòzhudhu, velaighghAri òrudhdhi avaனiDhadhdhil vandhu: nIyuM ghalileyaனAghiya iyejhuvoDhe ghUDha irundhAy èனRAL.
adhaRghu avaன: nI jhòllughiRadhu èனghghudh dhèriyAdhu èனRu èllArughghuM muனbhAgha maRudhalidhdhAன.
avaன, vAjhal maNDhabhadhdhiRghubh bhoனbhòzhudhu veRòrudhdhi avaனaigh ghaNDhu: ivaனuM najhareனAghiya iyejhuvoDhe ghUDha irundhAன èனRu a~Nghe irundhavarghaLughghujh jhòனனAL.
avaனo: andha maனuShaனai nAன aRiyeன èனRu ANaiyiDhDhu, maRubhaDhiyuM maRudhalidhdhAன.
jhaRRu neradhdhiRghubhiனbhu a~Nghe niனRavarghaL bhedhuruviனiDhadhdhil vandhu: mèyyAghave nIyuM avarghaLil òruvaன; uன bhejhjhu uனனai vèLibhbhaDhudhdhughiRadhu èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avaன: andha maனuShaனai aRiyeன èனRu jhòlli, jhabhighghavuM jhadhdhiyaMbhaNNavuM dhòDha~NghiனAன. uDhaனe jheval ghUviRRu.
abhbhòzhudhu bhedhuru: jheval ghUvughiRadhaRghu muனனe, nI èனனai mUனRu dharaM maRudhalibhbhAy èனRu iyejhu dhaனனiDhadhdhil jhòனன vajhaனdhdhai niனaidhdhughòNDhu, vèLiye bhoy, maன~Nghajhandhu azhudhAன.
viDhiyaRghAlamAனbhodhu, jhaghala bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM jaனdhdhiன mUbhbharuM, iyejhuvaigh ghòlaijhèyyuMbhaDhi, avarughghu virodhamAgha AlojhaனaibhaNNi,
avaraigh ghaDhDhi, ghòNDhubhoy, dhejhAdhibhadhiyAghiya bhòndhiyu bhilAdhdhuviனiDhadhdhil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu, avaraigh ghADhDhighghòDhudhdha yUdhAs, avar maraNAghghiனaighghuLLAghadh dhIrghghabhbhaDhDhadhaigh ghaNDhu, maனsdhAbhabhbhaDhDhu, andha mubhbhadhu vèLLighghAjhaibh bhiradhAன AjhAriyadhdhiDhadhdhiRghuM mUbhbhariDhadhdhiRghuM dhiruMbhagh ghòNDhuvandhu:
ghuRRamillAdha iradhdhadhdhai nAன ghADhDhighghòDhudhdhadhiனAl bhAva~njhèydheன èனRAன. adhaRghu avarghaL: è~NghaLughghèனன, adhu uனbhADhu èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu, avaன andha vèLLighghAjhai dhevAlayadhdhile èRindhuviDhDhu, bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, nAனRughòNDhu jhèdhdhAன.
bhiradhAன AjhAriyar andha vèLLighghAjhai èDhudhdhu: idhu iradhdhaghghirayamAனdhAl, ghANighghaibh bhèDhDhiyile idhaibhbhoDhalAghAdhèனRu jhòlli,
AlojhaனaibhaNNiன bhiனbhu, anniyarai aDhaghghaMbhaNNuvadhaRghugh ghuyavaனuDhaiya niladhdhai adhiனAle ghòNDhArghaL.
idhiனimidhdhaM andha nilaM innAL varaighghuM iradhdhanilaM èனனbhbhaDhughiRadhu.
isravel bhudhdhirarAl madhighghabhbhaDhDhavarughghugh ghirayamAghiya mubhbhadhu vèLLighghAjhai avarghaL èDhudhdhu,
ghardhdhar èனghghugh ghaRbhidhdhabhaDhi ghuyavaனuDhaiya niladhdhiRghAgha adhaigh ghòDhudhdhArghaL èனRu èremiyA dhIrghghadharijhiyiனAl uraighghabhbhaDhDhadhu abhbhòzhudhu niRaiveRiRRu.
iyejhu dhejhAdhibhadhighghu muனbhAgha niனRAr; dhejhAdhibhadhi avarai noghghi nI yUdharuDhaiya rAjAvA èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu iyejhu: nIr jhòllughiRabhaDhidhAன èனRAr.
bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM mUbhbharuM avarmel ghuRRa~njhADhDhughaiyil, avar mARudhdharaM òனRuM jhòllavillai.
abhbhòzhudhu, bhilAdhdhu avarai noghghi: ivarghaL uனmel èdhdhaனaiyo ghuRRa~NghaLaijh jhADhDhughiRArghaLe, nI avaighaLaigh gheDhghavillaiyA èனRAன.
avaro òru vArdhdhaiyuM mARudhdharamAghajh jhòllavillai; adhaனAl dhejhAdhibhadhi mighavuM AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhAன.

ghAvalbhaNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaLil èvaனai viDhudhalaiyAghghaveNDhumèனRu jaன~NghaL gheDhDhughghòLvArghaLo, avaனai avarghaLughghAgha viDhudhalaiyAghghuvadhu bhaNDhighaidhoRuM dhejhAdhibhadhighghu vazhaghghamAyirundhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu ghAval bhaNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaLil bharabhAs èனனbhbhaDhDha bherbhoன òruvaன irundhAன.
bhòRAmaiyiனAle avarai òbhbhughghòDhudhdhArghaL èனRu bhilAdhdhu aRindhu,
avarghaL ghUDhiyirughghaiyil, avarghaLai noghghi: èvaனai nAன u~NghaLughghu viDhudhalaiyAghghaveNDhumèனRirughghiRIrghaL? bharabhAjhaiyo? ghiRisdhu èனனbhbhaDhughiRa iyejhuvaiyo? èனRu gheDhDhAன.

avaன niyAyAjhaனdhdhil uDhghArndhirughghaiyil, avaனuDhaiya maனaivi avaனiDhadhdhil ALaனubhbhi: nIr andha nIdhimAனai òனRuM jhèyyaveNDhAM; avar nimidhdhaM iனRaighghujh jhòbhbhaனdhdhil vèghu bhADhubhaDhDheன èனRu jhòllajh jhòனனAL.
bharabhAjhai viDhDhuviDhagh gheDhDhughghòLLavuM, iyejhuvai ghòlaijhèyvighghavuM bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM mUbhbharuM jaன~NghaLai eviviDhDhArghaL.
dhejhAdhibhadhi jaன~NghaLai noghghi: ivviruvaril èvaனai nAன u~NghaLughghAgha viDhudhalaiyAghghaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu avarghaL: bharabhAjhai èனRArghaL.
bhilAdhdhu avarghaLai noghghi: abhbhaDhiyAனAl, ghiRisdhu èனனbhbhaDhughiRa iyejhuvai nAன èனன jhèyyaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAன. avaனaijh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyaveNDhuM èனRu èllAruM jhòனனArghaL.
dhejhAdhibhadhiyo: eன, èனன bhòllAbhbhujh jhèydhAன èனRAன. adhaRghu avarghaL: avaனaijh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyaveNDhuM èனRu adhighamadhighamAygh ghUghghuraliDhDhujh jhòனனArghaL.

ghalaghaM adhighamAghiRadheyallAmal dhaன bhirayadhdhaனdhdhiனAle bhirayojaனmillaiyèனRu bhilAdhdhu ghaNDhu, dhaNNIrai aLLi, jaன~NghaLughghu muனbhAghagh ghaighaLaighghazhuvi: indha nIdhimAனuDhaiya iradhdhabhbhazhighghu nAன ghuRRamaRRavaன nI~NghaLe bhArdhdhughghòLLu~NghaL èனRAன.
adhaRghu jaன~NghaLèllAruM: ivaனuDhaiya iradhdhabhbhazhi è~NghaL meluM è~NghaL bhiLLaighaL meluM irubhbhadhAgha èனRu jhòனனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu, avaன bharabhAjhai avarghaLughghu viDhudhalaiyAghghi, iyejhuvaiyo vAriனAl aDhibhbhidhdhu, jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuMbhaDhighghu òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu, dhejhAdhibhadhiyiன bhorjhjhevaghar iyejhuvaidh dhejhAdhibhadhiyiன aramaனaiyile ghòNDhubhoy, bhorjhjhevaghariன ghUDhDhaM muzhuvadhaiyuM avariDhadhdhil ghUDhivarajhjhèydhu,
avar vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghazhaRRi, jhivabhbhAன mela~Nghiyai avarughghu uDhudhdhi,

muLLughaLAl òru muDhiyaibh bhiனனi, avar jhirajhiனmel vaidhdhu, avar valadhughaiyil òru gholaighghòDhudhdhu, avar muனbhAgha muzha~NghARbhaDhiyiDhDhu: yUdharuDhaiya rAjAve, vAzhgha èனRu avaraibh bhariyAjhaMbhaNNi,
avarmel dhubhbhi, andhagh gholai èDhudhdhu, avaraijh jhirajhil aDhidhdhArghaL.
avaraibh bhariyAjhaMbhaNNiனbhiனbhu, avarughghu uDhudhdhiன mela~Nghiyaigh ghazhaRRi, avaruDhaiya vasdhira~NghaLai avarughghu uDhudhdhi, avaraijh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuMbhaDhi ghòNDhubhoனArghaL.
bhoghaiyil jhireனe UrAனAghiya jhImoன èனனbhbhaDhDha òru maனuShaனai avarghaL ghaNDhu, avaruDhaiya jhiluvaiyaijh jhumaghghuMbhaDhi avaனaibh bhalavandhaM bhaNNiனArghaL.
ghabhAlasdhalaM èனRu ardhdha~NghòLLuM ghòlghòdhA èனனuM iDhadhdhughghu avarghaL vandhabhodhu,
ghajhabhbhughghalandha ghADhiyai avarughghugh ghuDhighghagh ghòDhudhdhArghaL; avar adhai rujhibhArdhdhu, ghuDhighgha maனdhillAdhirundhAr.

bhiனbhu, avar bhuRabhbhaDhDhu vazhiyile bhoghaiyil, òruvaன oDhivandhu, avarughghu muனbhAgha muzha~NghAlbhaDhiyiDhDhu: nalla bhodhaghare nidhdhiya jIvaனaijh jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLuMbhaDhi nAன èனனjhèyyaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAன;
adhaRghu iyejhu: nI èனனai nallavaன èனRu jhòlvAனeன? dhevaன òruvar dhavira nallavaன òruvaனumillaiye;

vibhajhAra~njhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha, ghòlai jhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha, ghaLavu jhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha, bhòyjhjhADhjhi jhòllAdhirubhbhAyAgha, va~njhaனai jhèyyAdhirubhbhAyAgha, uன dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM uன dhAyaiyuM ghaனMbhaNNuvAyAgha èனghiRa ghaRbhaனaighaLai aRindhirughghiRAye èனRAr.
adhaRghu avaன: bhodhaghare, ivaighaLaiyèllAM èன jhiRu vayadhumudhal ghaighghòNDhirughghiReன èனRAன.

iyejhu avaனaibh bhArdhdhu, avaனiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrndhu: uனனiDhadhdhil òru ghuRaivu uNDhu; nI bhoy, uனghghu uNDhAனvaighaLaiyèllAM viRRu, dharidhdhirarughghugh ghòDhu, abhbhòzhudhu bharaloghadhdhile uனghghubh bhòghghiShaM uNDhAyirughghuM; bhiனbhu jhiluvaiyai èDhudhdhughghòNDhu èனனaibh bhiனbhaRRivA èனRAr.
avaன mighundha AsdhiyuLLavaனAyirundhabhaDhiyAl, indha vArdhdhaiyaigh gheDhDhu, maனmaDhindhu, dhughghadhdhoDhe bhoyviDhDhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu jhuRRibhbhArdhdhu, dhaMmuDhaiya jhISharai noghghi: aijhuvariyamuLLavarghaL dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil bhiravejhighghiRadhu èvvaLavu aridhAyirughghiRadhu èனRAr.

jhISharghaL avaruDhaiya vArdhdhaighaLaighghuRidhdhu AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhArghaL. iyejhu bhiனனuM avarghaLai noghghi: bhiLLaighaLe, aijhuvariyadhdhiனmel naMbhighghaiyAyirughghiRavarghaL dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil bhiravejhibhbhadhu èvvaLavu aridhAyirughghiRadhu!
aijhuvariyavAன dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil bhiravejhibhbhadhaibhbhArghghiluM, òDhDhaghamAனdhu Ujhiyiன ghAdhile nuzhaivadhu èLidhAyirughghuM èனRAr.
avarghaL bhiனனuM adhighamAy AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhu: abhbhaDhiyAனAl yAr iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhaghghUDhuM èனRu dha~NghaLughghuLe jhòllighghòNDhArghaL.
iyejhu avarghaLaibh bhArdhdhu: maனuSharAl idhu ghUDhAdhadhudhAன; dhevaனAl idhu ghUDhAdhadhalla; dhevaனAle èllAM ghUDhuM èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu bhedhuru avarai noghghi: idho, nA~NghaL èllAvaRRaiyuM viDhDhu, uMmaibh bhiனbhaRRiனome, èனRu jhòlladhdhòDha~NghiனAன.

adhaRghu iyejhu bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: èனனimidhdhimAghavuM, jhuvijheShadhdhiனimidhdhamAghavuM, vIDhDhaiyAvadhu, jhaghodhararaiyAvadhu, jhaghodharighaLaiyAvadhu, dhaghabhbhaனaiyAvadhu, dhAyaiyAvadhu, maனaiviyaiyAvadhu, bhiLLaighaLaiyAvadhu, nila~NghaLaiyAvadhu viDhDhavaன èvaனuM,

ibhbhòzhudhu iMmaiyile, dhuனbha~NghaLoDheghUDha nURadhdhaனaiyAgha, vIDhughaLaiyuM, jhaghodhararaiyuM, jhaghodharighaLaiyuM, dhAyghaLaiyuM, bhiLLaighaLaiyuM, nila~NghaLaiyuM, maRumaiyile nidhdhiya jIvaனaiyuM aDhaivAன èனRu mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
AghiluM mundhiனor aneghar bhindhiனorAyuM, bhindhiனor aneghar mundhiனorAyuM irubhbhArghaL èனRAr.

bhiனbhu avarghaL èrujhalemughghubh bhirayANamAybhbhoghaiyil, iyejhu avarghaLughghu muனனe naDhandhu bhoனAr; avarghaL dhighaidhdhu, avarughghubh bhiனனe, bhayadhdhoDhe bhoனArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu avar bhaனனiruvaraiyuM azhaidhdhu, dhamaghghujh jhaMbhavighghabhbhoghiRavaighaLai avarghaLughghu maRubhaDhiyuM jhòlladhdhòDha~NghiனAr:

idho, èrujhalemughghubhbhoghiRoM; a~Nghe maனuShaghumAraன bhiradhAன AjhAriyariDhadhdhiluM vedhabhAraghariDhadhdhiluM òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhuvAr; avarghaL avarai maraNa AghghiனaighghuLLAghadh dhIrdhdhu, bhuRadhdhejhadhdhAriDhadhdhil òbhbhughghòDhubhbhArghaL.
avarghaL avaraibh bhariyAjhaMbhaNNi, avarai vAriனAl aDhidhdhu, avarmel dhubhbhi, avaraigh ghòlaijhèyvArghaL; AghiluM mUனRAM nALile avar uyiroDhe èzhundhirubhbhAr èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu jhèbhèdheyuviன ghumArarAghiya yAghghobhuM yovAனuM avariDhadhdhil vandhu: bhodhaghare, nA~NghaL gheDhDhughghòLLabhbhoghiRadhai nIr è~NghaLughghujh jhèyyaveNDhumèனRu viruMbhughiRoM èனRArghaL.
avar avarghaLai noghghi: nAன u~NghaLughghu èனனjhèyyaveNDhumèனRu viruMbhughiRIrghaL èனRu gheDhDhAr.
adhaRghu avarghaL: umadhu maghimaiyile, è~NghaLil òruvaன umadhu valadhu bhArijhadhdhiluM, òruvaன umadhu iDhadhubhArijhadhdhiluM uDhghArndhirughghuMbhaDhi aruL jhèyyaveNDhuM èனRArghaL.

iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL gheDhDhughghòLLughiRadhu iனனdhu èனRu u~NghaLughghe dhèriyavillai. nAன ghuDhighghuM bhAdhdhiradhdhil nI~NghaL ghuDhighghavuM, nAன bhèRuM snAனdhdhai nI~NghaL bhèRavuM, u~NghaLAl ghUDhumA èனRAr.
adhaRghu avarghaL: ghUDhuM èனRArghaL. iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: nAன ghuDhighghuM bhAdhdhiradhdhil nI~NghaL ghuDhibhbhIrghaL, nAன bhèRuM snAனdhdhaiyuM nI~NghaL bhèRuvIrghaL.

AனAluM èன valadhu bhArijhadhdhiluM èன iDhadhu bhArijhadhdhiluM uDhghArndhirughghuMbhaDhi èvarghaLughghu AyadhdhaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhirughghiRadho avarghaLughgheyallAmal, maRRòruvarughghuM adhai aruLuvadhu èன ghAriyamalla èனRAr.
maRRabh bhadhdhubhbheruM adhaighgheDhDhu, yAghghobhiன meluM yovAனiன meluM èrijhjhalAனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu avarghaLaigh ghiDhDhavarajhjhèydhu: bhuRajAdhiyArughghu adhighArighaLAgha èNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaL avarghaLai iRumAbhbhAy ALughiRArghaL èனRuM, avarghaLil bhèriyavarghaL avarghaL mel ghaDhiனmAy adhighAraM jhèludhdhughiRArghaL èனRuM, nI~NghaL aRindhirughghiRIrghaL.
u~NghaLughghuLLe abhbhaDhi irughghalAghAdhu; u~NghaLil èvaனAghiluM bhèriyavaனAyirughgha viruMbhiனAl, avaன u~NghaLughghubh bhaNiviDhaighghAraனAyirughghaghghaDhavaன.
u~NghaLil èvaனAghiluM mudhaனmaiyAனvaனAyirughgha viruMbhiனAl, avaன èllArughghuM UzhiyaghghAraனAyirughghaghghaDhavaன.
abhbhaDhiye, maனuShaghumAraனuM Uzhiya~NghòLLuMbhaDhi varAmal, Uzhiya~njhèyyuvuM, anegharai mIDhghuMbhòruLAghadh dhaMmuDhaiya jIvaனaighghòDhughghavuM vandhAr èனRAr.

bhiனbhu avarghaL èrighovughghu vandhArghaL. avaruM avaruDhaiya jhISharghaLuM dhiraLAன jaன~NghaLuM èrighovaiviDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhughiRabhodhu, dhimeyuviன maghaனAghiya bhardhimeyu èனghiRa òru ghuruDhaன, vazhiyarughe uDhghArndhu, bhijhjhai gheDhDhughghòNDhirundhAன.
avaன najhareyaனAghiya iyejhu varughiRArèனRu gheLvibhbhaDhDhu: iyejhuve, dhAvIdhiன ghumAraனe, èனghghu ira~NghuM èனRu ghUbhbhiDhadhdhòDha~NghiனAன.
avaன bhejhAdhirughghuMbhaDhi aneghar avaனai adhaDhDhiனArghaL. avaனo: dhAvIdhiன ghumAraனe, èனghghu ira~NghuM èனRu muனனiluM adhighamAygh ghUbhbhiDhDhAன.
iyejhu niனRu, avaனai azhaidhdhu varajhjhòனனAr. avarghaL andhagh ghuruDhaனai azhaidhdhu: dhiDhaனghòL, èzhundhiru, uனனai azhaighghiRAr èனRArghaL.
uDhaனe avaன dhaன mel vasdhiradhdhai èRindhuviDhDhu, èzhundhu, iyejhuviனiDhadhdhil vandhAன.
iyejhu avaனai noghghi: nAன uனghghu èனனjhèyyaveNDhuM èனRirughghiRAy èனRAr. adhaRghu andhagh ghuruDhaன: ANDhavare, nAன bhArvaiyaDhaiyaveNDhuM èனRAன.
iyejhu avaனai noghghi: nI bhoghalAM, uன vijhuvAjhaM uனனai iraDhjhidhdhadhu èனRAr. uDhaனe avaன bhArvaiyaDhaindhu, vazhiyile iyejhuvughghubh bhiனjhèனRAன.
avarghaL èrujhalemughghujh jhamIbhamAyjh jherndhu, òlivamalaighghu arughAன bhèdhbhaghe bhèdhdhAனiyA èனனuM UrghaLughghu vandhabhodhu, avar dhaMmuDhaiya jhISharghaLil iraNDhubherai noghghi:

u~NghaLughghu èdhireyirughghiRa ghirAmadhdhughghubh bho~NghaL; adhil bhiravejhidhdhavuDhaனe, maனuShar òruvaruM òrughghAluM eRiyirAdha òru ghazhudhaighghuDhDhi ghaDhDhiyirughghagh ghANbhIrghaL, adhai avizhdhdhugh ghòNDhuvAru~NghaL.
eன ibhbhaDhijhjhèyghiRIrghaL èனRu òruvaன u~NghaLiDhadhdhil gheDhDhAl: idhu ANDhavarughghu veNDhumèனRu jhòllu~NghaL; uDhaனe adhai ivviDhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiviDhuvAன èனRu jhòlli, avarghaLai aனubhbhiனAr.
avarghaL bhoy, vèLiye iruvazhijhjhandhiyil òru vAjhalarughe ghaDhDhiyirundha andhagh ghuDhDhiyaighghaNDhu, adhai avizhdhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu a~Nghe niனRavarghaLil jhilar: nI~NghaL ghuDhDhiyai avizhghghiRadhu èனனvèனRArghaL.
iyejhu ghaRbhidhdhabhaDhiye avarghaLughghu udhdharavu jhòனனArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu avarghaLaibh bhoghaviDhDhArghaL.
avarghaL andhagh ghuDhDhiyai iyejhuviனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvandhu, adhiன mel dha~NghaL vasdhira~NghaLaibh bhoDhDhArghaL; avar adhiனmel eRibhbhoனAr.
aneghar dha~NghaL vasdhira~NghaLai vazhiyile viridhdhArghaL; veRu jhilar maraghghiLaighaLaidh dhaRidhdhu vazhiyile bharabhbhiனArghaL.
muனnaDhabhbhAruM, bhiனnaDhabhbhAruM: ojhaனனA! ghardhdhariன nAmadhdhiனAle varughiRavar sdhodhdhirighghabhbhaDhDhavar,
ghardhdhariன nAmadhdhiனAle varughiRa naMmuDhaiya bhidhAvAghiya dhAvIdhiன rAjyaM AjhIrvadhighghabhbhaDhuvadhAgha; uனனdhadhdhile ojhaனனA èனRu jhòlli ArbhbharidhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu, iyejhu èrujhalemughghu vandhu, dhevAlayadhdhil bhiravejhidhdhu, èllAvaRRaiyuM jhuRRibhbhArdhdhu: jhAya~NghAlamAனbhodhu, bhaனனiruvaroDhu~NghUDhabh bhèdhdhAனiyAvughghubh bhoனAr.
maRunALile avarghaL bhèdhdhAனiyAvilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvarughaiyil, avarughghubh bhajhiyuNDhAyiRRu.

abhbhòzhudhu ilaighaLuLLa òru adhdhimaradhdhaidh dhUradhdhile ghaNDhu, adhil edhAghiluM aghabhbhaDhumo èனRu bhArghghavandhAr. adhdhibhbhazhaghghAlamAyirAdhabhaDhiyAl, avar adhiனiDhadhdhil vandhabhodhu ilaighaLaiyallAmal, veRòனRaiyuM ghANavillai.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu adhaibhbhArdhdhu: idhumudhal òrughghAluM òruvaனuM uனனiDhadhdhil ghaனiyaibh bhujhiyAdhirughghaDhavaன èனRAr; adhai avaruDhaiya jhISharghaL gheDhDhArghaL.

avarghaL èrujhalemughghu vandhArghaL. iyejhu dhevAlayadhdhil bhiravejhidhdhu, Alayadhdhil viRghiRavarghaLaiyuM ghòLLughiRavarghaLaiyuM dhuradhdhiviDhDhu, ghAjhughghAraruDhaiya bhalaghaighaLaiyuM, bhuRA viRghiRavarghaLuDhaiya Ajhaன~NghaLaiyuM ghavizhdhdhu,
òruvaனuM dhevAlayadhdhiன vazhiyAgha yAdhòru bhaNDhadhdhaiyuM ghòNDhubhoghaviDhAmal:
èனனuDhaiya vIDhu èllA jaன~NghaLughghuM jèbhavIDhu èனனbhbhaDhuM èனRu èzhudhiyirughghavillaiyA? nI~NghaLo adhaigh ghaLLar ghughaiyAghghiனIrghaL èனRu avarghaLughghujh jhòlli ubhadhejhidhdhAr.

adhai vedhabhAragharuM bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM gheDhDhu, avaraigh ghòlai jhèyya vaghaidheDhiனArghaL; AghiluM jaன~NghaLèllAruM avaruDhaiya ubhadhejhadhdhaighghuRidhdhu AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhabhaDhiyiனAle avarughghubh bhayandhirundhArghaL.
jhAya~NghAlamAனbhodhu, avar nagharadhdhilirundhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAr.
maRunAL ghAlaiyile avarghaL avvazhiyAybh bhoghuMbhodhu, andha adhdhimaraM veroDhe bhaDhDhubhbhoyirughghiRadhaigh ghaNDhArghaL.
bhedhuru niனaivughUrndhu avarai noghghi: rabhI, idho, nIr jhabhidhdha adhdhimaraM bhaDhDhubhbhoyiRRu èனRAன.
iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: dhevaனiDhadhdhil vijhuvAjhamuLLavarghaLAyiru~NghaL.

èvaனAghiluM indha malaiyaibh bhArdhdhu: nI bhèyarndhu, jhamudhdhiradhdhile dhaLLuNDhubho èனRu jhòlli, dhAன jhòனனbhaDhiye naDhaghghuM èனRu dhaன irudhayadhdhil jhandheghabhbhaDhAmal vijhuvAjhidhdhAl, avaன jhòனனbhaDhiye AghuM èனRu mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
AdhalAl, nI~NghaL niனRu jèbhaMbhaNNuMbhodhu èvaighaLai gheDhDhughghòLvIrghaLo, avaighaLaibh bhèRRughòLvoM èனRu vijhuvAjhiyu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu avaighaL u~NghaLughghu uNDhAghuM èனRu jhòllughiReன.

nI~NghaL jèbhaMbhaNNuMbhodhu, òruvaனbheril u~NghaLughghu yAdhòru ghuRai uNDhAyirughghumAனAl, bharaloghadhdhilirughghiRa u~NghaL bhidhA u~NghaL dhabhbhidha~NghaLai u~NghaLughghu maனனighghuMbhaDhi, andhagh ghuRaiyai avaனughghu maனனiyu~NghaL.
nI~NghaL maனனiyAdhirubhbhIrghaLAனAl, bharaloghadhdhilirughghiRa u~NghaL bhidhAvuM u~NghaL dhabhbhidha~NghaLai maனனiyAdhirubhbhAr èனRAr.
avarghaL maRubhaDhiyuM èrujhalemughghu vandhArghaL. avar dhevAlayadhdhile ulAvighghòNDhirughghaiyil, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM vedhabhAragharuM mUbhbharuM avariDhadhdhil vandhu:
nIr èndha adhighAradhdhiனAl ivaighaLaijh jhèyghiRIr? ivaighaLaijh jhèyghiRadhaRghu adhighAradhdhai umaghghugh ghòDhudhdhavar yAr? èனRu gheDhDhArghaL.

iyejhu bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: nAனuM u~NghaLiDhadhdhil òru ghAriyadhdhaigh gheDhghiReன, nI~NghaL èனghghu udhdharavu jhòllu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu, nAனuM iனன adhighAradhdhiனAle ivaighaLaijh jhèyghiReனèனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòlluveன.
yovAன ghòDhudhdha snAனM dhevaனAl uNDhAyiRRo, maனuSharAl uNDhAyiRRo, èனghghu udhdharavu jhòllu~NghaL èனRAr.
adhaRghu avarghaL: dhevaனAl uNDhAyiRRèனRu jhòlvomAனAl, bhiனனai eன avaனai vijhuvAjhighghavillaiyèனRu gheDhbhAr;

maனuSharAl uNDhAyiRRèனRu jhòlvomAனAl, jaன~NghaLughghubh bhayabhbhaDhaveNDhiyadhAyirughghuM, èllAruM yovAனai mèyyAghadh dhIrghghadhdharijhi èனRu èNNughiRArghaLe èனRu dha~NghaLughghuLLe AlojhaனaibhaNNi,
iyejhuvughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: è~NghaLughghudh dhèriyAdhu èனRArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu, iyejhu: nAனuM iனன adhighAradhdhiனAle ivaighaLaijh jhèyghiReன èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòlleன èனRAr.

bhiனbhu avar uvamaighaLAy avarghaLughghujh jhòlladhdhòDha~NghiனdhAvadhu: òru maனuShaன òru dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhai uNDhAghghi, adhaijh jhuRRiluM veliyaDhaidhdhu, irajhadhdhòDhDhiyai uNDhubhaNNi, ghobhuradhdhaiyuM ghaDhDhi, dhoDhDhaghghArarughghu adhaigh ghudhdhaghaiyAgha viDhDhu, bhuRadhdhejhadhdhughghubh bhoyirundhAன.
dhoDhDhaghghArariDhadhdhil dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhugh ghaனighaLil dhaன bhAghadhdhai vA~NghighghòNDhu varuMbhaDhi, bharuvaghghAladhdhile avarghaLiDhadhdhil òru UzhiyaghghAraனai aனubhbhiனAன.
avarghaL avaனaibhbhiDhidhdhu, aDhidhdhu, vèRumaiyAy aனubhbhiviDhDhArghaL.
bhiனbhu veRòru UzhiyaghghAraனai avarghaLiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனAன; avarghaL avaனmel ghallèRindhu, dhalaiyile ghAyabhbhaDhudhdhi, avamAனbhbhaDhudhdhi, aனubhbhiviDhDhArghaL.
maRubhaDhiyuM veRòruvaனai aனubhbhiனAன; avaனai avarghaL ghòlaijhèydhArghaL. veRu anegharaiyuM aனubhbhiனAன; avarghaLil jhilarai aDhidhdhu, jhilaraigh ghòனRubhoDhDhArghaL.
avaனughghubhbhiriyamAன òre ghumAraன irundhAன; èன ghumAraனughghu a~njhuvArghaLèனRu jhòlli, avaனaiyuM ghaDhaijhiyile avarghaLiDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனAன.
dhoDhDhaghghAraro: ivaன jhudhandharavALi, ivaனaigh ghòlaijhèyvoM vAru~NghaL; abhbhòzhudhu jhudhandharaM naMmuDhaiyadhAghuM èனRu òruvaroDhòruvar jhòllighghòNDhu;
avaனaibh bhiDhidhdhugh ghòlaijhèydhu, dhirADhjhadhdhoDhDhadhdhughghubh bhuRaMbhe bhoDhDhuviDhDhArghaL.

vIDhu ghaDhDhughiRavarghaL AghAdhèனRu dhaLLiன ghalle mUlaighghudh dhalaighghallAyiRRu;

indha uvamaiyaidh, dha~NghaLaighghuRidhdhujh jhòனனArèனRu avarghaL aRindhu, avaraibh bhiDhighgha vaghaidheDhiனArghaL; AghiluM jaனdhdhughghubh bhayandhu avarai viDhDhubh bhoyviDhDhArghaL.
avarghaL, bhejhjhile avarai aghabhbhaDhudhdhuMbhaDhighghu, bharijheyariluM èrodhiyariluM jhilarai avariDhadhdhil aனubhbhiனArghaL.

avarghaL vandhu: bhodhaghare, nIr jhadhdhiyamuLLavarèனRuM, èvaனaighghuRidhdhuM umaghghugh ghavaiyillai èனRuM aRindhirughghiRoM, nIr mughadhADhjhaNiyaM illAdhavarAydh dhevaனuDhaiya mArghghadhdhaijh jhadhdhiyamAybh bhodhighghiRIr, irAyaனughghu varighòDhughghiRadhu niyAyamo allavo? nAM ghòDhughghalAmo, ghòDhughghaghghUDhAdho? èனRu gheDhDhArghaL.
avarghaLuDhaiya mAyadhdhai avar aRindhu: nI~NghaL èனனai eன jhodhighghiRIrghaL? nAன bhArghghuMbhaDhighghu òru bhaNadhdhai èனனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhuvAru~NghaL èனRAr;
avarghaL adhaigh ghòNDhuvandhArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu avar: indhajh jhurUbhamuM melèzhudhdhuM yAruDhaiyadhu èனRu gheDhDhAr; irAyaனuDhaiyadhu èனRArghaL.
adhaRghu iyejhu: irAyaனuDhaiyadhai irAyaனughghuM, dhevaனuDhaiyadhaidh dhevaனughghuM jhèludhdhu~NghaL èனRAr. avarghaL avaraighghuRidhdhu AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhArghaL.
uyirdhdhèzhudhal illai èனRu jhAdhighghiRa jhadhujheyar avariDhadhdhil vandhu:

ibhbhaDhiyirughgha, ezhu bher jhaghodharar irundhArghaL; mUdhdhavaன òru bhèNNai vivAghaMbhaNNi, jhandhAனmillAmal iRandhubhoனAன.
iraNDhAM jhaghodharaன avaLai vivAghaMbhaNNi, avaனuM jhandhAனmillAmal iRandhubhoனAன. mUனRAM jhaghodharaனuM abhbhaDhiyeyAனAன.
ezhubheruM avaLai vivAghaMbhaNNi, jhandhAனmillAmal iRandhubhoனArghaL. èllArughghuM bhiனbhu andha sdhirIyuM iRandhubhoனAL.
AghaiyAl, uyirdhdhèzhudhalil, avarghaL èzhundhirughghuMbhodhu, avarghaLil èvaனughghu avaL maனaiviyAyirubhbhAL? ezhubheruM avaLai maனaiviyAghaghghòNDhirundhArghaLe èனRu gheDhDhArghaL.
iyejhu avarghaLughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: nI~NghaL vedhavAghghiya~NghaLaiyuM, dhevaனuDhaiya vallamaiyaiyuM aRiyAdhadhiனAlallavA dhabhbhAன èNNa~NghòLLughiRIrghaL?

maridhdhor èzhundhirubhbhadhaibhbhaRRi: nAன AbhiraghAmiன dhevaனuM, IjhAghghiன dhevaனuM, yAghghobhiன dhevaனumAyirughghiReன èனRu, dhevaன muDhjhèDhiyaigh ghuRidhdhujh jhòlliya iDhadhdhil, mojheyiன Aghamadhdhil avaனughghujh jhòனனdhai, nI~NghaL vAjhighghavillaiyA?
avar maridhdhorughghudh dhevaனAyirAmal, jIvaனuLLorughghudh dhevaனAyirughghiRAr; AghaiyAl nI~NghaL mighavuM dhabhbhAன èNNa~NghòLLughiRIrghaL èனRAr.

vedhabhAragharil òruvaன avarghaL dharghghaMbhaNNughiRadhaighgheDhDhu, avarghaLughghu naனRAy udhdharavu jhòனனArèனRu aRindhu, avariDhadhdhil vandhu: ghaRbhaனaighaLilèllAM bhiradhAன ghaRbhaனai èdhuvèனRu gheDhDhAன.
iyejhu avaனughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: ghaRbhaனaighaLilèllAM bhiradhAன ghaRbhaனai èdhuvèனRAl: isravele gheL, naMmuDhaiya dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhar òruvare ghardhdhar.
uன dhevaனAghiya ghardhdhariDhadhdhil uன muzhu irudhayadhdhoDhuM, uன muzhu AdhdhumAvoDhuM, uன muzhu maனdhoDhuM, uன muzhubh bhaladhdhoDhuM aனbhughUruvAyAgha èனbhadhe bhiradhAன ghaRbhaனai.
idhaRghu òbhbhAyirughghiRa iraNDhAM ghaRbhaனai èனனvèனRAl: uனனiDhadhdhil nI aனbhughUruvadhubhol bhiRaனiDhadhdhiluM aனbhughUruvAyAgha èனbhadhe; ivaighaLiluM bhèriya ghaRbhaனai veRòனRumillai èனRAr.
adhaRghu vedhabhAraghaன: jharidhAன bhodhaghare, nIr jhòனனdhu jhadhdhiyaM; òre dhevaன uNDhu, avaraidhdhavira veRòru dhevaன illai.

muzhu irudhayadhdhoDhuM, muzhu maனdhoDhuM, muzhu AdhdhumAvoDhuM, muzhubh bhaladhdhoDhuM avariDhadhdhil aனbhu ghUrughiRadhuM, dhaனனiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrughiRadhu bhol bhiRaனiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrughiRadhume jharvA~NghadhaghaனM mudhaliya bhalighaLaibhbhArghghiluM mughghiyamAyirughghiRadhu èனRAன.
avaன viveghamAy udhdharavu jhòனனdhai iyejhu ghaNDhu: nI dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhughghudh dhUramAனvaனlla èனRAr. adhaனbhiனbhu òruvaனuM avariDhadhdhil yAdhòru gheLviyu~N gheDhghadh dhuNiyavillai.
iyejhu dhevAlayadhdhil ubhadhejhaMbhaNNughaiyil, avar: ghiRisdhu dhAvIdhiன ghumAraன èனRu vedhabhAraghar èbhbhaDhijhjhòllughiRArghaL?

nAன uMmuDhaiya jhadhdhurughghaLai umaghghubh bhAdhabhaDhiyAghghibh bhoDhuMvaraighghuM nIr èனனuDhaiya valadhu bhArijhadhdhil uDhghAruM èனRu ghardhdhar èன ANDhavaroDhe jhòனனAr èனRu dhAvIdhu bharijhudhdha AviyiனAle jhòlliyirughghiRAனe.
dhAvIdhudhAனe avarai ANDhavar èனRu jhòlliyirughgha, avaனughghu avar ghumAraனAyirubhbhadhu èbhbhaDhi èனRAr. anegha jaன~NghaL avaruDhaiya ubhadhejhadhdhai virubhbhadhdhoDhe gheDhDhArghaL.
bhiனனuM avar ubhadhejhaMbhaNNughaiyil avarghaLai noghghi: nINDha a~NghighaLaidh dharidhdhughghòNDhu dhiriyavuM, jhandhaivèLighaLil vandhaன~NghaLai aDhaiyavuM,
jèbhaAlaya~NghaLil mudhaனmaiyAன Ajhaன~NghaLil uDhghAravuM, virundhughaLil mudhaனmaiyAன iDha~NghaLil irughghavuM viruMbhi,
vidhavaighaLiன vIDhughaLaibhbhaDhjhidhdhu, bhArvaighghu nINDha jèbhaMbhaNNughiRa vedhabhAragharaighghuRidhdhu èjhjharighghaiyAyiru~NghaL; avarghaL adhigha Aghghiனaiyai aDhaivArghaL èனRAr.
iyejhu ghANighghaibhbhèDhDhighghu èdhirAgha uDhghArndhu, jaன~NghaL ghANighghaibhbhèDhDhiyil bhaNaM bhoDhughiRadhaibh bhArdhdhughghòNDhirundhAr; aijhuvariyavAனghaL aneghar adhighamAybh bhoDhDhArghaL.
ezhaiyAன òru vidhavaiyuM vandhu, òru dhuDhDhughghujh jhariyAன iraNDhu ghAjhaibh bhoDhDhAL.

abhbhòzhudhu avar dhaMmuDhaiya jhISharai azhaidhdhu, ghANighghaibhbhèDhDhiyil bhaNaMbhoDhDha maRRèllAraibhbhArghghiluM indha ezhai vidhavai adhighamAybh bhoDhDhALèனRu mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன;
avarghaLèllAruM dha~NghaL bharibhUraNadhdhilirundhu èDhudhdhubhbhoDhDhArghaL; ivaLo dhaன vaRumaiyilirundhu dhaன jIvaனdhdhughghu uNDhAyirundhadhèllAM bhoDhDhuviDhDhAL èனRAr.

avar dhevAlayadhdhai viDhDhubh bhuRabhbhaDhuMbhodhu, avaruDhaiya jhISharghaLil òruvaன avarai noghghi: bhodhaghare, idho, indhaghghallughaL èbhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhadhu! indhagh ghaDhDhaDha~NghaL èbhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhadhu! bhAruM èனRAன.
iyejhu avaனughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: indhabhbhèriya ghaDhDhaDha~NghaLaigh ghANghiRAye, òru ghalliனmel òru ghallirAdhabhaDhighghu èllAM iDhighghabhbhaDhDhubhbhoghuM èனRAr.
bhiனbhu, avar dhevAlayadhdhughghu èdhirAgha òlivamalaiyiன mel uDhghArndhirughghaiyil, bhedhuruvuM yAghghobhuM yovAனuM andhireyAvuM avariDhadhdhil dhaனidhdhu vandhu:
ivaighaL èbhbhòzhudhu jhaMbhavighghuM? ivaighaLèllAM niRaiveRu~NghAladhdhughghu aDhaiyALaM èனன? è~NghaLughghujh jhòllaveNDhuM èனRArghaL.

aனRiyuM jhaghodharaன jhaghodharaனaiyuM, dhaghabhbhaன bhiLLaighaLaiyuM maraNadhdhughghu òbhbhughghòDhubhbhArghaL; bhèRRArughghu virodhamAghabh bhiLLaighaL èzhuMbhi, avarghaLaigh ghòlaijhèyvArghaL.
èன nAmadhdhiனimidhdhaM èllArAluM bhaghaighghabhbhaDhuvIrghaL. muDhivubhariyandhaM nilainiRbhavaனe iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhuvAன.

meluM bhAzhAghghughiRa aruvarubhbhaigh ghuRidhdhudh dhAனiyel dhIrghghadharijhi jhòlliyirughghiRAனe; vAjhighghiRavaன jhindhighghaghghaDhavaன; adhu niRghadh dhaghAdha iDhadhdhile nI~NghaL adhai niRghagh ghANuMbhodhu, yUdheyAvil irughghiRavarghaL malaighaLughghu oDhibhbhoghaghghaDhavarghaL.

vayalil irughghiRavaன dhaன vasdhiradhdhai èDhubhbhadhaRghubh bhiனனiDhDhudh dhiruMbhAdhirughghaghghaDhavaன.

nI~NghaL oDhibhbhovadhu mArighAladhdhile, jhaMbhaviyAdhabhaDhighghu veNDhighghòLLu~NghaL.
eனèனil, dhevaன ulaghadhdhaijh jhiruShDhidhdhadhumudhal idhuvaraighghuM jhaMbhavidhdhirAdhadhuM, iனimeluM jhaMbhaviyAdhadhumAன mighundha ubhadhdhiravaM annADhghaLil uNDhAyirughghuM.
ghardhdhar annADhghaLaigh ghuRaidhdhirAviDhDhAl, òruvaனAghiluM dhabhbhibhbhovadhillai; dhAM dhèrindhughòNDhavarghaLiனimidhdhamo, avar andha nADhghaLaigh ghuRaidhdhirughghiRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu: idho, ghiRisdhu i~Nghe irughghiRAr, adho, a~Nghe irughghiRAr èனRu èvaனAghiluM jhòனனAl, naMbhAdheyu~NghaL.

eனèனil, ghaLLaghghiRisdhughghaLuM ghaLLadhdhIrghghadharijhighaLuM èzhuMbhi, ghUDhumAனAl dhèrindhughòLLabhbhaDhDhavarghaLaiyuM va~njhighghadhdhaghghadhAgha aDhaiyALa~NghaLaiyuM aRbhudha~NghaLaiyuM jhèyvArghaL.
nI~NghaLo èjhjharighghaiyAyiru~NghaL; idho, èllAvaRRaiyuM muனனdhAgha u~NghaLughghu aRividhdhirughghiReன.
annADhghaLile, andha ubhadhdhiravadhdhiRghubhbhiனbhu, jhUriyaன andhaghArabhbhaDhuM, jhandhiraன òLiyaighghòDhAdhirughghuM;
vAனdhdhiன naDhjhadhdhira~NghaL vizhuM, vAன~NghaLiluLLa jhadhdhuva~NghaLuM ajhaighghabhbhaDhuM.

adhdhimaradhdhiனAl òru uvamaiyaigh ghaRRughghòLLu~NghaL; adhile iLa~NghiLai dhoனRi, dhuLirviDhuMbhodhu, vajhandhaghAlaM jhamIbhamAyiRRu èனRu aRivIrghaL.

ivaighaLèllAM jhaMbhavighghuM muனனe indhajh jhandhadhi òzhindhubhoghAdhèனRu, mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

aghghAladhdhai nI~NghaL aRiyAdhabhaDhiyAl èjhjharighghaiyAyiru~NghaL, vizhidhdhirundhu jèbhaMbhaNNu~NghaL.

abhbhaDhiye nI~NghaLuM vizhidhdhiru~NghaL; eனèனil, vIDhDhèjamAன, jhAya~NghAladhdhilo, naDhurAdhdhiriyilo, jheval ghUvuM neradhdhilo, ghAlaiyilo, èbhbhòzhudhu varuvAன èனRu nI~NghaL aRiyIrghaL.

iraNDhu nALaighghubhbhiனbhu bhuLibhbhillAdha abhbha~njhAbhbhiDhughiRa bhasghAbhaNDhighai vandhadhu. abhbhòzhudhu bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM vedhabhAragharuM, avaraidh dhandhiramAybh bhiDhidhdhugh ghòlaijhèyyuMbhaDhi vaghaidheDhiனArghaL.

avar bhèdhdhAனiyAvil ghuShDharoghiyAyirundha jhImoன vIDhDhile bhojaனbhandhiyirughghaiyil, òru sdhirI vilaiyeRabhbhèRRa naLadhaM èனனuM udhdhama dhailamuLLa vèLLaighghalbharaNiyaigh ghòNDhuvandhu, adhai uDhaidhdhu, andhadh dhailadhdhai avar jhirajhiனmel URRiனAL.
abhbhòzhudhu jhilar dha~NghaLughghuLLe vijhaனmaDhaindhu: indhadh dhailadhdhai ibhbhaDhi vINAyjh jhèlavazhibhbhAனeன?
idhai munnURu bhaNadhdhiRghu adhighamAன ghirayadhdhughghu viRRu dharidhdhirarughghugh ghòDhughghalAme èனRu jhòlli, avaLaighghuRidhdhu muRumuRudhdhArghaL.
iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: avaLai viDhDhuviDhu~NghaL; eன avaLaidh dhòndharavubhaDhudhdhughiRIrghaL? èனனiDhadhdhil naRghiriyaiyaijh jhèydhirughghiRAL.
dharidhdhirar èbhbhodhuM u~NghaLiDhadhdhil irughghiRArghaL. u~NghaLughghu maனdhuNDhAghuMbhodhèllAM nI~NghaL avarghaLughghu naனmai jhèyyalAM; nAனo èbhbhodhuM u~NghaLiDhadhdhil ireன.
ivaL dhaனனAl iyaனRadhaijh jhèyadhAL; nAன aDhaghghaM bhaNNuvadhaRghu èdhdhaனmAgha, èன jharIradhdhil dhailaMbhUjha mundhighghòNDhAL.
indhajh jhuvijheShaM ulaghadhdhil è~Nghè~Nghe bhirajha~NghighghabhbhaDhumo a~Ngha~Nghe ivaLai niனaibhbhadhaRghAgha ivaL jhèydhadhuM jhòllabhbhaDhuM èனRu mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu, bhaனனiruvaril òruvaனAghiya yUdhAsghAriyodhdhu èனbhavaன avaraibh bhiradhAன AjhAriyarughghugh ghADhDhighghòDhughghuMbhaDhi avarghaLiDhadhdhiRghubh bhoனAன.

avarghaL adhaigh gheDhDhu, jhandhoShabhbhaDhDhu, avaனughghu bhaNaMghòDhubhbhoM èனRu vAghghudhdhadhdhaM bhaNNiனArghaL; avaன avaraigh ghADhDhighghòDhubhbhadhaRghudh dhaghundha jhamayaM bhArdhdhughghòNDhirundhAன.

bhasghAvaibh bhaliyiDhuM nALAghiya bhuLibhbhillAdha abhbha~njhAbhbhiDhughiRa mudhalAM nALile, avaruDhaiya jhISharghaL avariDhadhdhil vandhu: nIr bhasghAvaibh bhujhibhbhadhaRghu nA~NghaL è~Nghe bhoy AyadhdhaM bhaNNajh jhidhdhamAyirughghiRIr èனRu gheDhDhArghaL.

avar dhaMmuDhaiya jhISharil iraNDhubherai noghghi: nI~NghaL nagharadhdhiRghuLLe bho~NghaL, a~Nghe dhaNNIrghghuDhaM jhumandhuvarughiRa òru maனuShaன u~NghaLughghu èdhirbhbhaDhuvAன, avaன bhiனனe bho~NghaL.

avaன èndha vIDhDhiRghuL bhiravejhighghiRAனo, andha vIDhDhu èjamAனai noghghi: nAன èன jhISharoDhughUDhabh bhasghAvaibh bhujhighghiRadhaRghudh dhaghudhiyAன iDhaM è~NgheyèனRu bhodhaghar gheDhghiRAr èனRu jhòllu~NghaL.

avaன ghaMbhaLaM mudhalAனvaighaLai viridhdhu AyadhdhaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhirughghiRa visdhAramAன melvIDhDhaRaiyai u~NghaLughghugh ghANbhibhbhAன; a~Nghe namaghghAgha AyadhdhaMbhaNNu~NghaL èனRu jhòlli aனubhbhiனAr.
abhbhaDhiye, avaruDhaiya jhIShar bhuRabhbhaDhDhu nagharadhdhil bhoy, dha~NghaLughghu avar jhòனனbhaDhiye ghaNDhu, bhasghAvai AyadhdhaMbhaNNiனArghaL.
jhAya~NghAlamAனbhodhu, avar bhaனனiruvaroDhu~NghUDha avviDhadhdhiRghu vandhAr.
avarghaL bhandhiyamarndhu bhojaனMbhaNNughaiyil, iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: èனனuDhaனe bhujhighghiRa u~NghaLil òruvaன èனனaigh ghADhDhighghòDhubhbhAன èனRu mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL dhughghamaDhaindhu: nAனo, nAனo? èனRu òvvòruvaruM avariDhadhdhil gheDhghadhdhòDha~NghiனArghaL.
avar bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: èனனuDhaனe ghUDhadh dhAladhdhil ghaiyiDhughiRavaனAghiya bhaனனiruvarilòruvaனe avaன èனRu jhòlli;

maனuShaghumAraன dhaMmaighghuRidhdhu èzhudhiyirughghiRabhaDhiye bhoghiRAr; AghiluM, èndha maனuShaனAl maனuShaghumAraன ghADhDhighghòDhughghabhbhaDhughiRAro, andha maனuShaனughghu aiyo! andha maனuShaன bhiRavAdhirundhAனAனAl avaனughghu nalamAyirughghuM èனRAr.

avarghaL bhojaனM bhaNNughaiyil, iyejhu abhbhadhdhai èDhudhdhu AjhIrvadhidhdhu, adhaibhbhiDhDhu, avarghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdhu: nI~NghaL vA~Nghibh bhujhiyu~NghaL, idhu èனனuDhaiya jharIramAyirughghiRadhu èனRAr.
bhiனbhu, bhAdhdhiradhdhaiyuM èDhudhdhu sdhodhdhiraMbhaNNi, adhai avarghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdhAr. avarghaL èllAruM adhile bhAனMbhaNNiனArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avar avarghaLai noghghi: idhu anegharughghAghajh jhindhabhbhaDhughiRa bhudhu uDhaனbhaDhighghaighghuriya èனனuDhaiya iradhdhamAyirughghiRadhu.
nAன dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil navamAன rajhadhdhaibh bhAனMbhaNNuM nALvaraψghghuM dhirADhjhabhbhazharaڠΤdhai iனi nAன bhAனMbhaNNuvadhillaiyèனRu mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
avarghaL sdhodhdhirabhbhADhDhaibh bhADhiன bhiனbhu, òlivamalaighghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubh bhoனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: meybhbhaனai vèDhDhuveன, ADhughaL jhidhaRaDhighghabhbhaDhuM èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRabhaDhi, indha irAdhdhiriyile nI~NghaL èllAruM èனனimidhdhaM iDhaRalaDhaivIrghaL.
AghiluM nAன uyirdhdhèzhundha bhiனbhu, u~NghaLughghu muனனe ghalileyAvughghubh bhoveன èனRAr.
adhaRghubh bhedhuru: umadhunimidhdhaM èllAruM iDhaRalaDhaindhAluM, nAன iDhaRalaDhaiyeன èனRAன.
iyejhu avaனai noghghi: iனRaighghu, indha irAdhdhiriyile, jheval iraNDhudharaM ghUvughiRadhaRghu muனனe, nI mUனRu dharaM èனனai maRudhalibhbhAy èனRu mèyyAghave uனghghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
adhaRghu avaன: nAன uMmoDhe marighghaveNDhiyadhAyirundhAluM, uMmai maRudhalighghamADhDheன èனRu uRudhiyAyjh jhòனனAன; èllAruM abhbhaDhiye jhòனனArghaL.
bhiனbhu ghèdhjhamaனe èனனbhbhaDhDha iDhadhdhiRghu vandhArghaL. abhbhòzhudhu avar dhaMmuDhaiya jhISharghaLai noghghi: nAன jèbhaMbhaNNumaLavuM i~Nghe uDhghArndhiru~NghaL èனRu jhòlli;
bhedhuruvaiyuM yAghghobhaiyuM yovAனaiyuM dhaMmoDhe ghUDhDhighghòNDhubhoy, dhighilaDhaiyavuM, mighavuM viyAghulabhbhaDhavuM dhòDha~NghiனAr.
abhbhòzhudhu, avar: èன AdhdhumA maraNadhdhughghedhuvAன dhughgha~NghòNDhirughghiRadhu. nI~NghaL i~Nghe dha~Nghi, vizhidhdhiru~NghaL èனRu jhòlli,
jhaRRu abhbhuRaMbhoy, dharaiyile vizhundhu, andha veLai dhaMmaiviDhDhu nI~NghibhbhoghaghghUDhumAனAl adhu nI~NghaveNDhumèனRu veNDhighghòNDhu:
abhbhA bhidhAve, èllAM uMmAle ghUDhuM; indhabh bhAdhdhiradhdhai èனனilirundhu èDhudhdhubhbhoDhuM, AghiluM èன jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiyalla, uMmuDhaiya jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiye AghaghghaDhavadhu èனRAr.
bhiனbhu, avar vandhu, avarghaL nidhdhiraibhaNNughiRadhaighghaNDhu, bhedhuruvai noghghi: jhImoனe, nidhdhirai bhaNNughiRAyA? òru maNi neraM nI vizhidhdhirughghaghghUDhAdhA?
nI~NghaL jhodhaனaighghuDhbhaDhAdhabhaDhighghu vizhidhdhirundhu jèbhaMbhaNNu~NghaL; Avi uRjhAghamuLLadhudhAன, mAMjhamo bhalavIனmuLLadhu èனRAr.
avar maRubhaDhiyuM bhoy, andha vArdhdhaighaLaiye jhòlli jèbhaMbhaNNiனAr.

avar dhiruMbha vandhabhodhu, avarghaL maRubhaDhiyuM nidhdhiraibhaNNughiRadhaigh ghaNDhAr; avarghaLuDhaiya ghaNghaL mighundha nidhdhiraimayaghghaM aDhaindhirundhabhaDhiyAl, dhA~NghaL maRumòzhiyAgha avarughghujh jhòlvadhu iனனdhèனRu aRiyAdhirundhArghaL.
avar mUனRAndharaM vandhu: iனi nidhdhiraibhaNNi iLaibhbhARu~NghaL; bhodhuM, veLai vandhadhu, idho, maனuShaghumAraன bhAvighaLuDhaiya ghaighaLil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhughiRAr.
èனனaigh ghADhDhighghòDhughghiRavaன, idho, vandhuviDhDhAன, èzhundhiru~NghaL bhovoM èனRAr.

uDhaனe, avar ibhbhaDhibh bhejhughaiyil bhaனனiruvaril òruvaனAghiya yUdhAs vandhAன; avaனoDhe ghUDhabh bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM vedhabhAragharuM mUbhbharuM aனubhbhiன dhiraLAன jaன~NghaL, bhaDhDhaya~NghaLaiyuM, dhaDhighaLaiyuM bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhu vandhArghaL.
avaraigh ghADhDhighghòDhughghiRavaன: nAன èvaனai mudhdha~njhèyveனo avaனdhAன, avaனaibh bhiDhidhdhubh bhadhdhiramAygh ghòNDhubho~NghaL èனRu avarghaLughghugh ghuRibhbhujh jhòlliyirundhAன.
avaன vandhavuDhaனe, avaraNDhaiyil jherndhu: rabhI, rabhI, èனRu jhòlli, avarai mudhdha~njhèydhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL avarmel ghaibhoDhDhu, avaraibh bhiDhidhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu ghUDhaniனRavarghaLil òruvaன ghadhdhiyai uruvi, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனuDhaiya velaighghAraனaigh ghAdhaRa vèDhDhiனAன.
iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: ghaLLaனaibh bhiDhighghabh bhuRabhbhaDhughiRadhubhola, nI~NghaL bhaDhDhaya~NghaLaiyuM, dhaDhighaLaiyuM èDhudhdhughghòNDhu èனனaibh bhiDhighghavandhIrghaL;

nAன dhiனndhoRuM u~NghaL naDhuvile dhevAlayadhdhil ubhadhejhaM bhaNNighghòNDhirundheன; abhbhòzhudhu, nI~NghaL èனனaibh bhiDhighghavillaiye; AனAluM vedhavAghghiya~NghaL niRaiveRaveNDhiyadhAyirughghiRadhu èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu èllAruM avaraiviDhDhu oDhibhbhoனArghaL.
òru vAlibhaன òru dhubhbhaDhDhiyai mAdhdhiraM dhaனmel bhordhdhughghòNDhu avar bhiனனe bhoனAன; avaனaibh bhiDhidhdhArghaL.
avaன dhaன dhubhbhaDhDhiyaibh bhoDhDhuviDhDhu, nirvANamAy avarghaLaiviDhDhu oDhibhbhoனAன.
iyejhuvai avarghaL bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனiDhadhdhil ghòNDhubhoனArghaL; a~Nghe AjhAriyar mUbhbhar vedhabhAraghar èllAruM ghUDhivandhirundhArghaL.
bhedhuru dhUradhdhile avarughghubh bhiனjhèனRu, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனuDhaiya aramaனaighghuL vandhu, jhevagharoDheghUDha uDhghArndhu, nèrubhbhaNDhaiyile ghuLirghAyndhughòNDhirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM Alojhaனaijh jha~NghadhdhAraனaivaruM iyejhuvaigh ghòlaijhèyyuMbhaDhi avarughghu virodhamAghajh jhADhjhi dheDhiனArghaL; aghabhbhaDhavillai.
aneghar avarughghu virodhamAghabh bhòyjhjhADhjhi jhòlliyuM, andhajh jhADhjhighaL òvvavillai.
abhbhòzhudhu jhilar èzhundhu, ghaivelaiyAghiya indhadh dhevAlayadhdhai nAன iDhidhdhubhbhoDhDhu, ghaivelaiyallAdha veRòனRai mUனRu nALaighghuLLe ghaDhDhuveன èனRu ivaன jhòனனdhai nA~NghaL gheDhDhoM èனRu,
avarughghu virodhamAybh bhòyjhjhADhjhi jhòனனArghaL.
abhbhaDhijh jhòlliyuM avarghaL jhADhjhi òvvAmaRbhoyiRRu.
abhbhòzhudhu bhiradhAன AjhAriyaன èzhundhu naDhuve niனRu, iyejhuvai noghghi: ivarghaL uனghghu virodhamAyjh jhòllughiRadhaighghuRidhdhu nI òனRuM jhòllughiRadhillaiyA èனRu gheDhDhAன.
avaro òru udhdharavuM jhòllAmal bhejhAdhirundhAr. maRubhaDhiyuM bhiradhAன AjhAriyaன avarai noghghi: nI sdhodhdhirighghabhbhaDhDha dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya ghiRisdhudhAனA? èனRu gheDhDhAன.
adhaRghu iyejhu: nAன avardhAன; maனuShaghumAraன jharva vallavariன valadhu bhArijhadhdhil vIRRirubhbhadhaiyuM, vAனdhdhiன megha~NghaLmel varuvadhaiyuM nI~NghaL ghANbhIrghaL èனRAr.
bhiradhAன AjhAriyaன idhaighgheDhDhavuDhaனe, dhaன vasdhira~NghaLaigh ghizhidhdhughghòNDhu: iனijh jhADhjhighaL namaghghu veNDhiyadhèனன?
dhevadhUShaNadhdhaigh gheDhDhIrghaLe. u~NghaLughghu èனனmAydh dhoனRughiRadhu èனRAன. adhaRghu avarghaLèllAruM: ivaன maraNadhdhughghubh bhAdhdhiraனAyirughghiRAன èனRu dhIrmAனMbhaNNiனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu jhilar avarmel dhubhbhavuM, avaruDhaiya mughadhdhai mUDhavuM, avaraigh ghuDhDhavuM, ~nAனdhiruShDhiyiனAle bhArdhdhujh jhòl èனRu jhòllavuM dhòDha~NghiனArghaL; velaighghAraruM avaraigh ghaனனdhdhil aRaindhArghaL.
adhdharuNadhdhile bhedhuru ghIzhe aramaனai muRRadhdhilirughghaiyil, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனuDhaiya velaighghArighaLil òrudhdhi vandhu,
ghuLirghAyndhu ghòNDhirughghiRa bhedhuruvaighghaNDhu, avaனai uRRubhbhArdhdhu: nIyuM najhareyaனAghiya iyejhuvoDhe irundhAy èனRAL.
adhaRghu avaன: nAன aRiyeன; nI jhòllughiRadhu èனghghudh dhèriyAdhu èனRu maRudhalidhdhu, vèLiye vAjhal maNDhabhadhdhughghubh bhoனAன; abhbhòzhudhu jheval ghUviRRu.
velaighghAri avaனai maRubhaDhiyuM ghaNDhu: ivaன avarghaLil òruvaன èனRu arughe niனRavarghaLughghujh jhòனனAL.

avaன maRubhaDhiyuM maRudhalidhdhAன. jhaRRuneradhdhughghubhbhiனbhu maRubhaDhiyuM arughe niனRavarghaL bhedhuruvaibhbhArdhdhu: mèyyAghave nI avarghaLil òruvaன, nI ghalileyaன, uன bhejhjhu adhaRghu òdhdhirughghiRadhu èனRArghaL.
adhaRghu avaன: nI~NghaL jhòllughiRa maனuShaனai aRiyeன èனRu jhòlli, jhabhighghavuM jhadhdhiyaMbhaNNavuM dhòDha~NghiனAன.

uDhaனe jheval iraNDhAndharaM ghUviRRu. jheval iraNDhudhara~N ghUvughiRadhaRghumuனனe nI èனனai mUனRu dharaM maRudhalibhbhAy èனRu iyejhu dhaனghghujh jhòனன vArdhdhaiyaibh bhedhuru niனaivu ghUrndhu, mighavuM azhudhAன.

bhòzhudhu viDhindhavuDhaனe, bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM mUbhbharuM vedhabhAragharuM Alojhaனaijh jha~NghadhdhAraனaivaruM ghUDhi AlojhaனaibhaNNi, iyejhuvaigh ghaDhDhigh ghòNDhubhoy, bhilAdhdhuviனiDhadhdhil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhArghaL.
bhilAdhdhu avarai noghghi: nI yUdharuDhaiya rAjAvA èனRu gheDhDhAன. adhaRghu avar: nIr jhòllughiRabhaDhidhAன èனRAr.
bhiradhAன AjhAriyarghaL avarmel anegha~NghuRRa~NghaLaijh jhADhDhiனArghaL. avaro mARudhdharaM òனRuM jhòllavillai.
abhbhòzhudhu, bhilAdhdhu maRubhaDhiyuM avarai noghghi: idho, ivarghaL uனmel èdhdhaனaiyo ghuRRa~NghaLaijh jhADhDhughiRArghaLe, adhaRghu nI udhdharavu òனRuM jhòllughiRadhillaiyA èனRu gheDhDhAன.
iyejhuvo abhbhòzhudhuM udhdharavu òனRuM jhòllavillai; adhiனAl bhilAdhdhu AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhAன.

ghAvalbhaNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaLil èvaனai viDhudhalaiyAghghaveNDhumèனRu jaன~NghaL gheDhDhughghòLvArghaLo, avaனai avarghaLughghAgha viDhudhalaiyAghghuvadhu bhaNDhighaidhoRuM bhilAdhdhuvughghu vazhaghghamAyirundhadhu.
ghalaghaM bhaNNi andhagh ghalaghadhdhil ghòlaijhèydhu, adhaRghAghagh ghAval bhaNNabhbhaDhDhavarghaLil bharabhAs èனனbhbhaDhDha òruvaன irundhAன.
jaன~NghaL, vazhaghghadhdhiனbhaDhiye dha~NghaLughghu òruvaனai viDhudhalaiyAghghaveNDhumèனRu jhadhdhamiDhDhugh gheDhDhughghòLLadhdhòDha~NghiனArghaL.
bhòRAmaiyiனAle bhiradhAன AjhAriyarghaL avarai òbhbhughghòDhudhdhArghaL èனRu bhilAdhdhu aRindhu,
avarghaLai noghghi: nAன yUdharuDhaiya rAjAvai u~NghaLughghu viDhudhalaiyAghghaveNDhumèனRirughghiRIrghaLA èனRu gheDhDhAன.
bharabhAjhaidh dha~NghaLughghu viDhudhalaiyAghghaveNDhumèனRu jaன~NghaL gheDhDhughghòLLuMbhaDhi, bhiradhAன AjhAriyarghaL avarghaLai eviviDhDhArghaL.
bhilAdhdhu maRubhaDhiyuM avarghaLai noghghi: abhbhaDhiyAனAl yUdharuDhaiya rAjAvèனRu nI~NghaL jhòllughiRavaனai nAன èனன jhèyyaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAன.
avaனaijh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuM èனRu maRubhaDhiyuM jhadhdhamiDhDhujh jhòனனArghaL.
adhaRghubh bhilAdhdhu: eன, èனன bhòllAbhbhujh jhèydhAன èனRAன. avarghaLo: avaனaijh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuM èனRu bhiனனuM adhighamAygh ghUghghuraliDhDhujh jhòனனArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu bhilAdhdhu jaன~NghaLai bhiriyabhbhaDhudhdha maனdhuLLavaனAy, bharabhAjhai avarghaLughghu viDhudhalaiyAghghi, iyejhuvaiyo vAriனAl aDhibhbhidhdhu, jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuMbhaDhighghu òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu, bhorjhjhevaghar avaraidh dhejhAdhibhadhiyiன aramaனaiyAghiya mALighaiyil ghòNDhubhoy, avviDhadhdhil bhorjhjhevagharuDhaiya ghUDhDhamuzhuvadhaiyuM ghUDhivarajhjhèydhu,
jhivabhbhAன mela~Nghiyai avarughghu uDhudhdhi, muLmuDhiyaibh bhiனனi avarughghujh jhUDhDhi:
yUdharuDhaiya rAjAve, vAzhgha èனRu avarai vAzhdhdhi,
avaraijh jhirajhil gholAl aDhidhdhu, avarmel dhubhbhi, muzha~NghAlbhaDhiyiDhDhu avarai vaNa~NghiனArghaL.
avaraibh bhariyAjhaMbhaNNiனbhiனbhu, jhivabhbhAன a~Nghiyaigh ghazhaRRi, avaruDhaiya vasdhira~NghaLai avarughghu uDhudhdhi, avaraijh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuMbhaDhi vèLiye ghòNDhubhoனArghaL.

jhireனe UrAனuM, alèghjhandharughghuM rUbhbhughghuM dhaghabhbhaனumAghiya jhImoன èனனbhbhaDhDha òruvaன nADhDhilirundhu avvazhiye varughaiyil, avaruDhaiya jhiluvaiyaijh jhumaghghuMbhaDhi avaனaibh bhalavandhaMbhaNNiனArghaL.
ghabhAlasdhalaM èனRu ardhdha~NghòLLuM ghòlghòdhA èனனuM iDhadhdhughghu avaraigh ghòNDhubhoy,
