adhaRghu iyejhu: ghalabhbhaiyiனmel dhaன ghaiyai vaidhdhubh bhiனனiDhDhubhbhArghghiRa èvaனuM dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhughghudh dhaghudhiyuLLavaன alla èனRAr.

ivaighaLughghubh bhiனbhu ghardhdhar veRe èzhubhadhubherai niyamidhdhu, dhAM bhoghuM jhaghala bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLughghuM iDha~NghaLughghuM avarghaLaidh dhamaghghu muனனe iraNDhiraNDhu bherAgha aனubhbhiனAr.
abhbhòzhudhu avar avarghaLai noghghi: aRubhbhu mighudhi, velaiyADhghaLo ghò~njhaM; AghaiyAl aRubhbhughghu èjamAன dhamadhu aRubhbhughghu velaiyADhghaLai aனubhbhuMbhaDhi avarai veNDhighghòLLu~NghaL.
bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbho~NghaL; ADhDhughghuDhDhighaLai onAyghaLughghuLLe aனubhbhughiRadhubhola, idho, nAன u~NghaLai aனubhbhughiReன
bhaNabhbhaiyaiyuM jhAmAன bhaiyaiyuM bhAdharaDhjhaighaLaiyuM ghòNDhubhoghaveNDhAM; vazhiyile òruvaraiyuM viனvavuM veNDhAM.
òru vIDhDhil bhiravejhighghiRabhodhu: indha vIDhDhughghujh jhamAdhAனM uNDhAvadhAghavèனRu mudhalAvadhu jhòllu~NghaL.
jhamAdhAன bhAdhdhiraன a~Nghe irundhAl, nI~NghaL ghURiன jhamAdhAனM avaனiDhadhdhil dha~NghuM, illAdhirundhAl adhu u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhivaruM.

andha vIDhDhiledhAனe nI~NghaL dha~Nghiyirundhu, avarghaL ghòDhughghiRavaighaLaibh bhujhidhdhugh ghuDhiyu~NghaL; velaiyAL dhaன ghUlighghubh bhAdhdhiraனAyirughghiRAன. vIDhDhughghu vIDhu bhoghAdhiru~NghaL.
òru bhaDhDhaNadhdhil nI~NghaL bhiravejhighghiRabhòzhudhu, jaன~NghaL u~NghaLai eRRughghòNDhAl avarghaL u~NghaLmuன vaighghiRavaighaLai nI~NghaL bhujhidhdhu,
avviDhadhdhiluLLa bhiNiyALighaLaijh jhòsdhamAghghi: dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyaM u~NghaLughghujh jhamIbhamAy vandhirughghiRadhu èனRu avarghaLughghujh jhòllu~NghaL.
yAdhòru bhaDhDhaNadhdhil nI~NghaL bhiravejhighghiRabhòzhudhu, jaன~NghaL u~NghaLai eRRughghòLLAviDhDhAl adhiன vIdhighaLile nI~NghaL bhoy:

è~NghaLil òDhDhiன u~NghaL bhaDhDhaNadhdhiன dhUjhiyaiyuM u~NghaLughghu virodhamAydh dhuDhaidhdhubhbhoDhughiRoM; AyiனuM dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyaM u~NghaLughghujh jhamIbhamAy vandhirughghiRadhèனbhadhai aRindhughòLvIrghaLAgha èனRu jhòllu~NghaL.
andhabh bhaDhDhaNadhdhiRghu neriDhuvadhaibhbhArghghiluM andha nALile jhodhoM nADhDhiRghu neriDhuvadhu ilaghuvAyirughghuM èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

ghorAjhIன bhaDhDhaName, uனghghu, aiyo, bhèdhjhAyidhA bhaDhDhaName, uனghghu aiyo, u~NghaLil jhèyyabhbhaDhDha bhaladhdha jhèyghaighaL dhIruviluM jhIdhoனiluM jhèyyabhbhaDhDhirundhadhAனAl, abhbhòzhudhe iraDhDhuDhudhdhi, jhAMbhalil uDhghArndhu, maனndhiruMbhiyirubhbhArghaL.
niyAyadhdhIrbhbhunALil u~NghaLughghu neriDhuvadhaibhbhArghghiluM, dhIruvughghuM jhIdhoனughghuM neriDhuvadhu ilaghuvAyirughghuM.
vAனbhariyandhaM uyardhdhabhbhaDhDha ghabhbharnaghUme, nI bhAdhALabhariyandhaM dhAzhdhdhabhbhaDhuvAy èனRu jhòlli,

jhISharai noghghi: u~NghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhughghiRavaன èனghghujh jhèvighòDhughghiRAன, u~NghaLai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNughiRavaன èனனai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNughiRAன, èனனai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNughiRavaன èனனai aனubhbhiனvarai ajhaDhDhaibhaNNughiRAன èனRAr.
bhiனbhu andha èzhubhadhubheruM jhandhoShadhdhoDhe dhiruMbhivandhu: ANDhavare, uMmuDhaiya nAmadhdhiனAle bhijhAjhughaLuM è~NghaLughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhighiRadhu èனRArghaL.
avarghaLai avar noghghi: jhAdhdhAன miனனlaibhbhola vAனdhdhilirundhu vizhughiRadhaigh ghaNDheன.

idho, jharbhbha~NghaLaiyuM dheLghaLaiyuM midhighghavuM, jhadhdhuruviனuDhaiya jhaghala vallamaiyaiyuM meRghòLLavuM u~NghaLughghu adhighAra~N ghòDhughghiReன; òனRuM u~NghaLaijh jhedhabhbhaDhudhdhamADhDhAdhu.
AghiluM, AvighaL u~NghaLughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhighiRadhaRghAgha nI~NghaL jhandhoShabhbhaDhAmal, u~NghaL nAma~NghaL bharaloghadhdhil èzhudhiyirughghiRadhaRghAghajh jhandhoShabhbhaDhu~NghaL èனRAr.

andha veLaiyil iyejhu Aviyile ghaLighUrndhu: bhidhAve! vAனdhdhughghuM bhUmighghuM ANDhavare! ivaighaLai nIr ~nAனighaLughghuM ghalvimAனghaLughghuM maRaidhdhu, bhAlagharughghu vèLibhbhaDhudhdhiனbhaDhiyAl uMmai sdhodhdhirighghiReன; AM, bhidhAve! ibhbhaDhijh jhèyvadhu uMmuDhaiya dhiruvuLadhdhughghubh bhiriyamAyirundhadhu.

jhaghalamuM èன bhidhAviனAl èனghghu òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhirughghiRadhu; bhidhA dhavira veRòruvaனuM ghumAraன iனனArèனRu aRiyAன, ghumAraனuM, ghumAraன avarai èvaனughghu vèLibhbhaDhudhdhajh jhidhdhamAyirughghiRAro avaனundhavira, veRòruvaனuM bhidhA iனனArèனRu aRiyAன èனRAr.
bhiனbhu, dhamadhu jhIShariDhadhdhil dhiruMbhi, dhaனidhdhu avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL ghANghiRavaighaLaigh ghANu~N ghaNghaL bhAghghiyamuLLavaighaL.

anegha dhIrghghadharijhighaLuM rAjAghghaLuM nI~NghaL ghANghiRavaighaLaigh ghANavuM, nI~NghaL gheDhghiRavaighaLaigh gheDhghavuM viruMbhiyuM, ghANAmaluM gheLAmaluM bhoனArghaL èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu niyAyajhAsdhiri òruvaன èzhundhirundhu, avaraijh jhodhighghuMbhaDhi: bhodhaghare, nidhdhiya jIvaனaijh jhudhandharidhdhughghòLLuMbhaDhighghu nAன èனன jhèyyaveNDhuM èனRu gheDhDhAன.

ibhbhaDhiyirughgha, ghaLLarghaiyil aghabhbhaDhDhavaனughghu indha mUனRubheril èvaன bhiRaனAyirundhAன uனghghu èbhbhaDhidhdhoனRughiRadhu èனRAr.

bhiனbhu, avarghaL bhirayANamAybh bhoghaiyil, avar òru ghirAmadhdhil bhiravejhidhdhAr. a~Nghe mArdhdhAL èனனuMbher ghòNDha òru sdhirI avaraidh dhaனvIDhDhile eRRughghòNDhAL.

bhiனனuM avar avarghaLai noghghi: u~NghaLil òruvaன dhaனghghujh jhineghidhaனAyirughghiRavaனiDhadhdhil bhAdhirAdhdhiriyile bhoy: jhineghidhaனe,

bhiனbhu, dhaனghghu avaன jhineghidhaனAyirughghiRadhiனimidhdhaM èzhundhu avaனughghugh ghòDhAviDhDhAluM, dhaனனiDhadhdhil avaன varundhigh gheDhghiRadhiனimidhdhamAvadhu èzhundhirundhu, avaனughghudh dhevaiyAனdhaigh ghòDhubhbhAன èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

alladhu muDhDhaiyaigh gheDhDhAl, avaனughghudh dheLaigh ghòDhubhbhAனA?

bhòllAdhavarghaLAghiya nI~NghaL u~NghaL bhiLLaighaLughghu nalla IvughaLaigh ghòDhughgha aRindhirughghuMbhodhu, bharama bhidhAvAனvar dhaMmiDhadhdhil veNDhighghòLLughiRavarghaLughghubh bharijhudhdha Aviyaigh ghòDhubhbhadhu adhigha nijhjhayaM allavA èனRAr.
bhiனbhu avar UmaiyAyirundha òru bhijhAjhaidh dhuradhdhiனAr. bhijhAjhu bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனbhiனbhu Umaiyaன bhejhiனAன; jaன~NghaL AjhjhariyabhbhaDhDhArghaL.
avarghaLil jhilar: ivaன bhijhAjhughaLiன dhalaivaனAghiya bhèyèljhèbhUlaighghòNDhu bhijhAjhughaLaidh dhuradhdhughiRAன èனRArghaL.

avarghaLuDhaiya jhindhaனaighaLai avar aRindhu, avarghaLai noghghi: dhaனghՠρdh dhAனe virodhamAybh bhirindhirughghiRa èndha rAjyamuM bhAzhAybhbhoM; dhaனghghudhdhAனe virodhamAybh bhirindhirughghiRa èndha vIDhuM vizhundhubhoM.

abhbhòzhudhu niyAyajhAsdhirighaLil òruvaன avarai noghghi: bhodhaghare, nIr ibhbhaDhijh jhòllughiRadhiனAl è~NghaLaiyuM nindhighghiRIre èனRAன.

adhaRghu avar: niyAyajhAsdhirighaLe, u~NghaLughghu aiyo, jhumaghgha aridhAன jhumaighaLai maனuSharmel jhumadhdhughiRIrghaL; nI~NghaLo u~NghaL viralghaLil òனRiனAluM andhajh jhumaighaLaidh dhòDhavuMmADhDhIrghaL.

AdhalAl dheva~nAனmAனdhu: nAன dhIrghghadharijhighaLaiyuM abhbhosdhalarghaLaiyuM avarghaLiDhadhdhil aனubhbhuveன; avarghaLil jhilaraigh ghòlaijhèydhu, jhilaraidh dhuனbhabhbhaDhudhdhuvArghaL;

nI èனghghujh jhAbhbhADhu AyadhdhaMbhaNNi, araighaDhDhighghòNDhu, nAன bhojaனbhAனMbhaNNumaLavuM èனghghu Uzhiya~njhèy, adhaRghubhbhiன nI bhujhidhdhughghuDhighghalAM èனRu avaனughghujh jhòlluvAனllavA.
dhAன ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhavaighaLai andha velaighghAraன jhèydhadhaRghAgha avaனughghu ubhajhAra~njhèyvAனo? abhbhaDhijh jhèyyamADhDhAனe.

abhbhaDhiye nI~NghaLuM u~NghaLughghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhabhbhaDhDha yAvaRRaiyuM jhèydhabhiனbhu: nA~NghaL abhbhirayojaனmAன UzhiyaghghArar, jhèyyaveNDhiya ghaDhamaiyaimAdhdhiraM jhèydhoM èனRu jhòllu~NghaL èனRAr.
bhiனbhu avar èrujhalemughghubh bhirayAMbhaNNughaiyil, avar jhamAriyA ghalileyA èனனuM nADhughaLiன vazhiyAgha naDhandhu bhoனAr.
avar òru ghirAmadhdhil bhiravejhidhdhabhodhu, ghuShDharoghamuLLa maனuShar bhadhdhubhbher avarughghu èdhirAgha vandhu, dhUradhdhile niனRu:
iyejhu aiyare, è~NghaLughghu ira~NghuM èனRu jhadhdhamiDhDhArghaL.

avarghaLil òruvaன dhAன AroghghiyamAனdhaigh ghaNDhu, dhiruMbhivandhu, uradhdha jhadhdhadhdhoDhe dhevaனai maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhi,
avaruDhaiya bhAdhadhdharughe mugha~NghubhbhuRa vizhundhu, avarughghu sdhodhdhira~njhèludhdhiனAன; avaன jhamAriyaனAyirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu: jhudhdhamAனvarghaL bhadhdhubhbher allavA, maRRa òனbhadhubher è~Nghe?
dhevaனai maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhughiRadhaRghu, indha anniyaனe òzhiya maRRòruvaனuM dhiruMbhivaraghghANome èனRu jhòlli
avaனai noghghi: nI èzhundhubho, uன vijhuvAjhaM uனனai iraDhjhidhdhadhu èனRAr.
dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyaM èbhbhòzhudhu varumèனRu, bharijheyar avariDhadhdhil gheDhDhabhòzhudhu, avarghaLughghu avar bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha. dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyaM bhiradhdhiyaDhjhamAy varAdhu.
idho, i~Nghe èனRuM, adho, a~Nghe èனRuM jhòllabhbhaDhughiRadhaRghuM edhuvirAdhu; idho, dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyaM u~NghaLughghuL irughghiRadhe èனRAr.
bhiனbhu avar jhISharghaLai noghghi: maனuShaghumAraனuDhaiya nADhghaLilòனRaigh ghANaveNDhumèனRu nI~NghaL AjhaibhbhaDhu~NghAlaM varuM; AனAluM adhaigh ghANamADhDhIrghaL.

andhabhbhaDhiye dhevaன dhaMmai noghghi iravuM bhaghaluM ghUbhbhiDhughiRavarghaLAghiya dhaMmAl dhèrindhughòLLabhbhaDhDhavarghaLiன viShayadhdhil nIDhiya bhòRumaiyuLLavarAyirundhu avarghaLughghu niyAya~njhèyyAmalirubhbhAro?

bharijheyaன niனRu; dhevaனe! nAன bhaRighArar, aniyAyaghghArar, vibhajhAraghghArar Aghiya maRRa maனuSharaibhbholavuM, indha AyaghghAraனaibhbholavuM irAdhadhaனAl uMmai sdhodhdhirighghiReன.

bhiனbhu avar bhaனனiruvaraiyuM dhaMmiDhadhdhil azhaidhdhu: idho, èrujhalemughghubh bhoghiRoM, maனuShaghumAraனaigh ghuRidhdhudh dhIrghghadharijhighaLAl èzhudhabhbhaDhDhavaighaLèllAM niRaiveRuM.
èbhbhaDhiyèனil, avar bhuRajAdhiyAriDhadhdhil òbhbhughghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhu, bhariyAjhamuM nindhaiyuM aDhaindhu, dhubhbhabhbhaDhuvAr.
avarai vAriனAl aDhidhdhu, ghòlai jhèyvArghaL; mUனRAM nALile avar uyiroDhe èzhundhirubhbhAr èனRAr.

nAன uனghghu èனனjhèyyaveNDhuM èனRirughghiRAy èனRu gheDhDhAr. adhaRghu avaன: ANDhavare, nAன bhArvaiyaDhaiyaveNDhuM èனRAன.

uDhaனe avaன bhArvaiyaDhaindhu, dhevaனai maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhighghòNDhe, avarughghubh bhiனjhèனRAன. jaன~NghaLèllAruM adhaigh ghaNDhu, dhevaனaibh bhughazhndhArghaL.
avar èrighovil bhiravejhidhdhu, adhiன vazhiyAgha naDhandhubhoghaiyil,

abhbhòzhudhu mundhiனvaன vandhu: ANDhavaனe, uMmuDhaiya rAdhdhaliனAl bhadhdhurAdhdhal AdhAyaM ghiDhaidhdhadhu èனRAன.
èjamAன avaனai noghghi: nalladhu udhdhama UzhiyaghghAraனe, nI ghò~njhadhdhil uNmaiyuLLavaனAyirundhabhaDhiyAl bhadhdhubh bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLughghu adhighAriyAyiru èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM vedhabhAragharuM avaraigh ghòlaijhèyyuMbhaDhi yojhidhdhu, jaன~NghaLughghubh bhayabhbhaDhDhabhaDhiyiனAl, èvvidhamAy abhbhaDhijh jhèyyalAmèனRu vaghaidheDhiனArghaL.

avaன bhiradhAன AjhAriyarghaLiDhadhdhiluM jheனaidh dhalaivarghaLiDhadhdhiluM bhoy, avaraigh ghADhDhighghòDhughghuM vaghaiyaigh ghuRidhdhu avarghaLoDhe Alojhaனai bhaNNiனAன.
avarghaL jhandhoShabhbhaDhDhu, avaனughghubh bhaNa~NghòDhughgha uDhaனbhaDhDhArghaL.

bhasghAvaibh bhaliyiDhaveNDhiya bhuLibhbhillAdha abhbhabh bhaNDhighai nAL vandhadhu.

andha vIDhDhèjamAனai noghghi: nAன èன jhISharoDhughUDhabh bhasghAvaibh bhujhighghiRadhaRghudh dhaghudhiyAன iDhaM è~Nghe èனRu bhodhaghar uMmiDhadhdhil gheDhghajh jhòனனAr èனRu jhòllu~NghaL.

nAன u~NghaLiDhadhdhil viனAviனAluM èனghghu mARudhdharaM jhòllamADhDhIrghaL, èனனai viDhudhalaibhaNNavumADhDhIrghaL.

bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM vedhabhAragharuM avarmel bhiDhivAdhamAygh ghuRRa~njhADhDhighghòNDhe niனRArghaL.

muனனe òruvarughghòruvar bhaghaivarAyirundha bhilAdhdhuvuM erodhuM aனRaiyadhdhiனM jhineghidharAனArghaL.

u~NghaLai erodhiனiDhadhdhiRghuM aனubhbhiனeன; avaruM ivaனiDhadhdhil ghuRRaM ghANavillai: maraNadhdhughghedhuvAgha ivaன òனRuM jhèyyavillaiye,
AனbhaDhiyAl ivaனai dhaNDhidhdhu, viDhudhalaiϠξghghuveன èனRAன.
bhaNDhighaiΤoRuM avarghaLughghu òruvaனai avaன viDhudhalaiyAghghuvadhu avajhiyamAyirundhabhaDhiyAl abhbhaDhijh jhòனனAன.
jaன~NghaLèllAruM adhaigh gheDhDhu: ivaனai aghaRRuM, bharabhAjhai è~NghaLughghu viDhudhalaiyAghghuM èனRu jhadhdhamiDhDhugh gheDhDhArghaL.

bhilAdhdhu iyejhuvai viDhudhalaiyAghgha maனdhAy, maRubhaDhiyuM avarghaLiDhadhdhil bhejhiனAன.
avarghaLo: avaனaijh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuM, jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuM èனRu ghUghghuraliDhDhArghaL.

avaன mUனRAndharaM avarghaLai noghghi: eன, ivaன èனன bhòllAbhbhujh jhèydhAன? maraNadhdhughghu edhuvAன ghuRRaM òனRuM ivaனiDhadhdhil nAன ghANavillaiye; AghaiyAl nAன ivaனaidh dhaNDhidhdhu, viDhudhalaiyAghghuveன èனRAன.
abhbhaDhiyirundhuM avaraijh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyaveNDhumèனRu avarghaL uradhdha jhadhdhadhdhoDhu gheDhDhughghòNDheyirundhArghaL. avarghaLuM bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM iDhDha jhadhdhaM meRghòNDhadhu.

ghalaghadhdhiனimidhdhamuM ghòlaibhAdhaghadhdhiனimidhdhamuM ghAvalil bhoDhabhbhaDhDhirundhavaனai avarghaL gheDhDhughghòNDhabhaDhiye viDhudhalaiyAghghi, iyejhuvaiyo avarghaL iShDhadhdhughghu òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAன.

avarghaL iyejhuvaigh ghòNDhubhoghiRabhodhu, nADhDhilirundhu varughiRa jhireனe UrAனAghiya jhImoன èனghiRa òruvaனaibh bhiDhidhdhu, jhiluvaiyai avar bhiனனe jhumandhughòNDhuvaruMbhaDhi adhai avaனmel vaidhdhArghaL.
dhiraLghUDhDhamAன jaன~NghaLuM avarughghAghabh bhulaMbhi azhughiRa sdhirIghaLuM avarughghubh bhiனjhèனRArghaL.
iyejhu avarghaL mughamAydh dhiruMbhi: èrujhalemiன ghumAradhdhighaLe, nI~NghaL èனghghAgha azhAmal, u~NghaLughghAghavuM u~NghaL bhiLLaighaLughghAghavuM azhu~NghaL.
idho malaDhighaL bhAghghiyavadhighaLèனRuM, bhiLLaibhèRAdha gharbhbha~NghaLuM bhAlghòDhAdha mulaighaLuM bhAghghiyamuLLavaighaLèனRuM jhòllabhbhaDhuM nADhghaLvaruM.
abhbhòzhudhu malaighaLai noghghi: è~NghaLmel vizhu~NghaLèனRuM, ghuனRughaLai noghghi: è~NghaLai maRaidhdhughghòLLu~NghaLèனRuM jhòlladhdhòDha~NghuvArghaL.
bhajhjhaimaradhdhughghu ivaighaLaijh jhèydhAl, bhaDhDhamaradhdhughghu èனன jhèyyamADhDhArghaL èனRAr.
ghuRRavALighaLAghiya veRe iraNDhubheruM avaroDheghUDhagh ghòlaijhèyyabhbhaDhuvadhaRghugh ghòNDhubhoghabhbhaDhDhArghaL.

ghabhAlasdhalaM èனRu jhòllabhbhaDhDha iDhadhdhil avarghaL jherndhabhòzhudhu, avaraiyuM, avaruDhaiya valadhubhaghghadhdhil òru ghuRRavALiyaiyuM, avaruDhaiya iDhadhubhaghghadhdhil òru ghuRRavALiyaiyuM jhiluvaighaLil aRaindhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu: bhidhAve ivarghaLughghu maனனiyuM, dhA~NghaL jhèyghiRadhu iனனdhèனRu aRiyAdhirughghiRArghaLe èனRAr. avaruDhaiya vasdhira~NghaLai avarghaL bha~NghiDhDhujh jhIDhDhubhbhoDhDhArghaL.

jaன~NghaL niனRu bhArdhdhughghòNDhirundhArghaL. avarghaLuDhaனe ghUDha adhighArighaLuM avarai ighazhndhu: ivaன maRRavarghaLai iraDhjhidhdhAன, ivaன dhevaனAl dhèrindhughòLLabhbhaDhDha ghiRisdhuvAனAl dhaனனaidhdhAனe iraDhjhidhdhughghòLLaDhDhuM èனRArghaL.
bhorjhjhevagharuM avariDhadhdhil jherndhu, avarughghugh ghADhiyaigh ghòDhudhdhu:
nI yUdhariன rAjAvAனAl, uனனai iraDhjhidhdhughghòL èனRu avaraibh bhariyAjhaMbhaNனiனArghaL.
ivaன yUdharuDhaiya rAjA èனRu, ghireghghu ladhdhIன èbhirèyu èzhudhdhughghaLil èzhudhi, avarughghu melAgha vaighghabhbhaDhDhadhu.
aனRiyuM jhiluvaiyil aRaiyabhbhaDhDhirundha ghuRRavALighaLil òruvaன: nI ghiRisdhuvAனAl uனனaiyuM è~NghaLaiyuM iraDhjhidhdhughghòL èனRu avarai ighazhndhAன.
maRRavaன avaனai noghghi: nI indha AghghiனaighghuDhbhaDhDhavaனAyirundhuM dhevaனughghubh bhayabhbhaDhughiRadhillaiyA?
nAmo niyAyabhbhaDhi dhaNDhighghabhbhaDhughiRoM nAM naDhabhbhidhdhavaighaLughghudhdhaghgha bhalaனai aDhaighiRoM; ivaro dhaghAdhadhòனRaiyuM naDhabhbhighghavillaiye èனRu avaனaigh ghaDhindhughòNDhu,
iyejhuvai noghghi: ANDhavare, nIr uMmuDhaiya rAjyadhdhil varuMbhodhu aDhiyeனai niனaidhdharuLuM èனRAன.
iyejhu avaனai noghghi: iனRaighghu nI èனனuDhaனeghUDhabh bharadhIjhilirubhbhAy èனRu mèyyAghave uனghghujh jhòllughiReன èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu eRaghghuRaiya ARAMmaNi neramAyirundhadhu; òனbhadhAMmaNi neraM varaighghuM bhUmiyè~NghuM andhaghAramuNDhAyiRRu.
jhUriyaன iruLaDhaindhadhu, dhevAlayadhdhiன dhiraijhjhIlai naDhuvil iraNDhAghagh ghizhindhadhu.
iyejhu: bhidhAve, uMmuDhaiya ghaighaLil èன Aviyai òbhbhuvighghiReன èனRu maghA jhadhdhamAygh ghUbhbhiDhDhujhjhòனனAr; ibhbhaDhijh jhòlli, jIvaனaiviDhDhAr.
nURRughghu adhibhadhi jhaMbhavidhdhadhaigh ghaNDhu: mèyyAghave indha maனuShaன nIdhibharaனAyirundhAன èனRu jhòlli, dhevaனai maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhiனAன.
indhagh ghADhjhiyaibh bhArghghuMbhaDhi ghUDhivandhirundha jaன~NghaLèllAruM jhaMbhavidhdhavaighaLaibh bhArdhdhabhòzhudhu, dha~NghaL mArbhil aDhidhdhughghòNDhu dhiruMbhibhbhoனArghaL.
avarughghu aRimughamAனvarghaLèllAruM, ghalileyAvilirundhu avarughghubhbhiனjhèனRu vandha sdhirIghaLuM dhUradhdhile niனRu ivaighaLaibh bhArdhdhughghòNDhirundhArghaL.

adhai iRaghghi, mèlliya dhubhbhaDhDhiyile jhuRRi, ghaனmalaiyil vèDhDhabhbhaDhDhadhumAy òrughghAluM òruvaனuM vaighghabhbhaDhAdhadhumAyirundha òru ghallaRaiyile vaidhdhAன.

andha sdhirIghaL bhayabhbhaDhDhudh dhalaighavizhndhu dharaiyai noghghi niRghaiyil, andha iraNDhubheruM avarghaLai noghghi: uyiroDhirughghiRavarai nI~NghaL maridhdhoriDhadhdhil dheDhughiRadhèனன?

aனRaiyadhdhiனme avarghaLil iraNDhubher èrujhalemughghu ezhu alladhu èDhDhu mail dhUramAன èMmAvu èனனuM ghirAmadhdhughghubh bhoனArghaL.

ibhbhaDhi avarghaL bhejhi, jhaMbhAShidhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, iyejhu dhAme jherndhu avarghaLuDhaனeghUDha naDhandhubhoனAr.
AனAluM avarai aRiyAdhabhaDhighghu avarghaLuDhaiya ghaNghaL maRaighghabhbhaDhDhirundhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu avar avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL dhughghamughamuLLavarghaLAy vazhinaDhandhu, òruvarughghòruvar jhòllighghòLLughiRa ghAriya~NghaL èனனvèனRu gheDhDhAr.

avare isravelai mIDhDhiraDhjhibhbhavar èனRu nA~NghaL naMbhiyirundhoM ivaighaL jhaMbhavidhdhu iனRu mUனRu nALAghiRadhu.
AனAluM è~NghaL ghUDhDhadhdhaijh jherndha jhila sdhirIghaL adhighAlame ghallaRaiyiனiDhadhdhiRghubhbhoy,

ghiRisdhu ivvidhamAghabh bhADhubhaDhavuM, dhamadhu maghimaiyil bhiravejhighghavuM veNDhiyadhillaiyA èனRu jhòlli,

avarghaLoDhe avar bhandhiyirughghaiyil, avar abhbhadhdhai èDhudhdhu, AjhIrvadhidhdhu, adhaibhbhiDhDhu, avarghaLughghugh ghòDhudhdhAr.

annerame èzhundhirundhu, èrujhalemughghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoy, bhadhiனòruvaruM avarghaLoDhirundhavarghaLuM ghUDhiyirughghaghghaNDhu:

avaன avarghaLughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha èனனaijh jhòsdhamAghghiனvar, uனbhaDhughghaiyai èDhudhdhughghòNDhu naDhavèனRu èனghghujh jhòனனAr èனRAன.

jhòsdhamAghghabhbhaDhDhavaன avar iனனArèனRu aRiyavillai; avviDhadhdhil jaன~NghaL ghUDhDhamAyirundhabhaDhiyiனAl iyejhu vilaghiyirundhAr.

andha maனuShaன bhoy, dhaனனaijh jhòsdhamAghghiனvar iyejhu èனRu yUdharghaLughghu aRividhdhAன.

avar oyvunAL ghaDhDhaLaiyai mIRiனdhumallAmal, dhevaனaidh dhaMmuDhaiya jhòndhabh bhidhA èனRu~njhòllidh dhaMmai dhevaனughghujh jhamamAghghiனbhaDhiyiனAle, yUdharghaL avaraigh ghòlaijhèyyuMbhaDhi adhighamAy vaghaidheDhiனArghaL.

aனRiyuM bhidhAvaigh ghaனMbhaNNughiRadhubhola èllAruM ghumAraனaiyuM ghaனMbhaNNuMbhaDhighghu, bhidhAvAனvardhAme òruvarughghuM niyAyadhdhIrbhbhujh jhèyyAmal, niyAyadhdhIrbhbhujh jhèyyuM adhighAraM muzhuvadhaiyuM ghumAraனughghu òbhbhughghòDhudhdhirughghiRAr.
ghumAraனaigh ghaனMbhaNNAdhavaன avarai aனubhbhiன bhidhAvaiyuM ghaனMbhaNNAdhavaனAyirughghiRAன.

èன vajhaனdhdhaigh gheDhDhu, èனனai aனubhbhiனvarai vijhuvAjhighghiRavaனughghu nidhdhiyajIvaன uNDhu; avaன AghghiனaidhdhIrbhbhughghuDhbhaDhAmal, maraNadhdhaiviDhDhu nI~Nghi, jIvaனughghuDhbhaDhDhirughghiRAன èனRu mèyyAghave mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

maridhdhor dhevaghumAraனuDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhaigh gheDhghu~NghAlaM varuM, adhu ibhbhòzhudhe vandhirughghiRadhu; adhaigh gheDhghiRavarghaL bhizhaibhbhArghaL èனRu mèyyAghave mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
eனèனil, bhidhAvAனvar dhaMmil dhAme jIvaனuDhaiyavarAyirughghiRadhubhola, ghumAraனuM dhaMmildhAme jIvaனuDhaiyavarAyirughghuMbhaDhi aruL jhèydhirughghiRAr.
avar maனuShaghumAraனAyirughghiRabhaDhiyAl, niyAyadhdhIrbhbhujh jhèyyuMbhaDhighghu adhighAradhdhaiyuM avarughghugh ghòDhudhdhirughghiRAr.
idhaighghuRidhdhu nI~NghaL AjhjhariyabhbhaDhaveNDhAM; eனèனRAl bhiredhaghghuzhighaLiluLLa aனaivaruM avaruDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhaigh gheDhghu~N ghAlaM varuM;
abhbhòzhudhu, naனmaijhèydhavarghaL jIvaனai aDhaiyuMbhaDhi èzhundhirughghiRavarghaLAghavuM, dhImai jhèydhavarghaL Aghghiனaiyai aDhaiyuMbhaDhi èzhundhirughghiRavarghaLAghavuM bhuRabhbhaDhuvArghaL.

nAன èன jhuyamAy òனRu~njhèyghiRadhillai; nAன gheDhghiRabhaDhiye niyAyandhIrghghiReன; èனghghujh jhidhdhamAனdhai nAன dheDhAmal, èனனai aனubhbhiன bhidhAvughghujh jhidhdhamAனdhaiye nAன dheDhughiRabhaDhiyAl èன dhIrbhbhu nIdhiyAyirughghiRadhu.
èனனaighghuRidhdhu nAனe jhADhjhighòDhudhdhAl èன jhADhjhi mèyyAyirAdhu.

yovAனuDhaiya jhADhjhiyaibhbhArghghiluM meனmaiyAன jhADhjhi èனghghu uNDhu; adhèனனvèனil, nAன niRaiveRRuMbhaDhighghubh bhidhAvAனvar èனghghugh ghaRbhidhdhadhuM nAன jhèydhuvarughiRadhumAன ghiriyaighaLe bhidhA èனனai aனubhbhiனAr èனRu èனனaighghuRidhdhujh jhADhjhi ghòDhughghiRadhu.
èனனai aனubhbhiன bhidhA dhAme èனனaigh ghuRidhdhujh jhADhjhi ghòDhudhdhirughghiRAr; nI~NghaL òrughghAluM avar jhadhdhadhdhaigh gheDhDhadhumillai, avar rUbhadhdhaigh ghaNDhadhumillai.
avar aனubhbhiனvarai nI~NghaL vijhuvAjhiyAdhabhaDhiyAl avaruDhaiya vajhaனM u~NghaLil dharidhdhirughghiRadhumillai.
vedhavAghghiya~NghaLai ArAyndhubhAru~NghaL; avaighaLAl u~NghaLughghu nidhdhiyajIvaன uNDhèனRu èNNughiRIrghaLe, èனனaighghuRidhdhujh jhADhjhighòDhughghiRavaighaLuM avaighaLe.
abhbhaDhiyirundhuM u~NghaLughghu jIvaன uNDhAghuMbhaDhi èனனiDhadhdhil vara u~NghaLughghu maனdhillai.
nAன maனuSharAl maghimaiyai eRRughghòLLughiRadhillai.

nAன èன bhidhAviன nAmadhdhiனAle vandhirundhuM nI~NghaL èனனai eRRughghòLLavillai, veRòruvaன dhaன jhuya nAmadhdhiனAle vandhAl avaனai eRRughghòLvIrghaL.
dhevaனAlemAdhdhiraM varughiRa maghimaiyaidh dheDhAmal, òruvarAlòruvar maghimaiyai eRRughghòLLughiRa nI~NghaL èbhbhaDhi vijhuvAjhibhbhIrghaL?
bhidhAviனiDhadhdhil nAன u~NghaLmel ghuRRa~njhADhDhuveன èனRu niனaiyAdhiru~NghaL, nI~NghaL naMbhughiRa mojheye u~NghaLmel ghuRRa~njhADhDhuvAன.

iyejhu: jaன~NghaLai uDhghAravaiyu~NghaL èனRAr. andha iDhaM mighundha bhulluLLadhAyirundhadhu. bhandhiyirundha bhuruSharghaL eRaghghuRaiya aiyAyiraM bherAyirundhArghaL.

bhaDhavil eRi, ghaDhaliன aghgharaiyiluLLa ghabhbharnaghUmughghu nerAybhbhoனArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu iruDhDhAyirundhadhu, iyejhuvuM avarghaLiDhadhdhil varAdhirundhAr.
bhèru~NghARRu aDhidhdhabhaDhiyiனAle ghaDhal ghòndhaLindhadhu.

maRunALil ghaDhaliன aghgharaiyile niனRa jaன~NghaL avaruDhaiya jhIShar eRiன andha òre bhaDhavudhavira a~Nghe veRòru bhaDhavuM irundhadhillaiyèனRuM, iyejhu dhaMmuDhaiya jhISharuDhaனeghUDhabh bhaDhavil eRAmal avaruDhaiya jhIShar mAdhdhiraM bhoனArghaLèனRuM aRindhArghaL.
ghardhdhar sdhodhdhira~njhèydhabhiனbhu avarghaL abhbhaM jhAbhbhiDhDha iDhadhdhughghujh jhamIbhamAydh dhibheriyAvilirundhu veRe bhaDhavughaL vandhadhu.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhuvuM avaruDhaiya jhISharuM a~Nghe illAdhadhai jaன~NghaL ghaNDhu, uDhaனe andhabh bhaDhavughaLil eRi, iyejhuvaidh dheDhighghòNDhu, ghabhbharnaghUmughghu vandhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu avarghaL avarai noghghi dhevaனughgheRRa ghiriyaighaLai naDhabhbhighghuMbhaDhi nA~NghaL èனன jhèyyaveNDhuM èனRArghaL.
iyejhu avarghaLughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: avar aனubhbhiனvarai nI~NghaL vijhuvAjhibhbhadhe dhevaனughgheRRa ghiriyaiyAyirughghiRadhu èனRAr.
adhaRghu avarghaL: abhbhaDhiyAனAl uMmai vijhuvAjhighghuMbhaDhighghu nA~NghaL ghANadhdhaghghadhAgha nIr èனன aDhaiyALadhdhaigh ghANbhighghiRIr? èனனdhdhai naDhabhbhighghiRIr?

vAனdhdhilirundhiRa~Nghi, ulaghadhdhughghu jIvaனaigh ghòDhughghiRa abhbhame dhevaன aruLiya abhbhaM èனRAr.

nI~NghaL èனனaigh ghaNDhirundhuM vijhuvAjhiyAmalirughghiRIrghaL èனRu u~NghaLughghujh jhòனனeன.

èன jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiyalla, èனனai aனubhbhiனvaruDhaiya jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhi jhèyyave nAன vAனdhdhilirundhiRa~Nghivandheன.
avar èனghghudh dhandhavaighaLil òனRaiyuM nAன izhandhubhoghAmal, ghaDhaijhinALil avaighaLai èzhubhbhuvadhe èனனai aனubhbhiன bhidhAviன jhidhdhamAyirughghiRadhu.

ghumAraனaigh ghaNDhu, avariDhadhdhil vijhuvAjhamAyirughghiRavaன èvaனo avaன, nidhdhiyajIvaனai aDhaivadhuM, nAன avaனaigh ghaDhaijhinALil èzhubhbhuvadhuM, èனனai aனubhbhiனvaruDhaiya jhidhdhamAyirughghiRadhu èனRAr.
nAன vAனdhdhilirundhu vandha abhbhaM èனRu avar jhòனனdhiனimidhdhaM yUdharghaL avaraighghuRidhdhu muRumuRudhdhu:

ivaன yojhebhbhiன ghumAraனAghiya iyejhu allavA, ivaனuDhaiya dhaghabhbhaனaiyuM dhAyaiyuM aRindhirughghiRome; abhbhaDhiyirughgha, nAன vAனdhdhilirundhiRa~Nghi vandheன èனRu ivaன èbhbhaDhijh jhòllughiRAன èனRArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu yUdharghaL; ivaன dhaனனuDhaiya mAMjhadhdhai èbhbhaDhi namaghghubh bhujhighghagh ghòDhubhbhAன èனRu dha~NghaLughghuLLe vAghghuvAdhaMbhaNNiனArghaL.

adhaRghu iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: nI~NghaL maனuShaghumAraனuDhaiya mAMjhadhdhaibh bhujhiyAmaluM, avaruDhaiya iradhdhadhdhaibh bhAனMbhaNNAmaluM irundhAl u~NghaLughghuLLe jIvaனillai èனRu mèyyAghave mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

avaruDhaiya jhISharil aneghar ivaighaLaigh gheDhDhabhòzhudhu, idhu ghaDhiனmAன ubhadhejhaM, yAr idhaigh gheDhbhArghaL èனRArghaL.
jhISharghaL adhaighghuRidhdhu muRumuRughghiRArghaLèனRu iyejhu dhamaghghuLLe aRindhu, avarghaLai noghghi: idhu u~NghaLughghu iDhaRalAyirughghiRadho?

iyejhu avarghaLughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: èன ubhadhejhaM èனனuDhaiyadhAyirAmal, èனனai aனubhbhiனvaruDhaiyadhAyirughghiRadhu.

avaன dhaனனuDhaiya ADhughaLai vèLiye viDhDhabhiனbhu, avaighaLughghu muனbhAgha naDhandhubhoghiRAன, ADhughaL avaன jhadhdhadhdhai aRindhirughghiRabhaDhiyiனAl avaனughghubh bhiனjhèllughiRadhu.
anniyaruDhaiya jhadhdhadhdhai aRiyAdhabhaDhiyiனAl avaighaL anniyaனughghubh bhiனjhèllAmal, avaனai viDhDhoDhibhbhoM èனRAr.
indha uvamaiyai iyejhu avarghaLuDhaனe jhòனனAr; avarghaLo avar jhòனனvaighaLiன gharudhdhai aRiyavillai.
AdhalAl iyejhu maRubhaDhiyuM avarghaLai noghghi: nAனe ADhughaLughghu vAjhal èனRu mèyyAghave mèyyAghave u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.
èனghghu muனனe vandhavarghaLèllAruM ghaLLaruM ghòLLaighghArarumAyirughghiRArghaL; ADhughaL avarghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhughghavillai.
nAனe vAjhal, èன vazhiyAy òruvaன uDhbhiravejhidhdhAl, avaன iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhuvAன, avaன uLLuM bhuRaMbhuMjhèனRu, meyjhjhalaigh ghaNDhaDhaivAன.
dhiruDhaன dhiruDhavuM ghòllavuM azhighghavuM varughiRAனeyaனRi veRòனRughghuM varAன. nAனo avaighaLughghu jIvaன uNDhAyirughghavuM, adhu bharibhUraNabhbhaDhavuM vandheன.
nAனe nalla meybhbhaன: nallameybhbhaன ADhughaLughghughghAghadh dhaன jIvaனaigh ghòDhughghiRAன.

meybhbhaனAyirAdhavaனuM, ADhughaL dhaனghghujh jhòndhamallAdhavaனumAன ghUliyAL onAy varughiRadhaigh ghaNDhu ADhughaLaiviDhDhu oDhibhbhoghiRAன; abhbhòzhudhu onAy ADhughaLaibhbhIRi, avaighaLaijh jhidhaRaDhighghuM.
ghUliyAL ghUlighghAgha velaijhèyghiRavaனAghaiyAl oDhibhbhoghiRAன, ADhughaLughghAgha avaன ghavalaibhbhaDhAன.
nAனe nalla meybhbhaன; bhidhA èனனai aRindhirughghiRadhubholavuM, nAன bhidhAvai aRindhirughghiRadhubholavuM,
nAன èனனuDhaiyavaighaLai aRindhuM èனனuDhaiyavaighaLAl aRiyabhbhaDhDhumirughghiReன; ADhughaLughghAgha èன jIvaனaiyuM ghòDhughghiReன.

indhadh dhòzhuvadhdhiluLLavaighaLallAmal veRe ADhughaLuM èனghghu uNDhu; avaighaLaiyuM nAன ghòNDhuvaraveNDhuM, avaighaL èன jhadhdhadhdhughghujh jhèvighòDhughghuM. abhbhòzhudhu òre mandhaiyuM òre meybhbhaனumAghuM.
nAன èன jIvaனai maRubhaDhiyuM aDhaindhughòLLuMbhaDhighghu adhaigh ghòDhughghiRabhaDhiyiனAl bhidhA èனனil aனbhAyirughghiRAr.

òruvaனuM adhai èனனiDhadhdhilirundhu èDhudhdhughghòLLamADhDhAன; nAனe adhaigh ghòDhughghiReன, adhaigh ghòDhughghavuM èனghghu adhighAraM uNDhu, adhai maRubhaDhiyuM èDhudhdhughghòLLavuM èனghghu adhighAramuNDhu. indhagh ghaDhDhaLaiyai èன bhidhAviனiDhadhdhil bhèRRughghòNDheன èனRAr.
indha vajhaன~NghaLiனimidhdhaM yUdharughghuLLe maRubhaDhiyuM bhiriviனaiyuNDhAyiRRu.
avarghaLil aneghar: ivaன bhijhAjhubhiDhidhdhavaன, bhayidhdhiyaghghAraன; eன ivaனughghujh jhèvighòDhughghiRIrghaL èனRArghaL.
veRe jhilar: ivaighaL bhijhAjhubhiDhidhdhavaனuDhaiya vajhaன~NghaLallave. ghuruDharuDhaiya ghaNghaLaibh bhijhAjhu dhiRaghghaghghUDhumA èனRArghaL.
bhiனbhu èrujhalemile dhevAlayabh bhiradhiShDhaibhaNDhighai vandhadhu; mArighAlamumAyirundhadhu.
iyejhu dhevAlayadhdhil jhAlòmoனuDhaiya maNDhabhadhdhile ulAvighghòNDhirundhAr.
abhbhòzhudhu yUdharghaL avaraijh jhUzhndhughòNDhu: èdhuvaraighghuM è~NghaL AdhdhumAvughghujh jhandheghaM uNDhAghghughiRIr, nIr ghiRisdhuvAனAl è~NghaLughghudh dhèLivAyjh jhòlluM èனRArghaL.

iyejhu avarghaLughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: adhai u~NghaLughghujh jhòனனeன, nI~NghaL vijhuvAjhighghavillai; èன bhidhAviன nAmadhdhiனAle nAன jhèyghiRa ghiriyaighaLe èனனaighghuRidhdhujh jhADhjhighòDhughghiRadhu.
AனAluM, nAன u~NghaLughghujh jhòனனbhaDhiye, nI~NghaL èன mandhaiyiன ADhughaLAyirAdhabhaDhiyiனAl vijhuvAjhiyAmalirughghiRIrghaL.
èன ADhughaL èன jhadhdhadhdhiRghujh jhèvighòDhughghiRadhu; nAன avaighaLai aRindhirughghiReன, avaighaL èனghghubh bhiனjhèllughiRadhu.
nAன avaighaLughghu nidhdhiyajIvaனaigh ghòDhughghiReன; avaighaL òrughghAluM ghèDhDhubhbhovadhillai, òruvaனuM avaighaLai èன ghaiyilirundhu bhaRidhdhughghòLvadhumillai.
avaighaLai èனghghudh dhandha èன bhidhA èllAriluM bhèriyavarAyirughghiRAr; avaighaLai èன bhidhAviன ghaiyilirundhu bhaRidhdhughghòLLa òruvaனAluM ghUDhAdhu.
nAனuM bhidhAvuM òனRAyirughghiRoM èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu yUdharghaL maRubhaDhiyuM avarmel ghallèRiyuMbhaDhi, ghallughaLai èDhudhdhughghòNDhArghaL.
iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: nAன èன bhidhAviனAle anegha naRghiriyaighaLai u~NghaLughghugh ghANbhidhdheன, avaighaLil èndhagh ghiriyaiyiனimidhdhaM èனmel ghallèRighiRIrghaL èனRAr.

yUdharghaL avarughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: naRghiriyaiyiனimidhdhaM nA~NghaL uனmel ghallèRighiRadhillai; nI maனuShaனAyirughgha, uனனai dhevaன èனRu jhòlli ivvidhamAgha dhevadhUShaNa~n jhòllughiRabhaDhiyiனAl uனmel ghallèRighiRoM èனRArghaL.
iyejhu avarghaLughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: dhevarghaLAyirughghiRIrghaL èனRu nAன jhòனனeன èனbhadhAy u~NghaL vedhadhdhil èzhudhiyirughghavillaiyA?
dhevavajhaனdhdhaibh bhèRRughghòNDhavarghaLai dhevarghaL èனRu avar jhòlliyirughgha, vedhavAghghiyamuM dhavaRAdhadhAyirughgha,
bhidhAviனAl bharijhudhdhamAghghabhbhaDhDhuM, ulaghadhdhil aனubhbhabhbhaDhDhuM irughghiRa nAன èனனai dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraன èனRu jhòனனdhiனAle dhevadhUShaNa~n jhòனனAy èனRu nI~NghaL jhòllalAmA?
èன bhidhAviன ghiriyaighaLai nAன jhèyyAdhirundhAl, nI~NghaL èனனai vijhuvAjhighghaveNDhiyadhillai.
jhèydheனeyAனAl, nI~NghaL èனனai vijhuvAjhiyAdhirundhAluM, bhidhA èனனiluM nAன avariluM irughghiRadhai nI~NghaL aRindhu vijhuvAjhighghuMbhaDhi andhagh ghiriyaighaLai vijhuvAjhiyu~NghaL èனRAr.
idhiனimidhdhaM avarghaL maRubhaDhiyuM avaraibh bhiDhighgha dheDhiனArghaL, avaro avarghaL ghaighghudh dhabhbhi,
yordhAனughghu aghgharaiyile muனனe yovAன ~nAனsnAன~NghòDhudhdhughghòNDhirundha iDhadhdhughghudh dhiruMbhibhbhoy, a~Nghe dha~NghiனAr.
aneghar avariDhadhdhil vandhu: yovAன òru aRbhudhadhdhaiyuM jhèyyavillai; AghiluM ivaraighghuRidhdhu yovAன jhòனனdhèllAM mèyyAyirughghiRadhu èனRArghaL.
avviDhadhdhile aneghar avariDhadhdhil vijhuvAjhamuLLavarghaLAனArghaL.
mariyALuM avaL jhaghodhariyAghiya mArdhdhALuM irundha bhèdhdhAனiyA ghirAmadhdhiluLLavaனAghiya lAjharu èனனuM òruvaன viyAdhibhbhaDhDhirundhAன.
ghardhdharughghubh bharimaLadhailaM bhUjhi, dhaன dhalaimayirAl avaruDhaiya bhAdha~NghaLaidh dhuDhaidhdhavaL andha mariyALe; avaLuDhaiya jhaghodharaனAghiya lAjharu viyAdhiyAyirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu avaனuDhaiya jhaghodharighaL; ANDhavare, nIr jhineghighghiRavaன viyAdhiyAyirughghiRAன èனRu jhòlla, avariDhadhdhiRghu AL aனubhbhiனArghaL.

iyejhu adhaigh gheDhDhabhòzhudhu: indha viyAdhi maraNadhdhughghu edhuvAyirAmal dhevaனuDhaiya maghimai viLa~NghuvadhaRghu edhuvAyirughghiRadhu; dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraனuM adhiனAl maghimaibhbhaDhuvAr èனRAr.
iyejhu mArdhdhALiDhadhdhiluM avaLuDhaiya ΚghodhariyiனiDhadhdhiluM lAjharuviனiDhadhdhiluM aனbhAyirundhAr.
avaன viyAdhiyAyirughghiRadhAgha avar gheLvibhbhaDhDhabhòzhudhu, dhAM irundha iDhadhdhile bhiனனuM iraNDhunAL dha~NghiனAr.
adhaனbhiனbhu avar dhaMmuDhaiya jhISharai noghghi: nAM maRubhaDhiyuM yUdheyAvughghubh bhovoM vAru~NghaL èனRAr.
adhaRghujh jhISharghaL; rabhI, ibhbhòzhudhudhAன yUdhar uMmaigh ghallèRiyadh dheDhiனArghaLe, maRubhaDhiyuM nIr avviDhadhdhiRghubh bhoghalAmA èனRArghaL.
iyejhu bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: bhaghalughghubh bhaனனiraNDhu maNineraM illaiyA? òruvaன bhaghalile naDhandhAl avaன indha ulaghadhdhiன vèLijhjhadhdhaigh ghANghiRabhaDhiyiனAl iDhaRamADhDhAன.
òruvaன iravile naDhandhAl dhaனனiDhadhdhil vèLijhjhaM illAdhabhaDhiyiனAl iDhaRuvAன èனRAr.
ivaighaLai avar jhòlliyabhiனbhu avarghaLai noghghi: naMmuDhaiya jhineghidhaனAghiya lAjharu nidhdhiraiyaDhaindhirughghiRAன. nAன avaனai èzhubhbhabhbhoghiReன èனRAr.
adhaRghu avaruDhaiya jhISharghaL: ANDhavare, nidhdhiraiyaDhaindhirundhAl jhughamaDhaivAன èனRArghaL.
iyejhuvAனvar avaனuDhaiya maraNadhdhaigh ghuRidhdhu abhbhaDhijh jhòனனAr; avarghaLo nidhdhirai jhèydhu iLaibhbhARughiRadhaigh ghuRidhdhujh jhòனனArèனRu niனaidhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: lAjharu maridhdhubhbhoனAன èனRu vèLibhbhaDhaiyAyjh jhòlli;
nAன a~Nghe irAdhadhiனAl nI~NghaL vijhuvAjhamuLLavarghaLAghiRadhaRghu edhuvuNDhèனRu u~NghaL nimidhdhaM jhandhoShabhbhaDhughiReன; ibhbhòzhudhu avaனiDhadhdhiRghubh bhovoM vAru~NghaL èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu dhidhimu èனனbhbhaDhDha dhomA maRRajh jhISharghaLai noghghi: avaroDheghUDha marighghuMbhaDhi nAmuM bhovoM vAru~NghaL èனRAன.
iyejhu vandhabhodhu avaன ghallaRaiyil vaighghabhbhaDhDhu nAlunALAyiRRèனRu ghaNDhAr.
bhèdhdhAனiyA Ur èrujhalemughghujh jhamIbhamAy eRaghghuRaiya iraNDhu mail dhUradhdhilirundhadhu.
yUdharil aneghar mArdhdhAL mariyAL èனbhavarghaLuDhaiya jhaghodharaனaigh ghuRidhdhu avarghaLughghu ARudhal jhòlluMbhaDhi avarghaLiDhadhdhil vandhirundhArghaL.
iyejhu varughiRAr èனRu mArdhdhAL gheLvibhbhaDhDhabhodhu, avarughghu èdhirghòNDhubhoனAL; mariyALo vIDhDhile uDhghArndhirundhAL.
mArdhdhAL iyejhuviனiDhadhdhil vandhu: ANDhavare, nIr i~NgheyirundhIrAனAl èன jhaghodharaன marighghamADhDhAன.
ibhbhòzhudhuM nIr dhevaனiDhadhdhil gheDhDhughghòLLuvadhèdhuvo adhaidh dhevaன umaghghudh dhandharuLuvAr èனRu aRindhirughghiReன èனRAL.
iyejhu avaLai noghghi: uன jhaghodharaன uyirdhdhèzhundhirubhbhAன èனRAr.
adhaRghu mArdhdhAL: uyirdhdhèzhudhal naDhaghghuM ghaDhaijhinALile avaனuM uyirdhdhèzhundhirubhbhAன èனRu aRindhirughghiReன èனRAL.
iyejhu avaLai noghghi: nAனe uyirdhdhèzhudhaluM jIvaனumAyirughghiReன, èனனai vijhuvAjhighghiRavaன maridhdhAluM bhizhaibhbhAன;
uyiroDhirundhu èனனai vijhuvAjhighghiRavaனèvaனuM èனRèனRaighghuM mariyAmaluM irubhbhAன; idhai vijhuvAjhighghiRAyA èனRAr.
adhaRghu avaL: AM, ANDhavare, nIr ulaghadhdhil varughiRavarAன dhevaghumAraனAghiya ghiRisdhu èனRu nAன vijhuvAjhighghiReன èனRAL.
ivaighaLaijh jhòனனbhiனbhu, avaLbhoy, dhaன jhaghodhariyAghiya mariyALai raghajhiyamAy azhaidhdhu: bhodhaghar vandhirughghiRAr, uனனai azhaighghiRAr èனRAL.
avaL adhaigh gheDhDhavuDhaனe, jhIghghiramAy èzhundhu, avariDhadhdhil vandhAL.
iyejhu iனனuM ghirAmadhdhughghuL varAmal, mArdhdhAL dhaMmaijh jhandhidhdha iDhadhdhile irundhAr.

abhbhòzhudhu, vIDhDhile avaLuDhaனeghUDha irundhu avaLughghu ARudhal jhòllighghòNDhirundha yUdharghaL, mariyAL jhIghghiramAy èzhundhubhoghiRadhaigh ghaNDhu: avaL, ghallaRaiyiனiDhadhdhil azhughiRadhaRghubh bhoghiRAL èனRu jhòlli, avaLughghubh bhiனனe bhoனArghaL.
iyejhu irundha iDhadhdhil mariyAL vandhu, avaraigh ghaNDhavuDhaனe, avar bhAdhadhdhil vizhundhu: ANDhavare, nIr i~Nghe irundhIrAனAl èன jhaghodharaன marighghamADhDhAன èனRAL.
avaL azhughiRadhaiyuM avaLoDheghUDha vandha yUdharghaL azhughiRadhaiyuM iyejhu ghaNDhabhodhu Aviyile ghala~Nghidh dhuyaramaDhaindhu:
avaனai è~Nghe vaidhdhIrghaL èனRAr. ANDhavare, vandhu bhAruM èனRArghaL;
iyejhu ghaNNIr viDhDhAr.
abhbhòzhudhu yUdharghaL: idho, ivar avaனai èvvaLavAyjh jhineghidhdhAr èனRArghaL!
avarghaLil jhilar ghuruDhaனuDhaiya ghaNghaLaidh dhiRandha ivar, ivaனaijh jhAghAmalirughghabhbhaNNavuM ghUDhAdhA èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu iyejhu maRubhaDhiyuM dhamaghghuLLe ghala~Nghigh ghallaRaiyiனiDhadhdhiRghu vandhAr. adhu òru ghughaiyAyirundhadhu; adhiனmel òru ghal vaighghabhbhaDhDhirundhadhu.
iyejhu: ghallai èDhudhdhubhbhoDhu~NghaL èனRAr. maridhdhavaனuDhaiya jhaghodhariyAghiya mArdhdhAL avarai noghghi: ANDhavare, ibhbhòzhudhu nARume, nAlunALAyiRRe èனRAL.
iyejhu avaLai noghghi: nI vijhuvAjhidhdhAl dhevaனuDhaiya maghimaiyaigh ghANbhAy èனRu nAன uனghghujh jhòllavillaiyA èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu maridhdhavaன vaighghabhbhaDhDha iDhadhdhilirundha ghallai èDhudhdhubhbhoDhDhArghaL. iyejhu dhaMmuDhaiya ghaNghaLai eRèDhudhdhu: bhidhAve, nIr èனghghujh jhèvighòDhudhdhabhaDhiyiனAl uMmai sdhodhdhirighghiReன.

nIr èbhbhòzhudhuM èனghghujh jhèvighòDhughghiRIr èனRu nAன aRindhirughghiReன; AனAluM nIr èனனai aனubhbhiனdhaijh jhUzhndhuniRghuM jaன~NghaL vijhuvAjhighghuMbhaDhiyAgha avarghaL nimidhdhaM idhaijh jhòனனeன èனRAr.
ivaighaLaijh jhòனனbhiனbhu: lAjharuve, vèLiye vA èனRu, uradhdha jhadhdhamAygh ghUbhbhiDhDhAr.

abhbhòzhudhu, maridhdhavaன vèLiye vandhAன. avaன ghAlghaLuM ghaighaLuM bhiredhajh jhIlaighaLiனAl ghaDhDhabhbhaDhDhirundhadhu, avaன mughamuM jhIlaiyAl jhuRRabhbhaDhDhirundhadhu. iyejhu avarghaLai noghghi: ivaனaigh ghaDhDhavizhdhdhuviDhu~NghaL èனRAr.
abhbhòzhudhu mariyALiDhadhdhil vandhirundhu, iyejhu jhèydhavaighaLaigh ghaNDhavarghaLAghiya yUdharghaLil aneghar avariDhadhdhil vijhuvAjhamuLLavarghaLAனArghaL.
avarghaLil jhilar bharijheyariDhadhdhil bhoy, iyejhu jhèydhavaighaLai avarghaLughghu aRividhdhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM bharijheyaruM Alojhaனaijh jha~Nghadhdhaigh ghUDhivarajhjhèydhu: nAM èனன jhèyghiRadhu? indha maனuShaன anegha aRbhudha~NghaLaijh jhèyghiRAனe.
nAM ivaனai ibhbhaDhi viDhDhuviDhDhAl, èllAruM ivaனai vijhuvAjhibhbhArghaL; abhbhòzhudhu romar vandhu naMmuDhaiya sdhAனdhdhaiyuM jaனdhdhaiyuM azhidhdhubhbhoDhuvArghaLe èனRArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu avarghaLil òruvaனuM andha varuShadhdhubh bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனumAghiya ghAybhA èனbhavaன avarghaLai noghghi: u~NghaLughghu òனRun dhèriyAdhu;
jaன~NghaLèllAruM ghèDhDhubhbhoghAdhabhaDhighghu òre maனuShaன jaன~NghaLughghAgha maribhbhadhu namaghghu nalamAyirughghumèனRu nI~NghaL jhindhiyAmalirughghiRIrghaL èனRAன.
idhai avaன jhuyamAyjh jhòllAmal, andha varuShadhdhubh bhiradhAன AjhAriyaனAனbhaDhiyiனAle iyejhu yUdhajaன~NghaLughghAgha marighghabhbhoghiRArèனRuM,
andha jaன~NghaLughghAghamAdhdhiramalla jhidhaRiyirughghiRa dhevaனuDhaiya bhiLLaighaLai òனRAghajh jherghghiRadhaRghAghavuM marighghabhbhoghiRArèனRuM, dhIrghghadharijhaனmAyjh jhòனனAன.
annAL mudhal avaraigh ghòlaijh jhèyyuMbhaDhighghu Alojhaனai bhaNNiனArghaL.

iyejhu avaனughghubh bhiradhiyudhdharamAgha: òruvaன èனனil aனbhAyirundhAl, avaன èன vajhaனdhdhaigh ghaighghòLLuvAன, avaனil èன bhidhA aனbhAyirubhbhAr; nA~NghaL avaனiDhadhdhil vandhu avaனoDhe vAjhaMbhaNNuvoM.
èனனil aனbhAyirAdhavaன èன vajhaன~NghaLaigh ghaighghòLLamADhDhAன. nI~NghaL gheDhghiRa vajhaனM èனனuDhaiyadhAyirAmal èனனai aனubhbhiன bhidhAviனuDhaiyadhAyirughghiRadhu.

ulaghaM u~NghaLaibh bhaghaidhdhAl, adhu u~NghaLaibh bhaghaighghiRadhaRghumuனனe èனனaibh bhaghaidhdhadhèனRu aRiyu~NghaL.

èனனuDhaiyavaighaL yAvuM uMmuDhaiyavaighaL, uMmuDhaiyavaighaL èனனuDhaiyavaighaL; avarghaLil nAன maghimaibhbhaDhDhirughghiReன,

ibhbhòzhudhu nAன uMmiDhadhdhiRghu varughiReன; avarghaL èன jhandhoShadhdhai niRaivAy aDhaiyuMbhaDhi ulaghadhdhil irughghaiyil ivaighaLaijh jhòllughiReன.

bhasghAbhaNDhighaiyil nAன u~NghaLughghu òruvaனai viDhudhalaibhaNNughiRa vazhaghghamuNDhe; AghaiyAl yUdharuDhaiya rAjAvai nAன u~NghaLughghAgha viDhudhalai bhaNNa u~NghaLughghu maனdhuNDhA èனRAன.
abhbhòzhudhu: avarghaLèllAruM ivaனaiyalla, bharabhAjhai viDhudhalaibhaNNaveNDhuM èனRu maRubhaDhiyuM jhadhdhamiDhDhArghaL; andhabh bharabhAjhèனbhavaன ghaLLaனAyirundhAன.
abhbhòzhudhu bhilAdhdhu iyejhuvaibhbhiDhidhdhu vAriனAl aDhibhbhidhdhAன.
bhorjhjhevaghar muLLughaLiனAl òru muDhiyaibh bhiனனi avar jhirajhiனmel vaidhdhu, jhivabhbhAன òru a~Nghiyai avarughghu uDhudhdhi:
yUdharuDhaiya rAjAve, vAzhgha èனRu jhòlli, avaraigh ghaiyiனAl aDhidhdhArghaL.

bhiradhAன AjhAriyaruM jhevagharuM avaraigh ghaNDhabhodhu: jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuM jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuM èனRu jhadhdhamiDhDhArghaL. adhaRghubh bhilAdhdhu: nI~NghaLe ivaனaigh ghòNDhubhoyjh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyu~NghaL, nAன ivaனiDhadhdhil òru ghuRRamuM ghANeன èனRAன.

abhbhòzhudhu bhilAdhdhu: nI èனனoDhe bhejhughiRadhillaiyA uனனaijh jhiluvaiyil aRaiya èனghghu adhighAramuNDhèனRuM, uனனai viDhudhalaibhaNNa èனghghu adhighAramuNDhèனRuM uனghghudh dhèriyAdhA èனRAன.

bhilAdhdhu indha vArdhdhaiyaigh gheDhDhabhòzhudhu, iyejhuvai vèLiye azhaidhdhuvandhu, dhaLavarijhaibhbhaDhudhdhiன meDhaiyèனRuM, èbhirèyu bhAShaiyile ghabhadhdhA èனRuM jhòllabhbhaDhDha iDhadhdhile, niyAyAjhaனdhdhiனmel uDhghArndhAன.

abhbhòzhudhu avaraijh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyuMbhaDhighghu avarghaLiDhadhdhil òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAன. avarghaL iyejhuvaibh bhiDhidhdhughghòNDhubhoனArghaL.
avar dhaMmuDhaiya jhiluvaiyaijh jhumandhughòNDhu, èbhirèyu bhAShaiyile ghòlghòdhA èனRu jhòllabhbhaDhuM ghabhAlasdhalaM èனghiRa iDhadhdhiRghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoனAr.
a~Nghe avaraijh jhiluvaiyil aRaindhArghaL; avaroDheghUDha veRiraNDhubherai iraNDhu bhaghgha~NghaLiluM iyejhuvai naDhuvilumAghajh jhiluvaighaLil aRaindhArghaL.

abhbhòzhudhu yUdharuDhaiya bhiradhAன AjhAriyar bhilAdhdhuvai noghghi: yUdharuDhaiya rAjA èனRu nIr èzhudhAmal, dhAன yUdharuDhaiya rAjA èனRu avaன jhòனனdhAgha èzhudhuM èனRArghaL.

bhorjh jhevaghar iyejhuvaijh jhiluvaiyil aRaindhabhiனbhu, avaruDhaiya vasdhira~NghaLai èDhudhdhu, òvvòru jhevaghaனughghu òvvòru bha~NghAgha nAlu bha~NghAghghiனArghaL; a~NghiyaiyuM èDhudhdhArghaL, andha a~Nghi, dhaiyalillAmal mele dhòDha~Nghi muzhudhuM nèyyabhbhaDhDhadhAyirundhadhu.

avarghaL: idhai nAM ghizhiyAmal, yArughghu varumo èனRu idhaighghuRidhdhujh jhIDhDhubhbhoDhuvoM èனRu òruvaroDhòruvar bhejhighghòNDhArghaL. èன vasdhira~NghaLaidh dha~NghaLughghuLLe bha~NghiDhDhu, èன uDhaiyiனmel jhIDhDhubhbhoDhDhArghaL èனghiRa vedhavAghghiyaM niRaiveRadhdhaghghadhAghabh bhorjhjhevaghar ibhbhaDhijh jhèydhArghaL.
iyejhuviன jhiluvaiyiனrughe avaruDhaiya dhAyuM, avaruDhaiya dhAyiன jhaghodhari ghilèyobhbhA mariyALuM, maghadhaleனA mariyALuM niனRughòNDhirundhArghaL.

adhaனbhiனbhu, èllAM muDhindhadhu èனRu iyejhu aRindhu, vedhavAghghiyaM niRaiveRadhdhaghghadhAgha: dhAghamAyirughghiReன èனRAr.

abhbhòzhudhu bhedhuruvuM maRRajh jhIShaனuM ghallaRaiyiனiDhadhdhiRghubh bhoghuMbhaDhi bhuRabhbhaDhDhu, iruvaruM òrumidhdhu oDhiனArghaL.

iyejhu dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya ghiRisdhu èனRu nI~NghaL vijhuvAjhighghuMbhaDhiyAghavuM, vijhuvAjhidhdhu avaruDhaiya nAmadhdhiனAle nidhdhiyajIvaனai aDhaiyuMbhaDhiyAghavuM, ivaighaL èzhudhabhbhaDhDhirughghiRadhu.
ivaighaLughghubhbhiனbhu iyejhu dhibheriyA ghaDhaRgharaiyile maRubhaDhiyuM jhISharughghudh dhaMmai vèLibhbhaDhudhdhiனAr; vèLibhbhaDhudhdhiன vivaramAvadhu:

andhajh jhIShaனe ivaighaLaigh ghuRidhdhujh jhADhjhighòDhudhdhu ivaighaLai èzhudhiனvaன; avaனuDhaiya jhADhjhi mèyyèனRu aRindhirughghiRoM.
iyejhu jhèydha veRu anegha ghAriya~NghaLumuNDhu; avaighaLai òvvòனRAgha èzhudhiனAl èzhudhabhbhaDhuM bhusdhagha~NghaL ulaghaM ghòLLAdhèனRu èNNughiReன. Amèன.
dhèyobhbhiluve, iyejhuvAனvar dhAM dhèrindhughòNDha abhbhosdhalarughghubh bharijhudhdha AviyiனAle ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDha bhiனbhu,
avar èDhudhdhughghòLLabhbhaDhDha nALvaraighghuM jhèyyavuM ubhadhejhighghavuM dhòDha~Nghiன èllAvaRRaiyu~NghuRidhdhu, mudhalAM bhirabhandhadhdhai uNDhubhaNNiனeன.

avar bhADhubhaDhDhabhiனbhu, nARbhadhu nALaLavuM abhbhosdhalarughghudh dharijhaனmAghi, dhevaனuDhaiya rAjyadhdhughghuriyavaighaLai avarghaLuDhaனe bhejhi, aneghaM dhèLivAன dhiruShDhAndha~NghaLiனAle avarghaLughghudh dhaMmai uyiroDhirughghiRavarAghagh ghANbhidhdhAr.
aனRiyuM, avar avarghaLuDhaனe ghUDhivandhirughghuMbhodhu, avarghaLai noghghi: yovAன jaladhdhiனAle ~nAனsnAன~NghòDhudhdhAன; nI~NghaL jhila nALughghuLLe bharijhudhdha AviyiனAle ~nAனsnAனM bhèRuvIrghaL.
AghaiyAl nI~NghaL èrujhalemai viDhDhubh bhoghAmal èனனiDhadhdhil gheLvibhbhaDhDha bhidhAviன vAghghudhdhadhdhaM niRaiveRagh ghAdhdhiru~NghaL èனRu ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhAr.
abhbhòzhudhu ghUDhivandhirundhavarghaL avarai noghghi ANDhavare, ighghAladhdhilA rAjyadhdhai isravelughghudh dhiruMbhagh ghòDhubhbhIr èனRu gheDhDhArghaL.
adhaRghu avar: bhidhAvAனvar dhaMmuDhaiya AdhIனdhdhile vaidhdhirughghiRa ghAla~NghaLaiyuM veLaighaLaiyuM aRighiRadhu u~NghaLughghu aDhudhdhadhalla.

bharijhudhdha Avi u~NghaLiDhadhdhil varuMbhodhu nI~NghaL bhèlaனDhaindhu, èrujhalemiluM, yUdheyA muzhuvadhiluM, jhamAriyAviluM, bhUmiyiன ghaDhaijhibhariyandhamuM, èனghghujh jhADhjhighaLAyirubhbhIrghaL èனRAr.
ivaighaLai avar jhòனனbhiனbhu, avarghaL bhArdhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, uyara èDhudhdhughghòLLabhbhaDhDhAr; avarghaL ghaNghaLughghu maRaivAgha òru meghaM avarai èDhudhdhughghòNDhadhu.
avar bhoghiRabhodhu avarghaL vAனdhdhai aNNAndhu bhArdhdhughghòNDhirughghaiyil, idho, vèNmaiyAன vasdhirandharidhdhavarghaL iraNDhu bher avarghaLarughe niனRu:

èllAruDhaiya irudhaya~NghaLaiyuM aRindhirughghiRa ghardhdhAve, yUdhAs èனbhavaன dhaனghghuriya iDhadhdhughghubh bhoghuMbhaDhi izhandhubhoன indha UzhiyadhdhiluM indha abhbhosdhalabhbhaDhDhadhdhiluM bha~NghubhèRuvadhaRghAgha,

bhiனbhu, avarghaLaigh ghuRidhdhujh jhIDhDhubhbhoDhDhArghaL; jhIDhDhu madhdhiyAviன bherughghu vizhundhadhu; abhbhòzhudhu avaன bhadhiனòru abhbhosdhalaruDhaனe jherdhdhughghòLLabhbhaDhDhAன.
bhèndhèghòsdhe èனனuM nAL vandhabhodhu, avarghaLèllAruM òrumaனbhbhaDhDhu oriDhadhdhile vandhirundhArghaL.

andhajh jhadhdhaM uNDhAனbhodhu, dhiraLAன jaன~NghaL ghUDhivandhu, dha~NghaL dha~NghaL bhAShaiyile avarghaL bhejhughiRadhai avaravarghaL gheDhDhabhaDhiyiனAle ghalaghghamaDhaindhArghaL.

indhajh jhèydhiyai AjhAriyaனuM dhevAlayadhdhaigh ghAghghiRa jheனaidhdhalaivaனuM bhiradhAன AjhAriyarghaLuM gheDhDhabhòzhudhu, idhèனனmAy muDhiyumo èனRu, avarghaLaigh ghuRidhdhugh ghalaghghamaDhaindhArghaL.
abhbhòzhudhu òruvaன vandhu: idho, nI~NghaL ghAvalil vaidhdha maனuShar dhevAlayadhdhil niனRu jaன~NghaLughghubh bhodhaghaMbhaNNughiRArghaL èனRu avarghaLughghu aRividhdhAன.
uDhaனe jheனaidhdhalaivaன jhevagharoDheghUDhabh bhoy, jaன~NghaL ghallèRivArghaL èனRu bhayandhadhiனAl, bhalavandhaMbhaNNAmal avarghaLai azhaidhdhughghòNDhuvandhAன.
abhbhaDhi avarghaLai azhaidhdhughghòNDhu, Alojhaனai jha~Nghadhdhughghu muனbhAgha niRudhdhiனArghaL abhbhòzhudhu bhiradhAன AjhAriyaன avarghaLai noghghi:

nI~NghaL andha nAmadhdhaighghuRidhdhubh bhodhaghaMbhaNNaghghUDhAdhèனRu nA~NghaL u~NghaLughghu uRudhiyAygh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhavillaiyA. abhbhaDhiyirundhuM, idho, èrujhalemai u~NghaL bhodhaghadhdhiனAle nirabhbhi, andha maனuShaனuDhaiya iradhdhabhbhazhiyai è~NghaLmel jhumadhdhaveNDhumèனRirughghiRIrghaL èனRu jhòனனAன.

nI~NghaL maradhdhile dhUghghigh ghòlaijhèydha iyejhuvai naMmuDhaiya bhidhAghghaLiன dhevaன èzhubhbhi,

èbhbhaDhiyèனRAl najhareyaனAghiya andha iyejhu indha sdhaladhdhai azhidhdhubhbhoDhDhu, mojhe namaghghugh ghòDhudhdha muRaimaighaLai mARRuvAனèனRu ivaன jhòllagh gheDhDhoM èனRArghaL.
Alojhaனai jha~Nghadhdhil uDhghArndhirundha aனaivaruM avaனmel ghaNNoghghamAyirundhu, avaன mughaM dhevadhUdhaன mughaMbholirughghagh ghaNDhArghaL.

avarghaLai aDhimaibhbhaDhudhdhuM jaனdhdhai nAன AghghiனaighghuDhbhaDhudhdhuveன. adhaRghubhbhiன avarghaL bhuRabhbhaDhDhuvandhu ivviDhadhdhile èனghghu ArAdhaனai jhèyvArghaL èனRAr.

bhiனbhu èghibhdhu ghAனAன èனனuM dhejha~NghaLilè~NghuM bha~njhamuM mighundha varudhdhamuM uNDhAghi, naMmuDhaiya bhidhAghghaLughghu AghAraM ghiDhaiyAmaRbhoyiRRu.

avarghaL avaனaigh ghòlaijhèyya èdhdhaனidhdhirughghaiyil, èrujhaleM muzhuvadhuM ghalaghghamAyirughghiRadhèனRu bhorjhjhevaghariன jheனAbhadhighghujh jhèydhivandhadhu.

allAmaluM, òruvaனuDhaiya mIRudhaliனAle andha òruvaனmUlamAy, maraNaM ANDhughòNDhirughgha, ghirubhaiyiன bharibhUraNadhdhaiyuM nIdhiyAghiya Iviன bharibhUraNadhdhaiyuM bhèRughiRavarghaL iyejhu ghiRisdhu èனனuM òruvarAle jIvaனai aDhaindhu ALuvArghaLèனbhadhu adhigha nijhjhayamAme.

aனRiyuM òre maனuShaனuDhaiya ghIzhbhbhaDhiyAmaiyiனAle aneghar bhAvighaLAghghabhbhaDhDhadhubhola, òruvaruDhaiya ghIzhbhbhaDhidhaliனAle aneghar nIdhimAனghaLAghghabhbhaDhuvArghaL.
meluM, mIRudhal bhèrughuMbhaDhighghu niyAyabhbhiramANaM vandhadhu; abhbhaDhiyirundhuM, bhAvaM bhèrughiன iDhadhdhil ghirubhai adhighamAybh bhèrughiRRu.
AdhalAl bhAvaM maraNadhdhughghu edhuvAgha ANDhughòNDhadhubhola, ghirubhaiyAனdhu naMmuDhaiya ghardhdharAghiya iyejhu ghiRisdhuviன mUlamAy nIdhiyiனAle nidhdhiyajIvaனughghu edhuvAgha ANDhughòNDhadhu.
AghaiyAl èனன jhòlluvoM? ghirubhai bhèrughuMbhaDhighghubh bhAvadhdhile nilainiRghalAM èனRu jhòlluvomA? ghUDhAdhe.

ghiRisdhu iyejhuvughghuLLAgha ~nAனsnAனM bhèRRa nAmaனaivaruM avaruDhaiya maraNadhdhughghuLLAgha, ~nAனsnAனM bhèRRadhai aRiyAmalirughghiRIrghaLA?

meluM bhidhAviன maghimaiyiனAle ghiRisdhu maridhdhorilirundhu èzhubhbhabhbhaDhDhadhubhola, nAmuM bhudhidhAன jIvaனuLLavarghaLAy naDhandhughòLLuMbhaDhighghu, avaruDhaiya maraNadhdhiRghuLLAghghuM ~nAனsnAனdhdhiனAle ghiRisdhuvuDhaனeghUDha aDhaghghaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDhoM.
AdhalAl avaruDhaiya maraNadhdhiன jhAyalil nAM iNaighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaLAனAl, avar uyirdhdhèzhudhaliன jhAyaliluM iNaighghabhbhaDhDhirubhbhoM.

nAM iனibh bhAvadhdhughghu Uzhiya~njhèyyAdhabhaDhighghu, bhAvajharIraM òzhindhubhoghuMbhòruDhDhAgha, naMmuDhaiya bhazhaiya maனuShaன avaroDheghUDhajh jhiluvaiyil aRaiyabhbhaDhDhadhèனRu aRindhirughghiRoM.
maridhdhavaன bhAvadhdhughghu nI~Nghi viDhudhalaiyAghghabhbhaDhDhirughghiRAனe.
AghaiyAl ghiRisdhuvuDhaனeghUDha nAM maridhdhomAனAl, avaruDhaனeghUDha bhizhaidhdhuM irubhbhoM èனRu naMbhughiRoM.
maridhdhorilirundhu èzhundha ghiRisdhu iனi maribhbhadhillaiyèனRu aRindhirughghiRoM; maraNaM iனi avarai ANDhughòLvadhillai.
avar maridhdhadhu, bhAvadhdhiRghèனRu òredharaM maridhdhAr; avar bhizhaidhdhirughghiRadhu, dhevaனughghèனRu bhizhaidhdhirughghiRAr.
abhbhaDhiye nI~NghaLuM, u~NghaLai bhAvadhdhiRghu maridhdhavarghaLAghavuM, naMmuDhaiya ghardhdharAghiya iyejhughiRisdhuvughghuL dhevaனughghèனRu bhizhaidhdhirughghiRavarghaLAghavuM èNNighghòLLu~NghaL.
AghaiyAl, nI~NghaL jharIra ijhjhaighaLiனbhaDhi bhAvadhdhiRghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhiyadhdhaghghadhAgha, jhAvughghedhuvAன u~NghaL jharIradhdhil bhAvaM ALAdhirubhbhadhAgha.

AனbhaDhiyAl naனmaijhèyya viruMbhughiRa èனனiDhadhdhil dhImaiyuNDhèனghiRa òru bhiramANadhdhaigh ghANghiReன.

naMmuDhaiya ghardhdharAghiya iyejhughiRisdhumUlamAy dhevaனai sdhodhdhirighghiReன. AdhalAl nAனe èன maனdhiனAle dhevaனuDhaiya niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhughghuM, mAMjhadhdhiனAleyo bhAvabhbhiramANadhdhughghuM Uzhiya~njhèyghiReன.
AனbhaDhiyAl, ghiRisdhu iyejhuvughghuDhbhaDhDhavarghaLAyirundhu, mAMjhadhdhiனbhaDhi naDhavAmal AviyiனbhaDhiye naDhaghghiRavarghaLughghu AghghiனaidhdhIrbhbhillai.
ghiRisdhu iyejhuviனAle jIvaனuDhaiya Aviyiன bhiramANaM èனனaibh bhAvaM maraNaM èனbhavaighaLiன bhiramANadhdhiனiனRu viDhudhalaiyAghghiRRe.

èbhbhaDhiyèனRAl, mAMjhajhindhai dhevaனughghu virodhamAன bhaghai; adhu dhevaனuDhaiya niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhiyAmaluM, ghIzhbhbhaDhiyaghghUDhAmaluM irughghiRadhu.

dhevaனuDhaiya Avi u~NghaLil vAjhamAyirundhAl, nI~NghaL mAMjhadhdhughghuDhbhaDhDhavarghaLAyirAmal AvighghuDhbhaDhDhavarghaLAyirubhbhIrghaL. ghiRisdhuviன AviyillAdhavaன avaruDhaiyavaனlla.

AghaiyAl jhaghodharare, mAMjhadhdhiனbhaDhi bhizhaibhbhadhaRghu nAM mAMjhadhdhughghugh ghaDhaனALighaLalla.
mAMjhadhdhiனbhaDhi bhizhaidhdhAl jhAvIrghaL; AviyiனAle jharIradhdhiன jhèyghaighaLai azhidhdhAl bhizhaibhbhIrghaL.
meluM èvarghaL dhevaனuDhaiya AviyiனAle naDhadhdhabhbhaDhughiRArghaLo, avarghaL dhevaனuDhaiya bhudhdhirarAyirughghiRArghaL.
andhabhbhaDhi, dhiruMbhavuM bhayabhbhaDhughiRadhaRghu nI~NghaL aDhimaidhdhaனdhdhiன Aviyaibh bhèRAmal, abhbhA bhidhAve, èனRu ghUbhbhiDhabhbhaNNughiRa bhudhdhira jhuvighAradhdhiன Aviyaibh bhèRRIrghaL.
nAM dhevaனuDhaiya bhiLLaighaLAyirughghiRomèனRu AviyAனvardhAme naMmuDhaiya AviyuDhaனeghUDhajh jhADhjhighòDhughghiRAr.

nAM bhiLLaighaLAனAl jhudhandhararumAme; dhevaனuDhaiya jhudhandhararuM, ghiRisdhuvughghu uDhaன jhudhandhararumAme; ghiRisdhuvuDhaனeghUDha nAM maghimaibhbhaDhuMbhaDhighghu avaruDhaனeghUDhabh bhADhubhaDhDhAl abhbhaDhiyAghuM.
AdhalAl ighghAladhdhubh bhADhughaL iனi naMmiDhadhdhil vèLibhbhaDhuM maghimaighghu òbhbhiDhadhdhaghghavaighaL allavèனRu èNNughiReன.
meluM dhevaனuDhaiya bhudhdhirar vèLibhbhaDhuvadhaRghujh jhiruShDhiyAனdhu mighundha AvaloDhe ghAdhdhughghòNDhirughghiRadhu.

adheனèனRAl jhiruShDhiyAனdhu azhivughghuriya aDhimaidhdhaனdhdhiனiனRu viDhudhalaiyAghghabhbhaDhDhu, dhevaனuDhaiya bhiLLaighaLughghuriya maghimaiyAன jhuyAdhIனdhdhaibh bhèRRughghòLLuM èனghiRa naMbhighghaiyoDhe,
andhajh jhiruShDhiyAனdhu jhuya iShDhadhdhiனAle alla, ghIzhbhbhaDhudhdhiனvarAleye mAyaighghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhDhirughghiRadhu.
AghaiyAl namaghghudh dhèrindhirughghiRabhaDhi, idhuvaraighghuM jharva jhiruShDhiyuM eghamAydh dhavidhdhubh bhirajhavavedhaனaibhbhaDhughiRadhu.
adhuvumallAmal, Aviyiன mudhaRbhalaனghaLaibh bhèRRa nAmu~NghUDha naMmuDhaiya jharIramIDhbhAghiya bhudhdhirajhuvighAraM varughiRadhaRghugh ghAdhdhirundhu, namaghghuLLe dhavighghiRoM.
andha naMbhighghaiyiனAle nAM iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhDhirughghiRoM. ghANabhbhaDhughiRadhai naMbhughiRadhu naMbhighghaiyalla; òruvaன dhAன ghANghiRadhai naMbhaveNDhuvadhèனன?
nAM ghANAdhadhai naMbhiனomAghil, adhu varughiRadhaRghubh bhòRumaiyoDhe ghAdhdhirubhbhoM.

andhabhbhaDhiye AviyAனvaruM namadhu bhalavIன~NghaLil namaghghu udhavijhèyghiRAr. nAM eRRabhaDhi veNDhighghòLLaveNDhiyadhiனனdhèனRu aRiyAmalirughghiRabhaDhiyAl, AviyAனvardhAme vAghghughghaDha~NghAdha bhèrumUjhjhughaLoDhu namaghghAgha veNDhudhaljhèyghiRAr.
AviyAனvar dhevaனuDhaiya jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiye bharijhudhdhavAனghaLughghAgha veNDhudhal jhèyghiRabhaDhiyAl, irudhaya~NghaLai ArAyndhubhArghghiRavar Aviyiன jhindhaனai iனனdhèனRu aRivAr.
aனRiyuM, avaruDhaiya dhIrmAனdhdhiனbhaDhi azhaighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaLAy dhevaனiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrughiRavarghaLughghujh jhaghalamuM naனmaighghu edhuvAgha naDhaghghiRadhèனRu aRindhirughghiRoM.

dhaMmuDhaiya ghumAraன anegha jhaghodhararughghuLLe mudhaRbheRAனvarAyirughghuMbhòruDhDhu, dhevaன èvarghaLai muனனRindhAro avarghaLaidh dhamadhu ghumAraனuDhaiya jhAyalughghu òbhbhAyirubhbhadhaRghu muனghuRidhdhirughghiRAr;

èvarghaLai muனghuRidhdhAro avarghaLai azhaidhdhumirughghiRAr; èvarghaLai azhaidhdhAro avarghaLai nIdhimAனghaLAghghiyumirughghiRAr; èvarghaLai nIdhimAனghaLAghghiனAro avarghaLai maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhiyumirughghiRAr.
ivaighaLaighghuRidhdhu nAM èனனjhòlluvoM? dhevaன naMmuDhaiya bhaDhjhadhdhilirundhAl namaghghu virodhamAyirubhbhavaன yAr?
dhaMmuDhaiya jhòndhaghghumAraனèனRuM bhArAmal naMmèllArughghAghavuM avarai òbhbhughghòDhudhdhavar, avaroghUDha maRRa èllAvaRRaiyuM namaghghu aruLAdhirubhbhadhèbhbhaDhi?
dhevaன dhèrindhughòNDhavarghaLmel ghuRRa~njhADhDhughiRavaன yAr? dhevaனe avarghaLai nIdhimAனghaLAghghughiRavar.

AghghiனaighghuLLAghadh dhIrghghiRavaன yAr? ghiRisdhuve maridhdhavar; avare èzhundhumirughghiRavar; avare dhevaனuDhaiya valadhubhArijhadhdhiluM irughghiRavar, namaghghAgha veNDhudhal jhèyghiRavaruM avare.
umadhunimidhdhaM ènneramuM ghòllabhbhaDhughiRoM, aDhighghabhbhaDhuM ADhughaLaibhbhola èNNabhbhaDhughiRoM èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRabhaDhi neriDhDhAluM,
ghiRisdhuviன aனbhaiviDhDhu naMmaibh bhiribhbhavaன yAr? ubhadhdhiravamo, viyAghulamo, dhuனbhamo, bhajhiyo, nirvANamo, nAjhamojhamo, bhaDhDhayamo?
ivaiyèllAvaRRileyuM nAM naMmil aனbhughUrughiRavarAle muRRuM jèya~NghòLLughiRavarghaLAyirughghiRome.
maraNamAனAluM, jIvaனAனAluM, dhevadhUdharghaLAனAluM, adhighAra~NghaLAனAluM, vallamaighaLAனAluM, nighazhghAriya~NghaLAனAluM, varu~NghAriya~NghaLAனAluM,
uyarvAனAluM, dhAzhvAனAluM, veRèndhajh jhiruShDhiyAனAluM naMmuDhaiya ghardhdharAghiya ghiRisdhu iyejhuviluLLa dhevaனuDhaiya aனbhaiviDhDhu naMmaibh bhirighghamADhDhAdhèனRu nijhjhayidhdhirughghiReன.
èனghghu mighundha dhughghamuM iDhaiviDhAdha maனvedhaனaiyuM uNDhAyirughghiRadhu;
nAன jhòllughiRadhu bhòyyalla, ghiRisdhuvughghuL uNmaiyaijh jhòllughiReன èனѠρ bharijhudhdha AvighghuL èன maனjhjhADhjhiyuM èனghghujh jhADhjhiyAyirughghiRadhu.
mAMjhadhdhiனbhaDhi èன iனdhdhArAghiya èன jhaghodhararughghubh bhadhilAgha nAனe ghiRisdhuvaiviDhDhujh jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaனAghaveNDhumèனRu viruMbhuveனe.
avarghaL isravelare; bhudhdhirajhuvighAramuM, maghimaiyuM, uDhaனbhaDhighghaighaLuM, niyAyabhbhiramANamuM, dhevArAdhaனaiyuM, vAghghudhdhadhdha~NghaLuM avarghaLuDhaiyavaighaLe;
bhidhAghghaL avarghaLuDhaiyavarghaLe; mAMjhadhdhiனbhaDhi ghiRisdhuvuM avarghaLil bhiRandhAre, ivar èனRèனRaighghuM sdhodhdhirighghabhbhaDhDha jharvadhdhiRghuMmelAன dhevaன. Amèன.
dhevavajhaனM avamAybh bhoyiRRèனRu jhòllaghghUDhAdhu; eனèனRAl, isravel vaMjhadhdhAr èllAruM isravelarallave.
avarghaL AbhiraghAmiன jhandhadhiyArAனAluM èllAruM bhiLLaighaLallave; IjhAghghiனiDhadhdhil uன jhandhadhi viLa~NghumèனRu jhòlliyirughghiRadhe.
adhèbhbhaDhiyèனRAl, mAMjhadhdhiனbhaDhi bhiLLaighaLAனvarghaL dhevaனuDhaiya bhiLLaighaLalla, vAghghudhdhadhdhadhdhiனbhaDhi bhiLLaighaLAனvarghaLe andhajh jhandhadhi èனRèNNabhbhaDhughiRArghaL.
andha vAghghudhdhadhdhamAன vArdhdhaiyAvadhu: ghuRidhdha ghAladhdhile varuveன, abhbhòzhudhu jhArAL òru ghumAraனaibh bhèRuvAL èனbhadhe.
idhuvumallAmal, naMmuDhaiya bhidhAvAghiya IjhAghghu èனனuM òruvaனAle rèbhèghghAL gharbhbhavadhiyAனbhodhu,

bhiLLaighaL iனனuM bhiRavAmaluM, nalviனai dhIviனai òனRuM jhèyyAmalumirughghaiyil, dhevaனuDhaiya dhèrindhughòLLudhaliனbhaDhiyirughghiRa avaruDhaiya dhIrmAனM ghiriyaighaLiனAle nilainiRghAmal azhaighghiRavarAle nilainiRghuMbhaDhighghu,
mUdhdhavaன iLaiyavaனughghu Uzhiya~njhèyvAன èனRu avaLuDhaனe jhòllabhbhaDhDhadhu.
abhbhaDhiye, yAghghobhaijh jhineghidhdhu, ejhAvai vèRudhdheன èனRuM èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu.
AghaiyAl nAM èனன jhòlluvoM? dhevaனiDhadhdhile anIdhi uNDhèனRu jhòllalAmA? jhòllaghghUDhAdhe.

AdhalAl èvaனmel iraghghamAyirughghajh jhidhdhamAyirughghiRAro avaனmel iraghghamAyirughghiRAr, èvaனaigh ghaDhiனbhbhaDhudhdhajh jhidhdhamAyirughghiRAro avaனaigh ghaDhiனbhbhaDhudhdhughiRAr.
ibhbhaDhiyAனAl, avar iனனuM eன ghuRRaMbhiDhighghiRAr? avar jhidhdhadhdhiRghu èdhirdhdhuniRbhavaன yAr? èனRu èனனuDhaனe jhòlluvAy.

dhevaன dhamadhu ghobhadhdhaigh ghANbhighghavuM, dhamadhu vallamaiyaidh dhèrivighghavuM,

dhAM maghimaighghAgha èdhdhaனmAghghiன ghirubhAbhAdhdhira~NghaLmel dhaMmuDhaiya maghimaiyiன aijhuvariyadhdhaidh dhèriyabhbhaDhudhdhavuM jhidhdhamAy, azhivughghu èdhdhaனmAghghabhbhaDhDha ghobhAghghiனaibh bhAdhdhira~NghaLmel mighavuM nIDhiya jhAndhadhdhoDhe bhòRumaiyAyirundhArAனAl uனghghèனன?
avar yUdharilirundhumAdhdhiramalla, bhuRajAdhighaLilumirundhu naMmai azhaidhdhirughghiRAre.
andhabhbhaDhi: èனghghu jaன~NghaLallAdhavarghaLai èனனuDhaiya jaன~NghaL èனRuM, jhineghighghabhbhaDhAdhirundhavaLaijh jhineghaghghabhbhaDhDhavaL èனRuM jhòlli azhaibhbheன.

nI~NghaL èனனuDhaiya jaன~NghaLallavèனRu avarghaLughghujh jhòllabhbhaDhDha iDhadhdhile avarghaL jIvaனuLLa dhevaனuDhaiya bhiLLaighaL èனனbhbhaDhuvArghaL èனRu ojhiyAviன dhIrghghadharijhaனdhdhil jhòlliyirughghiRadhu.

avar nIdhiyoDhe jhIghghiramAydh dhaMmuDhaiya ghAriyadhdhai niRaiveRRuvAr; ghardhdhar bhUmiyile jhIghghiramAghave ghAriyadhdhai niRaiveRRi muDhibhbhAr èனRuM ejhAyA isravelaraighghuRidhdhujh jhòllughiRAன.
allAmaluM ejhAyA muனனe jhòனனbhaDhi: jheனaighaLiன ghardhdhar namaghghuLLe òru jhandhadhiyai mIdhiyAgha vaighghAdhirundhArAனAl nAM jhodhomaibhbholAghi ghòmorAvughghu òdhdhirubhbhoM.
ibhbhaDhiyirughgha nAM èனனjhòlluvoM? nIdhiyaidh dheDhAdha bhuRajAdhiyAr nIdhiyai aDhaindhArghaL. adhu vijhuvAjhadhdhiனAlAghuM nIdhiye.
nIdhibhbhiramANadhdhaidh dheDhiன isravelaro nIdhibhbhiramANadhdhai aDhaiyavillai.
èனனdhdhiனAlèனRAl, avarghaL vijhuvAjhadhdhiனAle adhaidh dheDhAmal, niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiன ghiriyaighaLiனAle dheDhiனbhaDhiyAl adhai aDhaiyavillai; iDhaRudhaRghAன ghallil iDhaRiனArghaL.

idho, iDhaRudhaRghAன ghallaiyuM, dhavaRudhaRghAன ghaனmalaiyaiyuM, jhIyoனil vaighghiReன; avariDhadhdhil vijhuvAjhamAyirubhbhavaன èvaனo avaன vèDhghabhbhaDhuvadhillai èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRabhaDhiyAyiRRu.
jhaghodharare, isravelar iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhaveNDhuM èனbhadhe èன irudhayadhdhiன virubhbhamuM nAன dhevaனai noghghijhjhèyyuM viNNabhbhamumAyirughghiRadhu.
dhevaனaibhbhaRRi avarghaLughghu vairAghghiyamuNDhèனRu avarghaLaigh ghuRidhdhujh jhADhjhijhòllughiReன; AghiluM adhu aRivughgheRRa vairAghghiyamalla.
èbhbhaDhiyèனRAl, avarghaL dhevanIdhiyai aRiyAmal, dha~NghaL jhuyanIdhiyai nilainiRudhdhadh dheDhughiRabhaDhiyAl dhevanIdhighghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhiyAdhirughghiRArghaL.
vijhuvAjhighghiRa èvaனughghuM nIdhi uNDhAghuMbhaDhiyAghagh ghiRisdhu niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiன muDhivAyirughghiRAr.
mojhe niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiனAlAghuM nIdhiyaighghuRidhdhu: ivaighaLaijh jhèyghiRa maனuShaன ivaighaLAl bhizhaibhbhAன èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRAன.

alladhu ghiRisdhuvai maridhdhorilirundhu eRivarabhbhaNNuMbhaDhi bhAdhALadhdhughghu iRa~NghughiRavaன yAr? èனRu uன uLLadhdhile jhòllAdhirubhbhAyAgha èனRu jhòllughiRadhumaனRi;
indha vArdhdhai èனghghujh jhamIbhamAy uன vAyiluM uன irudhayadhdhiluM irughghiRadhu èனRuM jhòllughiRadhu; indha vArdhdhai nA~NghaL bhirajha~NghighghiRa vijhuvAjhadhdhiன vArdhdhaiye.
èனனvèனRAl, ghardhdharAghiya iyejhuvai nI uன vAyiனAle aRighghaiyiDhDhu, dhevaன avarai maridhdhorilirundhu èzhubhbhiனArèனRu uன irudhayadhdhile vijhuvAjhidhdhAl iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhuvAy.
nIdhiyuNDhAgha irudhayadhdhile vijhuvAjhighghabhbhaDhuM, iraDhjhibhbhuNDhAgha vAyiனAle aRighghaibhaNNabhbhaDhuM.
avarai vijhuvAjhighghiRavaன èvaனo avaன vèDhghabhbhaDhuvadhillaiyèனRu vedhaM jhòllughiRadhu.
yUdhaனèனRuM ghireghghaனèனRuM vidhdhiyAjhame illai; èllArughghu~N ghardhdharAனvar dhaMmaidh dhòzhudhughòLLughiRa yAvarughghuM aijhuvariyajhaMbhaனனrAyirughghiRAr.
AdhalAl ghardhdharuDhaiya nAmadhdhaidh dhòzhudhughòLLughiRa èvaனuM iraDhjhighghabhbhaDhuvAன.

avarai vijhuvAjhiyAdhavarghaL èbhbhaDhi avaraidh dhòzhudhughòLLuvArghaL? avaraighghuRidhdhugh gheLvibhbhaDhAdhavAghaL èbhbhaDhi vijhuvAjhibhbhArghaL? bhirajha~NghighghiRavaன illAviDhDhAl èbhbhaDhigh gheLvibhbhaDhuvArghaL?

aனubhbhabhbhaDhAviDhDhAl èbhbhaDhibh bhirajha~NghibhbhArghaL jhamAdhAனdhdhaighghURi, naRghAriya~NghaLaijh jhuvijheShamAy aRivighghiRavarghaLuDhaiya bhAdha~NghaL èvvaLavu azhaghAனvaighaL èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRadhe.
AனAluM jhuvijheShadhdhughghu èllAruM ghIzhbhbhaDhiyavillai. adhaighghuRidhdhu ejhAyA: ghardhdhAve, è~NghaL mUlamAygh gheLvibhbhaDhDhadhai vijhuvAjhidhdhavaன yAr èனRu jhòllughiRAன.

nAன bhejhjhile ghallAdhavaனAyirundhAluM, aRivile ghallAdhavaனlla; èndha viShayadhdhiluM èllArughghu muனbhAghavuM u~NghaLughghuLLe nA~NghaL vèLibhbhaDhDhirughghiRome.
nI~NghaL uyardhdhabhbhaDhuMbhaDhi nAன èனனaidhdhAனe dhAzhdhdhi, dhevaனuDhaiya jhuvijheShadhdhai ilavajhamAy u~NghaLughghubh bhirajha~NghidhdhadhiனAle ghuRRa~njhèydheனo?
u~NghaLughghu Uzhiya~njhèyyuMbhaDhighghu, maRRajh jhabhaighaLiDhadhdhil jhaMbhaLadhdhaibhbhèRRu, avarghaLaigh ghòLLaiyiDhDheன.

nAன u~NghaLoDhirundhu ghuRaivubhaDhDhabhodhuM, òruvaraiyuM nAன varudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhavillai; maghghèdhoனiyAvilirundhu vandha jhaghodharar èன ghuRaivai niRaivAghghiனArghaL, èvvidhadhdhileyuM u~NghaLughghubh bhAramAyirAdhabhaDhighghu jAghghiradhaiyAyirundheன, iனimeluM jAghghiradhaiyAyirubhbheன.
aghAyAnADhDhiன dhijhaighaLile indhabh bhughazhjhjhi èனனaiviDhDhu nI~NghuvadhillaiyèனRu èனனiluLLa ghiRisdhuviனuDhaiya jhadhdhiyadhdhaighghòNDhu jhòllughiReன.
ibhbhaDhijh jhòllaveNDhiyadhèனன? nAன u~NghaLaijh jhineghiyAdhabhaDhiyiனAleyo? dhevaன aRivAr.

meluM, è~NghaLai virodhighghajh jhamayandheDhughiRavarghaLughghujh jhamayaM ghiDhaiyAdhabhaDhighghu, dha~NghaLaighghuRidhdhu meனmaibhArADhDhughiRa ghAriyadhdhil avarghaL è~NghaLaibhbholagh ghANabhbhaDhuMbhaDhi, nAன jhèyvadhaiye iனனuM jhèyveன.
abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavarghaL ghaLLa abhbhosdhalarghaL, ghabhaDhamuLLa velaiyADhghaL, ghiRisdhuviனuDhaiya abhbhosdhalariன veShadhdhaidh dharidhdhughghòNDhavarghaLAyirughghiRArghaL.
adhu Ajhjhariyamalla, jhAdhdhAனuM òLiyiன dhUdhaனuDhaiya veShadhdhaidh dharidhdhughghòLvAனe.
AghaiyAl avaனuDhaiya UzhiyaghghAraruM nIdhiyiன UzhiyaghghAraruDhaiya veShadhdhaidh dharidhdhughghòNDhAl adhu Ajhjhariyamallave; avarghaL muDhivu avarghaL ghiriyaighaLughghudhdhaghghadhAyirughghuM.
bhiனனuM nAன jhòllughiReன; òruvaனuM èனனaibh bhudhdhiyIனனèனRu èNNaveNDhAM; abhbhaDhi èNNiனAl, nAனuM jhaRRe meனmaibhArADhDhuMbhaDhi, èனனaibh bhudhdhiyIனனaibhbholAghiluM eRRughghòLLu~NghaL.
ibhbhaDhi nAன jhòllughiRadhu ghardhdharughgheRRabhaDhi jhòllAmal, meனmaibhArADhDhuM dhairiyadhdhiனAle bhudhdhiyIனனaibhbholajh jhòllughiReன.
aneghar mAMjhadhdhiRgheRRabhaDhi meனmaibhArADhDhighghòLLughaiyil, nAனuM meனmaibhArADhDhuveன.
nI~NghaL bhudhdhiyuLLavarghaLAyirundhu bhudhdhiyillAdhavarghaLaijh jhandhoShamAyjh jhaghidhdhirughghiRIrghaLe.

òruvaன u~NghaLaijh jhiRaiyAghghiனAluM, òruvaன u~NghaLaibh bhaDhjhidhdhAluM, òruvaன u~NghaLaigh ghaivajhabhbhaDhudhdhiனAluM, òruvaன dhaனனai uyardhdhiனAluM, òruvaன u~NghaLai mughadhdhil aRaindhAluM jhaghidhdhirughghiRIrghaLe.

nA~NghaL bhalavIனrAனdhubhola, è~NghaLughghu vandha ghaனvIனdhdhaighghuRidhdhubh bhejhughiReன; òruvaன èdhile dhuNivuLLavaனAyirughghiRAனo adhile nAனuM dhuNivuLLavaனAyirughghiReன; ibhbhaDhibh bhudhdhiyIனmAybh bhejhughiReன.
avarghaL èbhirèyarA? nAனuM èbhirèyaன; avarghaL isravelarA? nAனuM isravelaன; avarghaL AbhiraghAmiன jhandhadhiyArA? nAனuM AbhiraghAmiன jhandhadhiyAன.

avarghaL ghiRisdhuviன UzhiyaghghArarA? nAன adhighaM; bhudhdhiyIனmAybh bhejhughiReன; nAன adhighamAybh bhirayAjhabhbhaDhDhavaன, adhighamAy aDhibhaDhDhavaன, adhighamAygh ghAvalghaLil vaighghabhbhaDhDhavaன, aneghandharaM maraNa avadhiyil aghabhbhaDhDhavaன.
yUdharghaLAl òனRughuRaiya nARbhadhaDhiyAgha aindhudharaM aDhibhaDhDheன;
mUனRudharaM milARughaLAl aDhibhaDhDheன, òrudharaM ghallèRiyuNDheன, mUனRudharaM ghabhbhaRjhedhadhdhil irundheன, ghaDhalile òru irAbhbhaghal muzhuvadhuM bhoghghiனeன.

aneghandharaM bhirayANaMbhaNNiனeன; ARughaLAl vandha mojha~NghaLiluM, ghaLLarAl vandha mojha~NghaLiluM, èன jhuyajaன~NghaLAl vandha mojha~NghaLiluM, anniya jaன~NghaLAl vandha mojha~NghaLiluM, bhaDhDhaNa~NghaLil uNDhAன mojha~NghaLiluM, vaனAndharadhdhil uNDhAன mojha~NghaLiluM, jhamudhdhiradhdhil uNDhAன mojha~NghaLiluM, ghaLLajhjhaghodharariDhadhdhil uNDhAன mojha~NghaLiluM;
bhirayAjhadhdhiluM, varudhdhadhdhiluM, aneghamuRai ghaNvizhibhbhughaLiluM, bhajhiyiluM dhAghadhdhiluM, aneghamuRai ubhavAjha~NghaLiluM, ghuLiriluM, nirvANadhdhiluM irundheன.
ivai mudhalAனvaighaLaiyallAmal, èllAjh jhabhaighaLaighghuRidhdhuM uNDhAyirughghiRa ghavalai èனனai nALdhoRuM nèrughghughiRadhu.
òruvaன bhalavIனனAனAl nAனuM bhalavIனனAghiRadhillaiyo? òruvaன iDhaRiனAl èன maனM èriyAdhirughghumo?
nAன meனmaibhArADhDhaveNDhumAனAl, èன bhalavIனdhdhiRghaDhudhdhavaighaLaigh ghuRidhdhu meனmaibhArADhDhuveன.
èனRèனRaighghuM sdhodhdhirighghabhbhaDhDha dhevaனuM, naMmuDhaiya ghardhdharAghiya iyejhughiRisdhuviன bhidhAvumAனvar nAன bhòy jhòllughiRadhillaiyèனRu aRivAr.
dhamasghubhaDhDhaNadhdhu aredhdhA rAjAviனuDhaiya jheனaidhdhalaivaன èனனaibh bhiDhighghaveNDhumèனRu dhamasgharuDhaiya bhaDhDhaNadhdhaigh ghAvalvaidhdhugh ghAdhdhAன;

meனmaibhArADhDhughiRadhu èனghghudh dhaghudhiyallave; AghiluM, ghardhdhar aruLiya dharijhaன~NghaLaiyuM vèLibhbhaDhudhdhalghaLaiyuM jhòllughiReன.

ghiRisdhuvughghuLLAன òru maனuShaனai aRiveன; avaன bhadhiனAlu varuShadhdhiRghu muனனe mUனRAM vAனMvaraighghuM èDhughghabhbhaDhDhAன; avaன jharIradhdhilirundhAனo, jharIradhdhiRghubh bhuRaMbheyirundhAனo, adhai aRiyeன; dhevaன aRivAr.
andha maனuShaன bharadhIjhughghuL èDhughghabhbhaDhDhu, maனuShar bhejhabhbhaDhAdhadhuM vAghghughghèDhDhAdhadhumAghiya vArdhdhaighaLaigh gheDhDhAனèனRu aRindhirughghiReன.
avaன jharIradhdhilirundhAனo, jharIradhdhiRghubh bhuRaMbheyirundhAனo, adhai aRiyeன; dhevaன aRivAr.

meனmaibhArADhDhi, bhudhdhiyIனனAyiனeன; nI~NghaLe idhaRghu èனனaibh bhalavandhabhbhaDhudhdhiனIrghaL. nAன òனRumillaiyèனRAluM, maghA bhiradhAன abhbhosdhalarughghuM nAன èvvaLavuM ghuRaindhavaனAyirAdhabhaDhiyAl, u~NghaLAle mèjhjhighghòLLabhbhaDhaveNDhiyadhAyirundhadhe.
abhbhosdhalaனughghuriya aDhaiyALa~NghaL èllAvidhamAன bhòRumaiyoDhuM, adhijhaya~NghaLoDhuM, aRbhudha~NghaLoDhuM, vallamaighaLoDhuM, u~NghaLughghuLLe naDhabhbhighghabhbhaDhDhadhe.
èdhile maRRajh jhabhaighaLughghugh ghuRaivAyirundhIrghaL? nAன u~NghaLai varudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhAdhirundhadhe u~NghaLughghugh ghuRaivu; indha aniyAyadhdhai èனghghu maனனiyu~NghaL.

idho, u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghu mUனRAndharaM vara AyadhdhamAyirughghiReன; nAன u~NghaLai varudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhuvadhillai; nAன u~NghaLuDhaiyadhaiyalla, u~NghaLaiye dheDhughiReன: bhèRRArughghubh bhiLLaighaLalla, bhiLLaighaLughghubh bhèRRArghaLe bhòghghiSha~NghaLaijh jherdhdhuvaighghaveNDhuM.

AdhalAl, nAன u~NghaLil èvvaLavu adhighamAy aனbhughUrughiReனo avvaLavu ghuRaivAy u~NghaLAl aனbhughUrabhbhaDhDhirundhAluM, mighavuM jhandhoShamAy nAன u~NghaL AdhdhumAghghaLughghAghajh jhèlavubhaNNavuM jhèlavubhaNNabhbhaDhavuM viruMbhughiReன
abhbhaDhiyAghaDhDhuM; nAன u~NghaLughghubh bhAramAyirughghavillai; AனAluM, ubhAyamuLLavaனAyirundhu, dhandhiradhdhiனAle u~NghaLaibh bhiDhidhdheனAM.
nAன u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghu aனubhbhiனvarghaLil èvaனmUlamAyAvadhu u~NghaLiDhadhdhil bhòzhivaidh dheDhiனdhuNDhA?

dhIdhdhu u~NghaLiDhadhdhil varuMbhaDhi nAன avaனaigh gheDhDhughghòNDhu, avaனuDhaனeghUDha òru jhaghodharaனai aனubhbhiனeன; dhIdhdhu u~NghaLiDhadhdhil edhAvadhu bhòzhivaidh dheDhiனAனA? nA~NghaL òre AviyaiyuDhaiyavarghaLAy, òre aDhijhjhuvaDhughaLil naDhandhomallavA?

nA~NghaL yoghghiyarghaLèனRu viLa~NghuMbhaDhi u~NghaLiDhadhdhil bhejhughiRomèனRu èNNughiRIrghaLo? dhevaனughghumuனbhAghagh ghiRisdhuvughghuL bhejhughiRoM. bhiriyamAனvarghaLe, jhaghaladhdhaiyuM u~NghaL bhaghdhivirudhdhighghAghajh jhèyghiRoM.

AghiluM nAன vandhu u~NghaLai èன maனdhiனbhaDhiyirughghiRavarghaLAghagh ghANAmaluM, nAனuM u~NghaL maனdhiனbhaDhiyirughghiRavaனAghagh ghANabhbhaDhAmalumirubhbheனovèனRuM; virodha~NghaL, ghobha~NghaL vAghghuvAdha~NghaL, bhuRa~NghURudhal, ghoDhjhòlludhal, iRumAbhbhu, ghalagha~NghaL Aghiya ivaighaL u~NghaLughghuLLe uNDhAyirughghumovèனRuM;

maRubhaDhiyuM nAன varughiRabhodhu èன dhevaன u~NghaLiDhadhdhil èனனaidh dhAzhdhdhuMbhaDhighghu muன bhAva~njhèydhavarghaLAghiya aneghar dhA~NghaL naDhabhbhidhdha ajhudhdhadhdhaiyuM vejhidhdhaனdhdhaiyuM ghAmavighAradhdhaiyuM viDhDhu maனndhiruMbhAmalirughghiRadhaighghuRidhdhu, nAன dhughghabhbhaDhaveNDhiyadhAyirughghumovèனRuM bhayandhirughghiReன.
indha mUனRAndharaM nAன u~NghaLiDhadhdhiRghu varughiReன; jhaghala ghAriya~NghaLuM iraNDhumUனRu jhADhjhighaLuDhaiya vAghghiனAl nilaivarabhbhaDhuM.

nAன iraNDhAndharaM u~NghaLiDhadhdhilirundhabhodhu jhòனனdhubhola, ibhbhòzhudhu dhUramAyirundhuM u~NghaLiDhadhdhilirughghiRavaனAgha, nAன maRubhaDhiyuM vandhAl dhabhbhaviDhamADhDheனèனRu muனbhu bhAva~njhèydhavarghaLughghuM maRRa èllArughghuM muனனRividhdhu èzhudhughiReன.
ghiRisdhu èனghghuLLe bhejhughiRArèனbhadhaRghu adhdhADhjhi dheDhughiRIrghaLe; avar u~NghaLiDhamAybh bhalavIனralla, u~NghaLiDhadhdhil vallavarAyirughghiRAr.

eனèனil avar bhalavIனdhdhAl jhiluvaiyil aRaiyabhbhaDhDhirundhuM, dhevaனuDhaiya vallamaiyiனAl bhizhaidhdhirughghiRAr; abhbhaDhi nA~NghaLuM avarughghuL bhalavIனrAyirundhuM, u~NghaLiDhamAy viLa~Nghiya dhevaனuDhaiya vallamaiyiனAl avaruDhaனeghUDhabh bhizhaidhdhirubhbhoM.

nI~NghaL vijhuvAjhamuLLavarghaLovèனRu u~NghaLai nI~NghaLe jhodhidhdhu aRiyu~NghaL; u~NghaLai nI~NghaLe bharIDhjhidhdhubh bhAru~NghaL. iyejhughiRisdhu u~NghaLughghuL irughghiRArèனRu u~NghaLai nI~NghaLe aRighiRIrghaLA? nI~NghaL bharIDhjhaighghu nillAdhavarghaLAyirundhAl aRiyIrghaL.
nA~NghaLo bharIDhjhaighghu nillAdhavarghaLallavèனbhadhai aRivIrghaLèனRu naMbhughiReன.

meluM nI~NghaL òru bhòllA~NghuM jhèyyAdhirughghuMbhaDhiyAgha, dhevaனai noghghi viNNabhbhaM bhaNNughiReன. nA~NghaL bharIDhjhaighghu niனRavarghaLèனRu ghANabhbhaDhuMbhòruDhDhalla, nA~NghaL bharIDhjhaighghu nillAdhavarghaLbholirundhAluM, nI~NghaL nalamAனdhaijh jhèyyuMbhòruDhDhe viNNabhbhaM bhaNNughiReன.
jhadhdhiyadhdhiRghu virodhamAgha nA~NghaL òனRu~njhèyyaghghUDhAmal, jhadhdhiyadhdhiRghu anughUlamAghave jhèyyaghghUDhuM.
nA~NghaL bhalavIனruM nI~NghaL bhalamuLLavarghaLumAyirughghaiyil, jhandhoShabhbhaDhughiRoM; nI~NghaL naRjhIrbhòrundhuMbhaDhighghuM viNNabhbhaMbhaNNughiRoM.

AனdhAl iDhidhdhubhbhoDhavalla, UனRagh ghaDhDhave ghardhdhar èனghghugh ghòDhudhdha adhighAradhdhiனbhaDhi, nAன u~NghaLiDhadhdhil vandhirughghuMbhodhu, ghaNDhidhaMbhaNNAdhabhaDhighghu, nAன dhUramAyirundhu ivaighaLai èzhudhughiReன.

ghaDhaijhiyAgha, jhaghodharare, jhandhoShamAyiru~NghaL, naRjhIr bhòrundhu~NghaL, ARudhalaDhaiyu~NghaL; eghajhindhaiyAyiru~NghaL, jhamAdhAனmAyiru~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu aனbhughghuM jhamAdhAனdhdhughghuM ghAraNarAghiya dhevaன u~NghaLoDheghUDha irubhbhAr.
òruvaraiyòruvar bharijhudhdha mudhdhadhdhoDhu vAzhdhdhu~NghaL.
bharijhudhdhavAனghaLèllAruM u~NghaLughghu vAzhdhdhudhal jhòllughiRArghaL.
ghardhdharAghiya iyejhughiRisdhuviனuDhaiya ghirubhaiyuM, dhevaனuDhaiya aனbhuM, bharijhudhdha AviyiனuDhaiya aighghiyamuM, u~NghaL aனaivaroDhu~NghUDha irubhbhadhAgha. Amèன.
maனuSharAlumalla, maனuShaன mUlamAyumalla, iyejhughiRisdhuviனAluM, avarai maridhdhorilirundhèzhubhbhiன bhidhAvAghiya dhevaனAluM, abhbhosdhalaனAyirughghiRa bhavulAghiya nAனuM,
èனனuDhaனeghUDha irughghiRa jhaghodhararèllAruM, ghalAdhdhiyA nADhDhiluLLa jhabhaighaLughghu èzhudhughiRadhAvadhu:
bhidhAvAghiya dhevaனAluM, naMmuDhaiya ghardhdharAghiya iyejhughiRisdhuviனAluM u~NghaLughghugh ghirubhaiyuM jhamAdhAனmuM uNDhAvadhAgha;

avar naMmai ibhbhòzhudhirughghiRa bhòllAdha bhirabha~njhadhdhiனiனRu viDhuvighghuMbhaDhi naMmuDhaiya bhidhAvAghiya dhevaனuDhaiya jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiye naMmuDhaiya bhAva~NghaLughghAghadh dhaMmaidhdhAme òbhbhughghòDhudhdhAr;
avarughghu èனRèனRaighghumuLLa jhadhAghAla~NghaLiluM maghimai uNDhAvadhAgha Amèன.
u~NghaLaigh ghiRisdhuviன ghirubhaiyiனAle azhaidhdhavarai nI~NghaL ivvaLavu jhIghghiramAy viDhDhu, veRòru jhuvijheShadhdhiRghudh dhiruMbhughiRadhaibhbhaRRi nAன AjhjhariyabhbhaDhughiReன;
veRòru jhuvijheShaM illaiye; jhilar u~NghaLaigh ghalaghabhbhaDhudhdhi, ghiRisdhuviDhaiya jhuvijheShadhdhaibh bhuraDhDha maனdhAyirughghiRArghaLeyallAmal veRalla.

nA~NghaL u~NghaLughghubh bhirajha~Nghidhdha jhuvijheShadhdhaiyallAmal, nA~NghaLAvadhu, vAனdhdhilirundhu varughiRa òru dhUdhaனAvadhu, veRòru jhuvijheShadhdhai u~NghaLughghubh bhirajha~NghidhdhAl, avaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaனAyirughghaghghaDhavaன.

muன jhòனனdhubhola maRubhaDhiyuM jhòllughiReன; nI~NghaL eRRughghòNDha jhuvijheShadhdhaiyallAmal veRòru jhuvijheShadhdhai òruvaன u~NghaLughghubh bhirajha~NghidhdhAl avaன jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavaனAyirughghaghghaDhavaன.

ibhbhòzhudhu nAன maனuSharaiyA, dhevaனaiyA, yArai nADhibh bhodhighghiReன? maனuSharaiyA bhiriyabhbhaDhudhdhabh bhArghghiReன? nAன iனனuM maனuSharaibh bhiriyabhbhaDhudhdhughiRavaனAyirundhAl nAன ghiRisdhuviன UzhiyaghghAraனllave.
meluM, jhaghodharare, èனனAl bhirajha~NghighghabhbhaDhDha jhuvijheShaM maனuSharuDhaiya yojhaனaiyiனbhaDhiyAனdhallavèனRu u~NghaLughghudh dhèrivighghiReன.
nAன adhai òru maனuShaனAl bhèRRadhumillai, maனuShaனAl ghaRRadhumillai, iyejhughiRisdhuve adhai èனghghu vèLibhbhaDhudhdhiனAr.
nAன yUdhamArghghadhdhilirundhabhodhu èனனuDhaiya naDhaghghaiyaighghuRidhdhugh gheLvibhbhaDhDhirubhbhIrghaL; dhevaனuDhaiya jhabhaiyai nAன mighavuM dhuனbhabhbhaDhudhdhi, adhaibh bhAzhAghghi;
èன jaனdhdhAril èன vayadhuLLa anegharaibhbhArghghiluM yUdhamArghghadhdhile dheRiனvaனAy, èன bhidhAghghaLuDhaiya bhAraMbhariya niyAya~NghaLughghAgha mighavuM bhaghdhivairAghghiyamuLLavaனAyirundheன.
abhbhaDhiyirundhuM, nAன èன dhAyiன vayiRRilirundhadhu mudhal, èனனaibh bhiridhdhèDhudhdhu, dhaMmuDhaiya ghirubhaiyiனAl azhaidhdha dhevaன,

dhaMmuDhaiya ghumAraனai nAன bhuRajAdhighaLiDhadhdhil jhuvijheShamAy aRivighghuMbhòruDhDhAgha, avarai èனghghuL vèLibhbhaDhudhdhabh bhiriyamAyirundhabhodhu, uDhaனe nAன mAMjhadhdhoDhuM iradhdhadhdhoDhuM yojhaனaibhaNNAmaluM;
èனghghu muனனe abhbhosdhalarAனvarghaLiDhadhdhile èrujhalemughghubhbhoghAmaluM; arabhidhejhadhdhiRghubh bhuRabhbhaDhDhubhbhoy, maRubhaDhiyuM dhamasghu Urughghudh dhiruMbhivandheன.
mUனRu varuShaM jhèனRa bhiனbhu, bhedhuruvaigh ghaNDhughòLLuMbhaDhi nAன èrujhalemughghubh bhoy, avaனiDhadhdhil bhadhiனaindhu nAL dha~Nghiyirundheன.
ghardhdharuDhaiya jhaghodharaனAghiya yAghghobhaidh dhavira, abhbhosdhalaril veRòruvaraiyuM nAன ghANavillai.
nAன u~NghaLughghu èzhudhughiRa ivaighaL bhòyyallavèனRu dhevaனughghumuனbhAgha nijhjhayamAyjh jhòllughiReன.
bhiனbhu, jhIriyA jhilijhiyA nADhughaLiன bhuRa~NghaLil vandheன.
meluM yUdheyAdhejhadhdhile ghiRisdhuvughghuLLAன jhabhaighaLughghu mughamaRiyAdhavaனAyirundheன.
muனனe naMmaidh dhuனbhabhbhaDhudhdhiனvaனe, dhAன azhighghadhdheDhiன vijhuvAjhadhdhai ibhbhòzhudhu bhirajha~NghighghiRAனèனbhadhai mAdhdhiraM avarghaL gheLvibhbhaDhDhirundhu,
èனனaibhbhaRRi dhevaனai maghimaibhbhaDhudhdhiனArghaL.
bhadhiனAlu varuShaM jhèனRabhiனbhu, nAன dhIdhdhuvaigh ghUDhDhighghòNDhu bharனbhAvuDhaனeghUDha maRubhaDhiyuM èrujhalemughghubh bhoனeன.

nAன dheva aRivibhbhiனAle bhoy, bhuRajAdhighaLiDhadhdhil nAன bhirajha~NghighghiRa jhuvijheShadhdhai avarghaLughghu vivaridhdhugh ghANbhidhdheன; AyiனuM nAன oDhughiRadhuM, oDhiனdhuM vINAghAdhabhaDhighghu èNNighghaiyuLLavarghaLughghe dhaனimaiyAy vivaridhdhugh ghANbhidhdheன.
AனAluM èனனuDhaனeghUDha irundha dhIdhdhu ghireghghaனAyirundhuM virudhdhajhedhaனMbhaNNighghòLLuMbhaDhighghugh ghaDhDhAyaMbhaNNabhbhaDhavillai.

ghiRisdhu iyejhuvughghuL namaghghu uNDhAன jhuyAdhIனdhdhai uLavubhArdhdhu naMmai niyAyabhbhiramAraNadhdhiRghu aDhimaighaLAghghuMbhòruDhDhAghabh bhaghghavazhiyAy nuzhaindha ghaLLajh jhaghodharar nimidhdhaM abhbhaDhiyAyiRRu.
jhuvijheShadhdhiன jhadhdhiyaM u~NghaLiDhadhdhile nilaidhdhirughghuMbhaDhi, nA~NghaL òru nAzhighaiyAghiluM avarghaLughghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhindhu iNa~Nghavillai.

allAmaluM èNNighghaiyuLLavarghaLAyirundhavarghaL èனghghu òனRuM bhodhighghavillai; avarghaL èbhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavarghaLAyirundhAluM èனghghugh ghavalaiyillai, dhevaன maனuShariDhadhdhil bhaDhjhabhAdhamuLLavarallave.

adhuvumallAmal, virudhdhajhedhaனmuLLavarghaLughghu abhbhosdhalaனAyirughghuMbhaDhi bhedhuruvaibh bhalabhbhaDhudhdhiனvar bhuRajAdhighaLughghu abhbhosdhalaனAyirughghuMbhaDhi èனனaiyuM bhalabhbhaDhudhdhiனbhaDhiyAl,

virudhdhajhedhaனmuLLa avarghaLughghujh jhuvijheShadhdhaibh bhirajha~NghighghuMbhaDhi bhedhuruvughghugh ghaiyaLighghabhbhaDhDhadhubhola, virudhdhajhedhaனM illAdhavarghaLughghubh bhirajha~NghighghuMbhaDhi adhu èனghghuM ghaiyaLighghabhbhaDhDhadhèனRu avarghaL ghaNDhu;

èனghghu aLighghabhbhaDhDha ghirubhaiyai aRindhabhodhu, dhUNghaLAgha èNNabhbhaDhDha yAghghobhuM, ghebhAvuM, yovAனuM, dhA~NghaL virudhdhajhedhaனmuLLavarghaLughghuM, nA~NghaL bhuRajAdhighaLughghuM bhirajha~NghighghuMbhaDhi, anniyonniya aighghiyadhdhiRghu aDhaiyALamAgha èனghghuM bharனbhAvughghuM valadhughai ghòDhudhdhu,
dharidhdhirarai niனaidhdhughghòLLuMbhaDhighghumAdhdhiraM jhòனனArghaL; abhbhaDhijh jhèyyuMbhaDhi adhaRghu muனனme nAனuM gharudhdhuLLavaனAyirundheன.

èbhbhaDhiyèனil, yAghghobhiனiDhadhdhilirundhu jhilar varughiRadhaRghumuன avaன bhuRajAdhiyAruDhaனe jhAbhbhiDhDhAன; avarghaL vandhabhodho, virudhdhajhedhaனmuLLavarghaLughghubh bhayandhu, vilaghibh bhirindhAன.
maRRa yUdharuM avaனuDhaனeghUDha mAyaMbhaNNiனArghaL; avarghaLuDhaiya mAyadhdhiனAle bharனbhAvuM izhubhbhuNDhAன.

nAன iDhidhdhubhbhoDhDhavaighaLaiye nAன maRubhaDhiyuM ghaDhDhiனAl, bhiramANadhdhai mIRughiRavaனèனRu ghANabhbhaDhuveன.

ghiRisdhuvuDhaனeghUDhajh jhiluvaiyilaRaiyabhbhaDhDheன; AyiனuM, bhizhaidhdhirughghiReன; iனi nAன alla, ghiRisdhuve èனghghuL bhizhaidhdhirughghiRAr; nAன ibhbhòzhudhu mAMjhadhdhil bhizhaidhdhirughghiRadho, èனனil aனbhughUrndhu èனghghAghadh dhaMmaidhdhAme òbhbhughghòDhudhdha dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraனaibhbhaRRuM vijhuvAjhadhdhiனAle bhizhaidhdhirughghiReன.

madhdhiyasdhaன òruvaனughghuriyavaனlla, dhevaனo òruvar.

nI~NghaL dhevaனai aRiyAmalirundhabhodhu, jhubhAvadhdhiனbhaDhi dhevarghaLallAdhavarghaLughghu aDhimaighaLAyirundhIrghaL.

nADhghaLaiyuM, mAdha~NghaLaiyuM, ghAla~NLaiyuM, varuSha~NghaLaiyuM bhArghghiRIrghaLe.
nAன u~NghaLughghAghabh bhirayAjhabhbhaDhDhadhu vINAybhbhoyiRRo èனRu u~NghaLaighghuRidhdhubh bhayandhirughghiReன.

abhbhaDhiyirundhuM èன jharIradhdhiluNDhAyirughghiRa jhodhaனaiyai nI~NghaL ajhaDhDhaibhaNNAmaluM, arojhiyAmaluM, dhevadhUdhaனaibhbholavuM, ghiRisdhu iyejhuvaibhbholavuM, èனனai eRRughghòNDhIrghaL.
