nalviShayadhdhil vairAghghiyaM bharADhDhuvadhu nalladhudhAன; adhai nAன u~NghaLiDhadhdhil irughghuMbhòzhudhumAdhdhiramalla, èbhbhòzhudhuM bhArADhDhaveNDhuM.
èன jhiRubhiLLaighaLe, ghiRisdhu u~NghaLiDhadhdhil uruvAghumaLavuM u~NghaLughghAgha maRubhaDhiyuM gharbhbhavedhaனaibhbhaDhughiReன.
u~NghaLaighghuRidhdhu nAன jhandheghabhbhaDhughiRabhaDhiyAl, nAன ibhbhòzhudhu u~NghaLiDhadhdhil vandhirundhu, veRuvaghaiyAghabh bhejha viruMbhughiReன.
niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiRghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhDhirughgha viruMbhughiRa nI~NghaL niyAyabhbhiramANaM jhòllughiRadhaigh gheDhghavillaiyA? idhai èனghghujh jhòllu~NghaL.
AbhiraghAmughghu iraNDhu ghumArar irundhArghaL èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu; òruvaன aDhimaiyAனvaLiDhadhdhil bhiRandhavaன, òruvaன jhuyAdhIனmuLLavaLiDhadhdhil bhiRandhavaன.
aDhimaiyAனvaLiDhadhdhil bhiRandhavaன mAMjhadhdhiனbhaDhi bhiRandhAன, jhuyAdhIனmuLLavaLiDhadhdhil bhiRandhavaன vAghghudhdhadhdhadhdhiனbhaDhi bhiRandhAன.
ivaighaL ~nAன ardhdhamuLLavaighaL; andha sdhirIghaL iraNDhu eRbhADhughaLAM; òனRu jhIனAymalaiyiluNDhAன eRbhADhu, adhu aDhimaidhdhaனdhdhiRghuLLAghabh bhiLLaibhèRughiRadhu, adhu AghAr èனbhavaLdhAனe.
AghAr èனbhadhu arabhidhejhadhdhiluLLa jhIனAymalai; andha AghAr ibhbhòzhudhirughghiRa èrujhalemughghujh jhari; ivaL dhaன bhiLLaighaLoDheghUDha aDhimaibhbhaDhDhirughghiRALe.
melAன èrujhalemo jhuyAdhIனmuLLavaL, avaLe naMmèllArughghuM dhAyAனvaL.

andhabhbhaDhi bhiLLaibhèRAdha malaDhiye, maghizhndhiru; gharbhbhavedhaனaibhbhaDhAdhavaLe, ghaLibhbhAy èzhuMbhi Arbhbhari; bhuruShaனuLLavaLaibh bhArghghiluM anAdha sdhirIghghe adhigha bhiLLaighaLuNDhu èனRu èzhudhiyirughghiRadhu.
jhaghodharare nAM IjhAghghaibhbhola vAghghudhdhadhdhadhdhubh bhiLLaighaLAyirughghiRoM.
AghiluM mAMjhadhdhiனbhaDhi bhiRandhavaன AviyiனbhaDhi bhiRandhavaனai abhbhòzhudhu dhuனbhabhbhaDhudhdhiனdhu bhola, ibhbhòzhudhuM naDhandhuvarughiRadhu.

adhaighghuRidhdhu vedhaM èனனjhòllughiRadhu: aDhimaiyAனvaLiன maghaன jhuyAdhIனmuLLavaLuDhaiya ghumAraனoDhe jhudhandharavALiyAyirubhbhadhillai; AghaiyAl aDhimaiyAனvaLaiyuM, avaLuDhaiya maghaனaiyuM bhuRaMbhe dhaLLu èனRu jhòllughiRadhu.
ibhbhaDhiyirughgha, jhaghodharare, nAM aDhimaiyAனvaLughghubh bhiLLaighaLAyirAmal, jhuyAdhIனmuLLavaLughghe bhiLLaighaLAyirughghiRoM.
AனbhaDhiyiனAle, nI~NghaL maRubhaDhiyuM aDhimaidhdhaனdhdhiன nughadhdhughghuDhbhaDhAmal, ghiRisdhu namaghghu uNDhAghghiன jhuyAdhIன nilaimaiyile nilaighòNDhiru~NghaL.
idho, nI~NghaL virudhdhajhedhaனMbhaNNighghòNDhAl ghiRisdhuviனAl u~NghaLughghu òru bhirayojaனmumirAdhu èனRu bhavulAghiya nAன u~NghaLughghujh jhòllughiReன.

meluM, virudhdhajhedhaனMbhaNNighghòLLughiRa èndha maனuShaனuM niyAyabhbhiramANaM muzhuvadhaiyuM niRaiveRRagh ghaDhaனALiyAyirughghiRAன èனRu maRubhaDhiyuM abhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavaனughghujh jhADhjhiyAghajh jhòllughiReன.
niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiனAl nIdhimAனghaLAgha viruMbhughiRa nI~NghaL yAvaruM ghiRisdhuvaiviDhDhubh bhirindhu ghirubhaiyiனiனRu vizhundhIrghaL.
nA~NghaLo nIdhighiDhaighghumèனRu AviyaighghòNDhu vijhuvAjhadhdhiனAl naMbhighghaiyoDhe ghAdhdhirughghiRoM.
ghiRisdhu iyejhuviனiDhadhdhil virudhdhajhedhaனmuM virudhdhajhedhaனmillAmaiyuM òனRughghuM udhavAdhu, aனbhiனAl ghiriyaijhèyghiRa vijhuvAjhame udhavuM.
nI~NghaL naனRAy oDhiனIrghaLe; jhadhdhiyadhdhiRghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhiyAmaRbhogha u~NghaLughghudh dhaDhaijhèydhavaன yAr?

nI~NghaL veRuvidhamAyjh jhindhighghamADhDhIrghaLèனRu nAன ghardhdharughghuL u~NghaLaighghuRidhdhu naMbhighghaiyAyirughghiReன; u~NghaLaigh ghalaghghughiRavaன èbhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavaனAyirundhAluM dhaனghgheRRa Aghghiனaiyai aDhaivAன.

jhaghodharare, idhuvaraighghuM nAன virudhdhajhedhaனdhdhaibh bhirajha~NghighghiRavaனAyirundhAl, idhuvaraighghuM èனனdhdhiRghudh dhuனbhabhbhaDhughiReன? abhbhaDhiyAனAl jhiluvaiyaibhbhaRRi varuM iDhaRal òzhindhirughghume
u~NghaLaigh ghalaghghughiRavarghaL dhaRibhbhuNDhubhoனAl nalamAyirughghuM.
jhaghodharare, nI~NghaL jhuyAdhIனdhdhiRghu azhaighghabhbhaDhDhIrghaL, indhajh jhuyAdhIனdhdhai nI~NghaL mAMjhadhdhiRghedhuvAgha anujhariyAmal, aனbhiனAle òruvarughghòruvar Uzhiya~njhèyyu~NghaL.
uனனiDhadhdhil nI aனbhughUruvadhubholabh bhiRaனiDhadhdhiluM aனbhughUruvAyAgha, èனghiRa indha òre vArdhdhaiyile niyAyabhbhiramANaM muzhuvadhuM niRaiveRuM.
nI~NghaL òruvaraiyòruvar ghaDhidhdhubh bhaDhjhidhdhIrghaLAனAl azhivIrghaL. abhbhaDhi òruvarAlòruvar azhighghabhbhaDhAdhabhaDhighghu èjhjharighghaiyAyiru~NghaL.
bhiனனuM nAன jhòllughiRadhèனனvèனRAl, AvighgheRRabhaDhi naDhandhughòLLu~NghaL, abhbhòzhudhu mAMjha ijhjhaiyai niRaiveRRAdhirubhbhIrghaL.

mAMjhaM Avighghu virodhamAghavuM, Avi mAMjhadhdhughghu virodhamAghavuM ijhjhighghiRadhu; nI~NghaL jhèyyaveNDhumèனRirughghiRavaighaLaijh jhèyyAdhabhaDhighghu, ivaighaL òனRughghòனRu virodhamAyirughghiRadhu.
AviyiனAl naDhadhdhabhbhaDhuvIrghaLAனAl, nI~NghaL niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhiRghugh ghIzhbhbhaDhDhavarghaLalla.

Aviyiன ghaனiyo, aனbhu, jhandhoShaM, jhamAdhAனM, nIDhiyabhòRumai, dhayavu, naRghuNaM, vijhuvAjhaM,

mojhaMbhoghAdhiru~NghaL, dhevaன dhaMmaibh bhariyAjhaMbhaNNavòDhDhAr; maனuShaன èdhai vidhaighghiRAனo adhaiye aRubhbhAன.

naனmaijhèyghiRadhil jhorndhubhoghAmal irubhbhomAgha; nAM dhaLarndhubhoghAdhirundhAl eRRaghAladhdhil aRubhbhoM.
AghaiyAl namaghghugh ghiDhaighghuM jhamayadhdhiRghudhdhaghghadhAgha, yAvarughghuM, vijheShamAgha vijhuvAjha ghuDhuMbhadhdhArghaLughghuM, naனmaijhèyyaghghaDhavoM.

virudhdhajhedhaனM aDhaindhirughghiRa avarghaLuM niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhaigh ghaighghòLLAmalirughghiRArghaL; abhbhaDhiyirundhuM, avarghaL u~NghaL mAMjhadhdhaighghuRidhdhu meனmaibhArADhDhuMbhaDhighghu nI~NghaL virudhdhajhedhaனMbhaNNighghòLLaveNDhumèனRu viruMbhughiRArghaL.

nAனo naMmuDhaiya ghardhdharAghiya iyejhughiRisdhuviன jhiluvaiyaigh ghuRidhdheyallAmal veRòனRaiyu~N ghuRidhdhu meனmaibhArADhDhAdhirubhbheனAgha; avarAl ulaghaM èனghghujh jhiluvaiyilaRaiyuNDhirughghiRadhu, nAனuM ulaghadhdhiRghujh jhiluvaiyilaRaiyuNDhirughghiReன.
ghiRisdhu iyejhuvughghuL virudhdhajhedhaனmuM òனRumillai, virudhdhajhedhaனmillAmaiyuM òனRumillai; bhudhu jhiruShDhiye ghAriyaM.
indhabh bhiramANadhdhiனbhaDhi naDhandhuvarughiRavarghaL èvarghaLo, avarghaLughghuM, dhevaனuDhaiya isravelarughghuM, jhamAdhAனmuM iraghghamuM uNDhAyirubhbhadhAgha.
iனimel òruvaனuM èனghghu varudhdhaM uNDhAghghAdhirubhbhAனAgha; ghardhdharAghiya iyejhuviனuDhaiya ajhjhaDhaiyALa~NghaLai nAன èன jharIradhdhile dharidhdhughghòNDhirughghiReன.
jhaghodharare, naMmuDhaiya ghardhdharAghiya iyejhughiRisdhuviன ghirubhai u~NghaL AviyuDhaனeghUDha irubhbhadhAgha. Amèன.
dhevaனuDhaiya jhidhdhadhdhiனAle iyejhughiRisdhuviனuDhaiya abhbhosdhalaனAghiya bhavul, èbhejhuvile ghiRisdhu iyejhuvughghuL vijhuvAjhighaLAyirughghiRa bharijhudhdhavAனghaLughghu èzhudhughiRadhAvadhu:
naMmuDhaiya bhidhAvAghiya dhevaனAluM, ghardhdharAghiya iyejhughiRisdhuviனAluM, u~NghaLughghugh ghirubhaiyuM jhamAdhAனmuM uNDhAvadhAgha.

naMmuDhaiya ghardhdharAghiya iyejhughiRisdhuviன bhidhAvAghiya dhevaனughghu sdhodhdhiraM; avar ghiRisdhuvughghuL uனனdha~NghaLile Avighghuriya jhaghala AjhIrvAdhadhdhiனAluM naMmai AjhIrvadhidhdhirughghiRAr.
dhamaghghumuனbhAgha nAM aனbhil bharijhudhdhamuLLavarghaLuM ghuRRamillAdhavarghaLumAyirubhbhadhaRghu, avar ulaghadhdhoRRadhdhughghu muனனe ghiRisdhuvughghuL naMmaidh dhèrindhughòNDhabhaDhiye,
bhiriyamAனvarughghuL dhAM namaghghudh dhandharuLiன dhaMmuDhaiya ghirubhaiyiன maghimaighghubh bhughazhjhjhiyAgha,
dhaMmuDhaiya dhayavuLLa jhidhdhadhdhiனbhaDhiye, naMmai iyejhughiRisdhumUlamAydh dhamaghghujh jhuvighArabhudhdhirarAghuMbhaDhi muன ghuRidhdhirughghiRAr.
avaruDhaiya ghirubhaiyiன aijhuvariyadhdhiனbhaDhiye, ivaruDhaiya iradhdhadhdhiனAle bhAvamaனனibhbhAghiya mIDhbhu ivarughghuL namaghghu uNDhAyirughghiRadhu.
andhagh ghirubhaiyai avar jhaghala ~nAனdhdhoDhuM bhudhdhiyoDhuM è~NghaLiDhadhdhil bhèrughabhbhaNNiனAr.
ghAla~NghaL niRaiveRuMbhodhu viLa~NghuM niyamadhdhiனbhaDhi bharaloghadhdhilirughghiRavaighaLuM bhUloghadhdhilirughghiRavaighaLumAghiya jhaghalamuM ghiRisdhuvughghuLLe ghUDhDhabhbhaDhaveNDhumèனRu,
dhamaghghuLLe dhIrmAனidhdhirundha dhaMmuDhaiya dhayavuLLa jhidhdhadhdhiன iraghajhiyadhdhai èனghghu aRividhdhAr.
meluM ghiRisdhuviனmel muனனe naMbhighghaiyAyirundha nA~NghaL avaruDhaiya maghimaighghubh bhughazhjhjhiyAyirughghuMbhaDhighghu,

dhamadhu jhidhdhadhdhiன AlojhaனaighghudhdhaghghadhAgha èllAvaRRaiyuM naDhabhbhighghiRa avaruDhaiya dhIrmAனdhdhiனbhaDhiye, nA~NghaL muனghuRighghabhbhaDhDhu, ghiRisdhuvughghuL avaruDhaiya jhudhandharamAghuMbhaDhi dhèrindhughòLLabhbhaDhDhoM.

nI~NghaLuM u~NghaL iraDhjhibhbhiன jhuvijheShamAghiya jhadhdhiya vajhaனdhdhaigh gheDhDhu, vijhuvAjhighaLAனbhodhu, vAghghudhdhadhdhaMbhaNNabhbhaDhDha bharijhudhdha AviyAl avarughghuL mudhdhiraibhoDhabhbhaDhDhIrghaL.
avarughghujh jhòndhamAனvarghaL avaruDhaiya maghimaighghubh bhughazhjhjhiyAgha mIDhghabhbhaDhuvArghaL èனbhadhaRghu AviyAனvar naMmuDhaiya jhudhandharadhdhiன ajhjhAramAyirughghiRAr.
AனbhaDhiyiனAle, ghardhdharAghiya iyejhuviனmeluLLa u~NghaL vijhuvAjhadhdhaiyuM, bharijhudhdhavAனghaLèllArmeluLLa u~NghaL aனbhaiyu~NghuRidhdhu nAன gheLvibhbhaDhDhu,
iDhaiviDhAmal u~NghaLughghAgha sdhodhdhiraMbhaNNi, èன jèbha~NghaLil u~NghaLai niனaidhdhu,

naMmuDhaiya ghardhdharAghiya iyejhughiRisdhuviன dhevaனuM maghimaiyiன bhidhAvumAனvar dhaMmai nI~NghaL aRindhughòLvadhaRghAன ~nAனdhdhaiyuM dhèLivaiyuM aLighghiRa Aviyai u~NghaLughghudh dhandharuLaveNDhumèனRuM,

nidhdhiya jIvaனai aLibhbheன èனbhadhe avar namaghghujh jhèydha vAghghudhdhadhdhaM.
u~NghaLai va~njhighghiRavarghaLaigh ghuRidhdhu ivaighaLai u~NghaLughghu èzhudhiyirughghiReன.

nI~NghaL avarAle bhèRRa abhiSheghaM u~NghaLil nilaidhdhirughghiRadhu, òruvaruM u~NghaLughghubh bhodhighghaveNDhuvadhillai; andha abhiSheghaM jhaghaladhdhaiyu~NghuRidhdhu u~NghaLughghubh bhodhighghiRadhu; adhu jhadhdhiyamAyirughghiRadhu, bhòyyalla, adhu u~NghaLughghubh bhodhidhdhabhaDhiye avaril nilaidhdhirubhbhIrghaLAgha.
ibhbhaDhiyirughgha, bhiLLaighaLe, avar vèLibhbhaDhuMbhodhu nAM avar varughaiyil avarughghu muனbhAgha vèDhghabhbhaDhDhubhbhoghAmal dhairiyamuLLavarghaLAyirughghuMbhaDhi avaril nilaidhdhiru~NghaL.
avar nIdhiyuLLavarAyirughghiRArèனRu u~NghaLughghudh dhèrindhirubhbhadhiனAl, nIdhiyaijh jhèyghiRavaனèvaனuM avaril bhiRandhavaனèனRu aRindhirughghiRIrghaL.
nAM dhevaனuDhaiya bhiLLaighaLèனRu azhaighghabhbhaDhuvadhiனAle bhidhAvAனvar namaghghubh bhArADhDhiன aனbhu èvvaLavu bhèridhèனRu bhAru~NghaL; ulaghaM avarai aRiyAdhabhaDhiyiனAle naMmaiyuM aRiyavillai.

bhiriyamAனvarghaLe, ibhbhòzhudhu dhevaனuDhaiya bhiLLaighaLAyirughghiRoM, iனi èvvidhamAyirubhbhomèனRu iனனuM vèLibhbhaDhavillai; AghiluM avar vèLibhbhaDhuMbhodhu avar irughghiRavaNNamAghave nAM avaraidh dharijhibhbhadhiனAl, avarughghu òbhbhAyirubhbhomèனRu aRindhirughghiRoM.
avarmel ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDha naMbhighghai vaidhdhirughghiRavaனèvaனuM, avar jhudhdhamuLLavarAyirughghiRadhubhola, dhaனனaiyuM jhudhdhigharidhdhughghòLLughiRAன.
bhAva~njhèyghiRa èvaனuM niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhai mIRughiRAன; niyAyabhbhiramANadhdhai mIRughiRadhe bhAvaM.
avar naMmuDhaiya bhAva~NghaLaijh jhumandhu dhIrghgha vèLibhbhaDhDhArèனRu aRivIrghaL; avariDhadhdhil bhAvamillai.
avaril nilaidhdhirughghiRa èvaனuM bhAva~njhèyghiRadhillai; bhAva~njhèyghiRa èvaனuM avaraigh ghANavumillai, avarai aRiyavumillai
bhiLLaighaLe nI~NghaL òruvarAluM va~njhighghabhbhaDhAdhiru~NghaL; nIdhiyaijh jhèyghiRavaன avar nIdhiyuLLavarAyirughghiRadhubholadh dhAனuM nIdhiyuLLavaனAyirughghiRAன.
bhAva~njhèyghiRavaன bhijhAjhiனAluNDhAyirughghiRAன; eனèனil bhijhAjhAனvaன Adhimudhal bhAva~njhèyghiRAன, bhijhAjhiனuDhaiya ghiriyaighaLai azhighghuMbhaDhighghe dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraன vèLibhbhaDhDhAr.
dhevaனAl bhiRandha èvaனuM bhAva~njhèyyAன, eனèனil avaruDhaiya vidhdhu avaனughghuL dharidhdhirughghiRadhu; avaன dhevaனAl bhiRandhabhaDhiyiனAl bhAva~njhèyyamADhDhAன.
idhiனAle dhevaனuDhaiya bhiLLaighaL iனனArèனRuM, bhijhAjhiன bhiLLaighaL iனனArèனRuM vèLibhbhaDhuM; nIdhiyaijhjhèyyAmaluM dhaன jhaghodharaனil aனbhughUrAmaluM irughghiRa èvaனuM dhevaனAluNDhAனvaனlla.

bhòllA~NghaனAl uNDhAyirundhu dhaன jhaghodharaனaigh ghòlaijhèydha ghAyIனaibhbholirughghaveNDhAM; avaன èdhiனimidhdhaM avaனaigh ghòlaijhèydhAன? dhaன ghiriyaighaL bhòllAdhavaighaLuM, dhaன jhaghodharaனuDhaiya ghiriyaighaL nIdhiyuLLavaighaLumAyirundhadhiனimidhdhandhAனe.

nAM jhaghodharariDhadhdhil aனbhughUrughiRabhaDhiyAl, maraNadhdhaiviDhDhu nI~Nghi jIvaனughghuDhbhaDhDhirughghiRomèனRu aRindhirughghiRoM. jhaghodharaனiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrAdhavaன maraNadhdhil nilaighòNDhirughghiRAன.
dhaன jhaghodharaனaibh bhaghaighghiRa èvaனuM maனuShaghòlaibhAdhaghaனAyirughghiRAன; maனuSha ghòlaibhAdhaghaனèvaனo avaனughghuL nidhdhiyajIvaன nilaidhdhirAdhu èனRu aRivIrghaL.
avar dhaMmuDhaiya jIvaனai namaghghAghagh ghòDhudhdhadhiனAle aனbhu iனனdhèனRu aRindhirughghiRoM; nAmuM jhaghodhararughghAgha jIvaனaighghòDhughghagh ghaDhaனALighaLAyirughghiRoM.

òruvaன ivvulagha Asdhi uDhaiyavaனAyirundhu, dhaன jhaghodharaனughghugh ghuRaijhjhaluNDhèனRu ghaNDhu, dhaன irudhayadhdhai avaனughghu aDhaidhdhughghòNDhAl, avaனughghuL dheva aனbhu nilaighòLLughiRadhèbhbhaDhi?
èன bhiLLaighaLe, vajhaனdhdhiனAluM, nAviனAlumalla, ghiriyaiyiனAluM uNmaiyiனAluM aனbhughUraghghaDhavoM.
idhiனAle nAM naMmaijh jhadhdhiyadhdhiRghuriyavarghaLèனRu aRindhu, naMmuDhaiya irudhayadhdhai avarughghu muனbhAgha nijhjhayabhbhaDhudhdhighghòLLalAM.
naMmuDhaiya irudhayame naMmaigh ghuRRavALighaLAghadh dhIrghghumAனAl, dhevaன naMmuDhaiya irudhayadhdhiluM bhèriyavarAyirundhu jhaghaladhdhaiyuM aRindhirughghiRAr.
bhiriyamAனvarghaLe, naMmuDhaiya irudhayaM naMmaigh ghuRRavALighaLèனRu dhIrghghAdhirundhAl, nAM dhevaனiDhadhdhil dhairiya~NghòNDhirundhu,
avaruDhaiya ghaRbhaனaighaLai nAM ghaighghòNDhu avarughghu muனbhAghabh bhiriyamAனvaighaLaijh jhèyghiRabhaDhiyiனAl nAM veNDhighghòLLughiRadhèdhuvo adhai avarAle bhèRRughghòLLughiRoM.

nAM avaruDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya iyejhughiRisdhuviன nAmadhdhiனmel vijhuvAjhamAyirundhu, avar namaghghugh ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhDhabhaDhi òruvarilòruvar aனbhAyirughghaveNDhumèனbhadhe avaruDhaiya ghaRbhaனaiyAyirughghiRadhu.

avaruDhaiya ghaDhDhaLaighaLaigh ghaighghòLLughiRavaன avaril nilaidhdhirughghiRAன. avaruM avaனil nilaidhdhirughghiRAr; avar naMmil nilaidhdhirughghiRadhai avar namaghghudh dhandharuLiன AviyiனAle aRindhirughghiRoM.
anegha~N ghaLLadhdhIrghghadharijhighaL dhoனRiyirubhbhadhiனAl, nI~NghaL èllA AvighaLaiyuM naMbhAmal, andha AvighaL dhevaனAluNDhAனvaighaLo èனRu jhodhidhdhaRiyu~NghaL.
dhevaAviyai nI~NghaL èdhiனAle aRiyalAmèனRAl: mAMjhadhdhil vandha iyejhughiRisdhuvai aRighghaibhaNNughiRa èndha AviyuM dhevaனAl uNDhAyirughghiRadhu.

mAMjhadhdhil vandha iyejhughiRisdhuvai aRighghaibhaNNAdha èndha AviyuM dhevaனAl uNDhAனdhalla; varumèனRu nI~NghaL gheLvibhbhaDhDha andhighghiRisdhuviனuDhaiya Avi adhuve, adhu ibhbhòzhudhuM ulaghadhdhil irughghiRadhu.
bhiLLaighaLe, nI~NghaL dhevaனAluNDhAyirundhu, avarghaLai jèyidhdhIrghaL; eனèனil ulaghadhdhilirughghiRavaனiluM u~NghaLilirughghiRavar bhèriyavar.
avarghaL ulaghadhdhughghuriyavarghaL, AghaiyAl ulaghadhdhughghuriyavaighaLaibh bhejhughiRArghaL, ulaghamuM avarghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhughghuM.

nA~NghaL dhevaனAl uNDhAனvarghaL; dhevaனai aRindhavaன è~NghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhughghiRAன; dhevaனAl uNDhAyirAdhavaன è~NghaLughghujh jhèvighòDhughghiRadhillai; idhiனAle jhadhdhiya Avi iனனdhèனRuM, va~njhaghaAvi iனனdhèனRuM aRindhirughghiRoM.
aனbhAyirughghaghghaDhavoM; eனèனil aனbhu dhevaனAl uNDhAyirughghiRadhu; aனbhuLLa èvaனuM dhevaனAl bhiRandhu, avarai aRindhirughghiRAன.
aனbhillAdhavaன dhevaனai aRiyAன, dhevaன aனbhAghave irughghiRAr.
dhaMmuDhaiya òre bheRAன ghumAraனAle nAM bhizhaighghuMbhaDhighghu dhevaன avarai ivvulaghadhdhile aனubhbhiனdhiனAl dhevaன naMmel vaidhdha aனbhu vèLibhbhaDhDhadhu.

nAM dhevaனiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrndhadhiனAl alla, avar naMmiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrndhu, naMmuDhaiya bhAva~NghaLai nivirdhdhijhèyghiRa ghirubhAdhArabhaliyAghadh dhaMmuDhaiya ghumAraனai aனubhbhiனdhiனAle aனbhu uNDhAyirughghiRadhu.
bhiriyamAனvarghaLe, dhevaன ivvidhamAy naMmiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrndhirughgha, nAmuM òruvariDhadhdhil òruvar aனbhughUragh ghaDhaனALighaLAyirughghiRoM.
dhevaனai òruvaruM òrubhodhuM ghaNDhadhillai; nAM òruvariDhadhdhil òruvar aனbhughUrndhAl dhevaன namaghghuL nilaidhdhirughghiRAr; avaruDhaiya aனbhuM namaghghuL bhUraNabhbhaDhuM.

bhidhAvAனvar ghumAraனai ulagharaDhjhagharAgha aனubhbhiனArèனRu nA~NghaL ghaNDhu jhADhjhiyiDhughiRoM.

niyAyadhdhIrbhbhunALile namaghghudh dhairiyamuNDhAyirughghadhdhaghghadhAgha aனbhu naMmiDhadhdhil bhUraNabhbhaDhughiRadhu; eனèனRAl, avar irughghiRabhiraghAramAgha nAmuM ivvulaghadhdhil irughghiRoM.

dhevaனiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrughiRavaன dhaன jhaghodharaனiDhadhdhiluM aனbhughUraveNDhumèனghiRa indhagh ghaRbhaனaiyai avarAle bhèRRirughghiRoM.

iyejhuvAனvare ghiRisdhu èனRu vijhuvAjhighghiRa èvaனuM dhevaனAl bhiRandhirughghiRAன; bhiRabhbhidhdhavariDhadhdhil aனbhughUrughiRa èvaனuM avarAl bhiRabhbhighghabhbhaDhDhavaனiDhadhdhiluM aனbhughUrughiRAன.
nAM dhevaனiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrndhu avaruDhaiya ghaRbhaனaighaLaigh ghaighghòLLuMbhodhu, dhevaனuDhaiya bhiLLaighaLiDhadhdhil aனbhughUrughiRomèனRu aRindhu ghòLLughiRoM.
nAM dhevaனuDhaiya ghaRbhaனaighaLaigh ghaighghòLvadhe avariDhadhdhil aனbhughUruvadhAM; avaruDhaiya ghaRbhaனaighaL bhAramAனvaighaLumalla.
dhevaனAl bhiRabhbhadhèllAM ulaghadhdhai jèyighghuM; naMmuDhaiya vijhuvAjhame ulaghadhdhai jèyighghiRa jèyaM.

[bharaloghadhdhile jhADhjhiyiDhughiRavarghaL mUvar, bhidhA, vArdhdhai, bharijhudhdha Avi èனbhavarghaLe, iMmUvaruM òனRAyirughghiRArghaL;
bhUloghadhdhile] jhADhjhiyiDhughiRavaighaL mUனRu, Avi, jalaM, iradhdhaM èனbhavaighaLe, iMmUனRuM òrumaibhbhaDhDhirughghiRadhu.
nAM maனuSharuDhaiya jhADhjhiyai eRRughghòNDhAl, adhaibhbhArghghiluM dhevaனuDhaiya jhADhjhi adhighamAyirughghiRadhu; dhevaன dhamadhu ghumAraனaigh ghuRidhdhugh ghòDhudhdha jhADhjhi idhuve.

dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraனiDhadhdhil vijhuvAjhamAyirughghiRavaன andhajh jhADhjhiyaidh dhaனghghuLLe ghòNDhirughghiRAன; dhevaனai vijhuvAjhiyAdhavaனo, dhevaன dhaMmuDhaiya ghumAraனaigh ghuRidhdhughghòDhudhdha jhADhjhiyai vijhuvAjhiyAdhadhiனAl avaraibh bhòyyarAghghughiRAன.
dhevaன namaghghu nidhdhiya jIvaனaidh dhandhirughghiRAr, andha jIvaன avaruDhaiya ghumAraனil irughghiRadhèனbhadhe andhajhjhADhjhiyAM.
ghumAraனai uDhaiyavaன jIvaனai uDhaiyavaன, dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraன illAdhavaன jIvaன illAdhavaன.

u~NghaLughghu nidhdhiyajIvaன uNDhèனRu nI~NghaL aRiyavuM, dhevaghumAraனuDhaiya nAmadhdhiன mel nI~NghaL vijhuvAjhamAyirughghavuM, dhevaghumAraனuDhaiya nAmadhdhiன mel vijhuvAjhamAyirughghiRa u~NghaLughghu ivaighaLai èzhudhiyirughghiReன.

maraNadhdhughghu edhuvallAdha bhAvadhdhaidh dhaன jhaghodharaன jhèyya òruvaன ghaNDhAl, avaன veNDhudhaljhèyyaghghaDhavaன, abhbhòzhudhu avaனughghu jIvaனaigh ghòDhubhbhAr; yArughghèனRAl, maraNadhdhughghu edhuvallAdha bhAvadhdhaijh jhèydhavarghaLughghe; maraNadhdhughghu edhuvAன bhAvamuNDhu, adhaighghuRidhdhu veNDhudhaljhèyya nAன jhòlleன.

aனRiyuM, nAM jhadhdhiyamuLLavarai aRindhughòLvadhaRghu dhevaனuDhaiya ghumAraன vandhu namaghghubh bhudhdhiyaidh dhandhirughghiRArèனRuM aRivoM; avaruDhaiya ghumAraனAghiya iyejhughiRisdhu èனனbhbhaDhDha jhadhdhiyamuLLavarughghuLLuM irughghiRoM; ivare mèyyAன dhevaனuM nidhdhiyajIvaனumAyirughghiRAr.
bhiLLaighaLe, nI~NghaL vighghiragha~NghaLughghu vilaghi, u~NghaLaigh ghAdhdhughghòLvIrghaLAgha. Amèன.

dhèrindhughòLLabhbhaDhDhavaLumAghiya aMmALughghuM avaLuDhaiya bhiLLaighaLughghuM, mUbhbhaனAghiya nAன èzhudhughiRadhAvadhu,

ibhbhòzhudhuM aMmALe, nAM òruvarilòruvar aனbhughUraveNDhumèனRu, umaghghubh bhudhiya ghaRbhaனaiyAgha èzhudhAmal, Adhimudhal namaghghu uNDhAyirughghiRa ghaRbhaனaiyAgha èzhudhi, uMmai veNDhighghòLLughiReன.

mAMjhadhdhil vandha iyejhughiRisdhuvai aRighghaibhaNNAdha anegha va~njhaghar ulaghadhdhile dhoனRiyirughghiRArghaL; ibhbhaDhibhbhaDhDhavaனe va~njhaghaனuM andhighghiRisdhuvumAyirughghiRAன.
